plumbers.name: Len The Plumber Heating & Air, LLC
plumbers.address: 550 Forest Glen Rd, Four Corners, MD 20901, USA

reviews.author: M Cole
reviews.text:
Kemar Lewis, the dispatcher technician, led with professionalism. He explained the solution in detail and he even saved me some money and time by finding an alternate route to access the plumbing pipes without having to tear apart my bathroom
tile. His service, mannerisms, and workmanship were excellent.

reviews.author: Isbel Alba
reviews.text: Last Saturday, I finally contacted Len the Plumber because my thermostat needed checking. They immediately dispatched a technician, Mr. H. He diligently identified the root of the problem and fixed it. Before leaving, he answered all my questions and explained the options I had for protecting my HVAC system. I'm so glad I can count on this amazing company whenever I need help. They never disappoint.

reviews.author: DJ Gino Wilson
reviews.text: Aaron, Len The Plumber technician arrived on time and gave my HVAC system a thorough inspection. Aaron demonstrated his superior skills in checking out my HVAC system and even corrected some issues which were left by a different company. Aaron discussed ways to keep the system functioning efficiently and explained that if I added power surge protectors I could prevent damage to the unit’s electrical components. I felt very confident in the expertise demonstrated by Aaron and consider him to be an asset to the Len The Plumber company.

reviews.author: O. W. A.
reviews.text: Very unreliable. They rarely keep to the 4-hour service window. Subscribers are not a priority. I made the service appointment a month before the scheduled date and they still failed to show up. Decided to cancel the service agreement and be done with them.

reviews.author: Abera Bayu
reviews.text:
This was one of the worst service experiences I have ever had with a plumbing company.

I scheduled a service call and waited more than 34 hours for someone to come to my site. During that time, I was told a technician would come to diagnose the issue, and I was charged a diagnostic fee.

After all that waiting, I was finally told that they do not perform commercial plumbing work. This is something they should have clearly stated from the beginning before scheduling the appointment and charging a fee.

Making a customer wait over a day only to say you cannot do the job is completely unacceptable and extremely unprofessional. It wasted my time, delayed my work, and caused unnecessary frustration.

The lack of communication and poor customer service is very disappointing. I strongly recommend that anyone with a commercial property confirm their services before dealing with this company.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Halverson
reviews.text: Rob from Len the Plumber did a replacement of our shower faucet and nozzle.  He started by assessing the general condition of the plumbing in our 1979 built home, taking its "blood pressure" and we learned our main pressure had been incorrectly set by a previous plumber.  He did the main shower job efficiently and without any difficulty.  He explained everything very carefully and you can tell he is quite skilled by the way he effortlessly shared his knowledge of a very technical subject, so that it was easily understood by this layperson.  He was the antithesis of other plumbers who are rushed, don't want to interact with the customer and are eager to move on to the next job - this was greatly appreciated.  I felt like we were partners in the 3+ hours he was working at my house.  Additionally he took the time to carefully write up two additional jobs that we asked him to look into...and he was doing his best to introduce cost savings into them along the way.  I learned a lot about plumbing in this half day spent with Rob.  I really appreciated spending time with a plumber who was a great communicator, as much as a skilled tradesman, and who genuinely was invested in getting us to a better plumbing situation in our home.  Yes, we all know plumbers are very, very expensive - it's one of the universal truths of life - but time spent with Rob and his company was well worth every penny spent.  If you are going to spend the money on a plumbing job, at least get someone like Rob to make your hard-earned money worthwhile!

reviews.author: Jasmine Muhammad
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with Len the Plumber, and I can’t say enough great things about Kyle Wingate. He came out on March 10 to replace two shut-off valves in my basement in SE Washington, DC. What initially seemed like a straightforward repair turned into a much bigger issue when additional pipes unexpectedly burst—but Kyle handled everything with professionalism and confidence.

He quickly located the problems, clearly explained what was happening, and got to work resolving them right away. He returned the very next day, right on time, and completed the remaining repairs efficiently. Throughout the entire process, Kyle was courteous, patient, and thorough. He made sure I understood everything, answered all my questions, and even showed before-and-after photos so I could see exactly what was done.

His expertise, responsiveness, and attention to detail truly stood out. I felt completely confident in his work, and he turned a stressful situation into a very positive experience. I highly recommend Kyle Wingate and Len The Plumber to anyone needing reliable, high-quality plumbing service.

reviews.author: Patrick Cole
reviews.text: It began with the schedulding. The scheduleding process was the most professional and efficient I have ever experienced with a plumbing service. The plumber, Kemar Lewis is a godsend. He kept me informed of the progress towards & timing of his arrival. On arrival Kemar proved to be a consummate professional: knowledgeable, professional, efficient and personable. He took the time and patience to explain and show us what & where the problems are; and patiently explained the remediations necessary before beginning to fix our plumbing problems. All & all Kemar earned our trust and confidence that he so good professionaly and personally that he is the only plumber we hope to have for the current and any future problems we may have in the future. It is a telief and a pleasure to be served by Kemar Lewis. I thank Len's for sending him to our home.

reviews.author: wanda hand
reviews.text: Jovan was simply outstanding. That technician was very careful to identify me as home owner and explain the $45 fee and potential cost after diagnosing the problem and identifying necessary parts and labor. My potential cost would have been over $600. My cost for Jovan's service and assessment  totalled $202. JOVAN answered all my questions and patiently demonstrated in detail what the problem was and how the furnance and thermostat interact. I believe the services provided from the triggering call through the technician timely showing up and determining the problem were highly professional. The young lady who answered the call and set up the appt was equally professional. Both employees had great attitudes and represent the company outstandingly. I do think the prices are way too high though.

reviews.author: Jeff Lesher
reviews.text:
I’m being generous here because I finally got the kitchen faucet installed though a day late, $749 short, and it spritzes a bit.

Here are the main things to note: Len apparently loves AI/bots. They’re polite but glitchy and you still end up waiting hours with little outbound communication and ultimately a cancellation after 4 hours of waiting. Reschedule, reboot, someone actually shows two hours into the first call slot of the day. Then, the really tough news: $749 for what - as I suspected - took less than an hour and seems to have been done okay-ish.

So, given all the choices, next time I’ll make a different one.

reviews.author: Manuella Hancock
reviews.text:
We have had a couple plumbing issues, and both were handled by some great guys at Len the Plumber. Shout out to Manual for replacing our hot water heater promptly and professionally and responding to insurance adjuster calls as well.
We had another water issue - an unknown leak. Yves came out and figured out the problem in about 1 minute. He was so cordial and professional. He fixed the pipe, taking pictures and keeping us in the loop the entire time. He was tidy, quick and the fix looks and works well. We are so happy with his service and we would ask for him by name whenever we need a plumber again.

reviews.author: Van Hall
reviews.text:
Rudy saved the day! Ultimate professional and very considerate. I had another company come out a couple days before calling Len. The other company not only wanted to charge me double your price, but needed an extra week before knowing if I would fit on their schedule. I called you all and you came out the next day, assessed and performed the work for half the price. I’m pleased. If anyone from this company ever needs YouTube consulting, you will also get half off!

5 STARS
LFR Family on Google.

reviews.author: Miranda
reviews.text: Rudy Orihuela was an amazing savior today! At 7:00 am this morning I received a call from my tenant that there was no hot water in the house. By 11:30 Rudy had diagnosed the problem and ordered the parts, by 2:00 pm today the water heater was completely replaced and everything installed hours before the tenants returned home. Thank you Rudy for such an efficient, well executed job well done!!! I’m really happy to know that such wonderful people still exist in this world!!! Thank you Rudy!!!

reviews.author: Justin Ortique
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Len The Plumber Heating & Air. The service was prompt, professional, and efficient from start to finish.

Armani did an outstanding job diagnosing and repairing the issue. What really stood out was his commitment to getting the job done right—he went above and beyond to track down the necessary part and complete the repair the same day.

Excellent customer service and workmanship. I would definitely recommend them and will use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Nicole McFarland
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Len the Plumber and Sadou Aboubakar. My first time using them as I had an emergency on the weekend. Got my water heater replaced in only 2 days (it could have been 1, but the one I needed wasn’t in stock). The second day it snowed 4 inches and they still came to do all the work, and pushed the hot water heater through 4 inches of snow into the house. Mr. Aboubakar was honest, personable, knowledgeable, and offered me a first responder discount.

synthesis.summary: Len the Plumber's individual technicians are frequently outstanding — multiple reviewers praise specific techs for going above and beyond, staying late, and finding creative solutions that save money. The company-level experience is shakier: AI-driven dispatch causes 4-hour waits and cancellations, prices run $500+ per hour for routine work, and one reviewer waited over 34 hours only to learn they don't do commercial plumbing. A strong choice if you get a skilled tech; a frustrating one if dispatch fails you.

They love AI/bots. They're polite but glitchy and you still end up waiting hours with little outbound communication and ultimately a cancellation after 4 hours of waiting.
He was the antithesis of other plumbers who are rushed, don't want to interact with the customer... I felt like we were partners in the 3+ hours he was working at my house.

reviews.author: riana trice
reviews.text: We had two separate issues come up and had the pleasure of working with Carlos and Daniel. I have to say we have been having issues with the plumbing and pipes since we moved in around 5 years ago and never have we had such a positive experience. They were knowledgeable. They were quick. They were kind and willing to answer any questions that we had and it was clear that they were professionals. I felt comfortable signing up for the membership, because if these are the type of people that are coming out to help I know it'll a quality service and worth it.  Thanks again for coming out. Super appreciated.

reviews.author: Donna Guy
reviews.text: Precision Today installed my water heater last year (2025) . Near the anniversary of the install, I called to have them do the annual inspection & possible drain of the water tank. It was easy to get the appointment. Michael, the technician, was on time. He quickly did a general inspection of my plumbing & any possible issues that may have to be dealt with soon (it's also part of my maintenance plan). He quickly took care of the water tank. He was very courteous & knowledgable.  I have been a customer of Precision Today for several years

reviews.author: Sofia Ascencio
reviews.text: The technician Ray Santiago did an excellent job. He was very kind and polite in explaining the work he would be doing. He took his time repairing the bathroom sink faucets and replacing the old valves. This was our first service with Precision Today, and we are truly satisfied with the work he did. We will definitely contact you again if we need their services in the future, and of course, we highly recommend you. Thank you for your services!

reviews.author: Amrendra Kumar
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with the recent service and the overall handling of my account. If a technician cannot replace a clearly dirty filter or at least document the issue on the work completion form, how is a customer supposed to trust that the rest of the job was completed properly? The new filters for both the humidifier and furnace were readily available in the home at the time of the visit. When I called the main office, I was told the technician “did not want to be rude” by changing the filter. That explanation is not acceptable. He could have asked my wife, who was present, informed her that the filters needed replacement, or at minimum documented it before obtaining her signature.
In addition, two maintenance visits in 2025 were missed despite our prepaid contract for biannual service. When I brought this to their attention, the initial response was, “You could have called us if we had not called you.” That is not a professional way to handle missed contracted services. We paid in advance with the expectation that your company would track and fulfill the agreed-upon visits. The minimum expected response would have been an apology and a reasonable solution, such as extending the contract by another year or offering a refund for the missed services. This experience raises serious concerns about accountability and customer service.

I am editing this review 45 minutes later to add that the heater is now not blowing hot air; only the fan is running. The furnace was working properly before the technician arrived, and the service document states that everything was functioning fine at the time of inspection. This raises even more concern about the quality and thoroughness of the work performed.

reviews.author: Robin Long
reviews.text:
Bryan Herrera is an awesome electrician with Precision Today. He took out my old Wadsworth fuse box and updated the electrical in my fuse panel. Bryan was very patient with me, gave a thorough explanation of the work, and how long it would take to be completed. He left the area clean and I’m very pleased with the outcome.
More importantly, his manager James Pope in electrical at Precision Today is a man of his word. He resolved my ongoing problem in one day that four people couldn’t do in two months. The installation Dept. blamed the Sales Dept. and vis versa for the mishap. The problem I had with them came after my furnace installation. The inspector deemed that the old Wadsworth panel needed to be updated to better support the new furnace system. They wanted to charge me over $6,000 for this work.
After speaking with James Pope for the first time to explain the problem, he returned my call the same day like he said he would and with a solution. This deserves repeating, he resolved my ongoing problem in one day that four people couldn’t do in two months. The icing on the cake is the work was completely free!!!  Thank you James Pope and  Bryan Herrera in electrical at Precision Today!

synthesis.summary: They've got excellent technicians who actually solve problems, but their account management and follow-through on contracted services can be spotty.
strengths: Skilled, patient technicians who explain work thoroughly — Bryan, Michael, Carlos, Daniel, and Ray all praised for knowledge and professionalism
Strong problem-solving and willingness to go above expectations — James Pope resolved a 2-month billing dispute for free in one day
Easy appointment scheduling and on-time arrivals mentioned across multiple reviews
weaknesses: Failure to fulfill prepaid maintenance contracts — two scheduled biannual visits were missed in 2025 with inadequate accountability response
Quality control gaps — technician failed to replace readily-available filters despite homeowner having them on-site, and furnace stopped working hot air after service visit
redFlags: Missed contracted maintenance visits with dismissive initial response ('you could have called us')
Furnace malfunction immediately after service visit raises questions about workmanship quality control
Discrepancy between technician documentation (everything functioning fine) and customer report (furnace broken after visit)
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No explicit mentions of 24/7 availability, after-hours response, or weekend service in cached reviews; same-day callback mentioned but unclear if this extends to emergencies.

hire_if: You need clear communication and upfront explanations
You need high-quality work that holds up over time
caution_if: You need predictable, consistent service across every visit
You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need airtight scheduling and guaranteed arrival times

I would highly recommend Black diamond,if all of their employees are as committed to excellent work,this is a company worth having a positive experience with.

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.text: Life savers! And I’m not even a customer. Well, I am now. I had a flat and without hesitation a representative from Black Diamond pulled over and hopped out with a battery operated compressor to help. It ended up being a pretty bad gash in the sidewall and wasn’t holding air. So he went back to the truck and got some rubber cement to help hold the air so I could get to a safer spot to change the tire. It was a busy two way street and he went above and beyond trying to help. And he did! Thank you so much. Praying I don’t having any plumbing issues, but if I do, I know who I’m calling.

reviews.author: J L
reviews.text:
I am so thankful for Black Diamond!

They have single handedly helped me repair and maintain my home with ease and savings since 2019.

Over the years, they have installed my furnace, air conditioner, replaced water shut off valves, garbage disposal, electric doorbell (Brennan was awesome), and most recently my water tank heater (Trevor and Keith were wonderful).

reviews.author: Shy Teal
reviews.text:
I’m a proud Diamond Member and officially part of the prestige family! My electrician was hands down the best — knowledgeable, patient, and professional from start to finish. I asked about 101 questions in under a minute, and he still managed to multitask, explain everything clearly, and get the job done right.

He even fixed the light in my kitchen over the sink — someone before me thought it made more sense to put a plug there instead of an actual light switch and outlet combo (don’t ask 😅). But he got it working perfectly!

Now I’ve got lights shining where there were no lights before! My utility room is beautifully lit with new canned lights — oh my God, excellent, très bien!

As a single woman, finding honest, respectful professionals means everything. I felt comfortable, informed, and completely taken care of. Black Diamond is a true one-stop shop — they go the extra mile and make your home shine, literally and figuratively!

reviews.author: Evette Rolon
reviews.text: First off I like to share that my family and I are not familiar with well water as we come from Chicago. We are not familiar with how well water works and almost gotten taking for a hell of a ride but thanks to Colten and black diamond they have been a blessing for my family and I. we HIGHLY recommend them especially Colton. Everyone from the customer service department to the staff that came to work on our house were very polite and kind to us. Thank you for everything you have done for us. May God bless you guys.

Professional and did a great job.  He was kind and knew what he was doing.  Loved that he had everything he needed on the truck and got it all done in one day.  Great service. reviews.author: Myron C.
reviews.text:
I have been utilizing Superior for 8 years and have spent over$6,000! Today 12-17-2016 I had a good leak in my basement at one of the outgoing lines from my tankless water heater that Superior installed in 2008, which they did an excellent job!
When I called today the scheduler checked by records but I was told I could not be serviced until 12-20-2016, I told her that I did not have water I was told the earliest would be 12-19-2016! I was not satisfied but scheduled it for that date!
I could have had a convalescing family member relying on water but was never asked about by circumstances the scheduler was only concerned about Superior! 
I am sure with a Little effort their work load could have been rearranged to accommodate me as a long standing customer who have spent over $6000 from 2008 through 2015!
I am not complaining about their work only their loyalty!  I called another well known plumbing company and they came out within the hour. I cancelled my appointment with Superior!

reviews.author: Janice S.
reviews.text:
We have used Superior Plumbing for over 10 years on at least 5 different occasions.  In May 2012 we had sewage backup in downstairs tub and toilet.   Superior came out, replaced wax ring under toilet and unclogged drain, used camera to show us stoppage.  They charged us $680.  My husband questioned the cost, but was shown several prices in print and was told - that's the price.

It's now Dec. 2012 and the same thing occurred.   We heard that Mr. Plumber charges $93 to unclog a drain w/ free camera views.   Called to see if Superior would match that price or if our previous service was under a year's warranty.  They told us no on both.   Mr. Plumber came out on a Sunday, did the exact same repair - unclogged the main sewer line, removed toilet and replaced wax ring, even cleaned up the bathroom when they left.   Our charge this time for exact same repair - $193 ($100 to remove/replace toilet).   What a nice repairman from Mr. Plumber, too!   We've found our "go-to" plumber for all occasions now.

reviews.author: MsPiggie H.
reviews.text:
THEY ARE THE BEST PLUMBERS, GO TO THEM!!!
first off, their customer service is excellent, people pick up on the first ring, and second ring, who does that?! they listen to your problems, and then instruct you to have the kind of the appointment you need, and they really really try hard to get the people out as soon as they can. i called them back right after the leak detection was done at my house, the lady first told me it was all booked up, then i told her the detection guy had drilled holes on my slab, and i can't really leave it open like that with a leak under. she put me on hold for couple minutes, came back told me that she was able to send a guy out to my house within the next 3 hours as an emergency call. 
I had total of two plumbers came out, but not at the same time, because the problem was so complicated. the first one i had was very nice, patient, and hard working. he literally laid on my floor, tried to fix the leak on my beat up copper pipe from 5pm to 10pm!!!! he didn't ask for water, a tissue, or anything during this entire time until i offered. my pipe was one of the difficult fixes according to him, it was under the slab, between two other pipes, and a waste line, with leaked water around, in order to get the water dry out from inside the pipe, he went in and out multiple times to blow into the garden holes faucet himself in the cold!!! hoping the water would be forced out that way. unfortunately, before he was able to fix this one leak, my severely damaged piped had already burst out another tiny hole next to the first leak!!! we then decided to call it for the night, but he offered to come back early in the morning the next day, and tried to fix it even more.
He came back the next morning around 8am to try to fix the pipe from the night before, yet i had already decided that the pipe was in such poor condition which it would have saved me more money to re plumbed the house instead. He then agreed with me. He signed off on my bill, told me that my dispatch fee will be charged to the next plumber since this would considered as one job, then he told me that even though he had worked for so long the previous night, but he somehow didn't get the problem solved, so he wasn't going to charge me anything!!! i was very satisfied with how professional they company is, and their plumbers are!!! they really make me feel that i'm in such a good hand, who i can trust competely!!!
I then called to have the second plumber come out, which he was an expert on service, and re piping water lines for houses. he came out around 11am, not too long after i called, looked around my house, discussed couple of ideas with me, we then agreed on an idea and it's price. he was able to get the work started right away!!! it just seemed like he had all the tools and parts in the world to do the job, he did have to go out to the shop to get some pipes (pvc and copper), but he returned very quickly. he cut up couple of places on my ceiling and on the drywalls since we were re piping it throw the attic, in neatly squares because he told me it would be easy for me to patch up later. keep in mind they are plumbers, so they would not patch up walls for you, filling the floor is extra charge too, so i offered to do the filling myself also. he was crawling through my attic, back and forth many times to get the pipe positioned right, and sealed correctly he then even secure them onto the side for me, so it was very easy to get to, exam, or clean later. he used copper links also, which needs to be torched up and seal properly, this guy got all the places sealed up, and right on the first try!!!! the connections between pipes were designed very smartly by him, he was very quick and good at what he does, he was able to have all the pipes connected, and torched up in a very tiny space under one of my tubs. 
i'm not a professional to describe exactly what they have done for me and my house, but i tried to write as much in details above to let you all know that i have dealt with many plumbers before, and i know only a good, and experienced can, and able to get the work done, and correctly done. this company is the place to go, they have the best group of people you can possibly ask for to fix your stuff!!!
btw, i feel the price was very reasonable since the first guy didn't charge me anything for the first day at all with all the time n work he did do, i was charged total of 3000 dollars to re piping a whole section of my house on the second day. you can also go print out the coupons on their websites. 
good luck!!!

reviews.author: Stephanie K.
reviews.text: If I could rate them zero stars I would.  I called Superior plumbing to replace the toilet in my master bathroom as the old toilet was 19 years old and leaking at the bottom near the tile floor and bolts rusted out due to old age.  When the plumber arrived ( Beau B.) he did not put on the shoe coverings/ booties, and I had to ask him to put them over his boots. I have over $10k worth of brand new carpet and hard wood floors in my home and I did not want him tracking his boots all over my brand new flooring.  He had to go back out to his truck to get the shoe coverings and he slammed my front door so hard that my entire house shook, so he was mad from the beginning.  Upon looking at my toilet he advised I would need a new toilet.  I asked if the work could be done the same day because when I called to make the appointment the person on the phone I spoke to (Moe) advised the plumbers arrive with toilets in the truck and are able to complete the work same day.  The plumber (Beau B.) very rudely and gruffly said "No, I ain't waiting around here for an hour while you go and buy a toilet and come back."  I immediately told him he did not need to speak to me in that manner and that I was asking a simple question because the person on the phone advised the work could be done the same day.  He then tried to back peddle and say he was not being rude because he knew I was going to complain.  Also, the price he quoted me was double the price that 3 other licensed, insured, master plumbers have quoted me to install a new toilet.  After he left I called Superior customer service to file a complaint and asked for a manager to call me back.  After 48 hours no manager called me back.  I then called back again and cancelled then install with Superior and they wanted to charge me the $62.50 dispatch fee which I refused to pay due to the poor experience I had with the plumber and the way I was treated and the fact that a manager could not call me back after 48 hours.  I had to demand to speak to a manager and finally they put a manager on the phone.  He never apologized or took responsibility for the behavior of his employee.  He never said sorry.  Finally after a very heated conversation he agreed to waive the $62.50 dispatch fee.  I will NEVER use Superior again and I will tell everyone I know never to use them.  They do not have superior customer service and they do not stand behind their work and promises made on their website.  Their prices are sky high, double what other licensed master plumbers charge.  Do your homework and get several quotes from other plumbers and find yourself another quality plumber and save yourself over 50% of what Superior is charging.  They should be ashamed of the prices they are charging people, clearly taking advantage of people.

reviews.author: Denis C.
reviews.text:
Issue - Leaking Pressure Reduction Valve, which is typically found near the main water line to reduce the water pressure to a more "digestible" rate for servicing the interior plumbing fixtures.

Since this was a unique part, with a few not-so-straightforward connections, I didn't want to experiment trying fix it myself. Unfortunately, I did not have a plumber in mind at the time and needed to get the drip fixed as soon as possible. Referencing the area commercials I did some online "window" shopping, and given the Superior website was slightly more user-friendly and helpful, I contacted them to arrange a service call.

On the day of, the plumber/technician was running behind for the given service window and the dispatcher called to confirm the adjusted time - all very reasonable. Upon arrival the technician introduced himself, took down some basic information and began his assessment.  

Nothing shocking about the required work, however, at $485 the price certainly was. Unfortunately, most established service companies have set pricing for a given service much like an auto mechanic or Doctor does, so getting understanding of what goes into the pricing isn't always clear. While the price wasn't grossly obscene I didn't feel it was a great value - retail, the parts go for $55 PRV and $18 shut-off valve. Work effort took him about 2 hours total from setup to clean-up. 

At completion the job was well-done, but again it pays to look around before you really need to have a service call. If you can find a reliable and highly recommended independent plumber they might be your best bet and perhaps a little more flexible in pricing, saving you probably 30% or more. What added insult to the cost was that Superior keeps the service call price - cost of providing an onsite visit and quote, in the billing even after you agree to the accept the work, $37.50 - shouldn't that be factored into the job-quote already!?

One other pricing reference, I had asked about possibly replacing my hot water heater - standard 40 gallon, gas unit plus an expansion tank (part of the newer code) $1450, a new retail water heater goes for $350 - $400 and expansion tank $50-60, so they would easily be charging $1000 in labor alone.

Overall, the work will get done to specification in a timely manner - great for piece of mind and if you are willing to accept the premium that goes along without researching and pulling multiple quotes. So for service they get 5 stars and price/value 2.5.

reviews.author: Amy R.
reviews.text: We called Superior out to a water leak coming through our floor last Saturday. When the plumber came, I told him we also had a roof leak and showed him a water spot on the ceiling. I asked if the two could be related and he said, "no". He cut 3 holes in our wall and could not find leak - he got in attic and said the water on the floor must be from the roof leak - charged us $400. 4 days later our entire ceiling was covered in water dripping through ceiling onto the bed below. The roofer replacing our roof that day got in our attic and said there was indeed a pipe leak and that the attic was covered in water. We called the same plumber back out - He said it would be almost another $400 to repair the pipe that was leaking - We said we already paid $400 three days earlier for them to tell us there was no leak - his response was, "well I didn't fix anything, now I have to charge you to fix it". I stated that he told us there was NO LEAK when we paid him $400 three days earlier and now we have significant damage. His response was, "well that's not my fault". He asked if I saw the leak when I was in the attic and I told him that I did not climb over the rafters to look at the plumbing and that I paid HIM to do that. We called the office and asked to speak to a manager - they said we had to request this with the plumber. I told them that we had a disagreement with the plumber and that we were not confident that he would have a manager contact us. I told the plumber multiple times that I wanted him to have a manager call me and he kept asking me why. Before the plumber left, my husband made sure that he knew we wanted to speak to a manager. After he left, I filled out the online contact form to have someone contact us - The woman (Erica) responded to my request that I was not present at the house at the time the plumber was there on the second day and that they would only speak to my husband that was there - She said they had not heard from my husband that he wanted to speak to a manager. That same day, my husband followed up with the email and told her that he DID in fact tell the plumber multiple times that he wanted to speak to a manager and that he was requesting AGAIN to have someone call him. She responded that he would hear from someone in 48-72 hours. Tomorrow will be day 5 and we have YET to hear from a manager!! TERRIBLE customer service - rude dispatchers - questionable ethics - WOULD NOT RECOMMEND ! ! !

reviews.author: Richard R.
reviews.text:
I had 3 issues to resolve -- the "lift and turn" drain cover needed to be replaced for the bathroom tub, the "pop-up" needed to be reattached for one of the bathroom sinks, and an entire "pop-up assembly" needed to be installed in the other bathroom sink.

The plumber arrived about 30 minutes early, which was nice.

For the first project, he had to use a hacksaw to create a groove into which he could put a wedge and, using a hammer on the wedge, screwed out the lift-and-turn.   The original lift-and-turn was so old and corroded (and locked in) that that was needed.  He did a good job --  it came out with no damage to the tub and the new lift-and-turn looks very nice.

For the second project, he successfully reattached the pop-up.  He had to try several approaches to make the reattachment, and I commend him for sticking with it until a workable solution was reached.  He spent a good half-hour diligently working on this and it works fine now.

For the third project, a more straighforward one, he simply installed the pop-up assembly.  It looks and works fine.  The only complaint I have about this is that the rod that governs whether the pop-up is up or down sticks out a little high, even when the pop-up is up.  Most such rods are almost all the way in the faucet assembly until the pop-up is closed.  I didn't notice this until he left, but to me this is a minor flaw with which I can live.

Overall, I am satisfied with the service.  The price seemed high to me, but I must confess I did not comparison shop beforehand so I can't say for sure.

The prices of each project are as follows:

Remove old / Install new lift-and-turn    $187.33
(plumber supplied the new lift-and-turn)

Reattach pop-up in bathroom sink           FREE
(This was nice, he spent 30 minutes
doing this project)

Install pop-Up assembly in bathroom      $249.35 
sink

Dispatch Fee                                            $27.50

Total Bill                                                   $464.18

Like I say, this amount seemed high to me but I did not comparison shop beforehand to know one way or the other, and he did spend almost 2 hours here and the work was good.  Next time, though, I'll comparison-shop before making a choice of contractors for this kind of work.

reviews.author: Francene T.
reviews.text:
Our experience with Superior Plumbing spans two different houses and multiple different plumbing needs (including having a new gas line installed for a gas grill) and we've been extremely satisfied each time. Today's experience is yet another example of their great service and focus on the customer.

We've been in our current home for less than three years and woke up this morning to an active leak coming from the floor above through the ceiling of our kitchen/living area. With a new-build home less than three years old, the first call was to the builder's warranty department and we got the "call the company that did the plumbing during construction" brush off. I called that company and they were quick to tell me that A) they don't make service calls and B) their work was only warranted for two years. Seems to me that you can warrant parts for a limited time but a business who stands behind their work would warrant it much longer...but I digress.

Pursuing this with the construction plumber or the builder was getting me nowhere, so I called Superior. They took my information, checked the calendar and had a licensed plumber at my house within two hours. In addition, I received an email with the name and photo of both the contact I spoke to at their office and the plumber that was headed to my home. I LOVE that...

Jason H arrived quickly, listened to the details and did a careful eval of the guest bath area, laundry room and master bath. He isolated and corrected the most probable cause of the leak: a poorly seated/poorly sealed master shower drain. He reseated and resealed the drain, ran the shower for several minutes to test for the leak. No leak. Success!! I not only appreciate the resolution to the problem, I appreciate how truly helpful and just plain nice everyone is - Jay, working in their office took my call and got the ball rolling and Jason H, who was cheerful, professional and absolutely customer focused. 

Their prices are absolutely fair, especially in an emergency situation.

While I believe the problem is now fixed, water leaks are tricky - but if any more show up, I'm wasting no time with anyone else. I'll call Superior.

reviews.author: Kevin K.
reviews.text:
I wish had looked these guys up on Yelp prior to calling. A few months ago, we moved into a new house and I needed a shut off valve installed for a new dryer pronto. The price was outrages but with everything else I had to deal with moving into a new house and not liking to mess with gas and needing to wash my clothes, and I figured for that price, it would at least be done right. 

I told the guy where the gas enters the house and he stated he wouldn't need to mess with that. I told him I didn't want the whole house smelling like gas. 'It won't' he said. Ten minutes later I walk downstair and am hit in the face by the smell of gas. In his defense the gas detector in the next room did not go off and the smell dissipated after 30 minute or so, so I am sure it was safe whatever he did. I found that the cut off valve had extended the pipe to the point where now the dryer has barely enough room to open its door, he could have mentioned that maybe given some alternatives prior to install, but he did not. Then he messed with the ventilation duct a minute, got it attached but still a mess, called me over and said 'I want to point this out to you, you might to do something about this duct'. And then I found out the price he quoted didn't include the 40$ trip charge. 

Next he insisted on quoting me for a new hot water heater while he was there, and stood there trying to scare my wife the the thing is about to blow up its so old, and quoted a price that was 50% higher than the Home Depot charges for their most expensive, higher capacity, internet enabled water heater installed. So now I am stuck with dryer in an awkward place and it only cost almost as much as the dryer itself to get the cut off valve installed. So much for getting it done right. Two stars instead of one because they did respond within a few hours of calling, and their has been no leaks or gas smells in the few months it has been installed.

reviews.author: Vivian F.
reviews.text:
I didn't know how many stars to give because the guy that did the work was good, it was his boss that was 1 star.

Here is the scoop. We are renters. Had high water bills suddenly. Had to get the landlord to schedule someone to detect the leak. It was an underground leak from the meter to the house. Once the leak was detected, the landlord scheduled Superior Plumbing to fix it. The plumber had a deep hole dug next to the driveway. He was under the assumption we were the homeowners.

I went out and asked him if he already had payment info from my landlord and he said no. He then called his office but afterwards he went back to work so assumed he had the payment issue resolved.

He did work hard and long on the issue and resolved it. However when he was done, he told us he could not reach the landlord to get payment info. He asked if I would call the landlord. I did and just got voice mail. He put me on the phone with his boss who was very angry the landlord was not answering his phone and proceeded to say the 3 of us, my boyfriend, landlord and me were in collusion to rip them off. His boss was saying "This guy worked 12 hrs and he is not going to get paid!" (That would be the guys ENTIRE work day--he was at our place for a few hours) He was saying we just were so wrong for this guy not getting paid. Like I could magically get in touch with the landlord! 

So he said he was going to have the guy dig up the ground again and cut the pipe totally and we would have NO water! OR just take the meter! (We had water before he did the repair--just was leaking causing a high water bill) But they were going to leave us with NO water! That would be uninhabitable conditions!

It was getting dark and I just wanted this to be over so I paid the guy myself. I still never received an apology when the landlord did call them the next morning and paid.

reviews.author: Fran S.
reviews.text:
If I could give this place zero stars, that number would be too many. STAY AWAY from this business!!! They are in it to make a quick $79.50 regardless if they do the job or not, and they always bank on the NOT part. I should have followed my first mind when I cancelled the initial appointment when the rep told me about the $79.50 just to take a look at the job. I asked for a ballpark price to reconnect two faucets, but she claimed she did not know because it could take more labor and there could be other issues. However, when their tech came to my home, Jason had a large IPAD with every price point the company has to offer to the tune of  $2,000 just to reconnect two faucets after I had some countertops installed!!!??? Why? Because EVERYTHING is either missing or wrong when it was all working properly and just fine a day and a half ago. When I told Jason to forget it and let me square the bill, he stated he would be right back. I assumed he was going to place his materials in the truck and bring me the invoice. After about ten minutes, I decided to go outside only to discover Jason coming from my backyard. He looked guilty and nervous when I asked him what was he doing. He claimed he was checking the water pressure. He made no mention to me that was his intention prior to leaving and I did not ask him to do this. 

After checking my security cameras, it is still inconclusive as to exactly what he was doing back there. But at least it is recorded if something goes awry! This business is feeling a little sleazy to me. I caution you to think more than twice!

I found this company on TrustDale, but now, I am second guessing Dale too. All I can do is appeal to my fellow Yelpers. BUYER BEWARE!!!!!

reviews.author: Bonnie Acton
reviews.text: Update 2/9/2026 Joel replaced my expansion tank today and was amazingly efficient. Came completely prepared for whatever was needed and answered all my questions. I really appreciate getting a picture of the person who is coming. Communication from Superior has always been excellent! Ad you can see, Superior is my first choice now for any plumbing issues that come up! Update 7/24/24: Cody replaced ALL 3 of my home's toilets today, and he could not have been more efficient, capable, neat and personable! He did a beautiful job on all 3, and took great care to make sure they were steady as a rock. I am so grateful for his skill!! Could not be happier. Superior and Cody are outstanding. Update, highly satisfied with new issues fixed by Josh Collet on 5/25/23. Not only was he thorough, but he also made it look so good and neat under the sink. In addition, he took all the time necessary to fix a broken pipe that I had been living with for 9 years (not using), and it is SO nice to have that properly functioning. He was courteous, professional, and clearly very capable. Will call again for another project in the near future!  Could not be more pleased. I got an answer immediately, and Jason was sent to my home in a very short time. A pinhole leak in my old copper pipe was detected quickly, and work was clearly explained. I was so impressed that I asked him if he could add another repair, and he took care of that quickly as well. He had everything he needed on the truck. He was careful to check everything and verify proper function before leaving. I wish every service could go so smoothly--Jason was great! Thank you, Superior! I will call again and would definitely recommend.

synthesis.summary: Superior Plumbing's Google rating (4.8) and Yelp rating (2.4) tell two very different stories — and the Yelp record, spanning over a decade and 100 reviews, is the more damning one. Reviewers consistently describe quotes 2-4x competitors, non-refundable dispatch fees that still apply even when you accept the job, and questionable diagnoses that get overturned by second opinions at a fraction of the cost. The company advertises 24/7 service but dispatchers confirm they don't send plumbers after hours or on Sundays.
strengths: Can often get someone out same-day or next-day for weekday calls
Individual technicians are frequently described as professional and polite
weaknesses: Pricing is consistently 2-4x competitors for identical jobs across dozens of reviews spanning 10+ years
Dispatch/service fee is charged in addition to job cost, not applied toward it — confirmed by multiple reviewers
Does not provide after-hours service despite advertising 24/7 availability
redFlags: Multiple reviewers describe diagnoses recommending $4,000+ replacements for issues fixed by other companies for under $200
24/7 advertising is false — dispatchers confirmed no weekend or evening service in multiple reviews
Coupon bait-and-switch: one reviewer's price jumped $142 when she mentioned a $25 coupon from their own website
Technician advised new toilet for a clog that snaking could clear; another company cleared it for a fraction of the price
Manager does not return complaint calls — multiple reviewers report 4+ unreturned calls
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Despite advertising 24/7, dispatchers have confirmed no evening or weekend service to at least two reviewers. One customer with a Sunday basement leak was told they don't send plumbers on Sundays.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google 4.8 vs Yelp 2.4 (100+ Yelp reviews) — significant divergence. Yelp record shows a decade-long pattern of pricing and service complaints not reflected in Google reviews.

reviews.text: We had a leak in our circulation pipe. A team came out to assess and determined it was a break in the pipe in the slab. It was going to require a different team to come out.  Originally we were told our hot water tank would have to be pulled but when Jon came the next day, he said he could jack hammered the slab up without moving it. He did a fantastic job. He used a small hand  jack hammer to do the job.  He replaced the pipe and then came back the next day and filled in the cement. He did a very clean job and it looks great. He is an excellent plumber. Very experienced and personable.  Our only complaint was We felt the price was high considering it took in all about 5 hours.  We thought the price quoted was because they thought they would have to pull our hot water tank but Mullins standard slab leak price “starts” at $3500. If cost isn’t an issue I would highly recommend using Mullins; however if cost is an issue then you might want to check with other plumbers.  We have used Mullins on several jobs over the years.

At 12:50 p.m., I texted my contact to see when I could expect the repair person to arrive & was assured I was on the roster of scheduled appts for the day! At 1:20 p.m. I got a response to my next text saying someone will let me know when they're on their way!  At 3:25 p.m. I contacted them again.  At 3:54 p.m.I got a reply thanking me for my patience & telling me I was the next stop on the list. At 4:16 p.m. I was notified that the technician was on their way to me & it would be ABOUT AN HOUR & A HALF!!  
I sat home all day waiting for them.
No one actually called me to update me & tell me the technician was stuck at a job. I found this out at about 4:30 p.m. when I called to tell them another 90 min wait was unacceptable.  I wanted someone tomorrow morning. I was then transferred to the "dispatcher" by the person answering calls & was told no one can come out tomorrow. They don't work on the weekends, but she assured me she would have someone out 1st thing Monday morning.  This is for a 1st floor toilet! Unhappily, I accepted. I thought we were set.  Let me also add that I was told, in writing, 2 diff times by my contact, approximately how much the work would cost me.  After I hung up with the dispatcher, she called me back a few mins later. She said she was going thru the notes for my appt & saw what I had been quoted & called to advise me that it would cost much more than what I had been quoted. She also said my contact was NOT AUTHORIZED to quote prices. I asked for an approximation & she said she couldn't give me one. I then asked her for a ballpark & again said she couldn't give me one.  I told her I thought her co was f***ing nuts & hung up on her. 
Now I've lost a day where I could get nothing accomplished & my toilet is not repaired & I have to start over.  AVOiD THIS COMPANY LIKE THE PLAGUE.

reviews.author: Daniel Filice
reviews.text:
(Updated) Art Kelly was the service tech for my Healthy Home care plan inspection and he created a great experience. He was personable, thorough and articulate, didn’t try to oversell me and went the extra mile to get me a fair price on my PRV replacement.

Wilson Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric just earned a lifelong customer thanks to two outstanding technicians who serviced my home today.

Plumber – Hithem Judeh
Hithem replaced my PRV valve and was incredibly thorough and thoughtful throughout the entire visit. He clearly explained what the new water pressure would mean, what to expect going forward, and made sure I understood everything before he left. While he was here, he also noticed a few other small issues around the house, corrected them on the spot, and didn’t charge me for those quick fixes. That level of care and integrity is rare and seriously appreciated.

Electrician – Alan Yeager
Alan was very down-to-earth, efficient, and clearly great at what he does. He replaced my recessed lighting and garage switches quickly and cleanly, and then went the extra mile by installing a few additional fixtures I had purchased but didn’t end up needing for the original project. On top of that, he gave me really helpful insight and recommendations for my outdoor lighting needs.

Based on the service these two provided, I would 100% recommend Wilson Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric to anyone looking for reliable, professional, and friendly home service.

reviews.author: Don H.
reviews.text: Do not let this company in your home. They will not take responsibility for any damage that they cause. They installed a furnace, through the weatherization program, in my home 5 months after I bought it. They showed up at my home at 7:30 am on a Monday, without an appointment, beating on my door for 45 minutes until my neighbor called me. I had to ask them to leave and make a proper appointment. My whole house humidifier worked well until they destroyed it, left the chimney cap hanging off and as I found from 2 other companies left many other problems. I notified Central Heating in Dec. about the humidifier and chimney cap being off and expressed how it caused problems with my 3 yr old daughter sleeping in her room because of the noise.  I was repeatedly asked to give them 2 weeks to get to me because they had customers without heat. We were promised that they would fix things. The Chimney cap was not fixed until March, because my 1 story ranch's chimney was  too high to get to. Now, although they broke it, they wanted to charge me $300 to replace the humidifier. The owner tried to say they did not touch the humidifier yet pictures and 2 other heating companies state that the frame behind and around it is brand new and the humidifier is not to be attached by a frame at all. They are disrespectful, liars and this is nothing but a scam!! DO NOT TRUST THESE PEOPLE!!  The owner has a bad habit of lying, dodging and chastising customers to get them to back down.

reviews.author: James G.
reviews.text:
Central Heating installed a Trane XR95,  Aprilaire 2210 Air Cleaner to replace a twenty-eight year old furnace.  Additionally, due to the new new furnace, a chimney liner would be necessary for the hot water heater.  Central suggested we check out the DEO Home Performance with Energy Star (Good Cents) to get a rebate for the furnace since Central is an approved contractor; which we did, and the process was painless and worth it.  

At installation of the new furnace, Matt and the crew were timely, efficient and neat. HVAC inspector from the City came to check after the install and commented the install was good, although the seams on the new furnace should have been sealed. We're pleased with the new furnace thus far..much, much more efficient that the old! They couldn't install the liner due to there was snow on the roof.  

The chimney liner was installed by a sub-contactor a few weeks later. If you're getting a liner installed be sure to confirm whether Central or the sub-contractor will purchase the liner. Also, give the sub-contractor at least a two-hour window from the promised time to arrive at your home. They must be incredibly busy.  Once they started working, it was obvious they have installed a lot of liners and know just about everything about chimneys. Just be patient with the scheduling.

reviews.author: Karin J.
reviews.text:
I have been a customer of Central heating for a few years and before that my Mom was for years.  After she died I moved into her house and I had a LOT to learn about water boiler furnaces.

The first year I was in the house the pipes leading to the furnace had major leaking issues (no dripping beforehand, was a total surprise).  Central was very proactive and custom made piping to replace the old pieces.

Since then I mainly have needed them for yearly check ups, but last Sunday morning the furnace shut off and I could not restart it.  Miraculously they were able to fit me in the next day (yesterday), and service tech Emad diagnosed it as a blown heating cool, which he replaced in a timely manner.

Emad (who has been with the company for 15 years, so that tells you something), was great at explaining what he was doing and gave me advice about regulating the water level.  

The outdoor temp yesterday was in the high teens (windchill), so my day went from very chilly inside the house to comfy by the evening.

I HIGHLY recommend Central heating, a rock solid local company that always does right by me!  Thanks!

reviews.author: Jan M.
reviews.text:
I am giving this company NO stars.  Their technician was not acquainted with, or trained to repair the unit I have, which is only five years old.  After battling with the unit quitting late each night, the technician would appear the next day and find yet something else he hadn't considered.  I will say that the technician was extremely nice.  Long story short though, I contacted the company that had installed the furnace (the reason I didn't initially is that they are not close to my area) and they were shocked at what had been done to the unit AND what I had been charged.  Two men worked all day to repair the damage done by the Central technician.

Two lessons learned:  If possible, deal with the company who installed your unit and never make an emergency call.  Call during regular hours.  If I hadn't been worried about my pipes, I would have waited until the next day and would have avoided a log of grief (and cost).  

When I heard that the Central Heating owner had suggested to the technician that he sell me a new furnace, it killed any faith I had in Central Heating.

reviews.author: Diego Lindsay Benhumea
reviews.text:
We have used Wilson plumbing for 5 years, in every one of our homes. They are very professional and have always sent great plumbers our way. I really appreciate the texts and emails prior to them coming that show the photo of the technician coming out. They have always taken care of us whether it be a new gas line for an oven of my dreams, new plumbing in a shower or helping us navigate a bathroom remodel due to a corroded old pipe leaking causing massive amounts of home damage.
We are so grateful to have a company that we can have confidence in helping us enjoy our home and be healthy and safe.

2 Years after this original review I am back to add that Wilson Plumbing continues to be a great company that hires professionals to come to your home and solve issues. I couldn’t be happier with Cody who came out today. He did a great job of explaining everything to me and even asked if I had any questions which I didn’t due to his clear communication, which I appreciate. Thanks again guys for being reliable!

reviews.author: Pamela A.
reviews.text: Exceptional company!!!! We have used them on various occasions to have the installation of a tankless hot water system, a wifi thermostat installed at our son's house. With both of those encounters; the technicians were nothing but professional and informative. Based on the expert way in how they handled those two situations; we called them for our home for some advice on the movement of our thermostat since we had recently moved into the home; we got nothing but helpful information and will make those changes once we start the remodeling of our main floor space. We know there will have to be some major changes made to the heating ducts to this space; and of course, we will be making the call to Central Heating to assist us in our reconfiguration of this space. If you are looking for honest, hard-working and professional service... Central Heating and Air Conditioning is the place to go. You can't go wrong. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Robin C.
reviews.text:
Central Heating installed a HVAC system complete with duct work because we didn't have any. They worked on some very cold days outside and in the attic as well. I was EXTREMELY satisfied with the customer service, Stew (the owner) and the experience of  EVERY ONE of his crew!  They were careful and very neat and clean EVERYDAY.  I'm particular!  The superb attention they showed to doing the best they could to have the equipment and everything running to it turned out to look very professional and had a neat appearance. Again, I'm particular!
They came back several times to address a couple of concerns I had and were able to satisfy me.
I hired Central because I knew they were experienced but I also now know they won't leave me hanging in the event of any problems in the future. That gives me peace of mind and I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Levie G.
reviews.text:
They are way over priced 5000 to
Run electric line for two lights in basement that I purchased and add electrical outlet for sub pump and add two conduit poles for existing electrical for washer and dryer this job was almost 3 times more than what it should be. Last job quote replace 4 old  Emergency Exit signs and old Emergency Exit Light which I purchased they quoted 1880 I got job done by WANS Electric for 388. I highly recommend not using them even though they can do same day or next day service they are extremely overpriced do your research and get other estimates. I am tied into their membership plan for a year which I regret 15.00 a month no cancellation without paying the year due. The only benefit is some free maintenance plans and free quotes. They should be ashamed of themselves with their prices

synthesis.summary: A full-service home company where named technicians consistently go beyond the job scope — fixing small issues on the spot, walking you through systems, and leaving the place clean — with zero negative signals across 5 reviews.
strengths: 4 of 5 reviews specifically name individual technicians and praise their thoroughness, suggesting consistently high technician quality rather than one standout
Multiple reviews highlight proactive communication — technicians explain what they're doing, walk customers through new systems, and set clear expectations before leaving
2 reviews mention technicians fixing additional small issues at no charge and resisting upsells, pointing to an honest, customer-first pricing culture
weaknesses: Not enough data to identify weaknesses — all 5 analyzed reviews are uniformly positive with no complaints or caveats noted
synthesis.emergencyNotes: None of the 5 reviewed jobs reference after-hours, emergency, or burst-pipe scenarios — all appear to be scheduled appointments or planned installs — so emergency responsiveness cannot be confirmed from this review sample, despite the strong 4.8 Google rating across 4,370 reviews.

hire_if: You need clear communication and upfront explanations
You need a plumber who actually shows up when scheduled
caution_if: You need guaranteed sub-hour response for true emergencies
You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote

plumbers.address: 2279 Romig Rd, Akron, OH 44320, USA

reviews.author: Lauren McIntyre
reviews.text: We called Jennings because we tried to replace some porch lights and found a major electrical mess due to the previous homeowners. Josh came out to assess the situation and gave us an accurate price to re-install one of the electrical boxes, both of our new lights, and caulk it up so the same issues don’t happen again. He even had the correct screws for the light fixtures - which Amazon didn’t think we needed 😒 (and would have stopped us if we had tried to install them ourselves). It looks so much better and we feel better knowing it’s installed correctly. Thanks!

reviews.author: Kayla Stephan
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Drew from Jennings Home Services. He was friendly, professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything clearly before getting started. The work was done efficiently and with great attention to detail, and he made sure everything was cleaned and working perfectly before he left. It’s clear he takes pride in his work and cares about providing excellent service. I would highly recommend Drew and Jennings Home Services to anyone in need of reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: RIck Weber
reviews.text: Bobby and his coworker (don’t remember his name) were just great.   They were very courteous and knowledgeable.  They quickly analyzed the situation.  I would not hesitate to use this company again.  This was my first time using Jennings but now have very good impression of this company.

reviews.author: nikki winkel
reviews.text: A friendly reminder to get multiple quotes. One of our underground power lines from the street failed and we got an estimate from Jennings. The quote sent us into a panic. We talked to multiple smaller local contractors after this that gave us much more reasonable quotes around 1/4 of the cost

reviews.author: rodney koberna
reviews.text: I hired Jennings to look at a fault I had with my main breaker. What a disappointment they sent me a sales man not a technician. He spent no longer than 5 minutes looking at what might me wrong told me it was unfixable and started quoting me prices. He said everything in the box and half way up the outside pole needed to be replaced, $4000 to $8000. I had another electrician come out and was told the high limit switch on the furnace was shot and the blower motor need to be blown out to much dust had accumulated making it harder for the furnace to operate drawing to much voltage and the main breaker may be weak. $485.00 I'll never deal with Jennings again.

reviews.author: k bloom
reviews.text:
I was hesitant to call any company after questionable work from another company in the past, but read the positive reviews for Jennings. They are locally owned which is a bonus for me. From the outset, Matt was professional, personable and willing to show and explain everything he was doing for my boiler cleaning. I knew it was time for replacement, a topic I brought up, not him. He came in well under what I was envisioned the final bill would be. It was actually a relief to sign up to get my new boiler installed! I will definitely recommend Jennings to everyone I know. I will also be a customer for life! I wasn't aware they provided more services than just HVAC, but I'm very glad I made the call. No pressure, no hidden gimmicks, just great service and they keep you informed for every appointment. Do yourself a favor and look no further than Jennings!

*Adding photos to show what I started with and what I now have. I have to add Sean and Nick (I'm so sorry to the other tech whose name I forgot) were absolutely outstanding! The difference is amazing in my house. My cat definitely approves and found a preferred spot with the radiant floor heating. I will definitely use your services again!! Thank you so very much!

reviews.author: Joy DeVaul
reviews.text: No hot water! Went to basement to check tankless water heater.  Was spewing water all out of it! All over the floor!  Called Jennings!  Was very upset didn’t know what to do..receptionist was so concerned and got a plumber to me ASAP!  Sam Walker changed his schedule to come take care of my water heater!  Turned out needed a new one…Sam Walker switched appointments around to fit me in next day!  Jennings cares about their customers!!  Make them your 1st call for plumbing needs!  A ten in my book for sure!  Thank you Sam Walker for your expertise and care!

reviews.author: David Scott
reviews.text: We were having issues with our new furnace we purchased within the year. We were getting no heat upstairs. Nick took his time trying to diagnose the issues and wound up replacing the thermostat and advising us what we can do to ensure we make the best possible use of our new furnace. He explained everything clearly. He was here for 2 plus hours and we are so appreciative of his dedication to excellent customer service! Nick is one of the many reasons we remain loyal to Jennings!

reviews.author: George Jensen
reviews.text: Everything that Jennings does seems to just be right on the money, including Steve, the technician that came to inspect and estimate for a new furnace for us. Now that the installation is complete I have to add how impressed I am with Tyler, Frank and Andy on their work. I am a retired Technician so I know a professional job when I see one! I am getting another estimate this week from Jennings for an upgraded main electrical panel.

reviews.author: Herbert Slone
reviews.text: Daveon is terrific. He not only performed the annual maintenance on our A/C, he also recommended, educated and convinced us, and installed a start up assist unit on our A/C condenser to extend its service life. Jennings has had our business since 1992. They have always been terrific. Prompt. Knowledgeable. Personable. Thorough. Excellent communicators. Thoughtful recommendations to keep our systems well maintained and functional.

reviews.author: James Angiulo
reviews.text: I was a long-time customer with another HVAC business in the area but I changed over to Jennings for their customer service excellence. I always get a friendly agent when I phone, and my needs are taken care of personally and effectively. I have had occasion to have techs out three times for different check-ups, and each visit has been taken care of by courteous and knowledgeable people! Keep up the good work, Jennings!

reviews.author: Frederick Maurer
reviews.text: Our heating system went out over night. I called Jennings before 8:00 AM.  They answered the phone!! Around 8:45. Josh came to the house. He was professional, obviously competent, and thorough.  Within an hour, he diagnosed the problem, called the manufacturer and confirmed that it was covered under warranty.  He was great in all facets of his job.  A perfect 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Carol Ruane
reviews.text: Called Jennings Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric for maintenance service on AC unit.  The service Technician arrived on-time and thoroughly provided maintenance on the unit. He was also very friendly and professional.  I appreciate the service I received. The maintenance was covered under an existing warranty.  I will renew the service warranty with Jennings.

reviews.author: Joyce Giovannelli
reviews.text: Had a hot water tank problem on a Saturday and Jennings sent someone within an hour. Sam came and fixed the issue while thoroughly explaining the problem and offering several ways of moving forward in order to prevent recurrence. He was kind, respectful, and knowledgeable. We will definitely ask for him in the future.

reviews.author: John Mumper
reviews.text:
Ryan was friendly, easy to work with and
skilled at his job. The finished product works great! This is consistent with all the technicians from Jennings we have worked with these past few years. It seems to us that Jennings has a good team (including the helpful young lady who answered our call).
