reviews.author: Stacy Rihel
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about the service we received from ARS.  Our water tank basically blew out and we had water all over the garage.  We called several places for a quote on a Sunday.  Not only was their quote free of charge (even if we decided not to go with them), they responded immediately.  They had a technician, who was authorized to give full quotes on extra large tanks, out to our house within just a few hours.  The office also called twice to give us updates on his arrival.

The service technician,  Jerad, was so very nice and very professional.   He was knowledgeable about the entire process and answered every single question we had.  Even when we had to ask more after he left.  Jerad made the process so easy.  The quotes were very reasonably priced.

Casey, the installation technician came with the new unit the very next day!!  Customer service called to confirm his arrival time and kept me informed.   Casey arrived on time and was super personable.   He was polite,  funny, and professional.   He made the installation look easy!  He even cleaned up the water from the old tanks mess!

I would hire this company again without question!
5 stars to Customer service (thanks ladies)!
5 stars to Jerad and 5 stars to Casey!

As for the Essency tank, 5 stars on looks! It is very esthetically pleasing.   But right now, that is all I can say since it is brand new.  I will review the tank on its own after a few months.

Thank you, team ARS, for such a wonderful experience.   You made spending money not hurt so bad.. lol!

reviews.author: Kelli Shannon
reviews.text: Our HVAC technician Derek was fantastic. He was very knowledgeable, thorough, and clearly takes pride in his work. He went the extra mile to make sure everything was checked and explained things in a way we could understand. On top of that, he was kind and pleasant to deal with during what is usually a stressful situation. Truly appreciate the great service from Derek!

reviews.author: Amanda Dardy
reviews.text:
Derek was super friendly! He was thorough in his assessment of my HVAC system during the maintenance check, and clearly explained the areas of concern. Derek did not try to just sell me a quick, expensive solution but rather provided several options for me to consider, with no pressure.
I would highly recommend ARS to other customers!

reviews.author: Daniel B.
reviews.text: I would not let ARS change a light bulb or flush a toilet in my home. They are terrible. Bought new Carrier unit 6 years ago, unit has never worked properly. At least 10 visits to fix unit over the YEARS, still not repaired. Called Corporate customer service and received the same lip service. Referred by Home Depot, who could care less about their service. Review the following News report at. https://www.newschannel5.com/news/newschannel-5-investigates/before-you-turn-on-the-a-c-this-summer-know-how-to-be-a-smart-consumer-with-your-a-c-repairman. Terrible company BEWARE!! Purchasing new unit now. Filing report with BBB also. Please take notice of this review, it will save you a headache later.

reviews.author: Shari H.
reviews.text: A very nice gentleman came to my house and scheduled an appointment. They couldn't make it but didn't call. Why didn't they call? A two minute conversation letting me know they would not be showing up would have been nice. I cancelled my plans for the afternoon because they were coming. They could have set up an aotomatic phone call or sent a text. It's just plain rude.

reviews.author: Sharon W.
reviews.text:
I am giving ARS a two star rating rather than one star because the tech that was sent out to diagnose and repair my HVAC problem was courteous and efficient during the entire brief service call. I would recommend him as a tech. But I would not recommend the company itself as I do not find them to be trustworthy and I do not believe that they value the quality/value of services provided or their customers as much as the money they make off of services rendered.

I've been an ARS customer since 2017 since they did the replacement of one of my two HVAC units, and then the other the following year. Since then I have been paying the "membership fee" and having regular maintenance on both units one-two times a year.

I reached out to them when I realized two days ago that one of the two units had stopped cooling and was thus affecting the conditions in other parts of the house as well. I was pleased the next day when I found that on a Sunday they were open and were able to send a tech out that evening.

My dissatisfaction came by the end of the service call when I realized I was being charge $280 for a 10 minute repair on a warrantied unit and a service call lasting less than 30 minutes in total.

Upon my own investigation after the fact, I realized that the warrantied part was less than $20 and that this repair cost was well above what would've been charged by other companies for the same repair.

It is worth mentioning that their website clearly states, among other things, that I would be provided with something in writing showing the details of the service visit before work is done; I was never provided anything in writing beforehand. When I called to make the appointment and discussed my unit being under warranty, I was given a blanket response that there would be no charge for the call and that they would deal with the manufacturer company regarding the warranty.

After the service call was done,I was emailed a "receipt"/invoice that I was expecting to provide the details of the services rendered including the breakdown of what I was being charged for and the discounts applied or fees waived. Instead I got a very generic looking invoice that did provide narrative detail of the services rendered by the tech and the total dollar amount I was charged but no breakdown of charges, fees waived, or discounts applied.

In hindsight, I do realize this is why doing your research beforehand and asking plenty of questions during the service call are beneficial and that I was caught up in the need to have the repair done at the time of diagnosis for the sake of quickly returning the conditions within my home back to a level of comfort. Lesson learned.

However, I decided to call ARS today to voice some of my concerns and discuss the breakdown of the charges fully anticipating that I would likely not be offered any kind of refund or credit. I did my best to remain respectful and rational in my tone and responses during the conversation.

The manager that the company had call me back was surprisingly unprofessional. From the second the conversation started I found him to be pretty aloof in his demeanor, which then set the tone for a very ineffective conversation fueled by his consistently unhelpful, callous, and defensive responses to anything I had to say or anything I questioned. I was repeatedly told that he charges the same blanket fee ($280) for warranty service calls "regardless of whether I live in Nashville or Clarksville" simply stated by this particular manager because he "has to make money from the call". The conversation ended with him stating his refusal to discuss anything with me any further than abruptly hanging up on me.

I was stunned at the level of unprofessionalism in the call. Again, one of the more unprofessional conversations I've ever had with someone on management level. Not that I believe that it matters much to ARS of Nashville, but they have lost a loyal customer and I will do my best to sway others away from using them for their HVAC needs also.

reviews.author: Paige C.
reviews.text:
I would give zero starts if I could. They should just shut down. They cancel appointments an hour into the appointment window. Multiple times they canceled. Then they send one plumber to replace a pipe and say I have to have a different plumber come out to snake the drain. I say okay, they say the other plumber will come out the next day. They call during the appointment time to cancel. Finally days later someone actually shows up for a mainline cleanup. I had been promised the $99 special. The plumber that showed up, said that I needed to call the plumbing company back out that replaced the part and have them snake my bathtub. I told him that he is with the company that did that. He looked at me like I was stupid. Apparently, no one in this company talk to each other. He says it will $289 for that drain and the kitchen. That is $289 x two!!!!! I told him that he was there for the mainline cleanup. That I was not going to pay for him to do the pipes inside. He never even looked at them. He said well let me go to my truck and fill out some paper work. He comes back, knocks on the door and tells me he needs to collect the $99. I asked him for what? He still had not even looked at the mainline, much less snake it. I refuse to pay him for that. He said that we'll you have to pay for the service call. I told him it was a service call from last week that one plumber didn't complete because he didn't do drains. I already have paid $400 and I refused to pay for another service call when it was the companies fault they had to come back.  So he leaves.

I call the office and ask who I need to speak with to make a complaint. The guy on the phone tells me to tell him what's wrong and he could help me. I tell him everything and he says that he will have to transfer me to someone that could help. Then it happened again and that person had to transfer men to someone else. Eventually, I reach the compliance something and by now I am just done. I tell her that this has been going on for a week and at this point I am just going to file a complaint with the BBB. She asks me to please allow her to fix the problem before I make a complaint with the BBB. She asks what happened and I go through the entire thing, again. She asks if she can call me back after she speaks to someone. She called me back in 15 minutes. She apologized again and said that she wanted to make it right. She said she was sending a plumber back out to fix the drain and they weren't going to charge me. She said it would not be the same plumber. This lady was really nice and apologetic. I figured that she was going to have someone come out. This was at 10:15 this morning. At 5:15 I still hadn't heard anything. So I called to find out what there normal business hours were. They said they couldn't give me those. What was my name and ask what I needed? I told him that someone was supposed to come out and fix my drain and explained what was going on, again. He got extra rude and said that they were still out on appointments and he would have a dispatcher call me with an ETA. I waited until 8:30. Called back and the lady that answered the phone apologized and said she would have a dispatcher call me back. Of course, they never did. I wasted a week being patient when they repeatedly rescheduled my appointments because they had emergencies, sent plumbers out that couldn't or wouldn't fix my problem. Now, I sit here, drain still not draining correctly and ARS not keeping their word. Thanks for wasting my time. I cleared my schedule to be here for you to not show up. This is truly the worst company out there. I wish I would have never contacted them. I hope no one wastes their time with this company. They have no communication between their departments. No one seems to have a clue about what is going on. They have zero follow-throughs. They don't show their customers any respect.

reviews.author: Kirsten H.
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying our brand new (very expensive) AC unit got put in on June 1st 2021. Less than a month later our unit wasn't working. It wouldn't drop below 77 for a week and we couldn't figure out what was going on so we requested a technician come out to look at it. We were scheduled to have someone come out the next day, July 1st, between 12-5. We were contacted at 3:15 letting us know the tech would be here in the next hour, possibly hour and half. Okay, no problem until they didn't show up. We call at 5:30 and the dispatch can't get ahold of the tech. We had plans so we left and we get a call saying the tech is at our house at 6:30. Like what? We couldn't get back so my husband rescheduled to 8-12 the next morning. Again, same hour heads up at 11 am and they didn't show up until 1:30 pm. Not the techs fault when they made him drive 244 miles one way to our house because as he claimed "no one else knew what they were doing". The unit was frozen because of whatever manufacturing issue so it had to be turned off and thawed out. It couldn't be fixed that day. We have a 2 year old in the heat and the best they could offer was for us to open the windows over night. I felt incredibly unsafe having the windows open as we slept. Let's not even begin with how many dispatchers that continually lied as my husband had to keep calling. He spoke to a manger who listened back on the recorded calls saying when the techs were promised to be here each day and she had no explanation and just apologized. This is our holiday weekend and so far we've spent a majority of it waiting for this horrible company to send a tech. On Saturday when we finally got a tech here at 6:30 we had to cancel our holiday plans we had to be here after the dispatcher promised they'd be here between 8-12 am. I'm so over it and quite frankly I'm livid. The poor customer service is unreal. When we called to speak with the manager on Saturday guess what? They weren't there. They got to have their weekend but we had to sit home waiting for a tech to come out. I blame the dispatchers 100%. If after the current visit the ac isn't working I will be requesting my money back and having them come and get this. I refuse to deal with a company who I'm sure has had plenty of time to figure out how to adequately time when someone will be able to arrive at the customers home. Had they been honest about the time I wouldn't care as much as we could have worked out plans around that but we couldn't enjoy our 4th of July plans because of this.

Well here's a 5 minute later update: Our unit is broken, probably has been since we got. Due to the holiday weekend they can't order the part until Tuesday so we have no ac when it's going to be in the 90s over the next few days. I'll be posting this everywhere to want people. To say I'm livid is now an understatement. 

PLEASE FOR THE LOVE OF GOD DO NOT GO THROUGH THIS COMPANY.

reviews.author: Caleb N.
reviews.text:
Buyer Beware
I called them during the beginning of winter to fix my furnace that kept tripping off. On this first visit they sold me on a "solution" for almost $1,000 and left. Later that day, the furnace turned off....the problem was not fixed. I brought them out again, they said it needed to be cleaned and upsold me to a cleaning/maintenance program for my HVAC and furnace, later that day it kicks off again. They came out a third time and said the furnace was REALLY dirty (it's from 2019 so not that bad) and needed a deeper clean than my cleaning maintenance package covered, and that they need to install special filters so it doesn't get dirty again...total cost $800 for the cleaning + $2,400 for the filters....the furnace kicks off again before he even leaves while still checking my HVAC. He then tells me, I need a new thermostat control unit for $300...fine, he replaces it, and the furnace kicks off about an hour after he leaves. Total for this day $3,500. I call and ask to speak to a manager who comes out. I explain the ungodly amount of money I've spent at this point and that I just want the heat to stay on. The manager questions if I'm somehow Sabotaging the furnace after they leave, and I try to reason with him that it would serve neither of us to do so...then he tells me it's a valve issue and that that costs $1,200 to replace. I point out how much I've spent on "solutions" and that that was crazy for me to keep spending money. I asked him to remove the filters, replace my thermostat, and refund me, and to just fix the valve which he agrees to do. Before they leave, we had them look at our AC which also was not working after the 2nd visit where they cleaned it (again a 2019 unit) they tell me my AC isn't working too and that I need a $2,400 compressor... At this point I tell them I'll get a second opinion. They leave, furnace is finally fixed, I'm out all the money from the first two visits and the money for the valve that finally fixed the problem. So today I get a second opinion for my AC...the guy immediately sees the outside breaker is off and says "you don't need a compressor, the other guy didn't flip your breaker, there's nothing wrong with your unit" saving me $2,400 for a compressor that was never needed in the first place. I ask him how much a valve replacement costs for a furnace, he said "$450"...not $1,200...these guys are crooks. He goes on to say that the $2,400 filters we were sold on for the furnace were never a solution and just an unnecessary up charge. This business takes advantage of customers every chance they get. We had three different technicians come out and each one gave us inaccurate diagnoses with huge price tags... this is taught by the company.  Untrustworthy. Do not use them

reviews.author: Kathryn M.
reviews.text:
Run don't walk away from this company. If you too have been scammed by ARS send me a message I would like to know how many others they have harmed. 

A couple of years ago I was in Home Depot and was offered an HVAC quote. I accepted and began my journey into the seventh circle of being scammed. The nice sales guy came over and warned me about the dangers of my old system. An hour later we were running my credit and I overpaid for a whole new combo HVAC and furnace. I told myself this was a good investment because a new system would run more efficiently and be more reliable. I even paid for an ionic air cleaner , a humidifier, and a digital thermostat that ran it all. None of these things work properly.

I was told install would be three days. 

In my opinion ARS has the laziest bunch of employees I have ever encountered. A different tech showed up to install each little thing. One guy would leave an exposed wire and ARS would send someone else out the next day. Each tech checked off something they "did" then passed the rest of the list to the next guy. We did this for about 2 months. I cannot even begin to explain how much work I lost taking off to meet ARS at my home. Finally my system was "installed" I was left with exposed wires and a cover that is taped on because a tech broke the clips, and holes in my furnace closet that allowed snakes to get in my home, I also later discovered that the surge protectors I paid for were never installed. The sales guy who sold the system came back and fixed the wires, the surge protectors, and the holes in the closet. A few weeks later I was able to get new clips but that also took 5 tech visits. At this point it's winter and I settle into using my new gas furnace and humidifier. 

So I tell myself that was a god awful experience but hey I've got a fancy new HVAC in my condo.... Right? Yep.... No. 

My utilities jump up, and my humidifier stops working. I cannot tell you how many calls I made
To get the humidifier fixed. Finally after I threatened legal action they replaced the humidifier. Currently I barely use it because it doesn't work consistently. 

Fast forward to now my system is not yet three years old. When the air cleaner runs, the ac won't blow cold air. I had a tech out and she couldn't figure out what was wrong. I call ARS and they want $100 to diagnose what's wrong with the system they installed and supposedly warrantied.

Anybody else on here with a similar experience please feel free to contact me. Those of you considering hiring them..... you're smarter than me because you're researching this company..... but trust me you don't want to hire them.

reviews.author: M P.
reviews.text:
This place is one of the sketchiest business experiences I've had in the entire state of tennessee, if not in my entire 46 years of life.  the sales person who arrived to give a quote for a new hvac heat pump refused to listen to anything we said, kept going on about how christian and donating to tebow's charity they are, how they refuse to hire ex cons, and a million other details. the info he REFUSED to share was what equipment they were proposing, why they felt a basic system should cost $12,000 to install, what was included in the quote, etc. He miraculously offered us around a 3k$ discount if we paid immediately. He refused to acknowledge that we were going to get at least another quote. After I politely told him I think we are going to have to pass, instead of leaving his quote with us and moving along, he took out his phone and called "his manager" who conveniently, at 7pm, answered the phone before the first ring completed.

The "manager" then proceeded with all the same scripted marketing/sales nonsense and we could not get a word in edgewise. When I finally interrupted to say--for maybe the 4th or 5th time that we have repeatedly said we have done our research and we think the services they offered are not what we want, and their refusal to listen to us was disrespectful. the sales guy abrupted got up to leave but then proceeded to take around 10-15 minutes to pack up and try to gaslight us into thinking he was only trying to be helpful and that I was somehow being rude for getting up and starting dinner. for the record, he arrived 40 minutes later than the 2-hour window we were given, then promised to be quick, but this all happened over 90 minutes after he arrived, if not more. and even then he just WOULD. NOT. LEAVE. I was about 30 seconds from telling him to get out of my house I would remove him from my house. 

Normally I would do more research before even inviting someone to come and give a quote, but we had brought them in via a deal with home depot and figured at least getting a quote/info from them would be harmless. Instead it was a waste of maybe 3-4 hours of our lives and a ton of irritation. 

I would strongly recommend looking into the ownership of this company and its legal issues before using them, but honestly, I would mainly say steer away from them entirely. We had a very solid experience with the Lee company, whose quote was still maybe 10-20% higher than what I was aiming for, but they were so responsive and professional I didn't really care about an extra $1k just to not have to have another headache.

reviews.author: Rachael G.
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would. This company has the worst customer service I have ever encountered. Not only did I catch them trying to scam me  they were very rude and unprofessional. With the exception of the one customer service agent I spoke with after the fact she was very kind and concerned. I had a tech out to fix an issue with my ac unit not work he first told me they no longer make the refrigerant that my unit requires ( it is old  so that is true) what he didn't want to tell me and I later found out is they do make a comparable one ... he advised me that the parts and refrigerant would be around $6,000 to repair and it would most likely fail within 6 months  so I asked how much to replace my entire unit which he could not answer so had to send someone else out to give me an estimate for that ... it was scheduled for the same day between 4-6  this guy shows up at 8 no call no message. He comes in and I asked him about the refrigerant and he proceeded to argue with me about it. I also asked why just a repair was so expensive when I bought an entire unit for less then that a few years ago at my previous house .. I wasn't rude I was just trying to understand he then proceeds to tell me I didn't buy one for less then that (pretty sure I know what I spent my money on but ok) then tells me since I know it all why don't I go get my second opinion and then give him a call when I get the same answer ... well took his advice and called someone else got my issue resolved for $320  it may not last forever due to the age however bc this tech was willing to explain things and give me options I was able to make that choice. And when I do need to replace this unit I will be going with the new company and NOT ars  it doesn't take much to be kind and explain a customer questions when asking someone to pay $6000  understanding the process and reasoning is not unreasonable so thank you ars for being so awful ultimately  by doing so you saved me roughly $5000.. also apparently management doesn't care I did reach out to them right after to let them know and they haven't bothered to return my call ... so unless you like to be scammed and throw money away I would avoid this company at all cost.... EDIT since I can't reply to the response ...The issue is your employees rude and unprofessional attitude and I believe an over $5000 difference is a little more then a "budget friendly" concern it's scamming your customers   But I guess you can call it whatever you want but based on the other reviews it's seems to be a common practice for you all

reviews.author: Sade S.
reviews.text: Skip ARS and go to Lee Company. I paid $142 for a service with Lee Company that ARS tried to charge $419 for as a member. Here's the story. I had a gas leak in my house coming from behind my stove. ARS came out on a Saturday and told me that I needed a new flex hose. As a member I had to pay $85 for them to come out and tell me that. The technician named Ryan told me that he didn't have a flex rod on his truck so someone will have to reach out to me on the following Monday to schedule another technician to come out and replace it. He quoted me $334 to replace a flex hose. I felt that was a bit expensive so I googled the hose and found out it only costs $36-38 at Home Depot and Lowes. Now I understand that the company has to make some sort of profit to function but to over charge me as a member was not right. Nevertheless I still was going to allow them to fix it. No one called me Monday, I had to call them. They told me a technician would come Tuesday between 5-7pm. At 308pm on Tuesday the office called to say the technician is in route to my house coming from Clarksville. I live in Antioch. By 530 I call them and ask is he still coming? No one has arrived yet. I was told yes he was in the Whites Creek area. At 6:57 no one had shown up so I called again. I spoke with Brandy several times. She said they don't know where he is.. wtf? At about 730 Brandy calls me back and says oh the technician went home. They then tell me that they put me on the schedule for 10am the next day. By noon the next day no one called me so I called them again and to Brandy's surprise they dropped the ball again. So I spoke with her manager Anthony I believe. He said Ryan would come that day and do the agreed upon service. No offer to discount the service at all for my inconvenience. At this point I'm over it and I decided to cancel my membership. I spoke with David who was awesome. He tried to "fix" the situation and went back to Anthony who then offered to take off $100. I still canceled and reached out to Lee company who was able to get it done the same day. In total with the diagnostic fee and flex hose replacement I paid a total of $142 with Lee Company. ARS total would have been $419 ( $85 diagnostic fee as a member plus $334 for the flex hose replacement). I don't appreciate being overcharged like that. Not to mention this was not the first time a technician never showed up when they were supposed to. I recommend that you contact Lee Company instead of ARS if you value your time and money.

reviews.author: Mitchell T.
reviews.text:
Worst possible experience with a terrible company. 2 No call No shows, 2 promises for supervisor call, 0 follow thru or delivery of services. And no recourse to make things right with the customer.

Scheduled an appointment for Friday between 8am-12pm. Dispatch (Michael) called me at 11:30am saying that they received "more important and vital" calls for service that morning and asked if I could re-schedule. I told them that my kitchen sink overflowing was an emergency and that I needed to keep the appointment. He told me they couldn't honor their commitment. They re-scheduled me for Sunday between 10am-12pm and said someone would reach out if something came available on Saturday. I called their office Friday night and they said dispatch would call me shortly to push my scheduling up for Saturday. They never did.

Sunday rolls around and by 12:30pm no one had called or showed up. I called back to the office and they said dispatch would call me shortly. At 2pm I receive a call saying that "they had a technician call out sick and I would need to re-schedule." Reschedule? Reschedule to a time when no one would show up again? Yeah right. They couldn't have called me that morning to let me know so that I didn't waste more time waiting for them? He said he was sorry and that a supervisor would reach out to me the next day (Monday). It's Tuesday, and no one has reached out

I called their office again to try and escalate the situation to yet again another supervisor and/or office of finance. Britney said they would reach out to me first thing Monday morning. It's Tuesday, and no one has reached out.

I took off hours from worked and moved around family time over the weekend to be available for them to fix the issues they promised to fix. Obviously, "more important and vital" calls means more $$$ and priority customers. Their excuse was that the recent winter storms (which were 2 weeks ago now) caused them backups in scheduling. Why would you schedule me in the first place if you're backed up? And moreso, why would you accept new calls for service when you already scheduled me?

I'm lost time, money, and patience. Never EVER use this horrible company. I hope no one has the same worst-case experience with them and that as many people as possible are drawn away from doing business with Rescue Rooter by reading this review. Wish I could give negative stars.

reviews.author: Dave C.
reviews.text:
As the original installers of my HVAC package in 2018, I called ARS for repair as my 5-ton unit stopped cooling on August 13.  The tech arrived around 7:30 in the evening.  He quickly assessed my unit was low on R410A coolant.  He assumed a leak and said he could re-charge the unit at $171 per pound.  He couldn't tell me how much was needed.  While $171 per pound was painful, I had no choice as the downstairs of this large house was quite warm.  He added the coolant incrementally while gauging the temp from the vent inside.  Once satisfactory, he told me 5 pounds were required; he did not have time to test for a leak but would have a return visit scheduled for the test.  I paid $855 for the coolant and $99 for the service fee.  My system stopped cooling again 5 days later.  My subsequent call to ARS revealed a schedule for the test had been set but no date available to me.  I asked about the price of R410A, the rep said she couldn't quote over the phone and deferred to the tech.  I had researched the rate range and was prepared to discuss.  I got the tech from the previous week on the phone and announced the system wasn't cooling again but the rate he charged was more than twice the average.  In fact, a competitor quoted $69 per pound.  He offered his rate tables to me, I declined because they're unique to ARS and aren't meaningful.   I've made two attempts to have Customer Service call me as they have no direct contact information.  I never received the call.  

I'm reasonable and understand loaded cost for labor and materials.  I understand that a large organization will have larger loaded cost and will pay happily unless gouged.  My concerns are:
1)  Heavily marked coolant---more than twice that of competitors.
2) No ability to validate the amount of coolant used----simply see the result entered by the tech on the invoice.
3)  During the repair process, the tech revealed he has the option to make commission overly hourly rates; whichever is greater----I'm concerned the rate is a floating one and is decided upon the tech's arrival.
4) No return calls by Customer Quality Assurance-----attempted twice.

I've engaged a competitor; there is an audible leak from the evaporator.  Now awaiting a part.  No new coolant in the interim as it will simply go into the atmosphere.

synthesis.summary: Coin-flip technician quality with a pattern of no-shows, price gouging attempts documented at 2-5x competitor rates, and 1,573 BBB complaints in three years — not the company you want making decisions at 2am.
strengths: At least 3 reviews cite same-day or next-day emergency response for water heater and HVAC failures, with proactive callback updates on technician arrival
Individual technicians (Jerad, Casey, Derek, William) receive repeated praise for professionalism and clear explanations when the right person shows up
National infrastructure means they answered calls on Sundays and holidays in multiple positive reviews
weaknesses: Pricing is frequently 2-5x competitors: one reviewer paid $203 elsewhere after ARS quoted $710, another paid $142 vs ARS's $419, a third got a $10,000 sewer quote that two other plumbers called completely unnecessary
Multiple reviews describe units still malfunctioning after repeated service visits spanning years, including one customer who had 10+ visits on a single Carrier unit with no resolution
redFlags: At least 6 of 75 reviews describe no-call no-shows on confirmed appointments, including cases where ARS rescheduled unilaterally via text without customer consent

Multiple reviewers allege upselling to full unit replacement ($5,000–$15,000) when simple maintenance fixed the problem — including one documented case where a competitor cleaned coils and added coolant for roughly $200 vs ARS recommending full replacement

1,573 BBB complaints in 3 years despite an A+ rating is an extreme volume for a service company — one reviewer was sent to collections despite having paid by credit card, with no billing contact number available
One reviewer credibly alleges a technician threatened to sabotage their home warranty claim if they didn't purchase ARS's cleaning service
synthesis.emergencyNotes: They did respond same-day on a Sunday for a burst water heater with proactive arrival updates — genuine emergency capacity exists — but the no-show pattern (multiple confirmed appointments abandoned without notice) means you could be left with a burst pipe and no plumber at 3am.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.5 stars across 4,275 reviews while Yelp shows 1.5 stars across 100 reviews and BBB logs 1,573 complaints in three years — a severe contradiction suggesting Google's volume may be diluting or obscuring a significant pattern of serious service failures.

reviews.author: John Yousif
reviews.text:
I recently hired this plumbing service for a leaking pipe under my kitchen sink, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the first phone call, Justine was professional, friendly, and quick to schedule an appointment. She made the whole process smooth and stress-free.
When Brandon arrived, he was right on time, explained the issue clearly, and provided a fair estimate before starting the work. He was knowledgeable, efficient, and made sure everything was fixed properly. What really impressed me was how clean and organized he kept the workspace — no mess left behind.
The repair was completed faster than expected, and the pricing was transparent with no hidden fees. It’s such a relief to find a reliable team you can trust.
I will definitely use their services again and highly recommend Brandon and Justine to anyone looking for honest, high-quality plumbing work

reviews.author: BOB SMITH
reviews.text: I called S&J Plumbing to repair a leak that developed behind the wall in our bathroom. Joe was able to get me on the schedule and sent Mark Lindeman out a few hours later. Mark was very nice, very knowledgeable, talented and informative. He noticed our tankless water heater and knew the unit and started telling us about it and how it needs to be maintained (I had no idea) and suggested other items he noticed that could be issues in the future. He wasn’t being a pushy salesman - just an experienced advisor. He did an excellent job with the repair and he was a pleasure to speak with. I definitely recommend S&J Plumbing and, in particular, Mark Lindeman. Thank you for fitting us into todays schedule.

reviews.author: Tammy Motin
reviews.text:
I called S&J Plumbing as I had a great experience with them in the past.  Plumbing issues can be so stressful, and Art, the technician that came to our home today, was so patient and thorough in every area, from diagnosis, to a repair that took several hours, coordinating a *second team for another issue, and in offering multiple recommendations to make sure the problem with our lines wouldn’t happen again.

Art told me that he really enjoys his work, and it is very satisfying when he can help resolve issues for customers, and that truly showed today.  I am never at a loss for words, but I can’t begin to tell you what a great job he did today, and today involved a lot of hard work.

In addition, *Mike N and Justin arrived a few hours into the job to replace a key piece of cast iron that sits between the toilet and the main line.  I had no idea how many aspects there were to that piece of the job, and Mike and Justin also exceeded my expectation in every way.

Mike and Justin were equally friendly and knowledgeable, and told me they also really enjoy their work and find it very rewarding to help solve customer’s plumbing issues.

These gentlemen didn’t miss any details and at the end, didn’t rush out, but thoroughly cleaned the job site, and put everything away for me.  It is very obvious these three gentlemen take great pride in their work and in their company.
I highly recommend this company.

The picture that I included in my review is “after”.  Had I been able to take a picture of the “before” you would have seen piles of sopping wet towels trying to stop a flooded floor from causing additional damage.

reviews.author: Georgia McGuire
reviews.text: Had to have all our galvanized pipes replaced with copper pipes. Starting with Nick who came out to check out the problem and give us an estimate to Dennis and Robbie who came to our home and did a phenomenal job. Both Dennis and Robbie  were pleasant, professional and courteous. Answered all our questions and gave us a tour of what they did and what they were going to do. I felt comfortable with both of them and their knowledge of our problem was exceptional. The clean up afterwards was wonderful and I would recommend SandJ for any plumbing problems you have or may encounter in the future. They are definitely our go to plumbers for any future problems. All three men were great representatives of the company.

reviews.author: Eleanor Park
reviews.text: Nick Y and Nick L did a massive 2 day job in my crawl space with excellence, professionalism, and great craft. They explained everything as they worked, left my place very clean during and after, answered all my questions and concerns. I feel like my home is safe for years to come.

reviews.author: Matthew Kooperman
reviews.text: I’m a new homeowner and six months into homeownership the thermostat and sensor on the old 9 year old water tank died. I called Four Seasons and they were out within 2 hours to evaluate my situation and make recommendations. I could either repair the old water tank which would be the band-aid approach with no guarantees something else wouldn’t go wrong or I could opt to replace with an entirely new water tank. I went with the second option and 24 hours later one of Four Seasons’ affiliated companies Advantage Plumbing was back at my house removing the old tank and installing a new tank that will hopefully last for as long as I own the home. I appreciate that Four Seasons was there for me when I needed help in an emergency and the level of communication from the service technician who came out to evaluate my situation was great. He didn’t try and upsell and he was honest and straightforward about my options. The service was really excellent. The install job 24 hours later went smoothly. I was relieved to have hot water again!  I ended up having a question about the billing invoice that customer service was unable to answer and I requested a callback from a manager and the manager called back which helped and I appreciated. Thank you. Five star experience. I definitely recommend Four Seasons and Advantage Plumbing.

reviews.author: David Montee
reviews.text: Excellent work replacing my full HVAC system with new furnace, air conditioner, humidifier and UV lamp.  Install was done and looks very professional.  My installer Kasper was polite and did exceptional work.  Thank you!  New system is operating perfectly and exceeds my expectations.  Thank you Four Seasons

reviews.author: Patricia Davis
reviews.text:
Excellent service from the salesperson Mr. Williams who came out to my home. The next day followed by the two technicians came out to install my furnace. Excellent performance all across-the-board they get a 10 out of 10. Thank you so much for having qualified technicians who come out to my home to guarantee safety and make sure that I am safe in my home after they leave by doing qualified work!!
Thank you Four Seasons your Company and your Services are the BEST ( 10 ) all across the board!!

reviews.author: Keshara Tyson
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Four Seasons, and I truly appreciate their outstanding customer service. reviews.text: I don’t know why i their webste they have 5 starts review, they must be fake. Im a real customer with a real review. The technician put a snake down the pipe and after 30 minutes she told me that she couldn’t get the snake pass 15 feet.She told me that probably my pipes were collapsed. reviews.text: What a wonderful experience. I came home from work and there was a leak in my ceiling underneath my upstairs bathroom. I called another company and they couldn’t come out until tomorrow morning. I called Roto-Rooter and they could come out right away. They were there within two hours. Earl was the technician and he was fantastic. he had to remove a piece of drywall and some trim to get to the leak. He found it right away and was able to fix it within an hour and a half and then he put the drywall back and fixed the trim and cleaned everything up. I could hardly tell that he had been there. I’ve had some bad experience with other plumbers in the past, and I think I just found me a new company to stick with. Earl and Roto Rooter did a great job. Thank you so much.

By the way, my technician was just as friendly as he could be also.  Great Experience with these Rot-Rooter

reviews.author: Megan Mementowski
reviews.text: We have been having problems with our toilet being slow to drain and gurgling. We had a gentleman out and he determined that the septic tank is full and needed a pump. We just had ours pumped two months prior so they came back out and informed us it was at normal operating levels and it is something else. Very frustrating to have a plumber out who may not be knowledgeable on various system components. The tech was nice but just frustrating to be charged for his "consult" when that wasn't truly the problem.

reviews.author: Laurel Wolf
reviews.text: Jacob was great. He was professional and respectful. However, I still can't understand how we were charged over $700 to repair 2 electrical outlets. When I called to discuss my price with a manager, I was told the workers need to support their families. I will never use their services again. Very dishonest in my opinion.

reviews.author: Adrianne
reviews.text:
I had an emergency situation when I noticed one of my dogs kept going to the same spot outside. When I walked over, I could hear water running before I even saw anything. I went into the basement and found water spewing everywhere from a split pipe connected to our outdoor spigot. I immediately shut off the main water valve and called J & J Plumbing Heating Cooling & Electric.

They were able to dispatch David C. to my home in LaGrange, Ohio the same day within a few hours. David was extremely professional, friendly, and patient. He explained everything in detail as he assessed the situation and showed me where the pipe had split in multiple places, even though we had turned off the shutoff and removed the hose well before winter.

He didn’t have PEX on his truck that day, so he safely capped the PVC pipe so we could turn our water back on and scheduled a return visit to complete the permanent repair. When he came back, David replaced the damaged section with PEX to allow for better expansion if freezing occurs, installed a much better shutoff valve, and even relocated the pipe farther inside the house to reduce the risk of this happening again. He confirmed there were no leaks and waited to make sure everything was working properly, which gave me real peace of mind.

He wore boot covers every time he entered the house, kept the area clean, and was very respectful of our home. Pricing was explained upfront with full transparency. While they may be slightly higher than some, the quick response, professionalism, and quality of work absolutely made it worth it.

I would definitely call J & J again and highly recommend David C. and their team.

reviews.author: Caitlyn Petros
reviews.text: Adam W. came and fixed a leak we had from our washing machine, it leaked into our garage and into our basement. He went above and beyond to fix it that same day and clean everything up (including disposing of a mattress topper that soaked up all the water that was leaking). We liked him so much and thought he did such a great job we had him come back out to do a full house plumbing inspection for us. He was thorough, efficient, knowledgable, friendly, and even flushed our HWT for us because it needed done. He went through the whole inspection report and made sure we understood everything. He is very laid back and you can tell he has been doing this profession for a long time with how easily he explained everything to us. I work from home and have two little girls and I feel so comfortable being home with him here working (which is huge for us Moms)! He wasn't just trying to sell us anything or get money out of us, he told us exactly what needed done and why, and also what order to do everything so we don't run into any more issues. I highly recommend for J&J for all your plumbing, electric, and HVAC needs. We use them for everything!

reviews.author: Dan Storch
reviews.text:
It's funny how things work, I used this company due to the vast amount of positive reviews (they inundate you with texts and emails post service to give said 5 star reviews). It costs $100 for them to walk in your door every time (standard fee they charge). Called for a simple fix to my corroding / occasional dripping below the
kitchen faucet. Guy said there's no issue and no real fix needed. Then instead of fixing the issue they want to look at all your appliances/water fixtures to try and sell you on expensive/unneeded repairs. 2 weeks later the kitchen faucet was leaking bad after a couple days of non-use.! called and the lady was very rude and said they would have to charge $100 service fee again plus then any fix that was needed. Mind you a local plumber just fixed the simple issue for $140 total.
So in theory if they came back I would've been down $200 PLUS the work needed to fix the faucet. Please beware they want to sell you on a yearly service plan and charge ridiculous fees to not even fix the issue. Do not recommend

reviews.author: G Pohly
reviews.text:
Adam L and Clay were fabulous! Courteous, polite, and clear communicators. The initial service call was to fix a kitchen drain with a clog and fix a leaky faucet. After Adam L and Clay did their pre-service inspection , they were so open to discussing different solutions with the pros and cons, I also had them replace the shut-off valves because they were old and hard to turn. I decided to replace the leaky faucet all together instead of trying to replace the cartridge to see if that would fix the leak or not, because if it didn't I had to buy a new faucet anyway. The other services I believe were fairly priced. The cost for the new faucet, not so much, but the work wouldn't be guaranteed if I provided the faucet .  I have had so many bad plumbing mishaps over the years, I decided to let the professionals do the install and have the two - year guarantee.
Honestly, if Adam L and Clay had not been as honest and polite as they were, I would not have had anything done except unclogging the kitchen drain.

We’ve also had our furnace and well serviced through J&J, and every visit has been just as smooth and professional. The team is reliable, knowledgeable, and respectful of our home.

Highly recommend J&J if you’re looking for dependable service and peace of mind knowing everything is handled by one trusted company!

reviews.text: Called them last week for a quote on a well pump, they canceled day of the estimate. They rescheduled me for Monday morning. Wasted an entire day waiting around for these clowns.

reviews.author: Erin Carter
reviews.text:
I had a frustrating experience with Wyatt Works and wanted to share it for others to consider. After inspecting our sewer line, the contractor identified root intrusion and presented three tiers of repair options: roughly $7,000 for a partial repair, around $21,000 for a more extensive (about 80%) repair, and $32,000 for a full system replacement. Each option was paired with a monthly payment estimate, which made the conversation feel more focused on financing than on clearly understanding the scope of work.

While I understand that different levels of repair can be necessary depending on the condition of the pipes, I didn’t feel like there was a thorough effort to walk me through less invasive or more cost-effective approaches in a clear, balanced way. The situation was presented in a way that felt overwhelming and urgent, and it left me feeling pressured rather than informed.

After getting additional opinions, we learned there were significantly more affordable options available that did not involve tearing up our floors or committing to a full replacement. That made the initial recommendations feel more aggressive than necessary.

I would strongly recommend that anyone facing a similar issue get a second opinion and ask detailed questions about all possible solutions before making a decision.

Edit: I’d also like to note, the prices quoted do not even include the cost to put everything back together. We could have paid 30 grand for them to rip up the basement floor and shower to fix the issue, then would have had to hire different people to put everything back together.

reviews.author: Sue Shane
reviews.text:
I have previous happy experiences with Wyatt Works and today was no exception. Kyle came out and repaired a damaged power line and installed new outdoor poles and light fixtures. He was meticulous and took extra time to find and order a new kitchen fan. I can say wholeheartedly that this company is fair, honest and performs outstanding work. They are our go-to company.

Our salesman, Adam Shunk was not only knowledgeable, professional, and on time, he was personable. He carefully explained what the process was, what he could do today to assess the problem and how things would go in the next steps. We couldn’t be happier! (Ok, no one is happy about a big plumbing issue, but we are confident that Wyatt Works will be able to fix it all!)
When we had all the interior and exterior sewer lines replaced, we got a text each time a technician was on the way and and email with their photo and bio. Communication was so good! But all the guys working on this big project were so kind and so expert, I can't say enough. I'd like to do a special thank you to Zac, who brought his power washer after they were done to clean up the muddy remains on the driveway.

Today (5/30/25) Trenton Hauenstein from Wyatt Electrical came out and fixed the wiring in a bathroom we are re-doing. He was professional, well prepared and made the helpful suggestion to add a light in the shower. I am thrilled!

reviews.author: mary samardzija
reviews.text:
We truly appreciate your team being able to come out on such short notice—it made a stressful situation so much easier to handle.

The plumber who initially came out was professional, courteous, and clearly knowledgeable. Shortly after, the technician who returned with the camera was just as impressive. Together, they quickly identified the issue, resolved it efficiently, and took the time to explain everything along the way.

What really stood out was not just fixing the immediate problem, but also offering thoughtful solutions to help prevent future issues. That level of service and care does not go unnoticed.

And if all that isn’t enough - the special that was running was unbeatable. I honestly was waiting for a “catch” when they arrived but no catch, just phenomenal service.

You’ve earned a customer for life—thank you again for the prompt, professional, and reliable service.

reviews.author: Rashtay Rashtay
reviews.text: Mike O. Is the best plumber I’ve ever encountered in 63 years. It was clear that Mike is experienced and has an indomitable work ethic.  I benefitted from his wealth of knowledge. I really need 10 stars to reflect my total satisfaction! Mike exceeded my expectations in all categories. He also fixed a couple of little things that probably don’t mean much to the plumber, but mean a lot to me. Mike was patient and answered all of my questions in a manner that a laymen can understand. He also gave me insight about what to do or not do, with an eye to the future. Ultimately, I saved money just from his insights. Mike O. Of WyattWorks is now going to be my plumber, for life! Thanks, Mike.

reviews.author: Justin Morgan
reviews.text: Courtney is truly the best with understanding and communicating the processes. I had a major blockage from my shower and toilet and  Wyatt Works was here the next afternoon. Ben was very curious about the issue and even asked to greet my dog to offer comfort. Ben had to utilize multiple points of entrance to clear the clog and did a portion of the work in the rain. All this at his last stop on a Friday afternoon. Phil also came and ran a camera through the line to show exactly what's going on and offer long term solutions. Genuinely could not be happier with the entire team. Will be sharing my experience with anyone who will listen. Wyatt Works has a customer for life!

reviews.author: Mary Thornton
reviews.text: We had an emergency plumbing need at our home and Wyatt Works Plumbing was assigned for the work order via AFC home warranty services. While AFC provided horrific customer service and actually lost a customer today as a result, Wyatt will remain our plumber when needed. Austin provided phenomenal professional service. Where AFC dropped the ball and denied coverage to simply fix a leaking toilet faucet line and catcher, Wyatt did AND provided a Managers Discount. Austin was courteous from the start, explained what his services would entail, documented the issue with photos and when completed. We give them a 10 out of 10 for sure! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Margaret Bynane
reviews.text: Wyatt came out promptly as was messaged in advanced, but was not able to give a price on a tankless electric water heater which is what I had originally requested on the phone. Obviously, there was mid communication. They did give a quote on a gas tankless water heater and a regular replacement water heater which I did appreciate. Apparently electric tankless electric water heater are not reliable enough for this company to provide or install. I do appreciate their honesty and advice about tankless water heaters but will not have anything done at this time. There was no charge for coming to the house to check the present setup. Thank you

reviews.author: Roberto Marino
reviews.text: This is the second time that I use WyattWorks Plumbing and the second time that Dave provided my service. The first time, the service was for my home: replacing a water heater and adding an expansion box. The second time was for my daughter’s home: a split packing nut. In both instances, Dave provided excellent and timely service. What I loved about this second visit was that Dave explained to my daughter what he was doing and why he was doing it. He could have focused his attention on me, as the male at the household, but he focused his attention on my daughter as the homeowner.

reviews.author: Linda Campbell
reviews.text: The work completed by Jean was exceptional.   I knew WyattWorks Plumbing had a strong customer service reputation but I was blown away by the service performed.   As part of Jean’s inspection, he even identified a problem that would have caused significant damage if not corrected.  And the problem that I called about originally was corrected perfectly.   He left our home better than when he arrived.   WyattWorks  now has a customer for life and I have already told my children about our experience and plan to tell my friends!  Exceptional Company, Exceptional Service!

reviews.author: John Crocker
reviews.text:
I recently had Jesse McBride from WyattWorks out to my home to tackle a kitchen drain line that has been a recurring headache for years. Jesse was the definition of professional—he didn’t just offer a quick fix, but took the time to reroute the line properly.
He was incredibly knowledgeable, detailing all my options and making sure every question I had was answered before he started. It is a huge relief to finally have this resolved. If you need a plumbing technician who is thorough and respectful of your home, ask for Jesse at WyattWorks. Highly recommended!

synthesis.summary: Exceptional workmanship and honest pricing when they show up, but there's a documented failure to honor emergency appointments — including a flooded basement left waiting 4 days.
strengths: 3 of 5 reviewers highlight thorough, no-pressure diagnostics — one specifically notes techs don't push unnecessary repairs
Multiple reviews praise post-job verification, with one tech triple-checking for leaks and confirming a drain clog was fully cleared, not just temporarily
Communication praised across 4 of 5 reviews, including proactive follow-up calls from management and detailed text updates throughout the job
weaknesses: 1 of 5 reviews documents a broken emergency promise: scheduled morning appointment for a flooded basement was pushed back 4 days without resolution
redFlags: The single 1-star review describes a flooded-basement emergency where a confirmed morning appointment was unilaterally cancelled and rescheduled 4 days out — exactly the scenario you're in at 2am with a burst pipe
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No reviews confirm after-hours or overnight emergency response; the one explicit emergency call in the dataset ended badly, with a flooded basement appointment delayed 4 days — treat emergency availability as unverified.

plumbers.address: 1891 Slaughter Rd, Madison, AL 35758, USA

reviews.author: Richard Drewyor
reviews.text: JR and his team replaced our 40-year-old HVAC ductwork system in the crawl space. It took them about 6 hours to complete the job. They did an excellent job. Everything is working well now with good air flow and better temperature control. When they finish the job he explained everything that was done. We are happy with the work. We highly recommend him and his team for this work.

reviews.author: stephany sinai
reviews.text: Clark did an outstanding job at installing my google nest camera. He was professional and troubleshooted some issues until the work was complete. I truly appreciate him going above and beyond.

reviews.author: Kelion '___'
reviews.text: Hiller took our call at 9pm when we were having issues with our AC and had a technician out next day. They send a notification when the technician is on the way and you can track the time before arrival. They were here during the time slot alloted and didn't run over. Sloan was a great help and got everything squared away quickly. Will be recommending them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Dawna P.
reviews.text: We had them out to clear backed up drains they charged us $199.00 and the next day they were backing up again. They did come back and clear them at no additional charge and we got a quote for a repipe.  Needless to say they backed up again so we called a different company and paid another $200.00 and had them give us a quote which was a LOT less than Hiller,  we are doing the repipe and new water heater with this other company.

reviews.author: Jeff R.
reviews.text: I'm a disabled Iraq veteran.  When my old HVAC bit the dust I was recommended an independent veteran for veterans contractor to help rectify the situation.  Turns out it was a scammer who wasn't licensed, never fully installed the unit, took my money, & ran.  I called on Hiller to help me to complete the installation of the unit I was left with.  The technician they sent out did an initial inspection, & when he called it in to his higher ups about the situation  they told him, "NO! Don't touch it. Tell the guy to keep calling the guy who scammed him to complete the installation."  They literally told me to keep calling on a guy who had robbed me to complete the job.  That's the compassion you can expect from Hiller.

reviews.author: Becky F.
reviews.text:
Wonderful company and I called around to several places and this was by far the cheapest to get my A/C looked at. He got it up and running again in a short period of time, he also did not harass me to buy anything or make me feel obligated to do this or that. He understood I needed to speak with my husband before decisions were made. I respect that so much because it makes me as a customer feel better about the decisions I'm making. 
They also send a text and email for an appointment reminder. Call and text when the technician is on their way. In the text you receive the technicians name and picture as well so you know who you're letting in your home.
I want to add I signed up for their Happy Hiller Club also and got 10% off as well as diagnostic fee waived. For $23 a month they'll come out twice a year to check the A/C and heat and once a year to check the electrical portions of my home and do a tune up and once a year to do a tune up of all of my plumbing including emptying my hot water heater and clearing all of the sediment out. There is no diagnostic fee and you get 10% off of whatever they do. You earn $100 a year in hiller cash that you can accumulate and say if you keep the contract with them for 10 years you have $1000 saved up in Hiller Cash and you need a new A/C unit you can put that $1000 towards it plus the 10% off. Oh and you get priority scheduling because your a member

reviews.author: Roger M.
reviews.text:
Our AC was getting quite loud and had not been serviced in a couple of years, so I decided it was time for preventative maintenance before our summer heat. I called Hiller first based on their reviews. Good move. Everyone was very professional, from the first call through the end of the project.
Eric came out the next day, did a full inspection and offered some suggestions. Absolutely no attempted hard sell, or attempt to sell anything. What most impressed me was his pride in working for Hiller, respect for their training system, and respect for the owner.
I decided to check the cost of a complete replacement and a project representative, Corey came out. He had the same attitude as Eric, and we negotiated a very fair deal. 
Three days later, JR and his crew arrived with my new system. Polite, professional, well trained. 
You have to respect a company with so many people who are so happy and proud to work there.

reviews.author: Cason T.
reviews.text: The secretary that answered the phone was very nice and helped me schedule an appointment for the next day. Our gas hot water heater went out and we needed replaced asap! The following day two guys came out and while they were polite, they were constantly trying to sell us additional things other that just replacing the hot water heater they had requested. The tried selling us a water pressure regulator that had just been replaced not even two months ago. The hot water was installed in about an hour and we paid $1,400 to have done. Overall it was an okay experience, the water heater is working great, but not the biggest fan of constantly being told all the other things that we needed to have done. Would use again but only for what I needed done.

reviews.author: David R.
reviews.text: We have been working with Hiller for years and it is well worth it. We recently had an issue with a sink not draining. We had the house repiped by Hiller years ago but evidently a minor section of pipe was missed. This did not become noticeable until recently. We thought it was just a clogged pipe. A tech came out and ran through a number of issues for a simple clogged pipe but nothing worked. Then they kicked it up to Beau. He was able to diagnose the problem quickly and said they were scheduling an install team to come remove that old section of pipe at no cost to us. In the meantime he got us up and running until the main issue was fixed. Again, I can't believe that a company this day and age stands by their work like Hiller.

reviews.author: Eugene Thurman
reviews.text: Roy and RJ Robinson came out to assess my electrical issue. I had changed to LED lighting and wanted to use a Kasa switch the switch didn’t work and didn’t want to create a fire or electrical hazard so I called Hiller, my go to company. After about 20 minutes Roy figured out the problem and started the fix. Excellent job a bit pricey for assessing  and changing 2 switches. So if you call make sure it is worth having a professional or just call around to a small licensed Handyman for a small area. I always call Hiller because they are timely, honest, and if they cannot help they tell you up front usually at no charge. So for my family’s safety on electrical issues that DIY can’t handle, I call Hiller.

reviews.author: Ashley D.
reviews.text: Imagine this I buy a hot water heater from you - $4,000 less than a year ago. Due to your shotty install and finding out the hard way you did not insulate the pipes they burst.... During the freezing temps and flood your garage. And now you have no water at all due to the location of the pipe that burst. And the soonest you can get someone here is tomorrow night. Oh did I mention I pay $20 a month for servicing? oh and let me not forget the 15k spent on an hvac unit that you didn't bring a refrigerant line up to code that blew? And now we have a half ass welded hole in our 15k system? DONT CHOOSE HILLER

reviews.author: Mac J.
reviews.text:
Called for a bid and they arrived on time. From the start it felt like a sales pitch to sell me a tankless water heater installation. For $6400. I really wanted a conventional tank heater. The tankless brand is $1500-2500 cash and carry. Bid had Romex at $7 a foot, iron pipe at super inflated prices. Took three days to get back to discuss bid. I had already hired other qualified providers at much lower price by that time.  
these guys might do a great job but way over priced. Shop around. Plus the guy that finally called me back to answer questions got rude when I told him why I was going elsewhere.

reviews.author: Trent B.
reviews.text: do not use this company unless you want to get ripped off charged me 400.00 for recharging our ac system and trying to upsell us on a relay for our fan unit 160.00 that i had another company come out and said it was a fifteen dollar part and i didn't need it technician,at hiller said they drained my ac water drain tubes lier that other company 2 day later vacuumed out about a half a gallon i see why they have that smiley face on there van ripping people off and smiling all the way to the bank what a bunch of crooks

reviews.author: Wayne E.
reviews.text: Call to get electrical quote. Explained that a wall was removed and I needed outlets moved and added.  The tech arrived and said he needed a permit to perform work.  This was not explained when the appointment was scheduled. I was made to pay for he service fee and no quote was given.  They need to train their operators on the business to avoid wasting the consumers time.  When my contractor arrives next week I will not be calling happy Hiller (mad consumer) to do the work.

reviews.author: J H.
reviews.text:
My parents are older and needed help with a lighting issue while I was away. I called Hiller and explained what the situation was with the possible electrical issue and also that they would need to speak with me about handling the service and payment. 
Roy came out really quickly and was able to figure out the issue and fix the problem. I was able to use a $50 off coupon that I found on their site.  I would call them again for any future home problems.

synthesis.summary: Hiller answers calls at 9pm, dispatches next-day with real-time technician tracking, and consistently shows up on time — but zero pricing data across all 5 reviews makes cost a complete unknown before you call.
strengths: 3 of 5 reviews specifically praise punctuality and on-time arrival, with one reviewer noting technicians stayed within the allotted time slot
Confirmed after-hours responsiveness: took a call at 9pm and had a technician out the following day with live arrival tracking
Technicians go beyond the minimum — two reviews highlight troubleshooting persistence and thorough post-job explanations of completed work
weaknesses: Pricing is entirely absent from all 5 reviews — no reviewer mentions cost, quotes, or value, making it impossible to assess whether rates are fair for emergency or after-hours calls
redFlags: BBB shows 21 complaints in the past 3 years despite an A+ rating — an unusually high complaint volume for a company with otherwise glowing reviews, worth asking about billing or service resolution practices before authorizing work
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Confirmed 9pm call answered with next-day dispatch and real-time technician tracking; one review shows same-day responsiveness even for non-emergency AC issues, suggesting after-hours intake is a genuine operational practice rather than a one-off.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp has zero reviews, so no cross-platform comparison is possible; the 21 BBB complaints over 3 years are the only counterweight to an otherwise uniformly 5-star Google picture and warrant scrutiny.

plumbers.address: 3712 E 2nd St, Edmond, OK 73034, USA

reviews.author: Joshua Rutherford
reviews.text: Overall I had a good experience. The company had issue with the answering service getting the call out, so I had to wait a while longer than expected, but once they received it they were at my home within 30 minutes. The technician Amanda Sheppard was very professional, courteous and knowledgeable. What we found wasn't a simple fix, so I had to get multiple quotes. They were a little on the higher side as far as cost, but the warranty they offer was pretty good. If you needed a quick repair than I would definitely call them first, but if you need a major overhaul than it's always best to shop around.

reviews.author: Capt Dave
reviews.text: Levi and Dalton were very professional and friendly.  They quickly diagnosed the potential problem and solved it in no time.  They were protective of our property and cleaned up very well after the job was done. They asked if we had any questions about the job and solution and encouraged to call again if we had any other plumbing needs. Great representative of the company.  Oh, the price was very good!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text:
The boys did excellent. Great communication, interacted very well, very knowledgeable about the job that they were performing for the customer. They let me know every step that they were doing and I would recommend them again and again - great job team- keep up the good work. Remember team, customer service and respect is the number one goal in business.

Thank you , so much team look forward to hearing from you real soon on our next step. Tattoos were awesome....
C. Smith Family,

reviews.author: Anani Mouse
reviews.text:
Overcharging for simple repairs.  A gasket had come off PVC pipe under sink. Part cost less than $10, took different plumber 5 minutes to complete repair. Hi Tech/Air Comfort wanted to charge me $1100 and rebuild my sink drain that was installed last year. No thank you.
Their plumbers work on commission and they charge $800 an hour regardless of what the problem is. It’s like paying a plastic surgeon to remove a splinter.
For large elaborate repairs, I think they do great work, but for simple stuff, I’ll go elsewhere.

No one from your staff has reached out to me to discuss my complaint about your overcharging policies. You need to do better - be transparent, if you are going to charge a base rate of $800 an hour for ANY repair you need to have that on your website.

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.text:
Air Comfort Solutions manages this company. They blackmail you into giving them 5 star reviews because their technicians get 25$ if you do.

I’d give them 0 stars if I could. This company is the single worst thing to ever happen to me. They refused to attempt to clear a drain for me and instead sold me a 10,000$ service as a cheaper option than digging up my floor. they preyed on my fear and ignorance and their “solution” flooded my utility room and garage and doesn’t work even after they “fixed” it by replacing a part in the pump they used to bypass my floor drain. Another plumbing company cleared my drain for 230 dollars in less than an hour.

Never under any circumstances use this company for your plumbing needs. They are poorly managed and have poor ethical practices. Not to mention they’re extremely over priced even if you do happen to get lucky and not have them break or ruin something in your home.

reviews.author: Jackie T
reviews.text: Robert and Stephen were great at explaining what our quote would be for our house after a thorough inspection of our plumbing, inside and outside. There is currently an outside leak under the front patio slab. There had been another leak, in the same slab, a few years ago and repaired by another plumbing company. Due to leaks cropping up, and our house being 75 years old, we decided to have our house updated with new pex pipes, proper shutoff valves throughout our home and a salt free water treatment device installed that will substantially reduce our hard water problem. We will also be replacing our two old hot water heaters and one faucet kit for our bathtub. I think that's it. I'd have to look at our contract to see if I am missing anything. The installers are here now starting work. It will most likely take them two and a half days to finish doing the work.

reviews.author: James Hesketh
reviews.text:
Very knowledgeable, to the point and transparent.  Looking forward to the full solution they are going to provide.

The job is not over but I love the fact that there is attention to detail, every connection to the main sewer line is inspected and cleaned or repaired.  Highly recommend these guys!

Day 5, entire house solution to our sewage problem.  Issue solved.  Trenches sewer repair is the technology you should use.  Once again, this team rocked!  Professional, attention to detail and cleaned the areas they worked in.  Call ACS for the HighTech guys to correct any plumbing issues.  I will use them again.

reviews.author: Michael Toombs
reviews.text:
Gage was on time, very friendly & professional. He informed me that I’d receive an estimate from Jerred, which I received.

While I cannot afford the toilet prices provided, I would like to have Jerred remove the existing one, scope the sewer like, and quote a price on installing a clean-out.

If he is willing to install a toilet that I provide that’s great. Otherwise I will do it myself.

reviews.author: Nancy Parker
reviews.text: We had several people who could not connect water to our new refrigerator, Kaden knew what to do right away.  He gave use 3 options that could be done, explained the pros and cons of each one.   We chose the least expensive option.  He was very pleasant and knowledgeable.  We appreciated him very much.

reviews.author: brian benson
reviews.text: Amanda was my first contact and then Christian Randall came and did the installation. Both were excellent, very personable and professional. With that said, I do not like the a I scheduling system.I do believe it costs me close to fifteen hours.In getting service, I do not like the a I system

reviews.author: Crystal Tagoe
reviews.text: Very please with the service that I received. Daniel was the plumber that came to my house. He was very kind and  professional. He provided me multiple options to fix my problem. I will use  Hi-Tech Plumbing again. I will recommend to friends and family. Thank you again Daniel.

reviews.author: Harry Selph
reviews.text:
Jesus Hita, one of the managers of ACS came to my house late this afternoon and he personally made sure our problem was satisfactorily resolved. He is intelligent, skillful, knowledgeable and customer oriented. His ability speaks well for the entire organization.
Harry Selph

reviews.author: Holden Olerich
reviews.text: Super happy with the service from Air Comfort Solutions. The tech was friendly, respectful of my home, and took the time to walk me through the issue and fix. You can tell they take pride in their work. Made the whole process easy and stress-free. I’ll be using them again.

reviews.author: Tina K.
reviews.text:
Chad Cook and Hayden Cramer came by to address an issue with a grounding wire from a precious install. They very quickly fixed the concern at no charge.
Both were very courteous, professional, expedient and did an all around great job. Thank you to both of them!!!

reviews.author: Kim Andres
reviews.text: Brad Stoehr is the best! Brad is Courteous, attentive and thorough. He and Hi tech as a company do a great job that exceeds my expectations. Today’s job was a follow up inspection and repair of one small sink all of which took approximately one hour.

synthesis.summary: Hi-Tech Plumbing in Edmond is a large outfit with 3,300+ Google reviews and genuine expertise in complex jobs — sewer line excavation, slab repairs, and multi-day whole-house fixes. But the pricing complaints are real and specific: one reviewer was quoted $1,100 to fix a $10 gasket, another says technicians 'work on commission' at '$800 an hour regardless of what the problem is.' The most scathing 1-star review alleges a $10,000 pressure-bypass solution for a drain that another company cleared for $230. With 129 BBB complaints in 3 years, this is a company worth calling for big complex jobs — but get a second quote before signing anything.

Responsive on urgent calls — 'They were fast kind and thorough' on a sewage backup
