plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 25 Sweetbriar Rd suite A3, Greenville, SC 29615, USA

reviews.author: Josh Moeller
reviews.text: I had a water line break in a terrible spot under my house. You couldn't reach it from the crawl space and there was only a 20" hole in the foundation to access this pipe. Tyler came out in a Sunday and worked most of the day to fix it, but when the line repressurized, I went from having a small leak to a broken pipe. He told me that he was confident he could fix it but he needed a tool and some fittings he couldn't get till in the morning. He came back out Monday morning and worked till about one o'clock, but when he was done, I was leak free and the job looked good. The thing that really impressed me about Tyler was his attitude. It was a horrible job in a horrible space with horrible working conditions(it was between 35⁰ and 40⁰ outside and once the pipe broke, he was working in a mud hole). I said,  "For whatever it's worth, I'm sorry you got this job, but I'm glad you're here." He said, "It's just a job. We'll get it done, and for whatever it's worth, I'm sorry I couldn't get it fixed for you on Sunday." If you need a plumber, give 1-Tom-Plumber a call. They'll get you taken care of. Thanks again, Tyler.

reviews.author: Tripp James
reviews.text: Tyler was extremely professional and went out of his way to assist me on a weekend with snow, ice, and frigid temperatures.  Cannot thank him enough and highly recommend his services.

reviews.author: Craig Gilpin
reviews.text: I called to confirm a quote first thing in the morning and Matt and Tyler, we're able to be at our property at 1pm and had the whole new water heater install completed by 5:30. Additionally they upgraded our 40 gallon tank to a 50 free of charge as the 40 was unavailable on the day! Great, fast service and everything is working brilliantly. Thank you both we will definitely use 1-Tom-Plumber again!

reviews.author: Elle Cam
reviews.text: Tyler was courteous. He put something on his feet so he didn’t track dirt into the house. He was thorough and took the time to figure out the root cause of the problem. After having other plumbers come for the same situation (3 other times), I really appreciate Tyler’s process. Others left a mess for me to clean up, and patched work that should have been replaced, creating a larger problem for us. Thankful for Tyler’s work!

reviews.author: Sierra Carter
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of meeting Rooky and having him help my husband and I fix our bathroom. Rooky made this such an easy process for us, and was very informative and honest with his work. He is very trustworthy and I would recommend him to anyone who may need help with plumbing issues!

synthesis.summary: Tyler will crawl into a freezing mud hole on a Sunday to fix your pipe and apologize that he couldn't finish faster — this crew genuinely shows up when conditions are worst.
strengths: Weekend and adverse-weather response confirmed in at least 2 of 5 reviews, including snow, ice, and a Sunday water line break
Goes beyond the job scope at no extra cost — upgraded a 40-gallon water heater to a 50-gallon free of charge when the original was unavailable
Multiple reviewers highlight thoroughness and root-cause diagnosis, with one noting Tyler succeeded where 3 previous plumbers failed and left no mess behind
weaknesses: Not enough data to identify weaknesses — all 5 analyzed reviews are 5-star with no complaints about pricing, timing, or workmanship
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals across multiple reviews: confirmed Sunday response for a water line break, weekend callout during snow and ice, and same-day water heater installation completed within a business day — this crew demonstrably operates outside standard hours in difficult conditions.

reviews.author: JoBeth Dunaway
reviews.text:
Kenny an Dawson come out within 30 minutes .  Did a great job fixing a leak.  Service was quick and thorough.  Will always use this company. Every detail was explained to me, I approved, they did the work , now I a
m happy.   Thank you Kenny and Dawson job well done.  Thank you Around the Clock Plumbing for a remarkable team of technicians.

reviews.author: K.C. K
reviews.text: I can't thank James enough. He was able to figure out where our leak was coming from quickly (part of our water heater) and repair it at a fair quote. I appreciate his honesty and great work today. You guys were recommended to us by a family member on the spot this morning when I told them what was going on and I can see why. Thanks for saving this day from being an absolute disaster. The next time I need a plumber for anything you guys are my first call. Thank you.

reviews.author: maria gil
reviews.text: Fabion was very knowledgeable and found the leak quickly. He fixed it perfectly and explained everything along the way.Very professional. I called Aroynd the clock plumbing and they came in 1 hour!

reviews.author: Pamela C.
reviews.text: Before I had okay service but just the other day was not good. I had a leak at my meter, 3rd time in 17 months. June of last year a part broke and I called Around the clock, they came out and I paid almost 500 dollars to fix the leak and have a year warranty. The piece broke again this June just before the warranty ran out and they came and fixed it. I have no problem with them there, they stuck to their word except for what I found out later. But what I didn't know was the man who worked on it put the wrong piece on and after 5 months if couldn't take it anymore and cracked. The plumber who came out a few days ago told this to my husband that then said because it was on them it would only cost for parts. It was 385 dollars we paid for them to fix their own mistake (by the plumbers own words) we only got a 40 dollar discount. We did not just pay for parts. I'll be finding another plumber when undoubtedly this breaks too because like I said, this is the 3rd time they have come out for the same leak in 17 months.

reviews.author: Abby H.
reviews.text: They sent a tech to snake my pipe. He got it caught and on his attempt to get it out he broke a pipe.  Company claims it is the age of our house.  This is poor business to not cover it'. They left us with no use of our washer and dishwaher!

reviews.author: Stephanie P.
reviews.text:
Arthur and the team at Around the Clock Plumbing have our business FOR LIFE! They are prompt, honest, affordable, and experts in their field; also good people, to top it off.

We had recurring blockages in our main line that we finally decided to address, and after (mistakenly) calling another major plumbing company in town, we were out $500, main line blockage still not cleared, and being told that it was PROBABLY still the old iron main line which was causing the blockage and we should just replace it with PVC, for which they quoted us $8K-$15K. Needless to say, we were not thrilled and not about to commit to thousands of dollars of repairs on a "maybe that's the problem" solution.

Then we called Around the Clock. They arrived the same day, informed us they would not charge us for the main line clean out unless they could actually remove the blockage (what a concept!), and then proceeded to fix it within less than an hour - something the prior company could not do over two separate visits despite charging us hundreds of dollars to do so. They were also able to tell just by the "feel" of the pipes while snaking it that our main line was already PVC and not the old iron as the prior company had tried to suggest along with a $15K price tag. Because they were able to clear the blockage, the team at Around the Clock was able to determine the root of the problem (pun intended), and worked quickly, efficiently, and affordably to get it corrected. They even coordinated and worked with the City of Huntsville on our behalf, as some of the plumbing needs fell under the street in front of our home.

To Arthur and the entire team at Around the Clock, THANK YOU - for your expert knowledge, honest approach to your customers, and going truly above and beyond in what you do. We will recommend your services every chance we get!

reviews.author: Wendy W.
reviews.text: I just have to say, best plumbing company I have ever experienced.  Kasey and Chris were here to find a leak that was not easy to detect.  I noticed water in my Dining room ceiling and called Around the Clock Plumbing and they were here within ~ 30 minutes to shut the water off and begin work. Unbelievable!!!! This was not an easy task to find the pipe that was leaking, however, they were steadfast and able to find the leak and repair as quickly as possible. Their services and plumbers are impeccable and the gentlemen that worked in my home made me feel at ease through the whole process and explained everything as they worked.  They are so caring and treat you like family not forgetting how to be  professional.  I was also impressed that Kasey made sure to call me the next day after the leak was repaired to check to see if I had any more problems or had any questions.  The company office called as well to check on me.  I have found a plumber for life and recommend them to anyone out there that needs some work completed.  I am very satisfied and believe you will be too.  Thanks so much Kasey and Chris!!!

reviews.author: Derek S.
reviews.text:
Service Requested: I requested 3 things to be looked at during the plumber's visit, he fixed one thing within 10 seconds, which is something I could have done if I had known. The other thing, he told me the company charges 1,000 to run a water line to the fridge, which I later did myself in under 15 minutes, 70 bucks and a trip to home depot. And the last thing, he told me he wouldn't look at an appliance, even though I was pressing that it was most likely a plumbing problem.
So 1 star for service requested.

Value: Well I was charged 220 bucks for him doing the 10 second fix, and almost 1,000 for a line I installed quickly myself, so value I would say isn't right.

Quality: The people were very nice and the gentleman who came was very professional and cool. That was the only thing keeping me from giving a 1 star review.

At the end of the day, I didn't REALLY see any plumbing work, so I don't really know how they are with real plumbing.

But from my experience I would say look else where.

reviews.author: DesertRat332
reviews.text:
Micha and Jamari did an adequate job replacing my water heater.  I was disappointed that they installed a plastic drip pan with a large crack in it under the water heater.  I had to call them to come back out and this time they used a metal drip pan after reinstalling the water heater a second time.  I don't know why they didn't use a metal drip pan to begin with.  When they gave me the initial estimate they did not tell me that hauling away the old water heater would be an extra charge.  I thought I was paying enough for them to dispose of my old water heater. Now I have to wait a month for bulk pickup to remove the old one from my front yard.  I was also disappointed that the bill does not itemize parts and labor, it just gives a flat fee.
ATC called me and apologized for the misunderstandings.  Gave me a credit and the old water heater was picked up today.  I would highly recommend ATC plumbing for your plumbing needs.  They will make it right.

reviews.author: John G.
reviews.text: Very late on a Monday night we started to have toilets backup and had a significant amount of water in and outside our bathrooms. We called ATCP very early the next morning and were able to get an 8 am appointment. Jordan came out and quickly assessed the situation and said our main line was clogged. He snaked the line and cleared it so we were able to use our toilets again. At his suggestion, we also decided to have ATCP pump our septic tank.  Jordan also discussed several addition things that we might want to do to mitigate future problems. Dawson and Taylor came out later that morning quickly located the septic tank and dug up the hatch to it and pumped it. Jordan, Taylor, and Dawson did very thorough and fast work at a reasonable price. All three were polite and professional. We especially appreciate the promptness with which ATCP responded and solved our problem. We will definitely use ATCP again.

reviews.author: Emma Hollingsworth
reviews.text: This is my second experience with Around The Clock Plumbing. Neither time has been anything less than amazing. Ken came at 10 pm and exceeded literally any expectation we could’ve had. He fixed our pressure regulator valve (PRV) in maybe 15 mins and also helped us figure out further issues with freezing during the winter time (all while he should have been at home with his family). Everyone at Around The Clock Plumbing truly cares about the people that they are called to and Ken truly showed that in his work tonight. I can’t say enough, honestly. His kindness and knowledge went farther than any plumber I’ve ever experienced and I do not plan on using anyone else in the future based on price/relaibility/honesty.

reviews.author: Eva H.
reviews.text:
Nick is fantastic!  We had a seemingly undiagnosable (or very expensive) spigot problem around our pool.  Another plumber had quoted us THOUSANDS to fix it and said it would require jackhammering up our patio (for thousands more).  

We let it go until it became a geyser and were dreading what was to come.

We called Around the Clock, they worked us in quickly, and were very good about being responsive when we called to ask for an ETA a couple of times (we're those people...)

Regardless, Around the Clock came out, diagnosed it in no time, and we were in and out at an EXTREMELY reasonable price.  

We won't use anyone else for plumbers (and are alreading getting a quote for another issue...)

reviews.author: Teri J.
reviews.text: They are very professional and courteous on the phone and in person. They were on time both times they came. We had a problem with a leaky bathroom sink and called on a Saturday morning. I told Dana, the receptionist, that it wasn't emergency and to schedule someone for Monday. She called back a few hours later and said she could have someone out in 20 minutes if that was ok. I told her sure and he was there on time. Jake identified the problem immediately and came back when we requested him to put in the part/faucet when it came in. Jake was very knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. The price was reasonable. I would recomment them to anyone.

reviews.author: Tommy Yelland
reviews.text: Blew a pipe in my wall on a Saturday afternoon and called immediately. Casey and Hunter were there same day to get the initial fix done and the drying out process started. Hunter brought Tristan out later with him once the drying process was complete. Casey came back out with Andrew and Drew to do the full repair a few days later. All of the work was done exceptionally well and everyone who came out was extremely respectful of me and my home. I appreciate everyone who did the work and  helped me. I’ll only be using Around the clock going forward for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Tila Deitsch
reviews.text: We have had water pressure issues since we moved into our house 4 months ago and finally we’re doing something about it. we tried to do it on our own and ended up not being able to and losing water to our house for the night. We called around the clock and within 30 minutes they came and it took Ken maybe 20 to fix the issue. He was very kind and explained everything very clearly and even went above and beyond to help fix the water pressure after fixing the main water line. They were amazing and quick help and we are so so thankful to them!!

reviews.author: Grady Martin
reviews.text:
Todd, my Technician was great! He took the time to help me understand all that would need to be done. Very kind, polite and professional. He unclogged the washer line in my garage and did not leave til he knew I was very satisfied.
I was a little surprised with cost but was the first time having it done, and had to have it done, and Todd didn't pressure me at all about the cost.

reviews.author: Joel Brown
reviews.text: The Midway Plumbing staff was impressive from start to finish. Absolute best Customer Service, from Renee who took my initial request for service and kept me updated every step of the way to Alex the technician. Alex expert knowledge and ability to explain the entire process and answer every question and more importantly his ability to support his comments with written data.  His knowledge is only surpassed by his ability to install equipment in a timely manner.   Truly Awesome and Professional Team!

reviews.author: Scott Simpson
reviews.text:
I know enough about plumbing systems to know what questions to ask about some problems I was having. Two of the three issues I identified had to do with the 3” waste pipe under the house slab. I had already used an auger to clear a serious root intrusion and as my waste main is 60 years old, I was prepared for the worst. I would have given Midway the go-ahead for some seriously expensive work if their plumber told me it was necessary.
The Midway plumber scoped the 3” main from the city connecting point to the house vent pipe and explained everything we were seeing in a way I could clearly understand. He checked the work I had already done, carefully talked me out of doing either expensive project I had enquired about, and gave me some tips for improving the remaining flushing problem that was being caused by the 1.28GPM toilet.
The third project had to do with the incoming water supply. What I thought would improve the incoming water pressure and get a jump on a potential problem was diagnosed as a case of “If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it… and it ain’t broke.” I was wrong; he was right. He could have just done the work I requested and I wouldn’t have given it a second thought. Instead, he again clearly explained the issue and convinced me not to have the requested work done.
Summary: The Midway plumber was professional, courteous, knowledgeable, and honest. I now understand how they maintain such a high customer review rating.

reviews.author: Dan Flatt
reviews.text: I paid so little because I was not going to pay the $3400.00 to power wash a single line in the house then asked cost to replace 20’ of 2” pvc under a house with lots of space and no digging just remove cast iron and replace with pvc. Somehow the price was the same. I will never call them again. This is something I could do in about 45 minutes easily.

reviews.author: Kenneth Boutell
reviews.text:
Still leaks after you replaced cartridge which keeping the handlle in place was the only problem and two other fixes for over $800 supposedly fixed the problem.  Still leaks and the serviceman says it's the water and we need all new facets. He quoted $1065 for each new facet that's $2130 plus who knows what else will be charged.  I am not a wealthy oil baron, I had to work for fifty years to have what very little we have and can not just give it away. I find your charges exorbitant and will have to live with the leaky cartridge you installed. I don't even know if it was new.  Likely the last time I will call Midway and even though the servicemen
were pleasant, I would not be able recommend your company to others.

Had to shut the water off while we visited our children over the Christmas holidays. Based on cost only one star.

reviews.author: Crystal J.
reviews.text: I had a pretty serious plumbing problem at my house. I wouldn't call it an emergency, but it wasn't something I could wait around to fix. I called Midway and they assured me that they'd be at my house that day. I call 4 hours later to ask if I was still on the schedule and I was told "Nope, looks like it's going to be tomorrow." Thanks for the heads up, Midway. They left me stuck not being able to use my toilets, which is really great when you have two little ones in the house who pee constantly. I understand that things get busy, but enough notice that would allow me to call around to other places would have been nice. Needless to say, I called someone else. I certainly won't be trusting Midway ever again. If they can't be trusted or bothered to give their customers a call to let them know that the schedule has changed, then I most definitely will not trust them to not rip me off.

reviews.author: Sara B. Montgomery
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I can’t say enough good things about Midway Plumbing!  After the City of Clyde told me multiple times that my high water usage was “clearly a leak” and that I needed to call a plumber, I contacted Midway. They sent a technician out the very next day.

The tech was extremely kind, polite, and thorough. He took the time to investigate everything and determined there was no leak at all. Even with the valve completely shut off, the meter was still reading about 1.5 gallons per minute. He went above and beyond by checking all faucets, toilets, and showers just to be sure.

What really stood out was that he called the city back out and personally showed them what they had missed and couldn’t figure out themselves. Because of him, the real issue was finally identified.

If you want an honest, knowledgeable company that truly advocates for their customers, I highly recommend Midway.

reviews.author: Patricia M.
reviews.text: I called Midway Plumbing to install a new kitchen faucet because my old faucet was leaking. My house is six years old, so all hoses and pipes are in good condition. Upon arrival, the two young men assessed the situation, assured me that everything looked good and that they would only need to replace the faucet with the new one I had purchased. They gave me the price and asked me to sign so they could begin the work. They were charging me almost $700 to do a simple faucet installation. This is a job that would have taken approximately 15 minutes for an experienced plumber. Of course, I was not paying that ridiculous charge if I never have a new faucet!! I did, however, have to pay $89 for the 5 minutes the two young men were in my home. This is the most ridiculous experience I have ever had with a home service provider!! Do not get ripped off by this plumbing company!!!

reviews.author: Henry R.
reviews.text: First I have to say that I don't live in Abilene and I am a plumber in San Antonio but of course I do have family that lives there. I get a call from my uncle and I am trying to Sunday quarterback him trying to find a water leak because they had a high water bill. I started with the obvious items and the meter did not stop. I told my uncle Robert this is probably not good and we needed to get a company out there. So I called around and looked at all reviews. I stumbled upon this gem of a company- They were friendly on the phone(that's huge in my business) helpful getting a time frame down. They sent out a plumber and he found the leak within 20 mins. It was only a flapper that was leaking!!! My aunt and uncle were so thankful and I paid for the service over the phone with my credit card-  Thanks Midway from one plumber to the next!

reviews.author: Luis B.
reviews.text: Tried to connect the water line to the new fridge on a nice sunny Sunday. Should take 10 min. right? That water tap had never been used and was leaking. Even though I turned off the water main it ended flooding the whole kitchen and half the living room. Called Roto-Rooter between soaking towels and emptying buckets. Marc came out promptly and this "easy" job took him a couple of hours because he has to go get parts, cut drywall, copper tubing, re-solder joints and cleanup. Yeah, connecting the water line only took him a minute. Marc was professional, courteous, and Roto-Rooter doesn't charge extra for weekends. It did cost a little more than expected but hey, there's inflation, and wait, the color of the fridge doesn't quite match the kitchen!

reviews.author: Darrell B.
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of Gary McWhorter coming out to unstoppable a drain for me after I tried relentlessly and failed. He understands stopped it with ease, ran a camera down it to ensure it was good, and sold me some enzymes to help keep it from happening again which I had asked about. He didn't try to push them on me. He then looked at my main swore line and realized it needed to be rooted so he did that as well. I feel he went above and beyond what he needed to do there and I am thankful for that. He broke down exactly what it would cost before he did any work. My only complaint with the company is that they are more expensive than others in town. Although you get what you pay for and they also have the best warranty in town.

reviews.author: Rodney H.
reviews.text: I would like to share my review about Midway and the owner, David Ratcliff. I am a third generation Plumbing contractor and have served as President of the plumbing association P.H.C.C and on the state board of Arizona. I have been associated with David and his company for over 20 years. I've toured his shops, witnessed his integrity in the way he runs his company. Midways TEAM is highly qualified and they serve their clients at the highest level possible, offering the best product and warranty, in our industry! I wanted to pay this compliment to David. We are proud to have a company of this statute in our organization! SO Yelp browsers look no further! Congrats Midway Plumbing!

reviews.author: Laura Banker
reviews.text: Not happy with their prices. They prices just kept going up and up and while I understand they found more issues, what they already charged was really high. $250.00 to remove one piece of fence which took my finance 5 minutes. I guess they charge $250 every five minutes which seems about right. $12k later and five days my plumbing was finally fixed and they didn't bother to spread out the filled giant hole in my backyard. They also hit a gas line and didn't even bother to let me know.. I went to go smoke outside and if my fiance hadn't seen them break the gas line it could've been bad.

reviews.author: Courtney C.
reviews.text:
The toilets, tubs, showers were all backing up and not draining in two bathrooms. We called Midway and they scheduled a visit the next day. Russell found the problem, fixed it, checked all the pipes, checked the water heater, and other plumbing issues around the house. He was so friendly and professional. Super, super nice. We all loved him and Midway Plumbing! This was the first time we have needed a plumber since being in Abilene, but the next time we need something...ABSOLUTELY calling Midway!!!!
Thanks so much Russell and the Midway Plumbing Team!!

reviews.author: Anthony G.
reviews.text:
Ridiculous, insane prices ! I was a commercial developer for over three decades and dealt with many good plumbing contractors. I needed a replacement tankless water heater installed . All the stub outs as well as electric was already there. Their price.... $ 1,100. And it may be more if they " needed more electrical work" ! 
I called two Master plumbers and their prices were $225 and $250. 
I really feel they take advantage of customers who have no understanding of construction.
There are plenty of qualified plumbers .....why would you opt for midway?

synthesis.summary: Midway Plumbing's 42-year Abilene reputation is built on knowledgeable, honest technicians — multiple reviewers describe techs who talked them out of unnecessary expensive work and advocated for them with the city — but their pricing generates the most complaints in this market: $700 to install a faucet, $550 for a toilet flush assembly, $3,400 to power wash a single drain line. The high-skill techs are genuine; the price sheet is not for budget-minded customers.

reviews.author: Tonya Miller
reviews.text: What an absolute wonderful experience. I was sent a man named Jacob, and it couldn't have gone better! Skills mixed with kindness is what a homeowner appreciates.  Jacob certainly had that and more. The automated system was suspicious,  however, walking through the process and allowing them to come to your home is effortless.  Once they arrive, the job is accessed and a cost is given. You have the option of accepting the bid or declining.  Very happy I agreed,  mine was an unusual custom job that was finished flawlessly by Jacob. I will certainly have their team back again!

reviews.author: Andrew Rickard
reviews.text:
Chance was probably the best technician I've ever had.  He was prompt, polite, efficient, well spoken, and made us feel very comfortable with the entire process. There was literally no friction and I am extremely happy with the results.

He replaced our 16-year-old gas water heater by inspecting, Recommending the replacement, and having the new heater here at my house and install installed within four or five hours.

To make room for him, I took our mountain bikes off of the wall, and without asking, he put them back for me. That says a lot, and lets me know that his attention to detail and his Quality and Work ethic is top-notch.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Brittany Truman
reviews.text: The team members Hoffman Brothers sends out to my home have all been highly professional, curteous and good explainers. They treated myself, home and property with respect. They answered all my questions thoroughly, provided detailed pictures of the work completed and explained it in detail. They cleaned up after themselves. From the initial quote to the end result, the whole process was smooth. I liked how they gave me different options to choose from... just repair the worst items, mid level and full restoration. They never pushed a higher option on me. They simply laid the plans out and let me choose my comfort level. I have used other companies for HVAC needs and none of them provided the level of customer service Hoffman Brothers did. I fully intend to use them for all my future needs.

reviews.author: William C.
reviews.text: They  leaned my HVAC ducts on the main level of my house for 2.5 hours then charged me $1280!

reviews.author: Summer T.
reviews.text: This company is beyond disappointing. My husband and I have been trying to call and get an issue resolved with a manager and no one will call back. They sadly do not care about their customers.

reviews.author: Patricia E.
reviews.text:
Awful service!!!! We spent over $5000 on the purchase and installation of a tankless water heater a little over a year ago. We've had nothing but issues with consistent hot water. We cannot get hot water in our master bathroom without running water down the drain for ten minutes!!! Hoffman came back out a few times and told us that we would need to pay another $1500 for them to connect the recirculating pump that is already within the hot water heater we purchased from them!!!! Why didn't they explain this when they quoted the price for the water heater to begin with?! Or explain that there would be an additional cost to connect the recirculating pump if we wanted to have hot water in a timely fashion. Hoffman supposedly ran tests to see why the hot water was not staying hot consistently in our kitchen also. They claim it is the city's issue and has to do with the pipes bringing water to the house. We called Navien (the manufacturer) directly and they pulled up our unit and information and said there were multiple tests that Hoffman could have run but didn't. They can tell on their end because it logs all tests performed in their tracking system for our unit. 
Fast forward six months or so, our AC unit went out. We called Hoffman and thought we would start with them to get a quote. The gentleman, Billy, that came out seemed nice. He also looked at our water heater when we explained we were NOT happy with it. He gave us his word, which apparently is worth nothing, that they would make this right! That spending 5k+ on a water heater...you should be happy and should have hot water! He said that the air vent that was installed inside our basement was not allowing enough air circulation and probably should be vented to the exterior of the home. He said he would do that first and that it was not ok that they had not connected the recirculating line when they had initially installed the unit. He said that he would talk to their plumbing team and make sure to make this happen. He then proceeded to give us an astronomical rate for the replacement of our main AC/furnace unit. We chose not to go with them for that because we were able to get a quote for less than half the price for a brand new Rudd AC 16 sear unit with a longer installation warranty from a local company. We followed back up with Billy and our previous contact Mike a few times only to receive zero response to the promise that Billy had made to make our Navien purchase and installation right. 
When I originally hired Hoffman for the hot  water heaters replacement I chose them because we had just moved here from out of state. I didn't know any local family owned companies yet and was afraid of getting taken. I've learned that the big dogs on the playground are truly the ones to look out for! Terrible introduction to Tennessee and will never recommend Hoffman or Navien for that matter!!! Absolutely wish we had stayed with the 10 year old tiny tank water heater that was here originally instead of trying to upgrade to a tankless!!! I miss having hot water to wash my hands and my face! It's pointless to even hope to have hot water if you quickly use the restroom and go to wash your hands because it won't happen anytime soon!! Sad that a company this large can't do the right thing after spending such a significant amount on what should have been an investment.

reviews.author: Shelly Hoffman
reviews.text: I wish I could choose no stars. This entire business is about getting as many customers lined up as possible and then dragging out the job for as long as possible. I called on a Saturday because sewage was coming out of the cleanout in the front yard. They couldn't come until Wednesday. Stupid me, I didn't call another company because Hoffman is who we have had a membership with for several years. I somehow thought they would prioritize us. They didn't. I am a teacher and was in a secure testing environment from 9 to 4 every day this week. I communicated that to Hoffman Brothers and said that I needed the plumber to text me. So Wednesday they came out. I got a text from the plumber at 2:41 pm asking me if I wanted him to go ahead and camera the line. I replied "Yes, please!" After that, I got no communication, so I thought I would come home to a fixed plumbing situation. Unfortunately, the sewage was still in the yard. The next morning, I called on the way to work to find out what was going on. The human I finally was able to talk to told me that I needed to sign the proposal for the work. I told him my situation and that I was in the car and asked him if he could text me the information and let me give approval. He said that he could. He sent me the estimate, and I replied "Yes, I agree to this work! Thank you!" and he replied, "Thank you for the update. I'll get that over to them now." This was Thursday. I heard nothing from them that day. Then again nothing on Friday. I went home Friday and tried to wash a load of clothes, and the sewage started coming up in the toilet and kitchen sink. I called Hoffman hoping for emergency services. I got AI--a very condescending, time consuming AI that told me they didn't have anyone on the team who could help me until the morning. This morning I called again and again. Finally, I got ahold of Kristen at 8: 17 who told me all of the ways in which I had asked Hoffman Brothers to work outside of their policy and how they had gone out of their way to work with me and that our values were not aligned. I agree. Our values are not aligned. I expected them to help me. They just wanted to line up desperate customers. I called Benjamin Franklin plumbing and got a human being on the phone right away. He was nice. He didn't treat me like I was being unreasonable asking for work on the weekend. They will be out at 2 pm today. I am grateful that there are alternatives to Hoffman Brothers. I have cancelled my membership with Hoffman. So happy that I finally saw what they were.

reviews.author: Anika Goff
reviews.text:
This review is not related to services provided, but is intended as a professional driving safety concern involving a Hoffman Brothers company vehicle observed this morning on Interstate 40 while traveling from Baxter, TN toward Nashville.

I was driving a Hyundai Palisade equipped with factory-installed headlights. These headlights are bright at baseline by manufacturer design and are not aftermarket or user-modified, nor were my high beams engaged. I note this only to clarify that the headlight brightness was not a deliberate action and is outside of my control.

I was traveling in the passing lane behind a Hoffman Brothers truck at a safe and reasonable distance. A black Dodge Charger with emergency tags was also present and may help identify the incident. The Hoffman Brothers truck merged into the right lane, I passed normally, and shortly thereafter the truck abruptly merged back into the passing lane behind me, cutting off the Charger and causing it to brake suddenly to avoid a collision.

Following this maneuver, the Hoffman Brothers vehicle activated high beams and proceeded to follow extremely closely for several miles. During this time, I increased speed in an effort to create distance, as the situation felt unsafe. After several miles, the truck merged back into the right lane and immediately turned off the high beams.

Company vehicles represent an organization in public spaces, and aggressive or retaliatory driving behaviors create unnecessary risk for other motorists. This incident raised concerns about professionalism and roadway safety, and I hope it can be addressed internally to prevent similar situations in the future.

reviews.author: Hal Roseman
reviews.text:
After five days without electricity and temperatures hovering around 15 degrees, we finally got our power restored — and it’s entirely thanks to Hoffmann Brothers, especially their electrician, Justin.

Our electric mast had literally been pulled away from the house after tree limbs dragged down the service line. Two other well-known Nashville electrical companies came out, but wouldn’t touch anything until NES disconnected the hot line — which meant more waiting… in freezing weather.

Justin, however, didn’t stop without finding a solution. He secured emergency authorization, safely disconnected the line, rebuilt the mast and meter connection, and coordinated everything so NES could immediately reconnect our service. Within 24 hours, we finally had power back.

And the workmanship? Outstanding. He didn’t just patch things up — he rebuilt it correctly:
• replaced the entire mast system
• fixed the previous builder’s makeshift nail mounting with bolting screws
• secured and supported the conduit properly
• caulked the board holding the conduit
• cleaned the entire area
• hauled away debris and old materials

Even more impressive, during a historic weather outage — when many companies add “emergency” surcharges — their pricing was fair and honest, coming in almost a third lower than another major bid.

Skill, integrity, and professionalism when we needed it most. If you ever need electrical work done right, I can’t recommend Hoffmann Brothers and Justin highly enough. They truly showed up for us.

Grateful doesn’t even begin to cover it. 🙏⚡️

reviews.author: B P.
reviews.text:
SHADY business. Charged $95 for NO services rendered. Refuses to give full, Transparent breakdown of costs regarding new toilets with installation. Said they can't tell you the specifics of pricing for the different brands of toilets, even though the jump between brands is HUNDREDS of dollars. They know how much each toilet costs - that's how you run a business and keep up with inventory, etc. Completely UNETHICAL and ILLEGAL not to provide clients with a Proper, ITEMIZED quote and/ or receipt. Oh, and don't be mislead by  claims that they "give discounts" in exchange for a "monthly subscription". That's not a discount, that's shifting where the price goes and how long you will continue paying out to them. Also said, "if you're a member for the monthly subscription and you have an appointment, that appointment will never get pushed back or rescheduled. But if you're not, well, members get priority so your *scheduled* appt as a 'non-member' could be changed at anytime".... you have got to be kidding 
Wouldn't be surprised if they pay to have this post deleted either. They certainly pay off Google to remove Honest reviews that are less than 5 stars. Disgusting business

reviews.author: april brooks
reviews.text:
Do Not Use Hoffman Brothers!
We contracted Hoffman Brothers to install a tankless water heater in our home back in December. Unfortunately due to a broken foot, I was unable to personally inspect the work afterwards, which was instead looked over by my husband. Fast forward 3 months when I’m finally mobile again, I discover that my deep freezer has been damaged. There is now a huge dent in the top of the freezer, it has been scraped, and it no longer holds a seal. So not only is the deep freezer damaged to the point that it is unusable, but all of the food inside now must be thrown away. When my husband reported it, there was no call back. When I called, they did not even have my husbands name correct, are claiming we damaged the deep freezer due to a microwave sitting on top of the freezer, and also claim since we took so long to report it there is nothing for them to do. They also claim their employees are always honest and self report anytime they cause damage to a home. They insist they have no fault. Do not use them if you do not want your home damaged during services. I absolutely will tell anyone looking for any of these services to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Douglas C.
reviews.text: To their credit they were punctual and communicated when they would come out, which happened to be the same day. They had a 95 dollar service fee which a lot of places have but most other places roll that into the repair if they do the work, with Hoffman that is not the case. My review is based solely on pricing as Hoffman was more than double what other plumbers quoted me. I was given a thorough estimate that explained each option to repair my water heater. The cheapest option was to replace a valve and would have cost 400 dollars plus the 95 dollar service call. I called around because the quote to replace the water heater was 2100 which to me seemed a little high because a water heater is 500-700 dollars and I can't imagine it would be 1400 dollars in labor. The second and third quotes were both under a thousand to replace the water heater. I am not sure if Hoffman does good work or not but based on the very high pricing I would not use them. They were very communicative and came out the same day which was good, but again just way too expensive.

reviews.author: Kyle Shaffer
reviews.text:
Horrible experience with incompetent techs and customer support. Charged me $150 for a service call and then said it would be an additional $650 for the repair on the washing machine - with no waiving of the service call price if we move forward with repair, which is an industry standard..  I asked if parts were under warranty and they told me I would have to ask the manufacturer myself.  Yet they wouldnt tell me what parts to ask about..  They are intentionally witholding information hopes you dont ask questions and sign the invoice.  The invoice itself was a joke:

"the problem appears to be with the drive motor and
run capacitor."

The tech did not actually test capacitor microfarads or motor amp draw.  I can do more with ChatGPT than this tech did to actually find the issue.  Invoices are vague and include no detail of what needs to be replaced, part numbers and cost, or total hours needed for labor.

Ladies at customer support were totally rude and had zero knowledge about anything.  Very combative.

Dont get scammed by these losers.

reviews.author: Lawson McCoy
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying because of Brent’s ability to take the time to explain each issue, back it up with pictures and proof of exactly what was going on, lay out a clear game plan for how we’d fix it, and prioritize everything so we could work the critical repairs into my budget. I’ll be using this company for all things HVAC for the rest of my life

Beyond the technical side, Brent walked me through preventative maintenance steps I can take to avoid similar issues down the road. He genuinely seemed like he cared about me and my family. it felt less like a service call and more like having a best friend come over to help you fix something at your house.

When I asked to make sure I wouldn’t be keeping him out too late with all the repairs I needed, he said something along the lines of ‘I’m here to make sure you’re in good shape.’ I’ve never seen anything like it.

Just know, if I ever call and find out Brent has left the company, your next call will be from me asking where he went. I say that jokingly, but I also absolutely mean it.

reviews.author: E B.
reviews.text:
Had Hoffmann Brothers come to repair a leaking upstairs toilet. Bolt had rusted out which holds the tank to the base. Total charge to repair 2 bolts holding tank to base $274.00.  Toilet was removed and placed in tub beside the stool so the floor could be replaced. Toilet was reset several months later by ServPro. Water was turned back on only a few days prior to a second leak. This one caused by a faulty input line connecting to the toilet tank. I feel that the Hoffmann service when replacing the original leak should have caught this as it had to be damaged the same time. I did call and had Hoffmann come out after the second leak but they said it was not their fault. This time they did give mw a few dollar discount on the service call but I did not have them fix the problem as I am replacing the toilet - NO not by them as the estimate was well over $1000. Guess they only check the original problem and do nothing more. 
They claimed that ServPro touched the toilet last when they set it back in place so ServPro was responsible.

synthesis.summary: Hoffmann Brothers is a large Nashville multi-trade company where individual technicians often shine but corporate pricing and scheduling practices generate serious complaints — reviewers document $95 show-up fees charged when no work is done, quotes that are double or triple competitors, a sewage emergency left unresolved for days due to policy disputes, and a frustrating AI phone system that gets customers' names wrong and can't find their own appointments. When a good tech like Chance or Justin shows up, the work is excellent; getting there is the problem.

reviews.author: Kelsey Meyer
reviews.text: They were awesome! Zachary came out same day and did a great job of explaining the issue and his recommendations, as well as letting us know about future work we will need based on what he saw. Zach is a sweetie, give this man a raise!

reviews.author: Andrea Sanchez
reviews.text:
Mason did an excellent job unclogging my toilet! He responded quickly, arrived on time, and was very professional throughout the entire process. He explained what was causing the issue and made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. Not only did he fix the problem efficiently, but he also left the area clean and tidy.

I truly appreciate his reliability and quality workmanship. I would definitely recommend Mason to anyone in need of plumbing services!

reviews.author: Stephanie Edwards
reviews.text: Nick came to our home for a garbage disposal repair (that turned into replacement). He was very friendly and courteous to everyone, even greeting our kiddo. He was knowledgeable and explained everything we needed to know about the care for our new unit. Very pleased with everything.

reviews.author: Ma Myo
reviews.text: no good service

reviews.author: Brittany McKinnon
reviews.text: my boyfriend and i called the akron location sunday evening because our basement was submerged in water and we assumed it was a busted pipe. the following day jesse showed up to help! we called thinking a pipe busted behind a wall, but he took his time to diagnose the issue and didn’t just cut a hole in our wall and call it a day. he discovered that our sump pump motor burned out and it was improperly draining into our front yard and recycling itself. he called his supervisor and they squeezed us into their busy schedule. the day of the repair, jesse showed back up along with nate! they did an awesome job. i can hardly tell they dug up our front yard, were professional, very thorough and helpful, informative since my boyfriend and i are first time homeowners and very polite to top it off. couldn’t have asked for a better experience for what the situation was. thanks again, guys!

reviews.author: Jovelyn Coffield
reviews.text:
We encountered drainage issues and my husband contacted them on the same day, and they delivered service within less than three hours. Initially, we thought a root issue was blocking the pipes.

However, Justin showcased impressive expertise, examining the drainage system and providing an explanation of the blockage's cause. Although we were unable to resolve the issue on our own, he provided expert assistance, using advanced equipment to give us a thorough understanding of the problem.

Justin is the best and we couldn't thank him enough!

reviews.author: Jill Holdsworth
reviews.text: Kevin was just out. He is AMAZING!! He is always prompt when arriving for the appointment time. He is so friendly and personable and very efficient. Today he took the time to explain things to me regarding our sump pump and the issue we were having. He was very patient with my questions and made sure he stayed until I understood the procedures I need to take if the alarm goes off again to reset and test it. We are very thankful for him.

Was very congenial and did not interrupt very much what we doing.  He was very neat.  The price was a little high but we knew what it would be when we called.  It was worth it.  Would not hesitate to make the same call again.

synthesis.summary: Technicians arrive within hours and explain problems clearly, but 781 BBB complaints in 3 years signal a serious pricing or billing pattern that these 5 uniformly glowing reviews don't address at all.
strengths: Same-day or sub-3-hour response confirmed in 3 of 5 reviews, including one evening arrival
Every technician mentioned by name took time to explain the problem and future needs — consistent communication pattern across all 5 reviews
2 of 5 reviews specifically praise clean, professional work completion including tidy cleanup and thorough testing before leaving
weaknesses: Pricing fairness scored 0 — none of the 5 reviews mention cost, which is unusual and leaves a critical blind spot for emergency situations where Roto-Rooter is widely known for premium pricing
redFlags: 781 BBB complaints in 3 years is a high volume for any plumber and strongly suggests recurring billing, pricing, or service disputes that are completely absent from this small review sample — treat the 5-star sweep with caution
synthesis.emergencyNotes: One review was submitted at 2am following same-day service, and another documents under-3-hour response to a drainage emergency — response speed appears genuinely strong, but no reviews confirm burst-pipe or active flooding scenarios specifically.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.9 stars across 2,166 reviews, but 781 BBB complaints over 3 years — roughly one complaint every 1.4 days — contradicts that rosy picture and suggests dissatisfied customers are escalating rather than leaving public reviews.

reviews.text:
EXTREMELY SATISFIED WITH MY WATER SOFTENER SYSTEM

On 10/6/25, Mallick Plumbing & Heating, Inc. installed our new water softener, and we couldn’t be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, their team was professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure the installation was done cleanly and efficiently.

Our plumber, Frederick Mason, was absolutely excellent. He was professional, courteous, and clearly takes pride in his work. He answered all of our questions, made sure everything was set up perfectly, and left the area spotless when he was finished.

The results have been amazing. My wife absolutely loves the difference in our water; she immediately noticed how much better it smells and tastes. Even better, she says her hair feels noticeably softer, and both of us have seen a big improvement in how soft and smooth our skin feels. It’s honestly been a game-changer for our home.

Now, five months later, we are still extremely satisfied with our purchase. The system has been working flawlessly, and it has truly been money well spent. If you’re considering a water softener, I highly recommend Mallick Plumbing & Heating, Inc. Outstanding service, quality work, and real results. Five stars all the way!

A. Jones

reviews.text: Wow what amazing service! We had a group of guys from Roto Rooter come out. Brandon was quick and efficient digging the area. George was quick and efficient with jetting the line. Matt did an amazing job bouncing around helping everyone. Mike was also great taking his time to make sure all the fittings were tight and in the proper space. They were all super respectful of the property even putting on booties to enter the house. Everyone was in great spirits and took the time to break everything down and explain certain terminology.

reviews.author: April Trupes
reviews.text:
Cy came to my mom’s house. She had been experiencing repeated flooding in her basement. Upon mopping the floor the water mixed with cat litter and she was dumping the water down her laundry tub drain. Long story short she managed to not only clog up her drain she couldn’t wash clothes or use her kitchen sink.
When 2 plumbers failed to show we called roto-rooters. Cy showed up on time did a full inspection. He than walked me through everything he was going to do and took the time to explain it to me. He ended up replacing the sump pump, injector pump, routed out the sink pipes and the floor drain. He was very professional and knowledgeable. He made me feel at ease and very trustworthy. He was quick and efficient and after he completed the job he walked me through it and explained what he had done. And the best part of it all was it only took a couple hours and he gave us a discount on price. Thank you Cy!! We appreciate you, your honesty and your hard work.

reviews.author: Gloria Kouba
reviews.text: Team number 5281. I give these guys 5 stars!!! They went way beyond what I could I expected. If I need work done in the future I will for sure request them. As you can see they even cut the old floor out and put in new supports to even it out before putting in the water heater.

reviews.author: Michael Jones
reviews.text: Adam Freeman originally came to do the service check. My unit was originally installed by a now out of business service. There were several issues (of which I was aware) the previous techs had...plundered. I had intended to have these issues corrected but Adam pointed out how fixing these now could save my new unit from future repair costs if left unattended. He was knowledgeable and explained what and why the various things were being done. One example of the repairs he made? The techs that installed this new unit (now 2 years old) had ran the condensation drainage through the filter housing. Essentially compromising the efficiency of the filter leaving a 4 inch gap that was sealed with foil tape. The actual filter should have been a 20 inch filter not a 16 that was "urban engineered" to fit. In short I appreciated his honesty and professionalism in doing the job quickly, efficiently and at a fair price. I could have paid more and not have had the issue appropriately addressed. I feel confident that my unit will be in service for many years to come. Thanks to Adam's exceptional service.

He explained what was wrong with our fireplace in terms that I could understand and let me know about the plumbing deals going on AND discounts that were available if we signed up for a membership. Because of Ruben, we now have a reliable company that we can depend on and a safe gas line for a cozy fire.

reviews.author: nancy anderson
reviews.text:
Our old (and only) toilet had not been working right for a couple months (partial flushes, tank running, etc). It finally got completely stopped up and started overflowing and we couldn't plunge it out! Roto- Rooter to the rescue!

Our Technician, Marc, was great! He arrived within 3-4 hours of my call, diagnosed the problem quickly, and gave me possible solutions and estimates for the work before starting.

Marc augered toilet and replaced some old parts in a timely fashion. He got our old potty working better than it had before. Plus, he left the bathroom clean and tidy too -- Hooray!

It was expensive but worth it for the quick, friendly service.

reviews.author: Brent VanLanduyt
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Roto-Rooter. Nertil came out to fix the water supply stop valves under the sink, and from start to finish the service was top-notch. The work was done efficiently, professionally, and he answered all my questions before leaving.  I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Diana Caputo
reviews.text: I had water and sewage backup comimg from my shower. Mitchell was great. He came to my house twice. Both times in a timely manner, super friendly and respectful. He explained the whole process. He spent a lot of time getting to the root of the problem and didn't leave until he made sure everything was good. He was able to get my house running again until repairs can be done. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Chuck Damore
reviews.text: We had a catastrophic failure of the cast iron sewer pipe exiting the house on a late Friday night.  None of the toilets or sinks would drain.  The salesperson from Roto Rooter came quickly after I phoned them on Saturday to assess the problem and give me a repair price.  The issue was a broken cast iron sewer line exiting the house at the foundation.  It sheared in two pieces and became clogged.  Monday morning, Roto Rooter arrived on site.  They needed to dig an 8 foot deep X 4 foot wide X 8 foot long hole under the porch to access the failed cast iron pipe.  They had to cut out concrete stoop as well.  They removed the failed pipe and replaced it with a new PVC pipe.  They pulled all permits and arranged for a city inspection.  We were able to use our water Monday afternoon.  Tuesday morning, they filled in the hole and cleaned up.  The cleanup was fantastic.  If you didn't know what happened the day before, you would have never known they were there.  It was a big job that required a large backhoe and many service techs to make the repair.  The supervisor Brandon M. did a fantastic job along with the sales associate Kyle and the rest of the crew.  The finished site was professionally cleaned.  My neighbors commented on how well the guys cleaned up.

reviews.author: Day
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with Roto-Rooter thanks to Leonard and Levi. Leonard was the plumber who completed the work, and he was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and thorough. He took the time to make sure everything was done right and left the area clean afterward.

Levi, the supervisor, was also fantastic — he clearly explained what was going on, walked us through the issue, and helped us understand the best options to resolve it. Having someone explain things in a straightforward way really made the whole situation less stressful.

Overall, excellent service, great communication, and a team that truly cares about helping their customers. I would definitely recommend them and wouldn’t hesitate to call again if needed.

reviews.author: J_B Shad
reviews.text: Tony did a great job installing a water heater for us last minute. Fit us in right away, very detailed from Oscars assessment to Tony and crew on the install. Happy New Year guys and thank you!

reviews.author: Joseph Hall
reviews.text: We had Top Tec install a hot water heater, furnace and central air conditioning system in our home.  Our hot water heater was out and found Top Tec in the Lake County yellow pages.  They came out and assessed our hot water heater, and the next day they installed a new hot water heater.  Approximately 3 weeks later we had a furnace issue and Moe came to our home on a Friday evening and did a thorough check on the furnace, which continued our journey with Top Tech.  Moe was great and explained perfectly what was wrong with the fan and why it was not pulling enough air out causing the furnace to shut itself off and after an hour or so it would reboot itself and run again but never reach temperature.  Moe did a quote on a replacement part and called Robert, the service manager to do a quote for a furnace.  We promptly received the quotes and after looking over all quotes decided to have Robert do a total replacement quote to see all options.  After a few phone calls on Saturday and Sunday with Robert, we decided to do a total furnace and central air replacement.  Robert was great to work with and understood that this process is stressful for a homeowner to spend a non-budgeted large sum of money.  Top Tec was here on Monday at 8 am with a crew and completed everything in about 6 hours.  All of the technicians were very professional and knowledgeable and willing to explain the product and service to our understanding.  The technicians that replaced our hot water heater were:  Sam and Brian.  The furnace and central air technicians were:  Tony, Buzz, Bayra, Hero and Jim.  The office staff was also very professional and possessed excellent inter-personal communication skills.  Office staff included:  Eli, Jennifer, and Robert, Service Manager.  Eli is the first person to answer your call.  Jennifer did all the warranty paperwork with the manufacturer, so we had no paperwork to fill out on our own.  Jennifer did an excellent job at keeping us informed through email with all completed paperwork on all the jobs.  We will continue to use Top Tec for our home needs.

reviews.author: Ryan Taubman
reviews.text:
Wonderful thorough job!
Tony, Bayar, Jim, and Koss came to replace my full HVAC setup and from start to finish they handled everything without me having to lift a finger.
They brought floor mats and even swept up around the new units when they were finished!
Very highly recommend working with them everything turned out perfectly and was completely stress free!

Top Tec continues to impress me with the quality of work and the quality of people they hire! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Ridhima Singh
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with this plumber. From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained the problem clearly, and completed the repair efficiently and neatly.

What really stood out was his attention to detail and the pride he takes in his work. He left everything clean and made sure everything was functioning perfectly before leaving.

It’s hard to find reliable, honest service these days, and this was truly a 5-star experience. Highly recommend to anyone needing plumbing work done right the first time.

reviews.author: Alex Kalpin
reviews.text:
Hristo Ivanov from Plumbing Care INC is absolutely outstanding. From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and incredibly knowledgeable. He took the time to explain the issue clearly, offered practical solutions, and completed the job efficiently with great attention to detail.

What really sets Hristo apart is his honesty and workmanship — no shortcuts, no upselling, just quality work done right the first time. Everything was left clean and working perfectly.

If you’re looking for a reliable, skilled plumber you can actually trust, Hristo is the one. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Kristina Marin
reviews.text: Pablo was our technician & he found problematic areas on the hot & cold water valves under the sink as well as toilet wall valve. The valves were stiff & difficult to turn & showing rust & corrosion.   Also Pablo showed me a crack in the old original pipe connecting the pea trap that could start leaking, so he changed it to a new plastic PVC pipe.  Pablo is very conscientious, honest, knowledgeable, & communicated his professional opinion & experience whenever any problems arose or plans needed to change.  Thank you Pablo for a job well done!

reviews.author: Gil Spencer
reviews.text:
Update: We have used them for years at this point. Most recent was a broken shower and replacing a toilet. They have also crawled under our house to replace a pipe, noted water pressure issues, and replaced our water heater. We have even gotten repeat visits by their plumbers (that have worked for the company for years, which speaks to employee loyalty and good retention).

Toilet was clogged completely. We don't own a snake for clogs and don't even know what I would buy. I previously had Plumbing Care quote me for a gas line that we ended up not installing, so called them again for this service. It was Sunday morning, a regular working day for their techs. Within an hour of calling, the tech was here, unclogged the toilet and fixed the issue for us. I also got to see the use of the toilet auger (which I am now buying one to have on hand). There were on time, courtesy, masked, shoe bootied, quick and kept the bathroom very clean. And they didn't charge an emergency surcharge as they are open on Sundays! Worth the peace of mind and a quick resolution. Thank you Plumbing Care!

reviews.author: Junshien
reviews.text:
Dimitry just installed a water softener system for our townhouse, and I'm very happy with the entire process. He was very courteous, professional, and straightforward — basically the traits you would want in a service professional, especially when dealing with a subject matter you're not familiar with.

When he initially gave me a price quote, I had sticker shock because I remember water softeners costing a lot less a decade ago. But after calling around, I realized that his pricing was actually incredibly fair for providing a turnkey solution.

On the day of, he texted before arriving, and he arrived early. Removing the old system and installing and setting up the new one took him under an hour. When he was done, he went over everything in detail and made sure I was comfortable with the setup.

Dimitry came across as trustworthy and friendly, and I'd definitely be contacting Plumbing Care Inc again the next time I need a plumber.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Leary
reviews.text:
So I had originally set up an appointment with jazz plumbing and the experience was hot trash. After that, I gave these guys a call and Alan and Angel came to my house on time the next day. They were quick to understand the issue and provide a quote for the fix. They also called out some other options in terms of things they could replace that although not strictly critical to fixing the problem would be beneficial in the long run // as long as they were going to do x they could also do y. Both Alan and Angel were super kind and professional. They also were just pleasant to talk to and quick to get the job done. I would recommend them for sure to anyone needing a plumbing issue looked at.

TL;DR - great experience, quick to fix, don’t use Jazz Plumbing use these guys

reviews.author: Lou James
reviews.text:
I had a tankless water heater flush and it was a great experience. The technician was extremely nice, pleasant, and very professional throughout the entire visit. He took the time to do a really thorough job and made sure everything was working properly before he left and was sure to explain everything so I understood.

What I appreciated most was how friendly and respectful he was while also clearly knowing what he was doing. He explained things clearly and didn’t rush the service, which made me feel confident the job was done right.

If you go through this company, I definitely recommend requesting Juan Lemus. He made the whole experience easy and stress-free. Highly recommend this company and especially this technician!

reviews.author: Elliot Katz
reviews.text: When a tankless hot water heater stops working after 10PM who do you call? I scheduled an appointment on line with Plumbing Care, Inc. for the next morning. They sent Hristo who by his demeanor and professionalism suggested it would be better to buy a new one then spend dollars repairing the 12 year old heater. In my career I have managed a very large group of technicians and Hristo reminded me of the best that I have known. Upon returning and installing the new heater his mechanical skills as well as his expertise need to be praised. From the first time I met him I trusted his judgement and it has proven to be accurate. Plumbing Care, Inc. is the company I would suggest for your Plumbing needs. And ask for Hristo.

reviews.author: Marlene
reviews.text: Outstanding service from Plumbing Care Inc. by Technician Keith Cormier! He was very professional, polite and knew exactly what the problem was and completed job on time and on budget. So grateful to find a company and employee like Keith that I could rely on and not have to worry about during or after the work was completed. Don't hesitate to call Plumbing Care Inc.They are the Best!  My bathroom was left immaculately clean, no damage to my  marble floors and plumbing restored in short order!! Its great to find a company I can rely on for exceptional work!

reviews.author: Monica Caravati
reviews.text: I’m not one to toss out 5 stars but everyone at Plumbing Care Inc. deserves it.  I called this morning after a panicked night where my old water heater failed and had to call fire department.  Megan answered and said I can have service there and gave me a time window just 2 hrs later. Mr Alvictor Bradford Jr, texted me his arrival time.  He explained my options and features I would gain.  He did a great job and walked me through operating it.  Very competitive pricing.  You will be very pleased choosing Plumbing Care Inc.

reviews.author: Lucian Boyd
reviews.text: Mitko was the assigned plumbing technician assigned to my house to investigate the source of an internal leak and repair once identified. He arrived on time, briefly explained the process and after a short  conversation, started inspecting the area and quickly found the issue. Once identified, made quick work of replacing the damaged section of pipe. Mitko’s experience was key in tracking down the problem resulting in minimal holes (just two) to repair after completion.  Thanks Mitko and Plumbing Care!

reviews.author: Theresa Martin
reviews.text:
Alvictor was SUPER! SUPER! 10+++
He explained everything while checking water heater, showed me how to re light pilot light, showed me automatic exterior gas shut off light and how to turn it on again. I was never aware when unit installed or giving this information.
Was on time. Sent pre msg with arrival time, courtesy , friendly and most important a very caring individual who made sure  I understood everything before leaving. Kudos to this great employee!
