reviews.author: Tonia Eidson
reviews.text: Mark came out to give us a price to replace a 14 year old water heater for my in-laws after we woke up with no hot water. My husband and I come from the industry, but are from out of state and the company I would normally use was booked so I looked around for other local companies with good reviews and Upfront seemed like a great place. We were not disappointed! Mark was able to get the water heater temporarily fixed so that we would have hot water over night and then came back the following morning to replace it. He did an amazing job on the install! Everything was done to code and looks great! You can tell Mark really cares about his customers and takes pride in his work. The price was better than we expected! If you are looking for a local company that does great work at a decent price, these guys are great! Ask for Mark!

reviews.author: Bryan A
reviews.text:
I had a really good experience getting my furnace replaced by Upfront! Their estimate was fair, and they were extremely responsive, and they accommodated the replacement within 3 days.

My furnace was condemned on Friday morning. With temperatures beginning to drop next week and it being Christmas week, I scrambled to get my warranty company to take the job but their contractor was unresponsive during the weekend. Jakob coordinated with me throughout Saturday on getting the furnace replaced Monday. On Monday Justin and Austin finished the furnace replacement in less than 4 hours. Everything looks great and we don't have to worry about using space heaters to survive the cold that's coming. Thank you for doing a great job, being responsive, and working diligently to resolve a habitability issue quickly!

reviews.author: Randy M.
reviews.text: We thought we were getting a great after hours service when we came home one night and our heat was out, they didn't charge a lot for an after hours call and came right over, but after working on it for a couple of hours and charging 400$ it still didn't work the next day, called another company and the minute he walked in and saw the furnace he diagnosed the part that needed to be replaced which was 82.00$   I have emailed this company with no response to my complaint,   I do not recommend ever using this company!

reviews.author: Kyle C.
reviews.text: I requested a diagnostic for my heater that went out. It was $49 so I said what they heck why not. The guy came out. Got a text he was on the way didn't show up for an hour after saying he was on the way (which I think is a attic they use... I'll get to that). I say I have to get back to work cause I just wasted my whole lunch waiting when it was suppose to be a break. It gets WAY WORSE... I go back to work then get a call they found what was wrong. I supposedly need my flame sensor, ignitor and furnace capacitor and it's some "package deal" for $300. It doesn't make sense because two of the 3 things were just replaced in 2017 so I say I have to think about it because I feel like I'm getting cheated (which I was). I call a different heating and air place they do the diagnostic for $29 and replace the flame sensor all out the door for $161. The crazy thing is a stayed with the second guy and he went over everything with me and checked the 2 things that "needed" to be replaced and they were "basically brand new" one was suppose to read at 7.5 something and it was reading exactly at that. The guy from western heating and air also tried to pressure me that I wouldn't get this deal unless he did it right then and there. He is shady, if you ever call them make sure you are there watching everything they check and make sure it's actually bad because they will lie and cheat you out of money. Please do better this is sad to see.

reviews.author: Jeff F.
reviews.text:
It is unfortunate that I have to write this review.  

My upstairs AC system was not cooling and had frost build up on the insulation line going into my unit indicating either low Freon or a bad coil.  I used Yelp to set-up a request for an HVAC technician to come and give me an estimate on repairs.  Western H&A was the first company to respond and was very professional over the phone.  A time was setup for the technician to come to our home and Justin arrived on time.  He was extremely nice and professional.  
After spending some time looking at our system (which is a 9 year old, 13 SEER, 2.5 ton, Lennox unit), Justin stated that there was a leak and it was 2lbs low of the old R22 Freon.  He stated the following three options:
1.  Refill the system with R22 and put a "dye" in system, return in 3-4 weeks to see where the leak was originating.  Cost:  $500 ($49 for the diagnosis, $90 per pound of Freon, and $270 labor).
2.  With our system being an "OLD" unit and using the non environmentally-safe R22 Freon, it could be at least another $500 if its an easy fix to the outside unit.  If it was an issue to the inside unit it could go up significantly from that point.  Not only would we be replacing parts (which could be in the $1000s), chasing leaks, but we would have to re-charge the Freon at $90 per pound and still have an OLD unit at the end.
3.  He then gave the option that since R22 was going to be illegal to use in the future, he recommended for us to replace the system completely so we don't add to the depletion of the ozone layer with our leaking OLD unit.  Since our system was a "nice" unit originally, the estimate he gave would be $3500-5000.

I told my wife the night before that if we get a "scare" pitch with a suggestion to replace our entire system we would get a second opinion. I told Justin that this is what we were going to do and would call him back if the 2nd opinion validated his assessment.  This is when Justin's demeanor went cold.

He did recommend replacing the filters in our two units at a cost of $10 each.  I agreed and my wife paid him.  Thankfully, my wife went downstairs to check on the unit right after he left.  She found that he had not put in a new filter and the cover was not replaced.  She ran out  and found Justin still sitting in his truck.  She told him he forgot to put in the new filter.  He apologized and went back in the house, went downstairs, then came back up and apologized again and left.

When my wife went back down again, the filter was half sticking out of the unit.  She was able to seat it properly but was amazed that he left it in that condition.

Follow-Up:
We had a 2nd HVAC company come in today.  He ran a leak test, used a "sniffer", checked the compressors, found a couple of loose fittings outside and serviced both our AC units.  He was there about 2 hours.  One required 2 pounds of Freon and the other required 1/2 pound.  Total cost for the service call, Freon, and service to both units?  $435.

He checked the temperature of the air ducts after servicing and said you look for a 20 degree temperature drop from the setting of the thermostat.  Ours was reading 24 degrees lower at the vent.  He said our system is in great shape and to call him in 8-10 years when we need a replacement.  We will definitely be calling him.

reviews.author: Taylor M.
reviews.text: We chose Western for our new HVAC system install because of their sales rep and their reviews. Don't let that fool you. We paid a lot of money for a completely new system to be installed to have issues with it in under 48 hours of the install being complete. The first issue we had was that our ceiling started leaking water out of one of our light fixtures the day after the install. We called and they sent a tech out to fix the issue that night, however there is water damage to the ceiling now that they wouldn't fix. The next issue was that none of the new vents that were installed were actually secured to the ceiling at all. The vent covers were screwed in through only drywall. Another issue was that they broke the molding around the attic entrance and damaged the trap door to the attic entrance. During the install of one of the new vents in our kids room they ran into issues cutting the hole for the vent and cut the hole in a different area, but didn't fix the area they cut first properly. I called and had their supervisor come out to show and explain all of these issues to them. After this they scheduled another appointment and redid the whole install due to it being done wrong on pretty much everything. They fixed all of the major issues, however they wouldn't fix the ceiling where the water damage is. They fixed the molding however it looks terrible and their fix was that they would just fill the gaps with silicone. They wouldn't fix the trap door to the attic entrance though and gave the explanation that they didn't know how it happened. The HVAC system has had fault codes ever since it was installed. The one that is always active is Blower Motor Outside Limits, there is another one that is only intermittent and just randomly comes on which is Low Pressure Switch Open. The excuse for not fixing the cosmetic issues is that they are not master carpenters. When I asked them if they would be ok with it in their own home the response was no. I'm not sure why it's ok in my home then. I have attached pictures for all of the current issues that still have not been fixed. Whenever the fan runs for the HVAC system the house smells like the attic as well which it didn't do with the old system. This install has been my worst decision I've ever made to date. I hope they correct their issues so I can rate them at least a 3 star. *Update* They cam out and repaired most of the system, however the system is still broken. We have had multiple appointments since this review was originally posted. Today I came home from work to the newly posted picture. We had the air from our attic pouring out of the access door into our house. This is an absolute joke. I wouldn't recommend this company to my worst enemy. I have taken pictures of this joke of an install and service provided by this company.

reviews.author: Travis P.
reviews.text:
Let's start with the good stuff.

First off, there was enough to warrant 5 stars when we first started. The cost was low, the people were kind, friendly and open about what I'd be paying/getting with my purchase. 

That being said, let's get on to the bad stuff.

When the furnace was first installed I followed all instructions on how to care for it for the first 24-48 hours, then it began making "BOOM" noises. I contacted the company and they came out to investigate promptly (thank you). 

The tech said it was just a loose wire.   Two days later, same problem. Call again. Techs come back out and say that there's too many 90' bends in the pipes (why wasn't this noticed in the first place?) 

After they fix the bends they cut another hole in my house and another 3" hole in my houses main support beam.   Now my power bill hasn't gone down at all (it's actually begun to rise) so I investigated and found that they haven't insulated the holes that they've cut through the wall and there's cold air just blowing in from the outside. 

I've tried to contact them again, but there's no support email, and now the website says that they only allow 1 submission per customer and I've already had to contact them 3 times so I'm S.O.L. and have to contact them on the phone (which is a pain seeing as I work night shifts and have to lose sleep if I'm gonna catch them) 

 I'm tired of having to contact them for unprofessional work and, at best, will change this review to a 2 star if they come out and fix the holes that they've cut into my house, and remove the old pipe that they left from the first botched install.

Edit:

After spending a night thinking about the things I've said I've decided to raise it to a two star review. The people who helped were not rude or lazy. They have always been more than happy to come out (even when it was the the 2nd or 3rd time I've called.) and try to fix the issue. 

The rest still stand, and I'm displeased with the lack of quality craftsmanship that has gone into this install, but I don't want to throw them under the bus completely.

Final edit: 

After seeing the review they were nice enough to contact me and try to make amends. A tech came out quickly and patched up the place. Thank you very much for fixing everything up.

reviews.author: Steve D.
reviews.text:
Western installed a new compressor in summer of 2015. Our old compressor and A/C system worked great for over 20 years until the compressor went down. Cost of a new compressor plus install was about $3,000.

Since then things went downhill. In order to make the AC work they had to disconnect the heating. When we wanted heat we had to disconnect the AC.

After numerous visits to figure out what was wrong, it was determined that the person who installed the compressor messed up on the install -- crossed wires, etc. I've had to replace blower motor, transformer and numerous other expensive parts plus labor that blew as a result of faulty install.

So far I've had to pay about $3,000 additional and the system still doesn't work.

Two weeks ago I had another service call to look at the system (still wasn't working) and it cost nearly $300! The tec said there were no guarantees that it would work. We got air for one day and then it went down again.

The tec told me there was really nothing more to do. He said my blower, condenser was old and probably needed replacing -- more thousands of dollars

What's confusing to me is the system worked perfect for 20 years until compressor went down -- so why now after new compressor with the same specs as old one system needs replacing -- especially after being told the root of the problem was messed up install of compressor.

I guess the HVAC business is quite profitable. Keep charging customers to fix the mistakes the HVAC company makes -- yet never fixing mistakes and keep coming back for more.

I must say in a positive tone that one of their techs, John, has been over many times trying to untangle their mess. On some visits I wasn't charged yet I just found out I have about an additional $500 I owe them for some of those visits.

Just went out and bought fans to try to cool down house. Can't afford Western Air anymore.

reviews.author: Timothy Jeffryes
reviews.text:
We had degrading issues with our water pressure, but we could tell that it wasn't consistent throughout the house.  Our tub was fine, but the shower head was not.  Bathroom sink was fine, but the kitchen sink was TERRIBLE.  The automated scheduling app (which is identical to that used by Salt Lake Plumbing) was very convenient.  However, it was a bit annoying when the technician almost immediately texted me to try and change the time.  When they arrived, the quickly diagnosed that we needed a new regulator.  That was over $500.  Within a short period of time I recognized that didn't solve the problem at all.  To their credit, they did come back, but THEY DON'T WORK WEEKENDS, so we didn't see them until Monday.  They then determined that it was a "filter screen" under the sink.   That fixed the problem to a WONDERFUL degree and there was no charge.  We then told them our sewer system gurgled when we run the dishwasher and the washing machine at the same time.  They used some equipment to check the situation and gave us an estimate of $2,863.  To their credit, they did not charge for the estimate.  Salt Lake Plumbing charged $385 for the estimate, but their estimate was $1833, and they subtracted 1/2 of the estimate price.  We also got a cash discount, so ultimately we paid $1,783 including the estimate.  Both companies were responsive, both used the same booking system.  I can only "assume" that we needed the $500 regulator, but it was a little annoying that it wasn't the actual problem.   I would recommend this company, but I did get a better deal with Salt Lake Plumbing.

Trent followed up after this review, so I would consider them responsive and responsible.

reviews.author: Gigi B.
reviews.text: Unfortunately I cannot give a positive review for this company. Their "Red Handkerchief Promise" is a hollow one. And even though I am a maintenance club member with "priority service," I am feeling abandoned. What makes this even worse, is my non-functioning AC was working fine until my scheduled maintenance appointment on Thu. By Fri. evening I realized something was wrong as my house was getting hotter and hotter. By all appearances it was a result from that maintenance call. Beware if you have trouble on the weekend. I called Fri. evening and was told there were no appts. until next Wed. (our state is in the middle of an excessive heat advisory). But he was hopeful I could be seen Sunday evening or maybe today (Sat.) The person on the phone today was polite but firm in that Mon. morning was the earliest she could try to get me in. Saturday was only for previously made appts. I asked if she could contact technicians to see if I could be squeezed in. She cannot. I asked if there is an emergency, does the customer have to wait from Fri. till Mon. for any possibility of help, and she confirmed that is true. I find that appalling and incomprehensible. Don't do business with this company unless you don't mind not having any help should your problem occur after hours. And if you don't mind a company not making right ASAP an issue they caused themselves. I am beyond disappointment.

reviews.author: Brad H.
reviews.text:
In Summary: There are three possibilities. Either their tech was not very knowledgeable (I'm optimistically guessing this one), or their margins are too high, or the tech saw an opportunity to take advantage. A $500 estimate was more than double what a second company estimated as $200.

The story...
I originally called Western Heating because my furnace was short cycling (I strongly suspected a bad sensor). I asked if their tech had spare sensors in the van. They said he would. He came out, took a look, and diagnosed a bad sensor. He charged me a $50 dispatch fee (fair enough), but told me he would have to come back on Monday to replace the sensor and his estimate for that was $500.

It's worth noting that the sensor was held in place by two visible screws and when I looked online sensors ran from $29-$129 (for the most expensive ones that were part of kits). The tech started back tracking his estimate as he noticed I was looking up prices on my phone.

In the end I simply cleaned the sensor a minimal amount and replaced a damaged air filter that was pressing against the furnace (probably the real problem). It all works fine now and I saved $500. I checked with another company who looked up my make and model and said they would charge about $200 for parts and labor to replace the entire sensor/ignition kit in the future if I have a problem.

reviews.author: Mariah Morris
reviews.text: I've worked with Mason a couple times and he's been amazing. This time, we had mold and had to completely demo our bathroom to remediate. Mason came and was very thorough when looking at everything which was really nice because he understood everything that needed to be done to help avoid any surprises that he could. He even offered 2 different options based on my budget and what needed done, and made sure I was aware of what each entailed and potential consequences and benefits for each option. I've really respected and appreciated the full disclosure and time he's taken with me each time he looks over everything and goes over options and estimates. Two other employees came and did the work to replace my main drain stack and some other piping. They even noticed that my ABS had a recall on it, which I had no idea about. They've all done great work, been very respectful, friendly, and kept me engaged throughout the whole process so nothing came as a surprise. I've had other companies try to tell me I need products that I don't really need and Upfront has never done that. The office employees are also very nice and it's super easy to schedule appointments and make payments, they'll even text you a link for you to pay. I feel like Upfront is very trustworthy and would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: E. Taylor
reviews.text: I had the bottom nut to the shutoff valve to the toilet water supply line leaking that needed to be addressed.  Dominic, the plumber assigned to the job called to give me his ETA which was nice, especially since my appointment time was moved to a later time slot.  Not happy with that, since I had to make an extra trip to and from work that day.  Dominic arrived on time, was cordial and considerate of his actions upon entry of the premises.  He was knowledgeable, well experienced and evaluated the issue and had empathy for my situation and my 'sticker shock' and gave me his lowest cost for repairs. Even though I had replaced the old shutoff valve with a new one and replaced the old water supply line to the toilet with a new one. He replaced all that with new parts that he had which were better and more durable in the sense of functionality and providing longer life, which would be covered on their warranty.  I could then return the parts that I bought to the retailer and pocket the cash.  The job and cleanup was a cinch for him and was done within 15 minutes... he mentioned that, "it was one of the easiest jobs that he had done". Payment was easy and the experience was smooth and went without a hitch except for the schedule change.

reviews.author: Lloyd D.
reviews.text:
9 1/2 years ago we had the best Amana 96% with Aprilair humidifier and ultra violent scrubber installed. I was so proud. 
The April air never really worked and they came out many times and never fixed it. 
At 6 year point the condenser made a loud noise and stopped, it needed to be replaced and the labor cost me 1500.00 
I checked around and that was a lot. 
Recently at 9 1/2  the Furnace started making a gurgling noise and just started stop working. 
The first man that came out said it was a part and changed me 280.00
Labor to replace it. It didn't fix it, so he had someone else come out. 
The next man that came out was here for  several hours a couple of times. I realized these young men wasn't HVAC Furnace men.
I decided to ask around and my friend told me about a good Hvac Furnace man.
He worked on the Furnace several times and it just can't be fixed. 
We have been without a Furnace for a month, thank goodness we have a gas fireplace that will heat the house. 
We still have 4 months on warranty but I just want it fixed. 
We are retired and and just can't handle all this. 
We are totallyreplacing the Amana with a Day and night. 
This experience been like fighting the tar baby.

reviews.author: Andrea So
reviews.text: I had an excellent customer experience with Mr. Central. With regard to scheduling, they booked my appointment and our technician, Oscar arrived within two hours of my call for service. He did a great job diagnosing and fixing the issue with our tankless water heater. He explained everything that was causing the problem and gave me multiple options (including cost free options) for how to address it. The service fee for the visit was reasonable and transparent. I am very happy with this company and would schedule with them again.

reviews.author: David MacIntyre
reviews.text: Nick and Mark came to do my yearly plumbing review and look at a leaky toilet. The toilet needed to be overhalled and after discussing three options I decided to go with a new toilet and they were able to do it while they were here. They did a fantastic job and were very careful with my house and very considerate about wearing shoe covers and were great at asking questions and giving me information. I highly recommend this company and the folks that work for Mr. Central.

reviews.author: Jessica Coleman
reviews.text:
Jeremy was thorough, he took his time and he answered all my questions. He went out of his way to find out answers to some questions I had that he wasn't sure of related to payment. He explained the process of what they would do and made me feel confident with choosing then to get the job done right the first time.
Jeremy and Nik did an incredible job with installing our new water heater and gas lines for fireplace. The neatly mounted the water heater and safely removed the old water heater tank. They were very clean making sure to put booties on every time they entered the home. They cleaned up the yard very well after digging for the gas lines. We are extremely pleased with the work they did and the professionalism. We will be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Kathryn Fitzer
reviews.text: I had Jeremy come and provide me with multiple quotes for various plumbing issues. He was extremely thorough when explaining all of the needed repairs and cost breakdown. There are also several options regarding financing and discount through their TLC program. He was extremely knowledgeable and I appreciated the time he took to provide me with all of the information. I am waiting on one further quote regarding the HVAC system, and then I’ll be making decisions moving forward. I will provide further recommendation/review when services are rendered. However, I am extremely pleased with the customer service provided so far!

reviews.author: Lawretta Cameron
reviews.text:
Felix did an amazing job on our HVAC system! He was professional, knowledgeable, and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. He showed up on time, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was running perfectly before he left.

What I appreciated most was his honesty and attention to detail — no upselling, just real solutions. You can tell he takes pride in his work and truly cares about his customers.

If you’re looking for someone reliable and trustworthy for your heating and air needs, I highly recommend Felix and the Mr Central team!

Thank you so much! From the Simpkins family!

reviews.author: CeeCee P.
reviews.text: Jeremy Butler was my technician. He was so professional and efficient. I appreciate him taking time to explain what was wrong and going into detail on how he fixed it. I felt very comfortable giving him space and letting him work. Thank you for the awesome experience and we will be in touch. If you’re in Aiken I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Emily Pauli
reviews.text: Roto Rooter did an excellent job!  They were professional and took time to explain their findings and recommendations. The were timely, worked efficiently, and cleaned up when finished.   I’ve used them in the past and will do so again if needed.

reviews.author: Kristie Scheuer
reviews.text: Roto Rooter responded to our request for service, septic tank service, in a very timely and professional manner.  We called on Friday night and the service was performed on a Saturday which was extremely helpful for our situation.  The technician, Aye, was very knowledgeable, efficient and personable. I would definitely use Roto Rooter again for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: D.T.
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Roto Rooter today. Technician Markues Montalvo was friendly, knowledgeable, and right on time. He was honest about the situation, very thorough with the inspection, and explained everything clearly. I really appreciated that there was no charge just to come out and inspect. It’s hard to find service like this anymore — highly recommend!

reviews.author: Megan K.
reviews.text: Terrible customer service & terrible work!! I paid $250 a PREMIUM RATE for them to replace a WAX RING on my toilet. When Tim arrived he was rude, and damaged my toilet in the process of replacing the wax ring because he was in such a hurry. My toilet wouldn't stop running after he touched it, so I asked him to repair it, and he told me to call and speak to a supervisor. I called and spoke to Robert the same day who promised to have someone come out first thing the next morning and fix it, but that didn't happen. After numerous promises to come back out and fix it no one called or came out. I was forced to call another plumbing company who came out and fixed my issue that Roto Rooter caused. I tried reaching out to Paul Smith the owner of Roto Rooter to make things right and he didn't care either. DO NOT USE ROTO ROOTER IN HUNTSVILLE, AL!!!! THEY WILL DAMAGE YOUR PROPERTY AND THEY DON'T TAKE CARE OF THEIR CUSTOMERS!!! I WOULD GIVE THEM A ZERO STAR RATING IF I COULD!!!

reviews.author: Erin S.
reviews.text: Horrible service!!!! If you cannot do your job correctly DO NOT DO IT PERIOD! I have spent over $1000 in a week for them to clean the line from the sink to the grease trap and they still hadn't cleaned the line. The young man that came to do it the last time had a very bad attitude. I am very upset and will definitely not be using them again.

reviews.author: Christopher D.
reviews.text:
I had a very poor experience with this Roto Rooter. I purchased my home in Huntsville in 2021. During the inspection process, the inspector identified that the water pressure in the house was very low and the Pressure Regulator Valve (PRV) would need to be replaced. The seller and I agreed that he would reduce the price and I could have it repaired after purchasing the home. Shortly after closing, I had Roto Rooter come out to replace the PRV. The plumber came out and replaced the PRV, however the issue was not resolved at all - the pressure was just as low immediately after the replacement as it was before. The Roto Rotter plumber who was there agreed and said that this was odd. He poked around the house for another 30 minutes and eventually concluded that "that must just be how it comes in from the city". I was disappointed because that meant the house I just purchased would always have this very frustrating low water pressure. 

So taking the plumber at his word, I carry on for a year and half living with the very low water pressure and just chalking it up to "well Huntsville utilities is terrible". Earlier this year, I turned the property into a rental property. Immediately upon move in the tenants began complaining about the low water pressure. I told them repeatedly that "there is nothing we can do" as that is what I had been led to believe from the Roto Rooter plumber. After a while I gave in and decided to call another plumber and get a second opinion. The plumber comes out and is positive it is the PRV. I tell him it was recently replaced and provide him the receipt from Roto Rooter. He is so sure that it is the PRV he tells me if replacing it does not fix the issue, there is no charge. I agree and he replaces the PRV. Immediately the difference in water pressure is NIGHT AND DAY. Everybody was thrilled that the water pressure issue was fixed, but I asked the plumber what happened the first time it was replaced. He said the the original plumber (Roto Rooter) must not have known what he was doing, installed the PRV incorrectly, or not changed it at all. I was glad that the issue was fixed but very frustrated because I had been mislead by Roto Rooter. If the tenants had not kept complaining about it, we could have went on for years with very low water pressure believing what Roto Rooter told us "there is nothing we can do".

Afterwards, I contacted Roto Rooter customer service but did not get any resolution. I end up getting transferred to corporate. I provide receipts from both Roto Rooter and the second plumber who fixed the issue as well as before and after videos. Corporate essentially tells me tough luck and that is the end of the story. 

I would not use this Roto Rooter! Inexperienced plumbers and no accountability.

reviews.author: Matthew Sebastian
reviews.text:
Roto rooter scammed my widowed grandmother on a fixed income. One of the employees who arrived at the house told us the city wouldn't fix the broken grinder or drain the holding tank. On Monday, we find out the city does it all for free. The employee at roto rooter tried to quote us at $5,000 for the grinder and pump after we paid $400 for the tank drainage. When an employee lies in order to make a sale, it's deceptive trade practice. It was completely unethical to speak on a subject as if it was fact when he had no knowledge or accuracy on what the city would provide. We noticed there was $50 off coupon on their website. Upon speaking to the owner about a potential refund/partial recompense, he spoke over me and hung up. I never had the opportunity to ask for the $50 coupon. Based on the attitude of the owner, we believe he is okay with his employees being dishonest.

Beware of roto rooter.

Update - the owner did hang up on me. Upon calling back, the receptionist said she would let him know we were expecting a call to finish the conversation and never received one.My grandmother and I would never lie about this type of situation. We also have a neighbor who sent this

Hi
We are out of town but I see where it looks like some people are working at your septic/maybe grinder pump.  In case you didn’t know, I wanted to let you know that the city takes care of anything outside for our sewer/grinder pumps.  They have a phone number for emergencies as well and I can share that with you if you need it just let me know.

Beware of rotor rooter liars

reviews.author: Kelly W.
reviews.text:
Something stinks to high Heaven! Beware!!  Twice they put faulty parts on the same pipe. My house flooded twice. They admitted they put a defective part on both times.  First time my insurance paid including a whopping $5000 for them to dry out my house. A few months later the replacement part failed again and my house was flooded for the 2nd time. This time they told me they were not responsible and blamed the manufacturer of the faulty part for the 2nd time!!  They want to charge me $5000 to dry my house out again!! 

The parts they are putting on were all part of a pex fittings class action settlement years ago for dezincification.  There is NO reason on earth they should still be using the same parts made by this company and it's hard to believe I'm the only one out there they have done this to. 

1.) Why didn't they warn me both times that the parts had a high probability of dezincification which could result in tens of thousands of dollars of damage to your home?

2.). Knowing there was a high probability the part would corrode, why didn't they return at a given time to inspect their work? 

3.) There are plenty of the same fitting available that are "non corrosive" that they could have used.  Why didn't they? One can only assume they liked getting $5000 to dry out your house over and over and over. 

I want to know how many people in Huntsville they have done this to. If you are also a victim, please email me at wells6384@outlook.com

reviews.author: Jamaica W.
reviews.text: I wish I could put a ZERO- totally all about sales. We had two toilets that needed new valves to start. I was quoted over $500 PER toilet and he was "giving me a deal, 2 for just over $700! I didn't need a whole new toilet! We bought our own parts at Lowes for $15! Then he took me outside to check water pressure. He said we had a leak and did show me the part we needed and that alone was almost $800! Thank god I got a 2nd opinion. The other company quoted me $460 for ALL 3 jobs....and only $250 for the outside pipe that had a leak if we decided to fix the toilets ourselves. Even if we didn't fix the toilets ourselves, for those together (2 valves) it still was aprox $250! The other company also went under our crawl space to check the leak and make sure they knew exactly what was needed. They were very professional and I did not feel like they were just giving me a sales pitch! I may be female but I am not an idiot. I feel bad for those who get scammed by Roto-Rooter especially those that may not think of getting another quote or feel they are in need right then and there and have no choice. We aren't talking a hundred dollar difference or so, we are talking hundreds!! It makes me sick. I am shocked they haven't been reported they certainly are scamming people and it's very sad to me they would even consider being this way. PLEASE DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!

reviews.author: Joseph Lee
reviews.text:
Honestly, I’d give 10 stars.
I had been without water since yesterday, and at first, I brushed it off, thinking the nearby construction was the cause. But when the faucets were still dry this morning, worry started to creep in. After calling the water utility and hearing that the problem was on our end, I spent a long time searching for the leak—finally finding water seeping out near the meter.
I reached out to Roto-Rooter, and that’s when Riley arrived. He stepped out of the truck with a warm, genuine smile that immediately eased my stress. In the freezing cold, he knelt down and dug through the ground with his hands, determined to find the source of the problem. He went out of his way to get rust‑resistant parts so the repair would last, and he worked with such care and integrity that it honestly moved me.
He didn’t leave until everything was fully restored, checking and rechecking to make sure the water was flowing properly again. He even gave us a discount—something he didn’t have to do but did anyway. Before he left, he wished us a blessed day, and it felt sincere.
Thanks to Riley, we finally have water again. After a stressful, uncomfortable day, his kindness and professionalism turned everything around. If five stars is the limit, then he deserves double.

reviews.author: Maria Hernandez
reviews.text: I don't want to leave a bad review, but my house was having drainage issues, so we thought the septic tank must be full. They came to the house and pumped out the tank. The guy who did the work said the tank wasn't the problem—that the issue was likely inside the house. So, I called the same company again, and the next day a different worker returned to clear the pipes. However, when he reopened the drain cover, he realized that the main pipe leading to the septic tank was broken. He said, "The other worker didn't tell me he broke it." Obviously, I thought, "He's not going to admit that he fixed one thing but broke something else." It is abundantly clear that the tank wasn't the problem, because—as you can see—the area isn't wet; I had already been dealing with the drainage issue for a week, so if the tank had been the actual problem, the first worker would have told me. I clearly remember him calling me over to show me that the tank wasn't the issue. My mistake was not noticing that the main pipe was broken either before or after he closed up the septic tank. It cost $988 to pump out the tank, and the subsequent visit cost $1,300 to repair the pipe and clear the clogged drain.

reviews.author: Joshua N.
reviews.text:
If I could put zero stars I would. They came out to repair a leak. Which they said they did. Fast forward 3 weeks after the renovation including new subfloor, tile, and drywall from a great Reno company I went to clean the dust out of my shower from the tile work etc.

The water is still leaking through the floor down into the first floor like nothing was fixed. THOUSANDS of dollars and WEEKS of my life were wasted on their incompetence. Work is going to have to be re-done and they may have put more damage into my house.

"Customer Service" is a joke. They don't have anyone available to come look at it. I honestly don't want them to touch anything else, but I don't know if my insurance will be willing to let me switch plumbers since it is after hours.

Would and will not recommend to anyone. STAY AWAY.

reviews.author: Graham S.
reviews.text: I wish I could give 0 stars. Terrible service. Our main drain was clogged so they took out our toilet to find our main drain (and charged us extra to do so). They then dug a hole in our front yard (did not fill it back in) and "fixed" our issue. Told us we had a 6 month warranty. 1 month later, we started having the same problem so they came back and "fixed" it again. 2 weeks later, same issue PLUS the toilet they resealed leaked all into our bathroom floor. We requested a supervisor who came out and told us that their "6 month warranty" is really only a one time freebie and we would have to pay for anything else they do. We are much worse off after they came than we were in the first place! This establishment is an embarrassment and their service is laughable. RUN AWAY!!

reviews.author: Chrystalline L.
reviews.text:
My house was built in the 60s and has had who knows how many "customizations" over the years, so getting things cleared up can be an ordeal.  I've had good service from these guys twice - once when my laundry drain clogged a year or so ago, and then again recently when my kitchen and whole house lines clogged.

The best thing, for me, is the fact that they have on-call evening hours.  I work all the time, and can't just take time off for appointments, so being able to call at 6:30-7 pm to get someone out to the house is very helpful.

The drain-clearing apparently requires two people, and there's only one officially on-call, but both times I've had to call them, they've contacted a co-worker and gotten someone else out to help.

reviews.author: Robert K.
reviews.text: I highly recommend Roto-Rooter Plumbers of Huntsville. This team responded immediately to an emergency plumbing problem on one of the coldest days in January in Huntsville. The plumber showed up early and surveyed the area ahead of time, mapped out a plan, and stayed until he was able to fix my problem. He also offered several service tips and recommendations specific to my property to prevent future problems.  The serviceman was highly professional, knowledgeable, courteous, respectfully, and sympathetic to our problem and it showed in the work he did. Roto-Rooter will be the first and only company I call if I ever need plumbers in the future.

reviews.author: Jeanette Hoffman
reviews.text: Jon and Cesar came out to diagnose a noise I heard coming from the furnace. They arrived quickly, were polite and professional and did a thorough inspection of the entire furnace. They were able to figure out the issue and discussed with me the other things they saw that looked like they should be addressed to keep the furnace running smoothly. They offered me different options on what to repair urgently and what should be addressed but could wait a bit longer. They were not pushy at all and explained everything thoroughly while showing me pictures of what they were seeing. I continue to use Anderson because every time I’ve needed them this is the same reliable and professional service I receive.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.text:
I recently had a bathtub faucet installed by Andersen, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Evan and Michelle were professional, courteous, and clearly knew what they were doing. They took the time to make sure everything was installed properly and working perfectly before they left.

Their workmanship was clean and precise, and they made sure the area was spotless when the job was finished. It’s clear they take pride in the quality of their work. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone looking for reliable and professional plumbing services.

reviews.author: Andre Porche
reviews.text:
We had an outstanding experience working with Joe Harkins. From the moment he arrived, he demonstrated a high level of professionalism, knowledge, and attention to detail. He took the time to thoroughly assess our home and carefully identify the source of the leak, explaining each step of the process in a clear and reassuring manner.
Joe truly went above and beyond to ensure we felt confident that the issue was properly diagnosed and that our system was secure. His expertise and patience gave us peace of mind during what could have been a very stressful situation.
In addition, he provided thoughtful recommendations for trusted services that could assist with the necessary repairs. That extra level of guidance showed that he genuinely cares about his clients and the long-term well-being of their homes.
We highly recommend Joe Harkins to anyone in need of a knowledgeable, dependable, and customer-focused professional.

reviews.author: Anthony DiAngelo
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Joe and the Anderson team. Joe replaced our sump pump and was outstanding to work with. He took the time to educate us, clearly laid out all of our options, and explained the trade-offs so we could make an informed decision—no pressure, just solid guidance. The quality of the work was excellent.

We’ve had Anderson out to our house multiple times over the past few months for different issues, and each experience has been consistently superb. Professional, knowledgeable, and reliable service every time. We wouldn’t hesitate to call Joe or Anderson again.

reviews.author: Mariah Wright
reviews.text: Nate & Zach were great! They were on time, very polite and very knowledgeable. Immediately was able to identify the issue and provide a solution. Walked me through everything in a way I understood. Great service all around! “Im just a girl” lol and I was able to explain the issue no problem to my husband as well. 10/10!!

reviews.author: Carol Juergens
reviews.text: I can always depend on Plumb Crazy Plumbing for a good job.  I don’t have to wait long either!

reviews.author: Leah Jackson
reviews.text: I can no longer recommend Plumb Crazy to my family and friends.  After years of using them and referrals, I am going to have to find another plumber.  We had a clog in our main line.  We had them out and the tech lied to us.  He ran his snake in the line, told me he didn't hit anything but he got some resistance at the end ("it wasn't the clog though"), and then he checked the city sewer main and it was bone dry so it had to be something on the cities side.  Which made ZERO sense to me because if the city manhole is dry, there's no water coming from my house and if there was a clog in the city line, the manhole would be full of water.  So he told me to call the city and have them come fix it and if it was on our side, he was going to prepare an estimate for some additional work and charges. He made me pay him before he left on the initial visit.  The city came out within 30 minutes and of course the clog is on our side, some roots and toilet paper were clogging the line.  I feel like they just did this so they could charge us with some camera line service and he didn't even run his snake to the end of the line.  I will not use or recommend Plumb Crazy again.

reviews.author: Tammy Brannen-Rauss
reviews.text: Office staff very unfriendly!! Not helpful at all!!

reviews.author: Marc Schiler
reviews.text:
We had an emergency where the shower drain started bubbling up water at 2:30 am. Someone flushed the toilet a floor above and the toilet wouldn't stop flushing. It drained fine, but the shower on the floor below began to overflow. I turned off the water to the toilet above and the overflow in shower stopped and began to recede. But we did not want a repeat.
We called Plumb Crazy at 8:30 am and and they said that they could get someone there before 10:00 am. They did. Bruce arrived at about 9:30 and assessed the situation rapidly but carefully. He diagnosed the problem as a leak in the waste drain system, requiring a pipe snake. He had to search for the cleanout, because it was an old building and had been diverted past the swimming pool, where there was a vertical cleanout in the form of a vertical "T" from the line.
He managed to wrestle the snake into the drain and under/into the house until he cleaned out the pipel
He tested everything to make sure that the solution was correct, cleaned up and gave us the bill. It was entirely reasonable. In fact, given the special effort necessary, I thought it was better than fair.
I recommend Bruce from Plumb Crazy without any reservation, in fact, with enthusiasm. He did a GREAT job at a FAIR price.
Outstanding.

reviews.author: Michael Stephanic
reviews.text:

The late January winter storm Fern wreaked havoc on plumbing in and around Oklahoma. Even while leaving our hot and cold water faucets dribble to prevent freezing, we ended up with a cracked hot water pipe underneath the house. And the follow-up from Plumb Crazy was above and beyond what I’ve had from other plumbers. I highly recommend Plumb Crazy Plumbing for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.text:
I have used them a few times over the years. It's a fairly large company with several employees and it seems like your satisfaction will depend on who they send. This is a consolidated review of my 3 separate interactions with them over the last ~5 years.

1. I wanted my landscape drain hydro-jetted because those pipes are not as sturdy as a sewer pipe. I couldn't get hydro-jetting from small plumbing companies as it is a heavy equipment that comes in a trailer, and small companies don't have them. They didn't want to give a quote over the phone. OK. They came and quoted $650 and said that they will throw in a camera inspection for free. Won't they need to do a camera inspection as part of the free estimate anyway?! That felt weird to me. I didn't want to argue over that and went with the job. It was done satisfactorily.

2. Needed to replace the house sewer line. Clog identified by another small company that does not do replacement. We were told that we had "Orangeburg" pipe and that was cracked. Got a couple of quotes, all roughly the same ($14,000). We choose Wizard. Work was done satisfactorily through trenchless pipe-bursting. The crew did this well, and put all the landscaping back as if nothing was done there. This was a good experience.

3. This one was a bad experience. I think it was the 2021-2022 rain season when there were heavy rains with atmospheric rivers. Backyard flooded and the landscape drain could not keep up. The same pipe that was hydro-jetted a few of years before. Wizard was the first company I contacted in Fall before the next rain season. The person did a camera inspection. He showed me that the pipe was broken on the camera. Pipe camera is not easy to understand for inexperienced eyes like mine. I could see that the pipe was not in a single piece where he showed me. He recommended pipe-bursting to replace the pipe that drains to the street. Quote was $9,000 for replacing the drain pipe, fixing up the sidewalk that they would have to dig up to pull the new pipe from, and hydro-jet all the french drains in the backyard that feed into the drain pipe.

I called Pipe-Thru Trenchless Plumbing for another opinion and estimate. He did a camera inspection of the drain pipe and said that he had not seen a pipe in better condition!!! What about the crack that Wizard showed me on the camera?! Oh, that's a tee where the roof downspout connects to the drain pipe! Further he told me that, if I were to replace the pipe he would recommend against pipe-bursting (which Wizard estimator had recommended), because the drain pipe is too shallow and goes under concrete patio. Pipe-bursting could bust up the patio. He recommended pipe lining inside the existing pipe, if there are cracks. His final estimate was $0, no work needed. Why did the backyard flood then? Large yard, super heavy rains and a single drain couldn't handle it, and there is a small dip in the middle.

If I had let Wizard do the pipe-bursting the downspout would not be connected to the drain anymore!!

A few days later I received a text message from Wizard Customer Care Representative, Andrew F. Jr., reminding me about the $9000 quote and whether I wanted to proceed. I replied back politely with my experience and what the other company told me. There was no response from Wizard.

reviews.text:
$1,830.87 to replace leaking bathroom faucet. Had owner, who is a gravely disabled senior sign contract before starting work. Owner is not able to understand what was being proposed. Relative called about cost. They will not budge. Invoice follows

* Angle Stops: These are the small valves under the sink connected to the water supply. Turn both the hot and cold angle stop valves clockwise to shut off the water. If they don't turn off properly, you may need to shut off the main water supply.
* Open the faucet to relieve any pressure and let the remaining water drain.
Step 2: Disconnect the Water Lines
* Use an adjustable wrench to loosen the nuts connecting the water supply lines to the faucet and the angle stops. * Have a towel or bucket handy to catch any residual water.
Step 3: Remove the Old Faucet
* Underneath the sink, use a basin wrench to loosen and remove the nuts holding the faucet in place. * Once the nuts are removed, lift the old faucet from the sink.
Step 4: Replace the Angle Stops
* Use a wrench to remove the old angle stops by unscrewing them from the water supply pipes.
* Wrap the threads of the new angle stops with plumber's tape to ensure a tight seal, then screw them onto the water supply lines.
Step 5: Install the New Faucet
* Place the new faucet into the sink holes, making sure it is aligned correctly.
* From underneath the sink, screw on the mounting nuts to hold the faucet in place. Tighten them with a basin wrench. * Apply silicone sealant or plumber's putty under the faucet base if required by the manufacturer to prevent water from seeping under the faucet.
Step 6: Connect the Water Supply Lines
* Attach the water supply lines to the new faucet and the new angle stops. Hand-tighten them first, then use a wrench to snug them up.
Step 7: Turn the Water Back On
* Open the angle stops slowly to restore water flow. Check for any leaks around the faucet and the angle stops. * Tighten any connections if necessary.
Step 8: Test the Faucet
* Turn on the faucet and check the water pressure. Ensure that both hot and cold water are functioning correctly.
Once everything is in place and there are no leaks, you're done! Let me know if you need more details on any of these steps.

reviews.author: Taryn R.
reviews.text:
Generally we use wizard plumbing. Never had a bad experience until recently. We had a leaking faucet. I called, and asked for the earliest availability and someone was sent out the next day. When I called, I said our faucet hose is broken and needs to be replaced. I knew the brand of our faucet, and the problem. So that's the backstory. 

They send someone out, he comes out and says it's going to be $350 to diagnose the issue( again, I knew the issue) but if that's their rate I'm not going to fight it. He proceeded to tell me that my faucet is dated and parts are unavailable. Also that our shut off  knobs don't shut all the way and need to be replaced. I said I don't think that an issue as we've never had a leak prior and maybe the water he heard running was the dishwasher that was going. He called a few plumbing stores, said we couldn't get a replacement hose as they don't exist. I do have text message proof- and that we needed to buy a new faucet. Okay cool. I agreed. He said the turn around time was 3 weeks with the possibility to be sooner. He said he'd send a photo of the new faucet so I could approve before purchasing. Mind you our sink is leaking. So 3 weeks isn't a quick solution. Now it's about 5pm, assume he's off for the day, and decide to chat with the manufacturer of the faucet. Right away, I send him a photo- and he says that hose is xyz, it's available and here's a discount code. HONESTLY not even 3 minutes into a chat and the hose is available. Then he proceeds to tell me, guy plumbing has it in stock, and I should call them. I call guy plumbing- they have the part, they schedule an appointment for early the next morning. They show up and within 15 minutes the leaking hose has been replaced. Nothing is leaking, the shut off valves work fine- and ultimately in less time and money to FIX THE PROBLEM than the diagnostic charge from Wizard. 

This hasn't been my previous experiences with wizard but if this the nonsense they're sending out, upcharging clients and lying- I'll happily take my business to honest, quick and far cheaper places like GUY. So after 1000s of gallons of water wasted. The problem is solved and we won't be using wizard again.

reviews.author: Kelly C.
reviews.text:
Save yourself the $$$$ and hassle and just call a different plumber, I cannot recommend Wizard Plumbing AT ALL :(

Called them out on a Sunday evening for an emergency main drain line blockage in my home, after 3 hours onsite with a drain snake they couldn't solve the issue (hard blockage) and said they needed to come back first thing Monday morning to use a camera scope and then excavate the blocked pipe. We were left WITHOUT a functioning toilet or shower in a 1-bath house (and paid $975 for the sunday visit) (the plumber who showed up was nice, the only positive aspect of this experience)

Called them back Monday morning when no one showed up at the designated time and was told my appointment had been moved to the afternoon without anyone notifying me, even though they were aware this was an emergency issue. They had no explanation for why my appointment was moved and no idea why i was told they'd show up in the morning. Horrible communication and customer service! 

I had to scramble to find a different emergency plumber who could show up in the morning, after I found someone else, Wizards plumber called me to say they were at my house ready to work. I told them they were already fired and that I'd found someone else to do the work. So Wizards is incapable of communicating with their customers AND their own employees! 

The best (worst?) part of all of this is that my replacement plumber was able to actually resolve and fix the issue with just a drain snake in 20 minutes, no camera scoping or expensive pipe excavation required!! 

Had I let Wizards continue with the service call they would've been excavating my yard and tearing up the floorboards in my house for NO REASON AT ALL!! 

Do not use this company, just call Roto-Rooter instead!

reviews.author: Rick G.
reviews.text:
This is the second time I've used Wizard. First time was for landscape drainage to prevent (more) flooding in my house. They were excellent then, and this visit today was even better.
Sewer main was backing up and I figured to get ahead before it was completely stopped up. My call was immediately answered by a real person. An appointment was scheduled for within 2 hours, earlier if they could get someone.
About 90 minutes later Joe showed up. I showed him where the clean out was and stood by in case he needed an extra pair of hands. Joe went right to work. The job turned out to be more difficult than expected. We called in Max, the regional supervisor to "camera" the line (at no additional expense!) Unfortunately the blockage was much more severe than originally thought. We needed to hydro-jet the line. When Max showed me the camera video I could see we had temporarily dodged a bullet. We did complete the hydro-jet. The line is now clear and we have decisions to make about our plumbing future in a 70 year old house. I really dislike paying for home maintenance or repairs that I think I can do myself. But the professionalism and the technology used convinced me I was in over my head. Joe, Max, and the two techs whose names I did not get ( they run the hydro-jet machinery) were the best! Clear explanations about what was happening and why. Really clear explanations of what our options are going forward, and excellent communication on the prices charged today and any potential projects in the future. A really great experience for a literally poopy problem. I will ALWAYS recommend Wizard in general, and Joe and Max specifically. Well done guys!

reviews.author: Warren S.
reviews.text:
My experience with Wizard was less satisfactory than other reviews. I knew tree roots kept growing back to the main sewer line but managed to use it by snaking it every a few years without the replacement. 

At last it was clogged again and I decided to replace it. Wizard was hired to unclog the drain and to provide a proposal. The person finished snaking much faster than other plumbers I used before. I was alarmed and asked if he cleaned the sewer line thoroughly. He said he did and would guarantee his workmanship for 3 months. 

Then he was eager to provide a proposal for replacing the sewer. However, he completely misunderstood the layout of the drain pipes and gave an over-priced quote. After I told him he didn't understand where the pipes were correctly, he insisted he was right. I just let him go since a few other plumbers would come for a quote.

One of the plumbers later lowed a video camera to the drain. I was surprised to see that the "workmanship" of that Wizard guy. The roots did fill the pipe section. He did as little as possible and managed to punch a hole with the size of 1/8 of the pipe section through the roots. I let it go sine I was replacing the sewer line anyway. However, I would not recommend Wizard or use them .

reviews.author: Stacy G.
reviews.text:
We hired Wizard to replace our sewer lateral in 2018 and it worked fine for 5 years. Fast forward to 2023 when we started a large home renovation that required we provide the city with a video inspection as a condition for our renovation permit. 

It failed inspection. 

There was a sag in the pipe and standing water visible, the connection to the city main was not replaced as it should have been, nor was a clean out installed as required by code. It would need to be dug up and replaced. 

I called them out to discuss it and they were at first pledging to replace it at no cost. The technician who did the job was known to them to have overseen subpar installations and no longer worked there. They had been "cleaning up" his work for a while, I was told. 

More people came out, a second video inspection was performed and also failed to pass. Since then, no one seems to want to talk to me. I've made many calls over the course of the past 6-8 months. They have great reviews on yelp so I was hopeful they would stand by their work and honor their reputation. Doesn't look to be the case. 
Consider this in your evaluation when hiring a plumber who will do the job correctly and stand by their work.

reviews.author: Haiyang H.
reviews.text:
Later update: please check recent reviews. Apparently, my experience is fairly common recently. Do your diligence and check... something has changed at wizard....

The joy of having children around is having clogged toilets often... here I am again trying to fix a clogged toilet on early Friday morning. Called in the morning at 7:30am and was told someone would be here between noon and 3pm. They also mentioned that they are now having a membership program that the technician could explain to me live. The technician would reach out to me to confirm exact timing. About 2pm. No communication yet. I called again. They mentioned they would follow up. Past 3pm, someone called and apologized. They were so busy that they can't find anyone for a small job. Realistically, they can have someone over on Sunday or Monday morning. To fix a clogged toilet, it takes less than 30 min. I thanked him, hang up and called another company. Someone showed up within an hour, fixed my toilet nice and clean and charge me about the same price. 

I am not sure whether the membership program is now the main driver for the insane delay, or the scale of my job is the problem. Just to share the experience here.

reviews.author: Sandra T.
reviews.text: Our family has a duplex property in Trust and we had to address a leaking water heater that needed to be replaced in January by Jose J., and most recently a property inspection report in addition to a PGE inspection report that resulted in an additional repair to 1 unit and a new water heater replacement to the second unit with repairs done by Kevin G. I also had the pleasure of meeting Jose S., The Field Supervisor who was present and making sure that the PGE inspection report item and the health and safety items in the property inspection report were completed. The quality of work was outstanding. Kevin promptly arrived at the beginning of the 4 hour window, spent the whole day at the property thoroughly and completely addressing the jobs on both units. He was so knowledgeable, polite and respectful. The pricing was current market value plus a 1 year warranty. I did need some revisions with the description of work done at the request of our realtor and Jose S went ABOVE and BEYOND to promptly revise our paperwork. Wizard Plumbing and Drain has provided us with many years of continued high quality plumbing services and excellent customer service. Thank you!

synthesis.summary: Wizard Plumbing has undergone an ownership change and the quality decline is documented across dozens of 2024–2025 Yelp reviews: an AI scheduler that books appointments no one shows up for, prices that have roughly doubled, and a 'free estimate' promise that turns into $120–$200 charges once the tech arrives. Earlier reviews (pre-2022) were genuinely positive; the company appears to have fundamentally changed since acquisition.

reviews.text: Lee did an excellent job.  He explained everything in detail and answered all of my questions.

reviews.author: Kristine S.
reviews.text: I called to have some simple work done and it turned out to be $1629.47 for some work that is not up to par. They came out a total of 4 times and we are still having issues. They said they can no longer service my address and I had a warranty for 1 year. So I should be covered until 6/3/26. The employees take pictures, video and recordings of your home without consent and even after being told they can not do so without permission. I requested a copy of all the warranty information, company policy on pictures, videos and recording, and all documents they have for my home. I still have not received anything. I still have an issue with the work they done and will have to get another company out to fix. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY!!! IT WAS A VERY EXPENSIVE MISTAKE.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: Wow, so we had Chisolm over on the hottest day of the year because our AC wasn't working well. They told us it's 10 years old so either replace it (for $14k!!) or it would be $1100 to find the coolant leak and $1000+ for 7 lbs of coolant! I don't have that kind of money, most people don't. My dad said that was crazy, so we got a second option today. The tech that came out told us it may have a tiny leak, but it's not the problem, the system in the attic doesn't have the correct end boxes to function efficiently, a $500-$600 fix.AND the system only holds 6.2 lbs including the lines if it's completely out!! WOW, we almost got taken by these guys for $2k+ or $14k for a new system! They either did not know what they were doing or were trying to take us to the cleaners. BEWARE!

reviews.author: Jennifer T.
reviews.text:
I would give this company a zero rating if I could. The owner, John Barry Chisholm, talks a good game in the beginning, but he/his company do NOT stand behind their work. I had a very expensive air unit installed in August 2020 and within 2 days it wasn't cooling, so I called them to come out. The thermostat was set on 69 and it was 75 in the house. It wasn't cooling at all. It is only at his convenience he will send someone out. He doesn't care about your scheduling needs. I had to take a great deal of time off work to be there when they could come. I waited a week for my scheduled time- then they arrived late. Dale Kemp, the install manager, told me there was nothing wrong with it when he came out. It continued to stay in the mid to upper 70's in my house. I had to call and pay another company to come take a look and the thermostat wasn't even installed properly! 
I am also attaching some pictures to this review- they should tell you everything you need to know. The first is my air unit after installation. The remaining is what I uncovered months later. 
**Please keep in mind that I told them I did NOT want mulch because there is no landscaping on that side of the house. **
I called immediately when I saw this and again was told I'd have to wait about a week. The owner also told me that it was only cosmetic, but Dale (install manager) told me, no that wasn't true- that the pad underneath was warped and the unit could have fallen at any time. When they looked at it, I was told they would install a concrete pad for an additional $350! It should have had a concrete pad in the first place because the unit sits on a slope.

Not one time at any point through this ordeal did the owner ever apologize! He only told me I was being difficult because I wanted it fixed properly.

I do NOT recommend this company!! They are very shady and as you can see, the work they do is abysmal. The owner is very unethical and unprofessional. 
Save yourself the time and trouble and AVOID THIS COMPANY!!

reviews.author: michael spanbauer
reviews.text: Clark and Skip provided an outstanding level of service  and dedication to diagnose and repair a number of issues with my HVAC system. They first replaced the old fiberboard plenums that were sagging and leaking air with new sheet metal  enclosures and reconnected all the flex pipe duct work with new collars and couplings, then sealed the seams and joints with silicone.  Once that was done they moved on to address a suspected problem with the temperature sensor on the outdoor compressor unit.  However, they determined that the sensor was actually good, but the high pressure outlet was reading very low on the pressure gauge,  indicating that a leak was present in the system. Skip  eventually found a small pinhole leak in the evaporator coil unit in the attic, so they immediately called the warehouse to see if there might be a new evaporator coil available for replacement under warranty. Luckily they were able to get the coil and install it in the same day, so once it was in place and all the copper piping connections were complete, they purged all of the old refrigerant out of the system to eliminate any residual contaminants and moisture and re-charged the system with new R-410  refrigerant. Once this was complete and the system was activated, the inlet and outlet temperatures at the ducts inside the house indicated that everything was working well again. Throughout all of these different tasks I could tell that Clark and Skip paid a lot of attention to all of the details in their work and they did everything possible to get my system back up and running in the same day.

reviews.author: Rebecca Wagner
reviews.text:
Chisholm has been excellent. We've unfortunately needed their services multiple times over the past year, but everyone that has come out has been extremely kind and efficient. Our most recent technician was Jordan (Bear). His demeanor from the moment I answered the door was top notch. I'd honestly continue to use Chisholm just because of his service in particular.

**One note that I want to share, however, is that while this company is fantastic, please do your research if you need a restoration crew to come out as well. The one that Chisholm recommends and got us involved with is one that I would stay far away from. I didn't know any better, and they may not either. Just trying to save others the nightmare we went through with restorations.**

reviews.text:

They were quite knowledgeable about my system—it honestly felt like they were already very familiar with it before even arriving. What stood out most was how genuine they were. No sales pressure, no scripted feel—just honest, friendly service. It’s not always easy to find people who are both skilled and personable, but they absolutely delivered on both. Highly recommend!

He was also on time and very nice and professional. Thanks so much!

10/10!! From call to fixed less than 3h

reviews.author: Rhianna Kern
reviews.text:
Dex and the crew literally saved our night (and our hardwood floors!) We got home from work and the kitchen sink was backing up with gross water and quickly started overflowing onto the floor. Between bailing out drainage water and panicking, Rescue Plumbing answered the phone in 2 rings and said we can help you right now.

Not only did Dex and his team show up AFTER HOURS in the SNOW, they were warm, kind and jumped right into action to save my kitchen. They knew exactly what to do, explained it all to me, told me the costs right up front and stuck to it. Within 30 minutes they fixed our building’s drainage issue, cleaned up the kitchen neat as a pin and were out the door with a quick joke.

I hope I don’t need to see them again but also if I need a plumber, they’re saved in my phone and getting every recommendation. 4 seasons and ABC told me I’d have to wait til tomorrow afternoon at the earliest and I think my floors would have been ruined from overflowing sink water if I didn’t have Rescue Plumbing. Thank you Dex and team!!!

reviews.author: Claire Anderson
reviews.text: This team was outstanding. Within 10 minutes of me calling they had three guys in the house working to fix my pipes. Ended up having 6 burst pipes during the Omar vortex that were really complex to fix and Dex and his team were fast and kept me updated the whole time. I have two small children at home and need water to properly care for them and he promised me no matter what he was getting me water by the end of the night. And they did for a good cost. I cannot say enough for how amazing this company is and the men who work for it are. So great fun to have found them

reviews.author: Joseph Morisco
reviews.text:
I scheduled a plumber to come out and had a few questions after booking the appointment. I called back simply to understand what the technician planned to do since I had already had the line rodded a few months ago and didn’t want to just repeat the same service without understanding the approach.

Unfortunately, whoever answered the phone was extremely dismissive. She repeatedly cut me off while I was speaking and had a noticeable attitude. I wasn’t trying to be difficult — I was just asking basic questions about the service.

Instead of listening, she kept saying they couldn’t tell me anything over the phone and wouldn’t even let me finish my sentences. Because of that interaction, I immediately canceled my appointment.

Good customer service starts with listening to the customer. Losing business simply because someone won’t take a moment to hear a question is disappointing.

I even asked like you didnt even look at it.. you arent telling me whats broken just that it old and broke... well I can see that... he made a call to the company about warranty... wrote his paper for the 75 dollar fee and left... did nothing for 75 bucks Nothing

reviews.text: First service a few months ago left me happy, issue got taken care of right away. Appt was made and tech was there within the estimated time frame. Scheduled an appointment same day within the hour, the tech was dispatched- i waited 2 1/2 hours before calling for an update and being told there is issues with travel and they cant make it in, thats fine, i reschedule for next day, wait over an hour and a half before calling for an update, was told to hold on a bit more. An hour later they call to reschedule that the tech cannot come, made for next day in the AM this time instead of PM. Got a call this morning at 7am-(3 hours before my appointment time) to ask if my appointment can be moved up, the tech can be there in the next 30 minutes, i agree, wait, over an hour later, nothing- i call for an update, am told the technician is supposed to be on the way still but nothing. I cancelled the appointment. Ive had to rearange my schedule for 3 days now and ive been able to try things at home to help my plumbing issues. Crying in the club- send help
