No work was done by hero.
Called another company.
Due to original appointment was for 2/4 no show, sent email to confirm and rescheduled for 2/5 no response and then your employee shows up an announced with no schedule time window by then I already had called someone else which they confirmed the time

reviews.author: Debra Flohr
reviews.text:
This is the second time we have used Rooter Hero.. They are all very pleasant from the first call finding out what our issue is .. to again calling back with an appointment time as well as an email and txt message.. Today we seen the technician Darrion Davis.. Very nice and knowledgeable young man.. Explained everything he was going to do before he started.. Problem was solved and fixed and were very happy with his service and his company..
Thank you so much Rooter Hero & Darrion Davis.. Much appreciated .. Jay & Debra Flohr

reviews.author: Manoj varughese
reviews.text: "I had a great experience with Rooter Hero Plumbing when they came out to fix my kitchen sink. The technician, Diego Ruiz, was amazing—he took the time to explain every step of the process so I knew exactly what was being done. The work was finished exactly when promised, and the price was very fair compared to other quotes I received. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for honest, high-quality plumbing work. Thank you, Diego!"

reviews.author: Jordan Defiesta
reviews.text: Darrion was excellent to work with. He was fast, respectful, and very transparent about the work that needed to be done. He clearly explained the options, pricing, and next steps, which immediately put me at ease. His business and sales acumen made the entire process smooth and pressure-free, and it was genuinely easy to do business with him. I’d absolutely recommend Darrion to anyone looking for a reliable, trustworthy plumber.

reviews.author: Denise Jordan
reviews.text: Called this company and they came out short notice. Josias was the tech that came out and he was very professional. He asked what the problem was and got right to work. He went down to his work van and retrieved all the equipment that was needed and got the job done. If I’m ever a need of a plumbing company again, I won’t hesitate to reach back out. Great job Rooter Hero Plumbing!

reviews.author: Herve Hui
reviews.text: I called for sewer backup service. Al came on time and promptly went to work. The problem seemed to be more serious than anticipated and additional equipment did not clear the blockage due to a possible broken underground pipe. Although the drain could not be cleared on the spot Al and his team were very professional and maybe called back once my insurance coverage is confirmed.

reviews.author: Dennis Leung
reviews.text: The service technician we had was extremely knowledgeable with plumbing and water leakage. He explained well what went wrong, how he would fix the leakage and checked all aspects of the leakage to ensure no more water flows out! Technician came across as very friendly and courteous, no questions unanswered! My husband and I are very satisfied with the services he provided!

reviews.author: linda fiorito
reviews.text:
Jay, I believe knew  exactly what he needed  to do to fix my plumbing problem. He is courteous on time and if he’s going to be late, he always informed me by phoning. After replacing my completely old and clogged
pipes with new ones he cleaned up and took all the garbage with him. My double sinks and my shower now drain perfectly and we are very pleased.

reviews.author: Mike Robinson
reviews.text: Fantastic experience.  Kent was quick to arrive, quick to assess and diagnose, and quick to resolve the issue.  He was polite, personable, and made me feel completely at ease during the whole process - one that was causing me some concern as it was a potential flooding of my garage.  Great work - and would love to work with him again... anytime.

reviews.author: Lisa Disterheft
reviews.text: Leonard's always great - he's done a bunch of different jobs for me (I'm a small time property manager in charge of 14 toilets and more sinks, etc.). Everything from leaks in the ceiling to mysterious backups to sinks where someone installed fixtures upside down - he's always my go-to call. I would never hesitate to recommend. :D

reviews.author: Youmna Sirgi
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience with Kent and Rooter Hero. They were able to come quickly on a Sunday and worked for 4+ hours until the situation was resolved, going well into the late evening.

Kent was incredibly kind, calm and able to answer all of my questions and help my understand the problem. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: J T
reviews.text: Logan was great to work with on our drain issue. He was very courteous and had reached out to let me know what time he'd be there. He was done within 30 minutes of arriving and took care of the backed up drain. He was very conscientious of making sure water did not get all over the place and that was appreciated!

The regulars — Leonard, Jose, Jay, Eric — show up reliably for property managers and homeowners alike, fix things right the first time, and price fairly. One reviewer who manages 14 toilets calls Leonard her go-to without hesitation.

reviews.text: This company is the worst. It took them three visits over a month trying to get simple plumbing problems fixed. I have never ever seen anyone as unprofessional as these " plumbers " I wound up buying my own parts at the hardware store and inside of an hour I repaired what they couldn't do in three hours. and watch out because they will try to upsell you and convince you that you have more problems. my problem was allowing them to work on my house the first time!

reviews.author: Jamespp W.
reviews.text: Terrible service and very unprofessional. I won't even give them a 1. That's too high. Their 2,2 rating is too high

reviews.author: Robert P.
reviews.text: Mr. Rooter is the local contractor for American Home Shield. I contacted AHS on 3/28/2021 and requested service for my kitchen faucet. The request was assigned to Mr. Rooter who contacted me and scheduled the appointment. The plumber came out and examined the faucet by taking a photograph. The faucet is an upgraded, high-end, touch faucet. He never examined the faucet to see if it could be repaired. While at my home he contacted AHS and then said that AHS would order the faucet and that once it arrived, Mr. Rooter would let me know and come back to install it. He could give me no timetable because AHS was going to order the faucet. He said that if I wanted quicker service, I could purchase the faucet myself locally and pay Mr. Rooter to install it. I chose to wait for AHS because I have already paid for that service. On 4/16/2022, I called AHS to check on the status of the order. Over two weeks without water in our kitchen was an inconvenience. The AHS representative said the service order had been closed. Mr. Rooter was supposed to order the faucet and install it. I told her that the plumber had said that AHS was going to order the faucet and I had to wait till Mr. Rooter received the faucet from AHS before it could be installed. The AHS representative said that AHS does not order replacement parts; the plumbers order the parts. She said she would email Mr. Rooter to order the faucet ASAP. I waited 5 more days and then called Mr. Rooter because I had not heard from them. I asked for a status update. The person I spoke with said that the faucet had been ordered on 4/6/2022. I found that had to believe since the plumber had told me that he had to wait for AHS to order the faucet. I then asked for the name of the vendor they ordered the faucet from. The person at Mr. Rooter said she could not provide the name of the vendor they ordered the faucet from. I asked if she could check on when the faucet might arrive. She said she could do that but she did not check on that even though I asked her to please check on that for me. I then asked her for the name of the owner for the local Mr. Rooter franchise. She put me on hold and then came back on and said if I had more questions, I would have to contact AHS - that she could not help me further. I asked if she was refusing to give me the name of the local owner. She said that AHS would have that information. I called AHS and they did not have the name of the local owner. AHS placed me on hold and attempted to call Mr. Rooter to get the owner's name and contact information but no one answered the phone; it went directly to voicemail. AHS said that they would email Mr. Rooter and request that they send me the information I was requesting. I am disappointed and frustrated that we have no water in our kitchen; that I don't have any idea of when we will get the faucet installed or even when it will arrive. 4/21/2022 I attempted to call Mr. Rooter back to see if they had received the email from AHS. After waiting on hold for approximately 5 minutes, I was routed to a voicemail box where I received the message that the mailbox was full and could not accept further voicemails, and then I was disconnected.  It appears that Mr. Rooter attempted to circumvent AHS procedures to get me to order the faucet and pay them additionally to install the faucet when I have already paid AHS for the service. Their ethics appear questionable. Unfortunately, my contract with AHS requires me to use Mr. Rooter so I'm stuck with this plumbing company.

reviews.author: Billy M.
reviews.text:
I will never again do any business with Mr Rooter, and based on the other reviews you shouldn't either. They didn't do any work, but they wasted 2 trips, 6 days, my time, and my home warranty's money.

Atmos discovered a leak on our property on 01/22/2021. They shut-off the gas, and we immediately scheduled an appointment with a San Angelo plumbing company who did outstanding work on 01/25/2021. However, they detected a slow leak in the house. They gave me an estimate, but because I have a home warranty company I called them and they said it would be covered. They cancelled their open permit and instructed me to have the warranty company's plumbers open a new permit. While this was happening a city inspector showed up, and inspected their work. However, because there was a leak under the house they couldn't complete the inspection. With the city inspector there I was instructed to have the new company get a new permit, and the inspector would come back and finish the inspection.

That same day I opened a ticket with the warranty company, and it was Mr Rooter. I called to schedule a time, but the rude receptionist told me she'd have to check the schedule and call me back in a few minutes. She didn't call back that day.

Tuesday she finally called and scheduled for Thursday between 2 and 4. Usually a company will call ahead, but they didn't. At 2:06, the receptionist called and extremely rudely told me they were there but leaving. I asked for them to wait 5 minutes for me to get home. I got there 5 minutes later since I work nearby, but they were gone. I called back to rescheduled, and the receptionist was rude again and told me she'd call back.

The plumbers came back about 30 minutes later. I explained the situation and that the leak was under the house. They said they needed to test the line but didn't have a compressor. ON A CALL FOR A GAS LEAK THEY DIDN'T BRING THE TOOLS TO FIND THE LEAK! AFTER I'D ALREADY TOLD THEM THE LEAK WAS UNDER THE HOUSE...Why even bother coming out for 10 minutes?

They just left my house (Saturday), and I'm so mad I'm shaking while I write this. 2 different plumbers showed up, and I again explained the situation. The older plumber balked at doing anything and called someone. After the call, they hooked up the compressor and confirmed there was a leak. They said they'd have to pull a permit and climb under the house to find it. That should have already been done, but ok...

Another Mr Rooter van pulled up, and the man driving said they couldn't do the work. I told him they just needed to pull a permit and they could. He made excuses, left, and they just cancelled my ticket.

I explained the situation to Mr Rooter employees at least 4 times from Monday - Saturday. My family, including my 9 month old baby, has not had heat or hot water for 6 days because of Mr Rooter. It'll be at least 2 more days since it's the weekend and the city permit offices are closed. If they wouldn't do the work that's one thing, but they've been completely unprepared every step of the way. I told them multiple times the leak is under the house, so they knew they needed a permit. I told them multiple times there was a new line outside the house. They made a quick buck from my home warranty company for literally 10 minutes of diagnosis, but they'll never get the opportunity to do any work for me again.

reviews.author: Vidal S.
reviews.text: Update: The water damage that was caused by the improper installation of the water hoses was over $2500. I called the company (mr rooter from Abilene) and I was told not to call back, that they will call me with a respond. I asked them for a time frame and they said they don't have a time frame. The company has been working on a response to the reviews I posted about them. On March 7, I received an email from Peter, the owner, explaining to me that it was my fault and that my home insurance needs to pay for the water damage. Mr Peter also asked me why I posted the reviews online. I told him because nobody was calling me. He gave the impression that he was more worried about the reviews then the damage that his workers caused. When the workers (Juan and Leo) arrived the water was off, but they claimed the water was still on. I turned the water off when I was on the phone with them and I'm the one that said I'm turning the water off. The workers saw the hoses,that they installed, were loose enough that you could move them by hand. The technician Leo started blaming the other worker immediately. The workers, Juan and Leo, were arguing in front of me.  When they replaced the hose I was told by Mr Leo, that Juan believes that the seal might have broken and that is why it was leaking. I knew that he was lying to me because when Leo was arguing with Juan he said "you can't say that" and that is when he started blaming the other worker. This doesn't explain why the hose was loose. The original technicians Leo and another person installed the hose improperly. They took a picture of the hoses when they were initially installed. The hose became loose after the picture was taken and after they left. How the hose became loose, I don't know but I know that the technicians installed the hoses they brought and they are the only ones that touched the hose.  The technician,Juan, saying the hose was loose shows the hoses were improperly installed and the technician, Leo, becoming defensive and started blaming the other worker and then the equipment in front of me shows it was there fault. The workers are dishonest because they changed their statement.  Mr Peter, the owner, told me that my home insurance should pay for this. My home insurance will not pay because the amount is below my deductible, and why should my insurance pay for this it was their work that caused the damaged. They are the ones that should pay for the bill not me. Mr Pete claims the technicians ask me if I had any other issues and I said no.  This is not true the technician told me if I had any issues to call them but the hose should not leak anymore and left in a hurry. The water damage was not discover until I went to my sitting area in the bedroom until that night. The dishonesty of the workers and failure to take responsibility for their work shows a lot of the owner and the company. Them failing to take responsibility has put my family in a financial hardship.

reviews.author: Larry K.
reviews.text:
If could give a minus grade, certainly would.  Worst people ever.  Liars. Don't use this place, you will regret it.  Our water heater was leaking in the cellar where it is located.  We have a homeowner's warranty and they turned ticket in to Mr. Rooter.  Mr. Rooter staff came out on Friday  1.19.18 around 4:00 pm and inspected the unit, took photos, and made a list of parts needed for the job.  They told me they would submit to Old Republic that evening and if approved we may be able to get a new unit installed on Saturday or Sunday.  The request was listed as urgent because of continual water running in and out and gas running to heat the water.

On 1.20.18 at 8:00 am I call the office, no answer.  At 9:00 am, the call rolls to a cell phone; Heather responds will contact the techs.  A short time later, Heather calls back saying the techs didn't submit because they had to finish their appointments and are now in San Angelo so will do when get back.  

Three hours later, I call Old Republic who tells me the report has not been filed.  They put me on hold and call Pete.  Pete says he is close by and will stop over in about an hour.  Two hours later, with no response from Pete, I call Old Republic.  They put me on hold and call Pete who says he didn't come by and went to the office instead.  He was going to send in the report while I was on hold; this was at 5:30 pm.  A few minutes later, Old Republic says the amount is much higher than normal and will take their audit department approval, so they hang up with me and discuss with the audit department.

At 7:30 pm, Old Republic calls and says the job has been approved, but that nothing will happen until Monday because Pete has to pull permits.

Now it is Monday, 1.22.18 at 10:00 am; no word from Pete.  Shortly thereafter, Old Republic calls and says Pete will pull permits today, but will not be by until tomorrow to install.  Leak is much worse now and hot doesn't last a normal shower.

Wife goes to visit office and Heather says he not in, but low and behold he steps out of his office and he and the wife get into an argument, with Pete threatening to call the police.

At around 1:00 pm, Old Republic says get whoever we want to do the job.  We make a call, and at 3:30 pm on 1.22.18 a plumber we have used before comes over, drains the tank, takes inventory of what we need, and at 4:00 pm, goes to City to pull the permit and go get the new water heater and supplies.  By 7:00 pm, the job is done except a little clean up and hot water is an hour away.  Inspected this morning with NO problems.

Pete the lazy and his lying company employees will never set foot in our house................ever!

You should do the same and call someone else.

reviews.author: Daniel S.
reviews.text:
FRAUD ALERT!!! These animals came to my home as part of my home warranty with AHS and as a former HVAC tech I knew EXACTLY what they were thinking. The younger guy was rude to my wife as they went to the wrong door and never rang the bell then attempted to mock her suggesting she should have known they were there? 

Next, these fraudsters stood around as I attempted to move a stacked washer and dryer so they had more room with so much as offering a hand. The kid went back and took photos. But the older fraud already knew the problem or rather... the "solution" he would present. He told me they didn't sell valves separately but I KNEW THEY DID! I said they do, then he said something that made no sense and told me I would need to move the washer and dryer myself and they would have to replace the entire box even though the warranty would only cover the valves? But why would a warranty only cover valves you supposedly couldn't buy?

This along with obviously cutting drywall I would have to fix, replacing my CPVS piping with pex without giving me a reason. BUT did tell me the warranty would cover the valves? How could a home warranty cover valves that didn't exist as a part? How would they price them? 1/3 of a box set? I never told them I was an HVAC tech and they assumed because of our home that they could rip us off and tried.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY! They WILL take your warranty and include whatever they can to max out your repair. I WOULD NOT TRUST THEM WITH THE REPAIR THEY ARE THAT INCOMPETENT. So I purchased the valves myself and will make the fix myself.

Save your mothers and fathers and daughters from these dregs of humanity. The WORST!!! Negative 10 stars! They MUST BE PUT OUT OF BUSINESS!

Sadly the kids name was "Emmanuel." I would not want to be him when the REAL Emmanuel comes back in His Glory against all unrighteousness. He HATES fraud.

reviews.author: Matt B.
reviews.text:
There is a reason that these guys have such awful reviews on here. They are dishonest crooks at worst and extremely incompetent at best. 

Mr.Rooter was dispatched by Homeserve to check on a sewer pipe issue. The technician was nice but did not seem very experienced and had tons of mistakes in his write-up. Communication with the office is horrible and they act as weird middle men for the technicians. I was told on three separate occasions that I would get a call back by the end of the day and never did. They came out here twice and still could not estimate what the repair job would cost. However, they did send me an unannounced and unjustified invoice for $1800 with absolutely no detail. A supervisor was sent out from Abilene "just for me" and go figure...he did not bring a camera and STILL could not estimate the job. He did want me to pay an outrageous $450 for ANOTHER camera inspection that takes less than an hour. 

I had a local company do a camera inspection for half the price and had an estimate to me by the end of day. They did not experience the mysterious issue of not being able to get the camera through the "Collapsed line." I watched the entire time and there was plenty of space for the camera to go through.

Mr.Rooter's pay is commission based and this is most likely why they try to up-charge every time they move a finger and find different reasons to charge you for the same thing.

Mr.Rooter is not worth $10 an hour, much less the $450 that they try to charge.

reviews.author: Carey O.
reviews.text:
The techs sent to my home were  condescending.  They also bad-mouthed other plumbing companies and were not willing to do anything to try to diagnose my problem other than flushing the toilet.  They were sent out by HomeServe.  They stated that I would need to pay them to install a clean out in my yard and proceeded to tell me that I needed to agree to the price and schedule it right then because they were very busy.  They did all this while badmouthing other local plumbing companies and speaking to me like I'm a 2 year old. I didn't appreciate the pressure and told them that I needed to get other estimates and they promptly left.  I later learned that Mr Rooter should have reported to HomeServe that I needed a cleanout installed so they could accurately diagnose the problem and that HomeServe would have paid for that.  Instead, taking Mr Rooter's word for it, I am now out of pocket $544 for something that would have been covered by my warranty.  The amount Mr Rooter quoted when offering to "give me a deal" was $200 more.

Followup: I received emails from Heather and Ashley as a result of my review.  They both expressed wanting to make the situation right.  I told them they could pay for the clean out, which would have been covered by my warranty if their employees had accurately represented the problem to my warranty company.  They made multiple excuses and refused to make it right.

reviews.author: Jayleigh Patterson
reviews.text: So not impressed with service and customer service. We had to use them because of our home warranty. The only time they could come was when i had a doctors appointment. I let the tech know when he got to my house that i was about to go into my doctors and would be hard to get ahold of but would call back very fast. I missed his call by two minutes. Called to tell me it was going to be a $1,200 fix. I told him that wasn’t in our budget, and i ask if there was anything else we could try, where he notified me he had already left and there was nothing he could do. Called back to see about having someone else come back and get a second opinion and they would not come back without me paying a $178 travel fee and the best they could do was cut $20 off that fee. This was on top of me having to pay for the work they would do as well. Would not suggest using them if you don’t live in the Abilene area, unfortunately for us, we’re in cross plains and have to pay ridiculous travel fees for being in rural areas. Was hoping for some accountability with the team and have someone at least come and give us a second opinion but because there was no budget we will not be using them. Wasted our only stoppage claim on our home warranty on them to flush a toilet and quote us a $1,200 job when every other source says to pull the toilet and snake first, then try vent jetter.

reviews.author: Sandra L.
reviews.text: Terrible service, rude office staff. I had a busted pipe and my home warranty has a contract with Mr Rooter. The tech came out and turned off the water. He told me that someone would be out "either later today or first thing tomorrow". No one called so I called the office at 0900 the next morning to inquire about a time. I was told that they would call me back and let me know. I called two hours later and was treated dismissively and still not told when I could expect someone to come out. I called my home warranty company and he reached out to them and was told that they would be calling me shortly. I took the day off to be home and didn't hear from them before end of business. I decided to go ahead and hire someone else because I needed the job completed. Even with the warranty, they said I would have at least $300 of additional cost. The plumber I hired charged only $500 (and the job ended up requiring a new water heater in addition to fixing the pipe) and was competent, friendly, and thorough. I am planning to install a hot tub soon and now I know who I absolutely won't call for the job. Please spare yourself the aggravation and avoid Mr Rooter.

reviews.author: B H.
reviews.text: Horrible customer service and treatment from the owner!  Scheduled appointment and they weren't here, I called to check and was told CSR tried to call yesterday and it wasn't their fault I didn't answer the phone!  I checked phone records and there was no incoming call from them the prior day.  They said they were not done with the previous job and after putting me on hold, said they could come between 1-2 that day and start and come again the next day.  We had scheduled ahead of time, took off the day and were told they would complete it in one day.  I asked for the owner to call me before anything else was decided.  About an hour later the owner called, he continued the excuses and even said that I am not his only customer and he can't guarantee scheduled times!   I told him customers need to be told this ahead of time and he made excuses, was very harsh and rude to me and finally hung up on me!   I do NOT recommend this company and have seen many of the same reviews about the poor customer service and poor handling of customers by the owners himself.

synthesis.summary: Mr. Rooter Abilene has one of the most consistent negative review patterns in this dataset: a $3,000 quote for a $120 unclog, repeated no-shows (two-appointment no-shows on the same job), billing for work not performed, and a direct accusation from a reviewer that the owner told a customer his real client was the home warranty company — not the homeowner. The handful of positive reviews describe situations where a different tech or a straightforward job produced acceptable results, but the overwhelming pattern across Yelp (42 reviews) is fraud, upselling, and scheduling failure.
strengths: A handful of reviewers report good service when a tech like Grady or Torres handles the job
Same-day response documented on a few occasions when the job was simple
One reviewer reports honest completion of a hot water line repair at almost half the worst-case estimate
weaknesses: Tub stoppage quoted at $3,000 — competitor unclogged it for $120
Two back-to-back no-shows on the same job documented, with no calls or notifications
Home warranty customers report technicians adding non-covered charges and fabricating line items
Camera inspections conducted without proper equipment; camera video withheld with false HIPAA justification
redFlags: Tech told a homeowner: 'we are trying to get out of covering everything under warranty, so my boss tells me I have to charge for things that warranty would normally pay for'
Owner told a customer directly that his clients were the home warranty companies, not the homeowners
Reviewer paid $1,000 for no results, then hired another company for $130 to fix the same problem
Hose installation caused $2,500 in water damage; owner blamed homeowner and refused accountability — police called during final billing dispute
Military family paid $1,000 for work that made their toilets unflushing; competitor fixed for $130
Technician ghost-appeared on tracking app at the address, drove away without knocking, then submitted a 'missed appointment' notification
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple emergency situations documented where the company failed to respond, showed up unprepared, or abandoned the job — including a family with a baby left without heat or hot water for 6 days due to repeated Mr. Rooter failures.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google rating is 4.6 vs Yelp 2.3 across 42 reviews — a 2.3-star gap. The volume and consistency of negative Yelp reviews (pricing fraud, no-shows, workmanship failures) across many years suggests the Google rating significantly overstates actual quality.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: When I had a stoppage in my tub, they told me it would be around $3,000. I had another plumber come out — they unclogged my tub for $120!

burst-pipe.topQuote: Terrible service, rude office staff. I had a busted pipe and no one called so I called the office at 0900 the next morning to inquire about a time. I was told they would call me back and let me know.

sewer.topQuote: Mr. Rooter's pay is commission based — this is most likely why they try to up-charge every time they move a finger. Not worth $10 an hour, much less the $450 they charge for a camera inspection.

gas-leak.topQuote: My family, including my 9 month old baby, has not had heat or hot water for 6 days because of Mr. Rooter.

reviews.text: Wish I could leave zero stars. We're out 2 days ago. Said it's fixed same problem and water overflowing and they say well until your property company gives us another work order not our problem pretty much. reviews.author: Kat S.
reviews.text: The first time my husband hired a technician to have our garbage disposal removed more than a year ago, I did not realize he was from Brothers.  Fast forward plenty of months and the cold season starts.  Time to "fire" up your heater, except it doesn't.  It seemed like our HVAC unit had a mind of its own and turned on only when it wanted to (for the heater portion anyway).  After a couple days of this nonsense I told my husband to please, please call someone to get this fixed.  He did and someone came out, checked the thermostat and just like that it cooperated and worked fine.  I'm sure the technician thought we must be doozies.  A couple of days later the heater quit completely and so hubby called them back up.  Another technician came out and after a thorough check he informed us that the switch for the heater is broken and needs to be replaced.  I wish I knew what reasonable pricing on such work and parts is, but I guess as long as it is affordable it is decent.  He fixed it within an hour and we finally had the warm air flowing through the house as we needed to thaw ourselves up.  Thank God we have two small portable heaters that kept us sane in the time our heater was on fiasco.  I know they also offer a program or deal for a certain fee to have your unit checked quarterly and to cover minimal repairs/maintenance, but we cannot afford it at this time, otherwise it sounds like a good deal not to have to worry when some appliance in your house fails to deliver.  Their technicians have always been polite and professional.  The only thing I don't like is that there is a service dispatch fee of $50 that you have to pay for a technician to come out to your location; although sometimes, depending on the repair issue they will comp it.  Overall, I'm satisfied with the service we have received from this company and plan on using them again.

reviews.author: Greg C.
reviews.text: Just to inform people about this company I spent thirty thousand dollars replacing three new AC units in the past two years the install was good .I hand a five ton unit not functioning properly that was cycling every fifteen seconds I called they sent a Technician out the next week was quite a long time I know some things about HVAC this was probably a capacitor issue the Tech diagnostic test showed the capacitor was borderline I told him to replace they charged $211.00 to replace a $69.00 dollar part .I understand the charge less than 24 hours later I now have two new AC system not working not coming on called at 9 PM they returned my call the next morning no problem they told me they would not come until 4PM . I explained that they were there less than 48 hours before and their shop is only ten minutes away from my home still would not send a Tech till 4pm .I ask don't you have a emergency Tech on call still reused to help I know it is something small to repair probably take less than fifteen minutes to repair.Still no help on the time.I explained I will not do business with them again if this is the service that a good customer gets dint seem to care .I told them to send a Tech at 4 PM since I already paid oh they were going to charge me another service call $169.00 I refused to pay so the lady acted like she was going to do me a favor and waive the service call remember I already paid this less than 48 hours before.This is terrible customer service I will never do business with this company again they didn't care very casual about it acted like no big deal even after I spent $30,000.00 be careful about these Brothers

reviews.author: Dan K.
reviews.text:
These guys are AMAZING!!  I'm new to the area and I just bought a house, which had a thermostat downstairs that powered down and I couldn't get it back on.  I talked to the previous owner and we tried to troubleshoot it, but couldn't fix it so he told me to contact Brothers since they installed it.  

They were booked solid all week, but the receptionist was able to have someone stop by and look at it in between jobs.  The guy remembered the house and did an inspection to be sure he knew what was going on this time.  He was able to give me a short-term fix and explained what needed to be done and that he wasn't sure how long his fix would hold up -- I had a big problem that needed to be addressed.  This first visit was FREE and he coordinated to have another manager talk to me about scheduling a permanent fix.

When the second manager came out, the short-term fix already broke and he was willing to get parts and return to fix it for good.  Remember: they were booked all week and I already had two managers look at my house and now they're fixing it!  The job took the rest of the day, but I'm so thankful they stayed around to get it right.  Their prices were VERY fair and they honored a quote they have the previous owner at this house.

This is a highly professional company and I will ABSOLUTELY be working with them again.  

Tom & Bryan: thanks for all you guys did.  You're the best!

reviews.author: Bill K.
reviews.text:
A bathroom at my daughter's house had a hair clog in a corroded 1.5" galvanided waste line. Brothers used a combination of hand snake and mini-jet. The plumber and helper always had plastic booties on their feet in the house. The bathroom was very clean when they left. They were pleasant to talk to. They quickly assessed the situation, looked for options to fix, and recommend the repair. Their cost is very high. I have a house near San Francisco, and the cost is every bit as high as I would pay there.

There is an overhead charge of $70. They call this 'dispatch fee', but it is money charged to cover business overhead. The mini-jet was an additional $475. I tried, but could not fix the problem myself, so $545 for experience and their tools. Other than cost, I have no reservations recommending the company.

I'm torn on how to set the star rating. When you pay this much for a service, you should expect the positives I mentioned, so 3-stars (ok) would be fair. If the service was half the price, you wouldn't expect it to be as good, but if it was really good, you'd have to say 5-star (great for value). I'm splitting the difference - 4-star.

reviews.author: L H
reviews.text: I have had  mixed experiences with Brothers. I've been happy with the  plumbing side of their business, however I had a disappointing turn of events with the repair of my furnace that had unexpectedly stopped working. Because we have a maintenance service program which covers plumbing, heat/AC and electric we called Brothers. The technician ran a microscopic camera through the inside of the furnace and pointed out signs of wear that could lead to CO leakage! (He never did any CO readings). Neither my husband nor I could really see what he was pointing out. We would need a new furnace and a crew just happened to be available the next day, and discussed payment.  I've encountered a similar scenario with a different repairman on a different furnace many years ago. I got a second opinion from a reliable furnace repairman, and the issue was a cracked ignitor. It was easily replaced at very little cost.

reviews.author: thomas kammerer
reviews.text:
I moved into my home in 2020. The property is an older fixer, built in 1968, and this marked my first experience with a major renovation. I hired Expert to complete several significant projects, including the installation of water lines, electrical work, and a new furnace. Based on this initial work, I continued to rely on Expert for ongoing services, including furnace maintenance and the repair of faulty wiring for my front porch light.

In October, I encountered an issue with my sewer line and scheduled an appointment with Expert for an evaluation. Mika was sent to assess the problem. He explained the issue, removed a blockage, and performed a camera scope of the sewer line. Based on the results of the scope, he informed me that the line was corroded and required replacement. This was an unexpected and significant expense; however, Mika advised that without replacement, additional blockages would likely occur within a few months. Relying on this information, we agreed to proceed with the sewer line replacement.

The sewer line replacement work itself was completed satisfactorily. However, I did need to request a return visit to address a leaking toilet that had been newly installed as part of the project.

Because the total cost of the sewer line replacement exceeded $10,000, I contacted my homeowner’s insurance provider to determine whether any portion of the expense might be eligible for reimbursement. I opened a claim that same week and began the required process, including scheduling a visit from an insurance adjuster. My insurance agent requested two separate invoices from Expert: one detailing the work performed inside the home and another specifying the work completed on the exterior sewer line.

For approximately four weeks, my insurance agent attempted to obtain these invoices directly from Expert without success. She then contacted me for assistance. I subsequently called and spoke with Natalie on multiple occasions to request the required documentation. Despite repeated follow-ups, the invoices were not provided. When my efforts failed to produce results, my spouse also contacted Expert by phone and email.

After one month and three weeks of repeated requests, a manager from Expert finally contacted us and stated that once an invoice has been paid, it is difficult for them to generate revised or separate documentation. Instead, they offered to contact my insurance agent directly.

This experience has been extremely frustrating and represents a significant failure in customer service. As a long-term customer who has spent thousands of dollars with Expert and has referred numerous friends and family members, I found this handling of a reasonable and necessary request to be unacceptable. While the quality of Expert’s workmanship has generally been satisfactory, the lack of responsiveness and unwillingness to provide standard billing documentation has resulted in a loss of trust. As a result, I will no longer be using or recommending their services.

My husband and I can't say enough good about this team. The plumbers arrived on time, set to work on the repairs we requested. The owner, Keith spent some time on the telephone with our home warranty company and was able to get our new water heater installation authorized in order for us to be reimbursed for a covered repair. reviews.author: Lisa T.
reviews.text: Had a leak in July and they "patched" it but said my whole house had to be replumbed because the pipe was smashed and he didn't know how long the crushed pipe was. He didn't bother to dig parallel to see where it ended.  I cancelled due to finances. Had another leak in November and scheduled a re-plumb. I was given a ballpark price that was 600-1100 higher than in July. When I asked why I was told materials have gone up. Plus they couldn't get me in until the middle of December. I have been without water for 2 weeks and friends convinced me to get a second opinion, which I did. I had another company come and he dug where Scott's "patched" The patch was where it was leaking so my new plumber  dug one more tile over and found where the pipe was not smashed, cut the smashed pipe out, put new pipe in and it's fixed. I was told Scott's just wanted the money to re-plumb and didn't care about the fix that should have been done. I am disappointed and feel like I was ripped off in July when they were first called out. Shame on you for taking advantage of a widowed woman!

reviews.author: Ashley S.
reviews.text:
Scott's plumbers were super nice, but they told me that it wasn't possible to connect my disposal to my new sink and if I wanted to use the disposal I would have to order a new sink and have them come back out. 

Now, I typically use another Madison plumber, but they were booked up, so I went with Scott's which was recommended here and on our neighborhood site. When I was able to order and have a new sink delivered because we needed the disposal, the other Madison plumber came out and told me it was actually very easy to connect my disposal to my (at that point, current) sink, and they were really perplexed as to why they would tell me that. 

Writing this because it was an additional $300 and months without a disposal that shouldn't have happened.

reviews.author: Kenneth N.
reviews.text:
I don't typically write reviews, but when I feel like I need to warn others away from crooks, I'll sit down and write one. The review is a semi-detailed account of my experience, but the bottom line is at the end if you don't want to read the whole thing.

On the original call, the owner of the company came out to fix two toilets that I had running, and I assume he was training a new plumber. He claimed to fix both toilets, but he was lacking the parts on his truck and just "adjusted" one of them and said it was fixed, but it was not.

Both of the toilets were still running, so called him back out because the work was under warranty. The same new plumber came out, by himself this time, and fixed them again. At the end of the job, he tried to collect payment. I told him this was a warranty call and I shouldn't owe anything. He calls the owner, and the owner tells him to charge me for one toilet instead of two. His logic was that they didn't work on the toilet that they just "adjusted" last time, since they didn't have the part to replace it, and he claimed that I owed for that toilet.

Here is where the math gets a bit fuzzy. The plumber was going to charge me $150 for both toilets without any warranty. With one under warranty, he was still trying to charge me $117, and the first time he charged me $135. So if two toilets in one call was $150, then why was he trying to charge me the $135 from the original call with an extra $117 from this one? Mind you, I didn't agree to any extra work outside of the warranty work they were supposed to be doing.

I told the plumber that I wasn't going to pay because this is warrantied work and I don't owe anything. He calls the owner back and the owner calls me on my cell and says I have 5 minutes to pay his plumber or he is going to call the Sheriffs department and report me for theft of services, then just hangs up on me. He wouldn't even entertain the idea of going over his math for what he was expecting me to pay.

At this point, I decided to call the Sheriffs department myself, because I didn't do anything wrong. About an hour later, two deputies show up and get both of our stories. Since this is a civil matter, they couldn't really do anything, but they both agreed with me that the plumber should have given me some form of statement of work before starting new work.

At the end of the day, I ended up paying $100 because the owner was adamant about filing a theft of service report against me, and it wasn't worth anymore of my time to deal with this idiot. His plumber was there for 3 hours for less than a 1 hour job, so at least I got some justice of wasting his time and costing him business for his shady dealings; additionally, I hope this review will serve as a warning and help people find an honest plumber instead of this crook that cares more about being right than taking care of his customers.

Bottom Line: At the end of the day, the owner of this company would rather waste 3 hours of time for him, me, his plumber, and two deputies than honor a $100 warranty claim for his work. Not to mention the other customers that were scheduled for later that day. Stay away from this company.

reviews.author: Scott R.
reviews.text:
I found Scott Plumbing on January 5 at 4:45pm thanks to a very high water bill and Yelp's solid recommendations.  A quick call to Scott Plumbing just before closing and I had an 8:30am appointment for next day service.  Not a problem...I wasn't gushing water, and given the recent single digit temperatures I figured it might be a few days. 

Their communications are stellar.  I received a text an hour before my appointment:  

Hi, your technician Jeff E. (Rating 4.9/5) from Scott Plumbing, LLC is on the way to 113 Corwin Drive, Harvest, AL 35749 USA. Jeff is native to the Cullman area and has been in the Madison County area since 2018. Jeff has four daughters, is a die-hard football fan, spends his free time coaching softball for his girls, and plays in an adult softball league. Jeff has been in the plumbing industry since 2018 and has been with Scott Plumbing since 2019 and is now one of our managers. Jeff likes a challenge and plumbing tasks that make him think about how things come together. Track now: (link). Call our office for any questions: (256) 701-6181

Jeff and Daniel arrived just before the 8:30am appointment time.  They quickly surveyed my problem, gave me a verbal quote, and started work on a handshake.  I had calculated how much time I thought it would take me to do the repair, and considered how much I make an hour... And I had in my mind the budget for the project.  It would've likely been a five hour project for me, with two trips to Lowe's.  I'm an electrical guy...not a water guy.  Their estimate was a little higher than my budget, but they were here...ready...and my family of five loves using water (I would hear about a five hour outage unless it was at 2AM-7AM).

A little more than an hour later my leak was history.  No trips to the store--they had what they needed and they worked fast. The cutoff to my home (30 years old) had deteriorated and was watering my dormant lawn on the side of the house that nobody travels in the winter.  They dug it up by hand, siphoned water, replaced it with a new/improved shutoff, replaced a small section of the pipe with it, and added a new housing.

The only tip that I have--I should've asked them about veterans discount or explored their website for some of their coupons.  Their website is well done, and looking at it before service would've possibly saved enough to put them within my budget, but I'm not complaining.  I did take one star away from five because I prefer a straight forward cost model and not one that expects negotiation or investigation for coupons.  

Excellent service, and honorable skill-trade profession.  I will keep Scott Plumbing in mind for future work, and I recommend them as long as you take into consideration my tip...ask about discounts and check for coupons.

reviews.author: Rob R.
reviews.text: Used Scott Plumbing to repair a leak in the pipe running from the water meter to my house. Paid $1825.00 to "Repipe main, meter to house on 15 Oct. 2019. On 12 Aug. 2020 noticed a water leak from the house side of the water meter. Contacted Scott Plumbing and asked how long their work was warranted for, and they stated 1 year. I had them come out, they fixed the leak, which was caused by a leaking check valve between the house and water meter that they had to replace. This work was performed under warranty for no charge on 12 Aug. 2020. Five days later on 17 Aug. 2020 I once again observed a leak at the house side of the water meter. I called Scott Plumbing, who once again sent out a plumber to fix the leak. Scott Plumbing discovered the five day old replaced check valve was leaking again, Scott plumbing then informed me that I would have to pay for a replacement. I called Keith at Scott plumbing and told him I didn't feel I should have to pay to get something fixed that they had just fixed five days prior. Keith then informed me that I could pay, or he would send his plumber away, and I could call another plumbing service for my needs. I reluctantly paid the $75.00 for the repair, as I wanted my water back on. Would not use them again, as they failed to stand behind their work.

reviews.author: Casey K.
reviews.text:
Inadequate customer service. I knew exactly what my problem was but yet couldn't even get a ballpark idea of how much the charge would be to fix. They said they could send someone to look at it and tell me what was wrong and how much it would be to fix it but their estimates are NOT free. In other words I have to pay them to tell me what the problem is even though I already know what the problem is!?! Really!?! All I needed was a bathtub drain to be reconnected. They basically acted like I wasn't worth their time. 
I'm not a plumber but have worked in the service industry in Huntsville for years and my wife works in property management and handles all repairs for over 400 rental properties. So I always get asked which companies or vendors are the best for all different types of repairs which usually results in lots of business for whoever I recommend. The next time I get asked what plumber I recommend I will be sure to steer them clear of this company so they don't waste their time like I did!

reviews.author: Richard O.
reviews.text: I had been trying to remove a couple rusted galvanized pipes from bathroom sink inlets that would not budge. I was worried that I would break the pipes from inside the wall trying to wrench them any further. I swallowed my pride and gave him a call as brute strength obviously wasn't working. He was understanding and seemed to genuinely care as one person to another and charged the most reasonable rate I could have imagined for the late hour. It took him about 20 minutes and he was able to remove the rusted nipples from the pipe elbows without stressing or damaging the wall pipes or elbows at all. Well worth the price to prevent any potential damage. I was then able to easily put new fittings on and turn my water back on that had been off for about 6 hours. Sometimes you just have to pay for the expert that knows the techniques of the profession. I will definitely keep them in the contact list for future needs!

reviews.author: Tim and Jenni Westhoven
reviews.text:
We had Scott Plumbing do all of the plumbing upgrades when we moved a year and a half ago (primary bath, kitchen, new water heater).  We spent a LOT of money with them AND, invested our trust in them. Now, just a year and a half later, when the new water heater overflow tank and its’s connection failed, they tell us that they do not warranty their labor or parts past one year. A water heater system and all of its components and labor should definitely last more than a year and a half. When we requested that a manager be called and apprised of the situation, they still refused to stand behind their work. And to make matters worse, the manager that was called was actually the same person that did all of the work!
We have lost faith in Scott Plumbing and will not use them in the future.

reviews.author: Pamela B.
reviews.text: I just had the worst experience with this company. The pipe bringing water into my house was nicked by a lawnmower. It was coming out of the ground a bit when this happened. The man Scotts sent out said that he could fix it but he couldn't rebury it in that he had no dirt (???). He quoted me a price that I found to be high and so I told him thank you, but I think I'll look elsewhere. I got a call 10 minutes later from his boss saying I had slammed the door in his face and was rude to him. What? This guy had a speech impediment, as does my son. I was very kind and polite to him. His boss said that he was going to believe his guy and accused me of blocking his call when he used the business phone. I don't even know how to block a call. All pretty disturbing and weird.

reviews.author: Amy Stephens
reviews.text: My underground drains were clogged causing water to pour off my roof onto a back patio area. I had 2 inches of standing water. I knew I couldn't call my regular plumber. They can never come out the same day. I called Scott Plumbing to see if they could help me. Within one hour, J was at my house. He came up with a plan, left to retrieve the needed equipment, and was back within an hour. He unclogged 2 underground French drains and when the next downpour came, my gutters worked properly. I was very impressed with how fast they responded and fixed my problem. And J was wonderful! I am a Scott Plumbing convert.

reviews.author: Samantha T.
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic communication and quick service. I called and within a hour a tech arrived. Gabriel was friendly, extensive experience and overall fantastic tech. He had the problem shut off within the hour, and also assisted me in finding a service to come in and remove all water damaged flooring and walls. They worked out here from about 10am to 10pm! I would recommend this company and techie Gabriel to everyone. They are honest Hard working folks that are just fantastic.  Don't hesitate, call and see for yourselves. I personally will never call another plumbing service!!

reviews.author: Ann G.
reviews.text:
The customer service at Scott Plumbing is outstanding. Keith addressed my concerns and handled them professionally and promptly. 
As for the actual repair of my plumbing problem, Travis is the best in the business. He throughly diagnosed and explained my situation, then came out the next day and installed 2 brand new toilets. Within 24 hours my plumbing problem was completely solved! 
Scott Plumbing will be the first company I call for any future plumbing problems. I trust them completely! Thank you for your good work Keith and Travis. You make a good team.

synthesis.summary: Scott Plumbing LLC demonstrates excellent emergency responsiveness with same-day service and quick problem resolution. Multiple reviews highlight their professionalism, fair pricing, and thorough explanations of work performed.
strengths: Same-day emergency service
Professional and knowledgeable technicians
Fair and reasonable pricing
Thorough documentation and explanations
weaknesses: Unknown 24-hour availability
Limited sample of complex repair scenarios
synthesis.topQuote: Called Scott at 11am, had a tech to me by 2, and new hot water heater installed by 5. Absolutely incredible and for a fair price.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 333 W 2230 N Ste 320, Provo, UT 84604, USA

reviews.author: Deana Jorgensen
reviews.text: Matthew was wonderful service tech.  He came prepared for what we needed.  Very knowledgeable. Our boxer really liked him as well.

reviews.author: Justin Jorgensen
reviews.text: Matthew is an exceptional service tech. He had the tools and the knowledge to do a fantastic job. We hope to be able to have him help us in future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kona Plunkett
reviews.text: Matthew was great! He helped me understand the issues and made sure he didn’t leave any stones unturned. I appreciate his help very much.

reviews.author: Greg H.
reviews.text:
I have a floor drain in my mechanical room that was draining slow when the water softener cycled.  I called Roto-Rooter in Salt Lake City, Utah and they said they couldn't give prices over the phone and they would send a plumber over for free and look at it and give me a price and if it was acceptable to me they would fix it right then.   The gave me a 4 hour time frame for later that day and after 4 hours they called and said they were running late.  After another hour or so, 2 guys showed up and I said I just wanted them to snake 10 feet or so because I was sure it just need snaked a little way because it was close to the main line drain and nothing else in the house was having problems.  They said it would be $435 to snake a 1 1/2 to 2 inch drain!  I almost fell over and the guy just stared me down.  I said something like, wow, that's way more than I thought and he just said that's what is it.  I showed them the door... Then I went to the tool rental place and rented a small snake on a drill for $20 and it took me 10 minutes to clean it out.
I will NEVER call these rip off artists again!

reviews.author: Josh McCauley
reviews.text: Least reliable service out there. Use a different company. I cancelled a bunch of work meetings to get them out at a certain time and they never showed up. I’m really mad, I waited for hours and hours missing my meetings for nothing. Don’t use this company!!!

reviews.author: Keralee Greaves
reviews.text:
This was our second sewer backup in 4 months. I used another company the first time but changed to Roto Rooter this time. Adrian came in and diagnosed the issue and had restoration here just in case they were needed. He was friendly and answered my questions and fixed the issue quickly. I’ve found my sewer company!!

Update: a few months after this I used Roto Rooter again to snake a toilet in my spare bathroom that my granddaughter had flushed tweezers and TP down. The first tech said he snaked to the joint and it did flush but still gurgled which he claimed would clear after a couple flushes. Within 24 hours we were backed up again. The second time Adrian came back and argued with me that it had been done properly the first time that something else had been put down it—it had not expect liquid. He then took the toilet brush and shoved it like a plunger into the drain hole and splashed nasty water all over the bathroom requiring a deep clean of the entire space. Adrian got the water drained and claimed it was fixed. The next day it was backed up worse than before. I called Any Hour and the tech came out within the hour, removed the toilet something not done both times Roto Rooter came out and ran the auger snake over 15 feet into the line. You literally heard the tweezers and backup clear as they pushed them through the pipe. It was finally actually fixed! No more issues! I will never trust the arrogance of Roto Rooter again.

reviews.author: Justin Palmer
reviews.text:
We recently hired Roto-Rooter to diagnose and repair a major issue with our main sewer line, and I couldn’t be more impressed, especially with Max and Ricky.

From the initial inspection to the full excavation and repair, their team was professional, transparent, and knowledgeable. They walked us through all the options and kept us informed throughout the entire project.

The excavation was incredibly complicated, but done efficiently and with a lot of care for our property.

If you’re dealing with a sewer line issue, I highly recommend Roto-Rooter. They delivered high quality work with excellent customer service from start to finish.

reviews.author: Effy O.
reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY! We had them line our sewer in March of 2023 and they flooded our basement with 5 inches of water. It has been a nightmare trying to get our basement put back together. The project manager Gordon assured us that they would take care of everything and not to worry. They hired Pronto Pack Out to "inventory" all our damaged personal property, they put wet items in boxes and stored them for 7 months letting them mildew. We have over 500 pictures of water damaged items and now battling with insurance. Worst experience with any company I have ever had. They don't deserve the one star It forces me to give.

reviews.author: Cameron Corcran
reviews.text: The tech and his trainee were incredible. They were efficient, fun to talk to, walked me through the entire process, and charged a reasonable flat rate for their work. Would highly recommend ADI and his trainee. They cleaned it my main drain line for $508. They are running a promotion where a food drive donation gets you $55 off your service so my total was $453. Also included in our price was a guy to come out and run a camera down the main drain line to make sure everything is intact because they had a hard time getting through a section at the end. Definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Mason Mathis
reviews.text: I called several plumbing companies, and Quick Quality Plumbing was the only one able to get someone out immediately. Jaren arrived promptly and was fantastic from start to finish. His communication was on point—he walked me through the entire process and kept me updated every step of the way. The quality of his work was exceptional, and he made everything easy to understand. I would highly recommend Quick Quality Plumbing to anyone looking for a reliable plumber and will definitely be using them again in the future.

reviews.author: Justin English
reviews.text: I had a very pleasant experience with the dispatcher and the services connecting me with the tech. My tech was not very good however. When he initially started my repair he left the fixture in a place where it ended up getting broken. When he was searching for a replacement, he claimed he couldn’t find one locally and it would be up to two weeks for a replacement. I then had to search to find one on my own and I did end up finding one locally.  Over not a great experience.

reviews.author: Jazz Vintage
reviews.text: Abdul was the most kind and very respectful of my family being at home while he's working. Abdul made sure he fixed the issue before leaving. While he was working my family prayed for successful repair. This is the first time in 7yrs we lived here, having someone come fix our toilets. It was a minor issue but to us looks big. Abdul took his job seriously and very diligent. I would recommend calling Roto-Rooters and ask for Abdul. Thank you Abdul.

reviews.author: rose matayo
reviews.text:
I had my water heater replaced recently and the service was great. The technician came on time, explained everything clearly, and finished the job quickly. He made sure everything worked well before he left and cleaned up the area.

I also got a $500 discount, which made it even better. The new water heater works perfectly, and I’m really happy with the whole experience. I’d definitely recommend this company to anyone who needs plumbing work.

reviews.author: Brooklyn Christensen
reviews.text: My husband and I are doing a home remodel and needed a toilet flange repair... it was WAY overpriced (tried to ask for a better quote for pricing but was denied) We were eager to just get it done as soon as possible so we paid the hefty price anyways. 3 weeks later we scheduled an inspection for a leaky pipe problem and they were more than 2 hours late and unreachable when I called. We are very disappointed with our experience.

reviews.author: Rachel McKenzie Hansen
reviews.text: Service Guy was great and very kind.  Prices have just been increasing significantly every year which is a little disappointing as the regular main line maintenance service we are having them do doesn’t require any new equipment from year to year and is done in less than an 1 hour time. 4 stars because of price, not the customer service.

synthesis.summary: Roto-Rooter Provo shows excellent emergency responsiveness with technicians who work beyond normal hours to resolve urgent issues. Customers consistently praise their professionalism, clear communication, and quality workmanship across various plumbing problems.
strengths: Excellent emergency response
Professional technicians
Clear communication
Works beyond normal hours
weaknesses: One review appears to be for wrong company
synthesis.topQuote: Matthew worked well past the end of his normal shift to make sure we were taken care of. I would recommend them to anyone!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 4641 Montgomery Ave Ste 518, Bethesda, MD 20814, USA

reviews.author: Elizabeth B.
reviews.text: Well that was easy! I called this morning and there was a serviceman at my door within two hours. And my problem-- an old hose stuck on the spigot (really stuck, all home remedies unsuccessful)-- was solved within just a few minutes. I knew it would be pricy, but it was something I simply couldn't do myself. (Note: they should tell you the $250 show-up charge over the phone.) Particularly friendly and professional serviceman. Ask for Jo!

reviews.author: Cynthia M.
reviews.text:
Roto Robbers is more like it. They actually stink. They have a minimum labor cost of 380$. The part that needed repairing is sold for no more than $10. The technician refused to do the service necessary, will only up charge into replacing the whole unit rather than a part. If this was not needed before the holidays I would have not used this company.  
Also overall rude, did not wear shoe coverings and left my front door open.

reviews.author: Christopher M.
reviews.text: I requested a technician to come and check out a garbage disposal that wasn't working in Silver Spring. They were late showing up to the property, 30 min past the 2 hour scheduled time slot. They didn't provide an estimate before fixing the disposal and tried to charge me almost $500. This was very unprofessional and a deceiving business practice. I was able to convince the tech to give me half off but honestly i still think it costs too much for just spinning an Allen wrench to clear out the disposal jam. I will not be using them again and will make sure to let friends know to not trust this company.

reviews.author: David K.
reviews.text:
On August    25 2021 I called Roto Rooter to clear a clogged drain and the plumber who performed the service told me there was an "offset" in the drain and advised that I have the sewer inspected using a camera. After a few days a representative from Roto Rooter arrived with a camera and said there was a break in the sewer line and it could be repaired within 2 days at a cost of $11,000.00 (not including replacement of the driveway). I asked how he could get a Miss Utility clearance ticket as well as a plumbing permit and his response was "Roto Rooter had connections" and it would be no problem. I asked for a copy of the video and was told that it was proprietary and he refused my request. This disturbed me on several levels so I contacted a second plumbing company. The next day the second company arrived and within an hour or two discovered a blockage, removed its and provided a video record of the results. I ended up paying $800.00 for this service. FYI Roto Rooter charged $1200.00 for the first service call.
I hope this review gives some insite on the Roto Rooters' business model.

reviews.author: Will B.
reviews.text: Needed to unclog a kitchen sink, first time in 15 years. The 800 number made the reservation and a technician arrived fast. Unfortunately, he spoke no English and I never understood why it seemed so complicated. After sending the 800 number some photos on his cell phone, he consulted a large price book, and said it would be $800. I was shocked and asked him to explain, but of course I never understood is reply if it was English. I went online and found that the average charge is $250 to $500, so went ahead. After two hours he had run the machine, but said something else was needed (pointed to the metal trap). I joked that this cost like $10 at home depot, and he laughted and looked it up in his book -- $79. It was 6:30 pm and I had to go out to buy it myself while he had diner in his truck.  When I got back there was a new guy there -- the Roto-Rooter "consultant" -- who explained that there was water damage and it might cost $3-4000 to fix -- but of course he could arrange everything with the insurance company. NO THANKS.

reviews.author: Riggs 5.
reviews.text:
Outrageous prices! Tech came over to look at a leaking faucet (tub). He basically looked at the faucet - without doing any other diagnostics - and said I'd need a new valve/cartridge. As soon as I brought up the possibility of it being a gasket he said he wouldn't know until he got into it..... I asked - Well then how do you know that I need a new valve/cartridge....? To which he just began mumbling. 
I went onto ask how much it would cost to snake the drain (tub needed it as well) - he quoted me $800.00!!!! To snake a drain!?!?! I said you may not need to snake more than 5-7 feet and you're going to charge $800.00!!!? 
Needless to say that was then end of the consultation. 
I went to Home Depot - bought an augur/snake and did it myself for $25. 
$800 bucks to snake a drain  - you all should be ashamed of yourselves.

reviews.author: Janet G.
reviews.text: My experience with Rota Rooter was a nightmare.  We had a sewage back up in our basement and were out of town.  Rota rooter was high pressure to get us to sign their contract telling us incorrectly that our insurance would pay for everything. (insurance covers the damage not the cost to repair the pipe). Their estimates for were 2 to 3 times more than the other estimates we received.  They mistakenly told us that our sewar pipe ran from the front of our house to the street (in reality its on the side of our house).  Had we used them to repair our pipe, they would have mistakenly dug up the front of our house.  When I called to dispute charges on my bill, it took a month of calling before I could get someone to get back to me.  From start to finish, they are the worst company I've ever dealt with, stay away.

reviews.author: Linda C.
reviews.text: I requested a service call from this local business. A technician came the following day and did a good job, though dressed fairly sloppily, as well as providing me with a 6-month guarantee. All that was not the issue; it was the price $438.00 for a 15-minute job replacing a washer in the shower.  I asked for management to contact me, which did occur. His basic answer when I expressed incredulity at the cost was yes, Roto-Rooter is more expensive than their competitors.  I thought he might offer a small refund, but that did not happen.  Service is good, price is exorbitant.

reviews.author: Teri S.
reviews.text: Called first thing in the morning for a clogged drain was told my time window of 2 hours would be 9:45 to 11:45, 2 additional hours later still no tech. Called numerous times and was told that all 5 of the techs in my area were delayed. Seems like they need to have more techs working on Saturdays.  These people do not care one bit that you have waited 4 hours. Don't be surprised that they put you on hold for 10 minutes for you only to be disconnected and you have to call back again. Think twice before you use them, BTW where was my discount for the additional 2 hour wait

reviews.author: Richard W.
reviews.text: I understand that during COVID that times are tough,but changing me $689.00 to snake a drain with no clean up or putting appliances back in place afterward is no excuse and I will never ever use roto rooter again.Terrible!

reviews.author: Dave K.
reviews.text: So disappointed with Roto-Rooter. Once contract was signed they vanished. The workers were fine but supervisor was a smooth-talking salesman who disappeared. Left lot of sewage uncleaned. I will not recommend them.

reviews.author: Stephen H.
reviews.text: Called them to unclog a toilet. Charged $500 for a 10 minute job....Do not use this company (complete ripoff). The techs where awesome btw.

reviews.author: Ross E.
reviews.text: Ripped me off big time. Charged $6500 for two hours of work.  The absolute worst.  Should be reported to authorities for fraud.

synthesis.summary: They'll get to you fast, but expect to pay two to three times what competitors charge for the same work.
strengths: Fast response times: One reviewer received service within two hours of calling; another had a technician arrive the next day
Technicians are skilled and complete work: Multiple reviews note the actual work performed was done well, just at inflated prices
Available on weekends: Received calls and dispatches on Saturdays, though with long wait times
weaknesses: Severely overpriced across all service types: 11 of 13 reviews cite excessive charges—$800 for drain snaking (customer did it for $25), $500 for 10-minute toilet unclog, $689 for drain snake, $6,500 for two hours of work

Aggressive upselling and misleading diagnoses: Multiple reviewers report techs recommending expensive repairs (new valve, sewer line replacement at $11,000) without proper diagnostics; a second opinion found simple blockage for $800 instead
redFlags: Systematic overcharging: 10 of 13 reviews explicitly complain about prices 3-10x typical market rates
Questionable diagnostic practices: Techs recommend expensive repairs without thorough inspection; one reviewer caught tech contradicting themselves
Refusal to provide documentation: One reviewer denied video copy of sewer camera inspection, claimed it was 'proprietary'
Pressure sales tactics: High-pressure contracts offered during emergencies (sewage backup); misrepresentations about insurance coverage
Poor follow-through: One reviewer reports supervisor disappeared after contract signed; another notes incomplete cleanup after sewage work
Scheduling unreliability: 2-4 hour delays despite confirmed time windows; poor call-back responsiveness
