plumbers.name: 615 Plumbing
plumbers.address: 475 Metroplex Dr #108, Nashville, TN 37211, USA

reviews.author: Mark Jones
reviews.text: Max did a great job of diagnosing the problem and providing a great solution for the fix. I would recommend Max and 615 plumbers for my next plumbing issue.

reviews.author: Vickie Baker
reviews.text: Extremely positive and helpful. He knew his job very well.

reviews.author: Cody Cooper
reviews.text: Caleb came out quickly and did an amazing job.  Fixed our broken toilet flange!

reviews.author: Jenny Litvinchuk
reviews.text:
Used 615 plumbing back in July to fix a leak in the faucet in my bathroom. This is partially my fault for signing the papers before asking for a breakdown, but after the technician left to get the part, I couldn’t help but feel that the price given to me was very high for a simple faucet leak fix. (Over $600)

I called a couple of friends/ family members who are in the business to ask if this was a standard price for this job and they each told me what I was being charged was unreasonable. When the technician returned, I asked to see a breakdown of what exactly I’m being charged for and he said they didn’t have one. It’s just one standard price per job. I think that’s entirely unethical and unfair to the customer to not even have transparency on what everything costs and what I’m actually paying for. I told the guy that was there that I had asked around and that price was really high, so he called his manager to see if they could lower the price for me and from my understanding, the manager basically said because I already signed the papers he wouldn’t lower it. My options were to pay them $250 for him to put the broken prices back onto my faucet without fixing the leak or pay the full amount to actually get it fixed.

I am a young, single, first time home owner and I feel like I got taken advantage of big time. I went with this company because they had mostly positive reviews but maybe things have changed since those were posted.

I want to emphasize that the technician himself, Max, was great. Friendly, professional and clearly felt really bad about the situation. I know it’s not his fault and that he doesn’t make the prices or make the call on lowering it when they are called out for gouging people, so I don’t fault him at all. But it definitely sucked to be taken advantage of.

reviews.author: Maria Callahan
reviews.text: Mom needed a new Moen faucet. She didnt want to bother us, so she called 615. The repair was just over two hours (verifiable per house cam) Said faucet was $279 at Lowe's. Total charge was $1072.00. When I followed with a phone call for a breakdown of prices, and asked for an hourly rate, they informed me that they "don't charge that way". You want to be able to trust businesses with your elders, but I am convinced that she was overcharged. I encourage you to use anybody BUT 615; research and find a plumber with transparent pricing. Watch your parents, people.

reviews.author: William Cochran
reviews.text: In the aftermath of the winter storm that enveloped Nashville in late January 2026, one of our pipes broke. We called two plumbing companies we had used regularly in the past, and in both cases were greeted by AI answering bots, which informed us we could schedule an appointment four days from then. After being out of power and living from our suitcases for ten days, waiting another four to move back home after getting our power back was not an attractive option. We called 615 Plumbing randomly, were greeted by Shelby (a real person), who kindly and professionally processed our request, indicating they would do their best to come out that day or at latest the following morning.  Later the same day, Drake came out and took care of the problem. I've seen reviews of 615 Plumbing noting high prices. I don't know if other companies would have charged us less or more for the same work, but I do know that 615 Plumbing was the only company who responded to our problem quickly - and that to us was worth every penny we paid them. We recommend them warmly and will be using them going forward for our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Marina Barisic
reviews.text: Caleb came out to service my home and I am beyond grateful for him! He first started with a full diagnosis of the quality of my pipes which was amazing! I love that now I am fully aware of the integrity of my plumbing system. Next, he got down to the root issue of the call: a clog in my main line! Within an hour, Caleb had resolved the issue. I never once felt like I was being pushed to buy… Caleb showed professionalism and patience with me during the whole process. While I decided what to do, he patiently waited for me and never once pushed me to make a decision. Seriously can not say enough good things about this technician. He could have rushed our appointment as it was his last call of the day but no, he literally addressed every issue with pure knowledge and interest. I am truly shocked at how lucky I got to have Caleb as my tech. Thank you 615 plumbing and Caleb for taking a huge weight off my shoulders.

reviews.author: Patrick T
reviews.text:
Max had good communication instincts and manners. He always called ahead, door knocked on arrival to discuss the day's work, brings the owner into key discoveries or decisions to be made.  His solution approach to diagnosing, then designing and installing a new 65 ft of sewer line to replace the circa 1940s collapsed line was always shared aloud, thought of the homeowners wallet and near/long term life spans if the new system. He and his team member worked hard to get the job done in a day, gven the occupants were without water / sewage
until the new line in place. Max came back to further clean up, grade the site, and verify our fence was replaced correctly.  He shared images of the work done for our homeowner file.  Personable, high integrity and technical knowledge.

reviews.author: Cheryl Lowe
reviews.text: I called  615 plumbing to come to my house for some toilet issues. Caleb came and perform a diagnostic test and also a bucket test. He presented us with 4 options.  We customized our own option  using the info of his expertise.   He did not pressure us and gave us time to discuss all the options. He was friendly, outgoing, knowledgeable  and professional.   We asked several questions and he explained the pros and cons. He was at our house approximately 4 hours.  He had to go to the supply house and get the needed supplies. As he was installing the new toilet he notice the sink facuet was leaking and rebuilt it.  I cannot say enough about Caleb.  I will definitely use 615 plumbing  and Caleb in the future if I have any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Adam Hewitt
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with 615 Plumbing. Another plumbing company told us our sewer line issue would cost thousands of dollars to fix, but something didn’t feel right—so we called 615 Plumbing for a second opinion. Drake came out right away, and he was amazing to work with. He took the time to camera the line, clearly explained everything he saw, and confirmed there was nothing wrong other than an open pipe that just needed a simple cap. He was honest, knowledgeable, and very straightforward. It’s rare to find that kind of integrity in this industry. We’re so glad we called 615 Plumbing—Drake and the team truly earned our trust, and we highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Shawn Loehr
reviews.text: 615 Plumbing was amazing!  We had a leak coming from a second story bathroom through the 1st floor ceiling.  We couldn't determine the source of the leak.  We called 615 Plumbing around 11:30 am and were advised the technician would arrive by 4.  He ended up arriving about 12:45.  Max, the technician was able to quickly identify the source of the leak, which was within the wall.  He removed a small piece of drywall and fixed the problem quickly.  Max was professional, courteous, didn't make a mess, and fixed what I thought was going to be a huge issue, timely and at a very reasonable price.  Thank you Max and 615 Plumbing.  I couldn't recommend them more.

reviews.author: Kaiden
reviews.text: Toilet was consistently running, and I was not able to shut it off. Steven had came out and inspected the toilet and had found that the inner components of the toilet were worn and breaking down. Steven checked other possible issues in my home to make sure it was just isolated to my toilet and had found no other issues. He replaced all of the parts inside my toilet and did a thorough job. He made sure to inspect his work and did a wonderful job cleaning up after himself and the toilet is working like it’s brand new. We will definitely be using 615 Plumbing from here on out!

reviews.author: Callie Lee
reviews.text:
I would like to thank Tyler and James for their superb professionalism, friendly, very polite, excellent job troubleshooting and repairing the gas pipes in record time.

I appreciate the hard work in 90+ degree weather. Most of all I appreciate their thoughtfulness and respect to leave their work areas tidy and clean. I am very much satisfaction and recommend their service to everyone. Thank you so much for working with me on the billing side to make this happen.  Enjoy the rest of your day gentlemen❣️

reviews.author: Emily Rodgers
reviews.text: Very displeased with the cost and results of my experience with 615 plumbing. Paid $890 to have a shower handle replaced which I was assured would solve the issue. Within a few days the connector stripped and when they came back they suggested replacing the whole valve for $2700. When I asked to have the previous cost applied to the service they said no but they’d take $500 off. Those prices are high and after the first experience I do not trust the skill of the technicians.

reviews.author: Gideon Steed
reviews.text: Nick at 615 Plumbing provided outstanding service from start to finish. He was professional, punctual, and completed the work quickly without cutting corners. Nick went above and beyond by identifying an underlying issue and resolving it the same day, saving me time and future headaches. The quality and efficiency of the services made it well worth the cost. I highly recommend Nick at 615 Plumbing to anyone looking for reliable, expert plumbing work done right the first time

synthesis.summary: 615 Plumbing gets high marks for same-day responsiveness and friendly, communicative techs — but their opaque flat-rate pricing has triggered multiple complaints of being charged $890 for a shower handle, $488 for a 15-minute wax ring, and over $1,000 for a faucet install. The work itself is generally solid; the pricing transparency is not.

Technicians (Max, Nick, Caleb, Drake, Steven) frequently praised for clear explanations and professional demeanor
BBB A-rated with accreditation and only 2 complaints over 3 years for a high-volume company
weaknesses: Flat-rate pricing with no itemized breakdown — multiple reviewers unable to understand what they paid for
Several recent reviews describe charges 2-3x what comparable companies quoted for the same job
bestFor: Urgent plumbing needs requiring same-day service
Customers who want communicative, professional techs and can accept premium pricing

$890 shower handle replacement failed within days; company offered no credit toward the $2,700 follow-up repair

plumbers.name: Tidy Tank Plumbing, Sewer, and Septic
plumbers.address: 740 McArdle Dr, Crystal Lake, IL 60014, USA

reviews.author: Terry A
reviews.text: I called Tidy Tank plumbing because my sump pump line broke. Dan was here within 45 minutes. He looked at the obvious issue but then investigated further to make sure that there were no other related issues such as frozen drain lines, etc. He went through all of the options from doing a simple repair to replace it with a top quality sump pump and backup system. He did not push me in any direction nor try to upsell me. Once the choice was made he had all of the equipment on the truck, completed the work, tested the system, and cleaned up. I've always had very good luck with their septic service and now I can add their plumbing service to that.

reviews.author: Sabine Vosters
reviews.text: Was contacted by Tidy Tank Septic reminding me that the last service had been almost three years ago, and did I want to schedule a service. Set up an appointment for the very next day. They arrived at the scheduled time and got the job done thoroughly and efficiently. They explained what they were doing and documented everything in pictures and on the invoice. Their prices have gone up quite a bit since our last appointment, but I guess it's on par with every other price increase in the country. A very professional experience all around, I would definitely recommend this business to anyone looking for septic tank maintenance.

reviews.author: Kevin Morrison
reviews.text: Great experience with Tidy Tank Septic! Brad handled my septic pumping and was incredibly helpful. Not only did he get the job done smoothly, but he also took the time to explain my whole setup and what to watch for over time. I left the visit knowing a lot more about my system and confident about when I’ll need service next. I’ll absolutely be calling them again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gina W.
reviews.text:
Ron's Tidy Tank managed to ruin a good customer relationship.  

We had been super happy with Ron's pumping service since we moved here almost 4 years ago.  Recently we needed to have some emergency repairs done and they came out for a prompt estimate and gave us a great price, several thousand dollars under another estimate.  Great, right?  Well, it's 2020 so like everything else, it didn't work out as hoped.

The work was scheduled, we even received a reminder call the day before.  On the day of the work as scheduled, Jim called us to say "You're going to have to find someone else to do the work" !!!  And offered absolutely no help or guidance as to who we should call or why, or what we should do!  His demeanor made us feel like WE had done something wrong.  No apology, and really no explanation other than "employee disruptions".  Just - "bye".  

He could have actually expressed regret and compassion about bailing on us at the literal last second and leaving us scrambling to fix our problem.  We actually had to call back later in the day and ask for help to try and figure out who he suggested we look to for help - and he acted like it was all a big inconvenience.  

Unfortunately we no longer trust this business after putting us in such a reactive and defensive stance.  They lost a loyal customer and all future business.

reviews.author: Rosa L.
reviews.text: never in my entire 39 year have heard of such a disrespect company in my life! My neighbor who has had service with them for years called in for an emergency and the manager told her they couldn't help her........The poor 81 year old woman had fecal matter coming up through her toilets and  drains.......Mind u she just had her septic system serviced LESS THAN a year ago with THEM! They refused her service when she needed it the most.......I'm sorry but if you're answering the phone and still in the office and people are calling in for an emergency service which you offer you need to respect your customers and on top of it your senior citizen customers! I've never been so appalled in my life! We along with all of our neighbors will be finding another company! If I could give this company negative stars I would x's 10

reviews.author: Mark S.
reviews.text:
Post from 3/20:  I have had Ron's Tidy Tank come out several times in the past few weeks.  It all started with a semi annual inspection of the system.  They came out and told me my system needed to be pumped again even though they just did it a few months earlier (at the previous service and also installed a new multi flow).  When they had come before, I had asked why my neither of my alarms went off and they had said it probably did and I just didn't hear it.  They rechecked alarms at the time and said everything looked good.  Now when they told me it needed to be pumped again at the recent appointment, I asked again why my alarms didn't go off.  They told me this time that it was probably bad wiring.  So they came back out after pumping it to replace the wiring for the alarms.  The 2 guys they sent tracked mud in my house that was falling off the top of their boots all over the stairs and my front porch looked like a war zone.  The first guy attempted to drill a hole in my basement wall sideways on an angle and in the process cracked my foundation and got his drill bit caught in the wall.  Then they finally came up with idea of drilling from the outside which worked although they created a new baseball size hole in the foundation separate from the original partial cracked hole where the drill bit was stuck.  Meanwhile, both guys were coughing up a storm which made us nervous since this was the height of the coronavirus.  After finishing the job, they told me everything was working great and they had cleaned up and patched up the holes.  I was on a call for work, so took them at their word and paid them an additional $1,250 on top of the other three big bills I had just paid.  I went downstairs after my call ended viewing about 13 mud spots on the stairs on the way down only to see the insulation they had removed from the wall was left laying on the ground along with a pile of crushed rocks remnants from their drilling.  Also, it appeared from the inside that they had done nothing to patch the wall.  OK, I was upset but they had supposedly fixed the problem so I spent two hours replacing the insulation, cleaning the stairs and disinfecting the house.  I didn't want to see them again so I didn't bother calling to complain.  Well, unfortunately it looks like I will have to see them again as my septic system is currently overflowing in the backyard and NO ALARM IS GOING OFF!  I called their emergency line at 1pm on Saturday and still have not heard back from them as of Sunday morning.  I guess they don't work an hour past their stated times on Saturday which is until 12pm and don't come for emergencies at other hours which I find ridiculous.  The crazy thing is they still haven't diagnosed or figured out why the system itself isn't working and why it keeps overflowing  (something I figured was a given to be fixed since they had been out so many times now and had virtually replaced every possible item) let alone fixing the stupid alarms.  I will no longer take the excuse that it must be something that we are doing to kill the bacteria (cleaning supplies, wrong detergent, etc) as we have now replaced everything that would be considered not safe for septics.  I will keep you posted as to how this develops...,

Update 6/20:  After seeing my initial review, the owner called and asked if they could come back and try to fix it.  I figured I owed him an opportunity to so.  So I gave them another try to fix the problems I had and for a couple weeks after they came back out, the issues seemed like they were resolved.  Unfortunately, after a few weeks the alarm started going off again and I was told when they came out, that the alarm was doing it's job but my tank required another pumping since it was over flowing.  This time I called another company to fix the issue as Ron's Tidy Tank couldn't get me on the pump schedule for another month which I found ridiculous.  The other company pumped the tank and cleaned it thoroughly unlike Ron's.  Here were the issues they uncovered:  When Ron's Tidy Tank installed the new power  lines to the house, they could have just gone from the existing dedicated line box attached to the back of the house but instead chose to dig up the entire yard and put a hole in my basement (see pictures).   They also put the electrical box together with duct tape and left it in a state of disrepair (see pictures).  Several items were noted by the other company to be broken and they indicated it hadn't been cleaned properly.

When I informed the owner about all of this and asked him to remedy it (by giving me some $ back for the shoddy work or just a refund on the prepaid service contract since I wouldn't be using them anymore), he got very angry and refused to do either and also threatened to release my credit card information to the internet.  Look at all the other negative reviews.  It is amazing this company is still in business.

reviews.author: Eric B.
reviews.text:
From the scheduling department to the service I received so far, has been a great experience.  I scheduled one routine cleaning of the septic tank and needed ejector pump looked at.  The woman scheduled the service men was so nice and accommodating and was sooner than I thought we would be having a service team come out.  Great job!!!

For the ejector pump, we thought the whole thing would need to be replaced.  In fact my husband and his friends were going to try to do so but there was not a time that worked for both of them.  Thanks goodness they didn't.  Service scheduler called and asked if they could come early for the appointment.  I have never had that happen with something like this.  Usually you wait and wait.  Sean and his assistant (sorry didn't catch his name) showed up and were so polite and got to work right away.  Within minutes told me it was not the pump but a minor issue and they could fix right away.  We thought we would need to spend 500-700 dollars on this and was only a fraction of the cost to get our spare bath up and running.  They stayed a bit and made sure everything was fine. 

This company has the best employees I have worked with in a long time.  From scheduling to service, they were accommodating, polite, clean and awesome to work with.

reviews.author: Rebecca Masterjohn
reviews.text:
STAY AWAY! I think this company might be paying AI to give them a 5 star review every day. No idea how their rating is so high. We had an issue with out septic tank alarm and they came out. Triple charged us for the “evaluation” and diagnosed our system needing to be completely replaced which would be $25k-$45k. I sought out a different opinion and we discovered that they unplugged our pump which caused our whole septic to fill in 1 week. Very dishonest work. Clearly they were trying to trick me into a huge cost. We just plugged it back in and haven’t had an issue since. The guys working are not very experienced. I would never call them again. Yes I talked to a manager/supervisor and he promised to call me back first in the morning a few weeks ago…. Still no call.

UPDATE
Owner Joe: again I still have not received a call back. I called several times to whoever the “supervisor” was. He’s not good at call backs I guess. And you are good at responding to google reviews but not at picking up the phone. My review would be zero stars if that was possible

reviews.author: Rowena A.
reviews.text: Note i've used Ron's Tidy Tank since 2004.  I called them to see if they could deal with a possible issue with my water pump.  The building wasn't getting water.  The phone call was actually recorded and I clearly state that it was not an issue with my septic tank!  I figured since they deal with pumps perhaps they could help me.  Yes we can.  It was a $95 service charge to come out and I believe it would be used towards the bill.  Well the guy gets out there and says he only does septic tanks and left.  They still claimed I owed the $95 even after me clearly stating what my issue was.  I just found out today from Helmer Septic that Ron's Tidy Tank is under new ownership and there are a lot of unsatisfied customers these days!!! I'd stay away!!!

reviews.author: Barry M.
reviews.text:
I called today with an emergency, our septic was backing up into the house. Valerie was very friendly and knew that I needed to get this done ASAP.  She contacted a driver she knew was in our area and called me back to let me know they could be there in 45min.   Well I can't tell you enough how grateful I was...!

Craig showed up knew exactly what to do where to go and explained to me what was happening since I never lived on a septic before.  He took care of the problem and cleaned out our septic and said your good for 2 years!

Let me tell you I wasn't ripped off on the cost either, very fair price for such fast service.  I will be using them again and referring to our neighbors.

Thank you Valerie & Craig !!!

reviews.author: Microbiologist
reviews.text: We had a sewer line back-up recently and called Tidy Tank for assistance.  They responded quickly and put together a technical plan to determine where the blockage was.  It turned out to be a major issue that took several days to resolve.  All along the way, the plumber in charge, TJ, was completely engaged in finding the source with minimum disruption to the home.  He had skills, confidence, and drive that were unlike any other.  TJ and his co-workers treated our home like their own and were consistently comforting and reassuring.  Everyone who owns a property needs competent plumbers whom they can trust and rely on.  Tidy Tank is your source!

reviews.author: Linda S.
reviews.text: In order to pump out tank about 20, 25 year old established hostas had to be removed. In the past, they were simply dug out and then put back when filling up the hole. Brad from tidy tank proceeded to chop them up in little pieces along with the dirt he removed. He then used the dirt with chopped up hostas to fill up the hole. It would not have been that hard to shovel them out, remove the dirt, fill up hoke with dirt and put the hostas back. The job to pump out the septic tank was 577.00. For compensation, I was offered a 30.00 credit on my next job. I was in shock and very upset at hiw the job was handled.

reviews.author: Rich P.
reviews.text: I needed Emergency service on my septic tank. I had another company that we used for years. Well they never answer the phone during normal business hours on a Tuesday. Left Messages for them without a callback for three hours. I call Ron's tidy tank and they were nothing but professionals from the start. They fit me in to there very busy schedule and showed up in 2 hours from my call. The tech Brad was OUTSTANDING. Had the problem fixed in 45 mins and was such a caring guy that really enjoys helping people. What a great company. Customer for life. Thank you Brad and the team at Ron's tidy!!

reviews.author: Nick H.
reviews.text: Avoid if you want good service, as they are the worst I've ever experienced. Their service team couldn't clear a main line, dug an unnecessary hole in my yard, and ultimately charged over $200 for getting nothing completed. Jim, the supposed owner, even hung up on me during a follow up call. I wasn't cursing or being irate, simply trying to find a solution or get a refund. To contrast that, T & T Weidners' also had trouble clearing and tried from inside and out (without the digging). The difference: they didn't charge me, and walked me through the proper solution, albeit more expensive.

reviews.author: John M.
reviews.text:
Raiders of the Lost Fart. 
I called Ron's Tidy Tank the other day with some concerns about my septic system.  I'm new to this all so they walked me through my issues. They came out very quickly to service my septic which was beneath my patio. 
The previous owner of the house left no details of exactly where BELOW THE PATIO it was. They found it quite quickly and took care of things in a flash. I am happy that I found a company that I can trust to do a good job and bill me a fair price. Call these folks when the shit hits the fan!

synthesis.summary: Tidy Tank's Google rating (4.9) diverges significantly from Yelp (3.9), and the Yelp reviews reveal a more complicated picture: opaque pricing with undisclosed fees, refusals to service emergencies after 8 PM, and in one alarming case, a technician accused of deliberately unplugging a septic pump to manufacture a $25k–$45k replacement quote. Their Google reviews show a genuinely capable team for routine septic pumping and some plumbing work, but the Yelp history suggests high price variance and ownership/management responsiveness problems.
strengths: Proactively contacts customers when service is due — 'contacted by Tidy Tank reminding me that the last service had been almost three years ago'
Routine septic pumping consistently praised for punctuality and thoroughness, with photos and invoicing
Technicians like Dan and Brad explain options without pushing upsells for routine work
weaknesses: No set pricing provided on the phone — $129 dispatch fee required before any quote, leading to sticker shock on arrival
Pricing complaints across multiple Yelp reviews: $521 for a 1-hour faucet reconnect, $600+ for labor-only hose spigot replacement
$200 'same-day inconvenience fee' on top of regular pricing for urgent appointments
bestFor: Customers enrolled in their recurring service reminder program
redFlags: One reviewer alleges tech unplugged septic pump, causing tank overflow, then quoted $25k–$45k replacement — plugging it back in resolved the issue
Refused emergency service to a frail 81-year-old neighbor with fecal matter coming up through toilets despite being reached by phone
Owner threatened to release a customer's credit card information to the internet after a billing dispute
Multiple reports of no callback on emergency line — 'called their emergency line at 1pm on Saturday and still have not heard back as of Sunday morning'
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple documented refusals of emergency service after business hours, including abandoning a senior citizen during a sewage backup. Emergency line calls go unanswered on weekends.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google rating is 4.9 (1,131 reviews) vs Yelp 3.9 (43 reviews) — a 1.0-star gap. Yelp reviews disproportionately surface pricing disputes, emergency refusals, and workmanship concerns not visible in Google.

sump-pump.topQuote: Dan was here within 45 minutes. He went through all of the options from simple repair to replace with a top quality sump pump and backup system. He did not push me in any direction.

faucet-fixture.topQuote: I used them to re-connect a kitchen faucet after countertop installation. They used existing parts and installed new basket strainers. The service took one hour and they charged $521.

sewer.topQuote: Their service team couldn't clear a main line, dug an unnecessary hole in my yard, and ultimately charged over $200 for getting nothing completed.

toilet.topQuote: TJ and Mikey were very polite and friendly. They explained everything clearly and concisely so I could understand the situation and the work being done.

avoid_if: You need this for a complex or high-stakes install
hire_if: You need high-quality work that holds up over time
You need fast same-day or after-hours response
caution_if: You want detailed upfront explanations
You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need airtight scheduling and guaranteed arrival times

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 4207 Mike Padgett Hwy Unit A, Augusta, GA 30906, USA

reviews.author: Cuthbert George
reviews.text: Truly appreciate Trevor for his excellent customer and prompt service. He was very skilled and appreciate the late evening response.

reviews.author: Tony Graham
reviews.text: Mike Vance from Roto-Rooter did a great job repairing leaking sink. Great response time and quality service. Mike also cleaned up the area after the repair. Thank you!

reviews.author: Alicia Hudson
reviews.text: Very helpful was able to come out for an emergency visit in less than 30 minutes. Thanks Trevor

reviews.author: Elizabeth B.
reviews.text: I paid high dollar service and got low dollar work. I won't use them again. I paid them to install new fixtures and it isn't flush or even sturdy. It looks worse than what I had in before. They are scammers who don't know what they are doing. I will be submitting a better business complaint again them.

reviews.author: Jay M.
reviews.text:
Service call was a joke.  "Plumber" knew almost nothing except "replace". No grasp of repair or mitigation. 

Entry level service and company.

reviews.author: Richard P.
reviews.text: I hired them to install new plumbing for a Duplex. Some work had been done incorrectly by another plumber. I spoke w/Cullen 3+ times about the job. I walked it w/him &explained it so there was no confusion. The job was; install 2 water lines/2 sewer lines (inside&outside), remove cast iron vents, install pvc, remove all waste, install vents for kitchen sink/washer,& 2 hose lines. I called 3times to confirm the job&asked that it be in the contract. Each time it was not done as I asked. I called again&emailed them to have it in writing. I hired them for $10,200. The work was to be done in 2+ days. They rushed, didn't check their work/clean up. They ONLY installed water/sewer for 1 unit. The piping that was installed was sloped incorrectly. They used multiple couplings 4 the sewer line instead of using a longer pipe, installed water pipes in the Block walls w/o insulation (not code), didn't strap the pipes, & left the wrong couplings on parts of the drain(not up to code). They incorrectly; bent pex, used the wrong fittings 4 the tub. I told Cullen about him not installing the 2nd sewer/water line&he lied to my face & said that it wasnt in the quote! After I spoke to him 3+times& got it in writing! They didn't cap any of the lines/test the system for leaks. They charged my card for 95% of the balance b4 ANY work was done. We agreed on 50% up front & the rest upon completion. That is fraud. I asked them not to charge the card again & they stated that they wouldn't but they lied & still did. That is fraud. Their workers do not know the code & are operating w/o supervision. I spoke with Mike(mgmt) & explained the issues. He met with me at the site& saw the issues.  He said that they would "try" to get a more experienced worker on the job sometime next week. I had an inspection scheduled for Monday! I asked for a refund b/c I do not trust them to do the work correctly. Mike had an attitude b/c of this & said that I wasted HIS time for having him come out to see. 0/5stars!

reviews.author: Vicky
reviews.text:
I had an issue with the water continuing to run after the toilet was flushed, which could not be controlled by turning off water to the bowl so it ran for more than 24 hours. The 2nd bathroom had a similar issue but the water could be cut off.
The plumber arrived to give an estimate, which took nearly an hour and a half. After an hour he asked if there was another toilet in the house in which I showed the 3rd toilet. This took another 30 minutes
before he came with 3 estimates ranging from $654-$2,999. This covered replacing 2 toilets for $2,999, or replacing 3 fill valves and a angle stop in one for $982 or repair the angle stop and adjust the fill valves for $654.

It was not until I agreed on one of the options that the water was turned off. I saw the plumber with a shovel and tools in the middle of the yard, I went outside and asked what he was about to do and he said turn the water off once he located the water turn off.  I advised the water meter was on the curb by the power pole, he stopped and went to the meter and turned the water off. He was there for about 3 1/2 hours doing the work. (9-12:45)

The last issue was after leaving, the hot water was at a trickle so I notified the company around 1:05. The plumber called at 4:15 to advise he was 30 minutes away but remembered he forgot to turn the hot water heater back on and asked if I could go turn it back on. I asked if he could document that he asked me to turn it back on in case anything went wrong. He apologized and because it was late in the day on a Friday, I knew he did not want to come back.
For what I was charged, and sitting there all day, I should have received a follow up call from him or the company.

reviews.author: Essential Hauling: Junk Removal Service
reviews.text:
I will never hire this place again. The initial charged was $90 to look at the problem. Trevor Thomas was at my house for less than an hour. He looked at a few things,  quoted me a price of $504, which was ok because I wanted my issue resolved. He comes back after five minutes of digging and says that my problem is I need my septic tank to be pumped. He then explains that they do not do the service and he will knock a little off the price. He dug up a piece of my lawn then charged $402.  I expected to pay more for the inital charge to look at the issue because it is Sunday, however, $312 to dig a for 5 minutes and tell  me you cannot do anything to help?!?! Never again!

The issue wasn't just that you all did not have septic pumping services. That was only one of the problems and that was only a issue because the women who answer my call mentioned it could be my problem and I also said that I thought it was the issue, so why send someone who couldn't pump my septic tank. The bigger problem is you all told me it was $90 to come out and find out what was wrong on a Sunday. Trevor Thomas come out and told me it is clogged and it will be $504 to unclog. Then digs a hole and tells me the septic tanks needs to be pumped but still charges me $312. He did not do anything. The $90 was supposed to be to find what was wrong, which he told me he did and he was going to fixed the issue for $504. Then that changed to he couldn't do anything about it and still changed me $312. Unless you are going to refund my $312 there is no reason for me to call your customer service and I will not be hiring roto-rooter again.

reviews.author: Kim Jones
reviews.text:
We had to use your on-call service the evening of Sunday, May 26, 2019.  Michael was the technician that came out.  Our master bedroom and bathroom had gone for a swim in water that backed up through shower/tub, toilet, and sink.  After explaining what happened, he immediately knew we had a clog in the line and fixed us up in no time.  He was so professional and gave us great tips on how to prevent clogs in the future (we were using flushable wipes - NEVER AGAIN).  We can't thank Michael enough for the service he provided.  He was very patient and allowed me to fill up the washing machine to allow it to drain off and make sure we were in the clear with water backing up again.  Thank you Michael and Roto-Rooter for taking care of us when one of the other local companies in town failed us.

Fast forward - February 2026
We had a great experience with Roto-Rooter's on-call service yet again, thanks to their technician Morgan. Our septic lid was completely stuck! Years of dirt and sealing had it practically fused shut. Morgan didn’t give up for a second. He carefully worked around the edges, tried multiple tools, and put in some serious elbow grease to get it open without damaging anything.

What really stood out was his patience and determination. It would’ve been easy to give up, but he kept at it until the job was done right. He also explained what he was doing along the way and made sure everything was secure before leaving. He successfully cleared all clogs!

If you get Morgan as your tech, you’re in excellent hands. Professional, hardworking, and truly committed to solving the problem.

reviews.author: Angela B.
reviews.text:
I hired Roto Rooter Plumbing to fix the low water pressure at my home, but I ended up regretting it. The plumber installed a new prv, ball valve, and swing check and it did not correct the problem. Water pressure to the house did not increase. It was clear he didn't know what he was doing.
I called Roto Rooter to come back out the next day since the problem wasn't fixed. They came out and suggested there could be another problem, but there was no way to know unless the plumber dug up my yard. (More or less trial and error). I declined. By this time, I had lost total confidence in them. It's frustrating to PAY for a service and the problem NOT being fixed.
Therefore, I employed another plumbing company. They came out diagnosed and fixed the problem right away. I was told I had a second PVR that needed replacing. They located the second PRV and replaced it. Now I have the correct water pressure!!!!! Why didn't Roto Rooter know I had a second PVR if they are in the plumbing business?!!!!
Overall, I'm thoroughly disappointed with the quality of Roto Rooter Plumbing. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone looking for reliable plumbing services. Save yourself the headache and find a more competent plumbing Business.

reviews.author: Ryan Burgess
reviews.text:
I want to say how awesome working with Roto-Rooter was. Has a pretty big problem that then turned into a major problem when the 1 collapse in my kitchen drain line became 4....

But the techs they sent to my house, Anthony and Brandon and the other 2s who's names i don't remember were awesome! They answered every silly question I had when I didn't understand what a part was, or the direction we needed to go cause it just seemed like everything wrong in a concrete slab drain pipe went wrong at once.

But working from home and starting a new job I was worried about noise level among other things, but man aside from the tile hammer the first day, could barely hear them! And that isnt a fault in the tile hammer, work was kind enough to give me off that day since we knew it would be loud!

But they really came in clutch and helped me with a massive problem I was having and prevented me from spending a bunch of money just to have the same problem again!

100% the entire team I worked with was fantastic! Can't recommend enough!

PS: before someone says they didn't restore my concrete out front I requested they not as I plan to remove that walk way, makes it easier if its precut!

reviews.author: Shaunda T
reviews.text:
Greetings!  Thank you so much for promptly attending to my urgent call Sat, Feb 7 at 8pm.  I was shocked to find water draining from the ceiling of my master bedroom.  I called around but Rotor-Rooters was the only company able & willing to respond.  Trevor arrived and kindly greeted me at the door wearing shoe booties (which I reallyappreciated).  He asked to see the issue & immediately wanted to gain access to the attic.  He spotted the leak within a minute.  He diagnosed the problem (squirrel gnawing on my water pipe creating a hole in the pipe), provided an estimate of the cost (which was very reasonable), performed the work, collected the payment and emailed the invoice receipt before leaving the premises.  He was in & out within 45 mins or so.  He was very friendly engaging in casual conversation with me as he worked.  I pray I never encounter this ordeal again but if I do...I will specifically ask for Trevor.
~ Again, thank you ~

reviews.author: Janet Broeckel
reviews.text:
Today is Valentine’s Day and I felt bad for calling somebody out for a backed up toilet and shower on this special day. But I called Roto-Rooter and Cullen Sutherland came to my rescue. After assessing the problem, he went straight to work…And what seemed like minutes … he had everything taken care of!
I would definitely recommend Roto-Rooter in Augusta , Georgia who also services my area in Aiken, South Carolina. It started this morning at 8 AM when I talked to Miss Alexis… Who was such a delight on the phone. She actually heard what I was saying and said I will send somebody out there today! (In a very cheerful voice I might add) How wonderful it is that you can call somebody and actually get a real live person on the phone. My whole experience was wonderful! When you are a senior citizen, those little things are the things that mean the most.
Thank you so much for taking such good care of me!
Jan B
Aiken, SC

reviews.author: Kevin S.
reviews.text:
I recently had a main water line rupture and I called roto rooter for repairs. Cale was the dispatcher and the main interface I had. He was professional, courteous, and very quick to answer the call and get the help my family needed to fix the issue. The technicians Trevor, Brandon. And Morgan were experts in thier craft. They handled the issues that arised with professionalism, and were not afraid to contact and keep me updated on the repairs. Furthermore, they were amazing in the care and speed of the repair to get our water back safely, and rapidly. They also cleaned up so well, it was as if they were never there.
These gentlemen worked with pride and professionalism, which was a great reflection of themselves, and roto rooter overall. Every single one of them treated me as if I were family. I highly recommend thier services.

reviews.author: Melissa Sousa
reviews.text: We had an after hours emergency. The operator was kind and friendly. It didn’t take long for a technician to arrive. Bryant Cantrell arrived and was both friendly and professional. He thoroughly checked everything before talking to us about what the issue was. He gave us options to resolve the issue with our toilet and even addressed a slow drain in our bath tub. He didn’t just focus on the toilet, he checked the tub and sink too. He was very professional and we felt well-informed to make good decisions. He was also very friendly and easy to talk with. We will definitely request him again if we need more service. Excellent people providing excellent service is what keeps us coming back to Roto Rooter every time. Thank you, Bryant!

synthesis.summary: Roto-Rooter Aiken has strong emergency availability — techs like Brandon, Ruan, and Trevor respond to 1:30 AM calls, late evenings, and after-hours situations. But Yelp reviewers tell a different story: pricing runs $200+/hour with no upfront disclosure, a $10,200 large job had serious code violations, and one reviewer paid $275 for 30 minutes of repair work. Google/Yelp gap of 1.3 stars across meaningful Yelp volume warrants caution.

Techs like Ruan Hill consistently praised for finding root causes and transparent explanations

weaknesses: Pricing consistently described as high on Yelp — $200+/hour, $275 for 30-minute repair, no upfront quotes

Large $10,200 job had fraud allegation: charged 95% of balance before any work was done

reviews.author: Joshua R.
reviews.text:
Punctual. Professional. Respectful. Knowledgeable. Proactive. Meticulous. All defined by Richie and Cesar from Eric's Plumbing.

Richie arrived near the start of the scheduled window time frame. He was quite affable and considerately listened to all of our issues and our home upgrade goals. He courteously offered three options of how to help us and even explained different ways to mix and match and customize options even more.

Richie was straight forward and provided clear and concise details, he answered all of our questions, and he was very patient with us as we were deciding what was best. He was completely indifferent with zero pressure if we chose the "just fix the broke things" bundle or if we chose the "upgrade all the things plus" bundle.

We decided on the "upgrade all the things plus" bundle and Richie got after it. He soon brought in Cesar to expedite the work, and Cesar was just as friendly with the same level of professionalism that Richie had characterized.

They both did a superb job with installation; everything was pro and solid. They were also magnificent with clean-up; no dings, dents, scrapes and everything buttoned up nicely. They were remarkably fast. One thing that astounded me... they removed their shoe covers when they walked outside and put them back on each time they entered. These guys truly respected our home.

Moreover, Richie was outstanding when he went the extra mile by fixing a couple minor things which could be potential problems down the road. These were things that the original installer had cut corners and he wasn't contracted to fix. I greatly appreciate his unparalleled dedication and care. This is something I have not seen since I was a kid watching my father working with folks back in the 80's.

Overall: Class 1 - Grade A+ Superior skills, exemplary craftsmanship, and a couple extraordinary guys that I could've easily hung out afterwards. Because of their praiseworthy job, we subscribed to Eric's yearly maintenance deal, and will be referring Eric's to everyone we know.

reviews.author: Jeff B.
reviews.text:
After dealing with persistent sewage backups in our basement and receiving a concerning $45,000 quote to replace our supposedly decayed cast-iron pipes, we found Eric's Plumbing and Drain through a trusted referral - and what a difference it made.
From the very first visit, Eric and Ritchie demonstrated exceptional professionalism:
* Provided a free, thorough inspection (three hours)!
* Used camera technology to show us exactly what was happening in our pipes
* Correctly diagnosed the issue as removable cast iron scale, not pipe decay
* Offered a much more cost-effective solution: pipe relining
* Provided detailed quotes for various service options
* Upon finishing the inspection, left our bathroom clean and sanitized
* Never used high-pressure sales tactics

As happy as we were with the initial inspection, the work that Eric, Ritchie and Ian performed was even more impressive:
* They kept us informed with precise arrival times
* They removed 5 gallons of cast iron scale (prior to re-lining)
* They beautifully re-lined 200 feet of pipe (in one day!) 
* They documented the results with before/after video footage
* They provided a warranty for future backups
* They always put down drops on the carpet, wore shoe coverings, always deep cleaned any places where they performed work in the house.
* They were fantastic communicators.  They always kept us up to date with where they were at with the job.  I once contacted Ritchie and Eric with a concern and less than two minutes later, Eric called me to get more information and to communicate a plan.  

Eric, Ritchie, and Ian's expertise, transparency, and attention to detail transformed what could have been a $45,000 basement demolition into a clean, efficient pipe restoration. Their work stands out among all the plumbers we've hired over the years. The results speak for themselves - our backup issues are resolved, and we have peace of mind knowing Eric's Plumbing and Drain stands behind their work.

reviews.author: Jennifer Elliott
reviews.text:
We initially experienced a blockage at our office and called another plumbing company. They came out, snaked the pipe, and told us there was a pipe collapse. Wanting to be sure, I decided to get a second opinion and contacted Eric’s Plumbing.
Eric’s team came out, assessed the situation, and snaked the pipe again. They determined it was actually a clog, not a collapse, and proceeded to jet the line, which fully cleared the issue.
Richie, the technician, was extremely thorough and professional. He took the time to explain everything clearly and even showed us video footage of the pipe. He walked us through what had happened and pointed out exactly where repairs may be needed in the future.
I really appreciated the honesty, transparency, and level of care we received. We will definitely be using Eric’s Plumbing going forward and highly recommend them to anyone needing reliable service.

reviews.text: Blake did an amazing job! Every time we used our upstairs shower it was leaking down into our pantry. The price charged is comparable to other plumbers in the area.  I was thrilled to get on their schedule so quickly.   We will most likely be using their company again in the future.  I did have an episode where it began to plug up again in both sides of the sink - 3 days after this treatment, but I was able to get it to go back down, so I didn't call and report that.

reviews.author: Jayden Rucker
reviews.text:
Update 04/23/2025: Finally connected with the Director of Operations and he made things right. Jared listened and had a plan to correct the issues.

Original review:
Rescheduling, dishonesty, and headache.
My 9:00 a.m.-10:00 a.m. appointment was rescheduled with hardly any notice and I was told it would be closer to 12:00 p.m. Then 1:30 p.m. rolls around and after multiple phone calls to Black Diamond I was told that the install may have to be pushed to another day. Due to the heat and having little kids I pushed for install on the contracted day. Finally the tech showed up around 4:45 p.m. As 9:00 p.m. rolled around the job was still not done because the technician did not have everything he needed to finish the job.
Each time I had contact with someone from Black Diamond Experts I was given a different excuse as to why my appointment was getting pushed. I understand problems come up but be straightforward. After the second excuse the excuses feel more like lies, especially when they are all different.
I had to miss a shift at work, stick close to my house all day when I had errands to run, and I still did not have my a/c installed 100% on the contracted day. The next day the install was finished after 4 hours when I was told it would take 15 which made me late for work.
If it was just a review on Rusty, Jake, and Skyler it would be a 5/5. Because of the scheduling issues and lies 2/5 stars.

reviews.author: Mark Thomas
reviews.text: I have been carefully looking for an HVAC provider that would address some immediate air conditioning and heating needs for our house. We also wanted to build a long term relationship with someone we trust. We had some problems that needed to be addressed in the next few weeks. I wanted to find good quality work at a reasonable price. So a few weeks ago, I went out for bids. What I found surprised me. Let me tell you why. We picked Black Diamond and we are thrilled with their work. Jose from Black Diamond just finished fixing our furnace and air conditioner. Jose has nearly 20 years of experience. And he works for a quality company with a great HVAC program. We were looking for high quality work at reasonable prices. What really surprised me is that beacuse of his experience, Jose was able to find a safer solution with higher quality materials to solve our problem than his competitors. And it actually costs us several thousand dollars less than his competitors who claim to be the cheapest. I do not not how often I will come across this good fortune: superior quality work, safer and higher quality materials and solutions, very knowledgable workers, while saving us thousands of dollars in this one job, alone, over the other HVAC company bids. Thanks, Jose! Bravo!! Whatever Diamond Experts pays you, Jose, it is not enough.

reviews.author: Spencer
reviews.text:
I scheduled to have the MagicPak unit in my condo as these guys are one of the few that I've been able to find that service them that also do electrical and plumbing.

Long story short appt was set for between 12pm - 16:00 @ 11:37 I texted to ensure the appt hadn't been cancelled or rescheduled. At 11:43 I received txt informing me the appt was still on, and given a number to call for an ETA which I did and was told it would be around 14:00. At 16:13 after having not heard any further I called Black Diamond Experts and was told my appt had been cancelled and the soonest someone could come out was two weeks later.

Now I understand, stuff happens. And the lady I spoke to did apologize informing me that the tech had tried to txt me but that for whatever reason the txts hadn't gone through. So, I'm supposed to believe that the Tech didn't know that the txts hadn't gone through and that they then couldn't have called to inform me. I could have worked more hrs or done something else productive.

So be forewarned unless you are their first customer of the day or a subscriber to one of their maintenance plans you are going to have problems. Seems like ever since they merged with Anyhour their service has taken a nose dive.

reviews.author: Jared Tanner
reviews.text: I called black diamond when my water heater went out over a year ago. They came and replaced it and installed a water pressure valve they said I needed on my water main line. Ever since then, I’ve had a sludge that has been clogging up my faucets to the point the hot water just trickles out of them - zero pressure. I called them back about 6 months later. They said the sludge was coming from my water softener. So they disconnected my water softener to see if that was the problem. Fast forward my hot water faucets are all clogged again and just tricking water…and I no longer have soft water. Never in my prior 6 years in this house did I ever have water softener sludge issues. Never had any water pressure issues. Now I have all kinds of issues. I’m about to give up and have a new company come replace the black diamond water heater and undue all the issues they created in my home. Ugh

reviews.author: Tad Christiansen
reviews.text: I used black diamond to repair my furnace a few years ago and had a great experience with them so I used them again to replace a furnace in a condo I rent out. Not only were they easy to work with, their prices were fair and the work was done in a timely manner. Later I found that there was a slight issue that needed to be resolved. They were willing to call my HOA's plumber and work out details to go down there together so I didn't have to go back and forth between the plumber and the black diamond technician. When the issue was resolved, they not only didn't charge me anything, they paid for the plumbers bill as well. The whole process was hassle free and I felt like the treated me as fairly as possible. I can't recommend these guys enough! Get your hvac needs done with them, you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Gary Hatch
reviews.text:
Zack, Austin & Adien installed a motor home plug that allows me to use the motor home as an extra guest house.

They also ran an additional wire back to an automatic transfer switch they had installed for me earlier.

This will allow my 7500 amp motor home generator provide power to my home after the solar batteries lose power.

They also ran a Cat 5 cable to my son’s office that allows faster speed for work & gaming.

Even though the had to cut don holes on walls & ceilings they covered them back up & arranged for a drywaller to come repair the sheetrock.  They  Thoroughly cleaned up all that they did to make it look like they had never been here. Overall, they did a fabulous job and I would highly recommend them to anyone that needs any type of electrical work done.

reviews.author: Bob McCann
reviews.text:
Great experience all around. The initial technician they sent out was outstanding. Your the best, Jose!

He not only diagnosed our immediate issue, he also advised us about the condition/potential issues with all of the components (it's an old furnace).

He took the time to lay out several repair options, from just fixing our immediate problem through several different price options to repair/replace some or all of the other issues.

We ultimately decided to have Black Diamond install a whole new furnace due to age/overall condition, but the detailed breakdown of *all* of the options and their (very reasonable) prices was very much appreciated in helping us make the best decision for our home.

reviews.author: Patricia Fletcher
reviews.text: I am so glad that my project has been completed. Black Diamond has been very patient with me as I have run into snags with my renovation that has caused me to reschedule several times. They have been a dream to work with on updating my electricity throughout my home. Today, Bryce installed the last piece of this magnificent puzzle. He worked quietly and efficiently. I was able to continue my work and even forgot he was here. Thank you so much for continuing to impress with your world class service.

reviews.author: Christel W.
reviews.text: Thank you Spencer and  Bowers Plumbing! We have been calling Bowers for years now with any plumbing issues. Spencer came out and hooked up our dishwasher and refrigerator. He was very professional and checked to make sure everything was in good working condition before he left! Thank you!

reviews.author: Judy J.
reviews.text: Excellent service.  Prompt.  Reasonably priced.  Nick did a thorough job  fixing my bathroom faucet and installing my new kitchen faucet.  When I need plumbing service, I'll hire them again!

reviews.author: R. W. Marsh
reviews.text:
Evan was challenged with replacing a outdated and failing system with an all new system in a very small space. He managed to get'r done with minimum amount of gnashing of teeth and a few smiles.
Very friendly and professional, Bower's Pluming had a fantastic employee!

reviews.author: Dj B.
reviews.text:
We've called on this company three times in the past four years.  Once for a new hotwater heater and once to have plumbing moved & installed for a new, walkin shower.  These two times Bowers was awesome .
Then we had to call due to our washing machine drain overflowing.  The Tech came out (we've never seen this guy before) and seemed to ask the same questions over and over. I felt like I was listening to "who's on first".  When asked if he brought his camera, he stated he did not, but could run back to the shop to get it, however we would have to pay for his time to do so.   We declined.  He quickly  snaked the line and said he hit roots.  Brought the line back up and packed his gear.  His parting words were for us to make another appointment for him to bring out the camera.  And that was it.  Maybe 15 minutes of effort and he was gone.  Cost - $193.  We called another company the next day and the problem was found and fixed.   We won't be calling Bowers again.  Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Faith M.
reviews.text: Worst Plumbing experience ever and we were in a new home! They installed the toilets and had to come out and put in a new toilet well when they did so the toilet wasn't put together properly and it caused a leaked in my kitchen! Had to get them out here again to fix that! Now we've only been in this home for two years and were selling and during the inspection report the toilets were loose and they won't come out and fix that either! Stating were out of the 90 days but yet they installed the toilets! Worst company I've ever experienced as a home owner.

reviews.author: Jay T.
reviews.text: 2nd time we've used Bowers - first time Chris installed a new water heater (to code), and today Johnny installed a new shower-valve and prepped the drain for a shower pan (we're doing the bathroom re-model ourselves).  I didn't trust my soldering, so to get it done right we called Bowers.  Talked to "Robert" - and after finding out what we needed done, he said Johnny would be here between 08:00 and 08:30 the next day - he was here at 08:00.  Done quickly and well (he even gave me a few tips on soldering, and replacing a closet-flange) - and real personable to-boot.  These guys are BUSY - and that's a good thing - and because of that, I'd suggest getting ahead of the job by having needed pieces-parts already on-hand (if you can); prevents a trip to the store if they don't have something on the truck (which looked to be pretty well stocked), and it might save you a buck or two as well.  We'll be sticking with Bowers for any future work too...

reviews.text:

It required digging a line in the ground to the street.. very involved! Employees,

faucet. Additionally, an inside water turnoff valve was  put in my hall closet, I was very appreciative of their knowledge, professionalism,
and work ethic. I would absolutely recommend this company for any plumbing and heating needs.

Found and fixed the bursted pipe in one visit,  very happy with the service and the company. We'll be requesting their service again,  if/ when needed.  They were super friendly all the way.

I can always count on them when other companies let me down, and now they're going to be the only plumbing company that I use in the future.

reviews.text: We used Big Apple Plumbing to do our sewer line replacement and we were very happy with the work that was done. reviews.author: Rooster
reviews.text: So much for 24/7 365 days a year emergency service. Have a clogged toilet in my elderly mother’s house that needs fixed ASAP. Spoke with a dispatcher that said the technician was finish up a job nearby and would let us know when he was done. The next call I got was saying the technician had worked too many hours today and they would not be able to send someone tonight. DON’T ADVERTISE IT IF ITS NOT TRUE!

reviews.author: Chen Shen
reviews.text:
My tenants in San Mateo called Drain Doctor on Thanksgiving when both the kitchen sink and a bathroom drain were clogged. Unfortunately, I was out of town and they couldn’t reach my usual plumber. According to my tenant, Rocky (the owner) came out and said the old metal traps and pipes running from the shower and kitchen sink to the main line were corroded and not functioning. He quoted $4,500 and replaced about 15–20 feet of pipe in the crawl space within 4 hours. My tenant authorized the work. Rocky mentioned that he was giving us a “discount” since it was a holiday, claiming the job would normally cost $7,000 with other companies, but that he doesn’t overcharge like others in the Bay Area. He also noted that the remaining cast iron pipes should eventually be replaced.

After I returned from my trip, I asked him for a quote to replace the rest of the cast iron lines and also brought in two other licensed plumbing companies for comparison. Rocky’s quotes were $5,000–$7,000 higher than the others, again framed as a “discount” based on the earlier work. The two other plumbers I consulted also reviewed the Thanksgiving job and said the work should have cost closer to $2,800. They were surprised by how much I had been charged.

Overall, I am not satisfied with how this was handled. While I always try to support local small businesses, this did not feel like fair treatment. The “discount” pitch seems more like a sales tactic than genuine savings, and the prices were well above market rate—even accounting for the holiday timing. Unfortunately, I would not recommend this company and won’t be using them again.

reviews.author: John Al-Samarrie
reviews.text:
OK, this is overdue.  Last month I noticed water on the garage cement floor and thought it was just moisture.  After careful review I noticed that the water heater was leaking.  I called four different plumbers to get estimates with Drain Doctor being the first one I called.  A little history of my previous water heater is in order.  in 2019 I was overseas, and the heater broke and leaked all over the garage damaging some important personal items.  My girlfriend at the time called a plumber who installed a new heater and what a mess it was.  That plumber used galvanized steel for the inlet and outlet of the heater lines.  Routed the pressure relief pipe into the water heater pan rather than outside of the pan and installed my recirculating pump facing the side wall where I could not gain access.  Additionally, the gas line reservoir was installed by the water heater rather than near the gas line valve coming out of the wall.  There were no 2x4 boards in the back of the heater for earth quake bracing and the water lines were not earth grounded, all of which are city compliance requirement.  To say the least it was a cluster F.  When Bobby from Drain doctor showed up, he immediately pointed out the nonconformance of the water heater and gave me a bottom-line price from his standard pricing book which no other plumbers could beat.  Some quotes were almost double and after negotiating with those plumbers they got close to Bobby's price which didn't sit well with me.  So, I decided to go with Bobby and that proved to be fortuitist based on his efficient and compliant work.  Bobby is a plethora of plumbing information or more like a Wikipedia of plumbing.  He does have a laid back and straight forward attitude but don't let that fool you.  He's the top gun in his industry.  Anyway, I've read some of the negative reviews and in each case, there has been a unique set circumstance that all of us experienced in our daily life but over 99%+ of Drain Doctor reviews are very positive.  I can't tell you how happy we are with his work and in fact our outside main water line inlet valve was broken, unbeknown to us and we had him come back the next day to fix that as well.  I didn't bother getting other quotes because I knew Bobby would give us a competitive price but more importantly do the job right.
Anyway, you can't go wrong with Drain Doctor and ask for Bobby.  Bobby is your man.
Lastley, I don’t usually write reviews, but I was so impressed with the work I was compelled to write about our experience.
Thank you,
John A.

reviews.author: David Hunter
reviews.text: I only write reviews for services and businesses I think are exceptionally good— and this is one of those. Every aspect of working with Drain Doctor—from my initial call to the final payment— exceeded my expectations. The two people I interacted with were both very professional, helpful, friendly, straightforward and considerate the whole time. Jorge arrived early, diagnosed the problem within minutes and fixed it within 10. He then went above and beyond by caulking the toilet (not part of the estimate) and giving me info about what I needed to do to prevent future problems. At the end, when my card declined due to fraud protection, he and the lovely woman in the office (I’m sorry, I can’t remember your name!) were super patient while I fixed the issue. This was my first experience needing a plumber and Drain Doctor was the only one I needed to call. Truly, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I will definitely use them in the future and highly recommend them to anyone needing quality plumbing work done fast at a reasonable price! Thanks, guys!

reviews.author: Harini
reviews.text:
We had a plumbing emergency over the weekend, and from the first call to Drain Doctors, the experience was excellent. Vivian handled our case and sent Martin over on Saturday. He was punctual, diagnosed the issue, and provided a clear quote. When I expressed some doubts, Vivian immediately had Martin return in person to clarify every question we had.

We ended up proceeding with a much larger project: pipe replacement and two clean outs. Martin and his team were professional, courteous, and always informed us before shutting off the water. When I needed to coordinate the city permit, a member of the office team reached out on Sunday to confirm our Monday inspection time. Martin and the team were back again to assist with the permit and left the place very clean. Throughout the process, Vivian was always available via phone or text. Highly recommend this reliable and professional team!

reviews.text:
First call was made at 8:30pm for a flooded bathroom and emergency help needed. Drain Doctor quickly deployed a plumber George who got there within an hour to help research the problem. Our solution was not feasible so late with my kids already sleeping, so George helped get everything safe for the night and helped schedule an appointment for first thing the next morning.
Alex showed up around 8:30 in the morning and was an absolute professional. We found a broken pipe under the house. He working with my landlord and walked through our options. Got the work done much faster than expected. Kept my house clean and cleaned up after themselves. Alex was an absolute professional who knew his stuff, could walk you through the problem/solution, and worked fast and clean. I would recommend Drain Doctor for anyone with plumbing issues, especially in an emergency situation.

reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Jorge Moreno from Drain Doctor Plumbing, and I couldn't be more impressed. From the moment he arrived, Jorge was friendly, respectful, and genuinely professional. He took the time to explain everything in detail, demonstrating his deep knowledge of plumbing and his commitment to providing excellent service. His expertise and attention to detail ensured that the job was completed efficiently and to the highest standard. It's rare to find someone who combines such technical skill with such a positive and approachable attitude. I highly recommend Drain Doctor Plumbing and Jorge Moreno to anyone in need of plumbing services!

reviews.author: Monica DAguanno
reviews.text: Scott and Vivian with Drain Doctor were amazing! Vivian greeted me on the phone and was able to have Scott come out within 30 minutes. When he got here he quickly assessed the garbage disposal had a crack in it and replaced it right there. Because I rent not own, I got my landlord on the phone and Scott gave him a quoted price including the parts and labor. There wasn’t any confusion, it was very smooth, and my landlord was able to pay over the phone with his card. He worked quickly, promptly, and was great! I’d recommend and absolutely will be requesting Scott if any other issues arise. Thank you to Scott and Vivian! Shoutout to you both. 5 stars all the way!

reviews.text:

Four different businesses didn’t answer the phone and one said they only take appointments…. What???
Drain Doctor Fremont was next and I was assured someone would be at my home within the hour. The technician was here within 30 minutes and just as quickly he had cleared the drain from the street.
Both the office and the technician were very courteous and wanted to make sure I was satisfied.
The task was completed, but I will tell you service makes all the difference!
Job well done, and it let me get back to my weekend quickly!

reviews.text: I’ve worked with Drain Doctors Plumbing on many residential and commercial projects, and they consistently deliver exceptional results. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to doing the job right the first time make them my top choice for plumbing work. They’re punctual, communicative, and always maintain a clean, safe worksites. Whether it’s new construction, remodels, or emergency repairs, Drain Doctors brings a level of expertise and reliability. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a skilled and dependable plumber.

reviews.text: I had a great experience with this plumbing company! From the start, Diana was kind, friendly, and kept me informed, she made scheduling easy and ensured someone would come within the window given. Justin, the plumber, arrived on time, resolved our issue efficiently, and even provided a clear solution to prevent it from happening again. I truly appreciated their professionalism and the way they fit us in on short notice. If another plumbing issue comes up, I know exactly who to call. Thank you, Diana and Justin!
