reviews.author: Wayne Lindsey
reviews.text:
Parley Plumbing was prompt and pleasant. They performed quickly with no disruption to our daily routine. Their diagnostic skills were superior to our other quotes.
They left the place clean and tidy.
I am having them back for a new heater /AC and water heart. Their quote was20% lower than the bigger company quote, with better equipment.

reviews.author: Don Hastings
reviews.text:
Our plumber Isaac did a great job installing a water heater at my sister's condo. He obviously cares a lot about the quality of his work and the satisfaction of his customers. Parley's Plumbing has great customer service. If there's not someone available right away to talk to you, they always get back to you. That in itself is very valuable!

Update: 12-18-25.  Parley's Plumbing did such a great job with my sister's water heater installation, I decided to have them do some work on my house.  They replaced my old tank-style water heater with a new tankless water heater and... replaced all of my old steel water pipes with new Pex lines.  James and Russell did a great job. They did it quickly and with very professional service. The installation looks great!

In the middle of the tankless water heater installation, we decided to replace the furnace and change from a roof-mounted swamp cooler to a central air system.  Parley's lead HVAC tech, Mason was great and very knowledgeable.  His assistant Zachary was awesome!  Furnace and AC look great.  Haven't used AC yet, but the furnace is a very nice improvement over my old furnace.  I can't say enough about this company.  They were honest, reliable, responsive and did quality work at a fair price.

reviews.author: Joanne Wong
reviews.text: Issac gave us the best service! He answered and helped us with our issue and work beyond to help us! We are always satisfied with PPM!

reviews.author: D M.
reviews.text:
Overpriced!  Less than an hour to detect and fix a simple leak in the end of a copper pipe fix-was billed $247.00.  
Should have used "In-Line" plumbing company in Utah (as I have before) at $120.00 an hour.

reviews.author: Greg Patterson
reviews.text: I had a clogged drain.  I tried Parleys first, and because of the mess and urgency, I didn’t think to get a second quote and ended up spending at least $2,000 more than I should have for the fix.  I wouldn’t trust them anymore.

reviews.author: Aaron K.
reviews.text:
I was dumb enough to call PPM to do two jobs for me but i will NEVER CALL THEM AGAIN!

1.  Called PPM to do a simple fridge line installation.  The tech showed up and said he could only do a fridge line installation if I replaced the water shut off valve since the water pressure was too high they claimed and it would cost an extra $300.  I said whatever go ahead and fix it and after he left I had a horrible buzzing noise in the house every time the water turned on, so the tech came back out and just turned the water pressure back up so the noise would go away.  This defeated the purpose of even having him install a new water shut off valve that I never wanted in the first place!   

2. A different tech comes out to give me an estimate on replacing my water heater which turned out to be an absorbent amount, but I explained to him that my water pressure is high and that his company installed a new valve for me last year and if I turn the water down then there is a horrible buzzing noise.  He confirmed that the valve that was installed was not the correct one, but if I bought a water heater from him then he would replace it for free.  THEY ARE THE ONES THAT PUT THE WRONG VALVE ON IN THE FIRST PLACE! ARE YOU KIDDING?!  So after much argument they agreed to put the correct valve on and resolve the problem that the first tech did a lousy job on.  HALLELUJAH!  So they sent a different tech out who showed up 3 hours late for the appointed time to fix the valve and a few days before he showed up I called and I told them that rather then replace the functioning water heater I had I would like them to just replace the anode rod to help the tank get better life and I would ride it out til it dies.  They responded that they don't do any work on water heaters over 15 years old and that they would only sell me a new one if I wanted.

THEY ARE COMPLETELY DISHONEST AND HAVE NO INTEGRITY AND WILL LIE AND TAKE ADVANTAGE OF YOU AS OPPOSED TO FIXING WHAT YOU CALL THEM FOR!  BUYER BEWARE!

reviews.author: Amy O.
reviews.text:
I bought an older home that came complete with a giant, ancient furnace. I had many contractors come and bid on a replacement furnace and a/c install. Of all the contractors I called, PPM was the ONLY one that gave me options for high efficiency. They were the ONLY ones that cared to tell me about higher electric costs with certain units, they were the only ones that even bothered to explain different types of systems to me, and they were the ONLY ones who instantly recognized the old furnace in my house and knew how to remove it without taking walls down like all the contractors mentioned doing. Because of PPM, I ended up getting something completely different from what I originally wanted, because I hadn't known there was a difference. 

When they came to do the install, they were quick, efficient, and on time. They even worked within my busy schedule because I was leaving town for a few weeks. They completely cleaned up after themselves and were 100% professional. They even took time to show me how all the equipment worked and helped me to claim my rebates and tax incentives. 

Even though their bid was slightly higher than others, I actually got a MUCH better system than I ever would have simply because PPM took the time to explain everything to me and give me options. Plus, they had a bid estimate ready same-day. Before the contractor left, he handed me the estimate. No other contractor had a bid ready for me until at least a week later. I would highly recommend them to anyone. Best contractor I've worked with, and I've been working with a lot.

reviews.author: Jean W.
reviews.text:
We all find ourselves in need of a plumber now and then when things get backed up. Or, in my case, when you need a gas line pulled, and a shoddy shower valve install made right. 

Ellery, from Parley's, showed up on time - for both appointments - was extremely respectful of both me and my home, and did a fantastic job with both projects.

My new shower valve had been botched during install and left for dead. I didn't even know everything that was wrong with it. All I knew is that my brand new $1,200 shower valve didn't work. Ellery took one look at it and explained what was wrong with what he saw. It took him 30 minutes to repair and replace everything in need, and when he left, I had a working shower.

I called him to come back and plumb my gas line, which had to find its way through the exterior of my home to a grill bib. He even estimated that it would take him twice as long as it did. He was finished up before I knew it, and ... again, I had a system that worked. 

I've never had a moment's issue with any of the work performed by Ellery. I request him now when I call for service at Parley's. I have always appreciate how I've been dealt with there, from the intake/schedulers to Ellery, my serviceman. Invoicing and billing have always been 100% correct, leaving me with little doubt about Parley's integrity. Whenever I've need them, Parley's has been there in a reasonable time. And I never feel overcharged or underserviced, which is typical of most companies in this industry.

Parley's is my plumber any ol' day.

reviews.author: Greg H
reviews.text: I have used these guys for numerous residential and commercial jobs and they are professional and courteous and fair.  Rob is their master plumber and when no one else can figure anything out this is the guy that is the David Copperfield of resolving any and all concerns. I have had other plumbers from the company as well including Collin today that go above and beyond.  Do yourself a favor and give them a call. You will want to send me a handwritten thank you note.  Dave is very good at answering the phone and facilitating delegation and have worked with Mason and Issac as well and generally average about $15,000 a year with these guys with various properties. Trust me they are as good as it gets.

reviews.author: Tyler H.
reviews.text: I recently had PPM come to my house to replace an outdoor drinking fountain bubbler. He came to the house at noon took a look went to get the part, came back, turned off water, changed part, turned on water, checked part in under an hour. Then brought the bill of $287!!!! There was no breakdown of the bill... ie, how much for part, how much for labor. When my husband asked how much he had paid for the part, he told us $120. Then told us they just had a basic fee for coming to do this kind of job. So, $167 for labor an hour!?!?! We then checked the internet for the exact part he put on our faucet (we kept the box). It was $35 and that was including shipping. I cannot recommend these guys at all.

reviews.author: Melody R.
reviews.text:
I am a realtor and my seller lives out of town. When I called to get an estimate on a repair that needed to be made, the receptionist took my information to have a professional call me and within ten minutes I was able to get a second opinion over the phone and scheduled an appointment for the next day to get an estimate.

Robert was very knowledgable and answered all of our questions about the water heater and the manabloc.

We scheduled him to make the repair and he was easily accessible when I needed to change the time of our appointment.  The replacement of the manabloc took less than 2 hours and came in less than the estimated bid!

I will definitely be using this company again.

reviews.author: Hillary S.
reviews.text: I am remodeling areas of my house and ran into some trouble. I needed someone to come out quickly. I found PPM and they were able to help. They came out fast. They were friendly, educational, and quick to help. I had to replace lots of angle stops, a leak in my kitchen, and then lastly the garbage disposal. They suggested putting in heavy duty disposal which I was happy about (Badger 5 xp) and finally the bill came. $807!!! I found the same garbage disposal in other places and online for $100! I am very happy with their service but feel like I paid WAY to much!!! If only my husband had been home he could made sure that would not have happend! Too expensive!

reviews.author: Tom Meyer
reviews.text:
Parley’s PPM Plumbing Heating and Cooling in Orem is a family owned business that provides “Best in Class” service and expertise in and  ranging from plumbing repairs, to installing new water softener systems, new furnaces and new air conditioning systems. They are very customer focused, prompt and kind. Their pricing is competitive and they will help assist you in securing rebates and tax credits where available and depending on the system being installed. I highly recommend this company.

Update:  Wish we could rate Parley’s above a 5 star rating.  This company always exceeds expectations. Compliments to Lance and his staff.

reviews.author: A T.
reviews.text: We have used PPM (now Parley's PPM) for years for our home plumbing and HVAC needs. They've fixed our furnace, our boiler, put in new plumbing on a bathroom remodel, installed an entire Mr.Slim heating & a/c system, and I'm sure a few other things I can't remember. They are professional, prompt, and best of all they fix it RIGHT. I've never had to call them back and have them re-do anything like I have with a lot of other home repair companies. I would highly recommend Parley's PPM!

reviews.author: David B.
reviews.text:
These guys do a good job. One thing I really like about them is that they quickly fix issues with any of their work. I had them do the plumbing for a bathroom remodel and after they left one of the pipes had a minor leak. They came out the next day to fix it. I like that they stand by their work. 

As with all businesses, the different techs have different skill sets. I think Ellery is the best plumbing tech. He goes out of his way to make things look neat and clean.

synthesis.summary: Parley's Plumbing shows exceptional emergency responsiveness with customers reporting service within 1-2 hours of calling, even for late-night furnace failures. Their technicians are consistently praised for being professional, honest, and fairly priced without pressure tactics.
strengths: Extremely fast emergency response (1-2 hours)
No pressure sales tactics
Professional and patient technicians
Competitive pricing (20% lower than competitors)
weaknesses: Limited sample focuses mainly on heating/furnace work
No detailed plumbing emergency examples
synthesis.topQuote: Our old furnace died late at night. Parley's had a tech out to look at it first thing in the morning, and we had a new furnace installed the day after that.

plumbers.address: 310 Quecreek Cir, Smyrna, TN 37167, USA

reviews.author: Krysten Ritter
reviews.text: Cameron was great! Didn't give up when the job was a handful and got it done. Greatly appreciate his hardwork

reviews.author: Kayla hall
reviews.text: Shawn is fantastic. While I worked at a bar downtown as a manager he was my go to guy for all of our plumbing issues. He would always come out within a few hours if not sooner to take care of all of our needs, and trust me drunk people like to flush ungodly randoms things that clog toilets. After that, I changed jobs and was a manager at a restaurant and he was the go to guy there as well! At this point Shawn has been the only plumber myself and these companies have used in about the three years I’ve known him. I use him as my home plumber now as well. He fixed my bathtub faucet leak and my kitchen sink clog. He is efficient and fast. He gets the job done perfectly and I plan on using him for my whole bathroom remodel when the time comes! You need a fantastic plumber who is capable, efficient and just an all around great guy he’s your dude!

reviews.author: Si Tucker
reviews.text: The guys with 1 Tom were true professionals and got our heater installed fast and did a great job.  They were also courteous and friendly.  Thanks, 1 Tom!

reviews.author: Taylor Andrews
reviews.text:
UPDATE: Approximately 30 minutes after Shawn and Darian left, we were without hot water, yet again. I called them back out the next day, and I was informed it was a cartridge in the single-handle shower upstairs causing our entire house to be without hot water. I informed the technician I would not accept that answer, and we called another company out two days later. Upon telling the new company what was happening, he immediately diagnosed it as the recirculating pump, which we had mentioned both times 1 Tom had been out.

After running diagnostic testing, it was confirmed to be the recirculating pump. Fast forward to the next day, and we had discovered a significant gas leak at our water heater. There were missing and loose screws, allowing gas to flow freely into our garage instead of properly venting out into the exhaust. I’d like to think that 1 Tom would have noticed this since they “watched the flame rod for 30 minutes,” but nothing was ever mentioned about it (the second company did not have to “open” our water heater for the recirculation pump diagnostic). Our family’s health was severely jeopardized by this oversight. I highly recommend spending your money elsewhere.

Shawn and Darian were quick and efficient with their service! Having no hot water isn’t any fun, but they fixed the problem quickly, and they made sure to thoroughly explain the problem they found. 10/10 recommend these guys!!

reviews.author: Kriss M.
reviews.text: We were having a birthday party and our drains were backing up.  Wife wouldn't let me handle it and called around for a plumber as it was a Sunday.  Had a plumber out and took him longer than I'd expect, plus he said he had to reset our toilet in the master bath.  Said he couldn't get his snake to make the bend.  Long story short, couple months down the road, drains are backing up again.  This time I went under the house to check where the blockage was.  The drains should have never passed inspection when the house was first built but they've worked for  20 years prior to use buying it 3 years ago.  I pulled the clean out plug after draining the main line and looked towards the turn to the lateral that exits the foundation to the septic tank.  I could see the end of the plumbers snake broken off at the 90.  I ended up cutting out a 10' section after the 90 and found that the plumber hadn't even cleared the worst of the obstruction.  Had one of their managers come out to look at the job and he confirmed the snake head was one of theirs.  Saw what I cleared out to make my drains work again and verified the tech should have scoped to verify all was clear and didn't....all of this we were charged $1000 for crap work.  Asked him to give me a price on fixing a couple of problems with the drains that shouldn't have ever passed the building inspection, let alone the inspection we had when we bought the home.  He said they would knock off the labor as the job their plumber had done was not up to their expectations.  Yeah sorry guys....I'm not going to give you another $1000 for something I'm going to do for $150.  Got a call from a gal at their office on the 7th of October asking if I had looked at their proposal?  I laughed and said "the guy that came out and said they had done a piss poor job said they'd just charge me for materials, as the work performed before wasn't good at all". I told her I'd rather right this review than pay you guys another dime to tip me off.  She said that the manager/head guy would get in touch with me the next week as he was out of town this week.  I said fine, I'll wait for his call.... Again, that call was the 7th of October...it's now the 10th of November and not a word.  I've been busy and my drains are working as best they can so I waited.  Done waiting and here is my review.... I would hire these guys ever again..burn me once shame on you, burn me twice, shame on me.  Pics are of the initial cut on the main lateral and after I had dug about half way through the sludge their plumber didn't get rid of.

reviews.author: Lisa Mathison
reviews.text: Where do I begin?! I called Tom Plumbers after I came home from being out a couple of hours to find about an inch of water on the floor of our powder room. A hissing sound was coming from behind the sink in the wall. They were able to schedule someone to come out on Easter Saturday for the repair. When Jeremy arrived, he quickly identified the leak in the wall - the water line had a strange nick in it. Just as he was out to seal up the dry wall, he called me over and said: “well, we have a problem. There’s a squirrel in the wall.” And sure enough there it was curled up into a small spot. What transpired from there was wild. A failed attempt to coax the squirrel into a bucket led quickly to a chase around the bathroom and finally to a safe release outside and across the street into a field.  The water line didn’t have just one nick in it but several! Jeremy crawled into the crawl space, replaced the water line all the way through and had the water back on in a mere 2 hours for us. I can’t thank Jeremy enough especially for working late in the evening on Easter Saturday. He went above and beyond to make sure the water was no longer leaking anywhere and sealed up everything so nicely. 1 Tom Plumber is great in a pinch with such knowledgeable and thorough professionals like Jeremy.

reviews.author: Jesse
reviews.text:
Our water heater was producing inconsistent temperatures, so we scheduled a service visit. Unfortunately, the original plumber who was sent did not perform a diagnostic to our expectations and misquoted potential costs. However, management promptly followed up with us and sent out a seasoned professional at no additional cost, along with a commitment to retrain the newly hired technician.

Our second experience was much better. Shawn quickly performed a thorough diagnostic and identified the issue as a faulty lower thermostat. He clearly explained the problem, provided multiple reasonable options moving forward, and assured us that the cost from the initial visit would be applied toward any additional service related to this issue.

reviews.author: Miha Zupan
reviews.text:
Called 1-tom-plumber to help unclog a toilet line for one of our residents. The office staff was very polite, honest and helpful. They told us that the first plumber can only respond after hours in the same day but if they can they will send someone sooner.

Cameron called us and arrived at about 3:15 which was much sooner than we expected.

He was great and unclogged the toilet in about 15minuets time.

We are very pleased with Cameron and the staff. Everything was done very professionally.

I will use 1-tom-plumber in the future and also recommend the company to others.

2nd time using 1-tom-plumber was just as great an experience as the first time. Thank you for your service Cameron.

reviews.author: Tonia Easley-Gwyn
reviews.text: This was the first time calling this company and the customer service was great.  They sent Jeremy and two others over for a leak inspection for the property, he called the office to let me know they were here to complete the leak inspection.  The communication that  was provided by Jeremy was excellent during the time that they performed inspections and to narrow down if the was a problem!!! I would definitely call them again!  Thank you!

reviews.author: Rick Krieger
reviews.text: I live in an apartment complex and had a back up in the plumbing. I was told to expect someone between 2-5:30. Cameron showed up just a little after 2 and had everything fixed, plus he cleared my shower drain of hair within an hour. Cameron was very professional and respectful with my family and got the job done well and quick. I would 100% recommend to anyone with plumbing problems!

reviews.author: Regina Maddin
reviews.text: Thomas came out to install our water filtration system and did an exceptional job. He was very thorough and treated our home with great care, as if it were his own. He cleaned up completely after the installation and took the time to clearly explain how the system works. Highly professional service — we really appreciate the attention to detail.

reviews.author: ariel morales
reviews.text: I AM the maintenance supervisor for an apartamento complex that had a clogged sewer Main. We called 1 Tom Plumber and They sent Cam. He showed up right on time. And was able to quickly assessed the property and had us up and running within 30 minutes of his Arrival. I highly recommend Cam!

reviews.author: Johnny S.
reviews.text: I had a great experience with 1-Tom-Plumber. Axel showed up exactly when he said he would and explained everything very thoroughly before he began. He was very professional and had my plumbing issues fixed in 30 minutes. I will definitely this company again and highly recommend them.

The company has two documented serious quality failures: a broken snake head left in a drain with the blockage uncleaned ($1,000 charged), and a gas leak found after a water heater service because screws were left loose — a safety hazard the tech missed while claiming to have 'watched the flame rod for 30 minutes.'

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 2821 Lebanon Pike #206, Nashville, TN 37214, USA

reviews.author: Sarah B.
reviews.text: Woke up to find no hot water - ok, go check the heater and now we have a big problem - there's a steady stream of water pouring out of the upper heating element.  I turn off the breaker, turn off the water valve into the heater, call Roto Rooter as they were the first to come up after Hiller and I strongly dislike Hiller from a past job.  RR coordinates a tech to come out in 1 hour.  I get the water drained partially so that it's not flowing any more at least and the tech (Dragan) shows up right on time.  He was very friendly to work with, answered all of my questions, and showed me that, unfortunately, it's not the element that's leaking, it's behind it where the tank's rusted out (it's probably 12 years old, I've only had the house for 1 year).  We decide on a new tank, he runs to Lowe's to get it, comes back and has it installed.  The whole process took about 1.5 hours and now there's hot water again!  Prices seemed fair according to internet and a contractor friend (new hot water heaters are expensive, what can you do), and customer service was tops for me.

reviews.author: Isabeau M.
reviews.text: I've used Roto-Rooter twice in the past week (unfortunately), but FORTUNATELY, both my technicians were incredible, faster than ANY other plumber I called and efficient. GREAT experience!

reviews.author: Clarence Green
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup in Atlanta demonstrated true craftsmanship and precision during their recent visit. Jamal, Al, and Daniel arrived fully prepared, exhibiting a clear understanding of advanced sump pump systems. They carefully installed a battery backup sump pump in our basement and walked us through each feature, ensuring we felt secure in its operation. Their thoughtful approach to flood prevention showcased both technical knowledge and genuine care for the integrity of our home. It’s rare to find a crew that balances skill with professionalism so consistently. Our foundation feels protected, and our confidence in their work is absolute.

reviews.author: Bob B.
reviews.text: Quoted me one price $300, then called me back to say it would be more money.  and I could choose to have the problem partially addressed.  I greed to pay more money, turns out the guy spent more time flirting with my tenants than fixing the problem.  They had to send out another person to actually address it.

reviews.author: Naomi S.
reviews.text: We needed a plumber to fix a pipe leak we were unable to fix.  After finding a list of plumbers that advertised as servicing my area after calling the first two I discovered they didn't.  I was running out of time and getting desperate and Roto Rooter was the third one on the list.  They assured me they did service my area.  I was very grateful.  I was informed I would have a service fee of $59 plus parts.  I was fine with that.  The technician came out and fixed my pipe as was super nice.  It took him less than thirty minutes.  And then I got my bill.  In addition to the $59 service fee and $26 part fee, I faced an additional $183 labor fee that was totally unexpected.  I have no problem paying people for the work they do and I was very appreciative of the fact that they came out the same day and fixed the problem, but I feel it's just bad business to not be upfront with the costs.  Had I known it was going to cost over $200 for the job, I would certainly have called around to other plumbers.  I won't be calling Roto Rooter again.

reviews.author: Robert W.
reviews.text:
I know there's a lot of chicanery that goes on with positive online reviews in general, and we tend to believe the negative more than the positive, BUT...   I have to tell the world about my experience with Roto-Rooter.   This is ESPECIALLY so because I tried like HELL to not use them.   My wife and I have been terribly "under-water" with regards to our home/debt after having been flooded a few years ago.   So it is incredibly important that we downsize our living situation and sell our current home, which is now on the market.   So you can imagine my frustration when, only two weeks into our home being listed for sale, water began seeping into our living space from our A/C condensate drain line.  When my regular handyman was unable to successfully snake this clogged drain, he recommended I call Roto-Rooter, so with much hesitation, I e-mailed them to set up an appointment.   When the technician called me, he quoted me a price over the phone that I didn't like, and they needed to schedule me for a day a few days out (which I also didn't like), so I thought I should try some other options, first.   I made NUMEROUS calls and e-mails to both HVAC specialists and plumbers in my area, checked my neighborhood forums/social media sites for recommendations, and eventually began pleading on Craigslist for someone to come and help me.   

To begin with, 90% of the "master plumbers" I had contact with argued with me that my air conditioning condensate drain "can not" drain into my sewer line (it does) (RED FLAG #1).  Then, when I mentioned I had contacted Roto-Rooter prior to them, they almost Universally insisted they could do this job for between $50. and $100. (RED FLAG #2).   Fine, I'd say, "When can you come?".  "Oh, well...  I don't know, I'm really busy..." (RED FLAG #3).   After a couple of weeks of playing whack-a-mole trying to pin down a shade-tree "Master Plumber" who could come snake out my drain, I finally had to bite the bullet and request Roto-Rooter to come out, after all (who knew that in 2016 it would be so darn difficult to have a simple drain snaked???).   

To my amazement, their technician, "Bo", showed up at the very beginning of the arrival window, smiling, and very eager to help.  He was friendly, and not surly or dour like most techs I've hired over the years.   Unlike my typical experiences with plumbers, he didn't complain and whine even after I presented him with his first challenge (that my drain is in an awkward and difficult-to-reach spot).   He jumped right to it, and even worse (better?), after he had worked for a while and then learned that it wasn't THAT drain at all but ANOTHER drain on the same "tree" (after already spending so much time and energy to snake that particular branch), he DID NOT try to up-charge me, deride me (for being incorrect), or anything else of that nature.   What he DID do was HOP TO IT and began doing basic plumbing work that I in no way asked him to do or that he agreed to do.   There was no drawn-out discussion of what "needed" to be done- he was machine-like in that before I even knew it, he was DOING IT.   He bent over backwards to get the problem fixed, period.   He even kept insisting, afterward, that he clean up the nasty mess that was an inevitable result of pushing out a large clog of grease, but I assured him that I wanted to do it, myself due to the extra work he already incurred upon fixing my issues.   He insisted three or four times before finally giving in to my wishes.  

When I surprised him with a Roto-Rooter coupon (which I was eternally grateful to have been offered and desperately needed), he did not flinch, "hem" or "haw", and immediately adjusted my total.  Keep in mind, he didn't up-charge me for basically snaking extra lines that I didn't ask for, but needed, so this coupon was subtracted from my INITIAL QUOTE.   I was only angry with myself for [a] not having had Roto-Rooter and "Bo" out sooner, and that [b] I didn't have a larger tip to offer Bo.  Bo also assured me that if the problem wasn't fixed, I wouldn't be paying for it (or would be refunded or the amount adjusted), and for the first time in my life when talking to a technician/contractor, I didn't doubt that for an instant.  I NEVER would have thought that I would be writing a review- let alone a positive one- for a corporate "chain" type of service provider, and yet, here I am.   In fact, I believe this is my first Yelp review, ever.  My take-away from all of this is that it's REEEEEALLY easy for some shade-tree handyman/"plumber" with a truck and a free ad on Craigslist to talk smack about their more professional competition, but then not have to "put up or shut up".   If, after reading my review, you STILL want to go "cheap" by trying someone you don't know in lieu of relying on a long-time, PROVEN company such as Roto-Rooter because of price alone, then good luck to you- I know I've learned a VERY valuable lesson today!

reviews.author: John S.
reviews.text:
I am giving them two stars mainly due to their management. The crew that did the work were nice and should get four stars but after dealing with the front office I dropped this down to two stars. 

So, we had our plumbing back-up late at night. There wasn't any sewage coming up but our bathtub on the main floor was filling up whenever we ran a faucet and the toilets would not flush. This was after we had a nice ice storm during the day and nobody would come out that night. I initially thought it was frozen pipes but things checked out under the crawl space. I called the local plumbers first and they couldn't make it out until late the next day. Roto-Rooter was able to come out first thing the following day, which they did and quickly found the problem. 

Turns out our outside cleanout was at an angle and full of mud (somehow it got disconnected from the main line). This required a dig out and replacement of  a section of the main line and cleanout valve. After seeing the reviews here I should have called around after getting this news. I went ahead and scheduled the job for the next day at their quoted rate because we needed this fixed.  

The crew came out and did a great job. They were able to get to the problem area and replaced the section of the main line and cleanout. The cleanout snapped at the T fitting it was connected to. It was full of roots leaving only a 2 inch or so opening (amazing how the line was working at all). They also ended up pulling 4 or so feet of roots out of the line as they were growing up into the house. 

I was having financing lined up for the payment and it was set to come in within the next 3-5 days. The quote I was given had options for cash, check, credit or net 10 days to pay. It also had language about how they charge an interest fee for unpaid balances over 30 days so I figured I was good getting the financing in under the 10 days. 

After they were done with the job I informed the workers how I had the financing in play and they said just to call the office and inform them. Not long after they left, they called back and said they needed the money now. I gave them the information from the financing company and we were good. Then a few minutes later I get a call from the Manager. He said they do not extend credit to residential customers and needed either cash, a check or a credit card.  I ended up having to give them a credit card number.  

Nowhere did it say the Net 10 Days is for commercial customers only and I have yet to receive a final bill from them.  I noticed the other day while getting my front yard back together that the cap on the cleanout wasn't glued (plus they left it sticking 2 feet out of the ground instead of somewhat flush). They had to send someone to come back and cut the cleanout down about a foot and glue the cap on. 

This job was going to have to have been done eventually as those roots were running wild and our cleanout was broken. Now I know to check this cleanout now and then and hopefully next time it won't be an issue where the jobs needs to get done ASAP (not having flushing toilets with two kids isn't a good time).  I will also be sure to call around after getting a quote no matter what the urgency and check out reviews here!

reviews.author: Alisa L.
reviews.text:
I called Roto Rooter to help with my clogged shower drain after I had tried a few non-commercial plumbers but they couldn't come out that day. The man at the main number refused to quote me a price over the phone (this should have been my first clue) and said he would call me back to let me know if a tech could come out. About 30 minutes later a tech showed up at my door, no call or anything. I was pretty desperate at that point and felt bad turning him away so I let him in. 
He had a very thick accent which was very difficult for me to understand and I thought he quoted me $79 (which I thought was kind of a lot to snake a drain but I gladly agreed just to have it taken care of). 
He hooked up his electric snake/auger and in less than 20 minutes (and with VERY little work on his part) had removed a very large clog. When I went to write him a check he told me the price again, TWO HUNDRED AND SEVENTY NINE dollars! I just about had a meltdown! $279 for TWENTY MINUTES of work! Had I been able to understand him initially I would have never in a million years allowed him to touch my drain for that outrageous price! That is straight up shady, highway robbery pricing! 
He finally agreed to take $200 (the fact that he is able to "adjust" the base price at his own discretion was somewhat shady too) and I sent him on his way (after he had tried to sell me a small $30 bottle of drain cleaner!!!!!) 
The best part of the whole story is that my drain was not even fixed! I woke up the next morning, showered and had water up, over my ankles by the end. I called the local Roto Rooter office and spoke with a manager. By this time I was completely outraged by the astronomical prices, the shoddy work and the overall experience. 
The manager informed me that Roto Rooter is a "middle of the road" priced plumber service....uhhhh, whose road are we talking about?! $279 is beyond insane for less than 20 minutes of work!
The manager informed me that they charge $279 whether they are out for 15 minutes or 4 hours. That is the dumbest business model I have ever heard of. Had I known that I would have kept the first guy there for 4 hours to get my money's worth! And, the fact that they will not tell you that over the phone when you call is very concerning!!!! 
They sent a very nice second tech out to fix the problem again for "free" (damn right for free, I am never giving them another cent of my money). At this point the drain is running fine but I have the worst taste in my mouth from this whole experience. I will NEVER use this company again and I have told everyone I know my story and warned them to never use them either. No one that I have told about this experience can believe how expensive this was, again, complete and total highway robbery for a shoddy job!

reviews.author: Katelyn K.
reviews.text:
Roto Rooter, Nashville plumber did not correct issue. I was unfairly charged full amount. Now I am unable to get in touch with office, and have called 10 plus times.
John, Roto Rooter serviceman, was dispatched to my (rented) house on thanksgiving. He was here for 30 minutes. We had a clogged toilet, kitchen and bathroom sink. He was able to snake the toilet and clear that clog. He claimed that we needed to open up the wall between the bathroom and kitchen in order to install venting and new piping, in order to fix the problem clog with those two areas. I suggested that he try and snake through the kitchen, but he said that the issue was more complicated than that. As it was Thanksgiving, I didn't want to keep him longer. I also noted the time was 12 noon. He mentioned on the way out the door that he was off at noon and that we were the last house before he was off for the holiday. I understand he wanted to be with his family, but we were led to believe that he didn't complete his job because his day ended at noon, and as it was that time, he was not obligated to complete his repairs. Thus he didn't complete the repairs. He charged holiday rates for snaking the main line, and as I was in the midst of cooking, I paid and left it at that. We had to undo all of our plumbing under sinks in order to use the sinks without backup, and let the used water run into buckets under the sinks in order to host our family that day. The next day my landlord sent out another plumber to complete the repairs. It took him a total of 10 minutes to do so without having to knock down a wall. All that it took was opening up a valve between the kitchen and bathroom walls and snaking that line: Exactly what I proposed to John the day before but was told, "It is more complicated than that." 

I have tried on at least ten occasions to contact the Roto Rooter office and speak with someone who can address my concerns- and have been unable to talk with either managers, Drew or Danny. I have spoken to Charles at least 5 times, a lady at the office twice, and another gentleman at least three times. I believe I am due a partial refund for this amount, as the service was not completed. I have left my number all times that I have called being told that the manager is "on the other line" each and every time or "out on a call." I am tired of the runaround, and believe that businesses should operate fairly and not steal unrightfully from their helpless customers. Their serviceman was in too much a hurry to get home for the holiday, and didn't even explore ulterior options to remedy the clogged drains. He simply said the issue required another person to look at it. This is bad business. The fact that I can't even discuss this with a Roto Rooter manager, is inexcusable.

reviews.author: Sheena T.
reviews.text:
Hey Roto-Rooters, have you heard of something called customer service? No? Well, it's shows. 

I originally dealt with them back in May of last year when  they rooted out my bathroom after I was having some plumbing issues (home ownership is overrated). So I called them first since I was praying for a clog... please please please let it be a clog. Anyway, my BF was with the plumber and they were in my crawlspace where they took their devices and rooted it out from the pipe under the house that drains directly from my toilet. He even showed my BF where the issue was after looking around down there and using his equipment... some roots had grown into my drain line from the tree in my front yard (dandy) and the job was going to cost a couple thousand dollars for them to do it. FANTASTIC. 

So they charge me about $350 for rooting out the toilet and sealing it. I called Hiller and luckily they quoted me MUCH better rate. Definitely go with Hiller. 

Fast forward to 2014 with the biting cold weather. I was in the crawl space checking the pipes for leaks since it had been so cold and I heard running water coming from the pipe coming out from the bathroom. I walk over and see water in a large pipe along with some toilet paper residue that has gotten built up. I ask my stepdad to come look at it (cause I know nada about plumbing) and he tells me that whomever was working on my pipes from LAST YEAR never sealed back the pipe from when it was worked on. While nothing is broken, they just never replaced the cover on it. Fantastic. That's a lot of sewage under my house. 

So I call Roto-Rooters to see if they could come and put the cover back on for me. The lady I spoke to was very rude and nasty. Among the things she said to me were :

"This was back in MAY and you just now notice that?"
"The service you got WAS NOT guaranteed"
"Our employee didn't root it from under the house, he went in from the toilet" 

I told her I had a witness WHO WAS WITH THE GUY when he was under the house rooting it and she basically called me a liar.

She then told me she'd speak with her manager about it and get back to me. She also offered to e-mail me her invoice with the work and I said that would be great (over 24 hours later and I've still got nothing). Overall she was horrible to talk to.

Don't waste your time or money with them.

reviews.author: Kristin Marie S.
reviews.text:
The past two weeks have been a nightmare. Do you know what has NOT been a nightmare? Roto-Rooter. During the storm a few weeks ago our finished basement flooded, bad. We couldn't keep up with the water and felt helpless. I called Roto-Rooter right away and within an hour Drew was standing at our front door. Mind you, this was like 11 pm and we have never used their services before. At that point we had no idea what we were dealing with, but we knew it was not great. After agreeing on a price to get the water out, we gave him a deposit and they started to pull water out of our basement, all 1500 gallons of it. The crew packed up around 4am and put in some filters and dehumidifiers. The next day a RR plumber was at our house and identified the issue. Unfortunately insurance is not covering the damage, which was a major blow. 

We got back in touch with Drew and told him the situation. He helped us work through a pricing structure for remediation. They also gave us a filter for upstairs. We have a 20 month old and we were very worried about potential health implications from the water. They closed off our basement to prevent the air from circulating upstairs. Then they gutted it, cleaned the floors, studs, etc., and sterilized whatever we could salvage. We lost two dumpsters worth of stuff (floor, walls, couch, tables, kids toys, etc.). It has been incredibly stressful and thankfully they have been extremely helpful and responsive. My husband would have a question, Drew would FaceTime in to talk in through. 

We also used a RR plumber to fix the pipe problem. We had a slight set back from Saturday's rain (not related to RR) and RR was back at our doorstep in no time. Drew sent a team member who was familiar with our house who immediately got to work. We're still digging through this nightmare, but we would not be where we are today without the help of Drew and his crew. I highly recommend giving them a call if you need help. I seriously don't know where we would be without their help!

reviews.author: Alicia G.
reviews.text:
I hired roto rooter for a major plumbing issue in January 2017. Everything in my house was flooding. They came and said I had a broken pipe and it would cost me $5000 for them to cut a hole in my concrete and replace the pipe. I paid them without any question. Considering this is a large company, I expected the job to be done right and not have any issues. They never replaced the concrete and verbally told me that they would come back when it was warmer. 

I had a similar flooding issue less than 8 months later. They sent someone out who told me that it was an issue with my main line (and was very rude about it), but a different issue and he would get me an estimate. I spoke with the manager and explained that I don't want an estimate, but an explanation of how this could have happened 8 months later. A second guy came out and said it isn't an issue with the main line, that it was the washer line and it was at least 20 feet of roots that had blocked the line. I was confused because how could 20 feet of roots grow in less than 8 months and why this problem couldn't have been diagnosed initially. They proceeded to give me the runaround with the concrete in the garage. And had the audacity to send me an estimate for their second "necessary" repair of $3800 which involved them busting up concrete IN MY HOUSE (which they did not plan on replacing) to gain access to this pipe and fix it. I refused this, obviously, and upon doing a ton of research, I found that Roto Rooter is in the habit of making outrageous estimates that DON'T address the primary problem. I had a second opinion and my problem is FIXED and did not require any excavation or ANYWHERE near $3800 of repair. Also, the concrete is intact AND he replaced the concrete that they promised they would do. 

DO NOT PROCEED WITH ROTO ROOTER WITHOUT A SECOND OPINION. I WAS VERY NAIVE AND TRUSTED THEM BECAUSE THEY ARE A BIG COMPANY. BUT THEY DO THIS ALL THE TIME.

reviews.author: MaRisa J.
reviews.text:
I had a very slow draining toilet. The guy charged me $300 to snake and then another $300 to remove the toilet. He ended up having to dig out the pipe in the back and found out that it had a huge hole in it. He said it would be an additional $1600-1700 to replace the pipe depending on the parts price (it was max 3-4 feet of pipe). I recently had french drains put in and he suggested that the guys who installed the french drains put the hole there. But it was pretty clear that it was just an old pipe that was rotting away.

I had a contractor come out and look at it, he fixed it for $300 (vs 1600!!!). He also mentioned that the toilet was disconnected from the pipes under the house and that it probably happened when the plumber (roto rooter) snaked it and that they should fix it. He also showed me pictures of what the problem was. It was obvious that the toilet was not connected and toilet paper was falling out. The same guy (from roto rooter) came back out, said that who ever told me that was a liar. And he showed me pictures of completely unrelated things and told me that it was probably the toilet upstairs that was leaking. That was obviously a lie because the pictures he showed me would have just been small leaks but wouldn't have even been big enough for toilet paper to go through.

Overall, I will never use this company again. The guy was very pushy. He didn't explain things well. When he was telling me what needed to be fix I felt cornered in my own house. Especially when I told I was going to look something up before I decided whether or not I wanted to get it fixed, he just stood over my while I looked at stuff on my phone. I felt like he was putting his gloved hands that he had just used to work in the sewage all over my house.

I know having something as crucial as plumbing sucks, but don't be afraid to get multiple quotes even if the plumber is staring you down making you uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Brian A.
reviews.text:
I was up septic tank creek without a paddle.  On a Sat. morning.  I know the discharge pump is out (overflowing above the tank).  Go to check the circuit breakers, still on.  Try the outlet, and the pump wires dis-generate at the outlet.  Not a good start to the weekend.  

I could guess, with luck, just a plug replacement on a pump over 15 years old (and I had a Lotto ticket with 1 set of numbers too....).  Start to call, as I have to have this fixed this weekend.  I work 60 miles away (weekday is missing work with no PTO), I have 4 others in the house, school starting after the weekend.

So after getting the call us on the weekend alphabet search via yellow pages, RR takes my information.  I was very surprised as I was thinking this is a septic sump pump.  Not a clog.  

I get a call from Roger (385), the tech on call.  He is concerned he cannot be there until noon.    I was not expecting too much help, but someone to verify my pump died on Sat was much better than me missing work on Monday.

From our conversation he brought a small pump.  Now, I'm going to watch repairs, DYI or call someone.  He arrived and we went to it.  Ruled out the frayed cord (which I suspected, much like willing powerball).  Eventually get to the septic pump.  I had tools to get it disconnected, RR had the contacts to open a location to get a pump.  And there is a lot of interaction with Roger I left out, I think something to share is the pump costs about $900, I knew it.  

Of course as we are doing the work, we are talking. My goal was to finish the job over the weekend.  I never stated it, We had time time to talk while things were pumping.  

End result I gave him 2 water melons from my garden.  And called his boss (he was on the phone).  He said he would give the message to Danny (and would ask Roger where is his part of the melon).

Over all, a very good experience.

reviews.author: Bob A.
reviews.text:
Our favorite plumber (Ryan @ R.E. 615-878-6265) who is extremely ethical, economical, and great was not available, so our backs were against the wall since our demo guys were coming the following day to prep for a bathroom remodel.  So, we called a half dozen plumbers with great Yelp ratings but nobody was available.  

We finally called Roto-Rooter to do the job which was simply to cap off water lines to two bathroom sinks and a shower.   I repeatedly asked them for their hourly rate and they refused to tell me.  I just wanted a ballpark, but 'no' was the answer.  

They said I would have to pay $90 for them to come out and give a bid.  If I proceeded with the work, the $90 would go towards the bid; if I passed on their work, I'd owe them $90.  Okay, no big deal, but I don't remember any service provider unwilling to give their hourly rate over the phone so this really bothered me.  But I had them come out anyway because otherwise we'd lose a week on our project.

The Rooter guy looked under our sinks and at the shower, then gave me the price of $485.   What?!   Wow!  Extremely high for the simple tasks!!!   But we had to go with it, otherwise we'd forfeit the $90 service call and lose a week on our schedule.

He did a good job, but it took just 90 minutes which included a round trip to Home Depot for about $5 in parts.

That means he worked for $320 per hour ($480 / 1.5)!!   My main plumber, Ryan works for a SMALL FRACTION of that!!!

So, we were left feeling totally Roto-Rootered.    NEVER AGAIN!!

(And, come to think of it, anyone out there going to medical school really ought to drop out -- just work for Roto Rooter at $320 an hour which is nearly the salary of a brain surgeon!)

synthesis.summary: Roto-Rooter Nashville is available when you call, and their drain technicians are reportedly skilled at what they do — but their pricing is the dominant complaint across 70 Yelp reviews. The model: refuse to quote over the phone, dispatch, charge a flat fee (typically $265-$395 for simple drain clogs) and a shop fee on top, with additional charges layered in after the fact. Multiple reviewers were quoted one price and billed more after work was done. 781 BBB complaints in 3 years — a red flag even for a large franchise operation.
strengths: Generally available and responsive — confirmed by even critical reviewers
Drain and jetting work described as technically skilled by a repeat user
Can often dispatch same day or after hours
weaknesses: Refuses to quote prices over the phone — multiple independent reviewers confirm this is policy
Flat-fee model means paying $265+ for 15 minutes of work — no hourly adjustment
On-call plumber hung up on a midnight emergency caller who had already shut off the water
bestFor: Drain clogs when you can't find anyone else
redFlags: Price quoted before work began changed after completion — multiple documented cases ($329 → $395, $255 → $447 for same job 10 months later)
Insurance company described their water mitigation work as 'WAY more than was necessary' — lawsuit referenced
781 BBB complaints in 3 years despite A+ rating
Multiple reviewers report being pressured into large upsells ($3,000-$5,000) that competitors fixed for a fraction of the cost
One franchise tech sold a pool pump as a sump pump for $750; waterproofing company confirmed it was wrong equipment
Charged double on one customer's bank account; took over a year to resolve
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Generally reachable and can dispatch same day or after hours. However, one documented midnight emergency call resulted in the on-call plumber hanging up after learning the water was shut off. Availability doesn't guarantee quality emergency response.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google 4.7 (787 reviews) vs. Yelp 2.7 (70 reviews) — a 2.0-star gap is significant. Yelp reviewers consistently cite pricing deception, post-job price increases, and rude technicians that do not appear in the Google review sample.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: They charge a flat fee whether they are out for 15 minutes or 4 hours. Had I known that I would have kept the first guy there for 4 hours to get my money's worth!

sewer.topQuote: They sent a plumber — after he left they had shattered my pipes from the inside out, blowing the PVC pipe out in all directions. Their contract says they're not responsible for any damage they cause.

water-heater.topQuote: I called them about my water heater. The guy never turned the electricity back on to the water heater, and it still did not work. They called me a liar. Go with Hiller instead.

sump-pump.topQuote: Glenn sold me a new sump pump for $750. The waterproofing company confirmed the pump sold was actually used for pools. Had him set it on two bricks because it wouldn't reach — pump never worked.

flooding.topQuote: Insurance company said Roto Rooter did WAY more than was necessary — elaborate water mitigation and bathroom deconstruction costing $4,000. Insurance is now in a lawsuit against them.

toilet.topQuote: Charged $391.95 for setting the toilet I provided. They provided wax ring. Took plumber 30 minutes. Close to $800/hour. I spoke to the general manager who said they charge a flat fee.

avoid_if: You need this for a complex or high-stakes install
hire_if: You need fast same-day or after-hours response
You need high-quality work that holds up over time
caution_if: You want detailed upfront explanations
You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need airtight scheduling and guaranteed arrival times

Was quoted $329 — seemed a little high — but I agreed as they were already there. After work was completed, the invoice was $395. Tech stated price must have increased and he was unaware.

They convinced me I needed thousands of dollars of work done. They then never sent the documentation of the work they promised and worse yet, the exact same problem I called them out for in the first place returned not even a week after.
They are probably the best when it comes to snaking or jetting a drain. They are on another level for anything drain or pipe related. Always on time and good communication.
They will not quote a price over the phone. $125 just to come let me know that diagnosing the problem would be an additional $400+ to use a camera, or $1,100+ to use the jetter equipment.

plumbers.name: DeWolfe Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 211 Shrewsbury St, West Boylston, MA 01583, USA

reviews.author: Tommy Blair
reviews.text: The technician was great, professional and thorough.

reviews.author: Tami Parodeau
reviews.text: I’ve been using Dewolfe plumbing for many years. They are always very professional, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to work with.  Adrian did a beautiful job with my furnace. Thank you Adrian.

reviews.author: Camilla Douglas
reviews.text: Brian was great!  He was fast getting here, and super friendly.  He was aware that there was a baby here, and asked for alternate ways into the basement so as not to get water/mud in the main areas of the house and not to bother the baby, which was really considerate of him.  He ID’d the problem pretty quickly and got it solved as smoothly and quickly as possible.  I am so grateful he was able to come out and help, especially on such short notice for such a weird issue.  Absolutely will be reaching out again in the future!

reviews.author: Rajesh Mohan
reviews.text: I got this contact as a referral from my friend who owns a school. The technician was good and professional. He fixed the issue in 10 min. Was a minor block in a tube which he blew away with his mouth. However I was shocked with the price of $250 he charged for that. Really disappointed.

reviews.author: Frank Lashua
reviews.text: Called DeWolf to talk about changing a water mixer at the boiler. I sent them PHOTOS TO AVOID A PERSON COMING AND NOT DOING ANY WORK. With the photos, they could see this was a "PLUMBING 101 EASY REPAIR." Just bring the same mixer and change it. It's called Plumbing 101 that any plumber trainee could do. KILL THE WATER MAIN, DRAIN THE SYSTEM, CHANGE THE VALVE, AND REFILL THE SYSTEM, TEST WATER TEMP.. They arrived on Friday, looked, and said yes, it can be changed. I asked him if he brought the part, and if the office gave him the photos? He said no, so therefore he didn't have the VERY COMMON mixer in his van. He quoted the job at $757.10 to do the job and said he would be back on Monday. He needed to order the mixing valve from a warehouse. Keep in mind that my local three suppliers in my same town stocked the valve. Plus, Home Depot stocked the valve. He told me that the same valve at Home Depot was made differently and of lower quality. I called the valve mixing company, and they said they were all the same that they sell to all suppliers. I did approve the estimate, and Monday came. I called DeWolf and asked when the plumber would be arriving today. They told me they were working out of the Cape Cod office and didn't know if the valve came in at the warehouse, and they would call me back. I waited and then called the secretary to call me. She stated that she was still waiting for information on the valve. I canceled my agenda on Monday because I was told the plumber would be arriving. I also called three suppliers near me, and they all had the valve in stock. After not getting clarity on the job, valve location, I asked DeWolve who bought out the company because Gary DeWolf, the original owner, would not have operated this way. She said the tw sons took over the business. WELL, THAT TOLD ME ALL I NEEDED TO KNOW. I CANCELD THE JOB. Jump forward two hours, and I get a text that says the plumber was on his way. ARE YOU KIDDING ME???  THE RIGHT HAND HAS NO IDEA WHAT THE LEFT ONE IS DOING!!     NOTE: The worker was very courteous.

reviews.author: Emily Defilippo
reviews.text:
VERY DISAPPOINTED! had an emergency, sent a tech out that had no knowledge of diagnosis of a well pump issue, was unable to make any diagnosis at all, was only at my home for 15mins and I am in they exact same place I was before they came... correction, minus $225... originally the tech thought it would only be a $99 charge (which i was ok with) because he was here for less than 45min (their policy), after speaking with Luke he was told to charge the full amount... I don't fault the tech, he was nice enough, but the company was told ahead of time we had a well and sent someone unable to deal with it... as far as I'm concerned, all factors should have been taken into consideration since literally nothing was done... bad business decision on the part of the company and as a homeowner that works for a large local business I will discourage anyone from using this company... should have done the right thing

UPDATE: spoke to Victoria and after speaking with Luke, the decision was made to refund the money... I appreciate them doing the right thing in the end

reviews.author: Dennis Coache
reviews.text:
We contacted DeWolfe to check out a problem with out hot water. The tech, AJ, who came to our home was very knowledgeable. Discussed options and came up with a plan which included testing our water to determine if we need a filter system along with replacement of our tankless waterheating coil in our oil fired boiler.
Waiting on results and estimate.
5 stars so far. We'll see going forward.
Sooo... showed up as scheduled, replaced tankless coil...plenty of hot water now!! Tomorrow will be installing our filter system....
Filter system installed. All went well. Very professional. These guys are first rate.

Another service call to troubleshoot our baseboard heaters. Chris (technician) showed up right away. Checked out system. No clear cause of our intermitant short cycling problem found.
We may try replacing zone valve heads...
$100. For service call. Good info.
Still happy with this company.

reviews.author: Patrick McAuliffe
reviews.text: I had an emergency early in the morning where smoke was coming into my house from my furnace. Very frightening situation. But I called DeWolfe and they sent out an HVAC technician the same day (which was a God send since it was only 15 degrees outside that day). Sean was extremely knowledgeable and went through everything in my furnace to try and find the problem. He even explained everything to me that he was looking for and I was able to learn a lot. As a relatively new homeowner, I am happy Sean went above and beyond to help me understand the heating system, which certainly gave me extra peace of mind, considering I now know what to do if there is another emergency like that. I became a member of the Wolf Pack that day and will be doing business with them again. Thanks again Sean!! 😁

reviews.author: Carrie McFarland
reviews.text: Our water heater sprung a leak and we needed a new water heater fast. Working with DeWolfe was a great experience.  From the beginning when I was talking with the customer service rep to the very end.  The tech, Gokhan Yilmaz was on time, friendly, knowledgeable, and extremely helpful.  He was able to reduce the price of the water heater by making phone calls and finding an existing warranty on our tank that we didn't even know we had! He worked with the manufacturer, found the water heater we needed and went to pick it up by himself so we could have same day install.  We had a fully functioning water heater that afternoon! I will definitely use DeWolfe again. They are the best plumbing company we have ever used in the 20+ years we have owned our house.  A+++

reviews.author: Jim Kee
reviews.text: As relatively new owner of my residence, I wanted to have my boiler evaluated before entering the winter season. An online search directed me to DeWolfe Contracting and its Wolfpack membership program. It is designed to include an annual tune-up and emergency service plan. I joined. A technician came out, tuned up the boiler, evaluated the system, and recommended some reasonable replacements. A week or so later another technician came out and installed the replacement parts. Both technicians were very competent. They also clearly explained to me what they were doing and reviewed the features of my heating system with me. I was fully satisfied with the services rendered, and I look forward to a long relationship with DeWolfe Contracting.

reviews.author: Veronika Bentekovics
reviews.text:
Excellent service with DeWolfe plumbing & heating co!! 👌 All the guys were very knowledgeable and efficient with their work. I had a new gas furnace and hot water combo installed. Omar and his team were outstanding with installation. After installation they cleaned everything up and made sure all radiators were in working order. They explained all the parts and safety and operation of the unit. The unit had to be put on the wall, Ron installed all the framework and did an excellent job! I am VERY happy with the whole process.
Thank you also to the plumber Jamie for the complete initial rundown of different units and helped us purchase the right one for our needs. Awesome job guys!
Veronika & Rob

reviews.author: Maribeth Kusz
reviews.text:
Josh came this morning for an emergent call. Gas company came last night for what turned out to be 2 gas leaks and shut off service to our boiler.
Josh checked out the boiler and did all necessary testing to determine what was going on. Fixed the issue and our boiler is functioning properly now. Never had any gas leak problems in the past so this was very scary to have to deal with. Josh reassured us that our boiler is all set so we can rest easy.
We plan on getting a monthly contract with DeWolfe because we were so impressed with the genuine concern they had for our safety and well being.
Would recommend this company for the great and timely service they provide!

reviews.author: Kell Bell
reviews.text:
Highly recommend DeWolfe. They did a rip and replace oil furnace and duct project for us. They were very efficient and clean. The temperature dropped during the project, but they ensured the pipes were fine. All of the employees are so pleasant and helpful.
Out of all the companies we reached out to on this project, they came back with the best offer price wise as well as project scope. They do not try to upsell things you don’t need like other HVAC companies. The scope of the project made rational sense and they worked with us on the budget.
Definitely recommend reaching out for small or large projects.

reviews.author: glass half full
reviews.text: Wow! Sully and Nigel just left. They brushed and vacuumed out my duct vents and what a good job they did without wasting any time! My furnace had a puff back during servicing by another company and blew soot everywhere in my house. They gave me good advice on how to clean my carpets also. Very personable, clear explanations and they didn't tack on any additional costs or try to upsell me. I am very happy with them and highly recommend, will gladly call them back with any future needs. Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Nicholas French
reviews.text: Fast and friendly service! The guys were very helpful and went above and beyond at every chance they could! Strongly recommend using DeWolf for any plumbing/HVAC needs you have. I have used DeWolf for so many different projects. Updated plumbing system, water heater replacement, ERV install, exhaust fan ducting, and an oil tank removal to come. These guys do everything! Lots of skilled, accommodating, and friendly professionals in every department. Can't say enough good things about DeWolf!

synthesis.summary: DeWolfe is a long-established Worcester plumbing and heating company with consistently strong reviews for same-day availability and knowledgeable technicians — one reviewer had their water heater replaced same day after the tech found and activated an existing warranty they didn't know about. The 4 negative reviews in the sample center on pricing complaints ($250 for a 10-minute fix, $757 for a common valve) and an internal communication breakdown where the office didn't know a job was cancelled.

reviews.author: Michael Janesch
reviews.text: I highly recommend Jastal Plumbing. They were very prompt in getting an estimator out and they started the job a few days later. The crew was very professional and got the job done promptly. We had an issue with a small leak and the urinal needed to be anchored better. They were out the next day to fix the small issues. I will definitely use them again in the future.

reviews.author: P M
reviews.text: I had a new whole house filter installed and a new valve installed to fix a leaky bathtub. Paul and Kyle came out and did a great job. Both men were very courteous and professional throughout the day. The day after they left I found a small issue with the filter. I called Jastal in the morning and Paul and Kyle came back out the same day and rectified the issue. They were truly great and I will definitely use them again. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Heather Bridgeman
reviews.text: David came to my house today to help determine the source of the water that was in my basement.  He did a great job.  He was on time, professional and extremely knowledgeable.  He took his time to thoroughly explain the current issue and the solution.  He also helped bring in another Jastal employee to test my water and offer a solution to my filtration issue with my well water.  I plan on moving forward with Jastal and absolutely want David doing the work on this repair.

reviews.author: James Martin
reviews.text:
The work order concerned repairing two leaking stack pipes, enclosed with walls, replacing ABS pipes with PVC, reseating a toilet, repairing a leaking shower cartridge control.
Everyone associated with Jastal Plumbing, Allison, Jacob, Justin and David were all very professional, courteous and knowledgeable. The work was completed on time, as promised and expertly done. Jacob answered all of my questions and explained everything. The jobsite was left clean. I had spoken with three other plumbing companies previously, who either didn't know how to proceed, didn't want to tackle the job or were unreliable. I am well pleased with Jastal Plumbing.

reviews.author: Lily Bentley
reviews.text: I will never use these plumbers. Why? Because they hire people who obviously would prefer to be race car drivers. Specifically whoever was driving truck PL47594 - T20 going up route 8 North on 12/20/24 at 8:20am. They found it necessary to weave in and out of traffic and if this vehicle was any closer to the back of my car he would be kissing it. Real great marketing.

reviews.author: Lynn Vining
reviews.text: Oh my goodness, how thankful I am for JB Plumbing! My 22-yr old hot water heater went out on a Sunday evening (not a surprise; had already gotten a quote from another company a few months earlier & was saving up money for this purchase). However, after putting in a call to the "other company" TWICE, and not hearing back from them, I searched for a reputable plumber in my area and found JB Plumbing. Not only did the owner, Jean, call me back personally after I had spoken with his office, but he came out the same day to give me an estimate. While he was here, I inquired about the pipe/valve next to the water heater, wandering if that should also be replaced. His answer was "NO". He said I did not need to waste $400 fixing something until it actually needed to be fixed. What a delight to find a company that values PEOPLE more than money. Jean was so kind, completely trustworthy, and clearly values quality craftsmanship—thank you, Jean! And his quote was far better than the one from the "other company", forget the fact that they still haven't called me back. When he scheduled my installation, he expressed that he wanted me to get to know the rest of his team, so he set up my installation with Kerry. It was equally nice to see how much Jean values the people that work with him, too! Kerry was scheduled to arrive between 10 and 12. Kerry contacted me when he was on his way, and arrived only moments after 10AM, how cool is that? Kerry was so personable & professional that I readily knew I was dealing with a top-notch master plumber for sure! He took such care to make sure that everything was done precisely and TOP-NOTCH! Both of my sons saw the installation after he left, and both commented on his TOP-NOTCH work! Kerry even did things that were not part of the original estimate, like drill a hole through the wall to the outside, so that a proper drainpipe could be installed (he did beautiful work on that too). It is so comforting knowing that in the future, I don't even have to think twice about who I will call for all of my plumbing problems—the wonderful team of this family-owned business—JB PLUMBING! I HAVE FOUND MY PLUMBING FAMILY!

reviews.author: Octavia Andrews
reviews.text: We called JB Plumbing Services for a sewer drain clean-out and were very pleased from the initial call to the finish. The customer service agent was a gem. Upon arrival Kerry clearly explained the process even when additional equipment was needed, he and John handled everything seamlessly. Both were knowledgeable, professional, and easy to work with.  JB Plumbing will definitely be our first choice for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Barb Rafail
reviews.text:
I had my hot water tank replaced by Kerry Workman from JB Plumbing.  Was pleasantly surprised by the quality workmanship he performed as well as his gracious demeanor and kindness to me in answering all of my many questions!  He did an awesome cleanup as well.

In addition, the company is very professional and keeps their customers updated concerning your job-related information.

reviews.author: Katie Pizzo
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend JB Plumbing enough! I recently moved to a new house and discovered I had several problems and leaks that needed to be fixed. Chris and Kerry have been absolutely wonderful throughout the entire process. Their team is incredibly professional, and they get to you quickly – they've helped me resolve many issues that could have been major headaches.

What really impressed me was their responsiveness, especially when I had a gas leak on the weekend. I was panicking, but they came out immediately and handled everything with such care and professionalism. They were reassuring, took the time to explain what was happening, answered all my questions, and made sure everything was safe before they left.

Chris and Kerry truly go above and beyond. They're not just skilled plumbers – they're genuinely helpful people who care about their customers. Their dedication, even during what should have been their time off, really shows their commitment to excellent service.

If you need a reliable, skilled, and caring plumber, look no further. JB Plumbing has earned a customer for life, and I'm so grateful for all their help!

reviews.author: Rebekah L
reviews.text: JB Plumbing team has been wonderful in navigating the unexpected adventures of owning an old house! This morning (Wednesday) I woke up to my backyard trying to create a swimming pool without my approval. John was reassuring to speak to before business hours and Rachel was prompt at getting us scheduled to have it evaluated and a quick two hours later Jack was there to diagnose what happened. He had a solution for the day to get running water to the house and will be back on Friday to update some galvanized piping. We are so thankful for how quickly the team was out to our house with a same day fix at a reasonable price point! And we appreciate how soon we were put on the schedule to get the bigger job done. Thanks again!

synthesis.summary: JB Plumbing Services LLC appears to be an exceptional family-owned plumbing company with outstanding customer service and craftsmanship. They demonstrate excellent emergency responsiveness, including weekend gas leak service, and consistently exceed customer expectations with honest pricing and quality work.
