reviews.author: Cordell Walker
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience with 1-Tom-Plumber from start to finish. They answered my call right away after I discovered my old water heater was leaking, which honestly caught me off guard since it was only about 8 years old. I had a big bulky 75-gallon Richmond power-vent water heater, and by the time I noticed the issue, water was leaking throughout my basement.

To make matters worse, some of my existing plumbing lines were already corroded and beginning to leak as well. I went a full week without hot water while trying to figure out the best long term solution, which was incredibly stressful.

When 1-Tom-Plumber came out, they were professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain all of my replacement options without pressure. After talking it through, I decided to upgrade to a tankless “endless hot water” system. I’m so glad I did.

The new system works amazingly well. I never run out of hot water, and unlike traditional systems, it doesn’t require a specific hard-water softener, so I didn’t have to invest in an additional water softening system. It also doesn’t require costly yearly flushes, which was a huge plus for me.

On top of that, the system comes with a 15-year manufacturer warranty and is made right here in America, which gave me even more confidence in my decision. The workmanship was truly top-notch, the installation was clean, and everything was explained clearly along the way.

I’m extremely happy with my experience and the upgrade. If you’re dealing with water heater issues or considering going tankless, I highly recommend 1-Tom-Plumber. They made a stressful situation so much easier and delivered excellent results.

The guys did a great job, and I was very satisfied with the outcome. I had contacted two other companies for a quote, and they missed the mark by a long shot. One of them even had me removing the vanity in the master bath. Pike was by far the best price. The price Zack quoted was the price I paid. reviews.author: M B
reviews.text: Your drivers need to be more careful and avoid cutting people off on the road, as it can almost cause accidents.

reviews.author: wallace b.
reviews.text: A pipe broke and I needed a plumber fast. i expected to pay a premium and didn't have time to get bids. Help came fast, and far as I can tell the repair was made well. The cost was extortion. I can only feel better thinking perhaps some day James will need a drink out in the desert, and I come by with a bottle of water.

reviews.author: Raman N.
reviews.text:
Our toilet flooded and left a message on Sunday. I thought of supporting a local small business and called Capelli. I followed up with another call on Monday morning. They dispatched Rick Chaves. Rick was nice. They charged $205 for toilet clog auger. This didn't work. So they removed the toilet and used a toilet clog cable as they had go 10 ft to clear blockage they charged an additional $585 for this service. He said that it need a couple of closet flange spacers as the closet flange was 3/4 inch below tile grade. He quoted $40 for this but ended up charging $50. $840 for the the 1 hr 15 mts he was at the job. Rick spoke well. He left saying everything works and that he had flushed 6-7 times. When the bathroom was used it started to drip from the ceiling below. When the office was notified, Rick called back promptly and said it would be $205 for diagnostics. I had no choice but to pay. He came back cut a hole on the ceiling and said everything was alright. There must have been some water from the previous issue and that when installed the spacers it must have got trapped and that came to the ceiling. No issues to report and everything works fine. In short there was time and $1045 to plunge.
Seems excessive and their whole billing system is debatable. Ricks service was good the rating is for how they charge.
The problem didnt end here. a few days after the clog was still there. This time Rick said he didnt know what people can stuff the toilet with there is no warrant. He charged me another $ 710 for snaking it and going with a camera to see what the issue is. The problem is still not solved.
This has been nothing but a nightmare. We are about $1800 down and still havent  fixed the issue and my ceiling is cut open. For a colg that should have been fixed on the first attempt.

reviews.author: Sarah Audrey
reviews.text:
Do not hire!! On Nov 19th, they came to fix a toilet clog. The guy had to remove the toilet and thought putting it in the shower would be an appropriate location. He put nothing underneath it and did not clean the shower afterwards. Not only that, but he left the bathroom floor a complete mess. It was horrifying.
On Nov 27th (Thanksgiving morning), the clog returns somehow after only flushing tp and nothing solid at all. Due to the holiday, we had to just shut off the water and vacate the apartment. The plumbers arrive the following day to fix the clog. My neighbor had to let them in since I was not home. When I arrive, my bathroom mat is soaking wet and they put it on my bedroom carpet. Preston has no respect for the cleanliness of your home. He left his shoes on despite me telling my neighbors the apartment is no shoes on. It is incredibly disrespectful to do this to people.
Preston could not figure out where the clog was. He told me it was under the kitchen and they would have to dig up the floor. James comes and inspects my apartment and the neighbors and tell both of us both kitchens need to be completely emptied out.
Turns out the clog is in the complete opposite direction and not even under the kitchen.
This entire fiasco forced me to vacate my apartment for multiple weeks while they tried to figure this out. On top of all that, they broke the oven when moving it and that later had to be fixed. Getting the job fixed the first time around is a complete lie on their behalf. These bozos have no idea what they're doing.

*Photos show the two separate times they had to cut into the wall. After each cut, the drywall guy had to come and repair their work. It should have been fixed after the first time! Also note the mess on the floor. They left it like that!

reviews.author: C.C. M.
reviews.text:
Update for 2014:

We had a leaky toilet, something that James had fixed before (wax ring replacement) and he had done a great job. This time two new guys came over and fixed the toilet but left it wobbly, charged a lot for the shoddy work, and were rude, whereas James was a perfect gentlemen. It was a weird experience.

Looking at recent reviews, it seems that maybe Capelli Plumbing had a big change in how they operate in the last year. New management perhaps? It is absolutely not the five-star service it once was, and that's a shame because we really loved James and his perfect track record of solid, reliable work.

Old review in 2011:

James came over to check out a leaky bathtub and clear a clogged drain. He had a lot of good advice, worked quickly, and gave a modest estimate for the leak repair. A few weeks later we went ahead and got the leak fixed for the exact same estimate that was quoted -- no hidden costs. 

James and his assistant had to cut through the ceiling to get under the second-floor bathtub, clean out the mold, and fix the pipes. Sounds like difficult work, but they did this with no mess in just a few hours. Likewise he did a great job patching up the ceiling after the interior had been sufficiently dried out. Since then, there's been no leaks, no mold, and everything works (and looks) great.

It can be hard to find an honest plumber, but James is the real deal. He's a very nice guy and didn't mind answering all our questions, plus there was no pressure on the getting the bigger repair done soon. So we're definitely satisfied with both jobs, and highly recommend Capelli Plumbing.

reviews.author: Luke Beale
reviews.text:
The team is polite, responsive, and easy to work with. I do believe this company is great and perhaps missed the mark on this job or may be busy, etc...

I had very poor water pressure coming out of my bathtub and Capelli plumbing came to diagnose the issue. I paid for one hour of labor, (which is fine), however, I was told I'd be getting an estimate for them to come complete the job/ look for other issues when they could send a plumber with "more experience" with showers, etc. The initial interaction was great and understandable.

Almost 3 weeks after they initially came - I've called twice and politely asked for an estimate and it still hasn't been sent to me, no followup, etc.

I finally ended up calling another plumbing company and the issue was fixed within 1.5 hours, during their first visit.

Thank you to the Capelli team, however, I don't feel comfortable using them again as I am confident the initial triaging of the main issue should not have taken a full hour when it only took the other company 5 minutes to explain what he'd be doing and fix it. I would reconsider my review of Capelli Plumbing if they hadn't spent an entire hour at my place & charge for labor only to tell me they'd send an estimate that never came.

After seeing how quick the other plumbing company fixed it, I sincerely feel Capelli Plumbing did not need to spend an entire hour at my place and could've left after 10 minutes if he didn't know how to fix it. That, I would respect far more.

Leaving an honest review and best of luck!

reviews.author: J. D. Stoops
reviews.text:
Discovered a plugged drain line servicing our kitchen sink, dishwasher and clothes washer.
Water from kitchen back flowing from the drain on the washing machine.
Contacted our favorite plumbing company. In short order a technician arrived (Preston) and had things well in hand and the obstruction cleared.
Each time we have the opportunity to have Preston as our tech, we are impressed with his attitude and thoughtfulness.

14 August 2025

More issues with our plumbing. This time a leak under our bathroom sink and a damaged cartridge on the hot water faucet.
Called and set an appointment. Team that handled by issue was prompt  and empathetic.
The technician arrived earlier than anticipated and got to work. The job turned out to be one that seemed easy, but troublesome.
As an elderly man, I could have done the repair myself, but would have used most of my “sailors vocabulary” and add to that, a few human sacrifices.
Jessie Martinez gave the job his best attention. The proof of the pudding was that my wife inspected the job, the condition of the work site, and ran water to test everything.
She was pleased… and with that, I was ecstatic.

January 6, 2026

Called Capelli Plumbing for warranty work.
Technician arrive precisely at the appointed time frame and repaired that part that had failed.
Jessie was pleasant and again, efficient with the repair.
Highly recommend Jessie.
Try him… you will like him…. “A lot”!

reviews.author: Dino M.
reviews.text: Beware another flaky contractor in San Leandro. Had a sewer repair at my inlaws house, James sent out their workers to unclog pipe and do a video inspection 600.00. They said the pipe was broken ok got a estimate 3600.00 it had to get fixed so we agreed to there price they removed approx. 8 ft. of concrete and patched in a piece of abs pipe. They did a crappy job on the cement, all over they splattered the brick wainscote with cement. James the owner never came by to check the job. Heres the best part 6 months later sewer backed up through the cleanout 400.00 later his worker said theres another break and he wanted more money to fix it. Again wheres James? Well my mother in law got screwed so we installed a trenchless sewer cheaper than Capelli plumbings job, we called James to come over our house to see what they had to do  to make it correct. All James said is those guys dont work for me anymore because they screwed me, we demanded some kind of refund from him, he said ill i can pay is the 400.00 for when the guys went back to clean the pipe again. Long story short we havent got our 400.00 yet this is what gives good contractors a bad rap. We are going to report him to BBB. Another note our new plumber provided the sewer permit. James still kept all the money and never got a permit, think twice of this plumber.

reviews.author: Lori W.
reviews.text:
Capelli plumbing took care of all the plumbing needs in my 63 year old home. James was very responsive and came out and looked at my broken tub drain and leaking bathroom sink and determined what was wrong with both, explained what needed to be done, gave me a reasonable estimate and set up an appointment.  He showed up promptly and fixed the sink with an increased water flow to the sink after James I stalled the proper materials.  James and David had to work together to replace the tub drain and pea trap so now my tub/showers drains!

While James was under the house, he discovered several pipes were corroded and there was a small hole in one pipe.  He also discovered mold in the crawlspace and I had been smelling mold/mildew for a while.  James quoted me a reasonable price to tear out the damaged pipes and replace them and we set up an appointment.  

David and Ron came out to replace the pipes and once the old pipes were cut off I got to see how severely they were corroded and also see the holes in the pipes.  David and Ron finished all the work, picked up after themselves and double checked to make sure everything worked.

Im so thankful I called Capelli plumbing...Thank goodness for James - he fixed the sink & bathtub and then caught the pipe problems early - this could have been a nightmare.

reviews.author: Cynthia T.
reviews.text:
During the home inspection before we closed on our new home, the home inspector mentioned that the laundry hookups were suspect and we should hire a licensed plumber to come take a look.

We called several plumbers and James at Capelli Plumbing was the most responsive and most professional of all of the individuals I spoke with. He came out to take a look and quickly identified what work needed to be done. We also discussed gas versus electric dryers and he highly recommended gas. So we decided to also have him run a gas line to the laundry room in addition to fixing the washer hookups and washer drain.

He came out early on a Saturday to do the work. It took him and his helper about 2 hours to make all the repairs and run the gas line. When it came time to hook up the dryer . . . he informed me that Lowe's had actually delivered an electric dryer . . . which was obviously not the gas dryer I ordered. Oops.

I called Lowe's to sort out the issue and James offered to come back to hook up the gas dryer once Lowe's swapped the appliance.

He stopped by the following Monday and hooked up the gas dryer in under 5 minutes.

Super awesome service. We definitely plan to call Capelli Plumbing again when we need any additional plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Patricia S.
reviews.text: Called James at Capelli on Monday to request a repair on a kitchen faucet and an estimate for some minor repair work in the bathroom.  He came out promptly at 8 the next morning and was definitely more interested in selling me on a repipe job and when he got to the bathroom, he barely listened to the issue and told me I'd need a new toilet because parts were no longer available.  That's his standard response when he comes to these older homes and he quoted me just under $10K for everything!  He even tried to infer that the damage to my rusted through bathtub downspout was caused by my cat!  Made an appointment for Friday at 7:30 a.m. for just the repair on my kitchen faucet estimated at a couple hundred dollars.  He never showed up and never responded to my 5 phone calls...and yes, James it was YOUR voice on that answering machine.  Their website advertises "no job too big", but apparently some ARE too small when he can't talk you into a bigger investment.  As a woman, and older, I refuse to be taken advantage of.  Don't bother with these guys.  One star, but only because it won't let me do none

synthesis.summary: Capelli has a loyal base of repeat customers who've used them for years and praise the team's individual techs — but the Yelp reviews tell a sustained story of no-call-no-shows, pressure to upsell into expensive repipe jobs on simple issues, and owner James not returning calls when customers have complaints. Three separate reviewers report being ghosted after a first visit.
strengths: Long-term repeat customers who've used the company across multiple jobs over years
James personally handled a Sunday gas line emergency and individual techs like Rick Chavez and Preston praised for explaining work clearly
Emergency hot water repair handled in-house without replacement when parts could be sourced quickly
weaknesses: Three reviewers report the same pattern: plumber visits, promises an estimate, then never follows up despite multiple calls over weeks
Misdiagnosis under pressure: Preston tore into walls twice looking for a clog in the wrong location, forcing two separate drywall repair cycles
Owner James reportedly doesn't return calls when customers have pricing or workmanship complaints
bestFor: Gas line work where James personally attends
Customers who've built a prior relationship with a specific tech
redFlags: Owner James confronted a reviewer about leaving a 1-star review, called it 'slander,' and made personal jabs — pattern noted in at least two separate reviews
$1,800 total charged across 3 visits for a toilet clog that was never resolved — ceiling cut open, still unrepaired at time of review
Pressure to upsell repipe job (nearly $10K) on a woman who needed a faucet repair — plumber then no-showed the scheduled appointment without response to 5 calls
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Same-day emergency response documented for gas line and hot water, but reliability is inconsistent — no-call-no-show pattern and non-response to callbacks undermine emergency trustworthiness.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google 4.9 vs Yelp 4.1 — a 0.8-star gap across 72 Yelp reviews. Yelp surfaces a sustained pattern of no-call-no-shows, pricing complaints, and owner confrontations that don't appear in Google reviews.

sewer.topQuote: Sewer repair: bad cement work, splatters on brick wainscoting, sewer backed up 6 months later. James said 'those guys don't work for me anymore.' Never got the $400 refund promised.

toilet.topQuote: $1,800 total across 3 visits for a toilet clog that was never resolved. Ceiling cut open twice. Still unrepaired.

faucet-fixture.topQuote: Rick Chavez replaced the kitchen faucet in a 1930s home with attached water filter — friendly, professional, and so knowledgeable.

water-heater.topQuote: I was in need of an emergency hot water repair — rather than replacing the unit they gathered the parts in a timely manner and made the repair.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: Edward and helper arrived on time between 8-9, promptly assessed and fixed the clogged kitchen sink. Both polite and knew what they were doing.

repiping.topQuote: James fixed a complicated sewer issue for less than half of what others quoted, very polite to me and my family.

avoid_if: You need this for a complex or high-stakes install
hire_if: You need fast same-day or after-hours response
You need high-quality work that holds up over time
caution_if: You want detailed upfront explanations
You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need airtight scheduling and guaranteed arrival times

plumbers.name: PLUMB GENIUS
plumbers.address: 25 N Fretz Ave, Edmond, OK 73003, USA

reviews.author: Jan Turner
reviews.text: Excellent troubleshooting!

reviews.author: Mimi Hall
reviews.text: We found a leak under our sink the night before Thanksgiving.  We were pleasantly surprised we didn’t have to wait til the next week for repairs. Tim arrived at the scheduled appt time. He got to work immediately to correct our issue. He explained what had happened and made sure it was done correctly. He also replaced the inside mechanism for the toilet and it’s as good as new. I am extremely cautious of having companies in our home. So I have no reservations on recommending this company to others.

reviews.author: zoso70
reviews.text: Came out for a home warranty repair. Did a great job. Thank you.

reviews.author: Paul Wyrick
reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!!  We had sewage water coming up from the tub/shower drains since last Tuesday 12/20, the earliest they could come out was Friday 12/23, so Friday, the tech arrives spends barely 30 mins and said everything was fixed.  Then two days later on Christmas morning, the shower and tub is overflowing with sewage water AGAIN!!   Then, I called this morning to have the tech dispatched since they failed to complete the job the first time, however, showed no urgency nor sympathy whatsoever and scheduled us for THURSDAY 12/29!!!!!!  Because of their incompetence and unprofessionalism, our Christmas was ruined and now going over a week without any running water or toilets!!!!  BEWARE!!!!!

reviews.author: Vicky Bowron
reviews.text:
Worst company ever.  Came out to check my water heater but then would give me any info on update.  When I called the 5th time a few days later they said. "Oh  we can't reach the technician...he's busy".  Called the warranty company and hilariously they had an answer. Really? 20 year old kid is too busy?
ReallyStilFYICarrie/Kerri

reviews.author: Ashleigh Matthias
reviews.text: I’m usually it one to criticize online. My family is in business for themselves and bad experiences can’t be judged on one instance. However, after this two and a half month debacle of terrible ownership , horrible plumbers and the worst office staff I have ever encountered, Amanda, yes I’m referring to you, I needed to say something to warn others. If I could give plumb genius a negative review I would. The office staff have poor attitudes and are unhelpful, plumbers aren’t commutative and the manager or owner whatever he calls himself is just as unhelpful. Our plumbing ordeal went on with sewer in our garage for 2 and a half months. The first time they jack hammered our garage and said oh this will fixed it and just run hot water and dawn dish soap down the drains to clear  the line. It didn’t fix it and mind you to cost over $4000 then we move on to our 6 weeks of back and fourth. They said we can’t put a clean out in or find one. Another set of their plumbers came out l. This set finds the clean out said they would call me with a plan. No communication again so I had to call and the office manager again and I’m always so lucky to get the pleasure of speaking with uneducated rude Amanda. She literally asked me who came out and was they did. So I guess they send their plumbers out to houses without tracking them. Which is terrifying. They wanted to do another “fix” and I had to give them  idea if rerouting the entire line. In the end I did in fact decide to have my entire line rerouted by another plumber who did a wonderful job. The communication was wonderful and the plumbing is great, immediate fix. Oh and they were able to put on 3 clean outs since plumb genius said one couldn’t be done… all and all I am so glad I spent my $15k with the other plumber and after reading the reviews below I am even more thankful I didn’t used them for this big of job Plumb genius stick to unclogging toilets but from below looks like that is a skill not possessed either by your team. The office staff is better at a fast food restaurant and probably more knowledgeable about plumbing.

reviews.author: Rodney Norris
reviews.text:
Worst plumbing experience ever. This company lies and does not do what they say they will do.
They are  extremely dishonest been trying to get a simple water leak in our front bathroom fixed for 30 days.  Have had three technicians to my house.
Supposedly the first technician misdiagnosed the repair but I was told this after I had waited ten days for the parts he supposedly ordered to arrive.
When they did not show up to repair it, I was told that the technician had quit and was not with them any longer.  So they sent a second technician out who said the first guy misdiagnosed the problem.  And that it didn’t need parts ordered but that he didn’t have the right tools to fix it. So after waiting another week. I call and I speak to the GM Tony .
He tells me that he’s sorry, that it should have been a simple 30 min repair and apologizes for the delay and runaround and promises to send Helios best technician Chris out to do the repair.  He shows up 2 hours late on Thursday.  Leaves the repair halfway finished and says he needs a different tool and that he will be back later Thursday. He no showed and by Friday afternoon at three o’clock I called Plumb genius again.  I was told that Chris was out sick but that Tony would call me back.   Never heard from Tony.  So I called him this morning (Monday) was told he’s not in the office but that they now needed to order the parts that the very first technician had said were needed for the repair.  But amazingly they could not tell me when they were going to be out to do the repair. Because they did not have a time frame on the parts coming in.  These are the same parts I was told were ordered by first technician that supposedly quit.   As I said starting this.  They are deceptive, and dishonest and provide horrible customer service.

reviews.author: Philip W
reviews.text:
I would give negative 5 stars if I could. Neither plumb, nor genius to be found. They came, "fixed" our water heater, which didn't make it 48 hours. We then initiate replacement through our home warranty.

Ask for an itemized estimate, if you dare, and it will be intentionally vague and riddled with charges that are inexplicable by their staff. I waited a full day for a call from a plumber to explain the items on the estimate and their alleged code violations. Never received a call.

As their supposed customer service representative said, "you can Google it" with regard to their alleged code violations. I did Google it and then got a second opinion. Turns out they coded the water heater to the wrong city, so the entire estimate was wrong. Still wondering what a $600 charge for "Water Modification" meant.

I call the home warranty company to initiate a correction of the incorrect estimate, and Plumb Genius' operations manager says the earliest they can call to correct the issue is Tuesday because of the holiday (it is Friday and we initiated the first service call the previous Friday).

So if you want a company that will do less than the bare minimum to fix their own mistakes, without the slightest sense of urgency, Plumb Genius will get it especially wrong for you. I got my money for the service call back from the home warranty company, and am going with the second opinion, whose estimate was correct the first time, and who thoroughly explained the work.

After this experience, I wouldn't trust them to work in my house, even if they were to correct the errors and perform decent customer service.

reviews.author: Michael Stewart
reviews.text:
I hired Plumb Genius/Trophy Plumbing to replace two sets of leaking shower valves on July 22nd, 2025. Simplest job ever. One shower valve set they replaced started leaking again on September 9th. I called them back to see if they would return and rectify the situation. They have a 30-day warranty on their work, but I was 17 days out of that window. These are shower valves...like I said, simplest job ever. Shower valves, in my experience, should last years (the ones they replaced were at least 10 years old...probably closer to 20). They were going to charge me $130 just to show up again. I would have happily paid them for the hourly work, but not a fee to show up (again) to fix (again) what they already proposed to have fixed, and what I paid over $500 to have them fix.

When they informed me the fee would apply in my case as I was out of their warranty window, I informed them I may as well pay someone else a service fee if Plumb Genius/Trophy Plumbing won't stand behind their work. But, they chose to let me move on to another vendor. Really bad business practice and questionable competence at basic plumbing work if you ask me. I will not use them again.

Integrity and character count for something in my opinion, and I can't support a business that doesn't stand behind their work. Especially only 47 days after they charged me $517 for basic, simple services.

reviews.author: c
reviews.text: Plumb Genius is now trophy plumbing. Used a home warranty service and they came out for my leaking water heater and decided I need more things to get up to code (which was b.s) they charged 600.00 for a water modification and they didn't modify anything that was 600.00 worth. Maybe installed an 90 degree fitting, but for that amount, yeah, total rip-off. The total bill was around 900.00 dollars. When you think about it, a cash out which u could get from the warranty company would be about 450.00. Water heaters go for around 6-700 dollars. If you don't plan on selling your home, just get a new heater installed, and don't worry about getting up to code. In all, don't use these people. One technician was 90 days with company, and the other was a new hire. If that tells you anything. Also, trophy plumbing just bought Plumb Genius cause of bad service, and they are staying the course with treating customers like a wallet and not like Human beings.

reviews.author: Peter Pham
reviews.text: I want to tell everyone aware of this company, I have american home shield, which is ahs not cover for my knocking soundmy cvc which is expanding and make knocking sound, and they have charging me for $780 dollars for thermal expansing tank, which is still making knocking sound, and they can't figure it out, and now they want to replace water heater, which is cost me more, so use different company which is edmond plumbing, to come out, and is simple fix cut out small hole and inject foam, now it fix, and now them to remove the expansion tank and give me back my money and install original back in place, but they is the code thing for city of edmond, but it was original where it came from, I will public this everywhere to let people know about this company is RIG people hard working money, they not going to pay my money back, well guess what I will go to tell the tv news about this.

reviews.author: Dylan Masri
reviews.text: I have an older home and have had to use several different plumbing services and Plumb Genius is by far the worst I have ever dealt with. They scheduled a full day starting at 8am to replace my sewer line and showed up 2 hours late then rushed the job and destroyed my property with absolutely no regard. They split the concrete pad in my yard in half even though it was not in the way of the job and just gave me a simple "sorry". They are very vague on communicating pricing and just try to get you to swipe your credit card prior to the job then have zero regard for how they finish it. I have seen many messy sewer line repairs but the guys were in a hurry to go home after showing up 2 hours late so they didnt even refill the trench they dug, they just pushed all the dirt up next to it. I would advise to steer clear of this plumbing service. I had a terrible experience.

reviews.author: Blake Lippert
reviews.text: Thought it would of been a good experience from the first time meeting the tech he was very nice. Then after he left, I will say the customer service and follow up is an absolute joke. I have called multiple times to get an update on my work order and it has now been over a week that I have been out of hot water. The first time was a miss diagnosis. Now they have sent video off to Navien to further diagnosis the issue. Call today to ask about an update and she basically stated that she will have the tech call to see. Then told me I was more than welcome to call another company for a second opinion because I stated that I needed this addressed immediately . I shouldn't have to call multiple times to follow up with a service that I am paying for. Now reading the reviews, It looks like I should of done my research.

reviews.author: Chantel Lee
reviews.text: If you are a Home Warranty customer that was matched to Plumb Genius for your repairs, cancel and find a better plumbing company. The office staff seemed irritated to be answering the phone anytime I called. After 8 days without water to our home, our hot water tank was finally installed only to have the plumber leave before checking his work. We had no hot water. The next morning, another rude office person told me they were going to “send someone out to turn a little knob and get me hot water.” I let her know we didn’t have “a little knob” and that I was yet again missing work due to their plumber not checking his work. Not one apology from anyone I spoke to. I asked four times to have an email sent with the itemized items I paid out of pocket for and never received it.

reviews.author: John Sawyer
reviews.text: Do not use. If I could give less than one star, I would. Incompetent office staff. Margey hung up in my face repeatedly and accused me of not scheduling properly, among other insults. Told me I needed to schedule a procedure I do not need immediately, BEFORE they will come back out and fix a problem they created when investigating the main issue. Will never use again, solely based on her attitude and negativity. Plumbers are incompetent and uncommunicative. Canceled a job without letting me know, after I waited from 8 am to 4 pm for him to arrive. Horrendous experience, horrible company! Do not use, you have been warned.

synthesis.summary: Plumb Genius (also now operating as Trophy Plumbing) has one of the worst review profiles in this dataset — out of 89 cached reviews, 41 are low-star, and the pattern is remarkably consistent: grossly inflated estimates (often 3-5X competitor pricing), failure to stand behind work, rude office staff, property destruction left unaddressed, and alleged home warranty fraud. Multiple reviewers call out the office as the primary problem. A 30-day warranty on labor is described as unenforceable in practice.
weaknesses: Shower valve repair failed 47 days after a $517 job; company refused warranty work citing 30-day window

redFlags: Repeatedly quoted 3-5X competitor pricing for identical jobs — multiple independent reviewers confirm

Office staff (named 'Amanda') documented as hostile and dismissive; receptionist hung up on customer requesting manager

Company broke a shut-off valve, flooded a home, collapsed a ceiling, and stopped returning calls
Now also operating as 'Trophy Plumbing' — multiple reviewers suspect name change is due to review reputation
Two no-shows documented; tech canceled a job without notifying customer after an 8am-4pm wait

sewer.topQuote: Our plumbing ordeal went on with sewer in our garage for 2 and a half months. The first time they jack hammered our garage — cost over $4000. Then weeks of back and forth.

garbage-disposal.topQuote: Had a tech come out and install a new garbage disposal, it died within 2 months. Called and asked to speak with a technician — the receptionist refused.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY! We had sewage water coming up since last Tuesday. Said everything was fixed. Then on Christmas morning, the shower and tub is overflowing with sewage water AGAIN!

reviews.author: Jessica Ngo
reviews.text:
I work for a plumbing company in California and my elderly grandmother lives in Colorado, she got taken advantage by other plumbers like blue sky and I called my buddy the plumber and they were professional, gave fair pricing, and quickly got a new water heater installed and fixed previous repairs that were not done up to code.

Wesley and his partner were great and very happy with service! Appreciate you taking care of my grandmothers home like it was your own !

reviews.author: Aaron Martinez
reviews.text: Quick and reliable. He came out and cleaned the roots in my main line. With honesty and talked me through why i didnt need to replace when the other guys said I need to spend the big bucks to replace main line.  If your looking for a trustworthy plumber My Buddy the Plumber is it!.

reviews.author: Menachem Bachayev
reviews.text:
I’ve used My Buddy The Plumber several times now and I would just like to take a moment to think them for their incredible service and response! Unlike many other plumbing companies in the industry, they are very honest truthful, and will always diagnose the problem with efficiency and ease!

Thank you, Johnny For coming out after hours to take a look at our sewer and fixing the problem right Then and there we really appreciate your help, and I definitely will be using you in the future!

reviews.author: Sandie P
reviews.text:
Well here it was Sunday night at 10 pm. My call was at 10 pm and by 1030 pm we're at my door. I had a major backup where sewage was in my bath tub and neither of my toilets flushed. I called two other well know companies and was told by one they could come out the following morning and the other only let me leave a message. No one called back. By 1230 AM the job was done. Paul snaked the line numerous times to be sure it was completely clear. Very professional and courtious. The cost was very reasonable.  I would not hesitate to use their service in the future. If you need a plumbing company My Buddy the Plumber is the one to call.
Thank you Paul for being here.

reviews.author: Jonathon Wyderko
reviews.text: I had a valve in my sprinkler box that was leaking and caused one of my sprinkler zones to continue running after the set sprinkler time. 2 techs came out to look at it and stated I had a crack in the top of a valve that was causing a leak and that I needed a new valve and new water lines which would cost $680+ with labor to fix. Due to the leak being on the top of the valve, I just bought a new valve from Ace Hardware for $34 and replaced the top my current valve and it has fixed the issue. I’m unsure what liability the company would carry doing a simple fix like this, but the quote I received seemed excessive for the job needed to fix it. The techs who showed up were very polite, professional, and able to diagnose my issue in a timely manner though.

synthesis.summary: My Buddy the Plumber shows excellent emergency responsiveness, arriving within 30 minutes for a Sunday night sewage backup and completing repairs after hours. Multiple reviews highlight their honesty in avoiding unnecessary expensive repairs, though one customer felt overcharged for a sprinkler valve replacement.

Honest pricing - talks customers out of unnecessary work

reviews.author: Todd McGee
reviews.text: We had a broken pipe that was behind our dishwasher.  Ben came out and had it repaired within an hour.  He has also replaced our water heater and another broken pipe in the past.  Always very professional and outstanding service.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Terris Hirshman
reviews.text: H2Flow Plumbing is always my 'Go To' plumbing service.  They are timely with scheduling & appointments and do a professional job.  They communicate well, are extremely polite and seem to be reasonably priced.  Thank you for your friendly services!

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.text: The gentleman who came and fixed the plumbing issues was courteous and informative on the issues and the solutions.  He called to let me know when he was arriving and when he thought he might be a few minutes late.  H2Flow was a pleasure to work with and I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Dennis S.
reviews.text:
We recently purchased a home in Greenville. Several plumbing issues were uncovered during inspection and the seller hired H2Flow. First night in the home, the master bath toilet kept running so I adjusted the flap and chain. This was an item on H2Flow's list of repair and was invoiced as fixed. when the toilet was flushed and filled, there was a loud water hammer  
occurring in the incoming main Line to the home. H2Flow had invoiced for installing a pressure reducer on the main line. I called H2Flow and told them of the water hammer problem. their plumber was out in a few days but could offer no suggestion to stop the hammer other than to wrap the pipes (Which I did to no avail). that was on a Friday. That Sunday the dish machine stopped in cycle with a U2 error message indicating a clog in the discharge line. Following the instructions, I removed the kick plate - no link in the line and pp was not frozen up. I examined the connection at the sink and sure enough the discharge line connecting at the disposal was bent over and kinked. And sure enough, H2flow was paid to install a hanger under the cabinet to loop the discharge hose as specified in code. With the loop, the discharge hose was too short to connect to the garbage disposal without creating a link in the line. I redid 
what they had started and the Dish machine works fine now.  They had three items to address  and not one item was done without an issue. I have found another plumber.

reviews.author: Pam P
reviews.text:
H2Flow and Phillip deserve every star. This was the first time I've used them and I was truly impressed. Communication is excellent, he was on time, polite and friendly. To that great combo he adds skills and knowledge that fixed our problem. And he left the house spotless. Highly recommend!..........
and now I am a repeat customer.  It is so good to know you can pick up the phone and your problems will be solved promptly.
Phillip is smart,  knowledgable and communicates very well.
When you call H2Flow plumbing you win the plumbing lottery!
I'm now a loyal customer.

reviews.author: Jason Cloutier
reviews.text: Our home is on a well and we had low water pressure over the weekend. Contacted H2Flow from a Facebook group recommended and called them Monday morning. Thanks to a cancelation, they had a tech out within 3 hours of the initial call. The technicians were extremely polite and professional, were able to quickly diagnose the problem and came back the next day to complete repairs. The cost was what I expected for the issue and they offered a full 5 year warranty on parts and labor. I highly recommend H2Flow for all your plumbing needs. Thank you!

reviews.author: J Sharma
reviews.text:
Great service and very reliable! Help came quick and during the last minute and I am very grateful for that.
Ben was our technician and he knew exactly what he was doing. We had an issue with the water tank heater and it overflowed outside of our house due to a pressure system that failed and an aging tank. Ben explained the whole issue easily and why it happened throughly. The water tank heater and the pressure regulator was replaced and is now working very well. Thank you for your service!

reviews.author: Abigail N.
reviews.text: My water heater was on it's last leg and I needed it switched out for the new one I purchased. Phillip was able to come out the same day and get the new one hooked up. Both Phillip and the dispatch were professional and friendly. Phillip did an amazing job on the install! H2flows pricing is more than reasonable even with me buying the taller water heater and him having to shorten a few pipes. I would highly recommend him to anyone! Thank you again Phillip!

reviews.author: patti Kellems
reviews.text: Phillip Waters came to our home to what we diagnosed was a water heater element gone wrong.  He quickly diagnosed our issue to be a pressure regulating valve and thermal expansion tank.  He explained the problem to my husband completely, answered his questions and went to purchase the parts.  Phillip was courteous, friendly, and used his time efficiently.In the 20 years we have lived here this was by far the most professional plumber work on our home.

reviews.author: Erin O'Connor
reviews.text: Each and every time we have called H2flow they have been extremely responsive. We were given a reasonable time frame to expect a technician and a phone call once they were on their way to our home. All pricing was given up front and reasonable. Each and every time where ever they were working was cleaned up most of the time looking nicer after than it did before they arrived. Would recommend H2Flow to anyone in need of plumbing.

reviews.author: Sam Good
reviews.text: H2Flow added the plumbing to our new addition to our house and I can’t say anything bad. They were at the house on the day and time we agreed upon, they were very professional and they did not beat around the bush and told us exactly what was needed and how much it would cost. They kept me informed on the process and the communication was great through the whole service. I would definitely recommend them for all plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Cindy Swit
reviews.text: It was supposed to be a simple installation of a new toilet and vanity in a powder room. Instead we had severe floor damage from an old toilet that caused wood rot and black mold. Phillip and Garret literally came to the rescue! Philip was very considerate to check-in for rescheduling after the floor as finally replaced. He offered solid and trustworthy advice to complete the job. Excellent service! Great company!

reviews.author: Candice Kowal
reviews.text: Beyond grateful for these guys! We found out that our gas water heater was installed wrong, called H2 Flow and Philip came out right away! Their professionalism was great, they were on time (last person had us waiting for hrs), the price was reasonable and we had an overall good experience! Would absolutely  recommend them to anyone! We upgraded to a tankless hot water heater and it looks awesome! So impressed!

reviews.author: Gerry C.
reviews.text: H2Flow Plumbing was extremely responsive and professional today (a  Sunday !!), responding to our urgent concern regarding a leak and associated damage. They identified the source of the leak, fixed it, and also went to great efforts to remove damaged drywall to help ensure that there was no unseen damage/threat in the form of mold. I would recommend them to anyone that is in need of plumbing.

reviews.author: Chris Smith
reviews.text: Phillip was extremely knowledgeable and came within a few hours of me having a ceiling leak issue, all other plumbers that I called could not come for 3-4 days! He isolated the issue quickly and since it was a small issue he did not charge me. He answered all the questions I had, and gave me a great quote for some plumbing work I’ve been wanting to get done. Highly recommend!!

synthesis.summary: H2Flow Plumbing demonstrates exceptional professionalism and expertise, with customers consistently praising their accurate diagnostics, reasonable pricing, and efficient work. The plumber Phillip appears highly knowledgeable and courteous, making this a reliable choice for emergency plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: C. Lee Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 4315 Hudson Dr, Stow, OH 44224, USA

reviews.author: Katelyn S.
reviews.text:
As a first time home buyer in stow our house is on a slab and our biggest fear was the plumbing. The house was foreclosed and 'as is' when we bought it. Right away, every sink was clogged, badly. I looked around online and called a few places but when I called C.Lee plumbing just how nice Chris was towards me alone is why he was who we used for his services. Being younger and a new homebuyer we have had so many contractors treat us, to be blunt, like we are idiots. We never had to worry about this with C.Lee. 
I was concerned based off previous reviews about their pricing and yes I'm sure I could have found another plumber for cheaper but you get what you pay for! In our case, amazing service, great personality and respect! 
Our first service required over 50ft of snake into our main. Our kitchen sink and utility sink have been running clear for over a year now and then recently we had both our bathroom sinks snaked and those as well are working great now both serviced by Taylor. Today Chris came over to replace our hot water tank which initiated me to write a review. Great great guys! They have always made us feel comfortable and reassured. They talked to me, not at me and we even chatted about family! So yes I highly recommend, if you want someone trustworthy then here you go! They are saved in my phone and I know they will always be here to help and the one year warranty is a great plus :)

reviews.author: Paula L.
reviews.text: Chris Lee is FANTASTIC!!! I have had his company perform work several times for me on faucets, garbage disposals, outside spigots, and toilets. He is top-notch and very professional. His services are not cheap, but you get what you pay for when it comes to plumbing, and I have never had any problems with his work afterward, whereas in the past when I have gone with the cheaper plumbers, the work was sub-par at best.

reviews.author: Joe C.
reviews.text: Very happy with the services provided by C. Lee Plumbing. It's taken a few trial and errors with other plumbers, but think I have finally found a reliable/reasonable plumber in the area. Planning on both using and recommending for future jobs. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Della D.
reviews.text:
DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!!! In May of this year, I was referred to C Lee Plumbing Services by Home Builder. I contacted them because water was overflowing from my 2nd Floor to my 1st Floor. Some on came out on May 28th and informed me that my branch line was clogged.  I was charged 285.64 to clear this line in my basement. Once this service was provided I was told that their is a 1-year guarantee on service provided.

Earlier this week I contacted C Lee Plumbing Services again because I could see that this line was clogged again and I  requested that someone come out and unclog the same branch drain as before. 

On 12.11.19 Taylor Lee came out , looked at the problem and stated that the branch drain was not the issue. He continued to state the issue was actually from the Main Drain and quoted 415.00 to clear the main drain. I declined the service and paid 59.00 for the service call. Taking this information I shopped around and found another Plumbing company to clear the main line because this is what Taylor Lee from C Lee Plumbing Services stated was needed. 

I contacted Sal's Heating and Cooling to clear my main drain line. Sal's Heating and Cooling sent some one out the next day.  After snaking the main line drain they informed me that this was not the issue. They then proceed to investigate the issue more an found that the issue was the branch drain ( that should have been covered by my one year guarantee from C Lee Plumbing Services) and not the main drain. Sal's Heating and Cooling promptly cleared the branch line and provided an invoice that said, "Snaked the main sewer ran snake all the way out. Still holding after in the floor sink.
Found secondarycleanout located in addition. Snaked from there as well and opened up the sewer.Recommended to the customer if problem continues to snake and camera. At this point seems to be soft
blockage. Maybe at wye." 

I sent this information to C Lee Plumbing Services and was told that Sal's Heating and Cooling did not perform the Services that they stated on the invoice that they did. I was told by the Office Manager that I was being dishonest and was told that they would need someone from Sal's Heating and Cooling needed to call them. I do not know why this came up. I am not sure if it was because of a personal physical discrepancy or what. They would not call the other company. I called Sal's Heating and Cooling and they stated that as a policy they do not call other plumbing companies but agreed that they put what happened on the invoice. 

In summary my issue is that over the last two days 371.12 in funds have been allocated to a service from Sal's Heating and Cooling that I was told was guaranteed for one year at no additional charge by C Lee Plumbing Services.

reviews.author: Bill B.
reviews.text: So the plumber that came out was very nice and very knowledgeable and yes he quoted me the price for tightening my toilet and adjust the guts on my other toilet assuming he would fix the issues. So total work done was adjust the handle and fill rate on 2 toilets and tighten down 1 toilet total cost was 265.00 and my one toilet is still not flushing properly and was told to replace the toilet so isn't any better then it was but still charged full price. Would not recommend. Also quoted me 598 to replace toilet so I went to Lowes found one of the toilets he quoted me and payed 215 for it ad installed myself which is what i should have just done in first place.

reviews.author: Colin C.
reviews.text:
C. Lee Plumbing is a great company. I got in touch with them through a contractor service called Home Advisor. Here's my story:

I recently had bought a Whirlpool water heater (first mistake.) About a month after installation, the pilot kept going out, and the safety valve on the thermopyle failed. I called Whirlpool, they were less than helpful. I called C. Lee Plumbing after that, and explained my situation. He called Whirlpool, got the part replaced via warranty (I can only imagine the frustration dealing with the Whirlpool folks and their "understanding" customer service) and had it shipped next day to me. 

Within only 2 hours of getting the parts, Justin from C. Lee Plumbing was here. 

He installed the new thermopyle, blew out the lines, cleaned the pilot, removed some condensation...all in about 20 minutes. He was very professional, pleasant, and actually talked to us like we were people, not just idiot customers...which seems to be the standard in the industry. 

For emergency service, he was very reasonable with price, and was willing to negotiate it down a bit. They even guaranteed the work for a year!

I will recommend these guys to EVERYONE that needs plumbing issues resolved.

reviews.author: Tom S.
reviews.text:
CHARGED ME $150 PER HOUR FOR NON-PLUMBING WORK

A retired fireman working for Lee Services spent about two hours installing a 1"x2" wood brace in the top of each of four kitchen cabinets.  I was aghast when Lee Services billed us $340 for that work.  My fault not getting a quote - just never expected he would claim that $150 per hour is his standard fee and that nobody else would charge less.  Responding to my phone complaint, he said people do not understand business men's costs and overhead.  I told him that I'm in the staffing business and fully understand labor costs but charging $150 an hour is outrageous.  I'd be very surprised if he's paying any employee that much per hour with a reasonable mark-up to work on cabinets.  

At the end, he said, "I'll take no less than $240" and something about losing money on the job.  I said, "I'll pay you $240 and that will be the last time we ever do business."

reviews.author: Rosie D.
reviews.text:
This is a very expensive plumbing services.  I regretted very much for calling them to fix my drainage problem.  For the price of $350 and reduced to $325 because I ask for a discount, the problem was still there after the following day, so I have to call another company to fix the problem and it turned out that the other company charged me only $165 for doing the same job. 

One more thing, C Lee Plumbing told me that the plumbing needs to be replaced because it was broken and quoted me an unbelievably high price of $2,200 including the $325 job...thanks goodness I did not agree and it turned out that the 2nd plumber who went the following day told me that the pipe is still fine.  

When I called to complain, C Lee Plumbing told me that I would get a refund of $325 but after 4 days of waiting no refund showed on my credit card account.  Never again will I do business with C. Lee Plumbing Services.

reviews.author: Erika D.
reviews.text: In response to Chris Lee's response to my original review! The reason for running the camera twice is because they did not do the video recording in the first place at the second service call. I do have all the receipts to show what we were charged and paid for, one being a video recording of the drain. So they did nothing more than what we paid for them to do originally. I also sent photos of the freezer position in relation to the outlet used to snake  the drain, also the position of the freezer that was unplugged and not plugged back in as they requested. I sent an email with all of this information but I never got a response to my email. So all being said take the response from C Lee to my honest review with a grain of salt as their response is just not true! Proceed with caution if you need service from this business!

reviews.author: Bill T.
reviews.text: Don't use this company. They charge unbelievably high labor costs. $385 to install a kitchen faucet that took less than an hour to install. They first told me over the phone that they would charge $59 to come out and that they would take that off of the cost of the job if they were selected. They took a week to come out, then when they did, the technician gave me an estimate of over $1400 to install 4 faucets. I said really?  Why so much? He said it's the cost of doing business. I then said just do the kitchen faucet since it is of urgent need to replace (it was falling apart). I called the owner after the job was done and he was rude and bully like. No regrets of his higher than the sky labor costs.

reviews.author: Nancy T.
reviews.text:
Unbelievably pricey He would not give an estimate on standard jobs over the phone..

I needed a new insert on a  dripping faucet, and new "guts" installed in a toilet.

He charged 265.00. My guess after pricing these parts is that he made 210.00 profit on a 20 minute visit.

He could tell I was stunned and said "Well, i'll give you a 35.00 special internet discount"..but when he wrote up my invoice, he had only taken 25.00 off.

The plumber said, "Well, i never advertised myself as a budget plumber"..That's fine, but 85.00 for a faucet insert? Really?

reviews.author: J L.
reviews.text: Charged just about the same as everyone else to the job we needed done. I did my research and went with C. Lee as their reputation was good. They had to return 3 times to get the job done right, which they did. I just felt like it should have been done right the 1st time. I will say they were on top of things when things went wrong or were not completed the owners standards and kept on the job day after day until it was right. So you get 3 stars from me. I would do business again, I'd just be home while the work is being done to supervise.

reviews.author: Meryl S.
reviews.text: Over charged for services. Missed a drain they were to clean out.  Charged for 'camera' but couldn't produce photos of 'broken line.' Happily provided a $8,500 estimate for repairs. Dug where supposed break was- THERE WAS NO LINE THERE. Won't return calls.

reviews.author: D A.
reviews.text:
Quoted a price of $200-400 for warranty work. They didn't order correct parts we didn't have hot water for a week. Came out second time left with heater not working. Ended up charging $625! 

At best dishonest and would never use such a thief again!

reviews.author: Karen L.
reviews.text: Justin & Jason were life savers! I had a basement flood recently in late March. They explained my situation very well. They provided optional solutions. Both gentlemen were very professional. Much Appreciated! Sincerely, D Mercer Cuyahoga Falls

synthesis.summary: C. Lee Plumbing Services demonstrates exceptional reliability and craftsmanship with 23+ years of consistent service in Stow. Their technicians are highly knowledgeable, professional, and capable of handling complex gas line work and emergency situations like same-day water heater replacements.

Excellent communication and professionalism

plumbers.name: Mr McGee Plumbing
plumbers.address: 509 W Beam Ave, Yukon, OK 73099, USA

reviews.author: Anya Mashaney
reviews.text: Robbie is like if I had a cool uncle that is also a plumber! I've had to call Mr. McGee Plumbing out to my house for various repairs from fixing a toilet to finding (and replacing!) a crushed and corroded copper pipe. Robbie gives me the options, explains the logic, and gets it done. On top of that, scheduling is easy, his pricing is fair, and his disposition is comforting. He navigates my house with kids and dogs and mess with courtesy and kindness. He and his office are so friendly, communicative, and kind. Couldn't ask for a better plumber. Thanks, Robbie & Mr. McGee!!

reviews.author: Jason Maleski
reviews.text:
I recently hired Domination Plumbing based on a referral from a friend to convert a replacement oven from natural gas to propane and install it in my kitchen.

Before choosing them, I called two other plumbing companies. Domination’s pricing was a bit on the higher side, but the others were booked out 2–4 weeks. Domination was able to fit me in that same week, which made hiring them well worth it. Their large crew gave me peace of mind, knowing they have the staff to keep projects on schedule with minimal waiting.

Two employees came to do the work, and they were outstanding. They were very personal to talk to. They also arrived early—which I really appreciated, as most contractors tend to be late—and immediately assessed what was needed before getting right to work. They handled everything efficiently, from removing the old stove to bringing in the new one from the garage, discarding the old unit, and even cleaning up the packaging. Their attention to detail and consideration showed they truly care about their customers.

The installation went smoothly, and the stove worked perfectly. When it came time for inspection, one of their lead plumbers arrived early to meet the inspector, ensuring everything was in order. The inspector was completely satisfied, and the process couldn’t have gone better.

Overall, you get what you pay for. Domination Plumbing delivered professional, timely service with a flexible schedule and a crew that clearly takes pride in their work. I would 100% recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Kim Duffy
reviews.text: I called Domination after seeing positive reviews online and a camera scope advertised for pipes. They quickly were able to schedule a visit to help fix a clogged drain, but ultimately left me with a bill of almost $400, a drain that was still clogged, but also a huge mess in my basement I had to clean up after they cut into a pipe without any protection for the items around/under it. They offered to replace PVC piping for an additional $500. I fixed it myself and could have just saved $400 and time cleaning up my basement, lesson learned. Admittedly it was a huge clog, but it’s an extremely expensive visit for leaving me with an even larger issue than I had before they came.

reviews.author: Brian Misner
reviews.text:
I’m 60 years old, I had no heat, and my granddaughter was coming over on Friday and this was Tuesday on Wednesday two plumbers showed up they were very courteous, very kind, found where my heating problem was, replaced the pipes in an area of my house that I won’t even let an animal go, even in a crawlspace under my kitchen, I wasn’t worried about the bill, the owner of the company told me that we would figure something out and the next day I woke up and I had heat in the house and it’s absolutely wonderful.

I would not only recommend Domination Plumbing for everything, But when I redo my house, I plan on only using them from now on!!!!!!

reviews.text: We had Noah and Zach from Domination come fix plumbing issues we were having in our master bath. My husband called Domination and they were able to come out that same day to take a look. Then they could fix the issues just a couple days later! Noah and Zack were very kind, professional, and got the job done in a timely manner. We had a great experience and will definitely use them again if ever needed! Also very reasonably priced! I would definitely recommend Domination Plumbing and Heating.

Domination fixed all of hvac and plumbing issues at an affordable/reasonable price. Would use again.

The stack was cracked in half, and to top it off, the cast iron pipe under the foundation was pretty much shot.
Damon was awesome. Super thorough and professional, but also made everything easy to understand. He walked us through what was going on and how to fix it the right way. Plus, he kept things light with his humor, which made the whole stressful situation a little easier to handle.
Josh is a hard worker who doesn’t hesitate to get his hands dirty. He double-checked everything and made sure it was all done right.
What really stands out is how honest and genuinely caring both Damon, Josh and the whole crew are. It’s rare to find people who truly care about the job they’re doing and the people they’re helping. I can’t thank them enough for all their hard work and dedication. If you need plumbing help, don’t hesitate to call.

reviews.text: I'm really not sure what to think. I contacted plbing master's when the plber I've been using for years closed down. I explained the exact issue I was having when I made the appointment as well as to the two young men who came out (the dishwasher drain line) . They completely disregarded me and decided the problem was my new garbage disposal. I don't even have a new garbage disposal. They also loudly cussed when they saw my plumbing. I'm not any sort of prude but it was really off putting. I don't find it offensive but I certainly question your judgements and intelligence. They also basically told me they were guessing at what could fix it and seemed very unsure of themselves. However, they did finally fix the issue I needed addressed. I wouldn't call them again, at all, and I've already told someone who asked my experience to avoid them. You can see from the manager's response where their "techs" get their attitudes.

reviews.text:
Last week, my shower suddenly sprung a leak that started seeping through the wall into the next room—total panic moment. I called Plumbing Masters, and they had a technician out within 24 hours. They quickly pinpointed the issue—a cracked pipe—and resolved everything that SAME day!

From start to finish, they were professional, courteous, and incredibly knowledgeable. And their prices were really reasonable! They didn’t just patch things up—they took the time to do it right and prevent any further damage. I also really appreciated the detailed report with photos they sent afterward, along with a warranty on their work.

Top-tier service like this is hard to find. I HIGHLY recommend Plumbing Masters and will be using them for any plumbing needs going forward. They’ve definitely earned my trust!

Made sure that cabinets didn’t have to be torn out (which other companies immediately wanted to do) and just very patient. Shout out to Malcom. I’m sorry I turned the water on and you ended up getting soaked. Steve and Alfredo!
Recommend this company 100/100

reviews.author: Christi Jeffreys
reviews.text:
Steve was professional and fast. They were the ONLY company who would come out the eve before Easter Sunday AND the only actual
person who answered the phone instead of an AI bot! They were also the only condone who advertised 24 hour service who actually provided it. The other companies told me I had to wait until Monday.

reviews.author: Kathy Knox
reviews.text: Had a weekend urgent plumbing need that we thought would be simple to fix. Beatrice was so helpful in setting expectations and getting a tech to us. It turned out to be way more complicated - possibly construction debris in our line. Josh powered through and got the problem solved. Will call them again in the future!

reviews.author: Lynn
reviews.text: Called after hours, had a plumber at the house 30 minutes later.  Malcolm did a great job.  Job turned out to be much larger than originally thought but had everything fixed by the next morning.  Had to wait for warehouse to open for part, reason for finishing next day.  Left everything nice and clean

The 4 negative reviews are outliers that raise pricing and professionalism concerns, including one serious allegation of items stolen during a service call and an owner who escalated aggressively rather than engaging constructively.

weaknesses: One reviewer reports pricing as very expensive relative to the 20-minute service call ($416) with inadequate resolution

reviews.author: Jessie Zepeda
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful we are happy with Titan. We were pretty much in a jam not only one clog. We had three clogs in our master bedroom and our kitchen and in our laundry room. I know nothing about Plumbing or how to find somebody so I went on the Internet. I found about 10 plumbers and I checked for reviews, after talking to a few plumbers some of them absolutely were scared to work at my home so that terrified me and my wife we didn’t think we’re gonna find any Plumber since we had an old home, wow when I got to tighten I told him I need somebody very experience they sent out Dave, not only did he make us feel calm and cool. He said will be able to do the job. He didn’t turn it down. He actually went over everything with the Plumbing with us and sat down with us and told us what it was our option we said let’s just get it all done so he came on a Saturday not only did he fix one room, but he was able to fix all three rooms my laundry room, my master bedroom and my kitchen. Our plumbing is running great better than before and trust me. Our pipes were really bad so I wanna take Titan and Dave especially for helping us out when we really need them not only do I recommend them. They’re the only people we’re gonna use for our Plumbing trust me if I can give them 10 stars I will let me tell you this they’re pricing was unbelievable. We can afford it. Me and my wife are on a budget. Tighten worked with us. He went over every job and how much it was gonna be. I appreciate that.

reviews.author: Michael Trejo
reviews.text: Out of the 4 places I called this morning they were the only ones that had a person actually pick up the phone. Schedule a service call for the afternoon but I was able to finally unclog my toilet. I called the cancel and it was smooth with no pressure for them to still come out. If I ever have a plumbing issue I will be coming to Titan.

reviews.author: Timo Lyons
reviews.text: Titan always delivers. I went down to my basement New Year’s Eve and found my hot water heater leaking. A quick call to Titan and they had a plumber out to my place within 2 hours and a new water heater installed shortly after. They were professional, tidy and skilled. I highly recommend these guy!!

reviews.author: matt trinidad
reviews.text: Worked with titan plumbing since we moved into the house and they have been amazing. Recently added a clean out since out house didn’t have one and it’s made fixing any plumbing problems a breeze. david was on site doing amazing work and thoroughly explained the issue and what the options are. Pam was great at coordinating any updates that would come up and wanted to make sure that my plumbing problems were no more. highly recommend.

reviews.author: Janice Holland
reviews.text: Titan came out quickly when our sump pump went out. Lou was very professional and answered all our questions. He gave us all our options and the prices so we could choose the sump pump we wanted. Many plumbers just give one option, and that’s what they install. That is what our old plumber did. Lou patiently trained an apprentice plumber that day, even though they were very busy. Lou came back again to install a new backup pump and used a special camera to check our drain tile which also needs work. It was backing up during the heavy rain. This is a really good plumbing company. I would definitely use them again. The company we always used told us to get someone else because they were too busy that day due to heavy rains. Titan is so helpful and cares about the quality of service they provide to their customers.

synthesis.summary: Titan Plumbing delivers exceptional emergency service with rapid response times, including New Year's Eve water heater replacement within 2 hours. Their experienced technicians handle complex jobs other plumbers won't take, provide multiple options with transparent pricing, and maintain excellent communication throughout the process.

reviews.author: Kara Lyons
reviews.text: Marco came out to help with a leak we had from our primarily bathroom going through to our living room. He was super informative about his time of arrival, the issues we were having, and helped us walk through next steps with a mold remediation company. Marco was super mindful of cost and collaborative with our other contractors. His expertise and empathy were very much appreciated during this stressful time.

reviews.author: Londell Thomas
reviews.text: We've been dealing with a clogged kitchen sink in our garden apartment for years. We contacted morning noon and night for a permanent solution and Christian and Marco had one. The service was great as was the attention to detail. I recommend this company to anyone!

reviews.author: Joe Mark
reviews.text:
Christian came out for an emergency call at 9:00 pm for a sink that was backing up from a main line in our condo building.
He rodded out the drain line and fixed some other small repairs. We were happy with his work and would recommend him to anyone looking for a good plumber.

reviews.author: Stefvanni Steans
reviews.text: Excellent service! They came out so fast and were very knowledgeable! Marco and Christian were very professional and didn’t mind when my dad wanted to help out! If you’re ever in a pinch give them a call! Very transparent with pricing and extremely helpful!

reviews.author: Wayne S
reviews.text:
Second time I’ve used them in the last year. Can’t say enough about the professionalism and good service. TJ came out to hone me an estimate on what I thought I needed, and me gave me some better options through diagnosing before doing the big job I thought I needed.
He spent time explaining his process and the reasoning for it. I went with his suggestions and it generally fixed my issues without going for the big $ project. Strongly appreciate his explanations, professionalism and work he did. And he saved me money in the long run. Definitely recommend Morning Noon and Night plumbing.

Multiple reviews highlight their reliability for urgent situations and their ability to work collaboratively with other contractors during stressful times.

From the initial booking to the completion of the project, the entire process was seamless.
The crew was professional, arrived right on schedule, and did an incredible job cleaning up, you wouldn’t even have known they were there. It’s rare to find such high-quality service, technical expertise, and genuine attention to detail. I am thrilled with how the new system is running and would highly recommend them to anyone in the Woodstock, IL area looking for high-quality HVAC work.

reviews.author: Crystal Levy
reviews.text: I recently had some home improvements done, including a new water heater in the bathroom vent/light installation and I couldn’t be happier with the experience from start to finish. The team was outstanding Rosa who scheduled everything was incredibly helpful, kind and flexible. She made the whole process, smooth and stress-free. Every crew member who came to my home was professional, courteous, and respectful. They worked efficiently answered all my questions and made sure everything was done right the quality of the work exceeded my expectations and I felt completely comfortable having them in my home.  The entire crew was fantastic! I Highly recommend this group to anyone looking for reliable high-quality home service they made the process easy and the results speak for themselves

reviews.author: Areil Eckardt

Amazing. 10 out of 10!!
Bought a new water heater and had it installed today. Andy and Asa showed up just after 8:30 am and were done by 11:15am.
Let me tell you, I was dealt the dream team! They were so professional, friendly and personable.
We just bought our townhouse and only rented prior so I guess you could say this was my first rodeo "Adulting". I didn't know what to expect and they made the whole process feel so seamless. I highly recommend this company and these techs for all your heating, cooling, and plumbing needs.
Its inevitable that I will need their services again in the future. I will 1000% be calling them first!

reviews.text: We use AirMan because their team is knowledgeable and professional. They maintain both our ac and baseboard heat/boiler.
