reviews.author: Trent Artichoker
reviews.text:
Had simple leak in PEX tubing that needed repaired. Looked on Google maps, called McAdams Plumbing, Heating & Cooling, but yet the business that was actually doing the work was Mesa Plumbing, Heating & Cooling. They were able to come the same day, which is great. Cody showed up, we talked , agreed that 5' section of PEX needed replaced. Comes back with estimate, $14K for whole house plumbing, $1.4K to replace 5' PEX with copper, or third option, replace bad PEX section with updated PEX at $1.1K. I tell Cody that his estimate is overpriced and excessive that comes out to $400 plus per hour. He supports his estimate with rationalization. I agree because I'm helping a tenant, and they need water.

Cody spends 2.5 hours at the property and at the end takes $100 off because of the time. So, I pay $1,056.25.

I get a text after the visit wanting to know how they did. I complain about cost, their solution was $50 credit on file.

$422.50 per hour labor rate is ridiculous. Be wary of this business all

reviews.author: Kris
reviews.text: The folks at McAdams are so amazing! I had spent a month with a broken toilet trying to work with my home warranty and the terrible plumber from a different different company they sent out before I was able to break my contract. This this point and I was pretty skeptical of all plumbers but I saw that McAdams Plumbing had the best reviews in the area so I gave them a shot. The receptionist I talked to on the phone was so nice and incredibly helpful! I needed to replace my whole toilet (as a new homeowner this is my first time doing it) and she took the time to go over all the different models and gave me some great recommendation! They were then able to come out and install the new toilet the next day, the other plumber I had to work with took 5 days to come out and just look at the toilet.  Tim was my technician and, with a call a head of time, said he could be there earlier than the scheduled time. When Tim arrived he was extremely nice and very professional! We chatted a bit about why I was replacing the toilet and he listened to me rant about the awful experience I had trying to get it fixed before and he was very sympathetic to my situation. After I mentioned that I just moved in to this condo he asked if he could look at my water heater because he has had to replace a lot of them recently in this condominium complex, which was so considerate. He removed (and disposed) my old toilet and installed the new one and all its guts a lot faster than I thought and was really cleanly (he even put little booties over his shoes to avoid tracking anything on my carpet)! I cannot recommend McAdams enough and from now on they will always be the first people I call should I have any more plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Archana Shenoy
reviews.text: Very happy McAdams Plumbing! I called and they managed to squeeze me in on the same day even though they were booked out for the week. Tim took the time to show me the issue and was very efficient with getting it resolved. I really appreciated the attention to detail and care he took with wearing a mask, shoe covers, laying down tarp, cleaning up after himself etc. Will absolutely use this company again. As a relatively new homeowner, it was nice to have such honest service and to know that you are not being taken for a ride.

reviews.author: Gretchen Patel
reviews.text: We’ve used McAdams Plumbing for a few years and won’t call anyone else. Tim is professional, friendly, honest and punctual. He does great work, we’ve never had the same issue twice. The prices he quotes are fair and reasonable. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bob Casias
reviews.text: McAdams plumbing has been super responsive and professional. This is the first time we have used them and the service personnel showed up on time, we’re very courteous and had our issues solved and repaired in a remarkably reasonable time frame. We will certainly use this company again if we need plumbing assistance. Tim was super knowledgeable and did great work!

reviews.text: Yes, everything went well. In-N-Out no problems. reviews.author: Mike B.
reviews.text:
Scott, Tanner, and Dustin of PROFESSIONAL PLUMBER were simply outstanding.  They arrived to the job precisely on time and ready to work.  Everyone was professional, easy-going, and friendly.  I had three different plumbing projects, two of them major. 

At every step, they explained what was going on.  I could see the work being done with exacting care and each step was laid out so I could understand what they were doing and why.  They completely fixed a major water leak and replumbed the pipes in the basement ceiling to perfection.  Beautiful work.  All overhead.  In an hour. 

They worked quickly but with great care as they knocked out the next issue.  A major foundation leak.  Fixed.  Pressure tested.  Not a drop anywhere. 

They spent the rest of the day replacing a sewer main.  Their work was again done with great care.  Friendly, but no fooling around.  They fixed every problem in a single day.  Skill, knowledge, and caring together are a powerful combination. 

I have used three other local plumbers before and was not pleased.  I am happy to give PROFESSIONAL PLUMBER my top rating.  They got it done and done right.  Thank you!

That would be 2 hours labor for $800.00  What the hell!  I have filed a claim with Angie.  I did not know what the repair would cost and I knew more rain was on the way.  I guess the individual who did the work was making $400/hour!  Not a chance in hell.  I do mind paying for service, but I was RIPPED OFF.  Professional Plumbing will never be back.  I will let everyone know the situation and I would hope Angie cancels your listing.  This was HIGHWAY ROBBERY.  In fact your workman could use the money for his son's upcoming and periodic surgery.  I know damn well he will get his usual rate of pay which as sure as Jesus knows, was with an unfair and totally inconsiderate payment.  Thanks for the robbery by UNPROFESSIONAL plumbing.

Yes, with no doubt about the recommendation.

reviews.author: Melissa Whitley
reviews.text: I wanted to jump on here and give some praise to The Professional Plumber. I had to reach out on my community page for recommendations and they were highly recommended and didn’t disappoint! Jessica in dispatch answered my call on a Sunday morning. She was very knowledgeable and told me that an emergency visit wasn’t needed.  She got me on their schedule the following day! Lee Blackburn came out to evaluate. He completed the job this morning after warranty parts arrived.  Job was completed in a timely manner and pricing was fair. 5 out of 5 stars for the company and Lee!

reviews.author: Allen Irwin
reviews.text: Our kitchen drain had been clogged for a couple days, after attempting to remedy the situation our selfs we called Professional Plumbing late in the afternoon. They jumped right on the call, and was at the house in under an hour. Problem was diagnosed, tech ran to the store for the part we needed, and replaced it. Some additional work was needed to completely solve the issue which he did in a very professional manner. I highly recommend using this company if you're in need of Plumbing work!!

synthesis.summary: The Neighborly Plumber shows up when others won't — multiple reviewers note holiday and weekend availability when every other company they called was booked out days. Estimates come in substantially below competitors on bigger jobs. One documented pricing concern: a repair failed three weeks later in the same area, and the tech wanted to charge full price again rather than warranty the work. One reviewer also felt a simple toilet re-seat was severely overpriced at $400+.

water-line.topQuote: They were $1100 less than the other, fixed within two days, only took three hours to do the complete job.

water-heater.topQuote: Received a total of seven quotes and this company won the bid — reasonable pricing, amazing customer service, same-day install.

sewer.topQuote: They spent the rest of the day replacing a sewer main. Work done with great care. Fixed every problem in a single day.

toilet.topQuote: Called to have a toilet reseated with new wax ring. Tech stated talking about cutting holes in my ceiling. Price was over $400. I would never hire them.

faucet-fixture.topQuote: Emergency shut off valves, connections to fixtures replaced today. Competitively priced, went above and beyond.

They were fast to give a FREE ESTIMATE, they were so much friendlier than the other companies we contacted, and ended up being $1100 less than the other!
They completely fixed a major water leak and replumbed the pipes in the basement ceiling to perfection. Beautiful work. All overhead. In an hour.
Had a leak spring in a ceiling over Thanksgiving, and James came out and helped us out quickly, at a very fair price, and when almost all other plumbers wouldn't be able to help for days.
At every step, they explained what was going on. I could see the work being done with exacting care and each step was laid out so I could understand what they were doing and why.

plumbers.name: Alexander Plumbing Services Inc.
plumbers.address: 3214 Cedar Church Rd, Darlington, MD 21034, USA

reviews.author: Monica Beczkowski
reviews.text: Very pleased with service. Wes did a great job. Highly recommend Alexander Plumbing.

reviews.author: Dino Burner
reviews.text: The technician was very pleasant and thorough.  He unclogged a drain that was clogged approx. 20' down the line.  The price was very reasonable.

reviews.author: Melinda Arnold
reviews.text: Wes was extremely professional and did a wonderful job.  He was a pleasure to have in our house.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Brenda Taylor
reviews.text: Wes and Mike removed my concrete well top and took old neutralizer out of basement. I wasn’t present but was informed  of time frame and arrival time. I like their automated text system for that reason. Mike and I talked and he told me would take a water sample. I just had an expensive new submersible well, water softener and neutralizer system put in by Alexander. Mike  has been right there checking every detail out for he. Oh and about Marc, the owner of the company. He listens and helps you with any plumbing concern. He is awesome businessman. Mike and Wes are the best team to come out to your house! Top notch guys and top notch service!!!! If you want a good honest reputable company contact Axllecander

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.text:
I noticed the pressure gauge in our well system in the basement was continually cycling, indicating there was a leak somewhere.
Alexander Plumbing had  Mike M. ‘on it’
3 hours after I called.
Mike has been here before and _Absolutely knows_ what he’s doing.
He diagnosed the issue, after we discussed the cycling….
He helped me understand one small issue
I had not considered, which is the toilet tanks were over filling, in three separate bathrooms.😔…. That minimal leakage, every 20 minutes or so….was causing the pump to cycle over and again.
Mike  was respectful, focused & professional. Alexander’s has covered us for 30 + years….
Very satisfied customer
TW

reviews.author: Olinda Podgurski
reviews.text:
My first experience with Alexander Plumbing Services they responded within an hour to my emergency call and made the repairs necessary on the spot so I could turn the house water main back on. I especially appreciate the responsiveness, explanation of options, quick work and friendliness of the technician (especially as a first time customer).

My second and more recent experience was just as good.  A next day appointment that luckily was a pretty simple fix to what I worried may be a more serious issue.  Really appreciate the same quick response and honest resolution.

reviews.author: Sarah Spence
reviews.text: We had a great experience from start to finish with Alexander Plumbing. We had our well pump replaced and everything was flawless. It was easy to make the appointment with Amber in the office and I appreciated the follow up reminder texts leading up to the appointment. On day of service, I got a text that the technician, Wes, was on the way. He arrived with a smile and explained the steps he would take to complete the job. He was extremely polite and friendly. I would definitely call Alexander Plumbing again for any work I needed done.

reviews.author: Dave Morrison
reviews.text: We came home from vacation to find we had a pipe leaking somewhere behind a wall. At the recommendation of a friend, we contacted Alexander Plumbing. Their response was fantastic. Mike Moffitt showed up and diligently went through all possibilities and uncovered exactly where the problem was located. Within no time the pin hole size leak was uncovered, repaired and the drywall replaced almost like new. We could not be happier! Much thanks to Mike and Alexander Plumbing for all your help!

reviews.author: Sam Marlow
reviews.text: I was pleased with the prompt response to our service call to have a propane gas line disconnected and capped so we could remove our gas fireplace.  We appreciated the communication and updates from the Alexander Plumbing Services office staff and the plumber, Wes, was nice to talk with and got the job done in short order. They’re at the top of the list for future needs in this category.

reviews.author: James Marshall
reviews.text:
Septic pump issues fixed!! Fast same day service. Knowledgeable and friendly. Ended up just being the system floats. Awesome job!!

Had a leaking pressure tank. Old one was undersized for the home. Tech was knowledgeable and replaced with largest that he could given crawl space is 3ft. Alexander plumbing is simply the best hands down!!

reviews.author: Jack Worrel
reviews.text:
I needed a septic repair because I was selling my home.
Alexander Plumbing Lined up with my septic cleaning company and they both were at my home the next morning.
They fixed the problem in 2 hours and it was very reasonable. I got a receipt emailed to me and the  Closing company the same day.
Great people to work with.
Jack Worrel

reviews.author: Bernard cox
reviews.text: Needed a new water heater. Technician Mike was on time and very nice to me and my family. Replaced  the water heater after giving me the option to have it repaired. Price was cheaper than any other company I had come out for an estimate. Definitely will be using this company for all my plumbing needs in the future.

reviews.author: Lester Picker
reviews.text: Mark was absolutely terrific, as usual. It was an involved plumbing issue. We've had him service our home before. Alexander Plumbing is both very responsive and all their techs have been competent in our experience. A pleasure doing business with them (except for writing the check, of course!).

reviews.author: Lisa Burke
reviews.text: Wes installed tankless water heaters for us and helped clear up an issue with our tub.  He was very personable, punctual and logical in problem solving.  And the office staff was pleasant to deal with.  I would definitely use Alexander Plumbing for any future plumbing issues that arise.

plumbers.address: 16440 Ashland Ave, San Lorenzo, CA 94580, USA

reviews.author: Lia De Tomasi
reviews.text: Great aervice

reviews.author: Kamlesh Ganatra
reviews.text: Tyler, Christian, Mike, Daniel all did excellent job. Thanks for your help!

reviews.author: Froilan Ramos
reviews.text: Fast service, honest and trustworthy

reviews.author: John Karian
reviews.text:
The “hero” assigned to us for an emergency clog said he would be right back after buying some necessary supplies and disappeared for hours.

I,  being confused as to where he went , called the base near the end of day and found out that he was now on another job. The most unprofessional and unethical behavior I have ever seen . Clearly if the job isn’t quick and easy money they just tap out.  Lame. Worst experience with a plumbing company yet.

reviews.author: MS shaik
reviews.text:
Looks like what they have is all paid reviews, there is no way any customer can feel happy about their work and give 5 star review.

I don't have zero star option, otherwise I could have selected that. Don't trust their offers in their web site. I had clogging/drain at washer. Rooer hero sent an agent, first looking at problem he said $77 to snake it and check drain and it's attached a u shaped pipe and to remove that pipe it's $225. I never understand who in this world will have water flowing without pipe connections in the homes. I fixed that myself and allowed him to do the snaking job, he tried for 15 minutes and said there is nothing problem i see but could be something is broken inside. So next option is going with hydrojet which is $1600 cost. I asked can you give assurance that hygrojet fix the issue or don't charge if you can fix the issue. His answer is irrespective of fix/no fix its same charge. So they are looks like just fix basic problems which you can do yourself, don't waster even $1 working with them, they are not worth.

reviews.author: Elise Straub
reviews.text:
My elderly mother called this company for a clogged kitchen sink and mentioned that her garbage disposal was leaking. They replaced the disposal and pipes under the sink and charged her $1,700.

They attempted to snake the line for only a few minutes before saying it could not be cleared. Another worker went under the house and told her the pipes needed to be replaced and gave an estimate of $10,000.

I advised my mother to cancel that work. The next day, we hired a different plumber who snaked the same line for about three hours and fully cleared the clog for $225.

Based on this experience and the huge difference in diagnosis and price, I would not recommend this business to anyone.

reviews.author: Unknown User
reviews.text: Couple days ago my laundry sink wouldn’t drain so I started to google and found them for a quick snake, they sent Jordan a master tech to diagnose my problem. Turns out all this time my underground was filled with roots and had cracks in the old pipes. Yes, nobody wants to hear an issue like that but when you own a property it must be fixed eventually. We agreed on a fair price to get it replaced, it was a headache cause of course it involves money especially in this economy. Hindsight is 2020 I’m glad we had rooter hero to solve our minor problem before it became major. Ask for Jordan he’s super cool and Knowledgeable! The turn around time was quicker then I expected. Thanks again

reviews.author: Justin Mathers
reviews.text: The technician was able to identify and repair the leak with ease.  The reason I gave them 3 stars is because we had to reschedule, so we gave them a call and rescheduled.  Unfortunately when we called, it didn't reach the office that I originally had the schedule with, so we had to reschedule again.  Then after the repair, the technician did not fully clean up after themselves, leaving drywall dust all over our kitchen counter and even left a half full roll of plastic on our kitchen floor.  I just wasn't impressed by the overall lack of communication between their main office and our local office combined with the lack of attention to detail from the tech.

reviews.author: chelseasherman
reviews.text: Rooter Hero Plumbing is professional and responsive over time and has even gotten better over the years. We recently were helped by jed and are So grateful. Jed is highly skilled, professional, and is a clear communicator. He never speaks down to you and puts everything into simple terms. Jed recently went above and beyond on a couple service visits in particular. We will continue to ask for him every time. He has made our experiences with Rooter Hero Plumbing even better and we hope we he will be with them for as long as he likes! Thank you jed!

reviews.author: Trevor Robertson
reviews.text: Complete scam. Two guys came over, looked at our shower drain that was draining slowly, told me to leave the room, and then when I came back in, they said their auger was too big (even though it looked like a 1/4 inch which should fit my drain) and they said that they’d need to bring their supervisor out to do a hydro spray at an extremely jacked up price of $1500-$2000. My hunch is that they advertise cheap drain clearing services, make it worse, and then up sell desperate customers on expensive up charges. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

reviews.author: yvette hills
reviews.text: We called them for a clogged drain.  Not only did they not fix it (still charged us $50), but they told us our pipes were corroded, which would cost 15K to de-scale and line with epoxy (though they kept dropping the price if we wanted to get started the next day)!  We were wary and ended up calling another plumber.  They snaked our drain in less than 10 minutes and said nothing about our pipes being corroded.  Would not recommend.

reviews.author: Yasamine Karimi
reviews.text: Although we are still in the process of our repair our technician Adrian Tellez was probably the best we could get for the job. After searching for some time for a good company to go with we stumbled upon this one. Adrian was honest with the issue and was very helpful. If anyone needs any service through this company then request him. He will ensure the job gets done in the best possible way. :)

reviews.author: Susan Boren
reviews.text: I could not be happier with the professional service I received from Rooter Hero, and specifically Luis Negrete.  He was our first plumber to try to solve our blocked drains.  We ended up needing a whole house repipe, which the team from Rooter Hero did with exceptional knowledge and enthusiasm.  I’m completely satisfied with the job well done!

reviews.author: behnam Sar
reviews.text: I had overflowing at midnight, do I call them and Blake came. He assessed the work and damage, because it was a major problem, he came back at morning with his team to take care of it. They did good job and they could find the problem quickly and fix it. I highly recommend them if you need a professional plumber.

reviews.author: Julie Jackson
reviews.text: Came the next day, cleared  pipes, used a camara to find out our 67 year old pipes were full of holes. Estimate given and scheduled  2 days later to repipe. All done in one day. Inspected and paid for a few days later. Nice workers. Cleaned up after themselves. Decent price. Happy customers.

synthesis.summary: Multiple independent reviewers report a pattern at this Rooter Hero franchise: technicians diagnose simple clogs as requiring expensive pipe replacements ($6K–$15K), then another plumber fixes the same clog for $225–$500. One reviewer was told to leave the room mid-diagnosis; another's tech abandoned the job mid-service. The majority of 5-star reviews appear to be from a single cluster in October 2023, raising authenticity questions. Some genuine positive experiences exist, but the upsell pattern is well-documented.
strengths: Some individual technicians (Rodolfo, Jordan, Jedidiah) praised for thorough explanations and completing difficult jobs
Faster-than-expected turnaround for straightforward jobs
weaknesses: Multiple reviewers report being quoted $6K–$15K for work that cost $225–$500 with another plumber
Technician abandoned mid-job emergency call to take another job without notice
Cleanup issues — drywall dust left on counters, materials left on floor
redFlags: Documented pattern of diagnosing routine clogs as requiring major pipe replacement, then sharply discounting when customer hesitates
Technician required customer to leave room during diagnosis — followed by a dramatically inflated upsell quote
Plumber abandoned an emergency job without informing customer, who found out by calling the office

plumbers.address: 4400 Pecan Ln SE, Acworth, GA 30102, USA

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.text: This was the best experience I’ve had with a plumber, hands down. Communication was excellent throughout. Brandon Smith identified the problem quickly, provided great service, and explained things each step of the way. He is a talented service provider and exceptional communicator. Kudos to Brandon and the entire team.

reviews.author: BARBARA
reviews.text: Anthony Sr. Came out to diagnose our plumbing problem and he did a phenomemol job, he was timely and professional 👏  so happy with the outcome! The fee was super reasonable! I will highly recommend Tony to everyone!

reviews.author: Ron Blanken
reviews.text:
This is a great company to deal with they showed fast to find the problem with my septic tank and came back quickly to make repairs.
Brandon Smith and Ricky did an amazing job of digging up the drain line making repairs without damaging my fence and cleaning up.
Thank you guys for doing a great job.

reviews.author: Jason Frost
reviews.text: One star! Needed a 3ft piece of PVC going to my septic tank. Got a $1200 quote. Told plumber no thanks and he left. I dug out the pipe and repaired it in less than 3 hours and $20 of pipe.

reviews.author: Heather F.
reviews.text: I have been using company for several years. They have repaired a seal on shower drain twice that leaked through downstairs ceiling and other plumbing repairs. The leak happened again and called to discuss getting a repairman but wanted to check warranty. The representative told me that she has no record of the repair, only the service call and notes stating that we would repair ourselves. After several minutes of discussing if it would beneficial for me to pull my records, I realized I was getting nowhere. I told the representative that I will no longer be using company and she said, "Thanks, that is awesome!"

reviews.author: Brookie Weeks
reviews.text:
I called Serv'All first this time!!  (See my review below fom 7 months ago.) I echo the same Five Star rating for today's service call. Brandon Smith, who was very professional, courteous and efficient at locating the source of the leak, explaining the problem and making necessary repairs, did a great job! Thanks also to Kelly, who was very understanding of my problem when I called, working me into their schedule around my scheduled medical appointment today, and keeping me updated. I could not ask for a better company to deal with!

7 months ago:
I give this company 5 stars all the way from the person who took my original call, then the tech, Chris Beach, who called  me back within an hour or so and set up a next day appointment, and until the job was finished!
Out of 5 plumbing services I called, Serv'All was the only one to reply in a timely manner. My home is 55 years old.  I had a leak between a wall downstairs, an upstairs dripping bathtub faucet which would been very costly to replace, and a lavatory faucet replacement.  I can't say enough about Chris. He arrived on time, was very efficient in locating the source of the leak within the wall, and repaired it with minimal repair required, rebuilt the tub faucet, replaced the lavatory faucet, and cleaned up well after all the jobs. My son has always taken care of most of my home repairs until until his current health issues. When I told him my regular plumber and the others I found online hadn't replied, he remembered Randall (Dixie Septic Tank Service) mentioning Serv'All when they were doing some tank work for both of us.  He gave me their number which I called, and am very glad I did!

reviews.author: Peter Masha
reviews.text: So grateful to Sean and Brandon and Colby of Serv'All Plumbing! We ran into a situation over the weekend where water was flooding our basement… When I called, they immediately let me know the standard up charges for an emergency call on a weekend call and since the situation was somewhat under control, we chose to wait till Monday for them to come out here Though they originally quoted me Lower price it was very quickly obvious that the work has moved on the original, but because they shared with me every moment what was going on what problems they were facing what courses of action they would have to take to figure out the next step I felt in control the whole way! So when the cost came in at the end, they were very upfront and work to bring the cost down and then when I was still struggling with the ability to pay they provided Option to defer payment for 12 months, which is the difference between us having a merry Christmas or not! So I have now a clean house and a possibility of a merry Christmas because of their hard work! They were prompt, knowledgeable, effective honest and clean! I couldn't ask more from a plumber! Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jazmin D.
reviews.text:
We had an emergency situation where our main line was completely backed up, causing our basement toilet and tub to overflow into the carpet—basically making it impossible to use any water in the house. We couldn’t run a sink, take a shower, or flush a toilet without everything backing up. It was a nightmare.

The plumbers came out quickly and were absolutely amazing from start to finish. They communicated clearly, explained exactly what the main issue was, and were honest about what would need a long-term repair later. Even so, the work they did today helped us tremendously and allowed us to start using our home’s utilities again right away.

They spent about three hours fixing the problem and their pricing was beyond fair—no overcharging, no surprise fees, nothing. Just honest, quality work. We are extremely grateful for their professionalism, transparency, and the relief they brought us in such a stressful situation. Highly recommend them to anyone needing reliable and trustworthy plumbing services!

reviews.author: Andrew Huggins
reviews.text:
We've been using Serv'All Plumbing for the last 8 year - 2x different homes. They're the only plumbing company we will allow in our house. We had a leak the was dumping water into our basement on Sundsy and Serv-All had Anthony dispatched to the house quickly. Anthony had boot covers so he didn't track anything in the house, jumped the issues and resolved it. I had thought this repair would cost far more than it ended up costing - needless to say I was very pleased when I saw the bill.  Serv'All is hands-down the most trustworthy plumbing company I have ever dealt with.
I should note that I'm always cautious to have any contractor come to our house when Im not home as I have a wife and 3yr old daughter. Whether its Anthony or Chris - I feel more than comfortable not being home when they're working on the house. Give them a call!

reviews.author: Jennifer R.
reviews.text:
We cannot say enough good things about Serv'all and their staff. 

My elderly father lives in Acworth and had a plumbing issue. The first company we called wanted to do $3,000 of UN-NEEDED work and were horrible. 

We called up Serv'all and spoke to Jennifer in the office. What a professional, nice lady! 

She promptly sent out Donnie and Chris. They are amazing workers! They were prompt, courteous and professional. 

They were able to work with my Dad on his repair and got it done in 2 1/2 hours for a 10th of the price that he had been quoted by the other guys! We are so pleased with their work and ethics. They have lifelong customers with our family!

reviews.author: H J
reviews.text:
Serv'all's Plumbing Technician, Brandon, arrived at our home promptly and professionally, on a Saturday evening when we experienced a failed water pressure valve. He was patient, took all aspects of the issue into account, including safety, and then formulated a plan for resolution. His work was executed thoroughly and with precision.
Serv'all was recommended to us by a neighbor and has an excellent rating with the Better Business Bureau.
We experienced Serv'all's first rate work, professionalism, and diligence to complete each job to the highest standard, thanks to Brandon.
Thank you Serv'all!

reviews.author: Corrie Jamison
reviews.text: Anthony was great. Quick repair and cleaned up nicely. Appreciate the good work! Follow up-our initial pin hole leak in our copper pipes led us to decide to do a whole house re-pipe. It was a big project that took about a week with the plumbing and we chose to have them also handle the drywall repair. Brandon was the project lead and did a great job of keeping us in the loop of everything going on and ensuring we were satisfied. I totally trust Serv'all with all of our plumbing needs. It is nice to have someone we can trust, is always quick to respond, and completes a job well done. Thank you!

reviews.author: Melissa Brock
reviews.text:
Standards Professionalism & Integrity!!!
Prompt service next day!
Informational on all completed work & product detail.

- Your Employee saved my entire Home Structure on the response of his actions, as I wouldn't have a House to call Home as of date.
God Bless this young man and his actions to respond to the Fire on my Property as he was working/installation of Service.
100% with Complete Service
Upfront from start to finish!
Highly recommend!

Bless Your Company Service & the Employee whom saved my Structure on my Property upon completion of the service I requested

reviews.author: Patricia R.
reviews.text:
This company has a good rating for their job performance.  Well my experience doesn't support a 5 star rating.  In fact, Serv'all deserves a zero from me.  
Their employee, C.B., came into my home and took care of a few things but failed to completely turn the water off under the sink.  As a result, I had $2600
 of damage. Serv'all REFUSED to accept any responsibility for the damage. So I was out $2,000.
This company was recommended to me by a friend which I realize now means nothing.  Sadly, It's really difficult to find a business that is honest in metro Atlanta.

reviews.author: Janice Strong
reviews.text:
Sean Oliver from Serv’All Plumbing was sent out to our home because of an extremely loud banging come from our water tank 😩. He was on time! polite, mellow tempered and seemed to know what he was talking about. *He loved our dog BabyGirl 🤪🥰* He had to turn back on and adjust the temperature of our water heater. He did something I could have done from a YouTube video, but it seemed too dangerous to even touch so the $75+ fee was worth having a professional come help! I will save their number for the future!

The Strong Family

reviews.author: Betsy Wassilak
reviews.text: This review is long overdue. We have used Flotek for a couple years now and in a couple houses. They are always very responsive. Of course things always seem to happen over the weekend. No problem with Flotek. They always respond and will even let you know if it is urgent or can wait. They have replaced an ejector pump, removed an old battery back up and replaced our toilet fill valve and flapper. They seem reasonably priced but I am a believer in sometimes you get what you pay for! Professional and friendly service every time! Thanks Henry and Gabriel!

reviews.author: Cheryl Taylor
reviews.text: A backup in the sewage pipes at my place of business left my customers without a bathroom. I called Flotek at 9:00 a.m., the problem was cleared up by noon the same day! They were happy to speak with my septic guy to gather all info beforehand and find the best solution to my problem. Prices were given ahead of time. Very nice guys, will use again- but hopefully not too soon ;)

reviews.author: Joe Kuryla
reviews.text: I just had a water softener replaced, and about a year ago I had a water heater replaced in the winter around the holidays.  High quality work, easy to get scheduled, great products, and reasonable prices.  Flotek has become my go-to company for plumbing work.

reviews.author: J Matthews
reviews.text: We hired Flotek Plumbing to replace a hot water heater, install a garbage disposal, run a new water line for our refrigerator, and install a new primary sump pump along with a battery backup.  Flotek was very professional and responsive from the initial meeting for the estimate through the completion of the project.  They were prompt and came prepared.  They completed all the work in one day.  Once the installations were complete, Gabriel spent some time going over everything with me.  I have to say, the quality of their sump pumps is fantastic, they are very quiet.  All in all I highly recommend Flotek for any plumbing needs you may have.

reviews.author: victor Vukovich
reviews.text:
Our toilet would not drain properly.
Upon arrival, Gabriel quickly confirmed the main line was clogged.
Wrote up a proposal and explained in detail what was wrong and what needed to be done. No BS. No extraneous explanation.

Yes, an expensive repair but the pricing was fair and the tech was HIGHLY professional and thorough. Plus, per our request, Flotek arrived within less than an hour after we called.

Their consistently professional service, transparent pricing, and ability to handle both emergency repairs and complex installations make them a strong choice for urgent plumbing needs.

reviews.text: Superior Plumbing and Brian are the ABSOLUTELY the best… Brian came and analyzed my entire bathrooms’ plumbing fixtures and gave me all of my options. I truly appreciate both Vicky and Brian helping me through this process.  Superior is my “go to” for all of my plumbing needs.  A wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Hunter Wells

Jeff came over within 15 minutes to help shut off the water and had a crew come in early the next morning. Absolutely wonderful experience with a fast response, good pricing, and a great set of employees that helped identify and repair the issues with the piping.

reviews.author: Troy Jones

From the first call to the last they were professional, transparent and on-time!  Highly encourage this company for any of your plumbing needs!!  - The Swampy Dog bar+social

reviews.author: Christy Sanders Sarti
reviews.text:
My husband and I highly recommend this company.
Our hot water heater was leaking so we had Superior Plumbing come out to look at it. We have used them before and were really happy with their service. Again, they did not disappoint. Even calling to set up a day and time is so easy and the lady I talked to is such a sweet person. The two service guys ( sorry I’m horrible with names) are so professional and go over anything and everything so there are no surprises. They kept us well informed through the whole process. They never make you feel that they are just trying to take  your money or do any unnecessary work just to up the bill. They actually make you feel that they care and take pride in what they do.

reviews.author: mark cichy
reviews.text:
The Hansen technician, Bruce, called ahead and arrived on time to replace old water heater. They were very careful of home walls, etc... in swapping out the old and bringing in the new heater to basement. I had some additional shut off valves put in for fridge and furnace humidifier. They did a great job per my final inspection. Both gentlemen were very polite and eager to answer all my questions. We plan to use them again come fall of 2026 to replace our basement ejector pump.
Mark & Deb C. Hampshire, IL

reviews.author: Jim Bockmier
reviews.text: They were just the best ever. Our furnace was emitting a weird smell. Secondary heating exchange failed. We were extremely lucky that Hansen’s was so thorough in their diagnostic skills. Gave us multiple options, explained what had gone wrong and showed us, cleaned up after themselves and were very pleasant. They stayed until 8:45 to complete the job. Everything was done expertly at a fair price and major repair completed in one day so that we did not go without heat on a cold winter night

reviews.author: Suzy Q
reviews.text: You can always count on Hansen Heating & Plumbing for quality work and fair pricing. I’ve been their customer for over 10 years and fully trust what they diagnose as the problem. They provide complete estimates, quick response, and have kept my 50-year old home safe from water damage that can lead to even more costly repairs.

reviews.author: Geoff Yu
reviews.text:
Horrible business. Expensive and don't back their own work. Had a backup and they were supposed to address the issues permanently. The exact issue happened again about 40 days later and they told us they only warranty their work for 30 days. A waste $715. The gentlemen on the phone was also rude and impatient when we called back.

The techs were not through, skilled, and definitely not professional. Even paid extra for the useless inspection camera and they were unable to locate the clog or issue.

Hansen should be ashamed of themselves. Don't spend your hard earned money on this company. Plenty of decent plumbers out there.

reviews.author: Okta Viandi d.r

reviews.author: Stacey T.
reviews.text: This company is extremely responsive, provided excellent service and their pricing is reasonable.

reviews.author: Lance Spalding
reviews.text: Tyree missed finding the problem the first time he came on Wednesday morning and thought it was an HVAC issue.  The HVAC person came 6 hours later and found the general area of the water leak, so I called you back.  Tyree came back yesterday afternoon and was reluctant to try to find the source of the water leak suggesting that we consider hiring a leak detection service.  I rejected that and asked him to try to find it.  He tried to find it but couldn't and asked the restoration crew to expose the pipe upstairs and left.  In an attempt to remove the vanity, they broke the stone.  They were able to find the leak in the area he had worked on initially.  They were just more skilled and more motivated.  They have arranged for another plumber to come and fix the leak.  I was not happy with Tyree.

reviews.author: Katherine Pfohl
reviews.text: I called on Monday (a holiday) and Matt came out the next day.  My disposal would not run, just hummed.  Matt suggested a few remedies to save me a plumbing call, but they didn’t work.  So, he came, gave me an estimate to replace (motor was shot), and worked hard to work with my unusual plumbing configuration.  He was kind, respectful, knowledgeable, and patient with my questions.  He worked hard and explained the problems he encountered.  I can’t say enough what a positive experience this was, even with all the difficulties he had working with my plumbing.  He never lost his cool with me or the task at hand.  Thank you Matt!  And thank you 100% Plumbing!

reviews.author: Susanna A.
reviews.text: Everything posted about this company is true: amazing customer service, hard working people, detailed estimate, recommended options, all great. So great that we came back to them within a month of installing our tankless water heater and asked for the whole house filtration without getting quotes from other companies. Matt coordinated all the work related to tankless and Josh was our contact for water system & reverse osmosis. We are so happy we found a plumbing company that really cares about customers and treats them as a family (their words but we sign off as this is true). It makes it so much easier for the homeowner to have a trustworthy partner!

reviews.author: Chris Quinn
reviews.text: What a lifesaver!! I contacted 100 Percent Plumbing after not getting responses from other companies.  They not only responded (I am one of the unlucky ones still without power) after the ice storm to help me turn off water that I couldn’t reach, they came early!!  SO NICE too.  Price was reasonable—no gouging during the storm emergency.  When I asked if it would be easy for me to get the water back on once power was restored he said, you have my number, just give me a call.  For the first time in days, looking for hotel rooms, flashlights, sand for the ice, etc. to have such a positive experience was wonderful.

reviews.author: Mary Day Couch
reviews.text: Nick Standal of 100% Plumbing heeded our service call earlier today.  He immediately arrived and replaced our condensing pump in the dehumidifier located in the home crawlspace. Mr. Standal also identified the problems with our washing machine leaking from the pipes, in the garage. He recommended corrective actions, and committed to perform said actions if we are not made whole from the previous installation company.  His knowledge, courtesy and spirit of helpfulness is to be commended.  We are truly grateful to 100% Plumbing and Nick Standal for their ability to rectify our plumbing issues.  Chief Harold Couch

reviews.author: Steven F.
reviews.text:
I had a few plumbing jobs that had been building up and hired 100 percent plumbing to do it.  They sent a tech by the name of Nick, he put in a new pressure regulator, and added a shut off valve to my unit with an automated water shutoff system so if I get a leak when we are not home the house won't flood.  

Nick was on time, communicated well with their app.  He made sure I was 100% happy before he left and their pricing was reasonable.  I saved their number for the future.  You never know what you're going to get when finding someone online (especially these days) but I was pleasantly surprised here!

All in all, a very efficient and excellent job.  The guys were professional and friendly with very helpful hints and recommendations abut fixing our drains problem,  Impressive and we highly recommend 100% Plumbing. They even stayed much later than expected while we waited for the city water folks to fix something (not at all 100%'s fault), to make sure we could turn our water back on. We would absolutely recommend this team and will definitely be using them for any future plumbing needs!

Just wishes us a good night. 

Absolutely incredible businessman and human being. My favorite experience.

Your technician, Tyree, was amazing—very knowledgeable, professional, and thorough. He took great care of everything, answered all of my questions, and walked me through the work he was doing, which I really appreciated.

Matt was also incredibly kind and helpful. I truly appreciate you all and the great service you provided
Charlotte smith

I have nothing but good things to say about Coleman and the work his crew does. Their pricing was straightforward and the prompt professionalism was above and beyond.

I felt it was a fair price and asked them when they could come back and then offered to do it right then and there!  Could not have asked for a better experience.  Highly recommend.

reviews.text: I highly recommend Ability Septic. They did a great job. They were timely, polite, and knowledgeable. reviews.text:
Just put a call into Ability and they are running 100% for answering the phone with a speaking, helpful human being.
IMAGINE THAT!
Ability installed a new system for us last fall, upgraded the tank size and discharge piping (an old tech pipe material was near failure..good catch by them) and I needed to get a bead on the first pump out timing.

reviews.author: Terrie Munsey
reviews.text: Lieber Mechanical is now my GO TO COMPANY for HVAC and Plumbing. I was absolutely impressed by Lieber Mechanical's employees. They were honest, hard working and never gave up. Scott worked very hard to get my tankless water heater going. He had to replace the primary heat exchanger and several other parts. He had to order the heat exchanger from Navien which took a couple of days. The first day it took 3 hours, but they only charged a 1 time service fee of $99. I upgraded to a 1 year service contract. The service contract included the service fee, 15% off of services + flushing my tank again in the next 6 to 12 months. It paid for it self on this one repair and I still get a no cost tank flush. Scott returned 2 days later as soon as the recieved the primary heat exchanger. He removed & replaced it, but said he still needed an igniter. Unfortunately, it stopped working again before he could make it back out. I didn't have hot water for several days because of Thanksgiving holidays. No problem though I have a shower in my barn. So, I didn't call them to request an emergency visit. Scott returned for the 3rd time monday morning with the igniiter. It only took a few minutes, but it still would not ignite. After, Scott spent a long time diagnosing why it still would not ignite. He found a tube was blocked by a cap he accidently left in. He was very honest told me what happened. Immediately called his supervisor and told them what happend. He was so apologetic and asked what he could do the make things right. I told him I was just happy he fixed it. He was ready to go above and beyond to make up for a minor mistake. Unlike others who would have tried to cover up their mistake and probably added mored charges to my bill. There were no additional charges. His honesty was was surprising, but wonderful in a world where prices are high and honestly is not very forth coming. I also want to give a shout out to his assistants Brock and Stephen 2 super nice guys. And I want to thank Hillary who took my calls and quickly dispatched Scott the same day I called both times. reviews.text: Came out to the house New Year's Eve. Very professional and knowledgeable. Awesome service will use this company again.

reviews.author: Millie Brown
reviews.text:
After my plumber of whom I’ve used personally and for my business for more than 13 years was a no show , I called Maryland Sewer in the hopes of getting the sewer main snaked as soon as possible. I left a message with the answering service and within 5 minutes I received a call. I spoke with Ronnie, explained what was going on and he came out immediately to resolve the issue. Ronnie was friendly and thorough to a fault.  What seemingly was a huge challenge initially, didn’t bother him- he kept pressing forward and made it happen. He  took measures to protect my home with tarps and more. He went above and beyond by helping me in removing the drawers to my bathroom vanity so that I could clean the mess up that was underneath from the sewage flooding. In doing so, he found another issue and resolved that as well! I couldn’t be more grateful and thanks to Ronnie, he’s just an all around good guy. reviews.author: Ben Isaacs
reviews.text:
We were in the process of having a bathroom remodeled, and just our luck, our water heater goes out. I was recommended to contact Helton Plumbing by our contractors. I spoke with the owner, Jeremy, who was very helpful in my time of panic. Jeremy was able to give me the information about upgrading to different types of water heaters: tankless, tanked and power vent. What I appreciated was the upfront tasks required to install each one, as well as the pros and cons of each unit. We ended up going with the Navian tankless water heater. I've included pictures of the before and after.

Carey was my technician for the project. I cannot say enough about how magnificent Carey was. Answered all my questions, explained the process, gave me insight on the new product (including gas use, electrical use, rebate possibilities, etc). Additionally, Carey completed this entire task by himself, wasting no time to get the project going - it was an all day task. Carey even recommended a type of recirculation valve in the primary bathroom that will help to heat the primary bathroom faster (it is the furthest away from the water heater, so historically the shower took 60+ seconds to get hot). The recirculation valve and new water heater have the primary bathroom hot in under 10 seconds. It is sorcery.

I am very pleased with the service. Words can't explain how much we are enjoying the new water heater and the constant hot water. Also, the floor space that it opened up is monumental too. I will say that to go from a tank to tankless, it is an investment. It is expensive to make the change. It is definitely worth it - high efficient appliance, lower gas bill and constant hot water. We have young children and always worried about those 'hot pockets' of water in a tank water heater burning one of our kids. The tankless is so consistent I wish our Chicago Bears would take note. Overall, couldn't be happier with how it turned out. If you are on the market for a new water heater, consider Helton Plumbing. They fixed my issue entirely in one day!

reviews.author: Georgia Kelly
reviews.text: I came home from vacation to a leaking pipe and puddle of water on the floor. Helton was able to come within a couple of hours. Carey immediately put my mind at ease. He diagnosed the problem and explained it to me with a photo. He gave me an estimate before he began the work. He had everything he needed to replace the cracked piece of pipe and worked efficiently and professionally. He was friendly and courteous. This was the second time I’ve used Helton and have been 100% satisfied. Julie who took my call was great also.

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text:
We have used Helton plumbing many times over the years for various issues (water heater and other pipe related problems)
They always do an excellent job. Yesterday they replaced three toilets in our house. Their tech arrived on time and looked over our problems and gave me two options to solve it. One- to rebuild the toilet ( new parts) or two- to replace the entire fixture. We opted for replacement. He had to pick up the fixtures an hour away and then come back to begin. One man on his own and he removed and replaced all three units in three hours. After removing one of the toilets he found a broken flange that needed replacing. And he was equipped for that too.
He removed the toilets and wrapped each one in plastic so nothing dropped on our floors.
He arrived on time and did the job quickly and cleanly. He took the old toilets and all of the cartons and garbage left over from the install to dispose of. If I could give them more than five stars I would.

reviews.text: We are relatively new to the area and found ourselves in need of a plumber. I like to shop local and found Helton Plumbing had a lot of happy customers. They are extremely knowledgeable, polite, prompt, affordable and the finished job was done to perfection. I will not hesitate to use them again. Thank You Helton for supplying good old fashion customer service

reviews.author: Greg Bowman
reviews.text: We had a sewer back up into our laundry room. I called Alexander Plumbing and they were at our home within the hour! They had the line rodded out and were all done in two hours. AND, they cleaned the floor in the laundry room. Looked like nothing ever happened, all resolved by 11am. I am super thrilled with their work, their character and the decent people they are! Absolutely will call them again - and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Scott Hanssler
reviews.text: Pat is the man, he really came through for me when moving into my new home and had an immediate issue with the hot water heater. Went out of his way to help me over the phone and with a part out of kindness. Not many people/places nowadays would take the time to do this. If I ever have a plumbing issue in the future I’ll only call here.

reviews.author: Marty McGovern
reviews.text: They did a great job; handled all phases of the repair. Explained everything in detail and were prompt  and thorough. We would highly recommend them !

Their technicians are consistently praised for professionalism, thorough explanations, and going above and beyond expectations, making them a reliable choice for urgent plumbing needs.

reviews.author: David Zelken
reviews.text:
We went with HT Strenger to install a new water heater and couldn’t be happier with the work or their competitive pricing. They showed up on time, completed the job efficiently, and left no mess behind. There’s a reason they’ve been around so long and continue to earn excellent reviews.
Friendly, knowledgeable, and professional service—you really can’t go wrong. They’ll definitely be the first call I make the next time we need something done.

reviews.author: Janice Bautista Sassin
reviews.text: We had a very last minute job that needed attention and Brad was there to save the day! We were hosting a large dinner party later in the evening and the HT Strenger team was able to fit us in between jobs. Every company in the area charged ridiculous amount for same day service and their staff wasn't nearly as kind as the folks at HTS. Needless to say, great service, very accommodating folks and professional job well done (all within 25 minutes!). We like problem solvers with service with a smile!

reviews.author: Kevin Cullum
reviews.text: Brad was awesome. He's been to our house multiple times and always handles business well and efficiently. Most recently, he also took a look at our water heater (he was not there to look at it originally) and made a few quick adjustments which were huge. HT Strenger didn't even install the water heater, but Brad went above and beyond to help us out. Really appreciate it and would recommend HT Strenger to anyone.

reviews.author: Arif Ali
reviews.text:
We have used this company for over a decade and I’ve been thoroughly impressed by their service.
I recently had an issue after hours. I received a call back from one of the technicians, Brad within a few minutes of calling the operator. He was able to troubleshoot my FloLogic water shutoff device with just a few questions.  Thanks HT Strenger!

reviews.author: Randi Carlson
reviews.text: I was referred by Cahill since I needed someone out quickly and they were fully booked. When another company refers you that says a lot. HT got someone out super quick, they fixed the issue quickly and my panic was gone quickly!  I definitely recommend HT Strenger and if the needs arises again, I'll definitely use them!

synthesis.summary: HT Strenger is a highly reliable plumbing company with exceptional emergency response and customer service. They consistently deliver fast, professional service with competitive pricing and go above and beyond to help customers, making them an excellent choice for urgent plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Sam Chase
reviews.text:
Quickly fixed a problem behind my shower faucet that a different company cut holes in my ceiling and quoted me 3k needlessly for.
So grateful for Howard and Zach coming out and swiftly and honestly fixing the problem.

reviews.author: Jason Lehner
reviews.text:
We had a significant leak coming from the main in the basement Howard from US Allied came out with an hour to help.  He was able to band aid fix the leak until the correct part can be ordered so it can be replaced properly.  We are super thankful for his friendly, honest professional service we would highly recommend.

Follow up: US Allied came back out Monday morning as promised to replace the valve where the main comes into the house.  Kyle did an amazing job he was informative, fast and super funny.  Kyle is super friendly type of guy he is the kinda guy you wanna go and crack open a beer with after work just a great attitude. He explained everything he was going to do in detail so there wouldn't be any surprises.  He even took the time to replace a spigot for me while he was here.  Amazing job I stick by my statement I would highly recommend

reviews.author: Matthew Pronger
reviews.text:
Knowledgeable and professional, the plumber, first of all, brought his own boot covers to protect my home. Next, he performed a timely assessment and provided me with the issue and the repair cost before he did anything else. He also provided me with a replacement option.
During the replacement, he was respectful of my home, my budget and my dog. (My dog loved the attention) The work was clean,  time efficient and cost effective.
Thank you, US Allied. We've never had so much hot water. I will definitely use you again.

reviews.author: Mr. MKETHPN Hills
reviews.text: Kyle did an excellent job and provided a thorough overview of what needed to be repaired. More importantly, he provided a competitive price that exceeded my expectations. I will definitely keep US Allied Plumbing and HVAC stored for future repairs and consultation.

reviews.author: Steven Zink
reviews.text: Alex did an excellent job!  Positioned the new water heater so that the controls would be accessible, added vertical run in the vent line for improved draft, added an expansion tank, explained very clearly what routine maintenance is recommended.  Looking forward to the next project with US Allied!

reviews.author: Jessie Xenakis
reviews.text: We had a plumbing backup and subsequent leaking under our house which we wanted addressed quickly. We called Roto-Rooters and they sent their technician, Rick, out within a couple of hours. He was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable and professional. He diagnosed our issues and fixed them right away! We’d definitely call them again for any needed repairs in the future.

reviews.author: dino graniello
reviews.text: Rich is super easy to work with and professional!

reviews.author: Jason Reimann
reviews.text: I had a backed up main sewer line that has caused a major plumbing issue in my home. Both the technician and field supervisor were very knowledgeable and professional. The were thorough with addressing the problem and able to explain what was happening as well as my options in a way that was clear and understandable.

reviews.author: johnny nguyen
reviews.text: Even they don’t give me invoice, I tried to them so many times, but no result

reviews.author: N S
reviews.text:
AMAZING SERVICE! Had a random emergency issue in my home today (renter) and after contacting the company, a team of 3 arrived in less than an hour.

It was a big job - but the three workers came, listened, assessed thoroughly, and got right to work.

In the process, two toilets had to be taken out, sewage/water that flooded into two of the showers had to be vacuumed out, lines/pipes had to be cleared out, and all effected areas needed to the be cleaned up afterwards (which was a lot to clean up).

They worked their butts off for hours until everything was done, no complaints or breaks (even though I could tell it was very tiring).

They worked together without issue, communicated throughout (with me and my landlord both/they worked out payment etc with him over the phone for me) and were all super friendly and down to earth as well, which made the whole experience way less stressful.

The company will also be sending another team member out in a couple days to inspect and mar a plan to fix any potential damage as a result of today’s issue if needed.

****TERRENCE, AMAD, and MATT were the 3 workers who did the job today****
Y’all rock!

Thanks again!!

P.S - I do have one small suggestion for management though.

For emergency issues that happen to fall on weekends and that might require someone to come out and inspect for damage AFTER a situation like mine (from water damage) -

Having whatever general documents your company requires the customer/owner to sign before someone can be sent out to do a post inspection - readily available somewhere for them to access and get signed as soon as possible without having to wait until a weekday/when office opens again would be really helpful and avoid any delays.

In my case it’s Saturday, so I’ll wait until Monday, but would have liked that to be done today. It’s not a huge deal, Monday is okay too! But just a suggestion!

Again thank you for the amazing service!!!

reviews.author: Alyssa G
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was AMAZING!!! We needed assistance in installing a drain pan for a washer that needed to be connected to a pipe. Within the hour of calling, the technician Francisco arrived and was a class act! He helped my husband move the washer and then took it from there. The difficult part was getting the exact measurements so that we can fit our new washing machine in the drain pan due how our laundry room is set up. Francisco not only installed our new drain pan, but removed the old one and hauled it away for us. Previously before finding Roto-Rooter we called 9 different companies/small business technicians to see who can help us and wanted our business, however no one was helpful unless you purchased a product from them OR they flat out didn’t want to do it…..so thank you so much Roto-Rooter and the technician Francisco for helping us!!!

reviews.author: ma c
reviews.text:
Rich, from Roto-Rooter, just cleaned out our main drain in the front yard. What a nice gentleman. He did a wonderful job, cleaned up the mess that the plugged-up drain left behind. He was conscientious, professional and made sure that the drain was completely unclogged. I am very satisfied and glad that I chose Roto-Rooter.

Roto-Rooter also sent a second person, Jason, to run a camera down the drain to make sure that the drain was cleared to my satisfaction; it was.

Finally, Roto-Rooter had a $100.00 coupon that I could use, making the job very affordable. I will definitely use Roto-Rooter again.

reviews.author: Sam Goldhaber
reviews.text:
Richard service technician 7280 from Roto-Rooter's team made the experience of getting plumbing done at my home painless.
Additionally he spent the extra effort and time to explain the service he provided.

Roto-Rooter isn't the cheapest option in the Bay area but the service quality provided by this individual made it worth the investment and he worked with me to find a price that I could agree on.

I hope someone at his company is able to read this review because it was absolutely his work and professionalism that made me decide to say yes to the service as well as satisfied upon its completion.

reviews.author: Heather Johnson
reviews.text: Rich saved the day when our shower was backing up and found the culprit in a massive hair ball! He was patient, customer service oriented and very courteous as he releived us of our bezoar burden. He answered all of our questions and spent the necessary time ensuring the job was done right. We consulted a couple of other companies first and ultimately we are so glad we went with Rich and Roto Rooter because the service and price were impeccable. Thanks Rich, you rock!

reviews.author: Megan Coughlin
reviews.text: I had two issues and was unable to find an explanation or any solutions. During an estimate visit, I was given a good description of both issues and instructions on how to resolve them and keep future problems from happening. This was exceptional handling of the situation from my tech, Rich. He also pointed out an issue with outside faucets in my townhouse complex and gave me all the instructions for how this can be resolved before a problem happens!

reviews.author: Josh McCormick
reviews.text: I own a small business and had a plumbing problem that was going to potentially result in closing my business in order to get it resolved. Terrence arrived shortly after I called, quickly diagnosed the problem, and resolved it in less than an hour. I’m extremely appreciative for the quick, thorough, and definitive fix, as well as his professionalism and kind demeanor. Terrence was fantastic and I’m very appreciative. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: PD Wanjari
reviews.text:
We had an emergency kitchen sink drain problem, and on a friend's recommendation, decided to call Roto Rooter. Within the next 2 hours they were at my place working.

The work was prompt and to satisfaction. Apart from that, Richard, out technician, shared several tips to ensure longevity of pipes. Overall, when it's plumbing, I think I need not see elsewhere, but Roto Rooter.

Highly recommend the company, and Richard, in specific.

reviews.author: Derrick M.
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Terrence! Incredibly professional, well spoken, knowledgeable, and an excellent communicator. He was upfront about everything, and explained his process before he got to work. He was able to get the main pipe cleared out for us quicker than the UFC fight I watched while he worked his magic! I’ll definitely be a return customer for a long time to come. Great work Terrence, and thank you again brother.

reviews.author: Dana Holliday
reviews.text: Rich, the technician that came to the house at 10pm on a Sunday night was super quick, friendly, knowledgeable and resolved the issue. We had a block in our sewer line that led to water coming out of our downstairs shower and flooding the bathroom. Appreciate roto rooters speed to action and ability to quickly resolve the issue.

reviews.author: Susan Bradley
reviews.text: Terrence was so knowledgeable, kind and helpful! I had never had anything like this happen at my home and he was reassuring and confident in getting it done. He always had a smile on his face and was extremely capable! He truly is an asset to roto rooter! Thank you Terrence for making a not great situation fell not that bad :)

reviews.text: Justin was so awesome, helpful, and super informative.

reviews.author: JaKayla Caprice
reviews.text:
Justin was fantastic! He took the time to educate us on where our water meter is located, how to check it, and how to properly turn off the water valve. He was extremely helpful and quickly identified the source of the leak. After receiving outrageous quotes from several other companies just to locate the issue, it was such a relief to have someone diagnose and fix the problem the very same day.

10/10 — highly recommend! Be sure to ask for Justin if you want excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Mariah Mitchell
reviews.text: Thanks Steven for installing my new water heater.

reviews.author: Charles Barclay
reviews.text:
Greetings!
I used High Priority to help find the source of a leak. I’m very thankful that High Priority sent Devin to assist. When Devin came to my home, he told me how he usually troubleshoots in order to determine the source of a leak. He also told me some of the steps had he already taken before entering my home. Devin then went to each faucet and toilet of my home and very carefully figured out the source(s) of the leak. What I appreciate the most about Devin was his willingness to explain (and sometimes re-explain) how to identify the source(s) of a leak and how to fix the issue(s). He even showed me how to replace a flapper. I’m really grateful for Devin’s service today (02/16/2026). He did a sterling job!

reviews.author: Bravo Charlie
reviews.text:
Highly professional and thorough service.

Steven communicated when he would be here and arrived on time, punctuality is huge plus.

At each step in the investigation and repair of our leak, Steven asked if we had questions. He talked us through the "how" and "why" of each step in the process.

The thorough review of our plumbing and attention to detail, highlighted another issue that we will be working with High Priority plumbing to fix. Again, he displayed high levels of communication and professionalism.

We ended with a clear plan for the next step to correct our plumbing problems. I would highly recommend High Priority Plumbing and specifically Steven for future use.

reviews.author: Gabrielle Washington
reviews.text: Plumbing issues is never something you want to have to deal with. Yet it’s easier to deal with when you have someone who’s willing to see your issues out before saying no or direct you to someone else that may waste your time. Aaron was prompt, professional and transparent with expectations. His approach to this problem made it less stressful. I’m grateful a solution was provided, the effort and patience is key to why I’ll continue to do business with this company! Thank you

reviews.author: Ang
reviews.text: Mr. Darren from the Acworth location, for my AHS appt, he came and took care of 3 or 4 plumbing issues for me, I forgot to add 1 thing. He took a look at it anyway, it was an electrical issue instead and he could not help.  But that it did not stop him form wanting to do the repair when I forgot to add it to my list.  That is a Great Contractor in my book, not just a good contractor.  Thank you Mr Darren, you are lucky to have him Priority Plumbing!!!***

reviews.text: My experience with High Priority Plumbing was excellent!  Aaron was very courteous,  knowledgeable and professional.  He explained what was happening with my hot water heater and recommended for it to be replaced.  Upon his return to install my new hot water heater, he explained exactly what he would be doing during the installation.  I am very pleased with this company! Aaron is the best!!  American Home Shield got one right!!

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.text:
I’ve been in the construction industry for 26 years and am a licensed General Contractor, so I don’t give praise lightly.

Steven was outstanding—professional, knowledgeable, and clear in explaining the issues and solutions. He quickly identified what needed to be done and helped move the repairs forward. Based on my experience, he’s easily in the top 1% of vendors I’ve worked with.

Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Buck
reviews.text: Priority Plumbing did a great job again! Justin came by and replaced my sewage ejector pump fast and professionally. He showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and made sure the job was done right before he left. The whole process was smooth, clean, and stress-free. I really appreciate the quality work and great customer service—highly recommend Priority Plumbing and Justin for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Rebecca Camon
reviews.text: Shoutout to Jordan Harrington! He is professional and kind. I have had him on two occasions. The worst one was whenI had a real bad clog in my sink. It had my house smelling so terrible for days. The guys came out and were very professional. They unclogged my sink and told me what I did wrong so I can do better. Great service. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Allek S
reviews.text: Aaron was phenomenal. high priority was contracted through my home warranty, which can be hit or miss. Aaron took the time to diagnose, explain the issues and next steps through the lens of my warranty, and resolved the main issue within one visit, while flagging other suggested services to optimize plumbing given the age of my appliances.

reviews.author: Denise Picus
reviews.text: Great customer service! Steven did a thorough job determining the source of our leak which was coming from our master shower valve & was not a pipe. He replaced the shower cartridge which fixed the problem. We did, however, have to involve a water restoration company to assess the water damage in the crawlspace. Steven did a great job!

reviews.author: Willingham Family
reviews.text: David went above and beyond to make sure our problem was solved, even going to get a part we needed that was non-standard.  David was professional, thorough,  and provided superior expertise. I would trust him with any complex plumbing issues and recommend him and High Priority Plumbing with the highest possible rating!

reviews.author: Elissa Oshinski
reviews.text: Great experience overall! Communication was clear and easy, and the technician, David, was super friendly and professional. He fixed my hot water heater quickly (within his control) and did excellent work. Everything was explained well and left clean afterward. I’d definitely recommend them and would use them again.
