reviews.author: Liz Matiacio
reviews.text: I had a clog in the bathroom which plugged up the shower, toilet, and tub on one side of the house. The two young men who came to help me were kind, patient, polite, and not deterred by some extra challenges. They started with a 25 foot snake, but had to then use a longer one. They first found a small hex tool in the drain. Then they continued to look for the actual clog. It took a few hours but they found it, and it was stubborn. These two guys just kept working at it until it finally broke apart. They maintained a sense of humor. I thought the price was extremely reasonable. I would highly recommend 5 Starr Plumbing and these two guys without hesitation and with a lot of praise for a challenging job well done.

reviews.author: James Conley
reviews.text: I don’t write post often but feel compelled to share my experience with Five Star Plumbing.     I had a water line leak originating from the outside and leaking into my basement. Unfortunately, my home warranty company nor home owners insurance company covered the repair. This turned out to be a significant out of pocket expense. I called several big named companies and was met with broken promises and quotes between $7,300.00 and $8,300.00 being the highest. Something inside of me told me to keep looking for a better deal. I ran across Five Star Pluming online and gave them a call. It was a Sunday morning. I spoke with Chris who said they could repair my leaking line on Tuesday morning. I appreciated the honesty. The big companies said they could do the job the same day, only to come up with excuses. I reluctantly asked Chris how much the job will cost. The quote Chris gave me was thousands less. The quote included replacing all plumbing leading to the county meter inside. No other company offered this as part of their quote. Five Star Plumbing arrived on time and did an awesome job as promised for thousands of dollars less. Did I mention Five Star guaranteed the water line for 10 years? If you want a job done right, honesty upfront and a fair price, chose Five Star Plumbing.

reviews.author: Melissa Bettinger
reviews.text: They replaced a water main line for us. I called someone was out the same day to give me an estimate. Way below what I had received from other major plumbing businesses. They were here the next morning did the job quickly, efficiently and cleaned up afterwards. Will definately use them again.

reviews.author: Donald Littleton
reviews.text: Company charged me $606 for a garbage disposal replacement. The badger 5 cost $114 ! This is grossly overpriced for a 30 minute job. I contacted the owner, he refunded me $60. He said his overhead contributed to the cost although he claims to be a small business owner. Further I contacted 3 other local plumbing companies, they quoted me $306, $359, and $399. Simply unacceptable! Beware. Please get 3 quotes before using this company. Very unprofessional to say the least.

reviews.author: Yungjin Kim
reviews.text:
We recently completed two projects with Five Star, including the replacement of the water line between the main shutoff valve and the house. The cost and quality of their service for that work were excellent, and we had no complaints. Based on that experience, I would recommend Five Star for main waterline leak repairs.

During the water line replacement, I also asked Chris about repairing a leaking bathtub faucet. He said they could send another technician the next day to replace the diverter cartridge. The following morning, the technician arrived and, after a quick inspection, provided an estimate of $471 for the repair. He explained that the work required replacing the shower diverter cartridge, consistent with what Chris had mentioned. Although the estimate was higher than I expected, I approved it, assuming the repair might be complex and because the technician was ready to proceed.

After I shut off the main water for him, I took a short break to have a cup of coffee. Before I even finished it, he had completed the replacement and asked me to turn the water back on for a leak test. The technician was very professional, and the repair was completed within about 20 minutes with good results.

However, I felt that $471 was excessive for the level of labor and complexity involved. I later checked the price of the T809206 shower diverter cartridge and found it sells for about $57 at Home Depot, meaning roughly $410 was charged for about 30 minutes of labor. Because Five Star had previously provided fair pricing and excellent service for the main waterline repair, I did not obtain multiple estimates for the bathtub repair—I relied on my loyalty and trust in them. Afterward, I checked with other plumbers and learned that comparable repairs typically range from $250 to $350, including parts.

This experience was a lesson learned: relying on a single provider, even one with whom you have had good experiences, may not always result in fair pricing. It is always best to obtain multiple estimates before making a decision, regardless of prior loyalty.

reviews.author: Kayla F
reviews.text:
I could've sworn I'd left my review already but it seems I haven't.
Five star came out back in July to repair our main line sewer pipe because it had collapsed. From start to finish they were excellent. They explained everything in a way we could understand, showed us the video footage and did a great job getting it repaired. They had to dig a massive hole and when they were done you could barely tell they'd done it. I'm used to most places not putting things back the way it was and leaving the mess for me to clean up.

Today I had to give them a call because we started hearing bubbling from our basement toilet again. They came right out to us checked everything over and offered a quick simple solution to try out rather than just trying to push some expensive repair on us.

Five star is absolutely our go to plumber now and I highly recommend them for any of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Bigliss90
reviews.text: There is a reason they call themselves Five Star Plumbing. This was the absolute best experience I ever had with a service provider. Five Star Plumbing is my new company for any plumping issues. I called about a leak and the plumber was at my house 30 minutes later. My toilet flange was leaking into my basement. Jay was the plumber that fixed my leak and he was an absolute professional. He walked me through what was wrong and exactly what he was going to do to fix it. He was so kind, thorough, and truly great at what he does. Additionally, he gave a very fair price to fix the issue and warranted the work for a year. Lastly, Jay fixed the leak that day. All in all, I could not have had a better experience. This is a local company that has top notch employees. I would highly recommend you to give this company a shot. I know this is going to be my go to company for now on.

reviews.author: Demetrios “Jimmy”
reviews.text:
After 26 years, my wife and I moved to a new location and needed a new plumber.  After reading all the excellent reviews we decided to go with Five Star plumbing.  An excellent decision was made on our part. I Can't say enough about the folks from Five Star plumbing. The guys arrived here on time, were  polite, courteous and most importantly extremely knowledgeable.  They were able to get everything we needed accomplished and the prices were very reasonable.  I've been a homeowner for over 27 years so I have an idea about pricing and plumbing. Mitch and Jay were extremely detailed, thorough and were very conscious of keeping everything clean.
We have our electricians,  HVAC, septic, general contractor and now we have found our new plumbing company!

reviews.author: Flash Brasch
reviews.text: My experience with Five Star Plumbing was excellent. Miss Cindy was gracious and professional when we called on a Monday morning, and she dispatched TJ on the same day. In less than 4 hours, TJ effected repairs on our black water/gray water discharge pipe after detailing our options to us in easy-to-understand language, with pricing included. After a week of regular use now, there are no leaks, and TJ's work looks solid, indeed. Thank you Miss Cindy and TJ for a job well done at a reasonable price! :)

reviews.author: Rocky Robertson
reviews.text: When I called for an appointment I expected them to tell me they would be at my house in a couple of days but to my surprise they came the same day. They replaced my kitchen faucet. They asked me what kind of faucet I wanted and went to Home Depot and got a perfect match. When they returned they installed the faucet in less than 35 minutes and the price they gave me up front was the price they charged. And the price was very reasonable. If you need a plumber this is the company to call.

reviews.author: Mal Baker
reviews.text: We discovered water leak from the main pipe , which needed to be replaced . After few estimates we went with Five Star Plumbing which turned out to be the best decision! Brian showed up on time , extremely knowledgeable and professional. Explained everything they were going to do and did just that . We had a tree with huge roots on their way but Brian and his team worked hard to dig out all they needed and repair what was necessary. Would definitely recommend them to anyone !

reviews.author: monica Thayer
reviews.text: Five Star Plumbing responded immediately to our call for service. The plumbers gave an estimate of the cost for repair of our leaking copper pipe. The work was completed within 45 minutes and the plumbers explained how the pipe had been repaired.  Work was done quickly and neatly and to our satisfaction.  The plumbers were kind and professional, calling us 15 minutes before they arrived and making sure they had answered all of our questions before departing.

reviews.author: Ahmed Zouita
reviews.text: Great Company! The owner Chris was great to deal with. I received quotes from a few companies and he beat their prices by a good amount. They even cut a bush that was in the way. They finished everything within one day, like they said. Once they finished up, they cleaned up after themselves and took the trash with them including the part of the bush they cut. Thank you so much to Chris and everyone who helped restored our water with a new system.

reviews.author: Sabrina Nolan
reviews.text: It's good to know there are still kind, honest people in the world. We got four estimates on plumbing work. This company was the only one that made us feel comfortable. When explaining the work, they were so detailed, patient with our questions, and confident. We're thrilled with the work, and grateful for the extremely fair pricing. Super thankful we were referred to Five Star Plumbing, we will absolutely use this team in the future. Thank you!

reviews.text: Five Star Plumbing Services came to my home to install a submersible well pump after my jet pump failed.  Chris and his team performed the job efficiently. I had other issues, but Chris took care of it.  Thank you so much for your expertise and patience.  I will call upon you again!

reviews.author: Paul Tsupin
reviews.text: I’ve had an excellent experience with this plumbing company across my home and multiple other properties. Their service is always prompt, honest, and professional. reviews.author: Orlando
reviews.text: Konstantin reached out and was able to squeeze me in last minute to provide assistance and repair a copper pipe that was damaged during a remodel project. reviews.author: Ziyad Nazem
reviews.text: I’ve used this plumbing service several times, and every experience has been excellent. They are always prompt, reliable, and available when needed, and their rates are very reasonable. The quality of work has consistently been great, and I’ve never had an issue. Konstantin, in particular, does a fantastic job—professional, courteous, and efficient. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.text:
$35,000 DISASTER FROM A SIMPLE CLOGGED TOILET!!!

We called "Emergency Plumbing" with a clogged toilet in August 2024. After their plumber visited us, we ended up with THREE ROOMS DESTROYED BY WATER AND SEWAGE, costing $35,000 IN REPAIRS that took SEVERAL MONTHS, and then later getting dropped by our brand new homeowners insurance due to the claim!

"Emergency Plumbing" happily took my several hundred dollars in payment for "clearing the clogged toilet". They have offered no recompense for causing our massive loss. But, to their credit, they did say "sorry" a couple times.

THE FULL, DISGUSTING, DANGEROUS, SAD STORY:

In August 2024 I called about a clogged toilet I couldn't plunge clear. They were able to schedule a plumber for early in the morning.

He tried an auger to clear the clog, to no avail. So, he asked to see the sewer cleanout. We went to the basement, where things were about to go DANGEROUSLY BAD.

He opened up the cleanout and A FIRE HOSE RIVER OF SEWAGE immediately began to spray out onto him and our finished basement. He panicked and asked for garbage cans / bags to catch the sewage river.

My wife brought down some large utility garbage bags. The plumber and I held up and filled about 3-4 large bags of sewage over our heads during the next several minutes before the flow finally stopped and he could cap off the cleanout. He reassured me by saying, "sometimes stuff like this happens". We were both drenched in sewage from head to toe. Some had splashed in my eyes and mouth.

He started to hand mop up the large sewage puddle with some paper towels. I told him "don't bother, this all will need a mitigation company". He replied, "all you really need is some soap and water". Ummm no.

We dried off, shedded clothes and went back upstairs. The toilet still wouldn't drain, so he said he'd drive back to get the larger auger. He asked if I had any toilets upstairs, and I replied yes. He said "OK, you can use your upstairs toilet and shower, just don't use the clogged one down here". He left and I started to shower.

After showering I came back down to the main floor to discover that SHOWER WATER WAS GUSHING OUT OF THE TOILET INTO OUR BATHROOM AND HALLWAY!!! More fun!

In the second panic of the day, I tried my best to dam up the NEW RIVER OF WATER now FLOODING my main level hardwood floors. I ran downstairs to see even more water now soaking many ceiling tiles and raining onto the sauna and floor.

I called the plumber and the head plumber agreed to come join the fun. He arrived, I explain the scene, and he said "Oh no, he should never have told you to use the fixtures upstairs". Oh no!

The first plumber later returned with the larger auger. They managed to clear the clog with it. They did some hand mopping up of the now destroyed first floor powder room, hallway, hall closet, and living room. They asked for a check for several hundred dollars, said sorry for the problems, took my check and left.

The next day we opted for a water & sewage mitigation company, rather than the plumber's recommendation of "soap and water". We then watched much of our house get ripped apart and endured days of loud fans a dehumidifiers.

The insurance claim process and reconstruction took place over the next couple months. We had to cancel our Thanksgiving party, as we were still wrapping up the rebuild by then.In the weeks after the plumbing adventure, I texted and called the plumber, hoping to get some recompense for this disaster, maybe cover my insurance deductible, maybe even my money back? We talked on the phone once and I made my case. He didn't offer anything at all. Haven't heard from them since.

0 STARS - CANNOT RECOMMEND FOR ANY PLUMBING WORK. Maybe the head plumber is good? But whatever junior plumber they sent to unclog my toilet basically destroyed much of my new house. They were arrived on time and were friendly to talk to, though, tiny bonus points for that. ONE QUARTER OF A STAR

The work was done quickly, professionally, and at a fair price. I’m very satisfied and would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.text: My experience was as good as it gets. In 2017 my sewer and gas lines were replaced to the main. Unfortunately I didn’t have the right plumbing company. They only did the bare minimum. The plumbing team was awesome, courteous and professional. My job took one day to complete and they removed cast iron and lead pipes from 1951 and put pvc everywhere drains were needed for my home. They up sold me a back flow preventer which if I ever need it will definitely be worth it.

reviews.author: TERRY JOHNSON
reviews.text: Floor drain was backed up, the technician (Travis) who came out was completely awesome. His whole goal was to make sure I was satisfied. I have to replace the drywall but it is great knowing that the drip has stopped.  I now have full access to my shower. Thank you.

reviews.author: Adam B.
reviews.text:
This happened to me 3 years ago, and I'll be danged if I let it go...ever!

A Dean Plumbing service technician, Wes Shephard, came out to look at a possibly clogged condensate line on my air conditioner unit. Wes cut the line, past the trap, and claimed since some water was passing through the line that it was not clogged, and that I should have one of their air condition techs come back out to look at the AC unit. He was present for about 10 min and he charged me $94.25, even though he did not fix anything. Being that the unit was under warranty, I called my warranty provider, Alabama Climate Control, and they came out. Not seeing anything wrong with the unit, they rechecked the actual trap in the condensate line and discovered it actually WAS CLOGGED and they repaired the line, charging me $95 for the service call. So, in the end, despite the fact that I told the Dean Plumbing rep, not once, but twice, that I believed the line was clogged, he did not, thoroughly check the line, and he charged me $94.25...HAD he checked the entire line, I could have avoided the warranty call and the additional $95 spent to Alabama Climate Control. I believe Dean Plumbing's intent was to nickel and dime me and charge me an additional charge for having one of their AC reps come out, but, when this failed, they refused to issue a refund for improper and inferior service. DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY! They obviously do not value their customer relationship...to be such a small service issue, you would think they would just issue a refund, but they just kept offering unneeded future service when they should have just admitted being wrong and refunded my money. During submission to the BBB, this company also basically lied through their teeth about the facts of the service call, claiming I had them come to 2 different houses, claiming they responded to an after hours service call when, in fact, the guy was just 3 hours late for the appointment I made in advance, claiming they came out 3 different times (only 2), and claiming they completely took the line apart and flushed it, which they did not. This company is obviously ran by idiots...How in the world could they have an A+ rating is beyond me!

reviews.author: James Norris
reviews.text: Sunday morning before leaving town for a funeral, one of us completed our shower and one had not. There was an unusually loud noise which I thought was coming from the kitchen. I discovered backups from the drains in two showers. A toilet overflowed and others would not flush. Called Dean plumbing and requested Ty Troupe to come out Monday morning since we were going out of town. Ty had installed my water heater a few years ago. Called again first thing Monday morning. They said Ty would arrive in an hour. Turned out to be less than an hour. He began troubleshooting the problem with his helper, Tyler. To make a long story short, they traced the problem deeper and deeper underground and found it to be a blocked sewer pipe. In this process, emergency line locators were called in to locate and mark underground pipes and lines. Randy arrived with an excavator and began digging in my front yard. Electrical line, main water line, and several sprinkler lines all came into play as Randy kept slowly digging deeper while Ty used his equipment  to track down the exact point of problem. Ten feet down, the PVC sewer pipe coming from the house had separated from the steel pipe leading to sewer under the street. Summarizing, they fixed the problem with higher quality material than the original. They back-filled with gravel around the problem area (which was lacking in the original), and finished filling the ten-foot deep hole with soil. They checked to be sure everything was working properly and cleaned-up. I could not ask for better service at a time when all toilets, showers, and sinks in the house were not functioning. I highly recommend Ty, Tyler, Randy and Dean Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jeff G.
reviews.text: No show on two scheduled appointments wasting two of my days on this planet.  First one was canceled on the day and hour of the appointment and the second one was rescheduled on the day of the appointment and then one-hour late because the technician got lost.  Really?  How about a GPS or a smart phone? By the way, he had been to our house twice before. Called to express my disappointment and Ashley told me "no problem".  Nothing like I am sorry, how can we make this better, nothing but "no problem" click.  Seems Dean Plumbing has too much work and no regard for their customers.

reviews.text: I cannot say enough about this company. I awoke early Friday morning to water in the floor and under my kitchen sink. I called Josh Henry at 7:15am and he had a worker, Jason, there by 10:15 and by noon a new garbage disposal was bought and installed! He fixed a toilet that was running with no charge. reviews.author: John H.

I would use this service again. 
John

reviews.author: Jack M.
reviews.text: The whole team was friendly and courteous during the scheduling and start of work. reviews.text: I called j Henry for help because I couldn't get the internet to work for me. Two young men showed up. They said it would be $386 for them to do the repairs.  I said no thank you and told them to have a good day. The young man said they could put on the new seat, the new tower and their flapper for $185. I let them do the work with the only cost to them being the flapper. It took about 15 minutes.  They were friendly enough...

reviews.author: Jackie D.
reviews.text:
I acquired a clogged toilet on xmas!  UGH!!  I called J. Henry and they actually answered the phone.  I knew the rates would be high due to the holiday - so, having a 2nd bathroom,  we agreed that they could come on Monday.  I was so embarrassed of the 'mess' in the toilet upon his arrival!!  The young man was so, so very nice... never complained... even took his boots off outside!!  He had my toilet un-clogged in 10 mins!  I have never dealt with such nice folks!  I will definitely be using again.
Thank you...

reviews.author: MrRipsnowman
reviews.text: J. Henry Plumbing exhibited professionalism and courtesy. Each of the employees whom I encountered were friendly and willing to go the extra mile to answer any questions I had as the project progressed. I am very satisfied with their work and will recommend them when I am asked about any septic system work. They also came back and landscaped the area of the Septic tank and field lines. He did a fantastic job of leveling the yard. I would use J. Henry again and I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: j dawg
reviews.text: Dustin & co worker were extremely courteous and professional. They were able to diagnose and fix the issue in a very timely manner. I have had nothing but excellent service from the J Henry team when ever I have called upon them! Excellent technicians with great customer skills. The office team are always so nice and keeps you informed of schedule.  Keep up the great work and thank you!

reviews.author: Scott Haas
reviews.text: I have used J. Henry several times including having them replace a well pump on a rainy cold night!  Excellent service!  Always very responsive and never had to call them back to redo anything.  Every tech I have had was respectful and competent.  I have several rental properties and my own house and will always use them for plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Chris K
reviews.text: Had a leaky pipe under the house. Jonathan showed up and was great. Fixed the leaky pipe in a terrible spot under the house. I asked him to put a valve on the hot water heater and found a couple more issues with the water heater. Explained everything before the work began and fixed it all in a timely fashion.  10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Dottie Frost
reviews.text: These guys did a wonderful job clearing the drains to the sewer system and installing new toilets at VFW Post 2702. They saved us so much money by telling us what was actually needed. I highly recommend them for work.

reviews.author: Ken Miles

reviews.author: David C Matthews

reviews.author: Pauli Sherban

reviews.author: Jen Lemon
reviews.text: Benj was great. Communicated well made sure I understood what was happening and made things more accessible for the next time repairs have to happen.  The communication and customer service from the whole team was great.

reviews.author: Cheryl Apple
reviews.text: Benj is so awesome! He was very thorough and updated us on what he was doing. I would definitely have him fix any of it again and Recommend him to my friends and family

reviews.author: Julie Collings
reviews.text: We were just contacted that our plumbing appointment today was canceled last minute.  We are on a strict deadline and needed the plumbing service before Monday or we lose thousands of dollars for our down payment .  I tried to reschedule an appointment for Saturday or Sunday and requested that the after hours fee of $249.00  be waived due to the last minute cancellation and the response was “sorry we can’t do that, you will have to call someone else”.  I understand things come up and schedules change but I booked this appointment in advance based on the reviews I read for this company.  Now I’m left high and dry and scrambling to make an appointment with another plumbing company on a Friday afternoon.  Very unprofessional service standards, I definitely will not be contacting this company again.

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.text: I should have read the reviews before having Beehive come out. I paid $582 to have them replace a leaky fridge water line (ice maker box). It took them maybe 5 minutes max. We called several plumbers and they quoted us no more than $200. I feel ripped off.

reviews.author: John Doe
reviews.text:
Jonathon Pendly did an excellent job replacing a 20 year old manabloc and I had him replace ALL 21 connectors on the 18 port manabloc so that hopefully the new one will last another 20 years.
I had tried to replace a tub spout two different times and it leaked each time and someone else soldered a part on to allow a longer tub spout, but it was too short and made it still leak.
So I hired Jonathon to unsolder the tub pipe, and he cleaned it fully and the slip on tub spout he used didn't leak and he didn't use any tape or dope so I will do what I saw him do next time to save money.

Beehive Plumbing came in with a better price over Expert Services for the manabloc, but then Expert Services had a much better price on a water softener install (they did want to charge more later so I hurried and got that job done before their prices went up).
One downside on the manabloc even though I was told it was new and improved, it is more compact, it has a plastic backing instead of metal, and the front plastic to hold the key is really soft and feels like it will break so you have to be careful putting the key in that plastic hole so quality on equipment seems to be degrading across all products I have had installed in recent years as manufacturing moved overseas.
These companies seem to try raise and match each others' prices, but if their prices are too high, I know people who "find a guy" to do the work for 1/4 the cost.
I prefer hiring a licensed professional with a company that honors its warranties for bigger jobs involving main water and gas lines to be safe.
Getting a quote from several comapnies for every job lets me find the better prices, but I have to remember to first research price ranges online, what the top 3 equipment brands are and what warranties each offers and where each is made.
Then call to schedule a bid analysis, and ask on the phone what equipment they install, what the warranty is, and how long does the equipment typically last.
Then research how the brand is performing in recent years since those companies sometimes move overseas where the warranty is not honored and parts break more frequently.

reviews.author: Vance Everett
reviews.text: I had attempted to replace a shutoff valve under the kitchen sink but couldn't get it to budge so I called Beehive Plumbing to do it.  The plumber arrived on time, assessed the job and gave me an estimate.  The estimate ($249) was extremely high for the simplicity of the job but I agreed.  The plumber proceeded and had the same problem I had.  But instead of removing the valve he cut the pipe off which I could have done and was trying avoid.  Now I have a short pipe with no room to work in case I need to do another repair.  Then when I turned the water back on, there was just a dribble.  The plumber said everything he did was properly done.  He did take a look at the manifold and said the valve had probably gone bad and I would likely need to replace the manifold.  He wanted another $189 just to diagnose the problem.  I declined.  After the plumber left, I went back to the shutoff valve and twisted it and saw that the dribble increased.  The more I twisted the more the water ran.  So, I twisted more and got a full stream.  Problem solved.  Why couldn't the plumber do that?  I'm not going to call that plumber again.

reviews.author: Dick Beeson
reviews.text: Came home from church and discovered our current water heater had been leaking all day. Called Beehive Plumbing for assistance and they came on a Sunday! Caleb Davis was able to stop the leaking and still make it possible for us to have cold water overnight. He returned on Monday and spent 5 1/2 hours installing a new Rheem water heater with an accompanying water softener. It was a huge job, with some added expertise to make it all compliant with our existing pipes, etc. Caleb never stopped! He made sure everything was working properly, cleaned up the mess, and explained what we needed to know about the new appliances. We are very pleased with Beehive Plumbing service, their technician, and our new water heater! Thank you!

reviews.author: Brent Ostler
reviews.text: Well, first off, they charged me the service call charge of $50. And when I had the service done, they didn't credit it towards the service performed price,   and it was only a toilet that was wobbling.  I guess i should have stayed and watched but I didn't.  I guess I sounded too desperate as we had sold the house and needed to get it done for the new owners.  Plus, when I called their office, I was told usually plumbers will credit you IF you ask them, otherwise they just tack it on to the bill. $265 for 10 minutes.  Can you say gouge?

reviews.author: Jared Neiswender
reviews.text: Did a fine job but was reportedly curt with my staff and overheard being extremely unprofessional and disrespectful. The reason you were here, Tristen, is bc we employed you to do a job and paid you quite a bit to do so. I recommend that you act in a more respectful and gracious manner to your customers in the future. Would not recommend this service. There’s a million plumbers out there doing the exact same quality of work. I recommend you hire one that isn’t put out by doing the agreed upon work and is nice and polite.

reviews.author: Sharon Montoya
reviews.text:
Josh was very nice and professional.  Did quick work to get my hot water back on. So maybe I take back what I said within an hour of fixing it we still don't have hot water and it's doing the exact same thing I called for that he fixed! It's been 6 hrs since he left , 5hours since I called and told them it's not working,  said he would call me to walk me through a couple things . Still haven't heard from him . I paid over $500 today and still don't have hot water!!
I don't recommend them.

reviews.author: sharee wilson
reviews.text: Tristen was Awesome! He communicated through the whole process. He was very detailed in everything that he worked on, our house is under contract and these are items that the inspector called out.  We were able to get  Behive Plumbing out there the next day to get everything fixed and get our report back to the buyers, that everything had been taken care of! We are very grateful for Tristen and Behive Plumbing. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brad Floyd
reviews.text:
My wife had a Beehive plumber come out for a leaky fridge waterline (from the ice maker box). When I heard the price, it sounded outrageously high, so I called around to a handful of plumbing companies to compare - sure enough, Beehive charged us over 300% over what the other companies quoted!

I feel like the plumber took advantage of my wife because she didn't know how much the repair should cost.

reviews.author: Ian Lawson
reviews.text: My water heater gave up the ghost and started leaking. I called three other plumbers before but these folks really went above and beyond to get me back in business. not only were they able to get me same day but did a phenomenal job. Warren and Craig did awesome and were personable and walked me through the whole process. I will be recommending them and will use them in the future.

reviews.author: Cameron Elder
reviews.text:
Jordan Ostler was prompt, professional
, and knowledgeable. He quickly addressed the problem and offered solutions. He also offered preventative measures to ensure the issue was a one time issue. Beyond being a professional, he was also sympathetic. Fantastic customer service all around from the initial set up to the actual service itself.

reviews.author: Sheila Fullbright
reviews.text: Duvall plumbing, the people who work for them, the service and work is great and that starts from the top.  Thank you Duvall for all you do!  God Bless!

reviews.author: Ashley Black
reviews.text: If I could rate Duvall Plumbing 10 stars I would! Bobbly came out to help me and he was incredible. He was so kind and courteous and I cannot overstate how much I appreciate him! Give this man a raise! I highly recommend this awesome company.

reviews.author: Ginny Schiefer
reviews.text: I would give zero stars if I could. They repaired a slab leak at my house two years ago, and their work was so shoddy that I had to spend another $1700 today to have it repaired. I have attached photos so you can see their mess. Save yourself money and use another company.

reviews.author: Brianna McAlvain
reviews.text: Duvall doesn’t even exist. They were bought out by Airco. This is false advertising and a scheme to dupe customers into thinking they’re using one company, and then another actually shows up. Shady.

reviews.author: John Jensen
reviews.text:
My experience with this company was not a good one.  It started with the correct tools not being on the van and the tech having to leave on the Saturday. He came back on Sunday and tried hard, but decided at that point that it was "a two man job".  On Wednesday, electrical wires were hit, and power to my handicapped daughter's room/bathroom were cut off. The tech took my credit card, but did not bother to tell me that over the phone.  I found out from one of my sons  later as the tech told him.

I placed two calls to the answering service and sent an email to get an electrician sent to the house.  The service said someone would get back with me. They did not.  It was not until the next day (Thursday) when I called that anyone spoke with me.  She  had no idea what I was talking about.  Laura did get an electrician to the house. It took me two calls to Duvall and one call to the electrician to verify that Duvall was going to pay for the repairs.

The floor was left with drywall dust and it was also on the walls.  Nothing was cleaned or swept.  I put the water meter cover on as it was left in the yard.  The 4% up-charge for using a credit card was the cherry on top of this expensive mess. That should have been told to us upfront. As a teacher, every penny counts. I wish it would have gone to another company.

reviews.author: Trish kohl
reviews.text:
I recently had two plumbers Kalob and DJ who fixed a Bidet leak Bidet installarion and a shower head in my home, and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed with their professionalism, expertise, and exceptional customer service.

From the moment they arrived, both plumbers were polite, courteous, and respectful of my home. They immediately got to work, carefully assessing the issues with both the toilet and the shower head.

Throughout the repair process, they worked efficiently and with great attention to detail, ensuring that the repairs were done correctly and to the highest possible standards. They were knowledgeable about their their work.

What really stood out to me, however, was their commitment to customer service. They were friendly and approachable, always taking the time to answer my questions and address any concerns I had. They also went above and beyond by offering helpful tips and advice to prevent future issues with my plumbing.

reviews.author: Dana Morrow
reviews.text:
I called Duvall on a recommendation from a friend having a difficult HVAC problem to solve. She reported this company employed people who were thinkers. Meaning they listened to her issues and could really think a problem through, not just do the simplest repair and be on their way.

My HVAC was blowing hot air with over 100 degrees outside. They came the next day and gave me 3 choices to solve my issue. I decided on a new HVAC unit. They called each day before arrival, were here when they said they would be and solved issues concerning air flow which had been a problem for years. I would highly recommend this company.

I am grateful for a company that requires the best-trained technicians and superior quality service. I am grateful for a company you can trust to do what they say they will do.

reviews.author: Eli Glass
reviews.text: I had an outdoor faucet that wouldn't stop leaking and needed replaced. A lovely receptionist answered my call on a Saturday (Easter weekend at that) and had me scheduled for Monday. 2 professional and easy to talk to guys, Cayde and Rob had an earlier opening on Monday and where able to come out earlier and replace the faucet. This wasn't an average repair as they had to remove a tile in the shower to get to the back of the wall where the outdoor faucet was located and then had to fix the janky work that was previously done 40 years ago. The guys had no problem doing some problem solving and handled the curve ball efficiently and like it was nothing. They got it all taken care of for a reasonable price (Around $400) and my dripping outdoor faucet is no more.

reviews.author: Chad Collins
reviews.text: I don’t typically write reviews, but I felt I needed to express how satisfied I was with the service I received from Eric and Kylon with Duvall Plumbing. I had a 50 gallon gas water heater I needed installed. The techs called when they were in route and arrived during the window of time I had scheduled. They were professional and courtesy. Whatever questions I had, they made sure they were answered. As for the installation of the water heater, their work was so good and extremely neat. They really went beyond what they had to do, with the way they tidy up everything and left the space in a much better state than it was when they arrived. I was more than satisfied with Eric and Kylon, and I appreciated the service they provided.

reviews.author: Trevor Fullbright
reviews.text: We had to have an emrgancy plumber out at almost 10pm at night when the shut off line to our toilet broke and was spitting water. Joshua was there within 20 minutes after we called and the line fixed in no time and talked us through a quote to replace the toilet and Cayde move things around to get to our house early the next morning to make sure we got a new toilet installed before we had to leave for work so it could be taking care of before the weekend, on top of all that they were HALF the price of everywhere else we have called. If ANYONE asked me about a plumber I'm 100% giving them Duvalls number!

reviews.author: Melony irvin Irvin
reviews.text: I really want to thank Cayde from the  edmond office for helping us out. Cayde was very nice and professional  about what he was doing and took the time to explain every thing to me so i would know what to do in case there was a problem. I really appreciated the fact he was quick and clean and did not leave a mess for me to clean up. AND HE TOOK HIS SHOES OFF  BEFORE he entered my home to keep my carpet clean that is very important to me!! Thank you again CAYDE  you have made a customer for life!! I would HIGHLY recommend  Duvall Plumbing Company to EVERYONE!!  With much gratitude  Melony Irvin

reviews.author: Mina Williams
reviews.text: Remington and Cayde are rockstars! We had Duval Edmond assist with installation and repairs for a whole water home filtration, purification, softener and reverse osmosis system. The system required much trouble shooting and repairs due to manufacture issues.  These guys are the most kind, respectful and hard working young men that we have encountered. We appreciate all their hard work! The system is working perfectly, it’s quiet and looks great thanks to their expertise and diligence. Thanks Duvall!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Haase
reviews.text: Joshua was amazing! Very professional and knew exactly how to assist me with my faucet replacement. We had concerns because of a leaky faucet that had rusted some of the screws and connections but he was very knowledgeable and was able to resolve the concerns very well. I will be using this company as my plumber going forward and have referred their business to my dad for his future needs. Thank you Josh!!

reviews.author: Cayley Mosca
reviews.text: We had a clogged drain on a Saturday and Duvall was able to get in us same morning service at a very reasonable rate. Joshua was efficient, friendly, and professional. He was in and out in about 20 minutes, made sure everything was working well before he left, and explained what caused the issue so that we could be prepared in the future. We’ll definitely use Duvall if we have issues again!

reviews.text: The owner of this company is out of his mind. I asked for an estimate to install a four piece tub and shower wall surround, with the parts being $1,500. He quoted $8,500 for the total job. Said it was a 10 hour job, and the reason for the high cost was because he was going to have to spend so much time at the supply house to find a perfect tub without any flaws. I immediately contacted the next Plumber in line, $3,800 later, the tub was installed beautifully, without a single flaw. Either Frick up Plumbing purposely overpriced because they didn't want the job, or they are seriously out of touch with labor pricing. Taking away parts, $7,000 for a for a 10 hour job is $700 an hour. Who makes that kind of money? I paid $3,800 parts and labor all in, to a no name Plumber who me couldn't even recall if you asked, and the job couldn't have been more perfect.

reviews.author: Susan C.
reviews.text: My opinion of this company has certainly gone downhill. Just got off the phone with Gary, discussing the purchase of a new and expensive hot water tank. After some discussion of what I thought I needed, based largely on the size of my jetted bathtub, I told him I thought someone needed to come out to assess what was needed and determine if it would fit in the utility closet. He laughed inappropriately several times, like I was stupid or something, then said he could not afford to send someone out to do that, then before I could say I guess I'll have to hire someone else, he said have a nice day and hung up on me. The reviews here are accurate. Gary is not doing his business any favors with his behavior.

reviews.author: Nicole H.
reviews.text: If you're looking for a reliable plumber this is your place. They aren't hawking services that you don't need. Their brand isn't diluted by offering 6 separate services. Plumbing only, all licensed and union backed. They will come in, complete their service, and leave. Their prices are beyond compare and their plumbers are kind, courteous, and professional. Locally owned by Rick Frecka, a family man and pillar of the community with his many charitable contributions. You can tell he treats his employees well as they appear very happy with their work. 5,000 stars. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Kim K.
reviews.text: Frecka Plumbing installed a new toilet, new garbage disposal and new kitchen faucet in my condo.  When I called Gary to set up the appointment and let him know my needs, he was extremely knowledgeable and helpful.  Their plumber, Steve, was very courteous and got everything done in less time than we thought.  It has been 2 weeks since the work was done and everything is working great!  Also, Steve, cleaned up afterwards and left everything very nice.  I am very pleased and will definitely use Frecka Plumbing in the future!

reviews.author: Kellie R.
reviews.text: I called Frecka yesterday to get quotes for 3 major plumbing projects I need to have done in  my house. The guy who answered the phone seemed to be trying to talk me out of getting the work done because of the high cost. ? He told me the owner would call me back today to schedule. Instead, he called me back this morning to tell me the owner couldn't come out to give me estimates until late fall because they have so much commercial work right now!! It is obvious to me they just don't want my business. Very rude!!

reviews.author: Mark S.
reviews.text:
I would never use Frecka again.  I had them out to check a leak under my sink.  I did not know where it was coming from.  They came out and could not find anything.  It was a service charge for $140.
60 days later, I notice the same leak, which I know is now the disposal.  He (Gary) charges me 189. for a new disposal installation and won't give a break based on the first charge.  Basically the guy is rude on the phone.  Plenty of plumbers out there....do not go to Frecka.

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.text: Very friendly and professional. Rick came over and gave me an estimate that was much better than what I have received in the past, and Tim was the tech who came and fixed the problem.  Both wonderful to work and deal with. Mike scheduled my appointment and was quick and efficient both times I spoke with him. 1000% recommend this company!  I feel like most plumbing companies try to rip people off most days, but Frecka was so reasonable.

reviews.author: Nick K.
reviews.text:
I have had Todd out twice to replace toilets (first two toilets replaced the first trip, and the last two were replaced during the second trip) and am immensely satisfied with the service and professionalism. 

Todd made sure I was aware of the things he was doing and made sure that he didn't cut any corners during the installs. 

Very satisfied customer, and will be using Frecka for any future plumbing projects.

reviews.author: Pam O.
reviews.text: As a first time customer with Frecka Plumbing, we had an amazing experience!   Our technician Matt couldn't have been more professional and timely and he really took the time to make sure we understood our plumbing problem!  We most definitely will refer Frecka to family and friends!!

reviews.author: Min Ohio
reviews.text:
Called Frecka for some drain work, but they no longer do this. What they do is give great references. I'm grateful that Mike took the time to help me out.

Mike sent me to Allen Drainage. From admins Erin and Sara to plumbers Chris and Bill, Allen was great.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text: Very nice and knowledgeable. Had the sump pump installed in no time for a very reasonable and fair price. He was also great with my dog and that’s always a plus to me. We will be repeat customers next time we need a plumber!

synthesis.summary: Frecka Plumbing shows exceptional reliability with 20+ years of consistent service and same-day availability. Customers consistently praise their professional workmanship, fair pricing, and thorough explanations, making them a solid choice for emergency plumbing needs.

Consistently reasonable pricing, often below estimates
Thorough explanations and customer education
20+ year track record with repeat customers
weaknesses: Limited number of recent reviews to assess current performance
No confirmation of 24-hour emergency availability
synthesis.topQuote: Same day service! Absolutely amazing! His knowledge is fantastic...he is friendly and so helpful! I know that he will find and fix the problems every time!

plumbers.name: City Wide Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4200 Industrial Center Ln NW #100, Acworth, GA 30101, USA

reviews.author: Kia Kia
reviews.text: Josh was awesome, I work for a company  where our facility bathroom was stopped up, & he resolved the issue effectively & efficiently. I would recommend this company ask for JOSH!!! Thank You!.

reviews.author: Destiny Wright
reviews.text: Thank you to Mr. Ricky for coming out to fix the plumbing he had great customer service and the service he provided was quick

reviews.author: Derek
reviews.text: Joshua was on time and a big help.

reviews.author: Elle W.
reviews.text: BEWARE of using RENE NAVA for your plumbing needs.  He tried to charge me $3500 to fix my busted pipe.  That's almost 5X the amount he charged my neighbor, just minutes before, for what he told me could be the same issue.  He said he may have to disconnect my toilet & not reconnect.  The damage was not behind the toilet.  Which he could see at my neighbor's house, since we share some pipes.  I decided to call another plumber who charged $800.

reviews.author: Kurt F.
reviews.text:
My daughter flushed tampons down the toilet (sigh)...so you know where this is going. I couldn't get it cleared with my snake so I thought I'd pay the $50-75 to get a pro out here to clear it. This is where Citywide comes in. 

The Good: Owner was the only person that emailed me back with a quote and said it would be $60 and probably not much more. The plumber showed up on time. 

The Not So Good: Plumber showed up without a mask or gloves and walked into the house. That probably didn't bother me as much as the fact he didn't even put anything over his dirty ass boots. My wife, daughter and I all work hard to keep our little house clean and to have someone just walk in with boots? Come on. 

The Bad: Rather than concentrate on the clog I was told the problem was the fill valve. Yes, the toilet is close to 17 years old and I know the valve is dying, but all I wanted was to get the clog cleared. Then he proceeds to write up a work order for...get this...$368 to replace the fill valve: to the uninitiated, that is a $12 part and would take an inexperienced person about 30 minutes to install. 

I paid the $60, politely sent him on his way and then dragged my kid to Lowes where we bought a brand new toilet for $175. After watching a couple of YouTube videos my daughter helped me install the new toilet in about 30 minutes. Now she has a new toilet and knows how to install one to boot. 

My experience, while not necessarily bad, is that Citywide is your typical predatory mechanical service; they prey on the weak and old by charging exorbitant prices for even minor fixes.  $300 for your elderly mother to fix a leaky faucet kind of place.

reviews.author: S P.
reviews.text:
I took a rare risk reaching out to a business without good reviews, but I saw they were under new management so I went with my gut. Although I'm still in the middle of arranging the full job to be set up through my insurance, I want to go ahead and rave about the initial service visit. 

Tim was out to assess the problem within 24 hours of my reaching out, and he was not only professional, but very personable and willing to walk through and assess multiple concerns in my house and offer advice and referrals, completely free of charge until he can return to do his portion of the work. He even crawled up under the house into a small crawl space to check for water damage, despite the fact that it wasn't the issue he was originally called out for, and so far it seems that he saved me a potential future disaster by catching a hidden leak that I was only suspicious of.

I've had other plumbers out before, who did a quick job without much reassurance of what was going on or how to monitor the situation further, as long as they got paid and got out, but now I'm pretty sure I've found my go-to person for all of my home's plumbing concerns. Tim clearly cares about his work and the wellbeing of the home he is working with, and it's evident that he isn't interested in taking advantage of people just to make an extra buck.

I highly, highly recommend working with CityWide to tend to any plumbing concerns in your home. I'll try to add an update after they come back out and the full job is compete, but I can see that these are honest and decent professionals, which isn't so easy to find these days.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.text:
I signed closing papers around 3 PM today; 12:30 AM i was in tears and sopping up water with paper towels.  I called roto rooter, who actually stops service at midnight, then called CityWide.  Two agents called back within five minutes.  Fifteen minutes later, a plumber arrived and started assessing the situation. Long story short, a copper fitting had bent which spouted a leak from the line running to the ice maker.  Less than an hour later, Nick finished moving the refrigerator back in place and helped us clean up the last few puddles.  Nick Barclay is a bright, and confident guy, and I'm glad he was on call tonight.

PS - We did try to access the main shutoff valve as located in the home inspection report. Left, right..  is the water pressure decreasing?  No.

I  had referenced the home inspection report and now offer this homeowner tip - Ask your home inspector to engage the shut off valve and verify it does, in fact, control all water lines. What the inspector noted in the report only controls an outside hose line.  I compared the story with a couple other cases and found out that no one's home inspector did this obvious but important step.

The main cutoff supply in the front yard is largely inaccessible. However, just inside the wall of the crawl space, a  larger shut-off valve controls all lines inside the house.  I only know of it because of the urgent call placed tonight. Nick showed us how to access and made sure the valve did its job. Thank you.

reviews.author: Kenneth Giel
reviews.text: A huge shout out to CityWide Plumbing in exceeding all my expectations of emergency service yesterday when my hot water heater failed at the most inopportune time. I had just brought my wife home from a week of ICU care at the hospital and the hot water heater broke down. CityWide dispatched Technician Josh Montgomery who assessed the problem and assured me that I would have water service returned before the day was out. Working alone at the time he made a separate trip to their warehouse facility to pick-up the new heater and parts and, by mid-afternoon. had a new heater installed. What happened next was a totally unexpected nightmare. When he was about to turn water service back on to my home at the curb, Josh heard a hissing sound noticed water seeping into the meter box which needed immediate attention. It was the makings of a major water line break which required the assistance of Darron another CityWide technician. The outside repairs were accomplished during and around a rainstorm no less and hot water service was returned to normal by dinner! Reliability and professional service at its absolute best! Five stars to Josh, Darron and CityWide!

reviews.author: Mary G.
reviews.text: I highly recommend City Wide Plumbing! My late husband always used to take care of our plumbing and electrical problems, so when my kitchen faucet stopped working I was in a bind. It was the kind that had a touchless sensor, but even after I replaced the batteries: still no water. I Googled a few local plumbing services but this was the only one that answered my call and really listened. Chad was personable and professional, and explained several options so that I could make a decision. The plumber who came out did an excellent job: he was proficient and thorough. Overall: excellent communication, very reasonable costs, and trustworthy.

reviews.author: Kevin S.
reviews.text: Tech shows up, he's so fat he can't even walk up and down the stairs. Got mad when I asked him to move his truck because my daughter needed to leave for work. Then on the way down the stairs using the bannister wasn't enough, he put his hands on my newly painted wall just to go down the stairs and when asked to stop copped another attitude. When he gave the price of $180 just to fix a running toilet I simply asked, is this a weekend price or a regular price? His response, do want me to fix it or not. Stay away at all cost. Pathetic service with an attitude, because God forbid you ask a question.

reviews.author: Mike E.
reviews.text:
Let me just say that this is a company that I would not recommend to anyone, they were contracted to run a new water line, in the process they damaged my sprinkler system, failed to tie it back in as it was originally done and made a huge mess of my front yard, and in addition to that left a wheelbarrow full of dirt sitting right net to the hole that had to filled in, no solutions just excuses, 
As a service provider my self when we break it we fix it and we do our very best to leave things the way we found them, I will be posting pictures also, absolutely ridiculous customer service 
BEWARE!!!!

reviews.author: Traci
reviews.text: I had requested Citywide to come out and fix a leak under my kitchen sink I requested it late Friday at the end of the day wasn’t that bad didn’t need emergency.   I went in the hospital for surgery the following Monday they worked with me and my schedule and came out today.  Nick and Justin were amazing I still wasn’t feel great they let me rest while they worked.     They even brought my cat litter in off my porch that I had delivered earlier in the morning for me.   Very respectful young men and would recommend them to anyone

reviews.author: Tyler Couch
reviews.text: City wides service was outstanding. I work for Cobb County Parks and we had a plumbing emergency with drains backing up in our building at 10pm. Within 30 mins of calling, Nick was at the site and pulling tools from the truck ready to fix the problem. Repair was made quickly and he cleaned up after the job making sure to document the before and after with photos. Super nice and professional attitude for a late night call. Thank you all so much for the service to the county and its citizens.

reviews.author: George R.
reviews.text: I found them online about 6 months ago for an emergency repair to my basement sewer pump. They responded in a speedy manner, came in and replaced the unit. I was issued a 1-year warranty for the service. Unfortunately, the unit failed, and they were called to honor the warranty. The company sent a technician the very next business day, and replaced the unit at no additional cost. They are a company that stands by their word, and I will strongly recommend them.

reviews.author: JadeTheGem
reviews.text: Anytime I call City Wide plumbing, I ask for Nick! Mr. Barclay is amazing ang genuinely knows what he is doing. He always keeps me informed and my biggest thing is he always has reasonable prices that no other company can beat. He was an experienced plumber and I pray this company gives this man a raise for being extraordinary. Thank you so much Nick for always helping with my plumbing issues. You are a great investment to this company I’ll tell you that much!

synthesis.summary: City Wide has a strong bench of technicians — Ricky, Josh, Nick, and Bryce all get individual shoutouts for quick, professional work — and their response times are genuinely impressive (10 minutes from an emailed work order in one case). But the Yelp history paints a different picture: significant pricing complaints including a 5X overquote versus a neighbor for the same burst pipe, a $368 upsell for a $12 fill valve, and rude tech behavior. The Google record is better but the Yelp pattern is hard to ignore.

reviews.author: Melanie Arvanites
reviews.text: JMJ Plumbing is fantastic! I’ve had them come out several times now, and they’ve been consistently reliable every time. Even on a holiday, their response was fast and professional. The technicians are punctual, clean, and respectful of my home. Pricing is very reasonable for the quality and speed of service. It’s hard to find dependable plumbers—especially during holidays—but JMJ Plumbing always delivers. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Leslie Baird
reviews.text: Very quick response, thorough job.  Very fair pricing.   I’m very impressed!

reviews.author: Catherine Turnage
reviews.text: Great, quality service! Brent was extremely knowledgeable and respectful of budget. Service was done in a timely manner, and they cleaned up everything well! He explained everything fully. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Allan Fey
reviews.text: JMJ Plumbing in Woodstock, GA, did an outstanding job with our serious plumbing issue, due in most part to the expert work of their Master Plumber Brent McFarland. Our sewer pipe broke in several places from our house to the street. Brent guided us through the problem utilizing fiber optic cameras to validate the problems found underground. He was incredibly helpful with cost, and ensured the repairmen were constantly guided and well supervised. You can easily see his 25 years of plumbing experience as he explained requirements, minimized costs, and coordinated with the city and local utility services in order to complete this big project in 2 days. I recommend JMJ Plumbing for residential plumbing needs. Thanks Brent, and crew, for a job well done!!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: Greg has been awesome! I had four quotes done, and they were next to the lowest. I felt more comfortable with them and opted to pay a little bit more. They came out and completed the job without issue. About four weeks later, I had a major leak, right were they had worked, and where the line comes into the house. I found this at 6:30 am, I called and left a message and received a return call within 10 minutes. She (I can't remember her name), but she had Greg come back out first thing and he replaced the fitting. It was no fault of their own, the water pressure cracked the schedule 80 fitting, so he installed a brass fitting. Long story long, I will hire them again! Thanks!!!

reviews.author: Heather Dwyer
reviews.text: Greg was our technician that came to see us from BDS plumbing. We had been having a leak onto our ceiling from what seems to be from our master bathroom. Greg was knowledgeable, kind and explained the issues causing our water problems. Although our water problems were not directly a plumbing issue, Greg gave us some suggestions that would help fix the issue without spending an arm and a leg. I appreciate the honesty from BDS plumbing, as that is not something you get every day with some of these larger corporations. In the future, I will be glad to call BDS plumbing for any needs we might have. Thanks so much!!

reviews.author: Derreck Humes
reviews.text: Had a leak coming from my master bathroom for the past two weeks on and off. Did what I could to unclog the drain but that seemed to only be temporary as the clog would return. Did my research and came across BDS Plumbing. After reading other customers testimonials, I saw great things about a Brent. I was fortunate to get Brent for my appointment and I finally understand why customers rave about the guy! He is great, personable, and very knowledgeable. He inspected my situation while also providing me recommendations for future Instances. 10/10 definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Wendell Glenn
reviews.text:
Brent McFarland visited my residence today to advise me about the probable cause and remedy for the unusual waterflow from under my driveway. He quickly determined that the condition did not arise from a broken or ruptured water line/pipe that is positioned under the driveway from the water meter to the house. He was very polite and experienced and easily shared his knowledgeable with me. He recommended a solution to my concern, and I was very thankful to him. I was extremely pleased with his visit. I would recommend him or JMJ Plumbing to others.
Wendell Glenn

reviews.author: Tony Martin
reviews.text: Referred to JMJ by a trusted friend and neighbor. BINGO!...this trusted friend nailed it. Greg was extremely courteous and genuine from the moment he stepped up to our front stoop. He skillfully and promptly identified our problem and gave me the option to pursue a simple repair on my own (I mentioned doing a bit of DIY work) as a way of saving some money.  Very impressed  with this priority on what's best for the customer...says a lot about Greg and the company.  Happy to say we've got a new 'go-to' plumber to use and to recommend!

reviews.author: Jennifer Patrick
reviews.text: Brent came out within a couple hours of us placing the call. He was super helpful explaining all of the issues we had, showed me exactly where the issues are in our plumbing lines, and clearly explained everything that needed to be done to fix our issues. Even Cindy in the office was super kind and helpful! I would highly recommend BDS Plumbing for their great customer care, attention to detail, and being so kind and helpful! on such short notice. Our plumbing is back up and running thanks to Brent!

reviews.author: Robert A. DeVillar
reviews.text: Greg McFarland of BDS performed an excellent service in replacing a lawn faucet on the side of our house that was leaking and the associated pipe in the inside of the garage. The faucet is sturdy and cosmetically attractive (blue head) and the installation was completed excellently. The side of the house looks better for it and the leak has been fixed. This is my second time using BDS and I will call them whenever I am in need of their services. I recommend BDS highly and without reservation.

reviews.author: Kimberly Leon-Grey
reviews.text: I recently hired BDS Plumbing Solutions for a plumbing issue in my home and was thoroughly impressed. From the moment I called, their customer service was professional and friendly. Brent arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the issue, and resolved it promptly. The pricing was fair, and I appreciated their transparency throughout the process. I highly recommend their services to anyone in need of reliable,  high-quality plumbing work!

reviews.author: Christopher Spedding
reviews.text: If your plumping is giving you trouble, you want Brett the plumber to show up at your door. He was professional and solved a complex issue we were having with our sink. Brett was super transparent about parts, cost and the best way to solve our issue for good. Thank you for getting us going in time for the holidays! We are super thankful for the great work. We will be calling for any plumping needs we have in the future.

reviews.author: Gus Adolfo
reviews.text: JMJ Plumbing is the only company I’ll use for my plumbing needs. The customer service, prompt scheduling, availability, work, and quality of plumbers is unmatched and I couldn’t be happier. They don’t only assess and address your situation, they explain what’s going on, what they’ll do, and how you can best take care of your home moving forward. This was the best experience I’ve ever had with a plumbing company!

reviews.author: Steve liberatore
reviews.text:
Brent and the TEAM at BDS are amazing!  They just expertly completed a basement bathroom project that another plumbing group said, "Couldn't be done!"  BDS came in and got it done perfectly and within budget!
We have used BDS for 2 big household projects now and couldn't be more satisfied with their professionalism, expertise and more than fair quotes!  Thank you again BDS!!
