Brett was super transparent about parts, cost and the best way to solve our issue for good.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Harford County
plumbers.address: 16A Bel Air S Pkwy Suite 300, Bel Air, MD 21015, USA

reviews.author: Michael Hutchison
reviews.text: Israel, the plumber, was great! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dylan Nolz
reviews.text: Nice, quick, and affordable. Israel was great to work with!

reviews.author: John Goldsten
reviews.text: Israel was friendly, professional, and knowledgeable.  He performed a complete inspection of the plumbing in my house and made recommendations to replace its old valves that may leak

reviews.author: Jim Cigliano
reviews.text: Israel was expert, friendly, explained things well, and fixed the problem with our sump pump quickly. Unfortunately, two days later at 12:25am the sump pump alarm is going off and no one can come out until possibly noon tomorrow. Another sleepless night ahead...

reviews.author: Kunal Teeda
reviews.text:
A completely unnecessary upsell — get a second opinion before using this company

I called Benjamin Franklin Plumbing to diagnose a leaking faucet. The technician took a quick look and immediately quoted me over $700 to replace the entire faucet. No real explanation, no attempt to troubleshoot, and not a single alternative option offered.

What actually fixed it? A $20 cartridge replacement. I confirmed the issue myself and repaired it in minutes. No full replacement needed. No $700 bill. Just a basic part the technician never bothered to check.

This wasn’t just a high quote. It was a wrong diagnosis that would’ve cost me hundreds of dollars for work that wasn’t necessary. That’s a serious trust problem.

If I hadn’t stopped to verify the issue on my own, I would’ve been charged more than 30 times the cost of the real fix.

I won’t be calling this company again, and I strongly recommend anyone reading this to always get a second opinion. A plumbing company should solve your problem—not create an expensive one.

reviews.author: Robert Salvino
reviews.text:
We had a small-ish leak coming from somewhere near our dishwasher. I couldn't locate the leak myself, but it seemed to be near the sink-side of the dishwasher compartment. Israel called to check to see if he could arrive earlier than scheduled. After checking the various places where water as appearing, both in the kitchen and directly below in the basement, Israel located the leak. Unfortunately, it was in the dishwasher itself and that's something that most plumbers won't attempt to fix. Our machine is 16 years old, at the upper end of its life expectancy, so Israel recommended that we just replace it with a new machine.

Israel was prompt, professional, courteous, and very thorough. Although we didn't get full resolution to our problem, Israel successfully completed the tasks Ben Franklin could do and I was very happy with Israel's performance.

12-11-2024 Addendum: A toilet was unable to flush due to a disconnected flushing mechanism. The shut off valve for the toilet developed a leak so I called Ben (on Sunday) and they scheduled an appt for Monday. Israel appeared promptly and as usual was professional, courteous, and thorough. Israel replaced the shut off valve, the fill hose, the flushing fill valve, and the "flushing flap". Once he completed the repair, he checked everything including the water flow to other rooms. Israel did an excellent job and very efficiently.

A new review for Ben Franklin. Israel called to ask if he could come early and arrived about 45 minutes after his call. We thought we had a problem with the water heater. We had plenty of hot water up to and including Friday, 05/02/2025. Then, starting on Saturday, 05/03/2025, the output from the heater was lukewarm at best. Israel could find nothing wrong with the water heater except the setting had been changed and was too low. After setting the temperature to the 120 degree or "Hot" mark the heater was restored to its usual behavior. We have no idea how the temperature setting got changed, but it obviously did since we had hot water from installation of the heater until 05/02/2025. Israel instructed me to keep an eye on the heater and if there were any problems to call him right away. As always, Israel was professional, efficient, very clear in his explanations, and very polite. Another 5-star rating for Ben Franklin.

reviews.author: 4728P13A
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, my experience with this company was highly disappointing. The technician contacted me four hours after the scheduled appointment window to inform me that he would not be able to complete the plumbing request due to the age of the water heater. This issue should have been identified well in advance—especially considering the appointment had been scheduled ten days prior. It is concerning that the scheduling personnel lacked the knowledge to recognize the type of equipment their technicians are qualified to service. With a ten-day lead time, there was more than enough opportunity to properly review the job details and make necessary adjustments. Last-minute cancellations of this nature reflect poor coordination and unprofessionalism.

When my disappointment was shared with the technician, he brushed it off with the following statement "Will cancel your appointment. Feel free to call to reschedule  thanks 😊".  What a snub and a lack of courtesy displayed here.

I would NEVER waste my time with a company such as this who does not value their customers. FYI, NO CUSTOMERS, NO REVENUE!

reviews.author: Adam Holmwood
reviews.text:
It takes a lot for me to be compelled to write a poor review. We hired Benjamin Franklin Plumbing (Columbia, MD) on August 29, 2025 to clear a clog in our kitchen sink. The technician was here for about 40 minutes and used a standard Snake K-60 machine (the type you can rent at Home Depot for ~$75/day). The total bill was $650, which was shocking compared to the $350–$400 range that we later learned other reputable companies typically charge for the same service and labor.

I called Benjamin Franklin Plumbing's office three separate times (Aug. 30, Sept. 3, and Sept. 5) asking to please speak with a manager or owner about the invoice. Each time I was promised a call back within 48–72 business hours. No one ever returned my calls. On my third attempt, the receptionist became argumentative instead of assuring me I would receive a call back.

In my opinion, this company overcharged us and then refused to provide any accountability or even a courtesy call back from management. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this company and would advise others to shop around before calling them.

reviews.author: Nadine Khale -Marseille
reviews.text: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing Company a Maryland-based plumbing company provided a frustrating experience. They sent a plumber to diagnose an issue with my tankless water heater, but I was shocked to be overcharged after being quoted a much lower price initially. The plumber assured me they’d contact the manufacturer and order the necessary part, but follow-up has been a nightmare. Despite multiple attempts, they’ve been unresponsive to messages and calls. The lack of professionalism and communication is incredibly disappointing, leaving my issue unresolved and leaving me to regret choosing their services. I won’t be using or recommending Benjamin Plumbing Company again. Avoid them

reviews.author: Anita Ginyard
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Israel from Benjamin Franklin Plumbing. He arrived on time and was very professional throughout the process. After assessing the issue, he provided me with a clear estimate before any work was done. He was also very knowledgeable, and his plan for addressing the problem made perfect sense. Unfortunately, my insurance company did not approve the work, so I had to pause the service until I could resolve things with them. Despite this, I truly appreciate Israel’s professionalism, expertise, and promptness. I would highly recommend both him and Benjamin Franklin Plumbing for their excellent service!

reviews.author: Ramona Randall
reviews.text: All I can say is....AMAZING! Israel and his assistant were very professional, polite and everything was explained and all of my questions were answered. I did not encounter any surprises as Israel was up front on what i needed and pricing. I was advised on proactive techniques and they did an amazing job all around. Great job! Israel was absolutely fabulous and he made my horrible emergency, broken pipes/shower, go away and fixed my problem,installed a completely new shower system, so my family and I are back in business. Thanks for all your help!

reviews.author: Harry Silver
reviews.text: Arrived the day I called about a  fixed a clogged toilet and promply and competently fixed it. My only complaint is the plumber's persistent effort to give me a written estimate for a new toilet.  I repeatedly told him not to do an estimate because I didn't need a new toilet, but he wrote one up anyway.  Because this has happened before with this firm,I don't know if it is company policy to require its plumbers to pitch upsells, I didn't appreciate having to discuss an estimate for sonething I didn't want.

reviews.author: Karen Kaczorowski
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the services provided by Benjamin Franklin Plumbing.   Israel, the plumber, was very professional and took the time to explain why my emergency water shut-off valve was leaking and how long it would take to replace the valve.   I have used Benjamin Franklin Plumbing services in both Maryland and Delaware and always pleased with services provided.   Lexie, who works in the office, also provides great customer service.

reviews.author: Jason Hase
reviews.text: Israel was friendly, professional, and very thorough investigating our leak. He explained exactly what he would do and what the cost would be for each step in the process. Turns out he could tell there was no persistent leak and tie the water accumulation to excess water outside our upstairs shower and some gaps in the caulk by the tub. All options were explored to ensure nothing was missed which was much appreciated. Would hire again.

reviews.author: Sheila Anderson
reviews.text: Israel called me in the morning with his estimated time of arrival.  He arrived within his time frame and got to work—my garbage disposal had run its course and was replaced.  He let me know the “life span” of garbage disposals.  He also replace the flapper in the Kohler commode tank.  He was very informative about what I can do to maintain the plumbing “ health” of my home.  I am exceedingly happy with the work he did.

synthesis.summary: Benjamin Franklin of Harford County runs hot and cold depending on which tech shows up: Israel Romero and Ira Miller draw consistent praise for thoroughness, honest pricing, and quick turnaround — Ira restored water in under 2 hours for a quarter of a competitor's quote. But the franchise carries Benjamin Franklin's structural pricing problem: multiple reviewers document $700 quotes for a $20 cartridge fix, $800 for a sump pump, and $650 for a drain snake job that competitors charge $350-400 for, with management unreachable when customers try to dispute bills.
strengths: Israel Romero praised consistently across many reviews — thorough inspection, clear explanation of costs, arrives on time or early
Ira Miller restored water in under 2 hours on an emergency call for 1/4 the price a competitor quoted for a 2-day-later visit
Same-day and next-day availability is documented across multiple reviews
One tech went out of his way to avoid ceiling damage by finding an alternative routing for a gas line
weaknesses: Pricing is consistently described as overpriced: $700 for a faucet when a $20 cartridge was the actual fix, $650 for a drain snake job market-priced at $350
Scheduling reliability is a problem: one customer's 10-day-advance appointment was cancelled 4 hours past the window with no accommodation
Plumbers reportedly push upsells on toilet replacements even when explicitly told not to generate an estimate
bestFor: Scheduled maintenance and inspections where Israel or Ira is assigned
Non-urgent plumbing work where you can vet the tech assigned
redFlags: Technician quoted over $700 for full faucet replacement — actual fix was a $20 cartridge the tech never bothered to check
$800 charged for a sump pump replacement that other companies perform for significantly less
Management unresponsive to billing disputes — customer who was overcharged called three times and never received a callback from management
After spending $1,200 over two visits, customer's house remained in disrepair and gift card was not honored
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Some emergency responsiveness documented (Ira's under-2-hour emergency response is noteworthy) but scheduling cancellations and late arrivals appear in negative reviews. Not a reliable 24/7 service.

sump-pump.topQuote: Israel was pleasant, knowledgeable, and efficient. The pump replacement was close in cost to what my research online led me to expect. All done less than 24 hours after we discovered the problem.

faucet-fixture.topQuote: Israel explained everything and did a quick and fantastic job. Pricing was straight forward. Took less than two hours. Will use again.

toilet.topQuote: Arrived the day I called. Fixed a clogged toilet promptly and competently. My only complaint is the plumber's persistent effort to give me a written estimate for a new toilet I didn't need.

water-heater.topQuote: They quoted $600 to install a faucet and $800 for the faucet itself. When I said no, they tried to charge double the $100 service fee.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: They charged $650 for a kitchen drain unclog using a standard Snake K-60 machine — the type you can rent at Home Depot for $75/day. Other companies charge $350-400 for the same service.

plumbers.address: 208 Austin St, Worcester, MA 01609, USA

reviews.author: Michael Bollus
reviews.text: Our furnace stopped working on Thursday before Christmas, I called Garabedian plumbing. They immediately dispatched a service team to my home and had a new furnace installed by 4 o’clock the next day. The team that did the installation was outstanding, the customer service getting to that point was exceptional, and the pricing was very reasonable. I can’t recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Karen Wheeler
reviews.text: Very happy with this company. They were very nice to deal with.     Needed a faucet installed and some work under the vanity.    The plumber they sent was James Martin and he did an excellent job!  Very polite and professional.  He knew exactly what needed to be done and we are so pleased to have no more leaks and a beautiful new faucet.     Would have him come back anytime!

reviews.author: Heather Ulfves
reviews.text: Garabedian was professional, pleasant, knowledgeable and clean! Jesse did the work on our house. He was awesome! Even helped me find a new tub by recommending a little known place. He was the best! Thanks forr replacing all the plumbing in our house and saving us from more plumbing problems in the future!

reviews.author: Ivan Aguinaga
reviews.text: Not the way to run a business. Did not want to service me because my job wasn’t big enough for them to come by .

reviews.author: R G
reviews.text:
Will not be my first choice anymore,
They like to assume, you know what happens when you do this, make an as* out of yourself.

reviews.author: Joseph Summer
reviews.text: I've needed several matters dealt with recently, and Garabedian Plumbing has come through with aplomb. Alec has done excellent work on the problems I'd identified, but also gave advice that will save me problems in the future. Specifically, Alec identified a problem with the kitchen sink's mooring into the countertop (while installing a garbage disposal) and assisted me in identifying the proper masonry options I had to prevent the sink from falling. His advice will likely save me the necessity of replacing the entire countertop and sink after an expected accident. Alec's assistant, Sal, installed a jerryrigged temporary support to the kitchen sink so that I can use it while waiting for the masons to have an opening. All of this is above and beyond the call of duty. In addition to their professional expertise, they cleaned up after their work. The guys were affable and that temperament was clearly natural. It was a pleasure having Garabedian solve my plumbing problems now, and - unfortunately for me - I'm looking forward to their replacing my basement toilet that is more of an antique than it is functional. I recommend Garabedian without reservation.

reviews.author: Peter Gelles
reviews.text:
We've used Garabedian on a number of occasions for various small/medium projects (servicing, replacing a direct vent heater), and then sadly this weekend, both our hot water heater and boiler died.

Two days after this died, we had heat and hot water again! Yes, it's expensive (but not as bad as I'd initially feared). Yes, you get what you pay for and I will recommend Garabedian to anyone. Rick was terrific this week, and we'd worked with Steve in the past.

Rick clearly takes pride in his work and patiently took the time to show how everything worked together and what I needed to do to maintain it. The work area was clean and neat when he left.

If you need a plumber, call Garabedian.

UPDATE: We continue to use Garabedian for all our plumbing needs. Very recently, Al (Alec?) came to repair a couple of leaky basement pipes, unclog a slow shower, and replace a garbage disposal. In and out in a few hours. He continues the string of outstanding plumbers and outstanding work and I can't thank him enough. Maybe it's a little odd that my shower is no longer ankle-deep with water, but whatever. It's the little things, right?

reviews.author: Leslie Williams
reviews.text:
Our tenant called us Friday pm to let us know the water heater was leaking. Even though it was Friday evening, I began calling around (ABC order) for a plumbing company.
By evening’s end, I had received no return calls. On Sat am at 8:30, I called Garabedian Plumbing:: and received a call back by 8:40. RICK  gave me an amount, and said he would be at the house soon. I met him at 9:45 and the work began. He also wore an N95 mask, and I and the tenant were most appreciative.
RICK and Garabedian Plumbing will get ALL of our business from now on.
Thank you!!

Review #2:
First of all, Garabedian’s is the best plumbing company in central MA! We have had them out to our home in Northborough multiple times, and each time the plumbers come we get a professional, thorough, and swift job done by friendly, competent crews.
For example, I woke up to a ceiling leak this morning; I called before 8, explained by issue (active leak), Mike and Sal showed up around 10:30 and they were done by 11:30 - leak fixed!
They were friendly and efficient and bonus: they loved my dog!
You can’t ask for any better plumbing service! Trust me!

reviews.author: Derek Corriveau
reviews.text:
I recently needed their emergency service as it was 22 degrees and my boiler was not working.  I called at 7 pm on a Sunday and Rick called me back within minutes.  He assessed the situation over the phone and told me what my options were.
I had some work to do on my end, but Rick made himself available via face time to assist me with getting the boiler running.  After 4 attempts via face time the boiler fired up and is running this morning.  Rick was patient and helpful the entire time he juggled his family and helped me ( I was not a customer of Garabedian at the time).  I will be as of today.
A company that has people like Rick working for them is obviously invested in a company with a strong customer service focus.  I can't thank Rick enough for helping me get the boiler going and saving me hundreds of dollars for something I could do myself with a little guidance.

Thank you Garabedian Plumbing for carefully selecting the team that services your customers.  I will be calling to schedule a cleaning today and I now have a new Plumbing/Heating Company.

reviews.author: Doug F
reviews.text:
8 AM -Our Water Heater decided to fail and leak in our basement. We called Garabedian Plumbing. I sent a photo to them of our current water heater.
8:15 AM. received call back from Garabedian telling us they had a quality water heater in stock and would come by same day to install.
10 AM Garabedian arrives , removes the old water heater and install new one.  This is not easy- some new exhaust pipes installed to meet current code, getting permit and inspection from City of Worcester. I asked for addition of drip pan.
2 PM Zach and Kyle install new water heater  and 1/2 hour later the water is hot. My wife is very happy-which makes me happy.
Invoice is very reasonable for a quality AO Smith water heater with 6 year warranty. Workmanship on installation looks first rate.
Garabedian Plumbing was recommended to me by my neighbors and they gave me great advice. A very good experience that started with a what I thought was a big problem.

reviews.author: Delilah Everton
reviews.text: We made an emergency call and spoke with the answering service.  While the answering service was phenomenal, the service was not!  The on call person called us back and said he would be over after he finished 2 more jobs.  Hours and hours passed without word.  I called the answering service again requesting that the on call person let us know an approximate time frame in which we could expect him.  Answering service told me that if I didn't hear from the on call person within 30-40 to call back.  I waited an hour and called back.  Answering service sent a message to on call person yet again, asking them to call or text us with a timeframe.  No response at all from the on call person.  Received a call the following morning and at that point we had already found a much more reliable company to come out and fix our issue.

reviews.author: Tacori Tai
reviews.text: Do not use Garabedian. ZERO STARS! They are not thorough and Cindy is THE RUDEST person at this company. I don't know if she's the owners family member but you need to get her out of your office. She constantly gaslighted me during our phone conversation (yell-fest) and refused to allow me to express my thoughts and stance. She kept speaking over me and twisting my comments to suit her needs. Initially, I'd been a customer for Garabedian for a few years. I always dealt with techs like Zach or Jimmy (both of whom I enjoyed working with). I never had to deal with back office initially.  This January 2022 I had a no heat call placed.  It's April now and I still have no heat. I had 5 visits from Garabedian techs and they haven't fixed my issues (single family home, forced hot air from oil).

reviews.author: Deborah Gordon
reviews.text:
I have had wonderful experiences with Garabedian Plumbing without fail. They are incredibly responsive and do excellent work. They installed my hot water tank two years ago and recently installed a new heating system among other things. Rick is the main person I deal with and he is AWESOME. Great to deal with, professional, terrific customer service and extremely knowledgeable. I had a disaster experience with the prior company I used (major local company) and I am so glad I switched to Garabedian and glad to deal mainly with Rick. I highly recommend Garabedian.

UPDATE: It is now November 2025 and I had additional work done by Garabedian. Excellent quality and great guys- Nate and Eric. I continue to highly recommend.

reviews.author: Steve Lafortune
reviews.text: This company has always been amazing. My father used them for years and when I married and bought my first home 25 years ago, my father told me that I would never go wrong having Garabedian Plumbing & Heating do my work. He was so right! They just got me out of a no heat situation within hours after our initial call even though they said that they were buried with emergency calls. They told me that they prioritize their calls and get to emergencies as soon as possible. This is why I have been their customer in three different homes for the past 25 years. I like my father will make sure my 3 children when they have their own homes continue to use Garabedian for their plumbing or heating issues. Great company!

reviews.author: Paul Webber
reviews.text:
I would like to express my gratitude to Garabedian Plumbing & Heating and to acknowledge the professionalism and efficiency of their company
And,  further to acknowledge their attention to all the services that have been provided to me
Their detail to my needs was met most efficiently and respectfully
They have stood by their reputation and have stood by their services
They have gone beyond the normal in helping correct all my problems
Their staff and service personnel are courteous, efficient, and professional
Thank You Peter and Jim
And your company is a STANDOUT COMPANY
All companies should follow the way you run your company
And, yes for the way you took care of my needs I will pay it forward

synthesis.summary: Garabedian Plumbing has a split personality: loyal long-term customers (some 25+ years) swear by technicians like Rick, James Martin, and Jesse — but multiple 1-star reviews document billing at double the stated hourly rate, a plumber who flooded a home by not shutting off the water first, a 4-month wait for a manager callback, and a reputation for rude office staff. With 14 of 40 sampled reviews at 1 star, this is a company where your experience depends heavily on which tech shows up.

reviews.author: Andrew M
reviews.text: We had two toilets replaced on our second floor one included a bidet. They were actually able to come the day after I requested the service which was fantastic! Both toilets were installed with precision and look great. The guys cleaned up everything and even carried our old toilets outside for us. This is the second job we’ve had Plumb-It do and we’ve continued to have a wonderful experience. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: June McHale
reviews.text: James and Alex did a great job installing 3 bathroom faucets and new shower fixture.  They were very respectful of our home. They patiently answered our questions.  They did the job in a timely manner and cleaned up after themselves.  We would definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Christopher Yarborough
reviews.text: I've done business with Plumb It several times over the past 12+ years. Always customer focused, quick, direct, and with fair pricing. Support Scott and his team of trademen. A local small business that you can trust. I wish I could say that about any of the other smaller outfits I use for other needs.

reviews.author: Jody Bruce
reviews.text: Plumb It  Best did a great job at my house. I needed 2 new faucets installed. They showed up on time and had it fixed very quickly. If you need plumbing work, you have to call Plumb It Best!

reviews.author: Tory Tribuzio
reviews.text: They are the  BEST! My old waterheater was removed and a New Highest Quality Bradford- White 40 gallon waterheater was installed PROFESSIONALLY in 2 hours! Thank You PLUMB-IT BEST!

synthesis.summary: Plumb It Best appears to be a reliable, customer-focused plumbing company with strong installation skills and professional service. They have excellent customer satisfaction and a long track record, though emergency response time is unclear from these reviews.

reviews.author: Natalee Grant
reviews.text: Steven and Will did an excellent job! They were able to get me in the same day, which I truly appreciated. They were both very professional, took the time to explain everything in great detail, and made sure I understood the process from start to finish. Their knowledge and attention to detail really stood out. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Kevin Pagan
reviews.text: Steve and Will did an excellent job installing my water filter for me

reviews.author: Linda Randels
reviews.text: Steve and Will were great!

reviews.author: Johnnie Jacobs
reviews.text:
Called Cherokee Plumbing again after a couple other really good experiences.  They replaced my old bathroom pedestal sink with a new sink/vanity I had ordered.  Will and Steven did a great job. They called on their way over, were very detailed in their work, kept me up to date on the progress. From setting up the appointment with Mary, talking about sink options with Will and Colin, to completing the project, it was all a very pleasant, friendly, and good experience.  I have definitely found the company I can call "my plumbers". 😊👍  Highly recommend!!!  Thank you again for your help.

6 months ago...
My toilet was beginning to run on it's own and I was having to occasionally shut off the valve to get it to stop. I called Cherokee Plumbing and Will came out today to repair it. He was very polite and professional. He checked out the problem and gave me his recommendation and the cost before doing the work.  He completed the job and double checked it before he left.  I was planning on putting in a taller toilet in the future and he looked at the specs of the one I was interested in to make for sure it would work. He did a good job on the repair.  I'll definitely be calling Cherokee Plumbing in the future.  Mvto! 😊

reviews.author: G M
reviews.text: Cherokee Plumbing has provided me with quality plumbing at competitive prices for years and the service I received today was no exception. Rudy was the embodiment of a professional. He was punctual, personable, knowledgeable and had excellent communication skills. He accurately diagnosed the issue, explained the issue, told me what needed to be done and gave me a cost estimate. I approved Rudy’s proposal with the understanding sheetrock would likely have to be cut in order to reach the problem pressure regulator. Rudy worked efficiently making exceptionally neat cuts in the sheetrock requiring minimal cosmetic restoration. He at all times protected the carpet from debris and water. His excellent time utilization was reflected in the final cost being at the low end of his original estimate. The repair not only totally addressed the problem but he adjusted the whole house water pressure to a standard not previously enjoyed.

reviews.author: Patricia M
reviews.text:
My toilets had clogged tight but it was more than that!  In the attempts to clear the drain, they discovered I had a clean out!  It had been buried about 3 ft and was right where previous owners had put the hot tub (they took with them)!  WHO DOES THAT !!?!!??
Steven & Rudy dug out the clean out & back water valves & had to replace the very old broken valves. They cut pipes and added pipes setting it up as it should have been done.  They worked hard & steady & did a good job!  They were  also friendly, polite, & respectful.  Collin (owner) came out at one point & verified things were as they should be.
It’s not fun to spend $ on plumbing but it is so good to know my clogged drain issues are resolved!

reviews.author: Ariel Playstation
reviews.text: I love my plumber with Breco plumbing that he collaborated with Cherokee Hills plumbing and they saved me tons of money and did an excellent job. I just never seen two companies that go above and beyond like they do. Will and Rudy from Cherokee plumbing or absolutely so professional so courteous so nice and I knew they had my best interest .  Bryan from Bryco plumbing Heat and Air was and has been awesome to work with for several years but this time we need a camera so I am so proud of Bryan working with them and collaborating on my defense. They’re awesome. Will and Rudy could not be more pleasant and then Bryan just takes the cake too.!

reviews.author: Michael Shaughnessy
reviews.text:
First time customer. Very impressed with Cherokee Plumbing & Heating’s knowledgeable, and personable crew. They are quick to communicate, willing to take time to explain problem solving approach, answer customers questions, and are respectful of customers property, both inside and out. Very glad a friend of ours recommended calling Cherokee

Compliments to Mary, their office mgr, for quickly responding to my weekend voice mail request. Also to Will, the service lead, and to Rudy and Steven for their collective efforts and experience in developing the best option using specialty equipment to solve the drain line problem.
Mike S

reviews.author: Suzy Simpson
reviews.text:
New review post today, 7/16/2025.  Another great couple of jobs done in one trip “diagnosed” by WILL a week or so ago. RUDY  came today to replace a PRV & kitchen faucet.  Loved my new faucet Rudy found~perfectly matched kitchen sink. Always impressed how these guys get the jobs done, clean & timely.  Appreciate their honesty & care for the job.  #1 for all my plumbing needs‼️

Was a bigger job than thought, but Will was great at explaining each step of the repair. He was patient with me & my questions & kept the cost within the original estimate!!  Very respectful, too!  Thanks, Will!

reviews.author: USMC6565
reviews.text: I’ve used Cherokee several times over the years and they’ve always done a fantastic job. I recently started a DIY bathroom remodel and need help with setting and plumbing a new bathtub. Unfortunately I first went with someone I found off of the Nextdoor app. That was a mistake I won’t make again. I called Cherokee to see if they could fix the mistakes and correctly plumb the tub. Within two days, Will and Patrick from Cherokee came and professionally installed the tub. Don’t make the same mistake I did, hire Cherokee and get it done correctly the first time.

reviews.author: Eva Fancher
reviews.text: I called Cherokee Plumbing at 9 am and Rudy and Steven came out that afternoon. They were really nice, respectful guys and diagnosed the issue with my hot water heater within 15 minutes and repaired it within the hour. They went to Locke Supply and got me a $300 part under warranty so all I was out was for the labor itself, and the price was reasonable. Do not leave plumbing work to handymen who may seem cheaper! Prior to this I had a “plumber” come out who claimed my hot water tank needed to be replaced. Use this company for quick effective results.

reviews.author: Mary Monson
reviews.text: We had a variety of plumbing related jobs to be tackled and Cherokee Plumbing Heat and Air was referred to us for their quality, professionalism, reliability, and knowledge.  Rudy and Ty did a fantastic job.  Everything works just fine and they cleaned up after their work which was appreciated.  We will be calling them again for another job to come and are grateful to have Cherokee Plumbing Heat and Air as a company we can rely on.  Also, many thanks to Mary Moon and her kind way of managing all the messaging and order changes.  She's a keeper!

reviews.author: Timothy Pannes
reviews.text: We got back from work to a water bubble the size of a bowling ball on our office ceiling. Called Cherokee plumbing and they sent out Will to come fix the issue. This is our second time using Cherokee for our plumbing issues and we are customers for life. Both times they came out they’ve been open and honest about pricing and issues. Even giving us advice on what to try ourselves before trying anything more invasive/expensive. For this instance, Will was very knowledgeable and quickly diagnosed and fixed the issue. Huge fan of this company!

reviews.author: Christie Houghton
reviews.text:
Cherokee was super responsive and was able to get to me same day I called for service which was kind of an emergency when my shower wouldn't completely shut off.

Can't say enough good things about  Andy and Rudy.  They were both very professional, kind and completed all the additional jobs I requested when they arrived.   Andy was very knowledgeable and listened to my needs and discussed all options and costs and explained everything so decisions were made easy.   Thank you to Cherokee, Andy and Rudy.   Would recommend 100%!

reviews.author: Jason Henley
reviews.text: I had a leaking water heater in September. Jeremy from Cherokee Plumbing came out, inspected, grabbed parts, and repaired the issue that day. He was extremely knowledgeable and kind. Just this week, our water heater was leaking again. I called him first. He came back out, inspected the water heater. He tried to find a way to repair it to save us money. Unfortunately, it needed replacing. He replaced it that day at a surprisingly low price! Fast, knowledgeable, and amazing service that is trying to save me cash! SIGN ME UP.

reviews.author: Emily Codding
reviews.text: DJ did a great job at our house today.  He repaired 2 toilets, replaced the faucet in our outdoor kitchen, and replaced the pot filler above our stove.  He arrived exactly when he said he would and the prices were very fair.  I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Carolyn Sharp
reviews.text: They were very polite and quick with their repairs.  Reasonably priced also

reviews.author: Tee Lee
reviews.text: Called an hour ago, they've arrived 15mins later, and repaired my water pipe connection to the utility water pipe on the curb in less than an hour.  Issue was due to faulty connector, not freezing temperatures.  I highly recommend Plumbtastic and as a homeowner, will use them again.

reviews.author: Michael Stockman
reviews.text:
Avoid this company. Had them come out to look at a water line break I had and hopefully fix it. They wanted to charge me $2500 to install pex line and $325 to find the leak. Over $2800 to install one 30 foot pex line. Then they said we are charging you $69 to come out and look at it. At no time when I booked the appointment did they tell me about the $69 fee. When I called back after the appointment and asked about it. I was told “I assumed you knew.”  First off people just don’t know you charge fees. You must let them know about the fee BEFORE they book the appointment. That is bad business and just wrong to tell people about fees after you arrive. She then said we will remove it if you book with us. Well I would have had no issue booking if that price made sense. But I had already had to estimates for $1600 the day before. Which honestly I thought was high before getting their quote. The call got progressively worse and the lady even more mad when I stated that the prices were too high and the fee was never disclosed. The other two companies didn’t charge a fee to come out. Long story short just find a new company. I do not believe all of the reviews of this site for this company.

—-As you can see below by their reply they are not a good company. I recorded the call of her saying they she assumed I knew because I was asking for the repair and that’s what all business do. She should have just said from the beginning I’m sorry I didn’t tell you about the charge we won’t charge you. That would have been the end of it. But instead she argued with me about a $69 charge. Now she is attacking the reviews I complete when business like hers try and take advantage of the consumer or provide poor service. I will continue to post about poor service and horrible companies as they happen and great service and companies as I experience them.

reviews.author: Kaci Morris
reviews.text:
08/06/24
Needed Zack again and he was prompt, professional and did a great job! He’s definitely my go to plumber!

10/30/23
UPDATE: Needed Zack to put a cut-off valve on a gas line connected to my dryer. I called Laura and within a few days, Zack was at my house and not only took care of the gas line, but moved out my old dryer and brought in the new dryer. Zack is always going above and beyond for his clients! Plumbtastic Solutions is the plumbing company to call! I wouldn’t use anyone else!!!

05/26/23
UPDATE: Needed Zack again and he was prompt, thorough, honest and got the job done. We have used Zack and Plumbtastic Solutions ever since he first started his plumbing business. He never lets us down!!!

Keira takes care of the calls and always great to work with!  Mark always a great job!!!  Thanks to all!!!

reviews.author: M Richards
reviews.text:
Terrific small family company... my favorite kind.
Responsive, reliable. personable, punctual, communicative and conscientious.
Zach and Laura make an amazing synergistic team and have been invaluable in rehabilitating the 77 year old plumbing in my son's post war (1948) house, and will continue to be (we're not done yet!)
Laura keeps them organized and on schedule, completely understands the complexities of the job and the business and her estimates are always accurate. Excellent communicator. Not afraid to wield a shovel either.
Zach is undaunted by any complication and always has a solution. He is intuitive, efficient and works quickly and conscientiously.
They leave the work space clean, tidy and their
repairs are impeccable.
Best of all, they're delightful people. Recommend without reservation.

reviews.author: Nick Davis
reviews.text:
I have worked with a bunch of plumbing companies throughout my career, dealing with commercial buildings.  I haven’t ever experienced really terrible service but I just thought they were all about the same. Some good, some bad.

While dealing with an issue, I gave one of those companies a call and they actually referred me to Plumbtastic.

I quickly realized they are not all the same.  The level of service, easy communication, and price, puts Plumbtastic at another level. You can rely on them to do what they say. They arrive when they say they’re gonna arrive and don’t add services or change any plans without speaking to you first.

Each time, I paid what I was quoted. Every aspect of the customer to business relationship with them is simply great!

Thank you, Laura and Zach!

reviews.author: Clyde
reviews.text: I had a plumber come out 3 years ago to replace my outside leaking faucet. It worked fine for 2 years before starting to leak. The same company sent someone else out, who messed with it and was able to get it to stop leaking. He said that if it leaked again, they were going to have to do the work from the inside, meaning, cutting out the drywall that I would have to repair. A year later, I noticed it leaking after not being used for a period. I decided to use Plumbtastic Solutions, who was recommended to me by a friend. Zack examined the issue and determined that it was a cheap brand that was damaged during installation. He was able to replace the faucet and redo the mortar in a timely manner. I will use him again.

reviews.author: Julie Pyle
reviews.text: Hands down the best!  Noone ever wants to deal with plumbing issues, especially during freezing temperatures.  Plumbtastic was extremely quick to respond, communicated fabulously and has punctuality mastered.  They were courteous, respectful of my home,  and worked efficiently and professionally. Knowing they are swamped with all kinds of plumbing emergencies right now, they arrived with a positive attitude and did not rush the repair.  I could not be more invested in recommending a company than I am Plumbtastic.  Zach and Laura were such a pleasure to work with – took great care of me and my plumbing problem!  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Natalie Cooper
reviews.text: We had the most wonderful experience dealing with Zach and Laura with Plumbtastic Solutions!!  They were so professional, timely, communicative, and efficient!!  Before they entered our home they put on footies and Laura’s exact statement was, “we want to treat your home as if it was our own” and they did that exactly, which is a top level of customer service that I completely appreciated as a homeowner and it’s those kind of things that make them stand out from many!! They were so friendly and personable while executing the job efficiently!   I would recommend them to everyone, they were great!!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer H
reviews.text: We have worked with several local plumbing companies and Plumbtastic solutions has been the best! Not only do the answer their phones and respond promptly but they are timely and hard working. We have used them several times for large and small issues. They have shown honesty, integrity and persistence in finding the problem time and time again. So grateful for quality work at a good price! DJ and Cayde were very professional and courteous.

reviews.author: bassguitarman s
reviews.text:
This was my first experience with Zachary and Laura after having read several very positive recommendations on Facebook groups.  Very nice people to work with and no huge upsell pressure about replacement.  Zachary explained the problem and repaired it after making a trip for parts.  The price was fair and reasonable.

I have a few other jobs on other houses that I will call them for.  For now, I have found my new plumbing company to use.

reviews.author: Deryl Gotcher
reviews.text: I needed a kitchen faucet replaced. A friend recommended Plumbtastic Solutions. I left a message and they called back immediately. We made an appointment and they came out when scheduled and did an excellent job installing the new faucet at a reasonable price. Laura and Zach know their business and are very nice people. We will definitely call them in the future for plumbing jobs.

reviews.author: sonya hagler
reviews.text: Plumbtastic Solutions has been helpful, informative and reliable. We’ve had large plumbing issues over the past few years and Zach / Laura have been quick to respond to my initial calls and always have us scheduled within a reasonable timeframe.  They are dependable, trustworthy and just good people.  I highly recommend them for any and all plumbing related issues.

reviews.author: LaTosha Dancy
reviews.text: Josh with Plumbtastic was fast and professional. He was very knowledgeable and helped prevent us from being scammed by another company. When I called I spoke with Laura and she was very wonderful helping us quickly. She was very positive and helpful. This will be our go to company. They worked us in on an emergency situation and we are grateful.

reviews.author: Scot Sigler
reviews.text: Shelby was courteous and prompt. Got my sewer line back up and working after finding the break. Easy to communicate with and sent me plenty of pictures of progress to completion since I was out of town.

reviews.author: Steven frazier
reviews.text: Ricky did a great job and was very friendly & professional.

reviews.author: Lorri Davis
reviews.text: Greg was very polite and professional, took the time to explain to me what he needed to do. Tanner was also great.

reviews.author: Levon Clark jr
reviews.text: Toilet is not flushing the next day after service

reviews.author: Angel Reign
reviews.text: Attempt to call, agent with foreign accent hangs up my face.

reviews.author: Tim Miller
reviews.text: This is a derilic company. Stay clear! Three visits in one month, almost a thousand dollars later, to fix an ac unit? The owner, joe, was combative when i talked to him, just to finally get an ac repair done right. Do yourself a favor and call a qualified company. Joe told me i was out of their service range, after sending a technician the first time bc "they had some down time" he did offer to pay back the first two visits, like the check is in the mail type of deal. Last visit was a total accumulation of lies. Supposedly it was my downstairs unit that was affecting my upstairs unit. Downstairs unit was running perfectly. But the shady stuff happened when the tech lied about that,then passed me off to the money collector. After i gave my card number, he hung up abruptly. This company does not need to be allowed to do repairs in Oklahoma! Best of luck joe .edit, still waiting on that refund that you said two week ago.

reviews.author: Byron Hood
reviews.text: Taylor Faudree and his partner were absolutely amazing. Educated me in the process of getting my sewer line replaced. Even gave me a decent deal for install. He kept me in the loop of what was going on and being done throughout the entire process and always returned my calls for questions. He even came back after the job was done around 7:30pm on a Friday evening when I called about my shower drain backing up hours before. He kept his word about coming back to check on me. Of course when he got there, the drain was perfectly fine - just had to flush some gunk out that remained after the install. Couldn’t recommend Amped and Taylor enough. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Malc Combs
reviews.text: Dakota was actually 10+ stars - he made contact when he first arrived - again told me real prob after checking - again told me the fix & going to get needed parts- brought broken pipe of main water line for me to see - after fix completed, showed me pic of finished repair because it was now covered with soil - & lastly brought final invoice with great advice for future issues if any - just a jewel type of worker - patient, thoughtful, competent, positive, fast & efficient - wow, truly one-of-a-kind - THANKS FOR HIRING HIM - DESERVES A RAISE & PROMOTION - most sincerely, mc

reviews.author: Avery Cannon
reviews.text: I would give our service technician, Wade 5 stars. But the company as whole was lacking. No preparation or attention to detail before hand. Forced my business to close longer than anticipated. Told me a short timeline just to get the bid. I even called the day before to make sure they were prepared. Lost an entire day of work with no preparation. The job got done. They did a great job, but if you’re a small business owner, everyday matters. And losing days of sales is hard to come back from.

reviews.author: Bradley “B-radzilla” Vaillancourt
reviews.text:
Waited 4 hrs at a vacant house to be called after there time slot had passed and asked if they could reschedule the next day. Sorry, I just gave up a half day of work for a no show.

Update: Had a good conversation with the owner. He responded head on with humility and has committed to making it right. I respect his approach and think a lot of service providers can learn from him. I will be updating to a 5 star rating and will be recommending him.

reviews.author: John Biggs
reviews.text: Wes was super courteous and didn’t waste any time getting right to the job at hand, he gave excellent advice on how to keep my drains clean and hopefully problem free. He was done in just under an hour and left zero clean up for me the customer which I really appreciate. I highly recommend Amped and Wesley Norton. Thanks so much for your efficient work Wes!

reviews.author: Leslie Hammons
reviews.text: The 5 Stars definitely go to Wesley! He’s the real deal plumber.  Very honest, hard working guy.  He was my 3rd plumber to try and diagnose my problem.  He listened to me and knew exactly what the problem was! He had an apprentice named Tanner that worked with him and he was very polite and respectful. He will go far learning from Wesley!

reviews.author: Tara Ferguson
reviews.text:
Chris was fast and efficient getting to our emergency. He let me know. He didn’t have the parts for it today, but tomorrow he would be out first thing tomorrow now that is quality service coming out on a Sunday. Again thanks I really appreciate your company coming out on a Sunday and getting it done.
The Fergusons

reviews.author: Debbie Williams
reviews.text: Byron and Greg did a fantastic job ! They explained everything they were going to do and why and how they  were going to complete the job. They cleaned up after each cut in the sheet rock. They helped move furniture that needed to be out of the way. We are so impressed with the work that was done today!

reviews.author: Laurie Ramirez
reviews.text: Ricky was super helpful and knowledgeable. Our house was built in 1964 and has not had updates since then so as you can imagine every little thing balloons into a bigger problem but we really didn't have to stress because our repair was taken care of quickly and we are very pleased.

synthesis.summary: Amped Plumbing's field technicians — Wade, Dakota, Stephen, Greg, Shelby, Taylor — draw consistent praise for prompt arrival, clear explanations, and clean work. The company has a 4.9 Google rating with 195 reviews, but 5 low-star entries reveal friction points: one customer describes three visits and nearly $1,000 to fix an AC unit before the owner became combative and offered a refund that reportedly never came, and one review notes the phone agent hung up on them. For plumbing specifically, same-day and sub-hour response is well-documented.
strengths: Technician Stephen arrived in under an hour and resolved the job
Shelby fixed a sewer line break and sent progress photos to an out-of-town customer throughout the repair
Dakota photographed the buried finished repair and brought the broken pipe piece for the customer to see — thorough transparency
Presented all repair options without pressure to take the most expensive
Pipes burst response — sent someone over right away
weaknesses: One reviewer notes 'no preparation or attention to detail beforehand' — forced a small business to close longer than estimated
At least one pricing complaint: 'Excellent service but cost was high'
Owner became combative in one dispute after three failed AC repair visits
bestFor: Customers who want a communicative tech
redFlags: One reviewer documents three visits and ~$1,000 to fix an AC unit with no lasting resolution; owner reportedly combative and a promised refund never materialized
One caller reports the phone agent hung up on them

plumbers.address: 9083 Perry St, Westminster, CO 80031, USA

reviews.author: JoDee Ramstetter
reviews.text: Eloy was amazing! He was so conscientious and professional. He showed me the video & explained each step thoroughly. I paid 2 other plumbing companies, 1 large company & 1 independent before I called All Sewer & Drain who finally cleared the clog. I would highly recommend this company. Thank you

reviews.author: Cade A
reviews.text: This company has been amazing! I have used them for my house and some of my friends have used this company as well! They are very efficient and amazing about communication, they explain everything in depth and it was very clear what the problem was and what needed to be addressed as they communicate every step of the way! I had a main line clog and it needed to be cleaned out but there was an additional problem which was causing the clog. They found the problem and fixed it! Amazing price as well! I had a company come out previously and they were 2X the amount for the same scope of work. They have been amazing from start to finish! Pricing and reliability, professionally, quality, and every aspect every person hopes to get from a company! If you need any of their services, I recommend All Sewer Solutions ALWAYS!

reviews.author: Padam
reviews.text:
I was so worried after main sewer line clogged, called this company and got an appointment 1.5hrs later. Mr Ben was here, he was nice and friendly very cool guy, working with professional also good price. I would like to highly recommend for all.
Thank you

reviews.author: Karen Christensen
reviews.text: Extremely trustworthy company! As a realtor I have worked with Jeff and his team on everything from sewer cleaning to major sewer line replacements for my clients. Prompt, responsive, knowledgeable with very reasonable prices. Jeff is ethical and cares about his reputation, & in my experience he will never try to upsell you repairs that aren't needed. I highly recommend this company for all your sewer and plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Robert Akins
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with All Sewer and Plumbing Services! Their team was prompt, professional, and extremely knowledgeable about all aspects of sewer line repair, drain cleaning, and general plumbing services. They arrived on time, performed a detailed sewer camera inspection, and explained everything clearly so I understood exactly what needed to be done.

All Sewer and Plumbing Services handled my sewer line replacement efficiently and at a fair, transparent price. It’s obvious they take pride in their work and are committed to providing top-quality service to Colorado homeowners.

If you need sewer repair, main line cleaning, hydro jetting, or any emergency plumbing repair in Colorado, I highly recommend All Sewer and Plumbing Services. Outstanding workmanship, honest communication, and excellent customer service!

synthesis.summary: All Sewer and Plumbing Services LLC demonstrates exceptional reliability with same-day emergency response (appointments within 1.5 hours), professional service, and fair pricing. Multiple customers praise their thorough explanations, honest approach, and ability to solve problems other companies couldn't fix.

plumbers.address: 703 Millview Dr, Batavia, IL 60510, USA

reviews.author: Donna Bode
reviews.text: The team at Restoration Plumbing are excellent. Brandon and Aden were the technicians who worked at my house today and they were one-time, communicative, and ensured I understood what they were doing and that I was happy with the results of their work. From Derek, the owner, to every team member of this company you will experience their in-depth knowledgeable, their kindness, and professionalism. There is no other plumbing company I would have out to my home. I am a Realtor and if a client is in need of plumbing services, Derek and his team at Restoration Plumbing is the number I share. A+++ plumbing service and a very easy referral for me to make!

reviews.author: Billy Vigliotti
reviews.text:
Derek was very responsive from first contact and easy to work with.  Brandon and his son were great on the job.  They supplied and installed a new ejector pump and replaced 2 outdoor faucets. The team was very professional and thorough.
Highly recommended and will definitely call for any future needs!

reviews.author: Rebecca Gorski
reviews.text: The individual that installed our shelves drilled into a waste pipe thinking it was a stud, and we didn’t find out until the following evening after using our shower. We called Restoration first thing the next morning and they were able to send someone out that afternoon. Our plumber, Brandon, was incredibly knowledgeable and rolled with all the punches that came from communication with our shelf installer (as it turns out, he had drilled TWO holes into the same pipe). Brandon took the time to be sure the job was done right and answered all of our questions thoroughly and with kindness (and as new homeowners, we had quite a few!). We are so appreciative to have found plumbers we can absolutely trust and they will be our go-to from here on out!

reviews.author: Steve Beach
reviews.text: Brandon & Aiden did a great job! They were on time, friendly and affordable! They repaired a small leak we had and were very honest. They only replaced what needed it and did a very professional and clean job! Would definitely recommend!👍🏻🪠

reviews.author: Peter Heald
reviews.text: The team at Restoration plumbing did a great job replacing our water heater. They explained everything, gave a fair quote, and worked quickly and cleanly. We trust them for all our plumbing needs.

synthesis.summary: Restoration Plumbing Inc. demonstrates exceptional reliability and professionalism with consistently high-quality work and excellent communication. Multiple reviews highlight their responsiveness to urgent situations and honest, thorough approach to repairs. This appears to be a trustworthy choice for emergency plumbing needs.

reviews.author: David Brodsky
reviews.text: Highly recommended.  I was getting ready to travel and noticed a leak just before I was leaving.  I tried calling others I found online but nobody was available.  Luckily, I found T & T Plumbing.  I called and they were at my house within the hour.  They were quick and professional and got the job done right.  Tom Jr. is a great guy and very knowledgeable.  Next time they will be my first call.

reviews.author: Debra Chidester
reviews.text: I had a plumbing issue that turned out to be major and costly. My sewer system needed to be replaced from my foundation to some 30 feet down to the village system. I had used TandT in the past so was very confident in the diagnosis of my problem, not to mention witnessing these old pipes when they were dug up and exposed. The pipe in the foundation had literally sheered off. This was an huge job. Every one of the tradesmen were respectful of our property and  kept our inconvenience to a minimum,. There was great communication and they kept within the estimate. It’s very comforting to know a job like this was done by the highest standards in the industry.  We lost one sidewalk square but they were all 34 years old so we opted to go ahead and replace the sidewalk not just the one square. Tom gave us a referral of who could do this work and as you can see they also did a great job. Thank you TandT.

reviews.author: Jessie Graham
reviews.text: HIGHLY recommend T&T. We needed an urgent repair at 10pm on a Saturday night and they came over without hesitation and fixed it quickly and for a reasonable price. Tom was so friendly, helpful, and quick. We are so appreciative of him for coming out to help!

reviews.author: Chris Wagner
reviews.text: T and T plumbing were absolutely awesome. They were available within a matter of hours. They troubleshot the issue and had it corrected in less than an hour. Pricing is extremely fair. All around good people and great company. I will not be calling anyone else. Thank you for the help.

reviews.author: Paul DeBoer
reviews.text: I'm grateful for the awesome service by Tom (son).  He was very professional and kept things tidy.  Tom fixed my slow draining bathroom sink and a water leak.  Not at simple task as my house is 73 years old.   He also replaced my kitchen faucet.  I am extremely happy with T and T plumbing and I highly recommend them.  Great service at fair prices.  Thanks again Tom!

synthesis.summary: T And T Sons Plumbing consistently delivers exceptional emergency service with rapid response times, often arriving within an hour even late at night. Customers praise their professionalism, fair pricing, and ability to handle both simple repairs and major projects with high-quality workmanship.

reviews.author: Daniel DiMassa
reviews.text: Great, fast service; excellent work; fair price.

reviews.author: Harshad Chitre
reviews.text: Easy to communicate and professional service at fair price I would recommend their service

reviews.author: Cecilia Phillips
reviews.text: Quickly responded to our needs, set up a time to work on the problem asap and was completed in a very reasonable timeframe.

reviews.author: Nicole L.
reviews.text: I have known Curt form Stake Plumbing of about 10 years. I recently had the opportunity to use his services. He installed a soak tub, rewired the lines in the basement, and going to the exterior faucet's. He installed a new kitchen faucet, fixed a leaking toilet, installed a new hot water tank and ran a gas line in the basement to the new heating system, the fireplace and the exterior for venting. I think the most impressive was the gas connections as it I do not think of this is a plumbing person job. We had to have the heating company, fireplace company, chimney lining installer and him all here at the same time. He was supervising their work and working well with them to get the job den and in a timely manner, especially since it was heating season and we were without any heat. He was on site until the job was done (until 9pm). His prices for the same "normal" plumbing jobs seems high but plumber generally are high. The cost for the gas piping seems very reasonable, especially given the length of tie he was here.

reviews.author: Rory Allan
reviews.text:
I was putting shelves up in the garage with my father in law when POP, we drilled a hole right through a water pipe. It was a Saturday and we didn't know what to do. We called multiple "emergency" plumbers and didn't receive a single call back.

Google brought up Stake Plumbing, and after seeing their reviews, we called them up. Curtis immediately answered the phone, and he was at our house in 10 MINUTES. On
a SATURDAY. Sure he lives close by, but he was here so fast and repaired the pipe professionally and quickly, we didn't even have to change our lunch reservation.

Curtis is a really nice guy, and has clear mastery of his trade. He made a really bad situation as painless as possible, and we are very grateful.

reviews.author: Brandon O.
reviews.text: Curt replaced two sinks and two toilets at one property, and faucets, tub spouts, and shower heads at another.  He is professional, detail oriented and organized. He will make your job a priority and will call if he can get in earlier than the scheduled date. As many of you know, having a talented and dependable plumber is priceless; plumbing is often an urgent need and it helps to build the relationship ahead of time. Take a close look at your plumbing and do some preventative updates to old tired fixtures that are at the end of their useful life. I'll be using Curt again in the near future to replace sewer drainage pipes that are rusted and showing surface moisture.

reviews.author: Gary V.
reviews.text: Stake Plumbing is extraordinary. My plumber now for over seven years, Curt has literally come to our rescue many times for everything from weekend & overnight emergencies (leaking toilet, frozen pipes, etc) to major installs, including the install & plumbing for new baths in two Re-hab projects, as well as a major natural gas lines install project for our whole house generator. Not only is Curt incredibly responsive and fairly priced, but he literally leaves the house cleaner than he found it. I would unreservedly recommend Curt to anyone looking for a knowledgeable,  professional plumber that can't be beat. Gary V

reviews.author: Mark B
reviews.text: Stake Plumbing is fantastic!!  They recently installed all the plumbing in my new 3 car garage & work shop, which included a new complex water filtration system, hot water, sinks, rerouting well lines, and irrigation feeds and external spigots. All their work was to high standards, on time, and competitively priced.  They also stand behind their work.... when a well pump check valve started acting up, they came out immediately and replaced at no charge.   Curtis Jr. is a knowledgeable and  hardworking professional, and a pleasure to work with.  Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Arun Sathish
reviews.text: Curtis Stake did an outstanding job converting our electric stove to an LPG stove. He coordinated seamlessly, was punctual, and showed up immediately before and after the propane tank was delivered by another company to ensure everything was connected and running smoothly. His excellent text messaging system kept me updated on his schedule, arrival times, and important job details. Curtis provided a written itemized estimate and I paid exactly what was quoted after the job was completed. I will definitely be hiring him for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Meghan Kellicker
reviews.text: I'm a first time home owner, and (knock on wood) I needed to make my first home repair that required a plumber. I called about 10 places. All of them were big companies charging and arm and a leg! I called stakes and it was just what I was looking for a small family owned business. They were here the next day, even though they said they originally said they might be too booked to come by this week. They still made it happen. Not only did he fix it really quick but he showed me exactly what the problem was and explained why. Also very reasonabley priced!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Hunt
reviews.text:
CURTIS came to my house today to replace a drainage set up behind the washer that was leaking.
He was prompt on taking my call, giving me an estimate, and setting up a time to arrive.
Curtis was very polite and professional.  He changed the drainage set up, tested it for leakage, and snaked out the drain. His price was very reasonable. He and his father are partners so they don't have the high overhead that large plumbing contractors have. I am so grateful to have found an honest, reliable, prompt, polite, plumber.

reviews.author: Michael Ou
reviews.text: I had an issue with my water heater not heating up, so I called Stake Plumbing. They were very responsive and sent Curtis out to diagnose the problem. He quickly found the issue and went the extra mile by also informing me that my sink drain pipe had a crack and would leak whenever the sink was on. I really appreciate his thoroughness and professionalism. The service was top-notch, and I’m very happy with the experience. Highly recommend Stake Plumbing for their honesty, expertise, and great customer service!

reviews.author: John Herendeen
reviews.text:
Stake Plumbing is just great! I first encountered them when they sub-contracted on a bathroom remodel and was very impressed by both the quality of their work and by the fact hat they were just really nice guys. When we recently had a plumbing emergency we reached out via phone and were able to get the issue evaluated immediately and repaired in timely (and friendly) manner.
Five Stars!

reviews.author: Tim Gallagher
reviews.text: Curtis responded immediately when we were dealing with water overflow due to the clog.  He communicated appropriately, ultimately arranging a time to conduct complete service on a clogged ejector pump within 24 hours. Thorough explanation was provided, accompanied by photos of the repair. Professional, patient communication from Curtis throughout the scheduling and repair process.

reviews.author: Ian Wills
reviews.text: Called Stake Plumbing to help with a leak from a bathroom. Curties was quick to take action, very professional throughout all my interactions and quick to fix the issue. I felt Curtis went above and beyond to inspect the issue, fix and test the fix to ensure there was not going to be any further issues. Definitely will recommend and use again for future plumbing needs.

synthesis.summary: Curtis Stake runs a tight one-person shop where you actually get what you pay for — written quotes honored to the dollar, text alerts before arrival, and same-day availability even when others are booked solid. Multiple reviewers note he explains every step and leaves the area clean. No negative reviews in the 30-review sample.

plumbers.name: Gregory's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 322 E Main St #4600, Batavia, OH 45103, USA

reviews.author: Shelley Summers
reviews.text: Jacob is hands down the best plumber I have ever worked with! He installed a new whole house water filtration system and softener for us, and the quality of the installation was top-notch—everything looked neat and professional. I’ve lived in different places with similar systems, and this was by far the best plumbing job I’ve seen. Jacob also replaced our kitchen water filter, serviced our on-demand water heater, and took the time to teach us about all the plumbing features in our new Batavia home, without charging extra for his advice. I am extremely impressed and truly grateful for such excellent service from Gregory's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Tanya Bullock
reviews.text: The plumber was able to schedule my appointment quickly and showed up on time. Donovan came out to replace my old shower valve and ended up updating all the pipes leading to the shower head as well. He made sure everything was nice and secure, so nothing wobbles anymore. Since my house is pretty old, he even raised the shower head to a more comfortable height. The work was done really well and didn’t take long at all. The price matched what I expected, with no hidden costs or surprises. Overall, I’m happy with the service and would recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: lydia chavez
reviews.text: I'm really glad I went with my gut and chose Gregory's Plumbing for my plumbing needs. When I called, the office staff was friendly and respectful, picking up right away and making me feel comfortable. Even though my issue wasn't an emergency, they were able to schedule an appointment quickly—just two days later. I appreciated getting a confirmation call when the plumber was on the way, so I knew exactly when to expect them. Jacob was the plumber who came out, and he was fantastic. He had a great sense of humor, which made the whole experience easier, and he knew exactly how to fix my slow-draining sinks. Everything was explained clearly, with upfront estimates and honest communication about what to expect. If you're looking for a reliable plumber who does quality work and treats you right, I highly recommend reaching out to this company.

reviews.author: Clara Kirk
reviews.text: We woke up to find our basement flooded because our water heater had cracked overnight. We called a local plumbing company right away, and they responded quickly and acted very professionally. Donovan came out to inspect the water heater, explained everything clearly, and gave us a fair price for the replacement. He was friendly and made us feel comfortable throughout the whole process. Jacob, who was helping him, was also very polite and respectful when he introduced himself. Both of them took great care to protect our home while working. We were so glad to have hot water restored the same day. We will definitely call this plumbing team again if we need help in the future.

reviews.author: Veronica F
reviews.text: Gregory's Plumbing provided top-notch service when I needed several plumbing updates after moving into my new home in Batavia. I reached out based on their great reviews, and I’m glad I did. Jacob and Donovan came out to help finish a plumbing project I had started myself but ran into trouble with. They showed up right on time, which I really appreciated. Both Jacob and Donovan were very friendly and took the time to explain each step of the work so I understood what was happening. They replaced my kitchen sink, installed new shutoff valves, hooked up the dishwasher, and swapped out my garbage disposal. They also took care of the shutoff valves for both toilets and even fixed a small leak on the main water line. Everything was completed quickly and looked perfect when they finished. The price for all the work was fair, and I felt like I was getting honest advice the whole time. Later, I scheduled another appointment because I was having issues with my hot water tank. Jacob said he’d try to repair it first to save me money. When the water heater suddenly failed and started leaking everywhere, I called for help right away. The office was very understanding about the emergency and had Jacob and Donovan at my house with a new tank in less than half an hour. Once again, the work was done fast and professionally. I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs in Batavia. The prices are reasonable, the plumbers are trustworthy, and they don’t try to upsell you on things you don’t need. Overall, I am very happy with the service and the results!

synthesis.summary: Gregory's Plumbing demonstrates exceptional reliability and emergency response, with customers praising their quick response times and professional service. Their plumbers Jacob and Donovan consistently receive high marks for quality work, fair pricing, and honest communication.
strengths: Excellent emergency response (30 minutes)
Honest pricing with no hidden fees
Professional quality work
Great customer communication
weaknesses: Limited review sample size
