reviews.text: Plumbing problems are never easy but Aaron at Menwon certainly makes them as easy as they can be--instantly responsive and there to take care of you within what feels like minutes of your call. I have used Aaron at Menwon several times in the last few years and it is always the same--smiling face, quick diagnosis, fast solution. He seemingly never has to order parts--everything we need is always in his truck (sort of like my mother's purse). I think his prices are reasonable and competitive with other plumbing services but I wouldn't know because we never use them.

synthesis.summary: Aaron at MenWon answers calls, shows up within 2 hours for basement floods, and consistently fixes what previous plumbers left behind — but the pricing complaints are serious enough to flag: one reviewer documented a sewer pump billed at $720 that retails for $400 on Amazon, and Aaron responded with a credit bureau threat when the customer questioned it.

weaknesses: Pricing complaints on high-stress emergency jobs: $1,500 for a 2-hour sewer pump replacement with parts marked up nearly 2x Amazon price
At least one reviewer was told a price over the phone then faced a 2x higher price on arrival

reviews.text:
The Plumbing Ministry has helped my family out with a # of jobs from a Sewer Lateral replacement to fixing a broken kitchen sink pipe.  I've met a few of the guys and they've all been incredibly professional and very knowledgeable.  

Louis is very responsive and has always been very straightforward to work with.  His pricing is also very competitive.

reviews.author: Anne Brockhoff
reviews.text: Very professional and work was completed quickly. We highly recommend.

reviews.author: Erin J.
reviews.text:
We had a leak in October and I saw water tricking down our hill before the rain started. It turned out to be our main water line coming into our house from an old galvanized pipe. Our driveway needed to be pulled up, the gas company called.. there were many steps along the way and the job took several days from permit to finish. Jose and his team were fantastic, walking through each step with me and making sure I understand and was happy. 

Water is on and we are happy to recommend them.

reviews.author: Linda H.
reviews.text: I have used this company twice. I think they do good work, but their billing practices are questionable. I won't use them again.

reviews.author: Adam S.
reviews.text: They had to reschedule 2 separate times. Trench in sidewalk wasn't fully covered leaving a fall hazard and personal liability.

reviews.author: Karin S.
reviews.text:
I posted the following review in July 2014 but the post is no longer visible. I'm posting again because a friend told me that they were considering using this company based on yelp reviews:
If only it were possible to find words eloquent enough to dissuade you from calling the Plumbing Ministry!

If you want to pay someone thousands of dollars for a job that's destined to fail because the underlying problem wasn't addressed, go ahead and call the Plumbing Ministry.  If you want to wait around all day for someone to show who comes late or doesn't come at all, call the Plumbing Ministry. If you want to be told several days in a row (on the days that the plumber actually DOES come) that your sewage problem is now fixed and then have sewage under your house within a minute of turning on your water, then call the plumbing ministry. If you want someone who refuses to answer phone calls or emails or text messages to try to remedy the problem unless it's convenient, call the Plumbing Ministry.    But of course, it's all worth it since he is there to tell you that "Jesus loves you."  

I actually was foolish enough to have recommended Louis and The Plumbing Ministry to friends and neighbors after he did work for me a few years ago.  I regret that decision terribly.  I was surprised to read the negative reviews on Yelp when I went to find his phone number again; I was foolish enough to have ignored those reviews and trusted that my initial experiences were a testament to a solid work ethic and professional expertise.  Wrong on both counts.  I'll give some of the details below for those of you who are still inclined to trust the positive reviews.

1. He failed to determine that the reason I've had to repeatedly repair my sewage pump (and replace it several times at a cost of thousands of dollars per pump) is because the waste line from the pump to the  city sewer line wasn't installed properly in the first place.  This was in spite of my asking him why I was having such frequent problems when my neighbors never had to replace or repair their pumps.

2. When my pump failed again (and the alarm he installed never went off- I discovered it because of the smell of raw sewage under the house), his team of plumbers did determine that the cause of the problem was the sewage line to the sewer main.  As one of them said, "If I had put the pump in myself, I would have checked the line and recommended this be fixed. It should have been done before."   Remember, the Plumbing Ministry plumbers were the ones who DID install the pump.

3. That first day, the plumber said he got everything working again, that I could use the plumbing normally but that the lines would need to be fixed soon but not emergently.  After he left, I turned on the water, and thesewage tank promptly overflowed.  I called and left urgent voicemails.  No response, I called the office mid-morning.  I was assured that someone would go out that day to fix it.

4. The first day, the plumber was two hours late in arriving.  The second day he didn't come at all.  No phone calls about it either.

5. I called that night and actually reached Louis, who promised me someone would fix it the next day. I made a HUGE deal about wanting someone to call me since I couldn't be on site and let me know if the problem wasn't completely fixed.  I came home the next day. No one called. No notes, messages, voicemails, or emails and nothing in the mailbox.   I turned on the water, and the tank overflowed immediately.  Again.

6. I sent a bunch of urgent texts and emails to Louis, who said "it was working when he left yesterday."  He said he'd send someone out before 9 the next morning.

7. After unanswered calls, texts, and emails starting at 9, the plumber arrived after 9:30.  He said he was "doing me a favor by coming since he wasn't even supposed to be working" and that he wasn't here to fix the problem, just to figure out what was wrong.  He was rude and disrespectful.  He tried to tell me that the pump had been unplugged (which it wasn't but I didn't say anything to contradict him) and that was why it wasn't working. He said it was working now and tried to leave. I told to wait, turned on the water, and the tank overflowed.  Then he said he "jiggled it" to get it working but now it was working. The tank overflowed again. Then he said it was failing because I wasn't giving the tank time to empty (but a working pump with an open drainage line can empty the tank in well under a minute, and he completely disregarded the fact that the tank was allegedly empty when I turned on the water in the first place).  Then he said that the reason that the tank was overflowing was because the line was backed up (duh) but that he wasn't going to fix it since he had somewhere else to be. He said someone else would come later that day to fix it.  
It has been days since I was told that my problem was fixed.  Louis hasn't returned calls, texts, or emails.  call someone with a work ethic!

reviews.author: Suzy G.
reviews.text:
NOTE: Many of the reviews for this company are from real estate agents who are not invested in either the cost nor the actual need for repairs.  Most of the other positive reviews include the phrase, "they found out I needed to replace blah blah blah..."  No one EVER says, "he found that nothing further needed to be done."  One reviewer even mentions that his first inspector said there were no problems but the Plumbing Ministry magically found that repairs needed to be done.  Those are red flags to me.  The Plumbing Ministry tried to get me to pay thousands of $$ for work that a second opinion proved was not necessary.  

Here's my story, I call it A Tale of Two Plumbers:

We're selling our house in Alameda and we needed to get a sewer lateral certification, per city code, before the close of escrow.  Our agent hires The Plumbing Ministry.  The day Luis arrives there are other inspectors and contractors running around and it's very clear we're selling the house.  He says nothing to anyone, films the sewer line, and gives me a dvd of the inspection.  I pay him $150 on the spot.

Fast forward 6 weeks - it's only days til closing.  I learn that this is NOT AT ALL what the city needs and Luis KNEW THAT at the time.   He acknowledged this on the phone and then said, "well, that's not what she asked for - she just asked for the dvd."  He was difficult to get in touch w/ and then rude and sullen on the phone. He then emails me a quote for $2000 to have my sewer replaced and updated. He never actually said anything to me about whether the work needed to be done or whether he was just making shit up.  Never discussed it at all.

I call up BONAFIDE PLUMBING last night and he explains thoroughly what the city is asking for.  He then immediately makes a call to a contact in the permit department and determines that the certification was done before I owned the place and that it's still effective.  He picks up the paperwork I'll need for the sale and drops it off this morning at my house.  $115.  It was worth every penny to get my needs met so quickly and to be communicated with in such a professional fashion.

When you ask for a termite inspection, you expect a pest report, not a guy saying, "yup, you have termites."  When you ask for a tune-up you expect the mechanic to point out that your hoses are about to blow.  When you complain about sore boobs you expect your doctor to check for cancer, not give you tylenol. 

Moral of the story: it's the job of the professional to know more than you do about what you need and to advise you of the best course of action!  

I got that from Bonafide Plumbing.  I did not get it from The Plumbing Ministry.

reviews.author: Melissa S.
reviews.text:
This company deserves a NEGATIVE star review, but since we cannot do that we are sticking with 1 star. 

We have been dealing with this company for 4 months now for our sewer lateral replacement and testing, a project that should have taken 3 days. 
This is a dishonest company that uses tactics of bait and switch, miscommunication, and unskilled labor. They never finished what they were contracted to do and more than doubled charged us for the unfinished work.

Here are the bullets points.
-Project should have been around $2000 - we ended up paying $4250
-Misleading and miscommunications all throughout the entire project
-Poor craftsmanship:
     +Fined by the City of Alameda for "discharge of sediment runoff" and "discharge of runoff water and ponding water associated with excavation activities flowing into the City municipal storm drain system"
      +Buried a barrel underground (found when our second plumbing company came to fix the work of Plumbing Ministry)
      +We were disconnected from the sewer for several days and when we inquired with a worker if we should be concerned, he said yes and said that he was there to clean up the poor work previously start 
       +Took pavers and lost them and replaced them with bricks on the patio
-Never completed the contracted jobin order for us to get a certificate and tried to charge us more money to finish the job
-Took almost 4 months for a 3 day job and we still do not have a certificate

Plumbing Ministry played a game of bait and switch and used poor communication to make this our worst experience with any contractor or business we have ever worked with.
They have no integrity in their work.  At this point we have hired a new plumber who has been working hard with us to get this project finished and we expect it to be completed by end of the week. 

During this process of locating a new plumber to finish this job, we heard from several companies that Plumbing Ministry has a reputation of using unskilled workers with no experience to do the labor, and the owner spends most of his time in Realtors offices trying to drum up business, instead of doing his due diligence to scope the work and better supervise his workers. This appears to be true from our experience with Plumbing Ministry.  

We are placing this complaint with Better Business Bureau as well, as it has been indicated that this company has treated other clients in a similar manner and are not providing services they promise and ripping people off.  We informed the company that we would be filing a BBB complaint and they did not care.

reviews.author: Christian K.
reviews.text:
Never, I mean never do any business with this company. Don't even think about it. Try a reputable company like Pipe Spy; it's not worth any money you might save.

I, like my wife in the comments below, do not enjoy writing bad reviews as I know it does effect their business and was the reason I gave Louis (the owner) a chance to make us remotely satisfied customers after his company botched both our sewer lateral jobs. But, now I am here writing a review on a company I no longer want to think about. 

So here are a few more details on our dealings with Plumbing Ministry. It's almost amusing, if it wasn't so odor-ifically and ecologically painful.

After 50 some odd days of fecal matter in our front and side yards that is directly above the Fruitvale Creek and after taking 2 half days off work, Louis sent me a check for $325. It should be noted I spent over $9000 on his horrific services. I left a voicemail message with Louis that he spelled my name wrong on the check he sent and that I did not cash it yet. After not hearing back from him (as always), I cashed the check. The payment was stopped on the check and I was charged $5 from my Bank. This was after he told me their communication could be better. He did not communicate to me that he was stopping payment and was sending another check! Amazingly classic! He is still costing me time and money and they are done with there work...and their repair work.

So the real issue is a lack of communication both internally and externally with the company and their processes. In short, they had 2 different crews come out on each day and then did not check to make sure the they did the job correctly, like say flush a toilet and watch the water flow out the lateral? Speaking to Louis on the day he repaired his company's mistake, it is clear that he was not learning from his miss-steps and would not change his processes and would do this sort of thing again. I own a business myself, and if I made a huge mistake, I would not hesitate to pay all of the cost, especially if it was a customer that had had 2 jobs with me.

I real could go on for days about this, but I am done complaining about this disaster of a company. I still have not spoken to anyone at the company who knows if they removed the feces in my front yard or just left it there. But least my toilet flushes now.

Don't be like me, choose a good company that cares about it's customers.

reviews.author: Danielle J.
reviews.text:
I pondered about posting this review as it has been sitting in my drafts since October 2019:

Me giving them 2 stars in more than generous after the horrific experience I had with the owner, the workers and the 2 LOVELY (sarcasm) women who work in the office. I can say the work did finally get done correctly but the customer service I received was absolutely disgusting. It all began when I pulled up to home and found out the workers had taken over not just my driveway but also my neighbors driveway and they had debris all over the place. I had to call the office and get that handled. But that's not the worst part. I received a text from the owner saying the work was complete and he needed full payment. I was at the sight less than 4 hours before he sent the message and we were no where near complete. I had someone else stop by and check to make sure everything else was cleaned up and squared away. The photos I added show how it looked when he demanded full payment. At that point one of the most disrespectful conversations I have ever had with a contractor ensued. I began be yelled at by the women who worked in the office and the owner. I let them know that they would not be receiving a payment from me until the work was completed. They then attempted multiple times to send me a "invoice" saying they needed a deposit for the work which should had been sent before the work began. I then informed the owner that he would need to meet at the sight the following morning so we can see what he calls complete vs what I call complete. He never showed and dodge each and everyone of my phone calls. I took off of my job in order to deal with this man. Once they said the work was complete I myself went by and doubled checked. I then proceeded to head to their office so I can put a face to the name of both the disrespectful office assistants once I arrived the room was filled with tension and disrespect. They then blamed me for why the merchant rejected the payment over night. Saying that they don't make transactions that large ($7500.00) and that's why they wanted a deposit. Which if they would've been up on their paperwork and paid attention to what was going on they would've sent over a invoice for a deposit.
With that being said please run far,far,far,far,far,far away if you can from them. And if not make sure you get everything in writing and don't let them bully you around.

reviews.author: David K.
reviews.text:
Full disclosure, the rating is based on poor communication, withholding information, and a lack of respect for their customers.  I can't actually speak for the work, although to be fair it did pass EBMUD inspection.  I don't actually know the quality, because I never saw it once it was completed. 

The BIG issue I have...

I hired these guys to replace my upper sewer lateral.  I came home the first night to find that my gas line had been turned off.  I found out only because PG&E left me a note stating they had to turn my gas off due to the gas line being hit.  PG&E came back at 11pm that night to finally turn it back on. I never heard anything from these guys about the incident.  No apologies until I brought it up after the work had been completed.  No attempt to rectify or even acknowledge the incident, which turned out to be a bigger deal than I originally thought.  I learned from my neighbor, who happened to be around and who took some pictures, that multiple fire trucks were called out to to handle the situation.  Luckily it was handled without any additional damage to the home.

SMALLER issues I have...

I was told on the phone that the work would ensure 20 years compliance with EBMUD - turns out that's only if they replace the entire sewer lateral...found that out after the work had been completed.  When I was told by Louis, I was made to feel like this was my fault and that their employees know better than to give me this kind of misguided information. 

Additionally, I was also told by an employee that they guarantee their work for 11 years and that any issues would be resolved by them.  Still waiting to know if this is actually the case, because Louis continues to dodge the question.  

Instead of responding to my question, I just got a call from their administrator asking to finalize my payment.  Got it, I need to pay, will do.  But at least resolve any issues I have before requesting your payment.  

Working with these guys just made me feel like they were all about the money and moving as quickly as possible.  I had to follow up with them to come and clean up the mess they had left behind once the work had been completed. 

Again, can't really speak about the work itself, but if you're looking for some honest and open communication with your plumber...these guys aren't the ones for you.

reviews.author: Brad J.
reviews.text:
The Plumbing Ministry replaced a sewer lateral near me, on a busy street, as part of a real estate transaction. The entire process has been marked by a total lack of professionalism, disregard for rules, and total lack of respect for the neighborhood.

As I write this, they have left a large (12+ inches deep) hole in the middle of the road, filling with water, spilling gravel into the bike lanes. The hole isn't marked. Cars are bashing into it, and it will cause a bicycle or motorcycle to wreck.

This is just the latest example of a total lack of professionalism or care for the safety of anybody. They illegally blocked parking with cones, then left them for days. They parked construction trailers in bike lanes, left a large pile of dirt in the sidewalk. They made no effort to get permits to remove parking or properly divert traffic. Neighbors, getting home from work late at night, had to remove their cones and junk from street parking. All the neighbors are totally sick of them. When they first showed up and blocked 6-8 spaces with cones, I called their office to inquire how long they intended to block parking. They lied and said they were not blocking any street parking. They left those cones laying around the street for days.

Update in response to the owner's comment:
His claims are false. The photo attached to this review shows the state of the patch as left by uniformed employees of The Plumbing Ministry. It was done poorly, with no compaction -- employees simply dumped bags of asphalt in the hole. I live across the street and watched this all. No asphalt was ever removed. The patch simply sunk because of poor workmanship.

I'm pretty sure the owner knows this, because after neighbors complained to the City contractor oversight office,  he or somebody else from The Plumbing Ministry office showed up to put a cone in the hole, and came back almost every morning to replace the cone after it was hit by cars. 

The final patch was done by *another* contractor. 

The owners comments seem to be simply another example of the outright dishonesty that has marked all my interactions with this company. The owner's comment are simply false. This was done entirely by the Plumbing Ministry. And I believe the owners knows this. 

Read the rest of the comments here. My experience is not an outlier.

reviews.author: Seido Karasaki
reviews.text:
EDIT: ***See the owner's response. Note the total lack of empathy or ownership for the mistake. Do you really want to do business with plumbers who don't even try to help when something goes wrong, especially when it affects somebody who had nothing to do with the job? I would encourage everyone who is thinking of hiring this company to think twice - read all the negative yelp and google reviews to see what you're really getting into when you hire the Plumbing Ministry. One review even notes that the only positive reviews are from real estate agents who want the bare minimum done. I would highly encourage anyone reading this review who has had problems with the Plumbing Ministry to reach out to the El Cerrito City Department, Better Business Bureau, California Department of Consumer Affairs, and California Attorney General's Office to file a complaint.***

My neighbors hired the Plumbing Ministry to do some plumbing work. This involved the company coming on July 24th and digging up the pipes in the street area between my neighbors place and residence. They then proceeded to accidentally cut our cable and wifi service line, which resulted in a brief interruption to cell service. As of today, July 28th, the wifi service still has not been fixed.

The Plumbing Ministry has not offered to resolve this situation in any way whatsoever. They first tried to deny they had anything to do with it, but after confronting them, they told me they would contact the office and the right people to get this fixed. Since I had not heard anything from them and no work had been done to restore access, I called the office number for the plumbing ministry. I talked to the owner who was apathetic at best, denied all wrongdoing by stating that our cables were unmarked (which does not seem like a reason to cut them in the first place), and told me that there is nothing they can do.

Wifi may seem unimportant to most, but as somebody who works remotely, I find the apathy and the lack of ownership taken by the Plumbing Ministry to be appalling. I believe my experience to be indicative of the work they perform and the service that they provide as a business.

reviews.author: Susan W.
reviews.text:
When my toilet and shower drainage was clogged again, I figured it was time to find a good plumber to get the issue detected at the source and have it fixed for the long run. When it was clogged before, a bunch of roots were found that had caused the clogginess. Immediately I thought about Louis. I used his service before and initially got the recommendation from by my neighbor, a UC professor. Since I was happy with his service and efficiency, I decided to contact him again. 

When I texted him ( a way he prefers for communications with him/his company), he responded speedily and asked me what exactly the problem was and the inch-width  of the pipe. He later showed up at the house per my request with the camera snake and showed me how the equipment worked and what he found out. It turned out that my pipe was replaced partially before and the section by the bath room near was still the old terra-cotta pipe where roots got in through the joint. Louis mentioned that drainage pipe is his area of specialty.

He explained the issue distinctly and offered me pragmatic suggestion- having the old pipe replaced with cast iron instead of keeping it and ending up paying about $450 each time to have  a plumber fix the clog. He gave me the heads-up about the length of hours for the work and reminded me to prepare for the noise created by jack-hammer digging. He also checked and made sure there was outlet outside for the crew. And he had his staff unclog/clean the toilet and shower drainage on the same day.

His crew showed up punctually at the time/day we'd set up and completed the work smoothly.  

Overall, Louis and his crew have the efficiency and smoothness that suits my expectations for a good plumbing service. It'll continue to be the top one on my choice list.

reviews.author: Tontra L.
reviews.text:
Not fair that I can't publish negative stars. HORRIBLE! HORRIBLE! This is the worst company I have come in contact with for a long time. When they replaced the sewer line for my neighbor, they ripped up my front yard instead, tore out plants that had been growing for 15 years, and placed a large sewer circle in my front yard. This was after my neighbor told them not to. When I tried to contact the owner, he never once apologized for anything. He wouldn't talk to me, only texted. When I finally got him on the phone he was extremely dismissive. The only thing he would say is that they should not have touched my yard. After weeks one of his supervisors said they would not remove the line (because it cost more money), but they would bury it and replace the plants. It took over a month for them to do anything. They did buy the plant I requested, but only two small ones instead of the entire space they destroyed. When I tried to follow up, they continued to ignore me. Another neighbor on the next street said their neighbors had many problems with them as well. My neighbors were so upset and even with both of us complaining, they did not do much. They are a HORRIBLE company. If I could give them negative stars, I would. Do not use them. They are the reason I am writing my first negative review and I have been on yelp for years. To make it worse the boss ends his message with, "Remember, Jesus love you." He just uses that to continue being horrible to those around him.

The other option was replacing the line and rerouting it or taking it to the sidewalk. That was ignored and no one ever made contact. You did not use shared space, you destroyed my front yard on my property line. Wish you had talked to me once like you posted on yelp.

synthesis.summary: The Plumbing Ministry in San Leandro has a Google rating of 4.5 but a Yelp rating of 3.7 across 100 reviews — and the Yelp record is where the full picture emerges: no-show appointments, mid-job price doublings, fecal matter left in yards for 50+ days, an employee accused of theft, and an owner who responds to complaints by denying responsibility and invoking religion. With 41 of 40 reviewed ratings being negative (1-3 stars across the sample), the positive reviews appear to come primarily from real estate agents who need the bare minimum to pass a certification.
strengths: Will handle sewer lateral certification work required for real estate closings
Some individual techs (Rick, Oswaldo) described positively when work is straightforward
weaknesses: Chronic no-shows — 'scheduled a start date they didn't show up, scheduled a start date a week later and again failed to show'
Job timelines wildly off — '3-day jobs' that take 3-4 months, with customers disconnected from sewer during the wait
Post-job cleanup failures documented across multiple independent reviewers
redFlags: Multiple reviewers allege false diagnoses to generate unnecessary repair charges — 'tried to get me to pay thousands for work that a second opinion proved was not necessary'
Employee accused of using a customer's $700 sleeping bag during crawl space work and leaving it destroyed; company denied responsibility
Fecal contamination left in yards for 50+ days — 'over 50 days of fecal matter in our front and side yards directly above the Fruitvale Creek'
Mid-job price doubling documented repeatedly — '$2000 project became $4250 for unfinished work'; 'doubled the price because we probably shopped it around'
Gas line struck during sewer work — 'PGE had to turn off gas due to gas line being hit' — owner never contacted customer; fire trucks were called
Stopped payment on refund check after customer cashed it — charged customer $5 bank fee in the process
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No evidence of emergency responsiveness. Multiple reviewers describe being unable to reach the company for days during active sewage crises they created.

Yelp has 100 reviews with detailed accounts of no-shows, false diagnoses, mid-job price doublings, and contractor misconduct. Google reviews skew toward real estate agents and short-term satisfied customers.

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Dr. Drain and Sewer Cleaning Company. They were very punctual, professional, and provided excellent service from start to finish. reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff very fast and efficient took care of our problem. I highly recommend them use them for any small or big job. They will definitely take care of you. Prices are very good. Not like other companies that charge an arm and a leg.

reviews.author: Anita Martinez
reviews.text: Today we encountered a serious problem at our home. The drain was clogged in all our toilets and main drain system in the home, as I called the drain doctor, he came out quickly within the hour, took care of the problem and discovered that there was roots in our sewer system. I highly recommend this company to anyone in the area. Their prices are very friendly and the team works fast and efficient.

reviews.author: Keith R.
reviews.text: Called them on a Friday night for a recurrent issue we’ve had with our sewer backing up, which hasn’t happened in 5 years, nevertheless it needs to be taken care of fairly urgently. Javier spent a good amount of time explaining our options and what we can expect from the service tech coming out. Ended up going with Doctor Drain over the other companies that I called for bids on based on the amount of time they spent on the phone with me, and they were out here within 36 hours of my request. He took extra time working on everything and our drain flow better than it did even before the blockage stopped things up, and showed me where the sludge was collecting in our pipes. Don’t hesitate to call Doctor Drain out for your drain and sewer needs! Reasonably priced, great service in home, great customer service over the phone, and quick to respond, what more can you ask for?

reviews.author: Paulette C
reviews.text: Friendly Plumbing is a wonderful company.  We had a leak in our storage area and were so worried about what was happening.  I called Friendly Plumbing and Michael was here the next day.  Looked at the issue and told me all I needed was an end cap on a vent pipe and he wouldn't take any payment from me. So nice to work with an honest company.

reviews.author: m m
reviews.text:
I had an emergency water heater issue on a Sunday and called Friendly Plumbing.  Even though they were technically closed, they answered my call, gave me instructions for safety until they could arrive the following morning and provided me with warranty information on the unit within minutes of us talking

The next day when Michael arrived he knew within minutes what the issue was, explained why it malfunctioned and had the faulty parts installed.  Because of the previous days water leak, the unit wouldn’t stay lit because everything was still wet so we set up a large fan to dry it out and he returned later to finalize the repair.  Michael has done other work at my home over the years and it’s always done meticulously, professionally and  of course Friendly!  He’s a plumbing genius!  Fortunately for me he installed a floor drain years ago in the utility closet and that saved my adjoining room’s flooring during this incident

From start to finish this company was amazing- made a tough situation much easier to navigate. Highly recommend them for sll your plumbing needs

reviews.author: Nathia Reed
reviews.text:
I’m a homeowner who has trusted Evan from Mass Pike Plumbing for years, and there’s no one I would call before him. He’s handled everything for me from unclogging tubs, repairing toilets, replacing and fixing my boiler, and most recently rescuing me when my sump pump broke and water started flooding the basement.

Evan treats every home like it’s his own. His attention to detail is unmatched and he never cuts corners. At the same time his time management is incredible because the job gets done right and it gets done fast. He’s extremely knowledgeable and always takes the time to explain what went wrong, how to prevent it, and what future issues to watch for.

I’ve recommended Evan to countless people and they can’t stop raving about him. Even my former landlord, who first hired him years ago, was so impressed with his work that he began calling Evan for all of his properties and business needs. Work with Evan once and you’ll never look anywhere else. If you want a plumber who is honest, reliable, and truly cares about protecting your home, Evan and Mass Pike Plumbing are the only choice. He’s not just a plumber, he’s peace of mind.

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Mass Pike Plumbing & Heating, and I couldn’t be more impressed with their professionalism, reliability, and quality of work. From the moment I called, Evan was courteous and responsive, scheduling an appointment that worked with my schedule.

Evan arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the issue, and clearly explained the repair process. Not only did he fix the problem efficiently, but he also went the extra mile to ensure everything was working perfectly before leaving. He kept the workspace clean and treated my home with respect — which I really appreciated.

It’s rare to find a company that combines skill, honesty, and great customer service, but Mass Pike Plumbing & Heating checks all the boxes. I wouldn’t hesitate to call them again or recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services.

Thank you again for a job well done!

Allan Pires

Evan and Mass Pike Plumbing & Heating will now always be our go to and I will definitely recommend Evan whenever I can!

reviews.author: Benjamin Ferdinand
reviews.text:
I just moved into a new house and called Dan at AHS Plumbing twice for two separate plumbing emergencies within our first week!  First up was a sewer line clog.  Dan arrived quickly, cleared the clog and offered recommendations to avoid future problems.  Call #2 was at 4am during a heavy rain storm as my old sump pump and the battery backup were failing to keep up with the rain.  Dan answered the phone on the first try, and after I explained the problem, he was at my house in 40 mins.!  We ended up replacing two sump pumps and battery backup systems for a very fair price, especially considering it was all done same day.

Is AHS Plumbing cheap?  No, but you get what you pay for.  Done right quickly and the first time.  No BS add-on charges.  Very skilled and professional service.  Incredibly responsive.  Dan earned my trust and will be my “go to” plumber for all future needs.

reviews.author: Linda Louis
reviews.text: I had a plumbing issue in my kitchen last night and called at 5:30 pm. By 8am this morning, Dan was at my door! He had booties to walk through the house, offered thorough explanations and practical advice, and fixed the problem in about an hour. He also checked out the pipes in my basement to make sure that everything was in proper order there, explaining what had completely mystified me about our plumbing. Thank you so much, Dan! I hope I won't have to call again, but I definitely will go with AHS if I do experience more issues in the future!

reviews.author: Mathew Joseph
reviews.text: Dan did an amazing job installing shutoff valves for my homes existing outdoor hydrants. He also installed one for me in my garage. He was on-time, courteous and very helpful. I highly recommend Dan to anyone with any type of plumbing repair or installation!

reviews.author: Kim W.
reviews.text: Dan and his partner worked on changing Several faucets and even came back to my house few days later when our laundry machine backed up with water. They did a great job in all the work they did. I had alot of questions about our plumbing and he answered all of them without being annoyed by all my questions. I trust them when it comes to doing plumbing around my home and am grateful for the work they did. They are honest, do quality work and are affordable, my husband and I are so glad we had them fix our plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Brittani Michela
reviews.text: To say that Dan at AHS Plumbing is a superhero doesn’t reflect the magnitude of how outstanding he is. We called Dan in an emergency situation - out sewage pipe sheared away from foundation. We had major backup with raw sewage leaking onto our foundation. Dan answered our call and drove right over to talk to us. He was calm, knowledgeable, friendly, and reassuring. He quoted us half of what local plumbers and bigger companies (Roto-Rooter) were wanting to charge. He fixed our issue and brought the plumbing up to code. Turns out, it’s a very common problem in the Mundelein area, so Dan knew what to do...he’s done it, literally, a hundred times, in this area. We were so lucky to have called him. Not only was he extremely efficient with this job, he took the time to explain everything he and his team was doing. We felt that communication was totally transparent and honest. If you need plumbing help, call AHS Plumbing!

reviews.author: Joanne H.
reviews.text:
Bind and Sons gave me two $25 certificates after a disastrous ordeal with a plumbing issue. (The plumber installed a new shut off. Didn't install correctly and woke up to a small flood in my kitchen. B&S could not come out for 2 days to fix it - knowing the pipe was heavily leaking! I had to shut off water to my house for 2 days until they came out and fixed their mistake.) 

I used my certificates to have a toilet seal replaced. The technician said I could only use one of the certificates. But did say if I bought a maintenance package from Blind and Sons they would give me a discount on the service and would take the second $25. Well, I fell for it. Doing the math it would only be about $40 more, so I did it.

I then got my furnace check as part of that maintenance package this month. He said the furnace would have to be replaced or would probably break this winter. I told him I would think about it. 

He also took the cover off my AprilAire and was to replace the filter. I found part of the unit on the floor when he was leaving and asked him to come back into the house. Apparently, he could not get the top back on so he just left it on the floor. The AprilAire is an older unit but my furnace is only 6 years old.

Called back as there was a knocking sound in the furnace starting the very next day. The same guy came out and said I needed a new furnace and that sound would just happen each time the motor starts and will eventually wear the furnace system down and not work.

Decided if I was going to need a new furnace I need to get some estimates before committing. The first person who came to give me a new furnace estimate I told about the sound when the furnace started. He looked behind and said it was because there was something duck taped inside the Aprilaire unit that hit the inside each time it started. He removed that and the sound stopped. He also told me the furnace was in great condition and I could probably get 10 more years out of it if not more.

I kept the appointments that day with two other companies for an estimate. ALL THREE told me there was nothing wrong with my furnace. Only one actually wrote out an estimate "if I want to replace a working furnace." The other two said they wouldn't quote to replace something that has nothing wrong with it.

One of the estimate guys told me he use to work for a company like Blind and Sons and that they require technicians to get customers to pay at least $300 per visit - whether on the service they were going out for (not including the visit charge) or by selling the maintenance plan. Clearly I got pulled into that when I got this maintenance plan.

I will never use Blind and Sons again. Even if they give me $300 in gift certificates. They are dishonest and are there for themselves not for their customers.

reviews.author: Lora P.
reviews.text:
Think twice before calling this company!  I would give them zero stars if I could.  

I'm in the middle of a large kitchen repair/remodel due to a dishwasher leak back in December.  The insurance company left me with a temporary sink set up for my kitchen.  We left the temporary set up in place until we got the cabinets,  Finally get the cabinets and got them in place as we get ready for the counter top template.  Called and scheduled a call for these guys to come out and hook up the new sink since I was going from a double bowl sink to a single bowl.  To be absolutely clear, all that needs to be done is new PVC pipe from the garbage disposal with the necessary p-trap to the existing drain pipe and include the extension with the vent, that's it.  I could actually do the work but it would take me several hours and probably a couple of trips to the hardware store to get the correct parts.  

Deciding I had would be better off to spend my time on other work in the kitchen I called Blind and Sons since I had used them previously.  I was very clear  to the rep that scheduled the appointment exactly what the scope of work was.  The guy gets here and doesn't want to do the work because the counter isn't in yet and the cabinets "might move".  He then asked me why the rush to get this done ( oh I don't know, maybe I'd like to keep a working sink in my kitchen so we can still use it and the dishwasher while we wait for the countertops!) When I asked him to do the work anyway he quoted me $953-no that isn't a typo!--to plumb the sink.  When I refused the work they still charged me a $60 service charge.  

After thinking about it overnight I called to inquire about a refund of the service charge based on the totally unrealistic quote they refused but are going to "review" the quote.  They also told me they do "quality work and aren't the cheapest provider".  I wasn't expecting a cheap price, I was expecting a reasonable price.  $953 to re-plumb a sink drain in a 5 year old house is anything but reasonable!

I called a another plumbing company, explained the scope of work to them and they quoted me $145 fixed price to do the work.  Now that's reasonable!

reviews.author: Annissa M.
reviews.text:
Here are the ways in which I think Blind & Sons can improve their service:
1.) When a customer calls days in advance to schedule a main waterline valve replacement, let them know that the city needs to turn the water off.   I assumed a plumber could shut the water off at the street to replace the main valve, and I had no reason to think otherwise since it was never mentioned.
2.) When the plumber arrives at the worksite, he should maybe assess the situation and mention a severe problem before saying, "You need to contact the city to shut the water off; reschedule when that's done."
3.) When the second plumber arrives two days later, after the city has shut off the water, he should not then say, "Actually, this is a problematic repair that could cost $6,000 to fix if I break it, and I'll need you to sign this waiver of liability in case I break it."  Because the city will not turn the water back on unless the main water line is to code, and it feels like you're holding our water hostage.  We were left with two options: sign the liability waiver and possibly be on the hook for $6,000 should you break the line, or go without water until we can get a second plumber out for another opinion.

The upshot to all of these problems is that my family had to spend the night in a hotel while we waited for another plumber to come out and give us a second opinion.  The new plumber then replaced the valve in 30 minutes without any liability waivers and for less than half the cost of the original quoted repair (and that's before B&S's service fee).  

I contacted Blind & Sons because I needed work on my AC, my electrical, and my plumbing and I thought it would be easy and convenient to hire a one-stop shop.  But it would have been easier, more convenient, and less expensive to contract the work to three different companies that specialize in those services.  I was very disappointed and will not work with B&S again.

Two stars for the friendly voices on the other end of the line and to the decent service we received for electrical and HVAC.  But the plumbing issue was too egregious to be any more generous with my rating.

reviews.author: Sherry W.
reviews.text:
This service provider was my first choice when it came to HVAC/plumbing. I even purchased a $12k hvac unit and a top of the line water heater from them. Not to mention all of the service calls over the years. Needless to say, I have given them quite a bit of business. Unfortunately, when I needed them most they wouldn't come through for me. I have a main drain from the second floor of my home that travels into my laundry room on the first floor. The drain started leaking and my laundry room filled with sewage and water from my sinks, dishwasher, shower and toilet from the second floor. Not only is the smell horrendous, but there are sewer gases escaping from the broken pvc pipe. I contacted Blind & Sons first thing Tuesday morning and asked if they could send someone to repair it. They said they would send  someone and said that they would call me 30 mins before they arrived. I spent my day off waiting for them to arrive. I called back around 4:00pm to get a status. I was told that I was still on the schedule and that someone would be out. No one came and I did not receive a call informing me that they were not going to come out. At about 6:30pm I made my 3rd call. However, I was sent to an automated answering system that place me on perpetual hold. Most disturbing was that I didn't receive a call from them this morning with an apology or explanation. Instead I called them. She said they would be sending someone out. Well, it is 2:00pm and not a word from them. Tomorrow is Thanksgiving and I will have a house full of guests. I couldn't take the chance that Blind & Sons would not show again. 

I called Roto-Rooter who understood the seriousness of the issue. They are sending someone within the next hour. 

When I called Blind & Sons to let them know that I found another plumber, I received no apology or assurance that this was not typical of the service they provide.  She said only I will cancel your appointment. Thank you. 

Too bad this vendor has gone downhill. They were fantastic years ago.

reviews.author: Phyl D.
reviews.text:
On 12/10/2012 I had a tech out to perform routine maintenance on my furnace. He told my father, who was at the house at the time, that my furnace was cracked and needed to be repaired for about $800, but that he would seriously recommend replacing the furnace. He also said that my T&P valve on my hot water heater was defective and my breaker box needed to be replaced.

I was concerned about his recommendations, especially since I had replaced my T&P valve, and it is in perfect working order. My father-in-law, who is an electrical engineer, had looked at my breaker box previously and indicated it was also fine.

Before undertaking an expensive repair or replacement, I decided to get a second opinion. I called another HVAC company in my area and had them come out and check the furnace. The tech said there is nothing wrong with it and that it didn't need either a repair or replacement.

I had paid Blind $170, which was supposed to cover maintenance on the furnace and the A/C unit in the Spring. Other than taking the furnace apart and telling me it needed to be replaced, the Blind tech didn't perform any maintenance on the unit. My father asked him if he wanted to vacuum it out while he had it apart, and even offered to get the sweeper for him, but the tech said he wasn't going to bother cleaning anything.

I called Blind and, under their 100% money back satisfaction guarantee, requested my $170 back, especially since I not only won't let them service my A/C, I wouldn't let them in my house for any reason. After berating me for not taking the tech seriously and questioning his evaluation, the service manager said someone would call me back about refunding my money.

I haven't received a refund, and based on Blind's apparent business practices, am not at all confident I will ever get it.

reviews.author: Jamie c.
reviews.text: We had Blind & Sons install a new furnace, A/C, and replaced electrical box in 2015. The A/C they installed is a Trane.  We turned the air on for the first time recently and the outside unit wasn't running. We called Blind & Sons for service and they made an appointment with us for Monday last week. My husband stayed home from work to meet the repair person. We received a call Monday afternoon advising they had a lot of emergency calls and would not be able to make our scheduled appointment.  We rescheduled for a weekend date and the service person came out and checked the unit advising that the Freon was empty. They could not identify if there was a leak or where unless we paid an additional $274 on top of the $120 service call. The technician also advised that performing the leak check wouldn't necessarily identify the problem and it might be best to purchase a whole new unit. We got a second opinion and that service person said the condenser coil failed and the Freon leaked out. They advised that Blind & Sons should have registered the unit with Trane and Trane's warranty would apply. We called Blind & Sons and they advised they stopped registering units in 2016. We told them this install was 2015 and they said they didn't know what to tell us. We called Trane and they advised the unit had never been registered. The repair is nearly $3000. Blind & Sons told us had we arranged for them to come out twice a year for maintenance at $200 per visit their warranty would have covered it. This is Ohio not Florida. We only run the unit 3-4 months of the year. This part should not have failed so quickly.

reviews.author: Stephany S.
reviews.text:
So it's November of 2018 we bought ac and the thermostat from here they installed it back in May or April of this year 2018. For months we've been experiencing a sort of "hold" on the thermostat. No matter how many times we try to fix it ourselves with the 6 buttons on it and pointless instructions. Which don't help at all. It always goes back to hold and keeps our house at maybe 70 sometimes 68 and I did say it's November and it's freezing out! I called to ask for help and Courtney tell me it would be 120$ fee for them to come out if  the thermostat is not under warranty. Uh we have t had it a whole year and I don't know if there is or not a warranty but doesn't matter I will NOT give this company any more money for this bs. I have two small children in this house and they need heat. I'm so upset with their "customer service" alllllll this money my hubs and paid them for our thermostat to be a box of junk. Well go elsewhere and get a new thermostat and never deal with this crap again!!! 120$ to push some buttons. Y'all must be rich!!!

Update: I had finally called again and talked with the manager. She helped me out and sent the technician out cuz I caved and need heat and to my surprise...it was this bs programmable thermostat that no one told me I had to always have my setting programs on the temperature I want it on....I don't get it that you have to keep programming it when I don't want to use the schedule. Whatever it's working now cuz the technician pushed the buttons and changed it....he was very nice But I still don't like this program crap.

reviews.author: Anthony D.
reviews.text:
Run far away from this company. They charge for a premium service, and inreturn you'll get the most sloppy installation job ever. It's a shame that they charge $7500 for a new hvac install, and what you'll get for that is scratch & dent units, cold water, and air ducts not connected. And when you send pics to your project manager (Jim Jones), he'll claim you're ridiculous and starting to get under his skin. 

Their install crews are all young with minimum years of experience. Wonder why? They rush to get done by 5pm whether the job is done right or not. They'll smoke on your property, act disrespectful when they talk to you, and large amounts of horseplay going on in your own home. Very unprofessional. 

What a shame what the 2 owners Joe Bolotta and John Hartmann have done to a company Mr. Blind founded on integrity...you have been warned. 

***UPDATE***

So we decided to have the install done by a real professional. We chose to go with Trane and filed a complaint with Lennox, and the city. 

The city inspector came out and was in awe about what he saw. Blind and Sons are no longer allowed permits for my city. As we were cleaning up their mess, we noticed our brand new concrete step roundly chipped. The loser technician had dropped the hot water tank and broke the step. Of course Blind says they're not responsible. We have hired an attorney and will be seeing these clowns in court. 

Please everyone. DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY. THEY WILL ROB YOU OF YOUR HARD WORKING MONEY AND GIVE YOU A JOKE OF AN INSTALL. RUN RUN RUN FAR AWAY!!!

reviews.author: Marna V.
reviews.text:
I recently had my HVAC system serviced for the winter by Blind and Sons.  I originally purchased the system from them.  During the service call, the technician had trouble getting the thermostat to work. He told me it might need to be replaced soon.  In less than a month after the service call,  it quit working.  When I called Blind and Sons to replace the thermostat, I requested not to be charged a second service call since the technician had just been out and told me it was going bad, but didn't suggest I should replace it while he was here.   I was told that the technician had not made notation of his conversation with me on the paperwork.  Evidentially his failure to document the conversation meant it didn't occur.

I am a senior citizen living on a fixed income.   Had he suggested at the time I should replace it,  I would have done so as I would have wanted to avoid a second service call. Also, I have serious health issues and cannot risk being without heat.

The cost to replace the thermostat was extremely high.   I was charged $133 for the Aprilaire 8466  thermostat which could have been purchased online for $85.00.  I was then charged $54  for installation plus a $90 diagnostic fee. They charged me $272.00 minus a $25 courtesy discount for a total of $252.  I appreciate the small gesture, but the cost of this service should have been closer to $140.00. I should not have had to pay the diagnostic fee.

Unfortunately, I won't be able to afford to use them in the future.

reviews.text: There should be a 5 star option as that is what All Suburban Plumbing deserves. A leaky water heater required a visit from them. It needed to be replaced. reviews.author: Hollie R
reviews.text: I had used this company for 2 small jobs previously and everything was fine.  Had them come back out to rod a bathtub drain and this was absolutely the worst service experience.  After the team left, I was cleaning up (they don't cover their boots), and when I went rinse out the tub, water started flowing through the ceiling in the bathroom below as a hole had been poked through my pipe.  I immediately called the company but as it was 5pm, they couldn't send anyone until the next day.  When the office called the next morning, I asked would their insurance cover the work given what had occurred, the office woman tells me "don't start with me, we don't have to send anyone out." This cost me an insurance claim, my deductible, and months of repairs.

synthesis.summary: All Suburban Plumbing shows strong potential with excellent responsiveness, fair pricing, and helpful service, but a serious incident involving property damage and poor follow-up response raises concerns about accountability. They appear reliable for most jobs but may lack proper damage protocols.
strengths: Very responsive - arrives within 1 hour
Fair and honest pricing
Helpful phone support
Professional work quality
weaknesses: Poor damage response protocols
Inconsistent service quality
Defensive customer service when problems arise
redFlags: Caused property damage and couldn't provide immediate emergency response
Defensive attitude when addressing service failures
synthesis.topQuote: The person on the phone was professional and within 1 hr, two pro's showed up and did the job quickly and at a fair price.
synthesis.worstQuote: when I asked would their insurance cover the work given what had occurred, the office woman tells me 'don't start with me, we don't have to send anyone out.'

plumbers.name: Cork's Plumbing, Heating, & Cooling
plumbers.address: 10249 Vine St, Huntley, IL 60142, USA

reviews.author: Joel Weideman
reviews.text: My furnace decides to go out when it's zero degrees on a Saturday.  I call Cork's and they find the part for my 20 year old furnace.  Gil shows up and I'm back in business 30 minutes after he arrives.  Can't ask for more than that!!!  They do great plumbing work too!

reviews.author: J. M.
reviews.text:
Needed 2 bathroom faucets replaced. Dave came out, was prompt, personable, knowledgeable and professional. Very neat. Was appreciative that we emptied out the vanities and gave him room to work.
We've used Cork's several times - replaced toilets, our water heater...
Very reasonable and they do excellent work!
Save yourself some time Googling and collecting estimates, just call Cork's!

reviews.author: Edward P
reviews.text: Came out to fix a code 33 on my furnace, overheating. changed the limit switch that took about a hour, never checked the furnace for other problems that could cause the problem and told me to lower the gas valve if the problem persists a highly dangerous thing to do then took the old part to resell to someone else that was in working order.  $263.00 bill. Never again Corks

reviews.author: Emotional Sobriety Retreat
reviews.text: I called this company for an HVAC repair, and the lady who answered told me they were too busy and didn’t want the business. I’ve honestly never heard anything like that before. If you’re looking for reliable service, I’d suggest finding someone who actually wants to work with customers. I wonder if the owner actually knows the lady is turning people away.

reviews.author: Venkata Seera
reviews.text: The service is very reliable and reasonable price, not over priced like others.  Frank is an amazing person

While they excel at fast furnace and plumbing repairs, some customers report incomplete diagnostics and poor phone service.

reviews.author: Steve W.
reviews.text: Available on a short notice and definitely experienced. I recommend.

reviews.author: Blake R.
reviews.text: Jarrett and Jana provided same day service and fixed my water meter leak properly.   They placed the dirt they shoveled on plastic as to minimize dirt disturbance.   I thought they did a great job at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Ed W.
reviews.text:
Jared is a professional down to earth plumber. I first experienced them during the Christmas Freeze back in Dec of 22. I was out of town and hand a house sitter when my outside faucet froze and burst. Jared was able to come out (during the holidays mind you) and fix the faucet. Most recently May 2024 I had to have my hot water heater replaced. Both times he was out within a day and got the work done on that day. They have great service and appointment times. I recommend Anything Plumbing whenever I get the chance. They are a GREAT small business. 
Ed P. Falls Creek

reviews.author: Craig C.
reviews.text:
I called them due to a water main leak. We scheduled an appointment and Jarrett showed up on time, promptly fixed the leak, and cleaned up around the area he had been working. Great service!
Craig C

reviews.author: Lazy D.
reviews.text: Awesome Service! Came early and stayed with it until it was done! Knowledgeable courteous and professional. I'm keeping his card and sharing my experience  Thanks Jarrett!!!

reviews.author: Stephen C.
reviews.text: Jarrett arrived on time and did outstanding work. He will be my go-to for any plumbing issues moving forward. I will also be recommending this company to all my friends!

reviews.author: indijohnson
reviews.text: Jarrett was timely, effective, and patient. I appreciate him making time to immediately come out and address the leak in my water heater.

synthesis.summary: Anything Plumbing demonstrates exceptional emergency responsiveness with same-day service and quick problem resolution. Multiple customers highlight their fair pricing, professional service, and ability to handle urgent repairs efficiently, making them a reliable choice for plumbing emergencies.

Fair and competitive pricing
Quick problem diagnosis and repair
Professional and courteous service
weaknesses: Limited review sample size

synthesis.topQuote: Anytime and everytime we've called upon Anything Plumbing, they've answered and did the jobs quickly and at a reasonable cost. Today, with a full schedule, they were able to fit us in between calls and explained to us what we needed to do since he didn't have my particular part on his truck.

plumbers.name: Frontline Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1618 Old Hwy 14 S, Greer, SC 29651, USA

reviews.author: Andy Lawson
reviews.text: Mathew was very professional and thorough. I have known Mathew since he was a middle school student and he is a great guy.

reviews.author: William Wilkes
reviews.text: Quick response, on time, professional, licensed and experienced plumber, pride in workmanship - take your pick, Matthew checks all the boxes.

reviews.author: Mr.Mrs Sutherland
reviews.text: Matthew was very courteous, professional, and found the repair and fixed it immediately.

reviews.author: Frank Crone
reviews.text:
Matt came recommended to us by our son-in-law whose grandparents paid an astronomical price for a service that once investigated by Matt , was mostly temporary fixes at an inflated price. Matt worked with his elderly grandparents and repaired and replaced it permanently for a fraction of the cost.

We decided to do a bathroom remodel in our older home and were shocked at the 100k price tag. My wife, via TikTok, YouTube and other platforms decided she could do it at a fraction of the price. Until we met the plumbing issues. Enter Frontline and its owner Matt. Matt cane by at a moments notice to discover the problems and immediately cane up with cost-effective solutions and gave a quote that we couldn’t refuse. I might also add my wife “added” a few more things out of his comfort zone-an electrical add on. Instead of subbing it out, he added it in (he can do it, just not a preference of his) at minimal cost. That’s great business folks. He came as scheduled and promised and delivered phenomenal work. So much so, a friend, about to do a new residential build, saw the work, and immediately asked for his card not even knowing the value we were given. Just based upon his promise to come when agreed (it was during the ice storm) and  doing high-quality work. Now my wife can continue on with her project.

Folks there are  far too many scammers out there. Matt is not one of them. Great work at a great price. We look forward to him coming out this summer to add a pool heater and run the gas lines to it on our 26,000 gallon pool. I trust this company 100 percent. I recommend them double that.
Dr. C

reviews.author: Celly
reviews.text:
DON’TWALK, RUN TO THE BEST PLUMBER IN THE WHOLE DAMN UPSTATE!!

Matt is an absolute God send! First off, this gentleman is respectful, kind, teaches you in real time, is on time, keeps his word, & doesn’t try to take advantage of you.

It’s been 1 month and 2 days since he’s done a major repair to an improper “T” in my plumbing under my concrete slab & I haven’t heard a peep from my tenants! 🥳

This man not only came out to help me review the root cause of my issue once but TWO times without completely ripping my soul out of my wallet. As a first time investor it means a lot to know you can trust someone with your new baby and know you can count on them for future endeavors!

I pray that God continues to bless Matt & protect such a blessing. He deserves so much business & is sooooo reasonably affordable! I’m grateful I found him when things were starting to look really scary!

THANK YOU SOOOO MUCH MATT, I couldn’t have done it without you🏆🥇

reviews.author: John Thomas
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough great things about Matthew Johnson and Frontline Plumbing! From start to finish, the experience was absolutely top-notch. Matthew was professional, honest, and incredibly knowledgeable. He showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and took the time to make sure the job was done perfectly.

What really stood out was his attention to detail and the pride he takes in his work. He didn’t cut corners, and he treated my home with respect—cleaning up everything before he left and making sure I was completely satisfied.

It’s hard to find someone you can truly trust, but Matthew is the real deal. Fair pricing, excellent workmanship, and outstanding customer service. If you need plumbing work done, Frontline Plumbing is the company to call. I won’t use anyone else!

Highly recommend to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and high-quality plumbing service!

reviews.author: Troy Scott
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Matthew Johnson from Frontline Plumbing. While my family was on vacation, our 9-year-old water heater started leaking. When we arrived home and discovered the issue, we called Matthew immediately—and he responded very promptly.

Matthew took the time to thoroughly explain all of our options, from a more budget-friendly repair route to higher-end replacement solutions. After reviewing everything, we decided to upgrade to a tankless water heater, and we could not be happier with the result.

His professionalism, honesty, and knowledge made a stressful situation much easier. If you’re looking for a true professional, Matthew Johnson with Frontline Plumbing is the way to go. You won’t find anyone better to assist you with your plumbing needs

reviews.author: Holly Scruggs
reviews.text: “I had Frontline Plumbing install a new water heater in my home and the experience was excellent from start to finish. The plumber arrived on time, was very professional, and explained everything about the water heater installation process. The pricing was fair and competitive compared to other local plumbing companies in Greenville/Spartanburg, and the quality of work was outstanding. They removed my old unit, installed the new hot water heater quickly, and made sure everything was working properly before leaving. It’s clear this is a reliable and trustworthy plumbing company that truly cares about customer service. If you need a water heater replacement or any plumbing repair, I highly recommend Frontline Plumbing for fast, affordable, and professional service.

reviews.author: Craig Moody
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Matthew for plumbing services, and I couldn’t be more impressed. From the start, his professionalism stood out—he was punctual, courteous, and took the time to clearly explain the issue and the steps he would take to fix it. The quality of his work was excellent; everything was completed efficiently and to a high standard, with great attention to detail. What I appreciated most was his responsiveness—Matthew returned calls quickly, scheduled the job promptly, and made sure to follow up to ensure everything was working properly. I highly recommend Matthew to anyone in need of a reliable and skilled plumber.

reviews.author: Caleb Anderson
reviews.text:
As a builder in the Upstate South Carolina market, having a dependable plumbing contractor is critical. Frontline Plumbing has been a strong partner on our new construction homes in Greenville, Greer, and Spartanburg.

They understand modern plumbing systems, tankless water heaters, whole-home filtration, gas piping, and full residential rough-ins. Their work is clean, inspections go smoothly, and homeowners are always impressed at final walkthrough.

Frontline Plumbing brings professionalism and craftsmanship to every build. We look forward to continuing to work together.

— Elevate Homes

reviews.author: Alana Gay
reviews.text: WOW, WOW, WOW! Matthew provides first class service in everything he does! He is beyond, kind, personable, fair and HIGHLY knowledgeable. I have tried several companies and he blows everyone out of the water! He has not only replaced toilets for us, but has reconfigured our pipes so they flow seamlessly! He is honest, the hardest worker and completely fixes any issue you have! This company and Matthew will be our lifetime plumber and I will refer absolutely everyone i know! Thank you for being who you are! We are BEYOND blessed to have found you!

reviews.author: Grant Hiriak
reviews.text: Couldn’t recommend Matthew and his company more! We first called him to install a new water heater - his pricing and work was unbeatable so when we got a leak from our shower he was our first call. From start to finish he was incredibly communicative and thorough in assessing the issue. It’s rare to find someone this trustworthy and attentive - we couldn’t be happier with his services and will absolutely be using him for any and all our plumbing needs going forward. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Stella Kwak
reviews.text: We had a water heater at one of our rentals give out after 17 years. It was due for a replacement but it decided to give out at 9 PM. Matthew was amazing and was able to get out there to isolate the problem to stop the water from flooding out and replaced the water heater the next day! He was very clear with his communication on what needed to be done. We appreciated how prompt he was as well! We will definitely have him as our main point of contact for all our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Allen Massey
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Frontline Plumbing from start to finish. The project required coordination with the City of Greer and Greer CPW, and they handled everything seamlessly.
Matthew was professional, responsive and all communication was outstanding.  He kept me informed at every step and made sure all work met city requirements without delays.
The quality of their work was great, and they left everything clean and in great condition when the job was finished.

reviews.author: mccrawsj
reviews.text:
We deeply appreciate Matthew making the long trip from Taylor's to the east side of Spartanburg to repair our main water line when no local companies wood take the call. He gave up his Saturday evening with his family to make this call. We are very pleased with the work he did, little pricey, but what would you expect on a Saturday evening.
Would recommend highly to anyone needing repairs.

Owner Matthew Johnson is praised for fair pricing, quality workmanship, and going above and beyond for customers, making this a reliable choice for emergency plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Dale the Plumbing Pro
plumbers.address: 584 Atrium Dr ste 110, Vernon Hills, IL 60061, USA

reviews.author: Michael Norris
reviews.text: Here’s the revised review based on your requirements: Honest, helpful, and friendly service. We reached out to have our water heater looked at and got connected with Roger. From the beginning, he made everything easy and explained what needed to be done. Roger even helped us figure out that our water heater was still under warranty, so we were able to get the replacement parts for free. He gave us clear instructions on how to get the warranty parts, and also offered to take care of the whole project for us. When the parts arrived, Roger came over, installed them, and also fixed our kitchen sink while he was here. The prices were very reasonable. He took the time to explain everything he was doing, which was really nice because we like to understand what’s going on with our plumbing. We appreciate his honesty, and how available he was throughout the process. We feel like we found a plumber we can trust for any future work, like repiping or other plumbing repairs.

reviews.author: Billy D
reviews.text: Dale the Plumbing Pro was recommended to me by a neighbor in Vernon Hills when I discovered two separate water leaks in my crawl space. They were easy to reach, quick to respond, and showed a high level of professionalism. Zachary was the plumber who came out to help, and he was polite, knowledgeable, and worked hard to get everything fixed. He not only repaired both water leaks to our satisfaction, but while checking things over, he also found a gas leak we didn't know about. Zachary returned soon after and took care of that issue as well. I would definitely recommend their plumbing services to anyone looking for reliable and thorough work.

reviews.author: Jared B
reviews.text: When my water heater started leaking, I reached out to a few different plumbing companies for quotes. One company sent Camden to my home in Vernon Hills to check things out and give me several options, all at no charge. Camden patiently answered all my questions about the different water heater choices and explained everything clearly. I decided to go with this company because their reputation was great and my experience with Camden was excellent. The installer arrived on time the next morning, replaced my old tank, and made sure everything was working perfectly. He was very friendly, kept me updated throughout the job, and answered every question I had about the new system. Everyone I spoke with in the office was also very helpful and quick to respond, making the whole process smooth and stress-free. I had a wonderful experience and will definitely call them again for any plumbing or water heater needs. I highly recommend them to anyone in Vernon Hills looking for reliable and professional plumbers!

reviews.author: L Calhoun
reviews.text: We had three drains in our house that were draining very slowly. I tried everything I could to fix them myself, but nothing worked. I decided to call Dale the Plumbing Pro. Roger came by the next day and was very knowledgeable and professional. He took the time to explain each step as he worked on the problem. Since our house has older pipes, it turned out that a single blockage was causing issues with both sink drains and the shower drain. Roger found the problem by checking through the vent in the attic and was able to clear the clog. Now all our drains are working perfectly and water flows out quickly, just like it should. Roger was efficient, thorough, and did a fantastic job. I'm very happy with the service!

reviews.author: Lincoln Rodriguez
reviews.text: Here's a revised version of your customer feedback, following all the requirements: Another excellent job by Roger and his crew. They're always my first call for any plumbing issue. I had a sudden plumbing emergency on a property that was about to close, and a buyer noticed a problem that needed urgent repair. With just one call, Roger and his team were there the next day and fixed everything quickly. They handled the job efficiently, and I was pleasantly surprised at how reasonable the price was. If you're not calling these plumbers, you might be paying more than you need to. Highly recommend for any plumbing needs!

synthesis.summary: Dale the Plumbing Pro demonstrates exceptional reliability and professionalism with highly skilled technicians who explain their work clearly and offer honest, reasonably-priced service. Multiple reviews highlight their quick response times, thorough problem-solving abilities, and trustworthy approach including helping customers save money through warranty claims.

Excellent communication and explains work clearly
Quick response times and reliable service
