reviews.author: Rachael Ivanovic
reviews.text:
Stop searching and hire The Tim’s. 100/5 stars. If you need someone who is honest, does great work, is extremely knowledgeable, goes above and beyond AND has fair pricing, you found them.

We are SO lucky we found them. Our situation sucked but it could have been way worse (and frankly, 5x the cost). They communicated at every stage of the project, explained what was going on and what to expect and prepare for. They worked in single digit weather, early mornings/weekend/late nights, did everything possible to limit the cost, and really went the extra mile to complete the job although they had to move their schedule around.

We had a leak in a pipe in the yard. It became urgent when we started to get water in the basement. They moved their schedule around, got the permits, rented the equipment, etc in the matter of about a day. Most people would have told us “oh well you’ll have to wait”, but the Tims CARE and that’s the difference. When they identified another issue, they already had the plan of attack in motion. Although they told us it was most likely impossible, they worked literal magic so that we didn’t have to replace concrete that was poured this past year, saving us a lot of money, stress, and time. Overall, they did EVERYTHING they could to take care of us and our situation, and made a really stressful situation as pain free as possible. I cannot even begin to express how grateful I am.

reviews.author: Mark Whipple
reviews.text:
Drain Masters was recommended to me by two friends at the gym for what I thought was a plugged toilet drain line.  They came by within a day of my call, diagnosed the problem at no charge, and told me I could fix it myself, or have them repair the issue at what I thought was a pretty reasonable price.

I elected to do it myself to save the money as it was a pretty simple fix.  They were honest and comfortable to deal with.  I will definitely be calling these guys again for any plumbing issues I have.

reviews.author: Cheri Patrick
reviews.text: This is the second time we’ve used drain master to route our Floor drain by washer/dryer prevent back ups!  They are Extremely professional, and   cleaned the area after the work was done. They charged a reasonable fee, they were  on time and full of helpful information.  I would highly recommend them to anyone in the area who Have plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Jen Duberville
reviews.text: I needed some help fixing an underground downspout drain that I shattered while digging out a shrub in my garden. Tim was incredibly responsive, prices were competitive, the job was done quickly and no mess was left behind. DSP's card has found its rightful place on my fridge and they will be my first call if a future plumbing need arises.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Hudgins
reviews.text: These guys were super helpful and informative, and very professional and friendly! They had my toilet issues assessed and fixed in no time! Will definitely call them again!! Thanks Tim & team!

reviews.author: Karlee Cailyn
reviews.text: Their plumbing crew impressed me with how they fixed recurring toilet clogs caused by internal buildup. After contacting the team, the plumber performed a detailed inspection. The blockage was fully cleared. The toilet now flushes smoothly every time.

reviews.author: Nolan Finley
reviews.text: A pipe behind the bathroom wall burst suddenly. I called this plumbing service without delay. They replaced the damaged section and secured all connections. Their fast and professional repair prevented serious damage.

reviews.author: Conrad Bradley
reviews.text: A rattling noise began coming from a pipe inside the wall whenever we used the upstairs sink. The plumber opened a small access panel, secured the loose pipe, added proper brackets and tested the flow. The noise vanished completely. The repair was neat and minimally invasive.

I’m not a plumbing expert, but I trusted AllSTAR Plumbing to fix my issue as promised. They gave me a quote and assured me the house would be fully usable. After hiring a different professional plumber, I was told that AllSTAR’s work had actually worsened the plumbing issue and improper materials were used. A few days after I posted the review above, the owner called me and demanded that I take it down, threatening to sue me if I didn’t. I was shocked by the call. reviews.author: Monica Glumm
reviews.text: Watson’s has been my plumber since I built my house in 1980.  They are reliable and trustworthy…a contractor with whom I’d feel comfortable in leaving a house key. They stand by their work which is always high quality.  They honor appointments and scheduled times. I’ve tried other plumbers thinking it would be a good idea to have a fallback in case Watson’s was booked. My most recent “test case” was a complete disaster (although recommended by some folks who subscribe to Next Door). Norm Watson made sure my problem was resolved along with the anguish caused by this unscrupulous plumber at no cost to me for time or materials. I highly recommend Watson’s Plumbing.

reviews.author: Brian Buber
reviews.text: Over charging  for labor so sad 😞

reviews.author: Karen C.
reviews.text: Watson's replaced my hot water heater with a new one with a 10 year warrantee in 2006. It rusted and flooded my basement causing damage. When Watson's came out to repair they indicated the model was discontinued and needed to be replaced which was fine as the unit was under warrantee. Watson's proceeded to tell me that the unit was not under warrantee but would not return calls explaining why a 10 year warrantee had lapsed in 8.5 years. I called the manufacturer and found out that the "new" unit Watson's sold me in 2006 was 3 years old which is why it was out of warrantee. The manufacturer will work with me to remediate- I am still waiting for a call back from Watson's, however I went ahead and replaced the unit using another firm as I needed hot water especially with the Christmas holidays upon us.

reviews.author: Steve A.
reviews.text:
I have had 2 experiences with Watson. Once to replace my water main (good) and another to replace my water heater (not so good).

My water main had broke and required replacement. I called up Watson after waiting a week for another contractor to obtain a backhoe. Watson came out that night and gave me an estimate ($1800) to replace the main and told me the work could be completed the next day. Since Watson quoted me the same price and could get the work done faster, I got rid of the original contractor I hired and went with Watson. Watson came out early the next day to replace the water main, which required the front yard be dug up. It took them about 8-10 hrs (understandably) and at the end of the day we finally had water. The only issue we had was that since the work was done in the middle of winter the hole was backfilled with snow and the ground needed to settle before they could grade the yard. This took a little longer then I would of liked (about 2 months) and required us to purchase dirt but we finally had water and they did eventually came over to grade the yard. Overall I would rate this experience 4 stars

My second experience was not nearly as good as the first. I recently needed my water heater replaced because it had started leaking. I called up Watson again since they had done well on the first project. They came out within a few hours and quoted me $1285 to replace the water heater. It was a bit higher then I had expected but since they could get the work done same day and they had done well on the first job i agreed. The tech went out to get the replacement water heater and completed the work in a little over an hour. I signed all the paperwork and he left. It was not until about 30 minutes later that I went downstairs to actually look at the water heater and noticed that during the install a very large amount of water had been spilled, I assume from draining the broken water heater. a little less then half of the floor of my basement was soaked (1/4+ inch of water in places). Although our basement is unfinished and nothing was damaged that I could see, I was not happy to have to clean up all the water that had been spilled on the floor after having paid $1285. It took us about 30 minutes to clean up the water and throw out and waterlogged boxes we had in the basement. overall i would rate this experience 2 stars.

Would I recommend Watson for plumbing work? The answer is, it depends on what you need done and who comes out to do the work. 

At the end of the day i have not eliminated them from doing any plumbing work on my home but I will be shopping around more instead of going directly to them in the future.

reviews.author: Lanie W.
reviews.text: I will give one star because Watson's was the only company available the next day after my well pump went up on a Friday night. I will say this is all my fault because I wanted running water for my family and didn't want to wait a few days. With that being said, this company definitely took advantage of my situation and I paid majorly to avoid inconvenience. I paid $6150 to have my constant pressure well pump system replaced. They did not replace the pressure tank by the way. I looked up the parts I had replaced and you can buy them for a little over $2000. So if you say $3000 (to account for a reasonable mark up) that means $3150 went to labor. When I asked for an itemized bill the technician said he couldn't give me one because there were other costs associated with the repair besides parts and labor. The examples he gave were his truck, overtime, and so forth.  By the way, this repair took just two hours. And he had to replace the well pump wiring and could not bury the wire because an electrician normally does that. So we have to dig a trench and bury the wire ourselves so that we don't have to wait for an electrician to come to do it and so that we can have water today. He left with the wire going through a window in the garage and laying in the yard. Bottomline, I paid $6150 for two hours of labor, $3000 in parts, and other costs associated with running their business. And we still need to do work to complete the job. I feel like I should own part of their business now.

reviews.author: Bryan Welch
reviews.text: If google allowed for 0 stars, I absolutely would. I submitted a claim through Select home warranty after a septic back up. When finally was able to get ahold of someone to handle our dispatch, it was even harder to get ahold of someone who knew about our claim or property. Not only were we scheduled for a Tuesday, a week after our claim, we didn’t receive service until Wednesday; we only knew we weren’t being serviced because we called and hounded them. At 6 pm Tuesday we hadn’t received a call when our window was 11-3. Bad business, but we managed. When they finally arrived, Marvin, told us right away that he wasn’t going to be able to do an extended snaking, (even though the warranty company approved it immediately!!!) he claimed he had to submit another ticket, and we have to wait another 48-72 hours to receive service. We waited and heard nothing. We called the technician and received no information. Only to find out that our warranty company had approved everything. Marvin was trying to get us to spend the money outright to fix the plumbing problem without the insurance, by guising it in a way that “he had our back”. We smoked cigarettes with the man, had a great conversation, while he knowingly had no intention of performing maintenance  on our home. Avoid this company though your warranty. You will be waiting in sewage if it’s an emergency, just to be danced with through smoke and mirrors.

reviews.author: Carlotta Trotman
reviews.text:
On August 4, 2020, I noticed water in my basement. I contacted this company. I then contacted my home owner insurance company. After the plumber (Justin) contacted me to tell me that he was on his way, I told him not to worry because the insurance is sending someone. Justin ( the plumber) told me that the insurance company won’t fix the problem, they will only assess the problem. I said ok fine come on by. Justin came in with his muddy shoes and open his binder, looked at what was written on there and quoted $765. He went downstairs and said it was my sump pump. I also noticed that there was no water in the sump pump area. He did 5 minutes of work. I asked him how long sump pump lasts, he said 10 - 15 years. I said my sump pump was replaced about 3 years ago. He said you have a Home Depot special. He gave me a receipt that states Install new  Zoeller sump pump with 3 year warranty. Install new check. I’ve subsequently called Watson’s Plumbing and Heating Co for a proper itemization of what was done to include cost of labor and they refused to give it to me.

I’ve checked the sump pump and it is .3 watts. Not sure if .3 watts of power sump pump is worth $765. I am questioning their flat rate of $765 especially given the power of the sump pump. I am also questioning the fact that my sump pump was the issue. Justin took away the old one.

reviews.author: Yvette Mcclary
reviews.text: They were from Sears Warranty protection I have on my home.. In no way I am saying anything against Sears.. I am a satisfied customer with Sears Home Warranty... Watson's Plumbing answered the call right away.. The events that took place after that, i was very disappointed how they did business.  They two guys who I think runs the company were not professional at all.. But they got my $100 service fee right away....They lied about not having or having or getting the part for my Hot water tank... Didn't mention why i called Sears, it was for the Hot water tank... From the day they came out, it took them 9 days to come back and repair my water tank.. In the meantime I  called Sears Warranty at least 3 times to complain... But because Watson's already had the order and supposedly had the part I had to wait fir them to come back to repair my water tank... I was given the runner around by this company and would not recommend them to noone... #Disappointed Customer

reviews.author: Lisa Yingling
reviews.text:
They misled us in the sale of a water treatment system, and for 8 years, they came out every 12-18 months to service a neutralizer that we don't have.  We were misled into believing that the system they installed consisted of a neutralizer and softener.  It's just a softener.
The last time they came out, there were issues in getting the chemicals to take, and the tech called the office.  We were told a part would be ordered, and that was over a year ago.  We tried to call and got no response.
We had to call a new company to come out because we were noticing signs of low Ph.  Our water was tested and the ph was 5.3.  That's way too low.  The new company is how we found out we didn't have a neutralizer.
We feel scammed by the guy that sold us the system especially since we knew him.
Needless to say, we are having a neutralizer installed by a more reputable company.  Can't trust Watson's

reviews.author: Sarah F.
reviews.text: Would only give a one because the company did respond quickly to replace my broken hot water heater. That is where my good review ends. I made the mistake of telling the technician my husband was out of town. He gave me the estimate of over $2600 to replace and take away the broken hot water heater. My bad for not knowing any better, but I realized my mistake after he had taken away the broken hot water heater. As I paid him and he was leaving I did say to him, "You know that is too much to charge for a hot water heater", and his only response was to laugh. Would not recommend Justin or this company due to their blatant disregard for sound, ethical business practices. Taking advantage of a woman, rip off artists!

reviews.author: Michael A. D.
reviews.text:
Never again..a simple garbage disposal jam turned into an overpriced nightmare. We have used Watsons for several years. They are usually timely and efficient. Justin has been our service technician and does good work. However, when the jam was not repairable by Justin, he suggested a new unit he had in the truck.
OK, how much? "$525 installed for an ISE 1/2HP Badger 5." (FYI: on Amazon, this unit costs $100. Also, no parts/labor estimate was given. I felt this was excessive and was being taken advantage of. He took about 45 minutes to install the unit. I figured I paid about $200 for the unit and $325 in labor.
Ridiculous! I called Norman Watson/owner to discuss. He never returned my call. Way to go, Norman.

reviews.author: Kristine Reinhardt
reviews.text: We are so happy we found Watson's!!  The plumber that came to install our new water system was fantastic.  We were so comfortable with Scott.  He explained everything well, was very neat, protected our carpet, showed us how everything worked. And very important to me, he labeled everything!   It was just an overall wonderful experience. We've wanted to do this for a couple years.  Priced it here and there with a several companies, but in the end, not only did we choose Watson's for the great price, it really was for Scott.  Finding contractors to work in your home that you trust can be very difficult - Scott is a wonderful young man.  And my price quoted what I paid. Thank you.

reviews.author: Joseph Kluczynski
reviews.text: Last Thursday ,6/25/15, we were unable to contact our regular plumber and had to go to the yellow pages. Upon calling Watson's Plumbing we were politely received and given a time one of their technicians would be available. The tech. (Justin) was very prompt to solve our well and pump problem. He was done in a very short time and very curtious . His manner of repair got back to havng clear water days faster than others who have done the same procedure. The pricing for the service was the same as our regular plumber, who is very reasonable in his charges. To sum up, we will recomend Watson's in the future and use them as our first call for help.i

synthesis.summary: Watson's splits along two clear lines: Scott (tech) earns genuine long-term loyalty from satisfied customers, while pricing complaints are among the most severe in this directory — one reviewer paid $6,150 for a 2-hour well pump job with $2,000 in parts, refused an itemized bill; another paid $800 labor for a 15-minute install; another was sold a 3-year-old water heater as new and discovered it when the warranty expired early. If you're a Scott customer with a well or water treatment system, the relationship works. For general plumbing, the pricing risk is real.

Available next day on a Friday night for a well pump emergency when others had none

weaknesses: Multiple reviewers note pricing is on the high end with no itemized bills provided
9-day wait for a water heater repair during an active service call — customer had to call warranty company 3+ times to intervene

bestFor: Well pump service and water treatment systems — Scott has strong expertise here
Customers who have an established relationship with a specific tech
Non-emergency scheduled work where you can verify pricing upfront

$800 labor charge for a 15-minute water heater install; technician laughed when customer said the price was too high

synthesis.emergencyNotes: Available next day on a Friday night well pump emergency — but also documented cancelling a confirmed appointment and telling a different emergency customer they were now booked.

I paid $6150 to have my constant pressure well pump system replaced... the parts cost a little over $2000. So $3150 went to labor for a two-hour job. When I asked for an itemized bill the technician said he couldn't give me one.
Norm Watson and Scott just repaired my well pump foot valve under warranty. Quick, professional, just the best I've seen.
Watson's was the only company available the next day after my well pump went up on a Friday night.
They gave me the runaround — 9 days to come back and repair my water tank. Called Sears Warranty at least 3 times to complain. Given the runaround by this company.

plumbers.address: 321 Cary Point Dr, Cary, IL 60013, USA

reviews.author: Lisa Lonigro
reviews.text: John and his crew were great! My sewer line was full of roots and starting to back up into my house. The company that I had been using for the last 3 years refused to come out because they said I didn't live in a convenient enough location for them to continue to service me. Then I was in a bind, but John talked to me, I explained my situation and how the other company kept me waiting almost 3 weeks and then refused to come. John came the next day to help me out. He did a wonderful job and now I have peace of mind and no more sewer back up. They were quick and efficient and very helpful. They even checked my water heater for me because it was turned up to high, so they turned it down to a safer level for me for no charge. He has a new customer in me. Thanks All Family Plumbing!

reviews.author: Kathrine Clarke
reviews.text: Amazing service! We called Thursday evening and they were able to send someone Friday morning. The plumbers (Don and Shawn) were so helpful, clean, and determined to find the problem. They stayed calm and kept great humor throughout the call. The service operators were super nice and friendly too.

reviews.author: Mark Paulsen
reviews.text:
I recently had a water spigot installed (Aquor Water Systems V2) in my backyard by All Family Plumbing, and I couldn't be more pleased with the service! From start to finish, the experience was exceptional. They were prompt, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable.

The installation itself was seamless, they worked efficiently, and they left no mess behind. The new spigot functions perfectly, and the quality of the work is evident. It’s clear that All Family Plumbing takes pride in their craft and strives for customer satisfaction.

I highly recommend All Family Plumbing for any plumbing needs. Their skill, reliability, and outstanding service truly deserve five stars. Thank you for a job well done!

reviews.author: N E
reviews.text: I have used All Family Plumbing for years, they always do a stellar job. One time they came to the house because I had a problem with my kitchen faucet - turns out it was a loose screw, literally. 🤦🏻‍♀️ They refused to charge me! Another time the owner, John, replaced the piping under my kitchen sink . For years I’d had problems with the pipes coming loose and leaking due to the way the original pipes were placed. John reworked the piping and told me if I ever have a problem again he’d fix it for free. That was 10 years ago. Love these guys!

reviews.author: Eric Thrasher
reviews.text: Our gratitude to John and All Family Plumbing And Remodeling cannot be overstated. When we experienced a major water line issue in our home late this evening, they responded promptly and professionally. Their expertise and dedication were second to none, and they quickly diagnosed and resolved the problem to ensure our main water supply was restored for everyone in the house. Their dedication to customer satisfaction was truly remarkable. We highly recommend  John and All Family Plumbing And Remodeling for all plumbing needs, as they provided excellent service during our major water line issue.

synthesis.summary: All Family Plumbing shows strong emergency responsiveness and customer service, with multiple reviews highlighting next-day service and professional handling of urgent issues. However, with only 36 total reviews and a 3.7/5 rating, there may be some service inconsistencies not reflected in these positive reviews.

reviews.author: Janlyn Thaxton
reviews.text:
I had a leak in a pipe in a downstairs ceiling that was pouring out water from sources upstairs. Adams Plumbing was prompt to come and fixed the leak very inexpensively. They even came back after the compound on the pipe had hardened and dried and reapplied for added security.
I had called another plumber first, that I have used for a long time, and the only way they could fix it was to tear out the ceiling in two rooms to change out all the pipes! Yikes!

reviews.author: Leslie Brannon
reviews.text: I have used Adams Plumbing on several occasions. David is the person that came to my house. He always comes when he says he will, and he is respectful and polite.  He stays until the job is done and never over charges. I highly recommend using Adams Plumbing!

reviews.author: forrest weaver
reviews.text: Awesome service

reviews.author: Wayne Carter
reviews.text: I will start by saying the two gentleman that came and attempted to work on my faucet were nice. They attempted to fix my faucet in my bath tub from leaking. They worked on it for about 30 min and came and told me it was two old and could not be fixed so they put it back together and let me know options to fix completely and said it would be about a week before they could fit me in the schedule. I went back to check it was all back together and found the made it worse and it was now spraying water into my wall. I called the office to see if I could get them back out to At least cap it off to be able to turn my water on. The gentleman in the office tried to blame the fact my water had been turned off multiple times and the pressure is what made the leak worse. Then told me there was nothing he could do for me until Wednesday of the following week. So it was either go without water or let it flood my house. Luckily they did not charge me for messing up my bathroom more! But I will never ever use them again.

reviews.author: Mitzi G.
reviews.text: Adams Plumbing was recommended to replace a broken hot water heater at the home of my mother, an 84 year old absentee homeowner. In the course of the repairs, it was determined the base for the hot water heater and interior of the A/C should be replaced.  The home owner used a stone mason recommended by Adams Plumbing.  The homeowner paid $2020.00 for the base.  Subsequently, with no notification, explanation or offer of alternatives,  Adams Plumbing tore down 1/2 of the masonry and replaced it with ugly cinder blocks.  Pete Mares, owner of Adams Plumbing, agreed to make repairs to the base so they would match, but didn't.  Another stone mason had to be called in at the cost of another $450.00 to the elderly home owner who is on a fixed income. The home owner has texts, receipts, telephone calls and witnesses that Mares admits to the destruction of the stone work and that he would "make it right". He never did. He then said he would reimburse the homeowner for the repairs to the stone.  He never did.  In fact, the first week of Oct., Pete Mares took $200.00 to the contractor overseeing the repair to the house with the request to get the homeowner's daughter "Off his a**.".  I would never use this company and most certainly never trust them to not take advantage of the elderly or absentee homeowners.

reviews.author: Carole Langdon
reviews.text:
I am very pleased with the plumber David with Adams Plumbing.  I had an outside faucet that did not have any water coming from it.  I got an appt surprisingly quick.   When David arrived he bravely belly crawled into the crawl space (something I hope never to do) and found the faucet was not even connected to anything - no hose, connectors, waterline etc - yep, I previously had a shoddy contractor).  David quickly got the parts, dove back into the crawl space and got it hooked up.  Everything is flowing perfectly.  Price was very reasonable and up front - no last minute hidden charge surprises.
I hope not to have to need a plumber in the future but if I do, I will definitely call them. Also appreciated the professional and personable office manager, Steve.  It was a good experience.

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.text: I had called adams plumbing for a burst pipe after this recent freeze. They were very prompt, fair with the price and did good work. What I appreciate above all else was they called to tell me they broke a pipe while fixing the burst one and fixed it free of charge, thats honest and professional. They could easily of just said they found another broken pipe and charged me but they didn't, I will recommend adams plumbing to anyone and will happily do business with them again.

reviews.author: T Haley
reviews.text: Do NOT use these people! Terrible and cheap work. Complete jerks and not trustworthy!! They constantly make up excuses as to why they won't complete a job. Never show up on time and consistently postpone jobs. I was without water for two weeks because they kept promising to get the job done.

reviews.author: Lisa E.
reviews.text: Called the New Owner Rick Howell and scheduled service for my outside faucet to get fixed. His company was prompt and made the repair painless. I would recommend this small business for any repair whether small or big. Rick and his team will get it done! Thank Yall!

reviews.author: Doug Hickson
reviews.text: We have used Adams plumbing for over 4 years now how our residential and commercial needs. They have always been more than fair in pricing and always top quality workmanship. Customer service and professionalism has been above 5 star each and every time.

reviews.author: Pennilisa Esquivel
reviews.text: I used Adam's plumbing a few days ago. Not only was everyone super friendly they answered all of my questions and made me feel so comfortable. Great customer service. Fast appointments.  Speedy service! I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Becky “Becky Hooker” Smith
reviews.text: We had the BEST experience with Adam's and we won't ever go back to who we were using, or anyone else. We are 100% happy with our experience and would recommend Rick and his crew over and over. Great people.

reviews.author: Steve Savage
reviews.text: these guys are Awesome!  fast service and the bill was much less than I expected it to be.  I highly recommend Rick and his crew if you need good plumbers!

reviews.author: Brenda Lanham
reviews.text: Best plumbing and heating guys in town! When u call for service, they're there within a few hours. Curtious and knowledgeable. Definitely recommend.

Pricing is consistently described as fair and below expectations, and techs like David show up when promised. Older reviews flag a lopsided toilet installation that was dismissed and a multi-week stretch without water due to delays.

reviews.text: They came to fix my broken pipes under the bathroom sink they were absolutely wonderful they came the same day i called fixed the mess I made unstopped  my sink and fix a leak in my garage matt was very good listen when I rambled on will always use them for my plumbing problems I didn't get the other guys name but he was great too thank you so much

reviews.author: Donna Bray
reviews.text: Second plumbing company that came, got the job done quickly and was not overcharged, even discounted for already removing toilet. I first called Hogle plumbing and they overcharged me and still did not fix it and couldn’t tell me why or recommend what to do. These people will fix it and not overcharge you .

reviews.author: Charity Kelley
reviews.text:
I called late on Friday and they were at my house before noon on Monday!! Matt was very polite, professional and above all HONEST! I had another company come by on Friday and they quoted me TRIPLE 😳 the price that Ron-Co quoted and charged me to clear my clogged vent!! It is so good to know there are still companies out there who truly offer good service and treat their customers like people instead of dollar bills!! I highly recommend this company for all your plumbing needs!! 💯 Pass it on!!

reviews.author: Diane Rula
reviews.text: Ron squeezed us in & came late in the day. What a helpful blessing he was. He was very smart about what the problem was & he gave us the choice of doing the BIG fix which will eventually be necessary or a temporary fix to get us by for now. His pricing seemed fair & he was nice too. We'll be calling him again.

reviews.author: Autumn McNeel
reviews.text: We called this company to come clear out our sewage line and to get a quote to fix a huge mess a previous plumbing company had made. They showed up on time and were able to get it taken care of quickly. The quote they gave me to fix the other companies bad work was the best. All the other companies quoted me a huge amount and they were able to show me where I was being charged ridiculous fees that were not needed at all. As a woman, I feel like some companies take advantage of my lack of knowledge where things like this are concerned. This man did not make me feel stupid for asking questions, and did not try to take advantage of my lack of knowledge at all. I whole heartedly trust them to continue taking care of all my plumbing needs!

synthesis.summary: Ron-Co Rooter appears to be a reliable, honest plumbing company with strong customer service and fair pricing. Multiple reviews praise their same-day response, professional work, and transparent pricing that's significantly lower than competitors.

reviews.author: Doug Christensen
reviews.text: We had our upstairs 3 ton AC and heat unit replaced.  The sales and install team were thorough and efficient and completed work in less than a day.  There was a minor accident with a crack in ceiling sheetrock and it was addressed immediately and fixed flawlessly.  We're very happy to have Thorpe for our AC/HEAT, plumbing, and electric needs.  All crews have been responsive and dependable.

reviews.author: Krystal
reviews.text: Called twice was told that someone would be coming out.No one ever did. Nor did anyone call. Called another plumber service, they came out and completed the job.

reviews.author: Danny James
reviews.text: Thorpe came to work on my AC. Randy and Zack were very professional and did an excellent job Definitely 5 star service. Very good

reviews.author: Shelbee Carlton
reviews.text:
We had been trying to get a few plumbing issues fixed through our warranty company for a month and a half. They kept selecting companies that didn’t service our area and who didn’t answer phone calls. The leak in our water heater got so bad it shorted the breaker and we were without hot water for a week before finally giving up on our warranty company.

We called Thorpe and they were at our house within two days. Replaced our water heater for us and got a few other plumbing problems fixed for us all within an hour and a half.
Very much appreciated and recommended!

reviews.author: Debbie Gordon
reviews.text: Our heat stopped working Saturday morning my husband Phil called the office & spoke to a very nice lady who took his information we had a return call from Butch Thorpe within 15-20 minutes & a technician was at our home within 30 minutes, our heat was fixed within the hour. The technician was very polite, professional and very informative, he took his time to make sure we were satisfied with everything he did to fix it. We have used no one except Thorpe Sheet Metal for all our issues! We would recommend them to everyone!

reviews.text:
I manage 2 three family buildings in Worcester. I had very bad luck with one "plumber", I did not check up on him before hiring him and he charged me a lot and did terribly shoddy work. I found out later he was not even  licensed! 

Then I tried BEI Plumbing, run by Bob Bernstein. One of the things immediately apparent is that he does it by the book. He will not do poor, non-code compliant work. He has bailed me out of a few plumbing emergencies and he is a busy man because he does such good work at a reasonable price. Plumbing ain't cheap but Bob fixes it and fixes it right, with his personal guarantee. 

The work he has done for me was residential but he does big scale and commercial jobs as well. Please note, aside from being a customer I do not have any promotional or commercial ties to BEI Plumbing. I'm just glad to leave a good review for him.

reviews.text: If your a female have a Male present. Rude and disrespectful employees.

reviews.author: Steve Wilichowski
reviews.text: My gas boiler was almost 30 years old so I decided to upgrade through the MassSave program.  I contacted BEI Plumbing & Heating and explained my situation to Bob who took the time to walk me through a number of key considerations and provided a set of recommendations.  Bob was highly confident he could lower my gas consumption 25-50% by implementing the system he was recommending.  I told him I was skeptical because my home was already very energy efficient by installing new windows and insulation over the last few years.  However, Bob insisted his new heating system would deliver the cost savings he was quoting.  I decided to go ahead with Bob's recommendation and we worked out a plan to install the new system.  Bob had to rework the scheduling of the project multiple times to align with the MassSave loan I was receiving.  During this time he communicated clearly and often, which is an attribute not found with many other contractors I have worked with.  Once the project started, Bob and his team showed up on time, completed all the work quoted, finished the work on time, and the cost was not a penny more than what Bob had quoted.  He even helped me with a few other minor items that were not part of the original estimate, at no extra cost.    Bob told me he takes personal pride in each system he installs, but I didn't expect the results to look like a work of art when it was finished.  My heating system looks better than some of the other areas of my house.  Finally, what about the 25-50% savings Bob said he could deliver.  Over the first three months with the new system my gas consumption has dropped approximately 42%.  Bob delivered on his word!  I would recommend Bob and his team to anyone needing help with their heating system.  Bob and his team did a fantastic job for me!  Please feel free to call me if you need more details.  I can be found in the local phone book.

reviews.author: jesse shaw
reviews.text:
If you want personal care, Bob is the man to turn to. One year ago, Bob replaced our 40 year old oil furnace with a high efficiency gas furnace. This switch saved my family a tremendous amount of money. I only paid 900 dollars for the whole year in gas.  Leading up to and during installation, Bob was always available, no question was too small for him.  He helped us pick the right system for us and explained all the steps in detail.  He and his crew were always on time and on premise when they said they would be to help the transition from oil to gas through Mass Save.
Bob's commitment doesn't end there.  A few months after installation, Bob called just to check on how the system was working and if there was any questions.  I have also contacted Bob about plumbing questions we had for additional work and he is always ready to listen and offer up advice.  We love our system, the work done by BEI, and Bob's genuine caring personality.  You wont find that with a commercial heating and plumbing contractor.

reviews.author: Rachel Garlington
reviews.text: We could not be happier with Bobby. You will not find a better plumber, because he is just a good honest person who takes his work seriously and does whatever it takes to make the homeowners happy. After having an awful experience with a contractor, my husband did a lot of research to find a good plumber with decent prices. There is a reason BEI has such good reviews. Bobby talked with us extensively about our options for switching to natural gas, and was very helpful and knowledgable. He is also reliable- on the day he was supposed to come switch out the boiler, he had an emergency call, so he actually paid for a week's worth of oil for us to hold us over until he could come. Then he came when he said he was going to,  brought two other hard-working guys (one was his son), dealt with suppliers who sent a dented boiler, cleaned up, and explained everything he did. Even my dog likes him. He is definitely our plumber for future jobs.

reviews.text: This is the only plumber we use! Knowledgeable and budget friendly! Beautiful work done and clean up was perfect. Amazing work and friendly staff. Highly recommend. You can’t go wrong with the quality, reliability and professionalism that A&T provides our community. Big thanks

reviews.author: Sheri Lathrop
reviews.text:
We contacted A&T Plumbing due to a leaking expansion tank on our water heater.
Logan Mayer came out within the hour and promptly replaced it. The service was excellent and the price extremely fair. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: David Migliore
reviews.text: I just wanted to take a minute to detail the high end professionalism and excellent craftsmanship this particular company has displayed throughout my almost 20 year business dealings with them.  First off this is a second generation establishment and credit due to the original OG Mr. Lee Pearson. He has taken his time transitioning this company to his son Leth as I understand it.  Leth has been equally as professional and qualified. AT&T Plumbing is fair, detailed and straight forward. Leth has taken the qualities his father instilled in him and expanded upon them. His team is 1st rate. Shoes off at the door, I’ve personally seen them carry multiple water heaters up and down stairs while making sure first and foremost they do not damage my home. The installation was quick and precise. I’ve used them to install heaters in my personal garage which turned out perfect for Chicago winters. They have worked for my company when other plumbers were perplexed and confused what the issue was to backing up toilets. They came back 4 times finally breaking up concrete and finding an old antiquated piece of pipe that was leaking underground from the 70 year old building They fixed the pipe, hauled out all the insane amount of broken concrete from jackhammering. I have to take a second to compliment AT&T’s associates Logan and Scott. They hauled bucket after bucket of broken concrete for 8 hours up 2 flights of stairs then brought back pre mix concrete bags and finished with a concrete slab that looked perfect when finished.  I would recommend this company to anyone who is sick of dealing with plumbers who don’t show up, don’t accurately quote jobs and can just generally not be counted on. The owner will always answer the phone once a quote is established and they are always willing to go the extra mile. Merry Christmas guys and thanks again for being a company Northwest IL Suburbanites can count on when your professionalism is needed.

synthesis.summary: A&T Plumbing is a well-established family business with over 40 years in the community, showing strong reliability and craftsmanship. They demonstrate good emergency responsiveness with same-day service and have built long-term customer relationships spanning decades. While 24-hour availability is unclear, their track record suggests they're a solid choice for urgent plumbing needs.

reviews.text: HD Plumbing & Heating was superb! Their prices were also much more reasonable than almost all of their competitors who I spoke with for estimates. I would definitely use this company again for any of my plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Gary Medley
reviews.text:
I called HD because we recently had a leak start in our current water heater. Not only was the company out within 24hrs to assess the situation but also in no way pressured us to replace our current unit, rather, they made us feel comfortable by letting us know we had “some time” to decide what we wanted to do.

I actually received a call from one of the owners the following day to go over all our options. He was very honest in what direction to go with all the different options. My wife and I cannot speak highly enough about our experience with them or their installers who were also amazing, polite and beyond professional not to mention how clean they installed the new water heater.

reviews.text:

In the past HD has installed a RO system, which has been a great addition and nice to work with them in a non-emergency service appointment as well :)
The team is so friendly and reliable.  We felt good knowing the plumbing work was done correctly!  It's good to be able to trust a company like we do HD Plumbing and Heating!

They arrived on time, finished quickly, left the work area spotless and made a follow-up call to verify satisfaction with the product and service.  Very pleased with both!!  Will definitely use them again.

Our closing will be delayed because he didn't have the courtesy to just say he wouldn't fix it but rather ignored our phone calls.  After calling other plumbers in the area we found out they have had similar calls regarding Donnie and they have had to fix issues from this company for other customers.  DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY ...they will not install to code and will not make the correction afterwards.

reviews.author: Abraham W.
reviews.text:
I noticed a spot on the garage ceiling growing and bulging this year. I knew their was a leak because it was immediately below the shower of the master bedroom. I called Xpress Plumbing because they were the first ones able to come out. Thankfully, they kept me abreast of everything they found and the price for fixing everything was less then what I had expected. If you call the big franchise plumbers they would be twice as expensive. But, long story short, they ordered a brass drain, placed a piece of 4x4 wood under the floor of the drain and the problem has not come back for more than a month. Also, with Xpress Plumbing's 6 month warranty I know they will be back to fix any issues if the need arises (but I think I won't have too).

If you want fast and courteous service with updates and explanations and up front costs (with no hidden charges) then try out Express Plumbing, you might be pleasantly surprised.

reviews.author: Myles McDevitt
reviews.text: Don’t expect them to keep appointments, answer phone calls, or return voicemails. My hot water heater went out. I called early yesterday morning and he said he had availability for either later that afternoon or between 8-10 today, so I made an appointment for between 8-10 today not being sure if I could make the appointment that day. Soon after making this appointment I realized I could be home later that day, so I called to reschedule. There was no answer, so I left a voicemail requesting a reschedule. I never heard back. No biggie, I’ll just wait until the morning for him to come out. The day of my appointment, I don’t hear a word out of him and nobody shows up. I call 3-4 times and leave a voicemail and never heard back. Still haven’t heard back. Very unprofessional.

reviews.author: Jeff Murray
reviews.text:
Plumb Xpress should be your first choice and call for all your plumbing and drain needs. They are also experts in copper pipe replacements as they did our entire home and did an incredible job! Donnie and his team are experts at replacing the old pipes with a minimum of wall cuts and ceiling damage. They are fast but efficient and always clean up…and left us with a water supply every evening until the job was completed.
The best part is they handle the entire job from start to finish…no need to have to go out and find a drywall repairman or a painter unless you chose to!
We honestly could not have been happier with their work and are aware of a number of others that have been equally satisfied. You will not go wrong with Plumb Xpress I assure you…

reviews.author: Jessica DeMarco
reviews.text:
I was so pleased with their service, I came straight back to work and am writing this review! We woke up to a leak in our thermal expansion tank this morning. My husband was too busy at work to meet them and I had just started a new job!  We explained this to Adam and he was very willing to work with us, since I could not commit to the normal 2 hour time frame. They were there when they said they would be (actually earlier!) and was able to replace our expansion tank in a very short amount of time...getting me back to work within an hour. They were very knowledgeable and respectful, and I would definitely give them my business again...but hopefully I will not have too.
Best,
A very happy customer!

reviews.author: melissa herrin
reviews.text:
I had another emergency plumbing issue come up during the cold winter storm - my pipes froze and burst. I used Plumb Xpress Plumbing once before so I didn't hesitate to call them again. They had a service tech here within 60 minutes to shut my water off. They were able to diagnose my problem and make the repairs and get my family and I running water that night. They also went over our plumbing system and explained to me how to shut water off to house and outside spicketts.

Thank you for once again being there fast for our family and getting our problem taken care of so quickly.

reviews.author: Shawn Bartlett
reviews.text: I cannot recommend these guys enough. They were amazing. I had an emergency sewer issue. I'll save you the details... It was bad. Of course the three emergency 24/7 plumbers we had on the fridge had no one available. Then we found Plumb Xpress. They came out that night (Saturday) and worked through the weekend to get us back up and running. My house was built in the 40's and had the original orangeburg lines. They were able to offer a reasonable price. Really amazing. Thank you Donnie, Rick and Wayne. You've made a life long customer.

reviews.author: Michelle Abbott
reviews.text: HUGE shout out to Plumb Xpress for sending out Joey so fast!! We were having surges in water pressure and was so worried my appliances were going to be damaged from it!!!! We tried replacing the pressure reducing valve and still no change! Joey made sure everything was installed correctly and our pressure gauge was hooked up in the correct spot and determined our regulator was faulty and explained what happens sometimes with them! Super awesome people to work with!! Thank you soooo much!!

reviews.author: Nathan Miller
reviews.text: Called on Wednesday and the sent a guy out too look at a leak we had been having. He took photos of what I told what all we wanted replaced and  said they would email me an invoice for how much it would be, and they could be back tomorrow to fix it . Never recieved the invoice so I called the next afternoon and left a message trying to see if they had the wrong email or something. Today is friday and I still have not heard anything back from them.

reviews.author: Philip Barger
reviews.text:
Donnie, and his crew did a complete re-pipe of my Brookstone home last July, and got rid of all the leaky copper and replaced it with a high-end cross-link polymer plumbing. They did an excellent job got in and out, create a minimal amount of mess and kept me informed on every step what was being done. If you gotta have this kind of job done, these are
the people to see.

reviews.author: Austin Williams
reviews.text:
Had a leak coming from upstairs bathroom. Called and Donnie said he bet it was the tub drain that was the problem. He arrived when he said he would and fixed the problem. The price he said over the phone is what he charged even after he had to work on the tub spout also. I would recommend Plumb Xprees. If I have another problem this is who I will call.

Jim Williams

reviews.author: Leslie Seymour
reviews.text:
The plumbers texted and arrived early.  They were cheerful and helpful.  They installed our new garbage disposal, but went further to replace the piping to minimize spots likely to clog. They pointed out unusual features of the new unit.  Also he showed us the gunk in the old pipes and recommended flushing much longer after grinding to prevent future clogs.  They swept up thoroughly after they finished.

We were immediately put at ease by their cheerfulness and competence.  They worked quickly and efficiently.

We are very happy with Gustafson and have used them multiple times over the last 10 years.

reviews.author: Brandon Fusaro
reviews.text: Gustafson replaced the water line from the street to my mother's home, and we couldn’t be more pleased with the experience. Their team was knowledgeable, professional, and truly stood behind the quality of their work. I highly recommend Gustafson for any water line replacement needs.

reviews.author: Dave D
reviews.text: I can’t recommend Gustafson enough. From start to finish, they were outstanding. I needed a sewer line repair, and Shayna went above and beyond to get us scheduled quickly. Bruce came out to provide a quote, which was more than fair. The crew—Drew, Sean, Connor, and Javaughn—were professional, punctual, and transparent throughout the entire process. They took the time to explain what they were doing every step of the way, which I really appreciated. I never once felt like I was getting the runaround. I’ll be using Gustafson for all my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Michael Parker
reviews.text:
Drew & Joe came to clear the main drain in my condo. I was not home when they did the job, but my gf said both of them were professional, polite and helpful.
They did a great job and I highly recommend Gustafson Plumbers.

reviews.author: Kristine Jones
reviews.text: We have used Gustavson Plumbing for multiple projects and Derek went above and beyond for each service. We had a leaking toilet while our family house was for sale and he immediately took care of the issue- despite being very busy.He also repaired a  leak in the attic from a heating hy vent along with other items on our plumbing checklist for the sale. We very much appreciate the professionalism, skill and service we received for every service. Highly recommend!

synthesis.summary: Gustafson Plumbers appears to be a highly reliable company with excellent customer service and technical expertise. Multiple customers praise their professionalism, transparency, and ability to go above and beyond, with one long-term customer using them repeatedly over 10 years.

plumbers.address: 112 N Main St, Greer, SC 29650, USA

reviews.author: Carolyn Frady
reviews.text: I had another plumbing company wave the $89.99 service fee(thank you).Staggs plumbing didn't  charge me a service fee.The lady that answered  the phone was knowledgeable  enough to give me an estimate  to replace my hot water heater that was very close to actual cost.The other plumbing company gave me a very unethical price about 3× the price that Staggs charged.The job was kinda difficult because  of the tight space in my crawlspace.The man from Staggs was very experienced  and got the hot water heater  in with just one man and very quickly.I am very happy with  service with Staggs.Dont waste time with other plumbers,just call them .They are the best in service and price,very friendly  too

reviews.author: Teigan Behlert
reviews.text:
Amazingly quick response!!!  I was thinking hours and the guy was on my doorstep 5 minutes after I had called in my emergency leak. I have never experienced a plumber to show up so quickly,  almost like I rubbed a lamp and a kind, knowledgeable,  curtious plumbing gennie popped out.
Also very fair affordable pricing.  I didn't feel like I was being upcharged at all.  If anything I felt like he deserved more pay for the all around professional way he took care of my emergency.

reviews.author: Lisa Cress
reviews.text: Mr. Staggs has done plumbing for us, for several years. He manages to fit us in very quickly each time. I’ve never had to call them back for anything that wasn’t exactly right. The cost is very fair. I will continue to use their services as long as we’re living in this area.

reviews.author: Erin Albrecht
reviews.text: I called Wednesday to schedule an appointment and suggested Monday would be a good day.  I received a phone call Thursday morning asking if he could come out today and he arrived 10 minutes later!  I had a leaking ice maker line in my crawl space.  He capped it off, explained to me what he did and left.  It took less than an hour.  Price was reasonable and I will be calling Staggs with any future problems.

reviews.author: Melinda Fisher
reviews.text: Thorough and very honest.  No price gouging.  We have dealt with many different plumbers and Staggs Plumbing is the one we will continue to use from now on. No gimmicks, no pushy sales pitch. Honest and dependable.

The company stands out for honest pricing without service fees or upselling, and customers consistently praise their quick scheduling and reliable work quality.

Reliable quality work

reviews.author: Logan Powell
reviews.text: Our water pressure dropped drastically throughout the house, making showers and washing dishes difficult. Their plumbing team came out and inspected the pipes. They cleaned buildup in the main lines, tested all faucets and restored the water pressure. It feels like we have a completely new system and using water in the house is much easier now. The technician was very friendly and professional.

reviews.author: Anthony Murphy
reviews.text: I noticed a small leak under the bathroom sink and the surrounding area was getting damp. The damaged pipe section was replaced, all connections were secured and the area was dried thoroughly. The leak is completely gone and I feel confident it won’t come back.

reviews.author: Jordan Johnson
reviews.text: A faucet handle had become stiff and difficult to operate. Aurora Plumbing serviced the internal mechanism and restored smooth movement. The technician ensured no leaks remained. The faucet now functions properly.

reviews.author: Lily Turner
reviews.text: My bathroom sink trap was leaking at the joint. Their crew replaced and sealed it properly. The repair was quick and solid. I’m very satisfied.

reviews.author: William Taylor
reviews.text: Shower head had uneven water pressure. A technician cleaned mineral buildup and replaced worn connectors. Flow is now consistent and steady. The system was tested carefully. I would rely on them for future work.

reviews.author: Geo H.
reviews.text: These guys are great! We had them replace the heating and cooling system in our 100 year-old house. From the first estimate to the final inspection, they kept us informed, answered all of our questions and did a great job. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Yaj ..
reviews.text: They've helped me with my sump pump, great service as they are professional and very responsive (especially with emailing).

reviews.author: Wild B.
reviews.text: Weber plumbing is the best. I used many plumbers over the years and couldn't recomend any of them until I tried Weber. They come over when they say they will, do what they said they would do and at the price they said they would. Who could ask for more. If you're looking for a reliable local plumbing contractor, call Weber, you'll be glad you did.

reviews.author: Geoff A.
reviews.text: They have major scheduling issues. They took our deposit in September, and it's nearly January with no work started. When they did finally schedule a start date they didn't show up, scheduled a start date a week later and again failed to show. If you value your time, find a different company.

reviews.author: Geoff Aoyagi
reviews.text: They have major scheduling issues. They took our deposit in September, and it's nearly January with no work started. When they did finally schedule a start date they didn't show up, scheduled a start date a week later and again failed to show. If you value your time, find a different company.

reviews.author: Drew J.
reviews.text:
Please take a moment to read this before you select A.T. Weber for your plumbing work. 

I recently hired A.T. Weber to install a recirculating pump for my hot water system in my house.  I reached out for an estimate because of the positive reviews on Yelp and I found the owner (who also did the on-site estimate) to be genuine, knowledgeable and friendly.  I accepted their bid, although slightly higher than two others, because of the Yelp reviews, confidence in the owner, and a desire to support a local business in Alameda.  Unfortunately I came to regret it.

The plumber who performed the work was punctual and also friendly, although he was a bit confused by the specific work I requested.  He didn't know exactly how to install the aquastat I was using to moderate activation of the pump and needed an electrician to come out a few days later to finish the work.  

The real problem was that while installing the piping for the pump the plumber unknowingly loosened a nut connecting the main gas line to the hot water heater, causing a gas leak in my (unventilated) garage.   So when I came down there early the next morning to leave the house with my four year old son there was an extremely strong odor of built up gas.  After evacuating my wife, son and newborn daughter out of the house I first tried the main office, leaving an urgent message that was never returned.  Luckily I also happened to have the plumber's cell phone as he had previously called me for directions.  Thankfully he called back after an urgent voicemail and text telling him to come out immediately because I was about to call 911.   Yes, I know, I should have just immediately called 911. 

Did he fix the problem quickly?  Yes.  Am I happy that he literally almost killed my family? No.   This was a built up leak in an unventilated area over the course of about 18 hours - the leak odor was very strong.

Look, I understand that mistakes happen.  Even really horrendous mistakes that could jeopardize my family's safety.  But the fact that they never even called me back after I left that message with their office was unacceptable.  In fact, the next time I heard from them was when I got an email from the office manager with a bill for the work a few weeks later with no acknowledgement of what had happened.  After I replied expressing my displeasure, the manager called me and apologized, saying they had lost some voicemails...  Even if that is true a simple apology is not even close to enough.  Maybe others feel differently but my expectation is that they do more than say "sorry" for a situation like that.  Needless to say, I don't believe I got the service I just received a bill for.

reviews.author: Harold H.
reviews.text:
Well I'm very sad to have to right this review.  I have used AT Weber in for the past 18 years for my pluming needs and had been happy with them.  

Recently I had them work on my floor heater that was slow to start up.  They started with a change of thermostats which didn't work.  So we schedule a follow up visited to resolve the issue.  They cancel the this visit and rescheduled for a few days later.  Which was okay because we still had a working heater at this point even if it was slow to get going.  

On the rescheduled visit the tech did arrive on time, bang on it a bit then said he would need to come back and do a rebuild.  The one problem is the banging he did has caused the heater to completely stop working. Which means no heat.

We made an appointment to have the rebuild done.  A.T. Weber cancel ] this appointment, we reschedule again and the appointment  agian was canceled by A.T. Weber on the Friday before Christmas.  So here we are with a 3 day weekend before us with out a working heater at the coldest time of year.

A.T. Weber canceled appointments on us 3 times.  

Not sure why the service has gone down so much because in the past they had been so reliable.   

I guess that's the way the cookie crumbles.

Update - Feb. 8, 2018

I need to update and upgrade my review of AT Weber.

We had some plumbing work done by one of their techs last year.   We felt the the work that was done may not have succeeded in fixing the problem as there was a leek that had been going on for quite sometime which was evidenced by the very large wet spot under our house.  This was discovered by the other furnace company that we hired to come and fix our floor heater.    

We talked with the office manager and he assured us the work was guaranteed for a full year and set the first open appointment to have the original tech to come out and see what the issue was.  As it turned out this was a new leek and had nothing to do with the work previously done.   The tech showed me where the pipe with degrading and developed a crack that was the cause of the leak.  

He did the work in short order replacing more pipe then was currently leaking in order to prevent future problems as the plumbing in our house is very old.   

I have to say this tech was just great and I would not hesitate to hire him again.   

Bravo! AT Weber your guy has restored our faith in your company.  

Which make me very happy as I was quite bummed to think I would not be able to depend on you'll for my plumbing needs and emergencies.

reviews.author: Sugar E.
reviews.text:
Weelll...a few years back, something happened with the billing. I didn't understand what they billed me for, called to get an answer about it, held off on paying until I was able to reach them to get an explanation and then trotted right over with cash because I'm a goody two shoes and I was late paying it. I gave it to a guy at the back on the left and he didn't give me a receipt. You know how it is when you ignore that little feeling? I ignored that little feeling and now they think I didn't pay. I explained it to whomever I spoke to on the phone. Strangely enough, they believe their employee over a random stranger even if she's an earnest customer. Sigh.

One of the more annoying things is that the job I hired them for was to fix something in the crawl space under the house. The manager didn't want to send them if there was a bunch of water from the broken kitchen sink pipe or anything else unpleasant. I couldn't believe it. It *is* plumbing after all! 

I went under the house myself, raked the sandy dirt flat-ish, put down a trail of thick plastic tarp to the break point and went with the plumbers to where the pipe that needed mending was. I did all of this on my belly. When I say "crawl space", that's a generous descriptor. The primary plumber told me he has claustrophobia once he got out of there. Manager dude! Do not torment your employees! The problem is space, not a bunch of water. Double sigh.

The last time I called them, it was for an emergency toilet overflow situation. The person answering said that they wouldn't be able to help me for a couple of weeks. I'm guessing that they don't want me as a client. After all of that, I gotta say I'm not going to argue!

reviews.author: salo s.
reviews.text:
We hired AT Weber to do the plumbing for our remodel and while the quality of their work ended up being pretty good, it took very close supervision on our part for that to be the case. I would suggest using ATWeber for clogged drains and leaky water heaters but not anything more involved than that. Here are a few of the problems they caused that we had to make them solve:
 Their worker installed a toilet in our Jack and Jill bathroom, blocking the door from closing. He was going to leave it like that. When we raised the issue he suggested we buy a different toilet, despite the fact that there was plenty of room behind the toilet.  Another contractor (carpenter) suggested that the plumber reposition the pipe under the toilet so it would fit. 

 When ATW was running the pipes for our kitchen, they didn't follow the kitchen layout we had given them and we had to measure everything ourselves and make them reposition the pipes multiple times. They never got the drain pipe for the sink in the right position and the general contractor has to cut a bunch of holes inside our cabinetry for the drain to run laterally and it is super ugly. 

It took them 5 tries to install a pot filler. 

Essentially, ATWeber took no responsibility for getting things right the first time. They didn't follow the plans we gave them or keep track of what work they had remaining in our contract. We had to do all of their project management and monitor the quality and correctness of their work. They were the contractor that required the most oversight and attention in our remodel out of the 12 that we worked with. That being said they did use quality materials and the plumbing all works great.

reviews.author: Mjo K.
reviews.text:
It's now 10 days after we first contacted "our" plumber who installed a hot water heater 3 years ago in our 10-unit condo in Alameda.  Last week, we called AT Weber for help before the Holiday Weekend.  They were not available for us.  One of the officers of the HOA went into their office and were told they would try to get someone over before the end of the day, Friday, before the weekend. He was a no show/no call plumber.  But we also scheduled an appointment for Wednesday morning, telling them specifically what the problem was...an ignition part making a racket.  Our neighbor fiddled with it and got the hot water up and running, for only a short time, but we trusted that AT Weber would be able to resolve our problem.
  There's a reason their ratings are trending lower! Josh showed up Wednesday, fiddled with it and said he'd order a part that would "take a day or two."  Someone else came by yesterday, Friday, 9 days after we initially contacted "our" plumber.  Fiddled with it. An hour or two later, there's no hot water, no replacement part, no calls back from them.  Only someone will get the part and put it in today (yesterday). Well, now it is tomorrow, Saturday, and still no hot water, no part, no one who can be reached.
  They won't be "our" plumber any more.  Any you might want to think twice before hiring them or buying a service or system from them if you may need them for anything beyond the initial sale.
  Their service has gone downhill and they obviously need a management makeover.

reviews.author: Sykes A.
reviews.text:
Weber replaced our whole plumbing system including waste lines out to the sewer main.

  This was unavoidable work and we were under the gun. Our system was quite old and the piping was quite complicated; it included taking up concrete in our finished basement.

  Todd spent a lot of time here figuring out where the pipes went and how to avoid taking up original hardwood floors over concrete in order to change out our main drainage system, he was very knowledgeable, patient and, most importantly, thorough in his assessments. His quotes stayed true to what we were charged and we paid as each phase of the job was finished, not before.

  On to Felix, that poor guy. I have been in there AND calling constantly asking questions, having him explain the bill etc.
At this point I just do what Felix says and things work out well. 

 Most importantly for me was the city permits, I wanted to be sure everything was signed off appropriately.
In the past, when I have had work done, almost without fail, the last bit of inspection is overlooked or ignored by whomever is dong the work (very annoying to me). As a result, I have gone into the city permit office to get another permit for something else only to find out the previous one hasn't been signed off and until that happens, I can't get what I need.
This has cost me in a pretty big fine in the past.
Felix not only made sure this was done, he made sure to contact me to tell me this by both phone and email. That was such a relief for me.
Thanks Felix!

reviews.author: Meredith O.
reviews.text:
I have used AT Weber, exclusively, as our home plumber for over 4 years. The dispatcher, Chris, is usually challenging as he is not the most timely in returning calls or scheduling appointments, but the plumbers are friendly, professional, and do really great work. 

I called in a problem with my washing machine leaking on Jan 4 and scheduled an appointment for Monday, Jan 7th. The plumber came out, took a cursory look at my machine, and told me I needed an appliance repair man. He said he could snake the line, but he suspected the problem was with the machine. I was fine with this and reiterated that I would like him to snake the line. I was able to get an appliance repair man out the very next day. Within 5 minutes, he found the problem. The water line was clogged and backing up, causing water to spill down the wall and onto the floor. I was able to get video of this happening.

Later in the afternoon, I got a bill for the visit on Monday. I emailed Chris the video and told him about the issue and and my displeasure that the plumber did not actually do what he said he would do - snake the line, and asked to have someone come out ASAP. Chris was not able to get someone out until Thursday(tomorrow) afternoon. As a family that just returned from a holiday trip and with two small children that go through clothes like there is no tomorrow, going without a washing machine for a week is not okay. I will be taking my laundry to a laundromat and my business elsewhere.

reviews.author: Erast B.
reviews.text:
I work for a service company as a superintendent.

Today Weber Plumbing and Mechanical came in to jet out pipes in a corporate building, guys Mike and his friend were friendly and very cool, there was also a pump truck subcontracted to pump out all water out of the sump pump enclosure with their 3" diameter hose.

Everything went well until Mike made a .25" hole in the supply garden hose, they used this hose to complete the job after trying to repair it, the hose sprayed out around 300 gallons of water onto four floors of the garage, guys then left after completing the job, I asked them to clean out the water on the phone and they responded that they are on their way.

I let the pump truck go and I had a call from Mike and his partner in an hour telling me that their boss (Todd Weber) has asked them to turn around.

I later called Todd and he didn't seem that he wanted to correct the problem, rather he was trying to push the fault to the pump truck company.

I explained to Todd multiple times that the reason for flooding the garage floors was the broken garden hose that his guys used but Todd was looking past that and did not want to cooperate with me.

These guys left me with a complaint from building management and I believe that every customer should stay away from companies that do not take responsibility for their own faults and mistakes.

Thank you - Stay Away!

reviews.author: Cathy W.
reviews.text:
I just had an unfortunate experience with A.T. Weber Plumbing, which we have used for years. We have not run into this issue in the past so things have changed. We needed the outdoor spigots replaced. I sent photos. Plumber comes as planned. He looks and then tells me he needs to go to the shop to get the materials. I say just start work and I'll go to the shop and pick up what you need. He says he can't let me do that. I say I shouldn't be charged travel time - he has no copper pipe and no spigots and I say that's not right - I sent photos. So he calls the shop right there in front of me, and he tells me I won't be charged for travel time. The invoice comes today and at $150 an hour I am charged for travel time. I have some back and forth with Chris the Dispatcher and Chris reduces the bill. I think this is fair. But I got this quote:

"I'll take a half hour off. But for future reference we do charge for when we get materials. That's part of the job."

I call the shop to speak to Chris the Dispatcher and the call just gets defensive so I decided to post this warning about the practice - no standard material on a plumbing truck (like no copper pipe) leads me to believe this is an intentional way to bill more labor time so Consumers Be Aware of this company's practice.

synthesis.summary: A.T. Weber is an established Alameda plumbing company with loyal multi-year customers and genuine expertise on complex jobs like full repiping, sewer lateral replacement, and HVAC installs. But the negative review pattern is specific and recurring: bills higher than quoted, technicians who carry no standard parts (forcing billed travel time to the shop), dispatcher communication issues, and — most seriously — a gas leak caused by a bad water heater installation that nearly harmed a family. The 4.2 Google / 4.4 Yelp ratings split the difference on a genuinely inconsistent company.

Scheduling failures on major paid projects — 'took our deposit in September, it's nearly January with no work started; failed to show twice'

reviews.author: Adrianne Poe

Mr. Pete came right away when I called and said my old water heater broke and water was all over the house after returning home from work one evening. reviews.author: Skylar Farcry
reviews.text: He was supposed to come the day before around 4 p.m. but does not coming until the next day and comes at 7 a.m. in the morning. No call just pops up at my house at 7 in the morning saying "hey I'm here to fix your shower." Would not recommend since they don't have the courtesy to call you to tell you why they're running late or when there coming.

reviews.author: Concerned Coloradan
reviews.text:
This place is a total rip-off. They charge $250 to remove backed up hair from drains, don't actually DO anything (they didn't even bring a snake, nor did I see any hair from the drain), send 2 plumbers (lol, it takes 2 plumbers to unclog a bathroom drain?), and then pretend you have the wrong place when you call to complain because the drain is backed up a week later.

The owner, Pete, doesn't even say the name of the place when he answers the phone. Do not use this "business", they are total quacks just looking to rip you off. Spending 10 minutes vaping on a customer's dime so you can avoid actually unclogging a drain isn't a service. It's a rip-off and this place should be shut down.

reviews.author: Kimberly Chandler

I was only out of service for less than 24 hours only because they had to locate a new unit. Call Pete for all your plumbing needs. A fine company and person.

reviews.author: Josh Williams
reviews.text: We had Pipeworks come out and check our back flow preventer and they told us it was bad and quoted over $900 to replace it. We called Fix It Plumbing for a second opinion Jeff came out did the test on it cleaned the valve and retested it and everything was great. Pipeworks didn’t even offer this as an option. If you hire them and you feel something is off get a second opinion you might save hundreds of dollars on repairs you didn’t need.

reviews.text: Communication is horrible. You call and he answers with a "hello" so you have to ask to make sure it's the company. Leave a voicemail, never responses. reviews.author: Nealie Morgan
reviews.text: Pete's brother, Rob, came out the same day that I called and did such a great job with connecting all the plumbing for our new sink. He was super thorough, even had to go get a piece from the store and came right back to finish. He gave me suggestions on how to keep the drain lines clean and was very personable. Will definitely refer them!

reviews.author: James Rowe
reviews.text: I cannot recommend Pipeworks. Pete never sent me an invoice for work done (a sink connection) and then left me a long voicemail saying he was going to sue me. When I pointed out I was still waiting on an invoice he finally sent one, which I paid. Very unprofessional and I regret using his company. Use another plumber if available.

reviews.author: S. Hon
reviews.text: I agree with Sarah Tyree. This man told me twice he would come gave an estimate. First time I took off from work to meet with him. Called again thinking he might have gotten side tracked. Wife waited all day the second time. Never heard back from him.
