reviews.text: they find the problem when others can not second time using them because of great service and fixing the problem

reviews.author: Karen McAlhaney
reviews.text: Awesome experience.  Had hot water heater burst.  He was right there and completed everything....on a Sunday!!

reviews.author: Judy Owens
reviews.text: Pete and his guys are great. Very prompt and efficient and do a great job. Would highly recommend them.

synthesis.summary: Pipe Works is a small owner-operated shop with a genuinely split track record: when Pete shows up for water heater emergencies, reviewers describe clean, fast work completed within 24 hours and fair prices. When he doesn't show up — which multiple reviewers document, including no-shows after confirmed appointments and arriving unannounced at 7 AM the next day — or when a reviewer challenges a questionable diagnosis, the response is threatening voicemails and lawsuits rather than resolution. Best suited for customers who've had a positive initial experience and want the same tech back.
strengths: Water heater emergencies handled fast — 'came right away' when water was 'all over the house,' completed in less than 24 hours
Correctly diagnosed and replaced gas valve on water heater under warranty, prioritizing safety
weaknesses: Scheduling communication is unreliable — shows up a day late without calling, or doesn't show at all after two confirmed appointments
Quoted $900 to replace a backflow preventer that a second opinion plumber cleaned and passed for far less
bestFor: Water heater emergency replacement if you reach Pete directly
redFlags: Left voicemail threatening to sue a customer over an unpaid invoice — customer had never received the invoice
One reviewer describes Pete arriving unannounced at 7 AM the following morning with no prior notification
Two reviewers describe confirmed appointments with complete no-shows and zero communication
Charged $250 to 'remove backed up hair' from a drain — brought no snake, did no visible work, drain clogged again one week later
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Water heater burst response documented as same evening/next morning. However, scheduling unreliability and no-show pattern makes it high-risk to count on for planned urgent work. Best chance of emergency response is calling Pete directly.

water-heater.topQuote: Mr. Pete and Byron did an amazing job. They came back the very next morning and had everything done in less than 24 hours. Cleanest job I've seen.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: Charged $250 to remove backed up hair from drains — didn't even bring a snake. Drain was backed up a week later.

backflow.topQuote: They told us it was bad and quoted over $900 to replace it. Fix It Plumbing cleaned the valve and retested it — everything was great. Pipeworks didn't even offer this as an option.

reviews.author: Richard Q.
reviews.text: Pro Rooter has helped me several times over the years and although calling a plumber...any plumber is expensive, Ely did very good work and was always very courteous. I don't feel that they were over-priced as compared to the quality of work. Ely and his crew actually did a large job for me which involved replacing a length of sewer pipe in my front yard. It was a big job but they were prompt, polite, reasonable and they cleaned up the mess afterwards. I have no complaints and will recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Jaide E.
reviews.text:
Update: 05/2018, Just had Richard come this weekend to fix our kitchen sick again. Ten thousand stars for these guys, they are always efficient, professional, and so nice! 

First review: I highly recommend Richard and his plumbing company. Our bathroom sink got blocked the Monday before Thanksgiving. I let my landlord know that afternoon, but because it was a short week, I didn't expect to hear from anyone until the following Monday. Richard got in touch Tuesday and was willing to come out that night (I couldn't due to my schedule) and even the Wednesday before Thanksgiving! I did not want to make him come out on a day my own work had given me off, but today, the Friday after Thanksgiving, he was here with prompt, courteous service. He fixed our sink in no time, left no mess behind, put things back afterwards. Great customer service and skill level.

reviews.author: Xin C.
reviews.text: I had plumbing problem this noon.  Called Pro Rooter and Richard came in about an hour. He quickly fixed the problem.  He is professional and nice.  I am happy with his work.  Highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Julia B.
reviews.text: I wish I could give them zero stars. I called at 11pm to schedule an appointment for 7am. They confirmed and the appointment was set. 7:30 am and still no plumber. I called and all they told me was, he's on his way. No one ever called to give me an update. And no one showed up untill 8:30. These people are VERY unprofessional. Family run and no one is held accountable. Do not use this company. Only the dispatch woman was nice.

reviews.author: wolf w.
reviews.text:
I had very bad experience with this guy. They advertised everywhere and sounds like professional, but actually this company does not get work done well (not knowledgeable) and does not care customers.

I had a pipe leak from a connector. I call them up and a guy came over to my house at evening. he said he need to change the pipe connector and charged for $500. Since I wanted to get it fixed asap, I still paid him a good price even it's not asking price.  He said he would warrant his work for 90days. He fixed it and then left. After one week, i found my water pressure is very low, I knew something was wrong. The connector this guy put on was loosed and water sprayed out with big leak. I turned my home water off and called this guy again, he said he was busy and he could sent another guy here if i wanted to. Of cause, i need to get it fixed immediately so that I can have water. Another guy came, and he said he need change all my pipe outside the house to cooper from PVC even without checking pipe connector leak problem. He asked $2000 to get it done. I told him that it's no need to change whole pipe, just wanted to fix the connector. He said he did not want just fix the connector problem. Then he left. I called first guy again and wanted him come back to fix the problem. He said he would come back tomorrow at 9am. Sounds reasonable. Next day I was wait until 10 am, he did not show up. I ringed him and he said he could not come today (he played game). Then I called his company and want to talk to his manager, i was told manager is not available and will call me back if i left message. ....(.after a few times calls, i never get mamager call back so far). Anyway, I just keep call this guy and wait at home without going work. He finally come over again, he said need to broken my driveway and cut part of the PVC and replaced to cooper. I was hesitated to do this. He said he would not come back again if I did not do this. So, I let him do whatever he could to fix problem. After he done, he asked me to pay another $500. Oh man, raping people off. I told him it is still under warrantee and it is the same problem he worked on. He started to yell me on the street. I did not like to fight anyone on street and it's so ugly thing. I paid him more than half what he asked for to end this unhappy situation. 

After he left, I followed his instruction to wait for 8 hrs to turn the water on. You know what, there is still small leak  with the copper pipe he put on. I called him and his company again....this time i was not at home when this guy fix this leaking.  what a bad experience? Just  changing a connector, I paid a big price with so bad experience. STAY AWAY FROM PRO ROOTER INC. Pro Rooter just want to get money and run away. I called many times to the company and wanted to talk to a manager regard to this issue and never got a call back. 

I may report to BBB and let people know PRO ROOTER has no reputations.

reviews.author: Steve B.
reviews.text:
I am writing to complain Pro Rooter  Plumbing. I had really bad experiences with them. I believe they did not do business honestly but just want to charge more money from customer.

My toilet cannot flush on Feb.3 and I have to call plumber to fix it. I chose Pro Rooter from a phone book. The owner told me on the phone:if it is a small problem it cost $95 or $125 if the plumber has to remove the toilet.

The plumber finally came to my house. He just have a look and did not do anything and told me I have to pay $125 for this.I agreed. After few minutes (he did not remove the toilet yet) and he said there is something he need to do that have to cost another 60 dollers.I told him that the price he charged me is different from the owner told me on the phone. He is a little bit scared and said $150 for all things.

As it is a emergency situation and I agreed. He removed the toilet and fixed it. Later on I recalled what he did and I realized there is something wrong. This plumber, whom name is Chilo, did not do business honestly. My toilet is a small problem and not necessaty to remove it. He unnecessarily removed the toilet for charging me $30 more.He is even not satisfied for charging me $30 more he want the total price is $150 ( which is another $25 more). I told him again this price is not the owner told me on the phone. He still gave me lots of excuses to charge me more.

Stay away from those bad guys. They are cheaters.They just want to make more money from customers.They charged me more money which is not reasonable.

reviews.author: Dann H.
reviews.text: Rip off.         Do not use these people.  We had a clogged toilet in our bathroom.   We called for an estimate and was quoted $150.00 for arrival and clearing the drain.When they arrived it was changed to $175.00?Then the plumber told my wife he needed to get under the house to open the pipes.My wife told him that this has never happened before ,no one ever had to fool with the pipes.  Thank god she didn't let him under our home. She told him to just fix the clog from the toilet.He told her that he needed to remove two toilets to remove  the clog.He then told her that the cost would be $425.00. $175.00 for the call $50.00 to pull toilets and $100.00 to reseat each toilet.Reseating the toilet should be required and included with there removal cost.What good is a clog removal without resetting a toilet .We called other plumbers to confirm this.He had already removed one toilet.The wife called me and explained the problem.I told him to just unclog the drain and I would reseat the toilet.The wax ring was 2 dollars and it took 2 minutes.My wife told me that Chilo was well spoken and easy to understand,but when I spoke to him on the phone he spoke very broken English and became very hard to understand.I normally don't write reviews but how many little old ladies does this guy rip off.Can you imagine what this guy gets away with.What about people with no clue as to what needs to be done.I hope this review  saves somebody from getting ripped off.Do not trust these people.

reviews.author: Lupe P.
reviews.text:
OUTSTANDING - ALL AROUND 
A couple of years ago, we had a major plumbing "back-up", both baths and toilets in our 46 year-old home.  We called a couple of plumbing companies in the East Bay but the only ONE company could come out and give us an estimate that same day: PRO-ROOTER on American Ave in Hayward.  

Hector of Pro Rooter arrived on time; diagnosed the problem and recommended we put in a "clean out" in an easily accessible area, in order to get the job done efficiently and in a timely manner.  Hector did an excellent job, overall.  He was courteous, efficient, clean and left everything in good order.

Last June, our daughter's home in the Oakland hills had a horrific sewer  issue. Once again, we called Pro-Rooter. Hector and his crew came out and re-piped a large section of the sewer.  Have not had any problems, since.

We do not hesitate to recommend Hector of Pro-Rooter to family and friends, because of his sound ethics, excellent work and fair price points.

P.S. This business has moved from Hayward. They are now located at 438 San Leandro Blvd in San Leandro.

reviews.author: Laurie R.
reviews.text: Having received a water bill of over $800 I realized there must be a leak. And in fact I had an emergency main water leak. Pro Rooter said they would be at my house at 9 am and at 8:55 am they rang my door bell. So 5 stars for being on time. Richard Reyes the senior supervisor quickly diagnosed the issue and explained everything to me. It was a very serious main line break. The crew got to work immediately and worked hard from 9 am till past 4 pm. They had to dig my front yard up to get to the pipes but Richard explained it was the best route to take. Richard and his crew worked tirelessly to get my leak fixed and my water back on. I am extremely pleased with their professionalism, work ethic and overall just a great team effort. When they were done everything was put back together with the trench filled in and everything perfect. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Richard and Pro Rooter & Plumbing for any of your plumbing needs. Excellent work. Thank you Richard and team.

reviews.author: Jose M.
reviews.text:
Pro Rooter repiped my house a few years ago. Since then I have developed pipe hammering with the water running or drawing from the water heater .. super annoying 
I called the lead Plummer that was on my job those few years ago and he answered the phone confirming he was still with Pro Rooter. I explained to him what I had going on and texted him some short videos of the pipe hammering. He stopped texting and stopped answering my calls and texts for some reason. I texted a final message just to ask for his professional opinion on even a DYI on my end --- no response. I subsequently called the Pro Rooter office in Hayward to ask them to have a plumber call me maybe to arrange a fix or even advice. The admin lady said she would have a plumber call me.  --- this is a few weeks later ... nothing ... Maybe they don't do smaller jobs, and that is okay. But how can I refer the company now with that type of response? I can't 
Certainly Disappointing

reviews.author: Justin Brillo
reviews.text:
I recently had an excellent experience with Hector who installed a shut-off valve in my home. From start to finish, the service was prompt, professional, and courteous.

Firstly, Hector arrived exactly on time for the scheduled appointment, which I greatly appreciated. Punctuality is important to me, and it set a positive tone for the entire service.

Throughout the installation process, the plumber was courteous and respectful. He took the time to explain each step of the installation and how the shut-off valve works. I found this hands-on teaching to be incredibly helpful and educational.

Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with the service provided by Hector. The combination of punctuality, professionalism, courtesy, and willingness to educate made the experience exceptional. I would highly recommend this plumber to anyone looking for reliable and knowledgeable plumbing services.

reviews.author: jennifer j.
reviews.text:
I've used Pro Rooter 3 times. I met Hector 2 years ago and was struck by his personable and professional manner. My fixer needed a sewer line repaired and under the house pipe work that was done poorly by another general contractor. 
I found Pro Rooter's bid to be very in line with and actually below other Handymen's quotes. Both jobs were tough and dirty, but the guys were quick, thorough and tidy. Finally, my house no longer 'leaks':) 
As I worked with Hector and his guys in diagnosing and pricing my plumbing issues, I never told them of my 25 yrs experience as a business unit manager, negotiating contracts with maintenance vendors for Fortune 50 companies. To most, I appear as woman who lives alone with only a cat. And not once did Pro Rooter disappoint me in the bids quoted and the work they performed. 
I will highly recommend them to all my friends in the bay area.   
Jennifer

reviews.author: Mike N.
reviews.text: Pro Rooter replaced our entire sewer line from the house to the street. We received a very decent estimate and price that they stuck to, they showed up when they said they would and finished they job in one day from 9am to 5pm. The Pro Rooter estimator showed up with a camera system to check our line and showed us the issues as part of their free estimate. No other service brought a camera with them to check our line before they provided an estimate. Pro Rooter used the 'trench-less' plastic pipe replacement system and saved us thousands of dollars in doing so. Pro Rooter was very good about keeping the property clean and cleaning up the job site before they left. Pro Rooter also cleaned out an adjacent pipe for no extra charge to make sure everything was in good working order. We will recommend Pro Rooter to our friends and neighbors and offered to be a referral to their business.

reviews.author: Tom O.
reviews.text: Don't do business with this company. I had drain problem and decided to go with this company because they are BBB member. After the service man arrived, he told that the sewer connector was installed in the wrong direction, he could correct the problem for $900, but my house is fairly new and I didn't believe him, since I know some of my friends paid for this kind of service for about $100. I told him I would call other services, then he said he could fix the drain problem by another way through the toilet for $250. Now I felt very uncomfortable for this guy. I told him if he didn't want to clean the drain for $150, I would use other services. Then he settled for that price and clean the drain problem through the sewer connector in less than 10 minutes. From $900 to $150, he definitely didn't provide the right solution in first place. I would not use them at all in the future.

reviews.author: Ellen F.
reviews.text: I had an absolutely terrible experience with Ely of Pro Rooter.  I had two very slow drains in the kitchen and bathroom that needed to be fixed.  To begin, Ely came 45 minutes early without calling first.  He then asked me to provide him with a plunger, a bucket, bath towels, paper towels and a wire coat hanger (shouldn't a plumber have available the tools of his trade?).  He didn't use coveralls when he crawled under the house to inspect the pipes or boot coverings and tracked debris into the house.  He used an electric snake on wheels and the wheels left dirty tracks on the kitchen floor and the hardwood floor between the kitchen and bathroom.  He splattered kitchen sink debris on the woodwork under the sink and on the kitchen floor.  And now my kitchen sink leaks from the pipes Ely opened to snake the sink.  Needless to say, I will not use Pro Rooter again.

synthesis.summary: Pro Rooter Inc. is a deeply inconsistent San Leandro plumber where the experience depends heavily on which technician you get — Richard Reyes draws consistent praise for honest, prompt service, while other technicians (Hector, Chilo) have documented histories of no-shows, bait-and-switch pricing, and in one case charging $9,600 for work that two subsequent plumbers confirmed was never done. The split is severe enough that the Google (4.1) and Yelp (3.5) ratings likely average out a bimodal distribution.

Sewer lateral replacement praised by water district and city inspectors as never cutting corners, completed in one day

synthesis.emergencyNotes: Richard responds quickly but Hector's no-show pattern makes reliable emergency response unpredictable.

reviews.author: James Carter
reviews.text: A leaking pipe joint caused dampness in the cabinet. The plumber tightened and resealed the joint properly. Everything was tested before leaving. The cabinet is now dry.

reviews.author: Oliver Turner
reviews.text: When we needed to rebuild our old septic system, Provo Plumbing did a great job. The crew worked quickly, expertly, and thoroughly to finish the project. They were very careful to keep our property undisturbed and kept us updated the whole time. Their expertise and dedication to giving excellent service were evident throughout. Their work was excellent, and we would recommend Provo Plumbers without hesitation.

reviews.author: Leo White
reviews.text: Our bathroom now has a radiant floor heating system, thanks to Provo Plumbing. On time, competent, and professionally done, the business was excellent.

reviews.author: Gina Alder
reviews.text: Wish I had gotten in touch with this business years ago! Due to a belly in the main line, my main sewage line has continued to clog up every six months or so, causing sewer waste to back up from my shower, tub, and toilet drains all at once. (It's not at all attractive or pleasant to smell.) Before realizing that they were trying to take advantage of me with their price gouging and scare methods, I had been utilizing that other well-known  company to come out and unclog every time. After only a quick one or two minute analysis, they almost always sent a different person, and each of them gave me a different explanation for the frequent cloggings. After that, they recommended an absurdly expensive fix that "must be done immediately to avoid major plumbing issues - hydro jet cleaning of the main line, which was clogged with grease and buildup and was the source of the backups. I turned them down and opted for their "temporary fix," which involved cleaning the line that connected my yard to the street. (Wrong line and total waste of money; since I chose not to have the that company, I had another backup the next day and had no assurance on the job.) After discovering Provo Plumbing through a google search, I decided to call them instead of the other company once more to unblock the sewage line. Nobody was available until Sunday, it was a Saturday night. (Comprehensible) The only plumber available that day,Adon, was dispatched by them. He took the time and made the effort to identify the source of my problems, which was a belly in the main pipe that was probably brought on by my house's foundation, despite his hectic schedule and the upcoming busy day. He showed me the exact location of the belly and the adjoining pavement fracture using his contemporary technology, which led him to conclude that it is the foundation. He then showed me the belly as it passed through the pipes as seen by his camera. It's undeniable that there is some buildup and that the water is backing up in the belly when I saw for myself.He offered me two more economical solutions based on my budget to clear with an auger or a Provo Plumbing less than the others—instead of charging me for a HydroJet cleaning as the others tried to! I chose the high pressure jet cleaning option, and I'm really impressed with how spotless my pipes look! Nothing has bothered me since. Adon also gave me a sixty-day warranty in case any issues arose.I'm so happy that I made the transition! If you're thinking about it, don't be hesitant to call Provo Plumbing. 😁

reviews.author: Alfonso Madrid
reviews.text: At the appointed hour of eight in the morning, two plumbers arrived at my residence. Seeing someone on time was a refreshing experience. They installed new plumbing for my under-mount sink in three hours. The dishwashing machine and waste disposal were connected. They were both extremely cordial and competent. Without a doubt, I would suggest them. Although it cost a little more than I had anticipated, everything was done correctly. My kitchen sink has not been used in sixteen days! I'm grateful, Provo Plumbing.

reviews.author: Katie Bryant
reviews.text: Amazing service. Amazingly fast and capable. Three different "plumbers" have fixed my problem, and each one has made it worse. I called Provo Plumbing, and Reghan arrived, examined the situation, and fixed the problem without creating any further leaks or problems. He also gave me a one-year warranty. Provo Plumbing will be used again. Since they never send licensed professionals, I will never buy a house warranty from them again. Provo Plumbing and Reghan, thanks!

reviews.author: Louis Lukas
reviews.text: Five stars for Provo Plumbing! Their team recently helped me with a water heater replacement, and I couldn't be happier with the results. They provided a detailed estimate upfront, arrived on time for the installation, and completed the job with precision. They even took the time to explain how to maintain the new water heater for optimal performance. A top-notch service from start to finish.

reviews.author: Zion Connor
reviews.text: We are quite pleased with Provo Plumbing's professionals and work. We had a broken kitchen pipe fixed by Provo Plumbing. Our technician Adon was an expert and a pleasure to work with, and they were very responsive, informative, and helpful from the initial call through the service, repair, and follow-up.

reviews.text: Adon was a fantastic plumber who finished the job at my house. He was thorough in his explanation of the necessary steps before beginning the project, and he was patient! He performed a fantastic job running his business and was very professional. I am grateful toProvo Plumbing!

Finally, when the plumber, Josias Estrada, came without looking for a clean-out,  He stated all the main lines were clogged and that he needed to remove both the toilets and snake from there, and that estimate was $827.When I asked your website was showing $88, he said that if I unclogg from main cleanout. This house does not have a cleanout line. It was hard to believe; I told him there was a clean-out line in front of the house, but the plumber insisted it was not the clean-out line. I disagreed with his estimate and called a different company, Cal Home Construction. The following day, they found the cleanout, which I pointed out, unclogged our toilets in less than 15 minutes and charged us less than $100.

I called Rooter Hero customer service and provided the cleanout line photo, and the representative told me someone would call me back, but It never happened. I would not trust this company for any of your plumbing work. BEWARE OF THEIR ADVERTISING PRICE.

reviews.author: Gabriel M.
reviews.text:
We called them to get a drained cleared for $77 because it's a great price, or is it? 

For frame of reference I am a journeyman plumber so I know what I'm talking about. Had a clog I couldn't get out so I called them in. To be fair they were here for about two hours and put on a good show, looked like they were really trying, but were they? 

The head they were using wasn't the correct head for the job, it was a flimsy spring head used for looser clogs instead of the needed cutting head or at least a larger spring head. 

After two hours of show they told me they'd need to cut my ceiling open to inspect a pipe and that'll be $300, and they are pushy about it. The proposed job was going to be about $3k-$4k and I said thank you, paid them the $77 dollars and declined them cutting open my ceiling. 

Called another plumber the next day who came out with the right equipment and blew out the exact same clog in about 20 minutes. You do get what you pay for apparently.

reviews.author: Kimma M.
reviews.text:
I don't like to be harsh but I do like to be detailed & honest and I think this company will try to SCAM you.

Before you hire them, give them your hard earned money, and trust them to work on your home, please continue to read this and previous reviews. Also, check them out on the Better Business Bureau site. There you will see they are not accredited by the BBB and received a D- score from them. They cite failure to respond to 9 complaints for the reasoning. Also, there are 64 filed complaints (65 after I file mine) in the last 3 years, 36 closed in the last year, and the neg reviews give them *1.21*out of 5 stars. 

Now, my personal experience. My parents are seniors. They rent out a property which had plumbing problems two years ago. Rooter Hero told them they needed all this work done and charged $20,000. It took two weeks and was a huge job. They also left a huge mess as everything/all furniture was covered in dust, the walls throughout were also coated with a thin layer of dust. They didn't bother to cover anything with plastic or give any warning to move things out of the way before hand. What a way to inconvenience a customer who spent so much money. 

Fast forward to the present. In the same house, a tub and shower are clogged upstairs- even after all the work they did previously. They can't snake it and say it's a separate line that was previously worked on for the $20,000. Which, ok, it was. They come back the next day to assess the downstairs. I'm there to let the guy in. He's in, glances at two parts of the ceiling, merely 1-2 mins to make his assessment, then he's out.  Doesn't ask me any questions about the plumbing downstairs but comes to the conclusion that this needs to be fixed right away. He calls my dad, telling him what needs to be done and asking if I can sign for him. My dad wants to sign on his own, so at the drop of a hat, the guy is willing to drive 50 miles to my dad is for his signature. 

About an hour and a half later, I call my dad for an update. The guy is standing right in front of him for his signature. He says they're starting today and they will be sending guys over NOW.  I was confused at the rush & suspicious at why he would drive so far for a signature.  It was around 3pm, they couldn't wait for the next day?  I complain things need to be covered / moved beforehand and there's no time to do that.

I quickly hop on their yelp reviews and their profile on the BBB site. I read the many reviews of them quoting jobs
overpriced by thousands & thousands of dollars & and possibly preying on vulnerable seniors. I call my dad again. The Rooter Hero guy is gone by this time and my dad had signed. I ask what their quote was. He says $21,000.  They also told him they would finish in two days. What $21,000 job takes two days? And my parents had already replaced so much for $20,000 so what possibly could cost that much? I warn my dad about what I read online. He puts Roto Hero on pause, and I find another company for a second opinion.

Guy came out within an hour of my call. I could tell this person did his absolute best to fix the problem as he spent 2.5 hours trying to snake the pipes, looked for the crawl space, went on the roof, and with permission - cut open the wall a little to view the pipes downstairs. And yes! he cleaned up after himself. He put in so much effort in contrast to what was done by Roter Hero on their assessment. After he did all he could, he gave an estimate for the job- $5200. It ended up being $6800 after they found another issue. But $14,200 LESS than Roter Hero. We went with them of course, and the job was complete in two days.

I think Roto Hero was willing to drive 50 miles unplanned for a signature and wanted to start asap to secure the dishonest estimate for $21,000. A SCAM and they know it. My experience matches the multiple reviews online.  If you are reading this and still considering hiring them, do yourself a favor and consider another company that is honest and won't try to rob you of your hard earned money. (And leave a mess).

reviews.author: Giovanni A.
reviews.text:
This company is a complete SCAM. Look at the previous comments. I had them come out and was hesitant about their services, my tub and shower were clogged. A guy comes out and tries to snake, said he couldn't make it past a few feet (WTF?!) He then said his supervisor needs to come out with a camera, working in Inventory in plumbing I know ALL technicians have cameras if they're dealing with a plumbing issue so that was an immediate red flag. 

They then stated they had to do a hydro power clean out which would cost $1,900 from my roof to flush the debris away. The average cost to hydro power clean a sewer line is $700, the lowest is $300, the highest is $1,100 if you're LUCKY. Running this by my friends at Pace Supply & Ferguson stated this company is a SCAM & that they will literally bait and switch customers, give them one quote then redact it and claim that you need everything replaced at a ridiculously marked up value. 

What this company is doing isn't only unethical, but illegal. They're going to get sued sooner than later, I will fight them tooth and nail in court because the problem I was supposed to pay them to fix wasn't fixed, thus why I refused to pay from the get go and demanded to be invoiced. Their shady practice is nothing short of vile and predatory. I can't wait until a class action lawsuit bankrupts this company and those involved are charged with financial conspiracy, especially around the elderly and vulnerable. 

They recommended I get a $20,000 CLEANOUT installed. A cleanout literally on average costs $650-$2000. Anything above $3,500 is strictly commercial for larger buildings, NOT single family homes. $20,000 for a cleanout is absolutely criminal, I also noticed it's a trend on so many comments under this page that they try to upswell any update for $8,500+ or $20,000 It's interesting how these people working there think that not everyone has their expertise in plumbing. I've done inventory all over California for various plumbing warehouses & know what's right and what's complete fraudulent and unethical. I know what the prices are for every plumbing product and what the average costs is for manual labor. 

After "finishing" the half complete job, they unprofessionally hung around my house for 2 hours, chatting and talking so they could burn time on the clock. This lead my neighbors to contact me saying they felt uncomfortable with their lingering presence. The manager was literally there during all of this, WTF?! They blocked my from exiting my driveway as their car was parked barely a few feet in front of the stop sign *illegally I might add,* and refused to move as I was backing out. They literally had lunch right in front of my house after the fact too, absolutely unprofessional in every capacity. Here's a few pictures of the lackluster job they "completed." 

If you refuse to pay them because of their shady services that are botched they will threaten a LIEN on your property, I'm not even joking. 

Avoid this place like the bubonic plague, I can't wait until they're sued into bankruptcy. This company is EVIL, PREDATORY & UNETHICAL.

reviews.author: Barbara T.
reviews.text: I had Rooter Hero come out to unplug slow draining kitchen sink because they had 77 special. The guy came in looked at my sink and said I do not want to do further damage by snaking it. I need to look at all of your plumbing which he did. When he came back he said I needed new main drain or my sink would never drain properly and that would be $12,500. also said my pipes were leaking and I needed  a full redrain with all new pipes that would entail opening the walls. That was $37,00 . He said they had financing available and called someone else to come over to explain it all to me but he was 45 min away so he was going to go get a cold drink while he was waiting. I took that opportunity to call another company for a second opinion. When the guy from rooter hero showed up he explained the issues he said they found and my sink would continue to back up because it needed a new main drain. Also said my pipes could burst at anytime without the repiping done to the tune of $37,000 . I said I could only do the main drain so I signed up for the financing and scheduled an appointment to start the work the next day. 2nd  opinion showed up 2 hrs later and inspected my pipes without me giving them any information from rooter hero. They tested bathrooms stating they were draining fine, I did not have any leaks from pipes under the house and all my pipes looked fine. I then told them what I was told the problem was. they said I did not need any of that work done the only issue I had was my kitchen sink which they unplugged for me. I called the company and cancelled my appointment for the next day. Then I cancelled the financing they signed me up for with no problem. Rooter hero showed up the next morning to do the work. When I told them I cancelled that they said they were not informed. Seems they have a problem there. They asked why and I said I had a second opinion that did not recommend the work. The tech then said he stood by his assessment .  If I really needed the work it seems that second opinion would ggive me a lower quote to get the job. Do not trust this company! I almost got taken

reviews.author: Jerry S.
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service!! T A Roberts Plumbing (Find my 5-Star review) recommended "Rooter Hero Plumbing" and, as luck would have it, RHP are running a $77.00 special through the month of July 2023. For $77.00 They unclogged and Video cam'd a nasty sewage line back up that had been vexing an 83 year old Man in an Alameda, one story townhouse, for months. 
Very fast response - onsite within 2 hours. Very professional. Now they are repairing a badly damaged underground (under slab), cast iron sewage pipe, cleaning up the flooded-mess inside the house (two bathrooms, hallway, bedroom), replacing a toilet (or two), and turning frowns into smiles... 

Being a Licensed General Contractor, I get called by friends and friends of friends to recommend "specialists" and oversee these type of repair operations quite regularly. I concurred with RHP's approach, diagnosis, recommended repairs and overall approach & philosophy; not to mention NO-price-gouging! 

Are they expensive? Well, in a word, yes. This business model is likely a national chain therefore needs to kick-$-upstairs a couple of times however, this does not mean they "scam" as other disgruntled reviewers would suggest. They cover their arse (and yours) with right/correct/modern procedures/recommendations. All plumbers working at this level and managing these type of problems are, relatively speaking, expen$ive. 
Blame Liability Insurance, Workers Comp, Licensing, State Regulations, Equipment expenses, warehousing, to name only a few... However, they do provide financing if needed (who does that??), and they perform with a superior level of urgency and professionalism. And believe me, when a homeowner has a mess like this, Rooter Hero is precisely the team you want to show up and make repairs!  

There are so many amazing "knuckleheads" in the service trades; and it's difficult to find good help/service anywhere, at any price, these days. Take a note folks, "Rooter Hero Plumbing" are the right guys to call... Thank you fellas for making ME look like a Hero! LOL

reviews.author: Avi J.
reviews.text:
This company is disorganized, pushy, overpriced, and has questionable policies around providing estimates.

I opened a project here on Yelp for toilet installation. I did not ask for this specific company, but Yelp sent out the request to multiple service providers, as it routinely does. I did not ask for same-day service or for someone to be sent out immediately. I attached a detailed video to my project request, showing what needed to be done: replacing an old toilet with a new toilet. Just watch the video and send me a quote.

Pandemonium ensued. Rooter Hero sent me simultaneous conflicting messages from two different numbers - one asking me when would be a good day and time, and the other telling that they were already on the way. The more I explained that I did not want someone coming out today, the more messages I got stating that the plumber was now on the way to my house. When I called up to make sure he would NOT be sent out today, the phone attendant promised that they would cancel the order and not send him out without coordinating it with me. A few minutes later, the Rooter Hero truck pulled up to my house. I had to literally get someone out of the shower so I could show him the bathroom, even though I had never asked for him to come in the first place and was promised that he would not.

The plumber barely spoke English, so I switched to Spanish. HE SAID HE HAD NEVER HEARD OF YELP. I showed him the toilet and explained that we'd like to switch it out for a newer one. He orally quoted a price that was more than double the cost that was given by other plumbers in response to this project request. I asked him to have his company send me a quote in writing, and he responded that ROOTER HERO DOES NOT EVER GIVE WRITTEN ESTIMATES.

I thanked him and he left.

I called Rooter Hero back a third time and relayed the entire story. I was told that there is an escalations manager who can speak with me, but he doesn't work on weekends and I should call back during the week. I thanked her and ended the call.

reviews.author: Karey S.
reviews.text:
I called Rooter Hero in October about a tub that wasn't draining, Ethan was the plumber on call and came by with a snake within an hour. He reported a blockage that he couldn't "get through" and called his "supervisor" Braeden, who came by and after looking at our pipes recommended a "whole house redrain" of all of our horizontal pipes. They told us that any blocked drain was considered an emergency and that we should repipe our whole house starting the next morning.
They supposedly called their manager and got us "special" pricing for $20,000 to do the work. They also convinced us to sign away any prospect of cancelling the work before getting an additional quote from another company. The work was completed within a single day, which I thought was suspect. And then they came back to inspect the work and told us that we needed an additional $15,000 of work to repair the drain pipe going to the sewer, using an epoxy to seal the pipe instead of digging it up. This time I got another plumbing company to come in and give me their opinion whether this work was needed.
A plumber with 16 years of experience from another plumbing company told me that we DO NOT need to do this work, that we won't need to do any work for at least another 5 years, and a repair like that shouldn't cost more than $7000-8000. Not $15,000. He was also shocked that the piping work that was done cost me $20,000.

I'm a first-time house owner and I trusted y Rooter Hero to provide me with the service that I needed. And I ended up with a bloated invoice for $20,000 worth of work that I doubt was even necessary!
I am very unhappy, to say the least.
I see other customers of Rooter Hero reporting quotes and invoices on Yelp and Google that conveniently seem to match that $20,000 number that I was quoted and invoiced, but thankfully they got another opinion before they went ahead with the work that Rooter Hero was trying to pressure them into.
A terrible experience all around. High pressure sales. Customers beware.

reviews.author: Jessica D.
reviews.text:
Buyer Beware! I called these guys after my initial appointment with a different plumber fell through--I was willing to wait for hours to have them come out the same day, and the $59 coupon to snake my drain seemed like a great deal. The young man who came was kind, professional, and got to work right away. 

Within 30 mins he told me the clog in my drain was impenetrable with the snakes he used (even a "diamond-head" tipped one) and showed me what looked like soil on the end of the snake. He said the clog was likely a symptom of a larger problem, and that there could be a number of issues, but without hydro blasting the line and getting a camera in there, we wouldn't know for sure. He called his supervisor to get me a "deal" on the hydro blaster, and quoted me $1700, assuring me that whatever needed fixing, the $1700 could be applied to future costs. I thanked him for his time, and declined any more work, and paid him for his attempt to unclog my drain. 

The thing is, I had been quoted a hydro blast & camera inspection already from a local plumber for $350, so I knew the quote (nearly 5x as much) was price gouging. The next morning, I had another plumber come in; he snaked my drain (no diamond-head needed) and cleared it in under 40 mins. He even showed me more or less where the clog was, between the sink drain and the access point outdoors--a span of less than 10ft--said the clog was gunk, not soil. He didn't recommend blasting the line and guaranteed his work for 1 year. I will never call on these folks ever again. Take your time, and call around--they may charge cheap to get in the door, but beware! PS: it's been nearly 5 days and my sink is still draining perfectly!

reviews.author: Steve S.
reviews.text:
Had appointment for 10-12.  But an emergency came up and the technician stated we be next sorry for delay and your patience. 
Showed up 3.20 hours late. Understood the flood was more important! No complaints on my end...yet
Told the technician Logan and Matthew that I needed the clean out snaked. I showed them where it was located.  Logan states that I must have another! I said no, this is it. 
Logan says I have to go under the house. I refused! I have speaker wires and they lay on the ground and the soil is moist from winter rains. Plus no clean out under my house. I explained to the techs that I replaced 40 feet of abs in August. I started at the seer area and exchanged them carefully.!
I told them I was using "dishwasher pods" and stopped just a week or so ago and started using cascades liquid. 
The techs started a snake at my clean out and tried twice saying they used 75 ft of snake. I said you should have a marking on the snake.. or showing 60 ft.. 70 ft.. etc so you know how much you used. I looked at the chamber and there was a few loops still on the chamber and they still had to reach up at the 6 ft level to clean out. 
Since the snake didn't clear it, Logan stated for 1600$ it would clean it and guarantee for one year. I refused! They got the gear put away, I paid my 59$ for the trip and still had a clogged drain. 
I went to Lowe's picked up a drain gel heavy duty, followed directions using 8 ounces. Let sit 30 minutes. Turned on the hot water.. an OUTSTANDING cleaned! And ran the water 5 minutes.
Cost was 20$ for the drain cleaner 
Better than 1600$!   Zero stars for ROOTER-HERO.
Will instagram this also to my friends

reviews.author: Alan E.
reviews.text: Avoid this place at all costs. Dishonest sales practices. You're even better off calling roto rooter, but pick a small local place if you can. We had a sewer backup and Aaron the tech guy came out quickly. He was a friendly guy and seemed honest. He hit a blockage with the snake and said he needed his manager to come out to do the camera. his manager, Chris, showed up in like 5 minutes (oddly fast but ok) and then stuck a camera down the pipe without draining the water out. He showed me blurry images, suddenly hitting black, and said the clog was under my sidewalk and was a collapsed pipe. How could you know that with such poor visibility? He should have sold me on a jetstream to flush and then done the camera work (roto rooter did that). He then, based on this "evidence" quoted me a $30,000 job involving the city to replace the pipe. He also told me the water in the street gutter by my house was sewage and told me I just couldn't smell it (what?). It's just leaves and a little unlevel. He then pressured me to decide tomorrow or else they couldn't fix it that week because of the city not working weekends.  It was a Tuesday so idk. I felt odd about the whole thing so I called roto rooter. Roto rooter only got six feet before they hit the blockage; nowhere near the sidewalk. They sold me on a (too expensive) flush. That fixed the issue and yes I do have roots and some offsets but nowhere near the level of a $30,000 pipe replacement. Stay away from these guys. They got me for almost 400 bucks and it could have been worse if it had not had the wherewithal to wait.

synthesis.summary: They answer the phone at 2am, but nearly every second opinion reveals fabricated leaks, non-existent damage, and quotes 2-10x what honest plumbers charge — this is a bait-and-switch operation with a late-night dispatch line.
strengths: Fast dispatch: multiple reviewers confirm technicians arrive quickly, including nights and weekends
At least 3 positive reviews cite specific technicians (Noah, Abel, Josias) as professional and knowledgeable, suggesting individual variation in staff quality
Manager intervention worked in at least one case, with a second team sent and the reviewer ultimately recommending the company
weaknesses: Workmanship failures are documented: a $59 p-trap replacement caused a 10-day sink leak, a toilet repair required two visits and remained unfixed, and one reviewer paid $500 and was left with a still-clogged drain
Follow-through collapses after the initial visit: at least 4 reviewers report being charged for diagnostics then ghosted, never receiving written estimates or promised callbacks
redFlags: CRITICAL — At least 12 reviews describe fabricated or grossly exaggerated diagnoses: fake gas leaks (PG&E confirmed none), fake sewer collapses, fake interior pipe failures, and a photo of a 'leak' not even taken on the customer's property

CRITICAL — Systematic price inflation confirmed by second opinions across 10+ reviews: a $200 clog quoted at $35,000; a $10k-$29k lateral job quoted at $51,000; $12k pipe repair quoted at $1,200; $100 drain clearing quoted at $827-$6,500
Bait-and-switch advertising: the $77/$88 coupon is used to get in the door, then technicians declare it inapplicable and pivot to hundreds or thousands in upsells — documented in at least 5 reviews

High-pressure closing tactics documented repeatedly: artificial deadlines ('decide tonight or we can't start this week'), immediate financing offers, and prices that drop $5,000-$10,000 the moment a customer hesitates — a hallmark of predatory sales scripts
One reviewer overheard a technician at a restaurant discussing plans to 'get over on clients,' and recognized him as the plumber who had just quoted her $17,000 for a kitchen drain
synthesis.emergencyNotes: They do answer after hours and dispatch quickly — multiple reviewers confirm same-night or next-morning arrival on weekends and holidays — but the emergency responsiveness exists primarily to catch homeowners in vulnerable, high-pressure moments and upsell them into fraudulent repairs.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.8/5 across only 22 reviews while Yelp shows 2.0/5 across 100 reviews — the Yelp volume reveals a sustained pattern of fraud, fabricated diagnoses, and billing disputes that the thin Google sample completely obscures.

reviews.author: Shalini R.K.
reviews.text: We had Complete Plumbing compete with 2 other companies for work we had done at our business. They were not only the most reasonable in terms of quote, but they were the most professional, organized, and the guys who came out to complete the work were very nice and explained what was going on. They worked quickly, and most importantly cleaned up after they were done. Tina followed up with emails and called to make sure the work was done satisfactorily. I would definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Elvina Jones
reviews.text: Best customer service I've ever received. I called Complete Plumbing needing an evaluation and possible repair of two whirlpool tubs at my house and time was of the essence. Tina, one of the owners who answered the phone listened to my problem, looked at pictures I sent and agreed to help me. We exchanged at least 5 text messages and had that many phone conversations within a half hour. Tina, without my even asking, researched and contacted a whirlpool repair specialist who was better suited for the job - and they are hard to find! Tina sent me their contact information, spoke with them on my behalf, and agreed to be my backup until I was able to make arrangements for the specialist to come to my home. In less than an hour, Tina solved a problem I had been struggling with and stressing over for weeks! So intelligent, committed and responsive! Amazing…. thank you Tina!

reviews.author: Jim Montagnino
reviews.text:
The estimates and scheduling were done with Tina (President of Complete Plumbing Services) who was professional, personable and offer numerous options. All work was clearly spelled out and deliver in written format that was easy to understand. The install was done by Nick, who did a great job. He was very professional, polite, neat and quick in his work.
Very satisfied, actually quite pleased in that they came in under the estimated hours reducing my cost of service.

reviews.author: Andy Martin
reviews.text: We had Complete Plumbing replace our water heater yesterday. This is the fifth or sixth time we've worked with them. Every time they've helped us we feel that the work is done extremely well, very professional, for a fair price and have had no problems. We definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Eliska Pieper
reviews.text: I have used Complete Plumbing for years. For repairs on my central air, to replacing pipes, cleaning my furnace and then replacing my central air unit. Tina and her staff are always helpful. They are timely, honest and do an amazing job!! I will not use anyone else.

reviews.author: Corina Smith
reviews.text:
We have used Hara a few times now and loved the service we received. The first call was to repair an outside faucet, the second was to install a tankless water heater and the third was to replace our sump pump.

Each time, they were very responsive and professional. So nice and took the time to explain everything to us. As the last plumber left our house, he even fixed a door handle for me.

reviews.author: Brian DiFuccia

reviews.author: Endless Chapters
reviews.text:
After 2 visits and getting the run around a bit from another plumbing company in Woodstock, I sought recommendations from our town FB page on good and fair plumbers to repair a broken sewer line. The responses were overwhelmingly in favor MJ Plumbing. And I am so grateful they were. Matt was at our house the next day to properly diagnose the issue and explore repair options. Unlike the other company, he took the time to map the issue and do the necessary leg work to find the best repair solution. Whereas the other company handed us an estimate for $5,200 and said they "thought" they knew what the issue was. My husband who is inherently interested in knowing the interworkings of everything, was involved in the entire diagnostic process. Everything was communicated clearly to us. Matt even communicated with us while out of state visiting family, as he knew we were at limited capacity to use water sources in our house for fear of water backing up into our basement. Him and his crew repaired the broken sewer line in just a few hours. During the repair they identified another issue that definitely needed rectifying and only cost us $200 now, but would have cost us thousands later (B Box, which offers access to the water shut off valves, was improperly buried under a foot of dirt, packed with soil, and had no cap. So they raised it, cleared it out, and will be fitting it with a cap to allow appropriate access in the event of an emergency.)

Very grateful to have found MJ Plumbing. Matt and his entire crew were kind and extremely efficient. I feel at ease knowing this issue was handled by competent workers, and won't be an issue 6 months or 6 years down the road. Will be using them going forward for any Plumbing needs!

I now have multiple outlets that are not working and he is refusing to repair the damages he caused. As a reasonable solution I requested half of the payment I sent him back so that I could hire an electrician to repair the damages he caused and he refused. If you are looking for a reliable plumber that takes responsibility for their actions look elsewhere!

reviews.author: Brenda Galatolo
reviews.text:
I can’t possibly say enough good about this family owned business. A bit of a backstory…a little over a year ago I called a handyman to do a few small jobs around my home. One of them was to fix an upstairs toilet that would not stop running. This handyman took a quick look inside the tank and told me the entire toilet needed to be changed out and he gave me a quote of over $600 to do it. Nice guy, but he didn’t really seem to know a whole lot about any of the repairs I asked him to do so I wanted to get a professional opinion on the issue. I called Golden Coast Plumbing and Rooter and Joel Jr came out immediately. He removed the lid from the tank and explained that the flap on the inside mechanism wasn’t sealing properly. No new part was needed and the repair itself took seconds. I was very impressed and thankful.

Fast-forward to just recently and my water heater stopped working. I knew exactly who I was going to contact. It was nighttime, but it wasn’t an emergency so I just text messaged Golden Coast instead of calling. Very early the next morning, I got a phone call from Joel Jr. and he apologized profusely for not seeing my message the night before. (I didn’t expect him to). He told me he would be over between nine and 10 o’clock that same morning. I wasn’t expecting a response that fast. At about 9 o’clock, he text messaged me to say that he was 25 minutes away and would be there soon. When he got here, he put on shoe covers to respect our home and he confirmed what I already knew, that the unit would have to be replaced. Unfortunately, this was going to be no ordinary or fast water heater replacement. The water heater, along with the air conditioner and furnace are in a small closet in our kitchen. The garage is directly behind this closet. Several years ago when I had my air conditioner/furnace replaced, I was told, “I hope you don’t have to have your water heater replaced anytime soon because it’s going to be almost impossible to get it out of this tight area.” Now here we are… Because the closet is so narrow there was no way Joel Jr was going to be able to get the water heater out the front. So, his dad came by and they cut a perfectly rectangle hole in the wall of the garage and took it out the back of the closet. The hole was just big enough to wiggle the old water heater out and the new one in. They replaced the piece of the wall that had been removed and once we tape it, you won’t even know the wall had been cut!

Joel Jr went above and beyond what I expected. The response was immediate because he said we needed to have hot water ASAP. He moved gym equipment away from the wall in the garage so the work could be done, and he cleaned up all the dust and debris. He and his dad are extremely nice and very professional. The price was reasonable and I’m very happy with their work. I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone. Thanks Joel!!

reviews.author: Andre Nguyen
reviews.text:
I can't rave enough about Joel's plumbing expertise and outstanding service from Golden Coast Plumbing and Rooter! When my toilet started leaking, my wife and I were in a panic. It smelt terrible! Thankfully, Joel and his uncle came to the rescue, and he's nothing short of a plumbing superhero!

From the moment he arrived, Joel exuded professionalism and friendliness. He showed up right on time, ready to tackle the issue. His warm demeanor immediately put me at ease, and I knew I was in capable hands.

What impressed me the most was Joel's extensive knowledge and experience. He quickly assessed the situation, diagnosed the problem, and explained in simple terms what needed to be done to replace the wax ring. I appreciated how he patiently answered all my questions, never making me feel like I was bothering him.

Once he got to work, it was like watching magic unfold. Joel's skill and precision were mesmerizing. He swiftly removed the old wax ring and installed the new one with absolute accuracy. It was evident that he had performed this task countless times, and his confidence was contagious.

But it wasn't just about speed for Joel. He genuinely cared about the quality of his work. He paid meticulous attention to every detail, ensuring that everything was aligned perfectly and there would be no future leaks. It was clear that he took immense pride in his craftsmanship.

Throughout the entire process, Joel maintained a clean and organized workspace. He treated my home with respect, and when he finished, there was no mess left behind—just a perfectly functioning toilet.

Even after completing the job, Joel went above and beyond by sharing valuable tips on toilet maintenance to prevent future issues. His commitment to customer satisfaction was truly remarkable.

In conclusion, if you ever encounter a plumbing problem, especially involving your toilet, Joel is the plumber to call. He's not just a plumbing wizard; he's a genuine professional with a passion for his craft. Thank you, Joel, for your exceptional service and for saving the day (and my bathroom!). You've earned yourself a customer for life. Keep being awesome! ⚡🚽

reviews.author: Anthony Q.
reviews.text:
tl;dr

Joel and his team at Golden Coast are an amazing group of humans, and I'm lucky to have found them to help out with our past and future plumbing needs.

They're responsive, trustworthy, and most importantly, transparent and informative - they'll make sure you understand exactly what needs to be done, and why. Additionally, they do high quality work and somehow still manage to keep prices very reasonable.

---
Full review:

As someone who is extremely detailed-oriented and is a first-time homeowner, I was worried about finding the right person to help us with our first plumbing leak.

At 11pm on a Sunday, I rang Golden Coast, and was greeted by Joel who was able to come with his team on a whim (within the hour of the call) -  once they arrived, they worked relentlessly to pinpoint the cause of the leak - in fact, Joel didn't want to leave until they could confidently claim the cause and propose a solution.

Since then, we've continued contacting Joel (who is extremely responsive) for our laundry list of plumbing needs we had for our new home - from repairing a poorly installed hose bib, replacing 50-year old faucets in our bathroom, to even repairing our sewer lateral to meet EBMUD regulation (which we passed with flying colors thanks to Golden Coast).

Each job was done meticulously, and in every scenario, Joel explained every step of the process transparently and candidly to ensure we know exactly what's going on and where our money is being invested. We have been nothing but extremely happy with their work and fully appreciate Joel's approachability that has made every interaction feel less like a transaction, and more of a conversation.

We now have Golden Coast on speed dial, and won't hesitate to reach out whenever a plumbing need arises as we know we'll be in good hands.

reviews.author: Alan S.
reviews.text:
Joel and team were exceptional.  I can't recommend them highly enough especially in emergency situations.  

I reached out to Golden Coast Plumbing last night in a panic because the sewer system in my new build home was backing up through the shower in my first floor guest room.  Nightmare.  We were up until 3am cleaning and bleaching the floors and trying to figure out who to call to help us. 

Joel responded to my message right away (couldn't believe he messaged me back at 1:30am) and was out with his crew first thing in the morning.  He even rearranged his schedule to help us resolve our emergency.  Truly went above and beyond.

Joel and the team quickly unclogged the sewer line and provided a thorough explanation of the issue and provided me with helpful information to take back to my HOA.  Joel and his two technicians were timely, friendly, helpful and efficient.  Joel was patient with me as I asked several follow up questions to make sure I knew what steps I needed to take after they left.

Lastly, the cost of the service was lower than I had anticipated.  The value for the service was incredible.

Please consider hiring Joel and the team at Gold Coast Plumbing.  We're customers for life after this extremely positive experience.

reviews.author: Brenda G.
reviews.text:
I had a few jobs around the house I needed to finish, and I called a handyman. Big mistake. One of the jobs was a toilet upstairs that was continuously running. The handyman came out, changed a part (not the part that I could see wasn't working right), and ended up telling me that I needed a whole new toilet/install at a cost of over $500. As this is a second floor bathroom, I don't need water damage anywhere, and I wanted to confirm the handyman's assessment, I sent a message to Golden Coast plumbing. Joel returned my text almost immediately and came out the following morning.

After about 5 minutes, the problem was diagnosed. The gasket on the bottom of the cylinder in the tank had just become off-center. That's it. After the service charge, Golden Coast Plumbing saved me about $400 from what the handyman was going to charge.

I would definitely call Golden Coast again if I needed any plumbing work. The response time was fast, Joel knew exactly what the problem was and although I told him the handyman said I needed a whole new toilet, he was honest and told me the only thing I needed was to have the gasket reset. Problem solved.

reviews.author: renee m.
reviews.text: We worked with Golden Coast recently on a job we had to improve the plumbing to our main house and to set up plumbing for an in-law unit we will be building. I usually get 3 bids for every project but in this case I got 6 because the first few bids were significantly different (the highest was 300% higher than the lowest). I made sure I gave each the same requirements and materials, Golden Coast came in in the middle to lower end, I thought their bid was fair and they just seemed like they would be good to work with. My husband is handy, and does a lot of the work himself, but this job was too big - he has a high bar and he confirmed they were top notch, after the job he said we will go to them for all of our plumbing needs. Everyone told us the job would take 3-5 Days. GC did it in two. They had to work through some of our landscaping and we were prepared for some impact but it was almost nothing.  They were fast, friendly, well priced and did high quality work. I wish all contractors were so good!

reviews.author: Andrew C.
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying, Joel and his family were incredible. 

We had some plumbing issues that required someone to come in and snake our pipes.  We submitted our project proposal through Yelp and Joel was the first to respond and answered all my questions as I gathered quotes from other companies.  He was responsive throughout the entire process. Other companies weren't as transparent with their pricing and those that provided a quote, were significantly higher than expected.

Joel provided an incredibly competitive quote, and his team (which are family) were available the next day and I was able to get my plumbing issues resolved within 24 hours.  While completing their work, they even noticed a couple of other issues that I should consider getting fixed in the near future.

Incredibly satisfied with the work, the communication, the pricing, and the quality of the work. Joel and his family will be our first call the next time we need help with any plumbing related issues. Thanks, Joel!

Amazing plumber in the neighborhood and would recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Greg Paciga
reviews.text:
I contacted Matt to do a simple job at a friends house who is destitude and 70 years old. The poor woman is 70 and hasn't had a dishwasher in nearly 30 years. And at her age tends to two adult children in their mid 30's that have mental health issues.
So I bought her a new fridge because hers was only maintaining temps in the low 40's. And I bought and installed a used dish washer for her. I just needed a drain line and hot water connection installed under the sink.
I asked Matt if he could just give me a ball park figure for the job. I sent him pictures of the existing plumbing and he quoted me between $400 and $600. I thought it was a little high. But I was willing to pay it just to get her a washer.
I did however, text Matt and asked if there was anyway he could keep as close to $400 as possible. He texted back and said "if your under some budget restraints, maybe you should call another plumber". Well, at the time I couldn't find another plumber to do work in union.
So i told him it wasnt a matter of money. I has plenty of funds. It was just a request to do whatever he could to maybe cut a corner here or there to maybe save a couple of buck.
So what does he do yesterday when he was SCHEDULED to do the work? Doesnt show! Doesnt call! Doesnt return my texts or my calls asking if he got hung up some where and when he might show up. Thats just B.S. and if I wher anyone reading this review id steer clear of this clown.
P.S.  I did find another local plumber that was out today and quoted $300 for the same work.

reviews.text: I do not like to write a negative review, but I feel I must to help others who may be experiencing the problems we had.  After reading the positive reviews, we contacted The Plumbing Doctor to help figure out why both toilets were running quite often.  He came on July 26 and even though my husband stated he had already replaced the flapper, the representative said this had to be the problem and purchased a new flapper.  He charged $145 for the service call and $20 for the flapper we did not need and ordered another flapper for the other toilet.  The flapper was not the issue.  We had to be the ones to always call and find out where the part was.  My husband finally convinced the representative it was not the flapper, therefore the representative ordered another part (what part we do not know).  After being told again the part was on back order, and the plumber thinking we might consider replacing both toilets (house is only 4 years old) because the plumber was unsure what the problem could be, we decided to take matters into our own hands. We contacted the water supply company which came out to make sure our water pressure was good.  They suggested we replaced the float in each toilet.  My husband went to Lowe's -- purchased two floats on Tuesday -- replaced both floats on Wednesday, and as of today (Friday- September 6) no more running toilets.  Therefore if you have running toilets, replace the flapper---if that does not work---replace the float--and if still doesn't help, I suggest calling a different plumber.  We received no service for the money we paid.
