reviews.author: Karen H.
reviews.text:
I have come to understand over the years that lighting is one of the most important aspects to any room design, and from what I have seen from renovations I have watched, it is one of the last to be considered. That's too bad, because you can decorate a room worthy of Architectural Digest, but if you don't light it correctly, you've lost the opportunity to bring it from beautiful to striking.

Though I have known that lighting has always been my weak area (no matter how many lighting books I buy), when I decided to design my bucket list kitchen this was one expert I knew it would be worth paying for. I found the perfect person in Susan Arnold of Wolfers in Waltham (there is also a location in Brighton but the Waltham designer seemed a better fit for my needs ).

I haven't for a moment regretted my decision. Susan went above and beyond in helping design the best lighting configuration possible. There are at least seven zones of lighting throughout the space (now two rooms since a wall came down between kitchen and dining room). I never thought I would have needed so many different lighting areas, but I use every one of them in different ways.(Plus, Susan didn't try to up sell me. She showed my lights across various budget spectrum, and demonstrated each.) I went for the programmable system, where I can push one button on a controller and all seven zones will adjust to preset lighting levels. Six different "mood" presets can be programmed.

Susan's expertise in lighting is just one of the aspects for which to recommend her. She was also incredibly knowledgeable, responsive, and patient when helping me understand everything from the process of what happens and when in lighting installation down to finding a light we loved but could not locate anywhere. She calmed me down at my most anxious times and was enthusiastic with me when we figured out just the right lights to go in the space. She immediately got both my vision and my OCD nature, and, bless her, worked with both. In addition, she worked as needed with my contractor's electrician. The rare times she wasn't available, the staff at the Waltham location stepped in to help out with whatever I needed.

I likely won't be doing many other major renovations anytime soon. But if or when I do, a lighting designer will be one of the first things I add into the budget. I just hope Susan will still be on the job...

reviews.author: Barry R.
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to work with Joyce Gravel.  I went to the showroom and found the perfect lights for my kitchen, and they were discontinues.  I reached out to Joyce and explained the situation and she contacted the manufacturer and was able to get me the lights that I wanted.  When they arrived one of the globes was broken, so she re-ordered and another part of the glass insert was not the one that I had originally saw in the showroom, so she reached back out to the manufacturer and they sent the right glass insert.  Joyce was absolutely outstanding during this process.  She was responsive, kept me up to date, and was very kind during the process.  Joyce was the model for customer service.  Wolfers Lighting is lucky to have Joyce representing them and I will refer anyone looking for lighting there. Outstanding experience!

reviews.author: Ashlee V.
reviews.text: I could not be more pleased with the service I had at Wolfers Lighting! I had the pleasure to work with Joe, who was extremely friendly and assisted to help me find the perfect Chandelier for my home, even dealing with a very tight timeline. I would very highly recommend using Wolfers Lighting to individuals seeking lighting for their home.  A big thank you to Wolfers & Joe.

reviews.author: Jodi R.
reviews.text: I was in the Waltham store yesterday for a solid 25 minutes and not one person working in the store acknowledged my presence. Not one "hello" or "can I help you" to be found. I will never go back and plan to tell everyone else I know about how poor the customer experience and service was.

reviews.author: Patti F.
reviews.text: I met with a designer at Wolfers to learn the differences in recessed lighting.  He offered a great introduction and various options.  He had a bit of an attitude when I did not agree with some of his suggestions.  Even though Wolfers' prices were a bit higher than others I decided since the designer spent time with me I should go with them.  I was not disappointed with the product, but the customer service was awful.  I picked my order up and when I opened the box before the electrician came I found that I was missing items.  I called and spoke with a woman and explained the issue.  She spoke with the warehouse person and was told he remembered putting "the whole order" in my car.  I explained that was not correct and told her that only 2 boxes were placed in my car.  The warehouse person insisted he gave the complete order.  I kept saying the order was incomplete.  She then told me to send a picture of the open box and contents.  I did.  She then questioned me what was under the bubble wrap that I had taken out of the box (more bubble wrap).  She did not actually call me a liar, but her comments were rude, strongly suggesting I was not telling the truth and reporting the warehouse person remembered putting the "whole order in the car."   I felt attacked and became upset since they were questioning my integrity.  I suggested they go back to the warehouse and look to see if perhaps a box was overlooked (I would think this would have been the first thing this woman would have suggested, but again, awful customer service).  They did and guess what...they found the rest of my order.  The design consultant were knowledgeable and products reliable.  But the customer service was awful.  I do not recommend this company. When I have told people of my experience many have commented that since Wolfers is no longer associated with Standard Electric their customer service has gone down.  Through my experience, I can vouch for that.

reviews.author: Bob W.
reviews.text:
Apparently, Customer Service is an issue all-around.

I had a broken fan-blade on an older ceiling fan that needed replacing.  I was just looking for a little guidance, and didn't have a lot of information regarding the fan (I'm in a rental property).  On my way to Home Depot, I passed Wolfers and thought I'd give it a shot.  Fair warning...you'll get far better customer service at Home Depot.

I approached the gentleman (for lack of a better term) and told him my son had accidentally broken one blade on the ceiling fan and though I knew it was a long shot, could he look up the information based on the model number I had.  He looked down his nose at me and said "Well, that's not how it works.  The blades are all balanced, you need to replace the fan entirely.  Sounds like it's time for a new fan for you."  I explained that wasn't going to happen, as I was a renter and it wasn't my call.  I told him I'd be willing to replace all five blades if necessary to achieve "balance" as he called it.

The clerk did look up the information I had, but as I thought, to no avail.  I inquired if knowing the size of the fan I could possibly obtain five blades (again, I was looking for guidance or information).  He stated "Nope, it's definitely time for a new fan."  I again reiterated "No, that's not up to me" to which he stated :

"Then I Wish You the Best of Luck!"  Yes, those were the words he used, but his tone told me I was dismissed.  He sounded like Willy Wonka at the end of the original movie when he snipped "You LOSE!  Good Day Sir!"  (The link below is a refresher)

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xKG07305CBs

Not wanting to stoop to his level, or to level him, I left the store fuming.  I did call manager Joyce, who apologized profusely and told me to please ask for her the next time I came in.  I explained to her that the folks at Home Depot were far more knowledgeable and pleasant (directing me to a possible replacement blade), and that unfortunately, there would be no next time.

You would think these independent stores would be bending over backwards to gain/retain customers over the corporate giants, but apparently, because I only wanted a single blade or information, I did not warrant the time of day.

Stay away from Wolfers.  Overpriced and under-friendly.

reviews.author: Ty S.
reviews.text:
You will notice that my review is very much in line with the following reviews. And clearly Wolfer clearly doesn't care. 

This is the second time that we have saved up money to do a serious lighting project and gone to Wolfer. And yesterday we were treated like crap (again). We need outdoor lighting for the 2 stories of steps up to our porch. 

We stood around for 10+ minutes while sales people were "hanging out" in the back room. Finally a man walks out, past us and stops to ask us if we have been helped. We said no. He came up and asked what we need - he did not introduce himself.

We described our project and the challenges of providing a safe level of light to our staircase. And we told him what we were thinking to do about it - he simply stared at us and said "that will look terrible". Okay, so what would you suggest? A spot light at the top of the stairs aimed down the stairs at the street. That was it. 

When I said that a spot light would not address the issue of shadow and darkness at the bottom of the stairs. He second suggestion was to put up a pole light at the end (in addition to the spot light).

I am sure that these suggestions were aimed at us because we did not look "rich" enough, not sophisticated enough, so have a beautiful and thoughtful solution to the problem. 

Finally, after we pushed and pushed he came up with exactly one suggestion that would include completely reworking our entire staircase. I was grateful for the suggestion but his attitude, disregard, and disinterest were tangible.

I WILL NEVER WALK INTO THEIR STORE AGAIN - FOR ANY PROJECT - EVER.

Our concrete guy stopped by our house today, had 4 different lighting solutions for our staircase and gave us solutions ranging from easy to difficult - but doable solutions that will work. And he did not treat us like dirt.

If you are a working-class, or middle-class person, don't go to this shop. They will treat you far worse than anyone who works so hard for their money deserves. You deserve better. Go where you are respected.

Best wishes on all your projects.
tyson

reviews.author: Rosalita E.
reviews.text:
Terrible customer service. Rude, condescending, arrogant, and dismissive. 

Maybe if we had met with a different sales person, I would feel differently, but Ginger single-handedly ruined the experience for us. The bf and I were looking for a dining room light fixture. After looking  in Home Depot and Lowes, we decided we'd try a specialty lighting store, hoping we'd get a knowledgeable sales person to give us some advice and ideas. 

After wandering around the showroom for about 20 minutes without so much as a greeting from any of the employees, we went to the counter to ask for some direction. Ginger didn't let us finish describing what we wanted before interrupting us and making us feel like idiots. When we started describing what we were looking for, she interrupted with, "Well, how big is your dining room table?" (Who knows the exact dimensions of their tables??) "Well if you don't know the exact measurement, I can't get a sense of the scope and scale you need."

We told her we had looked at the Wolfer's website and found some options on it that we liked. "Well, that's just a virtual showroom and we actually don't sell the stuff that's on the website." (What? What's the point of having it on your website then?) "You can find the number on the website and email me and I can order it for you." (Oh, and get you a nice little commission? After how helpful you've been?) 

After a few more minutes of her condescension, she threw some catalogs at us and said she'd be back in 15 minutes. After 5 minutes of flipping through catalogs, no more knowledgeable than we'd been when we'd arrived, we decided to cut our losses and leave. We went to Savio's where we were treated much better, with the sales person being responsive, but not pushy, to help us come up with options in our price range and style choice.  There might have been some other, more helpful sales people at Wolfer's, but if Ginger is an indication of the type of people they employ, I am not going to take my chances by going back.

reviews.author: Kri F.
reviews.text:
Rude, dismissive, condescending and arrogant staff - on top of a VERY limited selection (read below) and SUPER OVERPRICED products.

Save yourself a trip to allston, and shop online. After reading the other reviews, i guess i should have read them before leaving the house. Not much has changed here in the past 5 years it seems.

When we walked in, we could see some of the paper shuffling staff in the back room, but they clearly were all on break, and as a result, there was no one to help us. After several minutes and several PA pagers for assistance at the front desk, a lady approached us, and after a very short introduction said she actually cannot help us because she has an appointment in 45 minutes.

Several minutes later - out came Bobby, the showroom manager, who accosted us for not knowing how tall the ceilings were, what we wanted, and how many of each. Needless to say we are not contractors, just a young couple remodeling a house, and this is the first time we set foot in a lighting store (all of which we explained before the barrage of condescending questions and insults). Then came the explanation of all those things we should know as contractors, builders, electricians, etc., but do not know and thus she cannot help us find the kind of light we want. 

Then came the arguments: there is only one kind of LED bulb for this fixture, says bobby. 
"I saw similar bulbs with several LED cells/lenses" says I. "No" said bobby, "this is the only thing that fits".

OK, how about pricing -just for kicks we walked in to a home depot. Everything there was about 300-400% more expensive for the exact same product then it is at Home depot and the home depot shelves are stocked with about 6-7 different LED bulbs which fit these fixtures.

Instead of service we got attitude, who ever buys anything here? i do not know. Perhaps people who do not yet have the "internet" in the house yet.

reviews.author: Jo-Ann K.
reviews.text:
I went to their Allston location but the service was not the same as in Waltham. 

I went their this past weekend looking for track lighting and fans. 

Not sure what I wanted since I just started remodeling my kitchen. 

Spoke to a sale person - Sarah she took me from the most expensive to the reasonable to cheap. 

Sarah took her time with me and I mean took her time . 
I arrive at the store at 2 pm and left at 4 pm. 

She explain in detail what type of fixtures to use what each one was use for, how many lights, the spectrum of the light and so much more. 

She then show me different colors that would go with the colors of my kitchen and even match the fan. 

Gave me both prices down to each detail. 

All this time never rushing me. 

I am a ask kinda girl and she in turn answered all of my questions down to the smallest detail of wiring, switches etc. 

I was satisfied and made my deposit for the lights and the fan. 

Plus they have a year warranty. 

If you are not satisfied they will return your money or if you fine you only need two strobes instead of four they will refund you for that also. 
hat they have here at this store is good quality lights and fixtures. 

Nothing that you will find at Home Depot or Lowes. 

Do not get me wrong Home Depot and Lowes are great but I wanted something unique , good quality for my place of residence. 

I would not purchase lights from them for my tenants apartment. 

Reason is I rather not spend way to much to keep the rent at a reasonable rate. 

If you are looking for unique track lighting this is the place...

reviews.author: G K.
reviews.text:
Okay, Wolfers is an excellent place for Lighting supplies and light fixtures.   They mainly cater to the trades ( electricians, designers etc.) and commercial /businesses. However,  Wolfers also has retail locations for consumers. 

- Excellent customer service
- Very knowledgeable staff
- Large selection in a great showroom
- High quality fixtures 

I stopped in the Alston store on North Beacon Street on a Saturday to check out track lighting options.      The gentleman that helped me was terrific.  

He covered : the power options, the different track lighting types,  showed me all the options for fixtures that go on the track that he recomended.     

Suggested a halogen light fixture that used less power, showed me how to remove the halogen bulb from the tight fitting socket with a piece of tape.    Also, he showed me how to properly mount the fixture in the track and how to unlock and remove the fixture from the track properly.   Tips on how to do it without breaking the track.    

My walls/ceiling are the old type of walls with lathe and plaster.  No problem, the Wolfers lighting guy knew exactly how to handle these older walls and made installation suggestions. 

I went home and installed the halogen track lights like I was a pro ...and when I plugged it it and turned on the switch the track lights  worked perfectly.  ( I opted to  use a track light configuration that could be plugged into an outlet - this also saved me the headache of getting an electrician )

reviews.author: Donald M.
reviews.text: Buyer beware. The website says "We offer free ground shipping for most online orders over $100. Please note that some large or oversize items require shipping by freight and will incur additional charges." I placed an order for a small $250 light with a customer rep, and asked for a discount since I could get the light much cheaper elsewhere. I was given a small discount. When I got the bill, there was a notice that shipping costs would be added later, and that this was a "special order". I called to ask why there was a shipping order and why this was special, I was told that all their orders were special because they have no inventory and everything comes from a factory. I was then told that because I talked to a rep and got a discount that shipping was added. Note that I was talking to a rep because I had placed an original order in March and had to call in May to be told I couldn't get the original light until August. The rep never said that talking to her made this a more expensive order. After a couple of phone calls and a threat to cancel the order I got the shipping cost waived as "a one time courtesy." It will be one time.

reviews.author: Rose S.
reviews.text: This store is the worst  service ever i came 10 min before they were closing and the wise mouth old blonde at the desk wanted to leave not caring that I was a Customer. I spent over 400 doll cash and the lights i bought were not gonna work for my house so i brought them back but she wuld not take them back because the box they came in was torn and to top it off one of the was a floor model i paid cash and got a check .and i had to keep one because the box was torn .and she was so rude and got off on tryin to power trip but wut she didn't no was u was planing to spend close to 10 grand on lights fo my home but after tha t i just left in shock i wish the owner was there .people like her put company's out of business  all because she wanted to leave at 8 pm instead of showing me sumthin I could use stay away lowes has alot of the same lights got half the price and they won't complain about a torn box and they are very nice i won't ever go back .and I think she was judged  me because of my tattoos with her little laughing under her breath which also stunck save ur money go somware ware they treat you like a person stay away

reviews.author: Eve S.
reviews.text:
Terrible, and I mean TERRIBLE customer service.  Yes, if you need a hard to find light bulb, this is a good place to order, but the showroom staff are awful.  I bought an expensive Flos fixture, and within 6 years it is disintegrating, falling apart.  I called Wolfers for help and the salesperson said "Well, it is 6 years old." What?  I bought my house with fixtures that were installed in 1959 and they all worked!  I had to push her to respond, and she agreed to try and see if Flos would do anything.  She requested I provide images and information, which I did, she never even responded.  I called TWICE and she said she'd get back to me.  Never did.  They don't care, it really shows. 

In this economy, you'd think customer service for people who have bought many items from you would be important, but at this location, don't even think you'll get a return for your loyalty.   I bought many fixtures from them in the past, for both my home and several real estate investments.  I'll never buy one thing from this company again, I'll take my chances on the internet.

reviews.author: Marcy K.
reviews.text:
I gave a fairly generous gift certificate from Westford Lighting (WL) to someone, but since the place closed ... and I had no warning ... I never had a chance to tell the recipients that they better redeem that certificate. The place that WL recommended (and said they'd provide good customer service) was Wolfers. So, we figured we'd ring up Wolfers to see if they'd honor some of the gift card. 

I know you're not your brother's keeper, but I wasn't expecting to hear, "Absolutely not." OUCH! It would have been fabulous PR for Wolfers to say, "We won't redeem that gift card, but we will knock a few dollars off your purchase for your trouble." They would have gotten my business, even if they offered to deduct $20, or had they been a little nicer about it, but since that didn't happen, I will find someplace else.

I've just read the other reviews, and I guess I'm not so far off re: customer service and attitude. Too bad. There's one less game in town, but luckily Wolfers is not the ONLY game left.

reviews.author: David F.
reviews.text:
I was leaving the Bay Area after 30 years and my house was 115 years old. As expected, I failed an inspection required by City of San Mateo's lateral sewer line ordinance (enacted in 2020).  

I contacted a very large plumbing outfit suggested by my realtor, but they gave me a very large estimate.  Later that night, someone recommended Joe at Total Underground Construction (funnily enough it was a Lyft driver who heard my sob story and had a similar experience). 

Joe assessed the situation and gave me a lower quote with a few contingencies for stuff he couldn't see until excavating. To my surprise, the contingent items weren't necessary and the quote held. 

Work was performed impeccably and quickly. Permits and all phases were perfectly sequenced, and we passed inspection. Now I can sell the house.  

Joe is very experienced and a good guy - total pro.  If you're ever in this situation, don't stress - just contact this company.

reviews.author: Cherry Mao
reviews.text: We had a clogged main sewer line that needed replacing and  our neighbor recommended Joe and Orlando.  They immediately came out to assess the situation and proposed a cost effective solution.  Right away, they came off as two guys who really enjoyed their work.  After accepting the project, they took the extra steps to drive out that night to get the sewer line in a passable condition for the few days until the start of the project so we would not be without water and this was all done free of charge with the project.  For comparison, other plumbers I've worked with have charged me even for using the camera to look at the line.  During the project, they had 4 guys working and were able to complete the sewer line replacement in a single day.  On top of all this, their price was extremely reasonable.   Highly recommend them and would definitely call on them for future plumbing needs.

Sooo liiike... I don't know a damn thing about plumbing.
Couldn't tell you how to shut off the water if my life depended on it. All I know is that a person like me who has absolutely no clue about any of that is probably an ideal customer for a greedy tradesmen. However, that was not the case with Total UG. Matter of fact, I called them and explained the problem with my boyfriend's sink. I was expecting a quote, but Joe actually told me exactly what we could do to fix it ourselves with just a cheap tool we could find on Amazon. I was so surprised he did that and yes, it worked like a charm!
A few months later when my boyfriend had a water leakage issue in a different bathroom, Joe and his team were a no-brainer! We're in the midst of that right now and it's been smooth sailing. I know we're in good hands... or should I say good pipes? (pause)

reviews.author: Dick D.
reviews.text: I had a sink that was very slow draining and has been a problem off and on for many years but the usual baking soda/vinegar fix wasn't working any more. I called them at 8:30am and was told someone would be coming before 1pm. I received a call about 10:40am saying we were next on the list. I received another call about 12:45 pm saying the technician was delayed a bit on the previous job but we were still next. I received another call around 1:30 saying the technician was on his way. He was here a few minutes later. Aaron came in, diagnosed the problem, and told me the cost and about their guarantee. After I agreed, he brought in all the necessary equipment and got to work and was able to locate and remove a large clog pretty far down the drain pipe (maybe 10-15 feet) in fairly short order. Aaron was very professional and friendly. He knew exactly what to do in order to remedy our issue. Although I may have been able to get someone else at a cheaper price, I felt that I would give Roto-Rooter a try since I've heard their adds for years and this is what they're known for. After the clog was removed, he verified that the other drains all functioned normally and then cleaned the area. I feel it was money well spent. My issue was resolved within a few hours from the initial call to them, I was kept up to date until the technician arrived and, due to Aaron's many years of experience (I believe he said he has worked for them for 11 years) and training, he was able to complete the job quickly. Based on this experience I would not hesitate to recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Scott W.
reviews.text: John #2786 did a great job! Thanks to Mike as well for all his hard work and assistance!

reviews.author: Kristin M.
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience with them! Sergey fully explained everything to me before I committed to the service and he had everything fixed in less than an hour. I will always use them in the future!

reviews.author: George E.
reviews.text: As a follow-up to my review.  The next day I called a guy from Sterling.  He unclogged the drain AND pumped the septic system for $465.  Roto Rooter wanted $432 just to snake the shower drain.  The guy from Sterling also showed up right when he said he would.    As Brian D. said DO NOT USE THEM.

reviews.author: Brian D.
reviews.text: DO NOT USE THEM.  They called me this afternoon 15 minutes before my schedule window was to start and cancelled the service for the second time in 2 days.  Both times they simply indicated that they couldn't get anyone out.  I called to speak to a supervisor and was transferred to someone who picked up the phone and sounded like she was at home and told me she wasn't a supervisor.  Then on my second call to a supervisor the guy tried to end the call with "if you need something in future, please call us" after I told him I would never call for service again.  By the way, I called another company who is sending out someone this afternoon.  THE SAME DAY.

reviews.author: Brian R.
reviews.text:
We called Roto Rooter after the sink in one of our bathrooms was slightly clogged (not fully, but water was backing up). A technician was sent to our house a couple of hours later and began working. The technician began work on the bathroom without laying down any protective gear (such as plastic), and walked around the house in dirty boots. After some time, the technician was unable to unclog the drain in the bathroom that was experiencing the problem, so he walked into our second bathroom and began attempting to unclog the drain from this bathroom. As a side note, this bathroom was having absolutely no problems prior to the technician working on it. The technician began making an extreme mess on the vanity in the bathroom with dirty water, and I asked him why he did not cover it with plastic (especially because it is a wood vanity). He began giving my attitude, used the F-word at me, and was extremely rude. At this point, I told the technician to immediately leave my house because he was no longer welcome inside. The technician left the house with the original bathroom in worse condition than when he started, and the bathroom that had no problems was also now backed-up. A technician who later came to my house actually discovered that this technician had physically damaged my sink and drain pipe in the bathroom that had original problems, and I was told that it would be my expense to get this fixed. 

At this point, I called the dispatcher and asked to speak to a supervisor to tell them what had happened, and to get somebody else out to my house to fix the problem since there are no usable bathrooms in the house. I was told that a supervisor would call me back in one hour, but after an hour, there was no call. I called the dispatcher again, and was told that the original one hour timeframe was incorrect and that a supervisor would be calling me "eventually." I eventually received a call from the supervisor 2.5 hours later. The supervisor told me that he would be sending out another technician to my house within the next hour to address what the first had broken (and that I should be receiving a call from the dispatcher within a couple of minutes of the estimated arrival time). Another 2.5 hours pass and it is now 9:45 PM, and I finally receive a call from the DISPATCHER that the technician is on the way. The technician took another 1.5 hours to actually arrive to my house. 

He began working on both bathrooms, and attempted to do the exact same thing as the first technician. The technician attempted to unclog the drain for another hour, could not do anything, and left my house just as the first had. It is now nearly midnight, and both bathrooms are still unusable in my house. 

I once again called the dispatcher and asked to speak to a supervisor, but was told one would call me in the morning. What kind of 24-hour service is this if I cannot speak to someone about a major problem? 

The next morning, the supervisor called me back, and informed me that they would need to call out a plumber to my house (to fix a SIMPLE DRAIN CLOG), and the plumber would have to open up one wall to gain access to the pipe. I politely said absolutely no thank you to the supervisor, and I made sure that I would not be billed for either of the technicians coming to my house because they accomplished nothing, and caused more damage than there originally was. The supervisor informed me that they would indeed be sending me a bill for both technicians. 

I called another local company after this conversation. They sent a technician to my house one hour later, and within TEN MINUTES, both drains were unclogged (and at a fraction of the price Roto Rooter charged me). If Roto Rooter actually has the dignity to send me a bill for their completely useless work, I plan to send them the invoice directly back, along with a letter from an attorney and the invoice from the plumbing company that actually solved my problem.

Moral of the story: never go with Roto Rooter. They are inappropriate, charge a fortune, and simply cannot run a successful business under their current status. You're much better off going with a local company. It's time that everybody hears about their terrible business practices.

EDIT: I'd like to follow up to this review. I emailed the Roto-Rooter agent who commented on my review within hours, and he has yet to follow up with me two weeks later. I hope this is another testament to Roto Rooter's lack of customer care.

reviews.author: Jenn G.
reviews.text: My toilet got clogged on Christmas Eve day and I called Rotorooter at about 4 PM and they gave me a 4 hour window up until 8 PM.  At first that seemed ok but it was all I could do to get the toilet fixed because there were 5 of us and only one non working toilet.  After sitting around the house by myself because the rest of my family was celebrating Christmas Eve I get a call at 8 and they tell me that suddenly nobody can fix my toilet tonight.  I was not happy. I was then told that the earliest that anybody could get there is the next day between 10 AM and 2 PM.  I stated that that was unacceptable because I have 3 kids who live at this house and that I was told that it was going to get fixed today.  Then at 10 PM I get another call that stated that a tech just became available but he could not be there until about 11PM...on Christas Eve. Then I get another call from the tech and he stated that he was over 2 hours away and that that night would not work.  The tech (Steve #4171) was awesome!  He told me that even though my home was not in his area he would be at my house at 8 AM on Christmas Day.  He would have been if dispatch didnt send him the wrong address.  Once he got there and did the work Steve was great and I was very appreciative of his great customer service and he did a great job over all.  I am very displeased with dispatch and the runaround that I received. I asked to speak with a manager and I was told one would call me back but nobody ever called me back except the same terrible dispatcher that was no help at all. I am very displeased with Rototrooter and will never use this service again.

reviews.author: Edward F.
reviews.text:
I called RotoRooter because my new kitchen drain line was clogged, I'll review my install plumber later, and I thought since I am doing a lot of other work in this place it'll be quicker/more economical for someone else to snake the line. Turns out that Roto-Rooter will come to your house on a Sunday without any extra cost...in fact they'll come for free to give you an estimate on the work. BONUS!!!! So I asked the person on the phone what a typical kitchen snake job like mine would be, I asked 3 times mind you. 

Here's the skinny. The guy shows up and I show him the kitchen line and tell him the plumbing history (very brief,  it's all new except the vent and line to the street). He says, "I can snake that for you right now and give you a 6-month guarantee for $399". I was like jeez that is a lot of money, is that typical? He says "We have a flat rate for this service" WHAT??? If there is a flat rate, then why didn't the guy on the call tell me it when I asked 3 TIMES? RR guy says "Well, I think they want us to get our foot in the door, because once we are in, people are likely to just say go ahead"

EFF YOU ROTO-ROOTER. I asked the guy to leave. I couldn't snake the line myself which is an issue for the future, BUT, I went onto the roof, poured drano down the stink pipe, rinsed with hot water, and 7 minutes later...NO CLOG. Total repair like $8 in material maybe, some ingenuity, and 2 hours. Way less than a flat rate of $399.

DO NOT CALL ROTO-ROOTER

reviews.author: Alex T.
reviews.text:
$840 for clogged washing machine drain (Sudbury, MA).

Called roto-rooter to fix a clogged washer drain, no other drains in the house were clogged. The guy showed up 2 hours late, and quoted me $560 to snake the line, I knew it was very high but agreed, I was in a situation where I had to get the line cleared asap, unfortunately he too realized my situation. Once he snaked the line, he proudly claimed that had no effect on the clog. He had snaked the wrong line, and then claimed there were 2 clogs, based on no evidence. This time he again wanted to snake a line not connected to washer, had to argue for 10 mins to just snake the washer line and not go looking for clogs in random pipes. He then made a claim washer line needed special tool, and his tool got beat in last job. At that point I asked him to leave, he then claimed he can snake the line, which he did and that cleared the clog. Unfortunately the whole endeavor cost me $850, and he made complete mess of my basement, that is now stinking of sewage.

I had used roto-rooter a few years back, and their service was satisfactory then, so did not care to shop around. This proved to be very expensive. They are not professional plumbers, but professional exploiters. 

#never-roto-rooter

reviews.author: Ay J.
reviews.text:
The heavy snow this year put my sump pump under extra pressure once the melting snow turned the ground area into small creeks, so the sump pump decided to quit. The result of this failed sump pump was water in my finished basement.  

My call to Roto-Rooter has resulted in a new sump pump and in water removal from my basement. The plumber was friendly and professional. He arrived at the scheduled time, and the work was completed for the price that he quoted. While the price was a little higher than another serviceman who looked at the pump, I valued the professionalism and the view toward quality that the Roto-Rooter plumber demonstrated. 

Similarly, the water removal was done with professionalism, and the workers always arrived when scheduled. I also was impressed with the attention to quality. There was a clear desire to ensure that the job was well done. The process was explained to me thoroughly so that I understood why Roro-Rooter needed to do each part of the clean up process. 

I am pleased with their service and anticipate that I will be pleased with the results over the long run. 

ayj
Granby, MA

reviews.author: Calindy S.
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this company. I was out of town when I had a main sewer line clog and back up while my house sitter was there. I had a local company come in and they quoted me $1700 just to determine the problem and clear the line and told me sewage would go all over my my basement and I would likely need a clean up company to come in. This all happened at 9pm. I needed a second opinion and called Roto-rooter and they were out within the hour. Ron called me and went over the cost right away with me and assured me sewage would not go all over my basement. My flat fee was less than 1/3 of the other plumber!!! Ron called me when it was done and told me a tech would be in contact to come put a camera down the pipe to give me more info on the issue in a few days. I was so relieved!!  What was a super stressful situation and about to cost a ton of money was made less stressful by the quick response of Roto-rooter and the reassuring and friendly words of the tech. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nancy H.
reviews.text:
I called Roto- Rooter yesterday to unclog a toliet line.  A technician did come promptly and attempted to unclog.  Last night I noticed the water was still going down very slow.  I called Roto-Rooter back this morning and explained the situation.
The person I spoke to on the phone was very nice, polite and accomodating.
This afternoon Aaron came and evaluated the situation.  It turns out he had to remove the toliet and found the clog way down the line.  He put on a new wax ring and replaced the toliet.  He tested the line several  times to be sure it worked. Aaron was very informative about the situation.  He also mentioned we may want to try the Roto-Rooter product that you use 1-2x month to keep lines clear.
Aaron also explained the fee.  We got a refund from yesterday's bill on todays.
I was very pleased with the service today.
Aaron was very knowledgable, polite and neat.  
I would ask for him again if I needed Roto- Rooter service.
Thank you.
Nancy Hesselton

reviews.author: Rameel R.
reviews.text:
Terrible experience! "24/7 service" - such a lie! 

Called on Thursday to get a water heater replaced, they gave me a time frame of Friday 12-4. I call on Friday morning at 11 to confirm and they said they'll be there. I get a call on Friday at 2:45 letting me know that the tech will be there in one hour, which would be perfect! Then at 4:00 I get a call saying tech will not be able to make it, no reason given. I ask to speak to manager and get completely ignored! How is it 24 hour service any day if they book appointments and continuously cancel as no shoes!

Overall wasted two days and about 7 hours of my time waiting for a tech to come! Dispatch and customer service is very rude and not professional! What am I gonna do with 20% off if my poor tenant has cold water!

reviews.author: Denise L.
reviews.text: Out of all the plumbers in the area I called, Roto-Rooter is the only one who would show up right away. I had just moved in to my house after it was being fixed due to a fire a year ago. The guy was super professional, and knowledgeable. I ended buying their very expensive "maintenance" liquid mix and it works great.  The whole thing came to $700 which was shocking to me. I knew my ins co would pay for it as it was related to the fire incident and not having had water running through the pipes for a long time. If I had been responsible for the invoice, I would've freaked out. That's why I knocked off a star. So yes, they are good, reliable and guarantee their work (the guy came back a week later to fix it again at no charge - not his fault, it was bound to happen due to the severe clogging) BUT they are super expensive. Before asking them to fix your problem, ask for an estimate.

reviews.author: Meredith L.
reviews.text:
We called Roto Rooter because our kitchen drain was clogged. We were given a window of between 3:30 and 5:30 same day service which was great, and the plumber arrived promptly and was very professional. 

The plumber did a fantastic job and it turned out to be a very bad clog.It took him a long time to get all of the sludge out of our pipes, but worked until the job was done and the drain was good as new. We ended up with several buckets full of sludge from the drain, so this was not your average clog. It was worse than average. 

I would give roto-rooter 5 stars, but the price is a little steep. It cost $475 Keeping in mind that we got same-day emergency service and the drain took several hours to clear, this certainly isn't as steep as it sounds, but it is steep enough to put roto-rooter on our list of places to use only in an emergency.

synthesis.summary: This listing operates as Roto-Rooter Worcester — they answer the phone when local plumbers don't, but you'll pay 2–3x the market rate for that availability. Appointment cancellations are documented across dozens of reviews spanning years, and when they do show, reviewer after reviewer flags the pricing as 'highway robbery' — $400–$840 for a drain snake job that competitors do for $125–$465.

Same-day and weekend availability when they do dispatch

Chronic cancellations: multiple reviewers describe waiting 4–6 hours then being told no tech is available
Refused to give price over the phone — 'if there is a flat rate, why didn't they tell me when I asked 3 times?'
bestFor: Situations where no local plumber is available and cost is secondary to getting someone out quickly

reviews.author: greg
reviews.text: I called Schuler, not in an emergency, but in need to address an issue with water pressure and air in the pipes.   They scheduled promptly for the next day.   The technician who arrived was very friendly, professional, courteous, but most importantly, knowledgeable!   After throughly diagnosing the plumbing, and explaining that there were several issues at play, Chuck outlined everything and made clear what options we had and the potential risk/reward of each.   After a decision was made, and a few phone calls later, parts were delivered and the work was completed.     The service was excellent and in the future I will not hesitate to call Shuler and ask for Chuck when plumbing issues arise.

reviews.author: D F
reviews.text:
If you live in Macungie Borough like me, you may enjoy “great” water pressure … but be careful, because you could unknowingly have *100 psi* running through your pipes, like I did!  At least, before Chuck Bell from Schuler installed a PRV (pressure reducing valve) to bring it down to a safe level.

It’s never fun to spend money on something you didn’t know you needed (and isn’t in budget).  But Chuck eased that blow by being patient (VERY patient) with my uncertainty and million questions.  Even when I asked the same thing multiple times, he was never impatient nor did he get offended - he stayed calm and kind.

Chick went out of his way to help set my mind at ease about the project and expenditure.  He went above and beyond: checking the pressure setting on my expansion tank (and matching it to the house pressure, as it should have been); measuring the temperature of my hot water; (and increasing the temperature on my heater to an appropriate level); and checking my toilet tank to make sure there wasn’t a leak.

I can’t forget everyone I spoke with on the phone at the Schuler Service office - they were all SO NICE!  I never felt like I was being a pest (these days, some places make you feel like … unless something has exploded or someone needs open heart surgery, you are wasting their time, so they can’t get you off the phone fast enough).  Everyone I spoke with at Schuler was warm and friendly, yet professional.  Thank you!

This review is too long and I doubt anyone has read it all, so I’ll stop now.  Do not hesitate to call Schuler; ask for Chuck Bell!

reviews.author: Stacey Silliman
reviews.text: Kevin and Cayden looked at my sump pump and Kevin did suggest a new one since mine was not functioning. I expected as much and he and Cayden had it installed quickly and professionally. I love Schuler Service. Always professional and helpful and I am a repeat customer and always will be. Also thanks to the kind receptionists too for being so nice and decent when booking. Everyone has great customer service skills which means a lot to me. Five stars. I would give them 100 stars if I could!

reviews.text: We had our garbage disposal go out suddenly and start leaking.  We called on Saturday at around Noon, and our tech, Terry came out ASAP.  He quickly diagnosed the problem, and went to get a new disposal for us.  He installed it fast!  He was extremely nice and very personable.  I'd highly recommend and would use them for future services.  Thanks!

reviews.author: Margaret Hall
reviews.text: Travis did a great job.  He arrived well within the time frame, he diagnosed the problem, and then gave a clear explanation of how to fix it.  He was very upfront about the pricing and what needed to be done.  He was personable, approachable, and easy to work with.  Very friendly and caring.  I appreciate his expertise and hard work.  After he finished with the emergency in the bathroom, he installed a new kitchen sink.  The job took all day and involved back-up help and several trips to Home Depot.  Travis stuck with it and worked hard.  Everything looks great and works perfectly.  Thank you, Travis.

reviews.author: S P.
reviews.text:
After dealing with recurring plumbing issues, we feel incredibly fortunate to have connected with Christian from Roto-Rooter. What began as a service call for a standard toilet leak has evolved into a trusted professional partnership; he is now the only plumber we call. Christian consistently makes a stellar impression from the moment he arrives. He is punctual, friendly, and always introduces himself before getting to work. He has earned our complete confidence to the point that we trust him to work unsupervised, which speaks volumes about his integrity and professionalism.
Over the past few months, Christian has navigated us through several complex issues, including a sump pump failure. His approach is both strategic and highly technical. While waiting for parts to arrive, he expertly locked down the affected systems and installed new lines to ensure we remained functional with minimal disruption. He takes the time to explain the "why" behind an issue in plain English and lays out all available options and recommendations without any pressure.
Christian returned to install the new parts the moment they arrived, ensuring everything was back to peak performance. It is rare to find a technician who combines high-level technical skill with such genuine care for his clients. While we hope we won’t need a plumber anytime soon, we know exactly who we are calling if we do. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Nick Lilly
reviews.text:
The technicians that finally showed up saved the rating.

Their offsite call center is among the worst. They quoted me a tech would arrive in 2 hours at 9am on Thursday. I called again at 1pm and they couldn’t tell me anything other than they were behind due to high volume of calls which I understood because of the rain storm. The problem arose when I called again at 7pm and she told me the tech assigned to me was off at 6pm and no one was coming. I had to call for that info. That should have been a phone call to me.

Robert finally arrived at noon the following day and quickly addressed the problem. Quoted me a price that was pretty high based on reviews I’ve read from other companies. I was fine with paying because he was there and had the parts ready and we’re expected to get rain again soon. Robert and his partner did a great and timely job.

reviews.author: Tayy Fink
reviews.text: Terry came out promptly after my initial call to Roto Rooter and was very polite and answered all of my questions to help me understand my situation. He was able to give me a very well explained estimate today. I just unfortunately did not have the funds at this moment to move forward with work. But I would absolutely recommend Roto Rooter to anyone who needs a responsive and reliable plumber!

reviews.author: Rory Nicol
reviews.text:
When our furnace went out during one of the coldest weeks of the year, I had four kids in the house and real concern about how we were going to get through the weekend. Five Star Home Services stepped in immediately. By Saturday morning — in the cold and snow — their team was at our home replacing the furnace.

What stood out most wasn’t just the speed or professionalism (which were excellent), but the way they treated my family. They were kind, calm, played with my kids, and treated our home with real care. The cleanup was spotless, and the stress we were carrying disappeared.

In a moment when it really mattered, they showed up. That’s the kind of company you want to call — and recommend.

reviews.author: Jay & Daniella
reviews.text:
We were referred to Five Star Home Services through the Lowe's Project Referral Service, and honestly I could not be happier. While they were not able to come out the absolute moment we needed them (our furnace went out on a Saturday in the middle of January, when I'm sure a lot of homes needed assistance), they were very quick to communicate and reschedule for first thing in the morning on Sunday.
Naturally, we ended up needing a whole new system, but Five Star was incredible and able to update the entire system, furnace and AC, the very next morning and for a reasonable price. Noah came out and did our diagnostic, and he was super friendly and knowledgeable. I never once felt like my time was being wasted or that I was being taken for a ride.
Zane and Mike (maybe Matt, I'm sorry I don't quite remember) were both awesome! They showed up exactly when they were supposed to, there's a tracking system so I was ready for their arrival. They worked all day and everything was awesome, they wore booties and put down a drop cloth, even swept up when they were done, extremely respectful of my home.
Even their staff on the phone were incredibly great to work with!  Five Star truly deserves all 5 stars, plus. Customer service is a dying art, but they keep it alive. Thanks so much for everything!

reviews.author: Roger Doyle
reviews.text:
Hi. My name is Roger, and I won Five Stars Home Services "Scariest Furnace Contest" and had my new, totally free furnace installed last week and I couldn't be happier!

I'm a 74-year-old retiree and having my 45-year-old furnace replaced with a new energy efficient model is a blessing and all the folks at Five Stars were great. They even through in a wi-fi thermostat with a room monitor, which I really love.

After I was told I had won their contest, a Five Stars rep came over and surveyed the monster in the basement and the rest of the house and set about determining the correct sized unit, which is very important. Then they scheduled the install for the next business day. The installers texted when they were on the way and arrived on-time at 9am and promptly got to tearing out the old furnace and installing the new one, and they had it up and running by 6pm. They were very courteous and did a great job at the install and clean-up. I retired from Port Columbus where I coordinated construction projects, so I know a good job when I see one.
I've added a picture of the Honeywell T10 Pro Wi-fi thermostat and room sensor that was installed as part of the project. Having Wi-fi access is great and the room sensor acts as a portable thermostat that can be located in any room.

reviews.text: Amazing company! Dalton was an expert installer! (his work in pics) Removed old water heater and had new unit installed within the same day! I absolutely recommend this company!

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.text:
I recently hired Eco Plumbers and felt that I paid a higher-than-average price with the expectation of receiving higher-quality work. Unfortunately, my experience didn’t match that expectation. Instead of removing the old piping and installing new lines to properly fit the new water heater, the technician retrofitted everything onto the existing setup, which led to work that didn’t look as clean or well-planned as I had hoped.

A few weeks later, I noticed my wood trim was warm to the touch because the water heater had been placed directly against the wall. When I requested a follow-up visit, the technician was argumentative about repositioning it. I even shared photos of a neighbor’s nearly identical layout where the heater fit properly, but the technician still pushed back. He eventually adjusted the unit by draining it and pushing it forward, without reworking the piping that should have been addressed initially. This left the pipes bent and angled awkwardly going into the heater. For the price I paid, I expected a more professional finish and a smoother experience.

Additionally, during installation I was told by their HVAC technician that I needed a completely new flue. However, when the city inspector arrived to approve the water heater, she informed me that a new flue was not required. This left me feeling uncertain about the guidance I received.

Overall, based on my experience, the work felt rushed and not as thorough as I expected given the cost. I hope the company takes feedback like this seriously, as quality workmanship and clear communication make a major difference for customers.

reviews.author: Andre' bradley
reviews.text:
I would rate Anthony’s performance 6 out of 5 stars.  He called ahead 30 minutes before his arrival .  He was cordial, professional and knowledgable.  His deliberate communication style and pleasant demeanor made him easy to talk and listen to.  He explained the plan using  examples that were relevant to my project.  Once the installation was complete he invited my wife and I to examine the results as he went over what he’d done and ask for any question.  He then removed the floor covering that he used to keep our floors and stairs clean, thanked and wished us well and took off.

Robert Crowder was very polite, knowledgeable and professional.  He immediately diagnosed my water heater issues with me next to him and made it easily understandable. Likewise, he laid out my options for resolving the problems he found without coming off as salesy or pushy.  No pressure whatsoever.  I was very impressed with his approach.

reviews.author: Colonel B.
reviews.text:
Water Fixers Plumbing & Filtration
2004 Preiska Lane
Santa Maria, Ca.,

Letter of recommendation:

Recently, I had the need to contact a plumbing service for a water heater problem. After an exhaustive search on the internet, I contacted the above reference company. I had no idea of what to expect with regards to the service or caliber of service. I originally thought only the worse possible experience as the water heater was new and had all the new gadgets on it with regards to the settings via the internet. Modern technology is not in my skill set.

All that being said I was surprised to find out that the company was very skilled at resolving the problem at hand. First, I anticipated a large statement for the house call on the weekend, which is a fair statement. I spoke with Christ and Linda, both of whom demonstrated a surprising amount of concern to quickly resolve my problem. Chris obtained the pertinent data about the new water heater and spoke with my wife, who understands the high tech jargon better than I. Once the data was disclosed, Chris indicated that he would call us back with a solution. This being the weekend, I figured on having a long weekend of cold showers. Albeit, a couple of hours later, Chris called back and spoke with my commanding general (wife) at the conclusion of this phone call, the heater was reset and all the lights started to reflect the proper colors. After the call we waited to see if this long distant fix would work. I am happy to say that this action worked and the heater is functioning correctly. During the course of the weekend I received several calls from Chris and Linda, following up on the call. Their follow up greatly impressed me as their attention to detail was superb. They expressed a concern to ensure that the solution was adequate and I was happy with the solution.

While I was very satisfied with the end result, the one aspect of this action was the fact that the company employees were so dedicated to follow up on their actions to accomplish the mission. The amount of time, to contact the maker of the water heater, (Rheem water heater) determines how to reset the heater on the internet is amazing. I think most companies would give you telephone number and leave the rest to the consumer. Rather than take this course, Chris took the time to call the manufacture and obtain the correct information to solve the problem and convey that message to myself and my wife. Perhaps another amazing aspect of this occurrence is the follow up that took place to ensure that the solution was effective and that the goal of correcting the discrepancy was appropriate.  

I strongly believe that the follow up action is indicative of strong leadership of management and these individuals truly support this philosophy. Their combined follow up action was not expected and I am very impressed with this company. I now have their phone number on my home speed dial for all related services by this company. It is unusual to have this level of professionalism and attention to detail in this current environment. My past experience has been one of getting someone to come out, attempt to correct the problem and present you with a large bill. With all the time spent on solving my problem, the company did not charge me for this assistance. While they did not physically travel to my home they did provide me with a great deal of time to solve the problem. They are certainly entitled to a fee for service. It is apparent to me that they place more importance to satisfying the needs of the customer. To me their professionalism and competence exceeded all expectation. I will use this company for all my future needs for their service.

EXCEPTIONAL LEADERSHIP AND DEDICATION TO SERVICE.

Sincerely,

Colonel Brazil
US Army Green Berets

reviews.author: Suzanne P.
reviews.text:
As you will see from the facts below water fixtures does not partake in ethical business practices and lack the knowledge and experience to locate a simple water leak.
All claims in this review can be verified with documents and pictures. Home serve, a Watermain warranty company, sent out water fixtures to find the leak in our Watermain. Their tech was here maybe 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours. He could not find the leak with his equipment. It is important to know that the leak was coming out of our drain pipe for the gutters and onto the street. He did not have a camera probe thing with him, which would have solved everything. I inquired about it he gave me some excuse as to why he did not have a camera. He determined we needed a new main. When we received the cost it was going to be $6443.80 total, the warranty would pay all but $1459.02 as a line would be significantly longer than the original. I received a copy of the proposal from home service and was shocked by some of the items. I will only list the ones that seem unreasonable. Number one hourly rate - $135 times 20 hours and $100 times 18 hours for the helper. I did not know digging trenches was so lucrative. Number two trench shoring, which I was informed by two contractors was not needed for $475. Number three miscellaneous parts/materials $1019.58. The two previously mentioned contractors told me that materials for that long of a main should not be more than $300 retail which contractors get wholesale price which is significantly less. That is considering they would be using the proper PVC. If they mark the materials by 30% which I believe is standard that's still only $390. 
After  receiving the proposal I inquired about which PVC they would be using I was told the thickness was .113. Schedule 40 PVC which is .95 thickness is what both of the contractors and the water company said should be used.
Back to the leak. It was found right next to the house and next to the gutter drain. I have pictures. No new line needed. Also water fixtures was searching nowhere near the actual water line up to 40 feet away from it.
As you can see from the facts above water fixers does not partake in ethical business practices and lack the knowledge, experience and equipment to locate a simple water leak. If I had not done my research I would have paid much more than what I actually paid to find the leak and repair it. I also would have had materials that are far inferior to what is needed and potentially down the road would've had more problems.

reviews.author: Seth D.
reviews.text:
They were the only company I could get to apply for the rebates for heat pump water heaters, and they did, eventually, get the water heater installed. However, there were many false starts, hiccups, and lack of attention to detail to that really soured the experience. I had 4 visits including at least 3 instances of them draining and refilling the entire water heater dumping all of the heated water away.
Visit 1: Installed water heater, drained it, refilled it, left is still leaking, didn't bring extension cord, and used extension cord I explicitly told them not to use, zip tied said extension cord, damaging the sheathing, paid no attention to cable management, leaving the cables looking significantly worse than they were when they arrived, did not insulate pipes, ran condensate pump through walls, per request, but did not fill holes with caulk or any other insulator, leaving a hole from garage to house for hot air to escape into garage.
Visit 2: Drained and refilled water heater, attempted to fix a leak, but did not fix it. Sloppily installed insulation on pipes
Visit 3: Actually Fixed Leak, pointed out several flaws with previous visits, including sloppy insulation installation, but did not have materials to fix problems
Visit 4: Drained and refilled water heater Installed and fixed some insulation, but left much of the original sloppy job. Left muddy footprints through the house to bathroom, including on carpet that was easily movable. Plugged in recirculation pump to wrong outlet causing it and the water heater to run constantly until I figured out the problem over a day later - this despite the fact that I told them explicitly what outlet it should be plugged into on a previous visit, and they gave me no indication that they were moving or unplugging any of the electrical.
Communication: There were over 40 emails exchanged, including many repeatedly asking me to take steps that I explicitly could not take because the instructions that they were reading specify that the contractor must take the action.

In the end, the water heater is installed and working, and they did appropriately apply the rebates, so I'm thankful that the work is done, but the experience was far from good.

reviews.author: Madalyn M.
reviews.text:
The owner reached out to me on 10 separate occasions via text message beginning November 1st that I update my status.

After 5 weeks of miscommunication I am satisfied with the job Victor and his worker did in my home . The little interaction that I had with Victor, he was very responsive and friendly. 

This was my original review :

 It was great communication at first to getting a water softener involved, however they were never able to follow through. My initial appointment was a no show. When I called 20 minutes after the scheduled appointment, the lady stated that I was not on the schedule . She then rescheduled me 2 weeks later. Well, they called me the evening before the second appointment and had to cancel due to staff being in the ER. They then rescheduled me 10 days later. I called 30 minutes prior to my third scheduled appointment, and she stated I was not on today's schedule . She stated they cannot come out today due to having to attend temergency gas leak. I understand emergencies happen, but keeping customers scheduled appointments is the professional and honest thing to do . It seems that they are short staff and emergencies are obviously a more priority than scheduled appointments. So now here I am five weeks later and still no water softener installed. I took the day off today for this appointment in addition to adjusting my work schedule the last two cancelled/no show appointments. VERY FRUSTRATING. 

It seems that more than one person is in charge of scheduling appointments, so maybe getting on the same page and confirming appointments 24 hours prior would be beneficial. I made the mistake of not getting anything in writing of my scheduled appointment 

The ladies who I spoke to throughout this were very apologetic and sincere. 

I would not waste your time with them.

reviews.author: Susie G.
reviews.text: We came home after a week of vacation and found that we had a hot water leak.  We contacted Water Fixers and they sent out a plumber to check out the situation.  After that we received a quote for the work to be done.  We spoke to Lynda the Office Manager a few times and she was very kind and helpful.  We also spoke to Victor, the Owner and he was very nice and professional.  Victor explained to us what needed to be done to repair our slab leak.  Fortunately the leak itself was small and had not done any damage so they did not have to rip up the floor.  They did have to cut several holes under sinks, the hot water heater and in the ceiling in our laundry room as they had to put in new water lines and reroute them into our attic and down the walls into both bathrooms and the kitchen.  We ended up having two plumbers doing the work and it took 4 days to complete the job.  The two plumbers were very nice and worked very hard to get the leak repaired and made sure to verify that the repair was done correctly and that there were no leaks when they were done.  The final bill was a bit more than the quote, but we believe that the charges were fair and we are satisfied with the work that they did.  Water Fixers also took care of the leak detection themselves, which was really convenient so we did not have to have two different companies involved.  We highly recommend Water Fixers for any plumbing job small or large.

reviews.text: The first time i used them everything was great! they changed my water pressure gauge but the guy put in backwards.. no water pressure. I called them back the owner ( at least I think it was) fixed the error. i have a water softener ( installed 2008 ) from another company.  So I called the company who installed it. They installed  ( 398.00 bucks ) new control panel bc it was leaking. OK good! two weeks later the water softener kept on running & would shut off!. I called them they send me a video do this & that! reset the gauge, water heater to low & shut the water softener off. the next morning my water tank over flowed. I call them they wanted to give me an estimate for a new water pressure, a thermo expansion tank all to cost an extra 472.79.00 buck. So I called Water Fixtures to see if that's true.. I only want to know if the Water Softener company is trying to get more money out of me. Anyway, I called made an appt they canceled last mintue Made another appt canceled again.. so I changed all MY appts & plans. still waiting to get some one over here. Then I receive a text from Home serve..it's not covered ( water softeners) I just want someone to verify if that is correct. Is the water softeners company ripping people off! I know I'll have to fork out some Benjamin's I just want it done correctly. The water softners work is still under warranty!

reviews.author: Drew M.
reviews.text: So Cal Gas had shut off our gas in the entire house due to a leak somewhere in our brick bbq.  Water Fixers was called in the late afternoon and even though it was Saturday they were able to get a plumber out the next morning.  Their excellent plumber Brian arrived on time and got right to work trying to find the leak.  It was 94 degrees outside! He traced it to the valve embedded in the brick and took out tools (power saws, jack hammers, etc) to remove the bricks to get to the valve.  After about 4 hours he had fixed the leak and I was able to call the Gas Company and to their credit showed up within an hour, pressure tested the line and determined it was AOK!  Brian, the plumber did not destroy the bricks and swept up the dust and debris leaving the area clean.  He also alerted me to another problem with the pipe bubbling up but not leaking yet.  The crew back at the main office called the insurance company the next day and got permission to replace the line.  Brian will be coming back at a future date to replace it.  Water Fixers earned every star in this rating and we will use them again.  Thanks for the great job.

reviews.author: Stephanie Adam
reviews.text: I went to pay my water bill and noticed a significant increase and panicked! I knew I had a leak on my 1/2 acre property! Home was built in the 60s, no plan’s available, no evidence where any of the water lines were actually situated. I called Water fixers and was immediately greeted with kindness and understand. I have no knowledge of plumbing terminology! Their team, from the start, were so helpful! They heard my panick and Victor and his team came out same day! Victor even stayed later on day one to investigate further. They found the leak so quickly, fixed it and even helped me contact my water company to be sure my meter was working properly! I honestly can’t thank them enough for going above and beyond to help us get this problem fixed so quickly. If you are looking for a plumbing company that understands normal people don’t know plumbing lingo, a company professional, polite, friendly, and efficient..,.  This company is for you. Big shout out to the good humans there! From he office staff, to the owner, to the plumbing technicians that assisted! You guys are great, and I’m forever grateful!

reviews.author: James Harvey
reviews.text: We contacted several water filtration companies in the area and we were disappointed with the lack of response to our questions about a complete home filtration system verses an RO system. When we contacted water fixers Lynda was very knowledgeable and responsive to our questions and sent information to us in detail to our email address for us to review and make our decision. Once we made our decision and signed the contract we scheduled an appointment. They were prompt and efficient in there work. Victor and Mike installed the system and asked question about placement of the system allowing maximum use of our under sink space. The install was done quickly and efficiently because of the experience and attention to detail of the technicians. We are working with them now on a hot water circulation system to prevent wasting water while waiting for hot water to reach the fixtures. They also provide service to systems they install and any other plumbing needs we or you may have. Based on our experience I highly recommend Water Fixers for your plumbing and filtration system needs.

reviews.author: Samuel Orozco
reviews.text:
Plumbers sometimes get a bad rap, but Victor and his team at Water Fixers in Santa Maria were absolutely outstanding. They recently installed a reverse osmosis filtration system and a pressure relief valve in our home, and the entire experience exceeded my expectations.

From the very beginning, they took the time to answer all of my questions and made thoughtful recommendations based on our household’s specific needs. It was immediately clear that he and his team are extremely knowledgeable, honest and fair. They take real pride in their work, and it shows in both their craftsmanship and professionalism.

The work was done efficiently, cleanly, and with attention to detail. I felt confident every step of the way and never felt rushed or pressured.

I am already looking forward to continuing to work with them as we replace our old water softener which has stopped working. I 100% recommend Water Fixers to anyone in need of plumbing services for their home or business. Very professional, trustworthy, and a genuinely great experience overall.

synthesis.summary: Water Fixers shows up fast — even Christmas Eve and within 30 minutes for flooding emergencies — but a detailed 1-star review flags no itemized invoices, pressure to exhaust insurance coverage, and an owner who admits breakage happens 'all the time' at customer expense.
strengths: Holiday and same-day emergency response confirmed by multiple reviewers: two separate households had water heater issues resolved on Christmas Eve 2025, and one flooding emergency was handled in under 30 minutes

Named technicians — especially Enrique, Alex, and Victor — are praised repeatedly across dozens of reviews for punctuality, technical explanations, and clean workmanship, suggesting consistent field team quality
Long-term customer retention is a real pattern: at least 5 reviewers explicitly cite 6, 10, or 10+ year relationships with the company, which is a strong trust signal
weaknesses: Scheduling reliability has cracked before: one reviewer documented three consecutive no-shows or cancellations over five weeks, with multiple staff apparently managing the schedule without coordination
Final bills exceeding quoted amounts appears in at least one detailed review of a multi-day slab leak repair, and the 1-star reviewer reports being unable to get itemized labor or parts costs at all
redFlags: One detailed 1-star review (cost: $1,000 to the customer) alleges the owner actively quotes work to consume available insurance funds, refuses to cover technician-caused breakage, and admits breakage occurs 'all the time' — specific enough to warrant asking upfront about damage liability policies before authorizing work

The 3-star scheduling review and the 1-star review both independently describe a pattern of poor internal scheduling communication, suggesting this is a structural weakness rather than a one-off incident
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: confirmed same-day response on Christmas Eve for a water heater failure, a flooding/sprinkler valve emergency resolved in under 30 minutes, and a hot water slab leak handled promptly after a homeowner returned from vacation — the company appears genuinely equipped for off-hours urgent calls.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 stars while Yelp shows 4.3 stars — a 0.6-star gap just below the threshold, but the most detailed negative reviews (billing opacity, scheduling failures, damage liability) appear on platforms other than Google, suggesting Google's rating may skew toward satisfied customers only.

reviews.text: I setup a service visit with Justin (for the first time) assuming I needed to have my toilet ring replaced to resolve a smell and to check a couple of other things.
