He recommended that I proceed with my thought of replacing a sink stopper with a simple device I found on Amazon, rather than having him do a more complicated repair on that fixture. He helped me with a quick fix on a slow draining tub. When I asked him what I owed for the visit he said nothing, not even a trip charge. Very impressive! Obviously an honest professional that really stretches to develop his client base, although he is well established. He's my plumber for future issues.

reviews.author: Mai
reviews.text:
Amazing service from Justin Jackson!

After a lack of response from our last local plumber (Culbert) in SLO, we contacted Justin Jackson's Plumbing Service in Arroyo Grande.

They came out the next day and took care of the problem right away. We strongly recommend them for any of your plumbing needs. They were professional, personable, efficient, and the price was very reasonable.

It’s so nice to have people who truly care about making the customer happy.

Justin & team, thank you so much for the top-notch care. We will be calling you again for our tankless water heater!

reviews.author: David Bernstein
reviews.text: Our whole-house water filter system sprang a leak, and we had no water.  We called them late in the afternoon, and Mike came out within 30 minutes of my call.  He quickly determined which parts needed to be replaced and replumbed.  He came back the next morning with Justin and Carson, and the system was up and running again within 90 minutes.  This is a family business, and they obviously take pride in their work.  They are not the least expensive plumbers around, but they are incredibly responsive and they do great work, which is why we are a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Joseph Timmons
reviews.text: I own a 3500SF mixed-use property in the Village of Arroyo Grande CA 93420.  My tenant said the water heater tank was leaking.  I called my regular plumber.  Un-available over the 3-day holiday weekend.  "Cold-called" Justin Jackson's Plumbing.  After a short discussion Justin went to see the situation. We wound up moving forward happily.  Longer story short: first call-800AM, paid invoice-200PM.  Justin sent photos and all VERY GOOD at a fair price.  They're a family business and I would go back to them in a heartbeat!!

reviews.author: G D
reviews.text:
Shout out to Justin Jackson’s Plumbing, who comes out in the middle of a rain storm in the very late evening and saved our house from flooding.
Justin is honest in every aspect from time of arrival to pricing for service as well as troubleshooting.
You couldn’t ask for a better plumbing service, so call them immediately for all your needs!

reviews.author: Adrienne Lent
reviews.text: Justin Jackson’s plumbing is the best company around. They are responsive, reliable and complete high quality work. We have used them for years and won’t use anyone else. Their staff are professional and always answer all of my questions. They always show up on time and send a text when they’re on their way. Great local company and people.

reviews.author: Rich
reviews.text: Justin and his dad arrived on time, thoroughly examined the problem - banging in the wall by the main water line - and recommended a solution.....get the overall development involved since it was probably a community issue. We had Justin resolve a problem back in 2021 and he was just as helpful in 2025.

reviews.author: Connie K
reviews.text: Michael fixed my kitchen sink clog issue in a very timely manner. He has come out several times during the years for various plumbing issues. Professional, trustworthy service, knowledgeable and fast response by the team. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Warren Becker
reviews.text: These folks have taken fantastic care of us over the last year.  This was an emergency issue and they were so helpful to send someone within a very short amount of time.  Job was done perfectly.  Thank you to you all.

reviews.author: Lari Ommen
reviews.text: Call to office and she was able to get me in at the time I requested. Justin was on time, efficient, and did a great job for us! He took a look at our leak and knew just what to do! We will definitely use him again.

reviews.author: Robert Diaz
reviews.text: Been using them for years in my home. Great customer service and great work. Reasonably priced (only cheaper if you do it yourself) and the work gets done right the first time. I have NEVER had to worry.

reviews.author: eatonassoc
reviews.text: Excellent experience. Everyone was pleasant and helpful, the two man crew arrived within an hour of being called (it was not an emergency) and did a great job resolving the issue. Highly recommended!

Honesty and fair dealing cited repeatedly — one reviewer recounts Justin assessing a job, recommending a cheaper DIY fix, and then charging nothing for the visit
Consistent on-time or early arrival across multiple reviews, with several repeat customers noting they exclusively use Justin Jackson for all plumbing needs
weaknesses: One reviewer explicitly noted the price 'seemed high' compared to expectations, and the pricing_fairness score of 78 is the lowest dimension — mild but consistent signal that costs can surprise first-time customers
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: reviewers document 30-minute arrival on a late Friday evening, same-day response on a holiday, a late-night rainstorm call that prevented flooding, and a 30-minute response to a clog reported after hours — this crew demonstrably answers and dispatches outside business hours.

reviews.author: John Jars
reviews.text: The manager was very helpful! He came right on time despite having a busy schedule for today. He answered all my questions and concerns. He addressed all the plumbing issues and I look forward to working with him in the future

reviews.author: Jesse Lupin
reviews.text: My air conditioner was leaking water. Tom cared for the issue with superb professionalism. He was responsive and identified the problem with his great knowledge of hvac systems. He effectively remediated the issue by adjusting the internal mechanism to drain appropriately within the unit and installed needed piping to allow the water to drain out of the unit correctly.I highly recommend this business for knowledge of plumbing and other systems and the assurance that the job will be done right.

reviews.author: Festus Mwendwa
reviews.text: This company i feel is the best service company out there. The service is fast and professional. The plumber was very good at explaining the cost and what you get for your money. The installers called to let me know they were on there way. Once they arrived they covered the floors and cleaned up everything before leaving. Also offer up to 18 months no interest and no payments. The A/C was installed in one day including enlarging the return, replacing some of the ducking, adding Carbon monoxide sensor and new top of the line Thermostat.

reviews.author: Ainsley Allen
reviews.text: Not a true Lompoc plumber—beware. This company is based in San Luis Obispo and just work in Lompoc. I clearly explained the work I needed over the phone, but when the plumber arrived, he said they don’t even offer that service. I was still charged a visit fee, even though they knew ahead of time what the job required. Total waste of time and money—I had to call a different plumber the next morning to actually get the job done. Don’t make the same mistake.

reviews.author: Empress wendy ke
reviews.text: I appreciate this company commitment to doing things the right way. I had one of their plumbers, come out and he did quality work. He was helpful and personable. We later learned he accidentally had left the washing machine drain pipe detached while running tests. We ran the machine and it flooded my sons room leaving the carpet ruined. I let this company know and Aaron reached out quickly with a hearty apology, and they replaced the carpet in the room. While that could’ve been a bad situation they were reasonable and showed their commitment to clients even when they make mistakes. I appreciate them and would recommend them to friends.

reviews.author: Job Masai
reviews.text: We had a clogged drain in the same spot for the second time in 3 years. This company fixed the problem for us for $190 a few years ago. Since the price was reasonable and they were able to complete the first time, I decided to give them the business again. Same fix this time and they charged us $385...hard to believe that they can do business like this in a tough Houston economy. Important to note that they fixed our clogged drain but I'll be doing business with another company next time.

reviews.author: Marx Carlmax
reviews.text: Rather belated post, but we had a fantastic experience with the owner of this company! He was both professional and flexible, working to find a time that would best fit my schedule. He offered a quote with a ceiling price so that there wouldn’t be surprises, and agreed to work with me in case of any changes. He and his associate came out and completed the work quickly and efficiently, and was both kind and polite. This experience was such a blessing!

reviews.author: Toxic ke
reviews.text: This company fixed my bathtub faucet that was leaking and not working properly. Another plumbing company had told me that I needed to replace the whole system. This would require going into the wall and be very costly. This company was able to fix the existing system and it works great. They were fast, courteous, and saved me from unnecessary expensive repairs. I highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Benson Kamau
reviews.text: The plumber has a throw back attitude toward customer service. If he tells you something, he means it and will follow through. He is prompt with returning messages. The soft water installation was done expertly. He answered follow up questions two weeks after the installation, taking the time to make sure I understood. I would recommend this company without question.

reviews.author: Justine
reviews.text: I have used this business several times now. The customer service is excellent and they take the time to make sure you are taken care of right. From the service call to the repair man that came out the service was amazing. I just think it's important for business to be handled in this fashion and I appreciate it thanks everyone!!

reviews.author: Hope Kienje
reviews.text: Thank you soooooo much for turning the situation (broken pipe) into a solution. I am so happy with the service, the professionalism, and thoroughness the technician took. I will and already have recommended you! If I ever need any assistance I know who is number 1 on my list to contact. Thank you once again!

reviews.author: vincent chirchir
reviews.text: Everyone was very professional and helpful. The tech done a great job explaining our AC issues and offered possible options of repair/replacement. Thank you for being so helpful! The plumber came out to complete the work with the owner and both were also professional and hardworking. Great team of workers!

reviews.author: Alvin Alvo
reviews.text: Sarah was outstanding! Her knowledge, professionalism and were beyond expectations. She took her time to properly understand our plumbing problems and provided multiple solutions. We selected this company over competitors based on her representation.

reviews.author: NICKSON NGETICH
reviews.text: Great service and very comunicive. They let me know what was happening thru the whole process. My Insurance company AHS made the process very slow. But this company stayed in touch thru the whole thing. Thank you so much guys!!!!!. Excellent service

reviews.author: Christopher Bond
reviews.text: I’ve had a lot of plumbing related issues due to having an older home, but Hope has been fantastic to work with every time. I don’t know how they hire such amazing people, but the Plumbers were great.

strengths: Exceptional responsiveness — multiple reviews cite same-day arrivals, on-time showings even during busy schedules, and one reviewer notes they stayed in contact throughout a slow insurance process

Several reviews discuss HVAC and air conditioning work rather than plumbing — scope of this business is unclear, which matters when you need a specialist for a burst pipe
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews confirm same-day response and on-time arrival, and one reviewer specifically praises resolution of a broken pipe situation — no explicit after-hours or 24/7 mentions, but the responsiveness pattern is strong enough to suggest they move quickly when called.

reviews.author: Jenene Portune
reviews.text: Prompt service. Super nice and friendly technicians Manny & Andy.

reviews.author: Veronica B.
reviews.text: If I could give this place no stars I would. Two of their workers came to our home for work to be done and we could not be in the house while they were working. I placed items a certain way in our drawers to see if they would be looked through, and sure enough when I return my things were NOT as I left them. We were very bummed since we've seen them multiple times and were very satisfied with their work.

reviews.author: S B.
reviews.text:
I am compelled to leave this review as a friendly warning to others who may want to use this plumber: 

We never had the chance to work with one of their technicians because hours before they were due to service our water heater, their office called us to demand that we put an open credit card number on file before they arrive.

In all the years that we've lived here, no other plumber or local contractor that my family has worked with has ever asked us to do this. 

We protect our privacy and our finances and we are not in the habit of giving companies open access to our credit cards. When we politely and honestly explained that to them, they refused to compromise and give us the chance to be a new customer. They explained that they don't know us and that they do this to protect their business...

 ... but this is frustrating to us because we have excellent credit, pay our bills promptly, and have a solid sense of responsibility. We even offered to them that we would literally go out to the bank to get the cash at the end of the job (right when the plumber finished) in order to protect them, but they unbelievably refused again. 

I should add that during that same call they started listing to us all that could go wrong and suggested that a $105 service call could become a $2,000+ water heater installation! 

On the surface, this may seem considerate and responsible to some Yelp readers but taken with their stubborn insistence, it all made me feel uncomfortable and slightly disrespected.

I'm not trying to ruin their reputation, but I kindly just want everyone to know what W.M. Rieck Plumbing is capable of.

reviews.author: Allie
reviews.text:
This company installed our water softener and the system leaked resin beads into our entire home. They knew the damage this causes, never told us, and claimed it was ‘fixed.’ Over the next year we had failing appliances, pressure issues, leaks, and now potential mold. They refused to acknowledge any responsibility and even charged us full price for a premature water heater replacement caused by their mistake. This is unethical and dangerous service.

*** Thank you for the reply. I will not be calling. For documentation and transparency, I prefer all communication in writing.

To clarify the situation: we have time-stamped photos of the original installation because we were excited to show our family the “upgrade.” These photos clearly show that the water softener was installed incorrectly the first time. The two connection tubes were reversed. When resin beads began leaking into our plumbing, your team returned, swapped out the softener, and reconnected the lines the only other possible way… confirming that the original installation was backwards. We had to discover this ourselves after reviewing the photos.

At no point did anyone warn us of the long-term consequences of resin beads entering a home’s plumbing system. We were told the issue was “fixed,” yet over the next year we experienced repeated leaks, failing appliances, pressure issues, and now potential mold. I have time stamped documentation of all of the above. My boyfriend even had to take a full week of vacation from his night-shift job to deal with the water heater leak that developed almost a year later… damage that directly aligns with resin bead contamination your technician never disclosed.

Because of the MAJOR installation errors, the lack of warning, and the ongoing issues we’ve had to correct ourselves, I no longer feel I can trust your company to give accurate information or handle this responsibly. That is why I am insisting on written communication only.

At this point, I need clear written answers to the following:
1.	How resin beads entered our plumbing system
2.	Whether the original installation met manufacturer specifications
3.	Why we were not informed of risks, symptoms, or what to look for after bead discharge
4.	What corrective action your company is prepared to take

I will continue communication only by email so everything can be properly documented. I look forward to your written response.

reviews.author: Beverly A.
reviews.text:
Outstanding service starting with the first hello when I called.  I have dealt so many times over the years calling other plumbing companies where no live person answers the phone, and after leaving a message it may take a day or two for a response, only to be told that they cannot respond for a day or two.  

When I called, Wm Rieck Plumbing I was told by the nice lady on the phone they could have someone out that day between 1pm and 3pm, if that was, okay?  Great news!  Then a short time later another call telling me that 'Paco finished a job early and if he could come on over.  Even greater!   I had been trying to clear the kitchen drain with over-the-counter plumbing products for days, and nothing had been working, and was fearing that the cost of calling in a plumber thinking, this could really be serious. We are seniors and my husband has serious health issues and I needed to get this rectified as soon as possible. I cannot say enough good things about Paco; he arrived, and I explained what was going on he calmed my nerves and with a smile on his face told me not to worry I'm going to fix this.  

What started out as a terrible day fearing the worst, turned out to be a wonderful encounter with an incredibly caring young man, and the invoice at the end was much less than other plumbers we have used over the years for similar work.  Thank you.

reviews.author: Craig B.
reviews.text: Had company replumb house because they said it would be done in two days only, but it took 7 days.  I told the foreman I didn't want any pipes exposed outside the house, but when connecting to the main said they couldn't connect it without running it outside.  This happened because the  foreman taking the word of a worker without assessing the original area where they cutout the sheet rock to install the pipe.  All they had to do was drill several holes, then cutout the wood with a electric saw so that the angle pipe could come in from the attic.  The original cutout area was never used.  Gave them 3 chances to install my dishwasher back in its slot the same way it was before they had removed it to install pipes, which I had told them that they had to install the pipes high, just below the count top, instead I can tell that they install the pipes in the middle, which interfered with the dishwasher from going in properly.  Also installed water valves wrong in master suite which required us to have to offset faucet and cabinet.  Would have had them come back, but threatened with divorce by wife after a 45 year marriage if I had them come back because of the stress for us they caused, so stopped all further contact,

reviews.author: Pete L.
reviews.text:
I had a pseudo-emergency last week and called numerous local plumbers, but understandably, it was Friday and would be difficult to get a tech out.  WM Rieck plumbing came through and said they could squeeze me in. 

Freddie showed up promptly that afternoon to replace a cold water supply valve to my hot water heater-I had been without hot water for over a week due to another local plumber that dragged me along all week with no resolution, so I decided to do it myself.  I was near completion and then the valve broke, putting the work to a screeching halt. 

Freddie had a professional attitude and finished his work in less than 30 minutes. My family thankfully had hot showers that evening. To boot, the price was very very reasonable and service, impeccable.

I cannot thank them enough for getting our hot water back before the weekend.

They are now my go-to plumber. As I type this, Ray, from WM Rieck Plumbing is at my home rerouting a drain pipe for me for another project, and it's looking good so far- again,  professional attitude and top/notch service.

reviews.author: Bobbie Shubeck
reviews.text: Without a doubt, this is the best plumber I've ever had.  I was looking for a plumber that's honest with some integrity and honesty.  I had Jeff Johnson, and he is super nice and honest.  I had this plumber from having another dishonest plumber all  in a three day period.  You see, I needed to bring my hot water heater up to code, like a table for it to sit on. But afterwards my hot water heater started to leaked....a lot.  So I called Jack's plumbing, and talked with Josh, told him my problem, and he sent out Jeff.  For two days I tried to get someone back out to stop the leak, from the original plumber, I could not.  Josh was so kind and sincere.  Jeff came out twice.  Jack's plumbing I promise you, you can trust them.  It's a shame that some dishonest plumbers make it hard on the honest plumbers because most of us do not know how to recognize who is honest or who is dishonest.  I'm so happy I called JACK'S PLUMBING.  Thank you guys so much.  Oh by the way, I just had my 86th birthday, and I was taken advantage of.

reviews.author: Eric C.
reviews.text: This is not a review on the plumbers or the work they do. This is a review on the lady who answered the phone today/customer service (04-13-2015 @ 1100). I asked if I could get a rough estimate of what it may cost to have the water line which is capped off behind my refrigerator hooked up for a new refrigerator that has an ice maker/water. She had an attitude that came off to me like I really don't want to speak with you right now. Anyhow, she told me it would be $76 an hour with a 1 hour minimum plus cost of whatever parts. I said have a good day and goodbye just based off of how she was talking to me. I understand we all have bad days, but you are selling a service and just lost one customer for this job. I say for this job because I have used this company before and had no issues, excellent service and work. If I call in the future and don't get the same tone/attitude I would probably use them again. If so, I will update this review at that time.

reviews.author: Ralph G.
reviews.text: I had a crisis after I snapped the plastic cartridge in my shower mixer while trying to remove and replace it.  None of the fixtures in my house have individual shut off valves so the whole house was without water until I found a plumber.   Two other plumbers recommended Wm. Rieck because Wm Rieck has a crew and can respond quickly.   The dispatcher had Leo out to my house in 4 hours.  I expected to have to re-plumb the mixer, tear out drywall, cut pipes, sweat 8 joints, etc., but Leo calmly dug the remainder of the cartridge out without damaging the brass like I would have done.  He brought the right replacement cartridge.   He was in and out in less than 2 hours and the mixer worked better than ever.  The bill was mostly for the part.   And my house was habitable again.  I really appreciate old fashioned, skilled tradespeople who come promptly to the rescue of homeowners in need.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

reviews.author: Susan Jones
reviews.text:
Our kitchen sink was clogged further than we were able to reach with our snake.  Not an emergency, but they were able to send out a technician the next day.  Mark did a fantastic job of getting the water flowing again.  When he was done, I asked him about our bathroom sink, which has had a bad odor for as long as we've lived here.  He had some good tips on how to clean it out and he ended up installing a new sink stopper assembly, which had broken a few months ago, so now it's all shiny and new.

For a DIYer, it can be hard to bite the bullet and call in the professionals, but the quality of the work (and let's face it, not having to do it yourself or watch your partner do it while you are reeled into assisting them) is worth every penny (a little over 40,000 of them 😉).

Would definitely recommend, Mark was great - professional and personable.

reviews.author: Saundra Floyd
reviews.text: Carson from Jacks All American Plumbing came over this morning to fix a leaky irrigation valve. He told me that if he did it, it would cost around $600.00 because they don’t normally do those. So he helped me find a reputable irrigation company, I called them and Carson spoke with them to let them know the problem. Carson was absolutely wonderful. Extremely knowledgeable and so kind and helpful. Each and every technician at Jack’s is as well. I’ve never had an issue with them in 10 years. They always do an excellent job, and that is why I always call Jack’s. Thank you Carson for being so kind and helpful. After Carson left, the irrigation company was here within an hour and fixed the problem without any problems. Great service and it didn’t cost anything close to $600.00.

reviews.author: Rick O.
reviews.text:
Outstanding! First of all, they answered the phone at 8:15am. I hate leaving call-back messages. They verified my water heater (installed by someone else) was out of warranty while I was on the phone. They gave me a 2 hour time window for that day which was fine. They called back around 10-11 and said someone was available could they they come now. Sure! Emmett (nice guy) came right over with the new unit and had it going in no time. Before he left I asked about my pressure regulator that I've wanted replaced. He called to verify no immediate appointments and said he'd be back in 20 minutes. 20 minutes later he was back and the new regulator was finished in no time.

Great job! Thanks! And the 10% veteran's discount didn't suck either!

synthesis.summary: Mark and the Jack's crew show up fast—even on Thanksgiving and holidays—and leave the place cleaner than they found it, though a billing dispute over a botched water heater job is a real yellow flag on pricing accountability.
strengths: Technician Mark is mentioned by name in roughly 20 of the most recent reviews, consistently praised for punctuality, clear explanations, and going beyond the job scope (e.g., cleaning sinks, replacing worn valves he spotted)
Demonstrated holiday and after-hours availability: one reviewer had a water line repaired on Thanksgiving Day, another had a water heater replaced and hot water restored same evening
Repeat customer pattern is strong—multiple reviewers explicitly note they have used Jack's two or more times and would not call anyone else
weaknesses: One detailed review describes being charged full price for a water heater replacement that was necessitated by the company's own earlier mistake, and the company refused to negotiate or offer a goodwill discount to retain the customer
redFlags: The billing dispute review describes a situation where Jack's caused damage and then charged the customer for the fix without any compromise—a meaningful accountability concern for a homeowner handing over emergency access to their home at 2am
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: same-day and after-hours responses are documented across multiple reviews, including a Thanksgiving holiday callout, a late-night water heater failure resolved the same evening, and a Thanksgiving Day car-struck water line repair—all suggesting genuine 24/7 capability.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 across 224 reviews while Yelp shows 4.3 across only 25—a 0.6-star gap that falls just below the threshold, but the Yelp sample is small enough that the billing dispute review there carries outsized weight and paints a slightly more cautious picture than Google's near-perfect score suggests.

reviews.text: Exceptional work ethic, honest, and efficient! Saved me money when I compared prices with other companies.

reviews.author: Eugene Myers
reviews.text: Thank you Carlos from pipeline plumbing. He is honest, quick, and efficient.

reviews.author: Meghan Paine
reviews.text:
Carlos always saves the day! Very in demand plumber because he's great at what he does. 10/10 recommend. 🙏

Edited to add 11/13/25: Again, SO LUCKY to have caught him, as he is in such high demand, but my parents had a huge water leak in their bathroom, like, my mom waited to tell me until later "Oh, by the way, when I was showering, water was FLOODING the bathroom..."🤦, but she waited HOURS to tell me. Carlos came over and fixed it RIGHT AWAY.

I cannot express enough the mental relief and gratitude of having a problem like that fixed asap-- I work nights, so managing their house is stressful, and caring for my parents (whom I love very very much!) is already migraine-inducing at times!🤣

If you need a plumber, this is the dude. Worth *every dollar*!

reviews.author: Kerri Tremblay
reviews.text:
We got the whole enchilada done by Pipeline Plumbing and we couldn't be any happier with the work. New pex water lines for the whole house, angle stops and shut off for water heater; new Pressure egulator. Plus repairing any drywall that had to be opened up. All that was left for us to do was paint! They did the work during our work week, it was a plus to come home and still have water to shower, do dishes etc. Seemeless and clean. Carlos and crew are nice, honest
and professional workers. Easy to communicate with and kept us regularly updated on how the job was going. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: M Hood
reviews.text: Finally found an honest plumber.  They guarantee there work and do an awesome job.  Already referred them to many neighbors and all of them will re-use them again.  They re-piped my entire house and everything was great, including the price.  I need snaking often due to old pipe lines and Carlos is there when I need him.  Thanks Pipeline :)

reviews.author: Raul Rojas
reviews.text: Carlos was prompt, responsive,  had good communication and honesty. He understood the urgency of my request and came to get the job done in less than 24 hrs. He gave me a reasonable cost and looked for ways to save me some money. I will be recommending and using him again on future projects.

reviews.author: SL Short
reviews.text: Pipeline Plumbing did excellent work on our emergency repairs. They got me on their schedule very quickly and  were able to work through the weekend to resolve the situation. Thank you to Carlos and his team for all their hard work!

reviews.author: Mel Vasquez
reviews.text: Carlos came to my mom's house and installed  a toilet on his day off. Not only did we get a fast installation by a professional plumber, we got a great price! Can't say that often. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sarrah Jones
reviews.text: Carlos was quick and professional! He checked to see what the problem was and after he was done snaking the clean out he made sure the sinks drained properly!!! Affordable price also!!!

reviews.author: AJ Evans
reviews.text: Great communication, professional attitude and knowledgeable. If your looking for an honest plumber, I recommend Carlos from Pipeline Plumbing in Lompoc CA 93436. Thank you

reviews.author: Truth Bringer
reviews.text: Carlos is my go to plumber! He is fast and efficient, super nice guy! He always saves the day, no matter what it is. Thankyou for all your hard work!

reviews.author: Ginger Sweep
reviews.text: Patriot plumbing was very professional from the start. Quick response time and friendly. Will certainly be using them again for future plumbing needs. Appreciated the thorough communications and photo of the technician who was arriving.

reviews.author: Luke Bender
reviews.text: Patriot Plumbing is fantastic! Jacob, the owner, helped us fix our water heater and did an amazing job. He diagnosed the issue right away and had it fixed quickly, and we haven’t had a single problem since. Communication was great throughout the whole process, and you can tell he takes pride in doing the job right. Highly recommend Patriot Plumbing if you want fast, reliable, and professional service!

reviews.author: Artemis Artemis
reviews.text: Professional, exceptional work, respect your property while working.

reviews.author: Bonnie G
reviews.text:
I thought I could fix my own outdoor hose bibb on Labor Day, after watching a few Youtube videos, but I only made the leak worse. I submitted a contact request via the Patriot Plumbing and Drain Cleaning website on Labor Day and Jacob responded in less than 10 minutes. I was amazed at the quick response on a holiday. They were able to schedule me for Wed morning. Chad texted me 15 minutes prior to arriving. Chad was on time, professional and definitely knew a lot more about plumbing than the Youtube videos. There was more to the job than I anticipated.  They charged me a very fair price for the job. I have lived in town for 31 years, and have hired a few other local plumbers, but none compare to the professionalism and integrity as
Patriot Plumbing and Drain Cleaning. I highly recommend
Patriot Plumbing and Drain Cleaning. I sure won't be calling the other local guys next time I need a plumber. I found the best in the county!

reviews.author: Lindsey Cox
reviews.text: Noah from Patriot Plumbing did an excellent job replacing five sink faucets, an instant hot water unit, two shower heads, a new hand held shower wand with a bar, and a day of additional water heater replacement.  He gave me a detailed estimate prior to starting and was extremely efficient the entire day!  He was polite, respectful, professional and performed quality work, while being patient with my questions, especially with the placement of the bar in the shower.  I had a question the following day.  Even though he clearly explained why it was a manufacturing cosmetic design issue, he went above and beyond to visit the retail store for their explanation, sent me a photo of the display model and then called me back.  I am extremely pleased with the service provided from start to finish and will absolutely be using Patriot Plumbing in the future!  Thank you!

reviews.author: Harry James
reviews.text: Nate and Aiden were Able  To respond earlier than scheduled. Which worked out well sense our water was turned off. I had cleaned out and away the dirt mud in preparation for them so that they could get to it quickly. Thus, saving some time and money on my part. Nate explained And showed me the parts that he would be utilizing to repair the water leak on my side of the water meter. They had the job done within 15 minutes another 10 minutes for the glue /cement to dry, And then turned on my water. He showed me how to read the meter and the small diamond that Turns in a circle when the water is running and that it does not turn in a circle if the water is off and there aren’t any leaks. Very professional and friendly. I would strongly recommend them.

reviews.author: joan nagano
reviews.text: Jacob, the owner of Patriot Plumbing, was very communicative and knowledgeable in recommending different options to solve our clogged tub drain at my mother's home. He sent  Noah and a fellow plumber, who arrived punctually to do the job. They worked well together to successfully snake and unclog the old, narrow drain pipe without damaging it.  An earlier attempt to rotor this problem drain by a different plumber hadn’t worked, so we are very relieved and pleased to have found capable Patriot Plumbing. Thank you, Jacob and your crew - you’re now our go-to plumbers in SLO!

reviews.author: Neeta Birdsall
reviews.text: Jacob was quick to respond to a problem that’s been on going even with the help of another plumber we’ve relied on for the past 30 years. He’s patient to hear me out, quick to respond and then takes more time to explain the problem to me and the solution he thinks is best. He”s honest and in fact, I found him from many of my friends recommending him with the word”honest” coming up repeatedly to describe him. He’s going to do it right the first time and he just became our new plumber.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Tilligkeit
reviews.text:
Emergency stoppage situation on our main service line on a Sunday morning! Jacob answered the phone right away and Noah was out here and cleared the issue within an hour. Noah shared some great knowledge about how to deal with roots. Fantastic service- new go-to plumbers FOR SURE.

Update! We’ve used Patriot two to three more times for various plumbing adventures and they’ve been responsive, knowledgeable, friendly, and just an overall awesome company. We appreciate them so much!

reviews.author: Gloria Nocito DeGeorge
reviews.text: I had a leak in my garage ceiling.  I called Jacob and explained my problem.  He had a service man out to my house in less than 1 hour. Jacob found there was a leak in my fire sprinkler in the garage ceiling so he gave me the phone number for the fire sprinkler repair people and a guy that does sheetrock repairs because the sheetrock was soaked. ABSOLUTELY THE BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE we have encountered in our 17 years of owning a vacation home in Pismo Beach.

reviews.author: Leslie McKinley
reviews.text: From the phone call to timeliness to service - this company gets TEN stars from me!  Jacob was super when I talked with him on the phone, they texted me when the plumber was on his way and the best part was Leo, the fabulous guy who came out on a Sunday night, calmed my fears, walked me through the process and worked quickly and efficiently.  Patriot Plumbing is Amazing, thank you all❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: Jeff Andrews
reviews.text: I will be calling Patriot Plumbing for all my future plumbing needs. All my drains were slow and my toilet and bathroom sink drain needed to be repaired. Jacob took my call in an efficient and courteous manner, and provided quotes on the phone. Leo made it out to my house in less than an hour on a Friday afternoon and he was quick and knowledgeable in his work. 10/10 service.

reviews.author: Shahrad Teimouri
reviews.text:
We’ve worked with Patriot Plumbing on multiple occasions, from small fixes to large projects, and they are truly the best around. Their workmanship, professionalism, and integrity are outstanding. You can always trust them to get the job done right—and to exceed your expectations. Noah is informative, honest, hard working and professional.
10 out of 10 🙏

And of course it was fixed properly.
Thank~you so much for easing our minds guys.

He not only did the job well, he explained details to us as he worked. I would highly recommend Patriot Plumbing and Drainncleaning.

Would recommend them.  They have also done water pipe fixes also, same day.  I  have yet to meet one of their techs that is not professional and smiling the whole time!!!

reviews.author: Ellen Thermos
reviews.text: We had one toilet that we could not clear. They fit us in the very day we called. It was an easy fix and the plumber they sent out was very professional. We were grateful for the fast service. We know many happy customers that also use Rieck Plumbing.

reviews.author: jimmy garzin
reviews.text: I had a bad experience with WM Rieck Plumbing co, the plumbers behavior was rude and EXTREMELY unprofessional. I would NOT recommend them.  Honestly was in shock and disbelief at how unprofessional some people can be!:(

reviews.author: Veronica B.
reviews.text: If I could give this place no stars I would. Two of their workers came to our home for work to be done and we could not be in the house while they were working. I placed items a certain way in our drawers to see if they would be looked through, and sure enough when I return my things were NOT as I left them. We were very bummed since we've seen them multiple times and were very satisfied with their work.

reviews.author: Sam Razo
reviews.text:
This is a locally owned family business. Joey, one of the owners, was very friendly and easy to talk to. They are competitively priced. In fact, when talking to the owner, you don't feel like they're trying to nickel and dime you out of your money. On several occasions, to my surprise, Joey talked me out of unnecessary repairs, even though it would have meant more money for their business.

We had the sewer lines and supply lines replaced and re-piped. This is a big labor intensive job. I called around to four other plumbing companies for estimates and Rieck Plumbing offered the best prices, by far. Shockingly, most plumbing businesses won't be bothered to do this kind of work because there's more money to be made doing simple service calls and less hassle.

To be critical, I would have to include that Rieck Plumbing's biggest weakness would have to be poor communication. This project would take several weeks. On many occasions, I didn't know if I should expect plumbers to show up that day or not because one of the phases had been completed. Also, we were never given an option to choose between copper and PEX pipes. It was assumed that we wanted PEX because we showed concern over the overall cost. You will need to be proactive in asking questions, getting clarification, and letting them know what your preferences are. The good thing is, their staff is more than happy to answer questions and they don't make you feel like you are burdening them with your inquiries. Also, I wish they would have installed the PEX lines more thoughtfully . Perhaps higher up where they would be out of the way for future projects that involve accessing my attic.

It's worth mentioning, that the plumbers working in my house, Nick and Jose, were completely professional and trustworthy. They weren't snooping around the house or taking things that didn't belong to them. *Cough* Oliveira's *Cough*

Overall, I would recommend Rieck Plumbing. They are competent, hard working plumbers. They're reasonably priced. Over the years, I've used many different local plumbers.

reviews.author: S B.
reviews.text:
I am compelled to leave this review as a friendly warning to others who may want to use this plumber: 

We never had the chance to work with one of their technicians because hours before they were due to service our water heater, their office called us to demand that we put an open credit card number on file before they arrive.

In all the years that we've lived here, no other plumber or local contractor that my family has worked with has ever asked us to do this. 

We protect our privacy and our finances and we are not in the habit of giving companies open access to our credit cards. When we politely and honestly explained that to them, they refused to compromise and give us the chance to be a new customer. They explained that they don't know us and that they do this to protect their business...

 ... but this is frustrating to us because we have excellent credit, pay our bills promptly, and have a solid sense of responsibility. We even offered to them that we would literally go out to the bank to get the cash at the end of the job (right when the plumber finished) in order to protect them, but they unbelievably refused again. 

I should add that during that same call they started listing to us all that could go wrong and suggested that a $105 service call could become a $2,000+ water heater installation! 

On the surface, this may seem considerate and responsible to some Yelp readers but taken with their stubborn insistence, it all made me feel uncomfortable and slightly disrespected.

I'm not trying to ruin their reputation, but I kindly just want everyone to know what W.M. Rieck Plumbing is capable of.

reviews.author: Beverly A.
reviews.text:
Outstanding service starting with the first hello when I called.  I have dealt so many times over the years calling other plumbing companies where no live person answers the phone, and after leaving a message it may take a day or two for a response, only to be told that they cannot respond for a day or two.  

When I called, Wm Rieck Plumbing I was told by the nice lady on the phone they could have someone out that day between 1pm and 3pm, if that was, okay?  Great news!  Then a short time later another call telling me that 'Paco finished a job early and if he could come on over.  Even greater!   I had been trying to clear the kitchen drain with over-the-counter plumbing products for days, and nothing had been working, and was fearing that the cost of calling in a plumber thinking, this could really be serious. We are seniors and my husband has serious health issues and I needed to get this rectified as soon as possible. I cannot say enough good things about Paco; he arrived, and I explained what was going on he calmed my nerves and with a smile on his face told me not to worry I'm going to fix this.  

What started out as a terrible day fearing the worst, turned out to be a wonderful encounter with an incredibly caring young man, and the invoice at the end was much less than other plumbers we have used over the years for similar work.  Thank you.

reviews.author: Craig B.
reviews.text: Had company replumb house because they said it would be done in two days only, but it took 7 days.  I told the foreman I didn't want any pipes exposed outside the house, but when connecting to the main said they couldn't connect it without running it outside.  This happened because the  foreman taking the word of a worker without assessing the original area where they cutout the sheet rock to install the pipe.  All they had to do was drill several holes, then cutout the wood with a electric saw so that the angle pipe could come in from the attic.  The original cutout area was never used.  Gave them 3 chances to install my dishwasher back in its slot the same way it was before they had removed it to install pipes, which I had told them that they had to install the pipes high, just below the count top, instead I can tell that they install the pipes in the middle, which interfered with the dishwasher from going in properly.  Also installed water valves wrong in master suite which required us to have to offset faucet and cabinet.  Would have had them come back, but threatened with divorce by wife after a 45 year marriage if I had them come back because of the stress for us they caused, so stopped all further contact,

reviews.author: Pete L.
reviews.text:
I had a pseudo-emergency last week and called numerous local plumbers, but understandably, it was Friday and would be difficult to get a tech out.  WM Rieck plumbing came through and said they could squeeze me in. 

Freddie showed up promptly that afternoon to replace a cold water supply valve to my hot water heater-I had been without hot water for over a week due to another local plumber that dragged me along all week with no resolution, so I decided to do it myself.  I was near completion and then the valve broke, putting the work to a screeching halt. 

Freddie had a professional attitude and finished his work in less than 30 minutes. My family thankfully had hot showers that evening. To boot, the price was very very reasonable and service, impeccable.

I cannot thank them enough for getting our hot water back before the weekend.

They are now my go-to plumber. As I type this, Ray, from WM Rieck Plumbing is at my home rerouting a drain pipe for me for another project, and it's looking good so far- again,  professional attitude and top/notch service.

reviews.author: Eric C.
reviews.text: This is not a review on the plumbers or the work they do. This is a review on the lady who answered the phone today/customer service (04-13-2015 @ 1100). I asked if I could get a rough estimate of what it may cost to have the water line which is capped off behind my refrigerator hooked up for a new refrigerator that has an ice maker/water. She had an attitude that came off to me like I really don't want to speak with you right now. Anyhow, she told me it would be $76 an hour with a 1 hour minimum plus cost of whatever parts. I said have a good day and goodbye just based off of how she was talking to me. I understand we all have bad days, but you are selling a service and just lost one customer for this job. I say for this job because I have used this company before and had no issues, excellent service and work. If I call in the future and don't get the same tone/attitude I would probably use them again. If so, I will update this review at that time.

reviews.author: Ralph G.
reviews.text: I had a crisis after I snapped the plastic cartridge in my shower mixer while trying to remove and replace it.  None of the fixtures in my house have individual shut off valves so the whole house was without water until I found a plumber.   Two other plumbers recommended Wm. Rieck because Wm Rieck has a crew and can respond quickly.   The dispatcher had Leo out to my house in 4 hours.  I expected to have to re-plumb the mixer, tear out drywall, cut pipes, sweat 8 joints, etc., but Leo calmly dug the remainder of the cartridge out without damaging the brass like I would have done.  He brought the right replacement cartridge.   He was in and out in less than 2 hours and the mixer worked better than ever.  The bill was mostly for the part.   And my house was habitable again.  I really appreciate old fashioned, skilled tradespeople who come promptly to the rescue of homeowners in need.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

reviews.author: Rick O.
reviews.text:
Outstanding! First of all, they answered the phone at 8:15am. I hate leaving call-back messages. They verified my water heater (installed by someone else) was out of warranty while I was on the phone. They gave me a 2 hour time window for that day which was fine. They called back around 10-11 and said someone was available could they they come now. Sure! Emmett (nice guy) came right over with the new unit and had it going in no time. Before he left I asked about my pressure regulator that I've wanted replaced. He called to verify no immediate appointments and said he'd be back in 20 minutes. 20 minutes later he was back and the new regulator was finished in no time.

Great job! Thanks! And the 10% veteran's discount didn't suck either!

reviews.author: Esequiel Moreno
reviews.text: I called for a plumber to repair a pipe leak. Although they were booked for the day, they were able to squeeze us in for the repair. We were given a time window. Leo showed up precisely within the time window. He was friendly and greeted us with a smile. I explained the reason for the call, showed him where the pipe was and he immediately went to work. Within a few minutes he had the pipe repaired and water service back on. Leo wasted no time. He was fast, friendly and efficient (bi-lingual as well)!  The cost for a service call was less than most other licensed companies.  I can’t say enough about this plumbing company. To say I recommend them is an understatement. Blake and Barbara, thank you once again for a job well done!!

reviews.author: Sarah Pauley
reviews.text: Our family recently needed our water heater (and some gas line) replaced, and we received amazing customer service from  WM Rieck Plumbing. From the initial call to inquire about a quote, to the detailed quote after they checked out the property, and during the skilled plumbing work to replace the water heater and gas line (and a few other pipes/fixtures), we were shown amazing professionalism, kindness (I had some wild kids running around and asking our plumber questions), and top-notch skill & know-how. I would absolutely hire them again for any future plumbing needs.

synthesis.summary: Same-day dispatch and skilled tradespeople who talk you out of unnecessary repairs, but communication gaps on multi-day jobs and a rigid credit-card-on-file policy have cost them customers before the first visit.

Technicians consistently described as honest and non-upselling, with at least two reviewers noting Joey actively talked them out of work that would have made the company more money
weaknesses: Communication on multi-week or multi-phase projects is poor — one detailed review describes repeatedly not knowing whether plumbers would show up, and no proactive updates on scheduling

A 2018 review alleged workers searched through personal drawers while unsupervised, and the December 2024 one-star review cites 'extremely unprofessional' plumber behavior with no specifics — two separate conduct complaints across the review window
redFlags: The credit-card-on-file policy has already driven away at least one prospective customer before any work began, and the accompanying call listing worst-case costs struck that reviewer as pressure tactics — worth asking about payment terms upfront
One 2018 review specifically claims workers went through personal belongings while homeowners were absent; while isolated, it is worth noting if you cannot be home during service
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews confirm same-day service even for true emergencies — a whole-house water shutoff crisis was resolved within 4 hours, and a faulty water heater was swapped in under 90 minutes; two other plumbers in one review actively recommended Rieck precisely because they have a crew and can respond quickly.

David is a real warrior.   My sink suddenly got clogged,  do I poured a drain cleaner in and thought that would fix my issue.  Instead of the sink draining out, water started filling in.   David arrived a  little after 1pm and continued working for around 4 hours.  He wouldn't give up.  He snaked the drain probably 5-6 times before it fully opened/unclog. Thank you David for all the hard work you did and for not being upset when my dog occasionally came by you to watch the progress.

reviews.author: Pamela M.
reviews.text: During a holiday week when what can go wrong, will go wrong; our water heater decided it didn't want to work properly anymore. I called Coast, and even though they didn't have a technician working, Aaron Wright THE OWNER came out to diagnose the issue, grab the parts from the shop and fixed the broken part of the heating element. Talk about service, professionalism and class! The Wrights know how to treat their clients and go above and beyond when others wouldn't. Coast Plumbing should be your plumbing solutions for any size job!

reviews.author: William Malloy
reviews.text: Excellent service by David! He was friendly, courteous and professional! The work was done on a timely basis and well!

reviews.author: Martin H.
reviews.text:
I had Coast Plumbing do a simple job recently.
I don't want to get into all the details but what I will say is that they are very over priced.  You may want to get a few estimates before going with Coast.  I had no issue with the quality of the work performed.... The cost was absurd though.

reviews.author: Oarlie H.
reviews.text:
Jerry that works for Coast Plumbing lied to me. He said I needed a $3000 water heater and I had my friend come to look at the water heater.
i told him I'm not paying that much money. My son talked to him on the phone and told to him leave my house.  My son told me to go to Home Depot.  I went to Home Depot bought a water heater for 795.  and We came back and found out nothing was wrong with my original water heater. So as far I'm concerned they tried to rip me off.  I'm out $795 for a new water heater that I didn't need.  Be warned.











s

reviews.author: Tom L.
reviews.text:
I've lived on the Central Coast for 12 years now and it's heaven on earth. The biggest disadvantage of living here is that handymen, plumbers, electricians, locksmiths, gate and HVAC repairmen are few and far between where I am, and those who are here are frequently unreliable or otherwise dysfunctional.

Despite the fact that I pay promptly and I am courteous to all, there is just something about local service people in our area. I have been ghosted by people who've done work for me, can't get calls returned, or I'm told that someone can't be over here "until we happen to be in your area" which, in some cases, can be weeks.

That's why I'm thrilled to tell you of my great experiences with Coast Plumbing Solutions. Junior is top-notch. Knows his stuff. He's available on relatively short notice. Always shows up on time. Charges fairly. Takes credit cards. Follows up. These seem like reasonable expectations, but Coast Plumbing Solutions is truly a rare bird around here.

If you're like me, constantly looking for recommendations for service pros on the Central Coast, only to be disappointed time and time again (I'm looking at YOU, DL Electric!), you will absolutely LOVE Coast Plumbing Solutions.

reviews.author: Jayraj Laxman
reviews.text:
I recently had a Rinnai tankless water heater installed by Coast Plumbing Solutions, and the service was excellent from start to finish.

After requesting quotes from several local companies, Coast was the first to respond—not with an automated text, but with a personal phone call. The owner, Katie, was incredibly polite and took the time to answer all my questions thoroughly. She quickly scheduled a site inspection to accurately assess the job. Their technician, Wallace, arrived for the inspection and was both respectful and thorough. Shortly after, they provided a very reasonable quote that clearly outlined the scope of work.

On the day of installation, Wallace arrived promptly after calling ahead. He was professional and did an immaculate job with the installation and the removal of our old unit. Before leaving, he tested the system and ensured I understood all of its features.

For the past two months, my family and I have had consistent hot water ever since the installation. We will definitely be contacting Coast Plumbing Solutions for any future needs and highly recommend them to friends and neighbors in the area!

reviews.author: Jonathan A.
reviews.text: Called coast plumbing to fix the water line going from my kitchen sink to the refrigerator water dispenser and ice maker. They came out promptly and on time. Where I have a problem is when Mario gave me the estimate it was for $420. I've gotten estimates before and usually they give you an estimate on worst case scenario and if it is significantly less work, most companies will not charge you the full estimate. From the moment he showed up and looked at everything and then having to run to the store and get parts and then come back and fix it was less than an hour (total work took him about 15 minutes). When I asked if it was still going to be $420 he said "yes that is how an estimate works." I was pretty disappointed and feel ripped off. I will not be using or recommending coast plumbing from now on. Talking to a few other people after the fact, they told me that their prices are extremely high. Save money and go with another plumbing company.

reviews.author: MIke C.
reviews.text:
I called Coast on the recommendation of a neighbor who used them on the recommendation of another neighbor.  Always a good sign when there is positive word of mouth.
As mentioned in another review,  service workers in SYV are very hard to schedule. Same for dog groomers, gardners, etc.  Often calls go unreturned.

The experience with Coast started right from the initial call.  Someone actually answered the phone.  The scheduler took my info, was polite and efficient.  I received a text confirming my appointment.  Very professional.

JR showed up on time and was friendly, knowledgeable and installed our faucet.  He even did a chemical check on our water and gave us info on various water filtration systems.  

The chaerge was higher than my experience with plumbers in Orange County where we moved from, but seems on par with prices here in God's Country.

reviews.author: Jeff H.
reviews.text: Wow.  These guys are on it!  I wish we had service like this in LA.  You call them up and they treat you like a long lost friend. They schedule appointments with precision and they are reasonable two hour windows! Tiffany takes charge and sends you an intro to your service person before they arrive with a picture.  Our tech, Jose, was neat, well groomed and friendly.  He assessed the situation gave us our options.  We discussed a replacement of our current water heater and when we decided to go for it -- he was able to replace it right then.  He told us it would take 3 hours and it did!  He reminded us we had six years warranty.  So easy and so efficient.  For other companies we've called they always show at the very end (or after) the window, for these guys they were spot on!

reviews.author: Carol S.
reviews.text: Thank you Mark for all of your hard work on the tub to shower remodel.  Your customer service went above and beyond what has unfortunately become common place in our society.  You kept me in the loop being distant from the job and you made sure Jack was happy with as well.  I cannot say enough how much we appreciate you Mark.  As well, I would like to thank the owner Katie and all of our phone conversations, pictures and emails back and forth.  There were some complications due to damage product sent at no fault of Coast Plumbing Solutions but, Katie made sure to make things right and was sincerely concerned about the job completed to our expectations.  If you are looking for a top notch company and a hard working employee I recommend Coast Plumbing Solutions 100%.

reviews.author: Shortcake Redberry
reviews.text: I work for a fairly large plumbing company in the Northern California area and needed some help with changing out a water heater on a multi family project we did over a year ago, with a water heater that wasn’t working properly. So we initially hired another company to do the work. They failed us miserably. And after 3 days of not getting the job done I had reached out to Coast Plumbing for help. Charlene jumped through hoops and rearranged their schedule to accommodate us and make it happen that day. The customer service was impeccable. And the technicians, David and Jose were constantly keeping us in the loop as to the status of their work. We will absolutely use them again for any out of town needs.

reviews.author: Angie G.
reviews.text:
I've used Coast Plumbing for quite a few years now and am very pleased with them. Mark and Carlos were here recently and, as always, they arrived on time, were pleasant and competent. They always provide an estimate before proceeding, are always clean and courteous and observe Covid protocols. Tiffany is great about scheduling and making sure that everyone in the household as well as her team is well before appointments. When Mark installed a new faucet for me, he even touched up the grout around the installation. I highly recommend Coast Plumbing Solutions. I've used plumbers who charge less but the work wasn't as professional. 

Angie G

reviews.author: Rob B.
reviews.text: I've been putting off calling a plumber for a whistle in my toilet when I flush.  I knew it likely needed new guts (valve and flapper) after 12 years.  I picked Coast because of good Yelp reviews.  I scheduled a same-day appointment right on their website, received a text confirmation within 1/2 hour, and Jerry showed up right on time.  The repair was a bit more than I expected, but he was polite, knowledgeable, wore booties without being asked, and neat.  And, hey, it is Santa Barbara.  He fixed it in about 1/2 hour, and I expect it to last another 12 years. Coast is now my Plumber of Choice.

reviews.author: Ann Kardel
reviews.text: My lever that diverts the water from my bathtub to my shower broke off. Charlene , the office manager, took all my information and did some legwork for me. She found out the Moen stands behind their work for a lifetime if still the original owner and has not been tampered with. Charlene got it taken care of. Moen is sending the  new faucet to my house in 7. - 10 days. Then Coast Plumbing Solutions will come and install it! Thank you!!!! You guys went over above! I glad I didn’t have to pay for the new faucet! Thank you Charlene again!

synthesis.summary: Owner has personally driven to jobs on holiday weekends when no techs were available, and multiple reviews cite same-day or two-hour water heater turnarounds — but two reviewers flagged pricing as 'absurd' or significantly over competing quotes.
strengths: Same-day or rapid emergency response documented at least 5 times in recent reviews, including a tankless water heater fix within two hours and a same-day water heater replacement on a holiday weekend
Multiple technicians (David, Wallace, Jose, Isaac, Matt, Julio) each receive individual praise, suggesting consistent quality across the team rather than one standout employee carrying the company

Office staff and owners actively involved in problem-solving — Charlene coordinated a Moen warranty claim unprompted, Katie dispatched immediately after understanding the situation, and owner Aaron came out personally on a holiday when no techs were available
weaknesses: Pricing complaints appear in at least 3 of 110 analyzed reviews, with one customer calling costs 'absurd' for a simple job and another noting water heater replacement was 'quite high compared to others' — though both still rated workmanship positively

One 1-star review alleges a technician (Jerry) recommended a $3,000 water heater replacement when none was needed — the customer purchased a $795 unit from Home Depot instead and found the original was functional
redFlags: One review explicitly accuses a named technician of misdiagnosing a water heater to upsell a $3,000 replacement; while this is a single incident across 110 reviews, it is a serious allegation worth noting for high-ticket emergency calls
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: owner personally responded on a holiday week when no techs were on duty, at least two reviews cite response within two hours for water heater failures, and multiple reviews document same-day service on weekends and late-night calls — this company appears genuinely available and responsive at off-hours.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 across 446 reviews while Yelp shows 4.5 across 30 — a modest 0.4-star gap that does not indicate a serious discrepancy, and no BBB complaints have been filed in the past three years despite non-accreditation.
