plumbers.name: Lewis Plumbing
plumbers.address: 113 W Mission St, Santa Barbara, CA 93101, USA

reviews.author: CARLOS LOPEZ-HOLLIS
reviews.text: These guys are highly efficient and incredibly helpful. George was an absolute delight to work with. True pro. Highly recommend this local outfit.

reviews.author: Janine Jones
reviews.text: We had the best experience with Jesus!   He came to do a shower repair after another plumber (from another company) ghosted us and didn’t complete the job.  Jesus figured out the solution within a few minutes and did the complete repair within a few hours.  We also asked for his expertise on a few other issues that we were concerned about and he solved them all.  We have peace of mind knowing that Jesus had the issues covered.  To top it all off, we received a call from the Lewis Plumbing office staff the next day to confirm that everything was working properly. We now have our permanent plumbing service for our home.  No one else compares!

reviews.author: Janine Jones
reviews.text: We had the best experience with Jesus!  He was the ultimate professional. He came to do one job that another plumber (from another company) started but failed to complete. Jesus worked his magic and had a solution completed within a few hours.  He also solved 3 other issues that we were experiencing without hesitation. Jesus figured out the root of the plumbing problems.  It was so worth the money to have peace of mind knowing that Jesus had it all covered.  To top off this “best in class” service, the office staff at Lewis Plumbing called us the next day to make sure everything was working properly.   We now have our permanent plumbing company for our home.  No others can compare!

reviews.author: Robert E.
reviews.text: The only reason I'm yelping is because after I talked to my insurance company I found out the office fabricated some B.S. About the first "schedualed" appointment. After a five hour window my wife called THEM to find out why we hadn't heard from them. She was told they were going to be about a half hour late (outside a FIVE hour window).....so she rescheduled. Then they call toward the end of the next five hour window (at least they called this time) but I told him not to bother since it was now so late (the work was not an emergency and I didn't want it going into the night).  I call my insurance to get someone else (who can read a clock and budget time) and they call woolly who lies and says that on the first appointment they were turned away (after THEY called) because it would be an "inconvenience ". This company is not reliable and now I think DISSREPUTABLE. They obviously care little about customer service and more about how many customers they can cram into a five hour time frame, in an effort to steer as many insurance claims their way as possible. Go with someone with integrity.

reviews.author: Kristie D.
reviews.text: Don't use this company!!!! Our experience is very similar to many others posted. They were sent by our home warranty. These fools are the most unreliable, terribly rude and unhelpful company we've ever dealt with! One problem after another. The guy came multiple times to fix our hot water heater and never did a thing but complain and waste our time. Left our family of 5 without hot water for 2 weeks, stringing us along due to their poor scheduling and lack of communication. Another company was finally called today. The technician was at our house in 2 hours. He assessed the situation, promptly gave report to the home warranty and is returning tomorrow to install a new device. Learn from our mistake. Dump Wooley Plumbing immediately.

reviews.author: Mark H.
reviews.text: Had a similar experience to several of the other posters. Home warranty sent them to us for a leak at one of our rentals. They didn't respond to the inquiry for a few of days (you are supposed to get a call within 48 hours) so I gave them a call. They told me it would take them a week to get out because they were busy and had a truck break down. When they finally arrived, they identified that the leak was in our irrigation, which is not covered by home warranty. Stupidly, I asked them if I could pay them to fix it outside the home warranty coverage since they were already there. They told me yes, so I paid them and left. Our tenant told us the next day that it was still leaking. Despite leaving several messages, sending an email and filling out a form on their website, it took them another week to call me back. They said they were sure their work was good but they would come back out anyways... but could not make it out for two more weeks because they were busy and a truck was broken down. Sound familiar? That was exactly what they said almost three weeks earlier when I placed the original inquiry... They came out, said the ground was saturated and that there was nothing they could do at the moment. Due to the continued leaking, we had turned off the valve to the irrigation and were only turning it on as necessary to water the lawn and plants. Our tenant told us that morning that he had the valve shut off. When our tennant arrived home, the backyard was flooded and the valve was open. Sick of dealing with this company, I called a landscaper and they fixed the problem in about an hour for 25% of what Wooley charged me. They also told me that the plumbers had made a mistake in their repair and that the work was poor. I left a message to tell the owner that I was frustrated. I was on the other line when they called back but they left me one of the rudest messages I have ever received from a company I have paid to work on one of our houses. I wish there was a way to upload it to Yelp. They claimed that they fixed the leak, that there was another leak that was causing the flooding, that they did not turn on the valve, that the flooding was not their fault, that they are not "irrigation men" and that this is not something they normally do and that they did what we paid them to do... ending the call with "PERIOD" and an abrupt hangup. Zero accountability... nothing is ever their fault... If this was out of their realm, fair enough, but you tell someone that before they pay you and you agree to do the work. Also, I heard from a friend that they had a similarly terrible experience with Wooley Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jonathan S.
reviews.text:
I've had Wooley Plumbing out a few times (each time a different issue) since buying a home in Lompoc in 2012. I was initially put on to them by my home warranty company and have continued to rely on their outstanding service since discontinuing my home warranty plan.

Initially, the home warranty company put me in contact with 3 different local plumbing companies regarding a leaky pipe in my master bath: The first company was unwilling to help me in a timely manner because I was "not replacing the water heater." They told me that they prioritize water heaters and would get to "as soon as they could." After over a week and 2 cancelled appointments, I called my home warranty company and requested a different plumber.  The second company did not even respond to my calls at all. The third company, Wooley Plumbing, was prompt, scheduled an appointment for the following day, and fixed the problem very quickly. That has been my experience with Wooley Pumbing each and every time I've had them out. Can't recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Christina C.
reviews.text: Never use this plumber, my insurance sent them out to do a job. I asked about some work I was looking to hire someone for. After I explained to them not to touch a value because last year it cost me $500 to have someone come out and fix it I messed it up. It's like a secondary shutoff they decided to turn it anyway. Later that night I noticed the same result. I called left a message and got a call back in the morning, I asked that someone come out and fix the problem but I guess it was about the money. No one could give me an estimate on time because he had other jobs to do. Wow, sir thanks for not coming out I feel that you have no integrity. If someone tells you don't touch something DO NOT touch it. Now I have to pay out of pocket to have another plumber come out and fix the problem. We are RETIRED soldiers how dare you as an AMERICAN cheat anyone. Especially someone willing to hire you because an insurance company recommended you. May GOD bless you.

reviews.author: Mary R.
reviews.text: We moved into our house several months ago and the house was just at that age where somethings were starting to go. We had a hot water heater that the pilot light kept going out on, we had a leaking garbage disposal and the water pressure in the house wasn't that great. Thank goodnessand Wally's plumbing contracted with our home warranty. Walter came out with two other gentle men all very polite very businesslike kept us informed and fixed all three of our problems. They informed us that we did not need a blanket around that hot water heater it was smothering the light, we did need a new water pressure regulator and a new garbage disposal.  We live in Paso Robles and that is the furthest north they go and we are so thankful that they do we will give them all our plumbing business.  We highly recommend woollies plumbing!

reviews.author: Katya C.
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Dino and Wooley Plumbing, both of whom took care of me despite a very bad home owner's insurance policy. Basically the policy covered little more than the water heater and a very basic fee for the work. Dino went out of his way to figure out the best way to get me the new water heater and the other parts needed, including a pan, hose and fixtures which the home warranty didn't cover at the cheapest price so I wouldn't have a huge out of pocket bill. He spent hours on the phone with the home warranty people trying to figure out the best way to get coverage and fixed my water heater extremely fast. I can't say enough nice things about Dino and Wooley's plumbing. They more than made up for the awful home owner's insurance policy people I had to deal with.

reviews.author: Susan S.
reviews.text:
Wooley plumbing was sent to us through our home warranty insurance. We have had this warranty for about 12 years and have always been satisfied with the service men sent.

Until Wooley Plumbing. 
They installed a new hot water heater with 23 welds. Each piece welded was about 4" long, rather than a 9 or 12" piece of pipe. Then we were charged extra for all the work. However, Mr Wooley had no authority to charge extra, as all was to be paid through our warranty.

When we reported this botched job to the insurance company, they are refunding our extra charge and sending out another plumbing service to evaluate this job and repair it.

I advise staying away from Wooley Plumbing. It is my personal opinion that they are both incompetent and thieves.

reviews.author: Kerry DeVilbiss
reviews.text:
Lewis Plumbing came out to replace a pressure valve on our water main. Our pressure tank was functional before their visit. After their repair, the tank stopped working entirely.
I have called their office five times over the past week. Each time I was told "the estimator will get back to you." No one has called. No one has come out. No one has taken responsibility.
I explained the situation was urgent — we have trees on the property that need water. I was told someone would follow up. Nothing.
I am now dealing with a broken tank they caused, dead trees if this continues, and a company that won't return calls or stand behind their work.
Do NOT use Lewis Plumbing. They will take your money, break your equipment, and disappear.

reviews.author: Nancy S.
reviews.text: We called first American out home warranty company.  You really don't get a choice in who they give your service ticket. In this case it worked out perfectly. The Wooley team showed up in time and were very knowledgeable. They fixed the first issue which was a challenge in itself. Then they went to fix the leaky faucet in the shower. The shower was always hard to turn and we thought it was just that type of faucet! Come to find out it was completely broken. They were able to fix it and now we have no problem turning in out faucet. Ken and Walter to the rescue! Thank you for you knowledgeable service. Excellent service team!

reviews.author: Sierra A.
reviews.text: Wooley plumbing is a fabulous company to work with! I got referred to them by my home warranty company. They are the easiest company to deal with that I've ever been referred to by that company! They came out to my house very quickly and reported back to the warranty company almost immediately which I have found is very unusual when dealing with a warranty company repair. Wooley Plumbing was extremely courteous, efficient, and had my repairs completely done within a matter of a couple days which was incredible! I would very highly recommend them and will definitely use them for any future plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Z Studio
reviews.text: This company sent two plumbers out to put in a kitchen faucet, air gap, and dishwasher and charged me nearly $1000 for parts and labor. The faucet was put in sideways, I had to point it out and have it adjusted, and the dishwasher was installed two inches forward from the cabinetry, which looks horrendous. I will never use this company again and don’t recommend them. I really should have used the hardware store’s installation service, which would have been $150 plus parts. I thought hiring a plumber would mean it would all be done properly with no guesswork. I was wrong.

synthesis.summary: Named technicians like Rick, George, and Jorge consistently deliver fast, communicative work — but a $1,000 installation job with crooked fixtures and a decade-old pattern of insurance-claim manipulation under the 'Wooley Plumbing' brand are worth knowing before you call.
strengths: Rick alone is praised by name in 12+ recent reviews for speed, communication, and thorough explanations — unusually consistent individual performance
Multiple reviewers highlight same-day or next-day arrival even for non-emergencies, with George credited for coming out the day before Christmas Eve
Post-service follow-up call from office staff noted by at least 2 independent reviewers as standout customer care
weaknesses: One review documents a ~$1,000 charge for a kitchen faucet, air gap, and dishwasher install that resulted in a sideways faucet and misaligned dishwasher — quality control on installations appears inconsistent
Pricing fairness scores lowest of all dimensions (61/100), and the $1,000 fixture install vs. a $150 hardware-store alternative suggests pricing can run significantly high for straightforward jobs
redFlags: Two reviews from the 'Wooley Plumbing' era describe a specific pattern: repeated missed or late appointments within 5-hour windows, followed by office staff allegedly misrepresenting what happened to insurance companies — raises questions about accountability when things go wrong

Score variance of 38 is high, meaning experiences range widely; the gap between Google (4.7) and Yelp (3.1) suggests dissatisfied customers are disproportionately venting on Yelp, which may reflect a real subset of bad outcomes being underrepresented on Google
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: George was dispatched the evening before Christmas Eve, Jorge finished a difficult sewer job ahead of schedule, and multiple reviewers report same-day response — however, no reviews explicitly confirm 2am dispatch or after-hours availability, so confirm by phone before counting on it.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.7 across 194 reviews while Yelp shows 3.1 across 25 — a 1.6-star gap that is significant, with Yelp capturing the billing and installation complaints that don't appear in Google's largely glowing feed.

reviews.author: Ramona Needham
reviews.text: Steve was very thorough. He Was very articulate and explained what he would do. He was also very knowledgeable and represented his company well.

reviews.author: Jason Heilmann
reviews.text: Fast professional service!

reviews.author: Jerry Imel
reviews.text: Did great job.

reviews.author: Kevin Teague
reviews.text: They were late and then wanted $600 to cap two copper pipes. Too expensive. Then they charged me $140 for the service fee when I told them it was too expensive. Looking forward to next week when my regular plumber is no longer sick.

reviews.author: Tiffany Forbes
reviews.text: Very unprofessional . I got no receipt and I’m going to need one so please send me one.

reviews.author: Robert Tieman
reviews.text: From the office dispatcher to the service tech, I am 100% happy with Red’s Plumbing. Will definitely use them again. AND the words “On Time” in the company’s name is not an exaggeration. Joe called me the morning of my service and said he’d be at my house in 45 minutes. Looking at the clock when he got here, it was exactly 45 minutes. On the dot. Joe also gave me some great advice on future service for my tankless water heater.

reviews.author: Nicole Subler
reviews.text: The work was communicated clearly and done neatly and efficiently! Oscar was very knowledgeable and patiently answered all my questions. I was particularly impressed that he had us run a load of laundry before he left (issue was replacing the laundry drain), so we were confident that no more issues would arise. We’re very happy with the work he did, and we will definitely be coming back to Red’s for any future plumbing work!

reviews.author: Chelsey Layous
reviews.text: Scheduling with the main office was such a breeze! I was able to get a Scheduling with the main office was such a breeze! I was able to get an appointment within 24 hours of calling. Marino was super friendly and  knowledgeable. He worked efficiently and even explained each step to me so that I knew what to look for should another problem arise. Will definitely be using Red’s again!

reviews.author: Concetta A
reviews.text: Red's On Time Plumbing came through for me.  Diagnosed the problems quickly, and we finally found out why there were leaks under the kitchen sink. Jesus was friendly and courteous and knowledgeable. He thoroughly explained the issues and what needed to be done before doing the work. Red's On Time Plumbing is now in my contact list if there's any future plumbing problems.

reviews.author: Terri Martella
reviews.text: Reds is a good plumbing outfit. The gentleman helped out my husband. We needed our water heater looked at. No repairs needed. I asked how much for the service call and was given the amount. But when I received the bill it was an additional service for diagnostics. I wasn’t told about the extra fee. I assumed that the service call was included. Disappointed ☹️

reviews.author: Martin Akel
reviews.text: Fonzy Rodriguez of Red's was everything we could want for in a professional to solve our water heater issues. He diagnosed the problem quickly, explained it all in plain language, and offered us a quality solution. He then executed the solution to our satisfaction, no problems. He then changed his schedule for the following day to return and complete a 6 hr install of a new tankless hot water heater so we had hot water by evening. He was professional, prompt, cheerful and on time. Thanks Fonzy!

The plumber was familiar with the issue and had my water line repaired and water back on in 90 minutes.  The work is skilled, the site cleaned up and everything back to normal!

reviews.author: Bobbi S.
reviews.text: The worst! It's like getting a haircut from Supercuts and paying for a NYC salon experience! They get a tech onsite for $79.95 then try to screw you on the repairs. It's all scripted communication. $550 to snake a line to a septic tank and $950 to incl hydrojet is so out of touch with comp pricing. Forget the Google reviews, those are bought with $$.

reviews.author: Carla S.
reviews.text:
We called Griffin Plumbing based on a recommendation from my husband's work mate. What they did right was they were professional on the phone when I called and they do send a text with the plumber's picture when they send him to your door. However, I will never use their service again for the following reasons:

1). The plumber arrived on time, slightly before 10 AM. However, as soon as he got here he said he had to be on a conference call so he would be out in his truck. He was out there for 45 minutes. My time is valuable to me. If he was going to be on a required conference call at 10 o'clock why did he show up at my house at 10 o'clock? That was the first big red flag.  

2). When he finally did come into the house, I pointed out that it was our disposal that needed to be fixed. However, he started darting around the house checking Water. I asked why he needed to do that if he was there to fix my disposal, and he stated that Customer Service is just a priority with Griffin. If Customer Service was a priority with Griffin why did he spend the first 45 minutes of his visit out in his truck on a conference call?!!!  

I mentioned several times that we were only looking for a repair for our disposal and he kept checking the water heater, osmosis unit and all our toilets.  He did not look at the disposal at all.

3).  After wasting all that time, he went back out to his truck to write up options for us. I told him we are not going to be replacing anything we just want our disposal fixed. He finally looked at the disposal for about three seconds and then ran out to his truck for another 30 to 40 minutes. I almost wanted to laugh it was so ridiculous. 

I started texting my husband to please come home because this was a very bizarre situation.  I have dealt with bad plumbers before but this man was not going to listen to anything I was saying.  It was evident to me that his only goal was to sell products we didn't need.  I wasted THREE HOURS of my time with him sitting in the truck, frantically running around the house trying to tell me his good customer service required that he checked everything before even touching the disposal, and then he FINALLY came in and started outlining plans for replacing everything!!!!
 and told me the city has my pressure set too high so he put something on that to regulate pressure?!!!!  What the heck?!! I just wanted my disposal fixed!

My husband finally was able to break away from work for lunch, and we told Griffin's representative the waste of our time was unacceptable.  We'd get someone else to replace the disposal!!!!!  It was like living in the far side.  No matter what we said we could tell it wasn't being heard.  

We told him next time sometime calls for a repair, fix their item first, THEN see if the customer has 3 hours to waste for their "good customer service."  When I spoke with the office, they said they are honoring their "good customer service" by not charging me the service fee!  Far Side craziness!!!!

reviews.author: Sue W.
reviews.text: Nothing but good things to say about my recent interaction with Griffin.  Mid afternoon I noticed that our hot water tank had developed a slow leak around the cold water inlet.  Immediately called Elizabeth explaining the situation.   She was able to arrange for Mike S to stop by to check out the leak.  Mike arrived less than 45 mins from my call to Elizabeth, thank you again and again.  Mike did a through look and let me know what was wrong.  Said that he couldn't provide any options as the tank simply had to be replaced, no choice.   Mike provided an estimate for the ball valve and pressure regulator that also had to be replaced but assured me that the new tank and it's installation was covered under the brands' warranty.    Unfortunately, he didn't have a tank on his truck that afternoon but with Elizabeth's help he was able to setup a early next day installation.  Cris S was here as promised and quickly confirmed Mike's findings.  He also was able to review the last tank installation documentation and determined that the entire fix (tank/ball valve/regulator/labor costs) were covered by the brands' and Griffin's warranties.  Huge huge savings!!  Cris quickly drained off the water, pulled the old hot water tank and installed the new one in just over four hours by himself with time to ensure we understood what had failed and how he had corrected/repaired/replaced.  His work was quick, clean and neat.   These three Griffin's employees were absolutely professional.

reviews.author: Rita J.
reviews.text:
I'm old enough to remember companies often using these types of deceptive marketing tricks - and getting away with them - before online review sites came along to expose them. 

So I was pretty flummoxed to hear the nice young lady's spiel (after getting all my contact, etc. info. down). 

Boils down to this:
Got a coupon in the mail for a free camera inspection - YAY! - what could be better for an intractably sluggish tub drain?

Oh wait - first the company charges $79 to show up.
Then, they insist that they have to try to unclog the tub first - which ISN'T BLOCKED, just uncharacteristically sluggish. I will then get charged for that labor.

THEN, they do the "free" inspection. 

Um, logically speaking, why can't they first TRY to do the inspection and then advise me on the problem, and we go from there? 

If you fix the problem, THEN do the inspection, what sense does that make??

It might have been a simple AT-HOME fix, that's what. But of course they're a business, and they need to make money.

I find this kind of deceptive trick incredibly sad. If they had been honest and transparent and done the right thing, they would have had me as a customer for life; yet they chose to get this lousy review.

They must think people are as dumb as doorknobs. What a waste of my precious "coffee" time.

Takeaway:  Beware of companies that have to give you a 5-minute spiel on their "terms of service" before they will honor a simple coupon...

reviews.author: Bob F.
reviews.text:
I was quite satisfied with the service I received from Griffin Plumbing. Starting with difficulty in replacing a garbage disposal unit, they gave me a window of time to visit. An opening came and they came earlier. The technician, Mark, was superb, thorough, professional, and very considerate. Their operation is very high-tech with iPads, and structured with regard to doing a household plumbing check, documents, releases, etc., and it took more time than I would have imagined. In the process, I ended up getting a new water heater too. Anyway, Mark accomplished everything he promised in the time frame he promised. He wore shoe coverings and spread out protective coverings and cleaned up afterwards. He was very considerate in answering all my questions, summarizing his work, and volunteering tips for me moving forward. 

I cannot speak to their pricing which was higher than I've ever experienced for similar work - particularly for the parts. (My Costco garbage disposal was more powerful and about $170 less than their option, a P-trap.  They charge about $60 more for paid in advance for an annual maintenance contract than they do for a $24.99 per month charge with an auto-renewal which I found totally bizarre, but the service was excellent.

reviews.author: Elise C.
reviews.text: Griffin Plumbing just completed the big project of repiping our whole house, and we can't say enough good things about this company and everyone we came in contact with from start to finish. First, the same day I called, they sent one of their top technicians, James C., out to evaluate the problem (copper pipes failing under our slab foundation). Before James left, we had a plan in place, knew the costs, and had a start date set. Second, we were very impressed with the 3 reliable, trustworthy, hard working, and knowledgeable technicians working daily on this project - Cris Sisneros, David Mercado, and Frankie Hamlin. Our unique architecture presented some challenges to moving the plumbing into the attic, but Cris S. was an expert problem solver and came up with thoughtful solutions. Under Cris' leadership, the team made the process less painful for us. Third, there was always clear communication from Cris, as well as the Griffin office staff (Elizabeth) who checked in with us everyday. We will definitely be using Griffin Plumbing from now on!

reviews.author: Donna W.
reviews.text:
My husband had Griffin install a garbage disposal in my mom's home. After that was done the person said the pipes in the house were not made for garbage disposal. It kept getting backed up and we called them to unplug it more than once. Also, they installed a kitchen faucet.
 I was told not to put anything down the garbage disposal. Then why have one if you can't use it? Now 6 years later I could not figure out where the smell was coming from.  Broken pipe with garbage and spiders at the end. Had to pay another plumber to repipe and fix the broken one. Was told not to use the garbage disposal because it would always back up. The smell went away though. Now for the faucet had to replace it because it leaked from day one. 
The person that installed the garbage disposal would try and sell us a water filtration system but I never found out how much it was. I just wanted what he installed fixed but that never happened. 
I would not recommend the company at all.

reviews.author: Patrick H.
reviews.text:
We used Griffin Plumbing twice in the past (2011 and 2012) and both times we received very good service.

We called Griffin back out on 01/09/14 as our water pressure regulator was leaking.  Mark came out, did an inspection and confirmed what I already knew... we would need a new pressure regulator.

Mark gave us options on replacing just the regulator or the entire inlet pipe with a shutoff valve and water spigot.  The price for the entire inlet pipe, shutoff valve and pressure regulator was more than fair and I agreed to have the work done right away.

Mark had spent about an hour replacing the entire unit and did a great job.  The new piping and hardware look great.

After paying Mark gave us a little welcome gift that was really nice.  We talked about services Griffin has and gave us more options to consider in the future.

Overall it was a great service and we will for sure call upon Griffin in the future when we need plumbing services.

reviews.author: Phillip L.
reviews.text: Griffin Plumbing....or did I mean to say, our local "Knights in Plumbing Armor"! Sean Ansari (our Griffin Plumbing Plumber) came out to our home yesterday to "re-install/seat" both of our toilets. His service was quick, professional, successful and informative! All the Griffin Plumbing representatives my Spouse and I spoke with, from one of the Owners (Jeremy) to Elizabeth (first office contact on phone) to Sean (Plumber) we're empathetic and compassionate to our dire situation and jumped into action (same day) so to speak, to resolve our issue! As a resident on the Central Coast, once again, I could not be more pleased and satisfied with the experience, customer service and results provided by Griffin Plumbing in Santa Maria,CA! Kudos and thanks to Jeremy Griffin, Elizabeth and of course...Sean! In this Yelper's opinion Griffin Plumbing, on this occasion, again, truly earned this 5 Star "highly recommend" review.

reviews.author: Darcy Staberg
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about this plumbing company. From start to finish, the experience was exceptional. I called on Monday and they went out of their way to work me in for Tuesday, which alone was impressive.

Communication throughout the day was excellent — I was kept informed every step of the way. When it started to look like they might not be able to make it out as planned, the owner personally reached out, reassured me, and promised they would work something out. True to his word, they showed up after hours to take care of the issue.

The plumber was extremely respectful, knowledgeable, and left everything clean — which I truly appreciated. It’s rare to find a company that combines professionalism, integrity, and genuine care for their customers the way this one does.

Above and beyond service in every sense. I would not hesitate to recommend them and will absolutely use them again.

synthesis.summary: Shows up fast for emergencies at any hour and technicians consistently deliver quality work, but pricing is a recurring complaint with multiple reviewers citing quotes that felt inflated or unexplained.
strengths: Emergency response is genuinely fast: at least 4 recent reviews specifically mention same-day or within-30-minute arrival, including Sunday nights and late-night calls
Technicians present multiple repair options rather than pushing one path, noted across at least 5 reviews spanning several years
Individual techs — James, Noah, Jake, Tim, Chris — are praised by name across a dozen recent reviews for professionalism and communication, suggesting consistent staff quality
weaknesses: Pricing draws complaints across multiple reviews: charges cited include $550 to snake a line, $1,000+ for a garbage disposal, and one reviewer was billed $370 after being quoted $149 — upsell pressure and lack of upfront pricing transparency is a recurring theme
At least two reviewers (both self-identified single women) describe feeling targeted with inflated quotes and high-pressure upsells, raising a pattern worth noting for vulnerable customers
redFlags: One 2019 Yelp review claims the company explicitly said 'we don't guarantee our work' after a drain job failed immediately — unverified but serious if accurate
Multiple reviewers warn that prices are not available over the phone and the $79–90 dispatch fee gets the tech in the door before any pricing is disclosed, which has led to sticker shock
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one reviewer got a tech on-site within 30 minutes on a Sunday night, another had a technician arrive by 2pm after calling at 1pm on a weekday with active water damage, and recent reviews confirm late-night and weekend availability.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 across 1,131 reviews while Yelp shows 4.2 across 100 — a meaningful 0.7-star gap driven largely by Yelp reviews detailing billing disputes, upsell pressure, and pricing complaints that are largely absent from the Google picture.

reviews.author: homer howzit
reviews.text: 45 Degree Plumbing was recommended to me by a local contractor. There are a friendly, local, and family owned business. I couldn’t say enough good things about them. They came the first time to put a drain through my wall for my water heater. And thank goodness they did, because months later my water heater actually sprung a leak and the water flowed outside instead of into my garage wall. I called that night and they were there first thing the next morning. Confident and professional, they really put your mind at ease. It’s like having a friend in the plumbing business! The service was fast, excellent, affordable, and the cleanup was amazing. If you walk in my garage, you never knew they were there. The only thing they left behind was my beautiful new water heater and the security that they’re just a call away if anything else happens.

reviews.text:
Had a late-night emergency with my water heater and reached out to 45 Degrees Plumbing. They immediately got on a FaceTime call and walked me through the situation step by step, helping me get everything up and running within minutes.

What really stood out was that they did this purely out of courtesy—no hesitation, just genuine help when it mattered most. That kind of professionalism and generosity is hard to find these days.

Huge kudos to them. I’ll definitely be using 45 Degrees Plumbing moving forward for any plumbing needs.

— Diego Ciranda
EZ CONCRETE WORX

reviews.text: Highly recommend! I needed immediate repairs to my washer drain that was severely clogged. They carefully pulled out my stackable washer/dryer combo, disconnected everything and cut a hole in the wall to access the pipe (access was blocked by cabinet, doh!). They did a great job clearing the blockage and put everything back the way it was. Cleaned up nicely!  Only took a couple hours and the bill was very reasonable for all the work they did.  So happy with the result and now have a clear drain and can use my washer again! Yay!!

reviews.text: Very prompt and efficient.  Our water heater went out and we called Longevity for help.  He was right on our problem and knew exactly what we needed.  He checked everything and put our new water heater in place and corrected some little things we would not have known to.  He did it all from delivery, install and removal of our broken water heater. One of the most pleasant and caring persons we have met... would recommend for any and all of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Stephanie R.
reviews.text:
My water heater went out on Friday at 2 PM, Javet responded to my request and went and picked up a new water heater for me before 5PM the same day. He was out at 8AM on Saturday morning changing it out. He is a very happy go lucky person, friendly, and knowledgeable. As if that isn't awesome enough, he was also very well prepared, requested pictures, and made sure he had everything on hand and in his van that he needed to complete the job. His prices were more than fair, his work was nice and tidy, and he was in and out in no time. He cleaned up after himself, hauled away my old water heater, and I didn't have to call him back for anything. I'm happy to report that I have found myself a new plumber! 

Highly recommend, no need to look any further. The job was kind of a pain in the butt, but he never made me feel any other way than he had it under control, and he would knock it out quickly. Thank you Javet! Great experience from start to finish.

reviews.author: Jimil-Anne L.
reviews.text: If you're looking for a great plumber for a reasonable price, Longevity Plumbing Services is the way to go!  Javet replied to my online request promptly.  He was at my house in less than two hours (my job was fairly nearby another job of his)!  Initially, he came over to replace my garbage disposal, which I had thought had died, but it was actually just jammed.  But since he was already over anyway, I actually asked if he could move the disposal to the other side of the sink (since the previous owners had the disposal in a place we didn't really like), he happily did it and finished it in no time.  He cleaned up after himself, leaving the area looking better than it was when he came in.  The garbage disposal has been running the best it ever has, and it's in a new area of the sink that makes it super-convenient for me and my husband-- I really couldn't be happier with Javet's work!  Will definitely hire again for any of my plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Michael N.
reviews.text: The water heater in our new house was making the rumbling sounds that tell you when there is massive mineral build up inside the tank.  Rather than wait for it to die on us, we decided to replace it immediately.  We searched around the Solvang/Lompoc/Santa Maria area and asked for quotes.  Not only was Javet the most responsive, but he was the best priced by far.  Add to that the fact that he was on time, knowledgeable and just a great all-round guy, we felt like we hit the lottery with him.  On the phone and again when he arrived, he walked us through the process, answered our questions and listened.  His work is pristine and he was in and out in no time.  Highly recommend using Javet for your plumbing needs.  These days it seems difficult to find quality tradesmen.  Great to know that individuals like Javet are still around.  Javet's our go-to guy from here on out.  Thanks Javet!

reviews.author: Jennifer D.
reviews.text: Javet is very responsive to calls, very friendly, and does great work. Prices were also good. I have lived in my house for 2 years didn't know how old the toilet was and it was a push button on the tank lid flush. It's always been a horrible toilet requiring multiple flushes and extra water to make it flush adequate enough to pass waste. He came out looked at it, put the auger down, and came to the conclusion that it seemed like the toilet just needed to be replaced. Called 8/3, he came out 8/4, and I had a new toilet 8/5. Snaked the drain for good measure. And now I have a very nice and correctly functioning toilet, only having one bathroom I wanted it fixed before it became a major issue. I would definitely recommend him for any of your plumbing needs. He purchased the toilet, brought to my house, and also hauled the old toilet away. I definitely happy with my results.

reviews.author: Beverly A.
reviews.text: My first experience using Javet was on a Sunday, when I had discovered water bubbling up from a pipe in my front yard.  Not what you want to see especially on a weekend.  I called numerous plumbing companies who I had used before, but no one answered their phones or indicated an emergency number to call on that Sunday until I called Longevity Plumbing and Javet answered his cellphone.  He came right over assessed the situation and began digging.  I called him my Angel that day, such a nice man with a beautiful smile.  Since that day Javet is my first call for my plumbing issues and less expensive that other's I have used.  I called him yesterday for a bathroom sink that would not drain, he responded quickly, solved the problem and cleaned up the mess before leaving... all with a smile!

reviews.author: Doug Gorham
reviews.text: “I’ve been a customer of Longevity Plumbing for a few years now and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the service that I have received from Javet Long, the owner and plumber.  He is truly exceptional, incredibly professional, and his expertise on all plumbing matters is unsurpassed.   He is very personable and takes the time to explain what went wrong and how he going to fix it.  He has even given me tips to prevent things from happening in the future.  His prices are extremely fair and his work quality is outstanding.  I highly recommend Javet and Longevity Plumbing to anyone in need of a plumber in the Lompoc, Santa Maria, and Central Coast area.  Thank you, Javet, for your wonderful workmanship and service!”

reviews.author: Natalie M.
reviews.text: Earlier this week, I put a request for service out to several plumbers and Javet Long of Longevity Plumbing ultimately won the job!  He communicated timely, and was fair in his price and that was key!  He was very flexible with my limited hours of availability at home, was very knowledgeable, experienced, and friendly!  He completed the installation of a new kitchen faucet perfectly and even wiped down the area!  I am truly enjoying the new faucet after years of having an older one!  I highly recommend Longevity Plumbing for plumbing services that will set your mind at ease as he knows his trade, is professional and offers a fair price.  Thank you, Javet Long of Longevity Plumbing Services!

reviews.author: Ronnie C.
reviews.text:
Javet just finished some plumbing work at my new house - ie replacing corroded valves, installing a dishwasher, installing a garbage disposal, running a water line to the fridge, etc and I couldn't be happier with the whole experience!

He's a super personable dude, and took the time to explain what needed (and didn't need) to be replaced and why. The estimate was fair, and there weren't any "hidden" costs. After dealing with a ton of different contractors over the past couple weeks, it was super refreshing have really solid communication and have him show up on time and finish the work.

I'll definitely be hitting him up when it comes time to replace my water heater. Thanks Javet!

reviews.author: CR HUM
reviews.text: Javet is a great plumber and a true professional.  I had a situation where I had not one but two leaks from my toilets to my ceiling.  I had tried to call several plumbers but the best they could do would be two weeks to a week and a half.  Not Javet, he offered to come check out my issue the following day.  He was a cool guy and listened to my concerns and then troubleshooted the problem.  He gave me a fair flat rate upfront and the rest was history.  I have already referred him to several coworkers and will let everyone else know where you can find a great plumber.  The best experience I have had and if I have any other issues i will call him.  Great service at a fair price.

reviews.author: Dianna W.
reviews.text:
We couldn't be happier with Longevity Plumbing. We just bought a home and had some issues that needed to fixed quickly and a few just would be nice to get done projects. Javet came out and quickly assessed the situation, haves us a very fair quote, and scheduled service within a few days. Even though there were some unforeseen issues along the way, he got all 7 projects done in one day and stuck to his original quote. 

He is absolutely professional and great at his job. He is also a great person with a big smile and a wonderful sinkside manner. 

We will definitely be keeping his number for any and all future plumbing projects.

reviews.author: Richard R.
reviews.text:
Javet is an absolute professional.  He is prompt to service calls, responds to calls and text quickly, thoroughly explains what needs to be done, and charges a fair price (and accurate estimates).  He is friendly and honest, and I trust his assessments.  Even during the free estimate for a sink installation, he went out of his way to check our water pressure and adjusted as needed based on a question I had about my shower.

The kitchen sink replacement looks stunning, and I am very happy with the results.

I highly suggest reaching Javet for any plumbing needs you may have and I will be using him for any future services.

reviews.author: Shelby S.
reviews.text: Javet is amazing. We had an emergency today when my husband accidentally broke the pipe to an outdoor spigot trying to remove a hose. The pipe cracked and we were in a serious pinch. Javet answered on the first call and was upfront about the increased cost for having to come on a Sunday (also Mother's Day). He was so responsive and showed up within an hour. He's also very friendly and kept his mask on the whole time, showing safety to Covid. He did an awesome job and we are so grateful. I highly recommend and we will definitely be a repeat customer! He was prepared with everything he needed and got the job done so quick!

synthesis.summary: Javet personally answers texts and shows up within minutes for weekend and Sunday emergencies — reviewers consistently beat out other plumbers they contacted simultaneously.
strengths: At least 6 reviews describe Javet responding faster than competing plumbers contacted at the same time, including arriving within 10 minutes of a Saturday call and being the only plumber to respond on a Sunday

Multiple reviewers praise proactive value-adds at no extra charge: checking water pressure, offering appliance longevity tips, adjusting fixtures beyond the scope of the job, and providing free estimates with drive time
Flat-rate and phone-quoted pricing cited in at least 4 reviews as a trust signal — reviewers note he stuck to quotes even on difficult jobs
weaknesses: Not enough data to identify weaknesses — all 75 analyzed reviews are positive with no recurring complaints about pricing surprises, callbacks, or incomplete work
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals across multiple reviews: documented same-day Sunday response, Saturday arrival within 10 minutes of a call, after-hours water heater sourcing and next-morning install, and a 2019 review explicitly praising performance on rush jobs — Javet responds via text which accelerates contact outside business hours.

plumbers.name: Jerry's Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 319 N Russell Ave, Santa Maria, CA 93458, USA

reviews.author: G M.
reviews.text:
I feel lucky to say this might be our first experience with a plumber. Jerry's sent Mario to give us an estimate first, free of charge. He was informative, and I felt that he was very honest and upfront with me. (A second guy from a different company didn't leave me with that same feeling.)

Next day, we decided to have the work done and Jerry's sent a gentleman named, John. He too was very professional. He made me feel comfortable and explained the work and the "why" in a way I could understand easily. He finished quickly and cleaned up any mess though he was careful not to make one since he was working in a carpeted bedroom. I am tickled with the level of service we received, and I would definitely call Jerry's again.

reviews.author: Rachel R.
reviews.text: We had a crazy leak. Had to turn off the water to the whole house!  Called Jerry's. Came within a couple of hours. John the plumber was great! He fixed our major issue super quick. He showed up with a mask on was very respectful. Thank you, Jerry's!

reviews.author: Rosita M.
reviews.text: The plumber showed up on time.  He wore a mask and shoe booties as I had requested.  He was very thorough and answered any questions I had.  He also cleaned up when finished. I would hire this company again.

reviews.author: Eva M.
reviews.text:
BEWARE
Before you use this company read the reviews from the other locations in Santa Barbara County. This is all one company. This company was used by Sears to install new appliances in our home. Even though installation was included they charged me another $150.00 saying it took longer than it should have. In addition they recommended $700 of work to change pipes and valves in the kitchen. I had another plumber come to give a second opinion. He did not feel that work was necessary and was essentially a scam since what they had proposed doing would not have made sense. 

I spoke with others in the area who had similar experiences with Jerry's. If you buy an appliance and the company uses Jerry's plumbing I strongly recommend trying to see if they will use someone else- or just hire your own trusted plumber to do it. I will never have them install anything I purchased again.

reviews.author: Myfa C.
reviews.text:
The folks at Jerry's Plumbing and Heating are nice enough, but they are not serious about getting the job done.  I had a broken cartridge in a kitchen faucet.  They were not at the house even an hour.  When they removed the trim to expose the cartridge there was a 27mm retaining nut.  The plumber said they do not typically work with socket wrenches, and left the job incomplete. 

But what is worse, they charged over $225 for the house call.  No specials tools, no special parts, less than an hour of time, the job left unfinished and they still charged me over $225.  Come on.

I agree with some of the other reviewers; there must be better plumbing choices in SB County.

reviews.author: Stephanie R.
reviews.text:
Terrible communication, and abandons jobs, both plumbing & heating. STAY AWAY. A month after moving in, we had an issue with our furnace, but we have home warranty with Fidelity, so they assigned us to Jerry's. Coincidentally, the same day the furnace was scheduled for service, we had a flood (sewer stoppage), so we thought we'd just go with the same company. Big mistake. The plumber who came was "after hours" so they weren't going to go through warranty, we had to pay $350 just for him to come.  He couldn't diagnose source of the problem... he told us he didn't have the equipment, so they would need to continue the next day. The next day, a different plumber from Jerry's came, who had no knowledge of the previous attempt, but after we filled him in, he said he said could do the work, just needed to get us a price, and then he just LEFT without a word... we called Jerry's and they said first that he had other jobs to go to (obviously we weren't a priority), then said we were trying to pay them for the job through our warranty company (we weren't), and they wanted to be paid privately (which we said over and over, we were going to). After an agonizingly patronizing conversation, it was apparent this company had no intention to actually help us (just collect money for showing up) and was ill equipped to neither discuss nor complete the plumbing work needed, so after 2 days of being unable to use our plumbing, we decided to go elsewhere for our plumbing issue (but Jerry's did decide to cash in on the "service call" though, to get paid by our home warranty!!!)
A week later, we tried to check on the status of our furnace repair only to find out from our warranty company that Jerry's submitted a "job complete" invoice to them (again, making sure they got paid for not doing any work), and we were going to be transferred to another service provider bc Jerry's was not going to come out to complete the service bc they received a bad review about walking out on our plumbing issue. It is January, the overnight low is going to be 40 degrees, and Jerry's plumbing and heating doubled down on walking away from their customer, literally leaving us in the cold, without explanation. Do not trust these guys.

reviews.author: Phillip and Stephanie Cornell
reviews.text: Company of miscommunication, misrepresentation, and condescension. A service call was requested to address a plumbing backup problem. A technician came out, removed our toilet, and tried to access but could not. Then placed the toilet back (incorrectly) and stated they would need to run a camera up the line the next day to find it. Next day comes, a different technician, takes 2 minutes and says the same thing. So we say proceed with it and we will pay for it. Tech says “let me get you a price” and leaves. During this time, my wife was on the phone with the home warranty company to see about reimbursement. The tech says he can’t wait for that authorization so we told him to go ahead and we will pay for it privately. That’s when he said he would get a price and ghosted. I called the dispatch where I was put on an indefinite hold. After, my wife called again to be told that we we miscommunicated and the plumber had other jobs to do. Bad service, nothing resolved, and now out $350 dollars to be ghosted. I would not recommend this company to a sewer rat.

reviews.author: Dave Miller
reviews.text: Very happy with their service. I called on a Monday and they were out there on a Tuesday. I had a two fold problem, my thermostat on my HVAC wasn’t working and I had a pressure valve for the house water supply that was malfunctioning and needed to be replaced. They sent out a plumber and  they sent out an HVAC guy. I felt the price was very reasonable, they were very professional, fast, and their follow up with paperwork invoicing was very professional and nice. Since the home is in Morro Bay and I am now in Texas they had a great opportunity to run the price up on the HVAC system. They were very accurate with what was wrong and he identified it was simply a switch had not been closed during the home inspection.

reviews.author: Mark R
reviews.text: First of all, let me state that the appraisal was below two other local Plumbers in the Santa Maria Valley...Call Jerry's Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning.  From the appraisal, scheduling, and work performed...top notch, great customer service and superior craftsmanship.  Turned my previous plumbing snafu into a clean, efficient system...Damn thing looks like a work of art!  As for the two plumbers doing the work, John & Jake, skilled tradesmen who keep me in the loop on everything performed and answered all the ignorant customer questions with professionalism.  So if you need a Plumber, call Jerry's Plumbing...you will never second guess yourself.

reviews.author: Bill Hrnjak
reviews.text: The technician, David, was extremely knowledgeable aa well as very intelligent.  He communicated extremely well both by phone and in person.  He was able to "McGyver" the broken cartridge on the hot water side of our upstairs shower on Saturday afternoon into the off position which allow us to turn the main water back on in the house, early on Saturday afternoon.  He was able to go to the supply house and acquire a pair of NOS replacement cartridges early Monday morning and basically rebuilt our 40 plus year old shower early Monday afternoon.  David was an excellent mechanic aa well as a real gentleman too.  I rate his service at 5 stars.

reviews.author: Tom Arrington
reviews.text: Your tech arrived on-time. He did introduce himself, but it slip thru my brain too quickly. Services was excellent. At my request he suggested two options of shower heads to replace the one he took off. He was up-front with the capabilities of the two heads and the associated cost. I believe in honesty and was that and more. I picked the upgrade model, which turned out to be a very wise decision, as it definitely has more useful features than the less expensive shorwerehead. I will definitely be calling you again for my plumbing needs.  Thank You. Great job.  Tom in Goleta.

reviews.author: Alan Munch
reviews.text: Was pleased that my job was able to be responded to so quickly (within 30 minutes from time of my call).  Your tech was pleasant and efficient.  However, the leaking seal was due to broken bolts, which were installed within 1 year from when your company had previously installed a new bracket and bolts.  I guess I expected some consideration of this circumstance in what I paid, and that the job was completed in less than an hour.  Was disappointed that no effort was made to clean the bracket and tiles after the toilet was removed or replaced.

reviews.author: Edward G.
reviews.text:
Stay away...plenty of other options in SB county. These guys have multiple yelp accounts all with consistently bad feedback for a reason. 

They robbed us of our insurance money and when we called to try and work something out they literally lied to me over the phone and when I called them out on it they refused to answer me anymore after that. They take zero ownership for their mistakes and customer service of any kind is lost on them. 

If you want good plumbing work call 805 plumbing....great honest guys and they do great work!

reviews.author: Phillip Cornell
reviews.text: Terrible communication. First on a plumbing issue where they dropped the ball, now come to find out that they abandoned us again on a job that was already in progress for a furnace repair. They didn’t even tell us, we found out from our home warranty company (Fidelity, who first referred us), that bc of a bad review for the plumbing job they walked away from, they weren’t going to complete the furnace repair— even though they sent a ‘job completed’ invoice to Fidelity. Don’t trust this company, they will leave you in the cold.

reviews.author: Christy W.
reviews.text: I called Jerry's Plumbing and Heating for a problem regarding clogged sink. Omar, was the plumber that came to do the plumbing issue. He was very professional, forthcoming with the explanation of the job. I appreciated the estimate before the job was started. Omar was very efficient. I would have no problem recommending this business. They help me once before with a heater issue. I won't hesitate to call them again.

synthesis.summary: Gets a tech to your door fast — often same-day or within 30 minutes — but a handful of reviews flag incomplete work and surprise charges that suggest you should pin down pricing before they start.
strengths: Responsiveness is their standout trait: at least 6 recent reviews mention same-day arrival, one within 30 minutes of calling, and a Saturday water heater fix with no apparent upcharge
Technicians consistently praised for explaining problems in plain language and cleaning up after themselves — noted independently in at least 5 reviews across different years
Repeat customers appear multiple times, including one reviewer on their third service call who calls scheduling easy and pricing wallet-friendly
weaknesses: Two reviews describe being charged $150–$225+ for incomplete or ineffective work — one job was left unfinished because the plumber lacked a basic socket wrench, another required a second service call the next day for the same toilet tank issue
One older review alleges a $700 upsell recommendation that a second-opinion plumber called unnecessary, and an additional $150 charge on top of an all-inclusive Sears installation fee
redFlags: Two separate reviews (2014 and 2023) describe being charged full service fees for jobs that were either not completed or not fixed — a pattern worth watching given the 55/100 pricing fairness score

Google (4.8 stars, 771 reviews) vs. Yelp (3.3 stars, 12 reviews) is a significant gap; the Yelp pool, though small, skews toward billing and workmanship complaints that don't surface in the Google volume
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one reviewer had water shut off to the whole house and Jerry's arrived within a couple of hours; same-day Saturday service confirmed for a water heater; multiple reviews cite arrival within 30 minutes to one afternoon of calling.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.8 across 771 reviews while Yelp shows 3.3 across just 12 — the Yelp reviews disproportionately capture billing disputes and incomplete-work complaints that are largely absent from Google, suggesting dissatisfied customers may be self-selecting to Yelp.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.text: I have had Five Cities Plumbing complete several major jobs for me in the last couple of years.  They have ALWAYS responded & taken care of everything as soon as I call. Everyone is friendly & professional-I will ALWAYS depend on this company!

reviews.author: Jana Debruyne
reviews.text: Very happy customer! These guys took care of business, done right the first time. Returning customer for sure! :)

reviews.author: Greg D.
reviews.text:
To: Roto Rooter Supervisor - Santa Maria, California

On September 9 & 10, 2014, your company employees: Rico Williams and his assistant "Stephen" performed plumbing work at my residence located in Santa Maria, California. 

I would like to commend both men for their diligence, professionalism, and polite manners while they worked inside and outside my residence. They performed their duties well, and did a commendable job during their cleanup, both inside and out. 

Please extend my sincere thanks to both men, and I also thank your for your kind assistance. I will certainly choose Roto Rooter in the future for my plumbing needs, and will recommend your services to my associates. 

Sincerely,

Greg Diamanti
Diamanti Investigations 


Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone

reviews.author: Mary R.
reviews.text:
BE WARE!!  the gas company red-Tagged my water heater because the said it wasn't venting correctly and I needed a plumb to fix the problem.Roto- Rooter. came out and said that my piping was installed incorrectly and need to be taken out of the wall re-piped and that I needed a new water heater. all this for $5967.00 and the even wanted to charge me $29.00 for the bid!!!!

I called Quality plumbing and Rick came out. got on the roof and fixed the problem for $149.00. 

I never write reviews but I just had to write this one.  I'm sure the saw single old lady... what does she know.  I know one thing Roto-Rooter's are a bunch of crooks.

reviews.author: Franny C.
reviews.text:
I would give this company zero stars if I could.  We had a simple drip drip leak in the bathroom wall that started to leak water into both bathrooms so we called this company based on a past reputation.  If I had simply taken 5 minutes of my time to look at the reviews here and on the Better Business Bureau site, it would have saved thousands of dollars and mine and my family's future health.  I called on a Monday, the repair tech showed up in late afternoon saying he was busy so he had to come back tomorrow; said he would call later on that evening to give a time frame but never called.  Showed up at 11:30 am the next day for what he said would take one hour to fix.  The 'sonar' people who are supposed to find the leak without cutting up your wall haphazardly said the leak was in the pipe he exposed in the upper wall; when the repair tech got there, he said the actual leak was coming from the ceiling.    
Long story short, the repair tech ended up punching a hole in our hallway popcorn ceiling from snapping a thin board he used to maneuver in our attic (the tech weighed over 200 lbs.) that most likely contains asbestos but their technician did not take any precaution to limit the spread of the toxic dust, assumed there was no asbestos when asbestos is invisible to the naked eye and did not care that this house was built before 1975, before asbestos was regulated as being a dangerous compound to either inhale or ingest in any amount.  Even though the technician was not certified in drywall repair nor was he capable of making the assessment that the popcorn ceiling had no toxic asbestos, he decided to 'fix' the hole himself(not really asking our permission or taking caution to not disturb the ceiling more and release more toxic dust by consulting someone who can tell us for sure if there is asbestos) which was a 2 foot x 2 foot gaping hole by further sawing into the popcorn ceiling releasing plumes of toxic dust that is now making my family and I sick with respiratory issues.  Supervisor I spoke to was not very helpful, didn't want to refund any of the $4000 we paid for a simple leak to have our home air tested for asbestos which would cost $325, insisted we use their company to fix the shoddy dry wall their technician put in that still left gaps because the hole is right next to the lighting fixture, damaged the attic entry cover which the tech failed to let us know, took 10.5 hours for the job that day and I noticed that we were missing a $6 box cutter and the supervisor said I was accusing his techs of being 'thieves' which never came out of my mouth; I only said it was missing from the entry way next morning and I use that box cutter to open delivered boxes almost daily which is how I noticed it went missing.  Unfortunately, we didn't have our indoor security cameras set up so I could document all of this if we do proceed toward personal litigation in small claims.  This company does not treat their customers in good faith, nor does it take responsibility for the damage that was caused to our home due to the negligence of their repair tech and causing us health issues due to the toxic dust that is now spread to every room in our home and that covers the furniture like snow and makes our throat burn, our eyes burn, sharp chest pain on inhaling, hoarse voices, not to mention a more than likely future of respiratory disease all over greed and bad business practice and unskilled technicians who cannot be trusted alone in your home.  Now when we flush our toilets in both bathrooms we hear a rumbling, rushing water sound from either toilet and the seam of where the floor meets the wall in the shower bathroom was pushed out and separated after this repair happened, so now we are probably expecting more repairs and water leaking due to their technician most likely not attaching replacement pipe properly and further doing damage.  Their technician also tried to sell us on water damage consult visit, said the pipe in our bathroom was black due to black mold but the copper pipe was black due to mostly oxidation from the air and being an older pipe; copper does tarnish over time; there was no fuzzy mold or growth on the pipe aside from the normal mold that would probably grow in a wet environment over the years.  The point of this review is that we are now breathing in toxic air 24/7 and Roto Rooter does not want to even help by refunding half of the money we paid to get someone to test the air, to repair the damaged ceiling(we have to provide an estimate).  If they wanted to treat their customers with good faith and good business practices, they would refund us most of the $4000 that they charged which probably would have cost us less than $1000 with a local plumber and no ceiling damage.  They refuse to take ownership of the negligence from their repair technician.  
Repair happened in Santa Maria, CA

reviews.author: RJordans Gaming
reviews.text:
They replaced a faulty bathtub mixer cartridge on Jan 14, which began leaking at an alarming rate on Saturday Feb 21 (good solid flow as the valve failed to close). Couldn't reach them all weekend. Spoke with them Monday morning, kept saying they were sending someone out, then delayed multiple times and never came, said Tuesday first thing... no show / no call. Around 11am, I received a hostile phone call from the owner, Chad, accusing me of trying to get free work, refusing to pay, and pissing him off with multiple phone calls. Not sure how he arrived at any of those conclusions. I had simply asked the receptionist if they would guarantee their prior work (which was paid promptly on the day of service btw).

Chad did eventually come out on Tuesday around 11, pushed past me at the front door and began demanding payment immediately before performing any work. I asked him to communicate with the home owner (who I had standing by on the phone), which Chad refused to do. Instead he left abruptly hurling profanity, yelling insults, and speeding away. Chad wouldn’t budge on his 30-day guarantee policy, even though the bath valve was becoming increasing difficult to fully shut-off since well within the 30-day window. Meanwhile my bathtub had now been hemorrhaging probably hundreds of gallons over 3 days.

So my issue was not fixed and I was a bit shook by the unhinged way the owner suddenly raged quit. I called another plumbing service who came out in less than 1-hour and replaced the cartridge for $280. They also confirmed that Five Cities Plumbing had installed the prior cartridge incorrectly. Won’t be using this company again.

reviews.author: SLORIGHT County Property Management
reviews.text: As a property management Co. We do a lot of business with plumbers. Finding a Professional one is really the challenge. Plumbing tends to be a business that people will over look customer service because they are desperate. Five cities Plumbing is one company that goes above and beyond as far as customer service. Angie, was very helpful in the office and the technician dispatch called me with numerous updates. He even went so far as to attend to an unrelated leaking hose bib for free and we all know how much we get charged for water here in California, so I was ecstatic and more than willing to compensate him for the hour of his time. The best plumbing company to call during normal business hours hands down.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.text: Great, honest plumbing service. My wife was staying at my elderly mother’s house in the retirement trailer park across from the Pismo RV park and the drain clogged up. I called Roto Rooter and without even looking in the clean out access, they said it needed to be hydro jetted from the mobile home to the street. They quoted me $2,750 !! I told them no thanks and called Five Cities plumbing. They sent two guys out, they looked at the clean out and determined it was between there and the house. They ran a snake up and cleared the drain and were done in about half an hour, start to finish. I was happy to pay their $215 fee. Can’t thank or recommend them enough!!

reviews.author: Vincent M.
reviews.text:
Would give fewer stars if I could.
Long story short I had them out to look at water heater whose pilot wouldn't light . Tech tried to light pilot for 1/2 hour said he'd need to go to the store to get a part. Then I offered to go pick up part so he could come back later and do the work. He called back later and suggested his boss told him I should look into warranty coverage. Tech texted me a video so I could do it myself, because I "seemed capable... WTF??! The tech never responded to my requests for an eta and when I called his office today they said the job was closed based on ME never having called back.
AVOID AT ALL COSTS

reviews.author: Ashley Burns
reviews.text:
We’ve had a handful of experiences with local plumbers over the years, and not all of them were great. After one especially frustrating situation, we decided to call 5 Cities Plumbing based on recommendations from friends. I wish we had called them years ago!

No hassle. No waiting around. No runaround or shady upsells like we’ve dealt with before. They were straightforward, honest, and actually fixed the problem the first time. What a relief to finally find a plumbing company that does exactly what they say they’ll do.

From here on out, we’ll only be using 5 Cities Plumbing for any plumbing issues. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Earl F.
reviews.text: Called to get a sewer line unblocked. They would not give any estimate of cost over the phone. Made an appointment for 1pm the next day. At 2pm that day, I called and was told the guy was stuck at another job. They called at 3pm to say he was on his way. He arrived two hours and 15 minutes after the appointment. I asked how much it was going to cost. He said it would be almost $300, and if they had to pull the toilet, it would be more than $500. The Roto Rooter guy I used for years never charged more than $100. Things have change with this company, and I will never call them again.

reviews.author: Ron Herren
reviews.text:
Chad Tanner and John Woodward of Five Cities Plumbing just did a terrific job rooting-out a clog in our drain, and no mess!

I'm a pretty confident do-it-yourselfer, and tried unsuccessfully to do it on my own with a manual snake... after much aggravation, sweat, and stress I finally surrendered and let a professional do it.  What a great decision!  Less than an hour later and they're done and gone.  Chad even took the time to recommend some simple monthly maintenance to keep everything clear.  Great service, and stress-free.  Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Lloyd L.
reviews.text: I had a stopped drain in my kitchen, which caused several problems. I called several plumbers in Lompoc, CA, and received a one--to two-day wait list for service and a rude attitude on the phone. I called Roto Router, and they came within the hour. Two plumbers (Jacob and Eric) arrived, and they went to work, evaluating my plumbing issues and quickly resolving them. Both men were professional and pleasant to work with.

reviews.author: Robinet C.
reviews.text:
I am very happy with Juan, who is the person who did the hard work of doing the excavations alone and worked under the sun for hours.  An exceptional,  professional, and respecful worker who should be rewarded with a raise.  job very well done. 
The company does not give many ways of payments considering the cost of their service.
After all, I would recommend their services because of their employee.

reviews.author: Ness H.
reviews.text: Set Appointment Thursday night for for Friday morning. Received a call from dispatcher giving me a window of 10-11am, at 11:45 I called to see where they were and dispatcher said they weren't able to come until later, she called me back and said they would be there between 4-6pm, they didn't show up. Now I get to go through a weekend with no toilet or pay overtime rates, don't waste your time.

synthesis.summary: Five Cities can save you thousands versus chain plumbers and gets there fast, but the owner has blown up at at least one customer over a warranty dispute and weekend callback reliability is unproven.
strengths: Pricing dramatically undercuts competitors: one reviewer was quoted $2,750 by Roto-Rooter and paid $215 with Five Cities for the same drain job
Multiple repeat customers across different years cite first-call fixes and no upsell pressure, with at least 4 reviews specifically praising honesty and straightforwardness
Same-day and last-minute response confirmed by multiple reviewers, including a property management company that cites proactive dispatch updates
weaknesses: Workmanship quality is inconsistent: a February 2026 reviewer had a cartridge installed incorrectly that failed within 38 days, confirmed by a second plumber
Scheduling reliability has failed at least twice: one reviewer was given a window that came and went with no show and no call, leaving them without a toilet over a weekend
redFlags: Owner Chad reportedly called a customer in an unhinged, hostile manner, accused them of trying to get free work without basis, then arrived on-site demanding payment before performing warranty repairs, then left shouting profanity — this is a single review but the specificity and detail are high
When the cartridge failure happened on a Saturday, the company was unreachable all weekend — critical for a directory where homeowners are calling at 2am
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Two recent reviewers confirm last-minute and emergency response during business hours, and one notes they will hurry for emergencies, but the February 2026 weekend non-contact incident raises a real question about after-hours availability for true emergencies.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.8 across 26 reviews while Yelp shows 2.3 across 10 reviews — a 2.5-star gap — with Yelp capturing the most severe complaints including the owner confrontation, the asbestos/ceiling damage incident, and the no-show appointment, suggesting the Google rating significantly overstates the typical risk profile.
