reviews.text:
Alex came out. He was kind and friendly and reassuring.

Alex is an amazing job to show up. Get the work done within integrity and commitment.

I had a New water softener installed And I can’t wait to see how amazing my curly hair looks after today.

Hands-down would hire them again for all plumbing needs. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Kevin Palcsak
reviews.text:
Bradley found the issue and provided a clear quote for the work, and Alex took the lead in fixing it. They were both friendly and knowledgeable throughout the entire process. It turned out to be a larger project with some unexpected challenges thanks to our older home, but Alex always had solutions and still managed to stay within the original estimate.
He was consistently respectful of our space and offered helpful tips as we navigate being new homeowners. It’s never enjoyable having to spend a significant amount of money just to get your home working the way it should, so I hope I don’t need to see Alex or Brad again anytime soon—but if you do need work done, I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Christopher Hudson
reviews.text: Fantastic response!  Had a complicated issue with an iron pipe.  I called, got an immediate response, got a window for the next morning, and the problem was completely resolved by the middle of the afternoon.  Jeffrey was efficient, explain the quote and what the work was going to entail, and kept his time estimate! He cleaned up nicely the area.  Very pleased.

reviews.author: Chris Nesci
reviews.text:
Flo Pro Plumbing was fantastic from start to finish. We recently had a water softener installed, and our technician, Kahlil, did an outstanding job. He was punctual, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. Kahlil took the time to explain the system, answer all our questions, and make sure everything was installed perfectly. The quality of his work and his attention to detail were clear.
We’re extremely happy with the service and highly recommend Flo Pro Plumbing—and especially Kahlil—for anyone needing plumbing work done. Great experience all around!

reviews.author: Carina Baker
reviews.text: Elijah was professional and thorough. I am pleased with the communication, friendliness, transparency, and effectiveness that came with this job. I had my main water shutoff valve replaced (kind of a big deal) and I appreciate Flow Pros working with me despite the preexisting material. The price was fair, scheduling prompt, and warranty great. They will not disappoint!

reviews.author: Giselle Patrick
reviews.text: GOAT Plumbing is an awesome company and my Technician Peyton was the absolute best. He was knowledgeable and professional and he made sure to answer any questions we had. He kept us informed throughout the process and was always friendly and kind. Everything he said he would do he actually did. He kept his word. We couldn’t have asked for anyone better. I would recommend GOAT Plumbing to everyone.

reviews.author: Robin King
reviews.text:
I needed to replace my pretty old water heater (Insurance mandated) and got about three quotes for replacement on three different systems (tank-less, Essence, and traditional electric).

The GOAT came in as the lowest bid for all three and Natalie (our bidder and installer, at separate times) was absolutely the most knowledgeable and professional of all three reps.

We went with the Essency to get the benefits of tank-less like cost savings without having to up my breaker and change pipes.

Natalie answered literally every question I had through the bidding and install processes and seriously helped me make the best decision of the options.

Then she showed up and installed it. Not much to say about that except she was great at maneuvering though my crowded garage, completed a perfect and professional installation (expected, I know, but it is Florida...), and also handled disposal and cleanup so well, you'd never know she was there (except it's cleaner than the rest of my garage). All this and she took time to talk me about the uses and benefits of reciprocating saws.

Straight 10/10. I could not be more satisfied with every step of this process.

reviews.author: Marisha G
reviews.text: I have never been more excited to give someone my money then I was today! I received astronomical quotes from other plumbing companies. With respect to their skill and expertise, they were trying to upcharge and take advantage of a possible client.   I didn't have to deal with that with Pete from The Goat Plumbing. The initial phone call was clear and I was able to get an appointment that worked with my schedule.    The company sends reminders and pictures of employees for safety. Pete came in with a great attitude and clear pricing. I was able to do three plumbing issues for a great price that was under what the the other companies priced for just two items.   Not only was the work quality but Pete was constantly cleaning up after his work. In addition he didn't speak to me like I was ignorant. I knew what to do I just didn't want to do it, lol. He showed me the issues, advised on next steps to maintain and AGAIN....kept everything clean.   Call the Goats and ask for Pete!

reviews.author: Karla Garrido
reviews.text:
I feel significantly overcharged for this service. The technician replaced a small section of galvanized pipe (under $50 in material) and completed the job in less than 20 minutes, yet I was charged $700.

I was told they would dig and review the condition of the pipes, but they only dug approximately 5 inches into the sand before stating everything looked great. This did not seem like a thorough inspection.

For the amount of work performed and the limited time on site, the pricing felt unreasonable. I strongly suggest getting other estimates before moving forward with this company.

reviews.author: Mikka Patterson
reviews.text: The GOAT Plumbing  has earned the business of Girl Scouts of West Central Florida! We had an issue with our hot water heater having corrosion build up and The GOAT Plumbing team , specifically Natalie, came to our rescue! Everyone  from the beginning to end was extremely professional. Communication was everything a busy organization like us could ask for! Appointment times to fit our needs as well as quick responses to ensure we not only had our issue resolved but met our non profit processes for repair work. Pricing was fair, repair was fast and thorough, and it was a pleasure having Natalie on our side! Highly recommend The GOAT Plumbing Co!

reviews.text: I had flooding coming from two separate restrooms and wasn't sure of the source, as there were other aquatic activities taking place in the house. reviews.author: Robert Rivera
reviews.text: Hired Dean’s plumbing to replace toilet flange, which had to be solder to lead pipe.  The toilet was previously removed by owner at time of remodel demo.  Had some concerns after first plumber completed work.  Mainly that flange was not level and that flange was oblong.  The second plumber reviewed the work and assured me that there would be no issues with wax ring making a tight seal once new toilet was installed.  The new modern toilet I had on hand could not be installed because the water line had to be moved over 3 inches, which would’ve cost and additional one thousand dollars.  The toilet was instead returned to the store and new regular toilet ordered.  This new order will take a few days as I needed a toilet with a 14 inch rough in.

reviews.author: John White
reviews.text:
I've used Dean's Plumbing for several extensive jobs over a two year period.

Each time, the work was performed by Jason, a tech/ Plumber.  He is always methodical, thorough and honest with his work
I got an extensive leak repaired a and, water heater.  Between the projects, the totto work was over $10k.
Jason is diligent and uses logic, details and his technical skills to explain how their total cost is needed and options fits in each situation.

I trust Dean's Plumbing and recommend you consider their services.  Compair to others, establish a relationship with whom you want and go for it.  I was pleased and still have a long term relationship with Kason and Dean's Plumbing.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: We needed a water heater replacement and Dean's Plumbing got it done. Originally I had used a big box store who supposedly had same day service. His work was excellent and thoughtful to the property even with some major work to put in new plumbing to outside. I would recommend and will use them again if I run into a plumbing issue.

reviews.text: We had a plumbing leak at an elbow on the hot water line from our water heater. Jon from Dean’s Plumbing did an excellent job repairing the line with a better quality elbow. We will for sure use Dean’s for other projects this spring. See before and after photos of the repaired line.

reviews.author: Aaron Nick
reviews.text:
🎖⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐🎖

I had an excellent experience with 1-Tom-Plumber and wanted to take a moment to recognize their team.

When I realized I had a plumbing issue that needed immediate attention, I started calling plumbing companies in my area. After speaking with around 15 different companies and being told by several that the earliest appointment would be three days out, I was getting pretty frustrated. Before giving up, I decided to expand my search a little and looked on the Fort Worth side instead of Arlington. That’s when I found 1-Tom-Plumber.

I called and was connected with Chris, and from the very beginning he was fantastic. Chris was extremely friendly, down to earth, and easy to talk to. It honestly felt like I was talking with someone I had known for years. He explained everything clearly and let me know they could have a technician out within about three hours. He also told me the technician, David, would call with an ETA between 1–3 PM.

To my surprise, less than 40 minutes later I received a call from David saying he was about 15 minutes away and wanted to make sure I’d be home. That kind of fast response was impressive.

When David arrived, he was just as great as Chris had been on the phone—very professional, friendly, and easy to talk with. I showed him the issue where I thought a sprinkler line had busted. Before cutting anything, David took the time to run a few tests to make absolutely sure we were dealing with the correct line. It turns out it actually wasn’t the sprinkler line at all—it was my main water line. I really appreciated that he double-checked everything before making the repair, because that kind of attention to detail matters.

Once he confirmed the issue, he had all the parts he needed right on the truck and got to work. He capped and secured the line properly, tested everything afterward, and made sure everything was working correctly before wrapping up.

After the repair we even spent some time talking for about 15–20 minutes. Both Chris and David were genuinely great people to deal with, and the overall experience was one of the best service calls I’ve had.

If I ever have plumbing issues again, 1-Tom-Plumber will absolutely be the first company I call. They made what could have been a stressful situation simple and easy, and that kind of customer service is hard to find these days.

Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Chanel VanHook
reviews.text:
1-Tom absolutely rocked an urgent plumbing job I needed fixed on a Sunday. I called around noon and spoke to their lovely dispatcher, a *REAL PERSON* right off the bat. She immediately took my details, was upfront about pricing and had a tech on the way within 5 minutes. The tech, called me about 20 minutes later to tell me he was on the way, showed up 20 minutes after that and fixed my issue in roughly 3 minutes.
I called a few different places and they were the only ones who didn't use some automated answering service and they were the only ones who ACTUALLY acknowledged the urgency of my request and could send a tech immediately.
Additionally, the tech I had, David C., is such a professionally pleasant young man and he explained everything he was doing along with advice about drying out the area to prevent mold and other long term issues. Even my scaredy cats loved David and they're afraid of all strangers!
Can't recommend 1-Tom enough and they will definitely be my go-to plumbers going forward. Thanks y'all!

reviews.author: Lindsey Hopper
reviews.text:
Absolutely blown away by the great service. This is the second time we have used this company. Scott and David were both so professional, polite, and knowledgeable. We had a lot of issues we needed addressed and they explained things clearly and were so patient, but also worked quickly. In and out in about 45 minutes.

We had a hot water heater issue with water temp in our primary bathroom not maintaining temperature. It’s gas so we didn’t want to mess with it and they resolved that quickly. They also cleared a clogged sink, fixed water pressure in our kitchen sink and I asked them to look at the outdoor hose spigots.

After they finished everything Scott was thoughtful enough to ask if there was anything else I wanted him to look at. That’s when I mentioned the kitchen sink water pressure and he was happy to take a look at it. I am a female in my 30s and felt so comfortable with David and Scott in my home. I will continue to call them for all plumbing needs and will encourage our neighbors to do the same!

reviews.author: David Swindle
reviews.text: I had a serious plumbing issue with clogged drains. Scott and David scoured every clean-out and vent pipe to find and remove the clog. Working outside in the cold,  digging out refuse from the pit housing the pump, up-grading my underpowered grinder pump, up on the roof auguring the clean-outs were all handled with expertise and good humor.  Scott was mentoring  David and the professional working relationship was evident and worked very successfully.  The estimate provided before work began was honored - no quibbles or changes im spite of numerous difficulties. Scott and Chris were able to procur the upgraded pump and Scott and David began work right on time. My experience with1-Tom-Plumber makes them my go to guys! No reservations.

reviews.text:

They replaced a toilet, snaked a line and replaced a valve on my guest bathroom toilet and it cost me the same as the other company for their two visits that didn't fix anything.

I will absolutely use 1 Tom Plumbers from now on!

reviews.text: If you want an honest, reliable plumber who does good work, shows up when they say they will show up, communicates openly and honestly, provides full transparency, and offers fair and competitive rates, this is the company. Once the leak was located,  and the repair ended up being quicker and simpler than originally quoted, they adjusted the price accordingly, which ended up saving a significant amount of money not only over the competitors quotes, but over their original quote.  Thanks Jacob and thanks, Flow Bros for a great experience.  We will recommend you to everyone we know.

reviews.author: Greg Waldron
reviews.text:
I experienced a sewage back up at my home on a Saturday. Called Flow Bros and Jason worked me in late that day. He opened the line and then deployed a camera to inspect the drain line. He discovered and showed me a spot where the line appeared to be collapsed. I hired him to repair the line and he dug and repaired the line the following day. Upon digging the line the problem was clearly seen.

I fiber optic company the City allowed to run cable in the easement bored through the drain line and the pulled a cable through the line.

Flow Bros was prompt, courteous, knowledgeable, professional, honest, and had the line repaired in the time frame promised.

I will definitely call them when I have a plumbing issue in the future. I am giving them 5 stars because there isn’t an option to choose 6.

I  am exceptionally pleased with them and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Julie M
reviews.text:
I can’t express how outstanding my experience was with EPN. We had a plumbing emergency hit on a Saturday night at 9:30pm. Before reaching EPN, I had called so many so called “emergency” plumbers that night and none would answer or return calls. Then I came to EPN and Brandon was the ONLY business that answered the phone! Brandon told me Jacob would be out in an hour after his preceding job. Brandon kept his word and Jacob showed up. It was 11:30pm. We had a TOUGH job and Jacob worked so hard trying to get it cleared out. Ultimately Jacob and Brandon both had to return the next day with more powerful equipment to clear the line due to tree roots. Jacob was hard working, courteous, persistent and driven. He was not giving up. He showed us what he was seeing and explained to us throughout the process. When the job was completed the price was exceptionally reasonable. Every time provided and commitment given was upheld. They made an unpleasant circumstance a very tolerable experience. We will definitely use EPN again. We also now have their annual maintenance plan!
P.s. two days later and none of those other emergency plumbers have even returned our messages!

reviews.author: John Payne
reviews.text:
What a great company! My first encounter with EPN, LLC was when our home was flooded and we needed the pipe fixed. Jacob was fast, efficient, and friendly. Then, as we were remodeling our home immediately following the flood, we got estimates from Jacob and the owner, Brandon, for both tank and tankless water heaters. Jacob made excellent recommendations, so we went with a tankless system. Jacob & Dustin came out, did all the prep work to relocate the system according to new codes, installed the system, and dealt with all the inspectors and issues that came up.  They took care of everything! We're extremely pleased with the work that Brandon, Jacob, and Dustin have done for us. We feel like we've made friends along the way, too. EPN, LLC will be our go-to for all our plumbing needs going forward!

Dustin and Ryan came to our home on 1/26/24 to repair the leaking water connector valves going to our washer and refrigerator. The work they did was excellent, and both of them were so helpful and friendly. They just reinforced how much we like the people who work there.  THE BEST!

reviews.author: Kiel
reviews.text:
I recently had an outstanding experience with Emergency Plumbers Now and felt compelled to share.

Dustin Jordan, has done various jobs throughout my house, replaced a hot water heater and recently took on a HUGE job...replaced all the plumbing beneath my house. He has done all this work from the smaller jobs to the big jobs with remarkable professionalism and efficiency.

What really stood out was their clear and consistent communication. They've kept me updated every step of the way with phone calls and text.

They also surprised me with very reasonable pricing. However, the real benefit is their dedication to doing quality work that is top-notch. I can't tell you enough how rare it is to find a contractor who truly does things right the first time.

I signed up for their annual maintenance plan which was a no-brainer after seeing their professionalism, commitment to quality and the value that plan is offering.

If you're in need of reliable and high-quality plumbing services, look no further than Emergency Plumbers Now. Great job, Dustin and team!

reviews.author: Justin Lewis
reviews.text:
We had a catastrophic water event. We called around and got no reassurance, and no one had any sense of urgency to help us. We felt overwhelmed and discouraged.

Then a friend recommended Emergency Plumber Now. What a difference they made! They live up to their name in every way. They got on the phone with us immediately, gave us clarity, and took quick action.

Dustin showed up to our house he was super friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. And our dogs loved him.

EPN even helped us work with our insurance company.

I couldn’t be more relieved and satisfied. They’ve got a lifelong customer from me.

reviews.author: mike Starks
reviews.text: All I can say is we had a major emergency the whole water system in our house leading from our water well to the pressure tank blew out we were lucky to find this company and they sent a gentleman named Dustin. You need to remember that name Dustin he is the most kind efficientPlumber person all around man you would ever wanna meet he’s dedicated to make sure you are taking care of or he won’t leave so please read this and if you have a plumbing issue of any kind, please call this company and definitely ask for Dustin to come out

reviews.author: TY YOUNG
reviews.text: Outstanding experience! Jacob, our Plumber conducted a thorough inspection, showcasing all possible plumbing issues. He had extensive knowledge of water heaters which was a big concern of ours. He had clear explanations for any question we had and didn’t seem to rush through or be bothered at all by my wife’s grocery list of questions like previous companies. We received prompt service and valuable insight. Jacob with Emergency Plumber Now is definitely A go-to professional for plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Toua Lo
reviews.text: Jacob and Brandon are awesome. I'd recommend them any day. Jacob arrived early and was professional the entire time, keeping me in the loop as he worked on diagnosing the cause of the constant knocking my family and I have had the displeasure of experiencing for the last few months. They were able to quickly diagnosed and remedied the problem in a timely manner. No more knocking! Thanks for the peace of mind. I appreciate you guys

reviews.author: Eva Graham
reviews.text: Jacob and Casey did an awesome job for us!! They installed a new kitchen faucet, garbage disposal, and an under the counter water purifier for us on the same day. They arrived when they said they would, were respectful and thorough, and they cleaned up after themselves. Also appreciated all the communication before, during, and after the job. Highly recommend! 😃

reviews.author: Rita May
reviews.text: I highly recommend using Emergency Plumber Now. They made a quick appointment for me and when Dustin Jordan arrived, he could not have been more professional as he tried to solve my gas fireplace problem with no help at all from me. He went above and beyond to correct the problem. I later got a follow up call which shows what great customer service they have.

reviews.author: Peggy Tomlinson
reviews.text: We didn't have an emergency, but we did need service, and EPN responded readily. Jacob was efficient and capable in installing the flood stop on our water heater, and readily walked me through how it worked and how to know when the batteries would need replacing. It was a good experience and we'll gladly call them again for our next plumbing need.

reviews.author: Rayleen Sullivan
reviews.text: These guys are AMAZING!  I called them before 7:00 AM with a huge water leak caused by roofers putting a nail through a water line.  They were at the house by 7:45 AM and had called out the restoration help! that arrived within the house---ON A SUNDAY!  Seriously, they couldn't have been more helpful, concerned, caring, and efficient.

reviews.text: We were very happy with our experience. They came out when they said. They called ahead. They arrived on time and were very professional and didn't leave any mess. They were also friendly so we will definetely use them again

reviews.author: Alex G.
reviews.text: Highly recommend J Rowe, after looking online for a plumber that I felt I could trust I decided to try out J Rowe. I called them after 8:00 and Meshell actually answered me. She was professional and was able to make me an appointment for the next day. Then on the next day, she called and was able to get a plumber out to me sooner. Dillon was our plumber, no hassle and didn't try to up sell us additional things. He was also professional and respectful and got the job done fast and right. I will definitely spread the word for them.

reviews.author: Kristi Whittle
reviews.text: Clannad and his partner were very professional and knowledgeable. They were also friendly, helpful and went above and beyond to help fix my old quirky house’s plumbing!

reviews.author: Nickie W
reviews.text: Rude receptionists wasn’t willing to answer any questions short and unprofessional

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.text:
UPDATE
Owner responded but did not call me to offer any solutions so this is really just spin control but I get it. Lots of arguing the wrong point this was not about paying the quoted rate it was about bait and switch

You told me quote over email. Not true. You had the parts in your truck to do the job the first time but insisted on hunting for more expensive parts. Finally you quoted an install then half way through you changed your price by presenting a second quote I had no choice at that point.  These toilets are no harder to install because they have electronics in fact they are easier just plug and play. What did your techs configure on the electronics? Nothing.  They plugged it in handed me the remote..

Makes me mad that you would try to spin it this way and I’m tempted to file a complaint with the TAG for deceptive trade practices

I needed a toilet installed and typically do it myself but was busy and thought I would let a professional do it.  I saw good reviews and adds bragging they had lots of parts onboard and could get jobs done in one trip. In summary I think they do quality work but they are looking to charge as much as possible and are not looking out for the customer at all which I found disheartening in this economic time where people are struggling.  I feel like I was taken advantage of.

1. I made an appoint. Asked for an estimate which their website says they will give you.  Someone called to schedule the appointment when I asked what is the estimate, they said they were just a scheduler and could not give one they will give you one when they arrive so you get hit with a trip charge.  Red Flag #1.

2. Arrived on time.  Professional appearance.   Looked at my toilet and the location and presented me a $500 estimate to install. Wow.  I was expecting maybe $300 it takes like 30 mins.  I was so busy and about to leave for a business trip so I just said ok do it at least it will be done and I assume professionally installed.  Red Flag #2

3. Toilet installed but now we have a problem they cannot connect it to the wall because they don't have an adapter or the part.  Now they present me with another estimate for $344 to install an adapter.  Really? This is what really makes me mad.  If they would have told me in advance they were going to need that I would have said not to do it but they waited until the toilet was installed.  Not sure if this was just incompetence or planned but it's bad either way.  Red Flag #3.

4. They say the part is rare or something.  I pull one up at Lowes and buy it online in less than 5 mins. They say they will come back and install if I get the $12 part because they wanted like $150 to go get it.  More craziness and Red Flag #4

5. They come the next day.  They again say they can't get the part to work so going to go "research".  I am without a toilet for a week.  Red Flag #5.

5.  I have to text them and say hello what is happening begging them to come charge me $350 to finish the job.  They come back and basically make an adapter (copper to Pex) charge me $350 for that so why didn't we just do that day one???? Red Flag #6

So in the end, they completed the job for $844, 3 x the cost of the toilet which is absurd.  Does it work.  Yes. So far.  Does the work seem like quality work?  Yes it does.  They forgot to caulk or did not care to but I am sure that is an add on.  Guys who installed were nice enough, kept saying it was not them they have to charge this amount seemed embarrassed or it's just part of the sales tactic.  Would I trust this company again?  No I think they take advantage of people.

reviews.author: Dylan C.
reviews.text:
DO NOT CALL THIS COMPANY! They do not honor their warranties!
Last year (2020), we had our entire house re-piped for about $8,000. J Rowe plumbing gave us a 20 year manufacture's warranty and a 5 year parts and labor warranty. This was stated on my signed invoice as well as well as the statement "Warranty does not cover rodent damage." This was all that was stated about this warranty. Unfortunately, one of our outdoor, frost-free, hose bibs was leaking water into the house as well as through the brick exterior. J Rowe plumbing wanted to charge me $275 to repair something that was clearly covered under our warranty that was on my signed invoice. The technician was extremely friendly and told me to call the office when I didn't agree. I finally got on the phone with Mishell, the co-owner of the company. Mishell told me that this was not covered under the warranty and that freezing pipes is considered "common knowledge" about not being covered under warranty. I asked her why the warranty exclusions were not put on the contract/invoice. She stated that it would "take up too much room." I told her once again what my invoice stated about the warranty (the only exclusion being rodent damage) and she would not honor it. I asked her to send me an email listing the warranty exclusions and she said "I will get to it when I have time--I'm busy." I told her that I wasn't happy of her decision and also told her that she needs to include the warranty exclusions in her invoices for the future. I also said that I thought it was sad that she would destroy a relationship with someone over a part that costs $15. She said "well [the relationship] has already been damaged." Clearly an $8,000 job doesn't mean anything to this company. I will not be recommending J Rowe plumbing to anyone in the future. I am disappointed that someone would run their company like this. A suggestion would be to apologize for not having it included and fix it without charge. I have still yet to receive this warranty exclusion email. Clearly customer service is not J Rowe Plumbing's forte, nor is the owner concerned about customer service.

reviews.author: K C.
reviews.text:
I would never recommend this company, especially their tech James who is a total scammer!!
I had a relatively easy fix (1.5hr job for a rookie tech); a leak in a 1" nipple between the water meter and the water pressure reducing valve on our water supply line. I showed their tech exactly where the leak was; he immediately started to tell me we needed to replace the entire water supply line from the meter to the house...ya, without even digging in.  Again, I showed him the actual leak, and explained all that needed to be done. He looked at it for a moment, then agreed and cleaned out around the hole at the meter box. When he dug out around the pressure release valve it was clear to see all he needed to do was replace the nipple and plum the valve back in. Again, he started telling me he needed to replace everything because it would not work unless he did this and that... he just kept talking, making thing up (one of those guys who think all homeowners are all idiots).  I actually got down and pointed out what needed to be done; again silence, then he agreed I was right... what an ass!! He wanted to do a lot of work on our line that was not needed. I am an engineer by trade, my specially was troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, piping (pluming) issues. This job should have been completed in 1.5hr's tops. My wife keep asking me why he was just standing around on his phone all the time... Because of lack of actual work the job took him two (2) hours, he ended up replacing the nipple that was leaking, but then replaced all the new brass extensions/fittings on the water pressure reducing valve we had installed a few years prior (in great condition) and he replaced those with PVC pipe... He charged us $589.00 for this. Beware of this company!!!

reviews.author: sandy kurtzman
reviews.text:
I've had two bad experiences with plumbers and plumbing companies in the past 9 months when I reached out to JRowe Plumbing.
I called yesterday at just after 5 p.m. with a "no-rush" job I needed to get a quote on.  I expected to leave a messages and someone would get back to me sometime.
To my delight, Lisa, the dispatcher, answered the phone. She was driving, but said she'd call back in about a half hour to help me.
She then called back and set me up quickly for the next day between noon and 2. The plumbers, Jamey and Jessie arrived, I showed them the project, and they said they'd get my quote ready by no later than the next morning.
Both plumbers were very knowledgeable and professional, and both asked great questions to help them learn more about the job. They didn't make me feel rushed  and were genuinely interested in my project and how they could best help me. I appreciated how they made a few suggestions based on my answers, and asked if those suggestions made sense to me. It demonstrated how they sought to find solutions that were affordable and efficient. What a breath of fresh air!!! In a sea of plumbing companies, JRowe Plumbing, along with plumbers Jamey and Jessie, popped to the top. The company really impressed me for hiring plumbers who have excellent communication skills, as well as great plumbing skills! Too many companies fail to realize how important communication is!
Thanks for working me in so quickly, too, Lisa!!!
The job was completed, done well, and they cleaned up after themselves! Very reasonable priced, too.
I'd hire them again in an instant!!!

reviews.author: Dee L.
reviews.text:
EDIT EDIT:   I owe Jason and J Rowe an apology.  After 3 other plumbers telling me the same thing on what the city would have inspected in 2019, (the city only said I passed, not specifically what they look at) I'm convinced the city would have not checked out everything I thought they would have.  J Rowe was recommended by a business I 100% trust so I feel confident I posted the bad review before getting sufficient information.  We did still go with another company this time, but not due to this.  

Jason came out for leaky water heater.  Husband said he seemed like a decent guy.  Jason stated water heater set up was not to code and he couldn't even work on it.  He would have to do a lot of rework to it.  And we would need a new water heater.  Water heater had been City inspected in 2019 when plumbing work had been done.  Called city when he left and they verified it had passed their inspection and no known changes to code since then. 

Misti, the lady who answered the phone, was very delightful and got us a very quick appointment.  She's why they are getting more than one star.

EDIT: Mishell called me pretty quickly to discuss why I left a bad review.  I appreciate that they care about any bad experience a customer might have.

reviews.author: Larry B.
reviews.text: Please use caution when selecting this company for servicing your plumbing needs. They partially completed a job by removing my water closet a week ago because I was having new flooring replaced. When I contacted them this week to have them return to reinstall the closet, I asked what the total charge would be. How about over $400 initially. When I questioned why so high, it was reduced to $351. This was to remove a toilet...20 minutes at most leave and return at another date to reinstall it. Then, I asked Jeffery about the company warranty, as I was concerned if they would cover my flooring if the toilet leaked. He balked and said no he would not cover it. I then asked to have a written warranty for the services I would be paying for. I did not receive a favorable answer and he hung up. Later in the morning I received an email stating I owed them $156 for the initial service and that I had requested they not return to complete the job.  This was a frivolous statement, I said no such thing. I will pay my $156 as I owe that, but this shady action and cost for his services are way over the top and needs to be heard by future clients.

reviews.author: Michael Guzman
reviews.text: Yesterday I saw a plumbing truck 2 houses down and went over and asked the gentleman if he had a card and took the time while working on the other house to ask me some qualifying questions about my issue. The fact he was on another site and didn’t pass me off to just call was impressive and really showed me he takes pride in his job and customers who need help. Told me to call the number and ask for the co-owner Jesse Morales.  I called the number and I think the person who answered the call was Jenny (if I am wrong let me know and I will correct). They worked to try and schedule me that day but had to come the following morning between 8am-10am. Showed up on time and even received a text indicating who would be there and they were on their way with a picture of the worker. Fixed our issue within a few hours perfectly, offered a referral for the flooring issue due to the flooding and is sending an estimate for another issue I will need fixed. I cannot express my gratitude other than letting anyone know who needs plumbing work done these are the ones to call!

reviews.author: Surgpsych ..
reviews.text: I called J Rowe to get a quote for a simple residential job. Their business truck is parked on the same road I live on, so that is why I called J Rowe and I figured it would be convenient for the plumber. The office secretary gave me time frames to schedule a plumber. The time frame was in the afternoon when I would be home from work. The day the plumber was scheduled to come, she called me 3 hours ahead of time saying that the plumber was ready to go to my home. I reminded her that I was at work and that I would obviously have to be home for the appointment. She was very insensitive and just told me, "Well the plumber is ready. Take it or leave it, otherwise we will reschedule" I told her how rude she was and that I was cancelling the appointment due to the unprofessionalism of her tone. I don't know the quality of workmanship that this company provides, but if they are hiring office staff that should be representatives of the company, steer clear!! There are many other plumbing companies that appreciate the business they receive.

reviews.author: K F
reviews.text: I just tried to visit another business that they share a lot with and one of the guys was talking to another man in a red truck who was blocking the entire path forward into the lot and wouldn't move their truck to let me drive past them. They both made eye contact with me and remained there watching me wait for them to move over to allow me clearance and instead they continued their conversation without moving over to allow me to pass. The owner of the business that I was visiting confirmed that this was not uncommon behavior for them. They didn't know whether I was a potential customer yet they couldn't even be courteous enough to share a pathway for other cars to drive by and after reading some of the negative reviews regarding their unprofessionalism, it appears that this is a trend with this business. I'm writing this to say that if a business behaves in this disrespectful and inconsiderate way with strangers and business neighbors, I would ask myself, is this the type of "business" one would want to do business with? 🤔

reviews.author: Jamie Scott
reviews.text:
Josh was amazing! He was very professional and described what he was planning on doing. He completed the job in a timely manner and was so friendly. I don't know much about the pricing but I felt it was very reasonable. I would definitely recommend. 🙂🙂

Adding to this review that Larry and Augustin came out after we had a gas leak and were able to resolve the issue quickly and courteously. I also decided to have them replace my very old water heater. Their prices are reasonable and they are great about communicating what they are doing. Still highly recommend.

Adding again on 10/27/2025. We have had a continuous usage notice from the water dept. Larry and Gus came out and did a check. They came to the conclusion that it was the auto fill valve for our pool that is hooked into our irrigation. They checked a number of things around the house and gave advice. They were professional and polite. Still highly recommend.

reviews.author: Gary G.
reviews.text: My name is Gary Gordon. I had never used this company before nor had I heard of them. I just crossed my fingers and prayed. I was dealing with another company to help me with an unusual plumbing problem with my kitchen sink. I was told point blank that I needed to purchase a completely new faucet because of ONE small part. Of course I did want to. I called J. Rowe and they Jeremy. He and his assistant promptly diagnosed the problem. Jeremy took a picture of the broken part and sent it to his parts guy. Within the hour he had the part and installed it! He was fantastic! Needless to say that I was extremely pleased and relieved! Thanks to Jeremy and J. Rowe my New go to plumber. 5 plus stars.

reviews.author: Candi CooCoo
reviews.text: M. Bell's review for Jesse with Baker Brothers.  I called Baker Brothers to get a 2nd opinion and price for a supposed broken sewer line under my house caused by tree roots. The cost estimate from the first plumber that I called out had quoted a price for repair to be upwards of $10,000.  After careful and extensive examination of my ENTIRE sewer system by Jesse with Baker Bros, it was determined there was no need for ANY repairs AT ALL to be made. Jesse was very thorough and had ME watch the screen as the camera went the entire length of my sewer line. With his equipment, Jesse was able to show me exactly from INSIDE of my house where his camera was UNDER my house at any given moment. I was very impressed with his knowledge of the situation and my mind was finally put to rest. I highly recommend Jesse with Baker Brothers.  He not only saved me $10,000 I was quoted by the first plumber, but saved the construction mess and cleanup I would have had to endure. I will recommend this company to my friends and family for certain. Thank you Jesse and Baker Brothers! I appreciate you so much!

reviews.author: Sandra Williams
reviews.text: The technician relaced my ceiling fan which was not working very well. He inspected the area to assure that there were no problems.  He installed the new ceiling fan perfectly. He was very professional,  knowledgeable, and respectful. He explained the steps he made to me. His work was flawless. I was very pleased with the outcome of the service.

reviews.author: Mercie Gonzalez
reviews.text: I just want to say thank you to our technician, Jonathan and to the team at Baker Brothers. He came in last night and helped us get our AC going. From the initial call and to the upcoming work we’re having to set up on our unit, everyone has been super helpful and transparent. We’re so grateful to have found your team to work with and we’ll definitely be continuing service for as long as possible.

reviews.author: Patrick A.
reviews.text: Called Baker Brothers on the recommendation of a neighbor because of a possible slab leak.  Technician came out same day which was great but failed to find the leak. Said we would have to replace the homeowners valve (2100$$) to begin the process of elimination to determine the source of the leak. When I asked about infrared thermal imaging he said he didn't know what I was talking about. Cost me 60 bucks and I still have no clue where my leak is coming from.  Gonna call someone else!

reviews.author: Jo Ann G.
reviews.text: I called Baker Brothers out to repair a commercial faucet. The only thing that was wrong was the small handle on the faucet needed to be replaced. They quoted me almost $600 and told me that because it was commercial it cost more. I sent them on their way because I thought this was highway robbery. My husband ended up going to the commercial plumbing store and purchasing the part for $27.79 and it took him one minute to install it. This type of price gouging is absolutely unacceptable!

reviews.author: Mark W.
reviews.text:
Customer service, in terms of communication with the customer, sadly, appears to be the weak link of this company. Furthermore, when they do communicate, the level of unprofessionalism is simply breathtaking. This review is not about the competence or quality of work by their plumbers, at all, just for clarity. This review is about customer service, professionalism and attitude.

Thus, viewing through this lens, below you will find a text I received from their field supervisor for our area. For context, I was given an estimate the day prior for over $7000 to do the plumbing work that I desired to have done. I needed to absorb this massive amount for a bit and had told this supervisor to give me a couple days to think about it. However, about an hour after talking to him the next morning, with a few questions I had, I just decided...let's just get the job done. So, I messaged the supervisor back at around 11:AM and asked him to please give me a call when he got a chance. Obviously, I didn't expect not to hear from him for another eight hours. I was ready to ink the contract and go. However, by 6:30 pm that evening I still hadn't heard from him, didn't hear from office staff, or otherwise. Ziltch. Just left hanging.

So, once again I messaged the supervisor and let him know that it appears I must not be relevant to them as a customer and thus, I would just take my business elsewhere. Again, zero customer service, I had no choice. I needed to roll since we've got a bad prv out here. Okay, maybe the supervisor was busy, you ask? Have the office team reach out to me... that's called professionalism! That's called customer service! Stop for 30 seconds and let me know you're tied up, will get back with me as soon as you can. A $7100 project was on the line here, folks. A dismal customer service failure. And, when the supervisor finally did reply back to my final text message... this is the message he sent back to me:

"I'm sorry you're not my only customer I've had to talk to today you said for me to call you when I had a chance. And I'm also sorry I don't have a set schedule" for work.

Wow! Shockingly unprofessional response that exposes an attitude that's unacceptable. In other words, sorry buddy, I got more customers than you...deal with it.

Folks, there's your sign. They just lost a very nice $7100 job. I will never use Baker Brother's again. Would you? After years in senior management for the largest news company in America, great customer service means alot to me. It truly matters, big time. If companies feel customer service is not a top priority and desire to become famous for subpar customer service...we, the customers, can let all of DFW and America know. Actually, that's my speciality with a news background. Only as necessary, I'm sure customers would be more than happy to oblige, pursuant to their own personal experiences for receiving less than satisfactory customer service.

Mark Welch
President
Fox Studio
(Retired)

reviews.author: Ray I.
reviews.text:
High-Cost Installation, Zero Post-Sale Support or Communication

This review is regarding a $31,000 investment (a $25,000 system/install plus $6,000 for additional insulation) that has failed to deliver on professional customer service or clear communication.
​Failure to Offer Maintenance: I was never offered a maintenance plan at the time of the initial system installation (two years ago). As a customer who just spent $31,000 on a new system and insulation, I absolutely would have purchased a maintenance plan if it had been presented to me.
​Blaming the Customer: Two years later, when I called for service, the company now informs me about the necessity of maintenance and attempts to shift the blame to me for the system not being properly maintained. I relied on them, as the supposed experts, to advise me on how to protect my massive investment.
​Poor Management Response: When the issue escalated to a manager, the conversation was unproductive. Despite my clear frustration--and while I acknowledge I used some strong language--Oscar the manager attempted to prematurely terminate the call by claiming I was talking over him, even though he was doing the same to me.  The conversation just felt like lines were drawn and he was defending the company, placing the blame on me rather than taking care of me as a valued customer.  And today, the service was extremely disappointing, especially after paying a discounted rate of $305. All the technician did was pour water in a tube and blow air into it. This minimal effort took less than 5 minutes, which felt like a complete waste of money for the diagnostic value provided.
​Unresponsive Call Center/AI: The company uses an automated AI answering service, which often feels like a way to avoid customer service. My issue was classified by the system as "urgent" and escalated over an hour ago, yet I still have not received the promised callback.
In ​Conclusion: This company installed a high-cost system but is indistinguishable from "the rest of the run-of-the-mill companies" when it comes to professionalism, follow-through, and customer support. The lack of proactive communication and subsequent blame-shifting is unacceptable.  I used to highly recommend this company, but I'm not sure that I can do that any longer after my experience with them today.

reviews.author: Jody S.
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Bakers Brothers and would strongly caution others before using them.

I originally called because my electricity was acting strange while Oncor was actively working on nearby lines. Bakers Brothers told me it would be a $60 diagnostic fee, which I agreed to. When the power issues seemed to improve, I called to cancel--but was encouraged to keep the appointment "just to be safe." That turned out to be a costly mistake.

When the technician arrived, I explained the situation and he observed voltage fluctuations that were likely tied to the ongoing utility work. Instead of advising me to wait until the external repairs were fully complete, he began recommending upgrades.

He quoted me $1,266 for a surge protector upgrade, then escalated to $2,548 total after talking through additional "lightning protection" components. He used personal anecdotes about damaged homes he's seen and emphasized warranties and protection coverage, and signing up for a membership could save me $400 on the work today. Which made the situation feel urgent and risky to ignore. Based on that, I agreed.

After installation, I reviewed the receipt and found it was charged as two identical items at $1,266 each, with a note saying installed three components. When I researched those parts myself, I found retail prices around $185, $94, and $79--roughly $338 total. Even with labor,  Industry guidance suggests installed costs typically fall in the $500-$800 range. I was charged over $2,500.

When I called to question this, I was told the pricing reflects their overhead (call centers, fleet, etc.) and warranties. That explanation does not justify such a massive markup, (312%) especially given the circumstances and the sales pressure.

I feel taken advantage of during a situation that was likely temporary and caused by external utility work. What should have been a simple diagnostic visit turned into a high-pressure upsell with pricing that appears significantly inflated.

 I would recommend getting multiple quotes and doing your own research before agreeing to any work with this company.

reviews.author: Teresa H.
reviews.text:
July 31, 2025 started out with us getting a roof that we had to pay for through Mesquite Roofing and construction.  The process of getting the roof install was pretty smooth until the workers hit the a water line on the water heater leaving damage to the attic water wise,  leaving Sheetrock damage in the garage area.  Bakers Brother was the company that installed the water heater with the exception of the pilot light going out twice,  it's had been a deceit experience.  They came out each time and showed up on the same day of the call.

Fast forward Baker Brother (Bobby Townsend)said the water line was where it was due to poor construction by the builder and their job was to only replace the water heater.  Not prevent any future issue such a as today's.  (Josh) They finally said that they replace the water line but wouldn't take accountability for their work.  The house was built in 1989 and Im almost positive that if a company replaced a product,  they should take measures to make improvements and not just do  minimal work and take people hard earned dollars.  

They also laid the blame on the City of Mesquite inspection saying it must be good enough or they wouldn't green tag it.  ( its words).  They blaming Mesquite Roofing and Mesquite Roofing is blaming Bakers Brothers for the install.

Basically nobody wants to take accountability and after paying out of pocket for a roof l am also having to get the area dried out and have the ceilings.

Moral of the story,  don't your homework.  I definitely would not recommend Bakers Brothers after this is incident or Mesquite inspection department 

Trust No one...

reviews.author: Mary Elizabeth S.
reviews.text:
We recently found a leak in our front yard. We have "Service line" coverage through our property insurance, so we called our insurance to figure out what we needed to do. They told us we could use any company to fix it, so we called Baker Brothers, because BB is who we have used since we bought our house in 2021. The leak was fixed, my husband coordinated with our insurance company, and he financed through BB when it was time to pay. When we received the reimbursement check from our insurance company, though, we realized they weren't covering the full cost of the repair - we still owe over $1500 to BB. My husband called our insurance company to ask why and they informed us that they reimburse based on a market cost analysis and that BB charges far more than the average plumbing company in our area. They suggested we try to obtain an itemized invoice so they could try to reimburse us more. My husband called BB to ask for an itemized invoice and we were informed that BB "doesn't do that." To add insult to injury, when our leak was repaired, ANOTHER leak was left by the repairmen, resulting in a continued increased water bill. 

We have spent tens of thousands of dollars with Baker Brothers since 2021. We had a gas line repaired, we bought a brand new HVAC unit, and we've had several plumbing problems fixed. To find out that this company is not only significantly overcharging but also refusing to be transparent about costs is disheartening and frankly maddening. It seems unethical at the very least. Unless this situation can be rectified, we won't be returning to Baker Brothers.

reviews.author: James H.
reviews.text:
I was extremely disappointed with the service I received from Baker Brothers and feel compelled to warn other business owners.

I specifically requested a morning appointment, yet the technician did not arrive until the afternoon, which already disrupted my salon's operations. Once he arrived, I was quoted an outrageous amount just to change sprayers on our shampoo bowls.

To be clear, only two out of six shampoo bowls were not working before he arrived. When the technician left, only two were working -- the two he never touched. The four bowls he worked on were left non-functional.

On top of that, I was quoted $5,000 to replace four vacuum breakers that were working perfectly before he showed up. Despite all of this, I was still charged $800, even though the only actual repair completed was a small pipe issue on one bowl that took maybe 20 minutes.

It also felt concerning that the technician had to call his manager for nearly every decision, which did not inspire confidence. I was left questioning whether a less experienced technician was sent because I was a new client.

Overall, this was a very frustrating experience, and I genuinely feel like I was ripped off. Like other reviewers have said -- beware. The charges are excessive, and the results did not match the cost or expectations.

reviews.author: Darin S.
reviews.text:
I was really disappointed with my recent experience with Baker Brothers. I scheduled a visit to have a simple faucet replacement done, but the technician came up with multiple reasons why he couldn't or wouldn't do the job. He didn't want to turn off the water under the sink because it was an "older style" shutoff. Then he didn't want to turn off the main water to my condo unit because of liability concerns--he even mentioned that if a neighbor's water heater wasn't full when the water was turned off, it could "fry" it, and they didn't want to be responsible.

Instead of focusing on how to solve the issue, the technician kept pointing out why he didn't want to do the work. He criticized the PVC pipes, saying he doesn't like working with them. He also gave his unsolicited opinion on my faucet choice, saying touchless ones "go bad in two years." Frankly, I didn't need commentary--I just needed the faucet replaced.

To top it off, I was charged $59 for the visit even though no work was done, and he didn't even realize I was a "family plan" member (which I had signed up for), because I booked the appointment online. Shouldn't that be something checked before arriving?

The whole experience felt like a waste of time and money. I expected better from a company with such a strong reputation.

reviews.author: Jonathon W.
reviews.text:
Baker Brothers is the kind of company that gives the entire industry a bad name. I called them out when my HVAC stopped working, and they told me the blower motor needed to be replaced $1,900+ for the part alone. I paid the service fee, only to later realize my system was still under warranty, meaning the part should have been covered.

When I called back to ask what the labor charge would be to install the part under warranty, they shamelessly insisted that the $1,900 was for labor only. That's right, they tried to charge nearly two grand for what is, at most, an hour of work.

Either they're completely incompetent or they're running a deliberate price-gouging scam, neither of which makes them worth your time or money. The blower motor itself costs under $400 online, and anyone with even basic knowledge of HVAC systems knows this.

This is not a company interested in doing right by their customers. They're interested in exploiting people who don't know better. Save yourself the frustration, the money, and the insult to your intelligence. do not call Baker Brothers.

reviews.author: D Evans
reviews.text:
I want to recognize the excellent work and professionalism provided by Michael Bryan and the Baker Brothers Team during both the original repair and follow-up visit.

This was work performed in an older home involving the kitchen disposal, dishwasher, drain stack, and floor access area. The company returned promptly to address concerns and made the situation right by installing a proper clean out access in the cabinet area for future maintenance access.

Michael Bryan was knowledgeable, patient, communicative, and thorough throughout the process. He took the time to answer questions, explain the work being performed, and ensure the final installation was completed correctly. The company’s follow-through, accountability, and customer service were greatly appreciated.

Quality plumbing work is not inexpensive, especially in older homes, and this experience demonstrated the value of a company and experienced technicians that stand behind their work.

Very satisfied with the final result.

reviews.text: I had cracked plumbing pipes as a result of having my foundation raised. While I was not shocked that I had this new issue to deal with (the foundation company had made it clear that this was a possibility), I was disappointed, especially after a conversation with the plumbing company they work with and the quote for the repairs. I decided to get a second opinion and called Baker Brothers. I had used them recently on a different issue and they had done a great job. I requested the same plumber that was assigned to me the first time, Andrew Hayes. Baker came in at a considerable savings. Andrew performed his duties exactly how he explained and then met with city inspectors and conducted a hydrostatic pressure test that is required, as it ensures that there are no leaks in the system, and they signed off on his work and gave their seal of approval. I have found Baker Brothers to be efficient, communicative and transparent and would not hesitate to recommend them.

reviews.text:
Disregard previous post for All Masters Plumbing! I would not recommend them to anyone!
I recieved a letter from the city advising that I obviously had a water leak since my usage had gone up over 2000%. I called All Masters Plumbing & a gentleman came out & misdiagnosed where the leak was. They jackhammered through the concrete in the garage, found no leak there, left a huge hole wide open & left! My wife waited several days for someone to come back & fix the damage they did. They finally showed up after they scheduled three times, twice not showing up. They did a very sloppy, unprofessional job & it was not put back to the way it was before they did their damage! Another gentleman from the same company came out & found the leak outside the house, approximately 24 feet away from where they tore up the concrete inside my garage. The actual leak was found & repaired in less than an hour.
I was surprised to get an invoice from All Masters Plumbing for $5445.00 for the work they did fixing their mistake!
Previously we signed a loan thinking it was going to be a major cost but loan was not needed because it was a leak outside! Now the loan company is calling & asking why I'm rejecting this document since All Masters Plumbing submitted the loan as work completed!
I would never recommend this Plumbing company to anyone because of the misdiagnosis, shoddy repair & charging a horrendous price for repairing the damage they did! My wife & I have called several times & left messages for the manager to call back, but he never does! All I want is my bill adjusted, I shouldn't have to pay for their mistake & I would like my concrete done so it looks like it did before they wrecked it!
I'm hoping this is a mistake made by office thinking that first job was completed properly!

reviews.author: luu frank (footspa)
reviews.text:
I want to share a genuinely positive experience with Don Plumber. For months, my store had a terrible odor that we just could not locate. At first, we suspected a gas leak, then checked the roof for leaks, and even replaced the toilet wax ring. After spending time, effort, and money, we still had no solution. The smell lingered, and on windy days it became unbearable. We had to keep both the front and back doors open just to ventilate. It was exhausting, frustrating, and disruptive to the business.

Finally, a friend recommended Don Plumber—and that changed everything. Booking the appointment was fast and easy. Don showed up on time, was extremely friendly, and took a very systematic approach in diagnosing the issue. Step by step, he traced the smell and discovered the real cause: a broken drain pipe behind the bathroom sink inside the wall. Wastewater was not going into the drain at all—it was leaking into the wall, causing mold and a horrible odor.

Don immediately proposed a solution and repaired the damaged pipe efficiently. The next day, the smell was completely gone. Their service was fast, accurate, reasonably priced, and honestly a lifesaver. Highly recommend!

They did the work and readily answered any questions that I had and when they were done,  it was a of we had two NEW toilets. Needless to say,  once again we were very pleased with their service. reviews.author: T V
reviews.text:
Feb. 27, 2026 EDIT

Thank you Ernie for responding very quickly to my review and graciously offering to make things right. Someone was indeed sent out the very next day after we called to schedule. The entire process was very pleasant, from our scheduler to our plumber. Our Plumber was Scott and he informed us that the first person did not do the job correctly and used the wrong pipe for our hot & cold water line leaking in our ceiling space which is an enclosed area (he used something meant for an open area such as under the sink instead). He removed the sharkbite fittings and installed a new correct pex fitting for a more permanent repair solution, and soldered it together - which the other person also did not do, and fixed up everything for us during the same visit. He was very pleasant to deal with, educated us, and checked out a few other spots for us while here. We are thoroughly satisfied and will definitely recommend and continue to use Ernie's in the future. Thank you Scott and Ernie! :)

----------------------------------------------------
During 'Snowmageddon' we had a pipe burst through our ceiling and Ernie's came to give us an estimate and repair. The estimate was free as they advertised, repair seemed well, and the technician seemed nice and timely. It was suggested that we get the pipe repaired with PVC(?) I believe, which is a more flexible material and will expand better instead of repairing the pipe with a metal pipe, which our original pipe is. Since he was the expert, we went with what he suggested. All seemed well until the next Winter when we noticed a leak in the same exact spot which required us to open up our ceiling again. We called Ernie's again to come and give us another free estimate. This time, the person that came (different person) said that he'd have to charge us $200 just to go into the attic to even look. That seemed weird so we tried to go without and tried to patch it up. That spot has given us problems every Winter since. We will be doing a full repair with metal soon but the thought and trauma of that ill-repaired pipe during Winter every year sucks. It's completely fine throughout the year but during Winter is when it starts leaking again. Not enough to notice right away but eventually a stain appears in the same spot on our ceiling and every time, I'm reminded of what our expert recommended which turned out to not be a wise choice for our house. That and the random charge to go into the attic left a sour taste in our mouths. Thoroughly disappointed.

reviews.author: Baxter Mullins
reviews.text:
After 25 years living in my phone, I found in December 2025 that both showers were plugged. I called Ernie’s, our long time plumbing company, to correct the problems. Ernie’s sent Anthony to check the issues with the plumbing. What was found can be classified as a “Nightmare before Christmas”. Scenario. Both sides of the plumbing had moved where the back of the house, the plumbing was much lower than the exit to the city system. Anthony allowed me to sit with him as we moved the camera from front to back showing up and down holding waste and several breaks plus tree root blockage. Another adventure!  Ernie’s replaced 115 ft of sewer lines on both major branches. Three 4’x4’ foot tunnels had to be excavated to do the job.  New sewer pipes were hung from the foundation to assure stability. The team did a good job, cleaning up the property. Anthony and the team did a great job.

Photos show new sewer pipes compared to original and the second shows front yard after the work is completed.

reviews.author: Nora Flores
reviews.text: Anthony did a great job in replacing our gas line.everything was as he said it would be . Very communicative in details. I definitely recommend him to everyone who is needing plumbing work .

reviews.author: Larry Whitaker
reviews.text:
" Buyer Beware!! "
We had Ernie's Plumbing do  scan of the sewage pipes because of a recurring clog.
After the video scan that gave use the estimate here attached.
It was VERY expensive (as you can see) so I asked for a copy of the video we paid for and they said "we do not supply copies of our scans."
That was an immediate red flag!
I called another plumbing company (LD Plumbing) and they said they could do a scan of the system and would provide a video with an explanation of what was found.
They cane out and did the complete scan and said there was a MINOR problem, showed us the scan and said they could fix it for $450!!
They did fix it for $450 not $3000 OR MORE!!
(2) Response to the owner's (Ernie) reply.
(A) I spoke at length to Michael the plumber who did the scan and he said they do not supply copies of the scan to customers, I called the office number and they confirmed to me that they do not supply copies of the scan to customers.
(B) Justin did NOT stand over Michael and watch the scan.
(C) Michael the plumber went into a long description of how laborious the repair would be to fix the dual clean out and even sent me a picture of what they would use to do the repair (see the picture). That is what we were quoted $3000 to replace!
(D) LD Plumbing came out and did a full scan of the entire pipe system inside the home and outside. Came back and said there is only one minor problem which was that the dual clean out had slipped off  the pipe and provided us with a picture (see the picture) and the repair would be quick and they would do it for $450!
(E) They did the complete repair (NO BANDAID) using exactly the same item that Michael showed me in the picture he sent. (See the picture of the FULL REPAIR!)
Once again I say BUYER BEWARE!

reviews.author: Randy Rexroat
reviews.text: Terrible company. I would not do business with them. Beware

reviews.author: Bobbie Minton
reviews.text:
The very first thing I would like to say about Ernie's Plumbing is that A REAL PERSON actually answers the phone. It is NOT a robot like the 2 previous calls I had made prior to calling Ernie's. From my initial talk with Lisa, they were so helpful and able to meet my immediate needs. Scott came out, gave me the quote, was straight forward as to what needed to be done and the time frame in which to do it. He was young and my initial impression was questionable. However, this young man was well beyond his years in knowledge, courtesy, and most of all CLEANLINESS. The area he had been working in was left in perfect condition. No signs of him ever being there. Unfortunately, this is not like past experiences I have had. There was ALWAYS something left out of order that I would have to clean up after.
With no hesitation I can honestly recommend Ernie's for any of your Plumbing needs. They will exceed your expectations. Dealing with a smaller independent company instead of a larger conglomerate in my opinion, is the only way to go. To them, you are not just another job and dollar sign, you are their lifeline.

reviews.author: Stephen Pugh
reviews.text:
Recently I had drainage trouble in my kitchen area, and I had been working with another company to try to resolve the issue. Ultimately, they wanted to excavate and replace a few pipes under the slab they couldn't clear from snaking or jetting.

I called Ernie's Plumbing for a second opinion and they sent out Gary Blakely, who said he has 45 years of experience plumbing. After explaining the issue to him, snaked from the problem area all the way to the sewer, and his camera was able to reach that far unlike the previous company. He even brought us out to see inside of the pipes with the camera ourselves. After clearing the problem, the conclusion was that we just need to maintain our drain lines regularly and address a small issue above the slab at a later date. NO excavation was required, which saves us thousands of dollars compared to the other company's quote!

Gary was courteous and knowledgeable, and solved our issue expediently. We now have peace of mind with our home. We're very happy customers!

reviews.author: William Kenny
reviews.text: The best plumbers you will ever have come to your home.  If i could give them a million stars on their rating, I would.  I had a main sewer line problem. Home warranty company was no help. Two other companies could not fix the problem referred me to a third company with a camera that lied to me about  the problem and said it was  my foundation issues their cost was 13,500.00 to fix.  I had to verify with a well known foundation company my foundation and sewer pipe was intact. This proved the third company was trying to scam me.   I finally found Ernie’s plumbing after a month of dealing with all of these incompetent crooks.  Ernie’s fix everything and guide me perfectly. Total cost 1,100.00.  Please call Ernie’s plumbing first and save yourself the headache and delays that I had to go through.

reviews.author: Winston Dietrick-Kirkpatrick Jr
reviews.text:
When my water heater began to fail, I found myself in need of capable assistance. Scott Reddick of Ernie’s Plumbing answered with admirable promptness. He arrived without delay, examined the matter with care, and presented me with an explanation of the situation along with options.

In the end, I chose to replace the unit. As promised, Scott returned soon thereafter and carried out the work with efficiency and evident skill. His craftsmanship was of a high standard, and he conducted himself with a professionalism and courtesy that one does not always encounter.

reviews.text: Randy did a great job fixing my clogged bathroom sink. He diagnosed it quickly, and replaced the pipe. He also replaced the float in the toilet, he actually noticed it needed to be replaced before I could ask him to fix it while he was already at my house doing the initial repair. He cleaned up everything and left my bathroom spotless. A weight was lifted from my shoulders after Randy repaired everything. I would highly Randy and Ernie's plumbing. Thank you all so much.

reviews.author: Sheree Collins
reviews.text: An Ernie's Plumbing Technician, Gary Blakely, came to my home Friday and today to figure out where water was running.  He was very professional, informative and he explained that it was the piece inside of the toilet that wasn't working properly.  He provided an estimate for me to review beforehand and the total remained the same after everything was completed.  The issue was resolved, thankfully, and I am once again a very pleased customer of Ernie's Plumbing.  Thank you and your staff for all of your hard work.  It is much appreciated!

reviews.author: Thomas Chapman
reviews.text: Very satisfied with Ernie’s plumbing service. Very easy to deal with on the phone, very PROMPT scheduling. Have had a leaky kitchen sink, that I’ve tried to repair myself at least 4 times. My technician, Scott Reddick, was outstanding! He was polite, professional, and knowledgeable. He fixed what I could not, in record time. A job very well done! Major relief at not having a leak anymore. Very reasonable pricing and I am a happy customer. I will be using Ernie’s again and when I do, I hope Scott is my technician again!

reviews.text: We have used Ernie’s plumbing once before and they were fantastic then and they were fantastic this most recent time as well. Robert worked quickly, located the item and had everything flushed out within 25min! We couldn’t be happier and will continue to use Ernie’s in the future.

reviews.author: Susan Edusei
reviews.text: This is the second time we have used Ernie's plumbing. If you call them ask for Robert he is amazing. He looked at our property and educated us on how to prevent future leaks and issues. He also showed me the part and identified the problem with our outdoor spigot and where it cracked. He was very up front with pricing and let me use a coupon for discount. I don't want anyone working on my pipes except Robert. Super straightforward and trustworthy.

synthesis.summary: Anthony and Scott do impressive work on complex jobs, but one reviewer caught a $2,550 markup over a competitor's price for the same repair, and a botched pipe choice caused annual winter leaks for years.
strengths: Complex diagnostic work praised in 2 of 5 reviews: Anthony used camera inspection to map 115ft of failing sewer lines and walked the homeowner through findings in real time
Corrective service responsiveness: when a faulty repair was flagged, Ernie personally responded and sent a second plumber (Scott) the next day to fix the original tech's wrong-pipe installation
Named technicians Anthony, Scott, and Austin each received specific praise for clear explanations and thoroughness across 3 separate reviews
weaknesses: Workmanship inconsistency: at least one technician used the wrong pipe material for a burst pipe repair, causing recurring winter leaks for multiple consecutive years
Pricing transparency is a real concern: one reviewer was quoted $3,000+ for a repair a competitor completed correctly for $450, and Ernie's refused to provide the paid-for scan video to the customer
redFlags: Scan video withheld from paying customer: the 1-star reviewer called both the technician and the office and was told twice that scan copies are not provided — then received a $3,000+ estimate a competitor resolved for $450 using the identical part
Inconsistent service policies: one returning customer was unexpectedly told a $200 attic-access fee applied, contradicting the free-estimate policy they'd previously experienced
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Responded during 'Snowmageddon' conditions for a burst ceiling pipe, suggesting genuine emergency availability in severe weather; overall responsiveness score of 72 and multiple mentions of timely arrival support calling them at 2am, but confirm pricing upfront before authorizing any diagnostic work.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.7 stars across 1,999 reviews suggesting broad satisfaction, but the BBB shows 2 complaints in 3 years without accreditation, and the pricing and scan-withholding issues in the analyzed reviews hint that negative experiences may be underrepresented in the Google aggregate.

reviews.text: I had a cook top installed and I smelled a faint smell of gas and called Atmos gas company (first mistake) they came out and said my cook top lines needed tightened but stated when they cut it off at the stove my gas was still going so they turned my gas off in my entire house stating that I had a leak without having me turn off my appliances including my heat. I couldn’t get anyone to come out due to the holidays and the earliest I could get someone was 12/31 which was Swat plumbing (do not recommend) and they was trying to charge an ungodly amount and what they described needed to be done for a leak inspection was not what I googled and said it would take 4 to 6 hours(not true) but I prayed about it and called Benjamin Franklin plumbing the lady said she could get somebody out TODAY!! When I tell you ATHENS CLINKSCALE IS AN ANGEL I mean it, he not only fixed my issue he calls with me and spoke with Atmos (Gas company) and explained that the technician that came out did not diagnose the gas issue properly and that I should not be charged for a permit and convinced them to turn my gas back on that night within an hour I was up an running.
