reviews.text:
Daniel was very informative, professional, and personable as he explained, thoroughly, different aspects of services that would help extend the life of my HVAC system. He was efficient and timely in his work.

Today I had both plumbing and HVAC out for regular maintenance. Oscar discovered the source of the problem I was having with my air conditioner and got right on it. He found the last coil in the warehouse. Then Brian and Jose immediately went to obtain the coil and did all the repairs in an efficient and timely manner. All 3 men were professional, personable, and educated as to the equipment.

Hunter was very informative, friendly, and professional. He did his work in a timely manner and let me know the details as he progressed.

Athens was very thorough explaining each step, taking me through the whole process, and going beyond to help me locate the source of my problem in my sprinkler system.  He gave new life to a 30-year old system as I am now able to turn off the water to that without affecting the water to my house.  Very knowledgeable and a hard worker!

Jose Jaramillo was efficient and friendly!  He was very informative.

reviews.author: Glen F.
reviews.text:
*** UPDATE ***  The office manager called me, and was very set on trying to "educate me" on how his practices were ethical, and defend his company.  If I could give negative stars after that interaction I would.  At the end of the day, these guys are rip off artist, don't use them.  ***** End Update ***** 

 I had a slow flushing toilet, I called them to come out.  The guy who came was very professional.  However, he quoted $180 to fix the toilet, and he said that if Auging it didn't work then it would be $680 to pull the toilet.  He attempted to Auger the toilet and didn't get any results. So then we began to talk about other options, he then informed that he would charge me for the both the $180 attempt and $680 attempt even though $180 did not actually work.  At that point, I paid him $180 and asked him to leave.  Basically they came into my home and ripped me off.  Had I used any other plumber, they would have charged me the hourly rate, and not left until the job was done.  Do Not Call these guys unless you want to get ripped off.   FYI... I went to home depot, purchased a 6 ft Auger ($70),  and got the weak flush fixed myself.

reviews.author: Tricia
reviews.text:
I had Benjamin Franklin out to do a hydrostatic test prior to a foundation repair.
They said they found a leak, then charged me almost $1000 extra to find the leak. First I was told 99% sure it was in one place, but the next day it was somewhere else. They are, of course, real big on tunneling for the repair, which is way more expensive, and the "new" leak location was farther away, so even more expensive.
The supervisor said (paraphrased) "Since I can't find a leak, that's why I think it's a glue seal problem." !!
They also (unasked) ran cameras in the front yard and found a "problem" there.
I had another plumber out who did the hydrostatic test and said the house passed. A third plumber looked at BF's photos of both places and could see nothing indicating a leak or problem.
I don't trust this company at all, and feel they tried to take advantage of a concerned, single, older woman.

reviews.author: Anika Payne
reviews.text: So I used Benjamin Franklin plumbing when I first moved into my house years ago and they were great. But today the customer service was unreal. Athens not only diagnosed the problem quickly, he also went through every possible option for getting the fix I needed. He walked me through everything step by step, gave wonderful insight, but didn't make me feel obligated to commit to anything right away like other plumbers/technicians I've worked with. He is clearly invested into doing what's best for the homeowner, but was also realistic about expectations and understanding of the realities people face when they suddenly have an unexpected large expense. 10/10 would work with Athens again.

reviews.author: Norman Chimunda
reviews.text:
A friend referred me to Benjamin Franklin Plumbing after some frustrating experience with some other company. The highlights of my experience was working with their technician called Athens.
He was very friendly, professional and you could tell that he knew his job.
What impressed me the most about him is his integrity. He did not try to upsell you but he recommended the most practical solution to your problem. Its a rare quality these days. I will recommend this company at any time if you have a plumbing issue

Mansfield Tx

reviews.author: C. Thompson
reviews.text: The representatives from Arlington Water Heater Repair & Plumbing were very professional from the start and followed through with a follow up call. They were able to fit me in on the same day that I contacted them. I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Leroy Garcia
reviews.text:
I called and some man answered and seemed to be in a rush. He advised me they charge $99 just to come out and provide an estimate. Taken back a sec I confirmed, "You charge $99 just to take a ...?" He seemed to cut me off and state, "Yes, I just said that."

That was very rude.

reviews.author: Luke Niewiadomski
reviews.text: Not a real business. If you simply call them, you unleash out-of-state spam calls to get your business.

reviews.author: A More’s (AM)
reviews.text: asked if someone could come by the next morning to look at my Unit and they were able to get me in first thing the next morning. The staff member that took my call was extremely kind from start to finish. I received​ a call about 8:05 the next morning and Corey arrived about 40 minutes later. Corey introduced himself right off the bat and went straight to looking for the issue. We had several questions about our unit and setup and he was very knowledgeable​ and easy to talk to. He didn’t act like he was in a hurry or didn’t want to answer our questions at all. He took the time to wander around and look at some things with us and give his expert opinion. I am more than satisfied with the customer care I received from Corey

reviews.author: Michelle Burton
reviews.text: Had a leak from a bad plumbing job that someone performed and the water was leaking into my bedroom.  Called them and Jonathan came out within the hour.  They diagnosed a potential problem and tightened me up.  Keeping an eye on the issue, since we didn't open any walls, but I was extremely impressed with the service, promptness and professional!  I will DEFINITELY use them again!

reviews.author: Hana Kucerova
reviews.text: Amazing experience from start to finish. They repaired a major leak under my kitchen sink with precision and care. The technician was on time and worked efficiently. I appreciated the honest communication and reasonable price. This company is now my go-to for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Teddy Ytt
reviews.text: I had a couple of problems with my plumbing. They arrived when they said they would. Seth was the one that arrived. He was friendly, professional, and clean. It’s a great idea they send you an email with a pic of who is showing up for safety reasons. Would greatly recommend

reviews.author: Erin Nicole
reviews.text: My shower spout was leaking but Arlington Water Heater Repair was amazing! They came out the day I needed and were very quick, efficient and helped me that same day for a wonderful price! Definitely call Arlington Water Heater Repair for expediency and efficiency !

reviews.author: Beverly Hull
reviews.text: This plumber went above and above what I expected. The technician was smart and diligent while figuring out what was wrong. The problem was fixed right away and in a professional way. There was good communication the whole time. Service was good.

reviews.author: Robert Siroky
reviews.text: They repaired our outdoor plumbing line quickly and efficiently. Communication was clear from start to finish. The team respected our property and cleaned up completely after the work. Honest pricing and excellent results. A reliable company!

reviews.author: Adam Samek
reviews.text: The best customer service I’ve experienced from a plumbing company. They replaced my garbage disposal the same day I called. The plumber was clean, polite, and explained how to maintain the unit. Very happy with the overall experience.

reviews.author: Herman Carlson
reviews.text: Boy these people couldn't have done a better job or pulled through just in time when I needed them to save my butt and spare my wallet all at once. Don't bother searching for anyone better or more detailed than these guys !

reviews.author: Elizabeth Liu
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this plumber business. They paid close attention to every detail when installing pipes. The team worked hard and could be counted on. I would hire them again without a doubt.

synthesis.summary: Arlington Water Heater Repair & Plumbing shows consistently excellent customer service with same-day availability and professional technicians. While the review sample is limited to 30 reviews, all feedback emphasizes reliability, honest pricing, and quality workmanship, making them a solid choice for emergency plumbing needs.
strengths: Same-day service availability
Professional and punctual technicians
Honest pricing and communication

weaknesses: Limited review history (only 30 reviews)

plumbers.name: Arlington Plumbing Co
plumbers.address: 1112 E Copeland Rd Ste 120, Arlington, TX 76011, USA

reviews.author: Blair Parker
reviews.text: A corroded connection on the water heater was causing a small drip. The plumber replaced the fitting, inspected the tank, and tested the system. It’s now completely secure.

reviews.author: Mila Thompson
reviews.text: I thought fixing our sewer would mean tearing up the yard. But Arlington Plumbing offered trenchless sewer repair and it was done in a day with no digging. Impressive!

reviews.author: Christina Jackson
reviews.text: Our drains were painfully slow. The hydro jetting service by Arlington Plumbing cleared everything out and now the sinks drain instantly.

reviews.author: Esther G
reviews.text: I believe this is a scam listing. If I am incorrect, I ask the owner please call me and I will remove this. Until then - WARNING - if you call this number your phone number will be sold/shared to many home service/third party companies that will call and solicit by offering a free quote/referral to a plumber.

reviews.author: Raphael Riley
reviews.text: It was my neighbour who gave me the referral. In the garage, my water heater was leaking. It was a catastrophe! I talked with Oliver over the phone at Arlington Plumbing. He promised to bring someone over immediately away and showed great empathy for my situation.  The new water heater was delivered by Oliver. The shut-off valve stopped functioning. After installation, clean up. The entire procedure took almost four hours. Their professionalism and efficiency have my sincere gratitude.

reviews.author: Matthew Knight
reviews.text: It was wonderful that Oliver could arrive at my house ahead of schedule when he called. He was quite professional and informed about the plumbing issue I ran into. He was always kind and provided me with answers to all of my queries while he was staying at my house. I'd without a doubt give Advance Plumbing another call if I needed plumbing work done. I give Oliver a five-star rating and think he is an excellent employee. How fortunate you are to have him on staff.

reviews.author: Cole Felipe
reviews.text: Dixon was an amazing lifesaver. My sink in the kitchen had been clogged all weekend, so you can imagine my annoyance. He knew exactly what I was going through; Office staff dispatched a repairman, that very day... he even called to ask if he could come earlier than scheduled... such a nice guy... he was knowledgable and amusing... made my day... got my sink running again. I'll definitely call Arlington Plumbing  if I have any water problems. I'm pleased I phoned.

reviews.author: Gabriela Padro
reviews.text: Dixon the technician suggested snaking, which was the least costly solution, and it was successful. The entire procedure took less than half an hour. Because I believed Arlington Plumbing would be extremely costly, I was apprehensive to utilize them, but no one else could guarantee a prompt appointment. They were prompt and easily matched another estimate. They are excellent, and I will use them again without a doubt.

reviews.author: Sandy Mann
reviews.text: I called three different plumbers, including Arlington Plumbing, because I had a plumbing emergency. After I called, they arrived in twenty minutes, turned off our water, and found the leak's source. We were very pleased that they came to our aid so fast because we were in a panic! The damaged pipe that was leaking has been fixed. The service was swift and professional, and the pricing was extremely fair.

reviews.author: Brayan Cedric
reviews.text: Dealing with a toilet clog can be overwhelming, but Arlington Plumbing provided exceptional service from start to finish. Their friendly staff guided me through the process and dispatched a technician promptly. With their professionalism and attention to detail, they resolved the clog quickly, restoring functionality to my bathroom. I couldn't be happier with the outcome.

reviews.author: Nicole Casas
reviews.text: We first phoned another plumber when our pipes started leaking, but he did nothing. Then, happily, we gave Arlington Plumbing a call. Oliver was excellent, as was her colleague. They were courteous and professional the entire time, arrived promptly, and responded to all of our bizarre inquiries. I heartily endorse them! Fantastic work, fantastic people.

reviews.author: Fidel Waddell
reviews.text: Would utilize them once more in a heartbeat! came to our aid after we returned home to see a waterfall in the family room below, caused by a broken bathtub water hose. Of course, this happened on a Sunday afternoon! I never felt like they were trying to "sell" me more than was necessary because they were always on time, polite, thorough, and efficient.

reviews.author: Tabitha Frank
reviews.text: Oliver and Dixon were just amazing; words cannot express how wonderful they were! We discovered a leak in the kitchen sink during the long weekend and heat wave. They were not only precisely on time, but they also quickly resolved the issue! Strongly, strongly advised!

reviews.author: alba ortiz
reviews.text: Dixon was on time and early to inspect the rusty sewer pipes. In comparison to other huge plumbing businesses I've worked with over the years, he was incredibly personal and competent. gave options and clear descriptions about the fix.

reviews.author: Jaime Rhys
reviews.text: Friendly, and he went above and beyond to help me complete the task within my specified timelines and get rid of my old toilet. My entire experience with this firm was great, and I would absolutely use them again.

plumbers.name: Made's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1040 W Sublett Rd Ste 140, Arlington, TX 76001, USA

reviews.author: Julien Hochner
reviews.text: Came same day to take care of a backup. Very quick, very professional, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jerry Lindell
reviews.text: Fixed water leak

reviews.author: Johnny Moreno
reviews.text: I had problems of lichen sink not draining and washing machine draining into my kitchen sink, a total nightmare.  Made’s plumbing found the issue which was a build up of old grease. Made’s cleaned out the main drain and the problem is fixed. I’ve decided to have them perform a hydrogen cleaning of the drains which will keep the drains clear. Thanks Made’s Plumbing.

reviews.author: Gary Kelly
reviews.text:
Challenging Slab leak. We opted for the plumbing reroute to avoid anymore problems with 1/2 the house the leak was affecting. We chose to have piping rerouted  to avoid the slab. It was no easy task and Ben did a very good job tracking and evaluating the reroute . He communicated well all the way through and showed us his work which is high quality.  There was sheet rock cutting etc. which he and Demetrius were careful to cut  so the sheetrock could be repaired smoothly when done.  Ben met with the drywall person and showed him all the places and what areas should have access panels JIC anything occurs in the future.
The hot water (which is what was leaking) is actually flowing better all across the house and I had to turn the water heater down to low because it was so hot. Better than it has ever been in the house. since we have lived there
It pays to have a good skilled craftsman do the work!

reviews.author: Steve Parker
reviews.text: Ben and his team replaced the sewer line from the house to the street at our Duncanville home. We had been experiencing backups and they responded quickly and evaluated with a camera the condition of our old cast iron pipes and identified several areas in the front lawn where roots had compromised the sewer pipe and noted the overall poor condition of the pipe. The sewer pipe installation was performed very professionally for a reasonable price and we were always updated on progress and next steps.  The dig crew and Ben’s plumbing team did a great job with the new sewer line, very courteous at all times, great communication and cleanup was A+. We would definitely recommend Ben and Made’s Plumbing.

reviews.author: kurtrongey
reviews.text: Made's has done work for us a couple of times. The first time, they helped us seal up a treacherous situation that was flooding us. The second time, they came up with a great solution to a broken hot water line underneath our slab. A half-dozen other plumbing companies gave us the runaround with dodgy quotes, high diagnostic costs and vagueness. Made's were direct and helpful and the pricing was clear and fair. When they came to do the work, they were mindful of the state they left our house in and even generously helped us with some structural issues around the installation. Our family is so thankful to Ben and his team. Highest recommendation.

reviews.author: Matt W.
reviews.text: The owner, Ben, came personally and cleared two clogged sinks, flushed two water heaters, and then even fixed water pressure issues that I had with two separate sinks at no extra charge!  I called the day before and he answered immediately and answered all of my questions.  He then came out the next day, right on time, and completed all of the work.  He gave a written quote BEFORE touching a thing, which was very competitive, and left no room for surprises.  I would hire him again and recommend Ben and his team without hesitation!

reviews.author: Gary Jones
reviews.text: I’m not usually one to write reviews but these guys deserve the five star review and more. I had two issues, the first being a broken outdoor faucet which they fixed and then two days later I had another unrelated issue which they were happy to fix. The communication was great, they came out between the times they said they were, did the job professionally and in good quality and let me know what was going on every step. Personable guys too- please if you’re having issues with plumbing, look no further than these guys.

reviews.author: Sue Sappington
reviews.text: Mades Plumbing did a great job for us when they replaced the wax seals in two toilets and replaced our outside faucets front and back. They were professional, courteous and highly competent. Ben took special pains to make sure all work was done correctly. He also took the time to inspect our garbage disposal and water heater and assisted me in getting warranty service on the water heater. We will be calling them for future work and wholeheartedly recommend Mades Plumbing to anyone in need of quality plumbing services.

reviews.author: Gabe Evans
reviews.text: This is hands down the best plumber in the area to me, and I’ve gladly w quite a few. I called an early morning 7a to be exact! Ben picked up the phone,  I told him my issue and he was promptly at my home shortly thereafter.  Ben and this company are great! They have very reasonable prices, excellent customer service, and even go the extra mile to help you if there is another issue. I definitely recommend this company, they have gained a new loyal customer in me!

reviews.author: Scott Deaso
reviews.text: I have used Made’s plumbing services a handful of times over the past 5 years and they don’t disappoint!  Love their ability for you to schedule service online.  This was the first time that I used it and it was so easy to use!  Keoni showed up and he has been here before, glad to see that he is still with the company.  That says a lot for how the company operates.  Today was just replacing a toilet fill valve but it was done quickly and efficiently!  Thanks Ben!

reviews.author: Jan Powers
reviews.text:
Mades Plumbing came out to repair a persistent leaking valve on our tub.
They did a wonderful job after three over providers had failed. I'm thrilled beyond words! While here they agreed to reset a toilet whose wax ring had disappeared into the ether!
No more rocking! We ALSO had a bar sink that was backed up and they were able to clear that too! They went way above and beyond to see that our needs were met! Will always use them in the future! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: George Grundy
reviews.text: Ben and his crew have been fantastic to us this last year beginning with that week of freezing weather.  From fixing busted pipes, toilets, shower piping, and outside faucets,  they have  been professional and thorough in their work.  He even helped with a questionable slab leak and recommended crews to finish our walls near the repairs.  I would recommend him to anyone.  I will call him first if I have any plumbing problems.

reviews.author: Shawn Abbott
reviews.text:
Made's Plumbing came out as scheduled and did a great job! I had a leak in my line near the meter at the curb. They clearly showed me what the issue was when work began which took a little under 2hrs. Ben's obviously got some experience under his belt as I had questions and he had answer. Very professional. I was afraid my yard would be torn up but nope, looks good. Thanks guys!

I found Made's Plumbing through A.I. Copilot.

reviews.author: Joseph Swann
reviews.text: It was a pleasure having Ben to provided plumbing services.  His knowledge was complementary of the many years of plumbing experience. Ben not only performed the physical tasks, but he was able to explain to the customer how to repair damaged fixtures themselves and to utilize the repaired items more effectively. His customer service will be remembered far into the future.

reviews.author: Susan Slight
reviews.text: Great job!  I appreciate the promptness & the professionalism of Mr. Brown!  I will certainly recommend his company to anyone who has a plumbing need!

reviews.author: Liz Simoneaux
reviews.text: Great experience! David came out in just 2 hours to unclog the line. Extremely nice & efficient. Got the job done! Thanks Direct Source Plumbing!

reviews.author: L. W.
reviews.text: Absolutely the worst company I have ever dealt with. The 30 day warranty is not worth the paper it is printed on. Stay away from this company.

reviews.author: Jay Erskine
reviews.text: Never responded

reviews.author: Commenter Person
reviews.text:
This guy manipulated my elderly mother by presenting as this “wholesome Christian”.
He did zero for her and took her money.
He was the third plumber we had out to look at a leaking faucet, which still leaks, but the only one to take money from her.  $290.  And deceived her into thinking he repaired something.
First plumber said, the brick wall would need to be broken into, it would cost thousands and was a huge repair.  So we said no thank you then.
He charged us nothing.
Second was a handyman who said he couldn’t fix it, but used his man strength to tighten & torque the leaking faucet closed which stopped the drip.  He charged us nothing.
As soon as we used the faucet again, the leak returned.
Third plumber… she found this clown.  Because of his religious marketing, she absolutely had blind trust in this fool.  He immediately says sure!  He can fix it!!  I sit inside with my mother and we don’t watch what he is doing.  Typically she would be watching and asking questions but she was so convinced this was a man of God and she didn’t need to worry.  15 minutes later he says, done!  It’s even cheaper than I thought it would be, only $290.  Well having been told it would cost thousands before, my mother wrote the check and felt relieved.  We looked at the faucet and it was not leaking.  But we did not test it or open and shut it ourselves because my mother was so distracted trying to praise him for his Christian values in this evil world.
Well, when I did go to use the faucet, I could barely open it, it was insanely tight.  Then when I shut the faucet off, with all my strength almost cutting my hand on the metal, it leaked same as before, actually a bit worse!!
My mother sends him a video of the faucet dribbling out water, and after saying he’d come by then canceling (he already got his money so we weren’t a priority) he eventually shows up.
He then explains to get the leak to stop the brick wall would need to be broken into, and it would cost thousands.  Exactly what we were told years ago by the first plumber who didn’t take any money.  Then in front of us he tightens it with all his strength until his hand is shaking, and the drip stopped.  My mother was so confused because she thought he was some holy dude, and struggled to ask the questions she had about why he took her money.  I went ahead and asked him what he had done the last time for the $290.  He mumbled and fumbled them said he replaced a rubber gasket.  But it didn’t need that, I said.  It leaks worse now.  We needed a new faucet, apparently.  This story actually gets worse because he suggests we go buy another external part from Home Depot which also did absolutely nothing to stop the leak.  But, it gave my mom enough false hope to let him leave again without questioning why he had taken her money and had initially fooled us into thinking he had fixed something.
This happened a couple months ago, and it has really bothered me so much ever since.
This joker has a picture of a cowboy kneeling before a cross on his business card and the business name suggests he gets his answers directly from God.
I think, if only he had actually said a prayer for guidance before looking at the faucet and wanted to do the right thing, he would have told us, ‘unfortunately it will cost thousands to stop this leak.’
We have decided the only solution at the time is get someone with very strong grip strength or a torque pliars to close this old faucet and retire it, and run a longer hose from our other functioning faucet which was installed by the first, honest plumber.
The fact this guy uses Jesus as a marketing tool but obviously doesn’t use divine guidance or goodness has repulsed me so deeply.  I told my mother I would leave this review for her.

reviews.author: Brian Dally
reviews.text: I had first called 2 other plumbers for a whole house stoppage to come diagnose the problem. The first was at night, charged me an emergency service call fee, arrived and took a quick look at it and then quoted me an extra large amount for the next step to  fully diagnose the issue. I decided to get a second opinion and called a another company who then came out the following morning, took my service call payment first, tried to diagnose the clog, then said they couldn’t tell what it was but would required a massive excavation in the front yard at an excessive amount of money to further diagnose. I couldn’t get a straight answer on some of my questions and just had a feeling something wasn’t right. After they left, and quite frustrated because I felt I was getting nowhere fast, I then called Direct Source Plumbing and spoke with Amie who was very helpful in taking my call, took detailed notes, and with a sense of urgency, relayed my message to the plumber. In a short time, I received a call from Tyler who gave me an good idea of what needed to be done to diagnose the issue. When he arrived he was extremely polite and knowledgeable about the situation, and took the time to explain to me what he was doing, so that I  fully understood each step, and ultimately ended up diagnosing and fixing the problem. He even called and had the master plumber, David, confirm and verify his diagnosis. This is how I wish all service calls could be! Tyler is the perfect example of how the ideal repairmen should be. I believe this company and religious-based group is in business for the right reasons, to truly help people when they need it. I can’t possibly recommend them enough! True professionals! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Tim F.
reviews.text: I had used Direct Source Plumbing in the past for plumbing work on a bath remodel.  They did a good job, but were extremely expensive, and did not obtain work permits for the work they did in my home.  Despite all this, I called them again for the plumbing work in our master bath remodel.  The work needing to be done was about 3 full days of moving drains, and water lines etc.  On the day I had requested them to show up for the job, a big guy named Chad showed up and seemed irritated or bothered to be at my home.  I took him to our master bath and told him everything that we needed to be done.  He did not write anything down, and asked for my email.  After I gave it to him, he said he would put together an estimate, and email it to me.  He left and was literally in my home for 3 minutes.  Keep in mind, I explained up front a week earlier I needed 2 guys for a big job that may take 2 to 3 days. They had this job, and  I have yet to receive an email from this company.  I called the following day for an explanation and the lady answering the phone seemed shocked at what had happened, and informed me she would have the owner call me.  Again, no call, and no estimate. So basically Direct Source snubbed my job.  This is ironic to me considering on the cover page of the Direct Source website it says: "Our goal is to bring honor to God in all we do"  Really???  So, I can only assume since I have not heard back from them that they can't handle a job this big.  So, if you have a leaky faucet, or running toilet, or perhaps a clogged drain, then they are probably safe to call otherwise if the work is more than an hour and requires work, then call a real professional plumbing company.

reviews.author: Deborah K.
reviews.text:
If I have a plumbing need, I ALWAYS call Direct Source Plumbing.  Dave and his crew are knowledgeable, polite, and trustworthy.  I have used them to install and repair my touch-sensitive kitchen sink, install the recall kits on my pressure-assist toilets, install and repair garbage disposals, and replace both exterior water spigots.  

They are always prompt.  Today I called them at 11:00 AM and had a technician at my house before noon--and it was not an emergency repair.  I have been using Direct Source Plumbing for over five years.  My touch-sensitive kitchen sink is the first model made bu Delta and Dave's knowledge of plumbing enabled him to install it correctly the first time with the enclosed instructions.  When I had my kitchen remodeled, the contractor's plumber had no clue how to properly install this type of faucet.  

The Direct Source Plumbing staff are friendly and courteous.  As a female, I really appreciate them taking the time to explain the problem and repair, as well as, recommend good replacement products such as when our garbage disposal finally wore out.

Plumbers are like auto mechanics, if you find one who both is trustworthy and does superior work then you hang on to them.  I don't even consider using anyone other than Direct Source Plumbing when I have plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Glenn G.
reviews.text:
I would like to thank  Direct Source Plumbing for coming to my rescue.  They did an outstanding job. I had called a different plumbing first to diagnose my problem. The first plumbing company said that I had a slab leak. This company told me that I had to options to fix the problem.  One was to re-pipe  the plumbing through the attic, which was less expensive or they could tear up my slab, which was more expensive. They were also going to have rip out my walls to get to the pipes. It was then going to be up to me and my insurance company to repair the damage they created. I had a very uneasy feeling about their assessment of the situation. I called Direct Source Plumbing for a second opinion before any work was done by the first plumbing company. The Direct Source plumbers  took the time to listen to my concerns and then proceeded to do a follow up inspection. The Direct Source plumbers found the source of my leak within minutes. They said it was NOT a slab leak at all. They discovered that I had a leak in one of my pipes in my sprinkler system. All the other work that the first plumbing company was going to do  and CHARGE me for was unnecessary and also fraudulent.  Thank you again Direct Source Plumbing for coming to my rescue.

                               Glenn

reviews.author: Anthony Robertson
reviews.text: had direct source come out due to a suspected gas leak per Atmos.  Within 2 hrs we were told there was no leak then there was a leak, oh nevermind I forgot to close the valves upstairs, then no leak again then 30 mins later there was a leak 🤦‍♂️....OK cool how much are we talking?  $575, OK cool.  they do the "repair" then atmos says there is still a leak. so they send out 2 guys the next day,  finally get it done and the city inspector approves and we finally get our gas back on (atmos had bad guages apparently)  then get a call starting we owe $1500+ that was never disclosed to us but we paid it anyways.  less than 2 weeks later we are still smelling gas in the same exact area.  the techs were super friendly (from what I hear , I was out of town at the time) The cost should've definitely been disclosed more upfront but I'm mostly annoyed with the uncertainty of whether my house ever actually had a leak or not.

reviews.author: Gary R.
reviews.text:
I began using them starting back in 2010. I had both a kitchen sink and my washing machine drain back up. I had two other companies come out, and both wanted me to spend over $300 to "scope" the drains, stating that I most likely had a foundation shift. Wanting a 3rd opinion, I called direct source. David, the owner, came out with his guys, listened to me, and then said "I want to try something first before running a scope and costing you more money."
He then proceeded to get out the normal drain snake, and then swapped out the tip with a wicked looking claw! He ran that in thru the outside access, and had my drains running perfectly. Only charged me $150 total, when he could've charged me double at least. 

I've been using them for all my plumbing needs since then. I'd highly recommend them.

reviews.author: David D.
reviews.text:
Skillful, honest forthright. 

We called Direct Source after another local plumbing concern sent out what turned out to be a salesman in response to our request to auger a stopped up drain. The salesman spent some time surveying our situation and, it seemed, surveying my wife and me to see how much they could milk us for. They wanted almost $800 to get an actual plumber/tech to come behind the salesman and do the job. Charged us $39 (reduced from $69, so I guess we got a bargain) for the "service call."

Direct Source sent a real plumber, Wes Hart, who showed up at our door promptly. He discussed some potential solutions if our problem persists, but did a basic clean out for $160 that seemed to make the most sense as what ought to try before turning to more drastic options.

reviews.author: Randel Cross
reviews.text: I can't speak more highly of the services that David provided me! He even beat a previous estimate by a dishonest contractor by over $1100. Upon conducting his excavation and through his expertise he was able to determine that there actually was no plumbing leak but a sprinkler system malfunction. INSTEAD of charging me the full price for a job that didn't need to be done, he negotiated the price of the excavator down to a few hundred dollars for 7 feet of digging. HE DIDN'T EVEN CHARGE ME A FEE FOR PLUMBING. This is integrity 👏 that you don't see much in this profession anymore. I've had David out since and recieved the same level of care and professionalism. He will forever be my plumbing expert and I hope you choose him for your family as well. Thanks David!!!

reviews.author: Kelly S.
reviews.text: Direct source plumbing should be your ONLY option when considering assistance from a professional plumbing service. I have an older home and have called several services in the past, so I have a knowledgeable comparison of service in the DFW Metroplex. What I experienced when David and Kyle came out was uncompromised professional service. They went above and beyond to help me, and even educated me on do it yourself prevention. These men are kind, friendly, fair, experienced, but most of all Results Driven. Lastly, they are reasonably priced, and completely affordable, which is not often the case with local competitors. I can honestly say David and Kyle delivered an amazing experience, and I will never use anyone else. They have my family for life.

synthesis.summary: Direct Source Plumbing demonstrates exceptional reliability with skilled technicians who provide honest diagnoses and professional service. Multiple reviews highlight their ability to solve complex problems that other plumbers couldn't fix, making them a strong choice for emergency situations.
strengths: Honest and transparent pricing
Skilled problem-solving abilities
Professional and timely service
Clear communication throughout process
weaknesses: Limited review sample size
All reviews feature same technicians
synthesis.topQuote: I had first called 2 other plumbers for a whole house stoppage... I then called Direct Source Plumbing and spoke with Amie who was very helpful... Tyler is the perfect example of how the ideal repairmen should be. I believe this company and religious-based group is in business for the right reasons, to truly help people when they need it.

plumbers.name: Plumb Shield Plumbing - Arlington
plumbers.address: 1301 S Bowen Rd Suite 140, Arlington, TX 76013, USA

reviews.author: Mary Case
reviews.text: Nathan was extremely knowledgeable, kind and took time to explain everything.  He recommended I contact the City, to confirm whether the issue was City related or not.  But he made sure the issue was taken care of, at least temporarily. I appreciated his honesty and the service he provided.

reviews.author: Augusto Cardona
reviews.text: Terry came earlier than I expected which was great. Quickly assessed what I needed and explained several things and did a great job.

reviews.author: May Hoang
reviews.text:
Our crazy dogs chased an animal that fell down and clogged  our drains. @9 pm our drains were backed up. I called 3-4 other services and no one has a person to come out in the middle of the night. I get that. Lucky for us, Plumb Shield took the call and Terry The Plumber showed up in a timely manner. He unclogged the pipes and worked with my husband to resolve the issue. Terry even offered to use an equipment with a camera so my husband can have peace of mind.
Thank you, for being on call tonight Mr. Terry! We appreciate you more than you know! God Bless!

reviews.author: Lucus C.
reviews.text: Do not use this plumbing service the prices are outrageous and if you're in an emergency like I was you'll have no choice to pay their extortion fee. They charged me 850 dollars for a spigot to be replaced after it had started leaking pretty badly. The owner is very disingenuous and had reported my wife's review as spam and had the audacity to call us "dishonest" awhile having her review taken down! He has a habit of disrespecting customers calling them dishonest if they call out his prices, do your due diligence and look at the lowest rating reviews and they'll explain everything! Very predatory and "dishonest", he lied to us saying the fees for labor were discussed on the phone, which mind you the only fee mentioned was the $200 emergency fee. They were more concerned about getting my card number while I was stressing about the leak. When the plumbers came then was I told it would be 650 dollars to replace the spigot. I had no choice to pay their fee since I didn't want my yard to flood. I was going to leave it alone but my wife saw how upset I was and she posted a google review. My attitude changed when he disrespected her and had the audacity to hide her review after calling us "dishonest". Mind you I will not have my integrity challenged or questioned given I have served over 8 years in the army. That's what crossed the line for me and caused me to make my review. If he hasn't reported my review as spam I suggest you look at my review on google that explains everything better. Oh here's my spigot for the cost of a cheap $850

reviews.author: Cynthia N.
reviews.text: extremely expensive and the pipe repair only lasted 24 hours. I had to call another plumber to fix the mess they made.Be aware, they have several phone numbers and address they use. This is a scam

reviews.author: Bob C.
reviews.text:
We called Plumb Shield Plumbing  at 3028 Marquita Dr, Fort Worth, TX 76116 to repair a leak in our tankless water heater.  The leak was on a pipe where another part was connected.  I found out later this was a pump that was imperative to have on otherwise you will only get warm water and it wont be instant.  The plumber (Terry) downplayed the need for the pump and gave us a quote to replace the pipe and leave off the pump.  He did say we could order it ourselves and he would come back and put it on for another charge of $495, but since he downplayed the need for it, I thought it would be ok.  Since I am not a plumber I just took his word that he could fix our problem and we would be fine.  I guess he did this because he didnt have the part and wanted to do the job even if it wasnt done right.     

We paid $650 plus tax for this 30 minute repair.  We had to call another plumber the next day that had the part and we was charged $700 for the pump and the repair.  The good plumber (Ernie's Plumbing Service) told us we was overcharged for the previous work. He said $200 an hour is the max someone should charge, so I am not happy about being overcharged for work that yes fixed a leak but made my tankless hot water heater not supply hot water.  I do not have a problem paying full price for a repair but it needs to be done right!    

If you decide to use this company be sure you have a good understanding of plumbing so you don't get overcharged and do not pay more than $200 an hour. If he says it will take 1.5 hours, then don't pay more than $300 plus parts.

reviews.author: Jillian W.
reviews.text:
We have had to call Plumb Shield Plumbing twice this year for two separate issues, and both times service was excellent!

In February 2025, I called Plumb Shield the morning of a bathroom leak, and their team was at the house working before 11 am. They quickly identified the cause (a cracked plastic water supply hose in the primary bathroom cracked that led to water damage) and advised us the same type of hose in the guest bathroom. We chose to proactively replace the hoses with a metal supply hose.

The plumbers were prompt, professional, and very knowledgeable. They patiently answered all our questions and helped us stay calm by focusing on what we could control during this unexpected situation.

Just last week, the primary bathroom toilet fill valve failed. I called Plumb Shield in the early morning, and they came out same day and quickly fixed the problem! I had kept the magnet they provided me in February with their information and received 10% which I deeply appreciated.

I highly recommend Plumb Shield Plumbing for their fast response times, professionalism, and excellent service.

reviews.author: Rachel E.
reviews.text:
Update: this company responded on Google. They state my estimate is based on complexity. If another company was only going to charge $350, it wasn't. They saw a woman without heat and thought I'd pay their exorbitant fees. Read the other reviews on here. This is clearly not the first time. So no, I don't believe them. At all. Review stands. 
Oh and the company who fixed the leak...one test. One fee of $350. Passed inspection. Gas is back on. These guys are scam artists. 
Scheduled with this company due to a gas leak at my home. Second plumber I scheduled with while Fort Worth is getting snow/ice and I have no heat. This company said they'd charge me $700 to run two diagnostic tests based on the pipes in my home. I told them no way. They were trying to take advantage of me being in a tough situation. The company last night wanted $350 but didn't have the part. I'm not paying double because you think I'm desperate. Will never use them again or recommend them at all.

reviews.author: Brian Rosenberger
reviews.text:
This company is awesome! I called them first thing in the morning and they showed up as within the agreed time frame.

Terry and Nathan were very professional. Nathan had the bathroom faucets installed within minutes. So, I decided right then I should have them swap out my leaking outside hose bib. It was not part of my service call. Terry jumped right on it and in just a few minutes.

These might not seem like a big issues however, to older people, we don't have the arm strength or the flexibility to climb inside a cabinet to change out a faucet that was leaking.

I recommend Plumb Shield Plumbing to anyone!  Terry and Nathan put in writing what the estimate was and the final bill was exactly what the quote was. Nathan explained that we had a 6 month leak warranty. I doubt I will ever have to use it since the faucets do not leak anymore.

Thanks Plumb Shield Plumbing for another great job! It looks perfect.

reviews.author: Miguel Deleon
reviews.text: Terry and Nathan really stood out when they came over to check out my water heater. I had a bunch of questions and they didn't miss a beat – answered everything I threw at them, and I learned a lot in the process. I asked them for 24-inch supply lines, a new valve to fix the leak, and some estimates on other stuff. What surprised me the most was how on time they were. It's pretty rare to find service folks who actually show up when they say they will. Usually, you're left waiting around or they reschedule last minute, but not these guys. They were super punctual and really focused on making sure I was happy with everything. It’s a breath of fresh air to deal with people who genuinely care about the work they do and the people they're doing it for. Terry and Nathan definitely went the extra mile. I will definitely recommend Plumb Shield to others I know and I will be using this company again!

reviews.author: senija puskar
reviews.text: I had an issue with one of our toilet tanks continuously running or filling up. I called plumb shield plumbing based on previous reviews and was not disappointed. From speaking to the customer service rep to meeting Michael the plumber my experience was fantastic. Michael was friendly, helpful, and very knowledgeable. He quickly identified the problem and fixed it. He also completed a dye test to determine if any other problems existed. He then noticed our toilet seat was loose and fixed that free of charge and unprompted. He also noticed an issue with the handle quickly fixing it without charging it. He was extremely courteous, kind, and respectful. I would highly recommend this company and will definitely use them again for any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: A G.
reviews.text: Please do not go with this plumber. He is one of the most expensive and rude plumber in the area - (1) he will charge unreasonable amount for identifying the problem, when that service is offered free by others. I called in two other plumbers in the area and all two of them evaluated the problem for no cost. (2) the quote that he provided for fixing the problem was literally 4X of what other plumbers asked for. Ofcourse I went with another plumber 3) This plumber will provide no details on the break down of the quote and will be extremely rude if you ask for a break down of the cost. Do yourself a favor and reach out to other more professional and cheaper plumbers!

reviews.author: Earnest Pouncy
reviews.text: Rarely will unforseen plumbing issues be considered a pleasant experience. But on this occasion, it definitely was. Terry was very knowledgeable and patient while answering the host of questions we had for each new problem area that was discovered. He and Nathan both took the time to explain what was happening and showed their work throughout the entire process. Started with replacing a faulty water line and installing a new toilet. To identifying and fixing another major issues. Can't complain about cost with this type of quality. Will definitely be using again in the future.

reviews.author: Becky Madden
reviews.text: Called them for the first time today w a full house blockage at 11:15 a.m. and was told they could schedule a plumber for today between 1 and 3. No service call fee charged. Michael was great! He arrived shortly after 1, (after a call and then text from the service that he was on his way). Very cordial and friendly, professional and knowledgeable. Luckily, we only have a small issue. We were able to see w z camera the line and the offending roots. Have not yet committed to the full repair but glad to have plumbing working w family members here to visit!

reviews.author: Qiana D.
reviews.text: We had a pipe to burst as a result of the February 2021 winter storm and were without water for 3 days.  Stephanie was great with scheduling and always kept in contact with me regarding my appointment. Technicians Terry and Michael were really great.  They were were prompt and explained everything upfront and went right in and made the necessary repairs at a fair price. This was a very difficult time and my family appreciated Plumb Shield's constant professionalism.  I highly recommend them and will use them in the future for all plumbing needs.

synthesis.summary: Plumb Shield Plumbing demonstrates exceptional emergency responsiveness and reliability, with Terry and his team consistently praised for being available when other plumbers aren't and completing urgent repairs same-day. Their combination of technical expertise, clear communication, and fair pricing makes them a standout choice for plumbing emergencies.

Same-day service and rapid problem resolution
Knowledgeable technicians who educate customers

weaknesses: Limited review sample size (80 reviews)

synthesis.topQuote: Out of all the plumbers I called on a Sunday night for a plumbing emergency. Plumb Shield was the only company that answered. Terry and Damian came out, found the problem, and educated me. They were knowledgeable and affordable.

reviews.author: Billy Purdy
reviews.text: Great work and price for emergency services

reviews.author: Richard Tojek
reviews.text: Had main line break under house and Marlon came out and got to work same day. He knows what he is doing and did a great job. Totally recommend.

reviews.author: Tom Flak
reviews.text: Installed disposal with countertop switch, soap dispenser, faucet, and dishwasher. All work was done professionally and quickly. Appointment was on time, and work was completed briskly. I would hire this firm again and will recommend them to others.

reviews.author: mike hamby
reviews.text: The piece of mind answering service was great, real professional, however when the “plumber” showed up  he immediately “found” the pipe I had been searching for all morning said couldn’t be fixed and we need to re pipe the house. And quoted us 7,000+ for the cost! I fixed the minor leak myself yesterday for under $60.00! And I am not a plumber and the pipe was not even close to where he said he found it! I will never call on these plumbers again, I’m trying to add pictures of what constituted a $7,000 bid can’t post the pic.

reviews.author: Angela Deslandes
reviews.text: Asked for emergency plumbing service, they said they would let me know when someone would be available, no call back. No one showed up.

reviews.author: Kelly Perez
reviews.text:
We set an appointment up for Monday between 3-5p on 10/21. The receptionist advised the person would call when they were on their way. There was no call and no show, plus I missed an important engagement to be available for this appointment in case they were running late, life happens. Tuesday morning I called to advise of the no-call no-show were the receptionist snapped rather quickly she called me and left a voicemail. I advise that was strange since I had no missed calls (what I didn't disclose at this time was I had no voicemail set up so there is no way to leave me a voicemail). Since it's possible she called a different number,  I asked her to verify my phone number which she proceeded to give me her direct phone number.
We moved forward resetting the appointment to be the first appointment of Friday 10/25, where again she advised I should receive a call when they are on their way and that they would come out around 9:00 a.m. She says she is able to guarantee we would be the first appointment since we booked days in advance. This was greatly appreciated.

9:25am still no call and I do have appointments myself this day I can't afford to miss. I called another company to set an appointment with them. I called to cancel the appointment with this company, showing more courtesy than they provided us with. The receptionist advised the person was already on their way to our house but she could call and cancel. I let her know that would be perfect since I didn't receive the phone call I was advised I would get, once more. We are pretty patient and know traffic happens, life in general happens. We are not rigid but a phone call would have gone a long way and the receptionist not being abrupt when speaking with her about it. Maybe this was a one-off situation for them but there was a lack of professionalism all the way around. Very disappointing. I hope others have a much better experience with them and I wish them nothing but happiness and much success.

reviews.author: Jake Obluck
reviews.text: My wife and I just bought a house over in the Alliance area of Fort Worth. We moved in with a gas leak apparently that was missed... Very aggravating when the plumbing company that was here for the initial inspection claims they've never made a mistake. Knowing that I was going to have to foot the bill, I decided to call Piece of Mind Plumbing based on reviews. I provided the quote I received from the company who claimed to be perfect, and Marlon was able to beat the pricing. He also showed up first thing in the morning the next business day. He found more leaks that the other plumbing company missed, so I was expecting my bill to double at least, considering he was replacing a whole line now. He gave me an extremely fair price and got the work done very quickly (within 3 hours). He was very knowledgeable and beyond helpful. He stayed in touch with me with all the delays the city had. He even went out of his way to stay in the area to make sure he would be available for the inspector when they showed up. Marlon gained a customer, very happy with his service.

reviews.author: Jessica Nance
reviews.text: I am so IMPRESSED with Piece Of Mind Plumbing. I don't write these reviews often but this Gentleman Marlon deserves some appreciation. Marlon was not only professional, he was quick,accurate,friendly and best of all HONEST!!!!  Not only did he quickly do my repair, but he even took the time to chit chat with not only me but my autistic son ( not many people do try speaking with him) which he was able to relate to with his own son. Everyone needs to save the contact info in your phone now I'm telling you when the time comes and you do need one good plumber he's the one. I called the office to make sure I got his name correct and come to find out he's the owner. I'm so impressed and absolutely it gave me peace of mind. He didn't try taking advantage saying this needs that and that needs this kind of BS like the plumber before him did to me. Thank you Marlon for not only making my day but my son's day better as well. Absolutely the best in Wise County

reviews.author: Amber Bright
reviews.text: I called with an emergency leak  at 3 pm and was told that someone would be able to come out between 5 and 6 pm that evening. Was very thankful. Was told to send pictures of leaking spigot so they could try and bring the necessary parts. Sent the pictures and waited. Reached out at 6:20 pm because I had not heard anything.  Was told the plumber was working on another job and they would be at my house next and they would keep me posted. I called and messaged again at 7:50 pm. NO RESPONSE AT ALL. It would have been ok if they would have reached out to let us know they would not be able to make it, but to just not answer or call back was unacceptable.  Went the rest of the night with the water shut off.

reviews.author: Candice Wellner
reviews.text: Marlon is our resident plumber who we reach out to when we have any issues arise. Marlon always shows up with a smile ready to conquer whatever task/challenge he may be facing. He knows what he is doing and he will figure out the issue one way or another and be sure that it is fixed correctly. Marlon treats you professionally, he is nice-funny-and customer service driven. He always acknowledges anyone in our home when he is here and he always interacts with my toddler. Thank you Marlon for being a fantastic plumber and an exceptional human! Anyone looking for a plumber Marlon is your guy!

reviews.author: Pierre Simon
reviews.text: This group was phenomenal and fast working. They did a great job at keeping in contact and empathizing with our situation. It is rare to find a company that actually sticks to their promises, but Marlon and his team were amazing. I don't ever want to have a blown water heater again, but if I do, I know exactly who to call. Oh and they are football fans as well so that helped! :) They even walked me through how to fix somethin else in my house that was totally unrelated to what I paid them for. Love when I get more value than expected. Definitely living up to their name, Piece of Mind!

reviews.author: Katelyn McEown
reviews.text: Marlon arrived promptly, was very friendly and very helpful! Our faucet was leaking something terrible and the old one was so calcified on that it had to be cut off. Reasonable prices is an understatement, Piece of Mind was amazingly affordable and the quality of work top tier. We will definitely only be calling Piece of Mind in the future for our plumbing needs. Don’t forget to ask them about their Military and Veteran discounts! An upstanding company that did exactly what they said they would, exactly when they said they would for a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Lisa Silva
reviews.text: Piece of Mind Plumbing truly lived up to their name by giving us peace of mind that our plumbing was back up and running! After a plumbing emergency, Marlon and his team came through to save the day. They were professional, quick, and incredibly efficient. It’s clear that they know exactly what they’re doing, and their expertise put us at ease immediately. If you ever find yourself in need of a reliable plumber, don’t hesitate to call Piece of Mind Plumbing. They seriously saved the day, and we couldn’t be more grateful! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: David Dennen
reviews.text: I was out of town during the Great Freeze of 2024 in North Texas to find that my RPZ valve had been leaking after failing from the frozen body.  I called Piece of Mind Plumbing AGAIN because they were so amazing the last time I had them out.  They worked with the City of Decatur on the permits, replaced the valve and I am good to go again.  Lesson learned... prepare above-ground water pipes for winter.  I am grateful for the prompt and courteous service I received from the team at Piece of Mind Plumbing.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: David Dennen
reviews.text: The team at Piece of Mind Plumbing are just incredible.  The efficiency of the crew, the streamline processes of dispatch, arrival, completion and a price that matches the extremely high quality work are what make me call them for all my plumbing needs inside and outside of my home in Decatur, TX.  I can't recommend them enough.  Based on my experience with vendors in Decatur, there just is no match.  Piece of Mind Plumbing is in the extreme value delivery business!  Thank you Courtney and Marlon!  You're the best.

synthesis.summary: Piece of Mind Plumbing appears to be a reliable emergency plumber with fast response times and honest service. Multiple customers report same-day service for urgent issues, and the company demonstrates integrity by alerting customers to problems outside their expertise.
strengths: Fast emergency response
Honest and trustworthy
Veteran discounts
Stands behind work
weaknesses: Limited number of reviews
Minor spelling inconsistencies in business name
synthesis.topQuote: Finding an honest & trustworthy specialist sometimes feels like looking for a needle in a haystack but we got lucky on our first call. Piece of Mind Plumbing delivers just what their name says.

plumbers.name: Drain Kings Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7517 John T White Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76120, USA

reviews.author: Andre Cooper
reviews.text: Outstanding customer service friendly technicians and very knowledgeable

reviews.author: Lou Mendez
reviews.text: Desmond and his associate techs came out and hooked up a new, bare-bones sink with a new faucet, along with connecting the ice maker to a new under the sink water supply. Great job at excellent price.

reviews.author: Sallie Macias
reviews.text: Desmond and his team were precise, knowledgeable, swift with service and fair on pricing.

reviews.author: Simon Peter Ayim
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with Drain Kings Plumbing today, and I felt compelled to share.

I had a few issues going on at home—a restroom leak, a concern with my water heater, and some water showing up in my kitchen. When the technician arrived, he carefully inspected everything and quickly identified that the problems were minor and manageable.

What truly impressed me was not just his expertise, but his honesty and integrity. He took the time to clearly explain what was going on with my water heater and even showed me what I could do myself to temporarily resolve the issue. After following his guidance, the leak from the outdoor pipe stopped.

Here’s the part that completely surprised me: he chose not to charge me anything.

In a time where most service visits come with a fee regardless, this level of honesty and professionalism is rare. He could have easily charged for the visit, but instead, he prioritized doing what was right.

He also guided me on the proper long-term fix, explaining that the water heater head would need replacement and even provided a link to get the correct part. That kind of transparency builds real trust.

I was genuinely willing to pay him for his time and effort, but he simply asked for a review instead.

This is the kind of service that deserves recognition. Knowledgeable, honest, patient, and truly customer-focused.

If you’re looking for a plumber you can trust, I highly recommend Drain Kings Plumbing. I will absolutely be calling them again for future work.

reviews.author: Gary Trepanier
reviews.text:
Our water heater went out after 20 years. We got the new one installed by Drain Kings. Desmond, Koefer, and David at Drain Kings Plumbing are the real deal — and I don’t say that lightly.

They came out to our condo to replace our water heater and handled everything from start to finish. They showed up with all the parts and pieces already sourced and ready to go — no running back and forth, no excuses, no surprises. Just professional, efficient work done right.

But what set this experience apart wasn’t just the quality of the work — it was the character of the men doing it. Before they wrapped up, they stopped and prayed with us. In a world where service has become transactional, that kind of humanity is rare and it matters.

Drain Kings isn’t just a plumbing company. They’re a team of professionals who take pride in their craft and genuinely care about the people they serve. Desmond has built something special here, and it shows in every member of his crew.

If you need a plumber in DFW — call Drain Kings. You won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Kymberli Anderson
reviews.text:
Huge thank you to Drain Kings Plumbing for helping me during an emergency water leak that was damaging my floors. I had no idea where the water was coming from, but their team quickly diagnosed the problem and found a hole under my bathtub.

They were professional, responsive, and very knowledgeable. Within just two days of my first call, they fixed the plumbing and installed a brand new tub. I’ve lived in my home for 32 years, and this is the first time I’ve ever had a new tub, so I’m really excited!

They also helped guide me on what to ask my insurance company, which made the claims process much easier. Now I’m just waiting for insurance to complete the rest of the bathroom repairs.

If you’re looking for a professional, timely, and knowledgeable plumbing company—whether you’re paying out of pocket or working through an insurance claim—I highly recommend Drain Kings Plumbing.

reviews.author: daphne 2
reviews.text:
I have been using Dezmond for plumbing services 2020. He has serviced my rental property and my home.

On Friday, Ausust, 29, 2025, I had a river of moving water all over my first floor as a result of washing clothes, my third load of 6. I purchased a wet vac and vacuum the water up. I called and texted Dezmond Saturday morning to access what caused the water damage from a plumbers perspective. He said his tech Johnathan would arrive between 3 and 5 pm Johnathan arrived at 1:56 pm.

He was in a company T-Shirt, courteous, responsive, professional, and provided quality work. He identified the source of the damage, explained everytlhing along the way and he fixed the problem. His price was reasonable. I would use him again and I highly recommend his service.

reviews.author: Willie Smith Jr
reviews.text:
Drain Kings Plumbing is hands-down the best in the business!

Desmond and his team are incredibly professional, always on time, and take pride in their work. Every time they’ve been to my home, they’ve made sure to keep the work area clean and left everything spotless after the job was done — something that really sets them apart.

I know I can always count on Desmond and the Drain Kings crew for any plumbing need. Not only is their service top-notch, but they consistently beat any competitor’s price. It’s rare to find a company that offers both quality and value like this.

Highly recommend Drain Kings Plumbing to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and affordable plumbing services!

reviews.author: M Ryan Grandy
reviews.text:
If you are looking for the best plumber in Fort Worth, look no further than Desmond and the team at Drain Kings. We were facing a scary natural gas leak that wouldn't pass city inspection right before a major cold front. After a disappointing experience with another plumber, Drain Kings came in and completely outshined the competition.

They replaced our entire natural gas lines and got everything up to code so Atmos could restore our heat just in time. Huge thanks to Desmond, John, and Marcus for their professionalism and hard work. They are personable, respectful, and walk you through every step. For a fair price and top-tier quality, call Drain Kings. You won’t regret it!

reviews.author: dw gospel
reviews.text:
I was quoted nearly $8,000 for something that didn’t need to cost anywhere close to that…

After dealing with multiple companies (including one that didn’t even fix the issue), I finally found Drain Kings—and they restored my faith in honest service.

Matthew and David were outstanding. They installed both of my water heaters, picked up one directly from Home Depot, and even fixed an extra plumbing issue for FREE—including picking up the part themselves.

And yes—everything passed city inspection.

Honest. Fair. Above and beyond.

Don’t waste your time and money going anywhere else. Get at least one of your quotes from Drain Kings.

reviews.author: Kristin Odums
reviews.text:
While I was out of town on a business trip, my upstairs sink overflowed. When I got home Friday, water was coming out of a water puddle in my ceiling and out of my air vent.

Saturday, and HVAC person came out and said it was not the AC overflow/ secondary drain, so I called a plumber. They could not come out until Wednesday.

I called Drain Kings, and they were here in less than a hour. They fixed the leak, replaced the cracked pipe, and broken seals and gaskets.

I will totally recommend them to everyone I know in DFW.

I’ll be calling to see if they can repair pool water fill valves later!!!

reviews.author: WonderFul Woman
reviews.text: I called Drain Kings for a leak under the kitchen sink and Desmond had availability within a couple of hours. Johnathan arrived early and assessed the problem and offered his expertise. Not only did Johnathan walk me through the process of the repair, he answered my questions and offered his professional opinion about leak detection devices. After he finished,  he doubled checked his work even showing how to use a device he recommended. I know I made the right call to Drain Kings and I wouldn't hesitate to call them again for my future needs.

reviews.author: Marilyn Davis
reviews.text:
Our home was in a panic when we woke up this morning. Our toilet, yuck, backed up into our shower, YUCK! Mr. Desmond is professional, courteous, informative, but most of all a business man of integrity and honesty. Within less than 30 minutes, he assessed the problem, identified the problem, informed me of the problem, and then fixed the problem.

reviews.text:

Very nice and respectful young man, and a great plumber.  If you need quality work performed and want to deal with someone who conducts business ethically. then Drain Kings is the one!

I’ve always been very pleased with the Drain Kings work.

reviews.text: Justin was very knowledgeable and explained several options to us and how they worked.  We were very comfortable with Justin and confident in the installation of our new system.  I would highly recommend Precision Plumbing the team was very professional.

reviews.text: Justin and Anthony from Precision Plumbing provided outstanding service for me today. I needed to have both my water heater and furnace replaced! They were extremely patient with my questions and concerns, and left me feeling assured that I had chosen the right people and company to manage the work I needed to have done in my home. Thank you Precision Plumbing for always being there for our plumbing, heating, and AC service needs since 2007! Precision Plumbing also has excellent customer service! When you call to schedule service, you truly feel like the person on the other end of the line truly cares about your issues. To me, that level of service really matters!! Thank you, Precison!!

reviews.text: Our toilet was plugged up and being only one of two bathrooms in the house (with 3 people), they were the only ones who could come out right away. reviews.author: Pam Musso
reviews.text: 5 stars because plumber Terry was able to locate the source of a water leak immediately, carry out the plan to install a new shower faucet system and get it Done the next day! Another Done plumber had been here two months before thinking the issue was caulking but it wasn't. Terry's work was meticulous, explanations excellent, he waited and tested that the leak was actually fixed. Terry was recommended to me by a neighbor. So when I needed a second plumber to come check the unresolved issue, I asked for Terry. He deserves a bonus for the work he did! I highly recommend you call Done and request Terry! I know what the market is like and how challenging it is to find a competent, honest plumber, I will definitely call Done if I need a plumber again and request Terry! Thank you to Done and Terry!

reviews.author: Linda Humphrey
reviews.text: I have been with Done Plumbing for a long time and always been happy with their work.  This was the biggest job yet and took  2 days.  They had to take the cast iron pipes under my townhome and replace with new ones.  They did a wonderful job and always kept me posted as to what they were doing and when they would be turning off the heat or water etc. They had to move a lot of things in my basement and nothing was broken and everything put back where it belonged. They worked very hard and were always friendly.  I was impressed that everyone had a specific job to do and did it well. I had plumbers, workers that took out the pipe, some with cameras, some that put in the new pipe and mixed the cement to cover it all up.  I have pictures and an estimated bill that they went over with me. I am now going to file a claim with my Insurance company to see if I can get some of the money back and they have a special person who just does claims that is working with me. I like that they are a family business and each person has their special job to do. Many thanks to Done Plumbing for a job well done.

Thank you, Kyla, for scheduling these two plumbers!
