reviews.author: Jacki Dixon
reviews.text: Four years ago we had Dave install our plumbing fixtures for our new shower and he did a wonderful job. He came out once to disconnect all the plumbing for our old bathtub which we took out, and then after the tiling was done, he came back to install the new shower fixtures. We’ve been very happy with our shower and the work that Dave did and he charged a fair price. Now we are ready to remodel our kitchen and two bathrooms and we’ve called Dave out to do that work and I’m sure he’ll do a wonderful job.

reviews.author: Michelle Donnelly
reviews.text: Dave is fast and efficient in taking care of his community!  He fixed everything exactly how it needed to be done and when he said he would.  He even came to check on us before and after he did the work. Great customer service! Hard to find someone that goes above and beyond for their customers anymore.  Thank you Dave!

reviews.author: June Jantz
reviews.text: I have used Dave for YEARS. His first visit was to finish the job a previous plumber gave up on. He knew exactly what and how to do the job! I will never call anyone else. If you need a talented great natured plumber, CALL DAVE!

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.text: Called for a service call and was denied because I own a mobile home

reviews.author: Robert W.
reviews.text:
I contacted Dave as he had done some work for my wife when she had a house in Prescott. Now that we had a place in Chino Valley we have a well with a high level of arsenic. Our first conversation with Dave was that we should go ahead and purchase the equipment we need and he would do the installation. 

Over the next month or so we did the research and purchased a water softener, reverse osmosis system and a couple of other items including a new kitchen sink. 

We made an appointment and Dave came out. Three-steps out of the truck he calls my wife a "cougar" but I let it go. Whatever? 

Next, he tells me I should not have bought the water softener as there is a better product on the market that he sells. I'm sure he is correct; however, my softener is not returnable. 

Dave also tells me my Wellmate water pressure take is no longer working, that the bladder is "shot." He can tell this be just "feeling" the tank.

He has to rush off and we consider all of this. 

The next day I text him and ask for a written estimate to do the installation and he DECLINES the work.

I the meantime I purchased a replacement Wellmate tank and retained a new plumber (review coming). 

THE KICKER...

MY OLD WELLMATE PRESSURE TANK WAS JUST FINE! It just needed to be re-pressurized. 

Use Affordable Plumbing at your own risk or find a plumber.

reviews.author: Lyn DeLano
reviews.text:
Yet another follow up with Dave.  Dave once again to the rescue.  As always, he is a great communicator and arrives as scheduled.  This was a difficult in the wall shower waterline leak.  Dave provided us the best case and least invasive scenario.  He nailed it!!!  And his company name says it all.  The best plumber this side of anywhere.   Steve and Lyn DeLano

This is a follow up for another plumbing service by Dave.  Since we had such great service previously, we contacted Dave to install a pressure reducing valve and water shut off on the house side of the City of Prescott water meter on our new home.  This was a very challenging installation, as Dave had to dig down to and below the city water line. He installed a high performance PRV and water shut off gate valve on a riser… so that the water could be shut off easily and access to the PRV for adjustment or replacement.  A very professional high quality installation, was well below the bid price, and was completed in less than 3 hours.  Amazing service all the way around!  Dave arranged all of the utility locate services, and made 3 visits to the job site to strategize the installation.  Steve and Lyn DeLano

Dealing with Dave was amazing!  We had a problem with a toilet.  Dave set up our appointment at 8am.  He called at 7:30 to see if it was ok to come early!  YES, please!  He was here at 7:40am. He took care of our problem in less then 10 minutes!!!  Fast, fair, and courteous.  The way business is done.  He was a consummate communicator, always returning phone calls and texts when contacted.  He even checked in to make sure everything was working correctly.  Our go to guy!  Steve and Lyn DeLano

reviews.author: Bob Park
reviews.text: Our sewer pump alarm went off and our toilets began to back up. I called Affordable Plumbing Sol.and left a message.  Dave called me back within 5 minutes and told me that he was sorry but couldn't get to me until 6 days later.  I called another company who came out and  gave me a ridiculous estimate of $14K to replace the sewer grinder!  I called Dave (Affordable Plumbing) the next day.  He said the price was totally outrageous....He explained to me what needed to be done and that it would be closer to $1500-2000.  He had just left for vacation but called me back from his trip and answered all of my questions even though he still was not able to come out for about 4 days.  I wanted to get our system fixed immediately since the toilets couldn't be flushed, no shower, no laundy until the sewer pump got fixed. I ended up with another company who was able to come out and replace the sewer grinder and get us back and running.  Dave was so polite, informative and spent the time to explain details to me even though he was not able to help with my sewer problem.  Affordable Plumbing will be the first plumbing co. I will call if in the future we need a plumber.   Their customer service is excellent and Dave is very knowledgeable.  Thank you Dave, for your help, even though you were so busy, you couldn't come immediately....I certainly see why!

reviews.author: John And Sandra M.
reviews.text:
I'm 75 years old and I've used plumbers in six states and in multiple cities in some of those states.  If I hade to rate Affordable Plumbing Solutions compared to everyone else I've used, there is absolutely no comparison.  I recently had to replace all hardware on top and underneath a bedroom sink due to a leak.  Two plumbers couldn't find the leak, a third gave me an estimate of $1700 and a fourth $750.
This problem went on for weeks.  I finally found Affordable Plumbing Solutions and he gave me an estimate of between $300 and $350.  The spread was due to not knowing how much the Faucet would cost.  He went to the house late Tuesday to see what he would need and fixed everything first thing the next morning.  My tenant called me to tell me how great they were.  Save yourself the trouble of finding a Plumber and call Affordable Plumbing Solutions firs

reviews.author: Brian Mansfield
reviews.text: Best deal in the area! I received four estimates from three local plumbers and one of the big box stores for a new water heater and recirculating pump. Dave with Affordable Plumbing Solutions was the best price of the local plumbers and his reviews offered a lot more peice of mind than the big box store installer.  All the bids were for the same items and we saved a lot of money using Affordable Plumbing Solutions.  One of the most important reasons we chose Affordable Plumbing Solutions is that if we were to have an warranty issue or another plumbing issue Dave will be there for us. The new water heater and the recirculating pump are a great upgrade, we could not be happier with the install and the installer.

reviews.author: Anita Howell
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about Affordable Plumbing Solutions! This is truly a family-owned and operated business that takes pride in their work, and it shows from start to finish.
Dave is absolutely fantastic—professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about doing the job right. He took the time to explain everything clearly, showed up on time, and made sure everything was working perfectly before he left. It’s rare to find someone this honest and dependable these days.
If you’re looking for a plumber you can trust, Affordable Plumbing Solutions is the one to call. Great service, fair pricing, and top-quality work. Highly recommend Dave and his team!

reviews.author: Joyce Crider
reviews.text:
You will not be disappointed if you choose Affordable Plumbing Solutions. Dave is very professional and reasonably priced AND he offers solutions that are affordable.  I was going to have a filtration system and water softener installed. He recommended a whole house filter that his customers have loved. I love mine too and way less expensive. Gals if you've been having trouble with your hair and you don't have a water filter - get one. Life changing! The water here is hard - a filter - the right solution!
Integrity is obviously at the top of Dave's list. He's completed three projects at our home and I'll call on him again.

reviews.author: Dave Loskill
reviews.text: I spent 20+ years as a general contractor and I wish I had someone like Dave working with me on all of my projects. He is a professional to the truest sense of the word. He was on time, extremely knowledgeable with everything that needed to be addressed. He explained everything completely to me and my options and performed all work quickly and expertly. He did not mind at all me watching the repairs made to my home or my questions why he was doing the repairs. I highly recommend this individual to everyone. I found it as an added bonus that he is also a Christian. God Bless.

reviews.author: Melody M.
reviews.text: When we needed a water heater replaced quickly, Dave and Mitch came through. They did top quality work for a great price. We also had two toilets replaced and another job well done for less than half the competitors price! We appreciated how they arrived on time, focused and ready to get the work done efficiently both service calls. A really nice touch is while they were here for the water heater, we had a leaky faucet and Mitch actually took the time to show us how to repair it ourselves as it's a common leak! They are definitely are go-to plumber for any future needs.

reviews.author: Wendy Shields
reviews.text: I’ve had so many trades people working at my house I’ve lost count.  However, of all of them, I’ve only been able to write a positive revue about two.  This will be my third.  Dave has helped me out on two occasions.  Both times he’s been prompt, courteous,  and knowledgeable  about the job at hand.  There was a potential issue with the old faucet I had him install, so he followed up the next day to make sure all was well.  All of this, plus I felt he charged a fair price.  I have highly recommended him to a friend and will do it again.  Thanks Dave!!!

reviews.author: elon luko
reviews.text: I was impressed from the start with Dave.  He prompt in returning  my first phone call to fix a constant toilet leak and arrived on time and quickly discovered the problem and had the parts needed.  I told him about another broken handle with a toilet and he purchased and replaced the handle within a couple of day.  He installed new shower and faucets in my bath to correct a constant drip.  His work was neat and done with care.  I would highly recommend Affordable Plumbing being dependable, prompt, very knowledgeable and  fair with pricing.

synthesis.summary: Owner Dave runs a one-man operation in Prescott Valley with a loyal repeat-customer base built on fair prices, on-time arrivals, and follow-up calls the next day. He's particularly strong on water heaters, filtration systems, and fixture installs. Two Yelp reviews (1-star) raise concerns — one describes being called a 'cougar,' a false diagnosis of a pressure tank, and abrupt refusal to take the job; the other cites rudeness toward women — worth knowing before you book.

plumbers.address: 3623 Crossings Dr Suite 228, Prescott, AZ 86305, USA

reviews.author: Dennis Osgood
reviews.text: Highly recommend. This is a family business and the service was terrific. We had all our cutoff valves replaced. The work was professional, the owner friendly and informative. We have found our plumber.

reviews.author: Ryan Sutton
reviews.text: Very impressed with Mike.  Happy with my sewer service which required a hydro jet and chain grinder clean out.  Pine Country Plumbing is professional and has experience to get it done right.

reviews.author: Ron Martina
reviews.text: Mike was great. He did an outstanding job on our tankless water heater and soft water unit. We are very pleased with Pine Country plumbing and will be using them for our future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Melissa Digerolamo
reviews.text: I am extremely happy with the quality of work that Pine Country Plumbing performed and their exceptional service. I called to schedule an appointment to get two blocked toilets fixed and a leaky shower. I spoke with Mike and he was able to get me an appointment the very next day. I’ve had such poor service from other plumbing companies in the past with scheduling and communication. Not only did Mike and Brad keep their promise & arrived at my scheduled time but they also called and let me know they were in route which gave me peace of mind. Mike and Brad showed up and were friendly and extremely knowledgeable. They did a thorough review were able to diagnose the problems with my toilets and shower. In just a day I was able to be have functioning toilets and a shower again; which we all know for a family of 4 is crucial. I can’t thank Mike and Brad enough for their professionalism, friendliness, and exceptional work. If you want someone that is trustworthy, reliable, personable and has 25+ years in the business, I HIGHLY recommend Pine Country Plumbing. You will NOT be disappointed.

reviews.author: David Sorensen
reviews.text: Mike from Pine Country Plumbing is a TOP NOTCH plumber in Prescott. I reached out to him on a Saturday morning after trying 3 other companies who wanted to charge an emergency call fee of over $250 for a simple 15 minute fix under the sink at one of my rental properties. Luckily Mike understood what needed to be done and was just wrapping up another job a few mile away and said he could stop by on his way to his next job. He was prompt, professional, and didnt charge me a weekend rate since it was a quick job! Thanks for taking care of my tenant!! He is my GO-TO plumber for all future needs. HIGHLY RECOMMEND to anyone wanting an honest plumber willing to go above and beyond for his customers.

reviews.author: Beale Monday
reviews.text: Pine Country plumbing did a great job for us while we were remodeling a bathroom.  Mike came over and discussed several options with us, his honesty and knowledge of the profession was apparent from our first meeting.  Mike maintained excellent communication with us throughout the remodel and always was available when we had questions.  Mike and his crew were always professional and prompt.  We really could not have asked for better service, honest price and quality work.  We will be reaching out again soon as our hot water heater is starting to fail.

reviews.author: Manzanita Village
reviews.text: Mike with Pine Country plumbing came to our HOA to help resolve a tricky plumbing problem where a grinder pump line was broken owing to too much pressure from our private Low Pressure Sewer line. He came, put in a fix and returned to find that although he worked at it and did the best he could, he was unable to fix the problem so he helped us find another company to do it AND Mike did not charge us at all since, in his words, he could not fix it. Now THAT'S not your everyday company. We are very grateful to Pine Country and especially to Mike.

reviews.author: Dwayne Sterner
reviews.text: Mike took on the task of replacing my main water line including a 75’ PEX run from the end of the driveway by the meter to the cabin. He also installed a hose bib by the deck. Despite getting rained out by the storm, he finished the job to perfection! Brad also assisted with the trenching portion, as well as Mike’s son Riley! They work hard and do an exceptional job. Would highly recommend these professionals for all your plumbing needs. Kudos to Pine Country Plumbing for a job well done!

reviews.author: Mark Brown
reviews.text: Called Mike to get a quote on completing our master bath remodel to install 2 vessel sinks and complete the plumbing. So glad we did. Mike was very prompt on calling back and coming right out to quote the job and we hired him immediately. Not only was he the best price his work is impeccable. The attention to detail and the pride he takes in his work is far above any other company we have used. He has our business for ever.

reviews.author: Chris Earl
reviews.text: We moved into our home and had several plumbing projects including a replacement for our water heater and a leak in our propane tank. Mike suggested a tankless option and prioritized his schedule to fix our gas leak! We LOVE the tankless (we had never owned one). His attention to detail was great and he’s always been prompt, responded to our urgency and his professionalism was always #1.

reviews.author: Donald Healey
reviews.text: We recently had Pine Country out to repair a leaking kitchen sink drain that required cutting into a wall and working in the crawlspace under our home. This was the second time we had used their services. Once again we were totally satisfied. They perform professional work at a reasonable price and we will continue to use them when plumbing needs arise; highly recommended!

reviews.author: Deirdra Carter
reviews.text: Wonderful service and customer service I'd highly recommend to anyone. Mike came out for what I thought was a gas leak by my fireplace. Turns out the pipe just needed tightening. He fixed my issue and didn't end up charging me. I would absolutely use his company again in the future. Thank you!!

reviews.author: visionhawk44
reviews.text: I highly recommend Pine Country Plumbing. Because he finished a job early, he was able to come out for an emergency at 4:00 on a Friday. And you can just tell, he's very authentic and does right by his customers ... Mike and his company would be the only one I would call for plumbing!

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.text: They came out quickly. They helped give us readings on our water heater so we could get parts from the water heater company. They came out quickly after parts were received and installed to get us up and running. Very reasonably priced and remained professional the entire time.

reviews.author: Julia Lewko
reviews.text: Mike was friendly and professional.  We had a leaky hot water heater that was still under warranty.  He did everything we needed and pointed out a few valves that needed replacing as well.  I will definitely call Pine Country Plumbing with any future needs.

One reviewer notes Mike looked at a leak clamp and told them nothing needed to be done, rather than upselling a repair.

reviews.author: d v n
reviews.text: Bee Plumbing is the best plumbing service I’ve ever used in the 8 states I have lived in. I would highly recommend using them if those services are needed. Brennan is a true professional. His ability to communicate and navigate tough trouble shooting is second to none. His work is excellent and his prices are fair. Will definitely recommend to friends and family and will use again.

reviews.author: Larry Scott
reviews.text:
Great plumber!  I hired Brennan by checking for reviews on Google (Facebook too).  We communicated by phone, text, and email.  Brennan's price was very good.   He replaced a teenage water heater.  Brennan was prompt, did great work, and cleaned up after.
He's a good communicator too.  I asked him to quote me for future work as well.   Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Cactus Mobile Ranch
reviews.text:
We use Bee Plumbing for both commercial and residential services. His easy scheduling and prompt service has quickly made him our primary service provider. Pricing is competitive
and requires no oversight.

reviews.author: judith davidson

reviews.author: Toby A
reviews.text: terrible company

reviews.author: Joey Furlan
reviews.text: WOW!  So my salon (Hair By Joey) is one of the largest in Prescott.  We service dozens of clients a day with a large staff working from 9am to 10pm.  After that big storm this week our water main went out.  Our property management folks called Bee and they  showed up at 8am.  They were short staffed so it was just one guy.  I can't remember the name but two hours later all I could see was this dudes shoes poking out a hole 4 feet deep and three feet wide.  The dude was relentless.  6 hours later, our water was back on.  Dude was out there in a pouring rain for half the job.  He didn't quit, wouldn't give up, got us back up and running.  We would have had to shut down for days if I'd called a rookie crew.  Would have cost us thousands.  Bee got it done.  You have an emergency?  Call these guys.  Frekking legends.

reviews.author: Chandry Rice
reviews.text: Brennan did just about everything at our home. Had him come out, find a leak and repair it. Was so impressed with his work and timely manner that we then had him as our go to plumber for everything else. Brennan has repaired pipes, installed showers, toilets and faucets. Took out our old water heater and installed the new one in a very timely fashion. He is busy but will usually always answer the phone and if not able to will return your call in a timely manner. Very professional, friendly and just a well rounded plumber. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Anne nightingale
reviews.text: Brennan was totally professional, kind and understanding... downright wonderful!  First he replaced our recirculation pump (and did a stellar job) but he noticed that our expansion tank was rusted and leaking.  So he came back and fixed that real quick.  He is dependable, reliable, knowledgeable and FAST!!!!  Highly recommend.  (Also he dealt with our home warranty company - which I will terminate my relationship next month- in a professional and patient manner.)  Kudos to Brennan!

reviews.author: Stephen D.
reviews.text:
Highly recommend this company. Here was my experience:
1. I called 12 different 24 hour emergency plumbers. Only this gentleman and one other answered the call.
2. The gentleman arrived in less than an hour on an emergency call.
3. He ran into several dead ends and did not give up until the problem was solved.
4. Very fair pricing!
5. Very professional.
I will definitely use this company again (fingers crossed that I won’t have to for a long time).

reviews.author: Zack Hollander
reviews.text: Brennan was a lifesaver. My water heated had a pipe that ran behind my furnace and had started leaking which we found out when we went to install a new furnace. He was out within an hour to fix the pipe and  my furnace installers were able to keep doing their job. He also helped them source a part  that day that we didn't anticipate needing to be replaced. I truly cannot thank him enough for helping out and going the extra mile.

reviews.author: James R. Hatty Jr.
reviews.text: Brennan made time to come out for an emergency repair for a broken pipe.  His communication was excellent, and when he arrived he was not only professional, but personable and efficient.  He knows his trade, and would highly reccomend his services to anyone in need of plumbing services.  Was charged a reasonable price for the services provided.  Thanks again Brennan!  And sorry you had to get so muddy!

reviews.author: Cindy Bancroft
reviews.text: We were tickled to find Bee Plumbing on FB with good reviews.  They did a major update of our old residential plumbing system.  This included at least 4 trips under the house in a snug crawl space. Provided very good problem solving & solid professional service.  Absolutely will use again & highly recommend!

reviews.author: MyHost
reviews.text: We had a clogged sink at one of our vacation rentals. Our usual plumber was unavailable and recommended Brennan. He was over at the home in a few short hours and unclogged the sink just in time for our guests to prepare dinner. Personable, professional, and fair pricing. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Donald Brenno
reviews.text:
Allen came out for a semi annua
l check of our plumbing systems.  He was  very friendly and professional.  He gave us explanations of whar he was doing, how our systems work, and explained what  issues may come up in the future.  We are extremely satisfied.   Thank you Allen

reviews.text: An opportunity came up for us needing a plumber. Contacted Brennan at Bee Plumbing and he quickly worked us into his schedule. The quality of his work was very good and we are pleased with the results. His prices were fair and we will be using him again if the need arises.

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.text: Trustworthy, honest, affordable, professional, knowledgeable and genuinely kind. If you hold these values in high regard, this is the company to hire for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Cindy Leath
reviews.text: Charlie is so responsive and does GREAT work! Replaced our water heater same day service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: christi Barbieri
reviews.text: BEST plumber in town!  week before Christmas and everyone was booked till first of the year.  This company came out and fixed my issues and it was same day!  reasonable and honest and now the only plumber I will ever call.

reviews.author: Barbara E.
reviews.text: He did a job on Feb. replaced pipes Etc. In Aug a piece he replaced broke & I list tons on water again $613 worth. He finally sent his Dons to repair part. It started to rain so they left & left hoke open. I called later to get it finished. He said he was busy, get to when he could. Called 3 mire times. Finally he said he have to charge me sgsin to close hoie. I'm an elderly widow & finally have had to cover it W/cover & put rocks around to hood it down. In the time it was open, it filked back up W/dirt, rain & weeds. It's still open to that day. That lady job was in mid Aug. I'm so disgusted   I may have to pay someone to fill it up. Plus he left my concrete containers out that go in hole around pipe. Very poor job. For sure.

reviews.author: Jet A.
reviews.text: Prescott Plumbing came out to attempt to fix a stopped up toilet and failed, yet charged $155 regardless. They used an augur for a full 5 minutes, declared it was cleared and left. 3 days later, the toilet backed up again. They did not send the bill for a full couple of weeks so I suspected perhaps they were not going to charge since they were called and told the problem had not been alleviated but oh no..... I tried to reason with them on the phone but they were stubborn and unkind. Do not hire them. They have no work ethic. They told me they were giving us a great deal and also lied saying they snaked the drain twice which they had not done. We hired another company and resolved the issue and in a very kindly manner.

reviews.author: Barry C.
reviews.text:
we had them come to our home to clear a drain on dec 23 cost $160.00

the next day the line backed up again.
so i asked Charlie  to  come back and he said it would be 6 days until he could come back out as he had gone out of town for the holidays. (understood)
when he returned he  never called on wed as promised to see what happened.
so i contacted him.
less than a pleasant  experience  when i asked for a partial refund for a job not done correctly. 

as i was not able to wait 6 days or more i  had to hire another drain service Rick @ R and R sewer and drain to come out and do the job properly. costing me another $200.00 as it was on Christmas eve.
 the  drain has been clear  since with no issues. 

the end result  after mentioning this review to the owner . was that i did get the 100 dollar refund in cash the rest of this review is what it is . 
a job done correctly the first time would have been worth the price .

reviews.author: Skip E.
reviews.text: Yesterday evening just before going to bed my hot water heater began leaking. I googled emergency plumbing company's near Prescott. I called four all listed as 24 hour emergency service. No one answered at any of them telling me to leave a message. I then called Prescott Plumbing and within 5 minutes Charlie called me back. He had me send him pictures of the problem and talked me through getting the leaked stopped for the night. The next morning he called and arrived promptly at 9 am and fixed my problem, which was not easy by the way. Charlie never tried to up sell me anything as a matter of fact stated there was no reason to buy newer parts as what I had was still perfectly fine. So after the emergency call the night before and a two hour fix job his rates were extremely fair. I would highly recommend him!  Oh and by the way only one other company called me back the next day.... Thank you Charlie. Great job!

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.text: We called Charlie after we received an outrageous bid from another plumber in town. Charlie explained that we didn't need all that additional work done and that he would be able to get the job done well within our budget. He worked hard and while the project wasn't easy he communicated with us on a regular basis and did the job quickly (which is what we needed as we had sewage coming in our home) and the fact that he stayed well within our budget was even more comforting. I highly recommend Charlie and will refer him to friends and family for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Susan Buehl
reviews.text: We lost our heating system in mid winter.  Charlie responded immediately.  Our systems was different and very complex.  I found Charlie to be very bright, personable and well informed.  We agreed to replace the water heater with an on-demand  condensing combi-boiler, a tank-less system.  His communication during the entire process was flawless.  Workmanship was the best and his knowledge of such complex systems was impressive as was his response and rapid installation.  The cost was about the same as replacing our original expensive water heater.

reviews.author: Claire MacBride
reviews.text: Recntly I had a leaky outdoor faucet and randomly called Prescott Plumbing.  Charlie Gorlick got right on the job and when it turned out that there was no good access to the faucet connection he went the extra mile to fix that situation.  He was on time, courteous and did everything necessary to solve my problem.  Definitely would recommend him if you need a plumber.  Oh and I feel the price was fair as well.

reviews.author: Vince DiRocco
reviews.text: Not a very attention to detail type of company. They both (Charlie and Tricia) really screwed up and cost me a lot of unnecessary headaches. Lack of an education and being ignorant was the root cause analysis. NEVER AGAIN!!! He even has his wife Tricia Gorlick and family leave fake reviews for the company right here below...WTH? BEWARE they are cheats!!!

reviews.author: Char Davis
reviews.text: we were in a tight escrow and needed some things for the buyer and charlie addressed them, with great service and great effort. 4 trips to the house and great perseverance. our hero in the clutch. would highly recommend him anytime. and we were in california not prescott also, even better job for sure with the long distance communications.

reviews.author: StrawberryMary
reviews.text: Charlie came after hours attempting to fix a clog in our apartment. Unfortunately he didn't have the correct tool, so he was unable to fix it. He was unable to come back and fix it as he said he was fully booked. He communicated well and came when he said he would, it's just disappointing he couldn't unclog our main line.

reviews.author: Zeke Robinson
reviews.text:
Charlie had us provide a service for him.
He signed for the service.
He then refused to pay the bill.
He says the contractor AJ Builders owes the money.
It was his plumbing truck license to Prescott plumbing.
He signed for the service.
We thought he was a honest businessman.
Beware of the COMPANY!!!!!
NOT HONEST!!!!!

reviews.author: Billy Studabaker
reviews.text: Prescott' plumbing is the best plumbing company in northern Arizona?? Third generation Charlie run the company !! Honest with his clients !!! He shows up takes dam care of his clients !! He's been my plumber ten years !! He shows up !! And you can count on prescott'plumbing five stars !!

synthesis.summary: Prescott Plumbing's owner Charlie gets strong praise for same-day availability and honest upfront pricing, but the Yelp record contains serious follow-through failures: an elderly customer had an open trench in her yard for months after a repair, and two drain jobs failed within days with Charlie refusing to return without additional charges. The business has been operating for 16 years but the quality is inconsistent.
strengths: Same-day availability including holidays — multiple reviewers confirm Charlie responds immediately
Honest pricing: several reviewers mention Charlie warned against unnecessary work and stayed within budget
Personal service: long-term customers describe him as reliable and trustworthy over many years
weaknesses: Drain clearing jobs have failed within days, requiring rehiring another company
Follow-through on repairs is inconsistent — one reviewer waited months to get an open trench closed
bestFor: Customers who want honest upfront pricing without upsells
redFlags: Elderly widow left with an open hole in her yard for months after a repair failure — Charlie said he'd charge again to close it
Two separate Yelp reviewers report drain jobs failing within days, then being charged again or abandoned
Negative Yelp reviews allege fake reviews posted by family members

reviews.author: Chase Rumfola
reviews.text:
Marcus and Danny with Ace home service services. Aka The dream team🫡🫡🫡

These guys came out, gave an estimate, then got the work done same day. Replaced an aging instant hot water heater with a slick new one and were professional with communication throughout the process.

reviews.author: Doreen Bender
reviews.text: Joe, Brad and Tom were at our house yesterday and installed a new heating/air conditioning unit and also cleaned out our ducts.  They worked in a very professional and friendly manner.  They cleaned up after themselves and explained how the new thermostat worked.  We are very happy with their expertise and getting the job done in a timely matter.  They cleaned up after themselves and left everything in order.  Thanks again, Don and Doreen Bender

reviews.author: luke hart
reviews.text: The whole process start to finish was great. I requested information from Home Depot and within 5 minutes I received a call back to schedule a free home estimate.  I had a sales rep at my house the next day and they didn’t try and over sell me. They installed everything very quickly and when they ran into problems they stayed with the job.  They were friendly, professional and proficient. I would highly recommend ACR home service to anyone.

reviews.author: Fun Z.
reviews.text:
Ace Home Services North in my opinion is just a wolf in sheep's clothing waiting to pounce on ignorant customers that don't know any better about these type of mechanical and electrical repairs but little did they know I build custom designed automation machines for a living and have an extensive mechanical and electrical background.

They tried to take advantage of me but I did my research before just bending over and taking it! I found out what the actual cost should be to replace the upper and lower heating elements in my electric hot water heater and boy was I shocked with their outrageous quote of $1,960.72 to do such a simple repair considering the previous company (Yavapai Plumbing & Heating) did a complete install in 2016 at this address for the previous owner that include the brand new Bradford & White 50gal hot water heater with installation for the cost of $2,034 and they expected me to pay $1,960.72 just to replace the 2 heating elements.

While researching I came across this informational guide on the internet "Water Heater Repair Cost Guide: Don't Pay Too Much! (2023)"
Resource link: https://www.cartersmyplumber.com/water-heater-repair-cost/
Section 5.1 of the guide (Heating Element)
"If you have a problem with your element, it will probably cost between $200 and $300 to fix it. The good news about elements is that they usually only cost $20 or so. Replacing one takes time, which means there is likely to be a higher cost of labor. You may spend up to $300 total. In most cases." Granted the source is located in Greenwood, IN 46142 but that's a huge difference $300 vs $1,960.72 that is unjustifiable and unacceptable in my book.

When I questioned the technician and asked for a breakdown of the quote for parts and labor he stated that it was just a flat rate. I found this very peculiar and suspicious for a company that claims to believe in honesty and integrity but not willing to show any transparency in their pricing! I sent him on his way and paid the fee of $79.95 for the service call which I was not pleased about but what choice did I have $79.95 or get taken advantage of and pay the $1960.72

In the end I did the repair myself and purchased 2 compatible replacement heating elements for a Bradford & White hot water heater from Alliance Home Improvement Center for $22.99 each for a total cost of $50.20 for the parts and it took me 20 minutes to drain the hot water heater, 10 minutes to remove both heating elements, 20 minutes to vacuum up the sediment in the bottom of the tank then 10 minutes to install both heating elements for a grand total of 1 hour of labor.

Plumbers charge by the hour or by the job, with hourly rates ranging from $45 to $150 or a flat fee of $200 to $250 for small repairs. Resource link: https://homeguide.com/costs/plumber-cost#:~:text=Plumbers%20charge%20by%20the%20hour,%2450%20to%20%2480%20per%20hour.

You be the judge and do the math even at 100 percent markup for parts and labor $1,960.72 was completely ridiculous for this repair!!! Where is the honesty, integrity and transparency certainly not at Ace Home Services North in this case?

When I tried to contact Ace Home Services North to speak to a manager about this outrageous quote it took 3 calls and over a week before I was called back to discuss the quote. A manger finally called me back and when I asked him to justify this outrageous quote his only justification was "You have no idea how much it cost to run this company" he got very angry and defensive and even threaten to have his legal team sue me if I posted a negative review about the company!

Well here it is and it's called freedom of speech and it is my first amendment right and I believe people deserve to know the truth about a company like Ace Home Services North so come and get me!!!

I chose Ace Home Services not only because they took over Yavapai Plumbing & Heating but they are also Veteran owned. To have this happen is shocking; I am appalled and just want to let other potential customers know how A.H.S. tried to take advantage of me.

reviews.author: Michael V.
reviews.text:
The tech came and spent about 20 minutes and told my elderly mother that she needed a new unit because it couldn't be fixed. Thank goodness she has us because we called another company and the tech was able to fix it.
We now have wonderful heat and the tech found why our ac bill was so high. So he helped her that way too. It's unbelievable that an elderly widow would be taken advantage of.

reviews.author: Jessica Mathews
reviews.text:
Our AC stopped working about a week ago. My husband called ACE, as they were the first business that popped up in a Google search and it has been between 90°-100°.

The tech came a few days later, did a (clearly not thorough) inspection of the unit.
He ended up telling us that our compressor was bad, the unit (that we bought brand new and had professionally installed 4 years ago) was "too old and obsolete," and that it was going to cost us an estimated $6,700 to change out our outside coil unit and compressor.

Since we don't have a spare $6,700, we contacted another business for a second opinion.
That person came out the next day and completely fixed the problem (NOT the compressor, not anything the guy from ACE lied to us about) for $300.

ACE wanted to rip us off for literally THOUSANDS of dollars that we don't have.
They offered no other options or solutions, and had we not found the company that actually helped us, we would be completely without AC for who knows how long in the AZ summer heat.
They still charged us over $200 to come out and LIE to us.

When my husband received a message from ACE to OFFER FINANCING on a completely unnecessary service, he told them what happened and how unacceptable their business practices are.
The only response was to tell him that they could still offer services in the future.

Absolutely unbelievable!
Bottom line, if I could give ACE zero stars, I would. They are unethical and clearly out to steal whatever they can from unsuspecting victims.
For as many elderly people on fixed incomes and young families just starting out as there are around here, it is disgusting to know that this company would rather let people overheat than to be honest and fo the correct work for a workable amount.

I will NEVER recommend ACE, and will be telling everyone I know how badly they tried to rip us off.
They should be ashamed of themselves, and I only hope that people see this and know not to trust these liars.

reviews.author: C M
reviews.text:
HIRE THIS GUY FOR WORK - he’s gifted in the HVAC field.  Derek came in and tackled a serious issue we’ve had for about 6 years with our HVAC system. We had incorrect roof PVC pipe drainage (too long to get to the gutter) and an HVAC unit  leaning 1 1/2”  the wrong direction which caused water to back up towards the blower motor i.e towards the expensive pieces not away - then rust, corrode, and likely create something flowing thru the air that made me sick/congested from contaminated HVAC condensation.  He fixed the problem in a really creative way and didn’t give up until he had the HVAC system exactly balanced to a centered bubble. No one has even tried to tackle this before so we are super grateful that he came up with a simple solution.  Now our unit drains condensation correctly with a new, direct path to the gutter.  This now prevents mold growth.  The guy literally saved our unit from probably dying in a year to living a much longer life.

Hire him because he just removed six years of frustration that other technicians had no desire to tackle.  The pics are after showing his finished work on PVC pipes. The precious version ran to the far right along the wall then down to the gutter.

You’ll appreciate his easy-going personality, kindness, and attentiveness . When you find a good one like Derek, you’ll be a repeat customer who is confident in his work.  He didn’t just “do his job”. He cared, fixed the real problem and then sealed it so no rusty water anymore could enter the house.

Derek, a big thank you for being a hero to this family. 🇺🇸 Cecelia

reviews.author: Ken R.
reviews.text:
I needed a frost-free hose bib replaced in Prescott Valley.  Prescott Valley is at 5300 feet and frequently freezes in the winter.  I called Ace up and told them I needed the exterior bib replaced.  Their technician showed up (he was a nice young man) and when he looked at the hose bib, told me "I was sent from Phoenix, and we don't have these (frost-free bibs) down there.. I don't have one.  Well, he said he would have to go locally to get one.  I asked how much they were, and he told me Ace would charge me $159 for just the hose bib!  A replacement frost-free hose bib costs less than $40 locally-the technician agreed it was much cheaper than his company's price, but his hands were tied..  Ace was also going to charge me $520 to replace the bib.  I told the young man that ACE was  "gouging" us folks, and told him to charge me for what he had done so far: remove some plaster around the bib.  It cost me $159 for this "service call".  
I later called a local plumber, who came out and replaced the bib for $275.... HALF what Ace was going to charge me.  My bad... I will NEVER call Ace again.  I may add that Ace Home Services is NOT affiliated with Ace Hardware, and it bought out Yavapai Plumbing and Heating whom I have used successfully in the past.  Stay away from Ace Home Services!

reviews.author: Dan F.
reviews.text:
Monday I called a plumbing company.  ACE HOME SERVICES.  They advertise 24 hour response and service.  Scheduled that day between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM.  
I blow the day waiting for them.  No Show.
I called at 7:00 PM that night to check the status.  A clearly frustrated but very nice lady said ... "... he's stuck on another job."  Rescheduled for Wednesday.  
Wednesday a guy from  came by to look at our hot water tank.  The pilot light device on our hot water tank was inoperable.  
He spent a good 45 minutes flat on his belly twisting this, humming and hawing.  He brought no tools.  He asked me if I had a barbecue lighter.  (?!??!!)
Failed to get the pilot light switch working.  Said he'd have the `office' send me an estimate for what he thought should be done.
Got the estimate yesterday: $7,000.  
An acquaintance owning several local properties suggested I call xxxxx.  I called at 8:45 AM and he was here at Noon.  Spent no more than 12 minutes making a small adjustment and got the pilot light mechanism fixed.  All in perfect operating condition.  Service call fee: $95.00.
Caveat emptor.

reviews.author: Steve B.
reviews.text:
Called ACE after doing some troubleshooting of my own on the Rheem Endeavor heater.  My conclusion was a control board in which I looked up pricing to be around $140 - $180.  They arrived about 4 hours after making the appointment and stayed in good contact until the technician arrived.  Once Ashton performed his testing, he came down and said yes, it is the control board and that will be $1,000.  I asked him to please breakdown the pricing showing the $79 service call fee, coast of the board and his labor.  He was unable to do so citing he has no control.  Ashton then asked me what my expectation of cost was for the repair.  I broke down how my expectation of $350 - $500 came to be and he said he could do it for $500 but would not have a 6 month repair guarantee.  That would be another $100.  With all of that, this is my first and last time doing business with ACE and will caution others to choose more wisely.
Have to add on, now he says another part is bad at the tune of $958 and cannot refund me for not fixing the heater,  ACE has been excused from my house.

reviews.author: Stephanie Welch
reviews.text: I had a sewer line backing up into the house. They initially estimated $351 to remove the toilet, clean the line, and reset the toilet. He snaked the line twice and pulled out materials both times but said that they couldn’t get past the clog. Then they said $455 to get a camera in to figure out where the clog was to then clear it out and I prepaid the service. I called another local plumber who came and cleared the line on the first attempt (larger and longer snake designed for sewer not small drains like ACE techs used) and he charged me a fraction of the cost. This happened before ACE even scheduled the “leak detection” service I prepaid. ACE didn’t resolve the problem, escalated it without trying appropriate equipment, and didn’t think it necessary to refund me despite the fact that they couldn’t solve the problem. Hard pass for me for any future needs.

reviews.author: Kathleen Maguire
reviews.text:
After numerous attempts to replace a hot water heater by several technicians and two different tanks, I have absolutely no confidence in Ace. The last visit was 3/2 with two techs, one of whom Keith, is the regional plumbing manager. The last thing needed was a joint/elbow to properly vent the unit and Keith was going to do it himself. I could go on with plenty of details but no one has returned my call or texts for a status. One rep said “oh that’s too bad, call the main number” and every subsequent attempt has been met with a computerized rep or a human who “will get the message to the right person”
To date (4/14), there’s been no reply, no acknowledgement and therefore, no vent/exhaust. I don’t believe I’ve been treated as insignificantly by any vendor and I could not give a favorable review rather, specific advice not to use Ace.

reviews.author: Judith D.
reviews.text: On October 5, 2024 a repairman made a service call to our home.  My husband signed a credit card authorization in the amount of $479.95 ($79.95 for the service call and a $400 deposit toward a new tank).  That same charge slip was presented to the bank with the amount changed to $879.94.  We reported the discrepancy, and the Bank rejected/reversed the charge as fraudulent.  We have now received a bill (4 months later) for an October 15, 2024 service call.  There was NO October 15, 2024 service call, nor was there a second service call at any time.  Ace is baffled that the amount of the charge was changed and assures me that they do not "engage in fraudulent business practices."  The amount didn't magically change itself!  In order to protect ourselves from any additional fraud we have notified local law enforcement.

reviews.author: Jacques P.
reviews.text: Hello everyone on July 5 2024 a ACE technician came to my home for a schedule maintenance of 79$ on my air conditioning system that was installed on May of 2024 , 6 years ago by Yavapai plumbing . Then the technician told me that my dual capacitor needed to be change 30$ part,I okayed it then after switching the part ? He made me sign a invoice for 340$ and then few minutes later he made me sign another invoice ?by adding 59$ to it for system testing and inspection that he  all ready done with the first invoice , really not happy with all that I feel that I been ripped off by ACE Home Services, never will I use this company ever again  this company do not deserve even a 1 star rating.

synthesis.summary: ACE Home Services has an overwhelming pattern of serious complaints: technicians routinely diagnose working equipment as needing $6,000–$14,000 replacements, second opinions consistently find simple $300 fixes. One customer alleges a credit card authorization was altered from $479 to $879 after signing. Of 40 reviews sampled, 30 are 1–2 stars driven almost entirely by pricing fraud allegations, misdiagnoses, no-shows, and a membership that's reported as nearly impossible to cancel.
strengths: A small number of Google reviewers report professional installations done correctly when technicians like Derek and Marcus are assigned
Some positive reviews for HVAC system replacements with cleanup and clear explanations
weaknesses: Systematic pattern of recommending $6,000–$14,000 replacements for equipment that competitors fix for under $300 — documented in at least 8 separate reviews
No-show and late cancellation pattern across multiple reviewers, including rescheduling emergency appointments 2 days out
Membership service described as extremely difficult to cancel — one reviewer reports repeated billing after verbal cancellation
redFlags: One customer alleges a signed credit card authorization was altered from $479.95 to $879.94 after the fact — reported to local law enforcement
Multiple reviewers document $1,960–$9,242 quotes for work competitors completed for under $300, including two-element water heater repair and drywall cutout
Technician told elderly customer her unit couldn't be repaired — second tech from another company fixed it; ACE tech was 'trying to take advantage of an elderly widow'
Manager threatened to have legal team sue a customer who posted a negative review after disputing a quote
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Advertises 24-hour service but documented no-shows on emergency calls, same-day cancellations, and rescheduling emergencies 2 days out. One reviewer spent 24+ hours without a working bathroom after a late cancellation.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google rating is 4.8 (1,984 reviews) vs Yelp 2.6 (37 reviews) — a 2.2-star gap. Yelp captures a concentrated pattern of pricing fraud allegations and misdiagnosis not visible in the Google aggregate.

plumbers.name: Paragon Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 8321 E Jacque Dr, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Robert Spurlock
reviews.text:
My water company tells me I have leak in my main water line, just before New Year eve.  My neighbors recommended them, after doing extended work on their property.  Called Paragon and the lady on the phone was polite and understanding.  The inspector, "Cody" came out and determined where the likely area the leak was occurring.  They called Blue stake and determined where the lines located.  Within two days their crew, of two, was on site and trenching for the new line.  Amazing work that was done in a day and half.  300' of water line, three shut off valves, and frost free spigot repaired or replaced.  Very pleased! Minimal intrusion and they cleaned up the area very well.  Their estimated amount for the work they did was in line with what I expected.  Exceedingly polite and respectful.

Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: harley guy
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible work and customer service. The price was very good considering the scope of work done on our bathroom shower. All times and quotes were exactly what was agreed upon and I was blown away , quite frankly.  Highly suggested.

reviews.author: Sheelah Savage
reviews.text: As a custom home builder, Paragon Plumbing has been a great company to work with. They work hard to make sure each job is done properly for us as well as out clients. They stand behind their products and work. We have worked with them for the last 6 years and plan to continue!

reviews.author: Advocate
reviews.text: After doing business with Paragon Plumbing for over 20 years, after new ownership took over a few years back, this business is not recommended for services. The new owner lacks quality customer service skill, in that he doesn't take his customer needs and/or complaints, seriously. Upon the first mishap with new ownership, an employee was sent out to a customer who was paying over $1,600 for a new hot water heater and installation, and while the employee was doing the installation, he received payment with a credit card, went out to his vehicle and took a photo of the customer's credit card, and one month later, there were 3 additional and "personal" credit card charges to the customer's account. When the customer called Paragon Plumbing to inform them of the issue and complain, the customer was told, "Oh, he quit." However, nothing was ever done to ensure customer satisfaction, not even an apology. Later on, the same customer would call for another service from Paragon Plumbing, where the plumber looked at a bathtub faucet for approximately 60 seconds, and then never really accessed the problem or fixed it, but, still, the customer was told they needed to render payment for the $169 service call fee. And again, months later, the same customer would call Paragon Plumbing to have a new toilet seat put on in their home bathroom, and was told that Paragon Plumbing would not render the service to them. This business establishment should not be trusted. Please report them to the Better Business Bureau and the Arizona Registrar of Contractors for not abiding by their agreements and for allowing theft of their customers to take place without repercussions or satisfaction of the customer's service.

reviews.author: Mark Middleton
reviews.text: You know that feeling when you finally find a car mechanic that treats you great,  charges you fairly and you have the confidence that it was done right?  Now you have that in a plumber!  Andy from Paragon.  My case is that I had a plumber come out (cause they put the pluming in my house when built) and detect what was wrong.  They had no idea and just guessed.  I just felt uncomfortable.   So i had heard about Paragon and called Andy.  They came out and detected a slab leak and proceeded to fix such leak and the gentleman that the team consist of were professional and caring to my situation.  You now have a plumber that you will feel confident recommending to your neighbours.

reviews.author: Gail Knowles
reviews.text: Steve and Corey just left our house to identify our water pressure issues. They were extremely nice gentlemen. Steve explained that our pressure regulator was failing and needed to be replaced. He even showed my the psi on his gauge. He had the part and they quickly installed it. Like night and day I'm telling you!! We have amazing pressure now and he charged a very reasonable amount. Highly recommend 👍

reviews.author: Andrew Mayer
reviews.text: Steve and Robert just left my house after installing a new water heater.  A quick and simple process for those who know what they're doing.  They were efficient and friendly, and the price was as quoted on the phone with their office beforehand.  Paragon will be my plumber from now on.

reviews.author: Tim Owings
reviews.text: Josh showed up on time and was extremely professional. He replaced 2 hose bibs, installed a 3rd hose bib and replaced our kitchen faucet. He was efficient and we are quite pleased with his work and Paragon Plumbing as a company. I would highly recommend  this company.

reviews.text: Paragon plumbing was on time, very professional, and courteous! Josh cleaned up his mess as he went and installed our utility sink quickly but efficiently! Recommend this company for your plumbing needs!

Great experience all the way around. The guys that came out were fantastic; professional, friendly and knowledgeable. reviews.author: Aadam Lamb
reviews.text: Clay Komos did an amazing job at diagnosing and repairing our circulator pump for our home water system. Once we received the parts needed for the repair, Clay was able to able to schedule the installation within two business days. He was knowledgeable and explained what the issues were with our old circulator pump. He was also very friendly with me and my kiddos! Would highly recommend Gold Star Plumbing!

reviews.author: Suzy Kitchukova
reviews.text: I cannot even begin to explain how much Clay went above and beyond. He was so professional and easy to work with. It truly is refreshing communicating with such a stand-up guy. He had all of our issues resolved quickly. I absolutely recommend Gold Star Plumbing!!!

reviews.author: M A.
reviews.text: We called them since they were a local company. We recieved a bill for service that was not fully completed. We feel cheated and taken advantage of. They said parts were replaced, but in fact, they were not. I would not recommend them. I called to let them know and was told a manager would reach out to me with no response yet. The invoice they gave me has multiple spelling errors and is very unprofessional.

reviews.author: G L.
reviews.text:
got a price quote , for a repair of a leak sewer line, think it was way over priced 
Vince insisted to use a crawler to remove a tree and dig a hole on where the work would be done...
but the price did not include the haul away of the tree..
and using a crawler could also damage the water spouts in which is very close by..
could not risk that..
plus they did hydroblast , prior  which broke the downstairs toilet , thank goodness they replaced that for free, since it was their mistake .. 
but unfortunately, I am a little concern for any further work...

reviews.author: Fred Kennedy
reviews.text:
After an experience with a local plumber who couldn’t resolve an emergency that stopped us from using water or sewer in our apartment complex, inconveniencing, both, us and our tenants…we went without water and sewer from seven o’clock that morning until the following day!!! We called Gold Star the evening of the first day and immediately spoke with Ann who understood our issues completely! She scheduled us for an assessment the following morning, with actual repairs scheduled for that afternoon. On the morning of the assessment, Clay, the technician, called me before eight o’clock an said he would see me shortly, he was expedient and reflected a high level of professionalism, warmth (especially on an extremely cold an wet day), and understanding!!! From the moment he introduced himself, explained the process, provided an estimate for the possible repair, and product knowledge, we were amazingly impressed! Upon his initial inspection, Clay, also, answered all of our questions intelligently, helping us understand a variety of issues we had been dealing with. At that point, we decided to do a more thorough investigation and repair, which he said he could start immediately!!! We were ecstatic!!! Upon approval of the new estimate, he began an extremely detailed assessment using a camera and an iPad to reflect the condition of our downline, the exact location of the blockage, and the condition of our sewer-line. We were impressed by Clay’s explanation of what needed to be done, both, short-term and long term! After the explanation, he began hydro-jetting our downline, our upline, and all seven roof vents on our property, including our waste-line on our kitchen sink!!! He cleared all invasive roots, cleaned and flushed all lines, removed all blockages and then videoed the mainline. He went on to show us how thorough his expertise and equipment had left our system in pristine condition!!! He then inspected the property, put away his tools, secured all of his equipment, cleaned up all work areas completely, and walked the area with us explaining the work that had been completed. He discussed future issues needing attention, and the level and quality of repair that could be done!!! Again, we were impressed and extremely comfortable with the absolute quality and outcome Clay exhibited throughout the day until the job was done!!!
We anyone could leap tall buildings, walk on water, and be faster than a speeding bullet, both, Clay and Gold Star would fit the description!!!
Thank you Clay and thank you Gold Star!!!
Humbly,
Fred & Joann

reviews.author: Sharon Lane
reviews.text:
We used Gold Star Plumbing four years ago when we moved from East Mesa to Gilbert and noticed a huge difference in the quality of water. Not only did it taste bad, but it was really hard and was making my hair completely unmanageable and within a month my hair was beginning to fall out.

Even though we were house poor from just moving 🤣 we researched different water filtration systems and companies and knew it was the right decision to use Gold Star.

They came out right away and installed the new system including RO, and the difference was immediate.  The team was very professional and wonderful to work with and they worked around our crazy small sink and devised a new system/setup that fits everything nicely.

We've had to use them several times since then for maintenance, not only for our water system but our plumbing as well.  They installed a new toilet and repaired another and even gave us a nice discount when they realized it was done incorrectly by somebody else.

Mike, the owner, is extremely accommodating and always responds quickly to my messages as well as fitting us in his schedule.

I really have zero complaints with this company and their products and services; in fact I have nothing but wonderful things to say and so  I would highly recommend them to anybody who truly needs work done quickly and done correctly.

Bottom line, you get what you pay for, and they are worth every penny.

reviews.author: Angie D in AZ
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service from Start to Finish!

This was my first time needing to call a plumber in many, many years, and I was pretty panicked after my pest control company found standing water in my crawl space. I contacted Gold Star, and they were able to come out the very next day (yesterday).

Michael and Andrew arrived and were absolutely incredible—thorough, polite, informative, and truly ROCK STARS. They walked me through everything, explained what they were seeing, and shared tips I know I’ll appreciate if anything ever comes up again.

They completed a full inspection, offered clear recommendations, and thankfully confirmed that the issue was minor and completely fixable. They genuinely put my mind at ease, and I slept peacefully last night because of them.

I’ve already told my family about Gold Star and will gladly recommend them to anyone who needs plumbing help. Their number is now saved in my phone, and they will be my first call if I ever need service again.

THANK YOU SO MUCH, Gold Star! 🌟

reviews.author: Eben Fetters
reviews.text:
Corbin DeLisle did an excellent and professional job of assessing our two leaky bathroom faucets and suggesting optional methods...repair vs replace. There was not much of a difference between the two so we chose replace.
Much to our pleasant surprise, he mentioned one option was for Gold Star to provide and install the faucets OR we could purchase the faucets and he could come back and install them and save money.  We decided to purchase them ourselves.  Again much to our pleasant surprise he pulled up the website for two local hardware stores and helped us find the make and model we wanted and verified that they were in stock.
I was able to get them and reschedule anothee visit with Corbin the next day for the installation, which was well done.

Outside of this, Corbin gave us great explanation of all the services Gold Star provides and told us about a comprehensive annual membership package that you provide.  We signed up for it.

reviews.author: Ciara Grey
reviews.text:
1/5/26  Vincent and Chad came out to fix the line blockage. They showed up excatly when they said they would. They were friendly and professional, got the job done, everything working perfectly. I cannot say enough good things about Gold Star Plumbing. When I get scheduled for service I stop worrying before they ever get here.

Clayton was professional, friendly and I was able to watch what he was doing. He explained everything. I am extremely impressed with Gold Star Plumbing and will recommend them to anyone!!! Work was done at a fair price as well. I am adding five more rating stars here ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  The job on the sewer line was done in one day and I was able to see the work being done. I was very pleased with the thorough care taken. Everyone who worked on my project, Todd, Clayton, Jose and I am so sorry I can't remember the technician's name who was with Jose was wonderful!

reviews.author: Tom Schrader
reviews.text: I called gold star out to locate the entrance to my leech field. The first tech they went out unfortunately did not locate the line correctly and i dug up an area only to find nithing. When I called them back to fix this issue and that's where the true work began. They sent clay out and he took all the time needed to properly locate the line and continue to diagnose my issue. Turns out the issue was not before the septic tank but after it. Clay worked very hard over 3 separate visits to locate everything and eventually solve my problem. Although we started off on the wrong foot, the effort and care clay exercised that day was truly amazing. He realized the job was not done properly to begin with and did everything In his power and then some to make sure my wife and I were taken care of. Thank you for taking the time to explain everything and for leaving no stone unturned.

reviews.author: Sylvia A
reviews.text:
Corbin and Andrew did a great job removing and replacing the water heater at the house.

Corbin explained the details for the new water heater and all of the items and work covered by the quote and provided explanations for the various valves before leaving.

They made sure that the work area was clean and when entering in and out of the house to assure no dirt was tracked in or around the work site.

Overall, Gold Star Plumbing was very professional and provided text and emails indicating when they would be arriving at the house.

Very satisfied with the work and company.  Would highly recommend them to anybody that requires professional plumbing to be performed.

reviews.author: Sharon Herzing
reviews.text: Was not happy with his company at all. I believe they Conned us , we had them to our house to clean a drain $299 They were there for a couple of hours and said That there drain cleaner just kept going through the clog .  they said that they would have to bring their water jet $2000. Well that was a disaster They made a huge hole in my garage.4 foot by 5 foot never repaired It ,flooded my Laundry room, and then wanted to charge me $2000 more to fix the pipe that they just cleaned. reviews.text: After many calls to obtain bids to replace our failing tankles water heater, we chose Gold Star.  Others gave us many options, but they came with a hefty price tag.  And it was not what we wanted.  Vincent was squared away and very professional.  He gave us an option that fit our budget.  He also provided another valuable source for water mitigation services.  After leaving, he reached out immediately to another source.  We had Rhino Water Damage arrive within 30 minutes.  We greatly appreciate the service that he provided.  GREAT SERVICE is rare now a days.  We liked the business networking that Gold Star has.  Great job.

reviews.author: Mark Yuravich
reviews.text: I scheduled an appointment for toilet repair with Gold Star Plumbing, and was told that the arrival time was between 8AM and 11 AM.  I received a text from the company dispatcher at about 8AM telling me that the technician was available and could arrive soon if I approved.  I agreed, and the technician arrived shortly.  The technician was Michael K. Michael came prepared with all necessary parts and quickly went to work.  Michael worked quickly and efficiently and was very friendly, and the job was completed in a short time.  The price was reasonable, and I am happy with the work done.

reviews.author: Shwetha Sharma
reviews.text: Justin and Parker were awesome. I had a pretty bad toilet clog which revealed itself over the course of 3 days of trying to unclog it, but Justin and Parker didn't give up. They tried every modality they could and eventually hydrojetted the clog out from the roof after hours of trying different methods. It was definitely costly at over $2,000, but they didn't give up. Parker is such a well-mannered young man, he even took his shoes off every time before going onto the carpet and left the bathroom clean before leaving. Thank you guys, so happy thats over!

reviews.author: Scott Nash
reviews.text: I called on a Sunday evening. The person I spoke with was extremely helpful and friendly. Justin arrived within an hour, diagnosed the problem, and fixed it right away. He was pleasant and professional. I'm so happy to have a new plumber I can trust.

reviews.author: Kathryn Santiago
reviews.text: We had a plumbing emergency on Christmas Day. I reached out to them around 4am, by 10am everything was resolved. I cannot recommend Emergency Master Plumbing & Air enough. They truly came in and saved the day. Our plumber was courteous, professional, knowledgeable, and gave us a fair price for their services. This is going to be my go-to Plumber from now on.

reviews.author: zack s
reviews.text:
I recently hired Emergency Master Plumbing to replace the shower pipes in our bathroom after an emergency break and I couldn’t be more pleased with the experience and how quickly the responded. From start to finish, they were punctual, professional, and incredibly respectful of our home. They quickly diagnosed the issue, clearly explained the work that needed to be done, and completed the job efficiently and with great attention to detail.

Not only was the workmanship top-notch, but they also made sure everything was cleaned up afterward—leaving the space better than they found it. It’s clear they take pride in what they do, and it shows.

If you’re looking for a reliable, knowledgeable, and courteous plumber, I highly recommend Emergency Master Plumbing. I’ll definitely be calling them again for any future plumbing services.

reviews.author: Nene J
reviews.text: I was referred here by second opinion plumbing who quoted $3,000 for new water softener and install w hookups existing - bc they only work in East valley. I spoke to owner Austin’s wife who was very prompt via phone and text w responses and quoted a very competitive rate (almost half of the above quote) for a new water softener install including a Clack valve with a great warranty. The unit was installed soon after I called and is a very good unit, assembled locally and with great warranty both from the plumbing company and from the manufacturer of the softener. I recommend this company to anyone who needs plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Andy A
reviews.text:
Austin was our repairman. He arrived when he said he would, and quickly got to work. Water heater release valve was dripping a little, and after suggesting that the water heater was getting old, drained the tank and replaced the valve. Also had him replace connector for one of our toilets. And for good measure, checked out a leak on the kitchen faucet.
And he passed the sniff test from our dog. We were very satisfied with his service.

And gave us a quote on a replacement water heater when we were ready. Will definitely recommend

reviews.author: Clifford Reph
reviews.text:
Justin was great by keeping me up to date on his arrival time.
We negotiated a deal to replace the washer hook up valves, but to find that price only included "one" valve. I asked Justin to check the hot water valve to be sure that it isn't leaking also. I was told that the valve was good to only find that it also leaks after taking the hose off. Now, I need to call another plumber to fix the other valve. The only reason that I gave 3 stars is that they negotiated a price that I could afford and Justin was so nice.

reviews.author: John Krebs
reviews.text: We had a very good experience with our technician Justin. He diagnosed the problem and repaired our toilet in about 20 minutes. We asked if he would take a look at  our bathroom sink and he found that a piece of the faucet was broken. He went to Home Depot and found the part and installed it with no extra charge! This was a 5 star experience and when we have plumbing issue we will call emergency Plumbing. Reasonable pricing. Highly recommend then to anyone who needs a plumber.

reviews.author: Terry Clark
reviews.text: Gave me a honest and reasonable quote and was at the house when they said and it was on the same day.  Polite and efficient and I got the best service from the owner which was a plus.   Also informed me about mold possibilities because it was a overflow of water from the water heater.   Was very appreciative of that, even though  it will cost me some additional money.  Thanks Austin for the great service.  Further plumbing needs will be directed to you and your company..

reviews.author: Brandon Seniff
reviews.text: Austin, the owner of Emergency Master Plumbing & Air, was extremely responsive and provided outstanding customer service. He went above and beyond by meeting us after hours to resolve our emergency plumbing issue, which allowed my family and kitchen to return to normal quickly and relieved a great deal of stress. I would 100% recommend Emergency Master Plumbing & Air to anyone in need of reliable, high-quality service.

reviews.author: Susan Sheuerman
reviews.text: Austin came to our home via a contractor. I had a faulty leak that had nothing to do with contractor job. He went out of his way to locate an unusual valve, quickly sent estimate, and came within a few days, at time arranged, to replace valve. Also fixed a small leak. Both the work he did for contractor job here and for us personally seems to be excellent. He is personable and easy to work with.

reviews.author: Andrew De Angelo
reviews.text: We had a problem with our toilet, the overflow tube broke.  The toilet was running all day and night, wasting a lot of water.  We called emergency Pluming and they came to our home right away.  Our plumber Austin repaired our toilet right away.  He replaced all the inside guts with all new parts, leaving us a brand new toilet.  Emergency Plumbing was fast, professional and guaranteed their work.

reviews.author: Jeff Neal
reviews.text: I love this company. I called them on a Friday and they're out Saturday morning. I had a shower that would not turn off all the way and they immediately fixed it. Apparently they carry enough parts to take care of almost everything and they cleaned up their mess. Everything works perfect. I am thrilled with their quick response and their price. Thanks, emergency Master plumbers

reviews.author: Pamela Greene
reviews.text: Once again you saved me! I thought I had really messed up when I change the cartridge of my sink faucet and Austin came out and was able to make the adjustments that were needed literally lasted maybe 5 minutes and had everything completed. Thank you for coming to my rescue and my time of need. I wasn't feeling well because I had knee surgery 3 weeks ago and I was struggling!

reviews.author: Heather Bruce
reviews.text:
Technician came within time window and said he would need to come back next day due to pilot not staying lit. We asked him to at least clean the pilot probe as we were desperate for hot water with a house full of teens.

Justin did what he could and was able to get the system back up and running within 20 min and followed up with us the next morning.

synthesis.summary: Emergency Master Plumbing & Air delivers on its name — they answered at 4am on Christmas and resolved a plumbing emergency by 10am, answered at 6am and finished by 11am on another call, and responded within 2 hours on weekend evenings at Thanksgiving pricing with no surcharge gouging. Owner Austin is directly accessible and personally handles many calls. Only 2 low-star reviews in 32 sampled, one citing a scope misunderstanding on which valve was included.
