plumbers.name: Fiscor Plumbing and Air
plumbers.address: 6719 E 2nd St, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Ryan Lynn
reviews.text: Robert and Diondre did an amazing job on the install! Discord is a professional company through and through. Preston who did the inspection caught that we had CO gases being leaked. If it wasn’t for the financing the company offered, I may not have been able to replace it. When the unit was pulled out the heat exchange was burnt through. The wall was burned too. We are very blessed to have Preston catch that it needed to be replaced. Robert and Diondre had extra issues with getting out the old unit. They had great attitudes and were super respectful and thorough. My wife and child were at home during install and I felt safe knowing that all employees are background checked and professional. Robert and Diondre were super fun to have around. The company also makes sure to double check all their workers via video and pictures. They also do a follow up inspection. Would highly recommend them. You never know what you are getting with an ad in the mail, but it paid off. No complaints and really thankful to fiscor for making my house safe again.

reviews.author: Leisa Boyd
reviews.text: Robert and Alan came out to do some minor repairs and verify work that had previously been done by other techs. They were on time, very friendly, and completely through. They walked me though everything and took the time to inspect each vent and close off some vents that were not being used to maximize airflow in our most used rooms. It was a great experience and I highly recommend Fiscor for their amazing techs.

reviews.author: Ken Brown
reviews.text: Jason, Diondre, Logan and Ryan did an outstanding job installing new “lungs” or ducting for my intake and exhaust system on my HVAC system. They were very professional, knowledgable and explained things very well. My system is working great and I’m happy with the service.

reviews.author: Michael H.
reviews.text: Have them come over on a promotional $45 to clean my system. He left saying that we had to spend $45,000 on a whole new heating system. What a complete joke I will never use them or recommend them to anybody. Other people told me to be weary of this company as they experience the same thing.

reviews.author: James S.
reviews.text: I have a $19.95/mo. service contract for my AC unit, and on the last inspection I was told my compressor was drawing too much power (134 amps) and that I needed a compressor saver/booster installed. The total charge was $834 but the cost of the exact same part online was $42 and it only involves connecting 3 wires to the current system (about 15 minutes). I requested a receipt and received a NON-itemized invoice with no breakdown on parts and labor. Consensus from others online is that I was ripped off!!! Fiscor plumbing and air,  Camp Verde AZ. location.

reviews.author: Sue D.
reviews.text: Fiscor did my spring hvac service. It was a 5 star service. for my scheduled fall service, they sent a senior tech with a second young man.  inspection of my system (home 7 hrs old) resulted in $17,000 work estimate to replace duct system and install air scrubber. (!!!). Stated bad design and cut corners when built resulting in wide variation of temperatures across 2300 sq ft home. That was not something I had even been aware of. My issue is very dirty/dusty air quality with raging allergies here. Actually I believed his assssment. everything made sense and despite the high cost I signed for the work. He told me I could call with questions which I did the next day and the day after that but no call returned until late the second day after I called with a message that I was cancelling. the morning of that same day I got a text that  tech was on his way And to call with questions. I called To ask why and was told they were on their way to start the project. I said no we scheduled it for 3 weeks out. I was told the scheduler was told to put it on the schedule right way. I said no. an hour later I get another text that a tech was at my home. I called again and said that I didnt see anyone and was told that it was probably an error.  What bothered me most was that neither of these techs were a part of the assessment Nd project plan of a $17000 project. I completely Lost my confidence in these guys and decided to pursue a second opinion. in looking at area hvac companies, they look the same on line. Report 4+ ratings, lots of reviews with great things to say and a fair amount of 1-2 ratings with do not use recommendations.  Seems like they all upsell (I get it but how do you know what you really need). You read about bad work and missed issues. It seems the luck of the draw on any given day with any of them. I'm really struggling with my choice of hvac professionals. .

reviews.author: Vicki M.
reviews.text: We received a mail piece offering a $49 tune-up/cleaning for our 11-year-old furnace. Depending on how the service job was performed, we might have considered Fiscor for our HVAC and plumbing needs. The friendly, professional Tech showed up as promised, properly identified.  He looked at our furnace and said, "Wow!" We asked what that was about, and he told us he'd never seen a furnace installed like ours, with venting in "unusual" places. Then he checked for carbon monoxide and said his reading at 7 ppm was concerning. I looked that up online, and it is in the "safe" range. However, he behaved as if we were at high risk. He asked if a "videographer" could stop by to film his service. We said OK, and soon another tech arrived. He reviewed the "many options" we had to correct our "problems", but as it turned out, there were only two: rebuild our current system or purchase a new furnace. Other than the CO reading, he found nothing else wrong. Our furnace works fine, and we saw no need to pay for anything else. He tried to set up an appointment with his manager to discuss a new furnace in the next few days, but we declined. Although he did a good job cleaning the furnace, we are disappointed that it turned into a pressure job to sell a new furnace we don't need.  However, we asked that he email a quote.  It's been almost a week, and still no quote. BTW - we bought our own CO reader. So far, the readings have been zero. No alarm, no alert.  Too bad. Not a great way to build your business.

reviews.author: Lauren Thagard
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Fiscor and their HVAC installation team! From start to finish, the team was respectful, knowledgeable, and true professionals. They took great pride in the quality of their work, paid attention to every detail, and made sure everything was done right. Additionally, they had to repair several problems our previous HVAC installers left behind and is also likely why our last system had to be replaced well before its lifespan. They thoroughly explained how our new system works and answered all of our questions, which we really appreciated. They also cleaned up completely after the installation, leaving our home just as they found it. We couldn’t be happier with the service and highly recommend Fiscor to anyone looking for a reliable and professional HVAC company! Huge thank you to Robert and Diondre who spent a 12-hour day working at our house on the full unit install, the duct repair in our attic, and adding an additional return vent, all to ensure our new unit’s efficiency. Jason was also great, showing up early and checking in regularly. Overall, just a wonderful team that did an exceptional job, under less than ideal circumstances (previous work flaws). Thank you all for the great work!!!

reviews.author: frank fleming
reviews.text: I’ve had multiple companies out to fix my sewer line that keeps backing up. Every time someone comes out they just snake the drain and call it good and I’m backed up again in a few weeks. So I gave Fiscor a call expecting the same thing to happen. $500 snake knowing I’ll have to do it again in a few weeks. However mikey from Fiscor plumbing and air noticed that my backflow may be causing problems. He recommended options to fix it that could either take care of short term or long term type fixes which is all I’ve been looking for this whole time. I ended up having them do a long term fix with replacing the damaged piping. Upon Fiscor and Mikey showing up to complete the job they worked hard and effectively to get the job done right and right the first time which is VERY RARE to find anymore. Give Fiscor a call and you wont be disappointed.

reviews.author: Miranda Fisher
reviews.text:
I’ve been battling my home warranty company for months trying to resolve issues with my HVAC, and finally decided it was time to get a second opinion. I’m so glad I did. Fiscor was able to get me scheduled first thing Monday morning, which was already a huge relief.

Donavan was incredibly helpful walking me through the process of getting a new unit and took the time to explain everything clearly, including the financing options available to me. The technicians, Ryan and Tyler, were absolutely amazing. They were respectful, professional, and extremely helpful from start to finish. They made sure everything was taken care of and answered all my questions along the way.

I truly cannot say enough great things about the entire team. After months of frustration, they made the whole experience smooth and reassuring. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Vinnie Angellotti
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Fiscor Plumbing and Air and I can’t recommend them enough. Our AC went out at the worst possible time, and Sebastian and Logan truly went above and beyond to take care of us.

They stayed late to make sure everything was fully installed, working properly, and cleaned up before they left—which we really appreciated. It would have been easy to come back another day, but they made sure we were taken care of that same night.

On top of that, they were both incredibly professional, friendly, and easy to work with. They took the time to answer our questions and made the whole process feel a lot less stressful.

If you’re looking for a team that genuinely cares about doing the job right and treating customers well, ask for Sebastian and Logan. Great work all around!

reviews.author: Susan W.
reviews.text:
Since they solved a major issue earlier this year, when we had a stoppage I called them first. 
I told the office person that we had attempted a snake and probably needed a longer one. So the person that came out had the exact same snake that we had tried and nothing else. Waste of time on both parties. 
Then they send out someone else the next morning with NO snake at all!  I really feel like they just wanted to use the most expensive equipment that they had on them since we maybe seemed desperate. 
Obviously I sent them away with no solution. Another waste of everyone's time. 
Fortunately I was able to get another company out who had a longer snake and took care of the problem. 
This new company is now my go to plumber and I won't call Fiscors ever again.

reviews.author: Patti Porco
reviews.text: We called Fiscor to have a look at our unit since we just moved in and wanted to make sure everything was working properly since the unit was 10 years old. Sergio came to service the unit and advised we had a few minor issues. Not wanting to deal with losing A/C in the middle of the summer, we decided to get a new unit. The financing was a huge plus. Robert and Diondre arrived the next morning and did our installation work. They were great! Unfortunately, the warehouse sent the wrong parts so the job took longer than any of us anticipated but they were troopers. They stayed until the job was completed. Excellent experience and would definitely recommend Fiscor Plumbing and Air.

reviews.author: Shing Aruguete
reviews.text: Robert Light and Diondre Rivera from Fiscor Plumbing and Air were very courteous and professional. We had some bedrooms that weren’t getting enough warm air from our furnace, which is mounted in our attic. Whoever originally installed the ductwork in our home did not do it correctly. Robert and Deondre removed all of the old ductwork, showing us some of the problems with our HVAC system. They were able to replace all of the ductwork without lots of bends or Y splits. Now our furnace operates very quietly and very efficiently. And every room in the house receives an equal amount of warm air. We can’t thank them enough for their very professional installation at our home.

reviews.author: Denise Rose
reviews.text: Robert and Diondrea were my installers on my new Bosch furnace and air conditioning unit! These guys are animals, they were very determined to make sure I had heat before they left, staying until 11:45 p.m., then returning at 7 a.m. the next day to complete the install. Jason, the Field Coordinator stopped in just to make sure I was satisfied. Since my old furnace had completely shut down, Tiffany and Wendy made sure I was on the top.of their schedule, that was phenomenal. I cannot say enough good things about the customer service provided by all Fiscor employees!!! Including Carlis, who was the first tech that helped me with a different concern. Thank you to all!!!

synthesis.summary: Fiscor Plumbing & Air in Prescott Valley is a full-service HVAC and plumbing company with skilled installers who genuinely go the extra mile — staying until midnight to restore heat, returning at 7am to finish. The problem is pricing: $769 to snake a drain for 10 minutes without prior consent is the most recent complaint, and Yelp documents multiple instances of non-itemized invoices, pressure to buy new systems, and quotes '$2,000 for a job that should have been $600.' The Google (4.9) vs Yelp (2.8) divergence of 2.1 stars is a significant red flag.

reviews.author: Corie Mcgraw
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of having an amazing technician named Christian Williams come and help out with my water heater. He was quick and professional the whole time he was here. He even helped me with my kitchen faucet, it was spewing water out of the sides. He went above and beyond with this service! Thank you guys also for getting us in on short notice!!!

reviews.author: Anne Marie Szabo
reviews.text: Branden was professional, efficient and kind. I am thrilled with his decision to complete the work all at once. It’s now working beautifully! Thank you!

reviews.author: Wendy Stokes
reviews.text: Persistent, Professional,  fair and helpful. I’m grateful to have plumbers I can rely on regardless of the issue. Franklin Plumbing has been very good to us over the years.

reviews.author: Isac Santos
reviews.text: This is like the 4th time they have came out to see why the sewage is clogging and over filling each time they find nothing wrong snake it and the issue comes back after a couple weeks to a month later. I'm tired of having to make sure my bathroom works each day or coming home to it poring out on the front of my house

reviews.author: Susan G.
reviews.text: I would give a 0 star if that were allowed. I had a sewer pipe clog at my down town business. Franklin came out to scope with a camera that did not work, kept giving me excuses that the pipe was too clogged. We had no toilets for over a week as the same Incompetent idiot came out after hours everyday, unable to 'see' the clog. After almost $700 and no resolve I finally called a decent plumber who had it fixed in less than an hour. Turned out the idiot was going the WRONG direction in the pipe! They still charged me and then after the fact sent me another bill! Never again. Do not trust them Prescott!

reviews.author: Scott A.
reviews.text:
We love the community in Prescott. The folks are genuine and helpful... so my wife and I bought an investment property in town. We requested gas service to be turned on. The technician arrived, inspected the house and declared the meter was too small for the number of appliances in the house....After changing the meter, he declared we had a leak between the meter and the house and issued a Red Tag....(funny the previous owner didn't have a leak...)  

I called Franklin and requested an estimate. 

Now you need to know I have been a California licensed general contractor and certified building designer for over 45 years. Our focus has mostly been on home renovations and remodels. Replacing, modifying and adding gas lines and conducting in house labor services for plumbing is one of our services. 

The gents (why they need 3 men there is beyond me) from Franklin showed up and took a look. They offered a replacement plan that made sense. But then they quoted me $6000 to $6500 to install a new line that was less than 80 ft long (only 60 ft underground). 

I expressed my opinion and was told " the ground may be difficult to dig through due to granite formations". Then I was offered a T&M prospect (time and materials) with the best scenario coming in at $3,000. This seemed reasonable as I was comparing what we charge in CALIFORNIA and agreed. BTW this would have been the same or less in California..... 

Now I have to accept some of the blame here, because my time in town was limited, I made a decision without comparing quotes...

They were quick to get it done and my property manager went by and took pictures. Unfortunately, she did not capture how many workmen were on the job. They were completed in less than 2 days. (According to their bill it took 14 hours). 

Upon receipt of the invoices, I was pained that it came to an ASTOUNDING $4,899.53!!

I took to email and sent the following;

"Good afternoon Brian,
We are in receipt of your invoice #8486 dated 6/29/2021
When meeting with your personnel on site I was give an approximate estimate of $6k.
As a trade professional with 45 plus years of experience, installing gas lines being a part of our work, I questioned the bill.
It was explained that the ground could be difficult to excavate due to boulders and rocks. I understand these conditions can complicate production. However, this lot is flat, open and free of any rock formations. I understand what is below the surface is unknown.
Further conversation with your crew determined that this work could be performed on a time and materials basis, your hourly rate was established and a somewhat optimistic quote of $3k was given based upon T&M.
I accepted this as reasonable based upon my own experience.
Our property manager did take photos each day and it is noted that the time frame of 14 hours appears to be accurate including the rain interference with production.
Having received the bill, the majority of which is acceptable, I must object to the necessity for a third man for 14 additional hours.
I would ask that the invoice be revised and reduced by the additional 14 hours for a third man.
The total amount would be $3,849.53.
Please advise if you will accept this adjustment".    

THREE MEN?!? Why on earth would you need three men? There isn't enough work to keep two me busy full time much less THREE MEN. 

Their reply:

Hello Scott, this is Brian we spoke at your place here in Prescott. Originally, I gave you a verbal price of $6000.00. We spoke further and agreed on doing the job on a time and material basis. I felt and you agreed with me that the likelihood of saving you money was good. We agreed on doing the job in this manner. With that I sent our crew that specializes in digging and installing outside utilities. That crew is a three-man crew and has been for many years. They always do a great job and typically get jobs done ahead of schedule. This again was the case at your place. We pulled a permit, dug the gas line, installed the gas line, got the gas line inspected, and then we backfilled the gas line. All of this was done in 14 hours. I have been plumbing for many, many years, and in my professional opinion that is a superb job. My ballpark estimate told you somewhere between $3000 and $6000 and we did just that. In my honest opinion we were able to do the job that quickly because we had a three-man crew there. I have gone over the bill personally and checked against the GPS on the vehicle and see no discrepancies in the hours we charged. I did notice we did not bill you the cost of the permit, and the cost for the shade material we brought in to shade the gas pipe. That alone is $250.00. Hopefully, I have answered any questions you may have had and we can get this bill paid.

Paid the bill. Posted this review....

You now have all the facts...it's up to you whether or not you want to hire them...

reviews.author: Julie O'Kon
reviews.text:
I have used Franklin Plumbing Services three times in the last three years.  This company is fantastic. All three times, they have been professional, thorough, friendly, helpful, and they came as fast as they could, within an hour or two of my call.  They assured me all three times that my problem would be solved THAT day and, since two of the issues concerned a clogged pipe that impeded the toilet, this was tremendous reassurance and dedication to satisfaction.  They totally honor time and are prompt and courteous.  This last time, which was 1/12/21, they were EXTREMELY dedicated to COVID-19 safety.  They were masked the entire time, and wore booties inside my home, they kept distance, and were in and out as fast as possible.  The office staff is open, concerned, friendly, and eager to assist.  I cannot recommend Franklin Plumbing enough.

Since, I have used Franklin for the same issue in summer 2024, with the same exemplary service, professionalism, and wonderful technicians. It’s always the roots/toilet debacle.

Today, 1/4/26, ZACH from Franklin came out to fix my plumbing issue. The same one, where the roots grow large and obstruct flushing the toilet and cause the tub to not drain and the sink to gurgle. ZACH was wonderful. Thorough, friendly, professional, and answered all of my questions and addressed all of my concerns.

Don’t even call anyone else. Call Franklin. They’re the best ever, and you will be so happy and relieved to be in such knowledgeable and professional hands with people who are dedicated to giving the ultimate in service.

reviews.author: Jeff T.
reviews.text: So for the second time since I have owned my home the plumbing completely backed up. Of course this couldn't happen at 7am on a Monday it happens at 5pm on a Saturday. I called several plumbers in Prescott who said they were 24/7 operations but they didn't have anyone working THIS weekend. I got ahold of Dave at Franklin and let him know what the issue was and that it had happened a few years ago as well. I let him know that he would need two reels of snake as the last time it was about 130 feet to the blockage. He thanked me for that info and said that he needed to stop at the shop and get an extra snake and he would be out to my house. I called him at 7pm and he arrived at 8pm. He also quoted me that it would be 1.5 hours for the initial charge. This was going to be $207 for that period and they would charge at quarter hour increments after the initial 1.5 hours @ the hourly weekend rate of $138 per hour. All was said and done around 9pm and the charge was a fair price of $207. Thank you Franklin plumbing!!!. I will be recommending you to anyone that asks for a plumber referral. By the way the last time it happened the charge on a Sunday afternoon was over $300 and that was 3 or 4 years ago and he did the same thing in the same length of time. Won't be calling that plumber again.

reviews.author: Christi W.
reviews.text: I would not recommend this company to anyone! I called for a leak in the pressure switch to a pressure tank. I was very specific about what was happening on at least three conversations, two with the office staff and one with the service technician.  They came for the call, were here less than five minutes and told me that they could not work on it because it was a well and they did not work on wells, I needed to call a well and pump company.  They charged my $75. I called back the next day after I thought about it to discuss a refund because I should have been told on the phone that they did not work on wells since pressure tanks are unique to wells. I was told that they gave me a deal since they normally charge $150 for a call. I told them it was not a deal since the call should not have happened in the first place.  That is a pretty quick way to make some money!  Where is the integrity these days!

reviews.author: Julie O.
reviews.text: Saved by Franklin Plumbing AGAIN!  This was my third call to Franklin Plumbing in the last three years.  I am so impressed with this business, and I highly recommend it.  They are professional, so helpful, prompt, and honor the customer's time.  My plumbers on this visit were Scott and Anthony, and they were able to solve the issue (3 feet of roots in the pipe under the toilet) by methodically working through every available remedy.  Franklin plumbers are always friendly, courteous, and thorough, and were eager to answer my many questions.  And they were extremely COVID safe and conscientious, wearing masks the entire time and, when they had to enter the home, wearing booties over their shoes that they changed every time they left and then re-entered.  I am so grateful, and I HIGHLY recommend Franklin Plumbing.

reviews.author: Chuck E.
reviews.text: I have a NUVO water filtration system throughout my house that was installed by another local plumbing company. I noticed I had hardened calcium deposits on my shower head and faucet aerators. I have had Franklin Plumbing before and have been very happy with them. I called and spoke with Mike, the owner, and he is very familiar with this filtration system. I asked to have someone come out and see if the system was installed correctly. I was set for an appointment the very next day. I received a call from Kade Connally that he was on the way. He is very polite and professional. He tested the hardness of my water at two different locations and confirmed the system was installed correctly. I will call NUVO on Monday to discuss the problem with them. Thanks again Franklin Plumbing Services!

reviews.author: George K.
reviews.text:
Found angled stop on my toilet with gently weeping leak. Don't know when started, but Franklin had changed out all my turn stops to quarter-turn ball stops when I moved into this house (three years ago).
Repair consisted of teflon plumber's tape and reconnecting.
But charged for new angled stop and new supply line to toilet plus huge hourly rate. With nothing to lose, asked for some break in charge since Franklin installed this angled stop. Told no warranty on angled stops.
Also, had made appointment for AM; 8:00 that morning was called to reschedule to PM. Ten minutes later plumber calls -- be there in 10-15 minutes. Then called back again -- had incorrect address.
Last time I use Franklin. They've really gone downhill since Mr. Franklin retired and Mike took over.

reviews.author: Shawna S
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience with Franklin Plumbing. From the start, the service was top-notch—they showed up right on time, and we really appreciated the notification that the technician was on the way, along with the ability to track his arrival in real time.
The technician, Christian, was extremely polite and professional. He quickly identified the problem, fixed the pipe efficiently, and made sure everything was working perfectly before wrapping up. What really stood out was the attention to detail—he even vacuumed the rug before leaving!
The entire job was completed quickly and at a very reasonable price. We couldn’t be happier and would highly recommend Franklin Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable, high-quality work.

reviews.author: Andrea P.
reviews.text:
Good value, responsive, and reliable is exactly how I describe this company. Very satisfied with Franklin Plumbing Services. I love how well they communicated with accurate price quote, confirmation texts, and a bio + photo of the technician before he arrived. Dominic L. replaced the box components and further indentified a clog outside the building. Dominic was fast and easy to work with. It was pouring rain outside and he never complained. He's a professional. 
Such a contrast from the other local plumbing company who gave us a price quote and inspected the toilet. They were literally twice the cost without the excellent communication.
Thank you Franklin Plumbing for fixing our office toilet!

reviews.author: Jesse G.
reviews.text:
I recently had Franklin come to my home and work on my kitchen sink. I was happy with the service. I would have at this point recommended to anyone. I asked Franklin to help me with a couple other plumbing issues in my home. I welcomed the Franklin Staff person in and showed him the problem areas
 The Franklin Employee said he was going to get some tools.  Twenty minutes later I received a phone call from the Franklin "Dispatcher" informed me they had pulled the worker from my service request. The working conditions were totally unsatisfactory. Why did the service person NOT tell me there was a problem.

synthesis.summary: Franklin Plumbing is a 35-year-old Prescott business with a loyal following among locals and property managers who value reliability and responsiveness. But the Yelp record contains repeated, specific complaints about billing practices: they charge drive time from Prescott, which surprises customers in Prescott Valley; a 3-man crew showed up for a gas line job and billed accordingly; and estimates have been described as arriving significantly higher than quoted. Tech quality varies — some techs (Ian, Hunter, Zach) praised, others criticized for sloppy work and rude behavior.
strengths: Stepped in same-day when another plumber was a no-show
35 years in business, BBB A+ accredited with zero complaints
Loyal property management clients praise consistent responsiveness
weaknesses: Drive time from Prescott billed at $165/hr — customers in Prescott Valley pay significantly more
4-time repeat sewer clog at same location — recurring issue never permanently resolved
One tech ignored a customer's request to remove boots, tracked in wet footprints repeatedly
redFlags: Gas line job quoted at $3,000 T&M, final bill came to $4,900 — customer disputed third crew member cost, was refused adjustment
Tankless water heater estimate of nearly $7,000 (equipment listed online under $2,000) — customer found estimate 'outrageous'
Worker pulled from job without explanation after arrival — office cited 'unsatisfactory working conditions' without informing homeowner
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Same-day or next-day availability confirmed by multiple reviewers. One reviewer reached out when another plumber no-showed and Franklin arrived the same day. No explicit 24/7 documentation.

water-heater.topQuote: I had the pleasure of having an amazing technician named Christian Williams come and help out with my water heater. He was quick and professional the whole time.

water-softener.topQuote: Thanks Zach for upgrading our water softener! Franklin Plumbing Services and their techs are very reliable for all your plumbing needs!

sewer.topQuote: This is like the 4th time they have came out to see why the sewage is clogging and each time they find nothing wrong, snake it and the issue comes back after a couple weeks.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: I would give a 0 star if allowed. Camera did not work — kept giving excuses the pipe was too clogged. After almost $700 and no resolve I called a decent plumber who fixed it in under an hour.

gas-leak.topQuote: They quoted $6,000 to $6,500 for a gas line install less than 80ft long. Agreed on T&M, final invoice: $4,899.53 with a three-man crew.

You need clear communication and upfront explanations

plumbers.name: City Plumbing and Rooter Az LlC
plumbers.address: 4750 N Stewart Rd, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Davis Guyatt
reviews.text: These guys are the best choice out here, very quick in responding to my issue, job was done same day. I won't be calling anyone else. I had a septic tank backing up and was quoted for completely wrong jobs by other folks. I hope everyone is doing their research and homework before accepting the first quote.

reviews.author: Corrine Brookshire
reviews.text: After calling like 20 different plumbers & getting expensive estimates. I called Paul with City Plumbing. Same day service, fast & professional with a sense of humor!! Very, very affordable pricing! We highly Recommend & we will call City Plumbing for future Plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jon Martin
reviews.text:
We had a water pipe leak at our cabin in the highland pines of Prescott.  Manny and his crew responded quickly, arrived on time and we're extremely professional throughout the entire process.  They recommended an upgrade and re-pipe that was completed on time and on budget.
The entire project was done in just 2 days. They left the work area cleaner than when they arrived.
I would highly recommend City plumbing and will be using them in the future.

reviews.author: Andrew Lockwood
reviews.text: Worst plumbing experience EVER!!! After not showing up to the first appointment with no call or explanation, they showed up to second appointment several hours late. They sent kids that were unsupervised and did not speak English. Had the water turned off till 8pm at night. Replaced my high end shower valve and faucet with cheap fake plastic bottom of the line junk. All the pipes were loose in the walls. No caulking. Cross threaded screws. Everything is crooked. They left a 4 inch DRYWALL screw literally up against the pex hot water pipe. Removed 2x4s and drywall...all this and then left without explanation. Probably due to the language barrier?? Several weeks later I finally got ahold of the journey man who originally looked at the job and talked him into just replacing the junk valve/faucet that I had to purchase....and he completely flaked on me AGAIN!!! No call. No explanation.  I'm DONE with City Plumbing. They are not allowed at my house ever! So disappointed in their AWFUL and unprofessional service. What joke...

reviews.author: Ryan M.
reviews.text: Plumber came out to the house an unclog the toilet. I guess he didn't get it all cleared. Renters called later that day an said toilet it clogged again. I called the plumber an they said they warned the renters to be careful cuz it is old. The plumber said if I go out it will be another charge.   I guess the don't stand behind their work.   Would never use them again

reviews.author: Buster Layne
reviews.text:
What started as a call to clear out a slow draining main line began the discovery of very badly designed and assembled drain piping in my home. The previous owners literally duct taped drain pipes together and buried them! I ended up with all brand new drain lines from under my house all the way to the septic. Paul and his crew kept me informed, were polite, provided options, and were not pushy. The new plumbing looks so clean and tidy and is smartly designed. They spent four days at my place making sure the job was done right. I couldn't be happier with my new plumbing and am pleased to have called City Plumbing and Rooter. Job very well done, gentlemen. Worth every penny.
Special shout out to Isaac for his professionalism and consideration when he needed to be let into my home to flip a breaker while I was gone.

reviews.author: C T.
reviews.text: I called Briggs Plumbing & Rooter to replace a leaking Water Supply Valve for the hot water under my kitchen sink on a Friday at 10:03 AM and left a detailed message. They returned my call in less than a half hour indicating they had an opening between 2:00 & 4:00PM.  Briggs arrived at 12:05.  He replaced all four of the water valves under my kitchen sink. Hot & Cold water, Dishwasher, and Refrigerator Ice maker. The work was completed in less than an hour. It could have been quicker if my three dogs were not helping him. Dolly our three month old Miniature Dachshund was particularly 'helpful'.  His work ethic and professionalism is first rate.  I highly recommend Briggs Plumbing and Rooter. Oh, did I mention his bill was under $175 for parts and labor? Yes it was

reviews.author: Arthur W.
reviews.text: I have used Briggs Plumbing a few times in the past and always had great service. This last time was no exception. Recently we had a severe leak in our shower and Briggs Plumbing came out to fix it. He took it all apart and tried to fix the problem. He determined that the flow regulator was defective. He knew that I had just replaced that regulator myself so he told my wife that if I just got a new one and changed them out it would be fixed. He said he didn't want to charge us for something we could easily fix on our own. He left without charging us a cent. That is the way business should be done.  Honest, ethical and caring.  Thank you Briggs Plumbing.

reviews.author: tanya gaddin
reviews.text: Both our toilets were non functioning! After calling Goettls Plumbing on a Monday night, setting an appointment with them for Tuesday afternoon, in which case nobody showed up, or called! I called them to find out what happened only to learn that they switched my appointment for the following day, without calling me! ( 2 full days without toilets?) We decided to call City Plumbing and Rooters! They had someone out within a half hour, and the toilets functioning within an hour and a half! I will definitely be using City Plumbing for future projects, and strongly recommend them! The technicians were very polite, efficient and very informative!

reviews.author: Jan K
reviews.text:
Originally thought the work done was done in a way that looks professional, with quality materials and seams. Previously noted that they had inadvertently forgot to turn the valve back.

One brass part subsequently leaked (witnessed by several).  While looking at how to address the issue, two others suggested I ask City Plumbing about additional work to safeguard against the harsh winters in my area.  But the owner got so defensive about it, he wouldn't even talk to me.  Just kept texting (like over a half hours worth) trying to ascertain the issue - all while I was in meetings with others.  So, I now have to give the work to someone else.

reviews.author: Jim D
reviews.text:
City Plumbing and Rooter came to my home today for a slow draining kitchen sink. While I knew this was a small project, our technician made sure everything was cleaned out and running properly throughout our home, even checking our main sewer line for proper waste water disposal.
I did ask for an opinion on a slow filling toilet which he was happy to look at and he made an adjustment to the fill valve to solve this problem.
I would not hesitate to use City Plumbing and Rooter in the future, and will pass on their information to any other friend or neighbor needing any plumbing issues repaired.

reviews.author: Del B.
reviews.text: Showed up 20 minutes late...  no problem.  He came out and told me that the (city required) waste water backup valves on the market all have problems creating a backup into the home.  He loosened a thumb screw pulled it out charging an additional $11 for a total of $98.50 for a 30 second job.  While he did snake the line (finding nothing).  I would prefer a business that would suggest pulling the valve first to see if the backup goes away before coming out and charging you $100 for snaking the lines when it was not needed.  Lessoned learned.

reviews.author: Don Stiles
reviews.text: Andy was on a call next door to us when we were suddenly confronted with an emergency plumbing problem, and as he was getting into his truck to leave, I rushed over to find out if he could come over and take a look at our problem.  He didn't even hesitate.  Once he saw what the problem was, he had it fixed in no time!  I am so happy and grateful for the great customer service he provided and plan to call this company again for some other repairs we are going to be doing in the future.  Great job, Andy and thank you so much!

reviews.author: William S.
reviews.text:
S&C Plumbing is the place to go for your plumbing needs in northern Arizona.
Shad and Carden Wood are knowledgable professionals who provide outstanding customer service support.  The quality and value for their services are matched by none.  Without a doubt they deserve a five star (plus) rating on all counts.  We  had a few jobs that needed to be done and they were responsive, knowledgable, and professional in performing what needed to be accomplished.  They are the BEST!!!!!  I give them a five star rating ~

reviews.author: Louis Lizza
reviews.text: My water softener pipe starting leaking a few days ago and I could not find a plumber in the valley available to come check it out. Unfortunately I wasn’t able to turn off any valve to it so the only way to stop the leak was to turn off water to the house. I called City Plumbing and Rooter and Andy and Zach came down same day and worked until I had a fully functional water softener again. They were efficient and affordable and the fact they came ASAP is why I will be using them for my property going forward.

synthesis.summary: City Plumbing and Rooter is an Prescott Valley area plumber with a genuinely split record — loyal repeat customers rave about affordable same-day service and honest pricing, while a notable minority describe serious reliability failures including no-shows, sloppy workmanship with loose pipes and cheap parts, and a defensive owner who communicates only by text. One reviewer reports the company's license was suspended with open disciplinary issues as of their review date.

reviews.author: Skye Puls
reviews.text: I am beyond thrilled with the service I received with Russell. R.E.D. was utilized as a second opinion and I am so glad we received it.  Next time, it will be our first call. Russell went above and beyond with his efficiency, level of being thorough and communication about potential options and following through on getting the work completed. He was willing to explain what is functioning improperly and offered to teach us how to do our annual flushing of the system.  I am so excited to have him install my new water heater.

reviews.author: Michael Eastwood
reviews.text:
I used R.E.D. Plumbing on a new build and was unsure how the warranty process would work. We have not even moved into the home yet when we noticed a leak under the kitchen sink. I called before the office officially opened and left a message, not knowing what to expect.

Hope called me back promptly. She listened carefully, showed genuine care, and took ownership of the situation right away. She scheduled help for the same day, which spoke volumes about how this company treats customers, even before move-in.

Noah arrived on time, was professional and respectful, identified the issue quickly, and fixed it without hesitation. No stress. No runaround. The problem was solved. He also took the extra step to check the water heater they installed to make sure everything was working properly.

Five-star service all around. This team delivers real service, stands behind the work, and values your time. I appreciate the quick response, the professionalism, and the care shown. R.E.D. Plumbing earned my trust and my strong recommendation.

reviews.author: West USA Realty of Prescott
reviews.text:
I used R.E.D. Plumbing on a new build and ran into a small issue. I called the office, and Hope answered right away. She handled the call professionally and had someone scheduled the same day. Noah arrived quickly, diagnosed the issue, and fixed it on the spot.

Strong communication, fast response, and quality work. This team stands behind their work and respects your time. I recommend R.E.D. Plumbing without hesitation.

reviews.author: Dorene Y.
reviews.text:
Poor service, with employees that need more training.
In a nutshell...they are a hot mess.

reviews.author: Google User
reviews.text: I scheduled them and they were running several hours behind. I rescheduled and they put me on first thing in the morning to ensure they would be on time, is what they told me. They scheduled me for 8:30 and it is now 9:30 and they still haven't been here yet. I heard they're pretty good, which is why I called them, but disappointing that they can't stick to their appointment times because I have a job and I rearranged my day both times to accommodate them. If you don't mind waiting around.

reviews.author: Andrea S.
reviews.text:
Outstanding Whole-House Water Softener and Conditioner!
RED Plumbing installed our whole-house XT60 Water Softener and KDC60 Water Conditioner 5 weeks ago in our home. Living in Prescott Valley before our installation, we noticed that the water was very hard water, quite cloudy when poured from the sink or even from the filtered refrigerator water, and had a noticeable chlorine smell. After RED installed our water softener and conditioner, our water tastes great and is no longer cloudy and the chlorine smell is gone! Since chlorine is not meant to be consumed, I am glad for that. Our house is plumbed for an R-O water filtration system, and we didn't even put one in because we no longer need it. In addition, my whole house gets the benefit of this much improved water: showers, cooking, cleaning (which is much easier as water spots and calcium build up is no longer an issue). A side benefit is that my hair dye last longer and doesn't fade. My hair grows out, but the color stays in my hair because there is almost no chlorine in the water. In addition, we noticed that our laundry is super soft! I went and washed even the clean stuff in the linen closet just so it could be soft too. We don't have to use water softeners any more - a money saver - or dishwasher rinse aid. Dishes come out looking clean and sparkly. My skin and hair feel better too. I was having a bit of itchy skin before and I just didn't really think about it... until it was gone. The maintenance for the unit is as simple as it gets. We do have to add salt (so far, not yet though), but there are no filters to change, clean, or replace. The systems are designed to be self-cleaning by running a regeneration cycle. Because of the water conditioner, there is very little salt remaining in the water. It is perfectly safe for our plants and they are thriving. I highly recommend the 2 units for outstanding water, and I recommend RED Plumbing as they were was very professional in their installation.
Andrea S. (April, 2019)

reviews.author: Dave B.
reviews.text:
I called for emergency service a few weeks ago on a Saturday for a blockage issue in my sewer pipe that was causing my toilets and bathtubs to backup.  The service guy came and removed one of the two toilets and tried to use the snake.  Without success in the one toilet he moved to remove the next toilet.  After the second attempt failed he called his supervisor and told me that my only option was to cut a hole in the drywall and try the snake again.  Of course I trusted him and let him do it.  Again no success.  The service guy then said the next step would be to find the sewer clean-outs outside of my house.  I told him that I would locate them and call for him to return.  I called back on Monday and RED had already sent a supervisor and a different service guy to my house.  They took a snake with a camera on it through the clean-out and within 20 min the blockage was taken care of.   Problem solved!
Everything that the emergency service guy did was not needed.  The first step should have been to go to the clean-outs first like they eventually did on Monday.  I couldn't use one bathroom for a week because i had drywall and paint repair to complete before they could put the toilet back in place.  
One week later I receive the bill for over $1000.  I placed a call to the office to talk to them about what happened.   I told them that the emergency service guy should have told me that the clean-outs needed to be located first, not the other way around.  After they talked it over with the service manager they called me back and said they would give me a 5% "good guy" discount.  I definitely won't be calling them again in the future.

reviews.author: Karolyn H.
reviews.text:
R.E.D. Plumbing had done the original plumbing installation on my home built 2 years ago. I purchased it in January 2018 so it was cold outside & didn't notice that the cold water in my kitchen & guest bathroom was lukewarm at best. It starts out cold then goes to warm & to hot and tries to go cold while running the water. My home warranty company sent out two different plumbers who both said the hot & cold water lines were crossed or touching somewhere in the foundation. I called R.E.D. Plumbing who also agreed that the lines were probably touching. After doing some work on my plumbing to try to pinpoint where plumbing was either crossed or lines touching, the owner of the company said that the city water coming into my home is 83 and that is acceptable and why my water is lukewarm. However, if that were the case, all of my faucets would be the same temperature. None of my neighbors have 83 degree water, which if it were city, they would. The owner said that they will not do anything else to remedy this. The service manager at the company is great. He's tried to work with me but I realize his hands are tied since the owner says there's nothing wrong. I'd love to have the owner come & have a glass of lukewarm water with me. I know that they think I'll just go away. I will not. I've been dealing with them and this issue for well over a month. Not the kind of company I'd do business with if I didn't have to.
As a business owner myself, I would never just wash my hands of an issue that my company is responsible for. The owner obviously just looks at the bottom line.

reviews.author: Gibor C.
reviews.text:
I must say, from the first and second phone call to RED Plumbing and your AMAZING technician Steven, I am beyond AMAZED at the professionalism, honesty, and just all around good vibes from your company!!!

It is very rare to meet such an AWESOME technician as Steven.  His attention to detail and knowledge just blew me away.

Thank you so much for your time and for sending me what has to be one of the most attention to detail technicians I have ever met.

Did I happen to mention how awesome Steven was?

I don't even care if I get any other calls or quotes from any other companies.  You have more than earned my business and respect.  Your receptionists were pleasant to talk with and your technician Steven sealed the deal.

Your quote was fair, your technician was beyond impressive, and I feel like I am dealing with family!!!

Also, people need to be more understanding during these bizarre times.  Many of these companies can not get good workers and many of them are dealing with multiple customers and service calls.  Be patient and more understanding, the world does not revolve around you.  Stuff happens and sometimes techs are running behind.  They are doing the best they can during these strange times.

reviews.author: Countedx 5.
reviews.text: A big shout out to technician Ian!  Our relatively new (three years) house has a very complicated electric water heater with a "smart" circulation pump that is designed to provide hot water anywhere in the house within about ten seconds.  It worked well until a couple of weeks ago, when suddenly it was taking four or five MINUTES for hot water to reach the furthest points in the home.  We called a different plumbing company, but they either didn't understand how the system worked or seemed to think there was no problem.  We then contacted R.E.D. Plumbing, which had initially installed the water heater.  Ian approached the issue with a view to taking the least invasive and least costly action first, before trying a more expensive and complicated solution.  We agreed with that course.  When that first attempt failed, he returned for a second visit and correctly diagnosed and repaired the problem.  He also suggested options in case we need to replace the circulation pump with a different product in the future.  He was very knowledgeable about this particular system, which was exactly what we needed.

He also suggested options in case we need to replace the circulation pump with a different product in the future.  He was very knowledgeable about this particular system, which was exactly what we needed.

reviews.author: A H.
reviews.text:
My hot water heater exploded last week.  Yes, it exploded.  I had never heard anything like that before, not even a blown transformer.  I'm sure it was amplified because the water closet was the next wall over!

It was the Monday before Thanksgiving & I'm sure you can imagine my panic!  I called around for quotes & availability.  Not only was R.E.D. Plumbing available, but they were very competitively priced.  They were able to send someone out on Wednesday before the long holiday weekend!  I was without water from Monday when the water company came out until R.E.D. showed up Wednesday morning.  (Even with the water turned off to the water heater, water continued to leak so it had to be shut off at the main.)

Chris from R.E.D. was amazing & so patient with all of my questions.  Very professional & very friendly.  He even gave me tips on how to direct the water out of the heater closet to prevent further drywall damage.

I'm saving their card for any future plumbing needs, & I highly recommend R.E.D. Plumbing for anyone else needing plumbing work, too!

reviews.author: Cedric F.
reviews.text:
We had a water heater that was 12 years old and it decided to go out this morning.

I called R.E.D. Plumbing hoping that they could squeeze us in since I like taking hot showers. They said they were busy but would try to get someone out as soon as possible. Sure effort about 2 hours later I get a call and a plumber named Josh came out to take a look. After inspecting the heater he presented to me my options and I decided on a new heater.

He mentioned that he had other appointments and might not be able to do it today, but after a while he decided that would install it today.

Josh went and got the new heater, and drained the old one when while he was gone. He came back and as I looked on, he explained the process changed some parts to make everything work better for me in the future. I felt very comfortable with Josh's work and would highly recommend him.

Great service and I didn't feel like I was getting 'ripped off'. I would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Andy R.
reviews.text: In June 2018, I had a plumbing leak in the wall of our walk-in shower and called RED for a quote which was $850.00. I had scheduled an appointment with them to have it fixed. A day before, I called to confirm and they said they needed to reschedule for a few days later. A few days later, I was driving in from out of town to meet with the contractor on the morning they were to be here when I received a call 2 hours before they were to be here to again reschedule for 7 days later. I haven't been able to use this shower in over 3 weeks and it continues to get rescheduled. I finally had another contractor come in and got it done in the same week and under $100 savings. I used RED in the past and was happy with prior work...knowing that I was a return customer and still continued to cancel and reschedule me is totally unacceptable. I would never use this company again, and as a Realtor, would never recommend them to a valued customer.

reviews.author: Karen Levosky
reviews.text: Called another plumbing company $3000 to fix something that this plumbing company should have fixed or installed right the first time. RED plumbing did the plumbing on our Dorn home. One year into owning the home there was a water leak after the meter and RED had to come out and fix it. The plumber said they had installed something wrong. Well guess what it is leaking again. Called RED said they would come out tomorrow and when I called back to find out the time they said I was never put on the schedule and that they couldn't come out until Thursday.  I owned my other house for 30 years and never had a water leak. Owned this one for 6 and this is the 2nd one. Of course it's not under warranty. Crappy work the first time and now can't even get them to come out and fix it. Time to call someone that will fix it correctly so I don't have a leak every couple of years.

synthesis.summary: R.E.D. Plumbing is a high-variance operation — when you get a good tech like Russell or Noah, the experience is exceptional (several recent Google reviews are genuinely strong). But the Yelp history over multiple years reveals a persistent pattern of no-shows, appointment reschedules, pricing surprises, and billing opacity that's hard to explain away. Forty-seven percent of Yelp reviews (46 total) rate 1-2 stars, and the complaints are specific and consistent: hidden costs, estimates that balloon, and a receptionist who is described across multiple independent reviews as rude or dismissive.
strengths: Russell came as second opinion, found another plumber had misdiagnosed — saved customer from unnecessary drywall demolition
Noah and Hope (office) praised in recent Google reviews for same-day scheduling and quality follow-through on warranty issues
Chris came out on Christmas Eve to fix a clogged sewer line — 'great attitude and got the job done'
weaknesses: Multiple no-shows and reschedules documented across several independent reviewers
$518 charged for 80 minutes of work replacing a $35 part
Estimates routinely exceed initial quotes — one reviewer found quote went from 2 hours to 6-8 hours day before job
redFlags: Pricing opacity: multiple reviewers report R.E.D. refuses to provide itemized estimates — 'pays $1,200 for a cartridge and valve with no breakdown'
Multiple complaints about cross-wired/misinstalled plumbing on new home builds done by R.E.D.
Receptionist described as rude and dismissive across multiple independent Yelp reviews spanning several years
One reviewer: '$250 quoted for parts, actual kit costs $20 online — very sketchy'
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Kyle answered a Sunday call and walked a customer through resetting hot water remotely. Chris came out Christmas Eve. But documented cases of being told first available appointment is days out.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google 4.4 (125 reviews) vs. Yelp 3.8 (46 reviews) — Yelp has substantially higher concentration of 1-star reviews including specific, well-documented billing and reliability complaints not visible in Google sample.

plumbers.name: Goettl's High Desert Mechanical
plumbers.address: 8001 E State Rte 69 STE F, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Jerry Carrier
reviews.text:
Thomas Pride did an excellent job of inspecting our HVAC system.  Upon inspection a bid for replacement of a plenum duct above the HVAC unit was submitted which I may have done in future.   At this time the system works perfectly so no repair was scheduled.   Thomas was very thorough in explaining that the HVAC system was clean and working proper internally.  Part of the inspection was to replace three return air filters.
This will satisfy our warranty with the LENNOX product manufacturer.
Thanks go to Thomas Pride for a job well done.
Jerry Carrier

reviews.author: Brindy Bringhurst
reviews.text: Jaxon was super helpful. Did a full inspection of our system and gave honest recommendations on what is needed and why. Showed me photos and measurements. Very thorough. The office is also very pleasant to work with. They’re the first I call for any HVAC needs in cottonwood.

reviews.author: Joan Griffin
reviews.text: The service technician, Moe, was prompt, professional and cordial.  During his inspection he reviewed the options for further maintenance and upgrade. He gave the pros and cons of each system in regards to my situation and hvac needs.  He was knowledgeable and clear in his presentation.  I felt very comfortable with my decision in going forward with his recommendation.  Thank you. Jg

reviews.author: chad nelson
reviews.text:
Had Goettl's come out to address our heater being broken. It ended up being a circuit board problem... We were quoted 2114 dollars to fix it. It is a 300 dollar part so I guess labor was 1800 bucks!? That's with our amazing 373 dollar member savings. He also proceeded to go around the house and photo the whole system trying to upsell us on new AC parts and fixes. Our membership was cancelled and we ended up calling about the pricing issue and were told a supervisor would call us. That didn't happen. Chino Valley Heating and Cooling did the repair for 630 dollars with overnight shipping for the part. This place is purely commsioned based as the prices would suggest.

Edit as of April 1, they never called me about my experience as they stated they would in their response.

reviews.author: Larry White
reviews.text: The prices are very high, but the quality of the work doesn’t match the cost. After doing some research, I found that most of the lead installation technicians are not EPA certified. Something I consider a major red flag. Without this certification, most of the lead tech installer  are not qualified to work on HVAC systems or handle refrigerants. I’d recommend verifying credentials before committing.

reviews.author: Albert Bamsch
reviews.text: From the moment we inquired about a new heating and air conditioning unit from GOETTL'S to installation completion, we have been thoroughly impressed with the level of professionalism maintained by every person we've encountered. Max came out to give us an estimate, and we immediately felt a connection with him. His honesty, integrity, and loyalty to GOETTL'S are attributes one seeks in a professional project manager. Caesar was the next person who was involved. He came out to evaluate the scope of work and to confirm all that was needed to get the job done. Marvin, Joseph, and Alex definitely were the "A-Team" of installers. They worked very effectively as a team, but each had his own specific responsibilities. After a recent nightmare  home renovation project, GOETTL'S has restored our faith and confidence in professional contractors.

reviews.author: Marc Krouse
reviews.text:
Technician Review
John Schaffer

John was dispatched later the same day as my call for assistance. 30 minute arrival notification with online map of travel progress.

John listened to my explanation and immediately began his testing and analysis. Intelligent, experienced, detail oriented. Excellent professional.

This was a second opinion service call after my HVAC split system was pronounced dead and non recoverable.

John determined that the unit could be made operable and proceeded to fine tune the installation. After comparing all the electronic status values with the OEM specs, I chose one of the many options within my budget.

Arrived at 5 pm and finished at 9 pm. Saved us $15,394.60. I will recommend Goettl and especially John Schaffer to anyone.

reviews.author: Joey Aquino
reviews.text:
Thomas Pride arrived first thing in the morning to do our “Annual Maintenance” schedule. Everything was OK and clean except that he found a couple of issues that we could address later.

Thomas was very professional and knowledgeable about AC Maintenance,  its mechanics and functions. He even taught me how to disengage the power properly if I need to hose down our outdoor unit. He also took photos for me using my iPhone up in the attic where the furnace is located.

Regarding the plumbing, he said he will send someone else to check on our plumbing since he is not a plumber. Hopefully that will be completed before we leave but it can also be done when we return after 4 months.

We did not pay anything for this service. Thank you very much!

reviews.author: Helen Hibbert
reviews.text: This was our 1st appointment for service/maintenance with Goettl. Thomas arrived on time for the inspection and was ready to answer any questions. At first we let him get on with his work and he kept us informed of every step he took.   Eventually yes we asked as he went along with his duties and he answered every question with knowledge and patience.  We were better informed about what to look and watch out for during the year for the next scheduled maintenance.  All in all we were very satisfied with Thomas's experience, knowledge and professionalism.

reviews.author: Dave Lobato
reviews.text:
We had our Annual HVAC service proformed and had a ion air purifier added to our system.  Our system is located in our crawl space under the house. Thomas in layman's terms showed us pictures of our system and explained what they showed. As a engineer and a trained observer, Thomas
Is an asset to Goettl, It'd be a better world if others business invested in there employees like Goettl does. God bless.
$99 Annual HVAC service
$1,500 Ion air purifier with installation.

reviews.author: Matt Ketchum
reviews.text: John was great with Quick service and found the problem super quick. I would use them again for sure. The tech that came out was knowledgeable and able to answer my million questions. He gave me every option and explained each one with detail. I ended up opting for a new system as my current one is 30+ years old. The service fee was all I paid for checking out my system. They even lent me some portable AC units to use until they put my new system in.

reviews.author: J Grall
reviews.text: On Sunday, February 1 we noticed water seeping from our ceiling in the area where our furnace was located. We called the service number and Rafael, a technician, was dispatched and arrived from the Camp Verde area within 90 minutes. He immediately diagnosed the issue and made the necessary repairs. He communicated with us through the entire process. Not only would we highly recommend Goettl for routine maintenance, but Rafael for special repairs.

reviews.author: Debra Horan
reviews.text: We had our yearly maintenance check completed and couldn’t be more pleased with the service. Thomas was extremely knowledgeable, thorough, and took the time to patiently explain what was needed for our unit in a way that was easy to understand. We never felt rushed, and all of our questions were answered clearly. It’s refreshing to work with someone who is both professional and genuinely cares about doing the job right. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Arizona Patriot
reviews.text: Jaxson Pratt was a phenomenal representation of what an HVAC professional should be! He was thorough, courteous, informative, and enjoyable to converse with about what he did, what we should look out for with our system and gave us options of what is the most up to date things we could do to improve our existing system and how we can take care of our system to last a for a very long time! Thank you Goettl’s and thank you Jaxson Pratt.

reviews.author: Julie Spichtig
reviews.text:
Super impressed with Goettl’s High Desert Mechanical. They were able to squeeze us in for a service call. John Schaffer was the gentleman who came to service our HVAC unit. He was extremely knowledgeable and professional. He tested and replaced all the parts needed. We were very pleased with this technician and would definitely recommend him and Goettl’s to family and friends. I’d give John 10 stars if available
Thank you so much.

synthesis.summary: Technicians like Thomas, Jaxon, and John consistently earn praise for thorough explanations and same-day service, but one documented case of a $2,114 quote for a $630 repair is a serious red flag for emergency pricing.
strengths: Communication is exceptional — across roughly a dozen reviews, technicians are specifically praised for walking customers through findings step-by-step, showing photos, and explaining in plain language rather than rushing

Same-day and prompt dispatch appears reliable: one reviewer was 'squeezed in' same day, another received a 30-minute arrival notification with a live map link, and Thomas is repeatedly called out for arriving on time

Technicians demonstrate genuine diagnostic depth — John Schaffer's second-opinion visit saved one customer $15,394 by reviving a system another company declared dead, and multiple techs caught root causes others missed
weaknesses: Pricing opacity is a recurring concern: one customer paid $1,400 and felt uneasy never seeing the old parts swapped out, another was quoted $2,114 for a repair a competitor completed for $630, and a third found water heater options 'above my budget' with no middle ground

Follow-through on customer service complaints appears weak — the overcharged customer explicitly noted that a promised supervisor callback never happened, even after the company publicly responded saying they would reach out
redFlags: One reviewer documented a $2,114 quote (after a $373 member discount) for a circuit board that cost $300 in parts — a competitor fixed it for $630 total, suggesting markup of roughly 3x on emergency or complex repairs

That same reviewer reported the technician photographed the entire home system pushing additional upsells during what was a straightforward repair visit, and a follow-up callback promised publicly was never made — a pattern of aggressive upselling combined with poor complaint resolution
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No reviews explicitly describe after-hours emergency calls or burst-pipe scenarios, but same-day dispatch is documented, one customer was squeezed into the schedule last-minute, and John Schaffer completed a 5pm–9pm service call — suggesting evening availability at minimum.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: No Yelp data exists for comparison, but 6 BBB complaints in 3 years alongside a 4.9 Google rating warrants mild caution — the complaint about an unresolved overcharge and missed callback aligns with the kind of issue more likely to surface on BBB than Google.
