reviews.author: Jessica Rose
reviews.text:
I wash shocked by the price, but that seems to be the cost of doing business these days. On the other hand they got here within 2 hrs and only took 50 mins, for that I am very pleased.
Jessica

reviews.author: Michelle Rush
reviews.text: Unfortunately, the place I rent has needed a lot of plumbing repairs the last couple months, but these Blue Plumbing was wonderful. Susie was quick to get us scheduled, and Robert did great work!

reviews.author: Aims LL
reviews.text: This is an excellent business! They helped us with a part we were having trouble finding. They were extremely affordable, kind, easy to work with, communicated well and went above and beyond to help us. Very grateful to them!

reviews.author: Cocoa C.
reviews.text: Our garbage disposal and kitchen sink faucet needed fixing. They did replace the disposal and it was known what the cost was around 300 for install and new disposal, but then the faucet could not be repaired so they had one on the truck that turned out to be awful. Total cost of the repair and new faucet install with garbage disposal $700.00!!! Lasted four months and the handle fell off. Not good, called to complain about the cost and they did not care at all. Too bad  they said!

reviews.author: Alexander F.
reviews.text: My fiancé called this company on Sunday to be told that she needed to hire a leak detection company to verify where the leak was. After digging for a few hours and getting very close to the leak, the leak detector showed up the next day (Monday) and verified we were right on top of it. It should've been another 18 inches or so down. He charged us $300. So we called Blue back and we were happy to hear that they were sending someone out that afternoon. He showed up, dug about 12 inches in less than an hour, told us the leak wasn't there, charged us $200, and told us we needed to get the leak detector back out to find the leak. So we called them back and they were happy to come back out the next day (Tuesday) for no further charges to verify the leak was where they said it was. After confirming that I called Blue back and they didn't like my attitude and told me to use somebody else's services. $500 dollars to 2 companies and I still only have a hole in the ground I dug myself, right above where I already knew the leak was coming from. Save yourself time and money by going anywhere else with your business.

reviews.author: Haley B.
reviews.text:
I called and explained exactly what needed to be done in the shower tub area and was quoted a good price on the phone. However when Brad arrived, the price almost doubled.  He explained that he "misunderstood" what needed to be done.  My advice, get a written estimate.  I did leave Brad the owner a message to discuss after the fact, and no return phone call.  I also emailed him as well.  Therefore, I did attempt to provide advanced notice prior to posting this review.  Had other's not been intimidated by his legal jargon, and posted, I would have been forewarned.  Be very aware of the full page disclaimer regarding reviews of this company.  
"ACCEPTANCE OF WORK PERFORMED
 In the event if I am unsatisfied with the work, I will contact this company prior to posting to any online forums, websites, social
media, or review sites. I agree to give Blue Plumbing & Drain Cleaning LLC the opportunity to address my un-satisfaction.
Any comment or review posted to anywhere on the internet must be removed immediately until Blue Plumbing & Drain
Cleaning LLC is contacted via a phone call to Blue Plumbing & Drain Cleaning LLC, and you have spoken directly with
Brad or Susie Brasher to address the issue. In the event that my grievances can not be resolved to my satisfaction, I
agree to post the full story of our conversation and interaction with any social media posting (which includes reviews to
Yelp!, Home Advisor, Angies List, Google, Facebook etc.). If my comments and/or reviews are missing the complete story,
the post must be immediately removed and will result in legal action by Blue Plumbing & Drain Cleaning LLC."

reviews.author: Michelle S.
reviews.text: This company is very unprofessional. We live out of town and need a plumber so our tenant found this company on Home Advisor.  We opted to have them out to do the work and were given an initial estimate. We were not contacted again or  advised that the actual cost was double the estimate. Called Blue and reached owner's wife, who stated the tenant already paid them. The tenant was not given the authority to as the as an agent, nor should she have been the one to pay the invoice. We were told, "too bad, take it up with your tenant". Not even sure that that is supposed to be handled that way.  Company owner used profanity and insulted customer(calling me a rude lady-via phone conversation, also saying he had worked for three hours, but was really there for maybe an hour and a half and acted like he did us some huge favor kept saying"you're welcome" over and over like some sort of ridiculous insult. He also stated that the granite contractor,  who had done the countertop work, made a huge mess of things, but would not elaborate,   Have yet to receive the work invoice, even though they promised to email it 10/27.  Basically said he was paid and too bad, he didn't care.   Not sure why Home Advisor would have them as part of their listing. Would never recommend this company.

reviews.author: John Rogers
reviews.text:
I initially had an issue with an outdoor frost‑free sillcock installation that didn’t come out the way I expected. When I contacted Blue Plumbing about it, they responded quickly and took my concerns seriously. They immediately arranged for a different technician, Robert, to come out and evaluate the situation.

Robert was extremely professional, courteous, and thorough. He explained what needed to be corrected and made sure the repair was done properly. The faucet is now flush with the house, firmly secured, and looks like a finished, quality installation.

I’m giving Blue Plumbing 5 stars because of their commitment to making things right. Their follow‑through, responsiveness, and willingness to send a skilled technician to correct the issue showed they truly stand behind their work. I appreciate the effort they put into resolving the problem to my satisfaction.

reviews.author: Brad H.
reviews.text:
Our tubs and toilets backed up this Saturday morning causing water to spill onto the floor and preventing us from doing Laundry or using the water for any other reason. I tried contacting several local plumbers and just got their answering machine and a promise to return my call the next business day ... which was two days from now. That wouldn't work for us since we had family in town, so we tried calling another plumber - Blue Plumbing & Drain Cleaning. My call was picked up by a live person on the first ring and Brad the plumber showed up in uniform and a marked service van, within a few hours to uncloak our drain. We were charged exactly what was discussed over the phone without any surprises. 

I highly recommend Blue Plumbing & Drain Cleaning service. 


Bradford Hall 
Prescott Valley, June 29th, 2019

reviews.author: Ed W.
reviews.text: I received a call Friday to tell me there would be someone at my house between 12-2 on Saturday.  I asked for hourly costs, and she said they charge by the job.  I was running late on Saturday and called to tell them I would be home at 12:15.  When I told him the pilot light on my water heater wouldn't come on, he said it would be $225 plus parts.  That seemed quite expensive, especially since he hadn't actually seen the water heater,  I got a call at 1:40 from the same guy who told me they were too busy to come and suggested I find someone else.  When a vender doesn't show up and tells you to look for someone else, that tells me the job is not big enough for them to make the effort.

reviews.author: Nancy B.
reviews.text: Horrible customer service.  I fully described the scope of work before they began, and upon arriving, they more than doubled their price.  Because I had a tile person starting the next day, it was too late for me to find another plumber, so I was forced to use them.  They took almost 5 hours to complete the job.  I had RED plumbing complete my main bath, and they only charged 95 per valve as apposed to more than twice for Blue Plumbing,   Also look at the bottom of their invoice, they have a two page legal jargon that says they can sue you if you leave them a bad review.  That in itself should be a red flag.

reviews.author: Roberta F.
reviews.text: My garbage disposal stopped working, was making a weird noise and the blades weren't turning.  I emailed my home warranty company on a Saturday night (late) and they referred me to Blue Plumbing.  The warranty company scheduled my appointment for Tuesday, but Blue Plumbing called me Monday morning and asked if they could come on Monday instead and that was okay with me.  CJ called before coming.  He was on time, and very nice and professional.  He knows his stuff.  My disposal was just clogged, he fixed it and that was that.  Thank you Blue Plumbing!  I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Julie R.
reviews.text: Great professional service!  He diagnosed the problem correctly and fixed it right.  Came to the house the same morning I called.  I couldn't be happier with them - definitely will use this service again.  This company worked with 2-10 Home Warranty to get our job done and believe me, working with 2-10 is one of the most frustrating and time consuming things anyone can do.  Working with them added a good hour on the phone to the plumber's job and he never complained or anything.

reviews.author: Michael R.
reviews.text: Very sad day...don't like doing this... Feel totally taken advantage of regarding our plumbing "repair".....we called because we were hoping after the service we would have been left satisfied, and our plumbing too, but instead we were left with a bill, and a job incomplete, with yet another potential soaking to make the repairs. We were the last job of the day, and it showed.  How do to you have recourse when payment must be collected at the service call.

reviews.author: Roberto R.
reviews.text: Trying to find a plumber in this town that can come out on the same day and not charge you an emergency service is almost impossible, but I found Blue Plumbing! They were pleasant and great on the phone, CJ the tech called me before he came over, showed up on time, unplugged the sewer root problem and was professional and pleasant to chat with. I put the magnet on the refrigerator so I can use them again in the future. Highly recommend these folks!

synthesis.summary: Shows up fast — often same-day or within hours on weekends — but pricing surprises are common enough that you should pin down the total before they start digging.
strengths: Exceptional emergency responsiveness: at least 8 reviews specifically mention same-day arrival, within-hours dispatch, or weekend/Sunday response including a 9am-to-9:30am turnaround
Owner-operators Brad and Susie personally show up on weekends and after-hours, mentioned by name across multiple recent 2025 reviews
Technicians Robert and CJ repeatedly praised by name for explaining work, professionalism, and efficient repairs — suggesting consistent field quality
weaknesses: Pricing catches customers off guard: multiple reviews describe sticker shock after service, one citing $700 for disposal plus faucet install with a faucet that failed in 4 months, another $798 for two exterior faucets

At least one review describes being double-charged for a repeat drain cleaning visit, and another paid $500 across two companies while a disputed leak location went unresolved — suggesting billing disputes are not isolated
redFlags: Two reviews describe owner becoming dismissive or hostile when billing was challenged — one was told 'too bad' after a faucet failed at 4 months, another was told to use someone else after pushing back on a misdiagnosed leak
One review from 2021 alleges final cost was double the estimate, charged through the tenant without owner authorization, and the owner used profanity on the phone — no rebuttal or resolution noted
Score variance of 38 and a 1.2-star gap between Google (4.8) and Yelp (3.6) suggest a split customer experience that may track to job complexity or billing disputes rather than routine work
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: multiple reviewers confirm same-day and within-hours arrival on Sundays, holidays, and late nights, with one reviewer specifically praising no emergency surcharge — at 2am with a burst pipe, they appear genuinely reachable and fast.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.8 across 381 reviews while Yelp sits at 3.6 across 37 — the Yelp sample skews toward billing complaints and owner conduct disputes that are largely absent from Google, suggesting dissatisfied customers may preferentially land on Yelp.

reviews.author: Chris Mattson
reviews.text: Had an emergency. My septic tank drain from the house was clogged. Tom was great. Very professional and thorough. He diagnosed the problem quickly. Unfortunately it was more involved than just a simple unclogging and he explained the next steps to take for me to get the ball rolling on fixing it. I was impressed with Tom and the Benjamin Franklin company and will recommend you guys in the future

reviews.author: The Pupp
reviews.text: Aaron was friendly and did most of the work in a short period of time.  He forgot to return to finish the job so I had to call four times. He came out and apologized as he forgot to finish the small job.  No biggie to me. What I was upset was the cost of $2K. It was excessive for the job.  I had surgery on right hand so I couldn’t do it. Aaron dug a few feet down reattach the flipper and install a new tube. Being retired with limited income the price was too high for the job. the only new parts was the 40 gage tube and cap which was about $25. The flipper was not replaced but reattached. I feel you folks could do better by not charging a high price for the type of job. The $538 to come out would have been the price to pay. The back up problem was the back flow flipper came off and cause the stop of the flow. Once it was moved the water flowed away. Other suggestions came with a price tag of $4K the back flow value was already installed. Like I said the cost was way too much.  Aaron was good doing his job.  I’m just angry at the price.

reviews.author: Paula McCoy
reviews.text:
Aaron arrived on time, he is very courteous and respectful of my home.
He worked quickly and efficiently.
He went the extra mile to assure I was taken care of.
I plan to have another ADA toilet installed after the first of the year.

I will ask that Aaron is my service technician.

reviews.author: Sydney Harrington
reviews.text:
Tom came back to check on previous employees failure to clean out tree roots. Previous employee used an electric snake, like the one we own, it got out of hand and he broke sewer line and water line, all he did was punch a hole thru toilet paper which it allowed to flush thru 2 guests in my Airbnb. When Tom came  you could tell he did not want to deal with the situation as telling my husband and I if he used his tool it would break our pipes. He never took a camera to look at the issue,  as we explained my husband and I had separated the pipes and had taken our camera to look into the issue, we had previously taken off the toilet( we are in our 70’s and my husband had a stroke wheelchair bound) Tom told us to get someone who does hydro jetting( which can breaks pipes too
Tom went back to office stated I wouldn’t let him cut pipes or take off the toilet never said such a thing. I am currently waiting for supervisor to call as I want a full refund($754).

reviews.author: John F.
reviews.text: Unethical deceptive practices to take money and supplies they don't earn. They tell me they want 100% customer satisfaction and want to work with me but then never get back to me.  They keep removing my review from their site.

reviews.author: Jeff K.
reviews.text:
So here's my update of Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Prescott.  Apparently the "owner" of the business owns several areas (Phoenix, Prescott, etc).  He's not man-enough to contact his customers himself; instead, I got a call from someone claiming to be an "area supervisor".  She said the owner doesn't call customers, himself.  I guess he just sits in his ivory tower, collecting money from the rubes stupid enough to hire his company.  I gave her the phone number that sent me the text-confirmation (photo attached). The text said "Ben Franklin Plumbing - Prescott", and gave the window of "between 1 PM MST and 5 PM MST", even though the area code of the phone number was somewhere in Pennsylvania (that doesn't really matter these days, though.  I've lived in PV for well over 5 years, and my cell has an 805 area code).  Anyway, this "area supervisor" said she'd try to get some out to give me an estimate.  She wanted me to accept another 4-hour window, and I told her that I wasn't waiting around for another 4 hours.  I told her I'd give them a 2-hour window.  She said she'd have to speak to someone else about getting someone out with my 2-hour window.  But here's the thing: if she's an "area supervisor", why does she have to confer with someone else?  Evidently, she's an "area supervisor" with no authority. A full day later, and no return call.

If they ever do call to send someone out, I'll reject them, even if their bid is to do the work for free.  I don't want a bid from a company so disconnected from their customers, and I'm actually kind of glad the situation worked out this way.  BFP sounds like a company that's top-heavy with management, and with too few actual plumbers doing the work.  The dissatisfied Yelpers speak for themselves.  A company that doesn't listen to their customers, and fails to modify their business-model accordingly, is doomed to failure!  This is precisely why you should always get multiple bids on any project: to weed-out the flakes!

So far, I've received 3 estimates, and by Monday evening I should have 3 more.  I base my acceptance criteria on promptness, profesionalism, cleanliness, equipment to be installed, availability of parts, price, and experience in the biz.  I give extra points if the person who shows up will be the actual installer, rather than some underwriter.

reviews.author: Glenda S.
reviews.text: Peter from Benjamin Franklin Plumbing in Prescott Valley responded to my call and came for an after hours service on Friday.  I had a clogged drain in my kitchen sink.  At the time I called I made it clear that I didn't have an outside septic clean out so he would most likely have to use the snake in the 2" PVC pipe under the sink.  When he arrived he quickly looked under the sink then went room to room looking for more plumbing to peek at, opening cabinets and turning valves & fittings in the bathroom.  Then he went outside & did a half dozen laps around my home looking for the septic clean out which I again said I didn't have.   He decided to remove the skirting & go underneath to have a look.  When he finally came indoors he told me what he found & what his recommendations were.  He said that the pipe under my MH between my kitchen & bathroom needs to be replaced.  He said it had developed a "belly" (a dip) and was going uphill to the main drain pipe & this was the cause of the clog.  I asked him to just try to run the snake instead & he said he didn't have one.  So, he proceeded to write up an estimate of all the repairs (9 of them) he said I needed soon.  The total repairs came to a whopping $3,767 but would be discounted 15% if I sign up for a $10/mo. maintenance program.  I was in shock.  He never did try to clear the clogged drain.  He left and I finally called another Plumber on Sunday (Dan D Plumbing) who came out within 3 hours.  Dan ran a snake down the drain, flushed the pipe & had it all working again 30-40 minutes after he arrived.  I asked him to look under my MH at this pipe so he crawled underneath.  He reported to me that there are no visible pipes since they're inside the floor joists surrounded by insulation & covered with a vapor barrier.  He had me run water through the line while he check for any leakage and there was none.  Everything looked good.  Dan only charged me $125, and on a Sunday!  He'll be getting a glowing review from me.  Peter, on the other hand, charged me $79 for nothing & doesn't even deserve the 1 star I gave him.

reviews.author: Mike W.
reviews.text:
Originally I was going to give them 3 stars, but then the service just went down hill.

I scheduled a service call on Wednesday through their web page for a Faucet Stem rebuild in my tub/shower and a flapper valve replacement in one of the toilets, and they called and scheduled one of their guys out on Friday between 1 & 5.  Bill showed up about 5:20, they missed the window, but they were 'close'.   They have a pricing schedule, a flapper valve costs $152.00 dollars, rebuilding (actually replacement) of faucet stems cost $316.00, the pricing schedule makes no adjustment for multiple repairs being done at the same time each charge is treated as a separate call which seems excessive to me, so that explains the 3 stars I was originally going to give them.

Then the problems started.  Bill replaced the flapper valve but did not have the faucet stems on this truck and would have to come back out the next day with them, but since he was not working the next day, Nick (who was driving down from Las Vegas to cover the area) would pick up the faucet stems and be out "sometime" on Saturday (at an additional service call charge) to finish the job.  So Bill ran my credit card and was off and I was left with a partially dismantled tub/shower to await Nick "sometime" the next day.

After waiting around the house all day for Nick to show up "sometime", he never did, no call no nothing.  So I ended up having to waste a whole day and I am still left with a partially dismantled tub/shower and a charge against my credit card for an incomplete job.

I know these folks have cell phones, Bill called Nick (at least twice) while he was at the house to make sure he would be out to finish the job and he sent him pictures of the existing faucet stems so he would know what to bring.  But no call from Bill saying he would be late and no call from Nick saying he was not going to make it.  Very very poor overall customer service plus leaving a customer with a partially dismantled tub/shower.  Not good!

reviews.author: Laura Reilly
reviews.text:
LOGAN *********was here on behalf of my insurance company, USAA. He had me show him the areas that were affected by the leak, and then he inspected the work done to repair the leak as well as the repairs being done to the wall board, pedestal, and the efforts to dry the carpet and everything that was affected. ***
********************ERIC********************
In February - I had a leak in a pipe at the outdoor faucet on the front of my home. Eric was sent out the next morning to evaluate the leak. After telling him what I had observed he was able to view it, assess the extent of the damage (a burst pipe) and give a reasonable quote of the cost to repair it, assuming he could remove the pipe assembly without having to open the wall. He also offered to do the same with the back yard faucet as well. I told him I wanted to do that.  He was able to remove both - the front one had about a 1 1/2 inch tear in it. The back one was beginning to tear away at the threads.  I'm very pleased with his work, his work ethic, and his offer to help me move a slightly awkward piece of furniture that had been displaced during the debacle with the H2O valve earlier. He was very positive, quick to get the work done, and personable.
******Ben Franklin Plumbing & Heating******
I would be pleased to have your employees work in/on my home any time they might be needed, and to recommend them and your company to anyone in the service area.

reviews.author: Susan S.
reviews.text: I put in a review 2 weeks ago regarding Benjamin Franklin plumbing charging me $6,754 for a bathtub install they said I had to have because they couldn't put the drain in that I needed on my old tub. Aaron the plumber did not tell me that they were going to put in a smaller tub leaving my bathroom a mess my floor is destroyed because it left 2 in without tile and it left my walls destroyed all the way around the shower and bathtub area with drywall for me to fill in by myself. If Benjamin Franklin plumbing would have told me they were going to destroy my bathroom by putting in that bathtub I would have never had them install the bathtub as I would have got another quote of gone through someone else that would not have left my bathroom a mess. When I left a review they said to contact them which I did I left message with Tasha Aaron Ryan Danielle for someone to call me and no one has called me. I am 67 years old and have no idea how to fix the tiling on the floor which is 2 to 4 in of their cement now and my walls all the way around the tub and shower that has to be drywalled and fixed. I'm putting in this review especially for the older folks that are vulnerable to be ripped off by a company like this. I would never want this to happen to anyone else. Go to any other plumbing company but do not go to Benjamin Franklin plumbing.

reviews.author: April G.
reviews.text: I saw this great video on YouTube from the evening news in Arizona about slow drainage of sinks etc. I called the number given & was referred to the Prescott Arizona location where I scheduled an appointment for them to come out to help me with my drains. I was very impressed with the products they demonstrated in the video. However, the appointment was unsuccessful. I called the number given to find out when the plumber was expected to arrive. I had scheduled for after 4 PM & agreed to pay $100.00 extra for after hours service. When I called back, a guy called "Peter" said that their scheduling computer system was "Down" & he had no way to check when the plumber was expected to arrive. At around 7PM the plumber called & said he was still in Prescott Valley, which is about an hour away. I had to cancel the appointment because it was getting late already. When I spoke with "Peter", he was rude & condescending. Based on my interaction with him, I'm not sure if I'm going to call to reschedule or not. I asked "Peter" to call a supervisor to help me. He said there was no supervisor. A company's products & services are only as good as the people who provide them. Ben Franklin himself would have been ashamed of the poor service I received. Just goes to show that what you see on  TV isn't always as good as it is in reality.

reviews.author: Kimberly R.
reviews.text:
1) GF Plumbing in Prescott, charges about $350 to $550 plus an hour so $ info on internet not even close. Quoted $1,300 to dig hole employee said would take 1-2 hrs. The parts are available on Amazon so math is simple when you get quote and ask how long job will take.

2) After completing agreed to work, BF did work that was not requested that disrupted immediate hot water to my home. I have recirculating water system where pump was turned off 5 years ago, but immediate hot water continued. This is called Thermal Syphoning, but BF didn't know anything about it even though it is part of plumbing training. Took me one second to google and figure out. Also communicated this to business, but didn't communicate to plumber.

3) BF Plumbing pressured husband to provide review on the spot. Never do this until job is completed and all issues resolved. Husband has no idea where review posted so can't undo.

4) Estimate was to replace exterior wall faucets (bibs), but didn't change even though just had to screw in vs removing dry wall and soddering. 

Highly recommend not going with this business- lots of other knowledgeable , reasonably priced licensed contractors out there.

reviews.author: Steve B.
reviews.text: i had 2 sinks in our master bath that were leaking from the hot and cold handles.  these guys showed up and proceeded to provide a quote of over $900.00 for replacing 4 valves in the sink.  along with a new shut off valve that couldnt coast more than $18.00 to buy.  everything was clean and ready for replacement.  however they said that they needed to go ba k to the shop for the parts, mind you these are standard plumbing parts and home depot or Lowes carry them.  i said is that the best price you can quote.  he then said that he could drop the price by over $200.00.   my statement to him was why did I have to ask for a discount.?   he had no answer....  in other words they are out to rip off the public.  I went to a plumbing parts business, bought the necessary parts and finished the job myself for less than $200.00.  these is the worst business that I have ever done business with.  i tried to contact management but was told they dont have access  to any supervisors. dont do business with this company .   The plumber that gave me the quote said he did not want to finish the job, so I put the handles back together myself.  Will not recommend this company ever.

reviews.author: John Fournier
reviews.text:
I paid a hundred and twenty nine dollars for the plumber to diagnose and estimate the cost to install two toilets that I had already purchased. the cost estimate was $300. The first one was installed, and then the second one was installed except for the one foot hose between the valve and the toilet. The current one that we had was a few inches short. The plumber called back to his home office and they said it would be $379 additional for this ten dollar item. This is extortion, and should have been estimated upfront with the hundred and twenty nine dollar initial inspection and estimate.  when the plumber was done.I asked him if he normally caulked the base of the toilet at the tile. he said, oh yeah, I should do that. see the pictures of the horrible caulk job. so between the extortion
And the poor caulk job... The rating is appropriate. i am pretty sure that this posting will not make it onto this company's website and I will not be using them again. disappointed. the plumber showed up on time and was courteous explaining the 2 stars.

reviews.author: Katherine K.
reviews.text:
Do not trust this company! If you do have them come to inspect or maintain your AC/Heating or other appliances watch their every move! And don't buy into their "Hero's maintenance free," program! It's not any maintenance at all!
Each time they come they will leave you a long list of expensive replacement parts for parts that are still working perfectly fine. They use scare tactics like "Oh this $10,000 unit might last you another 6 months to a year! If you don't watch them carefully you will be lucky if anything continues to operate after they leave! 
I watched the guy take a metal hard bristle brush and brush my motherboard to my ac with it... he claimed the motherboard was dirty but it looked clean to me. Metal brushes on a motherboard? Very questionable this company!

synthesis.summary: Technicians like Eric, Aaron, and Tom consistently impress in person, but pricing complaints are loud and frequent — multiple customers report bills of $800–$2,000 for jobs they later found could be done for half the cost or less.
strengths: Named technicians (Eric, Aaron, Tom, Andrew, Nick, Robert) earn repeated praise across at least 8 reviews for professionalism, punctuality, and going above and beyond
Same-day and emergency response confirmed across multiple reviews, including a septic emergency and trenching in frozen ground on short notice
Workmanship quality is consistently clean — at least 3 reviews cite thorough, efficient work with no mess left behind
weaknesses: Pricing is a recurring complaint across at least 5 reviews — customers describe $902 for an unresolved clog, $2,000 for a minor backflow repair with $25 in parts, and an $800 quote for a hose bib part that turned out to be readily available elsewhere

Follow-through on callbacks and dispute resolution is unreliable — two reviews describe being promised manager callbacks that never came, and one describes customer service hanging up after a failed job
redFlags: Two separate reviews describe a technician arriving without standard tools — one had to borrow the customer's snake, and a $902 charge was levied for a drain that remained clogged after the visit
One review alleges a technician filed a false report back at the office (claiming the customer refused access), suggesting a pattern of accountability avoidance when jobs go wrong

The extreme platform gap (Google 4.7 vs. Yelp 1.9) combined with one reviewer explicitly accusing the company of removing negative reviews from its own site raises credibility concerns about the Google rating's representativeness
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Confirmed emergency availability including a same-day septic response and outdoor trenching in freezing conditions; one holiday-adjacent review (Dec 24) shows technician deployment, suggesting meaningful after-hours or holiday coverage.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.7 stars across 1,041 reviews while Yelp sits at 1.9 across 35 — a stark 2.8-star gap — with Yelp reviews concentrating on billing disputes, unresolved repairs, and one allegation that the company actively removes negative reviews from its own platform.

reviews.author: Rusty Brown
reviews.text: I contacted Miracle man on 2/25/26 and was immediately put on the books for a free estimate the next day. Ron came out and he was efficient and personable from the get go. He did a wonderful job and was able to fix our problem at the time of the estimate. The price was very reasonable. I would recommend Ron and Miracle Man to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Jessup Goldbergcook
reviews.text:
The owner, Caleb, is an outstanding guy. I had called to ask a few questions about relighting a water heater that was giving me some trouble. He patiently walked me through the steps over the phone, and I was able to get the water heater lit with no problems at all. It’s rare to find someone so willing to take the time to help.
I would highly recommend Miracle Man Plumbing to anyone in the area who wants to hire a company they can truly rely on. Their professionalism, honesty, and genuine customer care really set them apart. 5 Stars!!!

reviews.author: Jake Eddy
reviews.text: Michael Mikey, Mike Caleb and Neil are superstars. I am overly impressed. I have some background in Plumbing and what they did how they did it how they priced it. I wouldn’t have it any other way top not true just 10 stars if I could.

reviews.author: Joeseph H.
reviews.text:
On the upside they showed up quickly the Monday after Christmas.  They did get the sewer snaked and draining in about an hour, maybe hour and a half. 

On the downside, they had 75 foot spools for their snake, not a 150 and charged me $150 per spool for a total of $300 which is pretty much a new record price for snaking a drain.    I think they used maybe 20 ft of the second spool. 

Next time I will wait until my regular plumber gets back from vacation.  For the difference in price I could have stayed in a hotel for three days.

reviews.author: Annessa M.
reviews.text: What an incredible waste of time and money. The price changed from 800 to 1200 in 2 minutes. Can be done tonight was yes then tomorrow then I'll have to check our schedule. They promised to check in Friday after Thanksgiving because we were by their advice living without water and did not show up then...after we called said they had no one to send. Monday after we got in touch...we were completely forgotten....we were given a time of 1 to 3 and we got a call for on the way at 3:20. We had dug out problem...he said it was not far enough. I said go ahead and do it. Then he could not give a time. In his flustering around I got upset about a huge amount of run around and fluctuating pricing and he said it was better they not work with us. Here we sit without water and a broken main dug out and ready for a coupler and a very bad taste from the explanation of all those others out there with frozen pipe issues. Do not....I repeat do not call them. This company is an exercise in frustration run by idiots.

reviews.author: Kellogg P.
reviews.text:
Don't know what turnip truck the other reviewers fell off of but I had nothing but quality service from the Miracle man and his crew.   They removed a 19 year old clogged 40-gallon propane hot water heater with a brand new 21st century system.  
Efficient and professional customer service team with crew boss Juaquin at the helm.  
But I was NOT getting hot water into the house.  Heater cycled like supposed to but not sending needed hot water to shower or sink.  
I called Miracle Man plumbing again and asked why not?  Then the propane system had to be checked to ensure there were no leaks in the lines.  When the Amerigas tech inspected my propane system to the water heater the next day,  he RED tagged the water heater for safety reasons.  The thermo coupler failed to maintain the flame. 
Miracle Man Juaquin returned to inspect the problem and ordered a new burner plate.  He returned and installed that.  The gas guy cleared the red tag violation and my water heater cranks out hot water with vigor.  
Nothing short of quality service, friendly reassuring crew boss that this will be fixed.   And it was above and beyond my expectations.  Wonderful customer service and follow through fixes.  Price was worth the quality product install and Miracle Man lived up to its name - literally!!.  Thanks for a job well done.

As for the reviewer who dissed them for solar power, don't call a plumber.  Miracle man respected my existing solar power grid and answered my questions about how the propane heater and solar power work together.  There is a solar company in Flagstaff called Solar Plus or some such name.  Google it.  They are who should install your panels and get you a quality system.  Solar is initially expensive to install but they are the go-to-guys for solar anything in Northern Arizona.  Not your plumber!!

reviews.author: David B.
reviews.text:
I called Miracle Man Plumbing because I needed a gas pipe moved that was behind our gas range, and an outside faucet replaced. They were prompt in getting here and installed the faucet. While there were here I also had them change out a washer in another outside faucet that was leaking. Joe spent about 30 - 45 seconds looking at modifying the gas pipe to the range and said he could do it but I would have to have a contractor here to cut a hole in the floor so he could work. The invoice had on it:
 "Replaced frost BIBB and Diagnosis for gas $375.00"
"New washer in BIBB - no warranty $32.50"
"TOTAL $417.50"
Where is the line item breakdown?
How much did he charge me for the 30 - 45 second diagnosis? And what does that mean.
Is this what it will cost me to do the job? Oh wait, I already paid that amount I guess the actual job will be another $350.00.
When Joe sent Joaquin out to do the job he wanted a 24 x 18 hole in the floor (where a one inch pipe came through) then asked "Where is your permit?" I said "Joe didn't say anything about needing a permit to modify the pipe when he change me $417.50 for the 30 - 45 minute job he did the on the first visit". At this Joaquin left the premises. 
I do not recommend this over priced plumber and stretched giving them one star.
I have a recommendation for the "The Plumbing Store" and will call them for a free estimate.

reviews.author: Mike F.
reviews.text:
I had a water main leak and contacted Miracle Man to get it fixed. Joaquin visited the site promptly and assessed the situation. Since I previously had other water main leaks, we explored replacing all water main lines (it's for a four unit building). The quote started getting extremely high. But after talking it over with my wife, we agreed to proceed.

Unfortunately once the utility surveys were complete, the quote went up substantially from the original quote due to the complexity of replacing all four lines. My wife and I decided to have Joaquin repair the line instead. While this cost was much more reasonable, it was still pricey.

Joaquin and Miracle Man are responsive, easy to talk to and the work seems to be done with quality. Joaquin showed me the PEX tubing that failed and took the time to explain the likely cause of failure. Overall I am satisfied with their work.

There's never an easy way to state that while I am very satisfied with the outcome, I never cease to be amazed at the cost. Given that I have had other similar water main leaks repaired at this location, Miracle Man pricing was a little higher but in line with other plumbers I have used.

reviews.author: Michael Harrington
reviews.text:
We needed a gas plumber for our new gas stove.  We had an prior issue with the gas connection we had and needed it modified quickly due to kitchen renovations.  We called on a Saturday thinking we would leave a message, and were very surprised to have a very pleasant woman to answer the phone. She scheduled an appointment for us for the following Monday morning (Federal Holiday).

Ron arrived on time and was able to troubleshoot the problem and he gave us a reasonable estimate to repair it.  He went out, bought the necessary parts, and quickly solved our issue.  Ron was polite, professional, shows great pride in his work, and was excellent to work with.  The repair was done efficiently for a very reasonable price.  For any future plumbing needs (gas or water) we will DEFINITELY choose Miracle Man.  We highly recommend them!

Ron arrived on time and was able to troubleshoot the problem and he gave us a reasonable estimate to repair it.  He went out, bought the necessary parts, and quickly solved our issue.  Ron was polite, professional, shows great pride in his work, and was excellent to work with.  The repair was done efficiently for a very reasonable price.  For any future plumbing needs (gas or water) we will DEFINITELY choose Miracle Man.  We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Rick Ulmer
reviews.text: Caleb, Michael and Neil are a fantastic team. I would refer them to anyone and without a doubt Miracle Man Plumbing would give the task 110% effort.  Caleb was given a difficult task of finding a leak in the main sewage drain, dug down six feet in a small front yard.  His team had a “Can Do” attitude the three days they worked.  Pulled out boulders and huge roots to clear the drain.  This problem affected all water related appliances in the house.  Prior to leaving, the team ensured all appliances were cleared and the huge mess was cleaned up. I also need to give Stephanie a member of admin staff a positive shout out.  She kept us informed and ensured we were billed accurately.  Outstanding job!   If you need a miracle accomplished call Miracle Man Plumbing.

reviews.author: Chuck Walker
reviews.text:
Caleb D came to my home. I hired to do a simple drain and flush my water heater for $67 as stated on their ad. He is high pressure and advised me $2,000 was needed to repair my problems. Three dealing with the water heater now 7 years old and one dealing with a bad job done by a previous plumber.  I declined due to the bait and switch as well as high pressure sales pitch
My new plumber referred bythe contractor who built my home came and reviewed all details given by Caleb in their written proposal. Only one is needed and the bad job by a previous plumber is what I'm doing. Beware bait and switch.

reviews.author: Nancy P.
reviews.text: We are having new tile flooring installed in our bathrooms.  Upon the contractors trying to reseat one of the toilets they told us the plumbing coming out from the wall was leaking so they couldn't move forward until we had a plumber out to fix it.  We started calling plumbers at 3:30 p.m. and Joe was the only one that called back right away.  I didn't think anybody would be able to come out that day but Joe was here within an hour and fixed us up right away so our tile contractors could continue their work.  Thanks so much for both your quick response and quality work!

reviews.author: Lizette Knorr
reviews.text:
Neil was absolutely AWESOME!!  We appreciated his candor and professional demeanor in what was quite an embarrassing situation. He made a point to explain everything he was doing and why, as well as do's and don'ts and pointers to maintain a good septic system. Neil, thank you! You ROCK!

01/27/2026
Had the same issue again and again, Neil came out and explained everything perfectly to our understanding, as well as what measures to take for the future to maintain our plumbing based on the anatomy of the plumbing. Thank you again Neil!!

reviews.author: Daniel A Solomon
reviews.text: We had a great experience especially with Neil who did a phenomenal job installing our custom water softener and RO drinking system with impressive attention to detail. He took the time to explain the technical specs of the setup and ensured the plumbing was clean, secure, and professional-grade. The water quality is now excellent, and the entire workspace was left spotless when the project was finished. I highly recommend their services for anyone looking for a high-quality, reliable installation. Ask for Neil!

synthesis.summary: Shows up on holidays and weekends with skilled crews, but pricing complaints are consistent enough that you should get a competitor quote before authorizing major work
strengths: Holiday and weekend availability confirmed by multiple reviews: answered phones on a Saturday, dispatched on the day before Thanksgiving, worked on a Federal Monday holiday

Named technicians (Caleb, Ron, Neil, Michael) praised repeatedly across independent reviews for punctuality, professionalism, and leaving job sites clean — suggesting quality is team-wide, not one lucky tech

Complex jobs handled competently: 6-foot sewage excavation completed in 3 days with full cleanup, root-line camera inspection, recirculation pump leak fixed same visit with proactive future-issue catch
weaknesses: Pricing runs above market on at least 3 independent reviews spanning 2017–2025: water heater install cited at $200–300 over competitors, drain snake billed at $300 for a job others charge far less, and a 2025 reviewer noted 'seemed a bit pricey' even while giving 5 stars

One detailed 1-star account (2022) describes a quote jumping from $800 to $1,200 within minutes, missed follow-up calls, and a technician walking off a job mid-dig — though no BBB complaints exist, this pattern of quote instability appears in earlier reviews too
redFlags: Quote escalation mentioned in at least 2 reviews across different years (2017, 2022): one reviewer saw water heater pricing above market with no explanation, another experienced an on-site price jump of $400 — ask for written estimates before work begins

One reviewer (2022) reports being left without water for days after a miscommunication, with the technician ultimately refusing to complete the job — isolated but serious given the emergency-plumbing context
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: answered live on a Saturday, dispatched the day before Thanksgiving, responded within one hour on a same-day emergency call per a 2021 review — this company appears genuinely reachable and deployable outside business hours
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 stars across 436 reviews while Yelp shows 3.8 across 24 — the Yelp pool surfaces more of the pricing and reliability complaints, suggesting Google's near-perfect score may not reflect the full range of customer experiences

reviews.author: geani ronne
reviews.text:
Stellar Plumbing was referred to me by my neighbors snd Duayne was FANTASTIC !
My wster heater went out and he came out within 39 minutes and had s new one installed the next morning on a Saturday !
His price was so reasonable and $36000 LESS than another company.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Stellar Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jacob Wright
reviews.text: Duane answered my call at 6pm in the evening and met me at my property at 8am the next morning.  He did a clean, professional job replacing a bad hot water heater that was leaking.  Not the cheapest price but definitely a fair price and he showed up and got the job done the next day.  I recommend Stellar Plumbing.

reviews.author: shihancheng
reviews.text: Duane was referred to me by my realtor, and I couldn’t be happier with how the project turned out. He truly had my best interests in mind—budget-conscious and never tried to upsell. He returns calls and shows up on time, which is rare these days. I highly recommend Stellar Plumbing and Duane!

reviews.author: Melissa R.
reviews.text: He is an unlicensed contractor and he says bad things about other people. I was even threatened for my last review. Not a good person all around.

reviews.author: Bill W.
reviews.text: On a Sunday we had a sewer blockage and called a YELP highly rated plumber in Prescott.  In fact, YELP had him second.  He came and spent all day clearing the blockage.  When he arrived we informed him we had a home warranty that would reimburse us for the cost but needed to know if it would be under $500.  He said yes but a few hours later said it would now be over $500.  We called the warranty company for authorization and they said OK.  He finally finished to the tune of $975 but we weren't worried.  He gave us a generic receipt without his company's name or address on it.  We sent it to the warranty company and they said it was unacceptable.  We asked them to send us a proper receipt but all they did was type one with still no address or company name.  Then we looked at Stellar's website and, down at the very bottom in nearly greyed out letters it says "Not a licensed contractor".  That should tell any new prospective customers all you need to know.

reviews.author: Midge V.
reviews.text:
We had a sudden backup in our basement and started calling the list of plumbers in our area. We reached "Stellar Plumbing" and thankfully he said he'd come the next day. He came 15-20 min late, but they all seem to do this..
 He worked nearly 5 hrs and it looks like he did a good job. For that we applaud him...and remain grateful.
  Our first error not asking him for an estimate. He'd been here before and I had no problem with what he charged then. 
 However we have a problem now. 
 To start we foolishly thought he was licensed and didn't ask. 
  I left soon when he got here, but he gave my husband the bill and he about fainted! He charged us for new motor which he installed, it was in his billing~ the price was what we'd expect for that...
 But he also charged us $800.00 for labor~$1172.50 total. My husband wrote the check knowing it was too high~ but he didn't know what else to do. 
 We then stopped the check until we could sort out the high billing. 
 When we finally reached him with our decision he was angry, defending his bill to the ground. He faulted us for not asking for the estimate, that is our bad. I guess he's right about that.
 He left a large black sewery mess when he clean out the thing where the motor was...and then left that mess right by our stairs. 
 He's a good man I'm sure, but he gouged us plain and simple. I want people to learn from our mistakes. Had we done these things. I believe it would have gone better. So beware and cover these bases.

reviews.author: David W.
reviews.text:
So, about a month ago a friend of mine had a clogged toilet at her vacation house.  A friend had recommended Duanae at Stellar Plumbing.  It was a straightforward non-emergency problem that just needed a snake job, and Duane was done in no time.  
NOW HERE IS THE STORY...  
Like I said this is a vacation home, so there had no been a lot of activity in the house, and it was clogged again this morning.  I called Duane, and told him I was a friend and we had another clog at the house.  Duane said I will be there within the hour.  20 minutes later, here is Duane out of his van and looking at the same trap he had fixed a month ago.  In five minutes, the drain was unclogged, and I asked what happened, he said, "It looks like the paper froze."  Not any deficiency in his work, just the weather and a bad sewer pipe depth, (House grade is below street grade to sewer), and the fact that we had not run hot water in over a week.  Duane was here for about twenty minutes, we ran a bunch of hot water and he cleared everything he could reach.  
Charge = $0, as a guarantee of his work...  I couldn't believe it.  Hence I am writing a review.  If you are in Prescott, I have a plumber for you.

Cheers,

David

reviews.author: Darkside U.
reviews.text: I wouldn't recommend Duane for anything. He took a whole month to unclog my tub faucet in which he diagnosed wrong at first. He had no follow up, I had to follow up with him. He way over charged me. He tried to charge me almost 1400 for about maybe 3 1/2 hrs of labor and $30 worth of vinegar. When he first came, he had no concern for my house with his dirty boots and laying his dirty tools on my high dollar counters. I had to spend an hour cleaning the grease off my counter and tub. He talks nice to you, but he looks to see how much he can get out of you all the while telling you he is saving you money. My opinion, he is a smooth talking con man. Just business nothing personal, that is how I for see him doing business. Oh, and he scratched up my almost $400 tub spout in which I will have to get that replaced. Just a careless guy looking to hustle a buck out of people. Im a pretty easy going go, do not say much and will usually just eat to let the other person have the upper hand. But this was so bad I had to call him out on it. He did nt bend, accept for $200. I was so upset I just wanted him out of my house. Great job, pulled that robbery off without a gun. Smooth!

reviews.author: Craig C.
reviews.text: Replace a hot water heater to say installed previously evidently six years ago. Don't believe it was that long. I messed up and didn't write the date on the hot water heater like I always do when I have a problem this one was out of warranty by two months three months and they wouldn't give me any warranty on it the new one that they installed that was installed today had a manufactures date of April 2023 so the water heater that I bought today is already six months out of warranty. I question how come there's not a leniency on it that this one sit in a warehouse and then when I if I have problems, then I am the one responsible for it because of the manufactures date very disappointed in it, the crew that did the work did a fantastic job on the previous job when they installed the previous one I had a plastic pan and they told me that it was against code that I had to have a metal pan and so they charge me for a metal pan and also the new installer said that I had to have stainless steel supply lines and the previous guys use my old lines so I'm just very disappointed in some of the things that happened on this but I am impressed with the team that installed it

reviews.author: Kerry Johnson
reviews.text:
Duane is so dependable and thorough.   We first contacted him out sheer random luck (thanks, Google!)  when we were vacationing in Maine and had to talk to him about a plumbing/water-leaking issue that happened in our home in Prescott when we were away and my parents (bless them, why does it always happen like this, right?) were at our house.     I believe the issue was a clog from roots growing into the pipe that runs from the house to the street.  After we returned home a few days later, there was a secondary issue.  Duane said the downstairs toilet needed to come out so he could get at the issue and since we hated that too-low 1960s toilet anyway, we had him install a new one.  No problems for almost 2 years.

Now almost 2 years later, one night recently we had a smaller water-leaking issue downstairs again, and sure enough he was out here by 10am the next morning and rootered the pipe again.

I think our plumbing issues are caused by the fact that we live on a steep hill in town with tons of foliage on our property.  So root growth is probably going to be a frequent issue to contend with.  I’m glad we have Duane’s number in our phone contacts!

reviews.author: Mary D.
reviews.text: Duane from Stellar Plumbing was honest and knowledgeable and seemed to care much more about being helpful and maintaining his good reputation than making as much money off my service call as possible.  I gave him a list of pesky plumbing problems and for several he explained strategies for us to either fix it or further investigate the problem ourselves.  For the garbage disposal, he confirmed what I suspected (but didn't say) that it was still functioning fine even though something is stuck in it and making noise.  He said we could wait and see if the object either works its way down and resolves itself or if we need a new disposal.  In the end he rounded down the amount of time he spent working on our problems and undercharged us.  I said something about that and he pretty much said he wanted to treat customers well and keep a good reputation.  He's seems to be a straight-up honest guy and I'm glad to have found a plumber like him.

reviews.author: Jim Kelley
reviews.text:
Duane is absolutely great. We've called on a number of occasions for various problems - each of them difficult, some of them emergencies. He always arrives just in the nick of time, and figures out what the problem is and advises of the best way to deal with it.

Our most difficult problem (for us, not for him) had to do with sewer stoppages and backups. Turned out it was a broken and malfunctioning backup valve. Someone had broken in by improperly snaking the cleanout. To make things worse, the builder had installed the valve four feet below ground and it was nearly impossible to service. But Duane figured out a way to do it - in fact, he made a tool for it.

And there have been several other problems like this that has solved for us quickly and at a fair price. We're so happy to have found Stellar Plumbing. Big problems for us always turn out to be small problems for them.

reviews.author: Michael Shawn G.
reviews.text:
Pretty sad when you ask you you are speaking with, and they won't even give you their NAME? 

ANY SERVICE INDUSTRY is reliant upon the CUSTOMER! Treat people as you would like to be treated and you will do well...  Obviously there's a reason this Plumber didn't want to tell me his name!
 
Absolutely nothing "STELLAR" about the Service from this company!
(They don't even answer the VERY FIRST question I had... which was "Whom am I speaking with?")  I wouldn't call this company for SERVICE if they refuse to answer me in a PROFESSIONAL MANNER!

Maybe it's time for some "COMPETITION" in the Plumbing Business in the West Valley, and surrounding communities? The way the area is GROWING... Methinks there's way too much Demand, and not enough REAL SERVICE!

I called "Roadrunner Plumbing" in Surprise, and they will be out later today!

reviews.author: Jim P.
reviews.text: Bought a 20 year-old house recently, that had been used extensively as a rental. Needless to say there were a lot of things in the way of maintenance that were sadly neglected. One of those areas was the plumbing system. We called Duane because we previously had outstanding service from him at our primary residence. We had him out on several occasions to address leaks, faulty shut-off valves, etc.  He also installed a new water heater and an instant hot water system. He was always very responsive, showed up as scheduled, completed the work expeditiously, and did a first rate job on each and every task. Very professional and took the time to explain what the problem was what caused it, and what he did to rectify it. He will be our go-to guy for all our future plumbing needs. Highly recommended, you won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Candy H.
reviews.text:
I called to ask Stellar a few questions but found out they dont travel all the way to Camp Verde...which is understandable. Even so, I was given some excellent information on trouble shooting and what i could do as well as a professional opinion on sleeving my septic. I have 2" cast iron, sleeving makes it smaller, I think thats bad. Stellar agreed it would be better to go to 3 " new septic lines and I am really happy I had this conversation as the sleeving costs were so high already and dont include P traps.
I really appreciate that even though he would make nothing from this conversation, he was generous with information and offered great suggestions for ways to check my incoming water pressure. He also answered the phone right away...wish he could be my plumber.

synthesis.summary: Duane personally answers calls at 10:30pm and shows up within 45 minutes for emergencies, but two separate reviews raise unlicensed contractor concerns that could matter for insurance and warranty claims.
strengths: Exceptional emergency response speed: at least 6 reviews cite arrival within 30-45 minutes for after-hours or weekend calls, including holidays
Dramatically competitive pricing: multiple reviews cite fair rates, one specifically noting a quote $36,000 less than a competitor for the same job
Consistent phone accessibility: 4+ reviews praise Duane for answering calls same evening or offering free phone troubleshooting before dispatching
weaknesses: One reviewer documented a recurring sewage drain repair that failed twice within two weeks, ultimately requiring a different plumber to resolve
At least one reviewer noted receipts lacked company name and address, creating problems with home warranty reimbursement
redFlags: Two independent reviews from different years (2019, 2020) explicitly state Stellar Plumbing is not a licensed contractor — this is corroborated by text on the company's own website. For burst pipe claims, insurance or home warranty reimbursement may be denied if work is performed by an unlicensed plumber
The 2019 1-star reviewer alleged being threatened after leaving a negative review — unverifiable but worth noting given the pattern of otherwise near-universal 5-star ratings
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals across multiple reviews: documented arrivals within 39-45 minutes of late-night calls, confirmed Sunday and holiday availability, and direct personal response from Duane at 10:30pm — this is a realistic option for a 2am burst pipe call.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 vs Yelp at 4.4, a meaningful 0.5-star gap — the two licensing-related 1-star reviews appear on Yelp and may be driving the lower score there.

reviews.author: Bree Fitzgerald
reviews.text: Lawhorn did a fabulous job working with us on our remodel! Moved the water heater to a whole new room, fixed various other water and gas leaks they found along the way, plus much more! They collaborated and communicated with my contractor to make sure everything was done smoothly. Skip and Kassandra are awesome! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: K L
reviews.text: Awesome company, came out to check on my water heater I've been having issues with. Gave me a diagnosis on the water heater and an estimate if I wanted to replace it. The technician Skip was extremely helpful very understanding and answered all questions I had. I highly recommend this company for anyone's plumbing needs. 10/10 service.

reviews.author: Jessie Weber
reviews.text: We were notified by the town of Prescott Valley that our water usage exceeded 500 gallons two days ago and 900 gallons the day before. I called Lawhorn Plumbing and was greeted by Kassandra.  I asked her if they would be able to accommodate an emergency same-day service call. She said she would check and promptly called me back within five minutes. Within one hour the owner, Skip, was at my house.  He did a thorough diagnosis of all of my bathrooms, toilets, and outside spigots.  He then proceeded to run a test of usage at the water main.  It was the determined that the issue was with the water meter. Skip proceeded to correct an issue that I was having with low water pressure on one of the outdoor spigots by clearing the sediment and adjusted the water level on both of our toilets. The total cost was more than reasonable for the education and prompt,, courteous, and outstanding customer service that I received. We have found a new plumber for life andI cannot recommend this company enough.

reviews.author: Apryl P
reviews.text:
Exceptional Service from Katt, Skip and the team at Lawhorn Plumbing!

I cannot recommend Lawhorn Plumbing highly enough, especially the stellar service provided by Katt and Skip! From start to finish, they exhibited professionalism, expertise, and genuine care for the job at hand.

Skip’s attention to detail and technical prowess ensured that every aspect of the plumbing issue was addressed promptly and effectively. Their knowledge and skill were evident throughout the entire process, putting me at ease knowing that my plumbing concerns were in capable hands.

Skip's friendly demeanor and commitment to customer satisfaction made the entire experience seamless. They communicated clearly, answered all my questions, and went above and beyond to ensure that I was completely satisfied with the work done.

Together, Katt and Skip make an unbeatable team, and Lawhorn Plumbing is lucky to have them. If you're in need of plumbing services, look no further than Lawhorn Plumbing. With professionals like Katt and Skip on their team, you can trust that your plumbing needs will be met with excellence every time.

Thank you for  your outstanding service!

reviews.author: Roger Dane
reviews.text: It's no accident that there are many reviews with 'five stars'. And it is a rarity in today's world that someone delivers on the promise of 'a job well done' but Lawhorn Plumbing did (and apparently does) for  us. A complex job of hooking up a second propane tank under permit to a whole house generator that had been put off way too long was finally completed and for a very reasonable price. We learned of Lawhorn thru our HVAC company (Mountain Air) and are very happy. Job done cleanly and without issues or incident and all ready to fire up our emergency generator. Skip and Kassandra were very communicative, always kept us abreast of their job intent and rapid. Came on time, told us 'what was happening' and completed on their time table just as planned. Remarkable. They are keepers and you won't be disappointed. They do smaller jobs as well. We will have 'em back for a 'hot water' tank issue.

reviews.author: Tina Provenzano
reviews.text: Lawhorn plumbing is truly the best! I moved to Prescott one year ago. I had issues in my home and my barn that other plumbers tried to fix and couldn’t! My issue in the barn was stumping everyone, all of them coming up with the same solution that didn’t work. That is, until Skip came out! He came up with a brand new solution that not only worked but was more water efficient and saved me $2,000! All of his guys are amazing and Kassandra’s customer service and follow up skills are beyond reproach! I am so grateful to have found them and will NEVER turn anywhere else! Save yourself a lot of headaches and call them FIRST… You will be so glad you did!

reviews.author: A Rebmann
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about this company! Lawhorn does an amazing job! They are the only company we ask to do our repairs. Since moving out of state l, we have had a few issues come up at our home in Prescott Valley. Kassandra got us scheduled in a timely manner, kept us updated on the price, and progress along with photos of the repair. The communication from this company is top tier! Any questions were answered quickly by either Skip or Kassandra. All of their crew have been amazing. I loved that they also recommended a local landscaper to fix our property after the repair. Love supporting small family owned businesses!

reviews.author: Tomas C
reviews.text: Above and Beyond service! Not only did they flush the nasty out of my water heater. They corrected issues that other plumbers had failed to fix. Wait there is more. My water heater was set to magma and they corrected that too and that is saving hundreds on my electric bill. Kassandra was very nice to talk to and schedule while skip and his helper did an amazing job thoroughly explaining the process and what they found in my home. I am definitely having them back for a whole house water filtration system and any plumbing needs. I recommend them for being honest, well priced and dedicated to helping out their customers

reviews.author: Fatima Avila
reviews.text:
I gotta give a shoutout to Lawhorn Plumbing LLC! These guys are awesome! It’s so great to support a local, family-owned business, and these folks really know their stuff.

What I love most, though, is their fair pricing. It’s hard to find a trustworthy plumber who won’t charge you an arm and a leg. But Lawhorn Plumbing is different. They fixed my plumbing issue without emptying my wallet.

I’m telling all my friends and family about them because good service at a good price is hard to come by these days. If you need plumbing help, these are the folks to call. Thanks, Lawhorn Plumbing!

reviews.author: Dakri Sutton
reviews.text: I highly recommend Lawhorn Plumbing!  Skip was able to change the plumbing from a tub to shower and move the plumbing for a new vanity sink location.  He went above and beyond and talked to my husband about a lot of helpful recommended maintenance items related to the toilets, sinks and hot water heater.  He is very knowledgeable and skilled and always showed up when he said he would which is not always the case with contractors.  We had an extremely positive experience with Lawhorn Plumbing and already have additional work scheduled with them.

reviews.author: dorothy haitoff
reviews.text:
From the first contact to finishing up, the experience was above and beyond what I expected.
Skip was very patient with all my questions and gave many tips that we can do in the future to save time and money. He is kind, very knowledgeable and a pleasure to be around.
Kassandra is also a reason this is a great company. She got back to my call quickly and has a wonderful demeanor.
We have a plumber we trust now and have the peace of mind knowing who to call if something comes up again.
Thank you Lawhorn plumbing!!!

reviews.author: Magdalena Waidner
reviews.text: A big shout-out to Lawhorn Plumbing LLC  for a great remodel job on our bathroom!!!!  From demolition to installing new tub, toilet, and fixtures, they were so careful about keeping the rest of the house as clean and dust free as possible, and we couldn't be happier with the results!!!! Beautiful job!!! Thank you to Skip, Tory, and Zack.  We even had some extra plumbing stuff done because they were so professional.  Lawhorn Plumbing will definitely be our go to plumbing company!

reviews.author: Jeff Hale
reviews.text: Before Mr Lawhorn left to Arizona, I had him work on many problems I had with electrical, my water heater, house fans, and so many other little things that continued getting old in my house. I was so bummed out when he chose to leave my area because he always did such a great job. Many years later everything he worked on in my house is still working great. I would recommend Mr Lawhorn to anyone that needs something done. I have never met a more honest man than him.

reviews.author: Alex Crapo
reviews.text: Super happy with my new tankless water heater! Over the last couple months this company has helped me on several projects in my new home with great results. They are quick to respond, pleasant to work with, reasonable pricing, and did an excellent job on the water heater installation. I really appreciate the extra effort that went into fixing the old venting and running pipe so that I can keep an eye on the relief line for the unit. Can not recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Melissa Sharpe
reviews.text: I'm a Realtor here in the Prescott area. I had an issue with leaking/ running toilets at a listing that was costing the homeowner $$!  I spoke with Cassandra first. She heard my problem and got Skip out that same day. He had the comodes diagnosed and fixed in less than an hour! Both! The homeowner was very pleased with the work AND The price! Skip is on MY real estate TEAM now!!

synthesis.summary: Skip and Kassandra run a tight family operation where the owner himself shows up within an hour for emergencies, fixes what other plumbers couldn't, and charges prices customers repeatedly call 'more than reasonable'.
