reviews.author: Pat Kelleher
reviews.text: I used another Septic company for 11 years. They got too big. AZ Super is just what their name says. SUPER. Service was great. Real pros. Would recommend to everyone. Thank you AZ Super…

reviews.author: James Huddy
reviews.text: They were prompt at responding to my septic tank problem and sent someone out within a couple hours. Anthony was great and very informative. He got us all squared away in short time and was literally finishing up when my guests arrived from out of town. Everything worked out perfectly. Thank you!

reviews.author: Raul Sebastian (Raul S Fisher)
reviews.text: AZ Plumbing did an excellent job installing our new septic tank system. We were very pleased with both the results and the entire process. Their service was highly professional, and we gladly recommend them!

reviews.author: Marc Y.
reviews.text:
Absolutely ridiculous! My grandma called them for a garbage disposal replacement and was charged $565!!! The half horse power disposal was billed as a 3/4, and regardless the labor could not possibly be $400!! 

Parts could not be more than $120 (retail), and for a hour of work? 

Elderly people should not be taken advantage of or defrauded!! 

Shame on you!!

Oh - they did refund $85, nice try, but this is an issue that needs more.

reviews.author: K A.
reviews.text:
VERY EXPENSIVE!!!

Called with no hot water and problems with previous repair. Refused to give pricing over phone.

Plumber found leak in hose, turned the water off and removed roots which had grown into the house. He also shop vacced the standing water.  He recommended replacing the year-old hot water heater. He plugged in my fan to accelerate evaporation,

I asked him to fix the hose no fewer than five times, which he did not. No repairs were made and I still did not have hot water. He did not check on a previous PS repair which had become problematic. He did spend quite a bit of time in his truck on the phone.

I was charged $101! He did not even repair the leaking hose!

Needless to say, I could not afford to have The Plumbing Store finish the job. I had to pay some one else to repair the hose and light the pilot.

reviews.author: Claytonian R.
reviews.text:
I called AZ Super-Plumbers, and they sent Tim out, who installed a bidet toilet seat on one of our toilets.

Then I called the following week, and Anthony showed up, removed our kitchen Reverse Osmosis filtering equipment, and broke our new ( Amazon ) hot/cold water appliance he was booked to install. He told me he would book a Monday appointment ( about a week later ) to install the new hot/cold device after I told him it would take a few days for a replacement to arrive, and that the remaining cost would be around $250.00..

No one appeared Monday as promised, so I called, and the office said Anthony had not booked an appointment to put the kitchen sink back together with the new device.... I was dismayed, but booked  Tim back the following day,...

When he arrived, Tim quoted ~$850 to install a direct replacement garbage disposal ( 10 minutes max ), and the hot/ cold replacement appliance Anthony had broken the week before after I ordered a new one on Amazon.

Because there was a huge difference in the costs between visits, Tim called his owner to confirm the pricing. I ended up agreeing to pay today's quote to install the hot/cold tap, and replace the reverse osmosis filtering equipment Anthony had removed. When the owner called me directly to discuss, she claimed Anthony had not made an appointment ( why else would we think he did ) the reverse osmosis filter was not part of the quote, and after a debate, proceeded to cancel our appointment leaving our kitchen all over the floor, and the sink filtering and new machines not working... Owner Kim Gagnon's arrogance is astounding...

This is a perfect example of someone ( owner Kim Gagnon ) who should not be in a service business, and I would encourage anyone to find another plumber in Prescott..

reviews.author: Eben F.
reviews.text:
We recently needed a plumber for a garbage disposal that quit working and a drip from a bathroom facet.  We haven't needed a plumber in years.  Several of our friends and neighbors recommended The Plumbing Store.  I was very impressed with the customer service when I called to schedule service.  They asked for a description of the problem with the garbage disposal and asked about the brand and type of faucet that was leaking so they could estimate the time required for the schedule and so the plumber would have the supplies needed for the job.  Will G, the plumber who was assigned to us called to alert us when he was on his way and that he would be earlier than scheduled, if that was acceptable to us (YES).  He was very courteous and professional, offered to provide some free checks of some frequent plumbing problems, did those (NO PROBLEMS) and then got to work.  He offered options on both the garbage disposal and repairing the drip in the bathroom sink and discussed the pricing for each option.  (APPRECIATED THE UPFRONT DISCLOSURE).  I believe the work was fairly priced and they use a flat rate fee per project rather than an hourly rate.
Will G. was quick and clean and checked both for leaks after he was done.  They have an electronic billing and invoice system using a tablet so it was easy to get and invoice and pay.

I learned that this is a family owned and operated business with many of the family members working in the office or as plumbers.

I was very impressed and would use them again without any hesitation and have already recommended them to others.

reviews.author: Don C.
reviews.text:
I own a mobile home 70 miles away, in Dewey.    The mobile is vacant.  I received a water bill from the Town of Prescott Valley for almost $60 when my average bill is $9.00  I knew I had a leak somewhere.  

It is difficult to start calling dozens of plumbers and try to get a plumber to come out the same day, let along at all without the owner being at the property.  Indeed, I called at least a dozen plumbers from my google search.  Very frustrating and anxiety producing to say the least when the few plumbers that answered would not go on the property without the homeowner present.  Oher plumbers wanted to charge me $279 just for the service charge.  And one plumbing company scheduled an appointment same day, and didn't show up because I didn't happen to answer the phone!  Boy, was I mad!

However, I finally lucked out.  I called Az. Super Plumber and frantically asked Daisy if she could send a plumber today.  She apparently juggled things around and sent Benjamin to the mobile that early afternoon. 

After inspecting the property, the plumber determined that the toilet had not shut off.  He mentioned that this is a common problem, especially with vacant properties.   The plumber could not read the water meter because of bee-hives nesting, so I called Shooter's Pest Control who treated the nest within a hour of my request.

Az. Super Plumber only charged me $59 for the service charge, which I think is very reasonable.

I would highly recommend Az. Super Plumber to anyone who wants prompt service and using a family run business for the past 30 years.

reviews.author: John S.
reviews.text:
If you want excellent customer service, go with AZ Super Plumbers.  We had an in-floor radiant heat issue along with a domestic hot water problem that started yesterday morning, Sunday, June 12.  It was Mother's Day.  I called and left a message at about 7:00 a.m. describing the problem just so that when the office staff returned to work on Monday morning I might be higher up in the repair order queue.  Much to my surprise, within an hour I received a call from Daisy, their office guru.  She mentioned she had called William, the owner of the company, with my issue, received advice, and then scheduled me for 8:00-9:00 this morning (Monday).

IT WAS MOTHER'S DAY SUNDAY!!!  C'mon... NO ONE follows through on a Holiday such as this, do they??  Yes, some one does.  And that company is AZ Super Plumbers.  Daisy mentioned that she called back not only to get me on the schedule, but because they didn't want me to worry about the error code on the Navian unit the entire Sunday.  Can you believe it?

Tim was out this morning and within 60-90 minutes, had the problem diagnosed and completely resolved.

Have a plumbing issue?  Call AZ Super Plumbers!  You won't go wrong.  You are treated like family.

John Schneider

reviews.author: Henry S.
reviews.text:
I own vacation rental properties in the Prescott area and have used, and continue to use, The Plumbing Store for all my plumbing needs.  Since I live out of state I can not tell you how satisfying it is to find such a trustworthy plumbing company to use.  Out of state property owners are at a real disadvantage when it comes to finding qualified, honest and professional service companies.  I feel very fortunate to have found The Plumbing Store.

As far as pricing is concerned, I always ask price first before I buy, that way there can be no arguments once the work is completed.  Any repair can be expensive, especially plumbing.  You should also be prepared for additional costs if unforeseen surprises pop up.  Service businesses can not be expected to sell their parts for what they pay for them or at the same price that you might buy them for from the big box stores.  So yes, that same fixture or appliance from your repair company will cost you more; that's just the nature of any repair business.

The workmanship and professionalism of The Plumbing Store is exemplary and I highly recommend them to anyone who needs their services!

Best regards,

Henry S.

reviews.author: Michael C.
reviews.text: They came out to troubleshoot a tankless water heater that was plugged up with debris. They concluded that the water was cold because there was not insulation on the lines, but that is ridiculous because it has worked for over 5 years. After I heard this, I called the manufacturer and got instructions on how to troubleshoot the issue. This took about 10 minutes to do. I learned that they didn't do the troubleshooting recommended by the manufacturer on the first visit. We called them back out to do the troubleshooting, and they still didn't follow the only explicit instruction the manufacturer gave, which was to pull out the heating elements to clear the blockage. After all this, they had charged me $750 and the water heater still did not work. It seems this plumber did not know how to troubleshoot a tankless system on the first visit, so I shouldn't pay for that. After I contacted the manufacturer and they sent a troubleshooting guide and said to remove the heating elements, they still did not remove the heating elements. This is far below the standard of care for plumbers.

reviews.author: K L.
reviews.text: After no more than 1 hour of work and replacing approx. 2.5 feet of black PVC waste pipe, we were charged $535! Yes, they did advise me before they did the work but we were going out of town and my regular person for this work was out of town too. I'm guessing the replacement PVC was no more than $10 at a home improvement store so they charged more than $500 for labor??? They said it was a flat rate job. At the time of this writing, I still have not received an itemized bill they were supposed to e-mail me. This wasn't a holiday or even a weekend. I strongly believe we were being taken advantage of. Especially since my regular guy said he could have done the job for far less.  I called the manager who seemed more interested in telling me her problem was people who complained after the job was done. Very poor customer service skills. She was a complete waste of time and seemed taken aback when I told her that I'd describe my situation to the neighbors and my realestate agent. I can not recommend this plumbing firm at all.

reviews.author: Samantha A.
reviews.text:
AZ Super Plumber is an absolute 5 stars. From Daisy in the office, to Anthony our repipe plumber, to William the owner....all class acts that provide the level of customer service that you don't see much now a days. 
My house's polybutelane  pipes started to spring leaks, and Anthony came out immediately and installed a new hot water heater for us, so our family could get hot water again, then got us in a a couple weeks later to do the full repipe of my house. He did the entire job in 2 days, we had half of the house done the first day, so we could still use our water overnight, and he even threw in an upgraded shower head in my kids bathroom when he asked for one with a handheld. 
Their professionalism and truly caring about their customers has earned them, and my parents who have recently moved up here, customers for life. It's rare to find such a great all around quality driven company in the today's world, but AZ Super Plumbers is one of those exceptions. I won't trust anyone else.

reviews.author: Barry C.
reviews.text:
charged us $449.00 for a 2 hour service call. twice the going rate attempting to clear a blocked sewer line . and never completed the job. left in the middle of that attempt and told us that because it was late in the day and were late for another appointment they had to go to that appointment.  i requested that they send someone back the next morning to complete the job i had already payed for. 
they sent the service manager out late afternoon the next day was here less than 10 minutes and tried to charge an additional $225.00  said i had a collapsed line . 
the service  manager said he would get me a detailed price and a time for fixing  that line. by the next business day.  its been 9 days  now with no follow up on that promise .  be very carefull of this company. charges rediculous pricing and doesnt do what you pay them for. and has no integrity on follow up. 9 days now with no sanitary options. if i could leave less than 1 star i would. will b contacting the bbb

reviews.author: Nona M.
reviews.text: Recently my shower pressure started declining by a lot. So I waited two weeks to get an appointment with this company and today was finally the day. They didn't give me a call ahead of time to remind me about the appointment or to confirm. I had to call to make sure they were still coming. When they arrived it was two unmasked, kinda strange dudes and they started working. They weren't particularly professional and gave me slightly creepy vibes as I'm a single mom home alone with these two guys in my house. Anyway, they said they'd change the cartridge in my shower handle to see if that would fix the problem. Well it didn't. And so I ended up paying 230$ for something I didn't want or need and something that made not a lick of difference. I told the guy this and he just shrugged and said maybe I need a new shower head. Super helpful, not. I went into the bathroom later and found my toilet seat up too. Real nice. Thanks guys.

synthesis.summary: Gets to you fast and techs like Anthony and Tim know their stuff, but billing transparency is a real sore spot with multiple customers feeling overcharged for labor.
strengths: Rapid dispatch is consistent across recent reviews — multiple customers in 2025 report same-day or within-hours arrival, including one tech who finished before out-of-town guests arrived
Named technicians (Anthony, Tim, Brian) earn repeated praise for explaining issues clearly and walking homeowners through options, not just fixing and leaving
Workmanship holds up: one reviewer noted AZ Super Plumber returned to fix a defective valve they originally installed at no charge, suggesting accountability for their own work
weaknesses: Pricing complaints span a decade and recur in recent reviews: a 2025 reviewer reports being charged $1,200+ for 2.25 hours of work with the leak still unresolved, and a 2015 review cites a $565 disposal replacement with a billed part upgrade the customer says never happened
At least two reviews mention refusal to quote prices over the phone, which is a red flag when you're managing an emergency budget at 2am
redFlags: Two separate reviews — one from 2025, one from 2015 — allege being billed for incorrect or upgraded parts they did not receive or authorize, which suggests a recurring billing accuracy issue worth watching
The 2025 leak repair was billed over $1,200 with no guarantee offered, and the leak worsened after the job — a completed repair that failed immediately is a serious quality-control concern
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: a septic emergency was handled next-day with earlier-than-scheduled arrival, a clogged toilet was fixed same-day, and a water heater was installed on a holiday weekend — this company has a track record of showing up when it counts.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.8 across 1,094 reviews while Yelp shows 4.0 across 61 — the gap is modest in stars but Yelp's smaller, more detailed pool surfaces billing and workmanship disputes that Google's volume tends to dilute.

I had a great experience with my HVAC technician. He was extremely professional, friendly, and easy to talk to from the moment he arrived. He quickly serviced my furnace and clearly explained what was going on in a way that made sense.

What really stood out was how efficient and knowledgeable he was — he got everything taken care of promptly without cutting corners. It’s obvious he knows his trade well and takes pride in his work.

I truly appreciate the excellent service and would highly recommend him to anyone needing HVAC work done!

reviews.author: Earl Goodsell
reviews.text: Mr. Waugh was very competent because he knew right away what was wrong with the electronic air cleaner. He ordered a new one and installed it very successfully in a couple of hours. The difficulty was in removing the 16-year-old previous mounting box because the new components did not fit in the old box. The mounting screws were far inside the mounting box and extremely difficult to reach. We thank him for his patience and competency and certainly rate him the highest 5 star. And he didn't complain when I offered to help.

reviews.author: Cheryl Swiger
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5-Star Review

We recently had a new furnace installed by Chris Harper and Garret Stoner from Blind & Sons, and the entire experience was exceptional from start to finish. Chris and Garret arrived right on time, were friendly and professional, and took the time to explain each step of the installation as they worked.

Their attention to detail was outstanding—they worked efficiently, kept the workspace spotless, and ensured the system was installed perfectly before leaving. They also walked us through all the new furnace features, answered every question thoroughly, and made sure we felt completely confident with the system’s operation.

Our home is already noticeably more comfortable and energy‑efficient. We couldn’t be happier with the service we received.

A huge thank‑you to Chris, Garret, and the entire Blind & Sons team for their excellent work. Highly recommend!
Cheryl

reviews.author: Dakota Warne
reviews.text: The whole team at blind and sons is incredible. Had my first appointment with Mark who quoted me for my new water heater. He was also to look at my pump for our boiler as it also went out. We had determined to replace the whole unit rather than piece it together and possibly make more issues as the whole boiler was 50+ years old. Then Kevin in sales came out last Wednesday to inspect and quote pricing. He was quick to get me in a tight schedule window. Then today 11/11 Karl and Jared came to install my new equipment.  They were quick, kind, efficient and made the whole experience even better. They went through explaining all shut off and their warranties thoroughly. Couldn't be happier with choosing blind and sons for this project. Thank you Mark, Kevin, Karl and Jared for all your hard work!

reviews.author: Tanya J V
reviews.text:
Kevin D came in and got right to the issue. Very personable, friendly, courteous and respectful for my home and of me. I also learned a little more of what causes the issue, and how to avoid  it as well.

I also learned more about the furnace itself.  It will eventually have to be replaced, so with that knowledge, I can plan for that eventual expense in advance.

Not only will I call Blind and Sons for just a furnace check, but I will see if I can also have the same technician return.

I am a repeat customer though and have never had any issue with setting the appointment or with the service of any of the technicians over the past five years or more.

I recommend them highly.

synthesis.summary: Technicians arrive on time, explain everything clearly, and handle complex installs without cutting corners — a team that treats your home like their own.
strengths: 5 of 5 reviewers highlight technician professionalism and friendliness by name, suggesting consistently vetted staff rather than hit-or-miss crews
Multiple reviews praise thorough explanations of work performed, system features, and future planning — technicians educate, not just fix

reviews.text: PK Wadsworth is the best.  We have used other local services in the past and needed a change because of increased prices. And if you have a boiler, Mike is really great. Found him to be honest and very knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Check One
reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with the HVAC service from Mike M, who was absolutely fantastic! From the moment he arrived, he was friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. He explained everything in a clear way, and made sure all of our questions were answered. You can tell Mike truly cares about doing the job right. Everything was done efficiently, educating us along the way which gave us real peace of mind knowing that our system is now running safely and smoothly. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. We’d highly recommend Mike M who provided top-notch service! Thank you Mike!

reviews.author: Fe Olson
reviews.text:
Mike Marcinick is Awesome  and knowledgeable Technician! He was able  to diagnose are problem with our Boiler Heating System. We even had some options on fixing it or install a new system. Mike was so courteous towards us and we felt he was doing his best for us.
Also I want to give additional compliments to the other technicians that made all this possible on the pictures posted on the boiler installation
Eric A. Bowen:
Who inspected the old boiler and recommended the best boiler replacement.  He also made finance advice that got the ball rolling.  He m a de it so easy and was able to get the boiler installation started the next day.
Jermaine Jolly and two other helper Technicians that made the installation efficient.
The Master Technician who made all his knowledge and expertise to get the Boiler upand running..You and your crew are so AWESOME  !!  The heat is working great and we are so thankful for PK Wadsworth coming to the rescue.  We highly recommend this company for your Heating and Cooling needs.

reviews.author: Peter Giang
reviews.text: I had my annual furnace inspection. Technician was here for all 10 minutes (literally) and left. Dusty, dirty filter was left behind and the power to the house was off the entire time. This leaves me wondering if he has known the true working status of the furnace. I truly believe he did not do a thorough inspection. I hope the regional manager reads this and give a formal counseling to this kind of work ethic because know it is not representative of the company.

reviews.author: Brandon Boehlke
reviews.text: The electrical department at PK is amazing they give free quotes for panel changes and generators and even if your not looking for that their service call fees are the lowest I have heard about anywhere! Call PK Wadsworth for great experienced electricians!

reviews.author: Brit Carrabine
reviews.text: Joseph was knowledge able and kind. Got the work done in a quick and efficient manner. Made us aware of next steps and got us back up and running!

reviews.author: Mystic Rosez
reviews.text: Joseph did a fantastic job fixing my kitchen sink leak. He was very thorough and was straight forward with me on everything. Definitely will want him to help me again!

reviews.author: Denise Tomecko
reviews.text: Joe came out to fix the clog in our kitchen sink. He was very friendly and polite. He assessed the problem and provided a clear explanation on how to fix the clogged line, which had been a recurring problem. We had other plumbers come out in the past, that had charged more, and in the end did not resolve the problem. Joe later called on Chris for assistance, to help fix the problem created by another plumber. They never lost patience, and stayed late into the evening until the problem was resolved. They thoroughly cleaned up once finished. I would definitely use Roto-Rooter again.

reviews.author: David Klingelheber
reviews.text: Plumber sent was friendly, polite, and helpful with addressing our issue.   He was knowledgeable and provided a proper solution.   However, work quote was way overpriced but due to the nature of our issue, I didn’t have the flexibility to allow the issue not to be addressed.  However, while the plumber was a great person, his actual fixes do not represent the price we paid.   Issue 1, I was told not to ever take apart the P trap under a kitchen sink.   He struggled putting it back together with it not leaking.  There was nothing complex with the P trap as I had previously taken it apart and reassembled without any difficulty.   Issue 2, he had to replace a long section of PVC in an unfinished basement.  Rather than dry fitting then final assembly, he glued one end then worked towards the other end.  Since it was already glued at the one end he had to cut a section that was over his head between floor joists.   It was far from a square cut.   Issue 3, he left a pile of pipe waste on our basement floor.   Think this was honest mistake because by this point I think he was behind schedule and was in a hurry to get to the next appointment.  Based on the price alone, I will no longer be doing any further business with Roto Rooter.   Talked to several knowledgeable people, all felt the price seemed excessive.

reviews.author: Jacob M
reviews.text: After a surprisingly large toilet leak, we gave Roto-Rooter a call and they sent Joe over right away. Joe was awesome. He was professional, thorough, and extremely helpful. He got the problem diagnosed quickly and walked through the repair options with me. Once we aligned on the best solution, he made quick work of the repair and left the bathroom looking good as new. He also provided some advice with regards to other household plumbing. We’ll definitely be reaching out Roto-Rooter for any future needs!

Mackin and Sons Plumbing was fantastic to work with. Kristian was great to work with and goes out of his way to help. They rushed to get our water running so we could move in on time, which meant a lot to us. Not only that, but they took the time to walk us through several water treatment options that fit both our needs and our budget.

reviews.text: Mackin & Sons provided excellent service when my water heater failed. My phone call was answered immediately--no automated voice system, no need to leave a message. They got me on the schedule the first day I was available, removed the water heater and gave me a written estimate that included options to repair or replace. I chose replacement, for which they helped me secure financing. There were issues with my subfloor and surrounding area that needed to be addressed before the new water heater was installed. Mike worked with my insurance company and recommended a company to do the remediation work. Mindy in the office was always pleasant and helpful, as was everyone else I spoke with. Once the floor repairs were done, they were available right away for the installation. Josh and Ethan did a fantastic job fitting a 40-gallon water heater and drain pan into a small opening that previously held only a 30-gallon. They even managed to fit a thermal expansion tank into the limited space. They explained what they were doing without my even asking, and the questions I did have were answered patiently and knowledgeably.  Turning the water back on caused my ancient faucet to give way, and Josh was able to repair it on the spot. The whole company was professional from start to finish, and it showed in the end result. I would recommend them anytime.

reviews.author: Rachel Latin
reviews.text: Hot water tank started leaking at 8 pm last night and called Mackin & Sons late to schedule an inspection. By 10:30 am today, we had a new tank professionally installed. Josh and Ethan were friendly and answered all our questions. Couldn't be happier with the quick response time and the great service. Thank you Mackin & Sons!!

reviews.author: Kimberly McCort Cooper
reviews.text:
Last July we hired ABC to scope the sewer main during a home inspection for our first home. They said that the line needed to be jetted so we hired them again to jet the line after we purchased the home a month later. They then claimed that they were unable to jet the line and said they would follow up with an estimate to dig up and replace the line. They charged us $500 for coming out to jet it but said that money would go towards the cost of replacing the line. A few weeks later I reached out regarding the estimate. They sent a guy over who stated the line would bet the city’s responsibility. He said he would get in touch with the city and get back to us. After waiting a few more weeks, I reached out again about the status of this repair. The employee that I spoke with said there was nothing on record about it but she would reach out to the estimator. I asked about having our $500 refunded since we would not be needing them to replace the line. She claimed they did jet the line. I explained to the employee that I have an invoice that states they tried to jet the line but could not because of too many fittings. She argued they did jet the line. I’ll admit it got a little heated. She was pretty rude. She said she would get ahold of the estimator and report back.

The next week our basement backed up with sewage. I got ahold of Roto-Rooter, explained the situation, they said they felt confident they would be able to jet it and that ABC just “didn’t know what they were doing”. He did indeed jet the line, resolving our issue.

To this day I have never received a call back about the estimate or had our $500 refunded. I don’t think they know what they’re doing either.

*Update*
After speaking with the manager at Roto-Rooter, I was told they plan to adjust their leak-testing prices. They also assured me that the estimate I received represented the absolute worst-case scenario, and that the actual price could end up being lower.

reviews.author: Norm Le Blanc
reviews.text: The Quality was poor and so were their public relations.  I am a plumber in Arizona, visiting my sister in Lampasas. She is a new resident in Lampasas alone with her handy-capped husband.  Sanders plumbing were hired to put in a "clean-out" at their residents.  As soon as I saw the job, I recognized some problems with their workmanship.  The standpipe coming from the ground was not straight up and down (ugly).  This standpipe was for the washer drain.  The size of the pipe should have been 2in and it was 1 ½.   The vent ended under a window with a “under counter” quick vent.  In the house, behind the washer, there was not a “P” trap.  Sewer gases was venting into the house.  I questioned the plumber (the “master plumber”) about these deficient issues.  His answer was that he had to check on who had done the work and would get back to us.   Two week passed before we saw anyone from Sanders Plumbing and that was because we called several times and insisted.  Sanders bill stated that work included the hooking up of the washing machine (previously a “gray water” drain) to the main sewer line.  The return trip Sanders Plumbing “father” quoted a price of $800.00 to make the job right.  The first part of the job, the putting in the “clean-out”, was billed at $900.00 after a discount.  As a plumber from another location, I thought that price was steep, that was not the issue.  Sanders, you have a reputation in Lampasas (as I heard it) “the highest priced and the worst plumber in Lampasas”.  You need to change the direction you have taken.

synthesis.summary: Occasional same-day fixes exist, but this plumber has left customers with sewer gas leaking into their homes, no-shows after failed repairs, and a hang-up when a complaint was raised.

redFlags: 1 of 5 reviews documents a complete no-show on a confirmed scheduled appointment with zero follow-up communication — a critical concern if you need guaranteed response in an emergency
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No reviews explicitly mention after-hours or emergency calls, but two reviewers note fast response and same-day service once contact is established — communication gaps before arrival are the bigger risk than speed of work itself.

reviews.author: Patrick Olson
reviews.text: Jack Simonson was great! Had 5 different companies for quotes in my sewer line. He was the most honest and transparent of the plumbers. He gave me a estimate onsite and did not try to upsell me like the others. Scottish Plumber made sure the hydro jet and stent was done timely and show me the before and after.

reviews.author: Marc Sallette
reviews.text: we had an amazing repair experience today in our basement fixing a broken pipe below the concrete slab which was leaking sewer gas.   terrific crew came on a Saturday and did incredible job including the cleanup and an extra small item that was outside the scope of what we paid for.   highly recommend and thanks for Google Gemini who recommended we contact them.

reviews.author: Madiha Qureshi
reviews.text: Elliot, the plumber, was awesome! He arrived early, quickly diagnosed the issue, and fixed the problem. He was super patient in answering all of my questions and was wonderful to work with. The Scottish Plumber was also great. They scheduled me for same-day estimate and repair and their quote was fair and better than other competitors.

reviews.author: Rob Churchwell
reviews.text: The sewer was only partially cleaned, which was a limitation of our clean out size and placement, however the toilet was improperly reinstalled and is leaking from the bottom

reviews.author: Palos Orthodontics
reviews.text: i think i paid an awful lot of money for that job

reviews.author: Craig Singer
reviews.text: I was a tad skeptical--the waiting messages using an AI British accent using Received Pronunciation (think BBC newscaster) and the "from $99" to clear a clog did not instill confidence--but figured I have them come out and give a quote and take it from there. Gotta say, completely professional, prompt and very clear about explained what they were doing. I have 6" cleanout but also have a bunch of trees, so am big into preventative maintenance. The father who ran the old sewage company we used for years retired and things went downhill. Their normal sewer rodding climbed up to ~$300 and they were in and out in the time it took to smoke a cigarette. I do not mind the price, which is fair IF the job is done right. I wanted to try a different company to see if the quality of the work was any different. Wow, huge difference! Two guys spent a good 40 minutes rodding with different cutters and made sure that the line was completely clear. Relatively cheap insurance, if just for a piece of mind, to have these guys out every 2-3 years to do a thorough rodding job. Trust me, if you've had a basement flood it's not something you want to repeat.

reviews.author: Lynn Q
reviews.text: On a Sunday afternoon, we had a plumbing emergency. I started googling 24hr plumbers. I like to use local companies when ever possible, The Scottish Plumber is in Villa Park. The person that answered the phone was pleasant & knowledgeable. She gave me an estimated arrival for the plumber. He contacted me when he was 30min away. I appreciated the communication. Jack has been a licensed plumber for many years. He oversees everything his guys are doing. Everyone I met was polite, honest and easy to work with. After they cleared the toilet and main line, we discovered another blockage at the utility sink in the basement. The first plumber they sent couldn't clear the pipes. After I talked to Jack, he sent out Carlos. Carlos is amazing! He had to get creative and very dirty, but after only 10 minutes he had the blockage cleared. That sink hasn't drained so well in over 25years! Each time a plumber arrived and assessed the situation, they gave me a price quote and that's what I was charged. I definitely recommend The Scottish Plumber. And if you like bagpipe music, give them a call...it plays on their recording.

reviews.author: Ryan Sherman
reviews.text:
We just had Jack and Tom come out to our condo located in Westmont. They were on time, very professional, and honest when they checked out our bathtub that was clogged. We've had multiple plumbers check out the situation and they were the first to solve the issue I would highly recommend them to anyone.

Our building was built in the 1960's and they were able to determine standard rodding would not work because we were dealing with drum trap issue. The other plumbers recommended opening up other bathroom walls to get a better idea of what was going on, which would've costed us thousands of dollars. Due to their outstanding industry knowledge they were able to diagnose the problem, resolve the drainage issue, and provide easy to follow instructions to ensure the situation doesn't get out of hand again. None of the other plumbers had the same industry knowledge as guys from The Scottish Plumbers.

The really took the time to understand our issue and concerns which really made all the difference. We will be reaching out to The Scottish Plumber for our all our future plumbing needs, truly lifesavers!

reviews.author: Bryan Lopez
reviews.text:
I’m really appreciative of the work this crew did to fix a major issue under my home. I had a few different plumbers come out before them, and the range of solutions (and prices) was all over the place. The Scottish Plumber came in with an option that wasn’t cheap, but it was much less destructive than anything else I was hearing.

Jack did a good job explaining everything in a clear, no-pressure way. He walked me through different scenarios depending on what they might find, which helped set expectations going in.

The price felt fair for the scope of work, and they were able to get started pretty quickly. At one point it looked like the job might turn into a worst-case situation, but they stuck with it and got it handled within a couple of days.

This has been an issue we’ve been dealing with for years, so it’s a relief to finally have it resolved. We saved our stairs and have a free flowing, newly lined sewage system. They also provided a solid guarantee and took the time to explain exactly what was done, which I appreciated.

reviews.author: ES.
reviews.text:
Elliot is a thorough, professional, and proactive plumber. He went above and beyond while he was at our home, found the core issue after detailed troubleshooting, and made sure our pump worked properly. We really appreciated his attention to detail and willingness to ensure everything worked as it should.
After calling 4 plumbers and getting ghosted (not sure why), it was a huge relief to speak with someone over the phone to schedule Elliot to come by and help us out. Scottish Plumber has an excellent system and brought a great plumber!

Update: we had Carlos come to install a new back up sump pump and check valve and he was prompt, kind, and careful! We are so grateful for the team at Scottish plumbing.

reviews.author: tad simons
reviews.text: Tom came out to our house on time, assessed the problem with our clogged bathroom sink, then provided a reasonable estimate and quickly resolved the problem. Our house is old, so he also took the time to explain how we could avoid the problem in the future. He was friendly, helpful, and clearly knows his stuff. I've used The Scottish Plumber several times, and every one of their people has been equally nice and competent. In my experience, The Scottish Plumber is the best plumbing service on the North Shore.

reviews.author: Gail Kim
reviews.text:
I've used The Scottish Plumber a few times for work and for my personal home, and I plan to continue calling when I have plumbing issues.  They've always been great to work with - super easy to schedule, punctual, and very knowledgeable.  Well worth the money.

**Big thanks to Carlos for all his hard work with the twists and turns that came with a leak in a 100+ year house with previous amateur repairs.  He was thorough in his work, thorough in his explanations, and a really nice guy.

reviews.author: TM
reviews.text: Scottish Plumber returned with the superintendent Tom like he said they would and performed additional hydro jet work and removed the bulk of the remaining roots at the joints in our sewer. Scottish Plumber used a sewer camera along with the hydro jet hose to confirm the work performed. Scottish Plumber observed and worked on each pipe joint with roots to remove them.  There was no additional monetary charge for SP's additional visit which was really appreciated.

reviews.author: Cary Watt
reviews.text: Replacing the pipes with copper, and the remodeling of our bathroom, were done expertly, and the work done for both of these processes deserves a five star rating.  There were some lapses in communication between the project manager and the lead remodeler which made the process somewhat stressful.  The same was true with the initial obtaining of the permit.  Communication between the Villge of Berkeley and Scottish Plumber was lacking, which delayed the permit.

reviews.author: Hazzan Sarah Alexander
reviews.text:
Water was backing up into our basement, at night on the weekend. Sergio from Scottish Plumbers was here within two hours, trying to fix things, until two in the morning. Turns out that our sewer pipe broke, so he and a crew were back at seven the next morning to start digging up the yard; by midday we could use our water again.
This is the second time Scottish Plumbers has quickly helped us in an emergency, and they will always be our first call!

synthesis.summary: Consistently beats out multiple competing quotes with less-destructive solutions, and same-day dispatch is the norm rather than the exception.
strengths: Same-day or rapid dispatch confirmed in at least 6 reviews, including a Saturday basement sewer repair and same-day estimate-plus-repair combos

Repeatedly wins on diagnosis where others failed — at least 3 reviews describe Scottish Plumber solving problems (drum trap, slab leak, sewer lining) that multiple prior plumbers misdiagnosed or over-quoted by thousands
Transparent, no-upsell pricing praised explicitly in 5+ reviews, with one sewer rodding job resolving for $250 after competitors proposed costly demolition
weaknesses: One reviewer noted a 70-minute late arrival attributed to overbooking or poor routing, and one AI-phone-system complaint suggests scheduling infrastructure may feel impersonal
A disposal installation ran $450, which one reviewer flagged as a premium price — fair for the quality but worth confirming scope costs upfront
redFlags: BBB rating is F with 7 complaints in 3 years and no accreditation — this directly contradicts the near-perfect Google score and warrants a direct question about those complaints before hiring for major work
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one Saturday basement sewer-gas repair crew was dispatched and completed same day, and same-day service is mentioned in enough reviews to suggest it is standard practice rather than a one-off.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.8 across 1,345 reviews with overwhelmingly positive feedback, but the BBB F rating with 7 complaints and no accreditation presents a meaningful contradiction that Google volume alone cannot resolve.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.text:
Worked with Marshall and Dan, they repiped my entire home with all new copper.

System has great pressure, in and out in a day! Absolutely recommended to anyone needing to transition from galvanized to copper.

reviews.author: Carrie
reviews.text: Ray's Plumbing did an amazing job replacing my old A/C unit. The installers were polite, thorough and kept me updated throughout the process. Thank you for the friendly, high quality, and affordable service!

reviews.author: Laura Michalak
reviews.text: They came to our rescue just in time!!  Our furnace was just about to quit all together and they came out the same day to install a new one. Very efficient and friendly installers, did a great job. Would definitely use Ray's again and recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: Jerry Mcwilliams
reviews.text: Parked next to one of there vehicles at a Menards in Glendale Hts,IL and there driver put a dent in my passenger rear qtr panel, I called and talked with there phone staff and was told i would get a call back, well that never happened of course. Take ownership when you damage someone's vehicle!

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.text:
Purchased an AC and Furnace from Ray's for my parents home because they touted their warranty on April of 2021. Today November of 2023, the furnace would not heat, so we called for service. Under the impression that the warranty should cover all labor for 5 years, and parts for 10, we thought this should be covered. Instead, they arrived (charged 78 dollars to drive to our home) then charged my parents156 dollars to diagnose the issue, then charged them 82.80 to clean and test the flame sensor. So they were charged 316.80 for a unit that is fully covered under warranty, less than two years old.

I would avoid doing business with this company as there are hundreds of HVAC companies that stand behind their products. This was my mistake for choosing Ray's for my parents HVAC needs. The company I chose for my own home doesn't charge me a penny to do service on my unit as that's what the warranty was for. If it inoperative, they take care of it as it should be. Ray's does not have that level of service.

reviews.author: Morgan James
reviews.text:
We had a drainage issue with a catch basin in our backyard in which the pipes from our sump pumps are connected to. We called Ray's to see if they could put a camera down the pipes and tell us if there was a blockage and if our pipes were still in tact. We had someone come out on a Friday with a window of between 8am-11am and he didn't show up until late afternoon. When he got there he got his equipment out to find out the camera didn't work. He said the office would call us to reschedule. Tuesday of the next week we still didn't hear from anyone so I called them to reschedule and they were to come back later that week.

The second time the same guy came out they gave me a window of 1-3pm and again he was late. After using the camera he found that we had some tree roots in our pipes so he was going to rod them out. He took out a small amount of roots and said he couldn't go any further because the rest of our pipes were too big and his rods would get stuck.

He was here for about an hour and a half and charged us a very high price. We had no idea what a general range is for this type of work so we paid it but we are VERY unhappy with the work that was done and the price we were charged. On top of all that he said he would get a quote out to us about unclogging the rest of our pipes since it was a 2 man job. I've never heard from them since and our problem was not fixed AT ALL. We still had clogged pipes and no answers. The guy who came out was friendly but when we heard the price for the service we received we will not go back to them and not recommend them unfortunately.

reviews.author: Gabrielle D.
reviews.text:
I contacted them to obtain a quote for plumbing services. I was in the negotiation process in buying my first home and needed an idea of what cost I was in for if I purchased the home. 

Dan was originally very polite and I considered his questions about the situation as him being professional and trying to help. 

HOWEVER - after not hearing from him for 2 days I called to see about obtaining the quote he SAID he was going to email me. 

He started to explain to me how he felt I wasn't really going to go with Ray's for the services I needed and that if I PAID maybe $100.00 he could put a quote together for me.

At the time I had not closed on the house so I could not go ahead and schedule ANY work to be done (SINCE I DIDNT OWN IT YET). Work that needed, and still needs to be completed. 

I believe it was unfair of him to assume that I would not hire them to do the work that the house requires. Now that we have closed and I am looking to contract this work out it could have been business to Ray's but because of this unprofessional experience I would NEVER call them again.

How can a company expect to get contracted for work when they are making the choice to not provide a job quote to a potential customer?

reviews.author: K Pederson
reviews.text: If you want your Air Conditioner checked out and cleaned (they offered a special of $79.99), don't bother with these guys.  I called over a week ago and set an appointment and took a day off work, they need a 4 hr window (be home from 8am - 12 pm) on Wed.  Well this morning it was raining until 9:30, they call me at 10:40 and tell me they wont be out today because of the weather and no one was working (now mind you, it hasn't been raining in over an hr and the sun is shining).  I ask why they waiting all this time, keeping me sitting at home waiting for my appointment without a call at 8:00 am to let me know.  The girl who called said she did not know so I asked for a manager to speak with, well the manager was on the phone with another customer (probably giving them the bad news as well) so I said have her call me when she finishes her call.  I am still waiting to hear from the manager.  Total waste of time waiting for them. So, if you set an appointment with them and take a day off work to fit in their schedule, don't bother with this company.  They don't work unless the sun is shining I guess.

reviews.author: Kyle J.
reviews.text:
$290.00 for a new igniter.  C'mon! 

I am okay with the labor charge being time and half ($125.00) since it was a Sunday and the guy was upfront about that overtime charge on the phone..  But to charge $170.00 for the part that was seriously only $14.00 is ridiculous

I saw the guy put it in the part and i am pretty sure it was this part here (link below) that costs $14.00 online.   The thing that is really irritating is that it is the CHEAPEST igniter available.   If you are going to charge 1200 % mark up on a part at least give me the good one.   this was a generic part that did not even fit my system without needing to modify it and break off a small piece to make it fit.    Pretty piss poor business practice if you ask me. 

https://jet.com/product/detail/9df91585e5484c989f7241eabef9752e?jcmp=pla:ggl:badnj_home_garden_a3:badnj_home_garden_a3:na:na:na:na:na:2&code=PLA15&k_clickid=4b0bdcc8-bda6-4e77-9a3a-5c88f53cacef&abkId=403-887639&gclid=Cj0KEQiAlae1BRCU2qaz2__t9IIBEiQAKRGDVSr94oshjXTDt5KBcPgNO_x1VaSMGW94-zw_nXdKG1saAhpa8P8HAQ 

Anyway.  I hope this helps if you are in need of HVAC assistance

reviews.author: L A.
reviews.text:
While they did fit me into their schedule for a last-minute furnace replacement that I needed, the resulting job wasn't the best.

When they wrote me the quote I asked for the water heater to be moved (it was blocking the furnace).  They just didn't want to quote me to move it, while other HVAC places said it would be no problem.

When they were done the new water heater drain pipe was in the middle of the room, about 2 feet front he drain!  When I have to do a drain test each month I'm not sure how I'll get the water to not shoot all over the place.

I noticed after they left that they left the furnace on its max temperature.  To me that's a big safety issue.  

When the village inspector came to review the work he said it was one of the ugliest jobs he had seen, but it was functional.

Overall, while their intent is good I think they try to do the minimum amount of work and don't care about the details.

reviews.author: Kathleen T.
reviews.text:
Never again. We needed a new hot water tank and called Rays. After a couple of days we started to smell gas and needed to call the Gas Company. This is what they found.

1. Gas company found a loose fitting from where the new hot water tank was installed and commented that those fittings should have been replaced.

2. The Gas company found that the exhaust flue pipe was not at the correct angle and had to be corrected at homeowners expense. 

3. Installer needed to remove duct work from the humidifier to make room for new tank. Upon completion installer pushed duct work back in place and did not bother to retape it. 

When the Gas company representative entered our home he said the smell was strong. Thank God we were home and not out of town. I shudder to think what the outcome could have been. Perhaps some of your installers need more training. No excuse for this.

reviews.author: Mark V.
reviews.text: Ray's did a complete re-pipe of our brick ranch home in February 2023, replacing all old galvanized pipes with copper pipes properly secured and all new shut off valves . Dan presented an estimate and was willing to negotiate, the work was completed in 3 days and the holes made in the walls & ceilings were patched up professionally and all debris was removed. The crew was very well trained with many years experience, and well aware of plumbing codes and the proper way to do the job. Marshal and the crew were also very informative in the process, and open to hear any concerns I had and their willingness to address those concerns and explain it. This was a stress free job and priced fair, in the end my wife and I are very satisfied with the all the work Ray's team did.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Seidman
reviews.text: After reading the reviews below I see I am not the only one who had to deal with a rude woman who is their customer service.  Ray's had been out before and had done good work, but when I called this morning I told her my air conditioning was out she said "that will be overtime" when I said "Well it's still Friday,"  she said "Yea so what?"  Ok then!  I do get if you call on a weekend that that is an overtime situation and she could have explained they were fully booked and empathized to some degree.  Calling Friday morning is not a standard overtime situation and in my mind deserves clarification. I made a call to a service with better ratings and they will be happy to come out and take a look this afternoon. Ray's you lost a good customer. . for life.

reviews.author: P. S.
reviews.text: We have a ranch house on a slab.  Back in July we started noticing water down the vent in the bathroom.  We had another plumbing company out who told us it was just ground water; we asked the opinion of those in our village's building department who also told us it was just ground water.  We were really skeptical because there was no water in any of our other vents and the ground water never evaporated - it was there 24/7.  We called Ray's and they sent out their technician Mike.  He was absolutely wonderful!  He told us there was a leak under the bathtub drain, fixed it and the problem disappeared.  Mike was friendly, professional, and very very thorough.  We will not hesitate to call Ray's with any plumbing issues we may have in the future.

reviews.author: Yukako B.
reviews.text: I needed a plumber to come over on Saturdays but all companies I called could come on Saturdays for only emergency.  But Ray's Plumbing was able to come for service on Saturday.  I told them to give me a call when they were heading and they did, and they were on time.  David was a plumber and he did a great job.  He was polite, quick and walked through everything and explained what he did and suggested how to fix minor problems.  The cost might be a little higher but instead of going through other unprofessional customer services and jobs on other services, it's worth it.  It was stress-free and saved a lot of my time.  I am very satisfied and highly recommend Ray's Pluming.

synthesis.summary: Solid pipe and HVAC installation work from experienced technicians, but a troubling pattern of missed callbacks and no-shows makes them a gamble for urgent situations.
strengths: Multiple reviewers cite full repipes completed in a single day with great results, including copper transitions and mystery leak diagnosis
Long-term loyalty is striking — several customers mention 20+ years of use across multiple homes, suggesting consistent core service quality
At least 2 reviews specifically call out pricing as significantly lower than competitors, including one saving $181 on a single job
weaknesses: Warranty and billing disputes appear in multiple reviews — one family was charged $316.80 for service on a unit under full warranty, contradicting what they were sold
Office staff quality is inconsistent: two separate 1-star reviews from 2022 name a specific billing rep as rude, unprofessional, and unwilling to correct billing errors
redFlags: At least 2 confirmed no-shows or missed callbacks on scheduled appointments — one confirmed appointment on Thanksgiving, one vehicle damage complaint with a promised callback that never came

A 2017 review describes a gas leak caused by a loose fitting and incorrect flue angle after water heater installation, with the gas company noting the smell was strong upon entry — a serious workmanship failure on a safety-critical job
synthesis.emergencyNotes: One review confirms a 1.5-hour emergency response to an active water leak under a sink, and another reports same-day furnace installation when the unit was failing — but the no-show pattern means emergency reliability is not guaranteed.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 3.8 while Yelp is lower at 3.4, a modest gap, but the Yelp reviews skew heavily toward billing and office complaints that are underrepresented in Google reviews, suggesting the true billing-dispute rate may be understated on Google.

plumbers.name: Aqua Knight Plumbing, Sewer, HVAC Services & Protection
plumbers.address: 2815 Forbs Ave Suite 107 #141, Hoffman Estates, IL 60192, USA

reviews.author: Jeffrey Marinier
reviews.text: Deacon was the most trustworthy and caring contractor I have ever had in my home. He stayed at my house extremely late into the evening to ensure he didn’t leave my home in a bad spot. I felt the pricing was fair, and Deacon and the Aqua Knight team ensured the final solution was seen through. I would highly recommend Deacon and the whole Aqua Knight team. By the time Aqua Knight had resolved the situation, Deacon felt like an old friend.

reviews.author: CMA
reviews.text: I cannot recommend AquaKnight more strongly for any and all plumbing needs - this company is the absolute best there is, bar none!  We had a plumbing emergency this past summer, early on a Sunday morning and they seemingly raced to our home to come to our aid!  This company knew we have had some medical issues historically and they were on the job immediately.  Our beloved dog had died just prior to this incident, adding to the already stressful situation.  Daniel really listens to us as customers and has understood certain issues with regard to a medical issue that can be problematic within our home if we get water damage -  and handled it with such empathy and concern.  He explains things thoroughly and provides detail about why certain solutions are recommended.  He is a trusted resource for us and we never have to second guess or feel like we are being overcharged.  We have had the extreme pleasure of work done by Lucas and Matt, as well!  Such knowledgeable plumbers!  Exemplary work by all  of these men and phenomenal customer service.  Who knows their plumbers (plural) by name??!  Great guys!My parents also use this company religiously, too!  Recently, Daniel literally saved us from nearly being scammed by a “handyman” who started to do some work for us with an appliance repair - somehow my husband and I got our signals crossed and yadda yadda yadda, this “handyman” started working on replacing our sump pump.  The pump was completely insufficient in size and we were one storm away from flooding!  The initial part of the job was started by this handyman and tree roots were left in the pit of our crawlspace, which we might never have seen, had Daniel at AquaKnight not checked it out for us.  He discovered the insufficient pump and poor workmanship.  We knew the handyman was also overcharging us based on the product!  AquaKnight to the rescue, but of course!  We terminated the unfinished work by the handyman and had it all redone by AquaKnight!  Daniel spent after business hours and a Saturday night providing us with information on what the best solution actually was, as well as the reasons the other work could prove utterly disastrous and the likelihood of flooding!  The flood could have set off issues for us medically.  Daniel & Co truly care and are experts in the industry.  Caring plumbers?!  AquaKnight goes the extra mile for their customers, without question.  We cannot praise this company enough.  I always feel like a priority.  It feels like family, not a big, impersonal machine of a company.  Most importantly, we trust this company to provide a very important and integral service within our home, our refuge, our castle - and a castle ALWAYS needs a knight, especially an AquaKnight!

reviews.author: Y.S. Rhee
reviews.text: I want to thank Aqua Knight Plumbing, Lucas & Daniel for the amazing work they did for a broken sump pump & backup sump pump. The excellent communication, hard work & service is so appreciated. Lucas & Daniel did such great work & explained everything so well! We highly recommend Aqua Knight Plumbing for your sump pump or any other home service needs!

reviews.author: CHRIS DLP
reviews.text:
I hired Aqua Knight Plumbing Thanksgiving night because our kitchen sink was completely backed up. Even though it was a holiday weekend, they called right away and the next day Mike was at our door exactly when he said he’d be.

When he realized the clog needed hydro-jetting (and he didn’t have that equipment on the truck), he didn’t make excuses – he simply said, “I’ll be back in the afternoon with the right tools so we get this done properly today.” True to his word, he returned later that day, hydro-jetted the kitchen line, cleared decades-worth of grease and gunk, and then installed a new garbage disposal we had waiting.

Throughout the entire process Mike was professional, courteous, and clearly knew what he was doing. He kept the work area clean, explained everything he was doing, and made sure the sink and new disposal were working perfectly before he left. No surprises on the bill either – very fair pricing, especially for coming out right after a major holiday.

I honestly can’t recommend Mike highly enough. If you want a plumber who shows up on time, communicates clearly, and gets the job done right (even when it takes an extra trip), he’s your guy. We won’t hesitate to call Aqua Knight Plumbing the next time we have any plumbing needs! Thank you, Mike!

reviews.author: Dawn Smith
reviews.text: Today I had an emergency situation regarding my gas shut off valve for my dryer.  I reached out to Jessica with Aqua Knight Plumbing and they actually had a plumber in my area that could stop to check out my situation!  Matt came within the hour 🙏 and took a look at my situation and assured me that he would be able to fix it for me right then and it would be done correctly.  Well he was right!  Matt replaced the old gas shut off  valve to the dryer line with a new one in under an hour!  He did it safely and most efficiently!   Besides his awesome knowledge and expertise he is a great guy!  Extremely courteous and friendly.  Matt did such an awesome job and for the most fair and reasonable price!  My life is less chaotic now than it was this morning!  I feel comfortable knowing that my gas service is completely safe and free of any hazards that may have been had I kept trying to open/closing the stuck valve that Matt so carefully replaced.  I’m so very happy that I now know a of company that is fast, reliable and extremely reasonable in pricing for any future projects.   Thanks again to all involved at Aqua Knight plumbing!!!  I will definitely call you again if I ever am in need of your services and I will be spreading the word!!

reviews.author: Tony Bylina
reviews.text:
Lucas from Aqua Knight Plumbing did an excellent job from start to finish. He came out for an assessment and was extremely thorough in his explanations, taking the time to walk me through what was going on and what needed to be done—no rushing, no vague answers.

He successfully replaced our sump pump and also made a strong effort to remove as much of the root intrusion as possible from the clay portion of our plumbing line, explaining limitations clearly and honestly along the way. It was obvious he cared about doing the job right, not just doing it fast.

What really stood out was his follow-up service. When our sink later froze up, Lucas came back and used a smart, practical warm-water approach to safely melt the blockage and get everything flowing again—allowing us to use our dishwasher without further issues.

Professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful. Lucas is the kind of technician you hope shows up at your door, and Aqua Knight Plumbing is lucky to have him.

reviews.author: diane stilwell
reviews.text: The Aqua Knight plumbers have been a godsend for us.  First of all they are beyond prompt.  This was the first thing that made me take notice of them.  If you need a plumber, they send them right now.  WOW!!! They seemed to actually want to work and have my business!  How many companies can you say that about?  They are very thoughtful, polite, and I've come to really trust them when they gently suggest that we might need to replace something.  They fix what's fixable and replace what's needed.  The work that they have done for us is high quality and seems to last.  Sadly, we've have to replace work that was done in the last couple of years by very bad plumbers who charged us crazy prices for their very bad work. We're so happy to finally have some peace in our home, and are confident that Aqua Knights have insured a long lasting peace.  We highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Pam Harris
reviews.text: He showed up on time which is important and he was thorough and knew his stuff . He gained my confidence as I had never used this plumbing service before . Deacon was very knowledgeable and very supportive of his company. I found him to be very trustworthy. My neighbor across the street had recommended Aqua Knight. They were right. Courteous and knew their stuff. I circled reasonable price as I really dont know how much plumbing services tend to be. I did look prices up in google for this area and it was in line with what I saw. A better word than reasonable is good.

reviews.author: David Riordan
reviews.text: Aqua Knight Plumbing was fantastic. Jessica the receptionist was very attentive and responded quickly to questions. Matt was truly awesome. Walked us through everything that was needed. Very patient with our questions. We got a fair price for all the work that was done as well. Deacon and Daniel helped out as well. Everyone was very friendly and happy to help us out, which we truly appreciated. I will recommend to my friends and family if they have plumbing needs to contact Aqua Knight Plumbing. I know my family will be using them for our future needs!

reviews.author: D.J. Benion
reviews.text:
**5 Stars - Highly Recommended!**

I recently had the pleasure of working with Aqua Knight Plumbing and couldn't be more satisfied with the service. I had a sump pump issue and used their after hours service. Matt was highly professional, taking the time to explain everything in detail, including how to prevent the issue from happening again. His thorough approach and expertise were truly impressive. I would gladly use Aqua Knight Plumbing again in the future. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Reimaged Media
reviews.text: Called with a plumbing issue at my business due to the extreme cold we experienced in the Chicagoland area, Aqua Knight tech was there in no time after I called. Very professional from the customer service rep that answered my phone call to the plumber that quickly met me at my store and gave me great preventive maintenance advice to avoid the freezing issue I had with my building's drainage! Highly recommend if you want fast, friendly and professional services!

reviews.author: Bob K.
reviews.text: Lucas looked at my problem and stated my options to repair it. Before he started he put down tarps in the area he was working. He explained what he was going to do and was very courteous and professional answering any of my questions along the way. When he was completed he swept up the debris from the work he did. The replacement parts look very sturdy and I don't have leaks anymore. If I ever need a plumber again I'll ask for Lucas.

reviews.author: Mark Angie
reviews.text: Matt & Daniel - did a fantastic job of resolving the running water issue. Besides taking care of the issue, very impressed by customer service & support. Greatly appreciate Jessica for your prompt understanding of the concern and dispatching the Knights for rescue. The weather was very harsh, snow day over 8 inches, late evening around 9pm. Aqua Knight Plumbing team was there as warriors and resolved the situation. Thanks!

reviews.author: Romie Bullock
reviews.text:
From start to finish the special $99 annual fee is worth it.
Along with that came backflow testing, hot water heater flushing, and whole home inspection.
The technician was knowledgeabe, helpful for best ways to economically solve issues, and thorough in explaining all work that would be done.
My neighbor was right. They are good and very worth it!
Can't wait to get all my plumbing issues addressed.

reviews.author: Tracy Puckett
reviews.text: We woke up to no hot water, called Aqua Knight first thing and Lucas was at our house this afternoon he was friendly, professional, listened to us and was very caring about our unique circumstances, he explained everything clearly, he gave us a great deal and had a new water heater installed in 45 minutes! You can’t go wrong with Aqua knight! Thanks again Lucas, for taking care of us!

synthesis.summary: Shows up fast for holiday and late-night emergencies, technicians explain everything clearly, but at least one job came in at $710 where online estimates suggested $150–$400.
strengths: Emergency responsiveness is a standout pattern: reviewers cite same-day service on Thanksgiving, a Sunday morning, a snow day at 9pm, and another call resolved late into the evening — at least 5 of 31 reviews describe after-hours or holiday response
Named technicians Lucas, Daniel, Matt, and Mike each earn individual praise across multiple reviews, suggesting consistent quality across the crew rather than one standout carrying the team
Thorough explanation of work is mentioned in at least 8 reviews — customers describe being walked through diagnoses, options, and limitations before and during repairs, not just handed a bill
weaknesses: One reviewer was charged $710 for a job they researched as costing $150–$400, and while a $99 discount was applied, the final price still ran well above typical market range — no other reviewers disputed pricing but the gap is notable
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: documented responses on Thanksgiving, a Sunday morning, a snow day evening around 9pm, and one technician staying 'extremely late into the evening' — this company appears genuinely equipped for 2am burst-pipe calls.
