reviews.author: Sarah Henricksen
reviews.text: Mike from J&S Plumbing did great work installing our new water heater. They were able to do the install a day earlier than planned, and the very reasonable flat rate pricing meant that we weren't surprised by the price.

reviews.author: Ryca Shih
reviews.text: Our experience with J&S yesterday is exactly why we continue to rely on this company. We had an issue with a frozen pipe, and they sent a plumber out in record time. Stephen was extremely professional and clearly explained our options for resolving the problem. I truly feel that other companies might have taken advantage of the situation and overcharged us, but Stephen and J&S were fair, honest, and reasonably priced. Most importantly, our water is running again. Thank you

reviews.author: Lynette Struck
reviews.text:
After contacting another plumber at 10:00 a.m. with a promise for them to be out at 3:00 and got screwed at 2:45 until Monday...

I contacted J & S Plumbing.
I explained my situation that I was a residential with a business need, and also that my daughter could not go to work because of the current situation, and with a new job on the 8th as a police officer......

It was imperative that we had this problem solved so that my daughter could go to work clean her first day.
Knowing that the probability of getting somebody to come out at 2:45 p.m. on a Saturday would be almost impossible....

J&S plumbing made it possible!

Thank you very, very very much from the bottom of our hearts.

We took care of your guys with take-home mine and chocolate dip handmade pretzels.

Thank you again, very very very much and have a happy holiday season. As far as plumbers go... I couldn't have asked for a better holiday gift,! ❤️

reviews.author: John Zinga
reviews.text:
What a Joke of a company to work with.
Their phone service ide man was super helpful Kaz ; when I called for service.
It’s a shame the installer didn’t understand customer service 101 and totally stuck me.

Being in the trades for over 25 years I would never tell a customer I would do something and then not do it after charging an astronomical cost to get half service is not good business. Had the worst experience with this company and would NEVER recommend them.

reviews.author: olivejuice
reviews.text:
We paid around $500 for a washing machine water shutoff valve replacement which is outrageous. We would have shopped around more if we had more time but needed it for a washing machine delivery.

The service was prompt, however, I was charged more than double the price of what I was originally quoted. When I brought up the discrepancy compared to the original quotes, they asked me with whom and when I talked to them on the phone then said that they could not find records for it.

They also said that the quotes are always subject to change and they cannot give an accurate pricing before evaluating in person despite of the basicness of the task - the catch is, there is a consultation fee of close to $100 just for them making the trip, which you need to pay if you don’t like the pricing and decide to not use their services.

They also tried hard to sell us on services/upgrades that we did not necessarily need.

I find the whole experiencing predatory, pushy and disingenuous and I cannot recommend them to anyone looking for plumbing services.

reviews.author: Tintu V.
reviews.text:
Called these guys to remove a cartridge that I had chewed  up pretty bad in my tub faucet. (strictly from seeing "good reviews" and them being local plumbers). I had the cartridge purchased from Just Faucet for my Kohler unit. (I was trying to get it done myself, after all it is just a cartridge). 

J&S sent couple of guys the same day (Fast service, I give them that)-- They came in and told me it was the wrong size cartridge and will come back when I have the right one -- CHARGED me $98 for 2 minute service. (that was fine since they had to come in - I was OK with that)

I went back to Just Faucets and told them the plumbers said this was the wrong size, and first thing the guy asked who did you hire? He said Kohler doesn't make cartridge bigger than this. And, he took out one of his set up and showed me that i have in my hand is indeed the right one.

So I called J&S back said, look I have the right part, they said we'll have someone come in Tomorrow (keep in mind my faucet been leaking bad for over the weekend). 
Jim came in today (he is a nice guy-- no hard feelings for this guy, just following orders -- I am also a field service engineer so I know how he's feeling)... tried to get the old cartridge loose/remove with a pipe wrench and couldn't do it. Suggest I replace or get a new faucet. Charged me another $98.

My thing is -- they made a mistake first time they came in by saying I had the wrong cartridge and made me run back to the store and back, while dealing with leaky faucet over the weekend--- If they hadn't made that MISTAKE--they could've tried and figured they couldn't remove the cartridge that first day...INSTEAD they came back and charged me another $98 while DOING NOTHING for me. I just paid them almost $200 for nothing.

While I try to get the 2nd $98 charge removed (since it was their mistake), they're boss (Ed) started arguing with me for the service charge. So I gave the 98 plus a "$2" tip and hope I NEVER see these guys again!!!

Instead of owning up to their mistake----arguing with customer. NO customer service.... and he's the boss of the company. (I see big future here)
__I only saw good reviews here mostly and that's why I went with these guys... So I am very confused here. So I plead everyone to do reviews, good or bad, help others!!! Thanks for listening

reviews.author: Mira H.
reviews.text:
Im giving the company 1 star because they got the job done.im upset because they left the work area very dirty and they didnt cover anything nor did they ask us  to move things or cover up.when they were rotting the pipe it splatterd on the boxes that were right next to the drain and on my shelf and cans with food and wall behind it.my towels were black,the door had black finger prints and the stairs were covered in footprints.i came home late ,discovered the mess and called the next day.they said my husband said i would clean,but they just told him it needs a mopping and he didnt look inside,but
a nice lady told me that j.is coming back to clean that day if they have time.i called again later and she told me j. Will be there on monday between 11 an 1 to clean.i called j. Around 4 and he told me he wasnt going to clean up because it was our fault that it splatterd  (there were wipes in it),so i tried to tell him that if they had covered up and brought soakable materials that that shouldnt have happened( they also used my towels that i had just put on to the water that am )to clean up the black stinking slime.he just said they were asuming since they were already there to use them.he told me they are not a cleaning service and said bye.i called the main number and talked to some supervising manager who after going over everything i already told the plumber and telling him im going to put that up on a public page  , said this a coward way out and he hung up the phone.i tried a couple times to get a hold of a manager or owner.in the evening that lady called again who is a dispatcher and apologized about everything and sent over another plumber to clean up their mess (the guy cleaned a little but not the slime on walls,i didnt sign his statement either)plus  we had to supply papertowls they just brought some spray.i  had to clean sewage for 45 min until it was all off the walls ,door and stairs .also she told me s.the owner is getting back to me the next day which is today and i havent heard from him.all i want is for them to have plastic, booties,their own towls or soakable material,a water vacuum etc or work with a cleaning service that specializes in cleaning up hazardous materials  etc to not mess up someones house like that.it says on their page they leave a clean work area...

reviews.author: Cathy B.
reviews.text:
DECEPTIVE!  I called them for an estimate today, after being referred to them then checking out their website.  All over their website it says FREE estimate...yet when I called, the guy told me it's $98 for them to come out to my home & give me an estimate & if I choose to have them do the work, they'd apply the $98 to the job cost.  I then told him that the website says FREE estimates, he said it was for something else.  I even pointed out that the page on their website that covered the services I wanted said FREE estimates & he insisted it wasn't.  He said I could email him pics & he'd provide an estimate based on that.  When I sent the pics & a copy of his website & stated if he was going to charge me for the estimate, I would not use them, I never heard back.

Text below is taken exactly from their website:

Swift and Safe Gas Line Replacement
If you smell gas in your home, the first thing you need to do is contact your gas company. They'll send someone to your home to locate any potential leaks. If a leak is detected outside your home, the responsibility falls on the gas company to make the necessary repairs.

If the leak is located inside your home, then you need a qualified plumber who can make the necessary repairs. With over 25 years of experience in the Chicagoland area, that plumber is J & S Plumbing Inc. Our crews are equipped with natural gas detectors that analyze your home's air for the presence of methane and other combustible gasses.

Once we've found the problem, our crews will install new gas lines, valves, and fittings to make your home environment safe again. Call J & S Plumbing Inc. today at 847-690-0384 for a FREE estimate. 24-hour emergency service is available. We stand behind our work with a 1-year warranty on all services provided. Senior citizen and military discounts available.

reviews.author: Tracy G.
reviews.text: Our Association uses J&S for repairs. They came out to fixed a backed up pipe behind my washing machine. While trying to get to the pipe they somehow broke the water pipe to my washing machine and flooded my entire bathroom/laundry area and also broke a pipe to my hot water heater that is in a separate room. After they cleaned up and fixed the piping they asked that I try to use the washing machine to make sure the new piping was on correctly and went to their truck. When trying to close the washing machine it wouldn't shut and the door was sagging down. They had broke the hinge and the prongs for the door. As they were still outside we called the office and my husband spoke to a nice woman who said that she would have the owner call us back. The next day the owner called and they said they would get back to us. After a week my husband called again and the owner he spoke to was now on vacation. The second owner Shawn said that he would contact their appliance guy and they would come out to fix it. Another week went by so my husband emailed Shawn. The appliance guy finally contacted my husband for the serial # and told him if it's too old they cannot get  parts, my husband replied that evening. Another week went by and no one contacted us. This was all during the busy holidays with out of town guests visiting and I was stuck carrying laundry to wash at my in-laws. After 3 weeks with no washing machine and no effort from the company to fix the damages my husband ordered new prongs so that the door will semi-close and I can do laundry. The door  is still broken and will probably need a new one. Also Upon further inspection there is a burn mark on my washing machine and my hot water heater and a nice gash in the front of my dryer.

reviews.author: Karen B.
reviews.text: Love this company! we had an emergency last night - I smelled "dampness" when i went in the basement so hubby checked our crawlspace and sure enough we had water - assuming it was the recent rains/snow melt we went to clean up til we saw an area by a drain pipe (from shower behind wall) that had water bubbling up under it hubby had to sit there for hours using shop/vac to suck it up and it would only keep coming back so we assumed it was a busted pipe i called several plumbers and they were the only to respond (mind you its super busy for them all w/the recent rains/etc.) so i get it but they were the only to call back right away i explained what we thought it was the nice woman on the phone gave suggestions (sump pump being one we didn't think of that thinking that was fine no water in utility room) so they would send someone when available - i went to investigate the pump anyway and lo and behold it was that - the balloon switch thing broke off and it was not draining we had to manually do it (and sit there all night to do it til fixed) the water ended up seeping into our foundation/crawlspace - they came out finally at 10:15 pm checked it all knew we needed a new pump and quickly installed one in like 10 mns!  yes didn't want to spend the $ but at that hour we had no choice but was pleasantly surprised it was not as costly as one would think (more than if we did it ourselves obviously but still considering it all not bad) they do not upcharge for evenings and weekends that alone sold me AND the guy gave us a coupon!   totally trust them - the techs were so super friendly and helpful even at that late hour and we were able to peacefully go to bed at 11 pm!   :)  totally recommend!

reviews.author: Sarah R.
reviews.text:
From the answering service to the moment that Leo left, this was as fantastic an experience as you could hope to have at midnight on a Friday. We came home to a filled sump well (with the pump not working) and water rising in another area of the basement. We called after 11pm on a Friday, spoke with a woman at the answering service who asked all the right questions and double checked everything. The J&S scheduler/triage person called back within a few minutes, gave a clear expectation of where the service tech was and when we might expect to see him, and promised a call-back when he was about half an hour away. It turns out that he was able to come earlier than expected, and by midnight, he was working in the basement. 
We actually had a couple of concurrent issues, and Leo identified and fixed them both, routing out the line from the house until it was clear -- which was quite a task. He also replaced our malfunctioning sump pump, all between midnight and 3am.
Throughout, Leo was pleasant (which is a great surprise at this time of night!), highly communicative about what he was finding and doing, clearly very experienced and competent. Not only did he do his work very well, he even worked to keep the basement floor clean as he pulled a disturbing amount of unpleasant muck from the pipe.
While I'm sure we paid some premium for the emergency service, we don't feel taken advantage of in the least; this service--and being able to sleep knowing that we weren't flooding with waste water--was well worth the price.
We will recommend J&S, and would gladly work with Leo any time.

reviews.author: Gary Z.
reviews.text: From Arlington Heights, IL. We had the misfortune to have a ring drop into a toilet in mid flush. I took the toilet apart but no ring and could not see it down the hole. It was not a cheap ring and had a HUGE amount of sentimental value. We thought the odds of find it were small but was certainly worth trying, Called one plumber who said he did not have the right equipment but that wonderful man recommended J & S  Plumbing of Elk Grove Village.  Lester and Mike of J & S came came with the right equipment and persistent effort weaving the camera through various turns on the drain system and found the the under the basement floor. A neat device that that beeps when it's near the camera told them exactly where the ring was under the floor. Fortunately the ring was within a few feet of a drain clean out port but unfortunately it was still unreachable. They tried several unsuccessful attempts to snag and pull the ring to the access hole. Eventually they tried pushing the ring toward the access hole with the camera and that worked. When Lester appeared with that ring in his hand it was like a miracle. They also did a great job on installing a new taller replacement toilet.  I highly recommend  J & S Plumbing of Elk Grove Village, IL for any of your plumbing needs, high quality work at a great price. I would like to again thank Lester & Mike for being so skillful and persistent.

reviews.author: Sandra K.
reviews.text:
February 1st, gotta' love Chicago weather; right?   
-24 degrees with a wind chill of -54 degrees; the pipes in my house can take it; NOT!   After my house and the people and pets in it survived 4 days of non-stop Arctic weather, just when  the temps were to reach a balmy 2 degrees, it happened.   The dreaded cracked pipe.  Luckily, it must had just burst, when we noticed the rec room carpeting was a bit squishy.  We're grateful it wasn't flooded.  

In the past, J&S had been great installing a new ejector pump and adding (I think this is the plumbing term?) a frost proof shut off from the outside hose spigot.  So, with this latest "event", I called J&S.  

Unfortunately, Ed told me that there were about 50 calls ahead of us and maybe I should call other plumbers, as well.   Well, other plumbers had wait lists of hours to 2-3 days.   Who can go that long without flushing a toilet? When the phone rang a few hours later and it was Ed saying a crew could be over in 1/2 an hour.  We were ready to  have a party!

The two guys got the repair made quickly.  They were competent, did neat work and were friendly guys.  We were glad that the bill didn't cause us a heart attack or stroke.   We were thrilled to have water.   

So, thank you J&S, once again.   You guys are the best!   Call them whenever you pipes decide to give you an indoor swimming pool.

reviews.author: Chris R.
reviews.text:
02/01/2022: Adam from J&S came out to replace leaking toilet with a comfort toilet. All went great. I opted to purchase for the Kohler Brand from J&S, which was a bit more expensive.
Total cost: $750.00.
Adam said they could add a spigot to the east side of our house in the future. 
________________________________________________________________________
05/05/2022 Adam and Mike came out to install the spigot and repair the kitchen faucet my husband had installed. The faucet could not be repaired, and we opted for a new Moen model that Adam had on his truck. I appreciate that Adam added an extra water turn-off valve in the crawl space for the new spigot.
Total cost: $1550.00 for new outdoor spigot and faucet.
Adam and Mike were very respectful to us and our home.
The price was fair. I really had no idea what the extra spigot would cost, but I imagined about a grand for the piping and labor.
I appreciate that Adam added an extra shut-off valve for the outdoor spigot - located in the crawl space.
The kitchen faucet was an added surprise, but we made the choice to have the item function properly.
Note: Another plumber I had been working with for a decade said the cost would be enormous and he'd get back to me with an estimate. One month passed, no response. I called to follow up. Still no response. Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Elizabeth S.
reviews.text:
We discovered this morning that our well-past-its-sell-by-date water heater down in the basement had finally failed. In other words, we had an emergency.

I called J&S Plumbing, and the phone was answered right away; the guy promised to have a crew to my house by early this afternoon, and gave me a reasonable quote for the job (based on our conversation).

A little while later, he called back, saying that a crew had unexpectedly become available sooner, and would I mind if they came in about half an hour? Heck, no; I didn't mind!

The guys soon arrived. After taking a look at the situation, they confirmed that the phone quote was valid; they didn't "find" new problems that could "pad" the bill.

The work was done quickly. During the process, they discovered a couple issues (such as the gas line, next to the water heater and heading outside to the grill, being the wrong sort of metal piping) that they dealt with -- at no extra charge. They were completely finished sooner than I'd originally expected them to arrive.

The company's slogan, brandished on their trucks and on the backs of their guys' shirts, is "Because sometimes a flush is better than a full house." You gotta love folks with that sort of sense of humor, especially when it comes with such good service.

I will definitely be using this company again.

synthesis.summary: They'll show up fast — including Saturday afternoons and holiday weekends — but budget-conscious callers should brace for quotes that can more than double once a tech is on-site.
strengths: Emergency responsiveness is the standout: multiple reviews cite same-day or within-the-hour arrival on weekends, holidays, and late nights — including a 2:45pm Saturday and a midnight Friday call
Individual technicians (Greg K, Stephen, Leo, Lester, Keith, Jordan) repeatedly earn praise by name for professionalism, cleanup, and clear explanations
Flat-rate pricing praised in at least two reviews as a welcome protection against surprises, and several customers specifically called final prices 'fair' and 'reasonable'
weaknesses: At least four separate reviews describe final bills exceeding initial quotes — including one case where the charge more than doubled — with the company disputing that any original quote was given
Two reviews flag a non-trivial diagnostic/trip fee (~$100) that is not disclosed upfront, effectively penalizing customers who decline service after seeing the in-person price
redFlags: Multiple reviewers allege upselling pressure for unneeded services or upgrades, with one calling the overall experience 'predatory and disingenuous'

One customer reports being told no one would speak to them about a defective installation because they had disputed the original charge — suggesting billing disputes may close off warranty or resolution paths
Three BBB complaints in the past three years, and the quote-discrepancy pattern across reviews suggests a systemic gap between phone estimates and final invoices rather than isolated incidents
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: reviews document after-hours response (calls answered past 11pm), midnight repairs completed by 3am, Saturday afternoon dispatch when other plumbers bailed, and holiday-weekend service — a frozen burst pipe was resolved within an hour of arrival.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google (4.4/5) and Yelp (4.0/5) are reasonably close, but Yelp skews more critical with several billing-dispute reviews surfacing there, while Google captures more of the effusive emergency-service praise — the gap is modest in score but meaningful in theme.

reviews.text: Had an awesome experience with nexGEN. My water heater completely died on me and the owner somehow fit me in same day. He replaced all the valves on the water inlet and the gas line, and the whole setup looks way cleaner than before. Overall 10 out of 10, would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alyssa C.
reviews.text:
I had a clogged bathtub drain and was honestly expecting a hassle, but this plumbing company made the entire experience incredibly easy. From the moment they arrived, they were professional, kind, and extremely understanding. They didn’t make me feel embarrassed about the issue or try to upsell unnecessary services — they simply got to work and fixed the problem.

They cleared the clog quickly and explained what they were doing along the way, which I really appreciated. It was such a relief to deal with people who were straightforward, helpful, and respectful of my time and home.

If you’re dealing with plumbing issues and want a company that shows up, treats you well, and actually solves the problem without any fuss, I highly recommend them. I’m very grateful for their help and wouldn’t hesitate to call them again.

reviews.author: Joel Cerdan
reviews.text:
Excellent service!!!  Very professional!!!  Highly recommended!!!

The booking process was easy, and they arrived right on time, which is always a big plus! They took the time to thoroughly assess the issue and explained the problem clearly, offering several cost-effective solutions. Their transparency about pricing was refreshing — no hidden fees or surprise charges.

It’s clear that Nex Gen takes pride in their work and values customer satisfaction. I had a leaky pipe with several clogged drains and they fixed it in no time, with no mess left behind. The quality of work is top-notch, and I feel confident that everything is in good hands.

I highly recommend Nex Gen to anyone looking for a reliable, trustworthy plumbing service. They’ve earned a loyal customer in me!

reviews.author: Kyle Jones
reviews.text:
Exceptional Service from Abel Villagomez at NexGen Plumbing & Drain!

I called Abel late in the afternoon with a sewage emergency—my basement in Hobart, IL had flooded, and I was overwhelmed. He didn’t just respond—he committed. True to his word, Abel showed up promptly at 9:15 AM the very next morning, ready to tackle the mess with professionalism and urgency.

His speed of service, reliability, and calm demeanor turned a stressful situation into a manageable one. You can tell he takes pride in his work and genuinely cares about helping people in tough moments.

If you’re facing a plumbing crisis or just want someone you can trust, Abel at NexGen Plumbing & Drain is the one to call. Fast, dependable, and deeply appreciated. 🙌

reviews.author: Jaymin Patel
reviews.text: We have an odd situation with the plumbing not being up to current standards and causing a backflow into our basement through our washer floor drain when the ejector pump is triggered. With our new furnace and AC unit we noticed a lot of condensation water dripping away and triggering our ejector pump, which caused consistent floods into the basement. Abel suggested us two options. One was $7, the other was an estimated $2200 project. One was no benefit to him, and the other had all the potential of a pay day. He gave us his sound advice which benefited him in no way at the time, the $7 fix. We saved money, fixed the issue, and I now know who to call/trust.

reviews.author: Baby Shell
reviews.text: Abel came immediately when contacted to help us solve our backed up kitchen drain. He called and gave us an estimated time of arrival which was exact! He was professional, asked all the right questions to get to the heart of the matter. He checked everything to make sure he was snaking the right area and would go far enough. He was clean and neat, protected my floor as well as under my sink. He snaked our drain and was patient about checking to make sure everything was flowing properly. He cleaned up after the job very efficiently. Highly recommend Nexgen plumbing!!!! Great job!

reviews.author: Hector Martinez
reviews.text: I’ve called Abel at NEXGEN Plumbing & Drain for multiple projects—bathtub drain replacement with new p-trap, laundry slop sink, new water heater installation, and an exterior water spigot with new copper plumbing. Each time, Abel has been extremely knowledgeable, professional, and reliable. He communicates clearly, explains every step, and always provides the best course of action. The work is efficient, thorough, and clean—he consistently goes above and beyond. I always strongly recommend him to friends, family, neighbors, and anyone in need of quality plumbing work.

reviews.author: Ella Hogue
reviews.text: Nexgen Plumbing is what one expects from a professional plumber. Very knowledgeable and professional and courteous. Work is performed in a very timely manner (with very little conversation), thusly, the technician primarily comes to work. Prior to leaving at the completion of services, the technician performed a water test for chlorine content and water texture (hard/soft). Explained work performed, per satisfaction of customer, cleaned area and left. It’s been some time since seeing this caliber of professional work; Nexgen is HIGHLY recommended.

reviews.author: Derrick Beard
reviews.text: I recently had a fantastic experience with a NEXGEN Plumbing. Abel , who came out to fix the shower head arm in my bathroom. He arrived on time and quickly diagnosed the issue, explaining everything in a way I could understand. The repair was completed efficiently, and I appreciated his attention to detail. Not only did he fix the problem, but he also ensured everything was clean and tidy afterward. The shower now works perfectly, and I couldn’t be happier with the service. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Dawn Solano
reviews.text: Excellent service! They truly are experts and go above and beyond with their work. They replaced my vanity sink in my master bathroom and did an outstanding job. They also just recently installed a new sump pump in my basement after heavy rain caused flooding, which was a huge help. They are knowledgeable, reliable plumbers who get the job done right. I highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work in the Joliet area or surrounding areas.

reviews.author: Rick H
reviews.text: Abel was very responsive and showed up exactly when he said he would. Quickly diagnosed the issue with my expansion tank on my hot water heater. Gave me multiple options. I chose expansion tank replacement only at this time and he had the parts on his van. He also had to replace a sensor on the water heater in order for the heater to fire up. He had our water heater back up and running within a couple of hours.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Stillwell
reviews.text: We had a clogged drain at our home in Alsip and called Nexgen Plumbing & Drain, LLC for help. They responded quickly, showed up on time, and explained everything clearly. The technician was professional, respectful of our home, and got the drain cleared fast. Everything is working perfectly now! Highly recommend them to anyone in Alsip or nearby looking for reliable and efficient drain cleaning services.

reviews.author: Sue F.
reviews.text:
We had these guys out for an estimate on replacing our sewer line and fixing our ejector pump. They gave us an estimate of 10,000 to replace the ejector pump, citing it was a commercial grade pump and they would have to dig a new pit in order to replace it. 

After getting estimate from 3 other companies, each of them told me the same.  The ejector pump did not need to be replaced.  Ejector pumps very rarely need to be replaced.   It was an electrical problem and I should contact an electrician to get it repaired.  

They can another totally way high estimate to replace the sewer line (about triple other companies estimate).  

They charged for the estimate too. 

They get the rating for being unethical and charging exorbitant amounts of money for their service

reviews.author: SG H.
reviews.text: The company was several hours late in coming out, rude over the telephone to me when I called to confirm appointment and then promptly charged me $650 to replace a plain old (nothing-fancy) sump pump - which took a whole 30 minutes in labor - but what are you supposeed to do when there's water in your basement? I knew I was getting screwed and they do it with a smile - -  I know Roto Rooter has franchises and that some of them are good so PAY attention to who you are hiring and AVOID this Elk Grove Village location -

reviews.author: Patrick K.
reviews.text:
It all started when my bathtub started filling up with gross water.  My wife and I wanted to go with Roto-Rooter because they seemed to be a reputable business and have been around a long time.  Their response to our problem was very quick.  We called them in the morning and they had someone the next day.  

The first tech they sent worked his butt off.  He was out rodding my front yard for several hours.  After a while he told us the line was not only clogged, but it appears to be broken in at least 1 spot.  He said he cleared the line good enough to use it for things like flushing toilets and taking showers. However, this was an issue that need more attention.  He said he would call his supervisor and that the supervisor would be out tomorrow.

The next day the supervisor arrived an hour after our scheduled time.  He seemed very knowledgeable about the issue and said he had been doing this 10 years.

He ran a camera down and showed us all the issues.  He gave us a quote of 10k+.  This was an unexpected expense but it was a major issue and since Roto-Rooter had a good name, my wife and decided to go with them.

The supervisor showed up on a Monday to have me sign off on the paperwork and said the job would start the next day between 8-10.  This was a 1 day job possibly 2 if there is an issue.

DAY 1The crew showed up roughly around 11 am.  The workers set things up duh holes for the pipe and then left....For approx 2 hours.  When the workers returned they worked for another hour or so

The crew came back around 3 and worked for another hour or so.  Towards the end of the day around 4, one of the workers knocked on my door to tell me they were done for the day.  I looked to the street and noticed water was running from my house down the curb all the way down the street.  The worker stated he hit my outgoing sewer line but it was ok, I still had running water.  He said water would stop running out once the pipe emptied.

After the workers left I evaluated the job site to find the holes they had dug left uncovered and caution tape hanging on by a thread.

DAY 2 The next morning, one of the holes filled up with water.  The hole was approximately 4' deep and nothing safely covering them.  I called the supervisor and told him that the crew needs to come here immediatelty fix up, I live around alot of families with children who could get hurt.  In the meantime, the city came to my door saying that the  water that was still running was actually the water hookup for the city.  The city shut my water off around 12.

The workers showed up around 10:30 covered the holes and left around 1 after the water had been shut off.  The workers would return around 3.  At approx 4:30 they knocked on my door to let me know they had found the issue but unfortunately the water would have to stay off for the remainder of the night.  They did offer my a hotel room which at that point was not what I wanted to hear.

I voiced my concerns to the supervisor that sold me the job and he said he understood my concern but couldnt do anything that day.  I requested a new set of workers because I was worried this expensive job was not being handled properly.  The supevisor said he would look into it.

DAY 3 The same workers showed up.  I called the supervisor and he said he didn't want to rock the boat with the workers or they may walk off the job and I wouldnt be able to get things fixed.  The water was turned on that day.  However the job was not completed.

DAY 4 The workers showed up at their normal time and said the job would most likely get done today.  However, by this point, the city was on to the job at my house and they were making regular visits to make sure the job was being done correctly.  The job was not completed

DAY 5 This was actually a Monday so I had these large exposed holes all weekend.  However, they were covered properly.  The job was finished and approved by the city that day.

CONCLUSION My wife and I are heartbroken and extremely upset by the lack of consideration for my community and the people living in it as well as the response by Roto Rooter themselves when called out.  During my frustration, I contacted the BBB and reported Roto Rooter as at this point, the supervisor I had been speaking with seemed to keep getting me the run around.  Roto-Rooter's response was pretty much "We did our job correctly, JULIE marked the lines wrong, so blame them"  They never addressed and of my other concerns.  

At no time was the supervisor that had sold me the job or any other representative from Roto-Rooter called me or showed up to the job site to address my concerns.  On top of that, when I spoke to the supervisor I had been working with, he really made it sound like all the work that had been done was a band-aid solution and realistically, we may have to dig up the line completely if it happens again.  A 10k+ band-aid.  Thats the work I paid for and the terrible service I received.

reviews.author: Eric S.
reviews.text:
We've used Roto-Rooter to clean out our sewer line as it periodically gets jammed up with root growth every few years.  In 2011 the tech was great, did good work and I was happy with the job.  So happy that I didn't think twice about who to call when we started getting some backup and it was time to get the line cleaned out again.

Quite a different experience this time.  I made an appointment online and selected the 10a-12p window.  Around 11:30 the dispatcher called to let me know the crews were working in the area but running behind.  ETA probably another hour.  Another hour or so passed and another call from dispatch with the same story and this time no ETA to give.  Finally at 2:30 dispatch called to say the tech was en route.

Another hour passes, and around 3:30 I called the dispatcher to ask where the tech was at.  Was told he was real close and he finally arrived shortly afterwards.

First thing I'm asked is if I have a clean-out he can tap into outside of the house.  I told him no it's in the utility room, I've got it open and the area clear and you are all set.  He asks me how long I've lived in my house and, after I tell him, lectures me that "You've lived here 12 years you should have had a cleanout installed outside the house".  For fun apparently.  Or maybe to make the Roto-Rooter guy's life easier.  I explained to him that every other Roto-Rooter guy has been able to do the job without issue from the same cleanout he'd be using.

Next complaint was that he would have to bring his 'big heavy machine' down a short flight of six stairs into my finished basement (again, same as every other roto-rooter guy ever has) because - you guessed it - I never had an exterior clean-out installed.

Finally getting around to looking at the cleanout in the utility room, I'm advised that it's only a 3 inch pipe and that the line by the street is 6 inches.  If I had a (you knew this was coming) 6 inch clean-out installed in any of the last 12 years like I should have, this wouldn't be a problem but as it stands he will only be able to cut a 3 inch hole through the clog.  Also the rusty pipe cap was in dismal shape (it is) and he might not be able to get it back on in which case the pipe would leak inside the wall.  His predecessor has simply smashed plumber's putty around the cap which served its purpose for over two years, which I pointed out.  He wasn't sure he had any plumber's putty.  The guy who works with plumbing for a living...

At this point I lost my patience.  I told him that if he didn't feel he could do the job or planned on leaving me with a mess to deal with afterwards, he could leave and I'd work with another company.  He stopped lecturing, gave me a release form to sign "so I am not responsible for any problems after the job", and went out to drag in his rodding machine.

I called Roto-Rooter management to ask what sort of person they'd sent over.  Got a nice explanation about why the rusty cap on my pipe was no good and how they see this all the time and how having a cleanout installed outside would be a good idea and basically a lot of talk that boiled down to a politer version of the attitude I was already getting from the tech.  Apology for the tech's attitude?  No.  Apology for blowing an appointment window by 3.5 hours?  No.

So the guy did the job and my clog was removed.  He tried to sell me a $20 replacement cap for the pipe, but the ones he had wouldn't fit.  So in the end, he had to use plumber's putty to seal it back on just like the other roto-rooter guys.
Turns out he had had some sitting in his truck the entire time.  Of course it had also frozen solid and couldn't be used.  So - I had to give him a container of mine.

The coup de grace was having to help him carry his big, heavy machine out of the basement.

After he left I spent another half hour cleaning dirt (yeah right) stains off the utility room tile and the basement carpet.  I also have a large, frozen puddle of 'dirt' on my driveway that leaked out of the rodding machine.

This is probably the worst experience I have ever had with a services company.  I used to work construction with my dad as a kid, so I'm aware of and sympathetic to a lot of the nightmare situations these guys have to deal with in people's houses I and tend to cut them a lot of slack.  Even showing up hours late - god knows what he got caught up in that he couldn't walk away from all morning.  No problem.  

But in the end, when I spend my entire day cooped up waiting for someone to show up and charge me $350 for 45 minutes of work - I don't need any attitude whatsoever and I expect them to be able to do the job correctly, with their own tools and without causing me any sort of headaches along the way.

reviews.author: Eric F.
reviews.text:
First time single family home owner here.  I have no idea what I'm doing yet.  Had an unexpected water back up and called one of the only places who answered at 6:30 pm on Thursday night.  That's why they get the 1 star.  They came out promptly.  They didn't call to confirm but they showed up so that was cool.  

First guy was nice.  He sort of explained things.  He kind of laughed as he had me sign the document saying it was 435 to rod from a clean out outside in front to the main line.  The internet says this is a ridiculous price but I had 435 dollars and I had an issue so I signed the form.  He worked for several hours until his machine failed.  He indicated he knew he had issues but had hoped the machine would make it through to the weekend.  I thought this was pretty unprofessional.  He also cut the cable and left a 30 foot metal cable covered in sewage in my front yard.  I guess I get to figure out what to do with that now.  So I now had to take the following day off work to meet with guy number two.  

Guy number two came out and he was also courteous.  He worked for a while and warned me (early on which was obviously a sales tactic) that he felt I may have a collapsed pipe somewhere in the main line.  I immediately hit google for additional info and to prepare myself for whatever bs was about to come next.  They sent a third guy with a camera out.  He showed me the tree roots on the camera and talked about how bad they were and gave me two options.  (Third guy commented on how they would get the metal crap cable out of my yard but they haven't done that yet and its now Tuesday.)    

One, have some guy with a high pressure machine that shoots water through the system that eliminates issues the first tools they had couldn't get.  Camera guy/supervisor expressed this as the only next logical option which would indicate whether or not I needed to go to option 2 I will get to in a minute.  This water pressure guy charges 550 an hour but Roto Rooter will have him cap the cost at 800 just for me.  Read that saturated with sarcasm.  Look up what that service costs elsewhere.  This was complete garbage and literally this company is now just taking advantage of me.  They called the guy and advised him to come over under this assumed close situation.  I am a saleseperson but I don't know anything about plumbing.  I was starting to panic as 435 became 1235 and was potentially about to become:

Option two: 

Lets rip your yard and driveway up and replace the entire line with this way stronger material for an insane number of dollars.            

Between the time the second guy left and the water pressure guy was about to head over... I had a plumber I know and trust become available.  He advised me to call off water pressure guy and said he would head over.  He came over with a heavier duty version of the tool the first two dudes used.  He cleared the obstruction in 35 minutes and wrapped up and my problem was resolved.  He charged me 200 dollars.

At the end of the day, I wish I had the foresight to emergency call the guy I knew instead of calling Roto Rooter during a panic mode.  They would have easily spent 5 times what I should have spent and wasted a ton of my time.  It's unfortunate that companies with names you recognize survive by capitalizing on inexperienced homeowners and a person's trust.  They don't deserve your trust.  They spent 435 of my dollars and 6 hours of my time and didn't actually fix anything and, in fact left a metal cable, covered in feces and grease in my front yard.

Edit: 

Within moments of me posting this review, a representative responded on here.  I emailed them and they called me.  They offered solutions that made me feel a lot more comfortable about potentially using them in the future.  

Situations can go sideways in any business.  The company itself is apparently very attentive to their clients needs and personal and financial situations.  I can certainly appreciate them for making the difficult call reaching out and I applaud them for taking the steps necessary to avoid others from having similar negative experiences.

reviews.author: JoVie W.
reviews.text:
I am writing this review because I want to warn people about Roto Rooter.  I called Roto Rooter because I was experiencing water overflowing from my toilet during heavy rainfalls.  Roto Rooter was late for the first appointment, however, I must say that they did call and were pretty good about keeping me in the loop in regards to when a plumber would be available.  The plumber did arrive, about an hour late. He informed me that I needed a camera inspection and that he was not prepared to do that.  He also said that he was only an emergency plumber and only prepared to rod out the sewer line.  He made an appointment for the next day for a camera inspection.

Next day...The plumber did arrive on time.  The plumber came equipped with an inspection camera and was ready to rod the sewer line.  It was determined that I had roots in my sewer line and that rodding was necessary.  The plumber preceeded to rod out the sewer line.  About 5 mins into rodding he told me that he thought my sewer line was busted and that I may have a broken pipe (1 strike).  I started to freak out and asked for verification.  He told me he would verify after rodding was complete.  He continued to rod the sewer line but kept insisting that the roots were too thick and that he "hoped" he could get through them.  I watched him rod out my sewer.  He was able to get through with the 2 inch attachment but was not able to advance much with the 4 inch.  He said the roots were too aggressive (this process took about 20 mins, including set up). 

He performed a camera inspection after he decided that rodding was not going to work.  The camera inspection did not identify any broken pipes but I could see the roots.  The roots were located on the city property but he told me that I had to have a clean out valve installed on my property to fix the issue.  A $500 job just turned into a $4500 job for a city issue (strike 2).  I asked him why he could not install a clean out valve on the city's side because that is where the issue was.  I wanted to know why he thought it necessary to tear my lawn apart.  He then told me that if I wanted to get the city involved it would cost me an additional $650 to enter the Private Drains Program (which is free by the way if you look it up on the city's website).  He also informed me that it would take the city about 3 to 4 weeks to respond and that he didn't think I had that amount of time.  He also told me that he didn't think that I should use my water (strike 3)! 

At this point, I felt like the plumber was just trying to rip me off and told him thank you for your services and paid him $400 bucks for a camera inspection (he told me he didn't charge me for rodding ....yeah okay!!). I called the city and they said a permit would be $250 and that an inspector would come out the within a week.  The licensed plumber who came 2 days later was able to unclog the sewer line, without any issues, within one hour.  He also used rodding to clear out the sewer line!  I did NOT NEED A CLEAN OUT VALVE WHICH WOULD HAVE COST ME $4500!!! All the original plumber needed to do was try a little hard to get his equipment through.  It's not as if he didn't have time on his hands to do it.  He sat at my house for an additional 2 hours waiting for the finance guy (so that I could finance the $4500) and listening to him reassure me that a clean out valve was necessary.

Beware of being ripped off my Roto Rooter!

reviews.author: Eve H.
reviews.text:
I am writing this  review at the request of Roto Rooter. At the end of the repair the repair man handed me of a flyer that said, "write a review get a refund." But I don't think he counted on the fact that I was unhappy with Roto Rooter they caused a leak in my pipe. 
I called Roto Rooter to get my pipes rodded out after my handyman said that he was unable to fix the slow drain. Before my handyman left he showed me where the pipe needed to be rotted out. He  told me they should not use the drain in the sink because there were too many bends in
 The pipes and they would break the them causing a leak. When the repair man from Roto Rooter  arrived I showed him where he should get into the pipe in the basement. The repair man said oh no I'm going to do it from the kitchen sink, I said , but there are so many bends in the pipe, aren't you afraid of causing a leak? He stated that he knew what he was doing. Before the repair man began he gave me a paper to sign I thought it was just to okay the amount I was going to be charged and giving them permission to rod out the drain. What it was he later told was a disclaimer stating they were not responsible for causing any leaks in the pipes. The workman asked me to watch the pipes in the basement and tell him when he reached a bend in the so he wouldn't create a leak. When he started threading the rodder through the pipe it immediately started to shake and make a loud noise. I told him to stop,  he said he barely had the rodder in the pipe and continued to try to fish the rodder through the pipe. When he finished he told me I had a leak in the pipe in the wall near the sink. This seemed very strange to me since I never had a leak there before Roto Rooter was in my house. The repairman tried to fix the leak with some kind of wax. I called Roto Rooter and reported the leak caused by the Roto Rooter repairman. The lady said they would send someone else out to repair the leak and replace the pipe. I asked if there was a charge and she said no. When the new repairman arrived he informed me I signed a disclaimer and wanted $750.00 to replace the pipe. I said they should repair it for free, the repairman told me he spoke to the first repairman who said I had signed the disclaimer, but he neglected to tell him it had been given to me surreptitiously. I did not have this man replace the pipe, I had someone else fix it  for $350.
I do not recommend Roto Rooter at all but,I had to give them one star since that Is the lowest Yelp will allow me to give.

reviews.author: Eric L.
reviews.text:
I had a problem on Sunday 9/7/14 with a sink drain that was clogged.  I called Roto Rooter and made an appointment for Monday.  The plumber came out and looked at it and told me the drain needed to be rodded to clear the blockage.  I have never had this done, so I had no idea what it was going to cost.  The guy showed me a book and told me it would be $469.  Not knowing what this service cost, I agreed to let him do the work.  Ironically, later that day I received a Valpak in the mail with a coupon for a local plumber that offered power rodding for $50 with no trip charge.  Obviously I got screwed.  The plumber was there for one hour, so $469 for an hour of work seems outrageous.  I will never use Roto Rooter again, and I will make sure everyone I know is told about this experience.  This is totally unacceptable, clearly they are taking advantage of an uneducated homeowner.  I could have even handled three times what the other plumber charges, but almost 10 times the charge is just plain screwing people.  Here is the funny thing, I just looked up the cost of the power rodding equipment on Global Industries website, an almost identical piece of equipment costs $563 brand new.  So what exactly does Roto Rooter do, use it a couple of times and throw it away?  That is the only explanation for this kind of charge.

Follow up:
I called a couple of local plumbers and the average price to Rod a drain was $115 for a kitchen sink.  Therefore I called Roto Rooter to complain.  I was told the price is set by the national home office and there is no negotiation in the price.  They also told me that I was charged $59 for a gallon of enzyme to help keep the drain clean.  I did get this bottle of stuff, but was never told I would be charged for it.  I told them I did not want it, so they said they would schedule a time to come pick it up and give me a credit.  The manager ended the call by saying, "I hope this makes you happy."  Seriously?  I got charged 4 times as much as the average price, plus was charged for a product I never requested, and you think I'm going to be happy?  Do not use Roto Rooter, they will scam you.  Call a local plumber who is fair and honest.

reviews.author: Jaime R.
reviews.text:
The first contact was via email and online.  It was positive.
They advertise free estimates.  When the plumber arrived, the free estimate was over $400 to rod the sewer line or over $300 to use the camera and video the line. I guess they should advertise that the free estimate is to tell you how much it will cost to tell you what needs to be done.  Creative way to mislead the customers.

Once the video was completed, I was told that I had 2 problems and it would cost almost $9,000 to fix it.  The problems were a leaky sewer line connection and a sewer line collapsing.  Basically they need to dig two areas, one about 4 feet and another about 6 feet and replace a couple of pipes, T connector and clean out.  I estimate this should take no more than 12 hours.  So, 12 hours at $750 per hour, not bad.  I want to be a plumber now. By the way, all other plumbers confirmed that it should not take more than 12 hours of work.  When I told the plumber that the cost was too high, he told me that there might be a way to repair the line without digging by patching the pipe.  He told me and wrote on the estimate that he had to talk to his supervisor, Kris, to confirm and he would call me the next day to confirm.  He never called me back, so they lost the business.

Next chapter - I called four other plumbers.  All of them suggested another way to correct the leaky line by replacing the pipe at another area to make sure the problem was fixed right. The final cost was way under half of what Roto-Rooter quoted.

I  do not recommend this company.

12-2-14 Review update.

I was contacted by the customer service team and they sent my comments to Lynnette who called me and we had a productive discussion about the service call. She refunded the full amount of the service call and assured me that Roto-Rooter appreciates my business and wants to keep me as a customer.  I was satisfied by the way she handled it.  I will try them again in the future.  Thanks for listening and for taking care of your customers. I appreciate it.

reviews.author: Lily T.
reviews.text:
I would rate my experience ZERO stars!!! We hired them to do some water mitigation in our basement. First thing the project manager wanted to see was our home owners insurance. Ooh your house has a great policy. Hmm why would he say that?? Red flag #1. We file a claim with our insurance. He tells us that he will send his best team. Next day 2 guys show up and ask what can be thrown out. Me: umm I want to save as much as we can as these are important to my family. Oh ok,
Note: we had original artwork stored in a storage room. We also had 10 folding tables that could have been used. Instead the two guys placed 14 pieces of original art on the wet floor of the basement along with the 14 easels and numerous boxes of personal items that originally were not on the floor but ended up on the floor. Removed
Baseboard/trim and flooring. Sprayed cleaner on the floor. Put a bunch of air movers on the floor, installed a separate circuit for movers. Then they didn't plug them into the separate circuit and blew out AC circuit. Couple of days later we had a major storm in our neighborhood. No power for over 25 hrs.  6 inches of water in the basement and personal items on the floor and original art damaged!Called pm who said we don't work with people who have no power call us back when you do. Umm you are billing yourself as water mitigation but you definitely are NOT. Hired another more reputable company who came
and cleaned up the mess that was made by your team. Insurance paid out a significant porting of your invoice. Why would we pay the remaining balance when you destroyed personal property during your time in our house? If anyone is looking at water cleanup or mitigation this is one company to stay far far away from! More crazy details too much to post and I'm too angry to write about but heed my words stay away from this company!

reviews.author: Jonathan O.
reviews.text:
I don't often write reviews, but in this instance I feel I may be able to help someone in the future.
We had a root problem causing sewage backup in our basement.  We were having other work done at our house through a trusted contractor, so we asked for his help.
He and his crew tried to get the roots out but were unsuccessful with the device they rented from Home Depot.  
The contractor then called Roto Rooter to come out and take a video of what was in the pipe and try to resolve the issue.  

One good thing about the experience is that Roto Rooter was out at our house right away with our contractor. (My wife and I were at work).  After taking a video and looking at the footage, Roto Rooter tried to clear the roots for about 30 minutes to no avail.  This charge was $550.

Then, according to our contractor, the two gentlemen were very bold saying that this should be taken care of immediately and that they will be back this afternoon to rip up the driveway and clear out the roots.  The price quoted for this was $8,000. Luckily our contractor didn't agree and sent them off and called us immediately and advised us to get another opinion.  
After 3 attempts to have the video footage emailed to us, we received it and reviewed it with a couple local plumbers who were not pleased that Roto Rooter wanted to rip up our driveway.
We hired one of them and they cleared the roots within 15-20 minutes with a 3" blade, then went back through with a 4" blade.  They had the issue resolved within less than an hour and guaranteed their work for a year and advised us to have it cleared at least every other year to prevent this from happening again.  

Long story short, get a second opinion.  It could very well save you thousands of dollars.

reviews.author: Jeff T.
reviews.text:
Back in September my toilets weren't flushing fully and there was a sewer type smell in the kitchen.  The Roto-Rooter technician spent all day rooting the lines.  After a full day, and $400.00 later, he told me he did the best he could but it's still not working and I should call his manager.  He was kind enough to leave a Roto-Rooter pen behind but he left it in the back of my toilet!!!!  No kidding, I found it when I lifted the lid off the back.  James came to my home with a camera.  He recommended a pipe patch at the shift and installation of a clean out access between the city and driveway even though I had one in the back yard.

$7,000.00 later and the same problem.  They refunded the initial $400.00 charge for rooting but I was still out $6,600.00.  James had a few different guys come to re root but still no luck.  After several frustrating days James came back with more cameras and a plumber.  They eventually cleared the lines but I wonder if the clean out was necessary as I already had one in the back yard.  The smell remained.

This time they said my problem was broken cast iron under a toilet even though the camera couldn't show it.  No problem, they were willing to rip my floor apart, replace the cast iron, install PVC replacement for the tub and clean the area for a measly $7,500.00.

This time I sought a second opinion.  Guess what?  NO CRACK IN THE CAST IRON!  The problem was a cracked pipe in my kitchen sink.  This legitimate plumber replaced it for $1,800.00  I later found someone to sanitize the area for $1,500.00.

Lesson learned, go with local family owned companies!!!!

strengths: Responsiveness is a genuine standout: at least 4 recent reviewers mention same-day or within-hours arrival, and front desk staff (Valerie named twice) consistently picks up and schedules quickly
Repeat customers appear across multiple reviews spanning years, with at least 3 reviewers explicitly stating they've used DPS multiple times — a real signal of baseline trust
Technicians across recent reviews (Yuri, Jerry, Roman, Dmytro, Sasha, Vadym) are named and praised individually for professionalism and clean work, suggesting consistent field crew quality
weaknesses: Pricing is the single most contested issue: at least 4 reviewers across different years describe charges of $320-$650 for sub-one-hour drain jobs, with one citing online research showing the same service should cost half as much
A 2013 review documents an estimate of $10,000 for ejector pump replacement that three other companies said was unnecessary — the underlying issue was electrical, not plumbing
redFlags: 793 BBB complaints in 3 years is an extreme outlier — that volume against an A+ rating is a known pattern where accreditation status does not reflect complaint load, and homeowners at 2am are especially vulnerable to high-pressure upsells

The Google (4.8) vs Yelp (2.2) gap of 2.6 stars is one of the largest possible on these platforms — Yelp's negative reviews cluster around pricing disputes and overcharging, suggesting satisfied customers leave Google reviews while dissatisfied ones go to Yelp or BBB

Several 1-star reviews describe a pattern of recommending expensive unnecessary repairs (collapsed pipes, full line replacement) that second-opinion plumbers contradicted — this was noted in at least 2 reviews in the analyzed set
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviewers confirm same-day appointments within a couple of hours, one review is timestamped after midnight and references fast service, and the company appears to handle urgent calls including ejector pump failures and burst pipe situations — responsiveness at 2am is plausible but unconfirmed by explicit after-hours reviews.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.8 across 731 reviews while Yelp sits at 2.2 across 100 reviews — a 2.6-star gap that is nearly the maximum possible, with Yelp reviews heavily concentrated on overcharging and unnecessary upsells that Google reviews do not reflect.

reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about my service today with Dennis. He took his time, explained everything along the way, and was extremely thorough, personable, and trustworthy. He gave me a clear estimate, was not pushy, I learned things about my home that I never knew before. Working with a family-owned business was the icing on the cake! reviews.author: L F
reviews.text:
I found my new plumber! I've been using a friend for years, but I needed immediate help. I needed a tankless water heater option and chose a Navien product and was looking for a certified installer. I got several quotes, and decided to go with MDM after meeting Dennis. Dennis is extremely knowledgeable and professional. He really cares about his customers and the work he does. I was confident that he would do a great job. Dennis didn't try to upsell and provided me with what he felt were the best options. He gave me a fair price and I didn't hesitate.

He just finished the install today, and everything is literally perfect. He did everything necessary to make sure that the install was exactly what I needed. Everything was done very well. Water is extremely hot again! He even made sure that the new high-efficiency exhaust pipes had a nice finished look on the outside of the house. He even identified another issue I was having, but felt it wasn't urgent enough to do immediately.

I highly recommend working with Dennis and MDM! They're definitely trustworthy.

reviews.author: Kelly McMahon
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about Dennis with MDM Plumbing. He was absolutely fantastic! He came out to fix a leak from a frozen hose bib, but also took the time to identify and correct bad work left behind by a recent contractor in my bathroom—work that likely saved me thousands of dollars in future repairs.

Dennis was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and patient. He walked me through every issue he found and explained multiple options to fix things based on my budget, without any pressure at all. It was clear that his priority was truly helping me and making sure the job was done right.

He even offered to come back and check future contractor work since I’m in the middle of a home renovation, which speaks volumes about his integrity. You can tell he’s honest, genuine, and takes a lot of pride in his family-owned business, and his pricing was more than fair for such high-quality work.

I’m so grateful I found Dennis and will absolutely be calling him again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jamie Mayhew
reviews.text:
We contacted MDM plumbing to inspect our sump pump as one of the battery lights was out. We recently moved into our home and did not know it needed to be completely replaced. Dennis was responsive immediately on a Friday night when I had a question about the potential issue via email and scheduled an appointment to come look at it. The appointment was a few days out but he did tell me that there were emergency hours available if needed for a fee. When he came, he informed us that the entire sump pump needed to be replaced, which we expected. He was very knowledgeable about the issue.

Dennis was able to give us quotes for multiple options based on budget and what we were looking for. We ended up choosing a better package that would last us longer. Since it was in the evening, he did not have everything that he needed for the job. But he installed a temporary pump (there was a lot of rain coming) and then came back the following evening to complete the job. Everything was completed in a timely manner and we were able to avoid flooding which was a close call. Dennis was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. He gave us education on our water heater that will need to be replaced soon and quotes. We will use them again for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Nancy Colby
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about my experience with MDM Plumbing.  I originally called them out to look at a shower valve problem.  I asked if he could check my sump pump and backup system. He quickly discovered that the backup battery was completely dead.  Something a larger plumbing company had previously missed when they inspected the same issue.

Dennis took the time to walk me through all of my options in a way that was clear and easy to understand, never making me feel pressured.  When he returned to complete the work, we ran into another unexpected issue - my hot water heater started leaking.  Without hesitation, he stated and took care of that as well.

His professionalism, thoroughness and willingness to go above and beyond truly stood out.  It’s rare to find someone who is not only skilled but also takes the time to explain everything and make sure you’re comfortable every step of the way.

I would highly recommend MDM Plumbing & Sewer to anyone in need of a reliable and trustworthy plumber.

reviews.author: Steven Mladenovic
reviews.text: The process to get someone on the phone and out to our home was very quick and easy. The communication leading up to the appointment and expected arrival was very convenient and given to us via text and email. The technician (Dennis) was very thorough and efficient in detecting the cause of the water damage and leak source. The technician (Dennis) did a step by step process eliminating possible causes before moving onto other considerations. The technician (Dennis) also provided other helpful advice regarding other plumbing and homeowner expenses to prepare us for future expenses and replacements that was included within the original dispatch fee. Overall great service and experience, we will definitely use them again for our plumbing and service needs!

reviews.author: Lori Matthias
reviews.text: Definitely 5 stars! I had a clogged kitchen sink. I called on a Sunday afternoon and they answered right away... Made an appointment for Monday morning between 9:00 & 10:00. Dennis arrived right on time (I actually received a text message saying he was in route)... He checked everything out and explained the problem and what needed to be done  for the repair. I was also given different options to resolve this. The quote was given to me and honestly it was around or a little under of what I was expecting... The work was done right away and I was given updates as he was working! Very professional and great service. No extra cost surprises! I will definitely use them again for any plumbing work!!!!

reviews.author: Joe Ayotte
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience working with Dennis from MDM Plumbing & Sewer. He is extremely knowledgeable and friendly. He explained everything and took the time to listen to all questions! If you’re looking for a true professional that takes the time to make sure your issues are addressed, repaired per code and completed in a timely manner, Dennis is the perfect person for you. This is a company that doesn’t cut corners, try to up-sell unnecessary services and they actually show up to do the work as a true 24 hour service company. Thank you guys for getting our issues resolved!!

reviews.author: Kasia Byrne
reviews.text: Dennis came to repair our Navien tankless water heater, it was leaking from the connection between the recirculation pump and the pipe that houses the check valve. I damaged it while replacing the check valve. He knew right away how to fix it, it was a faulty o ring. He did the repair very fast and efficiently and only charged the dispatch fee, no additional fee for the repair! While here he also assessed the state of the unit and provided some extra tips. They seem like a very honest company with great level of expertise!

reviews.author: Rachel Pomykala
reviews.text: MDM was by far the best when it came to customer service, protocol & transparency! I had water overflowing in the basement and unable to shower, do laundry or even wash dishes. I contacted them Christmas Eve and they were very responsive, giving me quick scheduling options, texts and emails with necessary information for moving forward. They did a thorough cleaning of the pipes and within a couple hours, my life was back to normal! Cannot recommend enough and will be reaching out for other necessary maintenance!

reviews.author: GetsMo
reviews.text: MDM plumbing came out on an emergency call to fix/replace my water heater. They did a great job and walked me through everything they did. The price was very fair and much lower than other companies in area I called for estimates for exact same product. I really recommend calling and getting quotes as you will see a difference in how companies mark up standard products. Again, MDM did a great job and gave fair prices. I’ll be having them back to do some other jobs in future.

I needed a bath tub replaced and although I ended up not doing the work, MDM shared invaluable and very knowledgeable advice and explained the pros and cons of such work.  They even told me about companies that can restore some tubs which is many times a viable option.  Anyway, after the conversation I decided not to replace the just the tub but save a bit more maney and then do the tiles and vanity also.
Thank you for your honest advice.

Not only did Dennis do excellent quality work in a timely manner, but he was a delight to have in my home. I highly recommend this company, especially Dennis!  If I could give more than 5 stars I would!!!!!!

Denis is super professional, super friendly, and spent extra time with me to discuss options for my current and future home. I highly recommend using MDM for any service you need.

reviews.text: This company did an outstanding job at my home. They replaced my hot water heater and installed a new battery backup sump pump system, and the quality of their work was top‑notch. These guys truly care about the work they do and the people they’re doing it for. reviews.author: Sean York
reviews.text:
I have nothing but good things to say about MAS plumbing. My initial call was after work, for a slow drain on my kitchen sink, I had a little bit of a slow drain throughout the week, and I thought I had time before things totally clogged up, so I scheduled my visit for the weekend (WEEKEND AVAILABILITY IS SUCH A HARD THING TO FIND). I was told that MAS could have someone come out and perform an inspection and I signed up. I tried to see if I could fix the issue myself using a hand crank drain snake, and I wasn't getting anywhere. Low and behold, later that night my sink and dishwasher totally backed up, and I knew I needed help ASAP.

I called MAS the same day at 9 p.m. and got a hold of their afterhours answering service, who let me know they would forward my call to the office to be addressed the next day. To my surprise, Carl called me back the same night! He offered to come out at 9 p.m. but let me know that since it wasn't really an emergency, he'd recommend that I just wait until the next day. He let me know that they could definitely get me in for the next day, and that he would probably be the one to come out and assist.

Without Carl I wouldn't have been able to sleep, just getting a call back from Carl letting me know that MAS plumbing could be out the next day helped me rest easy.

Carl came out the next day, and KILLED IT. Super kind, professional, skilled and also charismatic. He got the pro-sized snake out and got the job done in less than a couple hours. I could tell he really cared about the client experience, and he was super focused on getting the job done. Carl also went above and beyond and took a look at my drain line set-up so that I could ensure that it was pitched correctly.

I can't recommend MAS enough. The customer service was excellent from start to slightly panicked late-night moment, all the way to when Carl came and won me over as a client for likely the rest of my time in this house.

I'm so happy I found this Company, and Carl made me a client of MAS for life!

Thanks again, Carl and MAS!

reviews.text: I really appreciated Mas plumbing schedule my appointment for the very nice day. Everyone is very nice and friendly tackling the plumbing problem as soon as possible. Matt did an excellent job replacing the wax ring and bolting down the toilet. He was very neat and cleaned up afterwards. I highly recommend Mas Plumping. Thank you for a job swiftly done so my family could use our guest bathroom again. Diana

reviews.text:

Professional attitude - fantastic job.

We’re very thankful for the service we received and will absolutely be calling them again in the future. Highly recommend.

We will always use MAS Plumbing.

reviews.text:

Nick and Matt were friendly, respectful and knowledgeable.  Diagnosed the location of the blockage quickly and accurately, and went the extra mile to ensure the sewer line was clear in front of and beyond the point of blockage.

All of this at a reasonable and on short notice.

Thank you MAS, Nick, Matt and Candy in the office.

Reasonable price also.
