reviews.author: deliciamo
reviews.text: The service was AMAZING!! They were fast prompt and professional. I wasn’t expecting such an excellent service, but I got more than I bargained for. They were so informative and even gave me tips on how to move forward with better care for my plumbing system. I will definitely be using this service again. I am very pleased with my results. The two gentleman need to be recognized for such an awesome job. Great work guys!!

reviews.author: perry knight
reviews.text:
Great! Khaden came out in about 2 hours. He displayed exceptional customer service. Khaden listened, examined, recommended service, and completed service.

Khaden appeared to have a high level of expertise. He recommended action for reducing/preventing clogged pipes. Initial issue was slow draining water, leading to leaking.

reviews.author: David Monatelli
reviews.text: Israel and Mike were out at the specified time and did a fantastic job clearing my septic line. They went above and beyond to make sure I would not need to have my sewer pipe cleaned again anytime soon. Jayson came by after and checked my whole sewer line with this camera. They found a little more Roots so Israel went in and took those out as well. The whole process took over 2 hours. I was happy with the service and price. I recommend using coupons if you can. These guys are fast and good and worth a little bit extra.They went above and beyond to make sure I would not need to have my sewer pipe cleaned again anytime soon.

reviews.author: Lily T.
reviews.text: If there was a way to select 0 stars that's what I would rate this company. My mom called them to do some water restoration after a thunderstorm impacted her sump pump and she had some water in the basement. Someone from the Schaumburg office came out to her home and before even doing anything wanted to see her home owners insurance. Once he saw it then he stated his sales speech. His top team was sent to clean up the damage in her basement. This top team moved cardboard boxes onto wet floor(the boxes were not on the floor initially) they were on the vinyl tile that they removed because they said she needed it removed. In my opinion those boxes could have been put on the furniture that was in the basement but no these fools put it in the wet floor! They installed a separate circuit for their fans and this top team plugged all of the fans in the outlets in the basement and Not in the separate circuit which had over 10 separate outlet plugs. Took out our AC circuits called the same tech who initially came out asked me if it was ok when I called to come out the next day? It was 85 degrees! Problems 1/2. Then two days later our area had a massive thunderstorm so large that our neighborhood lost power for over 24 hrs!!! I called the same tech who told me 'we don't help people without power!' Umm you are marketing yourself as a water restoration company(which obviously you are not!) I finally convinced him to send one of the two guys who did the cleanup work to my mom's house because I said we signed a contract for them to remediate water. This guy shows up and says he needs to find a generator. Takes off for 4 hrs and keeps calling me to tell me he can't find one and he needs to take his wife shopping. I find a generator, ask my handyman to go pick it up which he does brings it to my house and all the other guy from Roto Rooter does is stand there and watch someone else do the work. Made up my mind to cancel the contract and informed my insurance. They said go ahead, hired another company who came in and cleaned up the mess that was left after I told Rotor Rooter to leave. Because of this fiasco, my insurance company sent out 3 adjusters who asked me to explain why which I did. They came up with the amount they would pay out for the work that was done. Meanwhile AP keeps harassing me on payment. I won't pay until insurance pays out the claim. Once the insurance company does I'm on the hook for the balance of the contract that I cancelled because of shoddy work??? Take my advice never ever use Roto Rooter for any work plumbing, water restoration clean up or anything. They over charge for work that they don't know how to do! They are crooks and seriously running a scam! I finally got fed up and turned this mess over to my attorney! So no they didn't do the service my mom requested, quality of work was shoddy and value was not great at all.

reviews.author: Caressa B.
reviews.text:
If you're considering Roto-Rooter, do not hire them. My experience has been a nightmare. It started before Memorial Day when I had a plumbing emergency. While doing laundry, water began coming up around my toilet base and through the tub. Roto-Rooter was the only company open 24/7, so I called them.

They initially quoted me $250 to snake the drain but had me sign a form saying the cost could go up to $2,500. It ended up costing $750 just to snake the drain. A few hours later, I got a call saying they found another issue that would require a $13,000 "temporary fix" or a $17,000 "permanent fix." I consulted my insurance, and Roto-Rooter assured me everything would be covered. I reluctantly agreed to the $17,000 fix, only for them to dig up my yard, remove my wheelchair ramp, tear out a tree my grandparents planted, and leave me without water for days.

When they finally returned, they claimed they needed an additional $4,999 to finish. My dad, a retired sheriff, called law enforcement to document their behavior because it was obvious they were trying to strong-arm us. They refused to finish unless we paid. We had no choice but to hand over more money.

Fast forward to months of ongoing issues: my yard is still a mess, and I had to hire another contractor to repair the sidewalk they destroyed and reinstall my mom's wheelchair ramp in October. After that job, I noticed my electricity wasn't working. My circuit breaker had tripped, but I couldn't figure out why.

Now, just a few days before Christmas, I woke up to an electrical surge and my circuit breaker tripping again. I called an electrician, and after thoroughly inspecting my outlets, switches, and fixtures, they found nothing wrong inside the house. Then I remembered: Roto-Rooter tore out my yard light pole during the plumbing job, leaving a live wire exposed in the ground.

The electrician confirmed that the exposed wire was the issue. This means that for months, my family and I have been living with a live wire in our yard, unknowingly moving it around. My dad and I both handled it several times without realizing the danger. Roto-Rooter's negligence could have killed me or my family.

All these ongoing problems--months of repairs, electrical issues, and the cost of fixing their sloppy, destructive work--trace back to Roto-Rooter's incompetent and predatory practices. My insurance company even told me they don't recommend Roto-Rooter because this kind of extortion and shoddy work is their standard operating procedure.

I've spent over $21,000 dealing with them, plus countless hours and additional costs fixing the damage they caused. I still don't have all my receipts, despite months of requests. These lying, conniving, thieving snakes are not just scammers--they are dangerous.

Save yourself the heartache, financial drain, and risk to your safety. Do not hire Roto-Rooter. They are con artists who prey on people in desperate situations and leave chaos in their wake.

#RotoRooter #ScamAlert #Fraud #Negligence

reviews.author: Richard B.
reviews.text:
Six months of hell $20k in the roto rooter hole. I had a toilet plug up near the end of October that flooded the bathroom. I had an older house but a bathroom I had remodeled about a year prior to October. New walls, paint, piping and a somewhat pricey tankless toilet that never plugged up. Even my old toilet never plugged up. So Roto Rooter, to their credit, came quick on a Sunday. It's been pretty much downhill from there. They wanted to excavate a good chunk of the basement, the storm drain and install a cleanout in the front yard because they detected two blockages. I couldn't figure out why, and I was especially skeptical of the storm drain since it didn't seem to have anything to do with the sewer line, but I'm not an expert on those things. The project manager said he woud do everything at a discount of $15k and since it was an older house, I figured I might as well handle it now. They also tested for mold and water damage and didn't find any. The first day the project starts, in early November, the project manager doesn't show up and people begin excavating in the wrong direction and away from the sewer line, to the piping of what might've been the plumbing for a nonfunctional bathroom in the basement. I asked to stop and talk to the project manager and one of the plumbers, right in front of me, decided to keep cutting one of the pipes. I put things on pause and reschedule for when there's an actual plan. Everything ends up getting dug up, even the pipes that weren't included in the blockage and the storm drain, but I was told the price would still be the same. We also reroute the drain for the air conditioning from the condenser pump by running a tube over to the sump pump. Well, I got charged $20k, then when I ask what happened to the discount, they can't seem to get a hold of the project manager while at the same time, threatening to send me to collections because I didn't sign a slip that I never received (though I had the financing approved). In December, I finally get a slip but apparently I could only get a discount down to $18k. I'm done, or so I thought. 

In February, my toilet plugs up again. First guy comes by and says its because my toilet was improperly set. I also have mold in my new bathroom floor now because of the setting. So I ask if it's covered under warranty. Roto rooter's office says they'll handle it free of charge and send out another team of expert plumbers. No, the plumbers say, the toilet wasn't improperly set, but the toilet itself is supposedly the issue along with the amount of toilet paper being used. They say they can either fix it now for $1k or come back tomorrow for $2k. Also, since they diagnose it's not Roto Rooter's fault, I'm also getting charged for the drain cleaning, so it ends up being about $2k anyway. Thinking about it for fifteen minutes was taking up too much of their time and I had to make an immediate decision. Feeling helpless and wanting to be done with it, I agree. So they remove my toilet and cut into the remodeled wall to make room for a standard toilet and cover the hole with plywood (which of course, doesn't match with the repainted, remodeled walls).

The new standard toilet plugs up more than the remodeled tankless toilet I had.

And, as a kicker, with the warmer weather, I just started running my air conditioning and when I went down to the basement an hour ago, I was disappoitned to see that the rerouted drain from the condenser pump is now leaking.

Every time I talked to someone from Roto Rooter, I got a different answer. Discounts, whether it came from the project manager or from their office, were just verbal and never ended up on paper. Meanwhile, being threatened with collections when I'm the one actively communicating and asking "where's the receipt to sign? why is the amount incorrect?" I feel I was upsold on "repairs" I didn't need and, in the end, after $20k, my toilet is plugging up more than it did before. Perhaps there's something from the toilet paper itself that's doing it, I don't know, but you'd think a professional plumber company could diagnose that instead of ultimately making things worse and more expensive. In any event, the next time it plugs up, I'll probably check Craigslist before Roto Rooter.

reviews.author: Kyle J.
reviews.text:
WARNING: TRUST ALL OF THE HORRIBLE REVIEWS ABOUT THIS COMPANY!

Our sewage main backed up late at night on a Friday, two days after my wife and I had just returned from the hospital with our first child. After a quick Google Search for 24/7 plumbers, I decided to give Roto-Rooter a call. At around 11:30 the next day, a technician came out and discussed the different services available. After discussing with my wife, we decided to root the main (a must in order to use water) and the camera search because we could see what other underlying issues could be there, totaling in at just over $1,100. We were also told we would be getting a digital version of the video taken of the pipes to refer back to if we decided to delay work. After about 15 minutes of rooting the cleanout drain, the technician told us he had cleared the blockage, and showed me the cleanout. The water flow was still extraordinarily slow. Soon thereafter, the camera tech arrived and took a video of our plumbing inside and outside the house. After only about 5 minutes of running the camera, he called me outside to show me his findings. According to him, there were tree roots that had broken through the T-joint on our sewage main, which was what was causing the back-up. They explained to me that this would need to be fixed immediately, because we couldn't even flush toilet paper without it causing a blockage (again, according to the technician). We were quoted $7,500 for an excavation of the soil (which included removing a couple of small bushes), fixing the t-joint, and backfilling the soil. The cameraman said he'll talk to his boss to see what he could do price-wise; coming back about 10 minutes later with a "discounted" price of $6,800. This price was all contingent on if we agreed to do the job with their company. The camera tech even had the balls to say "I mean if you don't book with us, I'm going to get my $500 either way." In other words, book our services or we're going to charge you full for the other two services. Also, when I asked the camera tech when we would be receiving the digital video, he replied that they didn't do that and I would not be receiving it, claiming they only used it for "court hearings."
After wanting to get a second opinion and finding out that we have family members who repair and replace sewage mains, they were astounded by what Roto-Rooter quoted us. He said he could get two people to do the job, one hand-digging the hole and the other repairing the plumbing pipes. We decided to go with them instead of Roto-Rooter. Long story short, after they dug down to the break in the t-joint, they realized something ridiculous. They came back and told us that somebody had stepped on the main clean-out and snapped the t-joint! Now, I can't prove it, but we almost know for a fact that one of the technicians stomped on the cleanout, breaking it knowing very well that with us recently having a newborn, we would be very desperate to fix the issue and fix it quickly. This company is a total scam;  everybody working for this company are con-artists and I don't know how they sleep at night. I would not recommend this company to my worst enemy. 

STAY AWAY!!!

UPDATE 5/12/23:
After spending over 45 minutes on the phone with a representative from Roto-Rooter's corporate branch, I fully stand behind my review. Throughout the entire conversation, the representative talked in circles, defended their employee's actions and behavior, and talked over me nearly every time she asked for details or clarification. She did not even offer up so much as an apology for the way we were treated. This conversation was another shining example of Roto-Rooter's disrespect towards their customers.

reviews.author: Anthony V.
reviews.text:
I'm iffy about what kind of review I should write. I do feel there was some over estimating of labor. 

We had clear blockage in our sewer line. I tried to do my own investigation and work but could snake anything out and was able to get about 20' in the line. I Called Roto rooter on Thursday. They came out when I asked. They had to pull the toilet in order to snake.

The drain tech spent an hour or so but couldn't get past where the sewer line dropped a few feet to go under the foundation. The tech called a supervisor who brought in a camera. I watched the camera. Clearly it was sludgy and clogged. More work was clearly required at this point. That was all fine. The tech and supervisor were great. This was a $750 service. Note this DID NOT clear the line. Although the paper work says that the line is cleared and warranties for 6 months. That didn't make any sense and should have caught it sooner. If the line is cleared then why is further work necessary? I should just kept calling him back every day since it was covered in the warranty? 

The first quote for excavating up to a 10ft section near my foundation and under a concrete slab, to jet the entire line, and to install clean out was initially $11,500. I definitely hesitated with that quote. I definitely pushed back asking what part of the labor I could get done, such as tearing out concrete, etc. the field supervisor made a call and came back with $9,500. I then tried to get the initial $750 snake work removed since it didn't do anything. But I was told that would most likely not happen. I should've pushed harder especially after seeing the paperwork saying it was cleared. Ha - that's a blatant lie. So all in $10,250. 

I was initially okay with this and signed all the papers for the work to commence. I did ask for a break down of the pricing. But only received a generic description of the work. Now that the work is done I do wonder about the pricing. Three guys worked on this line. Two guys worked on the excavating and new pipe install 4' of sewer line and 6' of clean out line. I clocked about 9 hours of on-site labor. The guy who hydro jetted the line was probably on site about 2 hours. I guess that's for you to judge. They did partial work on Friday 10a-12p and then 4p-6p and finished on Saturday 1045a-345p

The costumer service was great. I was popping in on all the work being done. Anytime there was a camera involved I was looking over their shoulder. And they were cool with that. Definitely wanted to see and understand the process. Which made me realize I should've just rented the excavator myself to install a clean out and then just paid for the jetting. 

All the work comes with a 5 year warranty on parts and labor.

reviews.author: Laura P.
reviews.text:
TERRIBLE SERVICE AND MANAGEMENT. DO NOT HIRE THEM FOR YOUR SERVICE. RUDE AND DISRESPECTFUL TO THEIR CUSTOMERS. DESERVES ZERO STARS.

I received service from Roto Rooter to getting sewer rodding done. I was given a two hour time frame when I initially called. Two hours later, I received a phone call that the technician was running behind schedule. The technician said it would be 400 hundred dollars for an outdoor rodding service when he came. We came to agreement to a lower price that would include both the rodding service and for camera inspection a couple days later included in that price. The technician mentioned I would hear from Roto Rooter a day or two later regarding the camera inspection...I never heard back, so I called the following week to get a status update.

When I called to get an update, the dispatcher not only raised her voice at me and argued with me, but also hung up on me without listening to the full story!! They were going to charge me an extra couple hundred dollars to have someone come do the camera inspection. I told the dispatcher that is not what I was told and what was written on the paper. I also have video proof of the conversation through our doorbell with the technician stating the camera inspection was included in the price. 

I had to call back off a different number for them to answer and speak with management. The manager was not willing to listen to the story of what happened, but instead was defending the employees while also being rude. What kind of company allows their employees to speak rudely and raise their voices at the customers and hang up on them. She said she does not allow customers to raise their voice at employees, but was okay with the employees raising their voice at me and hanging up. What kind of training and service is that!! It was very rude and disrespectful.

I DO NOT plan on using this company ever again. They try to scam you out of money for a service that won't take long, while being rude and disrespectful. Like other reviewers have mentioned, there are other companies providing  higher quality services at a lower price, who have better customer services skills than the employees at Roto Rooter. It is unbelievable they allow their employees to talk like this to customers. Never using them again!

reviews.author: Christina C.
reviews.text:
I honestly wished I read the Yelp reviews before I reached out to Roto-Rooter. Silly me for thinking a big business would actually have good process and people. 

As others have said, they subcontract out their work. Someone named David in an unmarked white van arrived. We had an odor coming from our sump pump. He promptly told me that our sump pump needed to be replaced. 

I almost fell for it too because he was initially convincing about how old our sump pump is and needing a backup pump and battery. And I had agreed to that work. What really got me suspicious was when he then told me that I had to replace the ejector pump too because the warranty is only 3 years old. I kept pressing him on warranty vs actual lifespan and he kept saying warranty is warranty and it needed to be replaced. Then started to give me a "if you buy two, you get 20% off the second today but if you decide tomorrow, the deal goes away. I don't make this up, Roto-Rooter does."

He left to go get parts. He had said he doesn't make up the pricing And I promptly called Roto-Rooter to ask about the pricing. The receptionist said that the technician comes up with the price and Roto-Rooter has no insight. I told her to cancel the work order because this was so sketchy. She then said she had to call the dispatcher. The dispatcher called me, assured me I wouldn't have to pay anything and that I could cancel. 

When David returned for his tools, he wanted to charge me $411 for having done absolutely nothing but claimed it was for 1 hr of analyzing the problem. He said because I agreed to the work then changed my mind. I was happy to pay for his time but asserted that I was told I didn't have to pay. So I ended up paying $200.

I had a small business plumber come out and they were able to quote me at $750 for replacing the sump pump when Roto-Rooter was going to charge me $1300.

reviews.author: Emily W.
reviews.text:
I have never had a worse experience with any company in my life. My new condo kitchen sink drain was apparently clogged between my condo and my neighbors upon move in. I called roto rooter. They sent someone that day to quote me. They quoted my $400 to snake/unclog my drain. I said no way so they walked out and came back in and quoted $275. Wow. Nice. I said I'll look around because that seemed shady but had to call them back since no one else was available Labor Day weekend. This was Thursday so they came back Friday. They tried for 2 hours (one guy seemed to be training another guy) to snake/clean out my drain. They could not get to the blockage and then recommended I hydrojet the drain. They told me roto rooter doesn't do this but they do. 

I then called roto rooter to do they jetting and they said they would send someone out Saturday in the morning. I waited all day and someone showed Saturday night. He was the camera guy that needs to inspect the pipes with a camera before hydrojetting and said this was never a hydrojet job, this pipes won't even fit his camera and said he had to leave for an emergency but someone would call back.

I had to call 3 times before someone finally responded, sorry, yeah, you need to have a tech come back and try and unclog it again. Maybe they went the wrong way in the pipes. I waited all day Sunday and was led to believe someone would come out. No one did. Same thing happened on Monday. My entire Labor Day weekend was spent waiting on this company. I will never recommend them or speak positively about them moving forward.  Worse customer service than Comcast. 

D&B plumbing came out Tuesday morning and fixed the clog in 30 minutes. Do yourself a favor and book that lovely company and never touch Roto Rooter.

reviews.author: Shalonda C.
reviews.text: If I could give 0 stars, I would.  This entire company is a scam.  Years ago, I called them out, and their technicians were drinking beer while on the job.  They price services however they feel.  On Christmas, I called them out and their tech charged me $800 for a sewage back up, only for it to happen again months later.  They keep telling me I need rodding and everytime they come out, they said they did it.  Well April 28th, I had a major back up, where my entire 3600 sq ft basement was full of sewage.  Dave came out, sold me a pecoating (sp?) service for $4500, only for the exact same back up to happen 05/27 so not even 30 days later.  Now, they are out here again, doing the same rodding.  I came in from a holiday weekend out of town last night to a home full of sewage.  Nico, a call center rep told me they would have a clean up crew on the the way, last night.  No one showed.  They called this morning and said they would have a crew on the way, but I would have to pay for it.  ARE YOU KIDDING?  I have paid you over $5000 since December, with no results.  Their call center reps don't operate off integrity.  Not being honest about where they are located - as they are probably remote.  If so, just say that.  And now, a manager won't even get on the phone and talk to me.  Call center keeps sending me to random voicemails, and no one is available.  They were available when they STOLE my money, but now, won't even get on the phone.  I am a single mother with a child in college, I don't have $5000 to give to this billion dollar corporation, to keep living in sewage.  They took complete advantage of me, and are here right now, taking advantage of me.  DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.

reviews.author: Anna P.
reviews.text:
The plumbing itself is fine, the employees are a mixed bag though. I had been through 6 of their plumbers/excavation people for one project that escalated into a larger project. Some of their team members were informative and professional, some of the others are very much unprofessional. 

One of the plumbers (he gave 'where's my hug?' energy right off the bat) made a pass at me and admitted it was inappropriate only to persistently text me to 'check in,' when he could've replied via the email his office was cc'd on. Also I told him it would be weeks before I could commit to their proposal multiple times. I was obviously ignoring his messages and when I brought up how uncomfortable it made me to the office, they didn't apologize, dismissed my claim, and defended the plumber. It wasn't until I spoke with a manager that they apologized and assigned someone else. It was pretty violating to put trust in a company to come into my house for quotes and have direct my contact info only to hit on me. Like I don't want to pay you to come back to my home and gawk at me.

Also there was another member of the team whom didn't show up to scheduled appointments for a week without contacting me and dispatch was pretty useless in tracking this person down. When he finally showed up, didn't even acknowledge he had missed those previous appointments at all..

It was a project for my HOA I took on, and roto rooter was their preferred plumber so I was tied to this company to get my problem fixed. They solved my problem eventually but it was a pain to get there and annoying to deal with their shitty team members. Use at your own caution.

reviews.author: Alex S.
reviews.text: My flush valve was broken and needed to be replaced. No other issues. All the plumber did was go to the store to buy the part and open the lid of the tank to swap out the part. When I did a google search of how much it would cost to fix the issue, it said within the $150-200 range. So imagine my shock when the plumber tells me $690 and this doesn't even include the cost of parts. I can respect this is a high cost of living area, but over 3x the price of a Google search is a pretty huge difference. I even asked to see a price breakdown just to make sure the plumber was not charging me for any extras and his price sheet did in fact say $690. I felt pressured to agree when it was quoted to me because when I booked the appointment, I received an automated email from Roto-Rooter stating that I would be charged a $99 service fee just for the technician to come out and that it would be removed once services were complete. I wasn't sure if this meant the quote or actual plumbing work and I was too flustered to ask. I used Roto-rooter in 2022 and 2023 and was never presented with a $99 service fee or been so taken aback by their prices before but I will definitely not be using them again after this experience. I also want to be clear - there was nothing wrong with anything the plumber did. He showed up within the arrival window, fixed the issue, and charged me based on his price breakdown sheet. All of the negativity in this review is purely about their business practices.

reviews.author: Frances S.
reviews.text: Be careful when booking appointments with this plumbing company! There fee for less that an hour typical plumbing service is outrageous! No parts, no water restoration, no leaks, simple snake drain was utterly ridiculous. Not only that, when I booked the appointment I (not my partner) was advised that I would be provided a quote before any work was done. The plumber arrived and had my partner sign to do work that I (the owner of the unit) was not informed of. First, I would have neve,,, ever paid that much for a simple drain snake,, $700+! Next, I felt that they took advantage of me by not letting me know the cost of the job. They said, oh no, we don't quote over the phone. Should have been my first red flag! I am so upset I am seeing red. When I called to complain about the absolute inflated rate, I was told that was their price and if I had a problem with what they charged, I would have to take it up with my partner and his credit card. Really!!!? You charged 3 times what other companies like Four Seasons, Shout out to them, I should have called them but Roto Rooter came up on my search first. Never....ever...never again! Then on top of all that, they gave a 6 month guarantee. For What? The issue only happens every two or three years!!! This company sucks rocks!!!! Lesson learned. Roto Rooter, you will not be in business much longer.. Unlike me, I hope everybody reads the reviews before calling your company. What a JOKE!!!

synthesis.summary: They'll show up at 2am when nobody else will, but expect vague upfront quotes that balloon mid-job and prices running 2-3x what local plumbers charge.
strengths: Confirmed 24/7 and weekend availability: at least 3 reviewers explicitly note they were the only company willing to come out on a Sunday or holiday
Individual technicians frequently praised by name for professionalism and knowledge (Khaden, Israel, Orion, Deshaun, Jonathan cited across 5+ reviews)
Several reviews mention thorough post-service walkthroughs and camera inspections to identify future issues without hard-selling
weaknesses: Pricing is consistently described as 2-3x market rate: specific examples include $720 for a 15-minute drain rod, $1,120 for a 30-minute valve replacement, $625 per faucet, and a $2,000 labor charge for a 5-hour water heater install
Multiple reviewers report mid-job price increases after work has already begun, leaving customers no leverage to refuse — a structural billing pattern, not isolated incidents
redFlags: At least 4 reviews describe technicians using camera inspections to pitch high-cost repairs ($7,200 liner, $13,000-$17,000 pipe jobs) that independent plumbers later said were unnecessary or grossly overstated
Two reviews report work performed without authorization or under pressure, including one case where a $3,300 job was done while the homeowner was absent with only a spouse present
One reviewer documents a live electrical wire left exposed in their yard for months after Roto-Rooter excavation work — a serious safety hazard
BBB shows 792 complaints in 3 years despite an A+ rating, and Yelp sits at 1.5/5 — both directly contradict the 4.7 Google score and suggest the positive reviews skew heavily toward simpler jobs
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Genuine 24/7 availability is their clearest strength — multiple reviewers confirm same-day or within-2-hour response on Sundays, holidays, and late nights when every other option was closed.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.7/5 across 8,464 reviews while Yelp sits at 1.5/5 across 100 reviews — a 3.2-star gap almost certainly explained by Yelp's self-selecting audience of dissatisfied customers, but the 792 BBB complaints in 3 years adds independent weight to the billing and workmanship concerns that Google's volume obscures.

reviews.author: Kathy

reviews.author: Jeff Ashlock
reviews.text: We had John replace all of our water pipes from steel to copper. First he was very prompt even early for the day of the estimate. As far as the estimate went I had researched what the job should cost and it was right in the ballpark so I didn’t bother going to anywhere else being that this company had good recommendations. Finally two days of work and all was excellent he was again a few minutes early to work which is gold in my book. John is super nice and knowledgeable and answered all questions I had about our plumbing system as well as easy to have conversation with I couldn’t say enough nice things. All the work was completed on time and as promised. He even went above the call of duty taking action on what needed to be replaced. We’re so pleased with he job and most of all we can use both bathrooms at the same time with the washing machine and dishwasher going all together. I will definitely be keeping Ford plumbing on file and recommended to a few friends already.

reviews.author: Robert H.
reviews.text:
Last week I made an appointment with Ford Plumbing, Lake Zurich, Il. to come to my home to fix three different problems I was having with my plumbing. Chris showed up exactly at the specified time,and I explained the problems to him and he began working on one of the problems. A short time later the owner of Ford Plumbing, John arrived and started on the other problem. 

One of the problems was an ejector pump in the basement which John examined. He could have easily told me I needed a new pump, but instead he said it was just a sticky switch which he quickly fixed. 

At the conclusion I was very happy with their honesty, and the manor in which they worked, and the price I paid for their work. If you need a plumber, call Ford Plumbing.

reviews.author: Donna C.
reviews.text: My husband and I had an emergency plumbing situation that happened over the 4th of July holiday weekend. We scrambled to find a plumber. The 1 plumber that  told us they could help us right away was Ford Plumbing!  We would have had to wait many days for any other plumber, and when it comes to plumbing, time is of the essence!  John Ford came out and not only is he efficient, but he is also very nice, knowledgeable, friendly and reasonably priced. He expertly fixed our plumbing situation in a matter of minutes and guarantees his work!  We will most definitely call Ford Plumbing again the next time the need arises and recommend John and Ford Plumbing to everyone who needs an outstanding plumber!

reviews.author: Christine Hardwick
reviews.text: Started to have a rank smell in the hall bath. At first, I thought it was just teenage boy funk but this was just too much of a London sewer smell. Ford plumbing was recommended by someone on Nextdoor. Called and left a message - Jim texted back and had me do a simple test to see if it could be diagnosed. It was and he had someone come out within a couple of days. Tech was super polite, work was done quickly, and he cleaned up after himself. After a thorough explanation of what he did (he also fixed a leaky outdoor tap), he was on his way and the bathroom was no longer attracting flies. Price was reasonable and communication was great....will definitely use Ford again!

reviews.author: J Johnson
reviews.text: I was trying to get a general quote on replacing a hot water heater. I called and left a message. They only texted me back, no common courtesy of a phone call. I gave them all the information. Current model, exact specifications, photos. Every detail they would need to give me at least an estimate to see if I could afford them. They wanted to come out which was fine but I didn’t want to waste anyone’s time if I knew I couldn’t afford them. They basically said I wasn’t being cooperative and they’d pass on helping me. Wow. Nice way to treat a potential customer (this all happened in under 5 minutes mind you). Now I I get to post bad reviews for them. Not that they care.

We had a clogged drain.  Called John, he returned the call within 20 minutes and came out the next morning, on Saturday, and NO upcharge.  His rate for a service call is $160 for one hour.  This is a little higher than our usual guys but we get a discount.

John riddled out the drain, made some suggestions regarding a couple other issues, cleaned up perfectly.

Would recommend this company.

My husband contacted John at Ford Plumbing regarding a leaking water pipe in the basement.  John's response was quick.  He found the problem right away and was able to take care of it promptly.  John was very friendly.  For those who are particular about cleanliness - he covered his shoes upon entering the house and left the area he worked in as clean as it was when he arrived.  I felt his fee was very reasonable and would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Melissa J.
reviews.text: We had a small wet spot in the ceiling of our basement bathroom that we decided we better get checked out. We called Ford Plumbing and they were able to come out the next day. They were able to identify and fix the leak, and since it was a basement bathroom, they were able to install a small access door in case of future issues that also allowed us to avoid having to repair the ceiling. All said and done they were in and out in under a half hour and after expecting a big expense I thought their pricing was very fair. I would definitely use them again for any plumbing needs!

synthesis.summary: John Ford delivers consistently fair pricing and tidy, competent work across 20+ years of repeat customers, but a recent 2024 complaint alleging significant undisputed damage and a communication score of 58 are real concerns before you hand over your house at 2am.
strengths: Pricing consistently praised across 10+ reviews, with one customer citing a $500 savings over a competing quote on the same water heater
Multiple long-term repeat customers spanning 10-20 years, with several explicitly saying they will never use another plumber
Cleanup and punctuality flagged positively in at least 8 separate reviews, including one reviewer noting he left the area cleaner than he found it
weaknesses: Communication scored lowest at 58, with at least one reviewer describing being told Ford would 'pass on helping' them when a dispute arose, suggesting conflict resolution can break down fast
The November 2024 one-star review alleges thousands of dollars in documented damage with zero accountability or apology from the owner, and this review has not been publicly addressed
redFlags: The 2024 damage complaint is specific, documented per the reviewer, and describes the owner accepting zero responsibility — a serious pattern risk for emergency work where mistakes are costlier

One review describes a Ford company van driver nearly causing a serious accident while speeding with reckless lane changes, raising questions about who is operating vehicles and reflecting on business oversight
synthesis.emergencyNotes: At least one review confirms same-day sump pump replacement when called, another confirms next-morning Saturday service with no weekend upcharge, and a decade-long customer says he calls John without hesitation when something goes wrong — reasonable signals for emergency availability, though no explicit after-hours or burst-pipe response is documented.

reviews.author: Gabriele Biondolillo
reviews.text: Had a plumbing emergency and these guys came to the rescue. They wasted no time and got the job done well and timely!

reviews.author: Vita Yuzko
reviews.text:
We recently had a smart water shut-off system installed, and the whole experience was excellent from start to finish. The installation process was smooth, professional, and completed on time. The installer explained how the system works, helped set up the app, and made sure everything was functioning properly before leaving.

The system itself gives great peace of mind — it monitors water usage, detects leaks quickly, and can automatically shut off the water to prevent damage. The setup was clean and well done, with attention to detail and no mess left behind.

Overall, I’m very satisfied with both the installation service and the smart water shut-off system. Highly recommend for anyone looking to protect their home from potential water damage and upgrade to a smarter home solution.

reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of using Smart Home Plumbing to fix a stubborn kitchen clog, and I am beyond impressed. The technician arrived promptly, was extremely professional, and took the time to explain the issue and the solution. The service was efficient and thorough, ensuring that everything was working perfectly before they left. I appreciated their attention to detail and the respect they showed for my home. Smart Home Plumbing truly lives up to their name by delivering intelligent and effective plumbing solutions. I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Anna Kinyak
reviews.text:

What really stood out was his attention to detail and how clean he left everything after the work was done—no mess, no stress. It’s not easy to find someone this reliable and trustworthy these days. If you’re looking for a skilled plumber who truly cares about his work and his customers, this is the one to call!

reviews.author: Stacey Hersh
reviews.text: We had Yaro from Smart Home Plumbing come over to take a look at several issues we were having throughout the house. He was prompt, did a thorough assessment, and took immediate action to fix all of our problems. He is kind, patient, and his pricing was very reasonable. Yaro even came back the same week when we forgot to address one of the problems we were having. We have had larger companies tell us they wanted to do more invasive procedures for way more money, and Yaro was able to fix everything on the spot and is fantastic. I highly recommend his services!

reviews.author: Ivan Oleshchuk

The team was punctual, knowledgeable, and efficient, navigating the limited area skillfully. They answered all my questions thoroughly, and the installation was swift, leaving the area clean. Our new heater works perfectly, improving energy efficiency and providing endless hot water. Highly recommended for their professionalism!

reviews.author: Valeriia Lebedeva

Highly recommend their services to anyone looking for quality plumbing work, professionalism and a great attitude.

Highly recommended.

I highly recommend Urban Plumbing for any plumbing project.

The last jobs they did for me were awful! Replacing the guts of an exterior water spigot that was dripping when turned on, only to have it dripping when it was turned off! They then came and replaced the exterior water spigot but it was dripping slowly when shut off. I was told this would stop over time. Fast forward three months and the PVC that was connected to my sump pump had come apart on the outside! Also installed by them, they noticed my exterior water spigot had filled with water and froze into a block! 
They blamed me for not turning off the shut off valve inside and called me a liar. I explained to them the front water spigot has never been shut off either and never had any issues! I turned it on a week ago full blast and now it just drips water! The reason this happened is because the faucet NEVER STOPPED dripping the entire time!!! Terrible owner and service!

After a house call assessment on my current system  , I agreed it needed a full update. Nick was able to install a complete new system with WiFi notifications. Now I have peace of mind, especially with spring showers. The price was very fair and he explained the entire system. He also performed real time testing with notifications on my cellular phone. I highly recommend this company. Very professional and respectful of your property.  Thank you Urban Plumbing inc. If you want fair pricing, reliability, and professional service do not hesitate to hire Urban Plumbing inc.

What really stood out to me is that they understand the specific requirements and specifications for businesses like beauty salons. They gave me the right advice throughout the process, which made everything much easier.

I highly recommend Urban Plumbing Inc. to anyone planning to build or renovate a salon or a similar type of business. You’ll be in good hands with them!

We called Urban Plumbing Inc. around 4 a.m., and to our surprise, they answered right away! Their technician, Nick, arrived at our house by 6 a.m. and got everything under control quickly and professionally.
Nick was polite, knowledgeable, and explained everything clearly. We're so thankful for their fast response and great service during such a stressful situation.
Highly recommend Urban Plumbing Inc. for any plumbing emergencies — they truly go above and beyond!

reviews.author: Valerii Pekarchuk
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Urban Plumbing Inc.! They completed plumbing work in my basement, and everything was done at the highest level. The team was professional, punctual, and very detail-oriented. They explained everything clearly, worked efficiently, and kept the workspace clean throughout the process.

The quality of work exceeded my expectations — everything functions perfectly, and you can tell they truly care about doing the job right. I highly recommend Urban Plumbing Inc. to anyone looking for reliable and skilled plumbers. Thank you for the great work!

reviews.author: Maria Gomez
reviews.text: We recently had our main sewer line cleaned out, both on the street and behind our house. The crew addressed a significant accumulation of debris and tree roots inside our 6-inch clay main sewer line, thoroughly removing scale, clogs, and root buildup. They responded extremely quickly and conducted themselves with great professionalism from start to finish. We also found their pricing to be very competitive, with several convenient payment methods available. Overall, we are extremely pleased with the service and highly recommend them for sewer maintenance and cleaning.

reviews.author: S “RS” R
reviews.text: Urban Plumbing has been an absolutely reliable partner for us, and I can't recommend them highly enough. We've worked with them on multiple occasions, from small fixes to new construction projects, and every single time they've been exceptional. They take care of absolutely everything: rough-ins, installing fixtures, redoing or moving lines—you name it, they’re the experts. They handled our RPZ valve seamlessly. In short, every time we've needed them, they’ve been there with the same punctual, top-notch service. Definitely a go-to contractor to keep in your contacts!

reviews.author: Izabela Draa
reviews.text: Mykola was fantastic. I could not recommend him enough. He came in, got an understanding of the job and began working. No hassling, no upselling of other services that appear “needed” in your home. He came in to install a new bathroom vanity, which required cutting drywall open and moving pipes to accommodate the new vanity setup. He did it in 2 hours and charged an extremely fair price. I received 3 other quotes from plumbers that are also licensed/insured and they were significantly higher. Mykola was very fair and very quick - all things you want in a plumber.

reviews.author: Jeff Mnichowicz
reviews.text: We needed to have our old galvanized pipes replaced throughout the house with copper. We got a few quotes from local plumbers. Bigger named companies. I researched area family owned ones and found Urban Plumbing, Inc. I read and loved their reviews. Nicholas gave us the estimate which was more than fair. We were scheduled in less than a week and his crew has competed the job earlier than we were told. Outstanding crew! Open, honest, professional company that I recommend highly! Thank you guys for such a wonderful job!

reviews.author: Julia Ignatenko

Everything went smoothly from start to finish — they arrived right on time and delivered top-notch service. I highly recommend Urban Plumbing for any of your plumbing needs!

Thank you Lake Cook Plumbing!!

reviews.author: Kenneth Hunt
reviews.text: Our old water heater needed to be replaced. It was leaking and causing a minor flood in the basement. Searched up plumbers in the area and lake cook plumbing was first on the list. They said they could come out the next day, so I was excited! They had to remove the utility room doors, to not keep them longer I said I would put the doors back on myself. They installed a new water heater and the plumber was nice and up front. It cost me $3000. Things were good for about 3 months but the pressure relief valve started leaking. Then a guy named Mike came out, he wasn’t a pleasant person, but he swapped out the gas valve, and we haven’t had a huge problem yet. Today I went to finally reinstall the doors to the utility closet and the bottoms are ripped and torn to where they won’t stay in the tracks and the rail above the door is bent so the wheels pop out. While i am grateful for the initial quick “we can be there tomorrow urgency”, that is the only good thing I have to say and will not use them again.

reviews.author: David Vega (Tridence)
reviews.text: Overcharged, didn't  fix our problem and did not clean up after themselves.  Not helpful in our issue. Would never use again or recommend them to anyone. Waste of money and poor service.

reviews.author: Mike Glatz
reviews.text:
While our 22-year old water heater was seemingly working fine, I knew it was well past it's useful life and started looking to replace it.  I called four organizations for an estimate.  Only one organization came out to my home -- Lake Cook Plumbing.  They sent two representatives out that reviewed not just the water heater, but the gas/water valves and connections feeding into it as well.  I received a proposal later that day and they were very responsive to my follow-up questions.

The other organizations I called did not come out to our home.  One firm wanted pics on the existing system and their proposal consisted of a text.  They were the cheapest.  The other firm provided a formal proposal, answered my questions, and was a bit cheaper than Lake Cook.  I decided to go w/ Lake Cook Plumbing as their owner, Jim Barrett, followed up on their proposal and provided some additional guidance on things to look for in other proposals.

Lake Cook Plumbing was ready to install a new water heater and replace the gas/water valves in the system the day after I gave them the green light.  When they had some scheduling challenges, Jim (the owner) showed up to assist his plumber (Eric Geyer - 16 years experience) early the next morning.  I couldn't be happier with the quality of the work Jim and Eric did for us.  They were thoughtful, thorough, and professional during the entire installation.

While Lake Cook Plumbing was slightly more expensive than the other proposals I received, I have an incredible peace of mind that this system will be efficient and safe for another 10-15 years.  I received e-mails from them both times someone came out to our home - with pictures of the representatives that were on their way.  (While I was home for both visits, this process made me feel this organization would be much safer if something happened and my wife was home alone to deal with it.  Small gesture, but much appreciated.)

Jim and Eric did a great job -- I'd highly recommend Lake Cook Plumbing!

Mike G.
Barrington, IL

reviews.author: Sofiya Volkova
reviews.text:
Lake Cook plumbing replace my pump on Zoller PN53-0001. Mike 1 took my old pump with him,never ask permission for this. Zoller Pump was very noisy, and never stop running. Company send Mike 2 to fix a problem,he fixed s a noise. Actually,Mike 2 show me the problem,that pump is not collecting water to any level. Next day Mike 2 get scared owner and denied his words.They fixed a heavy noise, but pump is running all the time. Company guarantee pump for 3 years, but forget to show warranty on a job-usually 1 year,but not in this company. Jim owner told me to call Zoeller Co. Zoeller is  willing to replace pump,but Jim told them he did not see problem. Now, I file complain to BBB. Today, Zoller Co told me to contact where pump was bought by lake Cook Plumbing and exchange for new one. For my request owner Jim,told me he will contact police about me. Jim told he would not guarantee his pump or job,and I should call another service  and pay again.
Zoller Pump the biggest problem is switch, or damaged-see google article.
I cannot understand why I should pay twice for the same job. Also,my old pump was under warranty and why Lake Cook Plumbing took it from my house.

reviews.author: John Coyne
reviews.text: I had a problem with my ejector pit float triggering the pump (water was coming out of the drain) but could run the pump manually.  I called Lake Cook Plumbing to help diagnose the issue.   The plumber basically immediately showed me a quote for $835 without even trying to look into the actual issue.  Looking at the retail price of the pump, it's about $350.  So apparently the labor to install this is near $500, which took less than an hour of work, wowza.   The plumber entered my house without wearing a mask multiple times though he put it on as soon as he got in, but still that made me a bit uneasy.   He made a bit of a mess with the install and did not clean up after himself which was mildly annoying.  And the last issue I had was the pump did not reach the outlet in the ceiling so he just said "you need to buy an extension cord" , so he left my house without actually confirming that it even worked.  I'm satisfied with how quickly they were able to get here and resolve the issue, but I think all of the other issues are enough to deter me from using them again.

reviews.author: Ken Lung
reviews.text: I called to get an estimate for rodding out window well drains.  I was specific about what I expected.  Instead of getting a free estimate, it would cost me $50 for someone to come out.  When their plumber came out, I reviewed want I wanted, he said that they would have to bring a camera to look inside the drain to see if it was plugged.  This would cost me $479 and then they would see if they felt they could clear it.  I was told that "If it turned out to be completely blocked, it could get really expensive".  When I said that $479 is a lot of money just to stick the camera in the drain, he replied that they have to pay for the depreciation of the camera, call a plumber out to analyze the picture...  sounded to me like they might not know even after they had pictures.  The estimate was supposed to let me know what the cost would be.  I rejected going forward and tested the drains by flooding them with water from my hose which they handled just fine.  I felt like I was being led on; why wouldn't they have brought the camera to start with?

reviews.author: Okamoto Corporation
reviews.text: reached out to Lake Cook Plumbing because they were rated as a top plumbing service company in Lake county, was not far from the most accurate recommendation i have ever seen. we initially got a quick quote and started the work shortly after, during that time we ran into more problems and had to start a bigger more expensive project another day. upon the start of the second round, and during the fixing of the issues, the service tech called me and told me that the solution was more simple than we assumed, and they were able to get the work done for much less than originally expected. the honesty goes a long way, they are not after just running up your bill and doing work that may not even be needed. they came in with professional opinion, laid out the options and were transparent and honest to complete an amazing job. will be my go to plumber in lake county from now on, don't miss out on this golden resource. #mustshare

reviews.author: Professor Kurt DiClementi
reviews.text: I felt very fortunate to have Louie, a plumber with over 20 years in the business, come out to clear the pipes leading out of our kitchen sink. Louie is the gold standard of plumbing professionals. He was very meticulous in the service he provided, explaining everything he was doing. He also ran the bathroom sinks and tubs to make sure that while he cleared the blockage in the kitchen sinks, he didn't push the blockage to plumbing in another area of our home. Upon finishing the job, Louie also offered maintenance advice to ensure we would avoid the same problem in the future, and he let me know about discount coupons I could find if I needed any additional service in the future. I think Louie provided a great value for the service he performed. He was the consummate professional, yet he was very amiable. He made me feel like he was a trusted friend rather than just another customer he had to deal with.

reviews.author: Holly Buck
reviews.text:
I have had a few plumbing companies complete work or do estimates in the several years I've lived here. One was great, but is no longer working in my area. 2nd one was unbelievably expensive and rather creepy to tell the truth.  Lake Cook installed a water heater in 2007 - working great and no issues.  Reasonably priced and installed quickly.
I called them again after #2 plumbing company (has a smiley face on their logo) gave me very little info and a "take it or leave it, cos you're going to call me again" attitude.
Mike was GREAT!  He explained the issue, showed me what was wrong, gave me options and replaced the device quickly and easily.  I got an upgraded device and it was still BELOW the cost quoted by #2.
All done in about 45 minutes!!
Can't say enough good things.  I will definitely call them again if needed.
Thanks, Mike!!

reviews.author: John H
reviews.text: Although the work was done properly, the prices were very high. Some laughable as a matter of fact. They replaced a leaking valve in my crawl space, replaced a wax ring on one my toilets and capped off a gas line from a grill I disconnected. $325 for replacing a valve in a crawl? That seems fair I have been under there. Ugly. Now comes the comedy. $363 to replace a toilet seal. They charged more for pulling the toilet than going under the house. Seriously? Toilet was 20 steps from the door. The gas line topped it off. The gas was already off. All they needed to do is unscrew a line and screw on a cap $145. No I do not recommend them. They did it in a hour and a half. No breakdown for parts and labor. Based on investigation, parts total was under $50. So you figure it out.

reviews.author: Jessica Joyce
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this company. We’ve had Mike B. For our last several jobs and he is knowledgeable, honest, and extremely helpful. He helped me so much with our recent water damage and pipe breakage and pointed me in the right direction how to take care of it all. I would have had no idea what to do for follow up and reconstruction. More recently Nick has come with him and he is great too. The office staff are reliable and organized and they communicate very well. The plumbers come when they say they will, prompt, very courteous of our home and very clean. The prices are legit and you never have to wonder what you’re paying for, it’s all laid out and explained for you. Feels great to have a company we can rely on in the future!

reviews.author: Michael Stammer
reviews.text: We have used Lake Cook Plumbing for several projects this year. We live in an older house and plumbing issues came one after another. We called Lake Cook Plumbing for these issues. Mike and Cory came to our house and provided options for dealing with our problems. The thing that I really appreciated, is that they offered us a low cost option for these issues. Mike and Corey were very upfront with us and offered the most cost effective solution to out problems. WE agreed and have had several plumbing issues resolved over the past two months. As long as you get Mike and Cory, I definitely recommend Lake Cook Plumbing. They really have helped us out during some serious plumbing issues!

synthesis.summary: Gets to you fast and communicates honestly about costs, but pricing complaints are frequent and at least two jobs had post-service quality issues that the company didn't fully own.
strengths: Responsiveness is a standout: multiple reviewers report next-day or same-day arrival, including one technician showing up within 30 minutes of a call
Transparent, non-pushy communication praised across several reviews — technicians explain work in detail, present options clearly, and don't upsell unnecessary services
Owner Jim Barrett personally intervenes on complex jobs, including helping a customer get homeowner's insurance approval and showing up to assist his own plumber during scheduling crunches
weaknesses: Pricing is a recurring sore spot: multiple reviews cite $2,100 for a water heater install, $300+ to cap a gas line, and a $750+ quote for a leaking spigot that turned out to need a $7 washer — suggesting a pattern of expensive-first solutions
Two reviews describe post-job damage or equipment failure (ripped utility closet doors, a pressure relief valve leaking within 3 months) with limited accountability from the company
redFlags: At least two reviews specifically call out a technician named Mike as having a bad attitude, suggesting a consistency problem with one employee
One detailed review describes the owner threatening to call police on a customer disputing a warranty claim and refusing to honor a 3-year pump guarantee — a serious customer service breakdown
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong signals for emergency use: one technician arrived within 30 minutes of a call, another came out on a Sunday to handle a basement flooding from a broken sump pump and stayed until the water cleared — suggests genuine after-hours and weekend capability.

reviews.author: Alyssa Gummerson
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with LZ Plumbing in Lake Zurich. From start to finish, everyone I worked with was fantastic. Maria was incredibly helpful and communicative, making the scheduling process easy and stress-free. John and Boris were professional, honest, and took the time to clearly explain everything that needed to be done.

It’s not always easy to find contractors you can truly trust, but this team made the whole experience smooth and reassuring. I really appreciated their transparency and the quality of their work. I would absolutely recommend LZ Plumbing to anyone I know who needs plumbing assistance. Great service all around!

reviews.author: Kellyn Cochran
reviews.text: Boris and John were both very professional and knowledgeable when replacing my garbage disposal. Not only were they professional, they are both very personable and went above and beyond to make sure that I understood what was the problem. They continually took the time to answer my questions and concerns, and Boris even took my nosey German shepherd under his wing as an apprentice at points. I highly recommend both of these professionals and will be using them again if the time ever calls.

reviews.author: Beth de Anda
reviews.text: Boris from LZ Plumbing came to my rescue again.  I first started using him when I bought a new home and no one could determine the point of a water leak that I was having sporadically.  Boris was able to zero in on a bad connection with the dishwasher and fixed it. This time he was able to quickly fix a water heater problem I was having in my rental unit. Highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: SYED HUSSAIN
reviews.text: We hired this company for a project in Niles and, unfortunately, had a very disappointing experience. They completed only half of the work and never returned to finish the job. Despite paying them in full, we have been unable to get any response. We’ve called multiple times and sent several texts with no reply. Based on our experience, we cannot recommend this company.

reviews.author: Susan Q.
reviews.text: I hired LZ Plumbing through a home warranty company to fix a shutoff valve and pipe that had become separated. I assumed it was fixed for good - but two years later, the same thing happened again. I tried to call and email them, but they never responded, so I guess they don't stand behind their work. I hired someone else to fix it properly (it needed more than what LZ had done)  and they gave me a three year warranty.

reviews.author: Petar Georgiev
reviews.text:
We have been using LZ Plumbing for several years now and have always been very pleased with them. In fact, this is the only company that comes to mind when I think of who to turn to for a reliable plumber.

We have used other plumbers before but none of them compare to the LZ plumber. They go above and beyond to assure a repair is done right the first time and has had to fix the work that plumbers did. For example, a couple years ago we had a plumber that just pushed a clog further down the drain with his pressure plunger. Well, a week later, the bathroom shower and kitchen sink had water coming up in them again and so I called LZ Plumbing. Borko, spent a good couple of hours rodding the pipes and knocking on wood, we have not had an issue like that since.

We have used LZ Plumbing for several services from rodding, to installing toilets, to replacing rotting pipes, and have be very pleased every time. They'll even squeeze us to their already full schedule and do what they could to make the cost reasonable and competitive.

Thank you so much LZ Plumbing for your continuous help with our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Robyn K.
reviews.text: I am a renter and LZ was suggested by the owner of my apt. I initially called because of a slow draining bathroom sink. While Boris was still here, I also asked him to take a look at the kitchen sink which has had poor water pressure for months. He determined that the problem was the cartridge in the faucet and not a problem with the pipes as I had been told by two other plumbers. He went to a local hardware store to find a replacement cartridge, but it did not fit the faucet. So, he told me he would check some other places and come back. He returned a few days later and was able to replace the cartridge. He had also bought a new faucet as a "back up fix" if one of the cartridges didn't work. Finally, after so many months, I had a great working kitchen sink! As an added bonus, I mentioned to him that the building's water supply was going to be turned off and he removed the aerators and showed me how to deal with everything so that when the water was turned back on, I would not have any trouble. I don't want any more plumbing issues, but I do know who to call when they arise!

reviews.author: Graham Grochocinski
reviews.text: Boris was able to diagnose and repair our water heater which had a bad valve control unit. He was friendly, professional, and took the time to be careful with our old home’s galvanized pipes. He also adjusted his schedule and came by an entire day earlier when he learned the part needed had arrived earlier than expected. He also checked for gas leaks using a sensor after the repair was finished — which gave us some peace of mind. :) We’ll definitely be calling him again for any future plumbing needs. Thanks Boris!

reviews.author: Ger T.
reviews.text: I have used LZ Plumbing in the past and I can honestly say that this is the ONE company that takes the best care of their clients. Borislav was amazing with his precise evaluation of the problem and was able to give me the best solution of how to fix it! I highly recommend this company to anyone who needs an extremely good plumber! I was able to shop around before I called them and I can say that their fees were extremely reasonable too!

reviews.author: Haider Ahmed
reviews.text: I used this company via a home warranty program. Borris, was great and fixed my leak. The reason for the four stars; communication. Communication is a key component for customers, whether through a third party program or direct. Plumbing is a tough business as a lot of jobs entail water leaks and emergencies. That being said the company does need to figure out how it can communicate to those customers it’s servicing.

reviews.author: Kevin B.
reviews.text: Boris was very responsive even while out of town and John did a quick assessment of the issues and took care of them. After several bad experiences dealing with the bug plumbing outfits that were over priced and frustrating to deal with, it was great to find a reliable and responsive small local business to do the work. We will definitely use them again when needed.

reviews.author: Krista Lee
reviews.text: This company is awesome! They are trustworthy and reliable, they came out on Mother's Day and replaced our water heater that had rusted out within a few hours. They put down tarps to make sure our floor didn't get dirty. And they went above and beyond to help us get our refund from our warranty company. I highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Itk K.
reviews.text: I have used LZ pluming for many different projects (at my home and several rental properties) over the past 10 years and they always do a great job at fair prices.  They are responsive, dependable, and hardworking.  I highly recommend LZ plumbing, and they are my first choice for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Galya Micek
reviews.text: Boris and his team at LZ plumbing did an outstanding job with our plumbing repairs. He is timely, very professional and priced very reasonably. He even stopped by to check and make sure everything was running smoothly a few days after the repairs.  My husband and I would highly recommend LZ plumbing!!!!!

reviews.author: Krista L.
reviews.text: Our water heater sprung a leak the night before Mother's Day. LZ plumbing came out ON Mother's Day and replaced the water heater within a few hours. They went above and beyond to ensure we were refunded by our warranty people. I would highly recommended this company! They are trustworthy and honest!

synthesis.summary: Boris and his crew consistently solve tough diagnostic puzzles and show up on holidays, but a concerning pattern of ghosting clients mid-job and ignoring follow-up calls makes them a risky bet for anything requiring accountability.
strengths: Strong diagnostic track record: at least 3 reviews cite Boris identifying elusive leaks or complex issues that others missed, including a recurring dishwasher leak and a tricky valve control unit
Holiday and weekend availability confirmed: multiple reviews document showing up on Mother's Day, adjusting schedules proactively, and coming out on weekends for inspections
Workmanship praised for thoroughness: reviewers note post-repair gas leak checks, follow-up visits days later to confirm repairs held, and careful handling of older galvanized pipes
weaknesses: Pricing fairness is inconsistent: while several reviews call costs reasonable, the low score of 51 and one review noting a repair failed within two years with no warranty support suggest value is not guaranteed

Communication is a known weak spot acknowledged even by satisfied customers, with one 4-star reviewer explicitly flagging it as a systemic problem and the office responsiveness being praised only occasionally
redFlags: At least 2 reviews describe being paid in full then abandoned: one job left half-finished in Niles with no response to calls or texts, another involved a failed repair with zero follow-up contact
One review alleges damaging an 88-year-old woman's water heater access bolt and then going silent for weeks, leaving her without hot water — a potential elder exploitation concern
Ghost pattern post-payment appears in 3 of 42 reviews (~7%), which is a meaningful signal for a directory where accountability after the job matters
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Legitimate emergency credentials: confirmed same-day water heater replacements, Mother's Day response within hours, proactive schedule adjustments when parts arrived early, and weekend inspection availability — Boris specifically has a track record of showing up fast for urgent situations.
