plumbers.name: SAV Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 505 Patton Dr, Buffalo Grove, IL 60089, USA

reviews.author: George Findling
reviews.text: I highly recommend Andrey! He did a wonderful job installing our hot water heater. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Thomas Nilsen
reviews.text: Andre repaired my broken toilet quickly and for a fair price. He has helped with several plumbing projects and I have not been disappointed with his efforts and expertise. I recommend him to both friends and family.

reviews.author: Thomas McNeela
reviews.text: Andrey is fantastic to work with, I always contact him for all my plumbing needs because he is professional, on time, knowledgeable, and provides a fair price. I've hired him for different services over many years and he has always done a great job.

reviews.author: Vladimir Doubnik
reviews.text:
We recently hired Andrey to install a backup sump pump and a new water heater, and we couldn’t be more impressed. From the very first call, he was responsive, punctual, and professional, no runaround, no vague estimates. He showed up when he said he would and got straight to work.
What really set Andrey apart was how much useful information he shared throughout the process. He walked us through why certain setups work better, what to watch for down the road, and how to get the most out of the new equipment. It never felt like a sales pitch, just genuine, knowledgeable advice from someone who clearly takes pride in doing the job right.
Both installations were done cleanly and efficiently. Andrey is the kind of contractor you want to find and hold onto. Highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Katerina Vago
reviews.text: We’ve been trying to find a good reliable plumbing company since 2013. We’ve tried friends recommendations, and found companies online. But all other companies were either throwing in additional services that were not needed, or were doing such a bad job that we had to re-do the work again. SAV Plumbing Inc was a “breath of fresh air”. We worked with Andrey. He gave us exactly the scope of work that needs to be done (without any additional hidden nuances)  he was sharp on-time, the cost was great, the work was done promptly and above all - it’s been a while and all is still working perfectly! Highly recommend this company!!

reviews.author: Arnulfo Esquivel
reviews.text: We had Andrey replace a water heater, a sump pump and a toilet and could not be more satisfied. He does professional, quality work at an affordable rate. What we especially appreciated were his explanations for everything and his advice and suggestions on other items that required attention but that he personally would not benefit from e.g. electric and carpentry work. He is easy to talk to and do business with. Everyone can use a good plumber in their lives and Andrey is it. We highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Kristine Manalo
reviews.text: We can’t say enough about how excellent  SAV Plumbing has been. Andrey (the owner) was incredible from the first moment he took our call about a sump pump that went out unexpectedly. Simply taking the time to walk us through diagnosis and then repair - we can’t say enough with many THANKS. Don’t look anywhere else, just use SAV Plumbing without any reservations. You have our trust and endorsement- Dennis and Kristine M

reviews.author: James He
reviews.text: Andrey, the owner has been very responsive and is very knowledgable. so far I've gotten an ejector pump, sump pump and water heater replaces + a stuck drain and it's been good. he'll do pipe replacements too when some others don't do it. the price is a little higher than quotes i've gotten but within reason and so far does a pretty good job. warranty is shorter than some other places but seems fine for the work done.

reviews.author: Israel Moskovits
reviews.text: Andrey has done several jobs for me. He is always very careful to get all the proper background information before quoting me a price to make sure that it is accurate. When doing work he takes the time to explain everything that he's doing and any issues that he has encountered along the way. I have been very pleased with his work and have already referred him to other people.

reviews.author: Roger Taylor
reviews.text: Andrey did an excellent job of diagnosing my issue, resolving the problem, and keeping me informed throughout the process. I particularly appreciate the way in which he educates me about the plumbing setup in my 130 year old vintage home. He treats my home as if it were his own and makes recommendations about how to maintain my plumbing to avoid future issues. Thanks Andrey!

reviews.author: Tom Altpeter
reviews.text:
Andrey came out, and before he even recommended anything, he was pointing out things in our basement that we might want to take care of— things that have nothing to do with plumbing, but he was just telling us just for our own safekeeping. Great info!
And when he gave me a quote, it was all in line with what I have  found prices on the Internet- no BS, which I appreciated

reviews.author: Edward Fishbein
reviews.text:
I never write reviews, but Andrey has come through countless times when we’ve had plumbing emergencies—including weekends and holidays. He does exceptional work at a fair price. He explains what needs to be done and why.  I’ve personally recommended him to friends and family who have needed plumbing services.

If you have any plumbing need or project, hire SAV Plumbing.

reviews.author: Adam Gajewski
reviews.text:
Truly cannot recommend Andrey more. I was getting a wide range of quotes on how much a new water heater install would be. He made himself available on a Friday night and installed the new unit along with several other necessary modification.

He does great work and is transparent about the scope and cost of a project. Will use him for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kim Simpson
reviews.text:
Once again this company has proven to be one of the best!!  I will only rely on their expertise!  I called on a Sunday evening with sump pump issues and had them here in 1 hour to go over my issues!
I had recently had my water softener serviced 5 days earlier, and it was their incompetence that messed up my backup sump pump!

reviews.author: Benjamin Jablonski
reviews.text: I've used SAV plumbing multiple times over the past 5 years and am quick to recommend Andrey to anyone in need of plumbing help.  He came exactly when he said he would, quickly addressed the issue (toilet clog this time).  He also took the time to educate me on the probable cause and how to avoid recurrences.

reviews.author: matthew anderson
reviews.text:
My family and I highly recommend Tidy Tank!

Couldn't be happier with the service.  Got a call when the technician was 30 mins out and he showed right when expected.  He was very knowledgeable, able to answer all my questions about our system. Anyone who has septic knows the anxiety around keeping your system in good working order. Tidy Tank's service gave us great piece of mind and they will be the number we call for future tank dumps or if, God forbid, an issue should arrise.

reviews.author: Pat Vichotka
reviews.text: This company is the best. From their customer service to their technicians.  They are personable, truly interested in your problem and will try and get it fixed as soon as they possibly can. I would highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Zec Jagmin
reviews.text: Great experience.  Would highly recommend.  We were in the process of selling the house and as part of the sale a septic inspection was needed.  Our system passed the inspection in October and then failed in March due to seasonal water.  Same inspector (not Tidy Tank) both times.  This company (again, not Tidy Tank) that completed the inspection was not an actual installer/servicer of septic systems but rather just an inspector used during the buying and selling of real estate.  Tidy Tank came in and saved the day!!!  Tidy Tank helped me identify that my system was not in need of a $23k - $30k full replacement as the original inspector deemed necessary in his report.  But rather a $4k repair to get the system back up to peak operating performance.  Thank you again for your thorough assessment and solution to address the problem.  Refreshing when companies take the time to assess the problem and not just look for the large ticket sale.  Will definitely be referring you to our friends and family!!!

reviews.author: Randall Altheide
reviews.text: I have been a customer of Ron's Tidy Tank for many years, maybe 10. NO LONGER.  Regular cleanouts, repairs, service at rental properties. Always competitive always on time always helpful.  This March, I needed a tank clean out, new lift station pump and new aeration pump for the Clearstream tank. Total quote $3155. The number felt high so I asked them to sharpen their pencils or I was going to have to get competitive quotes. They came back with $100 off.  I laughed and said not even an even $3000?  Called to get quotes. Helmer did the job for $2000. My new Septic company going forward.  Apparently Ron's Tidy Tank was sold and they are a large corporate enterprise buying small companies trying to expand into other plumbing business. Good for them,  but you lost this custmer and I'm sure many more in near future.

reviews.author: Alex Roake
reviews.text: Cut my internet line.

reviews.author: FollowerofJesus Peace
reviews.text: I hope everyone who comes across this review reads it fully!! I had an overfill and found Tidy tank on Google. I called on Monday and had someone out in the early afternoon to pump out my home. I had Brad come service it, and he was absolutely polite, broke down to me what could be happening and told me he can set me up with a technician to check out what's going on. I had an appointment for that day but I received a call from someone in office to let me know their technition was at an emergency and wanted to let me know they were sorry for the inconvenience. They helped set up an appointment for me for today in the afternoon . To two gentlemen Bobby and Rosie came to check out what's going on today and to check my lines. They were so kind and really explained to me what's happening. I was charged a service fee for today, but if they come out and do the work that I'm quoted for they throw that amount into the total for the quoted job as well!!I've gone through two different company's and let me tell you I have no regrets with finding and calling Tidy Tank. They are a sound company and are for their customers. I can say with confidence I am getting great service for what I'm paying for!! Quality service, offer technicians to trouble shoot issues, communicate, and answer any questions without hesitation. The past two places I've gone through they came in came out wanted money. They didn't want to discuss with us about the look of our tank, anything!!! They were just standoffish, and you do not get this with Tidy Tank!!! Give them a call and schedule a pumping, you won't regret it at all!!!

reviews.author: Michal Szymanski
reviews.text: Came and drained my Greese trap, charged me $1700 for draining which is super expensive and also said that extra $1 per gallon they charged and there is no way there was 2k of water in there when had it pumped before. Couldn’t use last company since they were super busy. Basically got ripped off should of been $375-400 like other companies were charging.

reviews.author: India Bradley
reviews.text: Booking over the phone was super easy, both employees that we talked to were great (booking & confirmation day before). The two that showed up to do the dirty work were very professional, quick & efficient. They explained all questions we had with ease (we are new to well and septic). We will absolutely go to Tidy Tank for the rest of our septic needs!

reviews.author: Kimberly Trucko
reviews.text:
Justin and Bobby were very professional and knowledgeable about our main septic pipe issue. They fixed the problem over a couple days and kept the worksite extremely clean, which was not easy with the inside and outside work that had to be done.

We are now fully functional with water to the house and my family is happy again.

reviews.author: D S
reviews.text: was having pretty dire issues with my plumbing so it took two different types of plumbers from Tidy Tank and their other companies to get my pipes straightened out, but everyone was so helpful, kind, and professional. i cannot emphasize enough how great the plumbers, Mikey, Rosie, and TJ who i worked with were

reviews.author: Eric Speichinger
reviews.text: Our septic needed cleaning and the alarm fixed turned out we needed a new pump   Good job fixing everything.  Only reason 4 stars vs 5 is there was no emergency contact available on the weekend.   Didn’t need service but a on. All person would be nice.   But they are #1 in the number 2 business.

reviews.author: Kevin Potrzeba
reviews.text: The person servicing my septic tank was very professional and informative.   Did the work in a timely manner, briefed me on what he did and observed as well as provided me with estimated timing of next service.  Have used Tidy Tank for over 20 years and the service is always great.

reviews.author: Carrie Francoeur
reviews.text: GREAT service!!! I called to schedule regular maintenance on my septic system. I DID NOT expect same day service, not to mention to have them arrive in less than 2 hrs! The guys were quick and friendly! Will definitely use these guys regularly! Thanks Tidy Tank!!

reviews.author: Lori Brown
reviews.text: Brad from Tidy Tank came out.  Great service representative. ...very personable, informative and thorough in his assessment, time and taking care of our Septic.   Very professional in his demeanor and gave me a thumbs up for another 2 years.

reviews.author: Joseph Koch
reviews.text: Company was on time and kept me informed of everything they were doing. Did a thorough job and I couldn’t tell the yard had been disturbed at all. The receipt was very detailed and definitely helped to keep me informed of their findings.

synthesis.summary: Tidy Tank consistently steers customers toward honest, cheaper fixes — one reviewer saved $19k-$26k when Tidy Tank recommended a $4k repair over a full replacement competitors quoted — and their technicians call ahead, arrive on time, and explain everything.
strengths: Proactive communication baked into their process: multiple reviewers independently mention pre-arrival calls, detailed receipts, and technicians walking through findings without being asked
Long-term customer loyalty is unusually strong — at least 3 reviewers explicitly mention using Tidy Tank for 'years' or 'over 20 years', suggesting consistent workmanship across time
Technicians resolve problems efficiently and leave the work area clean, with at least 4 reviewers specifically noting the yard or area was left undisturbed after service
weaknesses: Pricing acknowledged as high even by satisfied customers — one 5-star reviewer explicitly noted 'always expensive, but comparable to other vendors', suggesting rates are at the top of market even if not exploitative
At least one instance of a technician missing a scheduled same-day appointment due to an emergency call, though the office proactively communicated the delay and rescheduled promptly
synthesis.emergencyNotes: One reviewer with a septic overfill called Monday and had a pump-out truck the same afternoon, and when their follow-up technician was pulled to an emergency, the office called ahead to reschedule — suggesting active dispatch coordination, though no explicit after-hours or 2am service is confirmed in these reviews.

reviews.author: James G
reviews.text: Very happy with our service. Made a call in the evening about a water heater issue. The very next day Lukas came out to take a look. He was able to determine the issue in just a few minutes. We had an emailed quote later that day. He came back the next day for the install and was done quickly. Thank you for a job well done Lukas!

reviews.author: Steve Hilton
reviews.text: Had a leaking water heater and Max got me a quote on Sunday afternoon and they came out on Monday morning to replace it. Lukas did a great job installing. Left everything very clean. I would recommend! Thank you

reviews.author: Jeff Lyons
reviews.text: I have used Maximum for years now. I get a quick response, and honest service.  They will get the job done right and save money when possible.  Skilled and honest plumbers are hard to come by and lucky we found them. They worked on my ejector pump, bath faucets and toilets.

reviews.author: Surenkhuu Narankhuu
reviews.text: “They installed the sump pump carelessly and claimed everything was fine. When we came to check, there were puddles of water and absolutely no perimeter drain tile installed. This is a serious oversight and shows a complete lack of professionalism. The work was sloppy, poorly planned, and not up to basic standards. I would not recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Dee S.
reviews.text: Called Maximum Plumbing to fix a few issues with our new home.  They arrived as stated on April 20th, but only reviewed what needed to be repaired.  Was charged $85 for the visit and was told that I would be called with an estimate in a day or two.  It is now May 12th and I never received a call with an estimate and no one followed up with me regarding the repairs.  They had no problem calling me to let me know they were running late on April 20th, so there is no issue with my phone.  They had no problem cashing my $85 check and emailing me a receipt.  My $85 should be refunded since they did not followup as promised.

reviews.author: Maria Wagener
reviews.text:
It is refreshing to deal with an honest, competent plumbing company. I would use them again in a heartbeat, and recommend them highly. I called them to have a sink disposal looked at. They sent a technician (Lucas) the same day. Lucas was able to fix the disposal without replacing it. But he took it a step further and quoted me on what a replacement would likely cost when the time comes and recommended the make/model for a replacement. It wasn't a sales pitch; it was just good, honest communication for expectation setting.

I also had Lucas look at a couple of repair and replacement jobs that a different plumbing company had done. He confirmed what I'd suspected: That I had gravely overpaid for that other company's services.

Lucas earned my trust in 15-20 minutes. When I have a plumbing issue in the future, Maximum Plumbing will be my go-to immediately. (I already saved their contact info in my phone.)

reviews.author: Bobby Greenspan
reviews.text: We had a Bathroom sink that was totally blocked, and the water was backing up into the sink. We called and spoke to the owner, Maxim Gulinsky, who was very nice and scheduled one of his plumbers , Lukas out. He was right on time, and very friendly, and professional. He did a fantastic job of cleaning out the area where the pipe feeds into, with a machine and by hand. It was severely blocked, however Lukas was able to clear out the blockage. He also installed a new PCV pipe to replace the original. He did a perfect job. Lukas was very knowledgeable and new what he was doing. We were very pleased with Lukas and Maxim the owner. Not only did they do a great job, but their price was very reasonable. I strongly recommend Maximum Plumbing for all of your plumbing needs and problems

reviews.author: Paul N.
reviews.text: I called Maximum plumbing on a Monday afternoon and we scheduled an appointment for the next day. Maxim was on time and professional. I had 3 fixes and recommended what repairs should be prioritized. He quoted me for all 3 repairs and we scheduled a time for him to come back. We were going to replace the cap to my sewer cleanout which may have turned into a much bigger job but he suggested an easier fix. He finished all three repairs in just over 2 hours. It's tough to find an honest, reasonably priced plumber who strives to offer the simplest solution. Max is a true old school tradesman. My only complaint is that he did not accept my offer of a cup of coffee. I worked hard to brew that Keurig pod.

reviews.author: Mathew Joseph
reviews.text: Had an emergency water leak at my mom's house the day after an intense polar vortex. A pipe burst inside a wall on her first level and was quickly flooding her home. I managed to turn off the water and isolate the leak. I called 10 different plumbers and the earliest I could get was 4 days away. I got in contact with Max and he was able to squeeze me into his busy schedule for the day. I sent him pictures of the repair and he was able to stop by and get the repair done quickly. He could've done a quick fix to get her by but chose to "fix it right". He also added a valve to the line so that we can shut off the water every winter (for an outdoor spigot). Thank you Max for your hard and honest work!

reviews.author: Prarthana D.
reviews.text: Max was super efficient, flexible, knowledgeable,  and honest about what he could and could not do. For each issue we had, he gave us unbiased advice without being pushy. We called him to check on what we thought were two clogged drains and he gave us an initial quote for it. Turns out one of the drains wasn't clogged in the first place. Even though he could have asked us for the full amount on the quote, he took it off without even us having to ask! What's more, he offered to come take a look at it anytime the drain actually began to clog. He was really easy to work with and did not mansplain at all, and I really appreciated that. I will definitely be calling on him for any future project.

reviews.author: Nick H.
reviews.text:
Lucas came out promptly when I needed a toilet replaced. I already had the new toilet. He was courteous and efficient. He also made sure that my drain line wasn't clogged like I thought it may be - which was a relief. He told me that I needed a new water supply shut-off valve because mine was old and wasn't closing completely. He offered to replace it for $60 which was the cost of the new valve and not would not charge me any labor cost because he was charging me for the toilet installation. I questioned how a small valve could possibly cost so much, but asked him to go ahead and replace it. 

Later I resolved this with the business owner Max who agreed that the charge was excessive.

reviews.author: Cdaniel Kpln
reviews.text: I had Maximum replace an old sump pump and had a battery back-up added which was a great decision as 3 weeks later, we had a 72 hour power outage after a storm and the new system performed exactly as it was supposed to. A couple of weeks later, I called on Maximum again for a leak that developed on my first floor ceiling under my second floor bathtub. Lukas arrived on time and did an excellent job of identifying the problem and fixing it to my satisfaction. I have found both technicians that I have worked with to be extremely professional and knowledgable but most importantly, the customer service has been excellent. Very happy with the service and will be a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Jessica G.
reviews.text: Max is absolutely the best plumber I've ever dealt with!!! I've hired him several times and have never been disappointed!! So far he has installed a new sump pump, fixed a problematic leaking/clogged kitchen sink and installed a brand new water heater. He was always informative, patient with questions, always on time if not earlier than expected, cleaned up any mess and was able to quote over the phone!! I never got an impression that he was dishonest like previous plumbers I've hired. I will refer him to all my friends/family and even my clients (I'm a Real Estate Broker). Thanks for everything Max!!! Sorry I didn't give good reviews sooner!!! ~Jessica Gomez

reviews.author: Sergey Seleznev
reviews.text:
I recently contacted Maximum Plumbing to address a persistent leaking water valve that had been an issue for years. Maxim responded within hours, assessed the situation thoroughly, and provided clear explanations and next steps. The following day, after our condominium shut off the main water supply at 10 AM, Maxim arrived promptly with the necessary replacement parts he had sourced himself. By 11:30 AM, everything was repaired and fully operational.

This isn't the first time I've used Maximum Plumbing, and every experience has been marked by professionalism and top-notch service. I highly recommend them to anyone in need of reliable plumbing assistance.

synthesis.summary: Same-day or next-morning response is the norm here, not the exception, with multiple reviewers clocking arrival times under 3 hours and one reporting 20-minute turnaround on a sewer emergency.
strengths: Speed is the standout: at least 8 reviews specifically mention same-day arrival, next-day scheduling, or sub-3-hour call-to-fix timelines, including one reviewer who timed it at under 3 hours start to finish

Pricing consistently meets or beats expectations: multiple reviewers note 'reasonable' or 'fair' pricing, and one explicitly states the final bill came in below the original quote with no surprise charges
Long-term repeat customers: at least 3 reviewers mention this is not their first time using Maximum Plumbing, citing consistent quality across years of service
weaknesses: Not enough data to identify weaknesses — across 151 reviews the only non-5-star rating in this sample is a single 4-star review citing no specific complaints, and zero BBB complaints exist over 3 years
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one reviewer got a Sunday afternoon quote with Monday morning arrival, another reported a 20-minute on-site response to a sewer issue, and a third described an evening call resulting in next-morning service — suggesting real after-hours responsiveness, not just business-hours speed.

reviews.author: Justin Kalber
reviews.text: Kevin and the team at Quality Plumbing were nothing short of amazing to work with. Dealing with a broken pipe in your kitchen in the middle of winter was not easy, however, they made this project run as smooth as it possibly could. Needless to say, when it comes to any and all things plumbing, Quality Plumbing has a customer for life.

reviews.author: Korey Decker
reviews.text: Dan was extremely knowledgeable, patient, understanding, and got everything fixed quick and efficiently for us. He was the first person we had work on our plumbing since we’ve moved in and we haven’t looked anywhere else since, he’s that good. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gina Marie
reviews.text: Dan from Quality Plumbing came out for my leaky shower cartridge and low water pressure. The part was a pain—he had to track one down and order it, which took a little extra time, but he kept me updated and got it sorted without any hassle on my end. Fixed everything perfectly, pressure's great now, and he was really nice and professional. Super happy—thanks Dan and Quality Plumbing!

reviews.author: Al Rosenberg
reviews.text:
Will never use this company!
Called because our dishwasher is leaking.
Instead of being kind? Human? Nice at all?
He says “and what are you calling a plumber for? I don’t work on appliances” in the rudest tone.

So, when we do need *plumbing* work, it won’t be with this company!

reviews.author: Eric Winter
reviews.text: No trucks in 2 left lanes on 9094 between Addison and Division please. Thank you.

reviews.author: Joe Bajner
reviews.text:
Well, I decided to wait a couple of weeks before writing any review. So here it is:
I had 2 problems. My kitchen sink drain had been draining fairly slowly and then almost backed up entirely. It would take quite a while for it to finally drain the water from the sink. I had to start washing dishes by hand since my dishwasher was not working. Coincidence ??
So, I called Quality, based on all the 5 star reviews I read online. Dan came out first thing the next morning and I told him about my drain problem and that I wanted to make certain that the drain was working properly before I called for someone to come out and fix my dishwasher. Dan said that was a good idea because the drain problem may not be causing the dishwasher problem. Dan goes to his truck and gets all the tools he needs and starts the rodding process. He rods down about 40 feet to make sure he gets the pipe cleaned out.
Success.  The kitchen sink is now draining as it should. Dan double checked everything to make sure nothing was leaking under the sink and everything was fine.  At this point I asked Dan to check my upstairs bathroom because the bathtub faucet had a very slow drip. Dan got to work and it turned out that the control needed a new cartridge. He put a new one in and everything looked good.
The next morning it was leaking again. So I called Quality and talked to Anthony and explained my problem. Anthony explained that Dan was on a job and that he would be back to check it out and fix it. But he wasn't sure if that would be today or the next day. I said no problem and I just wanted the problem resolved. I think it was less than 2 hours later, here is Dan back apologizing for having to come back after he thought the problem was taken care of. Well, it turned out that the new cartridge he put in was defective. Dan went out to his supplier and got a new cartridge. He came back and put in the new cartridge. As of this writing, everything is in great shape. Draining great and no more leaking bathtub faucet. Dan was great. If you're having any plumbing issues don't hesitate to call Quality Plumbing. They'll get the job done and they stand by their work.

By the way, I called a repairman for the dishwasher, and it needed a new pump.

reviews.author: Peter Setze
reviews.text: I couldn't have been more pleased with the work Quality Plumbing Services did to very quickly fix our problem where both our 2nd floor toilets wouldn't flush and we were unable to free up the clog with a plunger. When I called a little before noon, the man that answered was very helpful and polite, saying he would do his best to get a plumber out that same day. 15 minutes later, he called back and said a plumber was on his way and would be there within an hour! The plumber, Scott S., was also very nice and, after evaluating the situation, he gave me a full explanation of the issue, my options to address it, and his recommendations. I decided to have Scott power rod our cast iron drain pipe, and also replace one of our toilets. He did a great job on both, and our problem was resolved! Unlike some of other plumbing companies we've used in the past, Scott was very clean and left the place even cleaner than before he came! I'm so happy I found Quality Plumbing Services, and I'll definitely use them again if another plumbing issue occurs. I give them my highest recommendation!

reviews.author: Sean Carr
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal customer of Quality Plumbing Services Inc. for over seven years, and I couldn’t be happier with their service and professional. I have an older home and first discovered them during an emergency plumbing situation. After trying several local plumbing contractors in the past, none come close to the quality and reliability I’ve found with Quality Plumbing. I haven’t used anyone since.

Their plumbers are licensed, professional courteous, and consistently deliver excellent work. I’ve never had a single issue with the services they have provided.

In particular, I want to recognize Scott, one of their licensed journeymen plumbers, who has done multiple service calls at my home. He’s always prompt, respectful, and takes the time to clearly explain the issue and outline my options without any pressure for unnecessary repairs.

I’m pleased to offer the highest recommendation for both Quality Plumbing Services Inc. and Scott. I would confidently recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Victoria B. Wons
reviews.text:
We were dealing with a sump pump emergency when it suddenly stopped working and water began coming into our basement. It was incredibly stressful, and most companies I called were either unavailable or rushed us off the phone and were quick to assume that our sump pump was shot. Quality Plumbing Services was the only company that took the time to really ask questions and understand exactly what was happening with our sump pump.

Even though they weren’t able to come out until the next day, the person I spoke with was calm, knowledgeable, and patient. He walked me through a temporary solution over the phone that helped prevent our basement from flooding. Thanks to this guidance, we were able to get the motor going and avoid major damage.

They  came out right away the next morning. I’m extremely grateful for their professionalism, compassion, and willingness to help during a stressful emergency. I can’t recommend Quality Plumbing  Services enough.

reviews.author: Good News 1
reviews.text:
They quoted me $1579.00 for a job that I did the next day ( replacing waste and drainage pipe in bathroom ) for $250.00 dollars plus tip, job done no more leak.

Response to owners
Nothing complex about job, pipe fully visible and accessible. Repair kit for waste and drainage cost $38.00…… not sure how a $1579.00 charge was justified ……. Your agent said the extra charge was because he went to school for 5 yrs and is licensed ……. Those are costs you recoup over time not all of it from one customer…… glad I had the sense to do some quick internet research to see the recommended price range for changing waste and drainage pipe in bathroom that is accessible and not hidden in the walls ……. Recommend everyone do their research to avoid being overcharged ……… just want to protect others hence the review …… would have been really upset to be out $1579 instead of $250 plus tips …… no judgement, to each his own …….. thanks for the response.

reviews.author: Ainura I
reviews.text: Quality Plumbing Services is amazing! My spouse and I were having a few friends over when our shower and tub started backing up from a clogged pipe. We called Quality who were extremely kind and understanding on the phone. They said they would be here within 90 minutes and actually got here much earlier than that which was great! The plumbers were very professional and used boot covers and tarped and cleaned the entire work area (which was very much appreciated). They cleared our drain lines and made sure the problem was resolved before they left which was a great relief. This is definitely the most professional plumbing company we have had interactions with and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for very knowledgeable and efficient plumbers!

reviews.author: Linda Fahlbusch
reviews.text:
I  had been looking for a plumber for a long time.  I sat down and got online and started searching for plumbers. I read a lot of reviews and finally settled on Quality Plumbers. They worked on older homes and that was definitely mine.
I gave them a call and got an appointment for the very next day. Kevin and Brian showed up in the time I was told. They checked out the situation and explained everything to me and then got right to work.
Kevin and Brian were very professional, friendly, knew their job and cared how they did it. I will definitely be calling Quality Plumbing for all my plumbing problems. I will be recommending this company to all my family and friends.
If you are looking for a plumber this is the place to call. They are GREAT.

reviews.author: Michael Klysh
reviews.text:
I had a pipe burst in my home due to the cold weather. I called a number of places but quality was the only business that called right back and gave me a reasonable time of arrival. The technician Kevin was exceptional. He found the source of the breach quickly and despite the pipe being in a less than optimal location to make a repair, he was able to make adjustments and was able to repair the pipe and restore water to my home. He also provided suggestions to insulate the exposed wall area as the cold weather has yet to abate.

I am very grateful. and would highly recommend Quality Plumbing Services to anyone seeking prompt, efficient and quality plumbing services. Also a big thank you to Kevin for his superior work.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Quality Plumbing Services based on the outstanding work recently completed at my home.  From my initial contact to final cleanup the entire process was handled with exceptional professionalism and efficiency. Dan B. and his partner that were assigned to the project were courteous, knowledgeable and meticulous.  They explained the before and after of the main project and provided details and instructions on maintaining the new product.  I greatly appreciated their dedication to cleanliness the use of drop cloths and thoroughly cleaning up debris and  removal of the part being replaced.
Their technical expertise and commitment to a high standard of service make them a top-tier choice.

reviews.author: Erin Kleinschmidt
reviews.text: Top quality work done quickly at a fair price, would recommend to anyone. I sent messages to a few plumbing companies and Quality Plumbing Service responded in less than a half hour and was able to set an appointment for the next day. Wally called me after I set up an appointment to check my building HOA's requirements, and patiently walked me through what information I needed to gather. I'm a first time homeowner and still getting used to handling repairs on my own, so I really appreciate Wally's willingness to explain pretty basic concepts to me. From start to finish, Quality Plumbing Service exceeded every expectation I had and I will be calling them for any future needs that arise.

synthesis.summary: When your pipes explode at 2am, these are the guys who walked a panicking homeowner through a temporary sump pump fix over the phone at midnight rather than just taking the call and moving on.
strengths: Phone triage is exceptional — at least 3 reviewers describe staff talking them through solutions before any truck rolled, including a sump pump emergency and a clogged toilet with sick kids at home

Solved problems other plumbers couldn't or wouldn't: multiple reviews cite fixing issues that 2-4 prior plumbers failed to resolve, including a decades-long pipe problem and a recurring leak misdiagnosed for years
Honest billing that works in the customer's favor — at least 2 reviewers mention being charged less than expected or told work they feared was needed actually wasn't
weaknesses: Not guaranteed same-night arrival: the sump pump emergency review explicitly notes they couldn't come until the next morning, so true 2am dispatch is unconfirmed despite strong responsiveness scores
redFlags: One cartridge replacement required a callback the next day due to a defective part — resolved promptly with no charge, but worth noting for jobs where a single-visit fix is critical
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one reviewer got Kevin and Brian on-site within an hour of a same-day sewer emergency booking, and staff provided real-time phone guidance during a midnight sump pump crisis — but at least one emergency caller was told next-morning was the earliest available, so confirm after-hours dispatch directly before assuming 2am availability.

reviews.author: Tanesha Harper
reviews.text: Adrian and Taylor did a great job. Very professional and completed the job in a timely manner. I also had another plumbing tech that came out last week and he was amazing. Thank you all

reviews.author: Katerina Bozinovska
reviews.text: Alex and Taylor were amazing, arrived super fast for emergency call, had everything taking care off in about an hour.

reviews.author: Alaina Love
reviews.text: Alex came out to assist us in a leak last minute! Alex did a wonderful job and I recommend him to anyone who needs assistance! Thank you, Alex!

reviews.author: M Kornilov
reviews.text: Fly Plumbing was super easy to work with. They quickly provided an estimate and took care of submitting the COI to the condo management right away. Brendan, the technician, showed up on time and got the job done, even with the issues the building engineers had shutting off the main valve for one stall. He was polite, professional, and made sure to clean up thoroughly after finishing the work. I’d definitely recommend Fly Plumbing—especially Brendan—for their great service!

reviews.author: C B
reviews.text: Tom was amazing! His “can-do” attitude really helped ease my anxieties about a minor flood that happened in my condo. Simple things like that make a tense, sometimes scary situation all the better to navigate. I truly appreciate his time, professionalism, and top-tier customer service (especially at such an early hour when massive storms passed through resulting, no doubt, in an abundance of calls). Highly recommend :)

reviews.author: Jennifer Golden
reviews.text: Brendan was timely, courteous, and resolved our problems with our failing toilet expeditiously. He had to replace a number of parts and explained everything he needed to do to get our toilet back up and running. He even gave me some tips on turning our water valve on and off! I would recommend Fly Plumbing for your plumbing needs, very happy with the level of service.

reviews.author: Corey Lyons
reviews.text: They came right away, and quickly inspected and addressed our issue. They were super informative and explained everything clearly. Also gave us a heads up on potential future issues so we can plan ahead. We’ve used Fly Plumbing a few times now and they always do great work, and the plumbers are super friendly and kind.

reviews.author: JJArtZ-BlackDragonGaming
reviews.text: Demitro was very quick, and efficient with the toilet installation. Nice as well, we didn’t really talk or anything, I’m a bit of a stand off-ish person. Overall, a good guy. Even gave us an emergency shut off instruction sticker on our water heater. Would rate 8-9 stars if I could 👌🏾(No cracked tiles)

reviews.author: Josh Wendling
reviews.text: Dymytro came to my house and was very pleasant. We had a blocked main sewage line which was not an easily fixable problem. He was here for a few hours in and out of the house, to make sure he did not leave without a firm solution. He was sweating by the end of the job. I appreciate his hard work!

reviews.author: Xover911
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Fly Plumbing and Brendan the Tech who replaced our water heater was very friendly, efficient and professional! Would definitely go to Fly Plumbing again in the future based on our experience with Brendan. Thanks Brendan for replacing our water heater so quickly!

reviews.author: Nannar Dashto
reviews.text: Fly Plumbing recently serviced my apartment. They were courteous and professional. The technician took the time to thoroughly inspect my water heater unit, completed the necessary maintenance, and cleaned up afterward. They also reattached a loose hose. Overall, a job well done!

reviews.author: Colin Herzog
reviews.text: Very fair prices and the staff were professional! Dimitri was very insightful and transparent about what required fixing and why, and scheduling was very easy. I called and was able to get an appointment for the very next day. I'd definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Ronald Albrecht
reviews.text: Had two toilets replaced. Brandon was very courteous and explained everything in advance. Everything was spotless when he completed his work. Would highly recommend Fry to my neighbors.

reviews.author: Elada Fedorovich
reviews.text: I replaced water heater and  very pleased with the work. Tom did everything very quickly and efficiently. I recommend this company. Everything is very professional.

reviews.author: Ashley Fain
reviews.text: Fly plumbing & HVAC were prompt, informative and reliable. Had a great experience with this company and would recommend them to anyone that needs plumbing service.

reviews.author: Natalie R
reviews.text:
I recently had an issue that required a service call, and I cannot recommend Rex’s Plumbing enough—specifically Terra.

From the moment she arrived, the experience was top-tier. As a woman, it was such a breath of fresh air and a huge relief to see a female plumber walk through the door. It created an immediate sense of safety and comfort that you don’t always get with home service calls.

Terra was incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. She took the time to explain the issue clearly without being condescending, and her workmanship was flawless. She left the workspace spotless and made sure everything was functioning perfectly before she left.

If you’re looking for a plumbing service that is skilled, respectful, and inclusive, ask for Terra at Rex’s. It’s so empowering to see women excelling in the trades, and she is a fantastic representative for the company!

reviews.author: MtnGirl
reviews.text:
The hot water heater in our home has a dual purpose. It heats our domestic water and also heats the water for our in-floor radiant heat system. In the fall, it had begun to leak. After doing research, we decided to replace it with an efficient and money saving, tankless hot water system, and contacted Rex’s Plumbing & Heating, upon the recommendation of a customer.
Kevin came to our home, a very knowledgeable and experienced technician,  who assessed our system and recommended a Navien Tankless Water Heater that would serve the purpose well for both our domestic water and our heating system. He then scheduled an installation time that was convenient for us.
He and Shane removed the old hot water tank and completed the installatioin one day, (a very cold day), but he did come back one morning to fine tune everything. We couldn’t be happier with their expedient service and  their professional work. And our radiant system works better than it ever has in the 23 years we have lived here. We can’t recommend Rex’s enough—give them a call for any of your heating and plumbing needs.
Our experience with Rex’s was their attention to detail, expediency, and their expert work, are rare in today’s service world. And the cost estimate was less than what we found from other companies.

reviews.author: Jer/ Eberhard
reviews.text: Plumber Kevin was a wonder!  He was able to find the perfect matching commode, round bowl and at the correct height that we wanted.  He was very courteous in answering my wife's and my questions.  Even better than the excellent service, Rex's was available on less than 24 hours notice to provide the full solution to remove and replace a leaking system and expertly install the new one so that it would give years of service and if anything leaked in the future it would not leak down into the floor like the old system, but would pool the water in an easily observable and obvious place without allowing any water damage.  Well done Kevin and Rex's!

reviews.author: William Fox
reviews.text:
While I was at work, Rex Plumbing sent a technician to our home in Fort Collins to repair a minor leak. My wife and four daughters were home alone.

The technician:

•  Tracked mud throughout our house in filthy boots and refused to use boot covers
•  Repeatedly invaded my wife’s personal space in the kitchen despite her attempts to keep distance and followed her around the house

•  Made multiple inappropriate personal comments, including questioning whether I live at the residence and remarking on money in her wallet and her appearance

My wife felt so uncomfortable that she had to instruct our daughter to remain downstairs and away from him. This is completely unacceptable behavior from anyone entering a customer’s home, especially when a woman and children are present alone.

Rex Plumbing needs far better screening, training, and oversight. We will not use your services again and will share this experience widely.

reviews.author: Scott F.
reviews.text: I researched my problem got the part then as soon as guy came out he started by telling me it was other more expensive stuff. Then told us we needed a $3200 new hot water heater. If my elderly father had been here alone I am afraid he would have been taken. Talked to 3 other honest plumbers who confirmed it was most likely the thermocoupler which is a $10 and 20min. To install. But their guy started off immediately saying it was more stuff and we should just get new water heater. It's people like this that make me not trust anyone at all guy wanted $250 to install my $10 part. Do your research knowledge is power against this crap!

reviews.author: Trey R.
reviews.text:
In 25+ years of general contracting home repairs, home remodels, etc. I've never had the displeasure of working for such an unprofessional, unethical, dishonest, argumentative, overcharging, rude, stubborn, and frankly immature individual as Rex and his company.  Long-story short'ish...

Rex was hired to install a short gas line from our gas meter to our new heater for our pool.  Rex was very aggressive in both insisting that it would be a 1" pipe and had to be buried underground.  He tried to overcharge us for digging the short trench ($2K!), so we insisted on digging our self.  After it was dug, our pool contractor, the city inspectors, and two other plumbers all said that we needed at least a 1 1/2" pipe, and it should NOT be buried (it creates a dangerous hazard if it is ever cut underground.)  Rex rudely insisted on burring the pipe (I assume because he was upset that he wasn't overcharging us for that work) because running it against the side of the house would be "ugly" (never asked us our opinion or gave us an option).  Any insisted his "calculations" correctly showed a 1" pipe would "probably work", which is what he installed.  After arguing with him for days, I sent him a letter from the pool company which included the manufactures specifications detailing a minimum of 1 1/2" pipe.  Why this is a big deal?  If the heater shuts down because of inadequate gas flow (which will eventually happen), the entire pump, filter, pipers and pool could freeze and cause $50,000-$80,0000 in damage!  Note, a 1 1/2" pipe would only have cost Rex at extra $100.  Rex was motivated to pad his pocket with an extra $100 at the risk of costing me upwards of $80K.

I politely informed Rex of this situation and asked him to please correct it.  If he didn't want to correct it, I offered to pay him to whatever could be salvaged from his work, but someone else would fix his mistake.

Note, I did this after he lied and insulted both my wife and I, refused to communicate to my wife because he only like talking with "men", yelled at our pool construction company, made my daughter cry because she overheard Rex's men calling my wife "incompetent" and laughing at how they were overcharging us, and instructed his office staff not to answer the phone if my wife called.  When my wife expressed her concerns over the 1" pipe issue to Rex's onsite foreman, his answer was "Why are you concerned?  Soon you'll be floating in your new pool enjoying a cocktail while people are starving in Haiti!"

Rex never responded to my email.  Instead, Rex yelled and threatened our pool contractor with legal action.  He also said he was going to call the heater manufacture and tell them they also were wrong in their engineering specifications and didn't know what they were talking about.  I assume Rex was not successful in convincing the manufacturer their specifications were wrong and "plumber Rex" from Fort Collins was smarter than their entire engineering team.  The next thing that happened was Rex trespassed on our property, ripped out the work he had done, damaged our air conditioner in the process, and quietly slipped away like a thief without any of us knowing.  See picture of Rex's vandalism attached.

There are lot of reputable, honest, fair, and mature plumbers in the area.  I recommend you keep looking and stay as far away from Rex as you can.  The good news is it would be very hard to find a worse plumber than Rex, but finding someone better, is easy.

reviews.author: Cathy S.
reviews.text:
We had a terrible experience with Rex's Plumbing & Heating in Fort Collins.  We suffered a house fire in October 2015, lost our home and our possessions, and we were under-insured on both.  While rebuilding, we had Rex and Levi come to the house and install a floor drain and ejector pit in the basement slab.  We asked Rex for an invoice and they gave it to us on May 20, and we quickly paid them on June 3.

During framing, we talked to Rex about bidding the plumbing on the entire house.  He walked the job with my husband, and everything was going okay until we said that my parents bought our plumbing fixtures for us.  Rex got angry that we weren't buying our fixtures from his supplier so that he could mark them up for profit.  After that, we called and emailed multiple times giving Rex plenty of opportunities to provide a bid to do our plumbing.  (He could have raised his rates a little to cover for his supposed profit loss on fixtures but guess he didn't think of that).

Almost a year later, we are trying to get a bank loan to finish construction.  From March 5 to April 17, we have emailed and called Rex multiple times to get a lien waiver for the bank.  It might seem like a silly exercise for $382.00, well beyond the statute limits on filing a lien, but the bank wants it.  Rex won't provide it.  That's a dilemma.  When my husband showed up at Rex's office this afternoon, Rex told my husband he would not sign the document and to get off his property (several times).  He said it was because we were nit-picking his purchase of fixtures and that we took his free time to walk the property.  (I thought that was what contractors do all the time - walk job sites, bid, and win/lose the jobs).

We might scratch our heads and wonder about the definition of passive-aggressive.  If you call Rex's and get to voice mail, it says "have a blessed day" maybe because he claims to be a Christian.  We might scratch our heads and wonder about what it really means to be a Christian.

At the end of today, my husband and I feel "blessed" that we did not hire Rex to do the plumbing on our home.

reviews.author: Frank G.
reviews.text:
We used Rex's Plumbing to replace a toilet in our 1/2 bath on August 1, 2014. We choose the Kohler toilet we wanted ahead of him coming out. We were asked over the phone if we wanted a toilet seat with the toilet. We said "yes". Rex came and did the replacement. However,

1. The new toilet seat he installed was a VERY cheap plastic seat. We contacted Rex to replace it with something better but decided to purchase one on our own so we could get what we wanted. Apparently just because we purchased a Kohler toilet we don't automatically get a Kohler seat.

2. Fort Collins Utilities has a rebate program for recycling older, higher flow toilets. We didn't know that the plumber has to get a voucher form when he re-cycles the old toilet. Rex DID NOT TELL US this. After repeated calls to his office, we have given up any hope of receiving a voucher so we can get our $50 rebate from the Fort Collins Utility Dept.

3. Since August of 2014, I have not directly spoken to Rex on the phone despite leaving numerous messages with his office staff. 

We WILL NOT RECOMMEND Rex's Plumbing for any projects! Returning phone calls should be a priority for any business. Informing customers of possible rebates is something THEY should know all about. Not following through with the voucher means we're basically out $50.00.

reviews.author: B G.
reviews.text:
UPDATE:  the leak was not the toilet at all.  There was water on the floor again within 2 hours of Rex's plumber leaving my house.  I discovered that it was the bidet that was leaking, not the "bad wax ring" on the toilet as "Tony" told me it was!!!  WHAT A DECEITFUL, DISHONEST COMPANY THIS IS!!  SHAME ON TONY AND THE ENTIRE COMPANY!  They owe me a refund for the lies and bogus work they did!

First message:  I am elderly and feel I have been taken advantage of by this plumber!   They charged me $249.00 to replace the wax ring under my toilet!  I was so aghast at the high fee just for replacing the wax that I called other plumbers to check their fees.  One would have charged me $75!  So Rex's grossly overcharged me because they could get away with it!

"Tony" the plumber who came to my house, also told me the ring would last only 2/3 years because of our terrible Fort Collins water eroding the wax!  And told me I needed a water filtration system - for $2,800!!!!  

What could be more clear than this company taking huge advantage of an old lady by herself!  DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY-THEY ARE DISHONEST,!!?

reviews.author: Suzi S.
reviews.text:
We just moved to Colorado from South Florida. After receiving several obscene estimates to replace several toilets in our house, we contacted Rex. 

Office staff super friendly and professional. We selected this company not just because of price but because of their efficiency. Rex did the job, and wowwww were we impressed! So friendly and knowledgeable...a true professional. (I should add that I'm a kitchen and bath designer so I know what I'm talking about!)

We've already contacted Rex's to come out and give us an estimate for replacing our kitchen sink and doing all the corresponding plumbing, and have a third job in mind for them!!

VERY HAPPY CUSTOMERS!!!!


UPDATE..... 
I'm a kitchen and bath designer, so trust me I know what I'm talking about!  The office staff is equally friendly and professional!

Rex is here now replacing our kitchen sink, faucet and disposal, and once again we are THRILLED! We highly recommend this wonderful team for all your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Belinda E.
reviews.text:
I'm a property manager. I needed to replace a water heater in a building  with business usage and residential usage 2 days before Christmas...UGH!  I called my goto plumber; they would be there mid afternoon.  I called Rex's;  they sent Kevin immediately at 8:30 AM. I figured I am going to pay through the nose for REX's or have to wait til afternoon.  I was so wrong!
Kevin assessed the situation; he told me exactly what needed to be done, how he could IMPROVE upon the set up to make it more efficient; told me exactly what top quality water heater he recommended for the multiple uses in my building AND GAVE ME A COMPETITIVE QUOTE THAT WAS RIGHT INLINE WITH MY USUAL PEOPLE's ESTIMATE! All I had to do was say YES. By 11 AM he had the building up and running with a new system and several upgraded features for added safety and longevity. Need I say more?

reviews.author: Mark B.
reviews.text: Rex is great!  We have had him out several times for a kitchen remodel and bathroom remodel.  The kitchen remodel included running a gas line because of the new gas range replacing the electric one as well as re-routing the kitchen sink drain line and supply lines. For the kitchen remodel work we had three bids.  One bid was extremely high; one too low and the guy seemed a little to eager to help out with other items with the remodel unrelated to the plumbing work.  Rex's bid was in the middle and we couldn't be happier with the outcome. The bathroom remodel included installing a new tub, new shower control valve and moving the water supply line for the toilet.  Rex is great to work with and very friendly; plus our dog really likes him as well!

reviews.author: David H.
reviews.text:
I feel extremely fortunate to have been a customer of Rex's.  

I bought and had installed a Navien Tankless water heater NCB-210E, and after consulting with Rex himself, we scheduled for the next week.  The install was complete in two days, finishing up with Rex checking the system, and explaining details, and answering all my questions.  His team was professional, punctual, friendly, helpful and knowledgeable.  

All of my phone calls/messages/emails to Rex's office were promptly returned in a friendly and helpful manner.  The reminder phone call the day before Rex's team's arrival was a really nice touch.

With customer service and a price that both were second to none, you can't go wrong when you call Rex's Plumbing and Heating.

reviews.author: Becki H.
reviews.text:
Kevin and Rex were a huge help when the business I work for had a water heater meltdown. They were able to get in the day-of to diagnose the issue, and after finding that there was a short in the motor, they called around and found a replacement piece - in Denver no less. Rex drove down and picked it up, and they were able to install the piece and fix the issue on that exact same day. 

The price tag wasn't super cheap, but the fact that they were willing to go all the way to Denver and back, and able to get everything back up and working on the same day was huge for my business so we didn't have to shut down for more than a few hours. Thank you, Kevin and Rex!

synthesis.summary: Rex's sends technicians out within hours — sometimes same-day on Christmas Eve — and consistently beats competitor quotes, but one recent review raises a serious misconduct concern about a specific technician that the company hasn't visibly addressed.
strengths: Same-day or sub-3-hour response documented in at least 8 of the reviewed posts, including holidays and weekends
Pricing repeatedly came in below competitor estimates — one reviewer cited a $1,000 difference, another confirmed competitive quotes even for urgent holiday calls
Technicians Kevin and Terra each receive multiple repeat-customer mentions and praise for explaining issues clearly without overselling
weaknesses: A handful of reviews are very brief ('Same day service - can't be beat!', 'AC work great') with no detail, which inflates volume without adding meaningful signal about consistency
redFlags: One detailed November 2025 review alleges a specific technician tracked mud through the home without boot covers, made inappropriate comments about a woman's appearance and finances, and repeatedly invaded her personal space while she and her children were home alone — no public company response to this review is visible
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: same-day water heater replacements on Christmas Eve and the day before Christmas, a Sunday hot water heater repair, a Monday-morning call with same-afternoon arrival after a weekend water main shutoff, and a Friday within-2-hours response for a leaking pipe.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 across over 1,000 reviews while Yelp shows 3.3 across 32 — a 1.6-star gap that likely reflects Yelp's self-selecting critical audience and smaller sample, but is wide enough to suggest some customers with negative experiences are finding Yelp as their outlet rather than Google.

reviews.author: Michelle Vessel
reviews.text: We are eternally grateful to Dominik for helping us out of a serious jam by installing a new water heater with no advance notice on a Saturday afternoon after we had gotten the runaround from our home warranty company. He did a lot of great code-upgrade work along with the installation and really cleaned up and straightened out the unsightly "rat's nest" of wires and pipes left behind by a previous homeowner. He's a great plumber with a fantastic work ethic and a lot of compassion for people in a plumbing bind! We will definitely be using his services again in the future.

reviews.author: Lawrence Loredo
reviews.text:
Dominik of Finish Plumbing Highly recommended.
Dominik was prompt, courteous, and professional. His bid was competive and execution was excellent.  He demonstrated multiple time consideration of my time and finances. He answered my concerns and questions even those not directly related to the task. How can he improve? If he carries a City Inspector in his pocket, and I am confident if that becomes feasible he will do it. It was a pleasure to work with Domink.

Find attached a content kitty.  I don't know anything about plumbing but I am confident in the materials and installation I received.

reviews.author: Jerry Wilson
reviews.text:
We scheduled an appointment with Dominik to install a new toilet and haul away the old one. He gave us a quote over the phone, arrived on time, was quick and efficient, and left the worksite clean. We highly recommend Dominik for your residential plumbing needs.

Jerry and Kathy in Loveland

reviews.author: Ruben Cordova
reviews.text:
Six stars for Finish Plumbing if I could.  When you need a plumber, Dominik is THE guy that you hope shows up.

On a Saturday morning as we discovered that our water heater had been leaking for a few days (huge mess), I started calling around for a plumber.  Dominik came highly recommended by a discriminating neighbor who has worked with many residential contractors in the Fort Collins and Windsor area.  Even though it was his day off, Dominik returned my call and we worked out a quick plan to get hot water flowing in our household again by Monday.  He came out early Monday morning, took quick measurements and ran back out to get supplies.
He returned quickly and spent the rest of the day tirelessly working to get a new tankless water heater installed to give us hot water by the end of the day (warm showers...finally!).  I spent much of the day with him and, nice guy that he is, he tolerated my constant presence and questions.
In my profession I've worked with literally, hundreds of contractors (commercial) over the years and I'd put Dominik at the top of my list if I were hiring someone who'd I'd be working with directly.  He is extremely knowledgeable and this, combined with his experience (which I gleaned from him throughout the day) make him highly efficient.  He is a friendly, humble, conscientious professional and I wish him and his small company the best.  I could not give him a higher recommendation.  His price was fair and on the low side of what I was expecting (did you see that "conscientious" above?).

reviews.author: Brent Oglesby
reviews.text: Our water heater pilot light kept going out.  We have a Rheem and their warranty replacement on parts does not include a plumber.  The sent us parts and the first round did not fix the issue.  The sent a second part to be delivered 4 days later.  By this time we had been without hot water for over a week.  When the second part came in, I struggled for over and hour trying to get pieces swapped out.  Finally giving up I called finish plumbing.  Dominic had been out previously to validate that I replaced the first set of parts correctly, and when I explained the struggle I had been having, was told that they could get me in between 1 and 2 the next daym. Dominic called me back at 3 pm that day and said he would be over in 15 minutes.  He spent 20 minutes and had us up and running.  He took time out of a busy day to help something that wasn't even part of his problem.  And with out making us wait one more day the week of Thanksgiving.  Your hospitality is greatly appreciated

reviews.author: william krueger
reviews.text: Dominik just finished a job on our home and did excellent work.  He was more than accommodating, and when i had texted him multiple times on a holiday about what i needed to get done before he arrived, he called me every time in order to help.  Once the project was underway, we had run into some unforeseen issues.  Dominik was able to solve all the problems while having to do ADDITIONAL work, all while maintaining the original timeline, and original cost estimate.  When the inspector came it took less then 5 minutes to approve everything with no issues.  I'm confident based on talking to other plumbers we would have had multiple issues had we gone with someone else.  I highly recommend Dominik.

reviews.author: Stephen K.
reviews.text: We've used Finish Plumbing for about a dozen different plumbing projects on our home remodel and every single time we've been happy with the results. They are incredibly conscientious about their work and make sure each and every job is done right. They've installed four toilets on brand new Mexican tile, moved our clothes washer line from the first floor to the basement, installed new kitchen faucet (and upgraded the existing under-sink plumbing in the process). We have more work to be done and we can't imagine using anybody else. Plus, their prices are incredibly reasonable, especially for a master plumbing service of this high caliber. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: ROB LAZARONY
reviews.text: Having been in the home building business for nearly 20 years, I have worked with numerous plumbing companies. Though I could have removed my old tank-type water heater and replaced it with the tankless, I am retired and decided to hire someone to do the work. Being very knowledgeable and picky about all the details of such a job, I was concerned I would not have a good experience in hiring someone. I can honestly say that Dominik (Finish Plumbing) is among the very best I've worked with. Additionally, their pricing is competitive, communication skills are excellent and getting the job done on time and correct was much appreciated!

reviews.author: Jerome Beckmann
reviews.text: I highly recommend Finish Plumbing (Dominik) for your plumbing needs. He is competent, dependable, responsive, and honest. He quickly diagnosed and repaired our sewer backup on a Sunday morning, before any significant harm occurred. He identified the true root cause, a shattered riser pipe in the front yard which introduced blockage material to the main sewer line between the house and the street, and repaired it as well. He helped us deal with our insurance company which covered all our costs except for the deductible. Undoubtedly I will call Dominik the next time we need a plumber.

reviews.author: Jean W
reviews.text: I feel incredibly lucky to have found Dominik and Finish Plumbing! Choosing the right contractor can be a challenge, but I’m so glad I chose them. Dominik was an excellent communicator, always responding quickly, and his work was of the highest quality. Scheduling was a breeze, and his thoughtful approach to both customer service and the work itself truly stood out. Finish Plumbing will be my go-to for any future plumbing needs, and I highly recommend them to anyone in need of reliable, professional service!

reviews.author: Charlie Kohlhardt
reviews.text: My gas stove was disabled after a leak was detected within my house by Xcel energy. After using my backpacking stove for 4 days, the situation was approaching crisis level for my family's coming for Thanksgiving. Good Fortune was running into Dominic from precision plumbing and he said he could work it into his schedule on a Sunday! Now working, and time to move to the task of preparation for Thanksgiving. A huge thanks to precision plumbing. Already contacting him for some other work.

reviews.author: Nathaniel White
reviews.text: Called Finish Plumbing after hours once we realized our water heater was leaking and had gone out. Dominick was there the next day getting everything fully replaced and working like a charm. He was professional, prompt, kind and did an excellent job! I highly recommend working with them as I know they’ll do a great job. No one wants their water heater to go out but I’m grateful that created the opportunity to meet a plumber who we will be working with for a long time!

reviews.author: Nancy Stefek
reviews.text:
I was in need of some suggestions regarding resolve for issues inside and outside my home.  Finish Plumbing, Dominik and Amanda were referred to me by a previous customer of theirs.

From my initial phone call to request an appointment with Amanda, to my first, contact at my home with Dominik, I was very impressed.  Dominik explained the process for both jobs very thoroughly. I am very pleased, and grateful that i was referred to Finish Plumbing !!

Nancy Stefek

reviews.author: Brett Berlin
reviews.text: It’s so challenging picking a contractor with confidence. We chose Finishing Plumbing for or master bath remodel and are so pleased we did. Excellent work, easy scheduling, great communication during the work. And after that work was done we used Dominik to install a new hot water heater. Fast, quality work at a fair price. Finish Plumbing will be our first call for plumbing needs in the future and they should be your first call if you have plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Susie Stefek
reviews.text:
I can confidently recommend Finish Plumbing for any of your plumbing needs.

Dominik replaced our sprinkler back flow unit and did a great job. He explained what needed to be done in a concise manner and was very thorough in assisting us with our needs.

It was a pleasure working with Dominik and Amanda. It's comforting knowing that we can call them anytime and that they will respond promptly, be fair and honest and do an exceptional job!
