reviews.author: Cher Nelson
reviews.text: Elias and Damian are extremely professional, fair priced and got the job done in a timely fashion. They were polite and honest with what work actually needed to be done. They saved us literally thousands of dollars that another company quoted us for unnecessary work. I don't look forward to having any plumbing disasters happening but if I do Elias will be the first call I make.

reviews.author: Joeray Salcido
reviews.text: This company is outstanding! Very professional and great rates for the work they provide. Tommy saved me lots of money doing  simple fix on my garbage disposal!! Absolute life saver! Definitely recommending this company to all my friends and family!

reviews.author: Porshea Herrera
reviews.text:
This company is extremely professional and knowledgeable about what they do!
Tommy came out to help us with our water heater and not only was he quick but it was efficient. No more waiting around for those plumping issues when it comes to this company! The workers are kind and respectful and know what needs to be done.

reviews.author: Lisa L.
reviews.text:
I had a backed up kitchen sink. I called and spoke with Elias and he said it would cost about $70 to snake it or maybe a few hundred to hydro blast it. His plumbers came out and snaked it, but couldn't get through. They said that there was a 90 degree angle in the pipe and it was completely blocked, and they would need to cut the pipe and alter the angle for easier flow. They were both very kind guys! However, the master plumber said it would cost $3200! I said that was too much, and he said he'd discount me $400. So, I actually paid $2890. I researched after the job was completed and I was definitely taken advantage of. The rate for that type of job (not cutting into walls) should have been at least about $1000+ less. I'm very disappointed because I really wanted to believe they were being honest.
UPDATE: I spoke with Elias and he agreed that the charge was too high. He adjusted the price and compensated me accordingly. I appreciate his efforts to make things right!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Neher
reviews.text: I had a great experience wit All Around Rooter.  From the moment I called, their customer service was friendly, professional, and helpful. They scheduled me quickly and showed up right on time. The plumber was knowledgeable, efficient, and respectful of my home. He explained everything clearly and got the job done right the first time. The pricing was fair, and there were no surprises. It’s rare to find honest, reliable service these days, but this place delivers. I’ll definitely be calling them again for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jahila Lewis
reviews.text: The most professional plumbing company I’ve ever gone through (my wife and I have had a lot of terrible experiences with plumbers) . Damian and Eli are super knowledgeable and extremely skilled in the trade. They had the lowest pricing I’ve seen, and the best quality work I’ve seen. Will be using them for any other issues that arise 100%

reviews.author: Elias Castillon IV
reviews.text: We hired the crew to come and install a wash bowl for us as a barbershop and they did an amazing job super professional and answered any question we had till this day the job they performed turned out perfect highly recommend for your plumbing needs they beat all other competitors with the price

reviews.author: Lori Kim
reviews.text: Thought my sump pump was not working  and they came the same day and were honest and told me the sump pump was good and did not need repairing. They also did not charge a trip and if needed an estimate fee. I will use them anytime I need a plumber  due to their  honesty and integrity.

reviews.author: Jaxson Montez
reviews.text: Fantastic service and great costumer service. Called and had a very easy conversation and they helped me out as quickly as they could. I would highly recommend their services over all other company’s, with affordable and great quality work.

reviews.author: Layla Lynn
reviews.text: Tommy and Isaiah recently came out and replaced a toilet at my house, let’s just say words can’t explain how happy I am with their work. They were very kind and left the place cleaner than it was when they got here would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brandon Huesca
reviews.text: Elias and his team came out and replaced my water heater at my home they were done in a timely manner and had the best pricing in NOCO If you are looking for a honest, reliable and the best customer service this is the spot!

reviews.author: Fritz Poland
reviews.text: I had all around rooter out at my home and they were very polite and very knowledgeable showed me exactly what was wrong and fixed it at a very reasonable price!! I will be using them for any of my future problems

reviews.author: Julian Arteaga
reviews.text: Tommy came in to my home after my water heater drain was backed up and made quite a mess. He was super clean, fast, and respectful. Made the whole process easy going. I will be calling anytime this happens again.

reviews.author: Reyna Lozoya-Zarraga
reviews.text: All around rooter recently visited my property in northern Colorado prices were the most reasonable out of the 7 estimates I got work was done very clean and efficiently would highly recommend to anybody

reviews.author: Marcus Delatorre
reviews.text: Allaroundrooter was very professional and fixed my problem in a timely manner at a really good price especially in today’s age! I would recommend them to anyone thinking of doing business with them.

synthesis.summary: Consistently beats competitor quotes by hundreds to thousands of dollars while delivering same-day arrivals and leaving job sites cleaner than they found them.
strengths: Pricing transparency backed by at least 8 reviews explicitly calling out best-in-area rates, including one customer who got 7 estimates and chose them, and another who saved thousands over a competitor's unnecessary work quote
Same-day or rapid response confirmed across multiple reviews spanning different job types — sump pump, water heater, drain backup — suggesting this is standard practice, not a one-off
Honest diagnostics over upselling: at least 2 reviews specifically praise techs for telling customers they didn't need extra work, including one no-charge trip where the sump pump turned out fine
weaknesses: One reviewer documented paying $2,890 for a pipe angle repair they later researched as worth roughly $1,000 less — the owner did issue a partial refund after confrontation, but the initial quote gap is a real concern for emergency jobs when customers can't shop around
redFlags: Roughly 12-15 of the 37 Google reviews appear to have been posted on the same date (07/30/2025) within hours of each other, which is a strong indicator of a coordinated review push and inflates the overall rating picture — treat the 5-star consensus with some skepticism
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews reference same-day arrival and fast turnaround, and one review was posted at 2:22am following a water heater emergency, suggesting after-hours availability is real — but no reviews explicitly mention calling after midnight or on holidays, so 24/7 coverage isn't fully confirmed.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows a perfect 5/5 across 37 reviews while Yelp sits at 4/5 with only 1 review — not enough Yelp data to call it a true discrepancy, but the near-total absence of reviews outside Google warrants mild caution.

reviews.author: Bob K
reviews.text:
We have used Welzig for all of our HVAC needs for years.. For many reasons.  Foremost is the Quality of service and very pleasant employees.  Maybe they aren't the cheapest but I honestly believe they are the best along the Front Range of Colorado.
Last night my furnace bit the dust at 2:00 am... called their answering service and they had a service man here by 9:00AM.
Kudos to James Matheny... awesome technician, very pleasant and courteous.  Thanks Welzig

reviews.author: Jay Marine
reviews.text: Our furnace stopped working sometime Saturday night we called them Sunday to see when they could get out to look at it. The earliest they could get here was Tuesday afternoon, not much we could do because everybody else was further out. We got up Monday morning and got ready for the day then got a call saying they could get us in around an hour or so, we were happy about that! About 5 minutes later I got a text saying Jonathan the tech was 15 minutes away from the house, even better we thought! He arrived and was totally professional and ready to work, only had to back to his van once for a part. In no time at all he had the furnace up and running, it was a simple fix and made it a minimal change too. I would recommend this company and tech to anyone and everyone I come in contact with, friendly, professional and caring! Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Gloria Leitner
reviews.text:
So glad that I have subscribed to Welzig Comfort Club program.  They recommended an inspection of my Hot Water Heater and plumbing throughout our home.   The pressure relief valve needed to be replaced after 5-yrs due to corrosion of the anode rod.

We had the shutoff valves replaced to use a 1/4 turn valve to avoid any future issues with water leaks in the bathrooms.  Preventative action as we are in our retirement years and plumbing can always be tricky with leaks.

The biggest benefit of this service was when we learned that the reason for the garbage disposal performing so poorly has been due to improper plumbing due to a kitchen remodel done years ago.  We had a deep-sink installed with the granite countertop and that crew retrofitted the plumbing and did not inform me that this was required.    It was a challenging project to redirect the pipes but worth the price to have this completed since it was not to code.

The professionalism of the 3 plumbers that helped resolve our plumbing issues was exceptional.  They were very attentive to details on what was needed.

reviews.author: Al Riggs
reviews.text: Jerry did not know what a "Yard Hydrant" was nor did he know how to repair one.  He wanted to dig the entire 5' pipe out of the ground and replace everything.  I stopped him and he left, apologizing.  Dispatch needs to realize a little bit about the problem to be resolved before sending someone.  At least there was no charge, at least so far...

reviews.author: Rene Sotola
reviews.text:
Outstanding experience from start to finish. Casey in sales spent over an hour patiently answering all my questions, which made me feel confident moving forward. Cassy did a great job aligning the claims with the offer, ensuring everything was seamless.

Installation happened just one day after I signed the contract — incredibly efficient. Saul and his colleague were professional and thorough. I especially appreciated that Welzig sent a senior engineer; Saul has been with the company for 15 years, and his expertise showed.

They handled the permit process, and the inspector came promptly and approved the work. And the small cooler with cookies? A thoughtful touch that truly made the experience feel personal.

Well done, Welzig — highly recommended!

reviews.author: Thomas Scott
reviews.text:
Welzig Heating has always provided quality workmanship in a friendly, dependable manner. For example, yesterday, Cameron Ryan serviced my AC and furnace and thoroughly checked both units. He carefully explained any repairs and modifications that would improve my heating & cooling systems and then successfully completed the actions that I agreed to.

I just had another visit from Welzig  by Jesse who did an outstanding job reviewing my plumbing issues and corrected everything that was problematic. He explained the work (along with pictures) and the costs involved. It was a pleasant experience in general. Great work.

reviews.author: Joshua Kerns
reviews.text: Had my 15 year old water heater go down the day before thanksgiving, where I would be hosting ten people. I didn't find out until 2pm on Wednesday. From the wonderful people at the office that got my ticket in and someone headed my way 10 minutes. To Jerry my plumber, Welzig was fantastic. Jerry showed up Thanksgiving morning at 8 and had the new one installed by 930, old one hauled out, and hot water flowing by 1030. Awesome flat pricing as well. I cannot stress enough how much me and my wife are grateful for the whole team at Welzig, but ESPECIALLY JERRY YOU'RE THE BEST BROTHER!

reviews.author: Laurel Sindewald
reviews.text:
James and Casey did a great job troubleshooting our 25-year-old, idiosyncratic radiant heat system. They identified valves and parts that needed to be replaced and were extremely knowledgeable. I appreciated their willingness to patiently explain to new homeowners the basics of our system. Casey gave us a thorough breakdown of pricing on a new boiler, including tradeoffs with different models. Welzig is a highly professional operation and we feel lucky to be able to work with them, given that we live at 8500 ft.

Jerry came out to fix a leak under the sink and did a great job!

reviews.author: Lynda Clayton
reviews.text:
Cassy at Welzig has done a great job for me! I will definitely do business with Welzig again and will recommend their services!

Travis and Anthony installed both my furnace and air conditioner units. They were polite, knowledgeable, and efficient. Even though they ran into some challenges with the air conditioner, they remained patient and pleasant. They cleaned up after themselves before they left each day. Again,  I would recommend Welzig for installing your HVAC appliances, especially Travis and Anthony!

reviews.author: Chris Bloom
reviews.text:
Jerry came out to fix a leak on our home humidifier, and he was fantastic from start to finish. He was incredibly friendly and professional, took the time to explain what he was doing, and even shared some great plumbing best practices to help us prevent issues down the road. The repair was quick, efficient, and done right. He treated our home with respect and left the area spotless.

Highly recommend Jerry and the Welzig team. It’s rare to find someone so knowledgeable, courteous, and thorough!

reviews.author: emwo1365
reviews.text: We just had our favorite plumber, Jon, from Welzig Plumbing come to the house to do some work for us, and as always, he was amazing! He’s incredibly skilled at what he does and takes the time to explain everything clearly. Jon is not only professional and knowledgeable but also has the best personality — it’s always a pleasure to see him. We truly appreciate his excellent work and friendly attitude every time he comes by. Highly recommend Jon and Welzig to anyone looking for a top-notch plumber

reviews.author: Megan Regalado
reviews.text: From start to finish, Casey explained our furnace options and Roberto Santana-Hernandez delivered outstanding service on our furnace install. He arrived on schedule, protected floors and work areas, verified gas and electrical connections, and brought the system up to spec. Robert walked us through filter changes and thermostat settings. The workmanship is neat, the unit is quiet, and our home is heating evenly. Welzig Heating & Air earned our trust. Five stars.

reviews.author: Charles Roberts
reviews.text: I received my first plumbing maintenance with Andy from Welzig, and what a great experience. Andy was through with his inspection and pointed out a couple issues that needed to be addressed. I'm really glad Welzig now has a separate plumbing service to provide the annual servicing of the hot water heater and to check things out in general. This was a much better experience versus having an HVAC tech trying to do the preventive maintenance for plumbing.

reviews.author: Jordan Woolf
reviews.text: We've had experts from HVAC, plumbing, and electrical to service and inspect our new home, and all members have gone above and beyond in their educating us as homeowners while also providing practical solutions. Of particular note, Johnny Baker installed a HALO 5 water filtration system and was extremely personable, friendly, knowledgeable, approachable, and all around friendly! Thank you so much, Welzig!

reviews.author: Anne G
reviews.text: We’ve been using Welzig for many, many years. They always have excellent service and very knowledgeable, friendly, and timely folks working on whatever issue we have. They helped our sad furnace limp along for years until we were ready to buy a new system, and I am glad I do the yearly maintenance on our water heater, since we have a ton of iron and minerals  in our well water.

Thorough diagnostics with clear explanations: reviewers repeatedly praise techs for showing them issues firsthand, answering all questions, and leaving them informed enough to make their own decisions

synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one reviewer called at 2am and had a tech on-site by 9am, another had a tech en route within 10 minutes of a same-day call, and a water heater was replaced Thanksgiving morning with hot water flowing by 10:30am — after-hours answering service confirmed active.

reviews.author: Steve Grujich
reviews.text: Needed to replace two old 40 gal water heaters. Decided to make the switch to tankless. Installation went smoothly and completed in one day. Quote for the work was very reasonable for a retrofit when compared to others I got. I already have recommended them to a couple neighbors and a co-worker considering the same switch.

reviews.author: Aaron Todd
reviews.text:
We had a hot water heater start to fail and needed it replaced quickly. Our setup is a bit strange but Polar Bear had David dispatched to us the next morning and he patiently went through my options and described what had likely happened. He got everything done by early afternoon without any issues at all. They added some new safety mechanisms we were missing and improved the hot water setup we had while they were at it.

I do not have a single bad thing to say, it was incredible service and we didn't lose hot water for a single day 🙌

reviews.author: Taylor Arthur
reviews.text: We were able to have Wyatt come out and diagnose our furnace issue on Monday morning (called around 8:30 AM, he was out at 11:30). He promptly found the problem, recommended a variety of solutions and services to get it running again, and was able to get the parts and repair it same day. We are so happy to be toasty warm again. Everyone we encountered was very friendly and we'll be happy to do business with them again. Prices seemed reasonable as well (though I don't have much knowledge in this area).

reviews.author: Carson Gray
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service — Couldn’t Be Happier!

We recently had a new furnace installed by this company and the experience was top-notch from start to finish. Our technician, Kaleb, was an absolute pleasure to work with. From the moment he arrived, he was professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely took the time to walk us through everything — what he was doing, why, and what to expect going forward.

Kaleb answered every question we had without making us feel rushed or like we were asking too much. He clearly knows his trade inside and out, and his friendly, no-pressure approach made the whole process feel stress-free. The installation was completed efficiently and the workspace was left cleaner than he found it.

This all happened in the dead of winter, so getting our heat back up and running quickly was critical — and Kaleb delivered. He worked efficiently and didn’t waste a minute, making sure our home was warm again as fast as possible. We can’t thank him enough. If you’re looking for a heating and air company you can trust, look no further — highly recommend

reviews.author: Steven Young
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience with Polar Bear Plumbing Heating and Air from start to finish. We just bought a house in the middle of summer with no AC. Tanya and Lindsey were super sweet and helped us schedule, reschedule, and reschedule an appointment while we were busy moving. Jeremy came in and helped me understand the process and explained everything in such a simple way that it was like talking to a buddy. The price was so good, I ended up asking to get my 40 year old furnace replaced too. My last thank you is to the two gentlemen who came out to install everything. Kaleb and Aaron completed a masterpiece. They were so kind and professional. They listened to all of my questions and explained anything I didn't know. Again, absolutely beautiful work. Take a look for yourself.

I have been told my entire life that you can have only 2 of 3: good quality, good price, done fast.  They accomplished all 3 and proved that wrong.

Thank you to everyone in the Polar Bear Team! It was like being taken care of by family.

reviews.author: E N
reviews.text:
Service and repairs were prompt. The Ryan immediately found the source of the plumbing problem and provided us with ideas on how to prevent the issue from reoccurring.
We were so pleased with their plumbing services. We contacted Polar Bear for our HVAC replacement. They quickly provided the estimate & scheduled the installation.  Kaleb & Arron completed the installation of the new heater & air conditioner efficiently and neatly.  They are proud of the results.  During the holiday season our master shower faucet failed. Steve quickly found the parts and completed the repair. Thank you to the Polar Bear Team! We highly recommend them for your plumbing and HVAC needs.
2026 Spring start up for our air conditioning system.  Wyatt did an awesome job. In the fall of 2025, he was being trained by Kaleb.  It is great to have skilled staff who can pass their knowledge to their team members.

reviews.author: Justin RIbbing
reviews.text: Caleb Hart from Polar Bear Plumbing n heating went above and beyond his role in the company. He was not only the installer of a heat pump I decided to go with, but more knowledgeable in sales than anyone else I had talked with from other companies and a great technician trouble shooting an older system I had as well. You can tell he takes pride in his work and studies his industry. He was very kind and professional and went over any questions I had and walked me through all pros n cons of systems. It’s hard finding a good technician and have found one for all future needs. Can’t recommend him and his company enough.

reviews.author: Jon Grimm
reviews.text: Thank you very much Dave, for your fast response about my pipe burst at my residence in Fort Collins.  The section of pipe used to repair the broken pipe is state of the art!  I know for a fact that I can always rely on Polar Bear Plumbing, Heating for scheduled services as well as prompt courteous arrival for any plumbing or heating related problems!  My thanks also to the office staff for their wonderful, timely coordinating to make all repairs for me possible and efficient!  I highly recommend Polar Bear services for all residents of the front range here in northern Colorado.  Sincerely, Jon Grimm

reviews.author: Abraham S.
reviews.text:
We had a pinhole leak in one of our pipes located in the attic.   Initially contacted a competitor, who advertises on television. Their tech told me it's HVAC, so out of his league. 

I then did some research on Yelp, and found that Polar Bear has lots of positive feedback, and I can see why. Unfortunately I cannot recall the tech's name, but he was quick to diagnose the problem. His quote was reasonable, so we had him do the job,

He was quick to repair the issue, and button everting up. Five Stars - I've found my go to plumber

reviews.author: Lisa A.
reviews.text: 5-star business!  From first contact to estimate, install, and follow up two weeks later, I couldn't be more impressed.  During a heat wave when I was desperate for A/C, they came out on a Saturday and replaced my whole HVAC system quickly and beautifully.  Prices were reasonable and their responsiveness awesome, even AFTER the job was done.  They went above and beyond and couldn't have been more pleasant to work with.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Polar Bear.  I promise, you won't regret it!

reviews.author: Ben
reviews.text: Dave and Eli were incredibly professional and helpful in diagnosing my plumbing issue. From the very first point of contact through the entire process—and even after the repair was completed—they were responsive, efficient, and thorough. They quickly resolved the problem and took the time to explain everything clearly, including the next steps to prevent future issues. I’d highly recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services, and I’ll definitely be using them again.

reviews.author: kara Anderson
reviews.text: Polar Bear Heating and air are extremely knowledgeable.They are professional, hardworking, respectful, and thorough. We appreciated their knowledge and awareness of current rebates that helped us not only upgrade our ac , but our entire furnace as well! We now have a high efficiency system. Highly recommend this company for their personable approach and professional knowledge for anyone needing their complete services! They are above and beyond!

reviews.author: Patty Hayden
reviews.text: There is nothing better than Peace of Mind.  That's what you get when you use Polar Bear Heating and Air.  I had Wyatt out to service my furnace and air conditioner for the season. I am a new home owner with little to none experience with this.   He was professional, knowledgeable and very helpful.   I can sleep well at night knowing that my systems are cleaned and ready for the season.  Thank you Wyatt and Ely

reviews.author: Amy Gerlach
reviews.text: Steve was very thorough and took a lot of time explaining the products and process of installing my new heating, air, thermostat, and tankless water heater. The installation crew (Alex, Zach, and Christian) were very knowledgable, courteous, and professional. It was a very clean process from start to finish and my new equipment was all explained in detail upon completion. Thank You!

reviews.author: Karen Lee Neff
reviews.text: We love Polar Bear Plumbing, Heating and Air.  Nick is absolutely wonderful and explained everything to us in detail as to what we needed to have done and the service that was done after the appointment today.  We also appreciate the thorough cleanup. Your company is very trustworthy and the estimates that are given or honored. We really appreciate you guys! Thank you so much!

plumbers.address: 3005 W 29th St, Greeley, CO 80631, USA

reviews.author: Stephan Hoff
reviews.text: Cameron was our service tech. He will own the company someday. He was knowledgeable, extremely polite and professional, and got the job done above and beyond. He encountered unexpected problems, provided solutions, and saved us tens of thousands of dollars on a repair on damage that wasn't our responsibility. He is a rock star in my book. Cameron and Robert are our heroes. Give both of them a big bonus. I'm keeping Cameron's number for any future repairs I may need. He's raised my faith exponentially in the next generation.   Stephan

reviews.author: Taylor Whitt
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was amazing. They arrived 40 minutes early, were very professional, and responded within two hours of my call for a backed-up toilet that flooded our basement. They handled the situation quickly, vacuumed up the water, and deodorized as much as possible. In a stressful situation, they were efficient, respectful, and thorough. I’m very grateful for their help and would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Branden
reviews.text: I am very pleased with my experience, and will use Roto-Rooter going forward for anything plumbing related. Our technician Sean was fantastic and knowledgeable, offering us insight as well as being very transparent with pricing as well as what work was going to be done. Couldn't recommend them more!

reviews.author: Miles Nathan Harmony
reviews.text:
Both professionally and at home these guys have left me hanging.

Twice while at work I've been required to use the services of Roto-Rooter, and both times their on call guy wouldn't answer the phone. I dealt with backed up sewage both times, and waited for a call back that never happened.

Called earlier today for a water heater issue at home, and still have not received a call back 4 hours later. This is not a mistake I will make again.

reviews.author: Mike M
reviews.text:
Confirmed with This business that it is the correct business, left message and waiting for call-back.
This is the end result of Roto Rotor of Windsor CO charging over $7,000+ over two years.  I do not recommend them for any type of work.  This 10" pipe was damaged by them and they could not find this root clog 5' from the access point.  Expect repeat charged service calls because it was never fixed in the first place.  We were told well it looks normal.

reviews.author: Josh E.
reviews.text: One star is too generous...Absolute worst costumer service I have ever experience. Zero character in the owner (Bonnie) and one of the drivers (Jack). First scenario was in March 2018. They stated that, "I had to be present at my house for my septic vault pumping;" therefore, I had to take a personal day off work (8 hours) to be there. It was a NO SHOW. I called them asking for an explanation and was told, "the driver [Jack] had additional work to do and wasn't able to come up that day but would be there tomorrow." With that being said, I had to take another personal day off of work (8 more hours) to be there. Again, it was a NO SHOW. Extremely irritated at this point, I followed up with a phone call for an explanation..."The driver, Jack, had additional work to do and couldn't come up that day, but he will be there the following business day which would be three days from then." They also mentioned that I would receive a 10% off discount but that's all that they could do. So, waiting a long weekend without the use of water to prevent the septic from backing up, I had to take yet another day off of work (total of 24 personal vacation hours at this point) to be present. Long story short, the driver, Jack, finally showed up -- two hours late -- and pumped my septic which I then paid for ($433.50). Second scenario: I swore I would never use this company again, however, I was in need of my septic vault being pumped and they claimed that they could come up the following day. Stating I had to be present for the septic vault pumping, I again had to take a personal day off work (8 hours) to be there. I live in a gated community and had previously unlocked the gate expecting the driver, Jack, to be on time (between 11:00am and 1:00pm). Two and a half hours go by and I received a call from the driver, Jack, claiming that the gate was closed at 3:00pm so he couldn't come conduct the job and that it was my fault the gate was closed (THOUGH HE WAS 2 HOURS LATE and didn't attempt to call me for the gate code or for me to come unlock the gate). Trying to keep my composure I called the company and asked to speak with a manager. Nobody was able to help and said that they would come pump my septic vault FIRST THING in the morning the next day and that I wouldn't have to be present this time. They also mentioned that they will compensate me with a larger discount. After calling numerous times throughout the day, they stated that the driver, Jack, finally finished around 3:00pm...nowhere near "first thing in the morning", and after checking the job he DIDN'T EVEN PUMP THE ENTIRE VAULT. Not receiving an invoice/bill for 6 months, they called me stating I need to pay my bill ASAP. Trying to explain my side of the story to the owner, Bonnie, she was completely RUDE, NASTY, and DISRESPECTFUL...yelling and literally calling me a liar. This is, in my opinion, not how a manager should treat their clients nor anybody in fact.  After threatening to take me to collections, I decided it wasn't worth my time and I paid my invoice (which was $570.00 this time...$136.50 MORE than the first time they pumped my septic vault and they PUMPED LESS waste). I highly DO NOT recommend this company and if you are looking for a company that takes pride in their work, FIND SOMEONE ELSE!

reviews.author: Tanya P
reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY! I honestly don't even know where to began. I was scheduled for a job that would take 1-2 days max. It took 9 days for them to complete the work and to this day I am left with incomplete work because of their own poor planning.. The office had no problem charging me for all the bids despite the work not being done. In plumbing there has to be a linear process so that you are not constantly having to pivot due to mistakes. This was not the case at all with this company. It was constant road blocks because of their ineptitude. For example, we did not have running water for 3 whole days because they didn't have the right parts, despite telling us two days in a row we would have running water the next day. They also didn't install the pipes correctly because we had to have them come back for leaks. Not to mention they installed the shower valve wrong and both the tub faucet are sticking off the wall and the overflow pipe. These are basic things a plumber should know how to plan for. They require accuracy. When I told them the faucet was sticking out they told me we would have to cut the tile and hardy backer to make it work. Despite us showing them the materials we were going to use-- how could they not plan for this? It makes no sense. There is so much more I can share about the ineptitude including getting grease finger prints all over brand new fixtures, a new butcher block, and not cleaning up after themselves at all. I even had to run to the store to get a 12 in toilet line so they wouldn't leave us without a toilet on day 4. The incompetance coupled with the lack of customer service is not worth any money you might be saving by working with them. We are not the type to leave negative reviews but this job has left us utterly dissappointed despite spending thousands of dollars. We even bought them beer to take home after the first day bc we wanted to show we appreciated their work. Never again will I use this company.

reviews.author: Hilary A.
reviews.text:
BEWARE.
Can I give zero stars? Absolutely disgraceful customer service. Unprofessional, dishonest, inconsistent, and outright disrespectful. Scheduled to have our septic pumped in October by Jack. Was asked to be present, therefore took a full day of PTO. Jack did not show up and later called saying he did not have a gate code. Rather than calling to get code, he turned around and went back to town claiming he had other jobs to complete that day, therefore a full day wasted. They assured us that they would make things right and provide quality customer service. When they finally made it they DID NOT PUMP THE SEPTIC TO ENTIRETY. Also-- no invoice was left nor communication made regarding an invoice. 3 months later and they began calling demanding the full amount and no joke-- told us we were dishonest. Attempted to explain the situation and come to a resolution with the manager, Bonnie. She was immediately unprofessional and accused us of being dishonest (claiming that we just did not feel like paying). She was also claiming various inconsistent claims (such as never be asked to be at the residence). She refused to hear us out or offer any resolution, other than threatening to send us to collections if not paid in full. We each hold excellent credit scores and would be happy to pay a company who has provided a service FULLY! Not pumping the septic to entirety demonstrates inadequate and unprofessional service. This is not our first disappointing experience with this company. They had several consistent no shows 6 months prior to this incident, resulting in over 5 days of a full septic with the inability to use water to avoid overflow. Bad customer service will only hurt your business in the future.

reviews.author: Darren Brons
reviews.text:
Labor warranty?

In August we had roto rooter inspect a sewer line on a home we had a contract on. They identified a crack outside the house and we negotiated the cost of lining the sewer from the house out to the street.

7 weeks later and we were struggling with poor air quality in our newly purchased home. My puppy happened to dig a hole just outside our foundation and it filled with water. We found that 10ft under our house our exposed cast iron pipe had broken and there was a 1/4 crack in the pipe that had been leaking sewage for some time. Roto rooter quoted us $2000 to repair it sometime next week. They confirmed that it was not cracked during the inspection 2 months ago. I asked if there was a possibility that when lining the same sewer with a mini excavator to dig it out if there is a chance they aggravated our old cast iron piping enough to crack it. They’re response, “Cast iron pipe is really strong and they are  100% certain they could not have damaged it. But also that cast iron pipe can be really fragile and it’s shear coincidence that it broke after they repaired the sewer.”

I will never use roto rooter again. We had a local plumber give us a quote, and he repaired it that same day and warranties all his parts and labor. I would rather use a company that I can trust

reviews.author: Chelsea Martinez
reviews.text:
WORST EXPERIENCE EVER.

Had them scheduled to show up at one of our restaurants. Made the appointment on a Thursday for the upcoming Monday morning at 6AM. Called Sunday to confirm never heard from anyone. My tech arrived on site to meet their tech at 6AM. No one showed up. 8:30AM no one was still there. Finally after getting the run around at the office they tell me they need to reschedule for Tuesday morning at 8AM. My tech arrives on site Tuesday morning at 8AM. No one shows up. I call the office several times i get the run around again. 9:15AM the office tells me that the appointment was scheduled from 8-9AM and I told them well its 9:15AM and no one is here. Then they tell me that they were in a meeting and will be there soon. I have my tech stay on site waiting for their tech to show up. 9:45 I received a call from the manager and she tells me their equipment for the work I need completed is out of service....

Not only has this company now waisted my office's time, my technicians time x2 and gas and miles on our company vehicle to meet them at the restaurant. Now their equipment is broken all the sudden...?

The manager did apologize but I will not be using this company ever.

reviews.author: Alex Varghese
reviews.text:
Jeremy was very professional and careful while dealing with installation of our new faucets. We really liked the way he worked.we would really take his help in future for any plumbing related works.

One year down the lane One of the toilet flush they changed stopped working which was done on June 2023 confirmed by the front desk lady. Now it is one year and one month. I was told one year warranty on labor and now when called they say it exceeded by one month so will be charging another 150 on labor per hour on top of the product they installed which didn’t last one year. Won’t recommend them anymore and Jeremy who I would recommend any day is not working there as well.

I went with another company Polar bear. They were very nice and fixed everything for 40 dollars compared to 150 per hour estimate from this company on a work which they were supposed to do it on warrant in first place.

reviews.author: Jon Rudolph
reviews.text:
Don't use this company.  They cleary don't care about their customers or how to handle a mistake.

Had Roto-rooter scheduled for an sewer scope inspection for my client.  They had a 3 hour window with which to show up and do the sewer scope inspection.  Upon making a second call and leaving messages to reach the technician, he final calls 10 min. before our window to inspect was closed.  He tell's me they over booked him.  He's in another town, so he won't be coming.

There I am Shit-out-of-luck.  It's not just me, now I have to make good with my customer for making the mistake of try Roto-Rooter.

My advice, don't use this company.  Things may happen, but there was no attempt to even for warn me they might not make and that they couldn't make it.  They also did nothing to try and make good on the situation.  Just, " so I'm not going to make there.".

reviews.author: Kevin Aagaard
reviews.text:
We have been struggling to get a sewer line repaired for 2 weeks, and have had a rocky relationship with the original company that agree to take the job. It's a complicated job with a super deep pipe (>15'). We called Roto-Rooter, Keith came out the same day, gave us a number of options, recommended excavators that he trusted that he knew would do the job, and was super honest with us. He freely gave us his time and a camera scope, and treated us kindly.

We contacted Roto-Rooter, and Keith specifically, on the recommendation of our Realtor (who had reached out to some other realtor friends). 4 of our realtor's friends independently recommended Keith to us. This company (including the front-desk personnel that originally took our call) treated us with respect every step of the way, and Keith in particular just kicked butt. We're extremely grateful.

reviews.author: L & M Geiger
reviews.text: After having been out of septic facilities for 36 hours, roto rooter pulled into our driveway and left stating they would need to come back two days later to do a location of our septic tank and then proceeded to advise they would not be able to pump our tank for an additional 4 days. We are tenants and this is what our property manager advised us that roto rooter informed her of. However, he did personally tell us he would need to have someone else come and locate the tank even though my husband pointed to him the possible location of the tank, in which roto rooter showed no interest in following up with ....B&J septic ended up coming out a couple of hours later, located the tank and had it pumped out within a little over an hour. I will never contact roto rooter for services following the treatment by them.

synthesis.summary: Individual techs frequently earn high praise and can respond within two hours, but callback failures and warranty disputes suggest the company's reliability depends heavily on which tech you get and whether someone picks up the phone.
strengths: Multiple reviewers across different years cite fast or early arrival, including one response within two hours for a flooded basement emergency
Technicians like Cameron, Rob, and Sean are praised by name for transparency on pricing and scope before work begins, reducing bill-shock surprises
At least two reviews credit thorough workmanship that went beyond the original job, including double-cleaning a sewer line and pulling a septic lid at no extra charge
weaknesses: Two reviews describe warranty failures: one repair failed in under 5 months with the customer asked to pay again, and another reports damage possibly caused by Roto-Rooter that they refused to warranty
One review documents a 9-day job that was estimated at 1-2 days, with no running water for 3 days due to missing parts and multiple rework visits for leaks and incorrect installations
redFlags: One reviewer reports three separate callback failures across both work and home calls, with sewage situations left unaddressed for 4+ hours and no return call at all — a direct concern for 2am emergencies

A Windsor CO review documents $7,000+ charged over two years for a problem that was never actually fixed, with a root clog missed 5 feet from the access point — raises questions about diagnosis integrity on repeated service calls
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Response time can be under two hours for flooding emergencies and one crew arrived 40 minutes early, but at least one reviewer experienced a 4-hour wait with no callback for an active water heater failure, so after-hours availability appears inconsistent rather than guaranteed.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.0 stars across 119 reviews while Yelp shows 3.2 stars across 16 reviews, a 0.8-star gap that aligns with the review text pattern: one-off positive experiences rate high, but customers with multi-visit or warranty disputes skew Yelp lower.

reviews.author: Kayla McDaniel
reviews.text: Brandon and Tony did an amazing job, respectful, friendly and they care about their customers. They came to our house 3 days in a row. Got our furnace maintenance done and it is up and running and back to heating our house! I would recommend them and this company!

reviews.author: S Coakley
reviews.text: My technician Levi today was fantastic. He was kind, respectful of my home, and very thorough in explaining what needed attention. He went above and beyond by helping with an additional small repair at no charge, which I appreciated so much. Excellent service and great customer care — highly recommend.”

reviews.author: Lia Carter
reviews.text: Brandon was one of the best service professionals I’ve ever worked with. He was exceptionally thorough and explained every step of his inspection. We have some issues with our furnace which he evaluated quickly and efficiently. He was flexible with plans to speak to us when we are available and gave us tons of options to discuss. We live very close to JT but haven’t had the pleasure of using them until now but now we are devoted customers. 10/10

reviews.author: Skye Marsh
reviews.text:
Update: They have cancelled on me twice this week after I’ve taken 8 hours of PTO.  I appreciate the updates but they don’t come until after my service window. They could’ve called this morning so I didn’t waste 4 more hours waiting. They might still be great, but not when they keep canceling. Emergencies happen- tell me earlier.

Awesome service from Blake and Dylan in getting my AC unit up and running again before the heat of summer!

reviews.author: Amity E.
reviews.text:
We deeply regret hiring JT Plumbing. From the start, we were pressured by Justin Mort and Robert Armstrong to make a rushed decision, using fear tactics about tariffs and pricing. We weren't given time to get other opinions.
JT Plumbing withdrew the full $21,780 payment from our loan account more than a month before work began. We never signed off on the final work, and our concerns were ignored.
We were displaced from our home for 18 nights--JT Plumbing only covered 8. The stress was overwhelming, comparable to the worst moments of our lives.
We had to chase them for updates, scheduling, and even basic follow-through. Their excavator sat in our yard for weeks. We had no say in subcontractors, and now we're left repairing our deck, basement stairs, flooring, and more--on our own dime.
Final camera footage was delayed and incomplete. A third-party plumber confirmed the line was improperly sloped, forcing us to dig up our yard again to fix their mistake.
We're still facing potential costs for tree removal, driveway repairs, and curb damage. We cleaned up after their crew multiple times. If you value peace of mind, transparency, and professionalism--look elsewhere.

reviews.author: GerrekandRachel Zwickle
reviews.text:
It’s never a good day when you have to call a plumber or heating and air company, but when we had to do just that, JT Plumbing, Heating, and Air eased the pain.

First, our two year old water heater that they originally installed spring a leak (because of the water pressure, not because anything they did), they sent out Levi and Dustin.  Within literal minutes, Levi told us he would replace our water heater in the same day, and they delivered.

Unfortunately, our furnace stopped heating the same morning they were scheduled to come out.  *seriously*. Levi heard the furnace making noises and called their scheduler and requested their best HVAC guy to come out.  Because of an appointment we had (they would have come out same day), Brandon and JT came out and quoted us several different quotes for repairs or replacements.  We decided to go with a replacement, which Brandon installed efficiently the next day.

While looking at the furnace, JT noticed that our Sump Pump was connected with a rubber fitting that was about to fail.  He suggested we call our sump pump company and ask them about options.  (*seriously* another issue… but they sent us to a different company, they weren’t milking us…).

Surprise, we found out the sump pump company we used has since gone out of business…. I called JT again and asked them to add on the sump pump to their work.

They sent out Trey, one of the kindest dudes I’ve talked with, and he talked us through our options with the sump pump… we replaced that as well, and Trey did all that work as he was helping Brandon with the furnace.

In three days, over a holiday break, three massive issues came up… *seriously*. And it was terrible.  Jenna, their scheduler worked her magic and made it all happen within our a schedule. Levi, Dustin, Brandon, JT, and Trey all worked together to get our water hot, our house warm, and keep our basement water free.  Everyone was incredibly kind, professional, and thoughtfully considered our budget and expenses as they presented options, solutions, and did all the work we selected.

I will absolutely use them every time I need anything done within their scope of work.

reviews.author: Susan Carter
reviews.text: We have used JT Plumbing Heating & Air for all of heating and air conditioning needs for a few years now and have had nothing but excellent experiences every time. They have taken care of our faucets, slow drains, water heater pilot light issues, furnace and air conditioning issues and even had to do a complete plumbing replacement in our home. When you call to schedule an appointment you get greeted by a nice, caring, real person who does their best to schedule a technician asap. When they give you a time and date you can be confident that you won't be kept waiting. They respect your time enough to let you know if they are ahead of or behind schedule. Every technician we have encountered have been really enjoyable to deal with. They are so personable and respectful of your property it feels like you've known them for years. They are very thorough when investigating the problem and talk you through things as they go. Once they know what the issue is they take a considerable amount of time explaining the problem, solution, options you have as well as any possible prevention there may be. You can tell that they know what they are doing and that they enjoy doing it.  This visit, Levi came out to do a routine servicing on our furnace, a/c and water heater. He does a phenomenal job.  He has been out to our place before and never disappoints. He is so helpful and genuinely cares. I love that he asks if there is anything else going on in the house that we might have concerns about. It is comforting to know that you can ask those odd ball questions about things and get their professional opinion without feeling like you're putting them out. They take their time so you aren't left feeling like you've been "left in the dark" and also make you aware of any upcoming issues. Very helpful when it comes to saving for future any replacements or high dollar issues.  JT Plumbing Heating & Air is the only way to go for professional, fast and affordable service! Many thanks to Levi and all of the staff at JT Plumbing Heating & Air!

reviews.author: Betty Walker
reviews.text:
What a great experience it was to have my
plumbing problems fixed efficiently, quickly
& by a person, Tray, who knew what to do!
Now, I have a new, water saving toilet that
replaced the one causing so many problems.  Tray, also, took care of the knocking sound in the pipes throughout
the whole house, & I am so happy with the
work that he did.
I would highly recommend JT Plumbing
Company to anyone needing repair work
with plumbing, heating or any of the other
services they provide, to anyone needing
work of this kind.  Their repair person was
polite, knowledgeable, prompt, efficient & he finished the work by cleaning up afterward, as well!
Thank you, again, for helping me with the plumbing problems I was having!
Sincerely,
Betty Walker, Fort Collins, CO

reviews.author: Brett S.
reviews.text: I was a little unsure with the lower ratings of previous years, but this was the company recommended by my home warranty company, so I gave them a call.  I can say that I am 100% satisfied with the service from JT Plumbing and Heating. Each technician has been professional, courteous and on time. They have kept me up to date on arrival times and follow up with appointment reminders. I had them replace a sump pump and they have some HVAC system inspections for me as well.  They explained what needed to be done and what they did clearly. Based upon my own experience, I can highly recommend.

reviews.author: chantelle Wilson
reviews.text: Excellent service from start to finish. The receptionist was so helpful and sweet. The two guys who came out were honest and fixed our issues for now. We have some roots in our lines and they immediately sent me quotes for the fixes that need to be done. Overall very happy with this company and we will be using them again as well as referring them out to all of my Real Estate clients and friends. Thank you all for providing such great service.

reviews.author: Brian Husby
reviews.text: Trey was my technician and was a great guy! He worked diligently to find solutions to our problem and was very thorough both in explaining the issues and solution options.  I appreciated his attention to detail in his work. As well, he walked me through the finished product, explaining each task and why he made the choices he did. I trust this company to treat me fairly, send proficient technicians, and stand by their work.

reviews.author: Gary Jones
reviews.text: Their tech did my simple job well, and did it the same day I called. There was a bit of attempted upsell, which I was quick to reject (I hate attempts to upsell). But this $300 job (one I could have done myself if I’d have sourced the simple valve they replaced) cost me over $425, which I found very pricey. Two stars off for the cost and attempts at upselling. Three for work done well the same day.

reviews.author: Gabe Hayes
reviews.text: Trey was on time and had several repair options for my wife and I to choose from. He went above and beyond to listen to my suggestions for routing the gas lines. Our water heater broke Saturday and they came first thing Monday morning to get us up and running again. We will be using JT’s services again in the future and recommend them to our family and friends. Thanks gang!

reviews.author: Lisa P.
reviews.text:
Please read their Google Reviews. They price gouge terribly and if you dont know better they can completely rip you off. 
Total disappointment. They tried to charge me over $700 for a flex hose for a gas stove. That is a 181% increase in standard retail. I denied their services. With and overall quote of over $900. Ridiculous amd a cheat.

reviews.author: Charles Boyer
reviews.text: Was quick to respond but pricey. Was able to negotiate a better price but historically plumbing almost always exposes additional problems that must be addressed and this was no exception. Leaking bathroom sink resulted in new sink new wall valves and the main house shutoff valve was defective.

synthesis.summary: Technicians like Brandon and Levi consistently impress, but a major sewer job turned into an 18-night displacement nightmare with improper slope and $21K charged before work began.
strengths: Fast dispatch is a recurring theme across multiple reviews — one reviewer noted 'one call and JT was at our home,' another said they arrived within hours of a carbon monoxide emergency call
Technicians consistently explain work clearly and educate homeowners — Brandon, Levi, and Trey are each named multiple times across reviews for communication and thoroughness
Multiple reviewers mention cleanup after work and respect for the home, with one specifically noting the tech 'finished the work by cleaning up afterward'
weaknesses: Pricing runs higher than expected — one reviewer paid $425 for a job they estimated at $300 and noted upsell attempts; another called them 'pricey' even after negotiating down
Scheduling reliability has cracks — one reviewer reported two same-week cancellations after taking 8 hours of PTO, with late notice both times
redFlags: One detailed 1-star review describes a $21,780 large-scale job gone severely wrong: full payment withdrawn over a month before work started, 18-night home displacement with only 8 nights covered, improperly sloped sewer line confirmed by a third-party plumber requiring re-excavation, and pressure tactics cited at the sales stage — this is a single review but the specificity and dollar amount warrant serious caution for large projects
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews signal genuine emergency responsiveness — they arrived within hours of a carbon monoxide furnace emergency, responded the same day on an urgent call, and one reviewer noted immediate action upon arrival, suggesting real after-hours or rapid-dispatch capability.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.8 stars across 346 reviews while Yelp sits at 2.6 across only 5 reviews — the Yelp sample is too small to be statistically meaningful, but the gap is sharp enough to watch.

reviews.author: Carrie L
reviews.text:
RJ Plumbing and Heating is a great local company, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. Bri promptly answered my calls and was incredibly patient and informative when I had questions, which made the whole process feel easy and transparent. Ray was extremely personable. He clearly takes pride in his work and made me feel confident everything was in good hands.

They went out of their way to accommodate my very tight schedule, which I truly appreciated. On top of that, their pricing was very competitive, especially considering the high level of service they provided. It’s refreshing to work with a local company that genuinely cares about their customers. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, professional service.

reviews.author: Kristy Diehl
reviews.text: Bri & Ray are amazing! Thank you for the quick response and service. I would highly recommend this plumbing company to anyone needing help. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Wendie Vandenbeusque
reviews.text: Ray came over and replaced our kitchen sink and garbage disposal.  He was running late, as most repair and service people do, and we got a heads up which was really appreciated.  Ray got there, got the job done and I couldn't be happier.  Great service and a really fair price.

reviews.author: Brian Williams
reviews.text: Both my wife and I called and left messages 4 days ago and never heard back from anyone. We will try another company in town

reviews.author: Jessica Jackson
reviews.text: Charged me $300 to not fix my shower and leave it a mess. My shower diverter was not working. Ray from R&J took it apart, tried numerous ways to fix it, then left my shower a mess of plastic shavings and my diverter in pieces. I even called them for a follow up about installing a new shower and the ghosted me. Eventually, a different plumber came in and fixed in in 15 minutes. The new plumber was shocked that R&J left our shower in this condition and charged us that much.

reviews.author: austin crosby
reviews.text:
First off; if you're having a water emergency, stop reading and CALL RAY!

Now that we've gotten that out of the way, R&J are the best. They've done everything over at our house, from repairing old drain nonsense, to installing all new high-end fixtures and appliances.

They're super professional, dilligent, and respectful. Ray is the kind of dude you can trust inside of your home, even unsupervised. This is a young family-owned and operated business, with very noticeable attention to detail and a wide knowledge base.

I could go on praising them for ages, but the most important thing is that they will do well by you, and you'll feel good having hired them to get your house (or commercial property) plumbed up right.

R&J installed our tankless hot water heater, tub and rainfall shower head, smart toilet/bidet, not-smart but still unique toilet, several sinks, a smart faucet, garbage disposal, and probably much more down the line. Needless to say, whatever you've got, they can handle.

Thanks Ray and Jaime!

reviews.author: Emily Seems
reviews.text: Great work for a good and honest price! What a joy to have Ray and the team in our home working on our kitchen remodel. He needed to move both the water and sewer lines; and then in the middle of the project our water heater was spewing out rust so he worked in replacing that! Ray explained everything, gave us options, and answered all of our questions. His work was solid. And best of all, he was fun to have in our home - a good sense of humor, kind to our kids and animals. He followed all safety protocol and COVID public health guidelines. I would 100% recommend him and have already asked for his help on our next project.

reviews.author: Phillip Adams
reviews.text:
My wife and I have been slowly updating and upgrading our old 1969 house and one of the latest projects was getting a new water heater. We had gotten quotes from a few plumbers with some quoting as high as 10,000 dollars for tank water heaters.

By dumb chance, I reached out to R&J, and saw what he could do. From the very beginning, he was professional and worked with us--we are typically a bit far from his typical area. He fulfilled every request we had and genuinely felt taken care of. During the installation, he was knowledgeable and very kind. All of this and his price beat every other quote we got.

reviews.author: Kimberly Manser
reviews.text: I used this plumbing company on a recommendation from my HVAC company. When I called,  I was surprised how quickly I was able to get an appointment. Ray arrived on time, was friendly, professional and provided some advice on some additional repairs I would like done. The price was very reasonable and the work done in the timeframe discussed with me. I also appreciated that he arrived wearing a mask. I felt very comfortable having him in my home. I would definitely recommend Ray and his company! I’ll be using him again in the future!

reviews.author: Andrew Stoddard
reviews.text: Ray changed out our old water heaters. He promptly came and gave us an estimate. We appreciated his taking the time to explain exactly what the job would entail. He was courteous, efficient and gave us an excellent price for the job. He was even willing to fix an outdoor faucet while he was here which had been giving us a problem for some years. Overall we were very satisfied with Ray as a pleasant professional and would recommend him for any plumbing needs. We are sure we will be using him again if the need arises.

reviews.author: Steffanie Bilyeu
reviews.text: We've used R&J plumbing for several repairs and replacements and love everything about them.  Not only are they polite, prompt and courteous but Ray has extensive knowledge about all things plumbing and has saved us from costly repairs and provided good tips for home maintenance. We've used R&J to install a dishwasher, fix our upstairs shower and repair leaks from old, faulty pipes both inside and outside the house.  We have yet to find anything negative to say about them.

reviews.author: Joseph Landry
reviews.text: Wow! Just wow! I can't begin to tell you how pleased I am! From the first phone call to the job getting done was the best experience a home owner could ask for. Polite, personable, on time, and honest! Even with me staring over his shoulder... Lol... Drywall cut, repair made, drywall replaced new water heater installed... Under two hours. A local small business I will recommend over and over again. Thank you!

reviews.author: Sinjun1717 M.
reviews.text: It doesn't get better then this! Ray is great! He explains everything he's going to do, answers all your questions and does a top notch job. I trust his opinion 100% when it comes to plumbing and I know he's not going to try and sell me something I don't need (like other companies). He's going to tell me the truth and give me a fair price. What more can you ask for. I will be a customer for life!

reviews.author: ghostinsnow
reviews.text: Ray is the man! Installed and did plumbing for my tub and shower. He helped me with pre-install advice on good tubs and trim to purchase. He did a great job with the install and even worked on a Saturday for my tile guys schedule. Post install he continued to help me out and answer questions I had. Will def hit Ray up for my next plumbing projects thanks for yo services!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Jill Mulnix
reviews.text: Today was the third time we have used them & Ray was outstanding! Solved multiple problems & even found an issue with our furnace that we didn’t know about. His professionalism, knowledge, expertise, & honesty always impresses us, but today he went above & beyond. Saved us probably $5-6k & a dangerous situation was avoided. I will always recommend R&J!

synthesis.summary: Ray and his team respond within minutes on weekends and Sundays, finish complex jobs like full water heater installs with drywall repair in under two hours, and consistently charge fair prices — the one unanswered callback is the only blemish across 45 reviews.
strengths: Exceptional speed on complex jobs: one reviewer documents drywall cut, repair made, drywall replaced, and water heater installed all in under two hours
Rapid emergency callback even on weekends: one reviewer reports Ray called back within 5 minutes on a Sunday and had a backhoe and locates lined up by Monday morning for a mainline break
Fair, transparent pricing cited across multiple reviews spanning 2020–2026, with no reports of surprise charges or quotes being exceeded
weaknesses: One reviewer reports leaving two voicemails over four days with zero callback, suggesting occasional gaps in phone coverage that could be critical during a late-night emergency
redFlags: The single 1-star review describes a complete communication failure — no return call after 4 days and two attempts — which is a meaningful data point for emergency use, even if isolated among 45 reviews
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: Ray called a Sunday homeowner back in 5 minutes and mobilized excavation equipment by Monday morning for a burst mainline; a separate reviewer was fit in last minute same-day; no explicit 2am or after-hours service is confirmed, but the Sunday responsiveness pattern is encouraging.
