reviews.author: Julia Kirby
reviews.text: Jerry Hearn provided the best service and experience.  Very helpful, knowledgeable, and was very diligent in his investigating of the issue. He found and fixed the repair quickly. We highly recommend Lion Home Services and Jerry is your guy. Thank you

reviews.author: Lizet Vasquez
reviews.text: I recently had maintenance work done at my home that involved plumbing (Jerry), electrical(Kyle), and HVAC(Jeff) services, and I couldn't be more impressed. Each technician was highly skilled and professional, addressing the issues efficiently and effectively. They arrived on time, were respectful of my property, and clearly communicated the work they were performing. The quality of their work was outstanding, and I've noticed a significant improvement in my home's systems. I highly recommend their services to anyone in need of reliable and expert home maintenance.

reviews.author: Kelsey
reviews.text:
Dagan and Maddix from Lion Home Service did an amazing job cleaning our ducts! From start to finish, they were professional, friendly, and extremely thorough. They took the time to explain the entire duct cleaning process, including inspecting the system, cleaning all supply and return vents, using powerful vacuum equipment to remove built-up dust and debris, and brushing out the ductwork to make sure everything was completely cleared.
They were very respectful of our home, carefully protecting floors and surrounding areas while they worked, and they left everything spotless when they were finished. You can really tell they take pride in what they do.
We’ve already noticed a difference and feel much better knowing our system is clean. Highly recommend Lion Home Service and especially Dagan and Maddix for anyone needing professional duct cleaning!

reviews.author: jim nelson
reviews.text: I had asked your office to send your your man out with a tall ladder cause I have a 11 foot six ceiling and I need a couple lights, new bulbs and Bella and them which I had which I told your office and he should have a no ladder at all and I had a 10 foot and a 7 foot he picked up the 7 foot complained about it all the time and I told her he would not use the 10 foot because he said he he can’t so he couldn’t reach the ceiling. He said he couldn’t work on it. He said he had to have new fixtures because these are older than used. They’re not older than you. They’re very, very new but way newer than my home said he couldn’t use the bulb even though they’re still in the cage never been used never out of a brand new cage he couldn’t use the ballast because they were still in the box. He didn’t buy them and he couldn’t give up on the ladder cause he didn’t have enough ladder and everything. He said he couldn’t do. It was not a thing that he said he could do so I sent him home. I had an employee like that. It would never put a day in. I was a commercial general contractor with the highest license you can get for 31 years built some major project around Colorado had a lot of good years 31 years of a good solid contracting business. I had it up to 125 employees if I had one show up like that it would not must be a single day. I hope you enjoy supporting him because he has not announced that to your company.

reviews.author: Steve T.
reviews.text: I realize it's New Year's Eve, but I guess "24/7" doesn't apply. Called in this morning as our refrigerator circuit tripped and would not stay on. They said their dispatcher would get back to me. After over 2 hours they called and said they would be out. Then I get a text saying they don't work on "appliances". I said it's NOT the appliance, it's the circuit breaker. Then they said they don't have an electrician available. I quote from Weld County Homeowner referral booklet: "We specialize in prompt service, quality fixes, and reliable response that you can trust." DON'T TRUST THEM!

reviews.author: Allie S.
reviews.text: Oh. My. God. I have never dealt with a more unprofessional business in my life! I called them, wanting Benjamin Franklin, and learned they'd been bought by Lion. I should have called someone else, but I've worked with Benjamin Franklin in the past and they've been wonderful. NOPE! We had them out in January to replace a broken water heater. I have no knowledge of this business, what prices are correct, correct plumbing techniques, and they took advantage of that. I tried to do my due diligence but we needed hot water and I was desperate. The first guy gave me a quote for $3500 for a new water heater and expansion tank, new plumbing, warranty, and prime membership (still not clear on what that includes). I was hesitant on the price but was pushed to buy the warranty and "membership" and for the price I'm paying I'm "going to be taken care of"...... I should have done more research and it's my fault for being taken advantage of, but anyways, I bought everything for $3500. The next day, two guys came over to install the water heater. I had been told by the first guy that the old copper pipes would be replaced and rearranged. The installers said the pipes didn't need to be replaced and they didn't touch them. Again, I'm dumb. And again, was taken advantage of. So, they just installed the new water heater and hung up the expansion tank. Alright so, a couple months go by and a master plumber is in our house working on a bathroom remodel. He sees the water heater and asks what moron installed this? He begins to point out ALL the problems. The water heater was not level, the water valve needed to be replaced, some of the copper pipes were resting on other pipes, they were also holding up way too much weight, creating stresses, the expansion tank was installed at an angle, it was also supported by a metal strap and touched the copper pipes. He asked what I paid, I told him, thought he was going to have an aneurysm, and he told me to call them back and make someone come out and install it properly. Thank God for him! So I called and had them come out a week later.... They sent an apprentice drain specialist. The poor guy should have come in, seen all the problems and said he wasn't right for the job and get someone else out here. We would have appreciated that SO much more than what he actually did. We told him all the problems, with our new master plumber friend there to help explain, and this guy just shrugged, eehhh, this is fine....he proceeded to spend 7 HOURS at our house and the ONLY thing he did was put a new valve on. VERY POORLY might I add. The longer he spent at our house the more he got frustrated because we were telling him what to do and he WASN'T LISTENING! So we didn't sign his service complete form and he STORMED out of the house and HIT MY HUSBAND WITH OUR DOOR TRYING TO SLAM IT SHUT WHICH I SHOULD PRESS CHARGES FOR!! His name is Ben Clayton by the way. We then immediately called Lion because he didn't turn our water back on or our water heater so we wanted someone to come out and make sure the valve was installed properly, there wasn't anything broken. Ben apparently had told his supervisor that he didn't feel safe in our house because we were yelling at him? Sorry sir, no we were trying to get you to listen and install it properly to which you said, oh I can't reach that, that's gonna be tough, and I don't have enough copper pipes to replace all that (which meant, no I'm not going out to buy pipes....which should have been replaced the first time someone installed this). SO the dispatch told us that they weren't going to send him back out because they didn't feel it was safe. Which we said, that's fine, we were treated horribly by this man we would love someone else to come out. THEN in the background of the phone call we heard someone say "hell no, were not sending anyone out there" to which my husband admittedly lost it and started yelling at them telling them how unprofessional they are. So I had to take over and calm everyone down so someone could just come out to look at our plumbing to make sure it was ok. So they agreed to send someone over and when he arrived he too was blown away by the terrible installation job that had been previously done. He also agreed that Ben should have stepped out and had someone else come in. ALSO he said that new valve should have been replaced with what I bought in the first place. He also agreed that for the money I paid, it looked terrible! He made an appointment for us with someone he trusted who was actually a licensed plumber, not an apprentice, with Lion and he came out the next week and made it look beautiful. He did everything that should have been done in the first place and also installed a new water shut off valve. He was in and out in 2 hours. Anyways, I was ripped off, taken advantage of, and treated horribly. With everything they did I could take them to a small claims court and win, but I don't want to deal with this company EVER AGAIN!!

reviews.author: Andrew V.
reviews.text:
In July 2019 I lost power to a section of my house. Lion Home Service was contacted. A technician arrived and began his inspection. A full house rewire would be needed. He prepared a quote and told us about some of the other services they offered; we agreed to install both a whole house fan and a fan in the bathroom and to sign up for their 1 year TCC.
The work took two weeks to complete. Our team was 2 people. They worked inconsistent hours. The only time there were any other technicians present was midway through the second week for around an hour or so. At the end of the second week they "finished" the work, but not everything we had asked for. They offered to install two outside outlets for us, and to cut a channel into a wall to house wiring for the TV. We asked that they not do these things. We discovered that they pulled the wiring to the garage but did not replace it. We asked that they simply leave because we were exhausted and just wanted our house back.
I thought the service, at the time, was satisfactory. On December 19th, 2019 I arrived home to find an orange tag on my front door from the city. It read "NO PERMIT FOR ELECTRIC WORK! Took pictures - tampering with City property. Police Report will be filed. No permit for electric work performed."
I contacted the city: no permit had ever been filed. The new breaker box was pulling more power than the meter could safely handle. The new line drop was illegal and can only be installed with city personnel present. Opening the meter housing was illegal without city personnel present. None of these things were done correctly by Lion Home Service.
The city felt the current situation was unsafe and were it not the middle of winter they would have requested we cut power to the house until the work was completed. This was the first time I heard a city employee use the phrase "You're lucky your house hasn't burned down".
The permit was pulled in late January and allowed to lapse. The paperwork would only be finalized by the city the first week of February. 
The day of the city inspection the line foreman, the safety inspector, and a building inspector for the city arrived at 10:30. The inspection uncovered several problems: The breaker box was installed upside down, the line in from the meter into my house was open and uncovered, an outlet in the kitchen had not been replaced, the wiring to the garbage disposal was not anchored correctly, an outlet in the living room was running directly off the ground and was deemed unsafe (again I heard the phrase "You're lucky your house hasn't burned down"), the wiring through the linen closet was not installed correctly (again, "you're lucky your house hasn't burned down"), the wiring in the attic had not been anchored properly and was just hanging loose, the wiring in the crawl space was not anchored properly and was just hanging loosely, the clothes dryer vent was not attached and was just blowing hot, wet lint directly onto the furnace ("you're lucky your house hasn't burned down"), and the wiring to the garage had been pulled but not replaced.
Lion Home Service did not arrive until 11:00. The technician's attitudes were glib; they seemed to not take this seriously. They told me they would get the permit pulled right away and that the work would be fixed "very soon".
Speaking with Lion Home Service is an exercise in frustration. I rarely get to speak with the same person more than once, and no one ever seems to know what exactly is going on. Some employees seem to take things seriously, the rest are just rude and difficult to speak with. I have been made to feel like I am the offending party for simply wanting the work to be done and done right. No one at Lion Home Service seems to care about making this right.
I am so tired. I am so tired of dealing with this. I just want it to be done, and I never want to hear the name Lion Home Service again.

reviews.author: Justin F.
reviews.text:
PLEASE BEWARE - I wish I would've taken the time to check reviews of this company first, but when you're in a situation of not having a working toilet, and they are on-site already, you tend to have to take their word. I hope this helps others steer clear of this company. Look at all the reviews (BBB, Yelp, etc.) and they are all very similar to my experience; overpriced, lazy work, etc.  I am a small business owner as well and made an attempt to call the office and ask for a manager to call me, to give them a chance to explain and/or correct, but still have not received a call a week and a half later. I will be very fair and factual in the details and let you decide if it's the kind of company you want to do business with and happy to update the review if I am contacted by the company for a resolution.

Service Date: 3/9/21  Issue: Toilet clogged/not flushing
Summary: We had a bathroom with a toilet that wasn't flushing. 

Company came and attempted to pull toilet and plunge = $29 dispatch fee + $276 for the attempt. No resolution.

Next - tried to snake/cable down the pipe = $398. No resolution.

Next - used camera and found spot outside where pipe was blocked and was going to require digging up the pipe to determine blockage. This is where things get very expensive. They charged $4,979 do dig this one spot up. It was an all dirt area, no more than 3 feet deep, and a basic PVC pipe (septic system). In full transparency, they did quote me the amount prior to me agreeing to proceed, but as I mentioned above, when they have the people and equipment there already and it's an urgent situation, it's hard to send them home for time to get other quotes. I agreed to move forward at this point. Still not a full resolution.

Next - After digging up this one spot they determined there was an additional 5 feet of pipe that was crushed. Unsure when this happened, but would require fixing as well. They quoted an additional $2,768 to repair. Again, an extremely basic dig of less than 3 feet deep, basic PVC pipe, and all dirt with no landscaping, building, concrete, etc. to dig around. After already spending over $5,000 to get to this point, and it already partially dug, I decided to let them continue to just get it done. This finally resolved our issue.

The next day I contacted three other long-time reputable companies in the area and asked for a quote of this exact dig/repair. The lowest was $3,000 and the highest was $3,800. All FAR below the nearly $8,000 I paid for just an afternoon of work!! I was blown away at how much I was ripped off. Never being through this type of work before, and in the situation we were in without a working bathroom, I didn't even know a general range of these services; I wish I would've.

After getting these other quotes I did ask for a manager to call me to review the charges and ensure they were correct and accurate, but have not received a call yet (week and a half later). I know they are going to point to the fact that they quote and get acceptance of charges prior to doing work, which is correct, but evaluating other quotes it's hard to believe they are truly 2X the price of their competition and I still think there had to be an error. I'm all for paying small premiums for better work, but no one should be paying prices like this for such basic services.

I'm attaching pictures of the area to show that it was in fact a very short run of pipe, very very basic digging in a dirt area, and even very lazy and sloppy on the backfill/smoothing out to get it back to normal.

reviews.author: Gary A.
reviews.text:
if you want to be PRICE GOUGED, CALL LION HOME SERVICE!!!  I regret not reading previously posted reviews of this company. Consequently, I have paid a heavy price for it.  I shall summarize my encounter with this company as follows: On October 21, 2021 the company's repair representative,  Anthony arrived to fix my non functioning furnace.  After spending less than 40 minutes in my home of which almost half included an unsolicited and unwanted sales pitch for a maintenance service contract, Anthony presented me with a bill.  This bill was on his hand held computer device, totaling $711.00. I paid the bill in full by personal check. This bill was included  $29.00 and $99.00 representing a dispatch fee and a diagnosis fee (which paid for up to 1 hour of service), respectively,  and $583.00 for a Dual Pressure switch (Honeywell HK06NB020). 

 Later in the day, the small size of pressure switch raised questions in my mind as to its cost.  It was half the size of an automobile generator. So I got its part number and priced it on the internet. I retrieved quotes from the first four vendors:  $53.95, $53.82, $57.85 and $54.74 From Ebay, Supply House, Amazon, and Technical Hot and Cold Parts, respectively.  Thus, it turned out that Anthony charged me 10 times the highest price available from these common sources.  One definition of price gouging is when a seller asks excessively more than other vendors. This is how I arrived at the conclusion of being gouged by Lion Home Service..

I called Lion Home Service on Monday 10/25/21 and asked to talk to the owner in an attempt to resolve this gouging issue. I spoke to Alexander who informed me that the owner was not in and requested that I convey my complaint through him.  I did so and requested and was told that a return call will be forth coming in a day or so.  I have not received any return calls by to date 10/29/21.

To those who are interested, the Covid motivated updated new Colorado Consumer Protection Act states that it is a violation to "either knowingly or recklessly engage in any unfair, unconscionable, deceptive, deliberately misleading, false or fraudulent act or practices". This law has raised the penalty from $2,000 to $20,000 per violation to $10,000 to $50,000 per violation if committed against an elderly person.  Reporting abuses to the Attorney General's office can be done through stopfraudcolorado.gov website. Also, Colorado Bill HB20-1414 deals with price gouging amid disaster.  It prohibits sellers to charge excessive prices during an emergency.  One could file a complaint via "https://coag.gov/file-complaint".

reviews.author: Corissa O.
reviews.text:
THE ONLY way to be seen/listened to by the owner is to leave online REVIEWS!!!
That is, if it's actually the owner. It must be a bot because all I see are generic cut and paste responses. There is NO SUCH THING as a 100% client satisfaction guarantee so please program the bot to omit this response.
If this was the case, why are there negative reviews?
If you feel like you provide 100% satisfaction, then you feel no need for growth and learning.
Where do these numbers even come from, did you make them up? Do you only search for positive things people say and avoid all criticism?

Our family is at a loss financially; the quality of services did not reflect the value of what this company provided. we paid TENS of THOUSANDS of dollars, UP FRONT, was sold the whole bells and whistles, only to be treated this way (by the company overall)

Since May, we hired Lion Service for a large variety of repairs and maintenance needed. It was very strange... after the crew did work on our home, despite many other things needed, we were GHOSTED.

However, for some reason we have still been waiting around for months and months to finish the jobs, which there has been no solid timeline, people have not shown up when they were supposed to...What is the hold up? Seriously. I'm done being patient, this is not just about the money but the way I feel, which is disrespected.

5 MONTHS of me trying to get ahold of someone, a manager, a higher up.... I can't tell you how many distressed phone calls I have made to your business.

There has been no follow up from the "project manager", it's like the crew came out for 2 days then ghosted us, taking their $$$$$

The communication was horrible or non-existent. I was promised many times that someone from the company would call me back after expressing my concerns, but the only ones who ever did were James and Joe the electricians. THEY showed up when they were supposed to and were of more help to me than any actual "manager"

I initially gave a 5 star review but most if not all of my previous statements didn't reflect the reality. I am giving this review 2 stars instead of 1 because, despite everything, there have been several individuals who did an outstanding job and were true professionals.

I suggest removing the tag line of 100% satisfaction, start paying really close attention to reality and overhaul your entire marketing strategy.

Advice: STEER CLEAR.

reviews.author: Nancy O.
reviews.text:
We will not now, or ever again, use their services.  On Monday, January 7, Jacob Smyth came to our house to investigate the cause of a water leak in our basement. 

 He informed us that we had issues with our sewer line and convinced us that there was major work that needed to be done to remedy the issues.  We put $14,000 on a credit card to pay for half of the work. 

The next day, we contacted the city of Longmont.  In October, they had videotaped our sewer line, tap, and saddle.  They saw no, I repeat, no issues with it.  We then hired two independent sewer line companies to inspect our building drain and the sewer line. 

 Neither company saw any issues with the system.  I repeat, no issues.  We personally watched the cameras as they inspected the line.  We ran water through the line, assured that the camera was at the correct location to view the tap and the saddle and there were NO issues. We have written reports stating that there are no issues.

Jacob had not even marked the spot correctly where the tap is and had the depth wrong as well.  He told us that the city would not take care of any issues with the tap.  That is false.  I have spoken to the city numerous times since the 7th.

Jacob sent us an invoice totaling $35,000 dollars to repair something that has no need of repair.  This is fraudulent practice and quite frankly, unconscionable.  We trusted him, even fed him some dinner, only to find out that we were being totally scammed.

On January 8, I texted him to do nothing until he heard from me, but on January 9th, he went to the city to pull a permit for a sewer line.  I have contacted the city and have withdrawn that permit and any others he may have pulled.  I understand that he paid $274.75 for this.  I also know that he can get a refund for that amount.

 We  had a reputable plumber come and he fixed the source of the leak, which was simply a pipe that was behind the cabinet that had become defective.  

We were also told that the interior pipe that ran from the sink was not at a proper slope.  That is false, as well. Lies, lies, and more lies.  

We had trusted this company before this attempted scam.  That, of course, is no longer the case, and we will never, ever use this company again.  Now, we will never know what other scams were perpetrated on us.

reviews.author: Linda T.
reviews.text:
I was pretty disappointed today after Lion's technicians  left. The technicians were friendly enough and seemed knowledgeable, but the woman who booked the appt.  over the phone said she would honor a $99 online coupon if I just told the technicians when they showed up about it. When the technician showed up, they mentioned it would be $168 to clean out the drain pipe and to get my stopper working again. They also added in this extra biodegradable drain cleaner... Which turned out to be $78 for a total cost of $233. I was given the five dollar discount for being a senior citizen. I felt like the cost was kind of high for what I was getting...and I was annoyed that I had chosen their company based on that coupon and then the coupon wasn't honored! The technician explained to me that the $99 coupon applied to cleaning out the mainline which involve taking off the toilet, and that they would speak to the phone person about that. That did not really make sense to me...because to me, taking off a toilet instead of just taking off a sink drain seems like a lot more work!

To add insult to injury, they showed me my pop-up stopper system set-up that had corroded clean through  using liquid plumber. Not a problem, they could replace it... For another $540! Say what?! I asked them to hold off for a minute while I looked up the part on Google , Amazon had several that were under $25. Needless to say I did not have this done and will be hiring a handyman to put in this part Lyons was able to put the part back, broken, in order to keep it from leaking while I look for, a cheaper pop-up system, maybe at Home Depot. I felt so disappointed and hurt that the coupon had not been honored, and that the cost would be astronomical just to replace this part.

The 2 technicians worked on my bathroom sink a total of 35 minutes they spent cleaning out my drain. That said, the money gouging was what really torqued me, but the technicians seem knowledgeable and friendly overall. Still, I am an academic and have two masters degrees... And I only charge $85 an hour for my services.

reviews.author: Susan M.
reviews.text:
We purchased a state of the art furnace, air conditioner, full house humidifier, and duct sealing from Lion Home Service the last quarter of 2020.  This review is really about the duct sealing. 

First, some background. The other items were installed before thanksgiving 2020, but not without time delays. The people who did the install were wonderful but there were issues with the humidifier. It took a year and repeated visits by electricians before Lion's supplier in Denver finally agreed to send a different part as everything they suggested to Lion didn't work. The new part worked beautifully. Lion can't be blamed for a lousy part.  We have had no problems since with any of the work Lion did on those three items. We find Lion's inspectors and electricians to be knowledgeable and professional.  

Now, for the duct work. The machine used to seal and test the duct work broke down toward the end of the job (2020). The young men who did the work said they were 90% done. They said they'd be back in a couple of weeks after the machine was fixed. Supply chain issues got in the way of that timeline. We weren't upset about that as Covid was causing delays everywhere on everything. 

I would call and leave messages. I was given assurances the message would get back to the duct work team. When the semiannual inspections were done I would ask about the duct work and, again, I was told the information would be passed on to the appropriate people. Months stretched into over two years. Finally, a few days ago I set aside a 4 hour block of time for them to come finish the job. It was a no show. I got a call afterwards and another 4 hour time block was set aside for today. Again, NO SHOW. 

Lion should do two things: first, don't sell a product you can't complete; second, reimburse us $500. That is the %10 of the amount we paid to have the duct work sealed. More than two years for an unfinished job is too long.

reviews.author: Nick J.
reviews.text:
I wish I could give negative stars, this company is awful.  

I had a guy come out and do a quote on a tankless water heater.  A couple of hours later I received two quotes, which was a nice turnaround time.  I have quotes from 5 other local companies, and Lion Home Service was nearly double the price of all the others.  

Some of the nonsense in the quote:  

A 240V outlet - no idea why, it's a gas water heater
A 6 year warranty on the heat exchanger and other parts, even though the product comes with a 15 year heat exchanger warranty and 5 years on other parts.  And what did they want for installing this Navien NPE-240A2 water heater, which goes for less than $2000?  The low, low price of $9100!!

If I wanted to push the warranty to 8 years, it drove the total price to almost $12,000!!!!! For a water heater that costs less than $2000!!!

I sent them an email telling them how awful their prices were, and that they appeared to be trying to selling me things I didn't need - like a 240V outlet and a warranty that was worse than the manufacturer's warranty.  

Their operations manager, Karen, called me.  To summarize the conversation - she said I was getting really nice discounts (they give a % off if you buy into their Total Care Club, which was added to the quote without any mention of it from the sales guy), to which I said of course I am, your prices are so high that a % discount will look like a lot, but it's still a rip off.  She said, these are their prices and they have many happy customers.  

I would guess this company's reputation will catch up to them, but I'm sure they'll grift every mark they can until that day.  I now tell this story whenever home improvements come up in conversation, and I notified all of my neighbors and family not to bother with Lion.

reviews.author: Loretta S.
reviews.text:
I would give them 0 stars if i could.......I called on Sunday Sept 6th to set up an appointment because we was having a cold front coming in temps dropping from 99 degrees down to 34 degrees by Tues night. We had no power to our thermostat and had just replaced the control panel to the furnace. They agreed that they could send someone out but not until Tues morning from 8-11. Perfect I will take it. Come Tues they call me around 10ish and tell me that they are running behind and that it would be more around 12-2. I was a little frustrated but understood. well 2:30 comes and goes and I call them to see where they are at and was informed that my tech was picking up his tools from his last job and will be on his way. I waited until 4:30 and called them back and they transferred me over to dispatch, which I was informed that it was getting close to after hours and they was going to have to reschedule. I was livid, told them that since i had an appointment from 8-11 then I was expecting them to show up. Dispatch informed me that it was going into after hours and that they would be there around 630-8 pm.  I told them fine. I have elderly in my home and needed to make sure that they were taking care of. 
in the mean time I had another company call and follow up with me to make sure that I had gotten someone out here to look at my furnace and told them that I was still waiting and had an appointment this morning. So I asked Mariano how soon he could be out to my house and he told me that he would call is partner and find out and then call me back. He did just that and I had someone at my door in 15 minutes(5 pm) I then called Lion Home services back and cancelled them to come out. I am glad that I had this second company come. I feel that they value customers over profit.

synthesis.summary: Technicians are generally skilled and personable, but Lion Home Service has a documented pattern of quoting jobs at 2-4x competitor prices and pressuring vulnerable homeowners into upsells — one reviewer was quoted $10,833 for a job completed elsewhere for $3,800.
strengths: Multiple reviews across different service types (plumbing, HVAC, electrical) praise named technicians for professionalism, punctuality, and clear explanations — suggesting consistent field-level training
At least 3 reviewers mention technicians arrived on time and communicated arrival windows proactively
One reviewer notes the company acknowledged a mistake and followed up to make it right, suggesting some accountability at the management level
weaknesses: Pricing is the single most consistent complaint: at least 8 reviews cite charges running 2-4x competitor quotes, including a $583 charge for a part retailing at $54, a $7,100 sewer quote vs. a $2,500 competitor quote, and a $350 toilet-pull fee
Reliability on scheduled appointments is shaky: at least 3 reviews describe no-shows or multi-hour delays with zero proactive communication from the company
redFlags: At least 3 reviews describe a bait-and-switch on pricing — a low dispatch fee quoted by phone ($29-$99) replaced by a much higher on-site fee ($168-$200) before any work begins

One review alleges Lion performed a sewer line replacement that was not actually necessary, then refused to complete insurance paperwork after being paid — BBB shows 22 complaints in 3 years, which aligns with this pattern
A reviewer reports Lion held $10,833 on a credit card for a job they never performed and refused to refund for over a week, requiring a credit card dispute to resolve
Multiple reviews specifically call out high-pressure upsell tactics targeting elderly or vulnerable homeowners during emergency situations
synthesis.emergencyNotes: One review references a 24/7 claim from a county referral booklet, but an actual New Year's Eve caller was told no electrician was available — treat their after-hours availability as unverified and call ahead to confirm before depending on them for a 2am burst pipe.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.7 stars across 6,008 reviews while Yelp shows 2.0 stars across 100 reviews — a 2.7-star gap that strongly suggests the Yelp audience skews toward customers motivated to report billing disputes and service failures that Google's volume may be diluting.

plumbers.name: AAA Service Plumbing, Heating & Electric
plumbers.address: 825 SW Frontage Rd #1B, Fort Collins, CO 80524, USA

reviews.author: Alexei K
reviews.text:
I contacted AAA for a water heater replacement quote and had an excellent experience from start to finish. Islom was very professional, straightforward, and a true straight shooter, which I really appreciated. He explained everything clearly, answered all my questions, and was even willing to price match.

Although I ultimately chose a different company for the replacement, that decision came down to specific circumstances—not the quality of service I received from AAA. They were responsive, transparent, and easy to work with throughout the process.

I wouldn’t hesitate to reach out to them again in the future and highly recommend them to anyone looking for honest and professional service.

reviews.author: Kristin Macintyre
reviews.text: Jeremiah G was amazing! He explained everything thoroughly and was super efficient. I will be asking for him by name if we have any future plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Brandi Fresquez
reviews.text:
Jeremiah G was polite when he arrived introduced himself.  Answered all my questions before we got started.
I would recommend Jeremiah to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Stacey Specht
reviews.text: Rating has nothing to do with service or the repair but, the price.  AAA is really expensive. I won't use them again.

reviews.author: Andrew Royval
reviews.text: My mom called them to look at a leaking spigot on her trailer.  They said they would be there between 10 and 2, of course they didn't show up until after 2. Then proceeded to try and rip my mom off by charging $1000 to do the job.  Because he had to climb under the trailer, and sauder..... blah blah.  So glad she called me before she went for it. I told her NO, way to much!! Called my guy and he is getting it done for  a tenth of the price!! Don't trust them, read the reviews. Price gouging like no other!!

reviews.author: David Riddle
reviews.text: I am super excited! After having a couple recurring issues with my air-conditioning unit, Anthony came out and got right to the problem. It took him a very small amount of time to figure out what was wrong with it and he said about to fixing it in a way that was incredibly thorough. He explained everything that needed to be done in a way that I could understand, he communicated with me every step of the way. He was by far the Best technician we’ve had out for our AC unit Since the unit was installed two years ago. If I could recommend individual technicians, I would recommend Anthony.

reviews.author: Lorraine Woodward
reviews.text: Jeremiah G & Sam B were, very professional but also very friendly explaining exactly what they were going to do and what it would cost.  After they had completed the work they explained what exactly had happened to my clogged toilet.  My appointment was scheduled for noon and the company and Jeremiah and Sam kept me up to date on their ETA often.  I really appreciated that!  All in all I had a wonderful experience with AAA and will definitely call them again if I encounter a problem.  Thank you so much for your fast courteous service!

reviews.author: Janice Wheeler
reviews.text: Jacob was extremely efficient in helping us find and repair an issue with our electrical box. He was respectful, thorough, knowledgeable, and quick. He knew a lot about our system and what to look for in moving forward. He made sure that his report contained valuable information that we had discovered and discussed. Thanks, Jacob!

reviews.author: Elida Gonzalez
reviews.text: Islom was awesome! He was kind and respectful. He explained what the issue was, how he would fix it, how long it would take and the estimate for the work. He was done in a little less than 2 hours on a Sunday and I couldn’t be more satisfied with him and AAA services. Thank you!

reviews.author: Mark A. Tichenor
reviews.text: Drain clogged. Water everywhere. Ayden arrived within 2 hours of my first call to AAA.  Very professional, very courteous, very respectful of our property. He cleaned up the mess and gave tips on how to avoid similar issues in the future. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Dennis McCrary
reviews.text: John Johnson did an outstanding job of replacing my water heater and the valves for my new washing machine. The new plumbing on the new water heater looks great. Have already talked to John about replacing water faucets in the bathrooms at a later time.

reviews.author: Tina Kivalu
reviews.text: I had the greatest experience with AAA service. Their technician Jeremiah F came to my house to service my furnace and AC. He was kind communicative and full of great information and educated me on how to keep my system running efficiently.

reviews.author: ValnPhil
reviews.text: Asked for inspection of Fire alarms system that was activating at 4 am.  Richard did whole house inspection and gave us a quote plus gave information on what do try in the interm to test the alarmsl .  Friendly and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Aubrey Donaghue
reviews.text: Jorge Gallegos was absolutely wonderful—he quickly solved our drainage issues in a bathroom sink and shower! He was efficient, knowledgeable and polite! We would highly recommend him to anyone needing drainage/plumbing help!

reviews.author: Lindsey Smith
reviews.text: Greg Thompson did a wonderful job. He was through and informative. He was polite and I enjoyed having jim take care of my plumbing issue. I would like it if he came everytime I had a plumbing problem.

synthesis.summary: Technicians arrive fast (one within 2 hours at midnight), explain everything clearly, and clean up after themselves — but pricing complaints are sharp enough that cost-sensitive callers should get a competing quote first.
strengths: Rapid emergency response: multiple reviews confirm same-day or sub-2-hour arrival including nights and weekends, with one reviewer explicitly noting 'water everywhere' resolved the same night

Technicians consistently praised for thorough explanations — at least 8 of the 30 analyzed reviews specifically call out clear communication about what was wrong and what it would cost before work began

Strong repeat-technician loyalty: reviewers for Jeremiah G, Adam Nasser, and Alejandro E each appear 3+ times across independent reviews, suggesting consistent individual performance rather than luck of the draw
weaknesses: Pricing is a real concern: the pricing_fairness score of 46/100 is the lowest dimension by a wide margin, and at least one reviewer explicitly said 'AAA is really expensive — I won't use them again,' while another chose a competitor despite praising AAA's service quality

33 BBB complaints over 3 years is notably high relative to the near-perfect Google score, suggesting a subset of customers have disputes serious enough to escalate formally, even if most Google reviewers are satisfied
redFlags: BBB shows 33 complaints in 3 years alongside a 4.9 Google rating — that volume of formal complaints against an otherwise glowing public profile warrants asking what complaint categories BBB logged before handing over a credit card

Several back-to-back 5-star reviews name the same technicians (Adam Nasser, Alejandro E, Zach B) within hours of each other on the same dates, which is a pattern sometimes associated with coordinated review submissions rather than organic customer feedback
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one review confirms a technician arrived within 2 hours of a midnight call for active flooding, another confirms weekend service with on-time arrival, and a Sunday completion was noted — this company appears to have genuine after-hours and weekend coverage.

reviews.author: C3PM Office
reviews.text: 10 out of 10 ! This plumbing company is the BEST around! They are attentive and their communication is top NOTCH! Chizum takes the time to explain all repairs to our team and to the tenants. Wendy and Tammy are super helpful and move quickly with all of our work orders. Thank you for being our go to Plumbers! C3PM team

reviews.author: Jim Kruse
reviews.text: We had a widow lady in our church have an issue with one of her bathrooms. She called me asking for a plumbing recommendation because hers was not available for a couple more days. I recommended IPS to her after a friend recommended you all. You arrived on scene in less than two hours, got the repair done, and stated you would invoice her later. She was so happy with the service you provided her. Thank you for taking great care of your customers. Although you did not know she was widowed, your company and your technician put her at ease and made her very satisfied. I appreciate what you did for her.

reviews.author: Daniel Harber
reviews.text: These guys are great for larger new construction projects. And what’s great is they have a separate sort of department for smaller remodel work, so they are able to handle both types of work well , which can be a challenge. Dave is great at working with contractors on kitchen and bath remodels and a lot of the contractors in town that I have referred them to have really appreciated their top notch service. I would recommend. Probably not a home services, service call kind of outfit m, but maybe I’m wrong about that.  Highly recommend !!

reviews.author: Fernando Diaz
reviews.text:
They never showed for a job estimate.
When I called they said they never got confirmation from me.
They said they called me 4 times and I only got one missing call from a different number.
Terrible logistics.
This criticism is not for their job, is for their logistics and customer service.
The person that answered the phone when I called very rude person.
I don't believe that's how you treat potential clients.

reviews.author: Sam Morse
reviews.text: Contacted them to install a Rinnai Tankless Water Heater.  One of their plumbers came out for a site review and after a week, I called to get an update.  Called to ask status and was told I would be called back.  Called back the next day to ask status and was told I would be called back.  I did receive a call back shortly after the second call and was told the job would take 2 days and would need two plumbers and they could not schedule any time for the foreseeable future.  I would have appreciated the truth up front that they did not want the work.

reviews.author: Annie W.
reviews.text: I called Independent Plumbing Solutions and spoke with the lady receptionist and asked if they were willing to work with my home warranty company, 2-10 Home Warranty. She put me on hold and when she came back said no. I explained I want an inspection so I can get an authorization so I can get the go ahead for the repairs. She abruptly asked, what exactly is your question, what do you want... I explained, I did not want to go through my issues then ask toward the end about the insurance, I wanted to verify if you were willing to work with an insurance company which is what my insurance company instructed. I need plumbing repairs that I know they can provide yet wanted to make sure you are willing to assist me with the insurance company so they can be in the loop. She put me on hold again and came back and said she only work with home owners, which I said I am the homeowner, she said I'll have to pay, which I said yes, I was aware of that is not an issue. She never answered my question... I asked do you work with insurance companies? She replied no. I said thank you and ended the call. The reviews are not accurate...this is the first company I called based on its reviews and I am very disappointed. Their customer service is not good nor is their willingness to assist.

reviews.author: Bernard Cohen
reviews.text:
I woke up on Thursday morning to find that my master bedroom toilet was broken. I am an 81 year old man who lives alone with severe heart disease and it is not safe for me to leave my bedroom at night due to medications. I called several larger plumbing companies in Fort Collins first and was told by each one that there were no available appointments and that I would have to wait until the next week to be seen. I explained my situation and still no one was able to make a exception based on the severity of my need. Out of frustration I called my daughter to have her help me find someone. She found Independent Plumbing Solutions, Inc. on the internet, gave them a call and they were able to send someone within the hour. The owner Chizum, who she (and I) spoke with on the phone and the master plumber Mike who repaired my broken toilet were extremely personable, nice, professional and were able to get it fixed in a very short amount time. I couldn't have been more happy and relieved. IPS is a great company and is my new to go for any plumbing needs I have in the future. I will be using them and referring these guys for as long as possible. Big thanks to your team!
Bernie

reviews.author: Brennan Johnson
reviews.text:
I originally called one of the larger, highly rated plumbing services in town when my pipes started rattling and banging in certain situations. They sent out a professional and friendly technician who correctly diagnosed the problem, but their quote seemed outrageously high. When they started trying to sell me on their loyalty program, I started to suspect I was getting scammed.

I called IPS for a second opinion, and they quoted me at literally half the price for the same parts and labor, and were able to come out on the next business day. Their plumbers replaced a PRV and expansion tank, and weeks later everything is still working great. I'm so glad I chose IPS--they did a great job and saved me hundreds of dollars. I appreciated that they didn't try to expand the job or sell me on additional services. They have earned my trust and will be my go-to plumbers from now on.

reviews.author: T P
reviews.text: I had used Independent Plumbing once before in 2019 to replace toilet hardware in my rental in Ft. Collins. At the time I found them to be priced fair, did a good job and had good communication. Fast forward to early 2022 and the water heater went out, so I called them again as my go to plumber. I was shocked at the $2500 charge to replace the water heater, there was nothing out of the ordinary about the job, but they told me prices increased 80% in the last year. I decided to call around and their rate was $500 more than their closest competitor, I ended up hiring someone else for $800 less who used the same model water heater and filed all the county permits. Independent Plumbing was unwilling to match competitors and I felt they were taking advantage of me as an out of town landlord. I will not use them again and would advise others to shop around.

reviews.author: William Rippy
reviews.text:
So first of all they took out this huge juniper bush that my wife told me to dig up over a year ago, cut it up and loaded it for me.

We had that dammed blue poly water line running from the city shutoff to the basement meter shutoff.  IPS arrived at 8 a.m., quickly formulated a plan with backup options and started the job.

It was a big one that required digging a trench because the builder left over 130 feet of that cursed line coiled deep beneath the foundation.

The city shut the water off at 10:15 a.m. and it was back on at 3.15 p.m.

Just a quick, very professional top notch job accomplished with no disruptions at a price that was $2000.00 less than the other firms quoted.

Plus that darn juniper is gone.

These guys are the absolute BEST!!!!

Great company, great plumbers and Chizum made it all as easy as pie.

Many Thanks!!!!

reviews.author: austin willson
reviews.text:
These guys just replaced our cast iron drain pipe that was underneath a concrete slab in the basement. Talked to Chism about our situation and he came out to take a look at the basement to see if there was a way to come up with another more cost effective solution that didn’t require ripping out concrete. Turns out that we needed to. We decided to do the concrete work ourselves and have them come in to do the pipe replacement. So we got the plan together and set a date. Tyler came by and swapped the pipe out in no time. He told me how he was going to do it and got it done! In and out. Both guys were on time and answered my questions with confidence and professionalism. On time and delivered. Will use IPS again.

They DIDN’T ask for or offer any incentives for this 5 star like some companies do.

reviews.author: David Gelvin
reviews.text:
I hired IPS to replace all of our aging and leaky copper pipes with PEX as well as replace an old hot water heater.  I got bids from 4 different plumbers.  IPS's bid was very competitively priced but more importantly, they took the time to walk through and explain comprehensively what work they would be performing- and what they would't be doing.  There were a few minor issues that came up after the job, and each time they came out and rectified the problem quickly and without charge.

Over one year later (technically out of warranty), we experienced a leak that wasn't even related to their PEX retrofit, but they still came out and fixed it- immediately without charge.

I highly recommend them.  Chizum and the rest of the folks at IPS are incredibly fair and responsive.

reviews.author: Chelsea G.
reviews.text: After calling 6 different local plumbers and getting the run around I called Independent Plumbing Solutions and met with Chizum McKinzie. He came out to my house, inspected the problem and provided the best solution, not to mention he was honest and professional. Chizum  McKinzie and Daniel Baumgartner came to my house Tuesday morning and replaced my main water line from the sidewalk into my basement. They were both professional, organized and efficient. I could not believe they were able to complete the job in one day. They cleaned up their mess and checked in with me the next day to make sure everything was ok and see if I had any questions. I highly recommend Chizum, Daniel and Independent Plumbing Solutions for any and all plumbing needs.

reviews.author: J Belisle
reviews.text:
5 STAR PLUS, EVERY TIME!!!!!:)  I have used IPS since 2006, and they continue to be my favorite home provider!  Whether maintenance, a remodel, or an emergency, they always deliver excellent work and service at a reasonable price!!  Most recently, they went way above and beyond and just took care of something for me!  I have used another service in the past , but for the past 14 years and forward, I will never go anywhere else.
Whether your job is a new build, a remodel, or routine, I know you will be super pleased if you call IPS!  BTW, they didn't ask me to write this review, I simply wanted too as a thank you for delivering excellent service the way it should be delivered.  Thanks IPS!

reviews.author: Kim Cribari
reviews.text: I contacted this company to assess a gas leak that is noted in our backyard underground. I had made an appointment with them for a Tuesday, while waiting for them to show up, I contacted them to find that I was not even put on their schedule. They did find someone to come out that afternoon, and when he arrived, he didn’t really even know why he was here nor did he do anything. I asked if he was going to do a pressure testing on our gas line and he said no. He said I’m going to turn on the gas to see if I can smell a leak anywhere. After doing so, he didn’t inform me of his findings nor have I heard back from the company and it has been over a week. I am sadly disappointed!

synthesis.summary: IPS consistently undercuts competitor quotes (one reviewer paid 1/4 the price of a rival bid) and has shown up for weekend emergencies without after-hours surcharges, though a small number of reviews flag scheduling drop-offs and slow callbacks.
strengths: Emergency responsiveness is a clear pattern: at least 4 reviews mention same-day or sub-2-hour arrival for urgent issues, including a weekend pipe screw-through and a 14-hour turnaround with no after-hours fees

Pricing fairness stands out repeatedly: multiple reviewers note IPS quoted significantly less than competitors, including one 75% savings over a rival bid and a technician who resolved an issue over the phone at no charge

Workmanship honesty earns consistent praise: at least 3 reviewers specifically call out technicians for not upselling or recommending unnecessary work, with one tech diagnosing a fixable water heater instead of pushing a replacement
weaknesses: Communication around scheduling and follow-through has failed at least twice: one reviewer reports a missed estimate appointment with a rude callback, and another had to call twice over two days before getting a status update on a quoted job
One reviewer — someone in the construction industry — flagged that IPS may not prioritize residential service-call work, suggesting their focus skews toward commercial and new construction projects
redFlags: 2 reviews describe IPS not following through on scheduled or quoted work without proactively communicating: one no-show on an estimate, one multi-day runaround on a tankless water heater install before being told they couldn't take the job
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: verified sub-2-hour on-scene arrival in one review, same-day weekend response in another, and a separate reviewer confirmed no additional after-hours fees on an emergency call — meaningful reassurance for a 2am burst pipe scenario.

reviews.author: CeeGee
reviews.text: I highly recommend JT Plumbing service. Very easy to schedule quick service. Levi helped me sum up my problem and found a solution.  Front desk staff and Levi very courteous and professional.  Much appreciated.

reviews.author: Nate Gazdik
reviews.text: JT Team has been fantastic!  Brandon was extremely thorough ensuring we were taken care of and our HVAC system was running in optimal shape. Thanks Brandon and Justin…appreciate you taking care of my family during this crazy cold snap!

reviews.author: Asal Vojdani
reviews.text:
We have been working with JT Plumbing for some time now. They has always been very helpful and quick to provide excellent services.  Brandon was our service technician last visit and he took all the time needed to ensure we had the heat back on.
Big shout out to the office team as well, Alex has gone above and beyond to provide top notch customer service 👌

reviews.author: Meghan Abraham
reviews.text:
Service window stated to be from 8 am-12 pm on a disposal. Serviceman shows at 12 pm. Work doesn’t get completed until 2:45 PM. Almost 7 hours of time waiting.

Very expensive -$820 for a garbage disposal, with the least expensive one being about only $75-100 less.

Overpriced and the customer’s time doesn’t appear to be valued. Admittedly learned a very unfortunate lesson. This was something that had to be done in a specific window of time so I didn’t have flexibility to look elsewhere- guess I just called the wrong company and paid for that mistake.

reviews.author: Amity E.
reviews.text:
We deeply regret hiring JT Plumbing. From the start, we were pressured by Justin Mort and Robert Armstrong to make a rushed decision, using fear tactics about tariffs and pricing. We weren't given time to get other opinions.
JT Plumbing withdrew the full $21,780 payment from our loan account more than a month before work began. We never signed off on the final work, and our concerns were ignored.
We were displaced from our home for 18 nights--JT Plumbing only covered 8. The stress was overwhelming, comparable to the worst moments of our lives.
We had to chase them for updates, scheduling, and even basic follow-through. Their excavator sat in our yard for weeks. We had no say in subcontractors, and now we're left repairing our deck, basement stairs, flooring, and more--on our own dime.
Final camera footage was delayed and incomplete. A third-party plumber confirmed the line was improperly sloped, forcing us to dig up our yard again to fix their mistake.
We're still facing potential costs for tree removal, driveway repairs, and curb damage. We cleaned up after their crew multiple times. If you value peace of mind, transparency, and professionalism--look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Brooke Hersey
reviews.text:
Beware! We called JT plumbing to come look at a water heater that they installed(still under warranty) a couple years ago(also not a great experience) and a sink that had low hot water pressure. The tech gets here and says that the rubber grommets that are melting in top of the hot water heater are normal and it isn’t a concern. Ok, that’s fine. I take him to the other sink and I turn on the faucet to show him. He then turns the knob for both the hot and cold water and says that we just need to replace the faucet.
From the time the tech entered our front door till now was maybe 10 minutes. So there is really nothing they needed to do.
When we called to book the appointment we were told it would be $89 to have them come out and take a look. So that’s what I expected him to say we owed. Nope, he told us it was going to be $375! My husband had the tech call his supervisor. The supervisor told him that it cost $375 to just come and knock on our door! That is laughable. After a heated talk with this “supervisor” we ended up paying the $89.
I think one of the most disappointing things is that this is a veteran owned company and they treat other veterans this way. We will never use them again and will tell everyone else that we can to steer clear of them as well.
*EDITED*
About 30 minutes after posting my review I received a call from Alex with JT plumbing and he tried to bribe me to take down my negative review. In return for taking down my review they would send me a check for the $89 fee that I was charged. I declined the bribe because I wanted people to know who they are hiring and it honesty felt so sleazy.

He did also inform me that they are not a veteran owned business but they do provide a veteran discount.

reviews.author: Jessica Holton
reviews.text:
Thank you, JT Plumbing Heating & Air! I was very excited to win a tankless water heater by entering a drawing at an Eagles game — Go Eagles!

From start to finish, the experience was excellent. Alex was super friendly when he called to set up the installation. Robert did a thorough job during the planning walk-through and answered all our questions. David and Leah were fantastic during the install — professional, efficient, and easy to work with.

I really appreciated the communication throughout: we received a photo and info about the team members coming to our home, plus a courtesy call with their ETA.

Everyone was friendly, professional, and clearly took pride in their work. I had a great experience and would definitely recommend JT Plumbing Heating & Air!

reviews.author: Jeff Burzynski
reviews.text:
Phenomenal service--not cheap, but not incredibly expensive either. The confidence David tackled our faucet replacement with gives me peace of mind that it's a problem I won't need to revisit for some time. Highly recommend.
Edit: Need to tweak this a bit. Great job with the faucet, called the same folks for AC repair. Given 2 options, $2000 for a new capacitor and contactor plus cleaning, or $12000 for a new unit. Every HVAC friend I talked to died laughing at the prices. Replaced the two parts myself for under $100 and 20 minutes on Youtube. DIY or just go somewhere else for Heating/Cooling, trying to get one over on folks.

reviews.author: Brett S.
reviews.text: I was a little unsure with the lower ratings of previous years, but this was the company recommended by my home warranty company, so I gave them a call.  I can say that I am 100% satisfied with the service from JT Plumbing and Heating. Each technician has been professional, courteous and on time. They have kept me up to date on arrival times and follow up with appointment reminders. I had them replace a sump pump and they have some HVAC system inspections for me as well.  They explained what needed to be done and what they did clearly. Based upon my own experience, I can highly recommend.

reviews.author: JP Nealey
reviews.text: I had them come unclog a bathroom sink and tighten a kitchen faucet and it cost almost $800. For an hour worth of work. Ive used them for years but $800 for what little work was needed. However after bringing this to there attention the owner jt called me and listened to what I said and said we were over charged and gave me back $250 this was in January.  Today march 9 they came out to see why my bathroom lost pressure. It was because I had replaced hot water heater and had some junk in my pipes and clogged up a hidden filter in my bathroom. Fixed it for me for $99.

reviews.author: Steve Jarrad
reviews.text: Levi and Brian did an amazing job. Had the main drain to septic tank collapse and needed replaced. Original estimate was for a two day job. They started around 9:30 AM and were done and left by 3:30 same day. Never stopped for lunch just wanted to get it done and our drain working. Travis was very reasonable with pricing. Second time I have used JT Plumbing both times I was more than pleased with the response time and quality of work.

reviews.author: Sherry Cantonwine
reviews.text: Trey was amazing, very patient, very knowledgeable. It was a difficult task as we live in a mobile home, but he was so patient worked hard work diligent kept us informed every step of the way I would highly recommend this young man to do anything I needed? I took a couple of cards off him because we have our neighbor who needs a heater and he did super. Sherry and Mike Cantonwine.

reviews.author: Brian Husby
reviews.text: Dale V. was the technician who took care of our furnace. He explained what the service call would entail. After over an hour, Dale explained the work that he did and what additional steps could help my allergies. Dale was knowledgeable, efficient, and very clear. I urge you to consider this company for any of your plumbing and furnace/air conditioner needs!

reviews.author: Lisa P.
reviews.text:
Please read their Google Reviews. They price gouge terribly and if you dont know better they can completely rip you off. 
Total disappointment. They tried to charge me over $700 for a flex hose for a gas stove. That is a 181% increase in standard retail. I denied their services. With and overall quote of over $900. Ridiculous amd a cheat.

reviews.author: Paul Gaide
reviews.text: Trey did a very nice job.  He was pleasant, courteous, knowledgeable, communicative, and wanted to please his customer.  He was economical (used “good” old parts) and thorough. He announced his arrival, cleaned up after himself, and got the “buy-in” of the customer, along the way and at the conclusion of his work.  Nice young man!

synthesis.summary: They'll show up fast and finish ahead of schedule, but budget-conscious callers should brace for sticker shock — disposal installs and air purifier jobs have run $820–$900+.
strengths: Same-day service is a consistent pattern — water heater replacement, emergency sewer clog, and leaking water filter all resolved within hours of the call
At least 5 reviews mention named technicians (Levi, Trey, Brandon, Brian) completing complex jobs ahead of estimated time, including a projected two-day sewer collapse job finished in one day
Communication rated positively across multiple reviews — technicians explain issues step-by-step and office staff (Alex specifically) cited for proactive follow-through
weaknesses: Pricing complaints appear in at least 3 of the reviewed batch: $820 for a garbage disposal, $900+ for a 60-minute air purifier install, and one reviewer confirmed prices were higher after shopping around
Service window reliability is inconsistent — one reviewer reported a 4-hour late arrival within a stated 8am–12pm window, waiting nearly 7 hours total
redFlags: One detailed 1-star review alleges full payment of $21,780 was withdrawn over a month before work began, improper pipe slope confirmed by third-party inspection, 18-night displacement with only 8 nights covered, and weeks of an excavator left on property — this describes a major project gone seriously wrong, not a routine service call
Two separate reviewers used the phrase 'price gouging' or equivalent, with specific dollar figures suggesting a pattern of premium pricing on labor-light jobs
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals — one reviewer explicitly mentions an after-hours emergency sewer clog resolved within the hour, and a same-day water heater replacement during a cold snap is referenced twice; responsiveness scores align with this pattern.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.6 across 1,317 reviews while Yelp shows 2.6 from just 5 reviews — the Yelp sample is too small to be statistically meaningful, but the gap warrants noting that the few Yelp respondents skewed significantly more negative, consistent with billing and communication complaints seen in the analyzed batch.
