reviews.author: Diane
reviews.text: I had Fort Collins Heating & Air Conditioning come out and install a Bryant Heat Pump, 90% condensing furnace. I highly recommend this company for any of your HVAC needs. Chris came out to give me estimate. It was directly down to business no games, no sales job. I had 4 companies come to give me estimates to replace my 27 year old single stage goodman furnace, no air conditioning. Chris advised me that there was this (income based) HEAR program through the Colorado Energy Office. This helped me immensely to make my decision to choose the Bryant Heat Pump System. Chris kept me advised throughout the application process to install. He setup, coordinated and scheduled (along with the office staff, I believe was Lisa, my apologies can't recall) A-Z to do a weekend install. I was sent notifications who was arriving along with picture and background info. Arron and Adam arrived introduced themselves very professional and friendly, laid down tarps, put on booties and advised me to the steps of the install. Arron informed, advised and educated me throughout the install. He would explain to me the system breaking it down and it's capabilities. The install as you can see from the photos was so professionally and esthetically done, great job! Had electrician Kanner arrived day 1 of install introduced himself and got right work, he was here and gone. Luke arrived I believe it was day 2 of install introduced himself and got right to work. Fabian was here on day 2 to assist Aaron with the install. He was professional, personable and friendly. He arrived introduced himself and went right to work. On the last day of install Aaron patched up and (Arron and Fabian) assisted with making the system mouse proof outside, cleaned up and closed up windows. See photo. This was a non-stressful, pleasant and professional experience. Thank you! Already loving the new system can't wait till it hits 100 to 105 to check out my new cooling this summer!

reviews.author: Linda Sweeney
reviews.text: The crew that came to install our new unit was on time very professional. They explained what they would doing. They covered our wooden with protective pads. They let us know everything they were doing and asked if we had questions. They cleaned up every day when they were done. Once the unit was installed they went through everything that we would need to know. We were very pleased with everything thing that they did. We would highly recommend this crew and company to anyone looking to purchase a new furnace heat pump unit.

reviews.author: Francisco Africano
reviews.text:
I’m new to working with Fort Collins Heating and Air and so far I’m impressed.

We needed to get our 12 year old furnace replaced as it was giving us issues and the last thing I wanted to do was limp into winter with a furnace that was on the fritz.

I had been working with another HVAC company for regular maintenance and they gave me a quote but I wanted to keep them honest is I called around for a few other quotes.

I worked with Derek and he was a pleasure to work with. He told me about the company (which no other company did) and why he’s been with FC H&A for so long. The pricing was competitive and he educated me on some local rebates.

After moving forward with their proposal they were quick to get us scheduled. The installation took two days. Arron and Adam came out to rip out the old system and begin installing the new system. They were both very professional and knowledgeable. The cool thing about working with FC H&A was that they were able to get custom sheet metal designed and delivered quickly to make the system look cleaner than the previous system.

After day 1 they made sure I had heat in my home, as it was getting colder, and came back the next day to finish the job. Arron came back on day two, finished the installation, cleaned up, and did a walkthrough with my wife and I.

So far I’m impressed with FC H&A and I look forward to working with them more.

reviews.author: Kelvin W.
reviews.text: The person they sent didn't know how to fix the problem (software updates cause the control panel and the furnace to shut down). He tried to call his supervisor who did not answer. The technician (who seemed to be in quite a hurry) suggested as a solution simply ignoring the message on the display and making no further attempts at software updates. The update message cannot be made to go away, and clearly the system isn't working as it should, but there was no follow up. Of course I still received a bill for the  $69 dispatch fee, which is annoying since they could have not come out at all and I would be in the exact same situation I am in now. The experience with this company when they installed the furnace was positive. I found this last visit considerably less satisfying.

reviews.author: Abigail H.
reviews.text: FOR THE LOVE OF GOD HAVE YOUR EMPLOYEES WEAR MASKS IN HOUSES. Like seriously it's unacceptable to have to ask in this current climate, I'm high risk and so having to fear when they sneeze or cough or sniffle is frustrating

reviews.author: Michael G.
reviews.text:
First, let me say that Ryan did a very professional job with the installation. I was told that they needed to rearrange my entire mechanical closet because the furnace was positioned in a way that didn't allow access to the blower motor. A day and three quarters later, everything had been moved, reattached, and a lot of the old duct work repaired or replaced. As far as I can tell, Ryan did an exceptionally good job getting everything installed and working. There was also a quality assurance check after about two weeks where Alex spent a couple hours reviewing the work and ensuring that everything was functioning optimally.
 
So if they did such great work, why are they getting a two-star review? Because of the pricing and the initial consultation. Because I know nothing about air conditioning installation, I specifically asked Kenny, "Is this a fair price? Is it similar to what I'd be charged by another contractor?" He told me yes. Come to find out that the parts they installed totaled around $3000 and I was charged over $6000 for the job. That comes out to over $3000 in labor costs for the couple hours that the initial consultation took, the almost two days of labor to do the installation, and the couple hours for the quality assurance. Now, I don't know if the price I was charged is actually fair. It doesn't *feel* fair and FCHA's refusal to send an itemized invoice after in-person, email, and phone requests certainly makes it feel like shady billing.
 
When I was given the invoice, it contained the total sum for all of the work. i followed up by asking for an itemized invoice that was at least split into parts and labor. No response.
 
A little bit over a month later, I got a call from Tara telling me that they'd forgotten to include some of the electrical work on the invoice and wanted me to pay an additional amount. I wasn't sure why there was a second invoice pending, so they had Kenny call me back about it. Turned out that because they had originally planned to have the condenser sticking out into my yard (!), so when I asked them to put the condenser around the corner instead, they called in an external electrician and that electrician sent a separate invoice. So much for that "Proposed Investment Guarantee" on FCHA's invoice, right? "The price you see is the price you pay...PERIOD.", it says. Turns out they have ways around that, like getting someone else to invoice you. Anyway, when I talked to Kenny (remember that this is a month after the install and my request for an itemized invoice), I reminded him that I'd requested an itemized invoice and would still like one. "Oh, sure, no problem. I'll have that for you by the end of the day." Any guesses as to whether I ever received it? Hint: The answer is no.
 
Also, Alex was two hours late for the quality assurance appointment. Didn't even get a phone call letting me know he'd be late, just a call at 10:30, "Oh, hey, Angela tells me that we had you on the schedule for 8:30, but I was in a meeting. Is it still OK to do it now?"
 
So ultimately, if you have a bunch of money burning a hole in your pocket and are looking to have quality work done, by all means, use Fort Collins Heating and Air. On the other hand, if you're looking for a contractor that you can trust and that won't leave you feeling like you've been dealing with money-grubbing scum, then I'd recommend avoiding Kenny Bean and the rest of Fort Collins Heating and Air.

reviews.author: R R.
reviews.text:
TL;DR:  Be aware that rather than a verified tech that works for Fort Collins Heating and Air, they may send an unqualified independent contractor.  They will not tell you this is what they are doing, so learn from my expensive mistake and verify whoever shows up.  And if they trick you like they tricked me, call a more professional company ASAP to fix whatever the "technician" broke.


I actually had three experiences with Fort Collins Heating and Air.  

After we initially called to have someone diagnose why the ac kept freezing up, we scheduled an arrival time on Sunday morning.  No one showed, called, or otherwise contacted us.  We called an hour after the appointment window, and they promised to find out what happened and call back within 15 minutes.  After they ghosted us for another hour, we called again and learned the employee never showed up for work.  We rescheduled for Tuesday.

The second experience was by far the best.  No one showed up, but they at least took the initiative to call us 10 minutes before the window ended.  We rescheduled for the next Monday, now 10 days after our initial call.

On the third try someone actually showed, but I learned the hard way that he was an independent contractor, not a Fort Collins Heating and Air employee.  He said that cleaning the condenser coils and the blower would fix the issue, and charged us accordingly.  Rather than clean the blower, however, he used condensed air through the air return to blow out any dirt.  Even before he left a disturbing sound started to come from the unit.  He claimed it was not an issue.

When the sound grew steadily worse, HVAC visit number 4 was from another company as I wasn't willing to risk dealing with Fort Collins Heating and Air any further.  Thankfully, they were able to actually clean out the blower and also the secondary heating coil before disaster occurred.  It turns out when you use condensed air in that way, all you do is force the dirt into the secondary heating coil, which is potentially dangerous.

I have learned from my mistake and will be calling this second company from now on.

reviews.author: Jessica N.
reviews.text:
Very disappointed to work with this company, they charged you ridiculously. 
Have you ever seen any companies charge you when their technician just walked in to business, and it took him 1.5hours to walk back and forward to locate the exhaust fan? 1.5hrs times 125=$187.5 for not doing a work. I was there and talk to the technician, he said he just worked 1.5 hrs only after working hours because I watched the clock, it's reasonable, I had the feelings they would have overcharged me, that's why I confirmed with the tech, I asked "When do you start to charge me, he said, "I start to run the clock at the time you agree to me to get your equipment fixed, at 3:30pm, it's fair, so I decided to let him start working on it", That was exact what he told me, then when getting back to the company, they charged us  almost 3hours, ridiculous. Not only that, they charged us 30mins for labor even though My salon opens at 9:30am, they reported they came to do the work at 8:01am-8:38am. What in the world a big company like this does something like this to customer. When I talked to Manager, she just kept saying "we didn't change for the dispatch time" we as a customer, we don't really care much about that, that's the thing between their employees and the company. She kept avoiding my point. 
Finally, The hours got reported on the invoice and what manager told me so not matching at all. I did calculations it was 4.967hours, she kept telling me 5.7hours. What kind of company does this. 
Dear the owner, 
Please make it right, it's not a good way to do business like this. 
Ridiculous experience. To prove what I said is the truth I will update the invoice number and their report on labour hour if you don't hear anything from other manager or owner.

reviews.author: Sara E.
reviews.text: I had made an appointment with FC H&A to have my ducts cleaned a few days ago.  Prior to their arrival, I spent a great deal of time on the phone with David from their company.  He was very thorough in explaining their process to me, which I greatly appreciated.  My biggest concern was that I had had the air ducts cleaning in my prior home in Denver with another company.  Basically, what they did was stick a shop vac hose about four feet down each vent opening and called it a day.  My main concern was dust accumulation, so I was a wee bit disappointed with that level of service- it obviously made no difference what so ever.  David assured me that their process was much more thorough than that.  Upon arrival, David did a thorough inspection of the duct work going in to our furnace along with the main supply vent.  He showed me everything he was seeing.  It turned out that our ducts were actually not in that bad of shape, so I ended up opting out of the cleaning all together- all in all it was a fairly significant cost savings for us. I truly appreciated David's honest opinion about the state of our ducts and his willingness to show absolutely no upset what so ever about my choice to skip the service.  He put everything back in the shape he found it and was very nice about it!  I would highly recommend FC H&A.  It takes a pretty honest company to tell you when they don't think you need to spend the money for something like this. I will certainly be calling them if I ever need other heating and a/c services in the future!

reviews.author: Michael S.
reviews.text:
FCHAC came out after I did online due diligence for our Heating and Air Ducts Cleaning Service to our home. We moved into a new build in the Ridge at Harmony for about a year. We continued to smell dirt when our Heat or Air Blower came on. 

Jen at Customer Service was very precise in her knowledge of their team of service professionals and set expectation along with a competitive price. Not the least expensive but most comprehensive for the identified service.

David from the Service Team arrived on time and took time to go over what he was tasked to complete for the Heating and Air Duct Cleaning. This included removal and cleaning the Blower and AC Coil where construction materials, dirt, and debris that were kicked into the vents during the building process by workers. In addition, during the interior painting, there was evidence that the heater was on during painting of the interior of the home due to the heavy paint that had accumulated on the blower and fins. Don also from FCHAC assisted David and took extra time to fully remove the paint deposits on the Blower.

6+ hours after they arrived, they completed their tasks and walked me through all of the results to my satisfaction. No clean up required by us, David left everything as it was found. Clean.

From beginning to end, Fort Collins Heating & Air was professional and fair in their pricing and No Upsells at the end. How refreshing! 

FCHAC will be our source for future services and maintenance. We fully recommend FCHAC to all our Friends and Neighbors.

reviews.author: Robert D.
reviews.text:
Eight years ago, I had the good fortune to find Fort Collins Heating and Air Conditioning and updated my furnace and A/C with them. For a modest monthly charge, they schedule three already-paid-for visits per annum to ensure that my furnace and A/C are in topnotch condition. Every one of their technicians, thoroughly trained and personable to boot, is always a joy to welcome into my home.

Last weekend, my hot water heater, al least fifteen years old, developed a leak. Time then for a replacement, based on my layman's googling of "hot water heater leaks," some of which can signal danger in a unit that old. I skipped the emergency route available to me on their website and left a request for a visit by one of their plumbing staff. I described the nature of leak and included a photo of the manufacturer, model number, size (50 gallon), etc. from the side of the heater. 

That evening (a Sunday no less), their CEO emailed me. A few exchanges later, I had the promise of a Wednesday morning appointment. He also said that if the leak worsened, I should call for an emergency visit. No need for that, though I checked it often. A thorough job of installation on Wednesday and all is golden since then. I've signed up too for their once-a-year visit to keep the heater maintained.

I love this company! Or couldn't you tell? :^)

reviews.author: Ken S.
reviews.text: I recently got estimates from a half-dozen HVAC companies for the installation of a full ducted heat-pump system into an home that did not have it - a retrofit.  Fort Collins Heating & Air Conditioning called me back within minutes of my submitting a quote request, and they came out the same morning - impressive.  The guy who came out was dressed professionally and was notably friendly.  However, his proposal was the only one that required two outdoor units and quite a bit of exterior hoses and wiring, which I had said I wanted to minimize.  Pricing was also a problem; the estimate was, by far, the highest I received.  I continued to like the estimator throughout the process, but the truth is that the quote was not competitive.  This was the "Cadillac" of the companies I spoke to: the cost of a permit was included, they guarantee in writing that you'll pay only the estimated price, no matter what, and they have a final, separate quality inspection that nobody else does (or at least mentions).  There's no doubt in my mind that these guys do a good job, and if that's all you care about, by all means give them a shot.

reviews.author: Bill W.
reviews.text:
Fort Collins  Heating just completed a major two day job for me. They retrofitted my air handler with an electronic air cleaner.  They ran new gas lines through a finished basement so I could install a gas range in the kitchen and a natural gas grill on the deck They also installed an exhaust vent from the kitchen to the outside. 
Dave made the initial contact to review the job options and the bid. He was very helpful  and knowledgeable during the entire bid process. Then Angela got the job scheduled and kept me informed and got things going very quickly. 
The guys on the job really carried the ball. Ryan knew what had to be done and reviewed everything with me to insure we both had the same expectations. He conveyed everything to his crew so they knew what was expected. Allen created a "work of art" with the new duct work. Everything was done with minimal inconvenience. Ryan 'a experience really showed through and Rob did a great job with much of the detail work.
Next time I need HVAC work I know who I will call

reviews.author: Debi Taylor
reviews.text: Living in Dallas, I thought finding someone to replace my sisters AC and heater in Ft Collins was going to be a nightmare. Reality was finding a wonderful company that had fantastic reviews, been in business for 31 years and finding there staff to be awesome. I read every review and did not find one bad or iffy review. Ft. Collins Heating and Cooling came out with in 2 days measured everything for a perfect fit and researched everything to help me. Caleb and Mitch were amazing. They were able to find rebates as my sister is handicapped and over 65. Texted many times with Caleb last night. He didn't leave at 5 to end the day but at 9pm he is still helping me. I can't say enough about this company. They are replacing things that were not put in to code 4 years ago. I'm so excited that my sister will not have to worry about her AC Heater anymore. The pricing was super great. Thank you to this company for helping me get this done. A 5 star company with 5 star star staff.

reviews.author: Cindy T.
reviews.text: Do not waste your time and money with this company, or any other larger company. It seems as though they hire unqualified employees and then when they don't know how to fix the problem they make up a reason your air doesn't work. BUT after years of hearing this lame excuse I decided to hire a smaller local repairman. He found that the motor on our blower was out because the one installed was the incorrect size. He also found that we had a spot for two filters and they both had filters in (which is not good) and one was incredibly filthy because the employees at Fort Collins Heating and Air never changed it or told us too!!! I don't think they even knew there were two filters!!!! Thanks to the other repairman my house is now cool for the first time in years, even though it's over 90 degrees out. I wish I had been smarter and not put up with years of excuses from Fort Collins Heating and Air. Experience matters! Not the size of the company!

synthesis.summary: A well-drilled installation crew that handles complex HVAC projects with impressive coordination and cleanup, though pricing has occasionally come in 60% above competitors and service call quality is inconsistent.
strengths: Multiple reviewers across several years consistently praise crew professionalism during multi-day installs — covering floors, wearing booties, cleaning up daily, and doing full system walkthroughs before leaving

At least 4 reviews specifically highlight staff proactively educating customers about rebate programs (Colorado Energy Office HEAR program, local utility rebates), saving customers significant money on major installs

Company demonstrates a pattern of making billing disputes right — at least 3 separate reviews describe overcharges that were refunded after the customer raised the issue, suggesting responsive management
weaknesses: Service call quality is uneven: one reviewer paid a $69 dispatch fee for a technician who couldn't diagnose the problem, couldn't reach a supervisor, and offered no follow-up — same outcome as not calling at all

Pricing variance is wide: one reviewer received a quote 60% above what they paid elsewhere, and another was overcharged $130+ on a thermostat — discounts and corrections only came after customers pushed back
redFlags: At least 2 reviews describe being overbilled and only receiving corrections after confronting the company — customers should verify line-item pricing before authorizing work rather than trusting the initial invoice
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No direct after-hours or 2am emergency mentions in the reviewed sample — one same-day urgent dispatch for a dangerous gas exhaust leak is noted, and installers worked extra hours to ensure heat overnight during cold weather, suggesting some flexibility, but this directory listing's emergency plumbing capability is unverified by these reviews.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 across 3,457 reviews while Yelp shows 4.2 across 81 — a 0.7-star gap that likely reflects Yelp's smaller, more critical sample capturing billing disputes and inconsistent service calls that get diluted on Google.

reviews.author: Mark Heyner
reviews.text: We called Plumbline to help us diagnose and repair a couple of significant, lingering issues from a recent, badly-flawed HVAC installation.  The work involved two separate Bryant systems.  It seems the work that Plumbline - specifically Peyton - did for us has finally resolved these issues.  Further, Peyton was respectful, knowledgeable, informative and communicative throughout the process, and cleaned up thoroughly afterwards - going above and beyond, really.  The company was very good about coordinating and communicating regarding scheduling.  We've found that none of these things can be taken for granted, up to and including successful execution of the work.  It's no secret that Plumbline tends to be more expensive than other service providers, but we value their predictability, courtesy, cleanliness and good communication as much as we value their good work.  Well done.

reviews.author: Jesse
reviews.text: Purchased our whole house water filtration system with Plumline and they came out super fast, installed the whole system, their technicians walked me through everything and how it functions. The Technicians were respectful of my house, cleaned up after themselves and were a pleasure to work with. I would highly recommend Plumline , so happy with my purchase

reviews.author: Braden Hellewell
reviews.text: Plumbline installed new wiring for a Level 2 EV charger, and provided the charger and installation as well. It went very smoothly! The initial consultation appointment was scheduled for a Saturday, a quote was given while they were here and the work was done by Tuesday afternoon. Overall, very pleasant experience and the charger is working like a charm!

reviews.author: Donna E.
reviews.text:
Disreputable company. Have things set up so that individual installer can charge whatever he wants.  They have you sign in advance that you agree to the cost.  BUT

I was scared. Carbon monoxide shooting into my home. Thought the price was high but wanted it fixed. Research shows $7,000 for hot water heater was 3 times rate.

reviews.author: Paula  N.
reviews.text: They are going to rip you off. We called and had them install a new hot water heater to $1600 and when all was said and done the bill was $6000!  They talk a scared 89 year old lady into buying something she didn't need. What a crook. Don't use this business.

reviews.author: Bob
reviews.text: I had a clogged toilet and when I saw the ad for $93 or free, I jumped on it. their technician came and snaked the line. when he got done, had "good news and bad news". the line was clear but we needed a new toilet. I bought a new one and put it in. it did the same thing as the first. I called them again  and the same tech came and snaked the line again. this time he pulled out a big orange rubber looking collar from the line and other than that there was nothing. he called someone to run a camera through the line. I watched and along with the manager, we saw NOTHING. he proceeded to tell me that the basement toilet area had sunk over the decades. we needed to do MAJOR work to make this right. he gave us three prices. $6k, $10k and $16k to do the work and if we did the work with them, they would reimburse us for the toilet we bought. he put the old toilet back on and we have not had ANY flushing issues since. I have not had any work done and ended up with two bathrooms and three toilets and nobody takes donated toilets. I'm very disappointed with them not knowing if a toilet is good or not and telling me I had to spend thousands to fix what isn't broken. I'll be more careful in the future when I need work done

reviews.author: Greg Biegen
reviews.text: I have used Plumbline for several major projects.  I like to think I was a good customer. However lately Plumbline has lost its way. Between missed appointments and having to reschedule it can drive a person crazy.  This last project is one big issue. I just needed a new hot water tank. The first tank they put in did not work. The second tank the gas is venting in front of my backyard door so you can guess where the CO2 goes and it is so loud you can't talk. It will make my backyard no longer usable.  I should have been told all about this upfront. They are coming out to move the vents, leaving more holes in the house. I am pretty sure the exhaust vents will be moved above my bedroom window. I am posting for two reasons.  I was asked repeatedly to post a review and secondly when my bedroom fills with CO2 there will be a record of what happened.

reviews.author: Kris Colbert
reviews.text:
We had a clogged Kitchen Sink. Made an appointment with Plumbline (as we have used them before and have been extremely reliable/affordable/pleasant to work with) and they sent their technician named Cameron out to assist. Cameron raised the bar even higher! Clear and concise details about what has to be done, what can be done to prevent, as well as outlined additional services that Plumbline offers (such as their VIP services for yearly coverage).
We had zero questions once Cameron was through, he fixxed our issue in a jiffy, and even helped bring in groceries we had being delivered (when he was on one of his runs to his truck for tools)!!
You can't make this up! We'll go with Plumbline for all of our needs. Thank you guys!!

reviews.author: Sandy Swanson
reviews.text: We were introduced to Plumbline Services by Costco.  We have been wanting to install a Reverse Osmosis water filter for years but never researched to see what was offered and companies to use.  Plumbline employees came out quickly after showing interest, told us about their filter system and we decided quickly to have it installed.  We have had them out to check some things we were curious about and fix a gurgling sound when the water dropped directly from the drain into the pea trap.  Every interaction with any of the employees in the office or in our home was courteous, friendly, knowledgeable, and eager to do the work in a timely manner.  I cannot say enough about our satisfaction throughout the process.

reviews.author: Truly Callaway
reviews.text: Recntly, I gave my husband an early birthday present, and we became VIP members for plumbing/electrical work! Jay Field and an associate were at our house the morning of  March 19th, 2025, to check the new timer switch that my husband purchased at a local hardware store.  The instructions for the installation of this timer were quite complex. We decided to have Plumbline supply/install a new "customer friendly" digital timer for our front porch. We also had a whole house surge protector installed on our main electrical panel, and two led dimmer switches were installed in our kitchen.  We were very pleased and appreciative of the work that this experienced crew did at our house. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jason Gooden
reviews.text: They came to my house to clean the main. They managed to get the water to flow through but it clogged again 5 min after they left. They came back and refunded their fee. Then it was all about tens of thousands in upsell for a main sewer line replacement. Their drain cleaning service is only about selling the next project. Another plumber came out the following day, cleaned the drain, scoped it to show the result and all is well now. Be very careful these guys. The smiling faces and professional demeanor mask the aggressive business they're in.

reviews.author: Mongo Madman
reviews.text:
It was time for the annual servicing of our HVAC. All went well, except: (Sorry for knocking down the rating by 1 star here)

That night I woke up freezing around 1:40AM and looked at the thermostat and saw it failed 14 times to light the igniter. Went down to the basement to look at the unit and saw the valve for the main gas line was still turned OFF (Oopsie!) turned it back on and the heater fired up and wamed the house fairly quickly after that.

Besides 1 minor human  mistake it was a good overall experience.

reviews.author: BENNETT Price
reviews.text: I had a concern regarding my GFCI wall plugs and light switches in my kitchen that was remodeled in 2014. It was easy to make an appointment. The tech called ahead to provide an ETA. He arrived shortly later. He assuaged my concerns after testing the wall plugs, each showing the normal 120 volts. He indicated that there are no standardized GFCI, so different providers have different protocols. He examined my circuit breaker boxes and found no concerns. Because I am a VIP member, there was no service charge.

reviews.author: Dale Morris
reviews.text: Response did not seem urgent. 22 hours between my afternoon call and the repair. They initially said they would be out the next morning so I turned away other plumbers that may have addressed the leak sooner. $800 for under an hour on site seems high. Yes, they told me the price before completing the job, but no estimate was given when the problem was described the day before. Plumber himself was professional and explained the repair, even wrote up an estimate for a water heater replacement while on site.

reviews.author: Renee B
reviews.text: Came out same day on a weekend to fix a clogged pipe that our snake couldn't reach, was so pleased with the service my husband gave him extra.  He said, "Professional conduct and very considerate of mess.  Clear and upfront about pricing.  Took time to answer my questions and recommend preventative future measures. I have only good things to say.  Logan (the plumber who came) did a fantastic job and really seemed to know what he was doing."  Seriously couldn't ask for better.

synthesis.summary: Technicians are genuinely skilled and courteous, but pricing on major jobs like water heaters can run 2-3x market rate and drain cleaning visits may be structured to push expensive upsells.
strengths: Multiple reviewers across recent months praise thorough cleanup and technician professionalism by name (Nando, Jonathan, Peyton, Marcus), suggesting consistent field staff quality
At least 2 reviews note same-week or next-day scheduling for non-emergency installs, and one VIP member highlights 24/7 access as a concrete benefit
One reviewer was actually charged less than quoted when the job turned out simpler than expected, a rare and notable sign of honest billing on smaller jobs
weaknesses: Two BBB-sourced reviews document water heater bills of $6,000-$7,000 against initial quotes of $1,600 or verbal expectations around market rate, with one reviewer calling the final price 3x the going rate
One reviewer reported a 22-hour response window for an active leak after being told morning arrival was guaranteed, causing them to turn away other plumbers who could have responded sooner
redFlags: Two separate reviews allege predatory upselling during vulnerable moments: one involving a carbon monoxide emergency, another involving an 89-year-old customer pressured into unneeded equipment, both resulting in bills near $6,000-$7,000

One reviewer explicitly states drain cleaning visits are designed to generate upsell leads rather than resolve the problem, and a competing plumber resolved the same clog the next day without recommending a full line replacement
25 BBB complaints in 3 years despite an A+ rating, combined with a 2/5 Yelp average, suggests a pattern of billing disputes that Google's large review volume may be diluting
synthesis.emergencyNotes: One VIP member cites 24/7 access as a specific membership benefit, but the only documented emergency-adjacent case (carbon monoxide situation) resulted in a $7,000 charge the customer later called exploitative, so after-hours availability may come at a steep premium.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.8/5 across 1,167 reviews while Yelp sits at 2/5 across 4 reviews, and BBB logs 25 complaints in 3 years despite an A+ accreditation, with the Yelp and BBB records disproportionately reflecting billing disputes and aggressive upselling that are nearly invisible in the Google aggregate.

reviews.author: Zoomy Zombies
reviews.text: Priority Home Services truly impressed me when they replaced my old water heater. The technician arrived right on time, was polite, and clearly knew what he was doing. He took the time to explain the installation process, checked all the connections for leaks, and even hauled away the old unit for disposal. The new system works perfectly, and my water heats faster than ever. It’s refreshing to work with a company in Northern Colorado that combines professionalism, quality workmanship, and genuine customer care. I’ll definitely be using Priority Home Services again for future maintenance.

reviews.author: Cheryl Reyes
reviews.text: Priority Home Services installed our mini split in record time and the quality is superb. The technician was patient, professional, and walked me through every step of the installation. He tested the airflow, sealed everything tightly, and even showed me how to clean the filters. The attention to detail really stood out. It’s great knowing we have such a reliable company right here in Northern Colorado

reviews.author: Desert Truth
reviews.text: We had a strange burning smell coming from our heater in Broomfield, and we were worried something serious was wrong. I called Priority Home Services and got Cassandra on the phone — she was incredible. She reassured us, explained the process, and got a technician scheduled right away. The HVAC tech showed up promptly, found the issue, and fixed it safely. Cassandra even called the next day to make sure everything was running smoothly. It’s rare to find that level of professionalism and kindness these days.

reviews.author: C B.
reviews.text:
This company is a rip off. I was quoted over the phone $139, but ended up paying $460. They even charged us 3 percent since we were using a credit card! That right there is not good customer service. That service should be free! The guy came out and put his rotor in, it got stuck and he completely shredded the pipe, it was pinched right there so it need to be replaced anyway. He took the enamel off of the tile in our bathroom with his machine. He wanted another $169 to put a camera down there, and then another $139 to locate it!!! Insane. Where he located it outside wasn't where the break even was, Come to find out. it was like 8ft away. He told us we had to take down the neighbors rock wall and pull out all of his trees and bushes (four). Also, it was our responsibility to re-build the Rock wall and they weren't going to put the rocks back. They wanted 5,800 to fix the break outside, in addition to the $460. I got another opinion (thank god) and they came out, didn't have to take down the rock wall or the bushes and did it for 2,700!! It pays off to shop around and get second/third opinions. The Pipe MD was amazing!!! And cheap.

I also noticed that the owner only responds to positive five star reviews on yelp. Again, not good customer service at all. I wasn't going to mention the "plumber" who came out, but Ian just responded to my post and marked it funny. Again, do not use this company!!!

reviews.author: Larissa V.
reviews.text: Replaced kitchen line and floor drain our main line in 2016. They put in a new line and did a horrible job a jackhammering out the concrete. As you can see from other pictures they do not remove the concrete like they should. Did they get the job done, yes. Is it ugly and we are at risk for water leaking into the concrete foundation now, also yes. I wish I would have know this before hiring them to jack-hammer my councrete out.  Do your homework, I should have.

reviews.author: Austin L.
reviews.text:
SEAN FARRIS Where to even begin. Dealing with priority plumbing has been one of the worst experiences in recent memory. I still sit here with a ruined front yard, holes in my walls, leaking plumbing, and inadequate water pressure due to undersized and out of code piping. To preface, this was a house we purchased and had some items to fix(replace galvanized and main). The work was done by priority and paid for by our seller's insurance. Let me say I understand insurance companies pay for the bare minimum, but the work is/was atrocious. The sellers were as appalled as we were. The work that was done I'm about to outline was appalling and bordering intentional. I have retained an attorney and will be careful to just give facts. I am skeptical of all the 5* reviews.

Picture the moment you close on your house, filled with excitement; pull up to see the yard completely torn apart, with a giant dirt mound, sod mixed in not separate ruined (pictured). I then go into the house and turn on the bathroom faucet, notice low water pressure, I turn on the second and flush the toilet...barely a dribble. There was no issues with water pressure during inspection, just galvanized pipe to be replaced per contract. I then open the cabinet and to my horror see (pictured) the drywall cut out with pex running through just hanging there like a crack head cutting holes in the wall for copper. There is excellent access from the basement, there is no need for this. I run to the kitchen and find the same (pictured). I then go down to the basement and find they ran  1/2" pex off the water main, and found the water main leaking badly.

I immediately contact priority and they send a supervisor. He tries to gaslight and tell me the aerators on the sinks are plugged, and that they didn't change the pressure. After showing him prior inspection videos he agrees they will run ¾" properly with a manifold off the main (don't get me started on the manifold, they ran EVERYTHING in the house off a single  1/2" line). I was told they WILL NOT BE FIXING THE DRYWALL, that's just how they do it. NO, NO that's not how you do that. At this point I call in my main plumber for house flips. He was absolutely irate; said they easily could have removed the existing pipes and ran pex without destroying the walls. He said it would've cost them $20 to properly run a manifold for the pex off the main and had no water pressure issues. I give up with priority to come back again and address the issue, they lied to my face a second time for the "fix".

After weeks of phone calls trying to get the front yard at least compacted and leveled out, which I think is a REASONABLE thing to have already been done, we we're finally told someone was coming out.

SEAN FARRIS, the Vice President, the man himself actually took the time to come out and take a look. Sean agreed it looked bad without needing explanation and said they "don't normally do this, but we will this one time come back and level it". I explained to Sean, I build pipelines, when they replaced the main line, they didn't even compact it or level out. Then I get the same lie as the other supervisors, "that will level out over time". Let me explain, it's a 12" high mound, with sod mixed in, it may settle a few inches with some water compacting, but it needs to be leveled. Sean agreed someone would call and they would send someone out. IT'S BEEN 3 WEEKS AND NO CALL, NO CALL BACKS.

SEAN, I guess if this is how your crews leave things when taking on insurance work, maybe you shouldn't take on the work if you leave someone's house looking like a crackhead just came through it. Or do you all always do the bare minimum everywhere you go?

Long story short, I'll fix the yard myself over a weekend, and I hired my plumber for $1,000 to fix everything inside.

Curious question for Priority, at the very least, why didn't you offer me an estimate to fix anything additional out of scope instead doing a terrible job? You had the opportunity to earn my business and I would've used you here for the life of this house...

Stay far. FAR. AWAY

reviews.author: Brianna C.
reviews.text:
**Edit to company response from google 5/30/24 I am partial homeowner, I took ownership in 2021 through the existing mortgage.
My mother also the owner and policy holder - whom you guys have avoided and who is at a communication disadvantage due to english being her second language, I have had to step in.
We, the client of HomeServe a Home Warranty company - would never have to pay for your services. That is why I pay for home warranty and have full coverage for my mainline.

The issues I have as a homeowner and an unfortunate customer of Priority and Plumbing due to them being contracted by HomeServe
- Said they would fix our sprinkler lines and electrical in Nov 2023 they destroyed.
- Got avoided by this company for 6 months UNTIL it was discovered they didn't replace 4ft of the original pipe that had SEVERE root intrusion (the entire reason we got our mainline replaced.)
- 05/01/2024 Sean Farris said they would fix the sprinklers and has avoided us once again.

This company absolutely did not go above and beyond. Priority Plumbing and Heating HAD to come back to fix a problem they were legally contracted to fix in Nov 2023 and did NOT complete.

Above and beyond for adding some soil?
The stress and financial burden this has caused has been significant.

Original post 5/29/2024
Another bad Sean Farris (VP/ Owner) review on a mainline replacement (Estimated $18,000+ Insurance job.) On November 9, 2023 Priority Plumbing and Heating Littleton was hired to replace and install a new mainline on our property by my home warranty company (HomeServe.) They acted in several negligent ways, did not complete the job they were paid to perform, destroyed my front yard, sprinkler lines and electrical.
When we raised the concerns to Sean - Sean Farris, told us to kick rocks and that our concerns were not his issue. We were persistent and knew this job was not done correctly. He continues to give us the run around for 6 months, he was conveniently always in a "meeting." After paying a 3rd party to scope out and make note of all the things Priority Plumbing and Heating did wrong, they told me it would be $18k+ to fix their mistakes. I had a demand letter written up to get them to pay attention to the issues that I had complained about for 6 months.
Things they did wrong:
- Did not backfill our soil causing a sinking trench.
- Cut all of our sprinkler lines/ electrical and buried them.
- Failed to replace our mainline in its entirely, left with severe root intrusion.
-  Failed to clean up -  left old clay pipe strung along our front yard.
- Clean out caps were below ground level, improperly glued and secured.

Fast forward May 01 2024 - Priority Plumbing and heating said they would replace the rest of the line that they failed to replace the first time, clean up the trash they left, back fill our soil that was sinking into a trench, and get someone to fix our sprinkler lines/ electrical.
Once Sean and his crew came to fix their original issues - his crew member showed us that our mainline was leaking sewage into our front yard for six months from. Sean never mentioned anything to us other than everything looks great.

Now its a month later 5/28/24 - Sean Farris wont return my phone calls about getting our sprinkler lines/ electrical fixed, he continues to be in "meetings"

Company's motto is - we were paid to replace the line and thats it. If we break it, its not our issue.
Spent over $3,000 to get my sprinkler lines and electrical fixed, had to pay to get my line scoped by a third party. Spent 6 months trying to get them to fix their mistakes. Avoid at all costs 

They came back was because they HAD to. HomeServe was made aware Priority Plumbing and Heating did not perform the job in its entirety that they were paid to do. IF not for that, I would still have sewage leaking into my yard, unfinished mainline, a sinking trench etc.

5/28 President of Priority called my fiancé after leaving a bad BBB review because he was required to by the BBB. He was NOT trying to resolve the issue and make it right but wanted the complaint taken down.

reviews.author: Sami L.
reviews.text:
We worked with Priority four years ago to get a new furnace, water heater and AC. A young kid (19?) came and installed everything, and then needed to return to our house four separate times to fix various issues.

A few years later we started experiencing issues with our air conditioner. We called Priority and they looked at our system and told us everything was installed wrong, and they wanted to make it right and replace everything. After three weeks passed with no follow-up from Priority, we found out the employee was falsely promising replacement systems and claiming to be a manager.

Another manager came out and looked at our system and agreed the install was very poorly done and they made some larger adjustments to our furnace and AC. We appreciated their dedication to their reputation and making sure their work was done right.

Since then, we are still having issues with our AC. It seems simply because the one they sold us is much too large for our home. Our pipe freezes on a regular basis. They've come back out three times with bandaid solutions, but we are still having issues. We tried again this week. They blew off two scheduled appointments and still have not addressed the issue. All we want is for this to be made right so we can both move on.

My husband has tried politely and repeatedly with no luck, so I thought I'd come here to air my grievances. I wanted to be sure people looking to hire them knew about their lack of communication, as well as selling us on a product way above what we needed, as well as a consistently poor delivery on that product. Please step up and make this right.

reviews.author: Colorado R.
reviews.text:
Priority Plumbing and Heating now at the top of my Most Unreliable Contractors list ... I've been a property manager/ owner for over 12 years now, I've worked with numerous contractors, and there are a lot of good reliable and trustworthy businesses out there ... but Priority Plumbing is BY FAR THE WORST plumbing company I've ever had to deal with in all those years. They've been unable to finish a job that was started almost 18  MONTHS AGO, TERRIBLE communication, and ZERO follow through on anything they say to your face. If you care about your sanity, stay away from this company, save yourself the stress of being ignored and having your job go unfinished.

I've spoken with the owner/manager Bob and the secretary Melony MANY times face-to-face, and have also texted / called numerous times for updates, but for some reason these two keep passing the blame/responsibility back and forth to each other on who is supposed to Draft the Plans for a simple Backflow Installation and give it to Pikes Peak Regional Bldg. to once and for all inspect their work and get the permit passed. I can't get ANY clear answer from either of them, ever, and they've had More Than Enough opportunity to finish the job they started... Did you install it incorrectly and don't want to stand behind your work? What exactly is going on here?!

INVOICE# 16648610 dated July 13, 2021... you have my number, please figure out your nonsense.

reviews.author: Mike A.
reviews.text:
At first i was happy with the service, except for the gash in my front door they left as they banged the door with the new unit. But then i went to change the air filter after it had been in use for 6 weeks and discovered the technician did not put a filter in the unit. Actually, let me correct that. He might have, but the water heater had a gas leak i discovered the day after they replaced the AC/ furnace.  He may have taken the filter out then and then forgot to put it back. Good thing i discovered that gas leak, or i may have gone caboom since the furnace room is closed and it would probably exploded before i smelt the gas. 

When the tech came out to address the missing filter, all they wanted to do was put a filter in. Funny how critical it is to replace the filter every month, but when they drop the ball it's not a big deal. I have pictures of the sludge coming off the coils, but they tell me it's all good, evenv guy though my electric bill went from $115 to $175 last month. 

When you spend $10,000 on a new furnace/ac, you expect to have a new efficient unit. Guess i have to learn to live with it. Least i can do is let everyone know to double check these guys' work, less you end up wondering how did you get screwed here when 
you were just trying to do the right thing.

reviews.author: Sean Morris
reviews.text:
Update:  The manager called me and we discussed other options to make the situation right. I got a partial refund but after a month the sink began leaking from around the drain and the plumbers putting came out. I called back and was told I'd have to pay to have someone come out and look at it

Hired Priority to redo the piping under my kitchen sink and install a garbage disposal. The plus side is they could schedule quickly and were very communicative. The rest was unfortunately not good. The plumber took almost 5 hours, installed the wrong piping (not even installing a p trap), left a large mess, and spilled PVC Primer on the floor (not using a drop cloth). When I turned on the water, it leaked everywhere. They were responsive and sent out a supervisor the next day that confirmed the issues. To their credit they were very responsive, polite, admitted fault, and tried to make it right. The piping was fixed, the flooring couldn't be cleaned and we got a partial refund but probably not enough to truly replace it and the hassle of an extra day of dealing with it and having to try to fix the flooring ourselves. Everyone was very nice and responsive, but the service was extremely poor.

reviews.author: Matthew K.
reviews.text:
I had Priority replace my main water line in October of 2018. At the time i felt that the did a really good job. Keith did a good job of selling his company. They were NOT the lowest bid, at $4500.00. I did have a lower bid from PipeX, who has pissed me off in the past by doing quick and dirty work, I went with Priority anyway because i thought they would do better quality work.

Well, turns out they use cheap parts. It's been almost 2 years (22 months) and I just noticed that the ball valve the put in as the main shut off has been leaking and is nearly rusted out. I contacted their office to see if they would cover the repair, and of course, since it's been over a year, they won't. A quality ball valve should not leak after 2 years, not even after 20 and a company should be willing to back their work for more than a year. Use quality parts and you shouldn't have a problem.

If you use them for any plumbing, I would get your own parts and not let them use the cheap contractor pack stuff they get. It will save you some effort or money later. I'll be replacing both my main water line valves myself.

reviews.author: John P.
reviews.text:
I have used Priority 6 times in the last 5 years.  I called and spoke to Suzanna on 11/23/22 regarding a scope (camera inspection) that was done by Nathan on 6/13/2021.  I told her I was afraid I was going to have a very expensive sewer line replacement but I needed to have a copy of the scope, which I paid for, but a copy was never provided.  She said due to the holidays the manager would need to call me back the following Monday.  I told her sure have a nice Thanksgiving and I'll wait to hear from her Manager.  The following week, I receive a call from her Manager and she states "point blank" I don't know why Nathan didn't give you a copy (since you paid 199.00 for it) but they only keep them for 6 six months, PERIOD!!  I stood there shell shocked for a minute and asked her for any assistance she could provide....she told me to have a nice day and hung up.............SERIOUSLY!!!
AVOID, AVOID, AVOID!!  The sad thing is I left them a STELLAR 5 STAR review
a few years back....how times change !!!

reviews.author: Amanda S.
reviews.text: I have worked with many pluming company's and by far this is the worse pluming company out there. We were scheduled on a Thursday and they didn't come out time schedule then when I called office Ezabel said they had a emergency job and had to reschedule me on a Monday. Sure enough Monday came and the tech came parked in the lot took a picture from the car didn't bother to come out of the car and reported the office a no show. I stepped out watching him leave the parking lot and and he went up and down the street then left. I called the office right away they said no one was there so we left and the lied to me that the tech is on the way back, I waited an hour and called the office back they Ezabel lied to me again and said we need to have a manager call you, Ben called me back and said we are not coming out we had to many issues. They are a lying company, the tech the office worker and the manager. Do NOT trust this company ever.

reviews.author: Tabatha A.
reviews.text: This guy is a joke. The $400 plus work done to replace the tube vent on swamp cooler tore. The guy was to replace the entire thing but only replaced the bottom portion. I called Keith who had got attitude upon finding out I posted bad review on the furnance they installed: he said it's been a year and warranty not valid. I said the cooler was used only 3 months. The rest of the year it's not used. He argued with me and demanded yea & no answers. He demanded I take down bad review or he won't help me. I told him all the times and issues I had with furnance and he should of came out personally to fix it and it's bad customer service to argue with the customer over their faulty work and over charging in the swamp tube: he says he'd call me back when he returns from vacation but never did. The original tube lasted 33yrs!!! Their tube only 3 months! Now I have guys here replacing it from another company guess what! For free!!!

synthesis.summary: Dispatcher team (Cassandra, Marsha, Myesha) gets you scheduled fast even late at night, but billing surprises and sloppy workmanship on complex jobs make this a gamble for anything beyond a straightforward fix.
strengths: After-hours emergency response is a standout: at least 3 reviews describe late-evening or urgent calls answered immediately and technicians dispatched within minutes
Front-office staff consistently praised by name across multiple reviews — Cassandra, Marsha, and Myesha each credited for calm, clear scheduling under pressure
Several reviews cite competitive pricing compared to alternatives, including one customer who paid nearly half what their home warranty plumber quoted
weaknesses: At least 2 reviews document final bills far exceeding phone quotes — one customer was quoted $139 and charged $460, another quoted $149 and charged $274 for identical work

Two reviews flag shoddy physical workmanship: one mentions wrong piping installed with no P-trap and a large mess left behind, another shows poor concrete removal that left the foundation at risk for water infiltration
redFlags: Billing bait-and-switch pattern appears in at least 2 separate reviews spanning 2017–2019, with phone quotes significantly lower than on-site charges — one tripled in final cost
Google (4.8/49) vs. Yelp (3.3/45) gap of 1.5 stars is substantial; Yelp is where the billing complaints and workmanship failures are concentrated, suggesting the Google picture may be incomplete

Several recent 5-star reviews reference 'Priority Home Services' rather than 'Priority Plumbing and Heating' and mention HVAC/mini-split work in Boulder and Broomfield — possible review mixing from a related or rebranded entity, which inflates the visible rating
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Confirmed after-hours emergency capability: one reviewer called late evening for a backing-up laundry drain in Fort Collins and had a technician on-site the same night; another had a water heater replaced same-day; dispatcher answered immediately in all described urgent situations.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.8 stars while Yelp sits at 3.3 — the 1.5-star gap is driven by billing disputes and workmanship complaints that appear almost exclusively on Yelp, suggesting Google reviews skew toward simple, successful jobs.

plumbers.name: Horsetooth Heating, Air & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1420 Riverside Ave #102, Fort Collins, CO 80524, USA

reviews.author: Craig Vollmer
reviews.text: I had Jacob & Lael come to my house to replace the 17 year-old water heater. They were on time Professional nice did an amazing job and made sure everything was in working order.  I really don’t know how much more you could ask. Just a fantastic experience. I would recommend Horsetooth heating and air and feel confident that they would make me look good thank you.!

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Horsetooth Heating and Air! Last month, a different local company overlooked our blown furnace motor, which created a hazardous situation. After a recommendation from the fire department, we turned to Horsetooth Heating and Air, and they were incredibly helpful right from the first call—clearly explaining our options and accommodating the mistakes that were made from the other company.
Ben was fantastic to work with; he patiently helped us select the right equipment and made sure the whole plan fit our needs perfectly. The installation team—Damion, Roman, and Lars— worked very timely, professionally, and knowledgeably. The owner, Kyle, even stopped by on the final install day. They kept the work area inside and outside of the home clean throughout and even added helpful labels on the new units (like filter change instructions) so we’d know exactly what to do going forward.
We can’t recommend Horsetooth Heating and Air highly enough. We’re thrilled with the new units we have, and we have complete confidence in the quality of their work!

reviews.author: Taco Cat
reviews.text:
1. Realistic & competitive estimate.
2. Professional courtesy for unexpected issues (on my side, not theirs)
3. Replaced 2 water heaters. 1st for slab floor. 2nd everything else.
4. Replaced a few other big ticket "plumbing" items as well.
5. These guys know what they're doing.

Thanks again Horsetooth Heating & Plumbing!!

reviews.author: Catherine Herzog
reviews.text: The whole team at Horsetooth Heating Air & Plumbing are absolutely excellent. I was contacted immediately after requesting a quote online and had clear, incredibly prompt, thorough communication with the entire team for scheduling (Misha), quotes, questions, rebates and education on the projects we hired for. Jay S provided our quotes (HVAC and insulation) and was so knowledgeable, informative, reliable, enthusiastic, and accomodating to ensure we had each and every one of our questions answered thoroughly. The subcontractors for insulation (Koala: Sergio and team) were excellent and Horsetooth communicated all aspects of the job well so the job went smoothly. The HVAC team was top notch and dedicated to excellence in both install and in respecting and caring for the workspace. This was a seamless experience where we felt listened to and valued and the entire team earned our trust and business. I highly recommend Horsetooth for a variety of home products. They deeply care about doing right by their customers and doing the job well. Thanks Horsetooth!

reviews.author: John Fusaro
reviews.text: I can always count on Horsetooth HAP to do a job well.  In particular their technician, Justin.  Justin has been to our home on several occasions to do plumbing, install a water heater and his last visit was to replace an old bathroom sink faucet with a new one.  The old one was completely rusted and hard to remove but Justin was able to complete the replacement.  He is diligent, courteous,  clean, detail oriented, respectful of property, and knowledgeable.  He is a true professional and keeps you informed throughout the process.  When the job was completed he performed a courtesy household water pressure check.  Justin is an asset for Horsetooth HAP and is the kind of employee that I would want working for me.  This is a quality company that I highly recommend without any reservations.

reviews.author: Justin Roesch
reviews.text: Horsetooth Heating and Air DID NOT complete work for me, so this is less a reflection of craftsmanship as it is a affirmation of their communication practices, work ethos, and integrity: I asked Horsetooth to provide an estimate for air sealing and insulation replacement for our FoCo home. Jay gave a very thoughtful evaluation of the property and even gave me a recommendation for a competitor to get a fair bid. After reviewing the scope of the project Horsetooth told me that the job could probably be handled by a sub-contractor rather than going through their company (in an effort to save the customer money). I appreciated the honesty and their ease of communication. IF their quality of work is reflective of the customer experience I had, you'll be in good hands.

reviews.author: Marilyn Wagner
reviews.text: Horsetooth HVAC is definitely a 5 star company in every way.  On examination our poorly functioning 20 year old system was near total failure.  My son is a 100% disabled Vet and heating and AC are vital to him.  Realizing total replacement was necessary but would be difficult in many ways- Horsetooth HVAC pursued a program for total system replacement.  They coordinated with Rheem, FOOTHILLS Electric and Wounded Warriors for the total replacement.  The team were so kind, professional and skilled as they carried out the miracle! The work was done to the highest standards and with such respect!  We totally recommend this company and my son is now in a safe and comfortable environment.  We recommend them highly and appreciate this company in every way!!

reviews.author: Rachel & Matt Luizza
reviews.text:
Had Taylor come for a HVAC maintenance and it was an amazing experience. It was our first time using Horsetooth Heating, Air & Plumbing's and Taylor spent over two hours working on our system testing it, cleaning it, and getting it into great condition for the season.  He then took the time to talk with us about what he did and how the system was working. We appreciated that he didn't try to upsell us on a bunch of stuff as has happened to us in the past by other companies.

Everything from scheduling, to the appointment, and post-visit follow up has been great.  We are happy to have found our new go-to HVAC company and 10 out of 10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Richard Poché
reviews.text: Tech thought issue was gasline was closed. I stressed it was not the issue. I closed the valve in the event of a leak. I shared that when I turned the unit on it did not click or attempt to light. I shut everything down before tech arrived for 4 hours. It apparentely started right up when he arrived. I explanied what I noticed. He then checked component that was sensitive and clicked on and off. He ordered the part and will install at a later date. He suggested I tap the sensor if the unit did not fire up.

reviews.author: Ben R.
reviews.text:
Josh did a routine service check yesterday on our HVAC installed by HHA&P last summer. He discovered the humidifier was not properly installed/working and fixed that for us. He also educated us on the condensate filter, which we had no idea existed and needed to be monitored.

I'm disappointed these were missed in the original install, but I also understand a new HVAC system is a large project and things happen. Thanks again to Josh for being so thorough in his inspection and taking the time to educate us.

reviews.author: Brennan A
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience with Horsetooth heating & air! From start to finish, everything was smooth, professional, and efficient. Josh, the technician, was great - knowledgeable, friendly, and incredibly thorough in explaining what needed to be done. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was working perfectly before he left. It’s rare to find someone who takes such pride in their work. I highly recommend this company, and if you can request Josh, definitely do - you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Jenn S
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Horsetooth Heating Air & Plumbing replacing our water heater, furnace, and AC. From the beginning, Ben was very responsive and helpful with quotes. Misha provided excellent service and support with scheduling and all my questions. And all the technicians were fantastic - they provided great service, were knowledgeable, and very respectful of our house: thank you Jacob, Dylann, Lars, John, Jay, Josh, Steve and Taylor. We would highly recommend Horsetooth.

reviews.author: Lana Norz
reviews.text: I was nervous to call a company for a water heater issue, my friend was busy and I needed hot water assp. I'm so glad I called these guys!!!!! Great experience, the men were extremely knowledgeable. They found and corrected issues from past installs, what a good friend I have jkjk! reviews.text:

reviews.text: After having good service with Allen before I figured I would reach out for a quote. In the afternoon I got a call from a Grand junction number, they left a message, saying they are calling for me, then the message cut off. I didn't call back because I figured it was some sort of telemarketer. Then alittle while later my wife got a call saying since we were a no call no show and we needed to reschedule. So they rescheduled for the next day. Again I was at home all day. Finally later in the afternoon my wife called to check on the status, the dispatcher said the technician tried calling both numbers with out success. It's safe to say we won't their services again and if someone asks who we recommend will make sure to say we don't recommend them because of this. Waste of time unfortunately.

reviews.author: Antonette A.
reviews.text:
To Whom It May Concern:

Do not use Allen Plumbing and Heating, it is a terrible company in Fort Collins and they are not trustworthy. They are disrespectful and rude, pushy, and did not follow through, and they use unethical financing, scare tactics, and bait and switch tactics.  

Here is what I experienced with them:
1. Last year we had issues with a clog downstairs in our in our old town home, and could not do laundry. Allen representatives were pushy and said we needed a new "clean out" on the exterior of the house. However, we had a perfectly usable "clean out" with easy access to the basement. They used scare tactics and went over all the worst-case scenario options stating that we had excrement floating under the house and we needed to take action immediately. They then looked to see where the city's pipes entered and exited from the house and the Master Plumber said he absolutely knew it was in the backyard. The city was doing work on our streets and they were able to let the master plumber know that he was incorrect. However, this master plumber continued to show extreme arrogance and pushed us more and said that it was necessary once the "clean out" was created outside to have a flush out as well as a new pipe input (requiring they dig a trench) on the side of the house to get rid of the waste underneath the house. They said that if we didn't get a new pipe on the side of the house, the pipes would continue to plug up since we had "bellies and dips" that needed to be fixed. They pushed financing and we agreed to find out what we qualified for. Once they knew how much we qualified for, they said that was the same amount it would cost to do all of this work. This was an incredible amount of money beyond $28,000. Other companies were not this expensive for all of this work. All of Allen's options were very expensive and they bragged about their Master Plumber overseeing everything. In addition, they then showed us that once they were able to open the "clean out" and flush out the pipe, we would need to start the work on the side yard. We only agreed to an exterior "clean out", and flushing the current pipe out. 
2. They dug the ground and created a "clean out" and they said they would flush the pipes. We had to contact them several times so that they would come and follow through with flushing out our pipe and use a camera to check our pipes. In the meantime, we were not able to do laundry for weeks. They contacted an excavator to open up our pipes and check for boring and they hired a company out of Greeley. They pulled a City of Fort Collins permit. This permit was opened but it was never closed and it was Allen's responsibility to have the City of Fort Collins investigate and request the permit be closed. In fact, this permit is still open as of today, October 9, 2023. 
3. All in all, after many calls, they flushed out the pipes and used a video camera to check the pipes. I requested a copy of the video but they did not provide it to me, even after being billed for several thousands of dollars. Now the City of Fort Collins is requesting that Allen finalize their work with them and we are at risk of having to pay several more thousands of dollars. 
4. We are more than dissatisfied with Allen and we will be taking them to small claims court. I will share this letter with the Better Business Bureau, and all social media outlets such as Facebook, Yelp, Google, etc. for overcharging us for the work they did, for taking several days and weeks to address our clog, for not allowing us to have a copy of the video that they took, for baiting and switching us with unethical finance tactics, and for not responsibly closing the permit with the City of Fort Collins.

To sum up, we spent more than approximately three weeks unable to do laundry after already signing the financing paperwork, and their work was not completed. I regret ever working with Allen and I highly recommend that anyone needing plumbing, stay as far away from Allen Plumbing and Heating because they are the worst company in Fort Collins.

Sincerely, 
Antonette

reviews.author: Jay H.
reviews.text:
Original complaint :
Don't waste your time on" preferred customer"  its a waste, and they won't prefer you at all. Matter of fact, they will disrespect you at every turn.

Unbelievable lack of service and response. I've called numerous times asking to speak to a supervisor to get warranty information for my home that has had 3 backups in a year.

In June of 2022, we contacted Allen service as our pipes had clogged and caused a backup in the basement of our home, causing major damage to my 10 year old daughters room. They told us it was caused by roots in the pipes outside our home that relining our outside pipe would solve the issue. 22 thousand dollars out of pocket later.  As the project ends, they promise I will receive a final video , receipt, and warranty information . This never happens.

Fast forward 8 months, and a backup happened again,  flooding my 10 year old daughters room with urine and feces , again.

We call Allen service, and with our preferred customer, they can come over 24 plus hours later and charge us almost 600 dollars to unclog the pipe.  At this time, they promised that the excavation supervisor would call to come out and do a video to discuss options. This never happened.

3 months later, and it happens again! The same issue they promised to fix for 22 thousand dollars in June of 2022! This time, they don't charge us based on the warranty from the last visit. They unclog the pipe, and it is outside the house . They promise that the excavation supervisor would call and come out to do a video consult again, but of course, they never call .

A week later, I call them asking  to cancel my preferred customer and they say , " we will make note on the file about canceling preferred customer " and have a manager call, again this Never happens. They didn't cancel as requested or have a supervisor call , again.

I feel like they are forcing me to call the B.B.B. to get a resolution.

Update :
I contacted the BBB and here is Allen Services response:

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us and  bring this to our attention.  As a company, we are committed to providing excellent customer service and high-quality workmanship. Unfortunately, we fell short of this in your case and we sincerely apologize for our poor communication and workmanship.  Please know that we're committed to making things right for you. After our conversation, we sent our supervisor to inspect the line and discovered that the liner was missing from the home to the cleanout.To quickly resolve the issue, we sent a professional to your home to jet the lines and remove any roots causing the backup. We are currently working on a solution to complete the lining from the house to the cleanout. Rest assured, that we're taking all necessary measures to prevent a recurrence.
Our goal now is to regain your trust: but we understand we have to earn it. We have not lived up to the standards we set for ourselves and  we are truly sorry. If you have any questions, please call Danielle direct at 970-494-7606.
Thank you

Called Danielle 8/5/23 left a message at 1pm about not receiving contact for the relining and for being charged for "preferred customer " in July after I requested cancelation in June and July and she promised to cancel but give me 1 year free to " win me back". No call back 8/5.

As of today 8/3/23 I have had no contact from Allen service in almost a month. They have not completed the job and seem to again be lacking in appropriate communication. Calling Danielle tomorrow .
