reviews.author: Aaron A.
reviews.text:
My Experience with Allen Service - Never Again

I will not be using Allen for any future services. I highly recommend doing thorough research and getting quotes before working with them, as they will take advantage of you with inflated prices. They are more interested in how much they can make off you than actually helping you.

Allen reached out to me about a simple, routine water heater drain as part of the service contract I have with them. While I expected to pay for the service, I appreciated their outreach to check in with a member. However, things quickly took a turn for the worse. They sent Logan Edwards, who was inexperienced and failed to properly drain my water heater. He didn't follow standard procedures, and when he couldn't reignite the pilot light, he blamed it on the age of my water heater, claiming it was common.

So, they sent out a senior plumber, Jaden Wright, who immediately told me my only option was to replace the entire water heater for $4600. I was shocked. Then, Jaden claimed he was offering me a "deal" at $4000. What upset me most was when Jaden admitted that Logan had not followed the proper process, which made me think, "This is your fault for sending someone out who doesn't know what they're doing."

I made it clear that my water heater had been working perfectly fine before they arrived, and now, suddenly, it was completely nonfunctional. With temperatures dropping to 20 degrees, I was left in a tough situation, needing hot water. Feeling pressured and stuck, I reluctantly agreed to pay the outrageous price. Jaden even claimed the water heater itself was a $1500 unit and that Allen only sells the best. But after doing some research and getting a couple more quotes, I found the same water heater was available at Lowe's for no more than $700. The other companies I contacted (American Plumbing & Sewer and Noble Plumbing) would have done the same work for $2200 and $2300, respectively.

The next morning, I called Alec Nelson, the manager, to explain the situation. I asked for a $1500 refund, and we eventually settled at $1200. While I felt a bit better, I was still upset about the overpayment for something I didn't even need. The pressure they put me under was created by Allen's own lack of training--either that, or it's part of their business strategy: send out a novice plumber to mess up your equipment, then have a senior tech come in, force you into a no-win situation, and upcharge you twice the market price.

After reflecting on the entire ordeal, I called Alec back to express my disappointment with how Allen takes advantage of its customers. I ultimately exercised my "3-day right of rescission," and Alec immediately agreed to let me keep the water heater they had installed and provide a full refund--though I still had to deal with all the stress and time lost.

While Allen did eventually make things right, it doesn't erase the terrible experience I had. I would have been happy to pay for proper, trustworthy service, but instead, I was met with a greedy company that only cares about making a profit. I would never recommend Allen to anyone. My advice is to find a local shop that provides upfront quotes over the phone and doesn't try to pull a fast one like Allen. They may have resolved the issue in the end, but it doesn't change how poorly I was treated throughout the process.

Shoutout to American Plumbing and Sewer--Lanney and Amy were great and helped me navigate this difficult situation. They are local to Loveland, CO, and I would highly recommend getting their opinion on any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jia Z.
reviews.text:
Allen Service is an unethical, unprofessional, overpriced, underqualified company and they lead customers to financial SCAMs. Their shady "bait-and-switch" financial practice leaves a bad taste. I would advice anyone to AVOID Allen Service in Fort Collins, this scammer company at all cost.  

Heating and dirty financing tricks: Last year we hired them for an inspection on a perfectly functioning furnace. They cited a small problem and persuaded us to buy and install a new furnace with financing plan. Later we learned from our professional friends that the small problem is not only an easy fix, we also OVERPAID our new furnace for 150% market average. The young technician accidentally broke our dry wall and destroyed many of my plants while installing the furnace (fine, shit happens during installation, we understand). The WORST part is the financing plan. Allen Service persuade customers for unnecessary expensive jobs by providing this financing services. When they explained  it to us, it was interest free for the first year and the interest starts to accrue after the first year. However, when getting the real plan, they have switched the terminology and played dirty financing tricks on us.What a "bait-and-switch". In reality, they forces customers to pay 15% as the total interest because you cannot pay the whole amount early and all of the interest appear after one year. Now we are paying an UNNECESSARY new furnace for 200% market average.  

Plumbing: We had a complex plumbing issue this year and called Allen Service. They quoted 150k for a complete remodel (because they can't fix the problem without a whole kitchen/bathroom remodeling) and provided loan option. We hired another company who finished the job in one afternoon for 2k. During their visit, they also told my tenant that they are hiring because my tenant (not plumber) seemed more knowledgeable than their plumber.  General Word of Mouth: We discussed this Allen Service with other friends and it seemed like everyone had an unpleasant experience with them. One friend specifically made and spreadsheet and found that Allen Service charges at least 60% more than the real cost of the job ( cost includes a good technician salary). I do not know how they got this much good review and I suspect the legitimacy of those reviews.  Judge it yourself.

reviews.author: Margie N.
reviews.text:
Hilda P Nigh

my husband had passed away and I didn't know the ins and outs of hiring a plumber when my furnace went out. so I called Allan Services and they told me I needed a new one because mine was old and burned out. I was so confused and they sent a well dressed man to sell me on a new furnace. it was very Formal and he convinced me to sign with the company for a new furnace. I thought I passed when he said it would be $15,000. for a new one. so I signed and paid $5,000. cash to get a new one. Now I'm in Hawk for the remainder of the total. they must have seen me as a dummy and a female who fell for it. then I mentioned my kitchen faucet was no longer working and again sent a young worker to install a new one which ended up costing a thousand. I thought what else can go wrong? well my sewer line in the basement overflowed and I idiot called them. they said they had to go through the toilet downstairs and check the line. I stupidly said ok from the urgency and they charged me $691. and because 5:00 came around he said he had to return the next day to finish the job. I was so frustrated that I called a different plumber that was recommended and they came out and when I said what was charged they said I was taken and they did the same job for $190. and finished the job and said to keep the pipes flowing have it done yearly. they also mentioned I should stop payment with my credit card because they didn't finish the job. which I did. 
people men and women don't be fooled like I was and call Allan Services they will charge big amounts for something that could have been cheaper. when Allan zest I es wanted to know why I didn't have their man return to finish I told them that they over charged and took me for a fool to not question their quote. I should have looked up the company for reviews before doing anything. learn from my mistakes and DO NOT CALL ALLAN SERVICES unless you want to be taken advantage of thank you and beware!

reviews.author: Chris B.
reviews.text:
cancelled on me three times. this is a follow up to an earlier review I left where I'd already been rescheduled twice. Client relations reached out to me and gave me a voucher to cover the cost of maintenance. nice perk. however, upon scheduling my tankless water heater to be descaled a third time, the earliest appointment was another 8 days out, making it already a three week endeavor, and putting in for PTO twice to be available for the appointment. The other fun part is that there is one number on their site for the company, but apparently the early scheduler was giving me techs for the Foco area, as the individual scheduling me for my latest attempt for service mentioned, "huh, you're in the denver area,"....no kidding. you ask my address/area code. not sure how that wasn't automatically changing how you book my appointment.
That brings us to today, when I get a call AFTER THE TIME WINDOW MY TECH WAS SUPPOSED TO CALL FOR WHEN THEY WOULD BE ONSITE. not before, which is consistent with their brand of customer service. the scheduler mentioned that she has to push my appointment out to the week of march 9th, which will make this a 1 month endeavor to get a simple project done. they also mentioned that three of their techs called out with the flu......I would like to say I'm completely understanding of illnesses.....but amidst the current situation and how it was handled, that's incompetence. Especially when you take the time to mention that you only have 2 techs in the area that are trained to do the service I requested. which kind of tells me that either your schedulers need a bit more training on how to handle these kinds of issues, or more likely, you're making up a story.
If you want to wait around, call Allen services. if you want to get your job completed, call someone else. I've now actively lost a day and a half of work/pay trying to utilize their services......at least they have a snazzy website.

reviews.author: Debbie Campbell
reviews.text:
Our experiences with Allen Service have all been positive until now. We discovered that both our furnace and AC needed replacement at the same time (they were old, we knew it was coming) rather than continuing to patch them both. The quotes we were offered ranged from several thousand to almost 2x more than the very highest end of the price range locally for the same type of job. Going back and forth with the quote was very similar to the treatment one gets when buying a car (let me ask my manager). In the end we got $4000 off a mid-priced option and would likely have gotten a further reduction since they immediately agreed to this.

The day of the work the two technicians arrived within about an hour of the planned start time. But - they took 11 hours and 45 minutes rather than the 8 we were told by Allen. No one ever came out to check on progress. They missed dinner and still didn't finish the project, there was a task left undone in the basement and they told us about it. This seemed to be a 3-person job.

The person who quoted us told us he'd be bringing out smoke detectors that were required for the city inspection. I had to call and email several times before someone brought those out - and then the day of the inspection they were not even an issue (though all the work was perfect according to the inspector). I also had to call more than once to get someone to come out and finish the job - they had no idea what I was talking about either.

The new AC can't be tested until it's above 70F. While we had several unusual days in December/early January that met that mark, no one has contacted us and I assume like the rest, it will be up to us to get them to come do that in the spring.

Not the best experience for sure and the pricing was way above the average for this area.

Added March 2026: no one has ever contacted us about testing the AC. Waiting for a response on that now.

reviews.author: J H.
reviews.text:
I recently had Allen Service do an overpriced $16,000 sewer line repair, and it was probably the worst financial decision of my life.

First: The plumber who wrote the handwritten contract, is a 
liar.  I was lied to on at least five occasions.  He promised me again and again that they would provide emailed documentation of the contract as well as an itemized invoice.   I never received any documents from the company.   Jason also made verbal statements clarifying the extent of the work to be done.  These statements were either ignorantly forgotten, or they were lies.  Additionally, Jason and the crew were 1-4 hours late EVERY time they showed up.

Second: Many issues developed from the work completed.
-They left hundreds of pounds of concrete chunks spread literally all over my front yard (which took me 20 hours of labor to remove)
-They left PVC, cast iron pipe, rubber gloves, and straight up trash in the front yard.   Nothing was hauled away.  They attempted to bury all of the work mess in the trench they dug to fix a belly in the yard.  However, the rubbish was only spread on the surface.
-Broke a water line and didn't fix it properly (the water line started to leak after they left, and I ended up fixing the CPVC myself)
-Left exposed wire next to a shower drain
-Left 2x4 framing unsupported when they broke the concrete underneath and caused a small wall to fall down later and destroy the new concrete
-Left pvc pieces under reinstalled carpet, so I had to tear the carpet up and remove it
-Two way clean outs were installed 8 inches bellow grade in the front yard! I had to place large rocks over the clean out location, so if we need to access them, we can locate and dig them out.

This project was to replace less than 15 feet of sewer line.  Save yourself money, stress, and dignity by choosing a company other than Allen Service.

reviews.author: Elizabeth E.
reviews.text:
I just want to warn anyone thinking of using Allen Service --BUYER BEWARE. We had a serious sewer drain issue at our house, and called Allen Service. We've been using them for about two years.

We got the bid to dig a 8'x1' exploratory hole for a little more than $8,000. Of course, we called for second and third opinions. Both other companies came in more than $5,000 lower. 

If that wasn't enough reason to be concerned, I then had reason to check my security cameras that are outside of my house. To my surprise and disgust, the lead guy on the bid job was out there coaching the younger guys how to get us to accept the bid, and how to get us to sign right away, leaving no time for second opinions. I was horrified. 

I called and spoke to someone to cancel the work. They showed up the next day anyhow. That same guy screamed at me on my front porch (also have video of this), and refused to leave. He threatened me that if I didn't let them in to do the work, the company would charge me for "every cent" anyways. It was scary. I was shaking and very alarmed. 

I had interviewed with this company at one point, and was told how they pay their employees. They pay very low wages, and then pay 20% commission to their employees who "up-sell" projects like this one. 

They still have not refunded the deposit they collected the night they put pressure on me to sign, saying that if I didn't sign right then, I'd likely be without water for at least a week and a half, since no other company would do it for less, and they only had time the next day. All bullshit.

They have nice looking trucks and ads on tv, but DO NOT trust this company.

EDIT: Upon further review of the security cameras, Jason, the technician, very clearly calls me a "dumb b*itch". Very professional.

reviews.author: Joe A.
reviews.text:
Scored in multiple categories.

Five stars for employees calling ahead before they arrive. Employees were also very clean and wore boot covers. They were friendly and courteous and paid attention to detail and seemed like they did a good job and left the area clean. 

One stars for corporate waiver forms. I was told that I had to fill out a form saying that I would pay the price or else there would be a certain fee that was a certain percent along with percentages that would accrue as an interest rate and legal fees. Really this was crazy! I would agree to pay the price and give them my credit card and pay immediately but I wasn't signing anything stating that they were going to sue me and I would pay certain percentages and there lawyer costs. It really turned from a friendly agreement on price to a possible litigation agreement. It was a horrible way for a company to build trust with the new customer. It instantaneously broke rapport !



One stars for price. The price for just labor on the toilet replacement in a new house that is only three years old was $525!  According to home advisor.com "A standard toilet install should take between one and two hours to complete and cost an average of $348 or less. Basic installs will run around $115. Unexpected costs could raise the cost up to as much as $800." Unfortunately many plumbers will not give you an estimate over the phone. It is also not easy to compare prices since many plumbers will charge you a fee just to give you an estimate. If there are plumbers out there that are more transparent about their cost and publish them on their website at a fair price then I think they would get a ton of business.

Overall score 2.33 stars.

synthesis.summary: Technicians are skilled and low-pressure, but pricing complaints are severe and consistent — multiple reviewers cite 200-500% markups on parts, and their 24/7 emergency response has at least one documented no-show at 2am.
strengths: At least 6 reviewers specifically praise no hard-sell or upsell pressure, with techs offering options across price points rather than pushing the most expensive fix
Multiple reviews highlight same-day or ahead-of-schedule service completion, and several techs (Tyler, Nate, Mark Hatfield) are called out for diagnosing problems others missed
Technicians consistently described as courteous, thorough, and willing to explain work and answer questions — a pattern across reviews spanning 2017 to 2026
weaknesses: Appointment reliability is a documented problem: at least 3 reviews describe no-shows or back-to-back cancellations with no proactive communication, including one reviewer who took half a day off work and was never called

Parts and labor markups draw repeated outrage — reviewers cite $2,700 charged for a $650 water heater, $480 for a valve worth $30, and a $3,500 hot water heater quote that Home Depot fulfilled for half the price
redFlags: At least 5 reviews independently report extreme pricing — markups described as 200-500% on parts, with one reviewer quoting $28,000 for work competitors priced far lower and another charged $1,300 for a job a countertop installer quoted at $430
One verified 2am emergency call resulted in a no-show until 6:39am the following Monday — a serious risk for a burst-pipe scenario with a family at home

One detailed review describes a permit pulled for excavation work that was never closed with the city, leaving the homeowner exposed to additional liability — and the company never provided the camera inspection video the customer paid for
One review from 2018 documents plumbing work that was not up to code on a $5,000 job, caught only by a second plumber
synthesis.emergencyNotes: They advertise 24/7 emergency service and one reviewer confirms same-day completion, but a documented 2am emergency call resulted in the technician never arriving — do not rely on them as your only 2am call option without a backup.

reviews.author: Eric Unger
reviews.text: Joel came out and put a ton of hard work in snaking my seriously clogged main line. Took some doing but he got it. Very impressed by his tenacity. Don’t know if I would have had the patience he did. Fair price too. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Gil From Greeley
reviews.text: Clogged kitchen drain causing us to call Drain Doctors...Joel arrived that morning and snaked it out...80 feet. Gave us tips to help prevent this from happening again. Friendly and knowledgeable. Might have saved my marriage. 😁

reviews.author: elizabeth meyers
reviews.text: These guys returned my call almost before I'd finished leaving a voicemail about my clogged main sewer line! A friendly, professional technician arrived within half an hour and cleared out the sewer line within minutes. The price was extremely reasonable and the speed of service couldn't have been any better. Thank you!

reviews.author: Andi Lawlor
reviews.text: Called about a septic issue, was told he would be out the next day. We followed up the next day and was told he’d be out the following morning. That never happened and we got ghosted without an explanation. You’re busy, I get it, but this is not good business practice and you wasted two days on a time sensitive issue. We had a great experience with a competitor.

reviews.author: Colorado G.
reviews.text: The first time I called Drain Doctors, they were quick and fixed my drain issues pretty quickly although did I thought the bill was a little high. $230 to have the mainline jetted and cleaned. It has only been a little over a month and my drains are backed up again. When I called today, they weren't able to look up my information. I don't think they have an effective method (a computer) for looking up customers information and paid invoices. I was accused of not paying my bill even though it cleared my account several weeks ago! Also, I called at 8 am this morning and he said they would be there by 11am but did not show up until after 1pm and never called to let me know! I don't think I will be using them to fix my drains again.

reviews.author: Jamie Lohrius
reviews.text: These guys are the absolute best in every way you could think of and that's no exaggeration either - they are simply the lowest/best priced, best top notch professionalism from the time you call in to everyone you will speak with in between and finally to the technicians that come to your house and get the job done, extremely fast to respond and also extremely fast to get the job done, friendly, completely honest (no exaggeration at all), and extremely knowledgeable and helpful. Just great human beings to deal with all around in a mostly thankless job that is a tough job most people would not want to do whatsoever so I see them as basically heroes quite honestly. I called them on Tuesday and left a message with my name number and problem and within the hour, Riley called me back and told me someone would be on the way later in the day and this was at a time when I knew they were extremely busy with many different jobs to deal with but they fit me right in the same day and a few hours later Joel called and said he was 5 minutes from my house and if I was home he would be there in 5 minutes which I was and he was there within exactly 5 minutes. The problem I was facing was standing water in my vent roof stack which brought draining of all connected sinks and drains and toilets in my home to a virtual standstill and basically the next time I flushed the toilet there would have been a backup due to the lack of venting in the main 4" cast iron 98 year old main drain sewer pipe all were connected to. Joel arrived alone and immediately went to work on the top of my roof with 125 foot electric drain auger that had a special yolk cutter attachment on the end and within 20 minutes time put virtually the entire length 115 ft deep into my sewer line until he reached the connecting municipal tap out on the street and augured the complete distance of my sewer line. The standing water in the main roof vent stack finally broke and started to drain at the final 115-ft mark deep so this was plugged back all the way to the municipal main 115 ft away. Joel had the entire distance cleared within 20 minutes of what he told and showed me was heavy sludge and roots and some synthetic lint and sponge material all bound up together. He clean the entire length out and flushed the entire pipe system out afterwards by running the taps and that was that he completely solve the job and did it 100% complete the whole length of the sewer line. No BS here at all just a top professional who's probably seen it all 100 times over and knew exactly what to do and was lightning quick to get it done and done right the first time. I then met him at his truck for the bill he wrote up for me and when he told me the price I had to hesitate out of shock because I could not believe it was so low and I will not tell you how much it was here because I don't think it would be in their best interests but let me just tell you it was unbelievably low to the point of shock. I was expecting about 3 to 4 times the amount he quoted me. I had to do a double take to ask him if this was really the price and he said yes and then I simply paid him and he was off on his way. He also gave me some expert advice for the future in regards to this job as far as the roots he found were concerned and how extensive he thought it might be or a problem in the future and what to do or what not to do and this was extremely helpful. So there is my story with no embellishment or exaggerations. I cannot recommend Drain Doctors any more than to say they have absolutely everything going for them in an ideal drain and plumbing business from the consumer or customers perspective. I could not have asked for a better experience in every single way possible from price to service it was a 10 out of 10. Thanks again to Riley and Joel. You are a rare breed of extremely honest and extremely skilled technicians.

reviews.author: Mike T.
reviews.text:
Our kitchen sink (!) clogged on Friday afternoon . . . apparently it doesn't like chunks of pork, even after chewed up by the disposal.  After  I opened the cleanout plug in the drain line under the sink and snaked it with a 25' snake attached to my 3/8" drill and having NO success, I began looking for a plumber.
I spent a bit of time reading reviews, finally settling on Drain Doctors.  I called around 7:30 a.m. on Saturday morning.  Within an hour, as promised, "Joel" arrived and went to work.
He brought in an electric snake and ran about 60' of line out before he cleared it completely, saying he felt several obstructions along the way.  I had an issue just waiting to happen I believe, and my last little bit of pork gristle was the straw that broke the proverbial camel's back.  Just for good measure, Joel continued until almost 80' of snake had been paid out.
He said he has been in the drain clearing business for 42 years; I believe it.  His little machine cleared my drain in about two hours, all told.
As good as that story is, the best part was the reasonable cost.   His total cost was $115, about as reasonable as anyone could expect for a plumber to show up on demand at 7:30 in the morning!  WOW!  Need a plumber?  Call Drain Doctors!

reviews.author: Nicole B.
reviews.text: I called to have a clog fixed in my kitchen sick. The technician came to my house got under my sink and when unscrewing a pipe broke one of the pipes. The pipe was not in good condition and I had no issue replacing the broken pipe. However upon repairing the broken pipe it seemed like another separate pipe was damaged when the drain was being snaked. After fixing both broken pipes at our own expense I called to let the company know that the original issue of the sink being clogged was still present. The gentlemen, Joel, on the phone asked me how it was even possible for the technician to break the pipe because they go in xy way to snake the drain. I told him I didn't know because I was not a plumber. He said he would have to get his technicians side of the story ... in reality I just wanted to have the clog which was my original issue fixed. What side of the story? I wasn't asking for compensation of my piping, I just wanted the clog (which I was being charged for) to be fixed. After having my piping ruined, being called a liar by Joel on the phone he hung up on me when I was upset. Would NOT recommend this company. Very poor unprofessional service. Well ... not service, because my drain is still clogged.

reviews.author: serialgriller
reviews.text: Had made a call and literally 5 to 10 minutes Donnie was at my door....there's not enough good things to say it took about 45 minutes and he was professional quick knowledgeable and again just not enough good words to say about this guy.....highly highly recommend them ....I waited for Allen's for 3 weeks to do our services and am still waiting for a call back I've called several times a week for 3 weeks .....called these guys ONE TIME and they where there literally the fastest I've ever seen the guy had to be just a house or two down seriously it was THAT FAST.....Donnie can't thank you or praise you enough sir!! Drain doctors ....thank you for everything....maybe give that guy a fat raise or a bigger bonus when the time comes because seriously he deserves it!!

reviews.author: Sean Reifschneider
reviews.text:
Our upstairs bathrooms weren't draining.  Because our main and lower floor were ok, I called in as "not an emergency, whenever you can get to us."  They said they could be over in an hour, but I think it was actually closer to half that.  The tech was professional, personable, and took good care to prevent leaving a mess.  It was a bit of a tricky job, because  the clog was down the side of a T fitting, so the snake wasn't wanting to make that turn.  Working together we were able to come at it after removing a fitting and then he was able to get a giant clog of hair out of the pipe.

This is the second time I've had them come help with a clog, previous time was ~4 years ago, and based on both of these I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.

reviews.author: Tansy Diaz
reviews.text:
I had a kitchen sink that was clogged. The last time that happened, I called Roto Rooter and it was so expensive that I was determined to fix this myself. Tried snaking it (25ft). Tried a chemical approach. No luck. I had to find a professional to help me.

Researched service providers using Google Reviews (so thank you to all the folks who left reviews for Drain Doctors!). I called at 8:15am, they were out to my place by by 9am and fixed the sink within 15 min (and 45 feet of snake) all for a super reasonable cost (my point of comparison being Roto Rooter). They were quick, professional and affordable. I felt taken care of, not taken advantage of.

Many thanks to Christian for getting my kitchen functional again!

reviews.author: Kara Lyn Hines
reviews.text: We had a clogged drain in our guest bathroom, Christian came out to unclog. He spent about 15 minutes on the job & charged $100. That was fine considering it worked after, 1 week later the drain clogged up again. I called back to share this information with them & they sent out Joel who was the father of the boy who came out the previous week. I got charged another $100 for that same repair. If Christian would have put in the same effort as Joel, there should have been no reason to have another repair made or another $100 fee. The second fee should have been taken care - of no charge, considering the job was not done properly the first time. Would not recommend this company for future business needs.

reviews.author: Mo D.
reviews.text:
20 minutes to kickoff and the basement kitchen sink is spewing sewer water everywhere. Omg!  Who u going to call?  After making the serious mistake of removing the drain access plug and getting a face full of sewer water I called these guys.  

The team arrived very promptly with extra points for doing so during the bronco game and took care of business very professionally and quickly.  

They were clean, courteous, efficient, and had good sense of humor. In and out in under 30 minutes and cleaned up a real mess. 

At the point I called money didn't matter but the price was surprisingly reasonable for a Sunday afternoon bronco game emergency call. 

Well done and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Wendy B.
reviews.text:
I greatly appreciate Drain Doctors' integrity. I asked them to come clean three potentially problematic areas due to concerns about the recent rains, including the drain in a basement stairwell and two slow-filling toilets.  After his inspection, Christian told me that cleaning the drains and toilets wasn't needed, to hold the toilet handles as they refilled, and if I was concerned about potential flooding in the basement stairwell, my money would be better spent getting a portable sump pump.  Thre was no charge for the call, which, by the way, was less than an hour after I spoke to dispatch.  

We could use more honest businesses like this.

reviews.author: Christa D.
reviews.text: like others, I started with the wrong company first to get my toilet blockage fixed.  like others, the other company also tried to tell me that the only way to fix it was to spend over $12000 to fix the entire house - for one toilet. I called these guys, they came out quick and diagnosed the problem and took care of it.  they did let me see pics and advised that I should think about doing some repiping - but not the super hard sell of the other guys. and gave me a reasonable quote to do the work where I didnt need another mortgage.  definitely calling them FIRST if I have any other issues due to their professionlism and great service!

synthesis.summary: Drain Doctors answers fast and shows up the same day for drain and sewer clogs, but a pattern of no-shows and ghosting on scheduled follow-up visits is a real concern for anything beyond a one-call fix.
strengths: Lightning-fast response time: at least 5 reviewers mention callback within minutes and on-site arrival within 30-60 minutes, including Sundays and holidays like Halloween

Pricing consistently praised as fair or below competitor quotes, with multiple reviewers noting the bill was lower than expected and one technician waiving the visit fee entirely when no work was needed
Technicians like Joel, Donnie, and Christian repeatedly named for thorough, fast work and leaving customers better informed with prevention tips
weaknesses: Communication consistency is the weakest dimension (scored 64): a 2011 review cites a no-call on a late arrival and inability to look up paid invoices, and a 2025 review describes being ghosted after two days of promises on a septic emergency
One older review reports a technician performed a different service than requested (snake instead of jetting) and charged for it anyway, suggesting scope-of-work clarity can break down
redFlags: 3 reviews across different years describe no-show or ghosting behavior: a 2015 reviewer reports two scheduled camera appointments with zero contact, a 2011 reviewer was told 11am and technician arrived after 1pm with no call, and a 2025 reviewer was promised service two days in a row and then ignored entirely

Two reviews explicitly flag after-hours availability: one states 'does not offer 24-hour service' and another reports being hung up on twice, suggesting the emergency line or after-hours contact may be unreliable
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong signals for business-hours and same-day emergency response, including a Sunday sewer backup cleared same evening and a Halloween toilet fix in under 10 minutes, but two direct reviews warn that after-hours and 24/7 service may not actually be available, so call ahead to confirm coverage before counting on a 2am response.

reviews.author: Lori Campbell
reviews.text:
These guys deserve all five stars.  They are down to earth, no bullshit, efficient, and affordable.   This is old school attention to detail and customer service that you don't see anymore.

I have an old house with it's fair amount of plumbing drama and these guys, Josh especially, have sorted it out without selling me on a bunch of upgrades and extras I don't need, which means I call them when new issues arise because I trust them.  My house was built in the 40's, something new always comes up.

The owner has been out for projects and is just as professional and straight forward as his employees.

As a homeowner who isn't handy having a company I can trust to get here, get the work done, not try to fleece me, and stand by their product/service is priceless.

You can shop around and get all the bids you want, you're not going to beat these guys on getting the job done.  They get my business every time and they have earned

reviews.author: Trish
reviews.text:
This is from a service done on Monday, Jan 5, 2026:

Today was my first time working with Salt City Plumbing. Got an appt set up for tomorrow to come do a FREE estimate to repair gas pipe leaks. They called me back shortly saying they had a cancellation, a technician would be out between 3 and 5!! 🥳 Tommy showed up early at 2:15 🤩! Tommy looked over the issue with me gave me 3 very reasonable quotes and got right to work. He fixed the pipes quickly and ended up not needing to replace a gas valve that another company was ready to charge me for.

It’s so nice to want to cry tears of joy rather than tears of frustration. We got astronomically ripped off by another company this weekend for a similar repair needed on our other boiler…which we were charged LITERALLY 4X the price of what Salt City Plumbing charged (and did a better job).

Got our heat and hot water restored to our second building after it being off since Friday night. Crying tears of joy 😭🥰

Thank you so much Tommy and Salt City Plumbing!!

I also took a good look at their newest reviews before Tommy arrived…. you have to scroll a LONG WAY to even find a 4 star review.

THIS BUSINESS IS AMAZING!! 🙌
Happy employees and happy customers!!!

Also, shoutout to Shae for coming over to look over our boilers and give us estimates for future work! Very knowledgeable and professional!

reviews.author: Ronda Z.
reviews.text: Contacted the company for the quote on swapping the water heater that is literally next to one another. Provided the pictures and asked how much for the response $900-$1500. Reached out to other plumbers of off the KSL as most people do now days. Got estimates from $250-$500most the time same process sent the picture explained what needs to be done and that was it. I expressed my concern that their estimates are the highest ones in the SL County got a massage from the owner that is not true and his price is in line with others... that is insane for 2-3 hrs tops of work you would pay$1500... who's hourly rate is that now days? Surgeons, government employees, anyone??? No one's that is insane. Oh yeah then he tried calling me and sent me a nice message that I'll post on her...By the way owner...I did not harass your people I responded on your add asking for an estimate if you don't like questions etc.you should remove your add...

reviews.author: Bryan F.
reviews.text:
UPDATE - response to owner's response: 

I can't say I'm surprised at this response from Paul after talking to him on the phone. He gave me a phone call recently to "get my perspective about my review". I spoke to him for 20 minutes and answered all his questions honestly and respectfully. However, it's clear now his intent when making the call was to find ways to twist what happened in a way where his company and team are RIGHT and I am WRONG. 

I'll give some additional clarity based on his response. The job was an basement egress drain that was clogged. I interacted with a plumber named Christian. I was told they needed to break the concrete and install a new system if they couldn't unclog the drain. I was told that $1200 was the estimate for the work. It seemed steep to me, but I considered they were factoring in breaking the concrete to get to the drain. No, I was not "told several times that $1200 was a best case scenario", that is a lie. I did ask several times what could go wrong with the job though, and all times Christian said he would just "abandon" the existing system and install the new one if they couldn't unclog the drain. No mention or implication that if that were the case the costs could go as high as 400% more. 

It was only AFTER Christian had already made a hole in the concrete of my tenants' unit and broken off the pipe (which was clogged but not broken) that he mentioned it would now cost $4800 to do the job and they needed to hire a sub that had a $70,000 excavator to do the job. This feels like deception. They hook you in with a low bid and then after doing some demolition suddenly it's not $1200 anymore, now it's $4800, but now you have a hole in your concrete and a broken pipe and the issue is more urgent. 

The following day, the sub had hired another sub, no $70,000 excavator, just two guys, a concrete drill, some gravel, and a small dump hitch. 

By the way, I understand that $1200 is an estimate, I'm not unreasonable, but any contractor that gives you a wildly wrong estimate (400% difference) is BAD news. It's incompetent enough to give bad estimates, in any field. It's worse to give estimates that are 400% off.

It's also interesting how Paul makes no mention of the lies I was told. Here are the lies:
- 5-10ft of digging and gravel promised, only 3ft (if that) of digging and gravel delivered.
- Mesh covering perforated pipe promised, only perforated pipe delivered, no mesh.
- $70,000 excavator will be needed, nevermind they just need a home depot concrete drill rental and a bucket. 

I think the mention of the $70,000 excavator was just Christian's way of exaggerating the complexity of the work to justify the 400% increase in price, I don't agree that the scale of the work was 400% more. I only found out about the lies outlined above because I physically went to the worksite and saw the work being done and asked questions. Imagine if I had not been there and just "trusted" them? I'd be thinking right now that my system is 5 - 10ft deep, covered in mesh, and so complex they had to use a $70,000 excavator!

The craftsmanship was okay, nothing extraordinary, and all the work (not just demo as Paul suggests) was done completely by a company called FLC Construction LLC, not Salt City Plumbing or their sub. 

Paul is also touts "16 years of market research" in his response and in another review yet his 16 years of market research cannot enable him and his team to give a reasonable estimate that isn't 400% off? Embarrassing.

Furthermore, very weird to say I "went through the trouble of having them finance me", it wasn't much trouble at all and Salt City Plumbing didn't do anything there but send invoices and agree to work with Green Sky. What Salt City Plumbing spends on their agreement with Green Sky is not my concern, that is the cost of doing business.

Regarding pricing, I mentioned earlier that the cost was not the main issue. The issue was feeling decieved and taken advantage of. $4800 seems like a lot for the work they did, I stand by that.

One final thing, and something I will agree with Paul on is the part about buyer's remorse - it's true, and that's not a good thing for Salt City Plumbing.

UPDATE #2: Attached are the images of the estimates, first $1200, then $1080. AFTER I EXPLICITLY asked for the the 10% off.

UPDATE #3: I used the word "system" and "drain" interchangeably. The french drain, is the drain. The estimate was not for fixing a pipe only or breaking "a little concrete" as he suggests. He said so himself, the existing FRENCH DRAIN was not working properly, so the estimate was for replacing the FRENCH DRAIN aka the existing "floor drain". Which is what they did, but for 400% more than the original estimate. I was unhappy about this and I expressed my frustration and unhappiness to Christian in person, but I moved forward despite the outrageously bad estimate because I didn't want to deal with the issue any longer.

reviews.author: Mari
reviews.text:
June 2025:

Our 1986 Heil AC unit finally sang its swan song during the recent mini heat wave. As outside temps went up to 90° F, inside temps went up to 81° F.

I immediately called Salt City Plumbing for an AC quote. Tommy was on site within a few days and offered quotes on four different AC options based on our conversations about the most energy efficient units that could reduce humidity and maintain temps.

We went with a Carrier variable compressor with a heat pump and scheduled the closest install date, which was one week later. The install took the entire day and then some, but Tommy provided exemplary service and explanations on how to get the most out of our Ecobee-enabled system.

Thank you Salt City Plumbing.

----

April 2025:

Tommy, with Salt City Plumbing, gave our old Carrier furnace the tune-up it needed to run well enough for the next few years.

He also replaced and moved a length of corroded copper pipe in our basement to fix a leak and make sure we had a little more head space.

We also walked the property to make sure we knew where the water shut-off valves were located in case of emergency.

Thank you Salt City Plumbing for the continued excellent service!

---
January 2025:

My husband and I now own a 1898 Victorian-era house, and we knew some key upgrades were needed before our foundation repair. Luckily, Salt City Plumbing was a pleasure to work with.

Shea spent the first day of installation in our basement:

+ Moving our furnace intake and venting
+ Moving metal air ducts
+ Enlarging and moving our gas lines
+ Moving a water line
+ Running a new gas line for a future gas fireplace

He was also very communicative and involved us with on-site decisions like the location of the lines and venting.

On the second day, Shea installed a new tankless water heater and water softener. He also hauled out our giant tank water heater. He made sure to explain the required maintenance for both machines and left us the salt bag wrapper, so we'd know which type to use on the softener.

My husband and I highly recommend Salt City Plumbing to anyone looking for a reliable company who focuses on finding solutions for your needs and not upselling anything you don't need.

reviews.author: Michael West
reviews.text:
Salt City Plumbing is absolutely fantastic! DJ came out and handled several plumbing projects for us over the course of a few hours, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. He is incredibly knowledgeable—not just about plumbing best practices and code, but also about how to properly use and care for different fixtures. He even took the time to share his knowledge with us. I really appreciated how upfront and honest he was about what needed to be done—and what didn’t.

One of our biggest concerns was a jetted tub that had been leaking. We were bracing ourselves for a full replacement, which would have meant tearing out tile and a huge expense. Instead, DJ carefully investigated, found the least invasive access point, and discovered a solution. He not only fixed the tub leak but also caught and repaired another small leak in the main drain while he was at it. It was amazing!

On top of that, he worked late to make sure all the other plumbing jobs—from replacing a water heater to resetting a toilet, installing a kitchen faucet, and fixing a tub diverter—were completed. His workmanship, honesty, and dedication really stood out. And Salt City Plumbing was much more affordable than other quotes we received.

We’re so grateful for DJ’s work and will absolutely be using Salt City Plumbing again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: McKell A.
reviews.text: I wanted to upgrade my sewer ejector system. This was a big project as it involved installing a larger basin, two sewer ejector pumps with an alarm system in the event of a pump failure. It also required an electrician to help with the wiring requirements. Where I live, the sewer line to the street isn't in the ground as deep as most residential areas. This causes a problem when it comes to homes with basements and requires a non-standard setup. Salt City Plumbing didn't shy away from the project due to it's complexity or uniqueness.  The project experienced a few minor hiccups like most home projects do. Salt City Plumbing managed the hiccups and the project well. I didn't need to find an electrician. Salt City Plumbing assisted with that task. The staff was polite and professional. I asked a LOT of questions during the process. They were very kind and patient with me. They educated me on my new system and setup. The owners of Salt City Plumbing kept me well informed as the project progressed. Often they were on-site working to ensure that my new system worked perfectly. My new system does work very well. I am very pleased with the service I received and my upgraded sewer ejector system. Thank you to all the staff at Salt City Plumbing.

reviews.author: katherine E.
reviews.text:
I needed a boiler looked at in my old house. When I searched on yelp for boiler repair this company showed up so I scheduled an appointment. They charged $275 to come out and find the problem.

The problem was that the valve on the boiler had a leak so I asked them if they would replace the valve and they said they couldn't get one. I thought that was strange since according to my searching they knew how to deal with boilers. It took me a few days to finally get a picture from the technician of what part of the boiler was the valve. I did a Google search and found one right away on eBay. When I called them back to ask them if they would please replace the leaking valve with the one I found on eBay they recommended I contact another plumbing company which I am now going with. The new company charged nothing to come out and take a look to find the problem. I feel I got cheated out of $275. I think I'm most frustrated because I actually tried to keep working with them but they clearly had no interest.

reviews.author: Joye Crouch
reviews.text:
5 Stars

Josh and his team at Salt City Plumbing is absolutely top-notch! We recently had a wide range of plumbing work done—from a major excavation to repair our main water line to the installation of a water conditioner, a new modern toilet, and outdoor waterline hookups. Every single job was completed with incredible care, professionalism, and expertise.

Their communication was outstanding. They kept us updated throughout the process, arrived exactly when they said they would, and were always quick to respond to questions. The entire team was hardworking, knowledgeable, and respectful of our property.

Most importantly, Salt City Plumbing is 100% trustworthy. It’s rare to find a company that combines technical skill with integrity, and they exceeded our expectations in every way. We’re so grateful for their service and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone. A truly exceptional experience!

reviews.author: Matt W.
reviews.text:
As both a homeowner and renter, I've seen my share of plumbers --  everything from leaky faucets to replacing entire sewer lines and remodels. 

Payton and Devin showed up promptly, scheduling was easy, and were instantly cordial and professional. They took great care to put on the boot liners as to not muck up the floors. 

They were curious, asked questions to diagnose the issue (sewer gas coming from shower drain), were able to infer the problem based on great communication skills and competency. 

The most impressive part of their visit is that he remembers details from 2 months ago about a single, rather unremarkable visit without having any communication in that time frame as a reminder. As a member of our military, he clearly understands conscientiousness and attention to detail.

reviews.author: Chris Parker
reviews.text:
Christian was fantastic at explaining the options we had for our AC replacement! He was personable and wanted to make sure it fit within our budget while giving us the best efficiency possible.

We found an option that would work for our situation and met our budget. Within 48 hours Tommy arrived. When I say this man is meticulous, it’s an understatement. Our mechanical room is cleaner than I have seen it in years. The install was flawless and looks even better than the previous system. He took the time to ensure the condenser was level and on a new pad while also sealing every joint around the new coil.

I really couldn’t be happier with the services provided and would 100% recommend them to anyone in need of help with their heating and air conditioning.

reviews.author: Sammy S.
reviews.text: Our sink has had a slow-flow clog for some time, and I thought I could just handle it with some Drain-O. Nope! Went googling and found these guys, and they just so happened to be close to the house. Very pleased I went with them! I wasn't in a rush and they got us on the schedule in 2 days, they fixed one drain AND a different one that I originally just wanted a quote on but said it'd cost just the same to do this basement one as the upstairs bathroom one, *and* they gave us a sweet first timer discount.  The plumber himself was super professional, fast, thorough (cleaned up after all that black sludge from the deep drain clear), and answered any questions my partner and I had. We'll be using SCP again in the future!

reviews.author: Gregory Dibb
reviews.text:
5 Stars: AJ is a Legend!

I had a drain issue that turned out to be more complicated than the original low quote suggested. I actually felt bad and told AJ I’d understand if he just got it "good enough" and headed out.

Instead, he said: "Whether you paid $100 or $100,000, I’ve got a job to do and I’m not leaving until I’ve done it!"

This makes them my new all-time favorite plumber:

Integrity: He stuck to his word even when the job got tough.
Tenacity: He didn't stop until the drain was clear.
Attitude: Super professional and helpful and communicative

It is rare to find someone with that level of commitment these days. I’m incredibly grateful for the hard work—Salt City Plumbing has a fan for life!

reviews.author: Kristy S.
reviews.text:
I am so relieved and happy that I called these guys! Im so reluctant when having to deal with home repair companies because I've been burned in the past and it's hard finding anyone trustworthy. 
From the first moment Jake walked through my home I felt at ease! He explained everything he was going to do, was very professional, and paid attention to details, fixing other issues I didn't even know i had.. it was a lengthy list of things and no easy task! Jake and Josh came over and knocked it all out in one day making sure my family wouldn't be without before the weekend hit. I'm just so grateful to those two! I will definitely be using this company again for all my plumbing issues in the future!

synthesis.summary: Salt City consistently undercuts competitors on price and avoids unnecessary upsells, with technicians regularly turning $1,200 competitor quotes into $20 fixes — but one detailed negative review documents a job estimate ballooning 400% mid-demolition.
strengths: Anti-upsell pattern cited across 8+ reviews: technicians repeatedly decline to recommend unneeded work, including one who converted a $1,200 competitor quote to a $20 repair on-site
Fast dispatch is a consistent theme — multiple reviewers report same-day or within-hours arrival, including one callback about a cancellation slot that got a tech out the same afternoon
Named technicians (Tommy, Shae, Tre, Christian, DJ, Josh) earn repeat praise across independent reviews, suggesting consistent quality across staff rather than one standout
weaknesses: One detailed, well-documented review describes a basement drain job where the estimate jumped from $1,200 to $4,800 after concrete was already broken — the reviewer also alleges work specs (depth, materials) didn't match what was promised
redFlags: The $1,200-to-$4,800 estimate escalation review is a single incident but unusually detailed, includes photos of the two estimates, and describes the increase occurring only after demolition had begun — a classic 'foot in the door' pricing pattern worth knowing about for any large excavation or drain work
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews cite same-day arrival and within-hours dispatch even for urgent issues like gas leaks and failed boilers; one reviewer had heat restored the same day it was requested after a weekend outage, suggesting real emergency responsiveness.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 across 669 reviews while Yelp shows 4.4 across 36 — a modest gap likely explained by Yelp's smaller sample, though the two most critical reviews in this set appeared on Yelp, suggesting dissatisfied customers may skew toward that platform.

reviews.text: Matthew was great! He explained the issue, knew how to fix it, let me know how to prevent it, AND he cleaned the floor and toilet before he left! He was also very friendly and worked quickly, I was very impressed!

reviews.author: Robert Allen
reviews.text: Matthew was extremely pleasant! He did a fantastic job with scoping our drain line for roots, and providing next steps. He was friendly and treated our home like his own. I would highly recommend Matthew at Beehive plumbing for any drain related issues!

reviews.author: Lawrence Linford
reviews.text: Mark did a great job cleaning out our bathroom sink drain and snaking out the pipe. He was very friendly, effective and informative. We will recommend him to neighbors. Thanks Mark!

reviews.author: Deanne Harper
reviews.text: Thanks to Jacob for prompt arrival and communication before and during our clogged tub situation. To ensure the baseline price reflected a full review, he also cleared a 2nd tub and checked sinks in both bathrooms. Everything runs like a dream. He was very helpful in advising on future steps to avoid such calls. We always rely on Beehive for our tenants’ and our own pipes.

reviews.author: Nelson
reviews.text:
Bryan was nothing short of helpful. Excellent, affordable, and fast work replacing an outside faucet and installing a shutoff valve inside the home to prevent it from freezing in the future.

Also looked at my showers and gave me advice and quotes on replacing the old hardware.

Will definitely work with Bryan (and Beehive) in the future.

reviews.author: Patricia Galbraith
reviews.text: Sunday afternoon we had sewer water coming out of our basement floor drain. Joshua was arrived within 45 mins of our call and got straight to work clearing our clogged sewer line. He was professional and friendly. We greatly appreciated him resolving our basement flooding on a Sunday. Thanks Josh!

reviews.author: Kristi Christian
reviews.text: Drain from kitchen was clogged and causing back up in our laundry room as well. Technician was very friendly and ended up having to clean through the pipe several times to get it cleared all the way. Beehive was also very quick on arranging a time to come and was very prompt on arrival.

reviews.author: S. Chacon
reviews.text: Mark is absolutely amazing! Stayed late and helped us with jetting our main line. Absolutely wonderful fellow and I recommend him for anyone having issues with their plumbing. 5 stars and we will call Beehive again if we ever have more issues.

reviews.author: Christina Fairweather
reviews.text: Chris came on time—went and got parts when he needed things he didn’t have.  Went above and beyond to complete what we needed and then some.  Gave helpful suggestions for an issue we were having not related to the repair.   100% great service!

reviews.author: Danny Morgan
reviews.text: Mark was fantastic to work with. He is very knowledgeable and cares about getting it right. Three toilets and some old cast iron piping replaced and we can now feel confident in our plumbing again. He’s made a lifelong customer out of me!

reviews.author: jan blair
reviews.text: Mark hadlock was awesome.  Very nice and professional andknew what he was doing.  Assessed the situation and listened to me and was very patient with me.  He was great!!! Highly recommend him and beehive plumbing.  Thanks Mark!!!

reviews.author: Montana Jackman
reviews.text: Mathew came within a few hours of calling and diagnosed our issue in minute. He helped me know where to turn to for restoration and reminded me to check my homeowners insurance for help covering costs associated with the damage.

reviews.author: Mieka Flisher
reviews.text: Wonderful, efficient, professional! Thank you Matthew Hover for your help today. He worked diligently even amongst a hurricane of little munchkins running to and fro. I will recommend you to EVERYONE that is plumbing challenged

reviews.author: Cameron Rigby
reviews.text: Daniel took care of us! He stayed late on a Friday night working to get our drains cleared and also reset the toilet. He did a better job than a few other plumbers we’ve used at setting the toilet. It doesn’t rock at all!

reviews.author: Samantha Harris
reviews.text: Matthew was excellent to work with! Great at answering questions, providing great suggestions to prevent further backups in our shower and ensuring everything works properly! Beehive was great at quick scheduling us!
