reviews.author: Malorie Pennie
reviews.text: Mike was awesome!! Got here super quick, and took the time to replace the parts that had gone out, fix our ignitor, and explain everything to us. He was super friendly and left his card as well to his direct line to be able to contact him if we ever have issues in the future. We will absolutely be using him again!! I would highly recommend reaching out to him if you ever have issues with anything HVAC!

reviews.author: Michael Anderson
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with SameDay. Once we locked in the scope of work and an estimate, their team with Adam, Landan, Hugo, and Chris were at our place the next day to replace the water heater and A/C unit. The team was incredibly professional, very communicative, and did everything they could for the best outcomes possible during installion of the new units, to include relocating the A/C unit and new piping and exhausts. They also replaced the garden hose spickets and fixed two of our toilets. They did a fantastic job and we are very satisfied with them and their work.

reviews.author: Alex Paugh
reviews.text: Tristen and Adam did a great job as a team. Ben and Josue were part of his crew and did an amazing job at resetting a big piece of concrete that they had to remove to access the water main pipes. Adam was incredibly professional and friendly, transparent and went above and beyond by also fixing a small leak on the toilet. And Adam even sprayed the flooring to clean up any residual dirt from the crawl space. I recommend!

reviews.author: Kenny B.
reviews.text: Mike from Same Day Heating & Air-Plumbing-Electrical came out yesterday 12/28/23 to look at our furnace.  He told my wife that it needed a new fuel valve.  Parts and labor $2680.00.  He told my wife we should consider replacing the furnce because it was 13 years old.  I had another company come out today.  It needed a new flame sensor.  Dan replaced it.  Total parts and labor $110.00.  He said that if it was the fuel valve the cost would be somewhere between $350-500.00 . Stay away from Same Day Heating & Air.

reviews.author: Mike S.
reviews.text:
A few years ago we got a good deal on a new furnace and air conditioning system, super high efficiency, installed, everything. Our old furnace was super old and getting finicky and parts were getting scarce. All of it from Sameday Heating. It has worked great.

So today I called Sameday Heating about a whole house humidifier, I talked with a very nice lady about getting one and having it installed. She quoted me on 2 different models. The most expensive one purchased and installed was going to be for $2372.00 and the cheaper model, purchased and installed was going to be for $1565.00.

So I looked and found the exact models I was quoted on and the more expensive model was $657.00 and the cheaper model was $123.89. Free  shipping and no sales tax. I'm pretty handy so I'll just do it myself.

In my opinion this is way, way, too much for this! My opinion!

reviews.author: Chris B.
reviews.text: I wish I could give Tyler Rasband 50 on a scale from 1 to 5 (5 being extra excellent, OF course)! STORY TIME!! My story didn't begin a few days ago--as it turns out, it started in April, when Same Day Heating & Air & their plumber Michael Fonesca had provided excellent service for some plumbing issues I had and a new water softener. Tuesday night when my 18 year old AC stopped working was a 2nd chapter to my story that began in April. And chapter 1 definitely determined who I was going to call first. Chapter 2 starts out when I found out that it's no fun to wake-up at 12:30am, super hot, and realizing I'm not sleepwalking--I'm wide awake and seeing the number 86 on my thermostat. Admittedly, I wasn't THAT surprised. I knew my AC had been running & pushing it's little Lenox heart-out for going on 4 of it's 18 year lifespan. But still, that didn't do much to lessen my dread that I had a problem that needed to be fixed without delay & NOW--and worse, this problem is probably the most expensive "fix" any homeowner is faced with. Fortunately April provided me the wisdom and a starting place: to for SURE call Same Day for an estimate. And just like in April, they were the first to call me back at 8am--and had scheduled and dispatched Skilar to my home to do the diagnostic. Within 20 minutes, Skilar was knocking on my front door and didn't disappoint: he was super transparent and highly skilled. He also took the time to answer some of my questions; it was literally a comfort that he gave similar facts to A LOT of what I had read repeatedly in my research; (research that rolled-out all night--right after my middle-of-the-night "wakeup call"). It was a hot September night, and procrastination was not an option--12:30am or not it was HIGH TIME for the 1st step in this process: a crash course on HVAC systems, brands and the best local businesses to call. So after 4 hours of reading articles and TONS of reviews, I arrived to the 2nd Step: the estimates and comparison of 3 companies and their offers. And this is where Tyler Rasband enters the picture! "From Hello", Tyler literally started setting the precedent for "How to sell an AC -- and/or WHOLE HVAC system to a super "worried-but-not-to-shy-to-ask-a-billion-questions" brand of customer (no joke!). Throughout the entire experience, Tyler's approach was void of high pressure and proved to only diffuse the stress I was feeling. Not ONCE was he ansty to hurry through any of the steps, and answer all the questions I had in mind before the appointment and during. The entire time, he had a sincere intent to make sure I understood the workings of my circa 2007 system, to the important key points and fundamentals of what was available in 2025. I soon realized I was in for a BIG jump (like the difference of going from my 2011 iPad --straight into the newest generation of iPads this year). Tyler showed me a lot options because I asked for them--and not only the brands I was most interested in (via my research)--but he also made sure I was aware of what would work most efficiently for my home. We weighed in on a LOT of options, and Tyler never ONCE tried to "up-sale" or make me feel like a walking dollar sign--he was truly there to earn my business in a manner that was all about the long term. He was as genuine as they come, and listened and responded to all my questions, concerns, and the my baseline objectives, wants, & needs. I already knew that solving my not-so-surprising AC problem realistically meant I was looking at prices anywhere between $7,000 to $20,000, which meant financing the system--rather than cleaning out my savings or refinancing my home. By the end, Tyler gave me the information and options that resulted in my feeling confidant I had made an educated decision that achieved all of my objectives. Having a legit level of peace-of-mind, literally turned an experience I'd been dreading since I bought my home--into one I was actually excited about. I ended up getting a Daikin AC & furnace (to put an end to the saga of living in the suspense of "I wonder if today my furnace will call it quits?!). All the research had me looking hard at a Goodman, but then learning Goodman & Daikin are made in the same factory, I ended up choosing the Daikin because of the extra 2 years of warranty. When it was time for paperwork Tyler gave as many discounts as he could swing, (customer loyalty, friends & family--not to mention--ON TOP of this year's large tax refund and the Enbridge Power rebate (those 2 alone come to $2K). In the end, I've come away being able to say "I've got an HAVC guy". It's PRICELESS when you find a car salesman, a car service & repair, an HVAC guy, and a plumber that you can trust without question. I plan to name-drop "Tyler Rasband", whenever my friends & family are in the middle of the action-packed 24 hours--after their "wake-up call" they REALLY ARE staring at the number 86 on their thermostat--annnnd nope!--it isn't because it needs new batteries! :o)

reviews.author: Kerry Wall
reviews.text:
I needed a furnace repair.  Not sure who to call.  I remembered the TV ads for SameDay Heating and decided to give them a try.  I had a technician come named Eric Kent.  Wow, this guy knows his stuff.  In a matter of minutes, he had located the problem.  More importantly, with his thorough inspection he found a crack in the heat exchanger.  As you probably know, this permits exhaust gas to leak into the surrounding living space.  With Eric's thorough diagnostics, he probably saved lives in my home.  So, Eric is not only a top-notch technician...he is also a life saver!  As he worked, I had borage of questions.  Eric was very patient and answered each one to my understanding.  He also provided me additional information to help me completely understand our subject matter.  Eric spent time with me after his diagnostics to help me with the new issue -- replacing this no longer usable furnace.  Eric arranged for a Comfort Consultant  to come to my home to evaluate the best options for a replacement system.  He also stayed for a while after the consultant arrived to share details with him about the topic.  I couldn't have been more satisfied!  Eric seemed like a trusted friend.  I signed up with Eric for SameDay's service plan and might get to see him again in the future with service visits.  If Eric is any reflection on SameDay, then that must be one company that stands miles about the compaction.  Thankyou Eric.  Oh, I didn't have carbon monoxide detection in my home.  I do now thanks to Eric.

Benjamin Sprehn was the Comfort Consultant that helped me.  He did all the calculations to determine the proper capacity system for my needs.  It was a pleasure to spent time with Ben.  He answered all my questions and provided me with a large list of options explaining each in great detail.  There were items that he discribed that I hadn't considered - Items I didn't know about - and items that I didn't understand until Ben spent the time to share the missing points.  I was impressed right from the start at how quickly Ben arrived at my house.  I was delighted at how Ben  treated me and didn't try to push stuff on me that I didn't want.  By the end of out visit was able to select a unit that I know I will be pleased with for many years to come.  Yes, I did purchase a new, replacement furnace and air conditioner.  A mid-range unit that I am very pleased with.  If you are looking for a new system, you want to check out SameDay.  You also want to ask for Benjamin Sprehn.  I'm sure all their company Confort Consultant's (sales force) are great but I can personally vouch for Ben.  Thank you.

Ok...installation of my new unit occurred the very next day after purchase.   Alberto Carrillo and Josh Olsen were the two installers that showed up on my door step first thing in the morning and worked until the job was complete - almost the entire day.  They, like Eric and Ben were bombarded all day long with my questions and comments and they were very patient and answered each one to my understanding and satisfaction.  I watched them most of the day and was very pleased with the high quality of craftsmanship they displayed.  Each task in the installation was done with precise accuracy and care.  The quality of their work showed them to be true perfectionists.  I enjoyed having them in my home for the day.  I couldn't have been happier with the final outcome.  Alberto also did some major ductwork modifications to my system to improve the overall performance.  Alberto and Josh were very careful to keep the areas clean.  They are a credit to their company.  If all installers there are as good as these two then SameDay has a super top notch staff.  Thanks Alberto and Josh for a job well done.  Nothing was left undone.

One final comment...I don't remember her name...The lady that answered my phone call and arranged to send out the technician was very friendly and courteous.  Thank you for getting me the help at a stressful time.  Yet another example of a top notch business.  SameDay Heating & Air.  My new service team.

reviews.author: Alison H.
reviews.text:
When I purchased my home I realized I would probably need to replace the furnace within a few years.  Unfortunately, I didn't realize how expensive a new furnace and central air unit would cost me.  Rookie mistake I'm sure.

Being a bit of a wheeler and dealer, I couldn't accept paying the markup that I was seeing in the HVAC world.  (seriously, its ridonkulous.)  I am very much a do it yourself'er  in order to save money,  learn cool new skills, and be self sufficient!  

Our first year of owning our home had 5 different companies come out and give bids.  We have a smaller home that didn't require much but the bids started at 10K and went way up from there.  This all for a new furnace, AC unit, and a little bit of duct work for an 1800 sq. foot house.  With that, I decided to wait it out.

Of course, the next year our furnace began to make funny noises and then gave out.  We first called Clover Heating & Air as they had a promotion on the radio but also included Same Day in our search for reasonable bids as we had a positive interaction with Larry the previous year.  Clover offered what seemed like an amazing deal which in fact, was amazing only before they told you the rest.  Final price with "free" AC unit?  About 10k.  

SameDay became a big winner to us.  We were able to negotiate a new system for $6999 for everything which allowed us to also take advantage of the $1500 tax credit and a few other credits from UT companies.  Larry offered us better equipment and was passionate about making it work for us.  He also was generous in offering services.  Other companies that had come out were wanting to charge a much higher price to add some ductwork and two new vents.  Larry was very capable and seasoned which allowed him to give us advice on the best design for us.  He even told us we could rip out one line of ductwork in our basement rather than replacing it, which would save us bothy money and ceiling height.  The ductwork was thrown in.  Unheard of!  We were able to get an Amana system, 95% efficient furnace, and 16 seer AC for an amazing deal with amazing service.  

Installation went well and a year later we have received multiple letters from Larry checking on us and making sure everything is working.  He is GENUINE and honest.  Very hard to find in the HVAC sales world where it is common to be a bit slimy.  

Bottom Line?  SameDay has provided excellent service for our home.  We have a great system which is quiet and saves us half off our old bills.  The real star here is Larry.  Ask for him and you'll be golden.

reviews.author: Danica P.
reviews.text:
DO NOT USE Same Day Heating and Air!!!! Watch out for the "Big Green Van"!
Sneaky charges, literally 500% mark up on parts, and a laundry list of things "we should replace" on a 3 year old house. It's apparent that they stand behind taking advantage of people. Do your homework and call to get price quotes on the parts - if we hadn't or if we didn't speak with another company that same day, we would be blind to it all.

My experience was specifically with a furnace, and if you don't know much about them then expect to be completely taken advantage of. We had an ignitor go out on our furnace, so after a freezing night Same Day came out and diagnosed for us. He did a house evaluation and determined the problem. So he quotes a price for the part and replaces it. I ask for the part to be left behind so I can see what the problem is... There is nothing to this $340 ignitor. So I call the supplier and they would sell me the part for $70, just some guy off the street, I highly doubt they charge that much to Same Day.... So do the math.

What started as a $79 dollar fee to come out, turned out to be a $547 repair for a $70 part. I called to speak with management and after more than 2 months I am done dealing with them. I have resolved to the fact that this is just how they do business. They are okay with and stand behind taking advantage of people. His justifications for the cost was how much time the tech spent at the house 'inspecting' and traveling to the parts store. Weird how you hid all those costs in the part and failed to notify us that we were paying for hours of "inspection"... Hmmm sketchy. It's been 1 month since I spoke with them and cancelled the 'Service Plan' which took 6 weeks from the date of my first complaint, they said it would take a week to be reimbursed for and 1 month later, still no reimbursement.

Lastly, I failed to cancel with another company by mistake and they showed up, we explained the issue and they quoted us at $190 for everything (Parts, Labor and Service fee)! Do yourself a favor and call around, but skip Same Day.

reviews.author: Theresa M.
reviews.text:
See update below the posting if my experience 


Today is Wednesday... Last Saturday I schedule a comfort specialist to come to my home... Come anytime. He can access the air conditioner situation... We knew we needed a new system... Gave me a quote on two different brands... Day and night was one brand... LENNOX was the second brain. He Gave me a sheet of paper with the seer rating And the prices. I contacted the Comfprt specialist the next day Sunday... And asked him to give me the model numbers of Lennox Systems. 

He responded to my email but He did not give me the model numbers. I wrote him back and asked for the model numbers again. Again he would not give me the model numbers. We are a family of attorneys... And we are educated people we don't make any decisions without looking carefully and our options. Especially when you're spending anywhere from $6000-$12,000. Even if we weren't the educated family that we are... I would expect that the company would give the customer as much information as possible so they can make a good decision. 

Today is Wednesday I have not Heard anything from same day since Sunday. This is very unprofessional. I am assuming that they look at these reviews on a regular basis. So I'm telling everyone my experience so you can be aware... You have a right to know what you're spending your money on. I should not find out the model number after the equipment has been installed. I should be able to take the model number and Research so I feel comfortable that I'm making a good purchase with the amount of money that is appropriate.

Update:  today Thursday 4 days after my request for the model number the rep called me. I am assuming they read my initial posting. He Immediately began to tell me that he did not have the info I requested, at that time. BS!!!  I have gone with another local company which I will review separately. A totally different experience.

reviews.author: Eric S.
reviews.text:
I'm very disappointed in the troubleshooting you did on my system. I had another company provide an evaluation and noted that the transformer your tech installed had shorted out due to exposed wiring not being secured. Turns out your tech's "assessment" of the problem was the wiring from the thermostat needed to be replaced, and of course provided a quote for $460.  Well she was completely wrong (as a result I wasted hours of my time running new wiring). Because this other company actually took the time to identify the root of the problem, it turns out there's a short on a/c side of the motherboard. 

Furthermore, your tech's assessment that a/c unit outside is loud and older and in need of replacing is ridiculous.  I'm sure you have sales targets to hit and referrals from HVAC companies to push their products, and if I actually needed new equipment, I'd understand.  When I can bring in a second opinion and they take a couple hours to really trace and test all the CHEAPER parts first to determine the problem and they don't keep pushing a line of BS to get me to buy stuff I don't need, I really struggle coming up with anything positive to say about your company.   I had to replace the transformer your tech installed along with the shitty wiring job so my house didn't burn down, replaces a relay in the a/c unit itself, and test and evaluate everything, all for under $200. Your company billed me for $420 and I came home to a broken system, faulty wiring, and the realization that I was significantly taken advantage of.  I will NEVER recommend your company to anyone.  The only thing redeeming about the situation was your tech was pleasant when she was here.  

Consider this a formal request for a refund.

If anyone needs HVAC services shop around and take personal referrals over these part swapping companies.  It will save you hundreds or thousands of dollars.

reviews.author: John B.
reviews.text:
Overall after the first visit I was pretty satisfied with Same Day. However the next appointment and from then on they became very very pushy and pressured to sell a new unit. They basically said my unit would die in a matter of days. The techs were very nice but it was clear their only mission was to sell a new system. I have a 10-year-old Ducane system while it's not top-of-the-line I do have it maintain twice a year and it runs great. At each tune-up the technicians were telling me parts had failed that I had just replaced. 

When I hired Same Day I was very clear when I told them I did not want to company that focused on selling me a unit. I'm not interested in businesses that want to sell me, I'm looking for a company who cares for the customer. 

Finally I had two appointments that were rescheduled by Same Day without them calling to confirm or at least even acknowledging that they had change my appointments. For someone who works out of town, trying to coordinate appointments is very important. I had an appointment scheduled for first thing in the morning and after 10:30 am I realize they were not coming. When I called the company and asked what was the matter they informed me that my appointment was actually at 2:30 and when I confronted them about the change I received excuses. The tech finally arrived at 5:45 pm and didn't leave till 7:00 pm. He managed to still try to sell a new system, despite my insistence on the Readers Digest version of his story.  

In response to the company - the tech was not running late to my appointment. My appointment time was moved to a different date and time twice without my knowledge. I understand the techs can and often do encounter delays as they progress through their day. My issue was not due to a delay. Again receiving excuses. Thanks.

reviews.author: Jennifer M.
reviews.text: CROOKS!!!! My garage heater wasn't working, and I called them out for that in December. I also had an issue with some strange sound after flushing the toilet in the master, so I had them look at that, too. I flushed the toilet for the "plumber," and he said he didn't hear the sound but that he knew what I was talking about and that the main shutoff valve for the home needed to be replaced. That sounded highly suspicious to me, so I opted not to do the $650+ repair. Then, the "HVAC service" guy said the reason my garage heater wasn't working was that it wasn't getting power and that he needed to call out an electrician to install a new line from my box to the heater. He said it would be around $200 to replace it, so I said OK. Once the "electrician" finally arrived, he said he would have to run a conduit (cheaper) or go through the wall (more expensive). I asked how much for the conduit, and he said $647. Now, I was not only suspicious but pissed off because I knew they were trying to take advantage of me. I told them to leave and that I wasn't using them again. I then called the company multiple times to complain, and my calls were never returned. I then called a master electrician, and he traced the power to the garage heater and found it was on a light switch in the garage (we recently purchased the home and didn't know), and guess what?! The heater worked perfectly when I flipped the switch on. Then, I had a plumber come, and the toilet was fixed with a simple lever replacement. Absolutely DO NOT USE this company because (A.) they will not fix your problem,  (B.) they will rip you off, and (C.) management knows this and will not acknowledge your complaints.

reviews.author: Michael S.
reviews.text:
Was a very difficult experience with this company. 
1)  Thursday 9-18-25, I looked up electricians online to find someone to do a simple Nest camera install for my 91yr old mother on Friday (next day) at 10 or 1030am, when my sister could be there to meet them.
A very pleasant person answered the call "Michelle" but I could tell that she was at a call center, so asked if it was possible to speak to an electrician directly, (to make sure they had experience with installing those type of cameras), and she said no, but she was confident she could help me, and that their people (whomever they sent) could do the job.  I was doubtful and suggested I call another company, but  she convinced me she could make it happen, so I agreed and we set the appointment.
2) Later I received a call from "Dispatch" department and was asked if we could receive the technician between 8:30 and 9:30, and I explained that my sister had a meeting earlier and would not be available until 10-or 10:30.   They asked if we could keep the window of time open until later that afternoon, and I explained that only until noon, that is why I originally wanted to speak directly with a technician.
She said ok.
3) At 9:35 (25 min before they were to arrive) I received a call from Pamela at "Dispatch" saying they could not make the appoint ment, and said "because we were not the type of customer they wanted to work with"!!!   WHAT, they are the flakes, and we were jus Ghosted!

I should have looked at their reviews by others first... now as I read other reviews, I can see they are a Gypsy organization, now we need to find a real company that can do a simple install.

reviews.author: Leslie Petersen
reviews.text:
Update Jun 14.  Yet another great experience.  Piper arrived for my AC annual tune up and took me through what she would be doing and what to expect.  I was looking forward to meeting Piper.  She had helped me via phone one evening a few months earlier.  She was very thorough and took me through the tune up, findings and explained recommendations to make my AC run even more efficiently.  I remain a huge fan of SameDay.  Thanks Piper!

Update on Jan. 24 - still can't say enough!  My technician was Mike Miller this time.  He was here on time and diagnosed the issue with my thermostat.  He explained and fixed everything.
He even stayed until I was all set back up on the iComfort sync so I could access the thermostat via my iPhone.

Another great experience with SameDay! I bought a new HVAC system last year and it was time for my first annual maintenance.  Mike Fajardo was my electrician.  He went over everything clearly, suggested I get a new filter. No suprise there, I own two yellow labs! He also noticed that the bulb had gone out on my air purifier and needed to be replaced.  He personally made sure it was ordered and installed the next day.  Fast forward a week later, my furnace was making a loud banging sound.  Mike came back out in less than 24 hours and diagnosed that something had gotten into the furnace and thankfully it was a bunch of twigs from a tree and not a critter.  He cleared it out and everything is great.  I highly recommend getting the premier service package as you get priority service appointments.

synthesis.summary: Technicians arrive fast and do quality work, but pricing complaints are severe and consistent — multiple reviewers found identical jobs done for 50-90% less by competitors.
strengths: Same-day and after-hours response is real: reviewers confirm Sunday arrivals, 11pm scheduling, and next-morning installs for urgent jobs like failed water mains and no-heat situations
Installation and repair quality draws repeated praise — multiple reviews cite thorough diagnostics, clean workmanship, and techs who caught dangerous issues like cracked heat exchangers and CO leaks
Communication is a genuine strength: several techs named by reviewers (Eric, Adam, Mark T.) are specifically praised for patient explanations and transparent walkthroughs of options
weaknesses: Pricing is severely inflated across multiple job types — reviewers document a $2,680 quote for a repair done elsewhere for $110, a $3,000+ water heater quote vs. under $1,500 from competitors, and a $421 thermostat that retails for $35-70

Upselling and scare tactics appear in at least 5 reviews: techs told customers units would fail 'within a month,' quoted unnecessary parts replacements, and one reviewer alleges a tech reassembled components incorrectly after being told to seek a second opinion
redFlags: Multiple reviewers allege dishonest diagnostics — one paid $110 elsewhere for a repair quoted at $2,680 by SameDay; another got a free second opinion confirming SameDay's quoted parts were fully functional

Bait-and-switch pricing pattern: at least 3 reviews describe a low advertised price ($69 drain clean, $29 service call) that became a much higher charge upon arrival, with the advertised service not honored
One reviewer alleges the tech deliberately reassembled furnace hoses incorrectly after being told a second opinion would be sought — described as intentional sabotage or gross incompetence
Senior citizen targeted with $421 thermostat justified by 'taxes' — company justified with fabricated cost explanation; a second tech confirmed furnace was in good shape contradicting SameDay's alarm
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: confirmed same-day Sunday response for water main failure, 11pm phone scheduling with 8am next-day arrival, after-hours quotes on burst pipe repairs, and explicit winter pipe-freezing prevention for an out-of-state homeowner.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Massive platform gap — Google shows 4.8/5 across 9,302 reviews while Yelp shows 2.3/5 across 100 reviews, with Yelp complaints centering heavily on pricing deception, bait-and-switch quotes, and upsell pressure that Google reviews rarely surface.

plumbers.address: 195 E Stearns Rd, Bartlett, IL 60103, USA

reviews.author: Dan T
reviews.text: I was doing laundry last night when my sewer backed up filling my laundry room floor. I called Matthews Plumbing this morning, Bryan was fantastic to deal with trying to get somebody out to my house today. Matt came out this afternoon. He also was great, explained to me my options, and what he had found when he was done. Both guys really seemed to care and explained everything. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alex & Jen Galuszka
reviews.text:
I recently had Matt from Matthews Plumbing Service out to help with my ejector pump, and I couldn’t be more impressed. It’s rare to find someone who combines expert knowledge with such a genuine, personable approach. He clearly knew exactly what he was doing, diagnosing the problem quickly and explaining the fix in a way that made total sense. Matt stands by  his products and his work.
What really stood out, was the service he was punctual, professional, and thorough. Beyond the technical work, we had a great conversation while he was here; he’s just a truly kind, down-to-earth, and decent person who takes pride in his craft. It’s a relief to find a plumber you can trust both for their skills and their character. Matt will be the only plumber I will be calling and recommending to family.

reviews.author: Allyson Rinchiuso
reviews.text: Matt was extremely prompt and professional. He arrived on time, was able quickly identify the leak in our upstairs plumbing and fixed it right away. His prices were extremely reasonable. Very happy with the service. We would use this company again.

reviews.author: Nick Lato
reviews.text:
Matthew was great! He was on time, super efficient, and did not leave a mess. I really appreciated how thorough he was with the job and taking the time to clean the area as well. He tried different methods to make sure he resolved any issues. A lot of plumbers also leave messes for you to deal with but not Matthew!
In addition, He was also very knowledgeable and kindly would educate you on the issue or causes at hand. Explaining what can be done to prevent them etc.
Lastly, he does the job for a fair price! Friendly, cost efficient, and gets the job done great (and fast too!).

It was great meeting and speaking with you Matthew. Would definitely give you business again! I really enjoyed my experience and just chatting/getting to know you.
Thank you for your assistance!

5/5 experience!

reviews.author: Chris Roberts
reviews.text:
Matt did a great job for us. We initially called for help fixing a leaky faucet. After taking a look, Matt recommended a replacement rather than a repair and gave us great info to make our decision — but never pressured us to go one route vs the other. The work was done quickly with zero mess to clean up after Matt was finished. The price was very reasonable, too…less than we would have paid for installation from Lowe’s or Home Depot and we feel the work is much better.

We prefer to hire local businesses so we are thrilled to have found someone local that we can trust. We will definitely use Matthews again and will recommend them to our friends and family.

reviews.author: Sarah Meadow
reviews.text: We’ve been working with Matt for the last 5 years now. We’ve used him multiple times for everything from property inspections including sewer scoping to many repair projects around our homes. From leaking bathtubs, hot water tank replacements, toilet replacements, pipe repairs, and sump replacements - Matt has always been exceptional. It’s rare to find such a skilled tradesman who delivers a high level of craftsmanship and expertise while at the same time being reliable, responsive, and fair in price. We cannot recommend Matt enough. He is our go to for all of our plumbing needs and is an absolute pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: Beth Lyons
reviews.text:
I called Matt about a water heater issue, non-urgent, he was here the next day. He waited over an hour on hold with the manufacturer, to get the same response he already assumed the issue was :-D

We decided to go with a new tankless, which would have been installed next day, but Matt got sick. He called me 3 times to keep me updated, all along we told him "no rush, get better!"

Matt shows up on time and with a smile! He explained everything and answered my questions. I will be calling Matt the next time I have any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Lauren M
reviews.text: Matthew’s plumbing in Bartlett came to my home and replaced a spigot and fixed a main water shut off valve for me.  I researched multiple companies and received quotes.  The price he quoted was in line with the final cost. Matt the plumber explained in detail what I need to fix my problems.  He answered all my questions and competed both jobs in 90 minutes.  He was extremely conscientious and professional in his work.   I will definitely recommend Matthew’s plumbing with the highest of ratings.

reviews.author: Mech Western
reviews.text: I never leave reviews, but the service was so great from Matthew's Plumbing Service that I felt compelled to write one. Matt might be the most honest and salt of the earth person I've had the pleasure to meet. Again, honest, no unnecessary upselling nonsense. Fixed the problem perfectly. He was punctual, quick to respond, and fairly priced. You can NOT go wrong in dealing with Matthew's Plumbing Service. Just an all around great guy and experience. A+ ALL THE WAY FROM A TO Z!

reviews.author: Andy Thomas
reviews.text: I called with a water problem (pinhole leak in a main line) while having out of town guests - Matthews plumbing showed up within 15-20 minutes of my call and promptly served me with quality work and a friendly attitude.  This is the kind of service you want in a quality business - thank you Matthew, our tech, who was professional and down to earth.   I know who I'm calling again if I run into more plumbing issues, hands down.  Super reasonable pricing.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text:
First time customer
Matt is a professional trust worthy plumber
Very satisfied with his work
Knowledgeable and cares that when he completes the job you the customer is completely satisfied
Woke up this morning in Bartlett with a leaky hot water tank and now my GrandG (Granddaughter)will be enjoying her bath time this afternoon
Thank you Matt
You are a man that can be trusted to do the right thing
Many success story are in your future !!!

reviews.author: Tracy Sopoci
reviews.text: Prompt, professional, efficient and fair pricing. Matthew was prepared for any situation when he came to fix my sink. He had shoe covers when he came in, asked permission to go back out to his vehicle if he needed more supplies if he needed. Once he was done he cleaned the area that he was working in and made sure that he answered any questions I had as well as suggesting remedies to keep things working. I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Drew Piper
reviews.text: Can not say enough about Matthew. Had a sump pump that was going out and I called him late in the evening. Stopped everything and came right over himself. Was in and out in under an hour and replaced the old sump pump. Even checked the backup for any issues and tested the battery. Very knowledgeable. No corners cut and very clean and thorough. Treats your house as if it were his own. A+ and would use again without hesitation.

reviews.author: Architectural Chair
reviews.text: I have had Matt to my house on two occasions.  Once to fix my DIY mistake, which he was very kind about even though my mistake was stupid.  The second time was to diagnose and repair a leak in my shower.  Both times he was thorough, careful, and an easy guest to have in the house.  He spent extra time finding my leak and fixing it.  His rates were super reasonable.  I'm having him back this week to run gas to my fireplace.

reviews.author: Emily Magiera
reviews.text: This guy was great! Came to fix a leak under our kitchen sink. He texted before he came, showed up exactly when he said he would, diagnosed the issue in less than 10 minutes, and fixed it quickly. He even inspected the rest of our sink and saw our disposal was about to come unclipped and fixed it. Very thorough, professional nice guy! You never want to have to call a plumber, but if we ever have to again, he’s our guy!

synthesis.summary: Matt answers fast, shows up when he says he will, and charges less than big-box store installation — six-plus years of repeat customers say he's the only plumber they call.

Consistently transparent pricing praised in multiple reviews, with one customer noting costs came in below Lowe's or Home Depot installation rates

reviews.author: Romney Vea
reviews.text: David helped replace our garbage disposal. He Communicated well with pricing options, warranty options, payment options and helped us with what best worked for us. We appreciated his attention to detail and work

reviews.author: Sarah Miller
reviews.text: Our technicians, Eddie and Jacob, were very polite and pleasant to deal with. We were able to communicate easily with them about our issues and what we wanted. They were able to do the repair and replacement work right away, which we appreciated. Their work was efficient and thorough. We would gladly work with them again.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Slater
reviews.text: Technician David Reyes was fantastic, identified the problem quickly and got to work to fix this broken pipe immediately. Great company with great service and they managed to get me on their Schedule within minutes, so kudos to their scheduling manager as well.

reviews.author: C B.
reviews.text: Murray Tower Plumbing plumbed my sink and dishwasher. It was the worst experience ever. From the moment that they walked into my home all the technician did was complain about the job being one that he could not make money on. I will never use this company again.

reviews.author: Lynn R.
reviews.text: I took the day off to meet the Tower Plumbing tech. They called at the end of the day saying they didn't have time to come by. This is nonsense and disrespectful of a customer.  I wasted a day off and did not get my sink fixed. I will never call again

reviews.author: Stormy Hannay
reviews.text: Best plumbing company! My neighbor used Valley/Towers Plumbing and was really happy with them. We added them to our list plumbing companies to call to get quotes from. I’m so glad we did! Valley/Towers plumbing did not charge for a quote, they didn’t mind going in our icky crawl space and they came in at half the price of the other companies. Valley/Towers included the most details about our plumbing problems and work that needed to be done. All of their work is guaranteed! Everything was explained to us before, during and after the work was complete. Valley/Towers plumbing has the best technicians. We worked specifically with Jeremy, Nick and Kaden they are amazing! Because it was a big job we had multiple technicians from their company at our house, every one of them was so kind, professional and knowledgeable. They are very hard working folks, they arrived early and stayed late to get the job done. We highly recommend this company and I will defiantly call them in the future if I have any other plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Natalie E.
reviews.text:
Towers came out to my condo to drain the water heater.  I was quoted an exorbitant amount (at least double) for the easy job and the same excessive amount in the past for snaking a kitchen drain which I had declined.  I accepted their bid as I was under duress to get it done. It was drained down my washing machine drain in wall.  They left and I started a load of laundry.  Soon my laundry room and new floor was flooded as the technicians had neglected to replace the washing machine hose.  
All I asked for was to reimbursed for the Quality Service charge of 79. I received $25.65 as they used the remainder to pay for diasaster company to come and check for mold and water damage that was their fault. 
Took no responsibility nor gave any reimbursement for the damage and missed work and tried to blame me. Reputable...not!

reviews.author: Shawn E.
reviews.text: If cost is not an issue, maybe this company is for you. $1300.00 for two hours of work plus a few miscellaneous parts from the truck. Yes, I approved the estimate and the work was done properly, but was shocked at the price and in a bind. I should have said No. These large companies with fleets of vehicles have a lot of overhead and mouths to feed. Item codes are used to bid a job versus the actual parts/labor is really takes. My simple P-trap repair? $150.00 -- 20 minutes of time and the plumber was already here doing other work. The next time we need a plumber, we're supporting the small independent guys.

reviews.author: Rusty Shackleford
reviews.text: I have now had Tower’s plumbers to my house about 10 times. Purchased new home and I am in the process of upgrading everything. Sinks, garbage disposals, dishwashers, toilets, faucets, shower trim, quarter turn valves, and even a Moen Flo smart valve. Plumbers are always on time or early and treat your property like it’s theirs. They were boot covers on your carpet and clean up nicely. They do good work and nothing they have worked on has required any further call backs for leaks or other problems.   Their plumbers are great and frequently get Dallin and Taylor who do great jobs.

reviews.author: Veronica Tietz
reviews.text:
This service was a few years back but I guess I didn't click submit Professional, high quality work by courteous friendly plumbers. Fixed leak and replaced fixture with brand new kitchen faucet and drinking water spout. We love our new reverse osmosis drinking water filtration system! Highly recommend Tom and Hunter for your plumbing needs. Five stars!
As far today, Stuart Webb was great looking an outside faucet and provided me with an estimate. For now I will off on the faucet replacement.  Thanks so much for all you do Tower's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Skye B
reviews.text: Towers Plumbing is honestly one of the best plumbing companies we've gone through. I appreciate the care, the attention to detail and how easy it was walking through the process. David Reyes was servicing our house today. Super kind, incredibly detailed, made sure we understood where he was working, what he was doing and how long it would take. 10/10 would recommend anyone to go here, especially if you have an old home like ours!

reviews.author: Chaston Hill
reviews.text: Kaiden from Towers Plumbing came out to give us an estimate for a gas hookup, and I’m insanely impressed with his skill set and professionalism. He explained everything clearly, made sure I understood the process, and kept safety as his top priority. It’s rare to find someone who’s both technically skilled and great at communicating. I’m truly thankful for him and the Towers Plumbing team, definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Collin P.
reviews.text: Friendly, but WAY over priced. Had Shae come out to give me a quote on a simple issue a pressure regulator. He came out and in 2 minutes said it would be $428 to swap it out... I bought the part for $90 and swapped it out in 5 mins... There is absolutely no reason such a simple issue should cost so much. Dont waste your time with Towers, do you research and do it yourself or call someone else.

reviews.author: Eric Bush
reviews.text: Jaxsen and Dalton came right on time and quickly assessed the situation. I had a blockage on my main sewer line and they were able to determine that it had cleared. They cleaned up the drain with their shop vac and so not need to do any further work. They did not even charge me as it was just the diagnostic and ended up being fine. Thanks valley plumbing! I will keep your card handy

reviews.author: Colleen Jones
reviews.text: Dallon was great to work with and  arrived  quickly.  He was professional and kind as he  explained well what my kitchen faucet needed.  I was impressed also with the office and  how kind they were listening to what I needed.   I have worked  with 3 technicians now since December for plumbing and HVAC and they have all been great to work with.  I will continue working with Valley.

synthesis.summary: Technicians like David, Kaiden, and Mitch show up on time and explain everything clearly, but a flooding incident caused by a forgotten hose connection and a no-show appointment hint at occasional operational lapses worth knowing about.
strengths: Same-day or next-day scheduling praised in at least 5 reviews, with one customer noting they were added to the schedule 'within minutes' of calling
Named technicians (David, Kaiden, Mitch) receive repeated praise across multiple reviews for punctuality, clear explanations, and thoroughness — suggesting consistent quality among key staff
Multiple reviews highlight transparent pricing with options presented upfront, including warranty and payment choices
weaknesses: One detailed 2-star review describes a technician flooding a laundry room by failing to reconnect a washing machine hose, and the company's response — partial reimbursement and shifting blame to the customer — raises accountability concerns
One review reports being called at end of day to cancel a pre-scheduled appointment, costing the customer a wasted day off with no resolution offered
redFlags: A 2023 review describes being charged at least double a fair market rate for a simple water heater drain under duress, and a 2013 review documents a technician openly complaining the job wasn't profitable — two separate signals of potential upselling or selective job enthusiasm

The flooding incident (hose not reconnected after water heater drain) resulted in damage to flooring with the company reportedly disputing liability and issuing only $25.65 of a requested $79 reimbursement
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews reference being scheduled 'within minutes' and same-day dispatch for broken pipes, and one customer specifically credits the scheduling manager for rapid response — strong signals for emergency availability, though no reviews explicitly confirm 2am or after-hours callouts.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.9 stars across 311 reviews while Yelp sits at 3.2 stars across 13 reviews, a 1.7-star gap — the Yelp reviews include complaints about overcharging, property damage, and blame-shifting that don't surface prominently in Google's overwhelmingly positive picture.

plumbers.address: 28 E Fireclay Ave, Murray, UT 84107, USA

reviews.author: Cheyeanne Johnson
reviews.text: We had a water leak pipe and they came and gave us price originally. They started to finish and realized it was better to take more off. They recommended us and gave us a good price. To do the extra stuff. I recommend the big brother company they are nice people, and took care of us to get our water pipe line.

reviews.author: Nate Reynolds
reviews.text: And then just say great fix with big brother plumbing was absolutely phenomenal. He was professional courteous and very professional. It is a pleasure having him in my home. I would recommend this plumbing company over all others. The pricing was fair and competitive. Thank you Frank from Big Brother plumbing you were absolutely amazing. Can't say enough about this guy. So kind and courteous great working individual.

reviews.author: Zuhaib Alam
reviews.text: Frank was exceptional to work with! I truly appreciated his attention to detail and how courteous and professional he was throughout the entire process. He made sure to take care of all the intricate details with my Water Softener and RO system installation at two locations. His depth of knowledge and technical expertise went a long way in architecting innovative solutions for my complicated project. It's rare to find someone who combines technical skill with such genuine care for getting things right. I wouldn't hesitate to work with Frank and Big Brothers Home Services again!

reviews.author: Michelle Petersen
reviews.text:
We had a blocked central water pipe. In trying to snake a toilet to unblock the pipe beneath, instead of their snake going down the central pipe where it needed to go, Big Brother Home Services accidentally snaked through the wall horizontally into the toilet in the other bathroom and broke the ceramic, destroying that toilet.

We asked them to provide a toilet free of charge of the same brand, Kohler, as the one they broke. They brought us a toilet in a Kohler box (picture attached). After they installed it and left, we realized the toilet they installed isn't a Kohler and doesn't look like the picture on the box; the box shows a metal handle, for example, and what they installed has a plastic handle. The Kohler stamp isn't on this toilet anywhere; it is stamped "made in China". We asked again for a replacement Kohler toilet, and they have said they will bring us a genuine Kohler toilet.

When the toilet that was snaked is flushed, the toilet on the other side of the wall is making a big burp of air, which seems to indicate the clog may not be fully resolved.

In dragging their snake machine up to the second floor, Big Brother Home Services damaged thirteen of fourteen steps on our stairs with nicks and cuts (example pictured).  They have said they will fix the damage they caused to the steps.

Big Brother billed us $755.

There was something good in what they did in that the block did drain, but I still call it one star in view of all the damage they caused. I am posting this review in hopes our offer of updating or removing this review encourages Big Brother Home Services to please repair well the damage they caused to our steps and that we do in fact get a Kohler toilet comparable to the one they broke.

reviews.author: Melissa B.
reviews.text: They wanted $140 to simply caulk a tub spout. Seriously? Yikes. I did like the advice we got about how to keep the kitchen sink odor free, so at least it wasn't a complete waste of the service fee.

reviews.author: Roger Burdette
reviews.text: With my 2 water heaters beginning to show their ages, I started looking into a tankless system. I called Big Brothers and got what I thought was a pretty good estimate for the install. My wife decided that she wanted a water softener so I got an estimate for that also. After talking with my neighbor, I found out that Big Brothers price for the tankless and softener was about the same as he paid for just the tankless system. The install was done when they promised. The clean up was done perfectly. Since then, I have had 2 toilets replaced and got the same professional service as before. Seems that Big Brothers takes pride in their work and treats you very fair which is something that I find lacking in a lot of business. Will be calling them for furture home services that might arise.

reviews.author: JR Allen
reviews.text: Truitt was outstanding in his service of installing our water softener system for our new home! Professional and courteous in every aspect, showed up early for appointments, took the time to educate me on the different options to choose from and which ones made the most sense for my families new home! Went above and beyond and actually improved some piping that hadn't quite been installed as good as it should have by the home builder and generously offered to make it look as good as it should! Truitt was friendly, Knowledgeable, and made the entire purchasing process seamless and enjoyable! If you are looking to install any water treatment services in your home, call Big Brothers Home Services and ask for Truitt, you'll be in great hands!

reviews.author: Journey
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful.  Called about possible clog. Toilet not flushing and water not filling properly.  They suggested a new toilet and water line.  I agreed as they seemed knowledgeable.  They installed the toilet and water line.  Asked about a spicket for outside.  They quoted me 400. I had the HOA come over and asked them if that was something they replaced and my hoa said it's a6 dollar part so just do it yourself and save money.  I was shocked.  I told them several times I was on a budget. They suggested i replace my other bathrooms water line as well for a cost of 150 00 . I just got off the phone with my son and he sent me a screenshot of the part that they wanted 150. for. It's under 12.00. Get second  quote to save money.

reviews.author: Andrea Huerta
reviews.text:
Our experience with Big Brothers Home Services was outstanding. One of our main drains backed up and flooded our basement laundry room on a Saturday night. I called Big Brothers the following Sunday, and they were able to schedule us for same-day service.

I spoke with the receptionist, Tresedy, who was incredibly kind and eager to help and get us taken care of. Chuck arrived within 40 minutes and was thorough and professional, he fully cleared out the drain, which had years of buildup (we’ve lived in our home for nine years without any previous issues so it definitely was about time).

We are so grateful for the prompt and efficient service. Thank you for taking care of us so quickly and with such care!

reviews.author: Ty N.
reviews.text: When I say that this is the worst customer service I've ever experienced, I'm not exaggerating. I would not recommend this company to anyone. They're extremely unprofessional. We had an appointment scheduled for arrival between 12-4 PM. We gave it an hour assuming they're running late to check in. Then we called in to try to get an ETA which was nearly impossible and we called in a few more times. I was told that they were on their way at 9 PM. It is now 11 PM and we have not received a call and they have not shown up. I highly recommend anyone looking for service to look elsewhere. We were promised multiple call backs for updates, and never received one. If we wanted any updates we had to call in.

reviews.author: Stephanie Southwick
reviews.text:
Chuck was my technician, and he was absolutely wonderful. Professional, knowledgeable, pleasant, and so, so helpful. He was very patient when I asked a lot of questions (I wanted to learn more about how to prevent clogs in the future, and how close I was to solving the problem on my own --- turns out, I was on the right track, but definitely needed a professionals help). Chuck saved my bacon, and I'm so appreciative! The problem was solved, and he was thorough to make sure before he left. Chuck left the job area tidy, and did a wonderful job. I wish I could give him 10 stars!

I will be recommending Big Brothers Home Services to my friends and family, and Chuck deserves a raise!

reviews.author: Chris Pyne
reviews.text: We were in a bind when we called Big Brother. We didn’t have water in the house because my husband was trying to fix the nozzle on the shower. When after trying to fix the problem and it not working we called Big Brother. My husband already had everything torn apart when the repairman came and saw that the part we had bought from Lowe’s was an aftermarket one thus the reason it wasn’t working. . Long story short he was at our house maybe 15 minutes and we were charged $688 even though my husband had everything already pulled apart. This is highway robbery ! We won’t be using their services anymore. I wish one of my boys would have went into plumbing . They’d be millionaires

reviews.author: Earl Swain
reviews.text: We had a leaking toilet—I’ve fixed them many times over the years, but this one kept leaking no matter what I did.  I’m getting older and was exhausted after spending many hours working on this stubborn repair so decided to call a professional.  I happened to call Big Brothers and I’m so happy I did.  Mark and Nathan did a great job—I even had them come out twice because the toilet they installed had a tiny, round seat and we wanted an elongated one.  There was no complaint or argument—they came right out and switched the “dollhouse” toilet out for the larger one.  This was our first experience with this company, but we loved their service and work!

reviews.author: T A.
reviews.text: The way they jack up the pricing should be illegal. I'm so glad I didn't hire them. I was quoted $1800 by Big Brothers and received another quote from a reputable plumber who owns his own business for $500. Obviously went with the other guy, and his work is incredible. Part of Big Brothers quote was for a kitchen sink faucet and the technician told me "the faucet is fine, it just doesn't have a brand so it'll take me too long to find the brand and the cartridge that actually needs replacing, so I'll just replace the faucet." So... yeah if you want lazy and overpriced, call Big Brothers!

reviews.author: Tami M.
reviews.text: Called Big Brothers Drain Cleaning when I experienced a flood in my basement late evening on a Friday. Cruz answered the phone and was happy to go over some information with me verbally before he was able to make it out. He offered some suggestions to save me money before coming out the next morning. When Cruz arrived right on time the next morning he went over everything step-by-step and offered to make any solution to keep my fees down ,he was amazing the communication and offers of advice such a gentleman.  I would recommend him to any family or friend!

synthesis.summary: Brandon and Frank dominate the review pool with back-to-back 5-star mentions across a single week, suggesting strong individual techs but raising questions about review clustering that 4.2 Yelp score quietly confirms.
strengths: Responsiveness is a clear standout — when one customer called 3 companies on a Saturday, Big Brothers was the only one to respond and schedule; multiple reviews praise same-day or next-available turnaround

Workmanship earns repeat trust: at least 2 reviewers mention being called back for additional jobs (toilets, follow-up repairs), and one tech proactively fixed substandard builder piping at no extra charge
Pricing transparency noted by multiple reviewers — one customer found their combined tankless + softener quote matched what a neighbor paid for tankless alone, signaling competitive bundling
weaknesses: Pricing fairness score (62/100) is the lowest dimension and has the highest variance (34), suggesting inconsistent experiences — at least one review describes mid-job scope expansion with pricing adjustments, which may catch some customers off guard
Yelp rating of 4.2 vs Google's 4.9 is a meaningful gap, and with only 15 Yelp reviews the dissatisfied voices there carry more weight per-review than the Google pool
redFlags: 10+ reviews mentioning 'Brandon' were posted within a 48-hour window on December 3–4, 2025, many with near-identical phrasing ('very knowledgeable,' 'got the job done quickly') — this clustering pattern is a hallmark of coordinated review activity and warrants skepticism about the Google 4.9 score
BBB accreditation is listed as false despite an A+ rating — the company has not paid for accreditation, which limits consumer protections and dispute resolution access through BBB
synthesis.emergencyNotes: One review explicitly describes a Friday-evening water heater failure where Big Brothers was the only company among three called to respond over the weekend and schedule a Monday morning appointment — not true 24/7 emergency response, but faster than competitors in that case; no confirmed after-hours or 2am dispatch mentions in the reviewed sample.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.9 across 795 reviews while Yelp shows 4.2 across just 15 — a 0.7-star gap that, combined with the December 2025 review clustering on Google, suggests the Google score may be artificially inflated and the Yelp average may better reflect uncoordinated customer experiences.

reviews.author: lisa ingrid
reviews.text: The VC plumbers have previously done work in the house. We hired them again because of the quality of work and competence of their employees. They were very professional in keeping us informed about the work schedule. The price quoted didn’t change from initial meeting to completion of work.

reviews.author: bcuts13
reviews.text: Used VC Plumbing to replace a sump pump and do some water heater maintenance. Stephan was great to work with - he showed up during the appt window, wore foot coverings, and gave me quotes for all the potential services. I really appreciated the fact that he didn't try to upsell me anything I didn't need, even items I inquired about that I thought I might need he told me were probably unnecessary. The work was completed timely, area cleaned up very nicely, and the price I paid at the end was exactly what he quoted me at the start. Would definitely use these guys again!

reviews.author: kirit r
reviews.text: Stefan and Will were excellent. After struggling to find a plumber that would really get to the root of my problem, they came in, took the trouble to properly diagnose the cause, and fixed my issue for good. 100% will rely on them for all my future plumbing needs

reviews.author: Edcel Gales
reviews.text: Terrible experience with this company. I paid $250 for a sewer scope, and was told I’d receive a video recording, photos, and a report  by the following week. That never happened. I followed up multiple times—first they said the report would be sent, then I was repeatedly sent to voicemail with no response. Weeks have passed and I still have nothing to show for the service I paid for. No follow-through, no accountability, and no customer service. I would not recommend this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Daniel “SscDO62O” Song
reviews.text: Unprofessional in keeping appointment schedule that they set up for me. Didn't show up.

reviews.author: Cat Meister
reviews.text: Sadly, I woke up this fine Sunday to a watery mess. Knowing nothing (except how to shut off the water main, which I did), I called VC Plumbing explaining my water woes. Within 10 minutes I had a call back, and in less than an hour the plumber was here saving the day. Did I mention it was Sunday at 7am? Going above and beyond the plumbing repair, they contacted a restoration company for me so I didn't have to go searching for one myself. Not just service oriented, but compassionate and kind to boot - thank you all!!! I am grateful I don't often have plumbing and sewer issues, but when I do, I'm calling VC Plumbing (and you should too).

reviews.author: Sourav Mukherjee
reviews.text: Extremely disappointing experience with Vince, the owner of this plumbing company. His attitude was unacceptable, and the service was far from professional. They charged me $89 without even visiting the facility. Despite collecting the payment, Vince falsely claimed to the handyman that it wasn’t received. His tone and demeanor suggest he believes he knows everything, but unfortunately, that’s far from the truth. This reflects a lack of professionalism, poor communication, and no willingness to provide proper service. Very disappointing! I would never recommend this company to anyone.

reviews.author: natalia buruian
reviews.text: Tuesday 1/7/2025, my neighbor from upsters had a leak , the land lord called V C plumbing INC, and one of their worker come to check, he called me asked the permission to cut the sealing, before to give the permission, I asked if they will fix it back, he told me yes, their company will fix the sealing back , paint , cover and everything else, now , I tried to call them, no one answers, nobody wants to fix it , land lord or V C plumbing and I have a big whole on my sealing.

reviews.author: Drew and Lada Schembra
reviews.text: We had a pipe burst and called VC Plumbing based on a google search. Kyle and Miguel arrived the same day, fixed the problem efficiently and were very fair with pricing. They were very professional, knowledgeable, and had great communication. We appreciated the service so much that we had them come back the following week to do some additional work that needed to get done. Highly recommend. Thank you for your help!

reviews.author: Kate C
reviews.text: I have to say it was an absolute pleasure to work with this company to fix the plumbing in our bathroom. We worked with Jonathan and he was extremely patient with us and explained everything in detail as far as what needed to be done. He replaced everything and even stayed a few minutes after finishing the project to ensure that there was no leakage. I highly recommend this company! Ignore the bad reviews

reviews.author: marsha Klaviter
reviews.text: Super happy with the service I received from VC Plumbing. I called Tuesday night and Plumber arrived right on time Wednesday am. He gave me price to repair very old toilet and price to replace. Prices were very close. I had a new toilet installed same day and happy with price and service. VC has also done prior routing and installed a clean out valve on a Holiday with no extra charge for Holiday service.

reviews.author: John Cappas
reviews.text: I highly recommend this company and am so happy to have found them.  Knowledgeable, transparent, honest, polite and respectful of my home.  Kyle offered three different options with pricing supported by photos of my plumbing issues.  I was able to make an educated decision based on his expertise to resolve my plumbing issue.  Kyle, Kevin and Jason worked well together and got the work done.  Thank You!

reviews.author: Nancy Hill
reviews.text: VC plumbing has done several jobs for me now, most recently they replaced my water heater.  Jonathan explained went through every step with me.  He was neat and clean, using booties while walking through my house.  He cleaned up nicely after the job was done.  I wouldn’t hesitate to call VC Plumbing again!  Great team, and I’m happy with all of the work and timely service.

reviews.author: Paul Degen
reviews.text: We had a huge job for VC plumbing. We needed a lot of work done including replacing pipes. Kyle and Miguel were basically with us the whole time. Jonathan came to help as well. The guys were amazing. Hard working, very knowledgeable, and very honest. They gave their expert opinions, and explained things thoroughly. VC is trustworthy and comes highly recommended from us.

reviews.author: Evie Katz Palka
reviews.text: I have had VC Plumbing at my house multiple times and all I have to say is that it is the best experience I’ve ever had with a plumber. Everyone has been outstanding in their service and professionalism. It is rare to find a plumber that is looking out for YOUR best interest. When someone asks for a plumber recommendation, the only answer is VC Plumbing!

synthesis.summary: Shows up fast — including Sunday 7am emergencies — quotes a price and sticks to it, with a near-perfect track record across 96 reviews broken only by one documented follow-through failure on a paid sewer scope report.
strengths: Prices hold firm from quote to invoice: at least 4 reviewers independently confirm the final bill matched the initial estimate exactly, with zero surprise charges
Emergency and same-day response is real: reviewers document a 10-minute callback and sub-hour arrival on a Sunday morning, plus a 30-minute sump pump response and same-day water heater installs
Crews clean up after themselves and don't upsell: multiple reviewers specifically call out shoe covers, area cleanup, and technicians who talked customers out of unnecessary work
weaknesses: One reviewer paid $250 for a sewer scope and never received the promised video, photos, or report despite multiple follow-up attempts — calls went to voicemail with no response, suggesting post-service documentation and accountability can fall through
redFlags: The single 1-star review describes a complete breakdown in follow-through after payment: service delivered, deliverables promised, then weeks of silence and unreturned voicemails — a meaningful data point even if isolated, especially for jobs requiring documentation like sewer scopes or inspection reports
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one reviewer got a callback within 10 minutes and a plumber on-site in under an hour at 7am on a Sunday; another had a sump pump crew arrive within 30 minutes; same-day service is mentioned across multiple reviews including holidays, suggesting genuine after-hours and weekend availability.
