reviews.author: Andrew McMahon
reviews.text:
Make this your first and only call.  I truly wish I had found Brandon and his team before bringing in other plumbers and even a foundation repair company.  It would’ve saved me so much time, money, and stress.

Brandon is hands-down the most knowledgeable expert in the leak detection and plumbing repair industry.  He identified the issue almost immediately, walked me through the plan to fix it, and had a crew on-site faster than I thought possible.  And the cleanup?  Incredible. I was honestly nervous about how my yard would look after replacing the main line, but they left it looking just as good, if not better than before they started.

Brandon and his crew have absolutely earned my trust and my business for life.

reviews.author: Justine Farrell
reviews.text: Joey came out for a simple, fast, and quickly fixed an issue.  Was awesome to learn what the issue so quickly. Was able to get parts and fix in less the the time quoted. Super kind and got an amazing quote for future work. Joey was extremely professional with the work he did while maintaining an excellent job.

reviews.author: Tamera Eaton
reviews.text: Just had my pool leak fixed. Felipe and Daniel did a fantastic job on both the plumbing and the cement work. We got prompt, knowledgable and friendly service.

reviews.author: Peter G.
reviews.text: Had an appointment with Joey. Called to tell us he couldn't make it due to being too far and asked for pictures instead to provide an estimate. We texted over pictures. Said he had a busy day and would get pricing back to us. Never did. We ended up hiring another company.

reviews.author: Jessica Ray
reviews.text: States 24 hours service but no one available during the weekend. False advertising.

reviews.author: Marilyn M.
reviews.text: After studying all the reviews on two or three companies, I opted to give this newer company a chance, since they has only 4 reviews (positive) and since there were complaints from all the others about price gouging, etc. The secretary was fabulous on the phone, you could tell it wasn't a chop shop with a bunch of telemarketers taking calls. That was good. I THOUGHT. Smaller company, new, needing to build reviews and customers. I explained I had a lot of rental properties and WOULD give a review. Maybe the first clue I didn't recognize was they COULD COME the very next morning at 9am when all the others said about a week. As I am not an early riser, getting up for this cost me a night of sleep, but after a week of my son shutting off and on the water at the main, I was pretty desperate. My son waited at his house for them. I got a call at 9:30 to say he would BE THERE in 20 minutes. So that's an hour later than they said. Oh well, not a big deal. The plumber sounded nice on the phone. The entire house is 600 sq ft, so no one is floating in big chunks of cash here! He got there and just to REPAIR/REBUILD the stem for the tub and snake the bathroom sink, he called back to say $395. It's a free estimate, luckily. I had spent two plus hours the day before deciding on this company. Online I noticed the national average to REPLACE THE ENTIRE UNIT, not just put a couple new washers, pins in an old cartridge, averaged $100-$250. Replacing an old cartridge, as found on YouTube doesn't take many tools, nor much time. There are several videos that show how easy it is to replace, but since I'm in another city from my son's house, I was willing to pay for a plumber to deal with it, rather than do it myself. I'm highly disappointed in a bid that demonstrates the reason why plumbers  and plumbing companies have such bad reputations, why it is so hard to find one without really bad reviews. I'm certain the plumber, who said he was a journeyman, could have pulled out the cartridge and "rebuilt" it, meaning putting in new washers and maybe a pin, within less than an hour, maybe 15 minutes? BUT REALLY? And their office is very nearby, so it's not about the "TRIP" cost. It seems to me people are going to wise up and realize MOST plumbing problems can be much more simple than they think, don't require "plumbers tools", and can be done for a fraction of a cost, and then plumbers will lose out in the end, due to the incredible greed of the industry. I am on my way, an hour plus away, to repair the leaking tub spout. It's a day out of my life I didn't want to give up. I would have paid $250, the max end of the national average for REPLACING THE ENTIRE UNIT, even though he was only going to put in a couple washers and pins to an old existing cartridge and snake the sink (replace the  trap with plastic one). The fact that I am looking for a plumber for my rental properties had zero weight, apparently. They LOST TONS OF MONEY by overbidding this job. They lost a positive review. I could be done with this problem and been able to do what I had planned for today, but...And so I thought it right to take the time to share this experience. I have learned that smaller plumbing projects are doable by anyone who can follow directions. I should have checked on YouTube first, that's the bottom line.

reviews.author: Lucinda Paschal
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience working with Utah Leak Locate and Plumbing Utah. We've had a small water leak in our front yard from our irrigation or the water main for some time that we were unable to diagnose and repair ourselves. I called Utah Leak Locate after reading many awesome reviews and Brandon, the owner, came out within the hour and immediately diagnosed the problem out front and a bigger problem we didn't even know we had with our water heater inside. The water heater was old and cracked due to a faulty pressure reducer valve. I really hadn't noticed the water on the floor since it's not an area we regularly enter. He offered a reasonable price for all the work so we opted to update to a tankless water heater and replace the water main rather than do a patch job. A crew from Plumbing Utah showed up the very next day and diligently worked on the repairs. Shane leads the excavation team and he was very professional keeping us informed as the day progressed. The water main took a little extra time due to the huge amount of rock in this area which required heavy equipment, but the workers were courteous and efficient and spent a lot of time replacing the sod and cleaning the yard up. Shane and the crew even power washed the driveway to remove all traces of the work they had been doing. We STRONGLY recommend this excellent company.

reviews.author: Lora Edwards
reviews.text: It has been a pleasure working with this company! We had a leak in our 1971 fiberglass pool that no one seemed to want to fix. The skimmer and part of the pipe at the bottom needed replacing. We tried working with Precision Pools and Spas. They were terrible to work with. They originally quoted us for the job but then the day they were going to fix it they backed out and said they were uncomfortable fixing our pool leak. They had the worst communication skills. Then I called around to so many people and no one seemed to be able to help with our problem. Then I found Brandon. He is the best! He responded quickly and we received a quote and a scheduled date of repair within a day. He has always been easy and quick to reach to answer any questions or concerns we had. This company was willing, determined, and confident in their ability to fix our problem! We did run across a road block but we were able to work things out and they were able to keep going and solve the problems we were having, being an old ‘71 pool that it is. Definitely highly recommend these guys work! They are pros at solving problems and getting work done well!

reviews.author: Joey V.
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Plumbing Utah! I called Plumbing Utah recently to help me with a sewer main replacement issue in Heber City, Ut. Ron responded very quickly to my online request and I was quite impressed with the immediate response. I have tried to get other companies to respond but they seemed uninterested or simply did not return my calls.
Ron was very professional and explained what exactly was needed for the repair/replacement of the main line. 
The finished job looks very nice and great care was taken to restore the lawn back to the original condition as best as possible!
If anyone is looking for a plumbing contractor that is professional, knowledgeable and prompt and will do what he says when he said he would, Ron is the man to call!
I will be using this company in the future and I will be recommending these people to everyone I know.
Thanks Ron and the rest of the Plumbing Utah crew.
Shane

reviews.author: Anna Whytock
reviews.text: I called several different plumbing companies in my area and without a doubt Plumbing Utah Heating and Air was the most reliable, decent priced, fastest service, and the most professional. I 100% recommend Heath, he was very knowledgeable, well-mannered, detail-oriented, and his work ethic is on point! He got the job done in less than an hour. I definitely recommend this company for simple fixes repiping, sprinklers, basically all your plumbing needs. I plan on calling them to have them repipe my house, redo my sprinklers, and any other future plumbing needs! Everyone in the office was extremely thorough, generous, upbeat and was able to answer any concerns or questions I had in a professional manner and timeline. Thank you all for the excellent service I'll definitely be calling you again for my plumbing needs!

reviews.author: C Bltrn
reviews.text:
I cannot overstate our gratitude for the outstanding service provided by Plumbing Utah Heating and Air. In the midst of a chaotic week, their lightning-fast response was a true lifesaver. A massive shout-out to Ryan, our dedicated rockstar, who went above and beyond to restore order. His unwavering positive attitude and constant communication were invaluable throughout the entire process. Ryan is undeniably a hero, and I wholeheartedly recommend him.

Furthermore, Heath and Kayden swooped in the very next day to replace our boiler. Their professionalism shone through as they thoroughly explained the issues with the boiler and presented effective solutions. The entire team at Plumbing Utah Heating and Air exceeded our expectations, and we couldn't be more impressed. Highly, highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: B Scott Satterfield
reviews.text: This is a top quality group.  They do top notch work and are fast.  I have had them do two jobs for me in the last two months ... and can witness that their work is very high quality.  The owner, Brandon, is a great follow through manager making sure everything is correctly done, and the customer is satisfied.  I had a little issue with the price on one of the projects they did for me.  Brandon got a hold of me and reviewed the problem and promptly made it right.  I recommend them highly.  If you have a plumbing need ... give them a call.  They will be quick to respond, will do a great job and Brandon will make sure everything is done to the customer's satisfaction.  They also guarantee their work.  You just can't go wrong with this group.

reviews.author: Ben R.
reviews.text: I want to give a shout out to Ron at Plumbing Utah.  I first contacted Plumbing Utah last spring seeking help on a recurring basement leak that no other plumber could seem to solve.  Ron came out within two hours and he found the problem and fixed it.  I have been contacting Ron ever since whenever I have a plumbing problem.  He is always responsive, usually getting back to me within minutes, and he always fixes the problem.  Just this morning, I contacted him about a leak in a bathroom sink.  He is already at the house checking it out before I have even finished my cup of coffee.  If you want a plumber for life with no hassles, rapid response, and quality honest work this is the company to call.

reviews.author: James
reviews.text: I had a very good experience with Jared that was beyond just plumbing. Right away I felt like I was working with an honest, straightforward and conscientious person who communicated well and who would, and in fact did do a thorough and excellent job.But what really set him apart was that I had arranged for him to do some work for my friend's very elderly parents and when he was finished, due to dementia they had forgotten the agreed upon(and reasonable) price, and said that he had quoted them less. Rather than making a fight over it he went along with it and accepted a little less, which I think is unusually  graceful and kind, and it really made my day!

reviews.author: Marc W.
reviews.text:
Ron has been a life saver. It started off with the shower not working Friday morning 6am and my wife was on her way out of town for an important meeting. 
While I was gone, we needed to get the shower working again since we've planned to do a bunch of yardwork, going camping, swimming, etc.. that weekend. Without a working shower, this would not have been possible. 
I've called 14 plumbers on Friday - NONE of them came through. Call #15 was to Plumbing Utah and Ron came through with it on a Friday night. What a relief! 
Going forward, my first call will be to Plumbing Utah whenever I need something done. 
Thanks again!

synthesis.summary: Brandon's crew tackles burst mains and gas leaks same-day — sometimes within hours — and consistently leaves yards looking better than they found them.
strengths: Same-day or next-day emergency response documented across at least 6 reviews, including a blizzard water main replacement and a commercial waterline burst fixed 'within hours'

weaknesses: One review documents a scheduled appointment where the tech (Joey) asked for photos instead of showing up, then never sent the promised estimate — a dropped ball on follow-through

synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: multiple reviews describe same-day dispatch for burst water mains, a gas leak response described as immediate, and a commercial waterline repaired overnight — this company appears genuinely equipped for 2am calls.

reviews.author: Chris Schaeffer
reviews.text:
When I want my plumbing fixed, I'd like it to be fixed in a way that the problem does not come back.  You get what you pay for and I'd rather pay a little extra up-front than pay twice when the first repair fails and it has to be done again.

We have had excellent experience with Expert Services for Plumbing.  Especially David and David, Chandler and Mika deserve shout-outs for the quality of their work, their explanation of what they were going to do and why and their recommendations.  We had a MASSIVE disaster when our connection with the main sewer system broke.  Mika rode to the rescue at short notice and the Expert team involved a disaster mitigation company and by the time I got back, everything was fixed and cleaned.  David gave us great recommendations for our plumbing system and implemented them.  Chandler replaced our water heaters and changed the configuration so that the chance of future water heater failure is much reduced.

They work clean and are very competent.  I will hire them again.

reviews.author: Lisa Lee
reviews.text: I have used this company for years- this is at least seven repairs on a 15-year-old house that has all the original appliances. They're always friendly, neat, and explain everything carefully so I understand. The work is always excellent and I recommend them to anyone

reviews.author: Eric Newman
reviews.text: Mika was awesome! We had to get our sewer line replaced earlier this month and he did everything he could to get us the help we needed. The plumbing manager, Aaron, did great keeping us up to date on their communications with the city. The rest of the crew who came out to help (I think Lyric, Toni, and Brandon based on my texts, but there might have been more and I apologize if I missed anybody), were great as well--they were very polite and if they needed to discuss something with us they did a great job explaining it and making sure we were okay with everything. When they were done they spent a lot of time making sure our lawn was as good as they could make it before they left. I'm very happy with everything. Everything works great!

reviews.author: Michael W.
reviews.text: Quoted me $1600 for a new water heater for something I easily fixed myself in under 17 minutes for $60. But they were friendly and came to check it out quickly.... I get why now.

reviews.author: Gilbert S.
reviews.text:
I called Expert Plumbing to do a few items to finish up a project at my home.  
1.  Install a toilet that I supplied
2.  Install the trim on my shower (shower head & control) that I supplied
3.  Change out a cartridge in a bathtub tub spout (they supplied)
The price quoted was $707.50, I about choked but agreed as I had no other option but to get it done that day. It was a Monday, normal business hours.  
Worker was on time and did the job but the pricing is out of line. 
Fool me once but not again

reviews.author: Nelson A.
reviews.text:
UPDATE TO MY REVIEW:
Within hours of posting the original review found below, the technician and his manager, John and Jim, contacted me trying to get more details about my situation, apologizing, and wondering if they could be given an opportunity to get things done right for me.

Sincerely, I was not sure I trusted them anymore so I initially passed on the offer and focused on getting a quote from a nationally known and reputable business. The quote came in and was in the $1,400 range with top of the line equipment and 12-year warranty. The only problem, I had to wait 2 days to get it installed.

Next morning, the situation got out of control as my water heater interior components completely collapsed and water was now dripping out uncontrollably. I was now in basement flooding risk.

So, after a second and more persuasive contact from the manager Jim, I decided to give them a shot and I am happy to say that they went ABOVE AND BEYOND trying to get me taken care of. They were patient, respectful, and extremely accommodating. I ended up getting the same equipment (Jim personally went to the competitor's store and texted me pictures to help me understand that what they were installing was exactly the same), warranty, and service than the larger company quoted me for less money and done within hours.

I have decided to leave the original and updated reviews here for you to see the whole story but, IF THEY TAKE CARE OF ALL THEIR CUSTOMERS IN THE WAY THEY TREATED ME, YOU ARE DEFINITELY SAFE TO GO WITH THEM.

PROPS TO JOHN AND JIM FOR THEIR OUTSTANDING LEVEL OF SERVICE. WAY TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CUSTOMERS GUYS!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

ORIGINAL ONE-STAR REVIEW:
A couple months ago I noticed that my water heater valve was leaking and contacted this guys so they could check out the issue. People in Google said that this problem was common and that it should be easy to fix but, reviews in Yelp looked good and I wanted to make sure a professional verified that everything was ok.

John from Expert Plumbing showed up and told my wife, specifically, that the water heater pressure was ok and that we just had a bad valve. We ended up paying $130 for him to replace the part and all was supposed to be good...

A month later I called again Expert Plumbing to come and check for a gas leak because of an unrelated issue and, in the process, they again check the water heater and said that nothing was wrong with it. This, even when I saw some unusual thin rusty water leak marks coming out the top of the boiler and a lightly wet edge line at the base of the water heater. We again paid for the time spent checking things out and thought everything was ok...

Yesterday, I went into our mechanical room and noticed the floor and adjacent wall all very wet. The water heater now full of thick rusty orange water lines coming from it. We called Expert Plumbing and John, the first time guy, came again and now said that the water pressure was too high and had broken the inside of the water heater requiring a full replacement for an initial estimate of almost $1,800.

What? 1.8k dollars? What is wrong with this company?

This time I decided to do more research and bring someone else to check the problem... it turns out that they were grossly trying to overcharge us and probably could have prevented the problem the first time they came. What a rip off, I don't know who is putting good reviews for this company. Do not use this people!

reviews.author: Everett F.
reviews.text:
We had our AC unit replaced by Expert Services in Salt Lake City a couple of months ago, and it has been a nightmare ever since. The unit has broken down more times than I can count. Technicians from Expert Services have been out to our home repeatedly--sometimes staying as late as 1:30 in the morning--trying to troubleshoot the issue. As I write this, they're on their way out again because, once more, we're without AC.

I spoke with Greg at Expert Services this morning. I voiced my deep frustration about:

- Being left in the heat time and again with no lasting fix

- Feeling like a guinea pig for endless patches and temporary workarounds instead of receiving a proper unit replacement

- Having the crawlspace left open--after I explicitly asked it be closed--resulting in my dog falling in and injuring himself (not badly)

- The fact that, even today, they're still attempting another workaround instead of replacing the faulty unit

- The constant disruptions to our lives--having to repeatedly rearrange my schedule to accommodate their visits, being stuck at home when I'd otherwise be out, shifting my workday around their availability, having meetings or tasks interrupted, and canceling personal plans over and over again

I've lost count of how many times they've been here. At this point, they may as well move in. 

Many more frustrations to list but the gist of it is we're left in the heat and no promise of this nightmare ending yet.

Greg with Expert Services wasn't hostile, but he also wasn't particularly apologetic. He talked over me while I was trying to express my concerns--especially when I demanded they replace the unit. Instead of listening, he kept interjecting with his own frustrations, which didn't inspire confidence that customer care is a priority.

I work in the service industry myself. If I had to return to the same job 5, 10, or more times, I would be falling over myself to apologize and find a permanent fix. In fact, I wouldn't have allowed a job to get this far gone without making it right.

I debated between giving a 1-star or 2-star review. I chose 2 stars because I do believe the techs are doing their best--they're clearly stumped and not malicious. But the repeated breakdowns, the lack of accountability, and the insufficient customer communication have worn me down.

If you're a potential customer reading this, I highly recommend shopping around before booking with Expert Services.

reviews.author: Erin T.
reviews.text:
Chose any other plumbing service.  I cannot begin to describe the con game that their plumber brought into my home.  How despicable is a company that will lie to your face and when you ask more questions because it doesn't feel right, he makes you feel like a stupid female.  
I called the company because I had a leaky bathtub faucet.  Fairly straightforward fix. The plumber spun this whole web of lies telling me that because I have an older home (Sugarhouse homes are 1935-ish but built extremely well) my water pressure valve had to be replaced.  I asked why since we had no issues with our water pressure. He said "oh I measured the pressure outside and it's 75. You definitely don't want it that high".  I asked him several times If this was really something I had to do since the leak seemed straightforward.  "Oh yes.  And when I put the pressure valve on, there's a good chance it will fix the leak".  $450 he said.  After he installed the part I did not need -- The leak was of course still happening. How much to fix a simple faucet leak?  Another $450 of course.  

What a scam!   I have hired a lot of contractors as we own a couple properties and I have never encountered a company so incredibly unethical.  How do companys survive when they are so dishonest?  I am out $900 as I didn't follow my gut and this despicable person took full advantage.  You don't have to be a victim of this scam.  Call anyone but this horrible company!

reviews.author: Emilie Havili
reviews.text: I am SO disappointed!  We have used Expert twice in the past and had great experiences with them. But, we had someone come out to replace a leaking water heater that was still under warranty in February and feel like we were RIPPED OFF.  When the technician gave us the quote it seemed high, but because we trusted the company from before, we went with it.  I reviewed our invoice to see the breakdown of charges and there was none...just a lump sum. Very different from the other technicians that had serviced our house before. I called the office and asked for an itemized invoice.  They sent one over. I called back and asked to talk to a manager because the labor price as it was written was around $800 an hour!  The secretary said she would have the technician call me. No one called me back for a few days. I called again and the secretary said she would have the service manager call.  I then received a text message from the technician sayin that they could not give me an itemized invoice (He lied. I already had one) and said they just did lump sums for services. See screenshot below.  He told me to reach with more questions...I did and told him I had an itemized receipt and felt taken advantage of. He never responded.  We will NEVER use them again.

reviews.author: Janeen D.
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with this company.

Looked on yelp to see which businesses had some great reviews and reached out to several. This company at first seemed great, but unfortunately seemed to forget they had already told me they were scheduling me.

This message is from Jim through Yelp "Great! We'll book it at 4:30pm then. I'll create an account for you to book the appointment. Can you please provide me with your complete name, address, phone number, and email address?"

I received another email that said should we book this for a time between 4-6? when they had already said they were booking this slot for me.

I provided all of the information they asked for and today when I wrote them to confirm, they said the appointment is not available. Very disappointing as I had called several companies to come out and give me a bid on this electrical project. Why promise an appointment and then go back on what you have already said?

While they may have quite a bit of great reviews, if you say you are scheduling me and then do not actually do so, and try to schedule me for a different day other than what we discussed, then apparently this job was not that important to you.

reviews.author: Juan Camilo Acevedo
reviews.text:
Our furnace broke on December the 30th. Real bad timing. Jim came and worked super hard on trying to get it back online. The circuit board was fried. Jim was thorough in trying to give us as many options and as much information as he could. He didn't push for any particular option and clearly just wanted to help us. We decided to go with a new furnace. On January the second Justin was in our doorstep first thing in the morning. He did  a terrific job replacing the furnace. After he was done everything was clean and organized. This is the third time we have used Expert Services, and we have been satisfied every single time. They are great!

January 2025 update: This is the fourth time we use Expert services in our house for a big project. Since my original review the AC went, the main line broke and the water heater started leaking. Our house is almost 100 years old, so this kind of thing happens. Every time Expert Services has done an OUTSTANDING job. Toda Matt came and install a new water heater, he was timely, fast, and professional. I cannot say enough good things about this company and all the people that work for it.

reviews.author: Kim B.
reviews.text: I have an 100 year old home in SLC and had a sewer back up in the basement on a Friday night. We had a plumber clean it out twice but he said the sewer pipe needed to be replaced. Online I requested a estimate from Expert Plumbing and the same evening they texted me back with some questions and requested the video from the plumber. We made an appointment for a visit on Monday. I met with a technician, Poncho, and he was amazing. He explained the process and was so professional. The cost was reasonable and they worked hard to get me on the schedule as fast as possible. They were the most professional and caring company I have ever worked with. They went the extra mile in every way possible and made sure we understood every aspect of the job and any issues that came up. Their recommendations were always spot on and every change that was needed was performed quickly, reasonably, and professionally. I would recommend them to anyone who needs HVAC, sewer or furnace repair.

reviews.author: Hannah Vognild
reviews.text:
BEWARE OF PREDATORY BUSINESS TACTICS. Expert Services contacted me to schedule a “routine furnace tune up” as part of my paid membership benefits. The tune up resulted in the technician red-tagging and turning off my furnace. He claimed dangerous CO leak (over 14ppm), gas leak, cracked heat exchanger, and several other issues, suggesting a full furnace replacement for almost $6k. Luckily I got a second opinion. Two independent licensed technicians evaluated the same furnace within 24 hours and found:
- No gas leak whatsoever
- No cracked heat exchanger
- CO levels consistently at or below 4 ppm (normal indoor range) verified on multiple calibrated devices
- A functioning furnace that ran normally aside from the dirty air filter

I shared these concerns about my experience with Expert Services but they were extremely dismissive. I would not recommend this company or trust any diagnosis they give without getting a second opinion.

reviews.author: Simon S.
reviews.text: A class act. These guys have their systems well worked out, and their service tech (Chandler) was a pleasure to work with. I requested a project via Yelp--a clogged kitchen drain which had been giving us problems for awhile). Expert Services was the first to respond (a few minutes), they communicated clearly and quickly at all times, they gave me a timeframe for the appointment, and they showed up early. Chandler got right in and did the job (plus one little thing extra which I really appreciated), and he took the time to explain what he found, which helps us understand what we are dealing with long-term. we requested a quote for a separate electrical project, and saw their system at work through that project as well, and the service was the same high-quality. They built trust, the value was reasonable, the service was excellent, and we have our lives back. :-) I definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Jim M.
reviews.text: Had expert services out twice in December 2023. First had them install two replacement bath exhaust fans that I had purchased. This took about 2 hours to complete and was charged about $390 or at a rate of $195/hr. Super excellent work fast efficient and very professional. Then had them return as had a short in one of the fans which they were able to rewire to combine with light switch, problem solved great work BUT was a first charged $860 for the 1  1/2 hr it took. Thought that was way too high. After 3 calls requesting a justification finally a manager called and said sorry wrong  "code" was used and refunded about $300. Even with that I paid just over $500 for a 1  1/2 hr job or $340/hr. Still an outrageous amount. Very high quality work but feel ripped off by price and lack of transparency to justify it. For this reason will not be using them again.

synthesis.summary: A well-staffed multi-trade shop that handles sewer disasters and emergency water heaters with genuine urgency, but a handful of reviews flag aggressive upselling that should make you ask for itemized quotes before authorizing anything
strengths: Fast emergency dispatch: multiple reviews cite same-day or next-morning arrival, including one sewer disaster resolved before the homeowner returned home
Strong crew-level consistency: at least 10 named technicians (Mika, Chandler, Jonathan, David, John Harvey, Gavin, Wes, Micah, Dan, TJ) each praised by name for professionalism and clear explanations
Durable workmanship on complex jobs: one long-term customer reports zero rework needed across 7+ repairs on a 15-year-old home, and a sewer line crew restored the lawn before leaving
weaknesses: Pricing transparency is inconsistent: two 1-star reviewers cite specific overcharges ($707 for basic installs the customer called wildly out of line; $1,600 water heater quote for a $60 DIY fix), suggesting quotes can vary sharply depending on the technician

HVAC diagnosis credibility questioned: one detailed 2025 review describes a furnace red-tagged for CO leaks and a cracked heat exchanger that two independent licensed techs found completely fabricated, with the company responding dismissively to the complaint
redFlags: Two separate reviews (2018, 2019, 2020) allege technicians recommended unnecessary repairs or inflated quotes — one homeowner paid $900 for work that didn't fix the original leak after being pressured despite repeated objections

December 2025 HVAC review describes a potentially fraudulent red-tag condemning a functioning furnace and pushing a $6k replacement; second opinions from two independent techs found no gas leak, no cracked heat exchanger, and normal CO levels — this is the most serious individual complaint in the dataset
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews confirm rapid emergency response: one customer with a sewer disaster got same-evening acknowledgment and a Monday crew; a water heater leak was diagnosed and replaced in under 2 hours; one review notes a technician arrived within an hour of a holiday-weekend call — emergency capability appears genuine for plumbing, less clear for HVAC after-hours.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at 4.8 while Yelp is notably lower at 4.4, and the reviewed sample contains three 1-star complaints about upselling and fabricated diagnoses that are consistent with the Yelp gap — the Google rating likely skews high due to volume of satisfied routine-service customers.

reviews.author: Tricia Bronson
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this heating service. Todd showed up with such good vibes - friendly, professional, and easy to talk to. He explained everything clearly so I understood what was going on. He also provided detailed photos of the work, which I really appreciated - it gave me confidence that everything was handled correctly. Excellent service from start to finish! I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Maria Mumby
reviews.text: He was very nice and easy to talk to. He went through everything with us and made sure we were told all our options prior to the work starting. We appreciated this very much as new home owners trying to navigate our home, having it laid out so thoroughly was a huge help. The work he did looks great and we would love to have him come back in the future

reviews.author: Thomas Osimitz
reviews.text: Todd Petersen from Just Right came to our home recently to do annual service on our 3 gas furnaces. We appreciated that he called about 20 minutes before he arrived. When he showed up, he was polite and cheerful and very professional. While working on the furnaces in our basement, he was very patient with my questions and told me the kinds of measurements he was making and why they were important. He offered some suggestions for possible upgrades for us to consider, but never pressured us to make a decision. When he concluded with the 3 furnaces, he gave us a detailed written Tune-Up Inspection check list showing, among other things the various measurements and how they compared to what was desired. This is the first time that Todd has come to our house and he was just as professional and customer-oriented as the other people from Just Right that served us over the last three years since moving into our home. This speaks to the fine training program that Just Right must have and also to their ability to attract friendly and highly capable service professionals like Todd.

reviews.author: Ryan U.
reviews.text: They did a great job installing my furnace 10 years ago. But now their service area does not cover my area. So they told me to pound sand.   So big promises of long time support but don't count on it.

reviews.author: Cydney F.
reviews.text: Sure go with them, If you want them to come too early, or sell you something you didn't talk about. to two old ladies, both who are disabled. I was given a quote in Middle of Oct for repairs of over 7k. I  told them we meaning my mother and I could not afford that for our out of pocket cost, which would be over 4000 for us. I kept saying no we cannot afford that. My mother has Alzheimer's and doesn't understand what is being said to her, so she really has no clue what's going on. I feel as though I have been strongarmed into buying a brand new unit of over 10k, of which I will have to pay for when my mom passes. Just a note here, I am unhoused ( you know homeless) where the hell am I going to get the money to pay for a new heater? I'm also disabled. Their so called money guy, was supposed to help us get a better price for repairs, not sell us a brand new unit. I'm sure he sleeps just fine, they have working heaters, we have an oven, to keep us warm.  I don't know how we are going to pay for a new heater we didn't ask for?  I guess we can keep using our oven, and not the 10 thousand dollar  heater we didn't ask for to heat our house !!!!!!

reviews.author: Sara S.
reviews.text:
Add me to the list of people they tried to pressure and swindle in the most shameful ways. Tried to get me to finance around $20K on the spot.

The outright lies made me wonder if someone is trying to fund a drug habit. Said the A/C unit was old and that refrigerant had crusted around the outside. Said the refrigerant was empty. Was going to be too expensive to perform a complete troubleshooting; new everything makes the most sense. 

Said my unit was all blocked up in the vent area and they would need a special tool to clear it because anything else will damage this fragile piece. How would I know? It's on the roof. They sent out their second 'guy' to close the deal. Told me not to run my A/C or it could burn it out without refrigerant. Then both their tech and sales guy (separate visits)  made sure to turn it on when they left. They tried to sign me up to their maintenance program. Made a huge case for why I would need to replace both heater and A/C at the same time and used fear as the motivator in about 3 different ways (and that I need to act now because the prices have already gone up significantly because of tariffs). 

Got a referral from our HOA for their preferred, longterm pro. He showed up, said the unit isn't very old and it's a quality one that he installs all the time. The crust on the outside is condensation from hard water. No big deal. Said there is a little big of leaking from refrigerant, but all A/Cs leak a little. Said the system was not empty of refrigerant. $310 TOTAL. Said I should call next year to check how much it is leaking. If more, then a simple leak stop solution treatment and valve adjustment will handle it. Unit is not blocked up; average buildup that could use a hose off but nothing concerning. 

Wisdom from someone else in the industry: If they are an HVAC company that needs to advertise, don't call them. Somebody has to finance their new, nice vehicles that have expensive wraps.

Get that second opinion. Ask others you know who have had longtime service from a local pro. Support those people. I would be embarrassed to no end to work for this company. 

edited: added info about 'clogged' vent.

reviews.author: Kevin M.
reviews.text:
I had them come out about two weeks ago to install a new central air unit and furnace. The unit and the furnace seem to work great so no complaints there, but their install and attention to detail doesn't quite match up with the price I paid. I didn't want to go with "the cheapest option" so I picked their bid of the 5 I got which was right in the middle of the road. My main issue was I had to call them back the next day because they forgot to turn my water heater back on, that was a shock to my morning, but they were able to walk me though turning it back on. When my air conditioner runs there's now an audible rattling sound from one of the pipes they laid to go to the AC outside, I'm going to see if I can put something up there to make a little quieter. And also they left one of the holes they put in my house going to the furnace unsealed and didn't put the insulation back. Not sure if it can be sealed.... I'm not an AC installer but it seems like a good way for bugs to get into my home so I'm gonna try. At the end of day my home is cooler and I got what I paid for, but the installers seem like they just want to leave at the end of the day. They will pressure you into signing the "jobs complete" paperwork and cutting the check before they are finished, but be sure to spot check their work before they leave and you should be fine.... but for the price I paid I don't feel like I should have to babysit them.


6/2/2020 update: I got into contact with them about my concerns and they are very professional and apologized for the water heater incident. They came out to inspect the rattling and the non-sealed areas outside my house and It turns out those hoses were sealed but they were sealed with clear sealant on the outside that I couldn't see that also let light in (my mistake), and they addressed the rattling issue which has made my house a lot more pleasant to live in. They were very professional about it and I'm a lot more confident in the work they performed.

reviews.author: Happy Dumpling L.
reviews.text:
My AC decided to die on me last week and these guys were amazing! 
First of all I live in a gated community of townhomes and my unit is in the middle so access is not an easy task. 
Upon arrival these guys were friendly and very informative. They assessed the situation and let me know the fan in the unit had been completely destroyed by something getting into it. Both of my outdoor AC unit and the indoor funace/ac were 20 yrs old and not functioning well to begin with, then it started making a rattling sound and was super loud then it just stopped completely, which is the reason I called. 
Chase was very helpful showing me my different options and explaining the difference between them all, he offered the option of financing and helped me through the payment process and explained clearly when I asked about thier cancelation policy which was as simple as if you cancel then u are refunded your deposite in full no questions asked. 
The delivery of the unit was complicated as I am the middle unit in my complex so
They brought in a crane and Regie helped the incredible operator direct it onto my back deck with no damage to my gutters and precision of placement, he put the new unit in place and had the old unit removed again by crane which is quite a task but such an amazing option to have especially in my situation. He also removed my old furnace/ac in the basement and brought all new equipment down for the following morning. He was a one man show on this job aside from the crane operator, I'm assuming because of the 4th of July the day before, and he crushed it!! 
The next day Todd and his partner showed up early and orked diligently and effectively! They we're able to come up with solutions with the thermostat and wiring that saved me some dry wall repair, which I greatly appreciate!! 
Overall my experience was very positive and I would highly recommend this company to anyone looking for an honest, reliable, and trustworthy team of employees and buisness!

reviews.author: Rick W.
reviews.text:
I rarely get my furnace serviced.  I usually just swap out the filters about every four months and it seems to work fine.  But since it's been eight years or so I thought I'd get a service performed before winter.  Just Right Air had a 50% off furnace service so I took advantage of it. 

They came out promptly and were professional.  The technician looked over the components, thoroughly vacuumed the dust away, replaced the filters (I provided), pulled the blower and looked up the duct, ran the furnace for ten minutes or so.  Everything took about 40 minutes.  Just as I figured, the furnace really didn't need anything.  The 50% off price was $90.  Paying $90 for someone to vacuum the furnace and replace my own filters was not worth it.  And to think that the regular price was $180 . . . ridiculous.  They advertise being much more thorough than the "cheaper" competition, but how much more thorough do you really need to be to vacuum and change filters?  

I think these "regular maintenance" promotions make the company a lot of money. He mentioned a  "service contract" so I'd be on a regular yearly schedule.  No way. The technician was polite and seemed knowledgeable and I'm sure if there were a problem, he would have been able to fix it (at additional cost), but I seriously doubt I will get a furnace "tune-up" again.  If I would have done as suggested and got a tune-up each year for the last 8 years, I would have spent $720 (and that's with the 50% off).  Not worth it.

reviews.author: Jeff H.
reviews.text:
I've had a horrible experience with Just Right Heating & Air. I had issues with the AC system in my home so I called Just Right. in a nutshell, I ended up replacing my entire heating & AC system with brand new, top of the line equipment. Just Right sold & installed the whole system. That was a month & a half ago. Yesterday the AC stopped working, it freezes up as soon as it turns on. Of course this always seems to happen after hours, on weekends. There is no human to speak with after hours, even though they advertise 24/7 service. you can leave a message with an AI assistant & you they may or may not call you back. I called them the next day right when they opened & scheduled a technician to come out the same day between 12:00-4:00
I got a text at 3:45 telling me the tech was just finishing up a job & would be headed my way next. He never showed up. By the time I realized that, it was after hours & no matter what number Id call or text, I was greeted by the same AI assistant that is utterly useless. So $17K later, I have a brand new AC system that doesn't function & Just Right could care less. Funny how proactive & attentive they are when they're trying to get your money, once they have it.... Crickets. I highly recommend looking  elsewhere for any of your HVAC needs.

reviews.author: John K.
reviews.text:
Tony W, and assistant arrived on time and we're immediately friendly. They  provided me with excellent service and insight into my heating and cooling system. They alerted me to a cracked manifold in the heat exchanger. This is potentially a dangerous situation, perhaps causing carbon monoxide poisoning if left unattended. The main controller board is acting wonky, while the furnace is at the typical EOL "end of life" stage and a s not as effective as a new system will be.  I am now as the main board is acting wonky and the furnace is at the typical EOL "end of life" stage and is not as effective and efficient as a new system will be. We are now in the process of having "Just Right Heating and Cooling" replace the furnace, making our house more energy efficient and much safer when it comes to our heating and cooling needs.

P.S. Tom T, the Design Technician at "Just Right Heating and Cooling" is just as professional as the rest of the team at "Just Right Heating and Cooling". Based on his bid and suggested options, we did not hesitate to have them replace our entire HVAC system. They are the most professional, and provided us with the best bid for a new system. Highly trusted!

Kind regards,
JK

reviews.author: mark p.
reviews.text:
I've given this company about 10 chances to not earn a one star review but at this point I'm done. I had an issue with a split unit system and the tech came out and charged me $349 to diagnose the issue. No clue why it cost that much and the diagnosis didn't go towards the fix. If I hadn't spent a ton of time over the next 3 weeks, I would have never heard back from Just Right.  It took me 3 weeks and about 5 calls to get a quote for the fix, but when the quote came it had only 1 of the things the tech told me about during the visit. So I called back and asked whether this was because the other stuff was unnecessary or if I might do the thousand dollar repair only to find out the issues aren't resolved. The nice lady on the phone said I'd hear back immediately. After another two weeks and several phone calls, I got a second quote from the original tech that was another couple thousand dollars with no explanation of what he actually was recommending.

Overall, they are super friendly on the phone, but they have done a bad job of providing basic service and I'd rather just buy a new unit (from someone else) then pay them for a who-knows-what chance that my unit will be fixed.

reviews.author: S. D.
reviews.text: I did extensive research and decided that Trane was the brand of A/C and furnace I was most interested in as replacement units for my Park City townhome. Much of the research says that who installs your HVAC system is as important as the brand you choose. I researched reviews and contacted Just Right Air for an estimate. Jordan showed up for his appointment on time and did a thorough review of my current system. His proposal included a two-zone system with a highly efficient A/C and furnace. I consulted with a Lennox dealer and after analyzing the offers I decided to go with the most highly rated contractor, Just Right Air. They scheduled the work, showed up on time, and installed my new HVAC equipment. Allan and Jake were phenomenal. They were very neat and clean and consulted with me throughout the process. They successfully performed a difficult installation of wires so that I could use my preferred thermostat for the 2nd zone. They cleaned up prior to leaving my property and were very knowledgeable and helpful. This has been one of the best experiences with a contractor of any kind. I would highly recommend the Just Right Air team.

reviews.author: Barry Ballard
reviews.text:
The detailed examination of the environment and thorough explanation of the options - benefits and advantages - much appreciated.  We've always had great experiences with Just Right and this is no exception.

Update:  4/6 less than 2 weeks after install of the Elite system at a fairly hefty price tag, we co.e back from a weekend away and the brand-new system is dead.  I contacted Just Right and they said a tech would be out between 9 and 11.  At 11 I contacted them and was told the tech was running late on another job.  When the tech finally got here, it was discovered the fann motor is not responding.  The soonest they can get a replacement will be the next day.  The biggest concern I have is what appears to me to be the lack of urgency Just Right is showing.  I recognize our brand new "Elite" system is likely a fraction of a percentage of their revenue, but that it is their best in class and within two weeks it is dead, it is receiving considerably less attention than I have experienced from Just Right up to this point.

reviews.author: Kelly P.
reviews.text:
recently had Just Right Heating & Cooling out to my home. The technician was professional and got my system running again by replacing a warm start capacitor. The work was done correctly, but the bill was $1,300 -- a job most reputable companies typically charge between $150-$400 for, and one I could have done myself for about $40-$60 in parts and 10-15 minutes of work.

At today's visit, I was quoted $2,178.94 total, including $393 just to replace a 24V control transformer. I ordered the exact part on Amazon for $25 and replaced it myself in about 5 minutes.

All told, Just Right would have charged me $3,478.94 across these two visits for work that cost me $85 total in parts and about half a day of light work to diagnose, order, and install.

The work quality was good, but the pricing is far out of line -- well over double what other reputable companies would charge. I recommend either doing these simple repairs yourself if you're comfortable, or calling around until you find someone whose pricing is more reasonable.

synthesis.summary: Technicians consistently earn praise for patient explanations and detailed inspection reports, but scheduling reliability and high-pressure upsell complaints are real enough to give pause before signing a membership contract.
strengths: Communication and transparency stand out across at least 8 reviews: technicians provide written inspection checklists, photos of completed work, and walk customers through all options before starting — rare for the trades

Fast dispatch on urgent calls: multiple reviewers report technicians arriving within 2 hours of calling, and one account describes the owner personally driving out in a snowstorm when staff were fully booked
Workmanship on installations is consistently praised, with reviewers citing thorough multi-point inspections of furnaces, faucets, hot water tanks, and pressure valves across several job types
weaknesses: Pricing transparency is inconsistent: one reviewer describes a $90 tune-up that amounted to vacuuming and filter swap, while another felt strongarmed into a $10,000 unit after being quoted $7,000 in repairs — suggesting upsell pressure exists even if it's not universal

Last-minute appointment cancellations appear in at least 3 reviews, with one Gold membership customer reporting their service was cancelled three times in a row — a serious reliability concern for planned maintenance
redFlags: One detailed 1-star review describes a technician condemning a furnace in winter as unsafe, with a second opinion finding it 'perfectly efficient' — a potential diagnostic integrity issue that directly affects emergency decision-making

Emergency after-hours responsiveness has failed at least once on record: a customer with a failed $17,000 system called the emergency line at 6:42pm and received no callback by 10pm in 35°F weather — and that reviewer attributes the decline to a corporate acquisition

A vulnerable customer (disabled, caretaker of an Alzheimer's patient) reports being sold a $10,000 system she explicitly said she could not afford, raising concerns about sales conduct toward at-risk customers
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Emergency line exists but has at least one documented failure — a 3+ hour no-callback in near-freezing temps. When it works, response is strong: one reviewer got a tech within 2 hours, and the owner himself responded to an urgent after-hours call during a snowstorm in an older review. Post-acquisition service quality appears to have declined, so emergency reliability is uncertain.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.9 stars across 475 reviews while Yelp sits at 4.0 across 99 — a meaningful gap suggesting the most critical voices are concentrated off Google, consistent with the pattern of concerning complaints found in the non-Google review data.

reviews.author: Christle Stezskal
reviews.text: Volodymyr was a huge help when a tenant reached out about their water heater not working. After another larger company got too busy to get to us that day, we called him at 4:00 and he was able to come over within the hour to do the repair. Communicated well and at a fair price. Thanks!

reviews.author: Matt Dailly
reviews.text: Vlad did amazing work for us.  He was actually the second plumber we called, and he was the first to make a real effort to get there that day.  After assessing our situation, he and his colleague came back the very next day to complete the work.  He noticed our old piping needed to be redone.  After completing the job, he noticed the same pipe had a hole in it behind the wall.  Without hesitation, Vlad spent the extra hour to repair that pipe as well.  We are very satisfied and will use him again for future plumbing needs.

reviews.text: Volodymyr is simply the best!  I usually don’t write reviews, but I felt the need to.  I had an emergency situation where the shower handle came off in my hand.  Water was spraying everywhere.  Vlod came out rather quickly and had the part ready to install.  He is efficient, knowledgeable, and super friendly! I will only use him from now on and recommend him to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Jason Cowan
reviews.text: Salt Lake Plumbing is amazing! Chad and Colton are great to work with. Colton went above and beyond helping with our home plumbing installation, making sure everything was perfect. Chad took great care of us after Colton was on site as well. Thank you!

reviews.author: Cassie Payne
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with Salt Lake Plumbing! I called them for a new water heater, and they were able to install it the same day. The service was incredibly professional from start to finish. Colton, the technician who handled the installation, was not only skilled but also kind and pleasant to work with. He made the entire process smooth and stress-free. I highly recommend Salt Lake Plumbing for anyone in need of plumbing services!

reviews.author: David Hanna
reviews.text: We are so grateful for Luke’s incredible service! He was professional, efficient, and truly went above and beyond by spending his Saturday working in our home. Thanks to his hard work, we have hot water just in time for the holidays. We couldn't be happier!

reviews.author: Seni O
reviews.text: Not very happy with this company. I had them come do some work on my home and the work was not done properly. We are still having issues. I was told I would get a call from a manager and no call back. They will take your money and not do the work properly. Find another plumber!

reviews.author: Dave H.
reviews.text: They emailed me and I told them to contact me the following Monday.  They said will do.  That was the last I heard from them.  Another failed recommendation from YELP - I have received several.  I now consider your service a recommendation of 3rd rate contractors and will decline any YELP recommendations in the future.

reviews.author: Merril Dayton
reviews.text: We recently discovered a leak in our jetted tub in the master bedroom which leaked through the ceiling of the laundry room downstairs.  We called Salt Lake Plumbing who immediately sent Luke Eddington out to evaluate and diagnose the problem.  After cutting a hole in the dry wall, he immediately made the diagnosis and explained that the tub would have to be replaced because there was no way to fix the leaking jet.  I asked him to send an estimate of the cost to replace the tub.  He immediately sent the quote which was better than others.  He set a date and, exactly  on time, showed up, removed the old tub, placed the new tub and did so without breaking any tile which would have been tough to replace.  He and his colleague, Colton Braiser, worked non-stop all day to finish the tough task.  They were efficient, focused, professional and did an outstanding job.  These bright young men are a real credit to your institution.  It was easy to give them 5 stars!  Attached is a picture of the completed work!

reviews.author: Emily Pilger
reviews.text: These guys are the best in the industry. After using their services a few times in a few different spaces, we will be calling them as long as we’re alive & they're in business. We’ve had experiences with Brandon, Luke, & Chad, all honest & easy to work with, knowledgeable & willing to explain. Started with a call for our rental when our landlord refused to come out, we just wanted the cheapest bid we could get. They gave an honest & reasonable estimate, coming in at 1/5 the estimate from another plumbing company. They also did great work, are clean & respectful & friendly. So we called them again when it was time do a full home inspection on the house we’re under contract for. Again, they came out right away, gave us a clear & complete idea of what we’re dealing with, were transparent when what I was asking for was going to start to cost money, and were completely enjoyable to work with.

reviews.author: Amity Mower
reviews.text: I can't say enough GREAT things about this company!! From start to finish, Colton and Luke were amazing! We had a complicated sewer line issue that required excavation to fix. We got multiple bids and Salt Lake Plumbing was the only company that didn't inflate the scope of the work that needed to be done. They finished the extensive repair quickly, and even stayed late into the evening to make sure it was complete. They did their best to minimize the impact on the inside of the house by tarping their work area off. And did a wonderful job of replacing the landscaping outside. They made an overwhelming project (in cost and scope) feel manageable by being transparent and giving us constant updates as the work progressed. My BIGGEST thank you to this wonderful company!

reviews.author: Nicole Evans
reviews.text: I just moved to my place and got a new washer delivered. The spigot connection to the washer hadn’t been turned on for a few months and the sudden surge of water caused a pretty bad leak in them. I looked online and found SL Plumbing. Although I didn’t get an answer when I initially called, within just a few minutes Chad called back and got Justin scheduled to check it out within the hour. Justin was professional and courteous and meticulous about getting the job done right. Once he saw what was going on he let me know of a couple options and got right to it. Thankfully with his fix the spigots are working as needed and we were able to break in our new washer. I’d definitely give them a call again and would most definitely recommend. 😊

reviews.author: Sonia Holt
reviews.text: We are renovating a very old house. We needed to get the bathroom vanity out but could not get the water turned off. No valve handles and vice grips wouldn't even budge it. We reached out and Justin from Salt Lake Plumbing was there in less than an hour. He was able to put new valves in and fix our problem. He went down in the little crawl space under the house so that we would know where the main shut off was in case of emergency. He even lifted out an old heavy trunk that had been there for years. This was on a Saturday evening and the price was very reasonable. Wow what a nice surprise that was. Thank you so much, you definitely have my business for life.

reviews.author: Jaws G.
reviews.text: I called to have a leaky faucet repaired and I couldn't be happier with the results. I was quoted a time they would be here and the original technician got caught up on another job so they made sure to send someone else so I didn't have to wait. The guy they sent was very professional and knowledgeable and quoted me what I felt was a very fair price. The job was done in about an hour and the results were perfect. This is not a big corporation type plumbing company but a locally owned operation so they really care about their customers and want return business. I highly recommend this company!!

reviews.author: Eric B.
reviews.text: I sent out a request on Yelp and five places messaged me back. Some seemed automated but a couple looked like a real person read and replied. Salt Lake Plumbing stated that they could see me today and left me a name and number. I called Chad and he got a tech to come to my house in only 30 minutes. He saw my problem and gave me options. He didn't try to guilt me into doing the more expensive work. He did the job I needed and was done in less than an hour. Clean and professional. I would use Salt Lake Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Josh Eddington
reviews.text: Salt Lake Pluming is the best plumbing service I've ever used! I've gone to them multiple times, for things as simple as a clogged shower drain, to tankless water heaters, as well as helping redo plumbing around traditional water heaters. Colton, Luke, Brandon, whoever they send out has always been the height of professionalism and their prices have always been fair! You can trust this company with your time and business, not to mention they are locally owned and operated so you can support a local business!

reviews.author: Moroni Alcibar
reviews.text: Chad came over to my house to help with my water heater issues after not having it function properly for a few days. They did everything they said they would from showing up on time, to inspecting, to fixing any issue I had. He inspected what was needed first and gave me options. We fixed the issue the same night. I highly recommend these guys as their service and speed to action was top-tier. Happy customer here, and plan to use these guys for any plumbing issues in the future.

reviews.author: david lewis
reviews.text: I take care of 28 commercial buildings I had a pretty big backup on the third floor of one of my buildings I called my regulars and they could not make it out I reached out to these gentlemen I seen them working on my neighbor's house they come out and handled the problem really fast and they were there fast very professional needless to say I will be using these guys in the future every single time and the cost was extremely reasonable no upsells I just can't say enough

reviews.author: Kim Belliston
reviews.text: Carlos, Tony, Onni and crew did a fabulous job with such a quick turnaround time. My water main was leaking heavily and not only were they able to put a new one in and route it in the best way possible, they brought the shut off valve to an accessible location in my home. Big shoutout to them for the great work done!

reviews.author: Janelle Leppink
reviews.text:
TLDR; Call these guys, they’ll take good care of you and your home 🙏 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

We had a pretty stressful situation this morning when a toilet supply line randomly burst and sprayed water everywhere in our third floor bathroom. Before we knew it, water leaked down three floors through the walls, the ceiling, everywhere. Total nightmare.

We called Monkey Wrench Plumbing and they were able to get someone out the same day, which saved us. Kyle was our technician and he was great. Super down-to-earth, easy to talk to, and clearly knew what he was doing. He explained that the old builder-grade plastic supply line had failed (which apparently happens more than you’d think) and walked us through what he was going to replace it with.

He swapped out the cheap plastic line and valve for a braided metal one that’s much more durable and built to last. It feels good knowing we won’t have to worry about that happening again.

What really stood out was that they also helped get a restoration company out that same day to start dealing with the water damage. When you’re standing in a house with water coming through ceilings, that kind of quick coordination means everything.

Overall, just a really solid local company that shows up when you need them. Hopefully we don’t have another plumbing emergency anytime soon, but if we do, we’re calling them again without hesitation. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Zoe
reviews.text: Excellent plumbers - Jerry has helped us out with leaks and estimates before. We recently had Jerry and Tony out to install new fixtures and fix a leaky sink shut off. Excellent work, professional communication, and on time.

reviews.author: Zuno Darcy
reviews.text: Extremely disrespectful, unprofessional and most importantly no integrity. NEVER call them for anything

reviews.author: Mitchell Peterson
reviews.text:
Bad plumbers, look elsewhere, especially for gas work.  They charged extra to add a hot water heater, claiming that wasn’t part of their bid.  Apparently homes typically don't have hot water.  After paying the extra $10,000 to have a water heater installed, I smelled gas in the mech room and asked that they come look.  They said “Oh, it’s just a small leak.”  Which is true, it was small, but it leaks into a confined space, thus creating a dangerous situation.  We had to have others fix it, and they were shocked that it was called good by anyone.
The hose bibs were not installed where they should have been and are all poorly installed and loose.  Water pressure to the master shower is low.  We can not run multiple fixtures at once without losing pressure.

reviews.author: Abigail Sorensen
reviews.text: We got multiple quotes to replace to toilets. Monkey wrench was cheaper and more responsive. Carlos came out for the quote and was honest and gave excellent feedback when we were discussing which toilet to go with. We decided to go with Monkey wrench and they came out the same week. Carlos and Tony were quick and efficient. They were friendly and answered all my questions. There was a hiccup when they picked up the toilet (it came in 2 pieces) and one piece was a different color. They quickly came up with a solution and when the tank was not available in the correct color for the toilet we had chosen their team made it right and gave us options. We ended up going with the newer version of the same toilet and they honored their pricing and went and picked up the new toilet promptly and had both installed same day as planned. Monkey wrench was easy to work with and incredibly honest. I would trust them with any future work in our home. Thanks Carlos and Tony!

reviews.author: Patricia Kulkus
reviews.text: I contacted Monkey Wrench Plumbing for a second opinion for some sewer line repairs. They were prompt in coming to my house and spent quite a bit of time evaluating the sewer line. They came up with a service plan that made sense to me and actually was more comprehensive than the first plumbing company I consulted. The job itself was a big undertaking and the team of Carlos, Tony, and Roman were great. They were very personable and communicated with me frequently. They demonstrated quality workmanship and good teamwork. They replaced an old basement drain as well. I appreciate their attention to detail. They will return one more day to deal with the finishing touches to my xeriscaped yard. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Namnecron
reviews.text: Our technicians Carlos, Cody, & Tony were absolutely outstanding! We had our water main break & we’re completely out of water. We got a bid from Scott Hale plumbing, which took a day for them to complete, & had priced the job at over $15,000. Carlos was able to assess the problem & had a bid to us at the end of his inspection. Their excavation crew Monkey Wrench bid came in at just over $6,000. Carlos was honest & fair with his bid, unlike the competition. Carlos, Cody, & Tony, along with their amazing excavation crew came in and completed the entire job in roughly 6 hours. Everything works great now! I highly recommend Monkey Wrench plumbing & will be going with them for all my plumbing issues going forward.

reviews.author: Joanna Larson
reviews.text:
My water heater stopped working, and Monkey Wrench Plumbing came out quickly and fixed the issue efficiently. Wes was incredibly kind and truly went above and beyond to help get my hot water back up and running. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. I will definitely be using Monkey Wrench Plumbing again for all of my plumbing needs!

Update: I need to add a sewer line in my home, Jeff came out quickly and was able to assess the situation and get me a bid. Super friendly, professional and knowledgeable. Five stars!

reviews.author: Monique Prutch
reviews.text:
Our plumber Jerry was absolutely amazing!! Very good communication, he did excellent work at a very fair price. He went above and beyond to help me and is very friendly.  Thank you.  Highly recommend!!

Carlo helped us today he worked very hard to fix our water heater and various other problems we had.  He was AMAZING!! I'm very grateful for his help.  This company is FANTASTIC I highly recommend Monkey Wrench Plumbing. Carlos was very professional and helpful,  very kind.  Thanks again.

reviews.author: Sara Arnold
reviews.text: I was so impressed at how quickly they responded to my request for service! Technician Kyle was thorough and helpful and incredibly nice. He explained everything clearly and was very upfront about estimates without any pressure. He worked quickly and I can’t believe that we were able to get our situation fixed that same day. Thank you for saving the first time our new daughter-in-law was coming to stay!!! Not to mention Christmas! Just found our new plumbers.

reviews.author: Bob Whiting
reviews.text: Monkey Wrench came and gave us a second opinion/estimate after a major sewer collapse and basement flood. Jeff B. was very competent, thorough and helpful, findng other problems that also really needed to be addressed. He proposed options and solutuins for our particular situation that were very helpful! The work was done quickly and competently. Jeff followed up and went way above board to take care of us and our particular needs! He's a great guy!

reviews.author: Judd Tingey
reviews.text: My water pressure regulator valve took a turn for the worst and needed repair. Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Sewer, & Drain had good reviews and were a local company and I am glad I picked them. Plumber Carlos L came over and diagnosed the problem and quickly arranged for a replacement. He was very nice and thorough in explaining what the part does, what happened, and what to expect in the future. I would definitely recommend them for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Danielle Wolf
reviews.text:
Jerry and Tony were great!  They were efficient, friendly, and knowledgeable. I would recommend them to anyone. That is why they deserve a five star rating!

I’m so happy to have hot water again and looking forward to utilizing a water softener with my new tankless water heater!  We were always running out of hot water. So when my water heater decided to flood the basement on Christmas morning, I figured it was time for an upgrade.

reviews.author: Jared Martineau
reviews.text: Jeff Beddow did a great job taking care of 2 sinks in master bathroom. He was very thorough  and also provided education and prevention which I always appreciate. There were cleaners here when he arrived and he worked seamlessly, though it was chaotic Great service, very timely and professional. I will be using them going forward. My friend referred them to me and he has been very happy with their work as well.
