He was professional, thorough, and took the time to show me pictures from inside the line after snaking it, which I really appreciated. I highly recommend Brian and would absolutely use him again.

reviews.author: Sherrita Magalde
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience with Mr. Rooter Plumbing. Brian Shepard arrived right on time, was an absolute gentleman in my home, and cleared two drains quickly, quietly, and without making a mess. He was truly a delight to work with.

I’m so happy I called my friends at Mr. Rooter—Brian and Wade. From start to finish, the experience was seamless and stress-free. I will never call another plumber again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: b ramsey
reviews.text: Brian was great. He was professional and efficient. Updates were given and he allowed me to check how things were going along the way. He notified me of potential future problems and made sure I got the best deal possible. I would highly recommend Mr. Rooter for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: David Young
reviews.text:
We hire plumbers to run their auger tool to cut the roots out of our main sewer line, and always see a video of the results.  We have done this preventive maintenance every 2 years, for the last 13.

This time we hired Mr Rooter, you should not.

In short, they agreed to cut the roots out, paid them, and the sewer line is still full of roots. They failed to do the job.  In all, they are nothing more then

shameless crooks. Licensed liars whose goal is to scam the consumer out of money - the proof, the after video showing us a sewer line full of roots.  No damaged pipes, no brakes, no dips, no joints coming apart.  Their manager said they couldn’t use the same double blade tool I’ve seen used over and over, but rather I needed to send a total of $1250 and jet-cut the roots out (400% more than 4 years ago), or for $19K have the system lined.

The plumbing industry in Utah has developed a sophisticated practice of deceptive fear mongering and exploitation of the consumer, prices have skyrocketed in the last 5 years, way ahead of any inflationary measures. Mr Rooter is right up at the top with all the other crooks.  Just avoid them.

reviews.author: Kinga Dupuis
reviews.text:
Our toilet has been leaking for a while so we called them to help us find out why. Because we had fixed toilet leak before we assumed we had a bad subfloor.

When the Plummer came he said our subfloor looked just fine and that all we needed was a new toilet. So we bought a new toilet at home depot for around $270. Previously we thought it was our washer that was leaking so we also bought a new washer for $700.
After the plumber installed our new toilet he wanted to charge us $800. We had already spent $270 for brand new toilet and $700 for a new washer. We told them that $800 was way too much. They finally agreed to $600 for the job of installing a new toilet and a new wax ring.

After a few days I noticed another leak. My neighbor came to inspect it. The tank was leaking onto the floor because they didn't tighten the tank to the base so it leaked all over the floor and onto the bathroom downstairs. We had to take the toilet off of the ring.

But after tightening the tank the water continued to leak but in less quantity. We think the seal is also leaking and it leaked into my downstairs bathroom and laundry room. Downstairs ceiling was dripping water down on our heads that we had to remove the ceiling.

They came to look and we found a small leak from a pipe's joint downstairs. They should have diagnosed this issue earlier instead of telling us we needed a new toilet. They did not pay us back for bad diagnosis of the problem and now we still have to reinstall the toilet ourselves and fix the leaking pipe so this post will stay up.

reviews.author: Andrew Ho
reviews.text:
We recently discovered some issues with our sewer line and called Mr. Rooter for help. They responded quickly and got to the root of the problem right away. The entire team was incredibly attentive, professional, and friendly throughout the process.

Not only did they do a great job, but their pricing was also very fair compared to other companies we looked into. Everything was explained clearly, and the work was completed efficiently without any hassle.

We’re very happy with the service and highly recommend Mr. Rooter to anyone needing reliable plumbing help!

reviews.author: Kellie Mieremet
reviews.text: We were extremely pleased with Mr.  Rooter’s installation of the sewer sleeve.  This sewer line had been a problem for years in our older home. Their team was professional, kind, and knowledgeable about our old pipes and the continued wear and tear on them if we did not seek a more permanent repair. We are delighted with how timely it was for the team to dig out the broken pipe and place the sleeve in. Now we have two additional clean outs and a solid sewer main line! They did great and we would work with them again!

reviews.author: Josh Hilburn
reviews.text:
Me Rooter plumbing was excellent! Wade and his team were fantastic to work with. From the start, they provided great customer service — professional, friendly, and easy to communicate with. Wade took the time to consult with me, answer all my questions, and made sure I felt confident every step of the way.

I really appreciated how smoothly everything was handled. It’s clear they care about doing right by their customers. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for honest and reliable help.

reviews.text: Brian Shepard was amazing to work with. After evaluating our clog, he presented options that were cost effective & efficient, the latter being more expensive. They resolved the issue which took a little longer than anticipated, but the trunk line is clean. Brian has snaked this unit multiple times before our occupation & notified us of the build-up in the cast iron pipe. He also presented us with a main line descaling option. Truly exceptional Brian! Give him a raise. Mahalo🤙🏾

Good work done right On time arrival to complete the job. Timely completion of the job .Even a follow up call. As well as a reasonable price , in a world when nothing is reasonably priced anymore. Just take egg and gasoline prices as an example of unreasonably high prices in this world .

reviews.author: Chaise Warr
reviews.text: Brian Shepherd did an amazing job. The project took longer than expected and ended up costing more. But he explained why and gave me many options to choose from. I told him time and time again, I’m a very busy person with a lot of properties, but he made the job go super smoothly and handled every detail. Thanks Brian!

reviews.author: Karl Nebeker
reviews.text: A fiber optic cable installation contractor damaged our sewer line when boring for the underground cable installation creating significant problems. Wade and his people at Mr. Rooter went to great lengths coordinating with the cable installation contractor to get the sewer line repaired, even working until midnight in December to get the repair done so we didn't have anymore problems.  Talk about dedication to customer service!

reviews.author: S Corry Jones
reviews.text: Mr. Rooters solved our kitchen drain issue in under an hour. I had used my 25ft pipe snake in both the bathroom and kitchen drains as everything was backed up, nothing I did was working. Our tech Troy was excellent and managed to squeeze us in on a Friday afternoon. He also gave me some tips on how to best clear things and increase my water pressure in the future. Thanks Mr Rooters and Troy!!

reviews.author: Emory Griffith
reviews.text: Mr Rooter of South Salt Lake did a fantastic job cleaning out our sewer main at our home in Millcreek. We had roots growing through in several places and they ran the camera and hydrojet to clear them. They provided a video of the entire cleaned line at the end and everything looked great. Very responsive team with great communication and a reasonable price. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kyle Muir
reviews.text:
I used to use these guys all the time. They are now Whipple. Overpriced and horrible experience.

Tech came put to visit. Reviewed units two tanks in our building and quoted me $3500 for each 40G hot water tank.

I quoted with another group that quoted $2300 for SAME unit.

Then, i checked myself, turned on gas, lit pilot light and BOTH units work Great.

No repair was needed. DO NOT TRUST Whipple.

reviews.author: Terry Harper
reviews.text: All Hrs installed a new Rheem water heater for us 3.5 years ago. This weekend it failed. The water heater was under warranty, but they charged us $1700+ in labor for 1.5 hrs of work to replace it. We feel taken advantage of.i would never do business with then after this.

reviews.author: Desiree M.
reviews.text:
DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY!  
 
Their website has a customer service satisfaction guarantee that they do not honor. 

We hired All Hours Plumbing to fix a broken heater. They sent a "professional" out to fix it. We were aware that it was already broken, which is why we hired the company. My partner and I both work full-time jobs. My partner works in the trades. The last thing we wanted to do on a weekend, was trying to fix a broken heater. So, we hired All Hours Plumbing. They seemed nice enough and sent someone out within the week. This person was a certified "professional" trained to fix heaters. 
 
The "professionals" approach to fixing our heater, which they claimed he was "trained" to do, was to watch YouTube videos for two days, then proceed to announce that our unit was broken. He did not fix the unit and charged us USD $650.00, which was how much the heater was brand new. 
 
I know for a fact, that if my partner was hired to do a job, and showed up to the job site with zero tools, spent hours on YouTube to figure out how to do the job, and had no idea how to execute the job, that he would not be a professional. He would, in fact, be a hack. 
 
After realizing we had been scammed, we reached out to All Hours Plumbing to discuss options. After having been avoided and given the runaround, a manager finally communicated with my partner that they had in fact, undercharged us, and should have charged us more. We hope that no one is unintelligent enough to ever hire this company and we hope you see through their false marketing. We regret not reading the reviews before hiring. 
 
All Hours Plumbing is not only providing false marketing, but they are doing fraudulent business. Do not hire them. They are not professionals. They do not care about you. They do not know how to fix heaters.

reviews.author: Felicia Boothe
reviews.text:
Updated review:
As this may be the only way I get the attention of someone that can help me, I'll update my previous review. Apparently this company merged or was acquired by Whipple. As of today, it is now the WORST customer service. I have scheduled HVAC service on, yes, my 1 year old system to have it evaluated due to extremely noisy operation. It may be entirely normal but I didn't pay attention in HVAC class in highschool so I want a professional to evaluate. I scheduled 3 weeks ago and every single week I get a call 30 minutes to their latest arrival time and they cancel. So, I am going to see which other company can service my HVAC without jeopardizing the warranty. Goodbye 👋 All Hours or Whipple, whichever you are.

Knowledgeable, trustworthy and professional. I put knowledgeable first because when hiring someone to do something I know little to nothing about, I need a person that knows it all. It builds trust to have a technician with that depth. Finally, they have to be able to communicate what they are doing. Isaac, Randon, Blaie and Elijah called to let me know they were on their way and arrived on time. They dressed professionally and wore slippers to keep the dirt tracked in down. They greeted my dogs! They spent the day installing my HVAC system and worked until it was done. They explained everything about the system and included some expert tips. They deserve a bonus for this job! I interacted with a total of 7 people from All Hours and they know their stuff. They listen and respond quickly. I had another tech come out for home warranty requirements and he did not compare to All Hours. Excellent experience.

reviews.author: MsK B
reviews.text:
We had a broken main sewer line. We called multiple plumbing companies. All Hours was the only company that got to us right away, took the time to explain everything to us and was upfront with their prices. They were efficient, professional, and had excellent customer service skills. They were also very kind and sympathetic to our situation. Everything that was not supposed to happen, happened. It was taking longer than originally planned not due to All Hours' fault, but Paul offered to pay for a hotel room for all of us anyway!! They spent a week with us and their qualities never wavered. They worked effortlessly around the holidays to restore our pipes so we could run our water (we have 3 children under 5). They tried their very best to work around issues to help with the total cost too. I not only recommend All Hours Plumbing to everyone I know, but I also TRUST them which is priceless when it comes to plumbing when you have no clue. It’s rare to find a company that is honest, hard working and has integrity. We use them always now, and are grateful to their entire staff. Paul, Alex, Shay, Anneka, Josh; all of their employees are amazing, thank you!!!

Update:
These guys have been bought out by another company. I’m not impressed at all, and looking for the people who helped us originally as they have started their own company.

They charged us over $20k for a new HVAC. Promised free filters for life and rebate options. Don’t fall for it! The follow up is non existent, there’s ZERO accountability or resolution for mistakes.
Shop shop around! Don’t fall for their sale$ pitch

reviews.author: Tahnee Sumner
reviews.text:
We had Whipple / All Hours Plumbing (same company) come out to assess a back flow issue with our main line drain system. The first tech was great. He ran an auger and fixed the immediate problem. It did cost $700 which is pretty outrageous.

We then had another tech come out to run a camera through the line to see what needed to be fixed. He didn’t record or take pictures. He gave us three quotes with three options. The lowest being $11k for a bandaid fix and $25k for a full pipe replacement from house to street.

This pricing is way beyond industry standard. I received another quote the next day from a reputable plumber for $8k for the full pipe replacement. Super frustrating to be taken advantage of. Also suspect that they don’t provide you with footage to review further. Customer service said they should take pictures at the least but the techs manager refused to redo it without charging us again.

I would never use Whipple or All Hours Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Makenzie Elliott
reviews.text:
Brett Averett did an outstanding job installing my sauna today. He took his time to make sure every part of the installation was not only done right but also looked clean and professional. His attention to detail was impressive, and he made sure everything was neat, level, and perfectly finished.

He was careful with my ceiling tiles and put them back exactly how they were. When he finished, the area was spotless. It honestly looked like no one had even been working there.

Brett ran two new lines from my breaker panel, about 75 feet, to my outdoor sauna and another line for a future hot tub. He wired everything beautifully, tested the setup with me, and made sure it was all working perfectly before leaving.

Thank you so much, Brett, for your excellent work, patience, and professionalism.

reviews.author: Anita Martinez
reviews.text:
We just had a new furnace and air conditioning system installed in our house. These guys were absolutely amazing throughout the entire process!!

They quickly responded to my request for quote. They immediately had us scheduled for a FREE in-home inspection & quote.
(We highly recommend Technician MIKE👍🏼)

The financing was a piece of cake!! It was unbelievably fast & easy.
(We highly recommend Gage👍🏼)

The installation was scheduled within 48 hours of completing the financing. The Installation Techs showed up on-time and fully prepared. They worked hard & fast, and they completed the entire job that day!!
(Highly recommend Emerson & Orlando👍🏼)

GREAT JOB ALL HOURS PLUMBING!
YOU GUYS ROCK!

reviews.author: Tracy Foster
reviews.text:
All hours is a great company. We have used them for about 5 year now. The service they provide is top notch,, the techs are great and punctual. Plus the prices they offer are very reasonable.
Since my review I learned the Whipple bought out All hours, which saddened me. I had a negative service call from Whipple some years ago and felt like I was screwed on the price for what they did. Today 4/8/24 , Whipple came out and once again I feel I was oversold on the service. Unfortunately I bought a 5 year service plan thru All Hours, and now I will have to deal with Whipple for 3 years, which is a real bummer. Then I will find a different plumbing company.

reviews.author: Mazdak Khalighi
reviews.text:
We just had a ver thorough duct cleaning by the hood folks at Whipple/all hours. Colin was insanely meticulous with his work and super nice and respectful of our house the entire time. After going through a renovation, the ducts were very much in need of a big clean and Colin delivered. Can’t say enough about the professionalism and excellent service we received. Can’t recommend it enough. Thanks again!

Great service! Answered my call at night, showed up first thing the next morning and were able to diagnose a problem with the sewer main missed by previous plumbers. Super nice and responsive. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jonathan Park
reviews.text: HOLY, do your homework before bitting any bullet! If they say something is wrong, ask what part and the name of it and do a quick google search before saying yes. We called for a tune up for our furnace, everything is working fine just preventative maintenance. The technician pulled out our ignition sensor as well as the hot surface igniter and told us it would be ~$850 to replace. Literally Grainger has that part for $25-75 for both. Don’t get scammed, that’s $700 dollars in labor for a 30min job and maybe $100 in parts. I get it’s a business but pretty steep at those prices.

reviews.author: Sadie Smith
reviews.text: We had a slow leak in the house we moved into 4 weeks ago. Had a tech come out from another company and wanted a second opinion. Lee came out and was so helpful, knowledgeable, and thorough. Really took his time with us and gave us so much information! We decided to go with them based on that. They got us in the next day with a new water heater with a great warranty, and Conner and Brady were SO KIND and thorough and helpful. The work looks great and they assured us that if we have any issues at all, that they’ll come right back out and take care of it. Definitely recommend!!

synthesis.summary: Shows up on holidays and Sundays for emergencies with skilled techs, but get a second quote before agreeing to anything — one customer was quoted $1,200 more than a competitor for the exact same water heater unit.
strengths: Strong holiday and weekend emergency response: Sam came out Thanksgiving night to replace a failed water heater, and a team arrived on a Sunday afternoon to stop basement flooding and a near-electrical fire
Technicians consistently explain work before starting and walk customers through results afterward — noted across at least 5 separate reviews spanning electrical, plumbing, and HVAC
Broad skilled trade coverage (plumbing, HVAC, electrical, EV chargers) with named technicians who earn repeat praise: Sam, Derek, and Michael each appear across multiple positive reviews
weaknesses: Pricing is a significant concern: one reviewer was quoted $3,500 per 40-gallon water heater versus $2,300 for the identical unit from a competitor — a $1,200 gap that suggests aggressive upselling or inflated rates
Reliability getting a technician dispatched has been an issue for at least one customer who struggled to get anyone to actually show up before finally reaching this company
redFlags: Pricing fairness scored 29/100 — the lowest dimension by far — and the one documented pricing example shows a quote 52% above a competitor's price for the same unit, suggesting this may not be an isolated incident
Extreme platform rating gap (Google 4.7 vs Yelp 2.3) with only 3 Yelp reviews, meaning a small number of bad experiences could be driving a significantly different picture than the Google aggregate
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Clear emergency capability: documented Thanksgiving night response, Sunday afternoon arrival for active basement flooding, and same-day service called out explicitly in at least one review — this company appears genuinely set up for after-hours calls.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.7 stars across 2,660 reviews while Yelp shows 2.3 stars across only 3 reviews — the Yelp sample is too small to be statistically meaningful, but the gap is stark enough that the pricing complaint may reflect experiences that don't make it to Google.

reviews.author: Nathan Feller
reviews.text: Casey and Tony were the techs that replaced my Furnace and AC. After getting quotes from multiple companies My Buddy had the most bang for your buck. Air purifier was the icing on the cake. Casey and Tony were professional, cordial, clean and fast! They broke down the information so I could understand it and even swept my utilities closet. highly highly recommend them and will be requesting them in the future. Thank you guys so much! Me and my family very much appreciate it!

reviews.author: M S
reviews.text: Derek D. and Hayden came today and installed much need faucets, and repaired my toilet which was loose and running all the time. They were professional, explained what needed to be done and the cost was super reasonable!! I appreciated the professionalism, neatness, and they were on time. Thank you!! I will be using you again in the future!!

reviews.author: Talon Ozmore
reviews.text:
They came the day after the earthquake here in Magna. Daniel looked at my water heater and between the both of us came up with a game plan to get our house back into shape. Unfortunately the water heater we had installed when we first moved in was replaced incorrectly. I explained that when you guys came to fix our AC unit and replace our furnace that our water heater was out of code. Expansion tank on the hot side. No earthquake straps. Wrong piping. Missing parts. No sediment trap on the gas line. Etc.Daniel took the time to listen and showed compassion for what we had gone thru. He offered solutions and advice that was greatly appreciated in a stressful situation. He came the next morning and explained every little detail on what he was going to do. We also found out that the water pressure was not where it was supposed to be. He explained that average range is between 50-80. Our house was 112. So our pressure regulator was the problem. He was a great help and I hope the owner Brandon( Daniel couldn't stop praising him at every chance he could) will see this and Give Daniel the recognition he deserves. You guys have come to our rescue multiple times now and I will continue to call on you guys even when we move. I have told multiple people to call if they need anything.
07/13 New service. We had our water main break and they once again came to our rescue. Brian was out within the service hours and said he would make sure we got taken care of.
We don't have enough words to thank this company for how many times they have come and treated us with compassion and respect for our house issues.

reviews.author: Aimee S.
reviews.text: I do not recommend this company. They installed a shower head and faucet that we purchased ourselves before hand, but charged us the same price as if we didn't buy it. The manager way over charged us for labor, even though the job ended up not as complicated as initially thought. We needed things done, and waited for 3 days for them to even come in the first place. I'm very disappointed in this company for taking advantage of us.

reviews.author: Karen G.
reviews.text:
Four calls, more than 1.5 hours on auto-hold, 3 voicemails, and attempts to contact online, all over 2 weeks but have never received a response from this company. I don't know what they're doing over there but it doesn't seem to be helping customers. I persisted only because they were recommended by another company. I eventually called someone else and had an appointment within the day. 
Don't waste your time with this company - they apparently don't need or want the business.

reviews.author: Getting By
reviews.text:
See BBB rating DON"T TRUST reviews
They charged $523.00 to put a 35 cent washer on a leaking cold water tub faucet.  They told my tenant that they needed to come back and charge another $700+ to come back and replace the manifold (a $60 part that shouldn’t take more than 30 minutes).

They even lied on the bill.  The bill claims they removed and replaced the seats.... They did not replace the seats.. They lied!!!
When you call them, they let you know the phone conversation is recorded.  I recorded my own conversation with them.  I have "Derek" the plumber saying that he did NOT replace the seats yet his $523.00 invoice says that he did.
I called and spoke to a manager and at first he seemed ok but quickly tried to justify the charges.  They tried to claim they did a “rebuild.”  By “rebuild” they meant they put a $16.00 valve stem and new handle ($10.00). The ONLY thing he did that even helped a bit was to put on. 35 cent washer. I am reporting them to all agencies I can as well as taking them to small claims court.   In court, I will bring a video from ringing the doorbell to fixing the faucet for less than $2.54 and less than 10 minutes!!!  In court I will also take the entire manifold out of my house and bring it to the judge.  I will be able to show EVERYTHING the plumber did do and what they were trying to charge nearly $1,300 for.  Maybe  these guys aren’t all criminals but at least one plumber and that plumbers manager are at best unethical.  I’m actually looking forward to showing the judge how blatantly crooked these guys are.  Again… they charged my tenant $523.00 when the only thing that needed to be done is replace a 35 cent washer and $2.70 seat.  The job should have taken 10 minutes total.  The plumber claimed he couldnt get the seat out thus why he wanted to charge an additional $700+ to change the $60.00 manifold.  I, the homeowner, EASILY was able to change this seat… EASILY!  The plumber either forgot “righty tighty… lefty loosy” OR he was purposely being unethical.  Even if he really thought the entire manifold needed replaced, parts would be less than $70.00 and absolutely no longer than 30 minutes.  I will prove this when I take them to court!  As a note, I asked them to email me letting me know they were issuing a refund or to provide a detailed justification for their bill or I was taking this to the next steps.  I have not heard back from them so I’m now suspecting it is more than just one plumber and one manager.  DO NOT TRUST THEIR PRETTY WEBPAGE AND GLOWING REVIEWS!!!!  I will update this review with the court case and number so that you can look it up.  Yes,,, I’m upset and don’t like it when people like this take advantage of trusting people.  Again.. they were trying to get $1,300 to fix a drip that parts should be $2.60 and 10 minutes.
If My Buddy The Plumber tries to respond to this review but states they dont have me in their system… They need to look up the multiple emails I sent over the past week regarding “Tyler and Derek” as well as the emails with subject line “Attn: Owner.”   My Buddy The Plumber needs to provide a refund.  “Maybe” they could keep a $49.00 service fee, 10 minutes work and .35 parts.  That’s it. I’ve given them more than three weeks to contact me.  I have contacted the Utah Licensing Board for them to investigate and will continue to file complaints with the Better Business Bureau.  I will also get my experience with them posted on Angie’s List, Home Advisor, Yelp and any other website for reviews.  The invoice that my tenant paid, clearly states the plumber “replaced the seats.”  as justification for the $523.00 charge.  This is a flat out lie.  I am the one that replaced the seats.  If they had replaced the seats, the problem would have been fixed.  You decide… Do you want to hire a company that charged $523.00 for a 10 minute job and 35 cent washer and still had the nerve to ask for another $700.00 to fix a problem that didn’t exist?  Even if the entire manifold needed replaced, the parts would be less than $70.00 and 30 minutes time. You've been warned.....

reviews.author: Casey B.
reviews.text:
Based on unsatisfactory service we received I do not have confidence in the abilities and knowledge of the plumber from My Buddy who "installed" a hot water heater for us. The hot water heater we inherited upon purchasing the home was leaking and we called My Buddy for an estimate on installing a new one. The manner in which the estimate was handled should have been a red flag as several incorrect quotes were sent over (wrong price, wrong size of water heater) before we finally agreed to allow them to replace and install. 
At the time of install we received more incorrect information from the plumbers onsite as they alleged we needed more work than what was actually not functioning correctly. We limited them to the hot water heater replacement only based on our own knowledge, speaking to the hot water heater manufacturer, and soliciting the feedback of another plumber who was familiar with the home's radiant heating system. 
The plumber alleged the equipment was installed and functioning properly when he signed off on the job being completed. Unfortunately the next day he returned to the house without contacting us as the owners when our painter onsite called to let him know the heat was not in the home. This means the heat was not working when he left the home the night before and was not on during the night when temperatures dropped to 12 degrees. 
He alleged to the painter, again never contacting us the owners, that the heater was working and he left the job again. And again, with temperatures below freezing the home was left another night and day without heat.
We discovered this the following day, now 48 hours into his job "completed" that the heat was still not on and the water heater had not been installed properly to allow for our system to return to where it could generate heat. We called My Buddy several times asking for help as the home was 50 degrees. While the dispatcher was very nice and empathetic, the plumber's manager was not. He ran through many excuses, none of which had to do with his plumber not completing the job or being knowledgable about our water heater or radiant heat system. We were left to our own google searches, speaking with hot water heater manufacturer again, and calling another plumber to reset the hot water heater and help our boiler get back on track to heat the home. 
No one from My Buddy called to check on this, apologize, or offer assistance. They only continued to send their invoice asking for payment for a job not completed with a botched install. Unfortunately we signed up for their "Membership" and now will not be in a position to use that service since they are not trustworthy.

reviews.author: Josh L.
reviews.text:
Watch out.

Found these guys via Yelp.

Needed someone to change my furnace filter. They sent a tech out here who insisted on doing a reading of carbon monoxide before changing the filter.

He instructed me to place device over an active heater in the house and we waited for 10 minutes. When I retrieved the device it was powered off.

I brought the device to him. He powered it on and pressed some buttons then turned the device around and pointed at the screen while informing me that I had 40 ppm of carbon monoxide in my house due to a broken furnace. He said that the EPA only allows carbon monoxide readings of 9 ppm and that my life was in danger if I continued to run my furnace. 

I called a second company who sent a tech out here. Second company tech did a reading in the house and right next to the filter. No carbon monoxide was detected in either readings. His device didn't power off.

**update**
After posting this they called me asking about my review...expressing concern. Representative from their company explained that it's possible the device was malfunctioning and that we should let them send out a his supervisor to take another reading. Oddly, their initial rep was ready to immediately take drastic actions after getting the 40ppm reading, like shutting off my gas, before having the supervisor "double check" the reading. Rep also had no problem charging me for their services. 

I told the rep on the phone that I didn't need them to come out. I told them I felt more comfortable buying a device and testing it myself. I asked him which device I should buy, he provided a recommendation due to the device's ability to measure peak times of CO readings. I told him if I found any CO readings, at the peak times, that would change my review to give them more stars. He instructed me to install my CO reader in the boiler room. 

CO reader came in the mail. I've been testing CO levels for 3 days and it hasn't picked up a single PPM. In the owners manual it explicitly tells you not to install it in the boiler room due to readings being thrown off.

Since discussing my experience with friends in the real-estate market, I've learned that these type of shady business deals are common. One friend said he had encountered this 3 times this year alone. I wouldn't recommend working with these guys...they seem to fit the bill.

reviews.author: Pauline S.
reviews.text:
I found My Buddy The Plumber Heating & Air through Yelp. They were quick to respond to my inquiry and set up an appointment, which was wonderful since it is so hot outside. The technician was polite and seemed knowledgeable. He looked over the air-conditioning unit which was still blowing air but it was no longer cold. He told me the high voltage distributor needed to be replaced which would be $225. He replaced the part quickly. When he came back in he said the compressor on my unit was working extremely hard and would probably break any day now. He told me I needed to replace my entire unit. I asked him to give me a bid so I could start the process of shopping around. He wrote down 3 different bids. Each included the retail price of the unit, the price he could get me and the price the unit would be before 8-1-18 because the tariffs would be affecting the prices of the units after that date. 

I wanted to shop around since the prices quoted seemed high. I had another company check out my air conditioning unit the next morning. This technician told me my air conditioner was working perfectly and I did not need a new unit. He explained to me the different tests done to show that it was working fine. He also explained the part replaced the previous day was actually a capacitor that only costs $89. 

I am extremely disappointed in My Buddy Plumber Heating & Air. I feel your technician thought he could make an easy sale because I seemed vulnerable. I will not recommend your company to anyone I know in the future. I believe it is important to be able to trust the people you invite into your home and from my experience your technician was not trustworthy.

Update:

The owner of the company did call to go over my review. We spoke about the experience and he asked if he and a sales technician could come out to check the unit. They came out and checked out the air conditioning unit. They could explain where the initial technician was making his assumptions. We talked about better ways of explaining the problem in the future. I appreciate the follow up and time to explain where I was coming from with my experience.

reviews.author: Sophia K.
reviews.text:
We booked an appointment with a plumber that MBTP scheduled to show up between 3-5 pm.

The time came and he hadn't yet shown up to the appointment or contacted us yet. We waited until 6 pm to call the company (we wanted to give him the benefit of the doubt that he might make it at 5:59), and the coordinator said that he was at a different job and she would text the technician that we were waiting for him. This implied to us that he would swing by and do a quick assessment after he finished his current job. Otherwise, why bother texting him?

The next day Alison called us to say that he had called us at 3 pm yesterday to confirm the appointment but that we missed the call. We looked through both of our phone logs to find that neither of us received a call. She said she had a log and recording that proves he called us. I asked what phone number he had dialed; she didn't have that information, "one of the two on the account."

"If you don't pick up the phone, you have 15 minutes to call back or the appointment is cancelled." This information could have easily been communicated when we called at 6 pm the day prior; we could've just booked a specialty after-hours appointment right there.

On the customer service call, Alison came across as incompetent, disrespectful and short-tempered. She was quick to cut me off and talk over me when I asked questions about what happened and the miscommunication over the 6 pm call. Her deaf, abrasive, patronizing nature dissuaded me of further hiring the services of this company.

I don't believe the phone call happened. Neither of our phones shows a missed call or a voicemail that they insisted occurred. My theory is that they overbooked, we were the casualties and they began lying to us about the situation to save face. Sometimes you drop the ball, that would've been fine. I don't know what the point is to harangue the customer over it.

1 star for Alison's customer service.

reviews.author: David T.
reviews.text:
About a year ago we had a small leak in overhead pipes in our condo. We called this company, and admittedly they had a tech out pretty fast even after hours. He then told us that due to the age of the building he had to call in a third party disaster cleanup company. We had the place tested for lead and asbestos when we bought it, but he said they only accept tests from this other company. The plumber left.

This disaster company shows up, and proceeds to cut a 40 by 28 inch hole in my ceiling. He didn't put down any plastic sheeting, and just let all of the insulation spill out all over the floor. He couldn't find the leak. They left us with a rented dehumidifier, but after finding out that it would cost $100 a day to "rent" it (they said 3 days minimum to get the moisture out of the drywall) I sent it back and bought my own at Best Buy for $150 total. 

The plumber comes back, and also can't find the leak. He turns the water back on, tells us to keep an eye out, then leaves. Of course the pipe starts leaking again, so using my own phone camera I find the leak myself and turn the water back off. The next day (2 days without water, bathrooms or showers), I contact my realtor and he sends us a private plumber. The issue was found, repaired, prevented from recurring (2 pipes rubbing together were spaced apart), and he only made a 6-inch square hole in the drywall to do it.

This company has got to have some sort of "special deal" going on with the disaster cleanup to generate business. We were charged over $600 to be without water for 2 days and the extra cost for a dehumidifier and a better company to actually find and fix the issue. 

We called the disaster company to find out the results of the super crucial asbestos test. The never bothered to do it, but charged us for that too.

reviews.author: Lina L.
reviews.text:
This company would take your money after doing an incomplete job to your water system.  On Friday I called out a technician to fix my water heater and PRV to fix the water pressure and get our water smooth and running. The technician gave me word that everything was ready to go and no leakage is going to happen again.  The next day my tenant called and said there was leakage in the kitchen and bathroom sinks. 

I gave the company a call and the receptionist Jamie said that the company is not responsible for any sudden incidents and said the leakage has nothing to do with the technician's job.  On top of that, the water tech has gone out of town. 

Okay, help me out here. The whole reason I called a technician out is so that the water doesn't leak again and you're saying any "sudden incidents" has nothing to do with you?!?! Then why do I need a technician for?!?! It hasn't even been A DAY! If it's been three years and the water starts leaking then yes, it probably has nothing to do with you. It's probably my pipes are getting old. 
But something like this happens right after the repair and you brush off responsibility and claim it has nothing to do with you?! As a customer, I can accept technical mistakes but I can't accept dishonesty from a business.

Not only that you tell me if it's weekend emergency you are going to charge me another 59 dispatch fee? It wouldn't hurt to let your technician to come out and clean up the mess the other technician has caused, would it?

At this point, I'm left unarmed. Homeowners please beware to not let any company charge you before they get started with the job. You never know what type of tech you are going to get and whether the company will put your needs forward after they take your money.

reviews.author: Alex P.
reviews.text:
I called in and was told the first available appointment was over a week out. It was a simple job so I scheduled it. I was going to have to take time off work for the appointment so I opted for an early morning appointment.  8:00-noon. As I waited and waited I happened to be at my computer and noticed a missed call from someone on my office office line. I called the number back immediately and was told it was the tech trying to get a hold of me. This would not be the number I would have given them if told you must respond within 15 minutes or they would cancel the job. (perhaps some better training on their end). Any way when I called in the person said they would contact the tech and let them know I was available, and it should be 20-25 minutes for someone to show up.

After waiting 45 minutes I called again and she said she would gt a hold of the tech. after a long hold online she told me she got a hold of the tech and he should be their in 20-25 minutes. Before she came back on the line the truck has already pulled up. The tech did inform me that he was just waiting around for my job but the notes said "not to show up before 10am". The tech looked at my outdoor facuet and without un hooking it  he then need to go under the crawl space to see the other end. Without getting into to much detail he decided that this was going to be a much larger job and quoted me $969.99. I called another plumber ManWill pluming. They came out the next day. It took them less than an hour and it was under $400. I have a rental property as well and am always looking for a good plumber unfortunately I would not be able to recommend My Buddy the plumber. When in doubt Aways get a second opinion.

reviews.author: Judy C.
reviews.text:
I will definitely not use this company again. In June, I needed a plumber to repair a broken toilet water tank, I looked at good reviews from Yelp, so I had this company to give me a quote for repairs. Mike the plumber came in and told me to replace the whole toilet because I have a commercial toilet( high-end model), he said it caused more to replace only the broken water tank( while the seating toilet was perfectly fine). I know it was a busy summer season and I was very busy so I decided to replace a new one that day. It was expensive then he continued to persuade me to replace the other two fine toilets which I have in the house. This is a high-end house in Holladay, and all he did was to sell toilets as a plumber!  To stop him, I told him next time.

First, the plumber was more than an hour late with another rookie plumber with him to come to my house. About half way to replace the toilet, the lead plumber Mike said he needed to leave, but he needed to collect the payment first. I was hesitated ( since I didn't have a good feeling about this service) but I paid. Then the worst happened, while the rookie plumber finished installation, he just left without letting me know that he was done. Luckily I had another handyman fixing something that day, he checked the new toilet for me and told me to have the plumbers come back immediately because the two pieces' new toilet was not even screwed together tight and they would break soon if not tightened together. I called their office and waited an hour again for the rookie plumber to be back because the lead plumber couldn't even face it! This was an awful plumber experience!

reviews.author: Isaac Riches
reviews.text: PLEASE READ THIS! We had My Buddy the Plumber come out 2 years ago to fix our furnace. They couldn't fix it so we paid thousands to replace the furnace. It sucks to replace a furnace, but it is what it is (so I thought). We had been happy with our experience until the past few days. There was condensation leaking outside the piping, so I called for a tune up. Turns out that the installers totally messed up the install and the condensation leaked into the furnace and is corroding the gas pipe, metal work, heat exchange, and has created an unsafe situation for my family. Though the furnace company warrants their stuff, since this is due to inept installers and employees of My Buddy the Plumber, it falls out of warranty. This is only a 2 year old furnace. So now we have to spend thousands more to either limp this along for another 2 years worth of life or buy another furnace. I had them come out multiple times during that first year (due to their loyalty program) to inspect the furnace and none of this was caught. RUN AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY. They are con-men and do not warranty their work. There are lots of reviews within 6 months to a year's worth of good reviews. But you can't trust those reviews due to the short time of owning those furnaces. Give it 2-3 years, and you would really find out that My Buddy the Plumber are terrible at what they do. Their inability to correctly do their work is DANGEROUS to anybody that is a customer. There should be a lawsuit against them and they should be held responsible for their unprofessionalism. Run Run Run away from them.

synthesis.summary: Technician quality is hit-or-miss — some crews are thorough and fast, but no-shows, unreturned calls, and botched installs that create safety hazards make this a risky call at 2am.
strengths: Multiple reviewers report same-day or next-morning arrival for urgent issues like ceiling leaks and broken hose bibs, with one tech on-site within 20 minutes of a call
Several techs (Shea, Daniel, Damon, Derrick) praised by name for explaining work clearly, offering multiple options, and occasionally waiving charges for minor visits
At least 3 reviews cite pricing as competitive or reasonable compared to other quotes received
weaknesses: Pricing complaints appear in roughly 1 in 4 negative reviews — examples include $555 for 30 minutes of PEX repair, $1000+ quotes later matched by competitors for $250, and labor charged at full rate even when customer supplied parts
Post-install follow-through is a documented problem: one furnace install left uncorrected for over a month, another caused corrosion damage and safety hazards discovered two years later
redFlags: At least 3 reviews report no-shows on scheduled appointments with no proactive communication, including one case where a tech physically fell through the customer's ceiling and the hole was never repaired
One reviewer spent 1.5+ hours on hold across 4 calls over 2 weeks with zero callback — a serious concern if you need emergency contact at odd hours
BBB rates this C- with 4 complaints in 3 years and no accreditation, while Google sits at 4.8 — suggests negative experiences may be underrepresented on Google

Two separate reviews describe dangerous installation errors: a furnace thermostat wire clamped on insulation instead of the conductor, and a condensate misroute corroding a heat exchanger and gas pipe
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Some evidence of fast daytime response — one reviewer got a tech in 20 minutes for an active ceiling leak — but after-hours contact is a known failure point, with the phone service drawing explicit complaints about hold times and communication barriers at night.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.8 across 2,527 reviews while Yelp sits at 2.9 across 100 reviews, a gap of 1.9 stars — Yelp complaints cluster around pricing disputes, no-shows, and poor follow-through that are largely absent from the Google picture.

plumbers.name: Near Me Plumbing & Drain Cleaning
plumbers.address: 3860 Marsha Dr, West Valley City, UT 84128, USA

reviews.author: Teresa Kuma
reviews.text: Near Me Plumbing & Drain Cleaning is a trusted local plumbing company that truly cares about our community. Not only do they provide professional drain cleaning, water heater repair, and emergency plumbing services, but they also actively give back to local families. It’s rare to find a licensed plumber that combines quality service with real community involvement. Highly recommend them for anyone needing reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Judit Tejada
reviews.text: The owner Cruz came out on short notice and was able to unclog our pipe. He did a fast job and had an amazing attitude. I would really recommend him to anyone looking for an amazing plumber.

reviews.author: Theressa
reviews.text:
Great customer service partnered up with amazing plumbing work. Thank you near me and Cruz for taking care of my clogged drain.

My mainline sewer way clogged and was able to get it unclogged the same day on a Saturday. They even gave me a free camera inspection to see the condition of my sewer.

reviews.author: Charles B.
reviews.text: The combination of the quality of work from the technician and the competency of the office is appalling! I recommend going elsewhere to get a better value. They really set me back because I am not having to pay someone else to fix their mistakes!

reviews.author: Cameron Steinman
reviews.text: I contacted Cruz to come out and hydrojet a mainline for one of my customers.  After spending 1 hour 20 mins on the jobsite they were gone and claimed to have cleared the roots in the mainline. I was charged $800 for 2 hours of work with no camera inspection. After doing a camera inspection myself I found the same amount of roots in the line as before, as if they didn't even hydrojet at all! I contacted Cruz and he set up an appointment for the next day at 3pm to return and complete the job properly. They no called no showed. I contacted Cruz again amd he set up an appointment for the following day at 9am. Again no call no show. Since then I have been ignored, they ignore messages from my office. They did not offer the services they charged for, did not warranty their work and have not given a refund. I do not recommend this company or Cruz for any type of work. DO NOT LET THESE GUYS IN YOUR HOME

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.text:
Oh, my heavens. I would love to give ten stars! The only unfortunate part of my interaction was that it didn't happen earlier! Two other companies came to my house before I was in contact with Near Me, nothing but salesman, with skyrocketed prices; blamed on necessary upgrades.
Near Me was the opposite experience. Cruz called right away and asked me for some pictures of my existing water heater, he was more than pleasant and completely willing to give me not only a free over-the-phone quote but also advice if I were to try to do it myself! The previous company told me they would need to charge me for "research" if I wanted direction in doing the job DYI style!
I must iterate this was during a holiday weekend! Such stellar communication! After Cruz gave me an out-the-door quote, of far less than half the other companies' price, the man of the hour, Jesus arrived punctually (again, holiday weekend) to replace my water heater. Words fail to describe how kind and helpful both Cruz and Jesus are! Jesus was more than willing to put up with me asking a million questions, and hovering over him while he busted his butt fixing my water heater! It turns out, all of the aforementioned upgrades were included in the quote! I could not be happier with this company and its wonderful team! I have found the people for my future plumbing, electrical, and HVAC needs, and most certainly any friend that asks for a recommendation!

reviews.author: dan white
reviews.text: So, I woke up this morning and went to go take a shower and I had to turn the hot water on full blast and was only coming out a little bit of lukewarm. I ran down to my basement and the pilot light was out and the little light on it was not blinking on the water heater. I wanted to maybe replace the necessary parts to fix the electric lighter that's on my water heater, but guess what, those parts take two weeks to arrive! So I called Cruz at this business and explain what was going on and he looked it up immediately to see what the serial number was on my water heater and found out that the warranty of it expired literally a week ago. So he then asked me to go down to the water heater and maybe he could talk me through on the phone just to see what's going on with it and lo and behold he explained a way to jump start the water heater and the electrical parts of it and now I have hot water! I cannot tell you how nerve-wracking it is to wake up on a Sunday morning and not knowing anything about water heaters, and worried about how am I going to even be able to take a shower now or what's going to happen when I try to go to work the next morning. I'm sure that this water heater will give me more problems and I will be reaching out to this business from now on for any problems I have with it! Gave me free advice over the phone on how to fix it myself, so now you have a permanent customer!

reviews.author: Colby Hake
reviews.text: My sprinklers would not turn off so I tried to turn off the water to my sprinklers and broke the stop waste valve then the water really started to flow, to the point I got some in my basement. I spoke with Cruz and he walked me through how to turn off my water from the main. Jesus was there the next day, this all happened at like 10:00 PM on a Saturday night BTW. But Jesus got the water on to house so we could at least shower. The crew showed up like 2 days later to fix the problem which was fine since we had water to the house just not the sprinklers. The whole experience was amazing and they were all so kind, legitimately concerned for our situation. They did phenomenal work and even recommended a great sprinkler guy. I can't tell you how thankful I am for their great service. This is the only company I would call if you have any plumbing needs. Thanks again guys, you are amazing and total life savers. Water damage is the worst but I don't have any thanks to them.

reviews.author: Amelia S
reviews.text:
This company is absolutely amazing! We had our main drainage from our home back up during a holiday weekend. These guys responded quickly when we reached out to them. They came out within 24 hours and arrived at the time they said they would.

Not only did they snake our drain to clear it, they also used a camera to show us what our drainage system looked like which we were not expecting them to do at no additional cost to us. At the end of the service, they were honest with us about what we could expect moving forward. We live in an old house so the pipes will need replacing or lining at some point in the near future. We didn't pay anything more than what we were quoted over the phone when we contacted them.

I will be using Near Me in the future for any of my plumbing needs. I will also be recommending them to my neighbors, family, and friends.

reviews.author: Jamie X
reviews.text: Unfortunately have to change my review to a 1 star. My tenants complained of a sulfur smell coming from a new water heater install by Cruz. I filled out an online form on 5 Feb and also texted Cruz's personal cell with no answer. I bought a gas leak detector and as soon as I walked into the house it reported 1% LEL. I then checked both gas connections on the water heater unit and it spiked to 4% LEL and 6% LEL. A very dangerous situation for this family and their newborn. You would think a plumber would check their work and test those connections. As I've now been ghosted by this company and also do not trust the work I now get to spend more money on another technician to fix this costly mistake.

reviews.author: Ckmom1 D.
reviews.text: Alex and Eddie did a great job.  Alex was very nice and explained everything to me.  Eddie also was very helpful.  We had a leak and Alex came that night to look into it.  We were glad he was available.  We had the pipes cleaned out the next day and a new toilet and faucet.  Our old faucet was very old and difficult but Alex persevered and now my bathroom is like new!  They also put in a new hot water heater at the home show rate.  It's so great to not have to wait forever for the water to get hot.  Getting the old water heater out was a bear but again Alex and Eddie worked really hard to get it all taken care of.  Thanks for all your hard work!

reviews.author: Qiu Lin
reviews.text: This is the best plumber I recommend. Cruise is the owner, he received my call for clog drain in early at morning during the weekend, and show up hour late at my place. And help me unclog the drain. He really acknowledged at what he doing. We had it done with short period of time since I have the  auger machine here already.  And he does it for FREE. He is really nice guy. And he show me what maintenance we should do to keep the drain flow. And he give me the suggestion that we should do hydro jet with hot water to completely take care the problem.

reviews.author: Alyssa Lathim
reviews.text:
Cruz and Jesus were so kind and helpful. They were the only ones that answered our phone call and they walked us thru what to do over-the-phone night of. It was late at night and our sprinklers were flooding into our house, they were at a real flooded house but still answered the phone to help. They proiritized us the next morning to make sure we had restored water to the house. We called at least 2 other compaines, no answer and no response from either of the other places for days. We would've had a ruined basement.
Thank you so much! 10/10!!!

reviews.author: Kristin Lillywhite
reviews.text: Cruz came out right away to help me with a weekend emergency. I was so impressed with his honesty. As a single mom, I feel like sometimes people try to take advantage of my lack of technical knowledge. Cruz serviced my home twice. Even though it’s only been a week, I’ve already recommended him to others. I highly recommend working with him and his company because it’s hard to find people who do the right thing anymore, and he does. I’m calling him first for all of my future plumbing needs and recommending him to all of my friends.

reviews.author: Lilly Villaneuva
reviews.text: Cruz came out within 24 hours to fix my water heater. I called and he was very sympathetic that we didn’t have any hot water 😭 he came right out on a Saturday and was very nice and was quick to identify the problem with my water heater. Even though he identified the problem he still checked the entire system to see if there were any other issues. I was very happy with the service provided and the cost as well. If I have any other issues I’ll definitely be using this company and will be recommending others as well!!!

synthesis.summary: Cruz and his crew show up fast for weekend and holiday emergencies, often charging half what competitors quote, but a thin paper trail of follow-up failures and a suspiciously low Yelp score warrant a second look before handing over your credit card at 2am.
strengths: At least 8 reviews explicitly mention same-day or next-day arrival for emergencies, including multiple weekend and holiday callouts
5+ reviewers specifically praise pricing as far below competitor quotes, with one customer detailing a price more than 50% lower than rival bids
3 reviews highlight free added value — free camera inspections, free diagnostics, and one job reportedly done at no charge — suggesting genuine goodwill rather than upsell pressure
weaknesses: At least one reviewer reports leaving a message that was never acknowledged or followed up on, suggesting communication can break down outside of initial contact
Several reviews are vague or very short (e.g., 'Great service, great price'), which limits confidence in the overall picture and inflates the positive signal
redFlags: Google shows 5.0 across 282 reviews while Yelp shows 2.6 across only 5 — a stark gap that could reflect a curated Google presence or suppressed negative experiences surfacing on Yelp
One review appears to be a word-for-word duplicate posted under two different dates (December 13, 2025 and December 13, 2024), raising questions about review authenticity

The February 2026 five-star review reads like promotional copy ('licensed plumber,' 'community involvement,' 'trusted local company') with no specific service details, a common marker of a planted review
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews confirm Cruz responds to emergency calls on weekend mornings, holiday weekends, and late nights, with several customers reporting arrival within one hour of contact — strong signals for 2am burst-pipe situations.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google sits at a perfect 5.0 across 282 reviews while Yelp shows a 2.6 across just 5 reviews — a 2.4-star gap that is too large to dismiss, and suggests either a concentrated negative experience among Yelp users or an actively managed Google review profile.

plumbers.name: Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 466 E 500 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111, USA

reviews.author: J G
reviews.text: We Love Monkey Wrench Jerry and Tony came and replaced the main drain in our house and they did awesome work. I would post a photo but am technically challenged lol but it looks great. Have used them in the past and will continue in the future best prices and very honest just what you want for repair/ home improvements. Thanks Monkey Wrench

reviews.author: Cindy Hall
reviews.text: Carlos Luna is a jewel to work with. Completed job as he said and very efficiently. He explained things well

reviews.author: Zack Myers
reviews.text: Carlos was great! I have an old home (built in 1908) & he added a shut off valve for my gas range at a very reasonable price. He also caught that I had a loose vent on my water heater & he fixed it free-of-charge. Highly recommend Monkey Wrench & I plan on using them on all future plumbing projects! :)

reviews.author: Kalen Abraham
reviews.text: They came out to repair the sewer line for my neighbor to discover it’s a joint line and connects to mine. They came over and asked if they could cut out a section of my driveway to access the line I said that was fine then the plumber assured me they would fix the spot they cut out and it would look fantastic better then before. We exchanged contact info and he would let me know when they would be out to do it. They came out fixed it and then left it for a little to make sure they addressed the matter. Week later they came out and finally fixed the driveway. Or so I thought a week passed and it started to rain after two hours I go out to find that the slab they laid was now sinking 2 inches and had a massive hole under it making it useless. It appears they just put dirt back in the hole but didn’t pack it so when it got wet it washed out and sunk down. That section of the drive way is useless and it is where I usually park. I text the plumber that set it up all with pictures of what it looked like and he told me he would send his guys out asap to address the matter I let a week pass and texted him checking to see when they picked a date. I was ignored it’s now been another week with no response. I’m writing this review to warn others of what kinda of work they do and promises they will make to you and not uphold.

reviews.author: c. sund
reviews.text: Monkey Wrench is my go to for plumbing problems. Wes Stringfield runs a tight ship and they're very reliable. Everyone there is knowledgeable, professional, and personable. If they have a problem like bad weather and need to change appointment dates or times, Wes anticipates it and gives you plenty of advance notice so you're not inconvenienced and you can plan around the change. Carlos Luna was my tech on this visit to fix a recirculating pump problem, a leaky tub drain pipe, descaling a tankless water heater, and installing a new bathroom faucet. He did awesome work and even simplified some convoluted piping from the tankless water heater to the recirculating pump for me! He's welcome back anytime. Great guy! Pricing was competitive and I have not one complaint. I highly recommend Monkey Wrench for your plumbing problems.

reviews.author: Rob Womelsdorf
reviews.text:
Jerry was great to work with. He arrived on time, explained what needed to be done and provided a reasonable estimate for the work. He added a pressure regulator and switched out a shower cartridge.

The following week Jerry returned to repair an unexpected leak under the kitchen sink and reconfigured the awkward plumbing that had been done before I bought the house.

Of the 3 plumbing companies I contacted, Monkey Wrench was the only one whose plumbers put on shoe covers before entering my house. They were very respectful.

reviews.author: Marcie Sabey
reviews.text: I used Monkey Wrench to come look at a couple toilets in my home that were making a gurgling sound. Turns out it was the sewer line. They got me on the schedule that week and fixed the issues we were having. They were fast, friendly and the price was great. I recommend them any chance I get and will definitely be using them in the future.

reviews.author: Lauren Stice
reviews.text: Carlos and Christian got my bathroom fixed quickly and with great communication and attention to detail. This is my second time going with Monkey wrench and I can’t say enough how amazing they are!! From scheduling with Marcie all the way to the work, they are awesome. And fairly priced as well!

reviews.author: Angela Waagen
reviews.text: Found our basement with water in it. The sewer had backed up. Had contacted several plumbers and had an appointment for the following day. Monkey Wrench was able to come same day and resolve the problem. We also discussed the eventual replacement of our sewer line.  Overall a good experience.

reviews.author: JODI CHRISTENSEN
reviews.text: Very Impressed! Chris and Wes were AMAZING! From scheduling the appointment to the clean up. Communicated what needed to be done when they assessed the problem. They were in and out in a timely manner. I will absolutely be using Monkey Wrench again for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: J Puckett
reviews.text: Carlos Luna came and did the work.  He was super friendly and professional.  Work seems to be done well and he walked me through all the steps he did so I can be sure nothing was skipped and corners weren't cut.  Even cleaned up after himself.

reviews.author: Charlie Tinn
reviews.text: Carlos and Chris were just absolutely incredible! Fast response, efficient repairs, and got it done rrrreeeaaallll quick. Can't thank them enough, now my fat ass can finally get a shower instead of sitting for a bath. Thank you guys so much!

reviews.author: Craig Poland
reviews.text:
Carlos is awesome! He was polite, professional and friendly. He cleaned up the little mess he made (no questions asked) and did a good job fixing the issues we were having.
Definitely coming back if we have issues in the future!

reviews.author: Kristi Bowler
reviews.text: Wes has saved me!  He squeezed me in for a same day clean out and didn’t charge me as he’s doing a bigger repair for me next week that will be a long term fix for this issue. He’s clean, tidy, friendly, and efficient.

reviews.author: Kim S.
reviews.text: Carlos came and assessed my drain issue and did the work needed so quickly and professionally and at a reasonable price. And he was so courteous and nice. I will definitely use them again when I have plumbing needs.
