plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 941 Bending River Rd W, Salt Lake City, UT 84104, USA

reviews.author: Ashley Wegrowski
reviews.text: Chad was fantastic! He took a thorough look at our water heater and helped explain what was going on in a way that was very straightforward and easy to understand. He helped to get us a new water heater under our warranty which was super helpful. He definitely is experienced and I couldn’t recommend him more! He was great and did an amazing job!

reviews.author: Gary Nielsen
reviews.text: A Roto-Rooter technician came to our home at 11:00 pm last night in stormy weather to assist with our plumbing emergency and advised me to wait until I had our septic tank pumped out before using their service. I was not charged for that service visit and really appreciated their honesty. The  Roto-Rooter crew came out again the next day after the pump out and were very, very persistent in locating and eliminating a clog in our main sewer drain line, which took many, many  tries and eventually relocating their equipment from outside to an upstairs bathroom . I really appreciate they they did not give up and got the job done. They definitely earned their fee. (The $100 off coupon on their website was helpful .) They provided me with texts and emails confirming their service appointments and the progress of their technicians driving to our home. Job well done!

reviews.author: Thomas Butts
reviews.text: Awesome techs! We were told a service window of nine to eleven and they arrived promptly at nine. A refreshing change from the norm of most businesses who leave you hanging until the last moment. Friendly, polite, sociable, and clean workers. Had the quote ready in less than ten minutes, and had a pipe removed, fixed, and replaced as well as a faucet changed in less than three hours, including the time it took them to run to the store for parts. Adie and Charlie are a credit to the profession!

reviews.author: Assad RAFFOUL
reviews.text:
3 days  ago I called Roto rooter at 9:00 PM to snake my 4 inch main drain pipe, in the basement. It was a straight 60 feet run in direct line to the street. The tech guy was prompt, he explained the possible problems that could happen and I signed quite a few documents. He told me the cost of snaking the line was $531.00 Dollars. That was an exhorbitant price that I never paid before in my life. But since it was an evening call and I needed to do the work I agreed. He brought down the tool and he snaked the line to the street in less than 15 minutes. I was expecting he will run the snake again but he was too busy trying to sell me further services. He refused to run the snake twice but he threatened me that if I did not agree to a free video inspection there is no warranty for the next 6 month on his work. He said if any thing happened  before 6 month the service is not warranted at all because there could be a problem in the line that only a video can find.
This was a totally new approach to snaking the sewer line. I have done it 25 years ago. The company at the time did it twice to make sure all waste was pushed out. Not Roto rooter. He packed his tool and left. I knew he did not clean the sewer well so I am calling my regular plumber to do another snaking of my line to assure all waste is removed.
Roto rooter is gouging its customers and will not do a decent job of cleaning the pipe i will have my line snaked in the day time for about a hundred dollars. Once Roto rooter steps in your house they want to make a big issue of snaking a sewer line, they want to do much more unneeded work to fatten their bottom line.
I will not recommend this gouging Company who refuses to give a tentative cost of snaking a sewer line on the phone. They keep it as a surprise. also any plumbing company who refuses to run a second run should be always rejected. Once the first run is done, the second is much faster and all decent companies will do it especially when they are charging the rate of a brain surgeon.
This is standard plumbing customs.

reviews.author: Jodi J.
reviews.text: They gave me a quote of $400 to unclog a basic kitchen sink. None of the other drains in the

reviews.author: Patty W.
reviews.text:
I will start by saying the field staff were friendly. Aside from a threat at then end of the job by the field manager.   I had an alleged clogged lateral leading to a city main. Roto Rooter performed a camera scope and a limited clean out.  Their diagnosis was that may ceramic pipe had "drastically" shifted and that my line was full of root structure.  I was returning to Utah from out of state work (so trying to diagnose over the phone); I asked: Did you take a look at the main city vault at all, to make sure this is not in the city line? Answer: Yes, we took a look and it is definitely in your lateral.

$400 for 40 minutes on site to camera and snake (which did not work). A bid was submitted to dig up my line and either spot repair or full line replace.  I did have a 2nd camera scope and found that my ceramic pipe was in great shape.

Due to having the home occupied, I made the mistake of working with Roto Rooter.  Total project was $7100.  Day 1 was a total work time of approx 3.5 hours. The use of the Mini-X was approximately 40 minutes (total) Field tech was convinced it was the Tap, and (in Roto  Rooter style) started the whole speech about more $$.  They stopped for the day, and rescheduled for a Monday (3 days later).  Arrived Monday at noon. This time with a "manager".  Lo' and behold, the issue was in the city line. The Roto Rooter staff had no idea how to contact the city or move forward. Thankfully I spent both days on site to observe and was able to quickly get the city on site and take care of the problem.  Total work time on day 2: 3 hours.  **Had they actually taken a quick peak at the city line (accessible from my lot); they could have seen the obstruction back on the very 1st site visit.

Sadly, they added a clean out right in the middle of my driveway; thus creating a future failure spot. I will have to dig down again and remove this to avoid breaking the lateral line (Thanks team!!).

Having a career in construction, there were quite a few things that occurred in the field that were "way off base" but they were trying to "sell it to me".
Lastly, when I tried to politely discuss the $7100 total bill, I was threatened by the Manager.  Very unprofessional.

This company may be good at the very basic/simple unclog a toilet, sink drain, take a picture of your line. I do not recommend for anything beyond that scope of work.  Pricing is way out of line for service rendered (borderline users).

reviews.author: D.j. S.
reviews.text:
CONSUMER BEWARE! ALWAYS get a second opinion! I SAVED nearly $6k by seeking a second quote.  Roto-Rooter will try to take advantage of people whenever they can. They immediately went to the extreme rather than logical, seemingly easier ways to fix my problem.

On 12/16/2024 I contacted Roto-Rooter because of a draining issue with my bathtub. A technician came out about 7:30 pm and evaluated the situation. We crawled in the crawl space and concluded that he was going to snake the line. He removed the  toilet adjacent to the bath tub and preceded to snake the line. He claimed he went the extent of his line (100 ft) and didnt resolve anything. The distance from the main to the street was no more than 35-40 feet. He proceeded to call a coworker who was going to camera the line. At his arrival, it was clear that he had jurisdiction over the initial technician and started calling the shots. This second technician began painting the story that would require exploratory excavation of my front lawn with no guarantee that it would resolve the situation. In his explanation, he began telling me that this would have cost nearly $20k but because of their "new" pricing scheme, it would be "significantly" less... more like $10k.  He continued to try to bait me with invalidated pricing anywhere from $17k to $10k which I assume was to try to get to a number I was comfortable with. I held my ground and refused to agree to their proposed work on the spot.  I asked him to email me his quote. His official quote was $6750.00 of which 50% was expected up front and was not comprehensive. In the quote they provided, it indicated "if further damage is found we will discuss options at that time." Additionally, they would not be able to start work until 12/18/2024.

I was able to resolve the issue for $1k WITHOUT exploratory excavation. Moreover, the work was completed on 12/17/24. There is NO WAY I will call on these guys again!

reviews.author: Bryan J.
reviews.text:
Warren at the Salt Lake Roto-Rooter did an objectively great job, but it especially stands out as wonderful because we were recommended by a friend to call them after it seemed another plumber could be hosing us and I needed a second opinion. (Won't bad-mouth the other company by name in this review because it's the circumstance that matters and I hope they will yet rectify a good portion of their charges.)

He listened to the stress and frustration we had experienced over the previous two days: a local plumbing company charged us $800 to try 20-feet of a couple different snake machines; then a water-jet today; and then a camera tech (maybe 3 hours tops for all the visits) on a clogged kitchen sink only to tell us it would be another $4000 to tear out carpet and cement in our basement to replace pipe. Otherwise they said they "did everything we could do on that clog."

After only a couple hours since our first call to Roto-Rooter, Warren was at our home. He did brace us that such extreme plumbing fixit problems do happen, though pretty rarely, and said, "Let me try. If I can fix the clog the price is $399, and if I can't well you don't have to pay me anything unless you want to give me $75 for the effort." He used a 3/8" snake machine similar to the other plumber but without the 'knife' on the end saying experience has shown him that works better in this circumstance. He fed out 40-feet of snake, boring through the clog in less than 30 minutes. Plus he took another $75 off the price when done "because it's a coupon we offer," and reminded us the work is guaranteed.

I'm so frustrated and exasperated to feel like the other plumbing company was half-heartedly stringing us along, billing more and more charges along the way, just to pitch a hugely expensive service. Yet I'm so thankful that Warren helped rescue us! (He was also wearing his Covid mask to be extra considerate.)

reviews.author: Natalie DeMill
reviews.text:
EDITED to add… you can see below that after this review, they sent a generic message asking me to send in the details of our service. I did this over a week ago and never heard back. THEY DON’T TAKE ANY PRIDE IN THEIR CUSTOMER SERVICE. THEY JUST WANT TO APPEAR ONLINE THAT THEY DO. CHECK THE REAL REVIEWS ON YELP. AVOID THIS COMPANY!

DO NOT USE!!!! If you need a late night or simple fix they are probably fine but don’t use them for a big job. We had a sewage pipe overflow and flood and we used them for clean up and to repair the pipe. Communication was terrible! We never knew what was going on or when anyone was going to show up. They made it sound like a big deal that we get started right away- got us to sign a contract and submit an insurance claim- then no one showed up for 4 days to cleanup. Then they sent one guy for cleanup that obviously had no idea what he was doing that unnecessarily banged and scratched up our walls in the process and has made the reno guys job much harder than it should’ve been.

For the repair the main plumber was great and did a good job but he brought along a guy seemingly in training that did most of the labor. We had to pay $7725 for one day of work ($460 hourly rate 🤯) because he spent a lot of the time explaining how to do things to the trainee and they charged us double rate for “two plumbers” even though only one was working at a time. Customers should not pay to train staff imo

We made the mistake of not getting another bid and spent thousands more than needed. Posting this here in the hopes that we help someone else not make that same mistake! Good luck with your plumbing needs and use someone else!!!

reviews.author: Steve D
reviews.text: I called Roto Rooter one evening for an emergency situation (sewer backup into the basement) and they came to the house the following morning.  Snaked the line, resolved the clog and then ran the camera through the line for an additional &100.00.  I was told there were potential breaks in the pipe joints, the pipe needed to be repaired, and it was recommended that they re line the entire underground pipe from the house to the sewer.  The total cost to clean out the line and send a camera was approximately $850.00. They then quoted me $14,000+ to re-line the pipe and suggested that I re-line the pipe “immediately” otherwise it could cost me approx. $30,000 if something were to happen to the pipe.  Fast forward.  I requested a copy of the video pipe inspection and was denied a copy, “due to their corporate policy”.  I then called a reputable long standing local plumbing company, scheduled another video pipe inspection, for a second opinion. This plumbing company sent out one of their owners with a technician, ran a camera in my sewer pipe and said my pipe looks great, no visible issues and said there was no need to re-line the pipe.  That cost me $240.00 which was money well spent.   The other plumber’s service and honestly was so impressive.  I will never deal with Roto Rooter again.  FYI, Roto Rooter did clear my pipe but your dealing with a big corporate mentality and their techs are out to upsell and happily take your money.

reviews.author: Natasha R.
reviews.text:
I had somebody come out last night to take a look at a drain that wasn't draining-right when he got there, he first asked if I had been quoted the after hours fee over the phone (I hadn't) and that he had just driven over an hour to get here (so basically, I had no choice at this point!). He then gave me the price for cleaning the drain and I asked what would happen to that price if the clean didn't work to which he replied that it would most definitely work...welp, it didn't. Then he asked me what he thought was fair to pay him but then ended up declaring the price I needed to pay after speaking to his supervisor. At first he offered to come back to camera the drain at no charge but then once I clarified that there wouldn't be a charge he told me it would be probably $200 just to camera it?
Fast forward to this morning, I am waiting for them to come out here (between 8am-10am is what I was told). I rescheduled appointments to accommodate this time! Called at 10:10 am and the operator said that they would be on their way soon, called again at 12 pm and was told that someone wouldn't be here until after 2 pm. 
Just unreliable service that didn't make you feel comfortable or like they were actually trying to help you.

Update:
Roto-rooter reached out and made things right-definitely appreciate the customer service! Thank you!

reviews.author: Jeanette M.
reviews.text:
The shower in the lower level of the house had water backing out of the drain. I called Roto_Rooter and explained the problem and that I heard gurgling sounds in the sinks upstairs as well. They scoped the drains and the mainline to the street and determined it was tree roots in the mainline causing all the issues. The scoped and rooted the roots out and all seemed fine. They charged me $300.  Then, 2 weeks later... Thanksgiving day I have water coming out of my sink and water coming up out of my basement vents onto my hardwood floors!! I have lived there for 30 years and this has never happened before. I called them back and they claimed it was a new clog and they would be happy to get rid of it for...another $300!!!

What happened to the warranty and fixing things right the first time? I offered to pay for the labor but not the drive out. He called his boss and still: No! the charge was going to be $300!!!! to fix something they should have fixed the first time. All for a grand total of $600!!!!

This is simply not ok. I spent Thanksgiving in a flood, 14 days after having Roto-Rooter claiming they fixed the problem.

I will tell to all I know and of course to those who check Yelp :) DO NOT USE ROTO_ROOTER!!!!!!! They Rip you off.

Word of mouth works.

reviews.author: Josh Jorgensen
reviews.text: Horrible and a Joke. Not normally the guy to leave a bad review, but my experience with this company has been horrible at best. Yesterday I called to have them replace a flame sensor on our tankless water heater. Gave them the description of the model, serial number and code that it was giving, simple fix. I called at 8:00am and they said they would have someone out by 10:00am. Well...at 3:45pm the plumber showed up; then walked in and said, "I have no experience with tankless water heaters and I don't know how to fix it" and left. I called their dispatch and they told me that they didn't have anyone working today that has experience with tankless water heaters and that Byron, who has experience would be out first thing this morning, clocking in at 8:00am and heading out. I received a call this morning letting me know that they did not in fact have any tech today with any experience and that the best they could do is tomorrow sometime in the morning. Not sure whom they are hiring and why they can't service a pretty simple repair; they have no notes between dispatched and have no clue who I talked to previously. I would be nervous to have their inexperienced plumbers working on anything in my home with Roto-Rooter. Good luck if this is your go to.

reviews.author: Brandon Tullis
reviews.text:
Our shower broke after-hours, such that the water wouldn’t shut off. We had to turn off water to the whole house to get it to stop. Roto-Rooter was the only company available to help with this urgent repair request (with the next best company scheduling us for 4 days out, after the weekend). Roto-Rooter said they were able to come within 1 hour, but when they heard the full story and realized parts would need to be purchased, they rescheduled for first thing the next morning.

Cameron was amazing, battling the most stuck tub/shower Moen cartridge he had ever dealt with and emerging victorious. He gave us options for low cost for just completing just that step versus higher cost for just finishing the job. After how much work it was to get the cartridge out, we hired him for the rest. He purchased a new cartridge, managed to get it in, and finished the job. Now our tub/shower works great!

When he saw a container of wipes in the bathroom, he double checked that we hadn’t been flushing those in an effort to save us more costs down the line. I didn’t get the sense of any attempts to mark up services or oversell.

Thanks Roto-Rooter and especially thanks Cameron for your timely and much-needed assistance! Five stars!!

synthesis.summary: Shows up fast day or night and gets the job done, but expect sticker shock on after-hours calls and aggressive upselling once they're in the door.
strengths: Strong emergency responsiveness: multiple reviews confirm same-day or within-3-hour arrival, including late-night, stormy weather, and 2-days-before-Christmas calls
Persistent on tough jobs: one reviewer described techs relocating equipment and making 'many, many tries' to clear a stubborn main sewer clog rather than walking away
Technician Adi Avdic drew 20+ reviews praising punctuality, clear explanations, and clean workmanship — consistent across diverse job types
weaknesses: Pricing is routinely flagged as high: one reviewer paid $531 to snake a 60-foot main drain line in under 15 minutes, and another was quoted $400 for a basic kitchen sink clog
Upsell pressure reported: one reviewer described the tech refusing a second snake pass and withholding the 6-month warranty unless a paid video inspection was added
redFlags: 790 BBB complaints in 3 years is an unusually high volume for any service company and strongly suggests systemic billing or service delivery issues that individual positive reviews do not capture
A cluster of 20+ reviews for a single technician (Adi Avdic) posted within hours on 12/12/2025 displays hallmarks of a coordinated review campaign — treat those reviews as unreliable signal
Pricing is not disclosed over the phone: one reviewer explicitly called this out, meaning you won't know the cost until a tech is already in your home at 2am
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Confirmed after-hours capability with documented late-night and holiday arrivals; one reviewer noted no extra charge for calls after 5pm, and another had a crew on-site within 3 hours of a midnight emergency call.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.7 stars across 2,367 reviews while Yelp sits at 2.3 stars with 51 reviews, and 790 BBB complaints over 3 years paint a sharply different picture — the Google score likely reflects post-service prompting and is not representative of worst-case experiences.

reviews.author: Sande Harris
reviews.text: If a water heater is going to go out it will be on the weekend.  Thank goodness that BeeHive Plumbing has technicians available.  Comfort Solutions referred us to them when we called them and we were so happy.  They gave us a window they would be here, then showed up in that window, found what they needed to for our Hot Water Heater and replaced it all the same day.  They cared about not doing any damage to carpet and made sure we were up to code.  Thank you for your caring and help Beehive, thank you for the referral Comfort Solutions!

reviews.author: Kayla Kehres
reviews.text: Jacob was awesome!! Super friendly and informative. I also want to note how efficient he was. Found the issue and solved it with speed and quality. Great customer service! Overall very happy!

reviews.author: Dynotron CBD CBD
reviews.text: 10 out of 5 STARS!!!! Benjamin and Maverik were outstanding!!! They had designed and installed an emergency shower, plumbing for washing machine, drainage, pump and a water heater. WE LOVE IT!!! Very Professional and highly recommended. Thank you very much! Everything was done efficiently, one day job. They Helped our Business tremendously at Dynotron!!!

reviews.author: Amy G.
reviews.text: If mediocre or "good enough" is what you're looking for, then these guys are right for you. They replaced  the PRV with the cheapest type available and installed some pex pipe where a decent plumber would've used copper. Not impressed.

reviews.author: Anica H.
reviews.text: Hey! If you're gonna force someone out of their lane because you don't feel like head checking, at least do it in an area of the freeway where the cars aren't all bunched together and the person you're pretending doesn't exist won't be in danger of a severe accident trying to get out of your way. Additionally, a small wave of apology for the danger you put someone in because you can't be bothered to drive with care for others, goes a long way. Thanks!

reviews.author: Rob Y.
reviews.text:
Set an appointment for this week, got a call but did not get around to calling back. They called me this morning to ask for more details on what I wanted done, which I provided. Then I got a call (I work from home and was on a 15 minute phone call with a customer so I could not answer). Within 3-5 minutes I also got a text saying they had someone available right then and could they come over? There was also a warning saying they would pass me by if I did not respond right away. I called within 5 minutes of that, and got the same person I spoke with that morning. 

The man I spoke with was a in a big hurry (which is fine) and wanted to talk over me (not fine). I said today wasn't going to work, and he said then I would need to wait a week for an appointment. I was confused on the date of the appointment, he clarified that it was scheduled for today, but my 4 hr window did not start for another 30 mins. I pointed out that the text and the voicemail I received (coming within 5 minutes of each other, and threatening to pass me by if I didn't respond) made it sound like the "plumber available right now" was an offer to come early, which I declined. Saying they would not keep my appointment (which had been scheduled for more than a week) because of that, seemed unprofessional. I had to specifically ask the man not to talk over me while trying to explain this, as he was eager to interrupt before I could finish explaining. As I said, being in a hurry is fine, but being rude is not. I also felt like while this man's words were polite, the manner he gave them in was rather defensive and rude. 

At first I was going to reschedule, but then decided I did not want to do business with a company that was okay with talking over a customer and treating them rudely because they have a lot of calls to deal with. From the reviews here, sounds like they are good at plumbing, but apparently not so good at dealing with people. I'm tired of giving business to companies that feel they can treat customers this way, without apology or respect.

reviews.author: Hubert F.
reviews.text:
Very disappointing. We called Beehive Plumbing on January 6th to have them fix a clog on our bathtub and laundry drain. When the plumber Alma arrived, we showed him the problem areas, and also asked about clearing the main line to the house. He told us the main line would cost $375, then $100 for the two drains. We didn't have $475 to spend right then and there, so we declined the main line expecting to pay $100 for the two drains. Having looked at competitors coupons (anyhour charges $40 per drain) I thought $100 for 2 drains seemed about right. When he was done about 20 minutes later we were billed for $325. I called Beehive to ask why this bill was so big when I was quoted $100. I was told "part of the reason why the bill is higher is because I offer a 90 guarantee on all my work. If something happens I'll come back out and fix it."

 After going back and forth, the plumber Alma called me apologizing that he wasn't clear about the pricing, and said he'd be able to knock off $125 from the bill "friends and family discount" bringing the total to $200. I knew I wasn't getting the original deal quoted, so I agreed and they mailed me a $125 check. 

Fast forward to this week. We are a little over 1 month since our visit. The bathtub isn't draining. I called Beehive Plumbing to have them make good on the 90 Day Guarantee. I was told that part of the reason I was able to get such a good deal at $200, was they took off the guarantee entirely without telling me. The plumber Alma said he'd "see what he could do" but he hasn't returned my calls. 

If you quote somebody a price.. stick with it. I am not a wealthy man. Single income with 3 kids. Having a plumber come to my house is never an expected thing to have to spend my money on.. but that's life and we do what we have to do. If you tell somebody that your work is guaranteed... Don't lie. I feel like a fool for getting duped by these guys. So hopefully this review serves as a warning to look elsewhere. Beehive Plumbing will spit in your face and tell you it's rain.

reviews.author: BoTerre H.
reviews.text:
Beehive Plumbing has provided the most prompt,  professional, detailed,  educational and pleasant service I've received in many years.  Since June 23rd 2024 I've had need of their help 3 times for plumbing regarding very old pipes in a historical home I inherited.  The pipes are cast iron and barely functioning. Beehive has responded within less than an hour for basement flooding and sewer overflowing in a large part of one side of my basement and major flooding in the other half of the basement where boxes of important items were involved. And twice it's been on a Saturday and Sunday morning. MARK has been a life saver with his expertise and positive attitude.  Has always made me feel like nothing is so bad that he can't make better and with this attitude has quickly put my frantic self back together. When I've called in I specifically ask for MARK because I have complete confidence in his understanding my house and it's quirks.  Saturday,  MARK suggested Ron come in to do the more advanced project of installing a liner in the old pipes.  The estimate MARK approximated,  when I asked for a ball park figure, was pretty much spot on when RON wrote up the estimate today.  RON couldn't have been more professional,  calm and pleasant.  Such a wonderful attitude and welcomed my input.  Explained everything in detail and left me with an email detailing the information to back up his verbal explaination of how the project will unfold  in the next few days.  I completely recommend Beehive Plumbing and especially MARK  and RON.
I would give them  complete reign over my house if I couldn't be here when they start and complet the project.  They radiate trust  and competency.  I appreciate everything about them and the company standards. I believe they are reasonably priced and will provide me many more years of solid water pipes that do there job without fail. I call that a good investment in a very old house.  THANK YOU

reviews.author: Amber D.
reviews.text:
We have a toilet that we have had turned off for about a year at my mothers house due to a small leak. We arranged for a plumber to come out to take a look and diagnose the issue. Jon Goble arrived this morning at her house and was extremely disrespectful and unprofessional towards her from the moment he walked in to the moment he left. 

He made several comments about how he was going to be sick while looking at a toilet that has maybe been used 10 times in the last 10 years. How does looking at a cleaned unused toilet make a plumber sick? It has been shut off for about a year but we have kept water in it to prevent the dry smell and when I was there just yesterday there was zero odor. That bathroom isn't even used. He kept repeating his comments about how disgusted he was because there was a dog in the home that she out of courtesy kept in an entirely different room before he even arrived. Unsure if his repeated I am going to be sick comments were related to looking at a toilet or the fact that she owned a dog. 

The house was built in 2006 but he is telling her the toilet is so old it has to be completely replaced and that she was out of luck as they suddenly just increased their prices yesterday. 

She tried to be friendly and lighten the mood and made a joke about how she knew how to replace small things like handles as her father taught her a lot about plumbing when he retired from the military, but he cut her off and told her "that doesn't make you a plumber". 

After he left my mom called me and was in tears and extremely embarrassed. Also convenient he mentioned higher prices than advertised after he was there making comments and cutting her off when trying to speak. 


You're a dick Jon and I am embarrassed for your employer.

reviews.author: Jim S.
reviews.text:
Another plumber installed my storage tank water heater on 9/28/17. On Friday, 5/22/20 at 8 AM I found that I had no water. I found a leak at the bottom of the tank. I called the plumber and found out they were closed. I had to call their answering service and wait 15 minutes. My  message was forwarded. I received a call and this lady said she could fix it on Tuesday. I complained and then she said 8PM Saturday night and pay OT or Tuesday and pay no OT. I kept complaining and she said 8-10AM Saturday and it would cost $675. The original was $1,000. She said my 40 Gal. was "old" and the State of Utah ruled that a new type had to be installed.
I then called Beehive and was told a Tech could be at my house by 3 PM. Benj came and told me that a storage tank lasts between 3-7 years. My wife and I saw reviews of tankless vs. tank with tankless receiving 95% favorable reviews. Beehive has Noritz Tankless with a 25 year warranty and it can never leak. I found on YouTube that Noritz is the only one that has the piping at the top, which is much easier for installation. Benj started at 4:15 PM and never took a food break. A young Tech named Sam came and helped for a few hours, but had to leave. Benj had special equipment he used instead of welding and saved time. He had to go outside and drill a hole through my siding to vent it and that was the night it rained very heavily. He also had to strap and hang large PVC pipes. He finally left at 11:30 PM. He was amazing, awesome and fantastic. He told us "I wasn't going to leave until you had hot water." On a scale of 1-10, he deserves a minimum score of 13 and maybe more. This is an example of a truly inspiring work ethic. I AM NOW A LIFETIME BEEHIVE CUSTOMER.

reviews.author: Courtney V.
reviews.text:
What can I say about Beehive plumbing & HVAC, they are the bee's knees!
We have a charming #old house in Midvale and they had done plumbing work previously, they saved us hundreds because we just needed an adjustment and not a whole new fixture. They were actually honest with us & because of that I called to get more work done, they told me that they also do HVAC work! For anyone who has had home repairs done since 2020, a company that can do multiple things #jackpot.
Junior & Chris were the HVAC team sent out, they are seasoned, kind, hardworking, honest guys. They covered their shoes every time they came in or out and they are not the shady type you have to worry about being home alone with them in your house:) (You know what I'm talking about ladies.)
They walked us through all of our options & they were very conscientious of our budget and all of the weird quarks of our house. 
I can honestly not say enough good things about them, they were real, timely & didn't leave our house in total disarray. We ended up getting two furnaces and a water heater and we plan to use them again and again.  
Truly I am not a blogger, nor a salesman, nor was I paid for my review, I am a real life customer who paid with my own hard earned money, and when people are as good as them I want others to know! 
Beehive Plumbing & HVAC is a rarity in this COVID suck feast of home repairs & we are told their owner is all about quality and honesty. 
They are an honest, local company with amazing employees. 
Chris and Junior are top notch! We would recommend them to anyone. Do yourself a favor & spend your hard earned money on them, they are worth every Penny!

reviews.author: Jeanette M.
reviews.text:
BEWARE!   Be sure to get everything in writing or you might get the bate and switch I got.  I have two water heaters in my home.  One of them went out.  I called for a bid to replace the one Rheem Energy Star water heater.  I told Hyrum that I needed a price for a comparable water heater.  He gave me the price for a regular, high efficiency and energy star.  Then he told me that if I would replace both water heaters at the same time, I could get get a significant discount. It would be a savings of several hundred dollars.  My energy star water heaters were the same age and he suggested the remaining water heater could soon fail, so I agree.  It was my understanding I would get two energy star Rheem water heaters, just like the ones I had for the same price as two high efficiency Rheem water heaters.  When the water heaters were installed they had the same manufactures numbers as the energy star except for the last digit.  I didn't realize I had been bated and switched until I applied for a rebate online.  They didn't install energy star water heaters, they were only high efficiency.  So I paid full price for both water heaters, I saved no money by installing two water heaters.

To make matters worse, we now are taking cold showers.  We are not getting water hot enough to take a hot shower, the water is luke warm.  Matt has said he will come check out the problem, but has never showed up, will not answer my calls when I phone him, and does not return calls after I leave a message.  

Jeanette M
Herriman

reviews.author: Christine L.
reviews.text: I am giving 3 stars because I think the plumber we had was good and very kind and knowledgeable. Younger kid, so I can't fault him for my negative feelings. And they did get to us pretty quickly, which I appreciate. I do feel highly ripped off. Our water heater wasn't working in December of 2021. I called Beehive and someone came out and let me know the water heater needed to be replaced. The good news is that it was under warranty. The bad news is that it was going to cost us over $1000 for the installation. I'm not sure why we were responsible to pay installation and not the manufacturer, but the water heater was about 5 years old, so I was happy that I didn't have to pay for a whole new unit. Here we are, less than 2 years later, and water heater is faulty again. No fault of our own as determined by the plumber, just a faulty water heater. Once again, it will be covered under warranty, and once again, we will have to pay an outrageous amount of money to get it installed. I am not sure why the plumbing company doesn't have an arrangement with the manufacturer to be reimbursed. I've never had to pay for installation for any other product or appliance that was covered under warranty. I'm extremely upset and will also be leaving an extremely bad review for Rheem. However, I will not use Beehive is this water heater goes out AGAIN. I will not be calling Beehive again.

reviews.author: Christie Allred
reviews.text:
Update2:
Kudos to Beehive who saw my update and is in the process of refunding the $50. Thank you! PS we don't want Christopher to lose his job. We just want honest, clear communication.

Update:
Three stars for the most recent repair person. He told us it cost extra to do the finish caulk, so we told him we'd do that part, and he said ok. He told us the warranty was included when we asked if it cost extra. After these communications, we signed and he went to work - come to find out, he did the finish caulking even though we had asked him not to, and the warranty is not included. It was itemized as a $50 fee on our final invoice. We felt tricked. We confronted him, and he said, "Well it was on the order you signed!" If you get Christopher Beck, double check his list of fees before you sign even if you have communicated clearly what you want and do not want. He was on time, and did a great job, but communication was questionable. Makes me want to try a different plumbing company next time, or request a different repairman.

Old review...
Five stars for the clogged drain guys: These guys are clean, respectful, friendly, and knowledgeable. They got the job done right and now our drains flow perfectly.

reviews.author: Kayla C.
reviews.text: Caution regarding Beehive Plumber, Russell. I'm not one to typically write reviews, positive or negative.  However, I feel compelled to share this experience. My sister, who isn't fluent in English, encountered a plumbing issue just before Thanksgiving.  She contacted Beehive, a highly regarded company in the area. Not very fluent in English, she was informed by Russell that the washer pipe had never been connected. 8 hours later, he handed her a bill for $5200.00 for 8 hours of labor. 2 weeks later, the same problem recurred.  This time I contacted Beehive again and another plumber was sent. This time, an experienced plumber came and determined the root cause of the issue lay 75 feet away from the property, where the main pipe was encroached by tree roots. I've contacted Beehive and was told the pipe in the house was never connected and that water had been draining into the soil under the basement for the past 50 years without anyone noticing. BWAHAHHAHA. While I appreciate the owner of Beehive supporting their employees, scamming a widow of $5200 for 8 hours of plumbing service is unacceptable.

synthesis.summary: Shows up fast for emergencies and does solid work, but a handful of reviewers report no-shows, surprise upcharges, and one credible account of a plumber allegedly tampering with a pressure valve to manufacture a sale.
strengths: Fast emergency response: at least 5 reviewers across multiple years specifically mention arrival within an hour or same-day service, including weekends and late nights
Technicians praised for transparency: multiple reviewers note plumbers showed camera footage, explained options without pushing unnecessary work, and left final bills matching estimates
Long-term customer retention: one household reports using Beehive for nearly 50 years across ownership changes, and several reviewers explicitly state they will call again
weaknesses: Pricing inconsistency: at least 3 reviews cite bills significantly exceeding quoted amounts, including one weekend job that jumped from $200 to $395, and repeated warranty installation fees over $1,000 that felt unjustified

Cleanup after major jobs is uneven: one water main replacement reviewer gave cleanup a 1-star rating despite otherwise average service, and an older review notes floors were damaged and responsibility was dodged for 3.5 months
redFlags: No-show on emergency calls: 2 recent reviews (2024) describe being promised a same-night technician who never arrived, one leaving a renter with water pouring through their ceiling all night

One detailed 2024 review alleges a plumber (named Tristen) recommended nearly $2,000 in unnecessary parts including a pressure valve that appeared to register dangerous pressure only after the plumber accessed it, with management dismissing the complaint — treat this as unverified but specific enough to warrant caution
Google (4.8, 2252 reviews) vs Yelp (3.3, 58 reviews) gap is substantial; Yelp concentrates billing disputes and no-show complaints that are diluted in Google's high volume
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Explicitly advertises and delivers weekend and after-hours coverage, with multiple reviewers confirming arrival within an hour on evenings, weekends, and Sundays — strong emergency track record overall, though two 2024 reviews show that during high-demand periods, dispatchers may accept jobs they then abandon.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google's 4.8 across 2,252 reviews looks stellar, but Yelp's 3.3 across 58 reviews surfaces a disproportionate cluster of billing disputes, no-shows, and workmanship complaints that suggest the Google score may reflect volume and satisfied customers who rarely leave reviews elsewhere rather than a universally consistent experience.

reviews.author: Rgeorge535
reviews.text: Fred came out to repair an old Moen shower valve that didn't flow cold water anymore.  We talked about what needed to be done and he gave me a firm quote for the job (which I felt was a fair price). I knew which part had to be replaced,  but I could not get access to it.  He was able to remove the siezed brass screw-on cover to get to the part and was able to extract it with some effort.  He had to go to a local plumbing supply store to get the (not so common) part, installed it,  and the shower works like new again! Fred did a great job,  was respectful of the house (put shoe coverings on), and was very friendly.  I was also appreciative of the firm price quote, so no surprises there!  I highly recommend Pipe Pros!

reviews.author: James Prince
reviews.text: We had them come out to our commercial building. They responded quickly, got someone out to do a toilet repair for us, and got it done professionally. This is our first interaction with them, and we'll be using them as our vendor for plumbing issues moving forward. Great experience!

reviews.author: Jordan Petersen
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this plumbing company. They came out to my house quickly, handled a warranty issue on a bad water heater without any hassle, and were professional from start to finish. Nick, the technician, was knowledgeable, courteous, and took the time to explain everything clearly. The whole process was smooth and stress-free. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: SASHLEY B
reviews.text:
I recently hired Pipe Pros Utah to fix a plumbing issue at my home, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. From start to finish, they were professional, honest, and incredibly fair.
They showed up on time, quickly diagnosed the problem, and took the time to explain what needed to be done in a way that was easy to understand. The work was done efficiently and carefully, and they cleaned up everything before they left.
What stood out the most was their integrity.  The pricing was very reasonable with no surprise charges, and I truly felt they had my best interests in mind rather than trying to upsell anything I didn't need.
It's rare these days to find someone who does such high-quality work at a fair price, and I'm really grateful I found them. I will definitely be calling Pipe Pros Utah for any future plumbing needs and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and trustworthy plumber.

reviews.author: Michael Yingling
reviews.text:
Fred came out Friday night at 9pm from Ogden (to Sandy) to fix a broken faucet.  While here he went above and beyond every step of the way: he made sure the other valve on the sink wouldn't have the same problem, he was quiet (as possible) since I told him our toddler was sleeping, and when he was done with the sink he helped me turn down the water pressure in my house so my plumbing will last longer.  That's integrity, and they sincerely earned all 5 stars (check my other reviews; I'm not a 5-star only reviewer).

Also, we called a dozen places and only Pipe Pros truly provided emergency plumbing.  I don't know why some others call themselves "AnyTime" when what they mean is "next Tuesday".  Don't waste your time with those other places, just call these guys.  They know what they're doing.

reviews.author: Jenny Gibbons
reviews.text:
Pipe Pros was fantastic to work with! They came out to snake a clogged floor drain, but what really impressed me was how thorough they were. Instead of just fixing the immediate issue and heading out, they took the time to investigate and found the actual source of the problem — a leak from another pipe that was causing the backup.

They explained everything clearly, showed me what was going on, and made sure I understood the next steps. The team was professional, knowledgeable, and respectful of our home the entire time. It’s such a relief to work with a company that doesn’t just do a quick fix, but genuinely wants to solve the problem the right way. Highly recommend Pipe Pros!

reviews.author: Patric Evans
reviews.text:
5 Star Review headed your way! I had an emergency gas valve fail during a DIY stove install. Had to shut off gas to my entire house. Pipe Pros saved the day. Trace (Technician) arrived at my home 1 hour after I called for help. I had called 2 others emergency lines and one never answered and the other one could get a technician here for 4-8 hours. It’s 26 degrees outside today and no way I could keep the gas off that long.

Not only did Pipe Pros respond fast but they were super professional too. Trace came in and got everything fixed properly, safely, and is the kind of pro you want working the job.

I am so grateful for them, they have earned my business fully for the future.

reviews.author: Yohauna Allart Kunze
reviews.text: Miracles and kind, honest people still exist. Last week my Dad died. While we were all in the condo saying goodbye, the toilet tank started leaking and we couldn’t flush. Wondering how in the world I was going to figure this out before the coroner arrived, I opened the door and Pipe Pros were at the bottom of the stairs helping someone else in the condo complex. I told them I’d pay whatever it took so all the family could use the bathroom while visiting. They came in immediately, replaced all the insides of the tank, got it all working, and refused to take a penny. Seriously a miracle I really needed that day. Thank you. I can’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Josh Thomas
reviews.text: Pipe pros went above and beyond. I had a sewer line backup and He got out there quick and communicated easily and well. He showed up with booties on and a mask when that wasn't required. He kept putting them back on every time it was appropriate too. Besides doing the work that I hired him for he took a look at my water pressure and water softener and helped me out a lot with those but didn't charge for it. These are truly great people! Wish the world had even more like them! Will definitely call these guys back next time.

reviews.author: Andy Sheehan
reviews.text: Super impressed with our experience from Pipe Pros! Fred and his team are absolutely amazing. They were super respectful of our house, always ensuring they had shoe covers or covers over the floor. We had a floor drain replaced and they had it done in about two hours! Of the five companies I called, they were the only ones who even wanted to look at it, and I’m so grateful they were the ones to do it. So neat and clean! Definitely would recommend and will have them back to do more work in the future.

reviews.author: jennifer feller
reviews.text: Pipe Bros lived up to its 5 star rating. When we noticed water leaking from our main line in the utility closet I felt my stomach sink. We called multiple places (those outfits with a lot of advertising) as well as Pipe Bros (since they are local and have a 5 star Google rating). Pipe Bros took the leak as serious as we did, got to us first, and had the issue reviewed, repair estimated, and work completed before noon. We'll be calling Pipe Bros first for now on. Thank you!

reviews.text: Pipe Pros was easily one of the best plumbing experiences I've had.  They answered the phone promptly each time I called.  Scheduling was incredibly easy (you get a text message with full details, including the name of your plumber within minutes after calling), and the crew always arrived promptly and on time.  They explained everything clearly and were efficient.  Would happily use them again for any plumbing needs.

The plumber I had (Fred) was professional and very accommodating for an 11pm service call.  I’m very happy with the work, quality of service and people, and the fact they are locally owned and operated.  I plan to use Pipe Pros for all my future needs for all my apartment buildings.

I would rather work with this local small business than the huge companies just looking to rip you off. Thank you so much, Fred!

reviews.author: Ron G.
reviews.text:
I was in need of a plumber to repair an outside faucet. I turned to the community groups on Facebook looking for recommendations. Wanted to avoid the large companies as have had bad experiences in the past.

In the Bartlett community group 3 people recommended Scott. I e mailed him explaining what I need done. He responded back quickly with an answer and a apology that he could not get to it until tomorrow.

When Scott arrived to start the work he realized it was something out of the ordinary and instead of saying that he couldn't or didn't want to do it, he explained the options to me. Once a decision was made Scott said it would take a second trip out to finish the job and he was very apologetic about not being able to finish it in one day even though it was not his fault but the fault of a previous contractor.

Scott arrived the following day to complete the job. He explained that because the work involved was more detailed the fee would be more then quoted, once again apologizing even thought he had nothing to do with the initial screw up.

I highly recommend Scott to anyone looking for a professional to plumber and person. Scott has earned all my future plumbing business.

reviews.author: Carol B.
reviews.text: Scott Marhofke Plumbing (Scott) is fantastic.  We had a problem with what turned out to be frozen water service pipes to the master bath.  Shower wouldn't work and the toilet tank wouldn't fill  during the particularly harsh cold we had in the Chicago suburban area Jan. 30-31.  We made an appointment with Scott for the following Friday. Fortunately when he arrived the pipes had thawed and even more fortunately they didn't break but Scott spent time with us to show us how to prevent the problem in the future.  He also showed us how to check our water meter to verify if we have any water leaks we can't see.  It was a perfect scenario with the worst cold we had in 35 years and the wind direction that problem caused our problem.  Scott was a Prince.  If you have any plumbing issues whatsoever call Scott!  He is definitely in our call list for any future plumbing problems we may have and we will recommend him to everyone!

reviews.text:

In an out in a little over 2 hours (including a trip to Home Depot).

I will definitely be using Scott Marhofke Plumbing for all my future plumbing needs and recommending him to friends and family around the area.

Thanks Scott!

He also was able to determine how long each project was going to take.  Plus, he worked around my schedule.  After he finishes, he's careful to make sure everything is working properly.

All this, and his prices were reasonable.  He is highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jenny K.
reviews.text: I love Scott! He is just the best plumber out there. When I was living alone, I definitely wanted to find a plumber that wasn't going to rip me off and made me feel comfortable. Scott is that plumber. He explains everything he is doing and even gives some tips so I don't have to call him for every little thing wrong. He was soo great I even had him fix the plumbing at my parent's house. Scott is honest and reliable. He is never late and always treats his customers with respect. I can't say enough great things about him. If you are hesitant, just call him. After one phone call, you'll agree that he is definitely the best plumber around the area!

reviews.author: Jo Ann D.
reviews.text: i was looking for a new plumber in my area of Bartlett Illinois that was responsive, professional, on time, respectful of my property and I found it with Scott Marhofke. Being a single woman he was very sensitive to what I was trying to accomplish. Explained everything in terms I could understand not to mention he was extremely fair in his pricing. I did do my  research and I felt everyone else was just trying to take advantage. He's simply a good guy. We don't find that often these days. I highly recommend Scott Marhofke Plumbing. I found my new plumber. Thank you Scott

reviews.author: Lora S.
reviews.text: We called Scott in the afternoon around 4 and he got back to us really quick. Within 2 hours. We were able to schedule an appt for the next morning. Scott was very punctual, friendly and professional.  Although our water problem didn't present itself when Scott was there, he attempted to try to fix the issue. He was also able to fix another minor issue I've been having with my shower water temperature. He charges reasonable and made aware that his hours could be flexible.  Scott has provided great service and I would highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Mike K.
reviews.text: Scott recently replaced my leaking water heater and I'm very happy. He's very busy but you don't have to wait long. His prices are very reasonable (call around for quotes, you'll see). He did a very professional job. The next day I noticed a small amount of water in that area, where the furnaces are also located. He came out that night to check it out. Turns out the source was not the water heater he put in but was condensation from a loose pipe coming from the furnace. He secured that for me, problem solved. I highly recommend Scott.

reviews.author: Lisa Seifrid
reviews.text: Almost 20 years in Bartlett and have used Scott Marhofke about 8 times over the years-each call was something different. New outside spigot, busted pipe under kitchen sink, leaking gas line pipe in laundry room, all new plumbing for upstairs tub/shower, years ago repair on plumbing of both bathroom sinks after we first moved in.  He's always been, fair, honest, doesn't try to take advantage of you, friendly, does what he can to get in to see your issue in an emergency - best, honest plumber ever. This review is June 2021

synthesis.summary: Scott is the no-BS solo plumber who shows up fast, charges fair prices, and won't invent work to pad the bill — repeat customers across 10+ years back this up consistently.

weaknesses: One reviewer (Sep 2019) noted he can be hard to reach initially — 'sometimes hard to get a hold of him' — which could matter critically at 2am with a burst pipe
