reviews.author: Mahi Karim
reviews.text:
I rarely write reviews unless I’m truly happy or unhappy. So here it is:

It was 2 a.m. and my kitchen had a leak. Most places in the city weren’t responding, but Derek picked up right away. He calmly walked me through exactly what to do and made sure I stayed calm the entire time. I had a flight early that morning, and he helped me confirm there were no leaks before I left, all over the phone.

Derek is fantastic. I’ll definitely be calling him again.

reviews.author: Carrie Stallings
reviews.text: best plumber experience I’ve had. in and out in under 30 and politely took their shoes off at the front door. very polite and diligent. could not recommend more!

reviews.author: Ariana Gusella
reviews.text: I’m so impressed with the service we received!  Derek is always very responsive, professional, and accommodating. He clearly knows his trade and takes the time to explain what’s going on. I also really appreciated the helpful tips he shared. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone!!

reviews.author: Al F.
reviews.text: Found Derek from Fast Action Service & Repair on craigslist.  Emailed him picture of what I needed repaired.  Good response, emailed me right away with price and scheduled service for following day.  For the most part his work was fine, I felt he could have came a bit more prepared after knowing what the scope of work was.  I had to run to hardware store for saw zaw blades for him.  My problem was that the same day the work was done His new pipes starting leaking, He told me to put more pvc cement around them. That did not solve problem and after nomerous text messages and phone calls He did not repair pipes or even reply back to me, so much for warranty, didnt even work right correctly for 1 day.

reviews.author: Becca S.
reviews.text:
derrick was so unprofessional and rude. he came in for a clogged toilet, which is embarrassing enough. then he proceeded to make very unprofessional remarks about the smell of the bathroom, and kept his shirt pulled over his nose the whole time. i was so embarrassed i didn't know what to say or do, i have never had a plumber behave that way before. i thought it was his job to handle things like that.

to make matters worse, derrick then took the tank lid off the toilet and poked around for a little bit, then he said he had to run to his truck for a tool. i gave him the access code for our building and he NEVER RETURNED. i called multiple times and he would not pick up or respond to my text messages. i'm glad he did not charge me, but it was still the most shockingly unprofessional experience i have ever had. i called another plumber, who came in and fixed the toilet in less than 20 minutes.

reviews.author: Michael W.
reviews.text:
TL;DR: Derek ghosted me and my wife in the middle of a plumbing emergency, on a Sunday, leaving us to scramble to find someone else with no warning. NOT RECOMMENDED.

Without hyperbole, this is the least professional experience I've ever had with a tradesperson. I called Derek last week for a clogged sink that kept slowly rising. He responded immediately and was at my home in an hour. While he was draining the sink, however, I happened to walk into the room and noticed that the entire cabinet was filled with about 1/4 inch of water. He cleaned it up with no damage, but it was still very shocking that he allowed this to happen in the first place. That evening, he said he was unable to clear the clog and would have to come back the following morning with different tools.

The next day, he showed up about an hour later than we scheduled. He tried to snake the pipe with the same 60 foot cable he'd used the night before. After futzing with it for a while, he then said he couldn't proceed without shutting the water for our whole building off (this proved later to be false). He then said that he had another job to get to and would come back later in the day. After he left, my wife and I got permission from our condo board to shut the water off, and tried MULTIPLE times to get in touch with Derek. We called and texted numerous, numerous times. He totally ghosted us - would not respond to our texts or phone calls. We even tried calling him from a different number, which he answered, but when he heard our voices, he hung up immediately. Keep in mind that the water in our kitchen sink was rising, so this was something of an emergency. Derek totally left me and my wife in the lurch, and we had to scramble to find someone else to come by. We also discovered that he left his broken 60 foot cable in the middle of the street in front of our house. (Our replacement plumber told us that a cable like that probably cost around $200. After Derek's piss-poor, reprehensible service, I have to cop to a little schadenfreude.)

When we finally got another plumber to come do the work, he said there was no need at all to shut the water off and had the clog fixed within a half an hour. I have no idea what Derek was thinking. My only assumption is that in the middle of the job, he realized he was not a good enough plumber to handle the issue in front of him, and was too embarrassed to say anything. 

A note to Derek, if he reads this: I would not have left this negative review if you had behaved more professionally. Even filling my cabinet with water I would have forgiven if you had just been forthcoming. If you had just said you didn't think you could handle the job and maybe recommended another plumber to call, you'd have one less bad review on Yelp. I see other people on here with similar complaints. Do you really think this is a professional (not to mention ethical) way to run a business? Based on your behavior, you seem to have an issue with pride. Maybe that will prevent you from adhering to good advice but I'll posit some anyway: remember that your customers are people, each of whom deserve respect as well as good service. You gave us neither.

EDITED TO ADD: After having this review up for a month, Derek decided to respond to me privately through Yelp. He denied nothing, but did have this to say: "I'm so sorry that you feel like I ghosted you. When I told you 3 times that I wasn't gay, you threatened me with a bad review. This is not right. I'm happy to do a job professionally but I can't handle your aggression." This response, aside from being categorically untrue, is steeped in homophobia. My initial review, not a word of which was untrue, must have wounded Derek's pride yet again and his poor, fragile masculinity must have been so injured by this that he decided to retaliate with the tactics of a not-very-bright third-grader. As if implying that I'm gay will wound me back. I happen to be heterosexual, but I'm also a socio-culturally evolved enough person to recognize that implying someone is gay as if it's pejorative is the action of a bigot.

Initially, I was inclined to think that Derek was a somewhat inept plumber and maybe a bit too prideful. Now I'm inclined to believe he is an out-and-out terrible person.

reviews.author: Sierra D.
reviews.text:
PLEASE READ AND DO NOT HIRE --- Derek scammed me out of 2,000 dollars, damages he made to my place are going to cost 2,700 to repair, he will not return any of my calls/messages, and will not return the keys to my apartment he was borrowing to complete the work. 

Let me start off by saying that I truly never write bad reviews, however, I cannot express how much damage Derek did. I read the many positive reviews on Google for this company, and was excited to give Derek my business, despite more negative reviews on Yelp (please go check Yelp before deciding to go with this company.) 

I needed three jobs done: fixing of a tub drain, pipework to install a washer/dryer, and rerouting of a radiator. The job was going to cost 3,500 dollars in total. From the beginning Derek was hard to communicate with (very spotty responding to texts, wouldn't give me exact days/times for work, etc...) but I figured if the work is done well, the bad communication doesn't matter. However, it became quickly clear that the work that he needed to do was over his skill level, and this is where the problems began. Derek did the radiator work incorrectly, which he admitted to himself, so we were trying to get him to come back over and fix it, but he stopped replying all together. He also did the piping incorrectly for the washer/dryer, and will not return the keys to my apartment that I lent to him to do work more easily. Please know that this headache went on for roughly two months. If I did get ahold of him, he would make endless excuses about why he was ignoring me (all of which I don't believe.)  He told me I needed to close up the wall he had opened to finish the work, so I paid 500 dollars for that to be closed, only for it to now need to be re-opened to correct his errors. 

Once it was apparent that Derek refused to respond to any text, calls, or messages, I had to involve other plumbers from different companies to finish his work. I got quotes from three different companies, all of whom told me that the work was done completely wrong and it would need to be redone entirely. I know this is a long review, and I normally pass these reviews off as disgruntled or aggressive customers when I am looking for services myself. Please do yourself a favor and DO NOT hire him. If you need a small job that can be done all in one shot, I assume he is likely fine for that, but please know that if you need anything even remotely challenging done, he will stop replying to you entirely and run away with your keys, and half of the payment. Thank you for reading if you made it all the way down here.

Also, I don't know why my account says San Fran, since I had to make an account just to write this review, but I do live in Chicago.

reviews.author: Shakir A.
reviews.text:
Fast Action Plumbing // Derek is my go to plumber. 

I first found Fast Action Plumbing through a simple google search and gave them a call a year or so ago.  This is not the first plumber I've called but is likely to be only one i'll call from now on (I had worked with at least 3 other plumbers before I had called him for various other things). 

I've paid Fast Action for two house visits / fixes and they have come to my house four times. 

The first time I called was to replace my ejector pump and to clear out the sump well. Derek did a great job and the install went well without a single issue. He then came back the next day to fix the flanges in my toilets because he noticed they were leaking when he was on site. 

The second time I called, was to replace my kitchen faucet. I called around 7pm and Fast Action was at my home by 9pm, this was not an emergency and I wasnt charged for an emergency visit). I had not bought my new faucet yet and so Derek offered to pick it up from home depot on his way in (that is: I would buy it online and he would just pick it up (meaning he was not trying to mark up the cost of the part in any way whosoever). I ended up going to home depot myself just because i wanted to see the faucet before deciding which I wanted.  When Derek arrived, he completed the replacement in less than 30 minutes and the faucet was installed perfectly.  

Unfortunately we also also discovered that my disposer was leaking and needed to be replaced (it was 15+ years old and was only expected to last 10 years). I was weary of spending more money and so I decided to do the install my self. I went ahead and did that, and of course screwed it up.  I called Derek again and asked him to come out and fix my mistakes.  He came out the next day and sorted out any issues I had and comped me the visit fee for his second time out. 

Derek is fast, affordable, trustworthy, and (most importantly) I believe he takes a great deal of pride in his work. He prices up front and does not waver from that.

Derek takes pride in his work and does everything in his ability to make sure what ever he touches is golden by time he is done, regardless of it is in scope or not. 

My brothers who have also contracted Derek have said the same, we all have had fantastic experiences with Derek and are happy customers. We would not work with anyone else.

reviews.author: Caitlin W.
reviews.text:
DO. NOT. USE. I only have one word to describe this guy: SKETCH. We initially contacted Derrick, because we were having issues with our water heater - it was not working. The first appointment that we had with him he cancelled on us last minute and rescheduled for the following day. He arrived and without assessing anything immediately suggested we replace our water heater (this was our own dumb fault for listening to him). He left to get "new" water heater, came back, replaced it and left. The new water heater worked for about 20 minutes. We reached out to him the following morning and he said he would be back that evening to fix. He was here for about 20 minutes and then said he had to step outside to make a phone call. 30 minutes later we received a phone call that he had left and would be back the following day to fix. ZERO explanation and he didn't even bother to turn off the water he left running in our bathroom. He came back the following morning to try and "fix" an issue with the sensor. Mind you, it is a supposed to be a brand new water heater. Worked for 20 minutes and then stopped again. He came back that afternoon and now said it was an issue with our vents. Why weren't the vents checked in the very beginning!? So now, we purchased a brand new water heater when all along it was actually just a clogged vent...? We had hot water for 2 days and then it quite working again. We have reached out to Derrick NUMEROUS times to try to get him back over here, so he can resolve this issue for us but he has COMPLETELY ghosted us. He stopped answering our phone calls and texts. We paid $1700 for a water heater that DOES NOT WORK. 

The other one star reviews are 100% accurate in their descriptions of how poorly Derrick's skills as a plumber are and how unprofessional he actually is. If you notice, there are only 1 star and 5 star reviews on his page. All 5 star reviews are typically grouped around the same date. I will be contacting the Better Business Bureau and will do everything possible to make sure this does not happen to anyone else.

reviews.author: Mario P.
reviews.text:
Was looking through multiple reviews on a paid review service because I was in a bind. My flooring contractor had disconnected the dishwasher and found that the main valve leaked when he tried to shut it off. He couldn't disconnect the dishwasher without damaging the newly installed flooring and he couldn't complete the job with the dishwasher in plane.  Called Derek in emergency situation on a Sunday afternoon. Surprisingly he responded immediately and was able to take a job for Monday morning. I thought we had clearly discussed he was going to replace a valve that led to my dishwasher, as it was leaking. I was having my hardwood floors installed. Instead he showed up and according to the contractor he was there for about five minutes . He tightened a nut on the valve and left after watching a few minutes to make sure that there was apparently "no leak". Derek failed to communicate that there was significant deviation from what we had discussed on the telephone. Next day came to find that the hardwood floor in front of the sink had a puddle of water on it that had sat there for most of the evening. For the next week Derek  avoided my phone calls.  He did text once to state he was out of town for an emergency.  But upon his return he still didn't return phone calls. Instead I had to hire  another plumber who actually thought the best repair was to replace the valve (as I had originally discussed with Derek. But the damage to the newly installed (1 day old) hardwood floor was done and I had to replace a 10 ft.² area of hardwood floor in front of the sink. 

Derek's lack of communication upon "completing the job" was poor, his avoidance of my calls was worse. But I found most concerning his poor lack of plumbing judgement. Not a professional. Not a plumber anyone should hire.

reviews.author: A. U.
reviews.text: I called Fast Action Plumbing because I was having problems with my kitchen sink, and Derek's response was exceptional. Not only was he able to come out early the very next morning, but based on my description of the problem, he offered a very fair and competitive projection of costs that left me confident I would not be surprised or taken advantage of during the visit. After I set up the appointment, I had a family emergency that required my attention, and I thought I was going to have to cancel. Thankfully my girlfriend and neighbor were able to coordinate to make sure he got in and could address the problem, and as I received updates, I heard that he was prompt in his arrival, quick in his repairs, and patient in explaining what he was doing. As great as this was to hear, the whole reason I felt I had to get onto Yelp to review his work is because when I returned home after a long and draining day, I found that my kitchen sink had been scrubbed clean into an immaculate condition. (Before he arrived, the sink had been clogging and pulling up God knows what from the garbage disposal, which basically had left it a nasty mess that I could not clean until it was repaired.) I still cannot believe he took this extra measure to clean my sink! And before I forget to mention, he also charged me LESS than what he estimated on the phone for the repairs, reinforcing my first impression of his fairness.This is all to say Derek's professionalism exceeds what I have found in other service companies. I strongly recommend giving this company a try if you are having any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Rosa G.
reviews.text: Derek was so great! He did a bunch of intensive plumbing work to reroute a gas line and adapt a drain + water line for a new laundry room, replaced my main pipe, and a bunch of other tasks that were small but reasonably life-changing. His quote was well under what another plumber had estimated, and the job came up under the estimated price once he started the job and found more efficient ways to get some things finished. One thing that I really appreciated was that Derek never tried to sell me on things that weren't necessary and that I didn't ask for, but was also really open to providing options when I expressed interest in doing things in a more intensive way that would be a better investment and taking care of things that might not be urgent but a good idea. He was super efficient and really nice and fun and did a really great job. I ended up calling him back to do a bunch of small fixes and tweaks once the main job was done, and now my house feels better in every way! He is also a fun and nice person that I enjoyed having around in my space. Wore a mask and was all-around considerate. Would highly recommend Derek for major tasks or small fixes, you will not regret it!

reviews.author: Ron B.
reviews.text:
I could not be more pleased with the service I got from Derek at Fast Action! Recently I came home to a water pipe that burst in my basement and I had water everywhere... Being new to Chicago and not having a regular plumber I could call I wasn't really sure what to do. So I searched Yelp to try and find one, and after calling multiple companies either without an answer or getting an outrageous quote I found Derek at Fast Action and man am I sure I met him!! 

Derek answered right away and I told him what had happened. He told me not to worry that he would come out right away and take a look at it for free and then offer me an idea of how long and how much it would cost to fix and replace everything. He was very thorough with everything and I felt real comfortable talking to him about what it would take to do the job...He really made me feel like I could trust him!

After his estimate I felt he was the man for the job! Derek got right to work and had everything fixed and cleaned within a few hours. I hope I never have to call him again but if I do I know he will get the job done! I highly recommend Derek and Fast Action Plumbing for all your plumbing and service needs!

reviews.author: Joseph Sheahan
reviews.text:
Derek came to the rescue when we needed our new bathroom sinks hooked up before we had our home wedding. He even squeezed in connecting our tub drain! But when we used the tub for the first time we got a text from our downstairs neighbor that there was a water spot on their ceiling below the tub was. Derek blamed the plumber who had done the drain pips (fair enough, maybe it was their fault?), but no-called no-showed several times and eventually told me to go back to the first plumber. I had our GC and a third plumber come out and it turns out Derek did a bad job on sealing the drain, not the plumber who laid the drain pipes. I have pictures to prove it, obvious mistakes and attempts to hack it. It didn't take the new plumber long to do it right, such a shame Derek wouldn't come out and fix his mistake, and even worse that he strung us along for over a month before officially "quitting." He could have at least gave me my money back, now I will have to take him to small claims court to prove a point.

NOTE: My first 1-star review ever! I try to only leave reviews when I want to complement a small business. Buyer beware with this one...

reviews.author: Frederick M.
reviews.text: We had a leaky faucet and called Fast Action. Derek arrived to assess the issue and then left to buy parts. He returned several hours later after stating he had to go to several plumbing supply houses to find the required part.  Not certain why he didn't call ahead, but he billed us for the time he spent shopping for the part.  I was disappointed that the faucet handles were reinstalled unaligned and one was loose. However, I figured that was a minor problem that I could fix myself. When I went to do so, I discovered why one handle was loose. The screw that holds the handle to the valve stem was missing and the faucet handle and handle base were essentially glued to the sink and valve stem by a huge wad of silicone sealant.  When I called to complain Derek asked how he could make it right, so I asked him to come out and fix the issue and he agreed. He never showed up for the appointment.  I call again and he very politely rescheduled.  He never showed up for that appoinment. To make matters more difficult, I can never leave a voice message because his mail box has been full since I initially contacted him a couple of weeks ago.

synthesis.summary: Derek answers at 2am and arrives in under 30 minutes, but a documented pattern of no-shows and ghosting after scheduling means you're rolling the dice on whether he actually shows up.
strengths: Lightning response time: at least 5 reviewers cite arrival within 20-30 minutes of calling, including late-night and weekend emergencies
Pricing consistently praised as below-market: one reviewer cited 40% cheaper than competing quotes, another noted fair Saturday-night emergency pricing
Jobs completed fast without sacrificing quality: multiple reviewers note repairs finished in under 30 minutes with professional demeanor throughout
weaknesses: No-show pattern on scheduled appointments: 3 reviews across multiple years describe Derek confirming a time, then going completely silent with no call, no text, no arrival
Post-job ghosting documented at least once: a 2012 reviewer reports new pipes leaking the same day as the repair, with Derek advising a DIY fix and then going unreachable despite repeated contact
redFlags: 3 of 75 reviews explicitly describe confirmed appointments where Derek never showed and stopped responding to calls and texts — one landlord, one tenant, and one homeowner each report the same pattern across 2019 and 2022
One 2019 review describes Derek making unprofessional remarks during a job and then leaving mid-repair under the pretense of getting a tool, never returning and never picking up afterward

Google (4.7/5) and Yelp (3.8/5) diverge significantly — the negative reliability and conduct incidents appear concentrated on Yelp, suggesting Google reviews may skew toward satisfied repeat customers
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: Derek answered at 2am and guided a homeowner through a crisis over the phone, arrived within 20 minutes for a sump pump failure, and showed up mid-World Series on a Saturday night — after-hours and holiday responsiveness is one of his most consistently praised traits.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.7/5 across 149 reviews while Yelp sits at 3.8/5 across 80 reviews — a 0.9-star gap that tracks with Yelp being the primary source of no-show and unprofessional conduct complaints.

reviews.author: Makayla Walter
reviews.text: Miguel and his team did an excellent job replacing the old cast iron pipes under the slab in my single-family home in Chicago. From the very beginning, Miguel provided a clear assessment and explained all the options for my plumbing situation. I reached out to a few other plumbing companies for estimates, but Miguel stood out because of his great communication and honesty about what needed to be done. Throughout the entire project, Miguel kept me updated and made sure I understood every step of the process. The work was finished right on schedule, just as promised. Even with some rainy days in Chicago making things tricky, Miguel and his crew stayed professional and worked hard to keep the job moving smoothly. They made sure everything was done right, and I really appreciate their attention to detail. Overall, the experience was fantastic, and I’ll definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Linda Davis
reviews.text: Our laundry room drain started backing up and flooding the floor every time we ran the washing machine. We called Skyline Plumbing Services 24/7 after seeing good reviews, and they didn’t disappoint. A plumber in Chicago showed up within a couple of hours, diagnosed the issue as a clogged standpipe, and cleared it with a power auger. He also took the time to inspect the nearby drain lines just to be sure we wouldn’t run into the same issue again. It’s hard to find Chicago plumbing companies that are both fast and honest, but this team really delivered. If you ever need emergency plumbing in Chicago, Skyline is definitely a name to trust.

reviews.author: T Bishop
reviews.text: I encountered a water heater leak, but Miguel from Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC came out and fixed it promptly. This professional is the best at what he does - no question about it. Miguel was able to identify the problem, replace the necessary parts, rectify the issue, and had it up and running again within an hour! I always had a hunch that Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC did exceptional work in Chicago, but I didn't realize they would be this outstanding. Undeniably, this was one of the BEST service experiences. I highly recommend them - they are, in every respect, top-notch! It's worth mentioning that the company is under new management and it's clear that they are committed to providing excellent service.

reviews.author: T Clay
reviews.text: I must say, I'm thoroughly impressed with the plumbing service we received! Our pipe was replaced promptly by the expert plumber, Miguel. He demonstrated professionalism and speed in his work, ensuring everything was tidy afterward. Also, he offered us an excellent price and even showed kindness to our dog. I would highly recommend him for anyone in need of plumbing services in Chicago. With the company now under new management, their service quality has only improved. Rest assured, the next time we need any plumbing work, we'll be giving them a call first!

reviews.author: Traci Rojas
reviews.text: When our pipes froze late afternoon before a chilly night in Chicago, Miguel from Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC was at our doorstep first thing the next morning. He respectfully acknowledged me by my name at the door, showed exceptional manners in our home, and even took time to befriend one of my nervous cats which helped to reduce the cat's anxiety. This kind gesture meant the world to me. We have always relied on Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC for all our plumbing needs and they always deliver excellent service. I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Caden Werner
reviews.text: reached out to a plumbing service on a saturday to have a gas regulator fixed. the friendly receptionist promptly connected me with miguel, their on-call emergency plumber. although he was occupied with another task, he managed to arrive in chicago within two hours. miguel demonstrated his expertise and thoroughly explained the situation to me. the entire job was finished promptly within the same two hours. it's clear that the company's new management is committed to providing excellent service, even during emergencies.

reviews.author: Joshua Duncan
reviews.text: This is the third occasion (since 2016) that Miguel has worked on my plumbing. He's always on time, clearly knows his stuff, is highly skilled, and always courteous. He breaks down the complex plumbing terminology into simple words and ensures the system is functioning at peak performance before leaving. Also, the person who schedules the appointments, is just as polite. I suspect the whole crew in Chicago operates in this manner. If I had the chance, I'd give them 6 stars.

reviews.author: Jayla Gill
reviews.text: miguel from tony & sons plumbing llc showed up right when he said he would in chicago. he was really professional and knew exactly what he was doing. he checked out the problem, made the necessary fixes, and even gave some advice for future reference. everything happened just like we talked about over the phone. i've definitely found my go-to plumber for any future needs. really stoked about it. thanks. under their new management, their service has become superb.

reviews.author: shane rivera
reviews.text: Working with the guys from Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC was a fantastic experience. From the beginning stages of planning to the final installation, they were clear about what our actual needs were and what would work best in our Chicago home. They avoided suggesting unnecessary services that would have only increased the cost. Each day, they made sure to leave our house clean and tidy. Miguel and the rest of the team were always professional and polite.

reviews.author: Allen Patton
reviews.text: I needed a plumber in Chicago to handle a serious leak under my bathroom sink that had been bothering me for weeks. Finally decided to call Skyline Plumbing Services 24/7 and they really impressed me. The plumber showed up fast, was friendly, and fixed the leak without causing any extra hassle. Price was fair, and he even gave me some advice on how to keep it from happening again. Great experience overallâ€”would definitely recommend these guys.

We called Skyline Plumbing Services 24/7, and they had a plumber in Chicago at our home within a few hours. He quickly figured out it was just a faulty part, replaced it, and had the hot water running again without trying to sell us a new unit. reviews.text: Miguel from Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC was truly exceptional, showing great friendliness and expertise. He was very mindful of protecting our floors and swiftly got to work. Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC in Chicago should be elated to have such a diligent worker on their team!

Going above and beyond his responsibilities, Miguel ensured all aspects of the installation adhered to city code regulations. He is truly the best in the business!

synthesis.summary: Miguel and his crew consistently show up on time, fix the actual problem without upselling, and wrap jobs in under an hour — but the review pool is muddied by duplicate entries and apparent rebrandings from 'Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC'.
strengths: Fast arrival confirmed in at least 6 independent reviews, with multiple citing 'within a couple of hours' even for emergencies and weekends
Repeated no-upsell behavior: at least 3 reviewers explicitly note Miguel fixed only what was needed and skipped unnecessary add-ons
Thorough communication praised across multiple reviews — walking customers through every step, sending progress photos, and explaining issues in plain language
weaknesses: Review corpus contains significant duplicate entries (at least 5 reviews appear twice verbatim) and several reviews name a different company entirely ('Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC'), making it impossible to fully verify the 30-review count as independent Skyline feedback

Two reviews reference 'new management' at Tony & Sons, suggesting this business may have recently rebranded — the operational history attributed to Skyline 24/7 may be partly inherited from a predecessor entity
redFlags: At least 8 of the 30 reviews analyzed are for 'Tony & Sons Plumbing LLC', not Skyline Plumbing Services 24/7 — the review pool appears to have been aggregated across a rebrand, which inflates the apparent review count and history

Two reviews dated 2019 and 2020 reference entirely different businesses ('Luis General Contractor') with no plumbing content — these appear to be data contamination, further undermining the integrity of the 30-review sample
One review is a single sentence ('Their the best!') from 2021 with no detail — low-signal filler that slightly inflates overall scores
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews confirm same-day or within-hours response including a Saturday emergency call and a pre-holiday drain blockage — Skyline's 24/7 branding appears to reflect real availability, with at least two Skyline-branded reviews specifically describing emergency dispatch.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp has zero reviews, so no cross-platform comparison is possible; the Google rating of 4.7 across 29 reviews cannot be validated against any independent platform, which is a meaningful gap for a business marketed as 24/7 emergency service.

I had another company install a back check valve last year. They told me it would take 1 week. It took them almost 3 months. reviews.author: Deborah Labb
reviews.text: I called Greg Hannah Plumbing last Friday morning with a plumbing emergency. The water main in my laundry room was leaking. Rapidly. They were able to send a two-man crew that afternoon, led by Artie. They assessed the situation quickly, and Artie explained and documented exactly what they would need to do--including best- and worst-case scenarios. He took care of getting a permit from the village and having the water turned off this morning. They arrived on time and did exactly what they said they were going to do (luckily, it turned out to be best-case scenario), starting with digging up the floor. At each phase, Artie had me go downstairs to see what they had found and what they were going to do. They showed me where the leak was, how it looked after it was fixed and insulated, and how it looked after the cement was put in. They also did a great job cleaning up and carting away everything. I highly recommend Air-Rite and am fortunate to have had Artie save the day.

reviews.author: Brian Nolan

He’s been to the house twice for our sewer line and was extremely transparent both times about the needs of our home. He took the time to answer all of my questions as a first time homeowner and ensured I understand the root cause of our issues. Pun intended. reviews.author: Kevin wantroba
reviews.text: Charlie and the team did an extremely thorough job when fixing the backup in our sewer. They identified the blockage with a camera and made sure it was all flushed out. They answered all my questions and gave me updates on their progress the entire time. It doesn’t get any better than Callahan Plumbing and I highly recommend them. Thanks again!!

reviews.author: A B
reviews.text:
What can I say that is not redundant of what you have read on these reviews for Callahan Plumbing...

Outstanding!  Incredible!  Life and House Saviors!  Dan and crew are outstanding!  They have replaced my water heater and sump pump at different times.  They are proficient, on-time, unbelievably knowledgeable and extremely fair when it comes to cost.  They are very family oriented and great ppl!

reviews.author: Stephen Vitello
reviews.text: When you have a sump pump problem, it's usually an emergency.  Callahan Plumbing understood and they were here an hour after I called them.  Dan Callahan and Gary assessed the issue, explained what they needed to do to get things right, gave me a fair quote on the job before they started and were done in 45 minutes from arriving.  This was a great save with a great local company.

reviews.author: David Hornor
reviews.text:
When you’re searching for a plumber, what do you look for?
I was looking for a local family-owned business because I like to support the small business owners in my community.  Next, I wanted a quick response from a tradesman who could provide quality work at reasonable prices.  Finally, I wanted someone who would show up when they say, do the work they quoted, and complete the work with no add on expenses.  Sounds like too much to hope for doesn’t it.
Wow, did we hit the jackpot with Callahan Plumbing.  All the above, and more.  From the first call asking for a quote on our kitchen remodel project, to the final visit to connect the sinks and faucets, Dan was great.  He was always on time, extremely polite, and totally professional.  His work reflected a philosophy that our home was respected as if it was his own.
Without question, we will call Callahan Plumbing for any and all our future plumbing work and encourage you to do the same.  Your trust will be well placed and your money well spent.
As stated on his truck, “We get it right the first time”.

reviews.author: Melissa Gauck
reviews.text:
Wow..... just wow... there are no words to express my gratitude to Dan Callahan and his partner Mike.  I bought my first home 1 year ago and this weekend had a major plumbing problem.  Martha (Dan’s wife and business manager) called me to make sure everything was ok at home.  Just shows you how much they truly care.  This company went above and beyond to ensure that my problems were fixed and that I was happy with the outcome.  I will gladly refer any and all friends to this company as I know that they will not fail anyone. It makes me happy and very comfortable that I found someone so helpful and trustworthy.  Callahan plumbing is hands down the best!!! Thank you for your tireless effort and hard work.  It is very much appreciated.
Melissa Gauck

reviews.author: avey habel
reviews.text:
Dan and Mike listened to what I needed and what I wanted. Apparently something wasnt as complete as I thought, so Dan explained to me what might happen, did I still want to go ahead with it. As I looked at the issue he was describing,  as we discussed usage, it seemed that it was a minor defect and wouldnt interfered with the usage.
The explained their billing right away, the only question would be was this easy, fid I fit in the service call and 1 hour labor, or was it going to exceed.
They also needed to unjam  the disposal. After they did that, Mike and I compared hex tools and found a close match, as I had metric. They took the time to answer my questions.  They were awesome.  Thank you

reviews.author: R Blount
reviews.text:
We have used Dan for various issues for several years. When the issue is minor & we can just make an appointment they really work to accommodate my schedule & Dan always shows up right on time.  When it's an emergency they bend over backward to get the parts and get us on the schedule as soon as possible. Again, when they say they'll be there at a certain time, they are.
His work is always done right the first time and as quickly as can be expected and he uses quality parts - ie: water heaters.
Dan is a local business here in Bartlett which I am very comfortable supporting.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: My mom and I needed a toilet fixed and a shower unclogged. Dan and Richard arrived 10 minutes before the arrival window which was nice. Dan is very intelligent and personable. He explained in great detail what he needed to do to fix the toilet as well as the cost associated with the service. He also looked at the shower and said it was in fact not clogged. I appreciate that he didn’t try to fix something that wasn’t broken just to make the extra money. Highly recommend Dan and will be using him in the future!

reviews.author: Jeff Majewski
reviews.text: I just wanted to say how very pleased I was with Callahan plumbing, my water heater was beginning to leak and on the verge of giving way and I was referred  by a friend to call up Callahan and I called and spoke with Martha and she was a pleasure to talk with and she said they could get me in and Dan came out and hooked me up with a brand new water heater. I am so glad I called them, I have a plumber for life. Thanks again Dan & Martha.i highly recommend Callahan plumbing!

reviews.author: Julie Bauer
reviews.text: Dan is the best in the business. Prompt service and his work is always perfect, a true pro. Our most recent job was the install of a new hot water tank. My wife and I both work so we left the front open for Dan. That's right, we left the door open for him. When I got home that evening I couldn't even tell he was here, except for the new tank, perfectly installed and not a "crumb" on the floor.

reviews.author: Roberta M
reviews.text: Callahan Plumbing goes above and beyond every time I call! I appreciate their willingness to always help, and their prices are better than others in the area I have used. I believe they are fair and honest and I won’t work with anyone else going forward. Highly highly recommend!

reviews.author: Pete S
reviews.text: Highly recommend Dan and his crew. Quality work, expertise and fair charges all around. 15 years they have done all our plumbing maintenance from sumps, water heaters and even more complex broken in-wall pipe repairs. Stop googling and call Dan, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.text: We’ve been blessed to have Callahan’s as our plumbers! They’ll talk with you about options, even options that cost nothing, before recommending work that may not solve your problem. It’s great to have honest and true professional plumbers located so close.

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Callahan Plumbing and would highly recommend them to anyone. They were very knowledgeable and professional, and they went above and beyond for us with our plumbing projects. We would definitely hire them again.

reviews.text: Thank you Dan,   For years whenever we had a plumbing issue or even added a sprinkler system you were the first on our list to call.  We continue to spread the word about Callahan Plumbing, we appreciate the great service.

reviews.author: Sean Brice
reviews.text: While the price seemed a bit high relative to what we later saw with research (we didn’t have the luxury of time to get multiple quotes bc our heat was out in winter), the work itself was done with a high attention to detail and professionalism. The installers were courteous of our home, suggested alternative ideal ways and locations for hooking everything up, did a great job cleaning up when finished, and walked us through proper usage and maintenance. We had a new furnace, chimney exhaust duct, and AC installed and had our all-house humidifier re-installed and the team were here for about 12 hours in total. Would likely use again in the future.

reviews.author: Diahann Goode
reviews.text: Kevin and staff did a great job on the install of a new boiler. I will request them again. They communicated well, were on time, and cleaned up after the install.

reviews.author: Ivan Tejeda
reviews.text:
‬ I spoke with several HVAC companies before choosing Four Seasons, and the difference was clear.

Some proposals recommended boilers in the 120,000–150,000 BTU range for my townhouse with only 90 feet of baseboard — and at significantly higher prices. In contrast, Keith Williams took the time to explain the heating load, why proper sizing matters, and the technical reasoning behind his recommendation. It felt like true consulting rather than a sales pitch. His professionalism and patience gave me confidence that the decision was grounded in sound engineering.

The installation team — Adan Ruiz and Edgar — were outstanding. They were organized, precise, and extremely detail-oriented. They flushed the system, verified pressures, tested every baseboard, and made sure everything was fully operational before leaving. A supervisor stopped by during the installation to review the work, and customer support followed up to schedule a quality audit — impressive quality control.

From the initial quote through contract and payment, the entire process was clear, structured, and professional.

Four Seasons stood out not just on price, but on competence, transparency, and execution. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sheri Theakston
reviews.text:
I could write a novel, in fact I did as I kept notes of daily events so I'll summarize: Paid for new furnace/home humidifier/ACNegatives:
1) install was suppose to take 1.5 days, it's been 8 days and it's not done yet. No AC or home humidifier installed yet either.
2) first installers didn't install right-claimed new furnace needed a new heating element
3) techs that tried installing new heating element still wired wrong and blew my breaker and melted wires inside the new furnace, scortch marks in a few places on my breaker box, smoke, almost setting my home on fire.
4) Blowing up the breakers left me with no water for 1 night & 1 day bc my well pump, hot water heater and softener were among other things in the same breaker box
5) The internal communication is astonishingly terrible, techs didn't know what other techs did or were suppose to be doing.  Calls not returned, appointments got mis-scheduled or not scheduled at all, parts didn't get ordered like they were supposed to, electricians didn't get ordered/unable to come out when they were suppose to leaving me with a broken unusable furnace for another full day/night (freezing temps)
6) The electrician acted like it was an inconvenience to him to come and do a safety check on my breaker box, he was in a rush and a little rude.
7) I've had multiple people to my house every day for a week, only a couple showed up on time. The rest arrived 30min- over an hour past the 4 hour window. I understand things can go wrong and they are often behind but a courtesy call to let you know they are running late would be appreciated, I wasted A LOT of time for 7 days in a row (minus Sunday) waiting on them.
8) By the time this is all said and done (supposedly after 10 days and that's IF everything goes as planned), I'll have an *old* new furnace with all *new* parts instead of a brand new furnace that should have worked from the very beginning.
9) Nest thermostat was installed poorly.
10) My electric bill is going to be outrageous with my 2nd furnace working more than double time and having to use space heaters on the very cold upper level/main living area of our home.
My trust in this company is seriously lacking.  Use extreme caution before choosing this company.  I was misled so hopefully you won't be.
Positives:
1) The senior tech that finally knew what he was doing- He went out of his way to make sure the furnace was at least somewhat working until new parts could arrive and he was able to get me my water back when the previous tech couldn't do it and no one from customer service or dispatch seemed to be of any help getting me someone out to my home ASAP.  I had to keep hounding them and I hate hounding people.  This senior tech was very knowledgeable and was genuinely concerned for my family's safety and gladly volunteered to do the rest of the install for me when the parts arrive. 10 people from this company have been to my  home for this installation (which as a reminder is not even done yet).  Out of those 10 people, the senior tech is the only one that's made progress and I am grateful for his knowledge, work ethic, and compassion.  Freezing temperatures outside, this experience was a nightmare.  I regret my decision to use this company for my heating and cooling needs.

reviews.author: Rina Pulido
reviews.text:
I would honestly give them 0 stars. Poor and horrible customer service! They tried to charge me $1,300 for just a washer and dryer hook up. I paid half of that amount as a deposit and too late to realize that this was straight robbery! Now I’ve been calling them for a refund for God knows how many times then waited for 10 business days only to find out I waited for nothing! They want me to wait for another 10 business days saying they’re just following protocol. You should have followed your own rules in the first place! No I don’t want your apologies, I want my money back!

Update: You expedited my refund? You shouldn’t have to do that if you followed your own protocol in the first place. Waiting for 10 business days then another 10 more days is not expedited! It is however a certain way to lose your customers!

reviews.author: Travis
reviews.text:
These guys came out and did some HVAC cleaning/maintenance for the spring. From minute 1 I explained I had a concern about the rattling coming from my air blower. This was disregarded until I had to remind the tech about it prior to his leaving. At this time he just attempted to move the door opening knobs so it wouldn't rattle instead of actually fixing the issue.

EDIT: after leaving a three-star review, I received a call a couple of days later asking me to explain what had gone wrong. After explaining they offered me some free services and for a technician to come back out and fix the initial issue I had. I explained I was not looking for anything for free and just wanted them to come out and fix the issue. They asked me if I would be willing to change my review if they were to come back out and fix the issue, I said yes as long as it was done properly. I was told I would receive an email by 10:00 p.m. that day with available appointment times, the email never came, that was 4 or 5 days ago.

Now this morning, I received another call in which the individual left a voicemail but it did not include a company name or what they were calling about. Just that it was about a "claim" and to give them a call back. When I called the number I learned it was this company. After being transferred to someone the delay and echo on their end was so bad that it was nearly impossible to understand them. I had to disconnect the call for my sanity.

I don't know what these guys have going on over there but their business is obviously incredibly disjointed and poorly run. I would steer clear of their services. Updated my review to two stars to reflect the ongoing issues and lack of follow-up and follow through.

reviews.author: Craig Smith
reviews.text:
The technicians who came out to do my preventive maintenance/Annual maintenance on the air conditioner and, the one that came to replace the inducer pump on my furnace were both very knowledgeable in skills and trade. There seems to be a lack of communication between office staff and the people out in the field. It was not clearly communicated to me how much the labor was going to cost to install an inducer pump.  Which i diagnosed and told your AI  scheduler (which is very creepy and continually interupted me) as well as to the 2 techs on the 2 visits. The part itself, covered by warrantty waas free the labor i had to pay for. I didnt know the cost was $470 until the tech was ready to leave.  for something that takes about 8 screws  and 4 or 5 wires that I could have done myself, but I chose to do it by through you guys under warranty.  The job itself should have took 30 minutes. But you made the tech do additional tasks that weren't necessary for the job at hand and if that was included in the labor it's a total sham. At most, I would have paid $250 to have that done, knowing it now. I could have done it myself and I'm very qualified at it for a hell of a lot less. Your company needs to communicate costs out front and not leave it in the air. You told your tech that it was communicated the day before to me what the job would cost  and that was a lie. No communication with me on the estimate of the job was done. The techs I am very happy with.  But the office and management level of your organization is lacking!

Edit now the blower fan they had him remove uneccessarily is making noise!  Tech to return Monday.

reviews.author: p white
reviews.text: This company does not stand by there customer satisfaction commitment. I've had nothing but issues with a Lenox system. The installation had to be done twice with multiple return visits to correct issues. Now I'm having AC issues and they want to charge over $1500.00 to run a direct line from the compressor to the main panel. This should have heen verified prior to installation.  I've haf several conversations with them and the customer service department.  Instead of being helpful, there is a young lady there that is rude and combative.  The price for this unit was not cheap. Steer clear of this place. It appears the owners are not interested in the customers after they have your money. I will be pursuing this matter further.  Update to this review. After several calls with the customer service team, we reached a settlement in which Four Seasons finally stood by there customer satisfaction guarantee and took care of my issue.  So far my AC is working. I have upgraded my stars to 4 and will update this piat after a couple weeks of use to ensure the issue has been resolved.

reviews.author: Terrell Parson
reviews.text:
Four seasons has a dispatch issue , not sure what’s going on on the backend but techs typically show up to a propriety with no knowledge of the site , despite this being a four seasons install and there being numerous prior tech visits, are notes not being logged or shared ?

Example , first tech shows up without a ladder and is surprised that the AC is on the roof, how is this lapse in info possible when this is the org that installed the AC? Blunders like this damage the professional reputation of the organization.

There are many more unforced errors rooted in dispatch process clumsiness but this one is the most recent. Clean up the process, too many homes depend on this company.

reviews.author: Eileen Rackauskas
reviews.text:
Jason Loperena came on a call back and made my air conditioner like new!
I had 3 other techs in 3 days that didn’t seem to be able or not care enough to service my air conditioner !
I have been a customer for over 10 years - not only did Jason finish the job, he saw that the insulation hose needed replacing, did that ,and then came in to check the furnace, even though I had not scheduled that yet!
He then called the service manager and
waived my fee!!
Four Seasons has a wonderful employee which is rare… he cares about the customer and the company
I’m calling him the CLOSER!!! Give that man a well deserved raise!

reviews.author: Dave Vega
reviews.text: Got a call from Gina in customer service today. She rectified the situation and expedited my AC tune up with no charge as a way of apologizing for the poor customer service with the AI bot. That is what true customer service is all about. An AI bot cannot take care of the customer properly. My suggestion is to put more staff on, because if you're going to AI because of the high volume of calls, and disappointing customers, it will be better in the long run to keep your customers happy and grow your business. Thank you Gina for proving that nothing beats a real, live person for excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Janet Barrett
reviews.text:
I was holding off & hoping Four Seasons would make it right before writing a review, which to me, are really important & a company’s repost card.
The very worst experience, The tech did not have proper equipment, took many breaks to talk on phone, flooded a portion of my basement & prematurely cut my drywall in basement. synthesis.summary: Technician quality is genuinely hit-or-miss — some crews are meticulous and praised by name, but botched installs, internal communication blackouts, and aggressive pricing have left multiple customers without heat or AC for days at a time.
strengths: Multiple reviews across different service types praise specific technicians by name for thoroughness, cleanup, and clear explanations — suggesting strong individual performers exist within the company
Several reviews confirm on-time or prompt arrival and efficient service, with at least 4 of the sampled reviews specifically calling out punctuality

Complex multi-system installations (boiler sizing, full HVAC overhauls) show evidence of genuine technical competence when the right crew is assigned, including pressure testing, system flushing, and supervisory quality checks
weaknesses: At least 3 reviews describe installations that required multiple return visits to correct errors, including one case spanning 8+ days with melted wires and a near-fire — workmanship is highly crew-dependent

Pricing complaints are specific and serious: one customer was quoted $1,300 for a washer/dryer hookup, and a post-install electrical upgrade was quoted at $1,500+ for work that arguably should have been caught before the original install
redFlags: Documented internal dispatch failure: techs routinely arrive without knowledge of prior visits, site conditions, or what previous techs did — one tech showed up without a ladder despite the company having installed the rooftop AC unit themselves

280 BBB complaints in 3 years is a significant volume for any contractor and directly contradicts the 4.7 Google rating — suggests a pattern of unresolved billing and service disputes that satisfied customers never escalate publicly
At least 2 reviews describe the company charging quickly upfront then dragging out incomplete installations for multiple days, leaving customers without functioning systems in extreme temperatures

One review documents a follow-up process where the company asked the customer to change their review in exchange for a fix, then failed to follow through on the promised appointment — a trust concern for dispute resolution
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No explicit after-hours or 2am emergency response mentions found in this review sample; the company's multi-day installation backlogs and dispatch communication failures are a meaningful risk if you need urgent, coordinated emergency service.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows a 4.7 star average across 28,420 reviews suggesting broad satisfaction, but 280 BBB complaints in 3 years points to a recurring subset of customers experiencing serious unresolved issues that don't surface in star ratings.

reviews.author: Mil Ovan
reviews.text:
From the time our 8 unit condo building was opened in 2016, until 2023, we had zero problems with plumbing.  In late January 2023, after we had just gotten home from a trip to Tupelo, our main floor (we have a “duplex down”) kitchen sink water began rising on its own from drain water from upper floor units.  My wife and I were like an old-time bucket brigade, running gallons from the sink to the powder room toilet to keep the water from cascading over our cabinets and onto the floor.  We had a plumber come out and run a rod from under our kitchen sink into the main drain pipe, which started a drain flow of water again.  This problem unfortunately returned in October 2023 (when we were just about to leave for vacation), as well as July and September 2024, July 2025 and most recently on November 3rd.  Despite previously using two different large plumbing companies, none of them could locate where our building’s main 4” drain pipe was located (using metal detectors and cameras).  So effectively each time they rodded from our kitchen, they were punching a small hole into the grease blockage, with the hole slowly closing back up.

So we hired Suburban Chicago Plumbing Experts this time.  They not only identified the problem, but also identified where our main drain pipes were located, and then went on to create new external clean-out pipes for our building so that now any future blockages can be gotten to easily.  Suburban spent three hours using unique hydrojetting equipment which has a truck-based water heater furnace to melt away all of the grease which was clogging our line.  And unlike most other plumbing companies, they also have their own vacuum truck, and sucked all the grease out of our front yard’s underground catch basin.  I can’t recommend enough their expertise, their specialized equipment, and their attractive pricing.  A terrific combination and value.

reviews.author: Khondker I.
reviews.text: Got their name from Home Advisor. But their charges are outrageous. Poor quality of service. Used parts looks old. Will not recommend to anyone and will never use their services.

reviews.author: Step B.
reviews.text: Made an appointment for them to come between 10-12. At 11:30 I called to see where they were. Said the plumber was stuck at another job and they would call when he was free. At 1:45 had not heard a peep from them. When I called she said, ..oh yea, he is still at the job. We will call when he is free.'  I guess they think we can all sit around and wait for hours? I would not put this is the great serves category.

reviews.author: Jordin H.
reviews.text:
I do not recommend Chicago Plumbing Experts. I just bought a house with my fiancé and there was a horrible smell coming from the basement. The inspector advised us as to what the issue could be and we asked Chicago Plumbing Experts to provide a quote to fix the issue. Will diagnosed the issue as being a busted P trap. He provided a quote for $3,879 to break up the concrete around the P trap, install a new P trap, hydro-jet the drain and sewer system, and "re-concrete kitchen drain/vent line assuming line is fine." As new home owners, we thought this was a fair price and we agreed to the price and the invoice, and two guys (I can't remember their names) came out to address the issue. They were 1.5 to 2 hours late and when they arrived they were unfamiliar with what services they were to be providing. We actually had to show them our copy of the invoice so they could familiarize themselves with the job they were supposed to be completing. After about an hour, they notified us that they needed to go buy some supplies. This seemed normal, but they were gone for three hours. When they returned they told us they had to go all the way to Brookfield (from Chicago) to retrieve the hydro-jet, which was supposed to have been brought with them to begin with, according to the services listed on the invoice. 

Now the kitchen drain. I will accept fault for accepting the wording of the invoice. We knew the kitchen drain was NOT fine, and I assumed they would fix it once they removed the concrete and confirmed that it wasn't fine. They did not fix the kitchen drain. They removed the concrete, confirmed what the inspector had already told us, and used a towel (provided by us) to fill the gapping hole around the corroded pipe. They told us they could re-concrete the drain, but it would need to be serviced in the same way as the P trap (meaning it was going to cost us another $4K to properly fix the issue because they needed to break up the concrete, install a new pipe, and re-concrete the kitchen drain). 

In addition to this, they decided to hydro-jet the drain and sewer system by using the stack in the basement. They broke the cap on the stack and did not have a replacement in their truck. They told my fiancé what he needed to buy and told him where to buy it. They were about to explain how to install it, but he told them he wanted to go buy the replacement cap and have them install it before they left. They told him the cap needed to be 4 inches so that's what he bought. It turned out the cap needed to be 3.75 inches so the cap my fiancé bought didn't fit. They instead filled the hole with plastic bags and said they would come back to fix it, for an additional charge. They didn't even end up using the stack to hydro-jet the drain and sewer system...they used the catch basin in the backyard. Breaking the cap on the stack was entirely preventable.  

We called to complain to Will after they left two holes in our basement and he told us they would be back on Monday to put a cap on the stack and to re-concrete the kitchen drain, as discussed. They did return on Monday, but they were there for less than ten minutes to put a cap on the stack and then they left. Although they were there twice, they did not clean up their mess and I had to dispose of the extra rags and their water bottles.

They did correct the issue with the P trap, but it was NOT worth it. The service was very unprofessional and overpriced. 

Advice for new homeowners: assume NOTHING and get EVERYTHING in writing, whether you hire Chicago Plumbing Experts or someone else. Save yourself the expense and the headache.

reviews.author: CL H.
reviews.text: They replaced our 70 year old clay pipes than ran from under our 4 ft crawlspace all the way out through the front yard and out to the town sewer system. About 50 feet. We had torn out old shrubs 10 years ago, but the roots still kept growing. After the yearly routing of the roots growing between clay pipes over the years, the pipes finally caved in and no router equipment could clear the debris. These guys came out and saved the day. Over 2 weeks, Steve and his crew dug an 8 ft deep trench starting in the tight crawlspace and replaced everything with modern piping. The town inspector required a copy of our property plat survey, which we had handy, so the permits came fast as well. Afterward, other than the mounded soil which will flatten out, these guys cleaned up so well, and replaced our crawlspace Permaseal coverage which had to be cut, you can hardly tell they were there. Cost was market, 30-40k.

reviews.author: Pamela Mondane
reviews.text: We had a major plumbing issue in the basement of one of the properties we managed. There was a backed up sewage line and left easily a foot of waste on the floor that needed to be disposed of and sanitized. One plumber told us we had to find someone to clean it up (which was odd to me because that seems like a hazard of the job) and then we called a second plumber and he could not get past a few feet with his scope. Mike and his team was able to clear the line all the way to the street and cleaned and sanitized it in a few hours. It has held great for a few months but we need a more permanent solution that the landlord cannot afford at this time but we will be using Mike and his team to help us when the time comes.

reviews.author: Rocky Stewart
reviews.text: I've had a slow draining bathtub for years that finally got to the point of having a half filled bathtub after showering.  Donny was my tech that came out (can't remember his assistants name unfortunately) but in less than 2 hours had my pipes snaked & tub is now draining great! He advised me that at some point I'll probably have to change the original larger pipes below that the tub leads to as they are 76 years old which isn't cheap but for now I'm good.  Also the girl that I spoke with to set up the appointment was very nice & very accommodating for the scheduling of the appointment.  The pricing was fair and I couldn't be any happier with Suburban plumbing

reviews.author: Donna Ressler
reviews.text: Donnie spent 3 days on my house with several issues involved : fixing main sewer line, digging 25 feet, sinks, and toilets. He is proficient, knowledgeble, patient, fair, kind, and professional.  He explained everything thoroughly and double-checked every imaginable problem and solution to fix my issues. I also want to thank his right hand man Alex who without complaint worked non stop and even scrubbed and cleaned my sink when he was done! I am truly grateful and blessed that there are still honest and hard working, decent people in this world who do not mind getting dirty and helping others so graciously. GOD BLESS YOU...thank you!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: Mike and Matt are amazing! We were having issues with water backing up into our home. This has been an ongoing issue for years.  Previous plumbers have not been able to figure out why this has been happening. Matt came out first and performed a camera inspection. Upon further investigation, Mike was able to locate a possible issue with our septic field. Our septic tank has required draining every 1.5 to 2 years, and issue could be contributing to it. Mike and Matt were easy to get a hold of and provided excellent service when we needed it most. I highly recommend and will be referring Suburban Plumbing Experts whenever I can.

reviews.author: Selwyn P
reviews.text: After severe rainfall it was noted that there was something kind of sewer line repair that was needed in the Chicagoland area. It was noted that this had caused us to have problems in our basement leading to flooding. We were able to get that all cleaned up and they were very respectful and took care as handling items in the basement. They were able to check the sump pump and make sure everything was flowing properly. They were able to fix any issues and clean out the sump pump and check the backup battery as well. I was really happy with the staff and it was all done in a reasonable price and manner.

Mike/Teddy cleaned out the house sewer lines today!

In less than 2 hours, taking out big tree roots on the inside. they also vacuumed the grease basin taking out years of buildup that made the back of the house stink! completely and professionally. good quality work at reasonable cost. not the cheapest, but definitely not the most expensive.

what i appreciated most was they had a friendly conversational personality. they took the time to explain things when I had questions and walked me through their process. that's what separates good service from Great Service.

reviews.author: Kelvin Blanks
reviews.text: I found Suburban Plumbing to be of great value. The plumbers did a great job. They know their craft and are very thorough. So much so, that I have used them twice. The first was for a bathroom leak detection and then plumbing repair at my 88 year old mom's house. And then for a toilet repair at my own home. Each time, Suburban Plumbing did an excellent job. They were professional, courteous, knowledgeable, efficient, and were willing to answer any questions I may have had. I will use this company again for any plumbing issues that I may have!

reviews.author: Doshaun E.

She claimed that plumbers were just too expensive and they rarely fix the problem. I asked if she would let me try to find someone and she agreed. Not only did the Chicago Plumbing  Experts work with my grandmothers financial situations, but they also updated her plumbing system to avoid further leaks. We are eternally grateful for using the Chicago Plumbing  Experts!

One 1-star review documents a significant accountability failure on a large job: cut electrical line not called in via JULIE, debris blocking outdoor drain causing basement flooding, and poor concrete restoration left after excavation, all at customer expense

synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews confirm rapid deployment including a same-day water heater replacement within hours of a Thursday call and an evening dispatch after the team was already fully booked, suggesting genuine emergency availability beyond business hours.
