reviews.author: Jeniza Ketay
reviews.text: Matt was great! Rolled two toilets, provided very in-depth details on how to care for it as well as tested our water pressure and recommended options for future projects we have on our list. We will definitely call up Matt when we start out next plumbing project.

reviews.author: Leela Uppuluri
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Plumbing Outfitters! Scott Miller came out and did an excellent job — he flushed out my water heater tank, fixed my kitchen sink faucet, and took the time to inspect all the pipelines in every bathroom during his visit. He was thorough, professional, and genuinely courteous throughout the entire appointment. It's clear he takes pride in his work. I felt confident that everything was in good hands. Highly recommend Scott and the Plumbing Outfitters team!

reviews.author: Capen Apple
reviews.text: Had an emergency leak causing water to come out of our floorboards.  Plumbing Outfitters was quick to respond. When Melvin arrived, he was quickly identified the issue after a few tests and even made a few very minor repairs to prevent further issues.  They gave us estimates for a few levels of service at a fair price.  We were able to schedule quickly for repairs and the work he did was top quality.  Never felt any pressure to upsell us or to force us to do anything that was immediate.  Will def be calling again if other plumbing issues arise.

reviews.author: Cody J.
reviews.text:
Highly unsatisfactory. Their technician quickly deemed a sink replacement "too difficult," quoted a high price, and left within 20 minutes. I hired another company that completed the job the same day for significantly less.
When I was contacted about the quote I told Plumbing Outfitters my concerns and they insisted on sending a supervisor out. That person  was less than professional and unnecessarily demeaning about the other company's work. More frustratingly, they've repeatedly called me since the initial visit, despite my clear requests to be removed from their list, they've insisted I discuss the issues with management. I received another call today trying to generate a lead. It's exhausting.

reviews.author: Elliott F.
reviews.text:
Methodical, Dedicated, and Stayed Past 5 PM on a Friday -- What More Can You Ask For?
Last Saturday I noticed water pooling near my foundation by the back of my house. No idea what was causing it and no idea how serious it was. I called Plumbing Outfitters and I am so glad I did.
They sent Seth and Micha out on a Friday. These two ran diagnostics and tests for three solid hours, and they kept going past 5 PM without complaint, without rushing, without making me feel like I was keeping them from their weekend. That kind of dedication tells you everything you need to know about a company's culture. They confirmed there was a leak but the source was elusive enough that they called in reinforcements.
That's when Melvin came out, their leak specialist, and he brought Micha and Tyler with him. This crew was methodical. They found and fixed a leak at the front of the house from the inflow pipe but also recommened testing all the drain lines to be safe. They went line by line, systematically testing every drain line in the house until they isolated the problem. Watching them work was genuinely impressive. No guessing, no shortcuts, just professionals doing exactly what professionals are supposed to do.
We now know what we're dealing with and we are on the road to getting it fixed. That peace of mind is invaluable when you're staring down a potential foundation issue. Highly recommend Plumbing Outfitters.

reviews.author: Teresa Burke
reviews.text:
Updated as of 28 Jan 26.
Called Plumbing Outfitters first thing to solve my leaking pipe issue and the men,Tom and Zach worked as a team to triage the problem, came up with the most efficient solution, and explain in detail the procedure. These gentlemen resolve this in a slab foundation in less than 2 hours with professionalism and courteous manners. I'm always impressed with their knowledge and can do spirit. As my previous review, Plumbing Outfitters will be my go to plumbing needs for my piece of mind and pocket. Definitely recommend this business!

My go to for plumbing issues will be with Plumbing Outfitters. They came out the same day and provided me with detailed options to resolve my plumbing problem.  After deciding the best course of action, they retrieved the equipment and professionally solve my clog.  Melvin showed his expertise and knowledge providing easy language to understand the process. I felt very valued as he extended his professionalism to my mother as she was my emissary.
Totally recommend Plumbing Outfitters for your plumbing needs. Dated 2024.

reviews.author: Manuel C
reviews.text:
Had the pleasure of meeting Tom today, was blown away. From the courtesy call when he was 20 minutes out over the shoe covers down to the way he cleaned up behind himself, absolutely courteous and professional.

He took time to explain recommended services, helped me understand the science behind his recommendation - and was not pushy or sales-y at all.

We also asked him for some minor installation work (honestly, it was way below his pay grade), and he tackled it with absolute focus and professionalism. As we were walking around, he spotted another flaw, immediately tried to fix it - he is the embodiment of relationship building.

He knows what he's doing, is courteous, collaborative and extremely detail oriented. I have asked that he please be our permanent POC for all future maintenance, repairs, upgrades. Tom is a true professional, he takes pride in his work - and it shows.

While I haven't met anyone else from Plumbing Outfitters (except for Warren, who is also awesome!), I can't recommend and praise Tom highly enough.

reviews.author: Bill P.
reviews.text:
We had our Master Bath drain backing up and called out one company which sent an inexperienced plumber who spent 2 hours accomplishing nothing. We then called Cold is on the Right who came out the following day. They diagnosed that there were rocks in our drain which meant the drain had collapsed and would require tunneling under our house to repair. A bid of $27,000 resulted in our getting a 3rd opinion. 
Plumbing Outfitters came out, diagnosed that there was a plastic grid blocking the drain and stated that they would try to break it up and wash out with a hydro jetter. This bid was for $1800.00. If not successful tunneling would be required at approximately $12,000. 
Matt and Zack came out, cleared the drain, hydro jetted to clean out additional debris in the drain and finished up their work after about 4 hours. 
My advice is if you need major or minor plumbing repairs, call Plumbing Outfitters and have Matt and Zack take care of you.
If you want a misdiagnosis along with an astronomical price, call Cold is on the Right.

reviews.author: Albert Jin
reviews.text:
I just moved into a new house and the faucet for the fridge wasn't working. I had home warranty from the seller, so I thought it was a quick fix. The guy came and quickly dismissed as calcified pipes and left, saying the warranty company doesn't cover it.

So instead of following up, I decided to take the recommendation of the previous home owner and called Plumbing Outfitters. Tom was dispatched to my place the following day from when I called, and he was thorough in diagnosing the issue, which turned out to be a twisted pipe that pinched the water flow. He was transparent the whole time and even showed me things to watch for and suggestions for how to keep the plumbing of the home in a good shape.

He came back and did a great job cutting the twisted pipe, and installing the faucet properly. I would strongly recommend Plumbing Outfitters for any plumbing needs, and will be calling them whenever there's a plumbing issue that I need a profession to work on

reviews.author: Dayna Bolger
reviews.text: Plumbing Outfitters is our go to plumbers. They are exceptional at providing exceptional customer service and expertise! They are diligent and professional. I would not recommend any other plumbing company over Plumbing Outfitters. Our latest service provided by Kyle Leeper was nothing short of outstanding. He arrived on time and performed the work quickly! I highly recommend Plumbing Outfitters! Every technician is knowledgeable and trustworthy worthy. Our latest plumbing need was handled timely and professionally. Our technician Matthew Ford displayed such integrity and professionalism. Plumbing Outfitters will always be our go to they the very best! We had our yearly inspection for 2026 and Tom Greer provided exceptional customer service. He was very detailed as he completed every part of the inspection. There is not another plumbing company I would recommend. The experience training and education of their technicians is like no other!

reviews.author: Jonathan Lehmann
reviews.text:
Melvin is the real MVP!!! Recently, Melvin with Plumbing Outfitters came to our home to address an issue we were experiencing with the drain in our master shower. A different plumber had come out previously but was unable to solve the problem. With Melvin’s experience and expertise, he was able to identify the source of the problem and come up with a solution.

I can’t say enough good things about Melvin. He arrived on time, was courteous, respectful and professional from start to finish. He was patient, identified the issue the previous plumber overlooked and even stayed late to ensure the job was done right the first time. He went above and beyond and far exceeded our expectations.

I want to sincerely thank Melvin and the entire team at Plumbing Outfitters. They provide excellent customer service along with honest and fair pricing. I highly recommend them for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Michelle J.
reviews.text:
During the February ice storm, I experienced a leak in my kitchen while I was stranded in Arkansas and unable to get home. Jess Shaw with Plumbing Outfitters was absolutely incredible throughout the entire situation. He spoke with me directly and walked me through everything he was doing step by step, as if I were there with him.

Jess took exceptional care of my home and belongings and was incredibly professional, kind, and reassuring during a very stressful time. He called when he was on the way, let me know when he arrived, and later explained in detail what caused the leak, the next steps, and made sure I felt confident that everything was taken care of.

Jess is a true asset to Plumbing Outfitters, and they are very lucky to have such a responsible and dependable employee. I highly recommend him for any plumbing work you may need.

reviews.author: Tammie Breedlove
reviews.text:
Excellent! Excellent! Excellent! I can’t say enough wonderful things about this company. They (the actual owner) arrived within an hour and had my problem ( broken sewer line ) repaired swiftly and professionally. I was impressed by the company truck, equipment and his patience with me. I asked multiple annoying questions and he walked me through everything he was doing and why. I will never hesitate to use this company again and highly recommend you call them for all your plumbing needs.

Used this wonderful company again and couldn’t be more pleased. Immediate response time. Melvin was super patient and explained everything he was doing. I referred my neighbors to this company and they are equally pleased. I truly believe they are the best plumbing company in central Texas. Probably the best in Texas and beyond.

reviews.author: Rachael Westerman
reviews.text:
Plumbing Outfitters was great.
Not only did they respond quickly to my voicemail and scheduled me same day….which was important as all plumbing calls are some level of an emergency….but my favorite part was the text I got when the technician was on his way.  It was more than a notification, but an introduction about the gentleman! Name, a little bit about him…he is local, with a family, his hobbies and a photo.
It’s a little things that make the big difference. I am not a single woman/mom, but it made me feel better and would have brought a high level of comfort had I been a single woman/mom.
Further, Kyle was just as kind and genuine as one could hope, in helping my husband and I navigate our financial decisions (repair or replace) regarding our water heater.

reviews.author: Rachel Malgieri
reviews.text: Super positive experience from start to finish. The dispatcher was so sweet, helpful and able to get us on the schedule for the same day. Received a text verifying the appointment as well as who my technician was, a picture and little information about the technician. Jess the technician was not only on time, very sweet, provided superb customer service thoroughly explaining everything to me, process and all and sent receipt and notes directly to my email. But then their company relations representative Lauren called and followed up. This company was so easy to work with, provided excellent customer service every step Of the way. Loved the little extra details like the text message info about the technician, etc. Highly recommend using this company.

synthesis.summary: They show up fast even on holidays, accurately diagnose what others miss, and their techs actually explain costs before touching anything — this is who you call at 2am.
strengths: Emergency and same-day response is a consistent pattern — reviewers cite arrival within one hour on Christmas Day, day-after-Christmas, and for a broken gas line, with one reviewer noting response within two hours generally
Diagnostics stand out: Matt and Zach identified a $25 plastic grid blocking a drain that two other companies missed, saving one homeowner over $10,000 compared to competitor bids

Pre-work transparency is nearly universal — multiple named techs (Noah, Melvin, Matt A, Paul Smith) are specifically praised for explaining scope and cost before starting, with no sticker shock reported
weaknesses: One review noted a delay in the scheduled arrival time, though the reviewer credited good communication for resetting expectations — no pattern of no-shows, but punctuality is not perfect 100% of the time
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: documented same-day response for a broken gas line, sub-one-hour arrival on Christmas Day and day-after-Christmas, and same-day dispatch for an active water leak coming through floorboards — this team demonstrably operates outside normal business hours.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google's 4.9 across 1,444 reviews is highly credible; Yelp's 4.5 is based on only 6 reviews and is directionally consistent, making the 0.4-star gap statistically insignificant rather than a meaningful discrepancy.

reviews.author: Anne Andrews
reviews.text: We had Roto-Rooter out to clear out an exterior drain line from the sump pump. Jaime and Yousef were terrific. They explained the process and were quick and efficient. They very kindly tolerated my questions about what they cleared out of the line and how to prevent this in the future. This was a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Val V
reviews.text:
Jamie Moreno with Roto-Rooter did a phenomenal job! He was extremely professional and took the time to clearly explain where the problem was, why the leak occurred in the first place, and what needed to be done to fix it. He completed all the repairs quickly and efficiently.

I especially appreciated that he took and shared pictures before and after the work, walking me through everything so I fully understood the situation. At no point did I feel pressured into unnecessary repairs — his honesty and transparency were truly reassuring.

In addition to fixing the issue, Jamie offered helpful recommendations on what to watch for in the future, which we greatly appreciated. We are very pleased with the work he did — 5 stars all around!

While we hope we won’t need plumbing services again anytime soon, if we do, I sincerely hope Jamie is the one who comes out to help us.

Attaching before and after pictures for reference.

reviews.author: Diane Greenberg
reviews.text: The gentleman that came today, Jamie Marino did an outstanding job. He was professional. He left everything clean after the repair was done. I would definitely recommend him again and your services. You all did an outstanding job of fixing the toilet the sink and now we have working items and running water. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Jeff S.
reviews.text: My kitchen sink was stopped up. I called Roto-Rooter. What a mistake. They quoted me $689. Most people charge $125-$200. It was the day before Thanksgiving so I was desperate. I bargained down $575. No bargain.

reviews.author: Mike T.
reviews.text:
Watch out!  RR is the Silver Spring area employs a nasty pricing ethic.  We had a clogged drain and it happened at 9PM.  Called Rooter Rooter believing they had the staff to come in an emergency.

They would not quote a price for a drain clean over the phone.  Siad the plumber would assess and talk when they came out.  Seemed reasonable.  

After 3 minutes of assessment, he quoted $1,450.  As it was an emergency situation and we had 2 small children we agreed.   Sort of "gun to the head" situation.  We could not use sinks, showers, etc...  They justifed the cost by adding on a mandatory camera inspection after it was cleared.  In other words, the $1,450 was for both servoces whereas we only wanted the clearing only.  They would not clear the drain if we refused the camera inspection.

After 30 minutes, the drain was cleared, they were paid and we felt robbed.  I will repeat, at 9PM, we felt we had no choice.  

Just BEWARE!  Call someone else.

reviews.author: Eric Weiss
reviews.text:
As bad as it was to have to call in Roto Rooter for our waste line blockage, the conduct of all the personnel involved has been very good, starting with the initial visit to clear the line, the diagnosis by camera probe showing the crack in the waste pipe just outside our foundation with intrusion of roots that blocked half the diameter of the pipe, and the crew that performed the work: 3 on the excavation crew plus a second plumber brought in for the final water supply connection, a “jetter” that blew out the waste line with his own water in tow after that line was connected (before our water supply was reconnected.)

Now, in the aftermath, follow up with the excavation manager is a continuing process into next week to make sure all will be satisfactory.

The crew arrived as scheduled to excavate the area in front of the foundation and replace the waste line and clean out standpipe. Unfortunately, the water supply line was broken during excavation (honestly, the utility company did not mark the pipe’s diagonal path line from the main at the curb to the house, and from what I understand it is not uncommon to destroy a water supply line in this kind of job).

The crew worked in horrible conditions for both weather, mud, and environmentally. There were several unforeseen situations that caused delays but they got the job done.

If it wasn’t for the excellent communications and empathetic way of conduct on the part of the crew foreman we would have had a terrible time.

We understood what the issues were at each step of the way and that went a long way to lessening the stress.

The plumber in the crew also went out of his way to advise us on what he was doing and answered every “plumbing” inquiry I had about the house in general (we’ve only moved in 6 months ago and have had more problems in this time than we had in the entire period of 26 years of ownership with our old home in northern NJ).

No comment on the cost…. But the service was prompt and I have to wonder if I would have been able to get comparable service and equipment in the time Roto Rooter had that got the job done. I’m thinking that this is one of the times that “big plumbing” is worthwhile!

reviews.author: Heather H.
reviews.text:
I just wanted to start by saying this is probably the most high quality company. 
I have six children so drain getting clogged and getting stuck in drains that shouldn't be. There is a continuous issue. I received some services in December and I was ecstatic because the knowledge & professionalism the care to detail the safety. I felt of the employees while they were in my home with my children was unmatched I was extremely comfortable. They were so informative and so helpful. I highly recommend This roto rooters.
unfortunately This evening I noticed there was a clog very disgusting and I could not get the toilet to flush properly. I had to manually empty it. I believe my four year old may have tried to flush something that doesn't belong in the toilet. I called Roto-Rooter because of the perfect services I had received from them before and I was so disrespectful and emotionally immature and just trauma dumping and high stressed. roto rooter's beautiful employee,  Lanika calmed me down, she was  listening to me, she was so patient with me, she was knowledgabLe and informative .    She was informing me on all the details on  how to prevent further damages and she was just so understanding and compassionate that it literally made me feel better about my horrible situation. I know this is a great company I'm so greatful Lanika expedited my appointment . And I also spoke to the manager Dwayne, who was also very comforting, informative his and Lanika's problem solving advice & great customer service really is a game changer in aiding to the prevention of me freaking out about the situation. - Thank you

reviews.author: Laura Scott
reviews.text: Jaime Moreno did an excellent job repairing our toilet. One of the exterior pipes to the toilet had a leak, which was causing water to seep through the ceiling onto the first floor below. He was able to replace the pipe very quickly with parts he had in his truck. While he was here he discovered another issue with a part inside the toilet tank. The toilet was filling up very slowly. He had a replacement part for that in his truck too so he replaced it right away. Jaime was very polite, patient, pleasant to work with, professional, and he explained everything thoroughly so we understood what the plumbing issues were. He guaranteed the work for 1 year, which is also great. The toilet leak we had was discovered unexpectedly and he came out the same day to fix it for us, which was exceptional!

reviews.author: Susan B.
reviews.text:
If I could give zero stars, I would. Avoid this company and any franchises unless you are desperate for an emergency plumber. Roto Rooter charges a FLAT FEE of $729.00 to snake an exterior drain. The work could take 10 minutes or 2 hours, but this is the fee.

The problem is that Roto Rooter does not tell you there is a flat fee up front, and when I inquired twice about the fee when booking the appointment, I was told the technician would give me the price on the job. I realize it was my mistake for trusting that the fee would be within the typical realm of other plumbing fees, BUT IF ROTO ROOTER  CHARGES A FLAT FEE FOR SERVICES, THEN WHY NOT TELL THE CUSTOMER THIS? This is a dishonest practice for a substandard plumbing franchise.

reviews.author: Arup Goswami
reviews.text: I scheduled a home visit for diagnosis and if necessary replacement of my Pressure Reducing Valve (PRV) for my Main Water at my home. Jamie Moreno was the Technician from Roto Rooter and he diagnosed my PRV and did some small adjustments to set it right. Immediate replacement was not necessary. And my cost was zero. I must confess that in today’s world, such honesty is seldom seen and I sincerely appreciate Jamie Moreno moral and professional practice. I highly-highly recommend Jamie and Roto Rooter for all your Water and plumbing related issues. Once again - Thank you Jamie and I wish you well. All the best!

reviews.author: Bill J.
reviews.text: STAY AWAY from this company. My elderly mother called Roto-Rooter for a clogged kitchen sink. When she  asked for a rough estimate, they told her they couldn't provide her one. They came out and unclogged the sink within an hour and charged her $900!! That was also supposed to include an elderly discount. It is completely unethical how they take advantage of people. My mother called to complain but the lady on the phone was extremely rude to my mother. The lady said she would reach out to the manger who never called her back. I plan to report this company as well.

reviews.author: Madina Wazir
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Roto-Rooter. Shams, the technician, arrived on time, was very professional, and took the time to clearly explain the issue and the work that needed to be done. The job was completed efficiently and thoroughly, and everything is working perfectly now. While the service was not cheap, the price was reasonable for the quality, expertise, and peace of mind provided. I really appreciated Shams’ honesty and professionalism and would definitely recommend Roto-Rooter to anyone needing reliable plumbing service.

reviews.author: J F
reviews.text: We had Jaime moreno and his apprentice from the Roto Rooter team did a great job with our repair. Our issue was the we had a high water usage detected by the local water company. Jaime and his apprentice diagnosed that the main water shut off valve and pressure regulator valve needed to be replaced. It didn’t solve the main issue of why our main water line was still running, but the workmanship excellent. We also had our water heater flushed and it needed it as Jaime noted by the sediment build up. Thanks for the great work guys!!

reviews.author: Michelle Soto
reviews.text: Jaime Moreno was wonderful. He showed up promptly on top and explained the issue of why my sump battery alarm was going off and even tested both outlets it’s was plugged into to make sure the electrical was all working. Showed me the age of sump pump to explain that the acid leaking from my battery was likely the cause and we needed to replace it. He was super friendly got fixed the issue quickly. Highly recommend him and Roto-Rooter as they have always worked with me in the past and kept things honest.

reviews.author: JoEllen Kentner
reviews.text: We had a stubborn floor drain in our appliance room that was semi clogged which wanted to flood every time we did a load of laundry. RR came same day and right at the start time of the two hour window the gave me (since when does that happen??) Jaime Moreno was efficient and helpful in the hour he was here working in it. Glad to have my washing machine back in full working order, thanks to RR! It was pricey but we had gotten a similar quote from another vendor, so we went with RR for the free warranty.

synthesis.summary: Technicians — especially Jaime Moreno — show up fast for emergencies and do clean, well-explained work, but multiple customers report being hit with $700–$1,450 bills only after the plumber arrives, with no upfront pricing and high-pressure upselling tactics.
strengths: Emergency and after-hours response is strong: reviews mention midnight arrivals, Saturday night service, Easter eve calls, and a panicked 10:30pm phone answered by a live person

Jaime Moreno alone accounts for 20+ five-star reviews praising on-time arrival, clear explanation of issues, before/after photos, and thorough cleanup — unusually consistent technician-level excellence
Multiple reviewers cite transparency and zero pressure toward unnecessary repairs, with technicians walking customers through diagnostics step by step
weaknesses: At least 4 reviews independently report pricing of $575–$1,450 for drain cleaning — 3x to 10x the typical $125–$200 market rate — with quotes withheld until the technician is already on-site

One reviewer suspects they were charged for a part that was visibly not installed, and a separate reviewer flagged being forced to accept a bundled camera inspection at $1,450 or get no service at all
redFlags: Systematic no-upfront-pricing policy: at least 3 reviewers independently report being told 'the technician will quote on-site' then facing extreme prices in emergency conditions with no real ability to refuse

791 BBB complaints in 3 years is a significant volume for a single location — that averages roughly 5 complaints per week, suggesting the pricing and billing issues in reviews are not isolated incidents

Large platform rating gap (Google 5.0 vs Yelp 2.6) combined with 791 BBB complaints suggests highly motivated satisfied customers review on Google while dissatisfied customers skew toward Yelp and BBB
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Genuine 24/7 emergency capability confirmed: reviewers document midnight dispatch, Saturday night response, holiday availability, and a live phone operator answering at 10:30pm — response time from call to arrival appears consistently fast.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows a near-perfect 5.0 across 239 reviews while Yelp sits at 2.6 across 14 reviews with multiple billing complaints, and BBB logs 791 complaints over 3 years despite an A+ rating — the Google score likely reflects happy customers incentivized to review, while Yelp and BBB capture the billing-dispute segment.

reviews.author: Sandy Norris
reviews.text: Josh is very detailed and professional.  He provides prompt service and warranties his work for a year. Highly recommend this vendor!

reviews.author: Adam Hall
reviews.text: Josh did a great job with our water heater! He gave us a fair price and the product was excellent. More importantly, when there was a small issue nine months later and we reached out to him, he got back with us that night and was at our house early the next morning where he promptly fixed the problem. We highly recommend Josh to anyone looking for a plumber!

reviews.author: Omar
reviews.text: I got a quick response from Josh after my initial outreach. He came in the next day and saw a major issue with a badly leaking pipe that he able to fix within a few hours. He explained everything that was going on, kept me informed of how my system was set up, and set up a better system for our home.

reviews.author: Ging Del
reviews.text:
Josh came out and said that he didn't know what the problem was but would charge me $975 for the first 2.5 hours and then $300/hour after. He saw someone in a desperate situation and tried to take advantage. 2 stars for showing up when he said that he would.

Edited to add:
After writing this review, this guy wrote a bad review on my business page about my plumbing problem and my office smelling like sewage. Michael and Sons is currently in the building taking care of it. He also remarked about us not having a licensed physician which we do. I feel unsafe with this unhinged guy. I would stay far away. You do not want this guy in your house or around your family.

reviews.author: C. Roemer
reviews.text:
First, I never want to contract or hire any other plumber to do work on my home other than Josh of Mint Plumbing, LLC from here on out. He is the hands-down best plumber my family has ever experienced. Second, I have never been happier to leave a review for a business because it has taken me years to finally find a trustworthy licensed, insured and bonded plumber whose work is not only excellent but above and beyond the absolute best. Prior to hiring Josh, I have hired technicians from big businesses who charge a hefty premium for supposed premium quality work except that in actuality the work was inconsistent and at times subpar. I took a chance in contacting Josh based on his reviews that were detailed and helpful and it was one of the best decisions I’ve made.

I initially contacted Josh because I wanted a second opinion on a repair entailing a damaged sewer pipe that caused a backup and flood into my basement. I felt uneasy with the first diagnosis of another company and when I left a voicemail for Josh to see if he was willing to take a look at it, he responded back to me very promptly and was able to come over to inspect the issue shortly after the call. His assessment was far more thorough and detailed and his estimate for the repair and labor was extremely fair. I already felt much more confident after talking with and meeting him for the inspection and contracted him on the spot. The labor entailed having to dig at least 6-8 feet underground to access the problem with the sewer pipe and he documented every part of the process and explained each step with meticulous detail.

His communication throughout the entire situation was consistent, professional, thorough and extremely informative. He provided a wealth of information that no other plumber or repair technician has ever been willing to detail and share. I cannot emphasize how much valuable information and lessons were learned from his knowledge. His work on the repair itself and every little detail involved even including the clean up was above and beyond excellent, meticulous, efficient and thorough. Like I previously mentioned, there is no other plumber I would ever want to contract other than Josh. If you have been like me and seem to go through various companies to no avail to find that one plumber who will do honest and excellent work that you can feel safe, secure and confident with, look no further. I cannot express how huge it is to finally have found that rarity of a trustworthy plumber who is the best. What a tremendous relief.

reviews.author: ThanhVu Nguyen
reviews.text:
This review may be a bit lengthy, but the key takeaway is that Josh is an exceptional professional who managed to resolve issues that had stumped several (5) other plumbers.

When my Navien boiler heater combi started acting up and displaying an error code two weeks ago, I had five plumbers from both large and small companies come out over the course of ten days. Unfortunately, they either gave up or provided incorrect diagnoses. This left my family without hot water and heat for an extended period, and I was on the verge of considering a complete replacement of the Navien system.

However, my frustration turned to hope when I came across Mint Plumbing and reached out to Josh. Despite initial reservations due to his limited online presence, with just 21 reviews on Google and a limited website, Josh was the “right” guy for the job. He arrived promptly on Friday morning and conducted a thorough troubleshooting session, accurately pinpointing the problem. It took him the entire day to replace a pipe and drain the system, but by the end of the day, the Navien system was up and running again.

Though the system encountered a different error code after a while, Josh didn't leave me hanging. He returned the following day, Saturday at 9:30 AM, and efficiently resolved the new issue. To ensure the system's reliability under high demand, he also performed a stress test for a couple of hours. So far, everything seems to be working well, and I have the confidence that if any issues arise in the future, Josh will be able to promptly address them.

reviews.author: Michel Heflin
reviews.text: As a property manager, it is hard to find good subcontractors and I need to say I have found one of the best plumbers out there that I have worked with in my field of over 35 years. I have had several emergency calls and surgical centers that need to be absolutely sterilized. He has come in and done work. You could never tell that he was there, and it was always cleaner when he left from his arrival. He has helped me do everything from installing new fixtures, plumbing and even a major leak on a 2 inch main hotline for an entire building, he had it so much patched to help slow the water leak down until we could shut the building totally down and drain it. He was absolutely fantastic and doing this. His prices are always extremely reasonable and sometimes I scratch my head on the price on a couple of occasions , I thought the price was way too low from my past experience dealing with other contractors. He’s extremely honest and will explain things to you. You cannot find a better man than him. I trust him and don’t need to stand over him while he’s doing his job because I know it’ll be right when he is done  with no cut corners which is strange and today’s time. I hope this help people realize on when you find somebody good you hold onto them so I definitely recommending him for anybody that needs plumbing work larger small and I would like to thank him personally for all of his hard work , and responding quickly to all emergency calls that I’ve had to place with him and his timing.

reviews.author: Carl Hutzler
reviews.text:
You can’t go wrong with Josh and Mint Plumbing. Extremely detail oriented. Extremely professional. He solves plumbing problems the first time! Just call him and get on the schedule.

Josh fixed a crappy plumbing job that my original installer did and added a couple of vibration damping/anti hammer attractors. And my problem is solved!

I think it’s beautiful too!?

___________

I had Josh come out a second time to look at a new vibration issue and it turns out the water pressure adjustment valve was the culprit. It provided 65lbs/in2 and was not adjustable. My shower DTV control has a rating of 45lb/in2 MAX and the higher pressure was the cause of the knocking. Josh arrived and had a sense that this may be the issue and even brought a new pressure adjustment valve. We tested everything first and then replaced the adjustment valve. Everything is working once again! So nice to have someone with as much experience as Josh to know ahead of time what the issue might be. You don't find people like this everywhere!

reviews.author: Liz Budnick
reviews.text: We used Josh for two services: 1. a gas leak behind our gas dryer, and 2. a sewer pipe repair. On both occasions, which were emergency issues due to actively leaking gas and leaking sewer water, Josh showed up immediately to help diagnose the issues and quickly outline a plan to repair them. For the gas leak, he explained exactly what the issue was, showed us the problems, repaired it, and gave us a ton of advice for how to identify future gas leaks. For the sewer pipe repair, a piece of the sewer pipe that runs inside of our house was cracked and actively leaking. He identified the issue right away, removed about 7 feet of a cracked sewer pipe, and installed a new sewer pipe in the area. He even gave us advice for fixing the drywall that had to be removed to get to the pipe. Overall, he provided a wealth of information to us that I don't think we would have gotten from any other plumber. Highly recommend Josh for any plumbing or gas fitting issues you may have.

reviews.author: Robert E.
reviews.text:
I have used Mint Plumbing on several repairs and I am glad that I did. Not only did Josh arrive on time but he did a great job. He replaced multiple sink faucets without any issues. He installed multiple new shut off values and main shut off levers under my kitchen sink. He extended the pipes so I can reach them. I trust Josh. He is an honest, hardworking, reliable and dedicated professional. Trust me you will be happy you called him.

I just hired Josh again: had Josh come over for what I thought was a 1day job. It turned out to take 4 days. I live in a Condo and had no water in my bathroom and I have only one bathroom. Josh cancelled other jobs and fit me into his tight schedule. By Thursday evening I had my bathroom back and it was great. I trust Josh and so should you. He is a hardworking, dedicated, and honest professional. Give him a call and you will be happy.

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.text:
Josh is meticulous and takes pride in his work. His plumbing skills are apparent based on the quality valve, pipe and project consultation when it comes to remodeling bathrooms and adding safety to our heating system. Moreover, Josh is knowledgeable about hydronic/water heating systems and the different work associated with new builds.

Josh will give you the best advice, outcomes and work that you can admire. Based on how long he has been in the business, he has knowledge and practical use of all the right tools to take care of new & old installations. Thanks for helping update my plumbing and save us from leaks. Highly recommend; you will get follow-through, an honest job completed and someone who keeps his/your workspace clean!

reviews.author: Mahmoud Mohammed
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of using Mint Plumbing Service for the second time and I must say, their consistency in delivering exceptional service is truly commendable. Josh, in particular, deserves a shoutout for his outstanding customer service. Not only is he highly knowledgeable, but he also takes the time to thoroughly explain the process and set clear expectations. My installation experience was seamless from start to finish, with no hidden costs or unwelcome surprises. It's rare to find such transparency and dedication in service these days. I would not hesitate to use Mint Plumbing Service again and I highly recommend them to anyone in need of reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Richard Rosenthal
reviews.text: Based on WSSC's inspection we required replacement of all valves, including pressure valve, and water pipe starting at main shutoff valve. Josh did a complete on site assessment prior to providing a fair and reasonable estimate. On the date of the work he kept us informed of his specific arrival time and completed the job expertly and professionally, while taking the time to test and QC all faucets and walk us through exactly what he'd done and how to observe and address any unforeseen issues. The work area was completely cleaned up. We highly recommend Mint Plumbing for any and all plumbing needs,

reviews.author: Kristen Dougherty
reviews.text: We used Josh for installation of our hot water heater and I have to say he did a great job.  Very meticulous and very concerned about the details in his work.  He came out on a Sunday and worked all day because we had gotten home from vacation to a wet basement. There was a defective pilot after he installed the 325 lb water heater.  He started the claim with the company and the part was at my house 2 days later and he came out and installed it as soon as it got here.  He is a top notch, professional plumber who went above and beyond!  I would highly recommend Josh and will use him in the future!!!

reviews.author: J T
reviews.text: I'm fairly handy, I've replaced sinks, toilets, shower heads, and drains, unglogged drains, re-pipped PVC, etc....   However, having said that sometimes I don't have the right tools or the learning curve is too steep for the time I have so I'll go to a professional.  I've used Mint twice, for the install of a new reverse osmosis filtering system and for a new kitchen faucet install to solve some corrosion problems on the existing plumbing.  Tech arrived ahead of time in both instances and completed job way faster than I could have at competitive rates.  Would highly recommend and will use again.

synthesis.summary: Josh solves problems in one visit that stumped five other plumbers, shows up within the hour for emergencies including holidays, and backs his work with a one-year warranty.
strengths: Exceptional emergency responsiveness: at least 6 reviews describe arrival within an hour or same day, including a holiday visit within 30 minutes while closed
Diagnostic depth that competitors lack: one detailed review documents Josh resolving a Navien boiler failure that 5 other plumbers gave up on over 10 days
Thorough communication and cleanup: multiple reviewers independently note he explains every step, walks through system setup, and leaves the work area cleaner than he found it
weaknesses: One reviewer reported a quoted rate of $975 for the first 2.5 hours plus $300/hour after, which they felt was exploitative given their urgent situation — no other reviews mention hourly rates, so pricing transparency may vary by job type
redFlags: The single 1-star review alleges Josh retaliated by leaving a negative review on the customer's business page after they posted criticism — if accurate, this is a concerning professional boundary issue worth noting when inviting a stranger into your home
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals across the review set: Josh responded on a closed holiday within 30 minutes, arrived within an hour for an active leak at a commercial property, and has handled gas leaks, burst sewer pipes, and building-wide hot water failures with same-day or next-morning resolution.

plumbers.address: 2740 Chain Bridge Rd #104, Vienna, VA 22181, USA

reviews.author: Trent Gilmore
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Hicks Plumbing the past couple times we've needed there service. Specifically, Domingo who did really great work.

reviews.author: Scott G
reviews.text: My regular plumber was out of town and he referred me to Hicks Plumbing Services due to a leak that needed to be pinpointed in my home ASAP, as my Leak Detection System had been activated and water for the house shut off. The crew showed up same day and quickly diagnosed the issue with a toilet seal. The guys listened, were friendly, helpful, professional and efficient. I would definitely recommend Hicks to others and would use them again in the event my regular plumber is not available.

reviews.author: Starr Arnett
reviews.text: We’re thrilled with Hicks plumbing services, reliable and efficient every time. They are always up to the task, large or small, and ensure the work is solid. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Donald Bostwick
reviews.text:
Gouge plumbing and sub par work
Screwed our plating in crooked which leaked and destroyed the plate and ruined our drywall….
Gouged us on pricing. for a grand we got shoddy work and about 35 minutes of their time.all while owner bragged about his riches and investments  and properties ( you get the picture) while dropping his tools on our tub and tile.then,told his partner not to answer our questions as we weren’t paying for that  particular service … we went under the crawlspace and found more subpar work too tore apart our insulation and wrap  to instal a 4 “ pressure valve and left everything open upon exit …. Run as fast as you can from this company …

reviews.author: Allison Widmann
reviews.text: I called because of a problem I thought was the disposal.  I got a text back and was never able to speak with anyone to ask my questions. Ever. Technician did not show up on time, but when he did come it was too late to do any work as I had to leave the house. The scheduler made an attempt to rectify by sending someone out on Saturday, waiving the $200 emergency fee. The technician, Tony (possibly Tony Hicks, based on reading reviews) arrived on time on Saturday but was quite rude, arguing with me that he could not quote me a price when the scheduler had already committed to a price.  I asked him to leave, which he did. Maybe they do good work when they do the work but communication is terrible and frustrating for the customer, particularly on issues of pricing. When I texted the scheduler explaining what happened and stated I would be giving a one-star review, the scheduler replied, "We didn't do any work there and you don't have a receipt. I will contact my attorney for advice if you do that."  That didn't stop me from giving my honest review of my bad experience with this company. Like others, I too, am surprised that they have so many 5-star ratings.

reviews.author: Lindsey Jo
reviews.text:
For the past four years, I have had the privilege of relying on Hicks Plumbing for all my plumbing needs, and I must say, they have consistently exceeded my expectations. From emergency calls to scheduled maintenance, Hicks Plumbing has proven time and time again that they are a cut above the rest.

My first encounter with Hicks Plumbing was during a sudden sump pump failure, which was nothing short of a disaster. In a matter of minutes after placing a frantic call, their team arrived at my doorstep. Their promptness and professionalism instantly alleviated my stress. Not only did they manage to fix the issue efficiently, but they also took the time to explain what went wrong and provided valuable advice to prevent future mishaps.

What impressed me most about Hicks Plumbing was their willingness to go the extra mile. On one unforgettable Thanksgiving Day, disaster struck yet again when my hot water heater decided to bid farewell. Just when I thought my holiday plans were ruined, Hicks Plumbing came to the rescue. Despite it being a holiday, they responded swiftly, armed with a new hot water heater ready for installation. Thanks to their dedication and expertise, my Thanksgiving dinner was saved, and I was left feeling grateful for their exceptional service.

One of the standout qualities of Hicks Plumbing is the trust they inspire. As a customer, it is truly refreshing to work with a plumber who genuinely cares about the well-being of their clients, rather than just seeing them as another opportunity for financial gain. Hicks Plumbing has always been transparent about the costs involved and provided fair, competitive pricing. They never tried to upsell unnecessary services or products, which made me feel confident that I was dealing with an honest and reliable plumbing company.

Over the years, I've come to appreciate the consistent high level of service provided by Hicks Plumbing. Their team of experts is not only knowledgeable but also courteous and respectful. They treat my home with the utmost care, always ensuring they leave it as tidy as they found it.

In conclusion, I cannot recommend Hicks Plumbing enough. Whether it's a minor issue or an emergency, they have proven time and again to be the go-to plumbing service that you can trust wholeheartedly. With their exceptional skills, reliability, and customer-focused approach, they have earned a loyal customer in me. If you're in need of a plumber, look no further than Hicks Plumbing - they are simply the best!

reviews.author: Jo Ann Thomas
reviews.text:
When my water heater went out on a Friday afternoon with guests arriving for the weekend, I discovered which plumber really was 24/7!  While several businesses listed as 24/7 answered my telephone calls to say that they could make an appointment for Monday., only Hicks Plumbing said they could send someone right away.  And they did, Tony Hicks not only came, but spend hours trying to fix the water heater. When he was unable to proceed because of needing information from the manufacture of the water heater, he explained all the possible causes and what needed to be done but said the work most likely couldn’t be completed until Monday. I accepted that he had given his best effort, and that he’d resume on Monday. However, when he got home, he continued to work on the problem (and it already was very late) and on Saturday morning, he was standing in line at the plumbing supply store. He called me to say that he had the part and asked if it would be convenient for me for him to come then and fix the water heater. And he did.
Over the years, I’ve had good service, and I’ve had some not-so-good service from repair people, but nothing like this. It turns out that Tony owns the business and has 30 years of experience, but what he did for us goes far beyond that. Not only did I get above and beyond service, but also the water heater was repaired rather than having to be replaced, thanks to Mr. Hicks’ experience and knowledge.

reviews.author: Shiraz Khan
reviews.text:
I recently moved to Vienna and upon encountering a few plumbing issues in my home, I wanted to hire a local company to come do the work.

I stumbled on Hick's Plumbing, based right here in town. From first contact, Christine made me feel like we were having a conversation among neighbors rather than a business transaction. She was patient in listening to all of my issues, and was honest with her scheduling availability. She even recommended another local company if I needed the job done immediately. Right there, I felt a degree of integrity that made me want to work with Hicks. They even offered free estimates on the work!

I had a tight work schedule and Christine was incredibly understanding and scheduled me for a timeslot. Tony showed up exactly when he said he would, and the service got even better from there.

When I explained the issues, instead of just quoting me a price and then charging me a ton, he explained that all of the issues were things I could do myself and could save a few bucks on by proceeding that way. He even showed me how to do it! This level of service and integrity is unbelievable in today's corporate approach to everything.

Hick's has earned my trust, my business and my recommendation to anyone that needs plumbing help. They are an honest, local company, and worth a call for your plumbing needs as well!

reviews.author: Daniel Yim
reviews.text:
I recently had an excellent experience with Hicks Plumbing. From my initial call to the completion of the work, their level of professionalism and efficiency was impressive.

The office staff was incredibly responsive. When I called with an urgent issue, they listened attentively, asked relevant questions, and quickly scheduled a technician. Their friendly demeanor and clear communication put me at ease during a stressful situation.
The technician arrived promptly within the given time window, which I greatly appreciated. He was well-groomed, uniformed, and arrived in a clean, well-organized company vehicle. The technician's professionalism was evident in his courteous manner and clear explanation of the problem and proposed solution.

His expertise was clear as he efficiently diagnosed and resolved the issue. Throughout the process, he kept me informed and answered all my questions patiently. The work area was left clean, and he even took the time to provide some preventive maintenance tips.

The company's commitment to customer satisfaction was evident in their follow-up call to ensure I was happy with the service.

I highly recommend Hicks Plumbing for their prompt response, professional staff, and high-quality work. They've earned my trust for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kira Brunjes
reviews.text:
I did not end up using this company's services due to an extremely high price quote. I needed a basic swap-out of a 1/3 HP garbage disposal—same exact model as the one being replaced, with no plumbing or electrical issues involved. The unit itself cost $95 on Amazon.

When I called, I was told a technician would need to visit in person to provide a quote, but there was no obligation. Once the plumber arrived, he quoted me $650. When I mentioned I had already purchased the disposal, he offered to reduce the price to $550. He estimated the job would take 30 minutes, which works out to an hourly rate of $1,100—completely unreasonable for a straightforward task. After I declined, he spoke to his manager, who agreed to lower the price to $450 if they used my unit. Still, even at $450, that’s $900/hour for a half-hour job—or $450/hour if it took a full hour.

In the end, I found a reliable company in Oakton that installed the disposal professionally for $150. I’m sharing this experience to help others be aware of potential price gouging. Do your homework and get multiple estimates.

reviews.author: Carol Dembicki
reviews.text:
An unexpected plumbing issue can send the heart rate soaring. I contacted Hick's Plumbing and spoke to Christine. She is kind, professional, and upfront. She explained the diagnostic process and the cost for that service, which was a few hundred dollars less than a competing company. Christine was able to schedule an hour window of service (not the standard four-hour block) for the following day. Tony then showed up promptly, performed the work, and finished by billing me the exact amount discussed with no haggling or upselling.

I recommend Hick's Plumbing to anyone that desires quality work and fair pricing. As Christine and Tony own the business, they work to make sure the client's issues are fixed instead of "lining their own pockets". It is refreshing to know that a trustworthy company like Hick's Plumbing operates in the Fairfax area, and I highly recommend Tony to anyone who has plumbing needs.

reviews.author: mehran sizdahkhani
reviews.text:
Hick’s Plumbing (Tony & Christina) are the absolute best and have been the ONLY under and above ground plumbing contractor that I will use for the past 10 years.
I manage Commercial Retail Real Estate (6 properties w/ 22 Retail Tenants) that includes Restaurants, Grocery & Convenient Stores, Dry Cleaners, Hair Salons …etc.
Water and sewage are an integral part of all these businesses where any interruption will cause them to shut down  until resolved.

This is where HICK’S PLUMBING comes to the RESCUE EVERYTIME !!! Day, Night, Weekend, Rain, Sun or Snow, anytime we have had an issue from simple plumbing to complete underground sewer and water line repair or replacement Hick’s has been and always will be the ONLY people I trust to have my back and tenants best interest at heart.
Calling and using them will be the best decision you will ever make.

reviews.author: Lindsey O'Keefe
reviews.text: I had two toilets installed. They were the 2nd best price of the 3 quotes I got (but close to the first). They came out and did a free quote where as two businesses I called wanted to charge me a service fee to come give me a quote that would be applied to my balance if I had them do the work. I was able to coordinate through email and text which was helpful since I regularly do not have phone service at work. Kevin was very nice, very professional, and we ran into a space issue that he was able to provide recommendations for rather than just leave it as our problem (which in this particular situations where we bought our own parts without measuring - it was our problem).

reviews.author: Chris Myers
reviews.text:
Called late on a Saturday afternoon/early evening for a leaking main shutoff valve.  They answered promptly, took our info, and then had someone to our house all in less than 30 minutes.   As a  comparison, it took over 24 hours for another "emergency plumber", who we called first, to even call us back.

Our problem turned out to be a very easy repair that I should have known how to do myself, but that's my fault not theirs.  Also can't fault them for the repair cost because they told us upfront what the after-hours/weekend emergency "show up" rate was.  I have some other plumbing work that I've been putting off and I will definitely contact them to get a quote.

reviews.author: Austin Evers
reviews.text: I can’t speak highly enough of my experience with Hicks, from the owner to the front office to the team in the field. On short notice heading into a holiday, the team responded quickly and tackled a major sewer line issue. They worked late after dark and came back again multiple times to ensure things were handled properly. And then they handled a significant excavation and replacement project on time and on budget. They also worked with us to secure reimbursement from the county based on their findings. They were responsive by phone, text, and email. And they were transparent on costs and timelines. I’d call them again in a heartbeat.

synthesis.summary: Hicks resolves emergencies fast—sometimes within 90 minutes of the first call—but one scathing review describes shoddy work, price gouging, and a legal threat when the customer complained.
strengths: Rapid same-day and after-hours response is a consistent pattern: multiple reviews cite arrival within an hour, one job completed 90 minutes from first call, and a Friday 11PM emergency call answered
Unusual integrity on pricing: at least 3 reviewers mention technicians declining to charge for minor fixes or advising customers to DIY to save money rather than padding the bill

Long-term customer retention across 15+ years documented by multiple reviewers, suggesting consistently solid workmanship across diverse jobs including water heater installs, garbage disposals, and leak detection
weaknesses: Pricing runs above expectations for some customers—one reviewer paid $1,000 for roughly 35 minutes of work and called it gouging, while another noted costs were 'a bit higher than expected'
Communication breakdowns appear in at least one review: a customer was unable to reach a live person by phone, received only texts, and experienced a scheduling dispute over committed pricing
redFlags: One detailed 1-star review alleges crooked installation that caused a leak and drywall damage, tools dropped on tile, torn-out insulation left open in a crawlspace, and the owner bragging about wealth mid-job—specific enough to warrant caution

When that same dissatisfied customer threatened a negative review, the scheduler reportedly responded with a legal threat ('I will contact my attorney')—a serious customer service red flag documented in a separate 1-star review
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: documented Friday 11PM response, holiday-season same-day arrivals, one job resolved 90 minutes from first call, and a recent late-night emergency with guests in the home handled quickly—Hicks appears genuinely reachable and deployable outside business hours.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows a strong 4.8 across 348 reviews, but the BBB rating of C+ (unaccredited) sits well below what that Google score would suggest, and Yelp has zero reviews—the absence of any Yelp presence for a company with hundreds of Google reviews is unusual and worth noting.

reviews.author: Teresa Simien
reviews.text:
Plumbing Outfitters has always done a good job when servicing our home.  They are prompt in their responses and scheduling, and always provide an estimate before starting repairs.

Our technician, Seth Sabo, was very friendly and professional.  He took the time to explain the plumbing issue and answered all of our questions.  He also advised us on potential future issues we may experience due to the root cause of our current problem.

reviews.author: Sam Ketay
reviews.text: First time hiring Plumbing Outfitters so was slightly nervous at first, but Matthew A was excellent. Super thorough and noticeably took pride in his craft. These guys will be my go to going forward.

reviews.author: Aubrey Berkowitz
reviews.text:
5 Stars as always for Plumbing Outfitters. Jorge and Joe came by today for a toilet replacement and were quick, polite, and of course gave plenty of pets to the dogs.

More so, Plumbing Outfitters never tries to oversell me. They walked me through a potential issue today and made me feel confident in their path forward-- even saving me money.

If you need plumbing work done, Plumbing Outfitters is the only way to go.

reviews.author: Cody J.
reviews.text:
Highly unsatisfactory. Their technician quickly deemed a sink replacement "too difficult," quoted a high price, and left within 20 minutes. I hired another company that completed the job the same day for significantly less.
When I was contacted about the quote I told Plumbing Outfitters my concerns and they insisted on sending a supervisor out. That person  was less than professional and unnecessarily demeaning about the other company's work. More frustratingly, they've repeatedly called me since the initial visit, despite my clear requests to be removed from their list, they've insisted I discuss the issues with management. I received another call today trying to generate a lead. It's exhausting.

reviews.author: Elliott F.
reviews.text:
Methodical, Dedicated, and Stayed Past 5 PM on a Friday -- What More Can You Ask For?
Last Saturday I noticed water pooling near my foundation by the back of my house. No idea what was causing it and no idea how serious it was. I called Plumbing Outfitters and I am so glad I did.
They sent Seth and Micha out on a Friday. These two ran diagnostics and tests for three solid hours, and they kept going past 5 PM without complaint, without rushing, without making me feel like I was keeping them from their weekend. That kind of dedication tells you everything you need to know about a company's culture. They confirmed there was a leak but the source was elusive enough that they called in reinforcements.
That's when Melvin came out, their leak specialist, and he brought Micha and Tyler with him. This crew was methodical. They found and fixed a leak at the front of the house from the inflow pipe but also recommened testing all the drain lines to be safe. They went line by line, systematically testing every drain line in the house until they isolated the problem. Watching them work was genuinely impressive. No guessing, no shortcuts, just professionals doing exactly what professionals are supposed to do.
We now know what we're dealing with and we are on the road to getting it fixed. That peace of mind is invaluable when you're staring down a potential foundation issue. Highly recommend Plumbing Outfitters.

reviews.author: Diane Shaw Bennett
reviews.text: It is always worrisome to have to have a plumber come to fix a problem given the horror stories one hears.  I contacted Plumbing Outfitters based on their recommendations in Next Door.  Their response was almost immediate and Matthew Albitre came the next day--because of my schedule, not his.  He worked quickly to identify the problem and was very transparent, with photos as well, with what he found.  The repair was going to be complicated; he explained the problem and gave me two options for the repair with prices for each option.  I chose the lesser option with the hope that I wouldn't have to go to the major repair.  As soon as I chose, Matthew cancelled the initial visit charge and we set up the repair for the next morning.  Two men came to the house, worked for several hours and solved the problem. Throughout the process, I was not pressured in the choices I was given, and the work was done competently and quickly.  In addition, after the work was finished, I was offered a service contract that covered any plumbing issue for a year at no extra charge.  It has been a pleasure working with Matthew and the two other employees of Plumbing Outfitters.  I highly recommend them.         Diane Bennett

reviews.author: Bill P.
reviews.text:
We had our Master Bath drain backing up and called out one company which sent an inexperienced plumber who spent 2 hours accomplishing nothing. We then called Cold is on the Right who came out the following day. They diagnosed that there were rocks in our drain which meant the drain had collapsed and would require tunneling under our house to repair. A bid of $27,000 resulted in our getting a 3rd opinion. 
Plumbing Outfitters came out, diagnosed that there was a plastic grid blocking the drain and stated that they would try to break it up and wash out with a hydro jetter. This bid was for $1800.00. If not successful tunneling would be required at approximately $12,000. 
Matt and Zack came out, cleared the drain, hydro jetted to clean out additional debris in the drain and finished up their work after about 4 hours. 
My advice is if you need major or minor plumbing repairs, call Plumbing Outfitters and have Matt and Zack take care of you.
If you want a misdiagnosis along with an astronomical price, call Cold is on the Right.

reviews.author: Michelle Janecka
reviews.text:
During the February ice storm, I experienced a leak in my kitchen while I was stranded in Arkansas and unable to get home. Jess Shaw with Plumbing Outfitters was absolutely incredible throughout the entire situation. He spoke with me directly and walked me through everything he was doing step by step, as if I were there with him.

Jess Shaw took exceptional care of my home and belongings and was incredibly professional, kind, and reassuring during a very stressful time. He called when he was on the way, let me know when he arrived, and later explained in detail what caused the leak, the next steps, and made sure I felt confident that everything was taken care of.

Jess is a true asset to Plumbing Outfitters, and they are very lucky to have such a responsible and dependable employee. I highly recommend him for any plumbing work you may need.

reviews.author: Michael Schramm
reviews.text:
Plumbing Outfitters is easily the best plumbing company I've worked with. They're always quick to respond, their pricing is fair, and the quality of work is consistently top-notch. But what really makes them stand out is how much they genuinely care.

Every single plumber who has come out has gone well beyond expectations. They take the time to explain what's going on, look out for anything that might cause issues down the road, and make sure everything is done right. It's clear they take pride in what they do, and it shows.

Every plumber we've had from Plumbing Outfitters has been a five-star experience. I'm not sure how they manage to keep that level of quality across the board, but they do.

I recommend them to everyone. Just a solid, trustworthy company that consistently delivers.

reviews.author: Terrie Paschall
reviews.text: Noah and his helper arrived on time the first day to assess and offer solutions. He explained each option and the reason for each. I selected what I wanted done and he and another helper arrived punctually the next morning. All repairs were completed as estimated with no surprises or last-minute additions. All three bathrooms were left clean and all ground displaced outside in the front yard was carefully replaced. Noah and his helpers were courteous, respectful, and professional. They were even kind and patient with my extremely inquisitive and talkative grandson, and quickly installed the inexpensive shower sprayer I bought for his bathroom at no extra charge. I will definitely call Plumbing Outfitters in the future and highly recommend to anyone needing plumbing service.

reviews.author: Caleb Ripple
reviews.text:
Plumbing Outfitters did an outstanding job for us, going above and beyond our already high expectations of this amazing company! From the first conversation, their team was prompt, professional, and incredibly thorough. They communicated clearly, showed up when they said they would, respected our campus, and took real pride in their craftsmanship.

reviews.author: Samuel Burke
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Shannon Markus
reviews.text: Chris was extremely helpful during the visit to our residence to fix our water heater. He was knowledgable and explained everything clearly and thoroughly. Extra points -- we actually got a different, very well known, plumbing company to come out 2 days before and they could NOT fix the issue. reviews.author: Katie H.
reviews.text: A damn joke. Called them bc my hot water heater igniter wouldn't stay lit. I've never had this issue. Tech comes out and says "oh maybe we just need to clean the burner/igniter. He starts looking at it and notices the screws were already off (I did that, trying to get a better look as well as turned off the gas). He says "oh that's not good at all!" Screws the screws back on and says "I'm going to try to see what it does" messes with it and says it won't light at all. I tell him I turned the gas off... he turns it on and says ok it may take a few minutes to light... it never catches and then he starts talking about the electrical unit may need to be replaced and if that works, great. If not it could be the burner part of the unit. If we're going to do one, might as well do BOTH?!?! And there's always a chance there could be calcium build up in the tank?? Whatever that meant... He never pulled the burner off to clean it to see if that MIGHT work like he said. I don't know it just seemed sketchy... wasn't consistent, he didn't explain why or what his reasoning was, never did what he said he would do originally to trouble shoot the problem. Then called someone to start talked prices. Thumbs down, you will never gain my business like that.
