reviews.author: Cynthia N.
reviews.text:
Exceptional O & Plumbing Service Experience
 
I highly recommend O & M Plumbing for any plumbing needs. In particular, Chris F. has consistently demonstrated exceptional skill and professionalism on every project of mine. His attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship set him apart as a truly outstanding plumber.

Project Background

I recently purchased an older home, full of charm and distinctive bathrooms. However, I encountered a leak in the master shower that required the p-trap under the shower drain to be replaced before new tile work could be completed. My concern was that reconnecting the new p-trap to the antique cast iron drains in the foundation might cause the cast iron to crumble.

Chris F.'s Approach and Solutions

Chris came to the rescue, using a camera down the drain to evaluate the situation. He explained the difference between what was probable and what was possible, providing two bids: one for the probable good case and one for the possible problem case. Having used Chris before with excellent results, I trusted his methods, which are always the least intrusive and focused on effective access.

In the worst-case scenario, Chris would need to cut and excavate a 2' x 2' hole in the foundation around the shower drain, then tunnel no more than five feet under the foundation from that access point to secure a solid connection to the iron drainpipe. In the best-case scenario, he would only need to excavate a 2' x 2' hole around the shower drain to replace and secure the new p-trap. He also showed me pictures of his past work for reassurance.

Successful Outcome

Fortunately, the best-case and probable case prevailed. While fixing the p-trap, Chris also discovered an unrelated drain leak under the foundation, which he repaired at no extra charge. I felt I received excellent value for the service provided.

Professionalism and Work Quality

Chris left the work site clean, as he has always done in the past. He and his co-worker collaborated well, using a small and quiet jackhammer designed specifically for plumbing foundation work. The new drain looks beautiful, and I can confidently proceed with the new tile work, knowing that the unseen part of the shower is sound and affordable.

Appreciation

Thanks to O & M Plumbing for introducing me to Chris F. and Mike. Both are good and considerate professionals, and I am grateful to have them working in my home.

reviews.author: Marc White
reviews.text:
Wow!  Talk about timeliness, competency and a job well done – you would be talking about O&M Plumbing, headquartered at Three Points Ave in Pflugerville, owned by Ben Morgan!  Two days after my initial call to Heather, Chris (a handsome 30 yr old) let us know he was 30 mins away, as per their advertising.  Upon his arrival, he greeted me with a big relaxing smile and I explained our issue: a running toilet and “hammering”.  He began by checking outside water pressure at 115psi – when it should be about 65psi!  OK, that’s a 4-5 hr project.  With our 20+ yr old plumbing Chris recommended a copper fixture to reduce incoming pressure and we’d have to reschedule in order for the gas, telephone and internet people to determine where their pipes and wires were located.  A week later, Chris showed back up and I watched as he cut, cleaned, measured, and soldered; using many skills for this project.  I was amazed that he could talk while constantly working!  He finished quicker than anticipated and we went inside to fix other things.  He completed the toilet issue in 25 mins because he had the needed parts in his O-M truck.

When asked about why he liked his job, Chris was very complimentary about his boss, Ben.  He explained that Competence and a Friendly Professional attitude is what drives Ben – he is a very knowledgeable man who expects nothing less from his employees than the very best they can produce – because that is what he does!  In fact, since he was in the area, Ben stopped by the next day to meet me.  It was a real pleasure to meet both Ben and Chris because we interacted as family members to each other including us having the ease, trust and humorous banter that happens with those that give off those friendly vibes.  Thanks guys for jobs well done!

reviews.author: Roneil R.
reviews.text:
Best Plumbing Services overall in my service area based on price, skill and quality of customer service. Many other reputable companies quoted double (or in one case triple) for the exact same work. Did I mention they were quick and cleaned up after themselves too?  

How did I determine that they are the best?
I had all of my plumbing inspected by a home inspector/contractor I trust, with estimates on cost and time. So I contacted every reputable plumber I could find on yelp for estimates including Aloha Plumbing, Good Flow, Blue Dragon, Plumb-Quick, the Plumbinator, Local Plumbing and EZ Flow to see what they would quote.

O&M was the first ones out, their prices were in line with my cheat sheet (that I did not tell any of the estimators about), Drew was head and shoulders above the other estimators in terms of knowledge and - here is the most important thing - NO UNNECESSARY UPSELL!!!!! All other estimators save 1 tried to sell me on a rebuild of a shower that only needed a handle fixed. 

All other estimators warned me that most of the undersink cabinet space would be used up in the remodel but O&M actually ended up using less space than before. So now I have even more storage room.

I don't usually use CAPS in reviews but the best service and best knowledge (given they improved the situation under the sink unlike every other company would have done), while coming in a few dollars below my cheat sheet estimates and being the 2nd cheapest quote out of 6.

I won't even try another company and I want to make sure everyone I care about is using these guys. Too many others out there gouge you. I have 4 emails in my inbox that prove it.

reviews.author: Justin A.
reviews.text: Andrew discovered a pretty major leak from a sewer pipe under our pier and beam home. Adding to this unpleasantness is the fact that our crawl space was non existent and our home is very low to the ground. They had a digging crew come out promptly to create an access point so they could access and begin work. Needless to say, this was not a glamorous job. Ben (the owner), Mike and Andrew worked in these conditions for almost two whole days until the job was complete. I cannot thank them enough!! They made the entire process so easy. Andrew did such a great job in explaining the issues and the work that would be taking place. He broke it down in layman's terms for us, preparing us for possible complications, etc. He is such an asset to the company, he really brought our anxiety down and assured us the work would be done correctly and with the least disruption possible. It was also reassuring (and rare) to have the owner of the company on site working alongside Andrew and Mike to ensure everything was done properly. From start to finish we were treated with respect and courtesy and they delivered on all of their promises. Heather in the office did a terrific job booking our various diagnostic visits and passing along messages when needed. I can't say enough about this company and we are so grateful to have found them. They truly have given our home back to us after living with an unpleasant situation for some time. And they couldn't have been sweeter to our dogs! I urge everyone to trust O & M Plumbing with all of their plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Meg N.
reviews.text:
Ben is honestly the best plumber in Austin. He's been with us through multiple plumbing disasters at three houses over our years in Austin (I think his first job for us was 2016? So over 6 years now), and it's hard to imagine relying on anyone else.

He's reliable, great at explaining things, really really thorough, and does great work.

Most recently, we woke up Thanksgiving morning with a wet floor and a bunch of warped floor boards. So stressful. Ben prioritized our call, diagnosed our issue quickly, and had the whole thing repaired within a couple days, making a huge headache way easier to deal with. It's always like this with O&M- we've done both major and minor work with them over the years, and they really take care of us.

A note about the kind of person Ben is: while he was out fixing our latest issue, he noticed that the handle was off in our guest shower. This had nothing to do with the issue he was out for: it had gotten corroded, and I was in the process of swapping it out myself, but busy parent life combined with all the YouTube videos I was going to need to watch to get it done had meant it had been sitting there waiting for me to actually do it for a couple months (shameful, I know). Ben noticed it and offered to knock it out while he was out fixing our issue, just because he could and he knew it would only take him a few minutes. He's just like that, goes the extra mile. 

I don't have enough good words about O&M - could seriously tell 5 other stories like this. Thank you, Ben! We are grateful for you and your team.

reviews.author: Cyndi Nickel
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ O & M Plumbing – A True Gem!**

We recently purchased a beautiful mid-century home built in 1962, and while it had charm in spades, it also came with a few plumbing challenges. Enter **O & M Plumbing**, and more specifically, **Chris**—a master of his craft and hands-down the best plumber we've ever worked with!

From the start, Chris tackled every issue with precision, professionalism, and a genuine care for our home. He installed a **new main gas pipe** for our HVAC system, not only enabling the upgrade but also curing **slow gas leaks in the attic** that had been a lingering concern. That alone was a huge relief!

But Chris didn’t stop there. He **fixed a leaky toilet and its stubborn shut-off valve**—a problem that had stumped *three other plumbers*. His persistence and expertise were unmatched. He also installed a **new diverter tub spout** that seamlessly blended with our vintage fixtures, preserving the home’s original aesthetic while ensuring modern functionality.

And then there was the **outdoor spigot**, which had been virtually abandoned due to severe corrosion. Chris brought it back to life, solving a problem we thought was beyond repair.

Every step of the way, Chris was courteous, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough. If you’re lucky enough to book him for your plumbing needs, you’re in excellent hands. **O & M Plumbing is a rare find, and Chris is a true plumbing hero.** Highly, *highly* recommended.

reviews.author: Marco S.
reviews.text:
O&M Plumbing was amazing. The upper hot water heater element had gone bad on our water tank. Easy DIY fix you're probably thinking right? I agree.. Only the element had fused to the tank and was not going to come out. After a few hours of trying, cursing and trying again I decided to reach out to a professional. 

I normally call 4-5  of Yelps top star plumbers when an issue comes up. I expect at least 1 to not return my call and 3-4 to tell me they can fit me in sometime next week and if I'm lucky one will be able to help in a reasonable time. O&M was a pleasant surprise when they not only picked up their phone, but told me they could be out the next day by 1pm. 

This was a great relief to us as we have a tween and hot showers have to happen.. or horrible things begin.. I was once again pleasantly surprised when O&M called on the next day and told me they would be there TWO hours ahead of schedule. Yes, two hours!! After trying to fix the existing tank failed we finally agreed that we would need a new heater. 

They were priced fairly, extremely quick to get the tank and parts and even faster to install the new tank. Within 3 hours we had hot water again (including going to get the tank) and our family can now rest easy knowing that our tween can bath once again. 

I would highly recommend O&M. They were enjoyable to talk to, informed and extremely polite. Thank You O&M!

reviews.author: K R.
reviews.text:
I was one of these winter vortex houses that had busted plumbing, to make a long story short. I was having a tough time even getting plumbers to come to my house to give me an estimate for the whole house re-pipe. Two of Austin's bigger named plumber companies cancelled on me, five minuets before my "window," with one on a Monday and one on a Friday. I don't start relationships like that, so I don't reschedule.

My brother in law owns a plumbing company in CA and I told him my woes and he found O & M on Yelp and told me to give them a call. I did and I'm so happy for it.  

Ben showed up Friday morning and on time, to give me an estimate and I told him I was looking for a relationship. I don't just what the wham bam thing, and that I wanted to feel comfortable. Ben walked the property with me and explained all and took the time to think about me needing an additional exterior water faucet and when I told him I'd be interested in a water softener system in the future, he suggested doing the piping now - which would be a great time/money saver.  

I'm so excited that they'll be able to start work in a week! Other companies were trying to quote me so high it was as if they were trying to dare me to give them the job! Looks like O & M is my plumbing Co and I'm sure I'll be recommending them to all. I have complete faith the work will be high quality.  

Thank you Ben!

reviews.author: Mario M.
reviews.text: I usually wait a few days after any work is completed before writing a review; I'm glad I waited this particular time.  O&M came out to a rental property to review a small toilet leak.  I ended up contracting them for more preventative  work in the other bathrooms.  It was a costly amount of work but O&M were reasonable about not overcharging (since I was "buying in bulk").  Initially the work seemed fine, but after checking a week later, the small leak was still there - they had not fixed the original issue :(  I was very disappointed in this and reached out.  The owner Ben got back to me and quickly made it a priority to personally investigate what was going on.  He tried several different options but because of the age of the toilet, it was best to replace.  I purchased a new toilet and he picked it up and installed it a couple days later at NO CHARGE.  O&M went above and beyond to make sure I was satisfied. I understand things may be missed at the first go round but I really appreciated the customer service and the honesty.  I would recommend O&M if those are qualities you look for.

reviews.author: Joe C.
reviews.text:
Reached out to O&M Plumbing, and was quite frankly the only plumbing service that reached out in a timely manner with a scheduled service call for issues related to our hot water tank. They were very reliable and had even made calls to make sure I was aware of their ETA on the diagnostic and the install days.

Ben came out and was able to quickly diagnose our tank, and with Brian was able to quickly and effectively replace and solve the problem we were having (end of life issues with the tank). 

Even more amazing, although their main supplier was closed on the day of install (holiday issues), they took it upon themselves to buy a comparable tank from a big box store and threw in an expansion tank (to avoid water hammer) at no extra cost, even though they'd make less on account of the difference in price on the tank vs. their typical supplier.

After install, Brian stayed behind and made sure I was satisfied with the install and explained the maintenance that I could do to extend the life of the tank.

We really appreciate their help, and would gladly recommend!

reviews.author: Barbara Mason
reviews.text: Just had my pressure regular valve and shut off replaced and water heater flushed. Seth and Mike were friendly, efficient, and competent. Explained clearly what needed to be done. Great job!  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Dan V
reviews.text:
I needed a toilet repaired for my home in East Austin. The toilet had leaks due to worn out washers in the tank. Master plumber Dan Howard came out and walked me through the options. I had him perform a complete tank repair and had no issues. I then noticed the second toilet start to show the same issues and that’s when I called GCP again to repair the second toilet. These toilets have the original washers from 2008 so it’s not surprising to seem them both start to fail around the same time.

Dan and the team at GCP made things easy for me to schedule and that was important as I didn’t have a lot of time. Could I have found a lower price option? Maybe. Could I have done it myself? Maybe. What I needed was for the repairs to be done right the first time and give me the peace of mind that the work would be done quickly with warranty. They also took care not to dirty home floors. I recommend GCP!!

reviews.author: Marybeth Runyan
reviews.text: Eric and his guys are great! they came out to fix a broken spigot handle something you think would be simple but old pipes didn’t want to let go of the spigot. i hired them so my husband wouldn’t break the whole pipe! they got it off after a long fight without breaking anything! very impressive with my house everything breaks. i asked about another small job and they told me it would be way cheaper and easier to do myself the. having them do it. I love the honesty and hard work! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Christopher T.
reviews.text:
I haven't paid this company a single cent yet, and already they've done more for me than some "professionals" I've interacted with in the past.

Dan, a master plumber from GC-Plumbing, reached out to me directly after hearing about a problem I was having with my shower. Instead of dismissing me or telling me to hire a plumber right away (like a certain big-name plumbing supplier did), Dan actually listened to my description, reviewed my photos and videos, and brainstormed solutions with me -- all without rushing the conversation or making me feel like I was wasting his time.

He walked me through possible causes, explained why certain theories didn't add up, and even suggested specific local supply shops that might be able to help me track down the right part. His approach gave me the confidence to keep troubleshooting and, most importantly, the reassurance that I was actually on the right track.

In an industry where it's all too common to feel talked down to, Dan was refreshingly respectful, encouraging, and generous with his knowledge. I'm still working on resolving my issue, but thanks to Dan's advice, I'm much better prepared -- both for this repair and for future home maintenance.

If this is how GC-Plumbing treats someone who isn't even a paying customer yet, I can only imagine how great the service will be when I do need to hire them. Absolutely top-notch professionalism, patience, and kindness. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jennifer Raichman
reviews.text:
We have been using Honest Air and Plumbing since 2016 for both our HVAC and plumbing needs. However, over the past few years, we have noticed a decline in the quality of their service. We discovered that a major corporation had bought them out. After a day of searching for local small businesses, we found Good Clean Plumbing to handle our three tankless water heaters, and for our HVAC needs, we found The AC Guy of ATX.

Both companies exceeded our expectations. Our service technician, John, from Good Clean Plumbing, did an excellent and thorough job. The costs were lower than what we were paying to Honest Air and Plumbing, and we are now enrolled in their maintenance program.

Similarly, we received outstanding service from Anthony, the owner of The AC Guy of ATX. Anthony is honest and does not try to upsell any unnecessary services. We are now on a maintenance program with The AC Guy of ATX, which is more affordable than the maintenance program offered by Honest Air and Plumbing, and the service quality far surpasses what we experienced with them.

Both Good Clean Plumbing and The AC Guy of ATX are local small businesses, and we are happy to support them. In return, we receive significantly better service at better prices.

reviews.author: Brian C.
reviews.text:
GC just came out to replace a failing water heater. I usually review restaurants, but I was pleased enough to come tell you about it.

Here is what my experience was like:
- fast response to my request for quote with the best price and warranty
- ongoing communication with the owner and thorough answers to my questions while making my decision between plumbers
- an update that they could come earlier than expected
- close to appt a text where I could track my plumbers en route!
- once on premises I showed the guys around and Chris answered my many questions. Then he asked if I needed anything else while they were here (well trained service and a win win)
- job was done quickly and cleanly and they also fixed up some outdoor hose bibs that needed love (thank you!) 

I'm not somebody who loves spending money on plumbing, but I was pleasantly surprised. I'd use them again (but hopefully not for a long time!)

P.S. I almost passed on them because they don't have a lot of Yelp reviews, but if you look a few other usual places you'll find I'm not the only satisfied customer.

reviews.author: Emme B.
reviews.text: the dynamic duo of chris and austin came to my home recently to fix my clogged toilet, and unfortunately came to the conclusion (what i suspected) that i needed a new toilet. they went back out into the heat of the day to get my lovely new throne and installed it that afternoon. they were very professional, keeping everything as neat and clean as possible and cleaning everything up when finished, removing all trash (although chris did jokingly ask me if i wanted to keep my old toilet to use in the front lawn as a planter!). they even put on booties over their shoes every time they entered my home. they are also very pleasant and enjoyable and easy to be around, and to communicate with, and chris does explain all options so that you can make an informed choice (i had several toilet choices-there are some pretty fancy ones out there!). both chris and austin have a great sense of humor so even though i hope i never see them again, if i do need a plumber i'm definitely calling good clean plumbing, and i'm definitely requestiong chris and austin!

reviews.author: Adrienne Kiesel
reviews.text: Had the pleasure of working with Seth from Good Clean Plumbing this morning and I cannot say enough good things about our experience. We had already known about Good Clean Plumbing from a friend, and they have always exceeded our expectations as far as being prompt, communicative, very clear and straightforward with quotes as well as very courteous and safe to be in our home. They went above and beyond to do a great job on installing our new fixtures and appliance, and even added an extra safety feature for stability. We have had water damage in the past from a poor builder, and need everything as safe as possible moving forward. Thank you, Seth and GCP for helping our home and our family! Will be recommending you and your team! And welcome to Texas Seth!

reviews.author: Jeffrey Cole
reviews.text: I am so glad I went with my gut feeling (and glowing reviews) and called GC Plumbing. Daniel couldn't have been a more honest, straightforward specialist with twenty years experience. I was afraid I had a busted pipe but it was just a worn out seal. The spigot was 26 years old so I'm thrilled to have a much better, brass spigot to be an addition to my home for the rest of my life, perhaps. Could not be more pleased with everything from the length of time to respond (initially on my first call this morning). They were very responsive right from the get go. From the start of diagnosis and completion of the part needed installed I'd say it must've only taken an hour or two. I will recommend Daniel at GC to anyone living around here.

reviews.author: Michelle Diane
reviews.text:
Good Clean Plumbing is a company that truly stands out for professionalism, integrity, and care. From everything I’ve seen and heard through the community, they operate with a strong commitment to quality workmanship, clear communication, and respect for their clients’ homes.
Their focus on residential plumbing, preventative solutions, and long-term reliability is exactly what homeowners want when they need someone they can trust. It’s clear they take pride in doing things the right way and delivering service that puts people at ease.
If you’re looking for a licensed, insured plumbing company that values excellence and customer satisfaction, Good Clean Plumbing is a great choice.

reviews.author: Liz P.
reviews.text:
Our grinder pump failed late on a Friday, and I was worried we'd be stuck without help all weekend. I called Good Clean Plumbing, and to my surprise, the president Eric came by right away to take a look. He assessed the issue himself and was able to get Johnny out the next morning to get it serviced and working again.

They were incredibly professional, prompt, and didn't charge a travel fee like other local businesses do. Their pricing was very reasonable, and above all, they were honest and ethical throughout the entire process.

If you're in Lago Vista and need reliable plumbing services, I highly recommend Good Plumbing. I'll definitely be using them again if the need arises.

reviews.author: Vince L
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience working with Good Clean Plumbing. I help operate management of short term rentals. One of our homes in the Lago Vista area had a report of a slow tub drain. Due to a scheduling conflict, I was unable to be at the home during the appointment. The to-the-point good things are:

- They arrive when they say they will
- Great communication before/during/after the appointment
- The problem was resolved and no mess left behind
- The price estimate was very reasonable and matched the final bill
- I received an electronic invoice with photos

Overall, a great experience! Definitely will be my first call for homes in the service area.

reviews.author: Elisabeth Barret
reviews.text: Seth came promptly at the schedule time. He found out very quickly where the leak was. Since the leak was coming from the dishwasher, he informed me that there was nothing he could do about it but put me immediately in touch with a company that would help me with the water damage. He was so helpful and polite and it was a pleasure to deal with him. This is the first time I called this company but in view of the friendly and professional service I got, I will certainly call them again and give their names to friedns and family, should the need a plumber.

reviews.author: Kris K.
reviews.text: We had Seth W. from Good Cleaning Plumbing come out today, and he was fantastic! He was friendly, professional, and efficient. Seth quickly figured out our hot water issue and got it working again, plus he replaced two toilets for us. Everything looks great and works perfectly. It's such a relief to have everything fixed! We'd definitely recommend Seth to anyone needing plumbing work--he did an excellent job and was a pleasure to work with.

Service was quick and great.

Would highly recommend  to anyone and plan to use for all future needs for both my home and commercial business.

reviews.author: Mark Costanzo
reviews.text: 2020 Drain Clean & Plumbing, and specifically Osbaldo Flores and his team, did a great job on my water main replacement after a significant leak.   They were very responsive, diagnosed the problem quickly, and then did the job ahead of a schedule because we were out of water.   Osbaldo made sure he had the right materials and made sure it worked well before cleaning up.  They left the site in excellent shape, covered, and ready for me to re-plant the grass.  They stayed until well after dark to make sure it all worked.   They will be my new go to plumber.

reviews.text: I ended up in touch with this company because they are the authorized service company for the water heater that just died on me. Wonderful experience working with 20/20 drain clean & plumbing. From easy accommodating scheduling to Courteous and professional job by J.

The process was transparent from start to finish. I knew how much the service charge was and before doing any work, the cost was clearly laid out. He was able to fix in less than 2 hours. He was very professional and would highly recommend again!

reviews.text: 2020 Drain Clean & Plumbing has always provided fast, efficient, quality plumbing service.  This company is a top performer, coming day, night, weekends, anytime service is needed for my tenants like clogged pipes, toilet repairs, valve replacements or hot water heaters.  This work is all done at a very reasonable cost.  I am truly grateful for the service this company has given me over the years.

reviews.author: Sherry P
reviews.text: We can’t speak highly enough of DB’s and particularly Aaron F. When we had a plumbing emergency late in the day, DB’s was the only company able to get someone out that evening.  Aaron F. Came out early in the promised window, diagnosed our problem, and got us all set up. He was courteous, incredibly knowledgeable, and did a great job of communicating with us what our issue was and how to address it in the future. The next time we call a plumber, DB’s will be the first call…and we’ll ask for Aaron F.

reviews.author: Jessica Gutierrez
reviews.text: I experienced the worst of the worst  plumbing disaster you can imagine. I had sewage back up on multiple floors and it was a hazmat. Aaron from DB Cooper showed up and we worked as a team to rid the biohazard immediately and had the plumbing working again temporarily until they could get a crew out the very next day. Aaron wrote up the invoice and report which was extremely easy for my insurance to read and dispense insurance funds to pay for most services. Not only did Aaron resolve and repair the issue he recommended me to a phenomenal clean up crew (Semper Dry) who came immediately and resolved the aftermath. I couldn’t recommend DB Cooper more, and I have dealt with other local plumbers who were not anywhere as near as proficient as Aaron.

reviews.author: Jennifer Hargis
reviews.text: Marv J installed a pressure regulator valve which we did not have and main water shut off valve.  It was a very small, tight space and he was able to do the work without cutting into the drywall.  He also replaced an old hose bib shut off for the outside water spigot and repaired a section of bent piping in the ceiling.  He did the work at a fair price and was very diligent and friendly.  He also cleaned up the area after he completed the job.  I would not hesitate to have him work on any other plumbing issues that we may have in the future.

reviews.author: Adam Kerr
reviews.text: I did not have a good experience with this company. They don’t charge for a service call but then charge a very high price to do the work, in my opinion. The technician was friendly and seemed knowledgeable. However, the price to do the work was very high to me. He was in the house for not more than an hour and fixed the pipe to my shower diverter that I improperly installed. Part of that hour included a delay b/c he needed to charge the battery for his tool, which is understandable due to the cold weather. I’m all about paying for quality work but the price seemed very high. They gave me a military discount which was nice of them but the price was still $350 for 1 hour of work (which required very few parts). I should have politely thanked them for their time and gotten a second quote from a different company. But, I was pressed for time and just had them do the work. I went with this company b/c they had an extremely high rating. I am providing this review so other customers are aware of potential challenges that they may face when requesting similar services.

reviews.author: Andrey Strakhov
reviews.text: I had a bad experience with them. I have intermittent sewer smell in my basement and bathroom right above. The plumber came and offered a smoke test for about $550. During the test he turned on the smoke machine and shot smoke into one of my basement cleanouts (I have 3). No smoke came out in the house anywhere and he told me that he is out of ideas but he can come back with a helper to do another smoke test from the roof for $850 this time. I told him I will consider it. I started educating myself on how these smoke tests are done after he left and found that he should have pressurized my system and done the test from a roof vent in the first place (I don’t have a yard cleanout). If system is not pressurized, the smoke will find the path of least resistance and will just exit out of roof vents, which is exactly what happened. I don’t know if he was inexperienced or did not feel like climbing onto my roof. I ended up buying smoke candles and did my own pressurized smoke test and lo and behold, I found the problem right away (whoever did work at the house before I bought it left an uncapped vent pipe just sitting in my wall cavity). Waste of $550 bucks as the test he did was useless and not correct.

reviews.author: Jason S
reviews.text:
We had just remodeled our bathroom and naturally, after turning the contractor grade water supply valves on and off under the sink ONE time, they started to leak badly.

We reached out to DB’s Plumbing and Drain through Yelp and they responded back almost immediately. I was scheduled for an appointment within a few days, only because of my schedule. We got a two hour window on the day of our an appointment and Aaron showed within 15 minutes of that.

Once in and introduced, he gave me a quick assessment of the issue, showed me the parts I’d need, and a quote. He had everything he needed and was done inside of 30 minutes. Aaron is AWESOME at his job and a true professional!

UPDATE!

After such great work the on the last  call, we decided called DB’s Plumbing and Drain again to replace some leaking hose bibs. Once again, we had an amazing service call! Our plumber, Mike, was courteous, worked hard in the heat and did an amazing job!

Upon arriving, he explained the job and the costs to us, showed us what he was going to do and after agreeing, went right to work! Once the job was completed, he explained again everything he had done, showed us a couple things we didn’t know and  took some time to explain a little about the company. All in all, a great call! We definitely want Mike back on our next call!

Thanks again for quick and clean service! You guys have made repeat customers out of us!

reviews.author: Keith
reviews.text:
Update 4/18/26: Not only does everything below STILL remain true, i recently decided to hire them to do preventative maintenance rather than waiting for somwthing to break and again i got Marv who is amazing and informative.

He was able to articulate things I was not a subject expert on and was even willing to show me key elements as he was diagnosing and repairing my problem.  He is easily my permanent plumbing guy and I will ask for him specifically next time I need service on something.

reviews.text: John  B. is very knowledgeable and especially when it comes to plumbing. Our hot water piping failed do to a builders issue with putting in water pipes (orange piping) that literally broke down causing holes and continuous leaking. He tried jackhammering my slab to find a good connection for new piping but the TOTAL  builder piping was just too bad. He by himself replaced many, many yards of new piping through the walls in our home!  I wish this on no one but John never gave up! His efforts were appreciated and I would definitely us DB’s Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Kenneth Stevens
reviews.text: Called them up to service a couple toilets. They responded in a few minutes and had a plumber (Peyton) come to my house that same afternoon. All compliments for Peyton. He is knowledgeable and can explain issues and different solutions in an easy-to-understand manner. Im a cheap bastard so paying almost $600 to install a new angle stop and changing out the guts in a toilet tank seemed a bit steep, but what he can do in an hour would take me all weekend. Overall, the company was super professional and I would use them again.

reviews.author: Ron Byrd
reviews.text:
Plumbing Tech-Mike did a Clean and Professional job of replacing my water heater. He was very friendly, knowledgeable and his Craftmanship is Top Shelf. Thank you for doing the job the right way! The Technicians involved were very instrumental in getting my factory warranty approved quickly with State Select and getting the install done within 24 hrs. of equipment failure. This was a Labor only job with the Water Heater being provided by State under Warranty.
All in All they did an Outstanding installation job.Thank you.

reviews.author: Lisa Conway
reviews.text: Marv J was my technician. He was very polite and extremely knowledgeable regarding my plumbing issue.  He listened and then addressed all my issues  and kept me well informed in the process.  He is truly an asset to this company.  Kudos to this company for the professionalism I encountered from the call to make the appointment , notifications of who would be providing the service, and sending messages to let me know they could come earlier than the scheduled appointment time.  I will be using them again.

reviews.author: Casey Graham
reviews.text: Duncan was outstanding! He fixed our toilet quickly and took the time to address several other issues while he was here. Friendly, professional, and completely straightforward—no fluff, just the facts. He also walked us through upcoming nationwide regulation changes that could impact future work and gave recommendations that saved us a significant amount of money. It’s rare to find someone this honest and reliable. We’ll absolutely call him again.

reviews.author: Monica Boone
reviews.text: Found them on our neighborhood FB page, off a recommendation from a very happy customer.  Have to say - Excellent service! Got to us same-day, and were even able to move us up to earlier time slot. Mike did an outstanding job diagnosing the problem, and fixing it for us, with no need for any added expense or return service.  Very professional, friendly, knowledgeable service. Thank you, Mike and DB’s Plumbing. We will see you again!

reviews.author: Lisseth Palacios
reviews.text: This company took my call and assigned someone to my home promptly. I was stressed and they were friendly over the phone.  The plumber that came to my home, Michael, was amazing.  He was kind and courteous. He explained everything thoroughly and was patient with my questions.  He was very professional and his work is neat and thorough. I highly recommend Michael from DB’s Plumbing & Drain!

reviews.author: R De Paz
reviews.text: Bobby N & John B did a great job in taking care of our plumbing issue. When what we thought was initially clog turned out to be a sewer line issue, they were able to quickly give us a fair estimate and come back out the same week to get it handled. They also took the time to show us and explain the issues we were experiencing. Would highly recommend DB’s for your plumbing needs.

synthesis.summary: DB's dispatches fast — often within 15 minutes — and their named techs (Aaron, Marv, Mike) consistently diagnose problems that stumped other companies, though flat-rate pricing can feel steep for short jobs.
strengths: Rapid dispatch is a recurring pattern: multiple reviews cite same-day or same-evening arrival, and one reviewer noted arrival within 15 minutes of the appointment window opening
Diagnostic depth stands out across at least 3 reviews — Aaron and others identified root causes that competing plumbers had missed entirely, avoiding unnecessary upsells
Named technicians (Aaron F., Marv J., Mike C., Peyton, Bobby N.) earn repeat-customer loyalty by name, with at least 4 reviewers explicitly requesting the same tech again
weaknesses: Pricing opacity is a real concern: the one low-rating review documents $350 for under an hour of labor with minimal parts, and the reviewer specifically warns others to get a second quote before authorizing work
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: DB's was described as 'the only company able to get someone out that evening' during a late-night plumbing emergency, handled a multi-floor sewage hazmat backup with same-night response and a full crew the next morning, and consistently delivers same-day arrivals — all strong indicators for 2am calls.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp has zero reviews despite the business being active and searchable there, making it impossible to cross-validate Google's 4.9 across 2,088 reviews; the absence of Yelp presence is unusual but not necessarily a red flag.

reviews.author: KatLMG
reviews.text:
I am so incredibly happy that I found Smooth Plumbing!  They are always able to schedule you without delay, and should you have any questions, their communication is quick - even at 9 PM.

The technicians are highly trained, very knowledgeable, communicative and downright nice!  The first job I booked, I was sent a bio for my technician, as well as a tracking map to know when he would arrive at my house.

Pricing is fair and upfront and you are always given at least three options to choose from as far as the work that could/will be done and what it costs.  I had two toilets replaced by Smooth recently, and thank goodness the technician was knowledgeable enough to know my issues were most likely stemming from high pressure in my home (THANKS TJ!).  Being as it was time to replace my hot water heater, I did so today and also had a gauge installed that will even out high water pressure when it happens.  Talk about fast, he did it all by himself within two hours.

Thank you Smooth Plumbing, I have not felt lied to nor taken advantage of.  As of this point, I do not believe I will go anywhere else when I need service!

reviews.author: Haley Johnson
reviews.text: Ian was so helpful and knowledgeable with my frozen pipe situation. I would recommend this company to any new homeowners needing a plumber.

reviews.author: David Kofalt
reviews.text: After my initial contact, they got me scheduled very quickly. They completed the job in a good amount of time and it was very reasonably priced. They explained the work done and gave appropriate suggestions for possible future work with definite care and not pressure. They were professional, courteous, and very friendly. Will definitely work with them again and will recommend to friends.

reviews.author: Bruce Steinke
reviews.text: I reached out to multiple plumbers via Yelp with a simple request for an estimate for a specific and straightforward project: Disconnecting and reconnecting plumbing and gas lines for a new kitchen countertop install. I received multiple responses, but only Steve from Nova Home responded with the requested estimate. I was somewhat hesitant to follow through due to the low number of reviews compared to other providers, but since they were all positive I decided to follow up. I later learned that Steve's business is fairly new, which explained the lack of reviews. But my experience with Steve from start to finish was excellent. I found him to be very responsive and accommodating, in addition to doing top-notch work. He also identified some other issues with our plumbing which we were able to address before they turned into problems down the line. I rvery much ecommend Steve/Nova Home for your plumbing concerns.

reviews.author: Janell Markey
reviews.text: I really appreciate Steve fitting me in to his schedule on a very cold Saturday afternoon. He stayed late and fixed the water issues - low flow and sewer line with roots growing in it. Plumbing is one of those jobs where you really need someone you can trust and who will do a good job every time. That's Steve. He's dependable, friendly, professional, and explains things so you can understand what needs done and why. He is great with questions and is really helpful in deciding which things are priorities, and if you need it to wait, which things can wait and for how long. I highly recommend Steve!

reviews.author: lisa coakley
reviews.text: Absolutely delighted with the service from Two Irish Plumbers! They arrived precisely when they said they would, and wasted no time getting to work. Their professionalism was evident as they quickly and efficiently tackled the plumbing issue, explaining each step in a way that was easy to understand. Not only did they fix the immediate problem, but they also took the time to clearly explain how I could prevent similar issues in the future, which was incredibly helpful. I truly appreciate their expedited and professional work, and I wouldn't hesitate to call them again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Merri Jo Brant
reviews.text: Ian arrived about three hours after they were called and was very friendly and courteous. The work was quoted before proceeding to snake our sink and that was the price paid. He was neat and meticulous and we had good conversations about our plumbing hookups and plumbing in general. He also fixed our clogged shower head for no charge. We give he and his company a 10 star and will not hesitate to call them in the future and will recommend them to our neighbors and friends. Well done.

reviews.author: David Lee
reviews.text:
Steve, the owner of Nova Home Professionals, provided the most responsive service. He offered a fixed-price quote along with a 10% senior discount, which I greatly appreciated.
Despite the distance, he drove over 40 miles to address my plumbing issue. His expertise and professionalism were evident throughout the process.
Not only did he resolve the problem effectively, but he also ensured everything was thoroughly cleaned up afterward.

reviews.author: Susan Albertine
reviews.text: We needed toilet repairs and a general check of plumbing, including water pressure, before putting our house on the market. Steve went above and beyond, suggesting solutions that were reasonable and practical. He repaired two toilets, caught a problem with a shut-off valve, and installed a pressure valve, allowing us to address water-hammer noise. Friendly and professional, he's the person to call for maintenance and repair.

reviews.author: Susan Stoltzman
reviews.text: I wish I could give 10 stars.  Steve was prompt ( I had a scheduled appointment the next day and within about 1 minute of my request!). He was exactly on time, professional, kind and funny.  He explained the problem, fixed it perfectly and charged us a very fair rate which we could pay with our debit card.  I have recommended him to many, many friends in Rappahannock County. We will certainly use him again.  Thanks, Steve.

reviews.author: ANN VAUGHAN
reviews.text: I called NHP Monday afternoon and Steve showed up on time bright and early Tuesday morning! He assessed the problem, showed me everything that needed to be done and walked me through what he was doing and explained why it needed to be done. He was very knowledgeable, very professional and answered all of the questions I had. I think his prices were very reasonable for all of the work he did.

reviews.author: Cris H
reviews.text: Had a water issue with AC condensation clogged drain and Steve came for the rescue. I cannot recommend him enough. Steve was very thorough and knowledgeable on the work. All was fixed on the same day and had a piece of mind without breaking the bank. Steven not just did an excellent job, but recommended another company to help with the water remediation issues and it was also excellent.

reviews.author: Premier Hospitality
reviews.text: I needed a last minute repair on a Sunday, and within 30 mins I got confirmation that there was someone available to provide service. They did not have crazy "emergency" up charges, not even considering that it was on a Sunday and the service repair needed within the same day. True professionals, and also did a free complete inspection. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jean-Paul Rattelade
reviews.text: Steve arrived on time, made sure to clean as he was working so as to not leave a mess, priced reasonably, extremely friendly and professional, addressed all my questions and concerns and ensured the work he completed was to my satisfaction before leaving. Very happy with Steve and will be first call for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Susan Canon
reviews.text: Install was ok but the plumber did not leave the area as good or better than he found it.  Left behind leaves on the floor he dragged in from outside, didn’t return the  ceiling panel to the rightful place and  didn’t turn off the light nor return the cover panel to block access from my pets getting into the crawl space

reviews.author: Truitt Adams
reviews.text: Sorry Batman and Robin but James and AJ are the REAL dynamic duo! I had a major clog in my mainline, called a plumber from Taskrabbit, he came out and made the problem worse! Called E Z  Flow the next day and James/ AJ were at my house at 11am sharp. James came in, assessed the situation and told me exactly what the issue was, remedies to fix it and the overall cost with no fluff. Jame and AJ got right to work and were very professional and kept me abreast of their progress. James is a straight shooter (which I like), and has a great personality to boot. AJ worked diligently and I could tell he knew what he was doing by his confidence. By 12:30pm the issue was resolved and James and AJ drove away like hero Cowboys at the end of a Western. The price for the job was VERY reasonable and didn’t make me sweat. PLEASE use E Z Flow Plumbing for any plumbing issues. They are the best hands down!

reviews.author: chuck lindsey
reviews.text: Bill at EZ Flow replaced a leaky water heater for me. Quick responses, clear communication, honest assessment, fair price and now I have hot water! What more could you want? I’m happy to have found EZ Flow as they’ve gained a new customer from me.

reviews.author: Phong Cao
reviews.text: fantastic experience. got a bradford white hydrojet 50 gallon 10 year warranty installed with the best price in the area - beat 40+ other plumbing shops here in Austin. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Luke T.
reviews.text: Ez Flow was recommend by a contractor. EZ Flow came (when I could not supervise) and cleaned a drain for $275. A few months later drain is still clogging up, the next plumbing company found two plastic bags.

reviews.author: Luke Tiemann
reviews.text: Paid EZ Flow $275 to clean a drain, a few months later drain is still clogging up, the next plumbing company found two plastic bags.

reviews.author: Josh R.
reviews.text:
I have nothing but amazing things to say about our experience with CT and EZ Flow Plumbing.  

Prices were more than competitive. When CT first showed up, he worked extremely hard to try and find our main water line for a soft water loop installation. Our builder gave us some really bad information, and CT spent hours trying to find the main water line based off their inaccurate locations.

We called it a day, and I ended up buying some wall scanning devices, thermal imaging devices, and even a stethoscope to try to find this pipe on my own time. CT offered to do anything he could to help find that pipe, but eventually I was able to get some good information from other homeowners in my community. The builders estimates were not even close to the actual location of the water line, and it would have costed us probably hundreds in repairs if we started cutting through the wall to find it.

CT and his crew came out, assessed everything, and scheduled to follow up asap to complete the loop work. They were always a pleasure to have around, extremely polite, professional, and super friendly. Everything looks beautiful, and we couldn't be happier with the price and the incredible attention to detail on making this process super smooth and as efficient as possible despite the misleading direction we were given initially from my builder.

If you have any hesitations, look no further! CT and the EZ Flow Plumbing team will treat your job as if it was their own home, so we never felt like any corners were being cut.

Thank you again, CT and EZ Flow Plumbing!

reviews.author: Laura S.
reviews.text:
Emelio was professional through the entire experience.  He called me before he came to the house giving me an estimate of when he would arrive.  He listened to me describe what was wrong, then he shared his game plan for fixing it with me.  My toilet was stopped up; when the water went down the drain in the bathtub, the toilet would bubble; and then the shower had sewage coming up the drain - gross.  He said all 3 were related and he'd need to remove the toilet to get directly to the drain and so the toilet wouldn't break.  

He brought in his huge auger machine - after seeing it, it was pretty clear why the toilet needed to get removed.  He explained to me what he was doing because I was curious about it.  He did an excellent job and got the clog cleared completely out of the drain so everything was flowing properly again.  He was careful to keep the area clean and didn't track anything through my house.  It was a lot of work to do everything he did - and it's not something I could have done myself.  He reinstalled the toilet and caulked it - a much better job than the builder did.  

He also discovered that one of the clean out valves - the one closer to the street - was broken.  He suggested to call the city, etc. to get them to fix it since it's likely their responsibility (I'm making some calls on that now).  I was very happy with the whole experience and I highly recommend Emelio and will hire him again when I'm ready to put in a new water softener.

reviews.author: Maiya Huffman
reviews.text: This was our first time to use EZ Flow Plumbing and have to share what care and service we received, after finding them on Yelp.  Everything from the scheduling and information they shared/collected, to our actual appointment and repair were top notch.  Mo came out on time and was professional, knowledgeable and conscientious.  We have a pressure assisted flushing toilet and since the whole working unit had to be replaced, this required sourcing the part for another visit.  Mo was quick about finding the part and setting the expectations of when it could be installed.  I checked the pricing he gave us and it was fair with no mark up.  He carved out time to come back on the same day and not only replaced the unit but also installed a new water line and all the screws, seals, etc. that had sustained wear and tear over the years.  He was thorough checking their work for leaks and functionality.  Mo also sent pictures for us to keep on file for warranty purposes and any follow up we might need with the manufacturer.  What a reassurance to have had him work on our plumbing issue.  We are grateful for EZ Flow Plumbing and Mo-highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nadine Y.
reviews.text:
We have been using EZ Flow for several years and are always happy with the work they provide. 
Today I had to call them to help with a dishwasher that was leaking.even after I called Bosch last week to have my machine evaluated.  Bosch sent a repair man who looked at my situation and told me that I needed a new washer but did not help me to mitigate the leak that was the result of the broken machine.  So, I then called EZ Flow to come out to make sure the leak was not from a pipe.  They came out quickly and went right to work.  They concluded that my machine was indeed broken and leaking so they stopped the leak, and removed the washer so the water that was standing could dry and not cause any further damage.  
They always do great work, but what makes them stand out is their character. Terrance and Henry cared about the problem left by the Bosch repairman and did what needed to be done to keep my home from experiencing water damage. While they worked they were kind, respectful and concerned about my home.  I highly recommend them.  They are fair in their pricing and just a really reliable company.

reviews.author: Rey B.
reviews.text:
If you're looking for an honest, and friendly, group of plumbers, this is your team right here. 

My wife and I were pretty nervous about a sound we were hearing in the attic. I would have almost preferred calling the Ghostbusters for that strange sound than learning that we had major plumbing issues. 

These guys came in and checked everything out. Turns out the issue wasn't nearly as bad as I thought. I've repaired my toilet, but this type of stuff...It could have been anything and I would have known no better. 

A plumber could have fed my a line about my house exploding unless I spent $2000. 

They didn't.

They told me it was a natural water heater sound and didn't charge me a dime. 

What this means is that next time I have a plumbing issue, I will give them a call. Not because they might not charge me a couple of thousand for a serious job in future, because I may have a serious issue at some point in my home's life. But, because they were honest with my current issue, despite it not leading to a job.

Trust is a huge thing for me. And these guys earned it.

reviews.author: Michelle N.
reviews.text:
Thank you EZ team for coming out and helping me on my job. I had a clog that eventually turned into a leak. Out of all the office assistants that I've spoke to, Melva was the most personable out of everyone. She was very professional and easy going. I loved talking to her. She even taught me some baseball history! She scheduled her team THREE days out as compared to the 14 days from the other companies.

Day of service: Theo and team were able to fix my problem. This happened after snovid and everyone was backed up for 2+ weeks. EZ team was able to get out to me in less than a week. They called me before coming, but my phone is set up to take them to voicemail. They still came and didn't cancel on me! (thank goodness) They were able to finish the job in under an hour and were very detailed in their explanation. They even showed me how to fix the problem the next time it shows up. We didn't have to cut any drywall or open any parts of the house up. 

If I ever get any problems (hopefully not) I'm definitely contacting Theo and EZ Flow again!

reviews.author: Ramiro J M.
reviews.text:
We live in SW Austin where the city water has very high pressure 100-120 psi. Our water "Pressure Regulator Valve" (PRV) had gone out. The city should pay for PRV due to excessive water pressure.  Normal city residential pressure 60-80 psi. 
I used my exterior faucet water pressure gage on my exterior faucet and bled the excess pressure overnight to 45-50 psi until I could find a good plumber. 

EZ Flow Plumbing workers Theo and Paul came to my home. They were courteous, professional and knowledgeable in replacing our PRV. They adjusted the new PRV per city specifications and my satisfaction. (City inspector came by today and PRV installation passed.)

Theo and Paul cleaned up all of their surroundings and gave me instructions of how to adjust the PRV without damaging it by loosing the under lock first, then the top nut screw or he PRV will malfunction for a new one. 

EZ Plumbing is the best and have good reasonable prices with quality and durable products. 5 Stars indeed.

reviews.author: Wayne B.
reviews.text:
Good service, but I've gotta be honest here, they are too expensive. 

These folks were responsive, professional, and provided solid work and service with a recently clogged drain. Given I didn't have time to check with more plumbers, I went with these guys as they were simply to be at the "top of the list." And I didn't have time to shop around as much as I normally would. 

However, after a recent unrelated plumbing issue, I did do just that. Not only for a water heater repair but also asked about the work they performed. In each case, it was very clear these folks were easily the most expensive of all of the quotes. In some cases, by hundreds of dollars. 

For this next plumbing service, I did go with another company, who provided comparable service, for much less. Bottom line, nothing wrong with the work, but they are over-priced. Which I suspect is a demand-related premium due to the positive reviews. Which unfortunately is a bit short-sighted.

reviews.author: Audrey T.
reviews.text: I have used EZ Flow Plumbing since I moved to my home in 2017 to clear clogged pipes, toilets and sinks. Bill and his team have also installed a new garbage disposal, shower equipment, and a toilet in my guest bathroom. Bill and his team provide excellent service and never hesitate to make sure that I am a completely satisfied customer. Last week Terrance and Henry came to diagnose a running toilet problem. I needed a new toilet. I bought the toilet and it was installed the very same day. Terrance and Henry were courteous, professional and helpful. I was not happy with the first toilet so without question Terrance returned and assisted me in identifying a toilet to better meet my needs. I am writing this review because these days it is so rare to receive the outstanding service that Terrance, as a rep for EZ Flow Plumbing, went over and beyond in providing to ensure my complete customer satisfaction. Thank you!

reviews.author: Bryan C.
reviews.text:
We had a leak of unknown source in our bathroom sending water out in multiple directions under the tile and eventually into carpeted areas.   Theo and Paul came out to take a look and arrived exactly on time as per the appointment, checked out the area, and then discussed options for stopping and repairing what turned out to be a slab leak.

The job took two days to stop the leak, and then to restore normal water service to the affected area, but they worked very well, communicated well, and cleaned up after themselves as well as could be done given the difficult nature of the job.  

I highly recommend EZ Flow Plumbing for any work that needs to be completed, they are easy to work with, punctual, friendly, highly competent,  and take the normal COVID precautions if that is of great concern.  It's nice to know that should we have another issue, I know exactly who I will be calling for help.

synthesis.summary: EZ Flow sends named technicians who arrive within hours, beat competitor quotes on water heaters, and have handled burst pipes on Christmas Eve — but two reviewers paid $275 for a drain clean that didn't clear the actual blockage.
strengths: Same-day or within-hours arrival confirmed in at least 8 reviews, including Christmas Eve freeze emergencies and a same-day business request — techs call ahead with an ETA
Pricing repeatedly described as beating competitors: one reviewer confirmed lowest quote among 40+ Austin plumbers for a water heater install, and multiple others note no surprise fees
Honest assessments over upselling: at least 2 reviews specifically note technicians advised against unnecessary work (one told a business owner their water heater didn't need replacing yet)
weaknesses: Two reviews (same incident, cross-posted) report paying $275 for a drain cleaning that failed to clear the real blockage — plastic bags were later found by a second plumber, suggesting the drain was not fully inspected
redFlags: The two 1-star reviews appear to be the same customer posting twice about the same failed $275 drain job — while this is a single incident, it raises a question about thoroughness on drain inspections, particularly when the homeowner cannot be on-site to supervise
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: multiple reviews confirm same-day dispatch during the 2022 Austin freeze (burst pipes, failed water heaters on Christmas Eve), one technician resolved a gas/water heater issue over the phone in 10 minutes, and the owner reportedly drove outside his normal service zone for a family in urgent need.

There was no pressure—just clear, straightforward information. Once we decided, he completed the work the same day. We really appreciated his professionalism and efficiency. Highly recommend

reviews.author: James Toles
reviews.text: I was extremely impressed with the work completed by Mr Mark Martin from Len Plumbing.  He was very pleasant and extremely professional.  He arrived on time, assessed the plumbing issue I needed addressed, and completed the work in less than an hour.  I wanted a valve to be replaced and we discussed a moving a second valve to make it more accessible.  He completed both tasks and now both valves are functional and accessible. I will definitely contact Mark for all of my future plumbing needs.  Excellent, excellent professional to work with.  Thank you Len the Plumber for sending Mark Martin my way!!

reviews.author: Ruth Ashlock
reviews.text: From the First Moment that Aturo Rivera arrived at our home this morning he was a True Gentleman. Thoughful , Articulate, and Kind. He explained in detail how the process of repairing our ‘Downstairs Toilet Issues‘would take, and gave us Useful Advice/Tips on the Different Plans that Lens Plumbing Services Offered. After settling on our choice of offers he Diligently and Smoothly went about bringing in the equipment ( By Himself) and Resolved our Plumbing problem. The toilet is Working and we’re 💯 Overjoyed that Aturo was our serviceman. Also, Shoutout to Brittney for taking our phone call on a Sunday. We  Highly Recommend Him and your company to our family and friends. Thanks again Aturo You Provided us with Excellent Advice and Service.

reviews.author: Sam Rice
reviews.text:
My plumber was friendly, competent, and did a good job, but the pricing was truly insane. When I talked to the office over the phone to schedule the service, telling them exactly what I'd need, they said it was a $49 fee to have someone come out and look. But when they got here, they charged me $550 to simply move the toilet and look. I should have laughed them out of the door at this point. But I didn't, and it was another $600 to just install a flange repair kit and reset the toilet! A toilet flange repair/replacement for $1100 (AFTER a discount) is ridiculous.

I called to talk to the office, and they said they'd have "a supervisor call me back." No surprise, there was no call back.

Bait and switch pricing tactics plus outrageous pricing in general makes me confident I will never, ever call this business again.

reviews.author: Jennifer Stanley
reviews.text:
** Edit: Just because they left a note saying they would contact about the issues. Suprise! They never contacted me.

DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY. I hate having to write this because they do have some very good people on staff. However, it is entirely inconsistent. Unfortunately, the incompetence outweighs the good. They padded a simple faucet replacement bill over $100 which the guy just referred to as "extra charge", sent a "plumber" who didn't even have his own tools, reaked of pot, and opened a shut off valve spraying my bathroom with water: then installed an incorrect furnace. I paid for a high end one, they installed one of the cheaper ones. Now, i have to find a second company just to verify that the AC and furnace they installed is even the correct one because i can no longer trust anything this company says. Oh, and they didnt even install the thermostat, just handed me the box. When the county told them that they installed (the now corrected furnace) wrong, they sent over several expired CO detectors and tried to tell me that the beeping every 10 mins was how you knew the detectors were working. If you like being cheated out of money, having randos that look like they've been picked up in a home depot parking lot and given a company shirt, and being lied to, then Lenny the Plumber is the one for you. Otherwise, find someone else.

reviews.author: Shaun Dakin
reviews.text:
1) Called Christmas eve and got an appointment two days later. Plumber arrived on time (live tracker helpful) and he quickly diagnosed the issues and then repaired them quickly. He was professional and answered all our questions. We now have hot water and didn't need a total replacement. Will use again.

2) Toliet failed a few days later and Len came again!  All worked out and the toliet works great. Great service.

3) another day another problem. This time a leaking pipe and water coming out of the kitchen ceiling! Called Len on a Sunday and had Dustin arrive in an hour. He was great and was able to id the leak and repair the pipes.  Another great experience with Len.

4) feb 23... Bought a new toliet and called Len to install. As always a great service experience with Len.

5) March 23 2023 - Nelson Sera replaced a leaking disposal in the kitchen. Great service as usual.

6) March 26 2026 - Brandon helped with our new condo sink issues and did a great job. Thanks len!

7) April 15th 2026. Richard came and helped remove a ton of wipes a previous owner had attempted to flush and now made the toilet flushing a daily problem. He did the job and was very professional.

reviews.author: Heather Meyers
reviews.text: I just wanted to share a really bizarre experience I had with trying to book an appointment over the phone with Len The Plumber. We have a leak in our basement and I have seen them in our neighborhood, so thought I would call them first. The interaction on the phone was quite strange. The first call dropped after I said I was having a hard time hearing the dispatch. I called right back and spoke to another person. She asked me if I was the home owner and I said I was. She then put me on hold and came back to tell me that they have me on recorded audio from the first call saying I am NOT the homeowner. I tried to explain that the call dropped and it's probably a misunderstanding but they didn't want to hear it. I felt quite chastised like I did something wrong. She was curt and hung up on me mid sentence. Not the best customer service experience to be sure. We will go with another company.

reviews.author: Stephen Pezzetti
reviews.text: James Milligan came back to my home to perform a leak test on the main line to the house after I consulted with him. I am in the process of selling and the buyers had two “plumbers” come and look at a “suspected” leak. Neither performed an actual leak test, but both said it was leaking and the main would need to be replaced at a cost of around $10K. James told me although the test would cost me $309 it would be money well spent if it demonstrated there was no leak (he suspected it was not leaking). After 30 minutes of watching the meter after shutting off the main it hadn’t moved. NO LEAK! James saved me from having to argue about a $10K subsidy/main line replacement. 5 stars just doesn’t cut it…10 stars!! Jim is a huge asset to Len the Plumber, no question about it!

reviews.author: Benita Jeanelle
reviews.text:
I worked with Len the Plumber to replace a water heater after a pipe leak and I want to recognize Shawn for his work.

This was all happening during active water damage and restoration, so it was a stressful time for my household. Shawn was incredibly patient and professional, and he worked very well alongside the other contractors on site, coordinating smoothly with the restoration crew.

He made the installation process quick and easy while still taking the time to do everything properly. The quality of his work was noticeably better than the previous installation, which gave me a lot of confidence moving forward.

Overall, Shawn made a difficult situation much more manageable, and I would absolutely recommend him.

reviews.author: Neil McCray
reviews.text:
The stem on our shower handle cracked off inside the cartridge on a Friday eve. I called around and Len was the first to be able to tackle the job. The basic requirement was to replace the cartridge… normally an easy job… but with the stem cracked off internally, getting the old cartridge out was going to be an issue.

Micheal Dailey was the plumber that showed up. He was very conscientious… kept things clean and confined… due to the missing stem, it took a while to get the old cartridge out, but Micheal managed to get to slide out. Once that was done, from there he quickly put in a new cartridge and had it all working in no time.

Overall, a quick, easy experience. I recommend their services.

reviews.author: Alice Wilson
reviews.text: Daniel Aguirre did an amazing job replacing our water heater. He truly Exceeded our expectations In his work, detailed explanations, speed and professionalism. We have a 1959 home and are so impressed. When you think about before and after pictures, you don’t usually think about your plumbing and utility closet , but if you could see ours you would get it. Neat, tidy efficient, clean, and most importantly- Up To Code =SAFE.  After this experience, I honestly can’t imagine having anyone else work on our plumbing. Thank you, Daniel Aguirre, passionate plumber extraordinaire, and another decade of working with Len The Plumber.

reviews.author: Dan Ignatowski
reviews.text:
Discovering a surprise gas leak on a Friday was a stressful situation, but Len the Plumber responded immediately. They sent Brandon, who was incredibly knowledgeable; he clearly explained our repair options and provided a solid long-term recommendation.

​While gas plumbing is never cheap, the company worked with us to find a comfortable price point. The craftsmanship was top-notch, passed city inspection, and was completed exactly as promised. Brandon even took the time to explain the new piping materials, ensuring my wife and I felt safe and confident in the work. Highly recommended for their transparency and expertise.

reviews.author: Jeremy Flannagan
reviews.text:
Our service was excellent from the diagnostic visit to our installation. Joseph Wright was thorough and willing to educate me (the home owner) on all the best practices for our unit before conducting the work.

The overall team was super friendly and the price for the work was exceptionally reasonable, especially given the level of care provided when installing our new water heater and updating the associated piping as well.

Other companies quoted near 50-80% higher. Len has great pricing (for the Nova area). Their team is also great and you can tell they take pride in their work and getting things done the right way.

reviews.author: David Banis
reviews.text: My technician Mark was very professional and worked diligently. Thank you for getting our water back on so quickly and making recommendations for upcoming plumbing maintenance. The staff answered the phone right away, although, they did not send me an appointment confirmation until I called again the next morning. No big deal though, they picked up the phone at 7:15AM and Mark was at my house a short time later. Although they are very expensive as compared to some reputable smaller businesses in the area.

reviews.author: S Lee
reviews.text: Percy did a very nice job.  I am small and I could not reach the main water shut off valve.  He installed an additional valve with a lever that I could access.  And he also installed a Moen Flo system which will monitor the water and shut off the water if it detects a leak.  Percy was very prompt at answering our questions while we were debating what to do.  And he made sure the Moen app worked on my phone.  The water pipes look better - more orderly - after Percy replaced them.  I would recommend Percy.

synthesis.summary: Len the Plumber sends knowledgeable, punctual techs who explain everything clearly and can show up within hours — even on Sundays and holidays — but expect to pay a premium over local independents.
strengths: Weekend and holiday availability confirmed across multiple reviews: Sunday arrivals mentioned at least 4 times, including Christmas Eve scheduling and a Sunday leaking-pipe call with a technician on-site within an hour

Technicians consistently walk customers through options and costs before starting work — at least 6 reviewers specifically praise clear upfront explanations from named techs like Mustafa, Arturo, and Chris
Same-day or next-appointment turnaround cited repeatedly, including one reviewer who booked online and had a tech arrive within two hours for a non-emergency call
weaknesses: Pricing is a recurring friction point: at least 2 reviewers call out costs as high relative to smaller local competitors, with one 4-star reviewer explicitly noting 'very expensive as compared to some reputable smaller businesses in the area'
Appointment confirmation process had at least one documented gap — a reviewer had to call back the next morning to receive confirmation after no automated follow-up was sent
redFlags: BBB shows 170 complaints in the past 3 years against a backdrop of otherwise glowing reviews — a volume that warrants scrutiny, though the nature of those complaints is not reflected in the 75 reviews analyzed here
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: multiple reviewers confirm Sunday arrivals, a holiday-eve booking, and at least one burst-pipe scenario where a tech arrived within an hour of a Sunday call — this company appears genuinely available after hours and moves fast when it matters.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: No Yelp data exists for comparison, but the 170 BBB complaints over three years sits in notable tension with a 4.7 Google rating across 7,145 reviews — worth checking BBB complaint details before calling for a high-cost job.
