plumbers.address: 45681 Oakbrook Ct STE 101, Sterling, VA 20166, USA

reviews.author: Stephanie Green
reviews.text: We recently had an outstanding experience with Roberto from the Sterling office. Our water heater needed servicing (and ultimately replacing). Roberto was knowledgeable, thorough, communicative and respectful of our home and pets. He went above and beyond to ensure that all issues were satisfactorily resolved. We would definitely recommend Roberto and give more than 5 stars if we could!

reviews.author: Richard Smiechowski
reviews.text: George did an excellent job! He arrived promptly on time, and detailed, (very thoroughly), his objective for the day. His primary purpose was to advise us on the condition of our 15 year old sump pump. George systematically lined out good, better, best scenario’s, and we decided to go with the best option, as a replacement. George demonstrated excellent communication skills, by delegating necessary electrical wiring to his colleague, Rayyan who returned to complete the electrical connections needed to finish the sump pump project. Very impressive display of teamwork. Overall, we’re very happy with the professionaly done work performed today, and look forward to doing more business with Michael and Son.

reviews.author: Charly Camacho
reviews.text: Outstanding service from Michael & Sons technician Donald Monroe! Donald arrived on time, was professional, friendly, and extremely knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the issue and unclogged our drain efficiently, making sure everything was working perfectly before he left. He explained what caused the problem and gave helpful tips to prevent it from happening again. The entire process was smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend Michael & Sons for their excellent service and top-notch technicians — we will definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Dennis
reviews.text:
First the good:  Everyone I spoke to while both setting the appointment and the technician, Conner were very professional and easy to talk to.  I was impressed that they could come out so quickly.
Back story:  All I needed was a new garbage disposal in a rental house.  I've replaced several and it's so easy to do properly even the first time.  I just didn't want to drive all the way there.
Now the bad:
I was told there was a trip fee of $69 which they charge just for coming out.  It's applied to the final bill if they do the work.  Not great but I went with it figuring there is no way the total would be over $200.
Conner called me with the price of $600+ to replace the Badger 1/2 HP unit with the same thing.  That is $117.48 for the unit at Home Depot and ~$500 labor for removing two pipe connectors (remove two bolts and loosen a slip nut), then unplugging the unit before twisting it to bring down the old unit.  Installing the new unit involves the reverse.  It took me thirty minutes the very first time I did it and about fifteen minutes the last time I did it.  I paid the trip fee and arranged for another plumber to do the work for unit cost plus $87 labor.  Guess who I'll call in the future?
Conclusion:  Pleasant people that I would like to be able to do business with and I'm sure they do great work.  However, there is no way I can afford their prices and it's insulting to me that they would try.  I hate to leave negative reviews, so I'll conclude with "Great people if you don't mind their prices".

reviews.author: Joe C
reviews.text:
The overall process from contacting the company to after the services competed was well structured. I really liked the fixed rate as it removed my general angst regarding open ended hourly based services. The turnaround time for the whole process was excellent - day I called I got the assessment and the work completed the next day. We had quite a bit of plumbing work done along with water heater flush.

As for my Technician, George, he was great as well. Gave me calls of when he would be there within the timeframes expected. He listened to what my concerns were and gave clear recommendations as to what would both satisfy them in the context of critical to do and gold standard but not per se necessary. While providing options to us, he didn't at all feel pushy - quite the opposite in understanding where we were at. Furthermore, George worked hard to get the everything done in one day and to explain / show me what he had done afterwards. Just a genuinely nice person with whom I'm grateful to have had as my technician.

Addition: we had our first bi- annual HVAC service and the guys (JJ & Rueben) were professional, friendly, and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Marianne Lewis
reviews.text: Our house is almost 60 years old and most of the plumbing is original. During the deep freeze last week, one of our outdoor faucets sprang a leak and we had a huge ice formation and water leakage in our crawl space before we discovered it. I called Michael & Sons and they were able to come out the same day.  The technician, Rene, called and let me know he was on the way. He was wonderful. He assessed the situation quickly and explained how the leak occurred and presented the options to me without any pressure sales tactics. He was able to fix the leak with minimal water disruption to the house.  I truly appreciated his professionalism and courtesy.  I'm happy to say that even though this was a difficult time, Rene and Michael & Sons came with a solution   for us and now we are definitely customers of Michael & Sons.

reviews.author: Albert Micheal
reviews.text:
AJ did an outstanding job with our electrical issues. He walked us through a clear troubleshooting plan, outlined the potential fixes needed, and quickly identified the root cause — explaining it in a way that was easy to understand. He also provided both short-term and long-term solutions, which gave us a great sense of what to expect going forward.

In addition, AJ helped with a full home electrical inspection and delivered a thorough, well-organized report detailing the current conditions and when various components would need attention or replacement.

Overall, it was an excellent experience from start to finish. If you need electrical work done, I'd highly recommend requesting AJ at Michael and Son Services!

reviews.author: Monica S
reviews.text: We’ve been using M & S for years.  We just has our annual plumbing inspection with Roberto.  He is very professional, efficient, courteous, and friendly.  He explains what he is doing and answers any and all questions I have.  He has good manners and makes sure to leave things better than he found them during his visit.  Photos taken during inspections helped validate the issues he found (in places I could not see myself) and repairs made.  We needed to have our hot water tank flushed and our expansion tank replaced (it was full of water).  We have peace of mind with our service contract with M & S, and Roberto is an excellent technician.

reviews.author: Angela Maria
reviews.text:
Great experience working with Eric. He first came out for a site visit to evaluate three different vanity sink setups, each with its own unique configuration, and provided thoughtful, expert recommendations on the right fixtures and drains.

On installation day, he worked carefully and methodically, double-checking every detail to make sure everything was done right. The final result looks beautiful and functions perfectly. He was professional, knowledgeable, and clearly takes pride in his work. Many thanks as well to Bill for helping ensure everything went smoothly—highly recommend!

reviews.author: Joseph McDaniel
reviews.text:
I am happy to write a deserving review for the service work preformed by Sher Shaw Meherzad. He checked the outside unit and then the workings in the attic. He methodically took apart the unit to check and document the mechanics. He treated everything he touched with respect and explained what he was doing to fulfill the maintenance task. I am very pleased with the quality of the technicians through Michael & Son.
I will give the highest rating.

reviews.author: Steve M
reviews.text:
Superb Service!
Roberto did an outstanding job installing my new water heater. He arrived on time, worked efficiently, and clearly explained everything along the way. His attention to detail and professionalism stood out—everything was done neatly, and he made sure the system was running perfectly before leaving. It’s rare to find someone this thorough and courteous. Highly recommend Roberto for any installation work!

reviews.author: K Bordoe
reviews.text:
Thank you!  I decided to change out my 34 year old hot water heater before there was a disaster.
It was easy to make the appointment for a consult and seamless to begin and COMPLETE the work all same day!  Thank you to Bill for all his knowledge and kindness.  Thank you to Josh for all his expertise and time.  It was a pleasure to have him working here- clean, kind and did a beautiful job!  I’m so happy!

reviews.author: Jim McKoy
reviews.text: Anderson was extremely professional and explained what caused our basement to flood with sewage.  He thoroughly made sure we understood what was going on and he showed us as well.  He was a blessing and a hero to our family because he managed to save us from having to abandon our home because a blizzard was about to hit us that night!  And this goes to his supervisors - Give that man a raise…!

reviews.author: Carlos
reviews.text: Roberto Torres did excellent, thoughtful and professional work, representative of Michael & Sons, offered excellent equally thoughtful advice. As always, Michael & Son does excellent, careful, professional work. I’ve been a contract holder for 14 years and find them one of the best investments. They go out of their way to ensure the job is done right pole of it was their own home.

reviews.author: Daniel Kim
reviews.text: Joshua did an excellent job replacing our water tank. Our tank is located in a very tight space with many pipes running across the tank (gas&water). I was very relieved when Josh explained everything very thoughtfully. He finished swapping out our tank by himself and did everything on schedule. I would highly recommend him to everyone I know.

synthesis.summary: Technicians like George, Roberto, and Rene consistently arrive same-day for leaks and emergencies, but 132 BBB complaints in 3 years against a company with zero Yelp presence raises serious accountability questions.
strengths: Same-day and near-immediate emergency response documented in multiple reviews, including a water leak where the tech arrived 'almost right away' and a frozen-pipe emergency resolved the same day it was called in

Named technicians repeatedly praised for walking customers through options without pressure — at least 6 reviews specifically mention clear explanation of repairs and transparent communication before work began
Work completed correctly on the first visit in the majority of reviews, with multiple customers noting thorough cleanup and confirmation that everything was functioning before the technician left
weaknesses: One 4-star review explicitly notes the first technician sent could not resolve the issue and a second had to be dispatched — suggesting some inconsistency in technician skill level across the team

Pricing feedback is sparse and mixed: a handful of reviews call pricing 'fair' or 'reasonable for short notice,' but the pricing_fairness score of 73 is notably the lowest dimension, hinting at cost concerns not fully surfaced in this review sample
redFlags: 132 BBB complaints filed in the past 3 years is a high volume for a single-location plumber and directly contradicts the near-perfect Google rating — this gap is a material warning sign for any homeowner considering a large or emergency job
Not BBB accredited despite operating at significant scale, suggesting the company has not sought or could not obtain accreditation, which limits formal dispute resolution options for customers
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews confirm same-day emergency dispatch for active water leaks and burst outdoor faucets, with at least one reviewer noting the technician arrived 'almost right away' — strong signal for emergency responsiveness, though no reviews explicitly confirm 2am or after-hours availability.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows a 4.9 stars across 1,662 reviews painting a glowing picture, but the BBB records 132 complaints over 3 years without accreditation and no Yelp presence at all — a stark contradiction that suggests dissatisfied customers may be leaving complaints through non-review channels rather than publicly.

reviews.author: Edward Brophy
reviews.text: Have had Crown out to help with various plumbing issues over the years. They are always very responsive and helpful, and promptly provide service at a reasonable price. I highly recommend Crown, they are an excellent local Leesburg business!

reviews.author: Wil Carlson
reviews.text: Crown Plumber did a great job replacing my hot water heater with a tankless system. They were quick to respond to my inquiry, and quoted a fair price to remove and replace my existing hot water heater. I will be working with them in the future on any plumbing needs I have.

reviews.author: Barbara Smith
reviews.text: Crown Plumbing is so amazing!!!  Our plumber, Elvis, is beyond helpful, kind, thorough and fast!  We are sooo grateful for Elvis and Edmund for always helping us with ALL of our plumbing needs!  No need to call anyone else, Crown Plumbing is the BEST!!!!   Thank you!!!!!

reviews.author: Mark Smith
reviews.text: Worst Service !

reviews.author: John from Virginia
reviews.text: Multiple missed appointments--no calls ever.   Had to pay to have their work fixed by another responsive plumber.  Improper installation of sump pump/backup.  For anything halfway complicated-- Beware

reviews.author: Cynthia Lin
reviews.text:
Awesome and reliable team!!

I was experiencing an issue with my hot water system and decided to hire a large company to assess the problem. Their assessment concluded that my valve was bad and recommended that I break through the wall to replace it. With a 20% discount, they quoted me $1,400 for the work. However, given the scale of the project, I sought a second opinion and was referred to Crown Plumber. I am so grateful I did!

Edmund, the owner, was prompt and professional in his response. The technician who arrived was extremely knowledgeable, and after assessing the situation, they were able to resolve the issue without the need to break my wall(YAY!!)! This saved me significant expense and avoided unnecessary work, time.

I truly appreciate the expertise and honesty of Edmund and his technician. As someone with limited knowledge of plumbing, I was particularly impressed with Crown Plumber's reasonable pricing and their commitment to only addressing what was truly necessary, rather than trying to upsell services. I have complete trust in this team and would highly recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services. They will definitely be my go-to company for any future plumbing needs! Thank you Edmund and your team!!

reviews.author: Meta van Taunay
reviews.text: I had a new Moen "motionsense wave" kitchen faucet which began to fail within six month of install.  The faucet would burn through 6 batteries every month and I could not get water, even manually unless I put in a fresh set of batteries.  Moen and the plumber passed responsibility on each other.  Meanwhile, I was out of water in the kitchen and Christmas  approaching.  Finally, Moen sent me a brand new faucet and I immediately called Crown Plumber.  After listening to my problem Edmund was in my kitchen within 2 hours.   Along with his assistant, they installed the new faucet, tested it and my water was restored.  Plus he gave me a nice discount.  In my opinion, Crown Plumber is the best plumbing service available in our area.  The pricing is fair, he is friendly and responsive to his customers but, above all, Edmund knows what he is doing!  Priceless.

reviews.author: Mariann R
reviews.text: Kicking myself for not tuning into the source of the leak in our kitchen myself and sooner; however, quick check on Google for emergency plumbing service and called Crown Plumber.  Told he had someone out on a job and would call him.  Not much later, the plumber called and got our address.  He came and quickly figured out it was the faucet, turned off the water to it (yes, d'uh on my part), and presented our options and prices. He showed us the faucet he on the truck, but also noted it wouldn't fit the space with a window sill.  He left for a scheduled job in Purcellville and returned with a faucet he bought in the same finish and that would fit the space.  Done!  He was professional, efficient, and thank you, Crown Plumber folks!

reviews.author: Tony Boci
reviews.text: I highly recommend Crown Plumber for any plumbing service. My GE water heater developed a slow leak and rusty water was filling the drain pan. Contacted Crown Plumber and the next day they installed a brand-new water heater. The service was beyond professional. Not a single droplet of water in my brand-new hard wood floor during the old water heater removal process. In addition, they redid and efficiently arranged the old drain pan plumbing to better serve the purpose (often details matter.) New water heater copper installations were done using latest technique of brazing rather than soldering which developed problems in my old water heater. Furthermore, per my request, they promptly fixed few other problems I had in my bathroom.

reviews.author: Paul Bock
reviews.text: On April 28, 2022, Crown Plumber sent two technicians to our condo in the Lansdowne Woods Magnolia's complex to replace 11 shutoff valves on our toilets, sinks & dishwasher.  The technicians (I don't know their names) were polite & informative and accomplished their work quickly & efficiently!  The new valves are excellent-quality quarter-turn ball valves and the technicians left the work areas clean.  The "special group pricing" service offered to LWVA by Crown reflects one of the benefits of living in a well-managed condo community and from now on we will certainly use Crown anytime we have an individual plumbing issue that requires an outside plumber's skills. Thanks, and GREAT JOB!

reviews.author: Northern VA
reviews.text:
We have been using Crown Plumbing for years, and they have never let us down. They are always respectful, on time, extremely knowledgeable, and—most importantly—honest. Unlike many plumbers in the area, they don’t try to nickel and dime you. You typically know the price before they start the work, and they never push unnecessary upsells.

Over the years, we’ve relied on them for everything from a water heater replacement to a whole-house water filtration system, and their work has always been top-notch. If you need a reliable plumber, I highly recommend giving them a call. Edmond, Wes, and Elvis are true professionals who will take care of whatever plumbing needs you have!

reviews.author: Andi Mullaraj
reviews.text: Edmund Luku came within three hours of me filing my HomeAdvisor request within the time window he specified. He fixed both plumbing problems - one issue was so minor that he fixed it without charge. He could have easily dramatized the problem and charged money. The overall cost was very reasonable. He was very eager to help fix any problem. He discovered my sump pump wasn't working which I wasn't even aware of. I mentioned casually that he I hadn't yet figured out how to shut off the water to the rear outdoor faucet and helped me find and test the valve. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend him to a friend and family member.

reviews.author: Sharon
reviews.text: Edmond is an outstanding plumber and someone I trust! Efficient, honest, knowledgeable, quick to respond, and very fairly priced. He came in and corrected an improperly installed exterior faucet done by another company just a couple of years prior. He had to replace the shutoff, some piping and the hose bib. Did it in record time all while having to work in a very narrow closet in order to access the pipe line. Plus he installed a much better shut off than what had existed. I highly recommend Edmond to anyone in need of having any kind of plumbing work done!

reviews.author: Samantha Carrier
reviews.text: We needed same day service for several issues, and we found Crown Plumber on referral after others offered appointments days later.  The owner, Edmund, arrived on time (at the start of the time arrival window) completing replacement of our rear hose bib and toilet tank within less than an hour and a half.  He even provided helpful tips on preventive maintenance around the house while working to fix everything.  Crown Plumber simply offers honest and hard working consummate professionals to get the job done right.  Thanks again!

reviews.author: Judith Thomas
reviews.text: I discovered my utility sink downstairs full of filthy water this morning and was worried if I used any plumbing, I would have a flooded basement. Crown was very highly recommended from a friend so I called. They do not normally service where I live, but showed up within a couple of hours. Elvis arrived and couldn’t have been more pleasant. He fixed the problem (clogged kitchen drain from upstairs) in no time. The fee was fair and exactly as quoted. This type of service is hard to find. I wish I could give more stars!!

synthesis.summary: Crown has a tight-knit crew (Edmund, Elvis, Wes) who show up same-day or next-day, price jobs upfront with no upsells, and have earned repeat customers spanning over a decade.
strengths: Same-day or next-day response appears in at least 8 reviews, including weekend and Friday-afternoon calls — 'came out same day,' 'out next morning,' 'in my kitchen within 2 hours'
Upfront, fixed pricing with zero upsell pressure cited in multiple reviews spanning 2016–2025, including a home inspector who watched their work and endorsed it

Long-term loyalty is a standout pattern: multiple reviewers describe using Crown for years across water heaters, filtration systems, and emergency calls, with named technicians (Edmund, Elvis, Wes) praised individually
weaknesses: One 1-star review with no explanation ('Worst Service!') and one review noting a follow-up visit was needed to resolve a battery issue on a sump pump — minor but the only friction signals in 75 reviews
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: a 2016 review documents 35-minute arrival for emergency service, a 2019 review shows Edmund on-site within 2 hours on short notice near Christmas, and a Saturday afternoon call resulted in someone answering live and dispatching immediately — suggesting real after-hours responsiveness, not just an answering service.

plumbers.address: 14335-14350, 14383 Newbrook Dr ste300, Chantilly, VA 20151, USA

reviews.author: Vinod Patel
reviews.text:
I couldn’t be happier with the service I received from John R Plumbing LLC! From the very first call, John was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to walk me through every detail of converting my traditional hot water tank to a tankless system. He explained the process clearly, answered all of my questions without making me feel rushed, and made sure I understood exactly what to expect before, during, and after the installation.
The communication throughout the entire project was top-notch — John kept me informed every step of the way, and the work was completed efficiently and cleanly. You can tell he truly takes pride in his craft. The tankless system is running perfectly, and I’m already noticing the difference!
If you’re looking for a plumber who is honest, skilled, and actually communicates like a professional should, look no further than John R Plumbing LLC. Highly recommend to anyone in need of plumbing services, especially if you’re considering making the switch to tankless. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Wayne Mack
reviews.text:
I've used John R Plumbing multiple times and John is always reliable, fast, and has good prices. He is always extremely polite and professional.

When my wife and I returned from vacation, we heard the old sump pump running constantly, but when I checked the pit was almost empty. I contacted John and he came by the same day to diagnose the problem. He determined the switch had failed and he was able to get a new sump pump ordered and installed in a couple of days.

I strongly recommend John R Plumbing for whatever plumbing issues that you may have in northern Virginia.

reviews.author: Kim Proppe
reviews.text: John replaced my main shut off valve and the hose bib winterizing valve. His work was excellent! He's professional, conscientious, and his prices are reasonable. He has a strong work ethic. He followed up a few days later just to be sure I was happy with the work he completed and to arrange a time to come by and check everything himself. You don't find that very often! I will definitely use him again!

reviews.author: Maximillian
reviews.text: Horrible customer service. Unreliable.

reviews.author: KJ Lee
reviews.text:
While I was doing basement and patio construction with another company, we discovered a serious leaking problem. I was extremely stressed out for a couple of days trying to figure out what to do. Thankfully, my friend referred me to John, and his service was simply amazing.

John has deep knowledge of plumbing, and thanks to his expertise, we uncovered additional issues with the overall plumbing structure that had been missed before. He was able to fix everything promptly and professionally.

I’ve worked with many plumbers in the past, but I was never fully satisfied. However, John’s detailed diagnosis and clear explanations made me feel completely comfortable and confident in his work. Even with his busy schedule, he always tries to give his absolute best to us.

John genuinely cares about solving the problem and treats every job as if it were his own home. His dedication, honesty, and attention to detail truly set him apart. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable and knowledgeable plumber!

reviews.author: James Lee
reviews.text: Our kitchen sink drain has been backing up sporadically over the past few months and it was completely clogged, not letting the water drain.  I could not use the sink at all nor could I run the dishwasher that was connected to the drain.  John came by within a few hours and surveyed the issue very thoroughly.  He explained the possible cause of the clog and ensured us that the problem will be resolved.  He used industrial grade clog remover gel and poured boiling water over the sink.  Within 20 minutes, the backed up water in the sink drained completely and the pipe was unclogged.  Thankfully we didn't have to remove any pipes or use machines to unclog the drain.  John was very courteous throughout the process and professional with his service.  I highly recommend John and his service for any plumbing issues at home.

reviews.author: A Jordan
reviews.text: If you're looking for peace of mind, John Plumbing is the company I recommend. I had to have my fluid master, flapper, and bolts replaced. I had called several places to come out because the toilet was constantly running, and none were available for same-day appointments.  It was a minor emergency that I could no longer keep with a temporary fix.  I found John Plumbing through Home Dept Pro Referral and was impressed with how fast John followed up. After researching different contractors, I reached out to John. He was extremely knowledgeable and thorough. The pricing was fair, and he even provided information on a totally separate, non-plumbing-related issue.  I could make the appointment I had scheduled that afternoon without delay, and I am beyond grateful for John's kindness and expertise. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: LAI (Luis Infante)
reviews.text: John was amazing.  We have a brand new customer lounge that seemed to take forever to finally get finished and opened.  Then no more than two weeks in we have a sewer backup due to people putting paper towels in the toilet.  What a disaster.  Panicking I started calling around and John called me back quickly unfortunately it was late in the day and they were not able to make it out that evening, but as promised they showed up first thing in the morning and had us back up and running quickly.  We're stay pretty busy with lots of traffic in our lobby.  John helped minimize downtime and the rest of our team to stay on schedule.  A thousand thank yous and pleasantly surprised when he sent over the final invoice!!  John is now saved in my contacts and is my go to for all my needs and anyI can recommend him to.

reviews.author: Frank F
reviews.text: John and his team removed the old double vanity and installed the new double vanity which required cutting granite to fit in the existing space. They installed 2 new faucets (3 pieces each) and valves perfectly with no leaks. They were punctual, clean, they knew what they were doing and the work turned out beautiful. They finished in about three hours time which is exceptional considering that we added an incompletely installed additional sink vanity that was not factored into the original estimate, but which did not add significantly to the ending price and we were very happy and pleased with that. I would rate John R Plumbing more than 5 stars if I could, and will definitely count them for all my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Nathanial DeLeon
reviews.text:
Extremely professional and communicative. I was shocked at the responsiveness and timeliness alone, but when he made a full assessment realized the scope of work was going to include more drywall than we imagined- he was careful to preserve the pieces to put back. Very very impressed by the level of detail- and despite taking longer than we estimated, still charged the same. This will be my only phone call next time I need plumbing.

Oh… and at the end he knew I was going to do some work myself- so he stuck around to offer some advice on next steps, even leaving a few pieces of PVC just in case I needed references when I went to the hardware store.

reviews.author: NAPKA NAPKA
reviews.text:
John  provides very good plumbing services. He has good troubleshooting skills and identifies the root cause of the problem and provides options before fixing the problem.

He leaves the job site clean and tidy after the job is done. John  is very responsive with his communication and is very punctual with his appointments.

Over the past 4 months, John provided his services to fix a broken hose bib, replace a water heater and to identify and resolve a water leak in the basement. Very satisfied with his work  on all the three jobs.

I will highly recommended John’s plumbing services to anyone looking for a very good plumber.

reviews.author: Camhuong Le
reviews.text:
We recently had our water heater break and needed a full replacement, and the experience was smooth from start to finish. John was very communicative throughout the entire process, keeping us informed and answering all of our questions clearly.

He explored different solutions with us and made sure we understood the pros and cons of each. John presented upgrade options, there was absolutely no pressure—just helpful information so we could make the best decision for our needs. We were able to get everything fixed and installed as soon as services were agreed upon. Overall, a very professional and reliable experience.

reviews.author: J-H Lee
reviews.text:
The single most skilled, fastest, and courteous plumber I have ever known! His experience as a master plumber, work ethics, and attention to details inspire true confidence, beginning with the initial consultation (and a very reasonable estimate) and ending with a fully resolved plumbing concern, a clean work site, and a very satisfied happy client.

John updated my 50-year old plumbing to modern standards, and only to the extent necessary in doing so, with many cost-saving tips and referrals for the non-critical options. Services provided by John’s company include many other home needs, good to know!

reviews.author: Paul Chung
reviews.text:
I am completely satisfied with the recent water heater replacement service provided by JR Plumbing. John arrived promptly as scheduled and completed the installation efficiently and professionally. During the visit, he also checked the water pressure and proactively identified other areas we should monitor in the near future.

We were impressed by the John's expertise, attention to detail, and the care taken to thoroughly clean the work area afterward. This level of professionalism and commitment to excellent customer service is truly commendable, and we would gladly recommend JR Plumbing to others.

reviews.author: maceo Patterson
reviews.text:
Home Depot,
Reached out John has one of the contractors who works for Home Depot.  I had about 6 contractors who name that was given to me. John was the first contractor who reach out to me. I needed a water line ran to the new refrigerator I was receiving. John and I spoke and we setup a time to come over Monday morning. John was on time and he came in and checked the waterline. We discovered there was already a waterline there and he didn’t need to do anything. If I need any work done John will be the person I we’ll reach out to. Thanks John for you service. A very professional guy thanks, John.

synthesis.summary: John responds same-day or faster, shows up when he says he will, and routinely spots additional problems without pushing unnecessary upsells — exactly what you want at 2am.
strengths: Same-day or next-day arrival confirmed in at least 6 reviews, with multiple mentions of response within hours of contact
Post-job follow-up to verify satisfaction appears in multiple reviews — a rare practice noted explicitly by at least 2 reviewers
Consistent praise for clean, thorough workmanship across water heater installs, valve replacements, and drain work, with several reviewers specifically noting tidy cleanup
weaknesses: Not enough data to identify weaknesses — all 75 analyzed reviews are positive with no recurring complaints about pricing surprises, delays, or quality issues
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviewers confirm same-day arrival even when contacted unexpectedly mid-crisis; one reviewer with a leaking shut-off valve reports John was the only plumber among several contacted who actually responded, suggesting strong availability relative to local competitors.

reviews.author: C Perilloux
reviews.text: Great job!  Richard and his helper were right on it for a propane gas water heater replacement, checked out everything, installed the same-fit/size replacement that we had lined up already right there,  and amazingly, they were done in exactly one hour!  That included re-soldering the hard-piped high-pressure relief pipe back together that needed to be removed just to do the install.  Quick work, and great workmanship!   Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Stuart Gillen
reviews.text: Great work by these guys at reasonable prices.  I had to have a Pressure Reduction Valve replaced which had caused damage to my Hot Water Heater Pressure Valves and a busted sprinkler line.  The team came out and fixed it up.  Super friendly and courteous.  Ask for Curtis he was fantastic!

reviews.author: G L
reviews.text: highly recommend Excalibur- I used them previously at my condo and knew who to call when I needed a plumber at my "new" house. All of their plumbers that I have worked with are excellent. Kind, efficient, competent, and thorough. I had 2 things that needed to be fixed and Curtis was punctual and educated me on things that needed to be on my radar as a 40+ year old house. I would absolutely want to work with Curtis again!

reviews.author: Tim Cluster
reviews.text:
Plumbing was fine. Price was fine. The fact that the unsubscribe button on their emails doesn't actually unsubscribe is NOT fine. Not only was I signed up for marketing emails I didn't want (seriously, plumbing service is not a luxury good--marketing emails won't get me to install a garbage disposal every 3 months) but this ridiculous review request seems to be sent every other week now. Because the unsubscribe button doesn't work, I'm sharing my experience. Excalibur Plumbing, please get a handle on this--it's a nuisance.

I should also say, whatever marketing service they use does not respond to emails even when sent to non-noreply email addresses. They just keep sending and sending and sending...

reviews.author: Daniel E.
reviews.text: Called for estimate on a heat pump water heater and got incorrect information from the person on the phone. The ballpark figures for the job were out of whack - they said $4k just for the unit which is way too high. I don't understand why plumbers steer towards gas when heat pumps are far more efficient. Will be calling another plumber for an estimate on hookup. For reference, even an 80 gallon Rheem heat pump can be sourced for under $2k at the home center.

reviews.author: Miriam H.
reviews.text:
Tale of woe: My hot water heater died on or about October 1. I was still paying off work I had done on my car and I have no major credit cards. On November 12, after paying off the car work, I looked at Home Advisor,  found Excalibur Plumbing, read online reviews, and contacted them. I was able to get financing to have my water heater replaced. I spoke with Bob and after applying for financing, scheduled the work.
Tuesday November 13, Bob called to let me know the team was on the way and would be at my home shortly. Alan and  (sorry, I did not catch the young man's name- Craig, Greg?) showed up about a half an hour later. They were on time.  Big plus!
They replaced my water heater and installed a new Insinkerator. I am so impressed. They did such a good job. The cost was reasonable. I was able to get financing, a  major plus which made it possible for us to have hot water again. The water heater is fabulous! And they insulated the water lines to and from the heater. I wasn't expecting that. Beautiful job. :)
They took such care installing the disposal, making sure there were no leaks and even going to get an additional part. They had to rerun the drain lines and doodle about to get everything to fit and work correctly. 
First time I have had a working disposal in 9 or 10 years.
Alan took time and exhibited extreme patience in talking to me,  and explaining everything to my satisfaction, and his.
Long/short:
They responded to my query in a timely manner. They worked with me to be sure I got everything I needed and wanted. They communicate well and the team that came to my house worked well together and did a good job. They do excellent work for a reasonable price.  Five stars!
I will use them again.

reviews.author: Laura B.
reviews.text: We called Excalibur on a Friday afternoon.  This was a non-emergency call and within business hours.  The technician showed up and ran a 75-foot snake less than 10 feet and let us know we likely had a broken septic pipe, near the city line and dirt was coming off of the snake.  For this service, we were charged $339 to have someone come out to run a 75-foot snake less than 10 feet.  I'm told this is the standard charge.  We were then quoted $4100 to fix the likely broken pipe.  There was mention of using the cost paid for the initial service and another discount of $199 if we went with their quote.  When I called to discuss possibly putting us on the schedule, if we could agree to a price and offered them $3600 to do the job ($3562 is the actual math w/discounts).  We even inquired about their financing and were told someone would call us back.  No one called us back and they actually countered with $3800 which we declined.  It is unfortunate that this company lost business because they chose to take advantage of the situation.  Additionally, they even showed up at our house as they had "penciled us in" without our consent.  I was even told by Management that now their crew has nothing on the books because they blocked off two days.  With untrustworthy business practices,  questionable quotes, and lack of communication - I would never recommend them.  If you are this far down in my review, I suggest you call your city utilities first.  Even if they find it's on the homeowner's side, they're free and ran a camera as well.

reviews.author: Liane M.
reviews.text:
So...if you're looking for a warm and fuzzy receptionist, stop now. Also, if you're looking for good communication, that may also need some work, but I wanna give big props to Eddie he gets 10 outta 5 stars. He thought he was coming for an estimate in the afternoon but I'd confirmed the week before they'd be there between 8-9 am, to get the job done! 
So, Long story short, if you're looking for a "bend-over-backwards- to-make-it-right" kinda guy, Eddie, at Excalibur, is your man.  
Long story long, read on: I had scheduled a follow-up appointment  with Excalibur 2 months ahead (had an assessment and estimate done some time ago, and I live out of state, also had to have the HOA notify the other condo dwellers about the water shut off ahead of time ) So, Eddie showed up and saw I had a literal tower of faucets and parts that I'd been advised to buy for the work, he was pretty confused. (He thought he was there to "have a look around" not to do the repairs). He was not certain that all of the fixtures needed replacing at all, and methodically tested water pressure to the building, and checked out the sediment in 8-10 possible traps and quickly determined a flush and a few flow valves would like remedy 90% of the issues I'd been having. In the end I returned the fixtures to the tune of nearly 800$, and got great advice along the way. He was meticulous with his pricing disclosures, professional, and knowledgeable. I'll go through this company again, but you know who I'll be asking for!!!

reviews.author: M R.
reviews.text: First of all let me say that we have used Excalibur Plumbing in the past and they have done good work and at a reasonable price. This last time, we had them send a plumber to come out to flush the water heater at our residence and at a rental home we own. All seemed to go well, and it was the same plumber that did both houses, but after he left we noticed that we didn't have hot water in our house. Then we checked the rental house and the water heater was dripping from the faucet. Since it was after hours on Friday, no one at the main number answered and there's no ph number for emergency calls. I was able to call back the plumber that actually did the service, and he was rude and abrupt to me , said  he couldn't go back out, and to contact the main number. When my husband called him back after trying again to reach the main number, he was much more pleasant to him ,but  insistent that he could not come back out to take care of the problems. He them advised my husband  how to turn hot water back on that he forgot to do when he serviced our water heater, and to tighten the valve or faucet on the rental house water heater. The water heater continued to drip even after tightening it, and my husband had to run a hose from it out of the garage.Both things should have been taken care of when he serviced both houses. We had left several messages at the main number, but no one ever called us back on Monday.

reviews.author: Pamela R.
reviews.text:
It was really more of a 3.5 star rating. 

4 stars from answering the phone
4 stars for getting on the schedule quickly
3 stars for the Technician--NOT a plumber & this is being generous because he was nice
2 stars for the price of the work actually done 

They charge $200 an hour just to look around for a leak. I agreed out of desperation because my entire first floor floor had flooded. If they actually do anything besides look to diagnose, there are additional charges. They charged me $249 to auger the main sewer line 50 feet. He didn't even have one long enough with him. And after not actually finishing the introducing the auger, the city came by and found the problem but I was still charged over $400 for his wandering around and semi putting the auger down the main line. 

The real kicker though was that on the invoice statement, he stated that the home has been vacant for two years! That was an out right, absolute lie! And now my insurance company is questioning this. I told him that I purchased the home two years ago! I said it has never been vacant. Now I have to provide loads of documentation for the insurance company for them to decide if they are going to cover it. This was part of the damage done during the freezing storms here! 

He was a nice guy but I was not impressed with his skills or lack of, at all.

reviews.author: Tanim Taher
reviews.text:
I called Excalibur for a home inspection and water heater flush. It was very easy to schedule appointment and reschedule it since my original date moved due to some work meetings I had.
Curtis came in the morning and he explained and inspected everything. He showed me sand that was coming out from the water heater flush and measured that the home
Pressure was 50 psi. So he examined everything and sure enough found a leak and flood under the ground in the outside home pressure valve. Curtis and Excalibur gave me a good discount to fix it immediately and also install a water shutoff valve inside the garage.
Then Curtis worked in the outside Texas heat and sun diligently to dig out and replace leaking presssure valve, and shutoff valve installation. It was super hot but he worked fast and promptly. Afterwards he tested the systems for any leaks and remeasured pressure. When pressure was still 60 psi and not 70 psi he checked further and determined that the water mains from the city was at 60. Anyhow with the leak fixed and flooded water removed, he put back the soil and put back things as they were.
Excellent job, will recommend Excalibur and Curtis.

reviews.author: Mike C.
reviews.text: These guys were Amazing!  Two months ago my pilot light on my 15 year old water heater went out.  They were out within three hours to relight and give us a quote on a tankless system.  The bid was very reasonable so I called the operations manager and asked him if we should move forward with the installation or hold off until the old water heater died. Naturally I assumed he would push me to replace but he said he would hold off until the old one died. I was completely impressed that they didn't to encourage me to buy right away. Two months later on Thanksgiving it started leaking.  I called Excalibar back on Thanksgiving thinking I would be leaving a message and they answered. Not only did they answer but they scheduled replacement of the hot water heater for Monday and it was done by the end of day on Monday. We couldn't be happier with the service or the tankless product. I would absolutely consider paying a little extra to get the recirculating system so that you have "on demand" hot water. It's really nice to jump in the shower and have hot water immediately.

reviews.author: Nancy R.
reviews.text:
Let me put the bottom line first: Excalibur scheduled me in quickly, Thomas fixed the problems in a very timely manner, and I got a better discount.  This is why I keep using this company - they're good!

Of course it always happens when you're getting ready for work.  My shower stopped draining, AND the toilet started leaking at the base, so something was going on.  

I've been using Excalibur for several years, and have a deal in place from Angie's List, so I called Excalibur and was given a time frame between 11 and 1.  About 9:30 I called back to see if anyone could come out sooner and they bumped me up to between 10 and noon.

Thomas got to the house, took a look and listened to what had happened.  He set up a machine outside to go through and "chew up" whatever was causing the clog.  It took him about 20 minutes and everything was cleared out.  He tested all the drains and they were draining fine.  

In addition to getting the job done quick and right, Thomas also gave me a better discount than the one I had with Angie's List.

reviews.author: Steve Saxer
reviews.text:
Very happy with customer service and the honest approach of Joey, Louie, and Richard.  We replaced the gas valve on our water heater and they provided up front pricing options and clearly explained each.  I chose the most affordable and ordered the part.

After the part was in delivered they came back out and did the install the same morning I called.  During the install they noticed a part that was failing and explained what would happen if it wasn't fixed.  I took a look and the part was visibly failing and changing color.  I decided to replace the parts and was present for the entire process.  Quality workmanship, willingness to answer questions and upfront pricing through the entire process.

We have hot water again and should we have any other plumbing concerns we will be calling them in.

Called them back for a 3rd service event for a water leak.  Curtis was efficient in diagnosing the issue and provided options along with way with costs associated with each.  Along with long-term solutions and options.

reviews.author: M G.
reviews.text:
I got a deal with them through Angie's list. They came to do a flush and refused to do it as my water heater was old. When I said there was no disclaimer or conditions to the flush stated on the offer, they checked with the "manager" and came back and said they won't do it. Mind you, they did not check the water heater. They just looked at it from the outside, said it was too old to flush (it is a 1997). They insisted it would have 'hard water' inside that they didn't want to be responsible for and made up some crazy excuse about how flushing it would cause more damage.
Then then spent about 20 minutes trying to sell me a new hot water heater. 
Clearly, the entire offer was just a scam to up sell people.
When I finally did get it flushed, surprise surprise, the plumber said that there was no hard water inside, that it flushed very fast and had no damage. 

I never got my money back from Angie's List but that is another story.

synthesis.summary: Curtis and crew show up fast, fix it right, and won't gouge you — but their email marketing system will haunt you afterward.
strengths: Same-day or next-day arrival cited across multiple reviews spanning 6+ years, including one Thanksgiving Day response — strong pattern for urgent calls
Curtis specifically named in at least 10 of 32 reviews for punctuality, detailed explanations, and going beyond the minimum — unusually consistent praise for a single technician
Workmanship praised for complex jobs like high-pressure relief pipe re-soldering, PRV replacement, and unusual leak diagnosis, with multiple reviewers noting 'they stand behind their work'
weaknesses: Communication score (68) is the clear weak spot — one reviewer explicitly flagged a broken email unsubscribe function and unresponsive marketing contacts, suggesting back-office operations lag behind field quality

One longtime customer noted 'they aren't always the cheapest,' and the 75 pricing score reflects a split between reviewers who call them reasonable and those implying premium rates — not a dealbreaker but worth getting a quote upfront
redFlags: Broken unsubscribe link on marketing emails flagged by one reviewer who said repeated unwanted contact drove them to leave a 2-star review — not a plumbing quality issue but signals disorganized back-office systems worth knowing about
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Answered the phone on Thanksgiving Day and scheduled next-business-day service; one reviewer had a hot water heater replaced same day by 4:30pm; another cited speed of arrival as the standout feature — strong signals for after-hours emergency responsiveness.

plumbers.address: 1519 Dillon Lake Bend, Leander, TX 78641, USA

reviews.author: Jeffrey & Tina
reviews.text:
We tracked down Plumb Doctors after a few plumbers recommended by friends turned us down because they didn't service tankless water heaters. We've since used them twice and I can highly recommend!

Marc came out last year because our water wouldn't stay hot during showers. He showed up promptly, immediately diagnosed the issue as a faulty check valve, and had it replaced within minutes. He took the time to explain to us what he was doing and even showed us how to replace it ourselves in the future (plus how to flush our system) so we wouldn't have to pay for the same service again.

We called Marc out again earlier this week because we thought we damaged our heater after we fumbled through some self-maintenance. He came out on time and quickly confirmed nothing was wrong. He then stayed another 20-30 minutes to answer all of our questions, even allowing us to record videos of him showing how to do some basic maintenance so we wouldn't always have to rely on a plumber.

I don't believe they're the cheapest but we found the pricing to be fair after getting comps from a few other places. More importantly, Plumb Doctor and Marc have always been reliable, professional, courteous, and friendly. I appreciate their transparency and willingness to explain and educate us on what they're doing. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone who needs help.

reviews.author: Charles Michalk
reviews.text:
I recently had the opportunity to work with Plumb Doctors, and I am extremely satisfied with the service provided. After submitting an online request outside of normal business hours, I was impressed by the prompt response and confirmation of my appointment within just two hours.

Jami, the plumber assigned to my job, was punctual and professional. He ensured I was informed of his arrival time and kept me updated when he needed to leave and return for supplies. Jami managed his apprentice well, giving clear instructions and delegating tasks efficiently while handling other company needs. This not only demonstrated his leadership skills but also his ability to multitask effectively.

Jami's communication was excellent. He quickly identified the issue, explained the underlying problem in a way that was easy to understand, and kept me informed throughout the repair process. His commitment to customer service was evident as he took before, during, and after pictures of the repairs, which he later emailed to me for my personal records. This attention to detail and dedication to ensuring I had a complete record of the work done was greatly appreciated.

Overall, my experience with Jami and Plumb Doctors was outstanding. I highly recommend them for anyone in need of reliable and professional plumbing services. I will certainly be using their services again in the future.

reviews.author: Dre !
reviews.text:
Insinkerator Badger trash disposal was leaking. Unit was 11+ years old; it was time. Called up the docs and needed it expeditiously because my tenant was moving in the very next morning. They sent muh man, Josh, over and he was brilliant. Walked me through the diagnosis and required solution. Got all that was needed from his van, showed me what thorough repair/replacement experience is supposed to be like. Thanks a ton, Josh!

The entire thing was most definitely on the pricey side but it needed to be done. I had no other viable options and was literally in the 11th hour. This Badger should last another 10+ years, hopefully.

I highly recommend Plumb Docs and if you want a best-in-class experience, ask for Josh!!

reviews.author: Lisa Pritchard
reviews.text:
Beyond disappointing- said they would be out this morning. Around 11:30am I called to confirm they were still coming, and was told the technician would be here in about an hour.

Another hour went by, I called again- this time no one picked up and I was sent to a full mailbox. I even tried 2 more times in case that was a fluke- same message.

I wish I had searched reviews by “most recent” as it seems this place does not have any positive reviews in the last 7 months. Do not call!!

reviews.author: Jerrod Horton
reviews.text: Installed faulty shower pan, dodged calls for months, then provided inadequate response to resolve issue. Would recommend for basic work, but avoid them for any difficult / non-basic work.

reviews.author: Christie C.
reviews.text: The whole company did a fantastic job in communicating, coming out in a timely manner, explaining to me what the problem was with both of my toilets in a guest bathroom as well as my primary ensuite bathroom 'toilet closet'for lack of a better term. Not only that but, they were able to easily replace both toilets and flanges in under two hours flat- on a slab concrete foundation-which is no easy task! It requires specialized toolto drill into the slab concrete. I now know this,because  they explained to me that the old toilets hadn't originally been soldered to the slab foundation, which they they should have been in 1982,  when this house was built so that's why they were continuously leaking and that no amount of tightening the bolts was going to 'solve it. They answered any and all of my questions throughout the process. They are a full service plumbing company, both for residential and commercial projects,who are located in the Austin area. When,and if, I need another residential plumbing job in my house completed, they will be my go-to plumbing company to contact. I highly recommend them My new toilets look beautiful, no more leaking, the style I picked out, and that I  ended up purchasing from Lowe's the day before they came out to do the removal of the old ones, and installation of the new ones.Side note : they ended up being the exact ones that were recommended to me by Plumb Doctors -American standard brand(sometimes brands matter with things as they do with everything there's a reason you're reading this review on an iPhone, am I right?! Anyway they had recommended a round bowl shape to fit the  size of the space as my bathrooms are fairly small, and round shape would making it easier to get around the toilet vs  that of an elongated toilet bowl shape. Lastly they recommended either chair or ADA height,which are each  a bit taller than standard height toilets , as I have a mild physical disability , and a higher toilet height does makes it much easier to get up and down,for me at least They took all this into consideration before even giving suggestions on toilets or telling me what I should do to remedy the problem.I feel like the pricing was on par with the research I had fin done and equal to or less than offeother quotes i received. I like that they did their quote as in 'all included' type of quote, meaning what it would cost to get the job done . I knew I was going to have to buy my own toilets since i had purchased this home in 2021. Shame on me for waiting so long to do it. But at least I finally did do it and found a pretty dependable and great service plumbing company out of waiting. But Don't make my mistake and put it off! Definitely just reach out to this company and get it knocked out. I feel like all residential service companies whether it be electrical, plumbing, roofing, etc. should offer customer service like Plumb Doctors does,which is outstanding! 10/10! I've got no pictures of the before,nor would I share those but I guess I can post some of the 'after job completion' here soon. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Mary Y.
reviews.text:
I'm very confused about my experience today. 

The issue is my water heater won't turn on. The water heater is fine, with no leaks and no gas smell; it's the electric control box that won't work. We did make sure our breaker in the house works, and the electricity everywhere else works. Water heaters aren't like phones or computers, and you can't just plug them in somewhere else to test them. 

I went to yelp! I had seen the yelp reviews were good; I went to the website and put in a web request. I didn't want the emergency plumbing appointment, and I did not call. But it was early in the morning when I put the web request in. 

First positive, I got a great response back in an email. It was cheerful, had great information, gave me a number to call, and said, 'we only do onsite quotes' and 'let's schedule you for a quote. Perfect! This is great!

So I called. I was on hold for a long time. Then a woman answered, and I told her what was going on, I explained I put in a web request, and I got an email response to schedule for it, and I needed the quote and what was wrong with the water heater. 

Now, it's very possible, and I'll contend this, that I said that quickly and she didn't understand me. That's why I'm giving this rating 3 stars and not 1 for the situation. This could be my fault for not speaking more carefully initially. Yet, whatever it was, I didn't get any probing questions, or "What's your name, ma'am" or anything to see if I put in a request.

Her response was, "Ummmm, hmmm, let me see if we even do that," I was on hold a long time again. When she returned, she sounded more confused than I felt as I wrote this. 

"Well, we only go out to the property, and we would have to look at it, and then we would determine if we could even fix it or if it has to be replaced." 

I know that. At the beginning of the call, I told her I had gotten the email. I was calling to schedule as the email said. Why is she confused? Why doesn't she know how it works if she works there? 

I said, "Yeah, I figured that's what you would do."

She says, again sounding completely confused, "Well, um, let's schedule you, but um, I have to tell you something to make sure you understand." 

Okay.

"We can only come out during the emergency hours, so it's going to be more money." 

I did explain that I didn't want the emergency hours; that's why I put in the request. She told me they might be able to "maybe" see me sometime next week.  She did it with the tone of someone about to tell you, "no, we can't," the next second. Are they that busy, or is it me? 

I don't get it. The reviews are great, the email was great, and the owner looks great, but if the person taking the orders isn't sure how to do an order or how the order works, how do I know it will be booked correctly? 

I told her I'd call back, but I'm unsure if I will. I was left confused and unsure after that call. I thought I'd leave this review, at least. Maybe it's a weird day. Anyway, that's my experience.

reviews.author: Jeremy Z.
reviews.text:
We first used Plumb Doctors (then called Plumb Masters) two years ago when the toilet started backing up at our previous house. Joe came out, did a thorough assessment, and found we had root intrusion from a nearby live oak. Joe turned what was looking like a $50K+ problem (tunneling under the slab foundation) into $2K through a creative (and code-compliant) solution. Joe's honesty, professionalism, and skill made him our go-to plumber.

When we were looking to buy a new house last year, we had Joe come out to do a thorough inspection. He found that the main sewer line had settled and no longer ran at the right slope, causing sections to be completely flooded. He provided a reasonable quote as well as a video of the issue that we provided to the sellers who agreed to split the cost.

We had the work completed last month, and it was completely seamless. Joe and his team came early and stayed late to ensure we weren't without water for any more time than was needed. They were always in close contact so we knew the status of each stage of work as well as the inspection. Andrew also got involved along the way who is also fantastic.

Finally, we had Joe and Andrew (of course) replace our water heater a few weeks ago which was also a great experience. They provided a quote in range of other similar shops and had the installation down to a science. In and out.

We hope we're at the end of our plumbing needs for a while, but if anything comes up, we know we're in good hands!

reviews.author: Jeff E.
reviews.text: One of our bathroom sinks backed up. We ran a snake down the pipe but it kept going into the roof vent path. We called Blue Dragon and they said that it sounded like we needed a drain camera and they did not have one but referred us to Plumb Doctors. I scheduled and was told that there was an $89 service call fee but it would be waived if we went ahead with service. Marc and Gabe came and after I signed for the $337 drain opening service they brought in a large power auger. They said their drain camera could not make the turns in the pipe. They tried several times to use the big snake but could not get it to go through. Marc said it looked like the pipe was collapsed or rusted shut and said we would need to tunnel under the house at a cost of $18,000. He knocked $50 off the service since they did not get the drain clear so I was charged $287 for no results. After they left we tried our little wire snake again, got it into the correct pipe and snagged the hair clog and cleared the drain. I called and asked about getting reimbursed for some of the $287 since it was obviously a wrong diagnosis. I was told I would get a call today from the operations manager but no call. I would not recommend this company.

reviews.author: Andrew T.
reviews.text:
This review is purely for their scheduling and reliability.  I cannot comment on their actual service/quality of work as I was not able to get that far. 

Overall, making an appointment is easy; however, there seemed to be a lack of communication between the person who took my information/confirmed my appointment and the person who schedules the technicians to come out.  After taking a work day off to be at home for the scheduled window 8am-12pm, no one showed, so I called after the window, and they could not find my appointment. The person on the phone even indicated that there was probably confusion with all the requests, but I understood things happen at that point, and they were reasonable enough to put me on the schedule for the second half of the day (2-6pm).  Well 6pm comes and goes, and I'm still here with a busted pipe and no water.    The scheduler tells me they are running behind and the tech is finishing a job and will be on his way, well another hour goes by and another hour goes by.  By 8:45, I just called it quits. 

Have a backup if you have an important/urgent repair at your home. Prompt in scheduling but failed to deliver. Maybe you'll have better luck.

reviews.author: Carolyn V.
reviews.text:
The Good:
  :: it's a local business!
  :: they offer regular and emergency plumbing services
  :: they are very professional in communications
  :: they text you with confirmation of your appointment
  :: they are very effective at their jobs
  :: they are licensed and insured, not some fly-by-night operation
  :: the fee charged for after-hours service is reasonable (less than $200)
  :: Mark/Marc (my plumber) was fantastic--very friendly, very effective at fixing the leak that happened with the line feeding into my tankless. He not only fixed the leak but improved the component that was the connector between tankless and water line so that it was a more secure, modern fitting. He also took time to explain things to me, which I always appreciate!
  :: they take credit cards
  :: they send you photos of the job with your receipt for good recordkeeping purposes

The Bad:
  :: none

The Ugly:
  :: none

Would I use them again? Absolutely yes...they are now my go-to for emergency plumbing needs, hands down. Put these guys on speed dial in your phones so when something goes awry, you don't need to look for who to use--you'll have these guys ready to go!

This place is IN.

reviews.author: Darren R.
reviews.text:
I have previously recommended this company for providing good service. Unfortunately, my recent experience was less than ideal. 

I had requested their services for an urgent request to find a gas leak and restore service to the water tanks. Given the complexity of the situation (multifamily home/condominium, multiple impacted water heaters), I had sent all of the details of the project to back office with the expectation the plumber would arrive prepared and able to fix the issue on site.

Unfortunately, this was not the case. He had come to the same conclusion as the previous plumber. He was not able to locate the true cause of the leak. Additionally, the notes were not reviewed or sent to the technician and seemed ill-prepared. So even if the leak was located, he would have likely needed to return with necessary equipment and supplies to finish the job. While I was not charged for the visit since no work was completed and diagnosis of issue was not certain. I definitely feel time was wasted for all parties involved.

On a more positive note, back office was responsive. I do appreciate the ability to send out a technician the same day.

reviews.author: Christopher T.
reviews.text: I called Plumb Doctors to get a second opinion on a big plumbing repair that another plumber told me was needed.  Plumb Doctors' normal business appointments were booked for the next week so I agreed to the extra cost of an after-hours appointment and they came out the same day - in the evening.  As he arrived, Marc called me to get the background info (I couldn't be there) then he went to work.  He called back later with the news that he couldn't complete the job due to broken equipment.  However, between the two of us, we had enough information to discuss the situation and make an educated plan of action that avoided the big repair the other plumber had recommended.  Even with the broken equipment, I got exactly what I was hoping for: a professional second opinion that helped me manage the situation in a more reasonable way saving me time, money and inconvenience.  I would have gladly paid for the service but to my surprise, Marc said there would be no charge because of the equipment issue.  What more could I ask for?  Five stars!

reviews.author: Jason H.
reviews.text: I recently discovered that my hot water tank was rusting on the outside, and I was probably days away from a catastrophic damage event, which would have surely cost me thousands of dollars if it had burst.  I reached out to several plumbers via Yelp, and Andrew with Plumb Doctors was the first to respond.  Andrew let me know that he could be there the same day.  Mind you, it was getting late in the day, and Andrew was on a job in South Austin.  Nevertheless, Andrew was true to his word, and kept me posted on his arrival time.  He showed up at about 7:00 p.m., quickly assessed the situation, and called in reinforcements to get the job job quickly and efficiently.  Andrew and his team quickly went to work, and had a new water tank installed, and working flawlessly in short order.  This type of service is rare, and I commend Andrew and his team at Plumb Doctors.  They have earned my future business.

reviews.author: Natalia Arzeno-Gonzalez
reviews.text: Alex was amazing!! Our shower leak ended up requiring 3 visits because of parts we needed to order and an issue with the city water cutoff to our house, but Alex was very patient and responsive throughout the process. The visits were also accomplished in consecutive days. He made sure to leave us with a working shower between visits, foreseeing what may be necessary for the repair and not beginning the core of the repair until we had our other issues worked out.  It was a complicated task with obstacles arising as more parts were removed from the shower, requiring a lot of specialized tools and knowledge. However, our bill in the end was just slightly higher than the original quote, he managed to fix everything without having to break our shower wall, and he explained what was going on throughout the process. We’ll definitely be calling again for future plumbing issues.

synthesis.summary: Great workmanship and genuine educator-style technicians, but recent 2025 reviews flag a pattern of no-shows and unreachable voicemail that suggests the company may have lost key staff.
strengths: Technicians consistently explain work and teach customers DIY maintenance — at least 5 reviews across different plumbers (Marc, Andrew, Alex, Jami, Graham) mention being educated on their own systems

Strong emergency and after-hours track record: at least 4 reviews describe same-day or sub-25-minute response to burst pipes, holiday crises, and after-hours calls when competitors couldn't come until the next day
Workmanship praised across 6+ reviews covering diverse jobs (slab leaks, tankless heaters, toilet installs on concrete slabs, water shutoff valves), with multiple customers becoming repeat clients
weaknesses: Pricing on parts-plus-labor jobs can run steep — one reviewer cited $451 to install an expansion tank and $406 for a drip pan, and a landlord noted disposal replacement was 'most definitely on the pricey side'
One 2-star review documents a faulty shower pan installation followed by months of dodged calls with only an inadequate resolution offered
redFlags: Two of the three most recent reviews (both from late 2025) report the same failure mode: confirmed appointments that were no-showed, phones going unanswered, and a full voicemail box — one reviewer explicitly warns 'the top three plumbers have left'
The most recent reviewer specifically notes no positive reviews in the past 7 months, suggesting a possible operational decline that postdates the bulk of the positive review history
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Historically strong emergency capability — verified burst-pipe response at midnight on Christmas Eve, sub-25-minute after-hours dispatch, and holiday weekend arrivals when all competitors declined — but the 2025 reliability failures make this uncertain for current emergency calls.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.9 across 576 reviews while Yelp sits at 4.4 across 96, a notable gap that aligns with the pattern of recent negative experiences being more visible on platforms where reviewers sort by recency.
