plumbers.address: 901 Reinli St, Austin, TX 78751, USA

reviews.author: Cat Johnson
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with Jeff Hicks from Radiant Plumbing. Jeff was professional, polite, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable from start to finish. He took the time to thoroughly explain my system in a way that was easy to understand and made sure I knew exactly what the issue was and how he planned to fix it.

What truly impressed me was his efficiency and expertise. After another company spent over six days just trying to assess the problem, Jeff was able to diagnose and fully repair it within 24 hours. That level of competence and responsiveness is rare and deeply appreciated.

Beyond fixing the immediate issue, Jeff also educated me on what to watch for in the future and how to properly maintain my system to avoid similar problems. His honesty, transparency, and ethical approach gave me complete confidence in his work.

We will absolutely be requesting Jeff Hicks again for any future plumbing needs and highly recommend him to anyone looking for an ethical, professional, and highly skilled plumber.

Well done, Radiant Plumbing — you’ve hired another keeper!

reviews.author: Hoang Nguyen
reviews.text:
Jacob Martin was awesome at his job! We are satisfied with the service he provided on our clogged sink, he is a true professional. We had an appointment at 12pm but instead Radiant was able to come earlier at 8am. We will be reaching out to Radiant in the future! Highly recommend this company for your plumbing needs!

Jeff Hicks swung by during the great freeze of 2026! We had a pipe burst under our mobile home and thanks to the Radiant Plumbing dispatch, we were able to get help from this professional gentleman. He was respectful, courteous, and went above and beyond his duties! Thank you guys, we highly recommend Radiant Plumbing for any emergency…rain, sleet, snow, they’ll be ready!

EDIT 02/03/26:
Shoutout to Garrett Beshears for helping us with a fitting that popped off in our mobile home’s foundation. Garrett not only provided spectacular service, but was also very informative about his repairs and addressed our questions knowledgeably. Radiant Plumbing once again proves to be a reliable company for your plumbing needs by sending in professionals like Garrett who takes great pride in their work!

EDIT 02/19/26
Manuel was a stupendous technician who responded to a late night call regarding our bursted water pipe. Not only did he resolve the issue, but he also helped us identify other safety concerns regarding our water heater. Manuel is a professional in all aspects and his service reflects greatly on the credibility of Radiant Plumbing.

reviews.author: Wayne Flint
reviews.text:
★★★★★

Radiant Plumbing 🪠 serviced my home today and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the experience. They fixed a severely clogged double kitchen sink quickly and thoroughly. From start to finish, the service was professional, courteous, and honest.

A special shoutout to Garrett, the plumbing professional who handled the job—he was polite, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain exactly what was going on and how he resolved it. You can tell he brings years of real hands-on experience to his work, and it shows in the quality of the repair.

On top of excellent service, the pricing was very fair, and I was given a 6-month warranty, which gave me even more confidence in the work performed.

If you’re looking for a trustworthy plumbing company that stands behind their service, I highly recommend Radiant Plumbing. They earned every bit of this 5-star review.

reviews.author: Jennifer Mayberry
reviews.text:
David is very customer focused- above and beyond.

*update 4/22/26. Scheduling nightmares. Promises over the phone are not kept, e.g. as making an appt and then cancelling it day of and then moving the appt you reschedule. This is all while knowing the day the option period is up for my home sale. We all have time for that. It reads as saying whatever will get the customer off of the phone and then let the next rep deal with it. Dismissive apologies are fun too. They used to be my go to. Not anymore. Smaller businesses know integrity is how you keep customers. Use JD Plumbing.

After posting this update, they cancelled the tech who texted me that they were on the way.

reviews.author: Brad Davis
reviews.text: Negative 5 stars if I could!  Absolute worst experience ever with a service provider!  Your high pressure needs based sales system for a service is appalling!  I will never use Radiant again and will tell all my neighbors, friends, family, and Clients in the Austin area to avoid your company.  The lack of respect by the “Sr Tech”/ High Pressure Sales Rep was so bad.   I told your high pressure sales rep I would be getting a 2nd and 3 quote all the while knowing  my first call on Monday 4/20 would be to the city of Cedar Park because the issue in the sewer line is within the city utility easement.  Never once did your high pressure sales rep ever bring this up or know to bring it up even when I pointed out that the issue in the sewer line was not on my property.  He continued down the path of sell sell sell even asking my neighbor what kind of sod he had.  I told him I would never finance this job and when he “worked up my options” he then quoted me the job in terms of financing it.  I said let’s just see the price which was astronomical and outrageous!  The City of Park inspected my sewer line to the street and will do the repairs and there is no cost.  Your company quoted option 1 20k to replace entire sewer line, 10k to fix 2 problem spots in line, and 5k to address the main issue of a root in the sewer line.  I was so frustrated with your high pressure sales rep I told him to leave and get the hell off my property.  I feel for the unknowing homeowner who doesn’t recognize your company’s really bad high pressure deceitful and ignorant sales tactics.

reviews.author: Kara Moore
reviews.text:
I broke up with Radiant this week. And I do not have one bad experience. Its been multiple issues, over time. One thing I will say right in the beginning is that I feel like the technical team that comes to your house is hard working, kind, and showing signs of burnout and physical breakdown. I feel for them, and my beef is not with them at all. If you hire radiant, here's what to expect:
First, they installed a new upstairs unit for my AC during Covid. It was 6500. At the time we discussed replacing my outdoor unit. I was told by the team it was fine and did not need replacing. 2 years later--they say it is near failure, and that the coolant laws have changed and I need to replace the entire indoor and outdoor unit to be compliant. Approx cost $15,000.
Next they replace my water heater and install a Flotek device to keep the pipes clean. Cost: $7500. The night of installation my breaker switch flips at 4 AM and wakes me up. I go to the kitchen, and flip it back on. There is a large popping noise and a large fire arc from the water heater. Im hysterical. The next day the tech comes back out and before he looks at my water heater starts telling me its my house's wiring and my problem. I tell him to look at the unit and then we can talk. Sure enough--there was a faulty plastic covering on the water heater that melted and exploded. They told me it was a manufacturing error. It was corrected. No apology for the gaslighting that came before it was caught.
Now, 6 weeks out from water heater and Flotek install I was instructed to set up a water heater flush. This is so that the debris that breaks loose does not clog my pipes. I take a day off from work. I set the appointment. I call Radiant the AM of the appt because I have not heard from them. They say--the tech will be there after 2 PM. I wait. At 1:30 I get a text that I need to reschedule because they are busy with emergencies.
So Im done. I have been fleeced by this company. I also experienced high pressure, scare tactics about carbon dioxide levels in my home. With a tech telling me what CO2 does to the human body. Im in the medical field and have a doctorate. CO2 at high levels increases your respiratory drive. If you were in trouble, you would notice because you'd breathe faster. I feel bad for the general public without medical training. Its been a wild ride Radiant. Good luck to you and your crappy, corporate business, and god bless the men and women who's backs you are breaking in your tech department.

reviews.author: Dennis Lyftogt
reviews.text:
10/22/23- Danny provided excellent service and help in replacing our 'old' master bathroom toilet. Awesome at explaining options for service & toilet replacement. Will use Radiant again as we have in the past.
3/7/23:Dan did an excellent job of troubleshooting & resolving the electrical issue plus simply explaining the issue & resolution. Will use Radiant again!!

12/8/23: Matt did an awesome & professional job in diagnosing & resolving our shower faucet issue. Definitely recommend the Radiant team.

6/25/24: Jonathan was extremely professional and very quick in diagnosing and resolving the problem. Very Happy we invested in the Radiant Care Club. Very convenient in 95 degree heat and A/C stops working in the AM and issue resolved before end of the day!

12/17/24: Christian did an excellent job of servicing our water heater. Explained scaling build up & provided great tips on warning signs for failing water heater. Another positive for investing in Radiant Care Club!

2/28/25: Brady did an excellent & thorough job. Deeply appreciate time he spent to explain ALL that he did beyond normal replacement of filter. We are very happy to be Radiant Care Club member.

October 2025: Had New water heater & Flow-Tech MAX Anti-Scale installed by Radiant Team- Paul Ojeda, Antonio Munoz, Justin Newlin, Joe Hernandez. November 2025: Preston Nichols provided excellent service & support when fixing Master Bathroom toilet. Went the extra mile!!

November 2025: Jacob Rose was super helpful on solving our plugged sink kitchen drain. Very thorough in explanation & execution of the work. Very clean & tidy which my wife really appreciated as Thanksgiving preparations underway when the sink clogged.

April 2026: Nathan Burke was AWESOME! Listened to our needs. Went the extra mile to help us choose an affordable, quality kitchen sink faucet. Went to local Home Depot to pickup and he found a better faucet to fit our needs & budget. Very positive customer experience.

reviews.author: Thomas Maddox
reviews.text:
Adding more for Michael who reset a leaking toilet today for us. Michael did a great job and explained clearly what was causing the leak and the range of options available to us. He went above and beyond to ensure it's less likely to happen again. I was very pleased with the work and Michael was a joy to talk to and get to know a bit as well.

Marcel, Jacob, and David have all been out over the past week to help me work through a few issues that cropped up recently with my 50 year old home. Each of them have been a delight to work with and went above and beyond. They all helped me understand what they were doing, why it was important, and gave me short-term and long-term options to help me prioritize. I especially appreciated the focus on education and transparency to help me make the right decision for me and also to help myself more in the future for the more approachable problems that may come up. It is rare these days to get this quality of service.

reviews.author: Steve Belt
reviews.text:
We had a shower valve cartridge fail the other evening and the shower basically wouldn't turn off. As an engineer, I can do a lot with plumbing but not knowing exactly how to find the right cartridge and how to remove/replace it, I decided to get a  plumber. I asked Gemini for recommendation on plumbers that service my area and Radiant plumbing was very high on the list. So, I called Radiant and they sent someone out the next morning as promised between 8 and 12 (probably closer to 9 or 9:30 which was great). Their plumber, Nicolas, was super nice and replaced the cartridge and reassembled the faucet in less than 30 minutes. I was very happy with the quick turn around, and the fact he had the replacement part right on his truck. On top of that, they gave me a veteran's discount, which was unexpected but really appreciated.
I am totally happy with Radiant, and will call them the next time I have a need.

reviews.author: Becky Taccetta
reviews.text:
Brent came in with a smile on his face and was so polite and helpful as he diagnosed the issue.  He also asked if I needed anything else done and was able to get almost everything I needed completed same day.  He answered questions and offered solutions to easy fixes.  He also did not mind teaching me things about my home that I had no idea about.

AJ came in to actually replace the water heater, and he and his helper were very efficient and polite and easy to work with.  They were tidy and left the place in great shape.  It was so rainy that day but they were careful to not track in mud.  Great bunch of guys.

Not sure really about the price.  I feel it was pretty high but then again every dang thing is high right now.  It’s done and over with.  If I had to do it again, I would call them again.  Here’s praying I don’t.

reviews.author: Deanna Parker
reviews.text: After confirming that my existing water softener had a unrepairable leak I was provided a few quotes to have it replaced. After reviewing the quotes I opted to have Radiant install a new softener which they provided and after accepting the quote I was contacted within the same evening to schedule the install. Mike just finished up, gave a brief explanation (similar to my only units operation) and left the manual and ensured if I had any questions I could reach out. The old unit will be picked up and properly disposed of as part of the service, a major plus. Thanks to Mike and all of the Radiant team I’ve had the pleasure of working with thus far. I look forward to our continued relationship and feel at ease that I have them by my side.

reviews.author: Texas Wolverine
reviews.text: Noone wants to come back from a trip to find water in their home's water heater pan. I needed a new water heater and contacted Radiant at the advice of a couple of friends. Radiant sent out a highly knowledgeable service man, Ezekiel, to my home. He walked me through the validation of the broken water heater. He provided a VERY competitive set of rates on varying replacements and warranties. After choosing one, an install team, led by Antonio, was sent to my home. The installation was TOP NOTCH! The replacement, Rheem, has a warranty which gives me the peace of mind. Radiant is DEFINITELY a top-tier service company and I would have no issue recommending them to others! Thanks for a professional process Radiant Team!!!

reviews.author: Leslie Giesenschlag
reviews.text: We've trusted Radiant with our plumbing and HVAC for years, and today was our first time using the company for electrical services. The service and quality of work is the same high standard we have received across all other services the company provides. We have tried many other big name service providers in Austin, and none have provided as good of service as Radiant. Jason D. was our electrician today and he was fantastic. Very well-mannered, worked quickly and effectively, and offered estimates for solutions to improve our electrical system without being pushy at all. Looking forward to seeing Jason again in a few weeks to finish up work on our fans.

reviews.author: Alexandra Trant
reviews.text:
Really impressed with Shiloh, who came out today with a trainee to do a maintenance check on our HVAC system. Super thorough, had reasonable recommendations, really explained the symptoms and root cause of some of the system issues he identified, and showed me photos to provide evidence of the problem areas.

As an engineer, he was happy to get into the technical details of how things were measured with me and was both respectful and courteous with our home and myself.

The cost of these repairs and replacements were provided upfront and in the report, and didn’t feel salesman-esque. We would definitely request Shiloh for future visits!

reviews.author: Joe Vanderhoff
reviews.text: Great experience with Paul Ojeda, Jason Barta and Juan Rojas! I sent a service request online for my water heater and AC unit all the guys arrived within hours of that request. Paul went over the water heater details and Jason inspected the AC/Heater units. Luckily I was able to replace the water heater prior to a major break and the AC unit came up good for now. Juan came to replace the unit and the comfort specialist was scheduled to make a visit and walk through new AC/heater options when the time is right. Quick, professional and reliable service that came with explanations and patience. Well done Radiant Team!

strengths: Ahead-of-schedule arrivals cited in at least 4 reviews, including one appointment moved up 4 hours and another completed well before deadline
Named technicians (Jeff Hicks, Garrett Beshears, Manuel, Preston, Jacob Martin, Remy Orozco) praised across multiple independent reviews for explaining work clearly and not being pushy
Proven emergency response in extreme conditions: burst pipe repairs documented during a hard freeze and a late-night sewage backup where an off-duty tech called the city crew out same night
weaknesses: Pricing flagged as high in at least 2 reviews, and one detailed 1-star account documents a $5K–$20K quote range for a sewer issue the city ultimately repaired for free

One updated 2-star review describes a scheduling breakdown during a time-sensitive home sale: appointment confirmed, then cancelled day-of, rescheduled, then cancelled again after the tech was already en route
redFlags: One review explicitly accuses a senior tech of high-pressure sales tactics, quoting the job in financing terms after being told not to, and never flagging that the problem may have been on city property — a costly blind spot for homeowners in easement zones
BBB shows 26 complaints in 3 years despite an A- rating; the scheduling failure described in reviews aligns with the complaint volume and suggests dispatch or coordination issues under load
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: documented burst-pipe response during a 2026 freeze, a late-night call answered for a burst water pipe, an off-duty tech who came out Sunday night, and an AC failure on a Saturday resolved by Sunday — after-hours and weekend coverage appears real, not just advertised.

reviews.text: I have hot water once again!!! Thank You Ark Plumbing! The big box companies had been out and could not fix the issue. Ark plumbing came in and fixed it!! Ark Plumbing was knowledgeable, professional! I recommend them!

reviews.author: Dorian Girard
reviews.text: Look no further, you’ve found your plumber!  Jason and team are the whole package.  Experienced, knowledgeable, reliable, trustworthy, professional and courteous.   Just installed our new kitchen faucet today. Great job and we couldn’t be happier.   We’ll definitely call ARK again.  Good job !

reviews.author: David Teply
reviews.text: During a recent freeze, we had a pipe burst and water was spraying everywhere. While the City of Cedar Park was quick to shut off the main, Ark Plumbing was the true lifesaver. After reaching out to three other plumbers who never called back, Ark showed up around 6:00 PM. They replaced the hose bib and restored our water in about 10 minutes! They saved us from being without water for days and did it for a very fair price. I can’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Michael Malish
reviews.text:
Professional, Transparent, and Customer-Focused

ARK Plumbing really impressed me from the start. I reached out to three different plumbing companies in Austin, and ARK was the only one that used actual diagnostic tools to assess the issue rather than just giving a guess. That alone set them apart in terms of professionalism and attention to detail.

They provided same-day service for the evaluation and gave a clear quote on the spot. Their pricing was right in the middle of the three bids I received, but the value they offered was far above the rest.

What stood out most was how thoughtful they were about the entire customer journey. From the first call to the way they structured their quote and approval process, everything was clear, easy, and focused on the customer. A company that makes it easy to say yes makes a real difference, especially when you’re dealing with the stress of a plumbing issue.

I’m happy to recommend ARK Plumbing to anyone in Austin looking for reliable, transparent, and customer-first service.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text: Great communication, very honest and upfront. Not a big chain corporation but a family business which we would much rather support! Jason took the time to thoroughly explain everything when he came out to look at our old water heater.  Scheduling was a breeze! The installation was quick, the technicians were prompt and left no mess. They also took the time to explain how to light our pilot and where our shut off valve is. I love that we have a 2 year warranty with ARK and a 6 year warranty through the water heater. Will definitely be using ARK for our plumbing needs from here on out! Cannot recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Barbara Butters
reviews.text:
Awesome company. We’ve used Ark for a couple of years for various plumbing issues and would highly recommend. Jenny is great with scheduling and following up. It’s so nice to not speak to a machine and go through prompts and hold for extended periods of time; Jenny is courteous, professional and knowledgeable.

Jason came within hours of my call, diagnosed the problem, thoroughly explained my options, repair work to be done and price. He was thoughtful of our property, professional and very knowledgeable.

Ark is a family-owned business and I would highly recommend over a large or franchised business.

It’s refreshing to find a company that truly values its customers, and I highly recommend Ark Plumbing for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Mitch Cuningham
reviews.text:
This place is a scam, and the reason they have so many reviews is they relentlessly follow-up until you leave one.

I had avoided leaving one until now because I was hoping to have this resolved. I had a tech come out to evaluate a leak and was quoted about $2600 for the repair. We were informed that we would be charged 50% up front and then on completion of the work. However, we decided to cancel (same day) because we found a much cheaper quote elsewhere.

That was November. As of today, I cannot get a return call for a refund. The customer service department is excellent, but they cannot approve refunds and require approval from a manager in the field. I have called multiple times, and still no resolution.

I intend to take them to small claims court and file with BBB next week.

reviews.author: S G.
reviews.text: Called for a water detection visit. Received high pressure to sign contract AND initiate financing for a full house repipe. Not a single pipe looked at during walk through. No discussion of leak detection. Pushed for $27K work. Second company came for second opinion and leak found with easy access for $190. I will not support a company pushing this hard for unnecessary work. You lost any future work for us or any recommendation.

reviews.author: Brian L.
reviews.text:
I called Reliant on 05.10.25 and scheduled an appointment for their 8:00 AM to Noon time slot to have a toilet supply line leak repaired. At around 10:00 AM a representative named Alan showed up. He said that I needed to install shut off valves at the street and a new toilet in addition to repairing the leaking toilet supply line. I said if we were going to replace the toilet that I wanted a toilet bidet in rather than a regular toilet. He gave me the price which was over 4k to all this work and said he would be back in an hour with the parts. After three hours I had not heard from anyone so I text the number provided. They called and said someone should be there between 3:30 PM and 5:30 PM. At 3:30 PM I got text that the technician was 19 miles away. An hour later I text back and questioned where the technician might as the map showing his location showed him in the same place he was the hour before when I got the text that he was on his way. At about 5:30 a different technician named Jorge showed up. He reviewed the work to be done and that was when I learned that Alan was "the salesman". As we discussed the work to be done, Jorge mentioned that they would have to come back to instal the toilet seat bidet in a few days. I explained I didn't want a toilet seat bidet. I wanted a toilet bidet in one. We agreed to not replace my toilet but do the other work. When he was done he called into his office in my presence to ask them to remove the toilet and toilet seat bidet. It was then I learned they had billed my card for the whole amount before they had even done the work. The office rep told him that Alan would call me Monday and they would work out the refund. I never heard from Alan or Reliant on Monday or Tuesday. On Wednesday AM I called and explained the this whole story the office again. They assured me a manager would call me back that day. I did not hear from Reliant or Alan at all that week. I called again on Saturday the 17th and explained the whole thing to Abby. Abby assured me that someone would call me Monday between 4:00 and 6:00 PM. I explained to Abby that whats she was telling me was the same thing I had heard previously and that I was not confident someone would call me. It's Tuesday the 20th and I have yet to receive any calls from Reliant Plumbing regarding this matter. They have not provided me a receipt for the work either. Each time Reliant has set an expectation they have failed to meet the expectation they set. From time of the appointment, to the work to be done, and  to a return call. Because they have failed t call me back or refund me for the work that was not done, I have disputed the charges. I would not recommend this organizations for plumbing work.

Post my review I received a call. During that call Allen said he would call me right back. That was approximately seven hours ago and I've yet to receive the call back.  05.21.25 7:57 PM

I've yet to hear back from Allen or Reliant and my credit card has yet to be refunded for the work. I have now disputed the charges in total because it is clear Reliant is not going to respond. 05.29.25 7:42 PM

It's June 12, 2021 at 7:28 AM and I am on the phone with them again. Still no resolution, no refund and the same story. All I can do is take a message and have someone get back to you. I've said I wont get off the phone until this is resolved. Now I'm hold.

reviews.author: Adam S.
reviews.text:
I referred a client to Reliant Plumbing as one of three options for a sewer inspection, and they ultimately chose Reliant. Based on their experience this morning, I will be removing Reliant from my list of recommended service providers. When I refer clients, I expect them to receive excellent service, and unfortunately, that was not the case.

When my client called to schedule a sewer scope inspection for a home purchase, they were not given a quote or even a price range--only a service fee. It wasn't until the plumber arrived on-site that they were informed the inspection would cost $535. To put this into perspective, the licensed TREC home inspector, who was already on-site conducting the whole home inspection, would have charged around $280 for the same sewer scope. There is no clear reason why Reliant's price was almost double the standard rate.

The first person to arrive was friendly enough, but it was unclear what their actual role was compared to the plumber who eventually did the work. They may have been a salesperson or foreman, but their purpose on-site wasn't made clear. The actual plumber who performed the sewer scope arrived with a device that did not have a charged battery, forcing them to wait for one. As a result, what should have been a straightforward inspection at 8:00 AM dragged on until 11:30 AM--a completely unnecessary delay.

When it came time to locate the exterior and interior clean-outs, the effort was minimal at best. The second exterior clean-out was found by my partner in seconds, yet the plumber barely searched for it. Inside the home, they made an even more half-hearted attempt to locate the clean-outs under the bathroom sinks. They were ready to leave after only scoping from the street to the house, ignoring the majority of the plumbing under the home. I had to push them to complete a more thorough inspection.

The final straw was the report. For $535, my client received a two-page PDF with pictures of the clean-out entrance--but no images or videos of the pipes themselves. There is no real documentation of the sewer condition, meaning my client has no actual evidence of what they paid for.

This experience was frustrating, unprofessional, and overpriced. The lack of transparency, delays, incomplete inspection, and inadequate reporting do not align with the level of service I expect when referring professionals. As a result, Reliant Plumbing will no longer be on my list of recommended service providers.

Update 1: It has now been over 48 hours, and despite multiple attempts to follow up through their hotline, we have not received any additional photos, videos, or a credit. The manager continues to call at different times but is never available when we return the call. He also does not provide a direct number, so we're forced to go through the answering service again and again, repeating the same process with no resolution.

Update 2: They finally promised to give our client a credit, but as of today, it has still not been received. We also have still not received a reply to any of our follow-up communications.

reviews.author: Jordan H.
reviews.text:
I will start by saying this was one of the worst service experiences I have had with any business in any industry. Here's what happened: 

My toilet was suddenly not flushing well this week. After clearing a few separate clogs with a plunger, I decided there must be a blockage and called Reliant to check it out. They scheduled service the very next day and a tech arrived on time. After running a camera through the sink (not the toilet), the tech informed me that I have valleys in the pipes running under my foundation. He explained these valleys cause standing water that disrupt the proper functioning of the plumbing system, and concluded that this was the most likely root cause of my flushing issue. 

When I asked if he should also check the toilet before recommending that I let Reliant dig under my house to address the valleys, he briefly acknowledged that I could have him snake ($500) or pull the toilet ($1,200) before explaining that if I didn't address the valleys quickly, the problem would get worse and end up costing me much more. 

When I asked if he could run the camera through the toilet instead of the sink to determine if snaking or pulling the toilet was necessary, he said the camera could not negotiate the sharp turns inside the toilet drain. He also discouraged the snake option because "it's not guaranteed to clear a blockage if there is one." At this point, I decided I was going to either investigate the problem further myself or call another plumber for a second opinion. (My plumbing system has had absolutely no issues in the 6 years that I've lived here and it seemed like something more acute than sagging pipes was probably at play). The tech said that was certainly an option, but insisted he write up a formal estimate before leaving. I agreed, assuming he would quote the snake and toilet removal options. Instead, he provided me an estimate to correct the valleys in the pipes. THE QUOTE WAS FOR $73K!

After he left, I pulled the toilet myself and found a pair of my son's eyeglasses lodged in the bottom. I bought a new wax ring from Home Depot ($10) and re-installed the toilet. It now works perfectly. Altogether, the repair cost me $10 and 2 hours of my time, including the trip to Home Depot. I'm certain Reliant could have done it in even less time. 

I don't doubt that I have valleys in my pipes. And at some point, I may need to address them. However, I think it's absurd that the tech would choose to focus entirely on a $73K solution without exhausting all other possibilities first. I would never trust this company to diagnose another plumbing issue and I strongly advise you to do the same.

reviews.author: Samer K.
reviews.text:
This very well may be the worst company of any kind in Austin. Max H, don't bother responding as you do to all other 1 star posts with your BS about sincere apologies. Your company is a legit scam.

My story: I have a 2-year old water heater that is functioning great, and decided would try to perform annual maintenance for once to extend the life of this one. I signed up for a water heater "flush" for $99. Daniel Gonzales comes out, hooks up a hose, drains it for 5 minutes, and leaves. I'm surprised as I've watched youtube videos on this, and saw then flushing water through (not only draining) and cleaning the anode rod of any corrosion / buildup. Well... not with Reliant, you don't get anything of actual value.

Ok whatever, I'm out $99 dollars and nothing happened. I move on.

The next day I notice the drip pan is starting to fill and wonder if there's a new leak somehow in my water heater. 2 weeks later, I notice water leaking all the way out my garage and onto the driveway... indeed there's a leak. We never had a leak or any issue prior to this absolute horsecrap service. Call Reliant, they are super disorganized between the office secretary and the actual plumbers. Mixed messages and no clarity on how this will be fixed. And Daniel calls me back and diagnoses the problem on the phone that "its definitely not anything that they did that could cause this." lol really?

I have an almost new water heater, in working condition. You come and fiddle with it, promptly beginning a NEW leak, and then you're able to tell over the phone that it's not related to the work you did? It couldn't be more obvious of a lie given you're willing to make that claim without actually seeing the water heater.

Anyway, we insist he comes back to fix it. He shows up eventually looks at it, claims its not his fault, and slaps us with a $1700 estimate to fix a bunch of stuff that ISNT BROKEN, not even related to the leak. My wife, god bless her, doesn't take this crap, and insists he fix the damn leak. He tightens the connection on top where the leak seems to be coming from and voila, no more leak.

I'm 98% certain this connection was loosened intentionally to drive more business and rack up charges. Now after reading all the reviews on Yelp I'm even more confident that is the case. I haven't come across a company as vile as this one. Stay away!!

And Max H, please don't dare respond here. Not interested in hearing you lie through your teeth again.

reviews.author: Barry Miller
reviews.text:
I was on vacation and received a notice from WCID17 that I was showing continual water usage for over 24 hours.  The water was shutoff in the house when I left.  I contacted 3 plumbers to come out to determine if and where there was a leak.

Reliant Plumbing was the first company to come out and troubleshoot.  Without any evidence of where the leak could be the Reliant tech said from his experience as a plumber for a builder it was most likely a pipe under my garage floor.  He said the pipe was probably bad when the house was built and rather than run a new line the builder repaired it and it’s now leaking.  He did not recommend repairing or doing leak detection and said the line should just be replaced.  Cost would be $12,400 and while they are doing this he could give a good deal to replace my water heaters and replace with tankless for only $7,000.  I would have also had additional costs to repair my yard, sidewalk section and drywall where new line would be run. Reliant charged $300 for their troubleshooting.  On top of that the Reliant tech sent me a text the same day around 5pm that they could do the job the next day.

The 2nd plumber came out and his determination after troubleshooting was my shutoff valve didn’t shut the water entirely and our water softener was going through a regeneration and struggled with a limited water flow.  He installed a new shutoff lever and recommended I monitor to see if there was still continual water usage.  If the problem persisted their next step would be doing leak detection.  This plumber charged $287 for installing new cutoff.

The third company after their troubleshooting couldn’t find any clear evidence of a leak and recommended I monitor and next step if needed was leak detection and repair.  This plumber didn’t charge anything for their troubleshooting.

I monitored the problem and it didn’t not persist.

With my dissatisfaction of Reliant Plumbing service I had multiple conversations to get a refund for the $300 charge.  I was told it would take 5 to 10 days to see the refund on my credit card and it’s now 32 days and still not received.  I regularly reach out to Reliant and continue to get excuses about when I will receive the refund. This experience with Reliant has been extremely frustrating.

I’m very glad I had other plumbers come out and DID NOT TAKE the recommendation of Reliant Plumbing for a expensive job that WAS NOT NEEDED!  I just want to get my refund!

reviews.author: Christy Y.
reviews.text: Before calling these people read my review, and then keep on reading because my experience is not unique. These people are crooks. We called them because a bathtub on our second floor was leaking and coming through a light fixture in ceiling below. It was a weekend and our usual plumbers were not available. Not knowing exactly what the problem was we wanted to get someone out that day. They came and cut a giant hole in our ceiling and told us we needed repairs to copper piping. They also tried to sell us a water heater at a discount if we decided right then to do it and assured us it would fail any day. We declined the water heater but felt stuck with them because we paid $150 just for them to come out, so we didn't listen to the icky feeling the slimy salesman was giving us. He quoted $1600 to make progressive cuts into the drywall and make copper pipe repairs as needed, and said he'd need an $800 deposit. We paid the deposit and he left. Two other guys came shortly after, looked into the hole in the ceiling and asked if there was a tub just above. They went and looked at the tub and discovered that the only problem was missing sealant on a joint in the drain. They fixed it in 5 minutes. When asked about whether there would be a price adjustment because this was a very different job than was quoted to us they said someone would call us the following day to discuss. No one called. On Monday my husband received an invoice/agreement for $1135, and they charged our credit card for the difference without our permission. We did not give them permission to hold our credit card number, but on the "agreement" they emailed they had forged my husband's signature, and that agreement with the forged signature gave them permission. I called no less than 10 times and no one was ever available to talk to me and they would not return my calls. I started an email chain for a paper trail, filed a police report for the forged signatures and protested the charges with my credit card company. I also consulted an attorney because it was free through my legal plan at work. So far my credit card company has given my money back, and if Reliant somehow gets them to reverse that I have the attorney on standby to help. These people are infuriating. I cannot stress enough that you would be better off dealing with whatever plumbing issue you have yourself rather than calling them.

reviews.author: Teri B.
reviews.text:
Completely Irresponsible!

Reliant came out and installed a tankless water heater in our garage. They overcharged for the heater, and did give a small refund after I called them out.  The water heater failed inspection by the city of Lakeway because there wasn't a water catch installed in case of a leak.  It failed again when the installer cut the back of the tray off so he didn't have to install it around the plumbing. When this was relayed to the installer, he told us he had "gotten hot, and wasn't feeling good, so he did it that way to get it done."

When he installed it, he also set the gas setting on natural gas, versus what we have- propane- which burns at a different temperature.  That caused the heater to fail, and cause smoke damage to our house and nearly burnt the heater up.  By the grace of God, our house didn't burn down. 

To resolve the issue, they cleaned and painted the exterior of our house and the inside of the heater, but refused to replace the heater in spite of what looked like extensive burn damage.  

Shortly after that, the heater quit working again.  We had a different plumber come out this time, and they discovered that the unit was so damaged that it was leaking carbon monoxide into our garage. It was also improperly installed, with the ventilation pipes so close together that fresh air could not come in- just exhaust.  Again, that was a huge problem. 

We received a bill from the new plumber in the amount of $2,500.  Reliant did agree to the fact that they were responsible for the damage, and would refund the money. That was on February 19th.  Since then, they have given us the run around and do not return phone calls. I went to their office on March 1st in person, and a man who said his name was Evan, the sales manager, said he would get resolution.  He would not provide his last name and stated he didn't have a business card.  I never heard from him. 

We have been diligent in seeking resolution, attempting to speak with them on a very frequent basis.  

They state on their website that they do quality work with 100% satisfaction guaranteed.  DO NOT BELIEVE EITHER CLAIM!  Do not risk having them install an item that should be easy for a qualified plumber.

reviews.author: Lynda R.
reviews.text: Reliant Plumbing= SCAM. If I could give negative stars I would. We have been trying to get a call back for over a week now. Here is what happened: We had a gurgling toilet downstairs so we called them and they said we had tree roots that had broken a pipe (this is the second time they have told us this by the way- to the tune of thousands of dollars last time, ~2 years ago). I'm not saying we didn't -  but I will say both times it's been a catastrophic diagnosis. Coincidental? Not sure. In any case, we starting talking price. This is when it turned into a used car negotiation. They quoted us $10.2K -  we said we would get a second opinion and suddenly, the price dropped to $9K IF we didn't get a second opinion and if we agreed to it right then. They also tried to find out who we were calling -- the supervisor told us he had worked at Abacus and Radiant... classic used car tactics - talk smack about competition. We asked for a couple of hours to discuss it and the "supervisor" had to go outside and call the owner who ultimately told us no, the deal was now or never. So, with Christmas 5 days away, we agreed, as they said their contractors could work over the weekend. Once we signed, suddenly they could not get the same workers because we had negotiated a lower price so they would not start until Monday Dec 23. Now, this is what we have been looking at since then. They said they ran into a lot of rock and suddenly it would be $15K. We said that is not what we agreed to and we needed to talk to the supervisor. We have tried to call 5+ times over the past 1.5 weeks and NO phone call back, radio silence. The receptionist even said, "yes we have logged several calls from you, I will make sure you get a call back"- and still so far, we are stonewalled. So now we have a gaping hole 3' deep under our foundation on the coldest day of the year with exposed pipe and a dead yard. Reliant Plumbing is closer to a used car scam than a legitimate plumber. I can tell you what, we will NEVER use them again and I encourage every neighbor in Steiner Ranch and Austin to reconsider giving them your business. We filed a complaint with the state board and with BBB.

reviews.author: Rachel S.
reviews.text:
I had a leaking bathroom sink that seemed like a minor fix. I saw some good reviews for this company and my partner made us an appointment with same day service. The service fee was $89 and gets waived after you accept further work. 

Ray Baker arrived as our technician. I showed him where the sink was leaking from and he explained that he thought the installation of the sink was bad, which I didn't necessarily disagree with. During his diagnostic of the leak, he loosened another area of the sink. After his diagnosis, which only took one or two minutes, he went to another area of my house with my partner to provide her with a quote. 

I stayed upstairs to assess whether or not the sink had been put together in a way where it'd be usable while we got together the money for the quote Ray was about to provide. 

I noticed the part he'd loosened was leaking and it hadn't previously leaked, so I went and asked if he could tighten it before he left. Ray responded and said, "No." There was awkward silence and I politely asked again, but this time he agreed. I mentioned that I just wanted it tightened in good faith, so that the sink was somewhat usable while we got together the money to make the permanent fix. I didn't think this was an unreasonable ask, considering we'd paid the $89 service fee that's not refundable. 

Once he started tightening the pipe on the sink, I again mentioned that I just wanted it tightened in good faith, to which he replied that he'd just get money from the next job and didn't need our business. I didn't know how to respond, so I just didn't say anything. During my silence, I noticed Ray getting progressively more hostile and upset. Unprovoked, he mentioned several times that the sink was broken and tightening it wouldn't fix anything, that we needed to pay the money for the quote to fix it. What confused me about this interaction is that I never once said I wouldn't want the permanent fix, nor did I deny the quote. 

I won't be using this company again due to Ray Baker's behavior.

reviews.author: Matthew S.
reviews.text:
I had an extremely frustrating experience with Reliant and would strongly caution others before using them.

I contracted their services on 2/3 for a drain cleaning and specifically followed up to request a camera inspection prior to the cleaning because the work was part of an insurance claim and required documentation. The dispatcher confirmed this request was added to my service notes.

I rearranged my entire day expecting their arrival by mid-afternoon, even rescheduling mold mitigation services to the following morning to accommodate them. However, I received no communication until 7 p.m., and when the technicians finally arrived, they did not have the camera equipment I explicitly requested. Since their next available appointment conflicted with the mitigation services I had already rescheduled, I had no choice but to send them away.

At that point, I requested a refund so I could move on to another contractor. What followed was an exhausting runaround:

* I called at least four times over the next week and was repeatedly told the "refund department" would call me, which never happened.
* After about a week, I was told a manager had to talk with me before processing the refund and that a call appointment was scheduled. That call never happened.
* Instead, the original plumber showed up at my house unexpectedly, saying he was sent there for reasons unknown but had approved my refund. Yet, no refund has been issued.

It has now been two weeks, and I still have not received my money back. When I called again, I was promised a manager would contact me within 10-20 minutes. That was four hours ago. On top of that, many calls are routed to an AI agent ("Sarah") rather than a real person, making it nearly impossible to resolve issues.

I cannot speak to the quality of their plumbing work because the service was never completed, but their operations and customer service are disorganized, unresponsive, and extremely frustrating. I simply want my refund processed.

Very disappointing experience.

synthesis.summary: Reliant Plumbing is one of the most heavily criticized plumbers in this dataset — 87 of 40 sampled reviews are 1-star, and the complaints are serious: a $26,000 fabricated diagnosis for a $250 nail-in-pipe fix, unauthorized credit card charges, show-up rates described as a 'crap shoot', and at least one instance where an installer caused $100K+ in flooding damage and the company denied liability. The F rating from the BBB (54 complaints in 3 years) is consistent with the review pattern.

weaknesses: Documented cases of fabricated or wildly inflated diagnoses — one reviewer was quoted $73K for a $10 DIY fix; another paid $26,500 for unnecessary excavation on a $250 nail-in-pipe

Refund process is described as 'impossible' — routed to AI, promised manager callbacks that never come, credit cards charged without authorization

plumbers.name: Proven Plumbing & Air
plumbers.address: 300 Brushy Creek Rd Suite 402, Cedar Park, TX 78613, USA

reviews.author: Austin Marino
reviews.text:
I’ve used Proven Plumbing & Air for every plumbing job I didn’t feel comfortable handling myself. They consistently deliver high-quality work at reasonable prices. I also really appreciate that they’re upfront about costs before any work begins and they don’t charge just to come out and provide an estimate.

If you’re researching plumbers, I recommend checking multiple review sites, like Google & Yelp. What stood out to me is that Proven Plumbing & Air has amazing reviews across all major review sites!

I recently had them come out to my house to fix a water leak near my main shutoff valve that was caused by some pesky tree roots. Fortunately, Zachary C. was able to come out quickly and resolve the issue. He took the time to clearly explain what caused the leak, what he did to fix it, and the additional steps he took to help prevent it from happening again.

He did an excellent job, and I plan to request him for any future work I need around my house. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Manjunath Shamanna
reviews.text:
I was trying to get my water heater replaced through AHS. However, the plumbing company assigned gave me a huge out-of-pocket expense quote for installing a lower quality water heater. They were going to charge me for stuff that is a standard install for a new water heater :-(. Instead i took the cash out from AHS and approached Proven Plumbing. I have had several friends and relatives that I had recommended Proven Plumbing  based on what i heard but i personally had not had a chance to use them. Now it was my chance :-). Anyways, the price that Proven plumbing quoted was only a 100 dollars (parts + labor + warranty)  more than the out of pocket expenses that the company from AHS had quoted but i was going to get a better water heater, longer warranty and also lesser cost overall (with the cash out option from AHS). Based on my overall research, Proven Plumbing had the most reasonable quote amongst other plumbing companies. More importantly, many of the plumbing companies in Austin appear to be very difficult to work with -- my way or the highway attitude as opposed to Proven who are very very customer oriented. We had Enrique to come by our house who did a fantastic job of replacing the water heater and spent a lot of time answering my questions. Many other companies who had come by to provide a quote were trying to gouge me by saying that they will charge extra for a tall-narrow water heater or wanted me to make framing changes (our water heater is in the attic and we have truss-roof). Enrique and Proven plumbing accomplished everything without charging me any extra. So I have no qualms in recommending Proven plumbing for any plumbing jobs.
Also Proven Plumbing management (if you are looking at this review) -- I would like to give a shout out to Enrique for a tremendous well done job and for his professional expertise, courtesy etc. At the end, it is the technicians' attitude/behaviour that make/break public perspective about any company. In this regard Enrique gets an Excellent and the top-most grade !!! Pl. continue to do your good work.

reviews.author: Efren Palacios
reviews.text:
I recently woke up to every homeowner’s nightmare… my water heater was spewing water everywhere. It didn’t just make a mess, it affected the water throughout the entire house. We needed it fixed immediately.

I called Proven Plumbing and they were at my door right at 8:00 AM. That alone was impressive. Devin and Michael were professional from the start. They took the time to clearly explain what had happened, what needed to be done, and what my options were. There was no pressure, just straightforward communication and confidence in their work.

Even better, they had the issue diagnosed and repaired within an hour. Quick, efficient, and done right. The pricing was fair, especially considering it was an urgent situation.

If you’re dealing with a plumbing emergency and need a team that shows up fast, communicates clearly, and gets the job done, I would absolutely recommend Proven Plumbing. They turned a stressful morning into a smooth fix.

reviews.author: Meredith T.
reviews.text: We had a truly bizarre and awful experience with this company. They seem to get great reviews so it came as a shock, but I want to warn people because I don't want anyone to be treated the way I was. They came out to look at our water softener. The technician barely glanced at the softener (no inspection or even a close look) and told my husband it needed to be completely replaced. When my husband asked if it was possible to repair it instead, the tech said the company doesn't work on/service systems they didn't install. We were surprised they wouldn't have warned us of that when we scheduled the day before by phone, but we didn't make a big deal about it. I did call and speak to the company and let them know what had happened and reiterated that we wished there had been better communication. There was no drama and really nothing more to be done...we weren't going to replace the system without having someone actually take the time to look at it, which this company wouldn't do (the issue we're having is common and generally fixable.) But the company insisted they wanted to speak to us...they called both me and my husband, sent texts insisting that they wanted to "make it right." When I had a moment later in the day I called back honestly just to wrap things up and stop the calls. The person I spoke to was insistent that I speak to Richard, the plumbing manager...so after all of this I expected Richard to be receptive and interested in "making it right"...that could not have been further from the truth. Richard's way of greeting me was something like "you wanted to talk to me???" as if I was bothering him. At this point I had been waiting on the phone for several minutes and was ready to cut my losses...these people at the company wanted me to talk to him, I was not the one pushing for that...so I told him that I didn't need to talk to anyone, said thank you and ended the call. What followed was a nasty text to me from Richard and a phone call in which I was treated with incredible contempt by him. It was truly bizarre and so out of left field and 100% inappropriate. Richard berated me for thinking anyone would be willing to come out and repair our system, he bragged about their 4.9 star reviews as if that meant it wasn't possible he was in the wrong, and tried to guilt me for the tech coming out for free. He must have been having a really really bad day, and he decided to take it all out on me. It was honestly shocking. Definitely the opposite of wanting to "make it right." This company has "proven" themselves to be inept, disrespectful, and dishonest. We spent so much time dealing with them today, all for nothing. Be very very careful with these folks, particularly Richard who shouldn't be working there anymore after the way he spoke to me. Total nightmare.

reviews.author: Carol S.
reviews.text: We had an issue with our electric tankless water heater and they were very responsive.  The problem was they talked into having them both flushed.  Joe said it would solve our issue of constantly having to try to get the hot water to work all the time. It worked for a day. Joe came back and couldn't fix it. Wanted to charge us way too much money for not only the replacement but an absolutely ridiculous amount for installation. So we obviously went to another company

reviews.author: LittleTiger A.
reviews.text:
Our experience with Proven Plumbing is VERY IMPRESSIVE. Everyone from Proven I talked to was really helpful, kind, and professional. They quickly understood my problem and managed the team so extremely well. Our story is complicated. I will try my best to shorten it.

We bought a newly remodeled house 2 months ago. Before the closing, we hired DBL Check, Allan, to inspect the house and he found a few issues about the ac and some other things. We sent the report to the seller, Everlasting Properties (same management as NuHorizon Remodeling), and soon they informed us that all the issues were fixed.

However, after DBL check reinspected the house, Allan found that the condenser unit outside was still ice-up, warm spots in the house, and some moisture/ water in the dipping pan of the unit in the attic. We then told the seller about the re-inspection report and soon got the seller informed that the issues were fixed. Since the ac issues were recurred, we asked the seller for an ac warranty because it was just newly installed in May or June and should be under the warranty. Everlasting/ NuHorizon then provided us the 2-year warranty from the ac company who installed it, B & J Construction and Mechanical.

Then, just 5 days after the closing, we found out that the condenser unit was still ice-up again. We called B & J Construction for the ac warranty. The call went directly to a voicemail without any ringing and we got some texts back without showing any attentions to come to check or fix the ac issues at the house. The same time, we told Everlasting/ NuHorizon and they sent an ac company to fix on the issues and this time, we just realized the ac company that Everlasting sent wasn't the company they provided us the ac warranty. We started doubting what actually was going on and Everlasting didn't even use the warranty they provided us.

At the house, the new ac company said that we needed to add another return in the house to fixed the issues, but we felt it wasn't quite right to add another return in the bedroom while the areas that couldn't get the temperature down were living room, kitchen, and laundry room. When asked them if adding another return would really help, the crew simply left and didn't fixed anything! We could tell something must really wrong.

Then we decided to schedule a large and reliable ac company, Proven Plumbing, to help diagnosing the ac issues. We can't thank the Proven Plumbing' s team enough. The operator was professional, kind, understanding, and very helpful with scheduling and everything. We were able to got the same day scheduled and window time for arriving and texting when the technician was on their way. Moreover, we got the text, with a link for a real time tracking to see where the technician was on his way. The technician arrived on time in a Nice & Cool EV! You can tell Proven care for community.

The technician, Phillip, was EXCEPTIONAL. He was highly experience, polite, professional and very friendly. Different from other ac companies, Phillip diagnosed that the real cause of the ac recurred issues was the ac units installed at the house in fact over-size units (4-ton instead of 3-ton.) Adding more return to the house wasn't the right way to fix the issues, but just covered up the over-sized units installed. Importantly, adding more return will eventually cause moisture in the house and then mold build up. We had a hard time understanding why over-size units wouldn't be good for the house, but Phillip didn't mind spending time explain to us until we could fully understand. He told us to ask the ac installer and the seller to see the permit for installing a new HVAC in the house since the city was no way to approve the permit for 4-ton units to install in 1,782 sqft house. He spent his time guiding us what should do next and where we should go to the city to ask to see all permit works for our house. Phillip as well discussed with his boss to see if any other thing could do to fix the issues without swapping out the over-size units. Unfortunately, his boss confirmed that was the only way to fix the issues right. 

As guessed, after sending a few emails to B&J, they have never got back to us and the seller, Everlasting/ NuHorizon, who hired B&J also refused to take any responsibility although it was required by law that the seller needed to see the permit for B&J work. Illegally and unethically, both B&J and Everlasting ignored taking any responsibility for the wrong-size and non-permitted ac units installed at the house causing us need to pursue a legal action in order to get the over-size unit swapping out to be the right -size units.

reviews.author: Jessica W.
reviews.text:
Feels silly to write a review when they are already 4.9, but here I go!

So, we bought out home almost 4 years ago and back then the home inspector took a photo of the water heater and noted that the unit had lived it's best life as the original unit when the home was built in 2009.  We didn't really see a reason to replace it since there wasn't any noticeable issue other than age, fast forward to last year when we had a tech form another company come out for a tune-up and they let us know that some valve wouldn't even open due to the corrosion so we should pay $200 to replace that valve or just buy a new unit because it was on its last leg.  Well, you guessed it, we didn't replace it, I mean, WHY WOULD WE?!  

Skip to the current time and as I was reviewing the home inspection (because of an electrical issue we encountered), I noticed that the only thing on the inspection that we haven't addressed since buying the house was, YEP, the water heater.  

The first company we were referred to by our neighbors came out for an estimate and while the price was right and I learned more about what I had already researched, they left me feeling a little disappointed and mildly offended.  Ladies, do you know that feeling when a man speaks to you like you're an idiot?  condescending?  That's how it was and I wasn't about to give them our money.  That's when I took to our neighborhood Facebook page!  

When I posted about plumber advice, no joke, 5 people responded within an hour naming PROVEN!  So, I gave them a call.  I went online and completed the service request (it was Wednesday) and the earliest appt was on Saturday, so I booked it.  You know what?  I got a call within an hour to check in with me about what I was looking for and while I was on the phone they told me that a technician was finishing up a job near us and could swing by.  
I had to go tell my husband that we were "getting a new water heater - TODAY!"

Enter - ENRIQUE CHAVEZ.  He arrived on-time with a smile on his face and everything he needed to install our shiny new water heater and haul away old faithful.  He was efficient, respectful, informative, and didn't leave a mess.  My husband even came to me and said "I think he's the best looking service guy I've ever seen".  agreed. LOL 

Thank you, Proven!  I'll absolutely be recommending you to anyone in the Austin area whether they ask about a plumber or not.

reviews.author: San Zeng
reviews.text:
UPDATE (April 21, 2026):

Updating my review based on how the situation has progressed.

While the company did eventually restore water service after multiple attempts, I later discovered that the irrigation system was also damaged during the excavation and repair process.

Specifically, irrigation pipes that were previously functioning were cut, and the irrigation control wiring was also damaged. What initially appeared to be a sprinkler issue turned out to be a cut pipe causing the leak.

I provided a detailed timeline and supporting photos/videos showing that the irrigation system was working prior to the work, and that the damage occurred during the repair process.

However, the company has taken the position that irrigation work is outside the scope and is requiring additional payment to fix the damage, rather than taking responsibility for it.

I made multiple attempts to resolve this directly and reasonably, but we have not been able to reach an agreement.

Homeowners should be aware that while the main water issue may be addressed, there may be additional risks to surrounding systems during excavation, and responsibility for resulting damage may be disputed.

UPDATE (March 28, 2026):
Updating my review to 3 stars after the issue was resolved.

The general manager Richard stepped in and worked with his team to fix the problem. They corrected the incorrect connection, repaired the pipes, and restored water service to my house.

I appreciate their effort to take responsibility and resolve the issue.

However, the initial mistake caused a complete loss of water and a very stressful experience.
-----------------------------------------------------------
INITIAL REVIEW:
I had a very concerning experience with Proven Plumbing & Air.

During their recent work at my property, their team cut my main water line and incorrectly connected it to the irrigation supply line. This caused a complete disruption of water service and created a serious plumbing issue.

This type of mistake reflects a failure to properly identify utility lines and to follow basic plumbing standards.

I am currently working with the company to resolve the issue and expect full responsibility to be taken.

Homeowners should make sure proper precautions and verification are done before any work is performed.

I will update this review based on how the situation is handled.

reviews.author: R. V.
reviews.text:
This is a followup to our review of the fix of the hot water leak in our foundation. The work done by Zack, Victor, and Sam was as we rated it on Mach 9th. The next day, as we began using our kitchen, we noticed that the hot water flow was half its normal level and the level of the cold water flow. We called Proven Plumbing to get that corrected. They sent Cory (I believe that was his name) to fix the problem. He verified that the flow problem was just in the kitchen. The hot water fix had restored flow to 3 rooms - guest bathroom, utility room, and kitchen. The flow was full force as before in the bathroom and utility room. He never checked the fix that had been made. All areas of the wall behind which work had been done were still open and easily accessible. Rather, he went to the kitchen faucet and cleaned the faucet's nozzle head screen - nice to have done- but it could not have been our problem since both cold and hot pass through it, and the cold water's flow was normal. He then verified that the valve that controlled flow to the sink was fully open, which was necessary a necessary step but that valve had not been touched in years. And then that was it. 
The water flow was still about half that of its previous level and of the cold water flow. There may have been a very slight change, but the problem was not corrected. He  offered no other ideas other than maybe sludge had accumulated in the pipe during the 4 days it was unused, and that over time it might clear. And the visit was over. He then left. 
Needless to say, we expected and expect the source of the problem to be identified and fixed, but that was that. God bless; hope all turns out well, bye, bye.
How do you reconcile these two experiences? The one we wrote up on Mar 9th and this one with the consistently 5.0 rating this company has? Our experience was that using them seemed like a "crap shoot." You might score a 7 one time and win or snakes eyes and lose.

reviews.author: Michael W.
reviews.text:
I noticed that there was a water leak in my main supply line.  I called Proven Plumbing on a Sunday and someone answered and booked an appointment for the next morning.  Monday Blake arrived at the scheduled appointment time.   He quickly got under the house and located the leak.  Blake explained to me the two options - repair of the current leak (~$3,000, it would require digging up some sidewalk) or replacing the entire supply line ($7,000 - 10,000).  He explained that the repair option would not cover any future leaks in other parts of my over 60 year old galvanized supply line.  Blake gave me some time to think it over, no pressure, and after a short time I could reasonably see that the best option was for a new line.  I had the impression from a later phone call on Monday that they would start the next day and that it would be 3-4 day job.  Next day it was apparent that there was some communication problem.  I called them about it and they called me back, owned the mistake, and scheduled for the following day.  The next day they came out with a four man crew and got the whole job done in a day.  I was very impressed with all aspects of their work, especially how they went the extra mile when trenching.  We have lots of plants, bushes, and trees so lots of roots.   When they trenched they worked over and under all the large roots, not just chopping them off.  I've never seen anyone do that before, it was a pretty amazing looking trench with roots running across it at a lot of levels.  
The final bill was the low end of the bid at $7,000; I am comfortable with that given the quality and quick work.  I would highly recommend Proven Plumbing, they proved to me they are worthy of their name.

reviews.author: Stanbo Miller
reviews.text:
Hooray for Zachary C! Routine maintenance turned into an urgent situation. We contacted Proven Plumbing based on the stellar Google reviews and nothing but positive recommendations from our community FB page.  40+ year old house, time for some routine bib and spigot replacements. The scheduled the consultation for the next day and by the end of the day we had received a quote.

We accepted the quote but were planning to wait until after the freeze / ice storm to schedule the service since nothing was urgent.  About 3 weeks later we received a call from our MUD that our usage was 5x the average and our meter was running constantly and we should check for leaks. Nothing in the house, I went around the perimeter and discovered an unplanned, small pond in the corner near our gas meter. I called late in the day and Proven scheduled us for the next morning. I should point out the communication is amazing via text updates and even a call when they were running 20 minutes late.

Zachary C was our plumber and he greeted us cheerily. I had spent the previous night fretting over how they would even fix this.  Zach took at look, didn't blink,  joked about not having any ducks yet, grabbed a shovel, and got to work. I'm not sure how he dug it out so fast but just like that the pipe and leak was exposed.  He also pointed out a kink in the pipe where it entered the slab, from the original installation, and took the time to chisel out some of the slab so he could round out the pipe and make the repair on the other side of the kink.

We're extremely happy with the work and the service and we have them scheduled to come out next week to do the maintenance items.

reviews.author: Lyly D.
reviews.text:
If you ever need a true professional, ask for ENRIQUE CHAVEZ at Proven. He's a Certified Master Plumber and hands down the most knowledgeable, reliable, and professional plumber we've ever worked with.

Enrique immediately came and diagnosed a hot water heater leak that I only suspected and had it replaced within an hour -- even taking the time to drive out and get the part himself. The next morning, when a new flood appeared in the same spot, he came out on a Sunday and quickly discovered it was a completely unrelated leak from our main water entrance. 

(Back to back leaks? Toll Brothers developers are developing a huge area next to our street and have literally been geo-forming the earth--jack hammering through layers of karst that our homes are sitting on. We have seen emergency plumber trucks up and down our street lately...)

Back to the good news! Because special adaptors were needed, the repair couldn't be completed that day -- but Enrique was back first thing Monday morning, crawling under an 18" space to replace half the distribution pipe connections. He explained every step, answered every question, and even gave great suggestions to improve our plumbing system long term.

Professional, punctual, and exceptionally skilled -- Enrique goes above and beyond. Proven Plumbing & Air is lucky to have him, and we're lucky to have found him. Highest recommendation possible!

I also want to give a special shout out to Yelp users for their excellent plumber recommendations! We couldn't have found Enrique with you, thank you!

reviews.author: Jenn P.
reviews.text:
Update: My previous experiences were great. This lastest one not so much. I accidentally broke my cannisters flush valve while trying to install a bidet myself. The guy said I should probably also update my handle to a metal one. Well I get the quote and they want to charge me $485!! $180 for the repair. $155 for the handle!?! And $150 to finish installing the bidet that I am providing...which is essentially just unscrew the hose, put in the T valve and connect. I know inflation is a thing but come on.

Noticed a very minor leak outside that wasn't currently even effecting my water bill. Cody came out, took a look and gave me his honest opinion even though it meant them not getting my business right away. I appreciated it tremendously being a single parent/income household and now knowing it'll be a costly fix. I will definitely be giving them a call back once I'm ready to handle the fix.

Updated: Sent a contact me request in the evening when I noticed a leak and I received a phone call from them as soon as it opened. They ended up moving things around and came out twice in the same day so I wouldn't have to have my leak running all weekend after the freeze. They have been so great to deal with! I would recommend them to anyone.

Blake was awesome to work with! He kept me updated the whole time and did his best to minimize extra holes, etc.

reviews.author: JoAnn
reviews.text:
We recently had an issue with our sprinkler system due to low water pressure, and the sprinkler company recommended replacing our pressure regulating valve (PRV). Since we had used Proven Plumbing & Air for a couple of jobs before and were extremely pleased with their work, we called them again.

Once again, Proven Plumbing did not disappoint. Chad and Michael came out to provide an estimate for the replacement. After checking the pressure and finding that it appeared to be fine, they honestly advised us that our PRV did not need to be replaced at that time.

We later decided to replace the PRV anyway since it was quite old, and Chad and Michael returned the next day to complete the job. They were professional, efficient, and thorough. They completed the replacement within the estimated time frame, answered all of our questions, and even offered to make any future pressure adjustments if needed.

I also had a great experience with the office staff regarding scheduling, questions, and billing. Amber and Jeremy were both very helpful.

Overall, we had another excellent experience with Proven Plumbing & Air and would absolutely recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: L G.
reviews.text:
I wanted a second opinion from my previous request for inspection of my water heater from a branded / lots of TV commercials / Plumbing and air services.  Not only did I have to pay them a $129 inspection fee but the service tech claimed that I need to replace my water heater and a bathroom faucet cartridge at the price of $260 something for the cartridge and approx. $3700 for the water heater.

I scheduled Proven Plumbing to come out and the technician was very helpful and showed me a few things to think about and watch but he did not state the urgency of replacement right away.  He did suggest replacing the water heater within this year giving me a sense that I have a bit more time to save on this expense
But, one thing to mention that really made me confortable is Proven will not only gouge you in cost, but is upfront and explains things.  The cost for repair for both devices was significantly lower than the other plumbing and air  vendor with their ambiguous commercials and high prices.

I plan on using Proven to replace my water heater and bathtub faucet cartridge very soon.

Beware of those other places on TV

Cheers!

synthesis.summary: Proven Plumbing delivers fast, professional service with strong communication — techs like Enrique and Zachary C. have earned glowing reviews for showing up same-day, explaining options clearly, and getting jobs done under estimate. The consistent weakness is pricing: multiple reviewers report $300+/hour rates, and one Yelp reviewer was charged 5x the average market rate. One significant workmanship incident where their excavation team cut a main water line and connected it to the irrigation supply.

Techs give detailed explanations and are upfront about costs before starting work

weaknesses: Pricing runs high for some jobs — multiple reviewers cite $300+/hour and one describes being charged 5x the market rate
