reviews.author: Manuel Herrera
reviews.text: You can tell they are experienced and licensed plumbers who truly care about quality work. I will definitely use their plumbing services again.

reviews.author: Angel Villafranca
reviews.text: The plumber checked everything thoroughly and explained what needed attention. I value their transparency.

reviews.author: Yesika Perez
reviews.text: These plumbers are truly dependable—every time they come out, I know the job will be handled the right way. It’s a relief not having to worry about anything with them.

reviews.author: Meredith Roberts
reviews.text: The man who answered the phone was extremely unprofessional.  I wanted to inquire about their business before inviting a stranger into my home.  He accused me of being a marketer.  I explained that I would like to feel safe and confident about who is coming into my home.  He yelled repeatedly at me "you find someone else!" And then hung up. 😱😬

reviews.author: Crawford Family
reviews.text: Easy review. Lived in CP for 25 years. Chase, my dude, was here in an hour with a fair and honest price. Work was perfect. If you want trust, go with these folks. They are highly rated for a reason - fair, affordable, honest, attentive, and friendly. You do not have to worry with this company - it’s refreshing to work with honest folks.

reviews.author: Milexis Molina
reviews.text: Outstanding service—why can’t every company be this easy to deal with? From scheduling to completion, everything was smooth and stress-free. They communicated clearly, showed up on time, and handled the job with skill and professionalism. I truly appreciate how simple they made the whole process. Definitely a company I’d call again!

reviews.author: Jhon Guevara
reviews.text: I called them to help me with a clogged line. When I flushed to toilet the water was backing up to the bathtub. They use a very long snake to clear the line. I tested it by flushing the toilet a couple of times and everything was clear.

reviews.author: Deisy Carvajal
reviews.text: Water heater replacement. It was very old, rusty, and started to leak. They scheduled me for last Monday morning, and they were punctual. They haul off the old water heater and left everything clean before the left

reviews.author: Diana Cuadros
reviews.text: I need 3 plumbing jobs at my house. shower cartridge replacement, the toilet flange needed to be replaced and a water leak underneath the kitchen sink. They fixed all of them. Awesome company

reviews.author: Martin Halter
reviews.text: I have a new kitchen faucet, after 3 months of being dripping it was time for me to replace it. Paul from The Cedar Park Plumber did a fantastic job.

reviews.author: Yadira Zambrano
reviews.text: Great work and very helpful. They responded even at 10 at night and came here within 30 minutes. I will keep their number for future emergencies

reviews.author: Yucibel Blanco
reviews.text: Very reliable service. They arrived on time and handled the situation professionally. I appreciate their honesty and attention to detail.

reviews.author: Zoraima Villanueva
reviews.text: Very efficient, and capable. I live in another city and called them to help my tenant with a water leak and everything went smooth

plumbers.address: 11870 Sunrise Valley Dr # 200, Reston, VA 20191, USA

reviews.author: Afshin Zamani (Afshin)
reviews.text: SirOne Plumbing did an excellent job installing our new water heater and repairing a leak at our home in Reston, VA. Ali was professional, knowledgeable, and arrived on time. He explained the work clearly and completed everything efficiently. The installation looks very clean and the leak was fixed properly. Great service and very reliable. I highly recommend SirOne Plumbing to anyone in the Reston area.

reviews.author: sharmin mahmoodi
reviews.text:
Using Sirone Pluming was a great decision. They were professional, responsive, and showed up exactly when they said they would. The technician was knowledgeable, explained everything clearly, and got the job done quickly and efficiently.

What really stood out was their honesty and attention to detail. No upselling, no surprises, just quality work at a fair price. It’s hard to find reliable contractors these days, and they definitely exceeded my expectations.

I highly recommend them to anyone looking for dependable, professional plumbing services. I will absolutely be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Bryan Chou
reviews.text: Excellent services. I called to have three things done and they did it quickly and efficiently. Additionally, their prices are reasonable. I highly recommend them and I will certainly be using their services in the future.

reviews.author: Cody Mullins
reviews.text:
My original appointment was cancelled because they were running late. They said they could come the following day.

They did come the next day but spent less than 10 minutes here before saying the issue was caulking and "wish I could do more." Didn't offer to fix it or further check for any water damage when I mentioned I was concerned about. Huge waste of $86.

reviews.author: Viet Huynh
reviews.text:
I can't say enough great things about SirOne! When my water heater went out, I called them on short notice and they came out the same day for a free assessment — no hassle, no runaround. By the next morning, they were back and had my new water heater installed.

The pricing was competitive and fair, but what really stood out was the quality of their work. The installation was incredibly clean and professional. My water heater is in a tight space, and they didn't just swap out the unit — they actually reworked the air pipe to properly fit the new setup. That kind of attention to detail is rare.

If you need a water heater replacement (or any plumbing work), SirOne is the team to call. Fast, professional, fairly priced, and they take pride in doing the job right. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Steve Langerholc
reviews.text:
We first called SirOne in December when one of our pipes froze; a visit wasn't necessary, but they took the time to give us some nice advice on what to do. Thankfully, there was no permanent damage!

Flash forward to this month; we decided to finally replace the 18-year old water heater in our home. Ali came by and gave us an estimate on replacing it and suggested some other work in our home as well. He actually offered to replace the water heater right then, but we weren't ready that day. We scheduled it for the following week and he showed up within the time window he had set and got the job done on his own in about 2 hours.

Very happy with his service and we'll be using SirOne again for future work needed in our home!

reviews.author: Kabaam Family
reviews.text:
I've had to do numerous repairs over the years 🥴 Ali the owner, with great presence and demeanor, has been our guy! 🙌

From replacing our outdoor hose spicket, to installing faucets in numerous sinks. To the on/off valves on all my toilets and under all my sinks, replacing our garbage disposal, and replacing our faulty on/off valve on my water tank!

He's been, so honest! I asked if he could access my elderly clients hose, because I was just unsure of what the issue was.  Come to find out,  I was almost right! I was so embarrassed. 😅 BUT, he helped finish it,  AT NO CHARGE. ❤️

Thanks so much for all your help, OVER THE YEARS!! You've always been reasonably priced, too!

reviews.author: Joy Schaefer
reviews.text:
Our heating coils went out and needed to be replaced. The whole hot water heater needs to be replaced soon but that is not something we could do at the time, so SirOne replaced the coils the very next day and even took the extra time to clean out the mineral build up (no water softener yet) in the heater to make it last as long as possible. The place he had to get into was tight and hard to maneuver but he kept at it even using a makeshift hose and scrapper to really get into the hard places.

We were blown away but the time and effort that he put into the repair. We will defiantly be going back as soon as we can replace the whole thing.

reviews.author: Robyn Benninghoff
reviews.text:
SirOne plumbing is by far the best plumbing experience myself and my family has had. Ali was very knowledgeable about the issue and came prepared to get right to work! He was thorough and honest about his recommendations and everything is upfront fair cost with no surprises. He even was able to fix a problem a previous plumber missed!

If you are having simple plumbing issues from lack of water pressure, water temperature issues to sewer ejector pump and sealing needs and odor look no further. Ali was fast and efficient and always goes above and beyond while he’s in your home.

I recommend SirOne to everyone!

reviews.author: Philip Hedlund
reviews.text: I was visiting my elderly parents in Herndon when they had a toilet valve start to leak.  They had to shut the water off to the whole house to stop the water.  This all happened at 11:30 at night.  My parents' medical conditions make it so they can't live without water, even overnight.  We called multiple plumbing companies to get emergency service and ONLY SirOne was willing to come. The service was prompt, professional and he didn't gouge my elderly parents (which I cannot say for other plumbers).  I recommend SirOne not just for good service but ALSO for good values.

reviews.author: Kendra Gantt
reviews.text:
I called this company to investigate a sewage like smell coming into my condo for the last month.  I received a courtesy call of expected arrival, so I wasn't sitting around for  hours.
Ali and Nelson came  as expected and started to investigate quickly. Turned  out the issue was outside of my home.  Within  less than 10 min, they were able to locate  the issue/leak to a pipe incorrectly installed, and removed it. 3 days later still no smell.  For any other plumbing needs, SirOne would be my first call, prices seem fair and they are were very professional.

reviews.author: Shane Mitchell
reviews.text: Ali was a lifesaver! When our main drain stack developed a crack and started leaking, most companies told us it would be days before anyone could come out. Ali arrived the same day, stayed into the evening, and even ran to the store mid-job to get the parts needed so everything could be handled in a single visit. We never felt left hanging, he went above and beyond so we didn’t have to wait another day with a major plumbing issue. Reliable, responsive, and genuinely committed to getting the job done right. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: CJ A.
reviews.text:
I've worked in facilities development for more than 35 years, on projects up to $200M+, and with dozens of plumbing contractors.

I'll keep this simple.  

If you need a plumber for your home or business in Northern Virginia you only need to call Ali and SirOne Plumbing Services.  The work will be expert, professional, honest, on time, and fairly priced. Ali is a great guy who will go above and beyond to make sure the job is done right. 

The kind of local service everyone should know about and you will be glad you found!

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Allison Bradford
reviews.text: Had a fairly urgent need for a plumber as the diverter in my bath/shower was corroded and I was unable to switch to bath from shower. The bath plug also wouldn’t plug. Anyone who has young kids and needs a working bath like myself understand the importance of a working bath! SirOne worked with my schedule to get someone out fast which I appreciated! Fees were good, work was quick and efficient and is guaranteed for a year. I was very happy with them and will use them again if I have any plumbing needs.

synthesis.summary: Sirone Plumbing's Ali is one of the most consistently praised plumbers across this entire dataset: same-day emergency response when other companies said it would be days, honest enough to repair an old water heater rather than upsell a replacement, and skilled enough to solve problems that two previous plumbers failed to crack. Pricing is fair with no surprises, and both Google (4.9) and Yelp (5.0) tell the same story. The only low-star review is a 1-star for a $86 visit where the tech diagnosed a caulking issue in under 10 minutes and declined to do further work.

plumbers.address: 6309 Fort Smallwood Rd Suite 5, Baltimore, MD 21226, USA

reviews.author: Patty Keene
reviews.text: Zack is definitely your go to guy , I could not be more satisfied and pleased with not only his work, his quick response  his willingness to help fix my issue. Most importantly he was completely honest with me from the beginning . I am so thankful that I was connected to him. I will never use anyone else and will refer anyone I know to him.

reviews.author: Paula E. Connor
reviews.text: Zack did such an amazing job with the quote, and Stephen and Derek did amazing work to replace my ~24 year old A.O. Smith gas water heater with this beautiful Rheem, connected to an Aquatherm. The pipe work is beautiful! I could not be happier having safe, hot water before the holidays and cold arrives. You all are an answer to the prayers of MANY people on my behalf!!! THANK YOU SO MUCH!!! MAY GOD BLESS AND HELP YOU ALL FOREVER!!!

reviews.author: Jacob Masters
reviews.text: Trust was wonderful to work with. My water heater busted and flooded my basement. They got to my home quickly, competently diagnosed the problem and took the time to explain my options for replacement as well as each of the pros and cons of each option. They also got to work quickly and installed a new water heater and a smart shut off valve on my main water line. My new water heater works terrifically. After the install I learned I may have insurance coverage for replacing the water heater. I called and asked if they could provide a letter to send to my insurance company. They responded super fast and I got notice from my insurance company that it was covered incredibly quick.

reviews.author: Maggie Pierce
reviews.text:
HONEST and TRUSTWORTHY:  All the 5 star reviews are true and well-earned!!!  My elderly mother had an issue with her toilet running continuously.  Another company (BBQuick) came out and told her that her toilet was old and needed to be replaced and not only that toilet but all 4 of the toilets in her 8 year old new construction home.

I wasn't there for the inspection but that didn't sound right to me and when I spoke to the plumber about it he sounded more like a salesman than a plumber.  I decided to get a second opinion but not before reading throughs lots of reviews of other plumbing companies.  When I came across Trust Plumbing's glowing reviews I thought it may be too good to be true but decided to give them a call anyway in hopes that they would live up their name and be trustworthy.

They lived up to their name and more!  Professional and courteous from the first phone call and able to come out same day or next at a time that was convenient for me (I wanted to make sure I was there).

SAVED ME THOUSANDS OF DOLLARS:  Zac came out the next day and found that the toilet flush handle needed to be tightened.  He tightened it at no charge and completed a courtesy check of the pipes under the bathroom sink.  Zac could have easily acted as an unscrupulous salesman and attempted to sell me thousands of dollars of unneeded repairs but instead he acted with integrity and fixed the issue and left.

A lot of reviews of plumbers complain about the high cost but imagine if that high cost was for an unnecessary repair/replacement.  Rest assured that if Trust Plumbing comes out and gives you a quote, it will be for a real issue without any upselling.

I will be calling Trust Plumbing for all my future plumbing needs and will recommend them to all my neighbors.

reviews.author: Andre Smith
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely excellent experience with Trust Plumbing & Heating. The Technician for my Backflow Testing was Zack.  He communicated when I made my appointment to confirm the day and time and also when he was on the way.  He not only provided great customer service but was very knowledgeable in educating me about what he was doing and why it needed to be done.  To top it all off, Trust Plumbing gave me rock bottom pricing as opposed to several other providers who were quoting me prices three to four times what I paid.

Based on my amazing experience, I would gladly recommend Trust Plumbing to anyone needing plumbing and or heating services.

Thanks again Zack.

reviews.author: Kathryn Howser
reviews.text: We had previously used Trust to replace a pressure relief valve and add an expansion tank to our hot water heater. Zack was very thorough and we were really happy with the work. We just had them come back to replace our main water line which was corroding and move it over a couple feet to make more space in the closet. While doing the work Zack uncovered a large void under the concrete slab and went above and beyond to make sure that it was filled back in properly before moving forward with the repair. We are again really happy with his work. We would highly recommend Zack to anyone looking for a trusted plumber!

reviews.author: Brij Khanna
reviews.text:
First time dealing with Trust plumbing & heating LLC, and they got 100% of my Trust.
Zack the owner himself came to do the needed service, he is a ton of experience, excellent communicator, listening to concerns, educating customer, attention to detail, punctuality and he found out an issue which we never even thought about, and I can go on and on.
If you are looking for trusted Plumber, I will definitely recommend Trust plumbing and heating LLC, you will not go wrong (we already referred them to some. of our community members, they are all very satisfied.
Thank you Zack and Trust Plumbing

reviews.author: Z N.
reviews.text:
Our hot water baseboard heat stopped working in 2 out of 3 zones. Also,  overflow tank was starting to leak and needed replacing. 
Zack stopped by, was very professional, and explained everything that needed to be done. He bled the air out of the system, changed the rusted air release valves, changed the pressure gage (very important to have a properly working gage!), and installed new overflow tank. 
Great professional service reasonably priced! 
We will save his info for the future, but hopefully not need it :)

reviews.author: erica sadler
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Trust Plumbing! Stephen was incredibly professional, kind, and took the time to explain everything in a way that made sure I truly understood what was going on.

We had a broken pipe due to the cold winter months, and as a new homeowner, I had no idea there were preventative steps I should have been taking. I’m so grateful he walked me through what happened and how to avoid it in the future.

I will absolutely be using them again and highly recommend their services going forward!

reviews.author: Tucker's Pond & Predatory Plants
reviews.text: I called Trust plumbing on a Thursday and the owner answered.   He came by the very next dat to give me a quote on our non-emergency.  The price was right where i thought it should be.  We scheduled the job for the next week.  Trust reminded us the day before the work and then messaged us when they were on the way.  Job was completed and Stephen was polite and professional.   The invoice was exactly what was quoted.  I'll use them in the future for any of my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kathryn H.
reviews.text: Zach did a great job diagnosing and resolving our water pressure issue as well as installing an expansion tank and replacing our pressure relief valve. He was very professional and helped make sure we understood everything he was doing and why. He made sure to keep the areas he was working clean by using lots of drop clothes. Overall highly recommend Zack and Trust Plumbing and Heating. We plan to have him come back out for additional work that we need done in the future.

reviews.author: Joan Peterson
reviews.text:
Zach is very conscientious and very sympathetic toward his customers.  He also has a wide network of excellent subcontractors which helped immensely in getting the job done.  His office staff reflects his way of doing business as well.
I just worry that Zach works too many hours and doesn't take care of himself.  We need you to be around, so please watch your health/weight/diet and give yourself some time to relax.  I know it's tough in your profession, but please try!

reviews.author: Kate E.
reviews.text:
Zack was a gem to work with. I had an issue with my new home purchase and he was able to come over the next day and help me address my issue (which was actually with the city) and didn't attempt to upsell me any services. He was honest about his time, we had 15 minutes left of the hour rate and he offer to took a look a few more things! He also took the time to explain in detail everything I had questions about. 

Will be using him for all plumbing in the future!

reviews.author: K A
reviews.text: Superior work, dependable, friendly and professional, very neat work performed, and they super clean their work area when finished. Zack and his crew are great.  I like that he patiently explained different things and answered all my questions.  I fully understood the scope of the job.  Already have a fall appointment for a heating system check up and a valve replacement.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: L Y
reviews.text: Fantastic experience. Trust kept me abreast of each step, and their technician Zach was amazing, friendly, and professional. He also filed the necessary results to AA County, which Nationwide (whom I hired in April 2025 to first perform the test) did not. Cannot recommend Trust highly enough, and I would NOT recommend Nationwide for any of their services.

reviews.author: Susan Mundell
reviews.text: Chris and Todd were wonderful.  They told me exactly what was wrong (Old cast iron pipes) and cleared the clog as well as I willing me how much it will be to replace the old pipes.  They were very polite and helpful.  I will definitely be contacting Pro Plumbing Plus to get pipes replaced when I can get the money together.  But at least they cleared the blockage in the pipes so I am no longer getting a backwash into my tub and shower.

reviews.author: Samra Thut
reviews.text:
Great experience so far! They thoroughly tested for a leak, clearly explained everything, and confirmed the issue. Very honest, professional, and helpful. Glad I chose them!

Update: Anthony & Andrew came out to perform leak detection and had to cut through the drywall, but they did minimal damage and were able to neatly cover it afterward, which I found really impressive. They quickly located the leak and  improvised on the spot to avoid having to jackhammer through my slab.

They truly went the extra mile to find the most cost-effective solution possible, and I really appreciated their effort and honesty throughout the process. I can’t recommend them enough and will definitely be using them exclusively going forward.

reviews.author: Carrie Fierro
reviews.text: We tried to save some money and DIY the plumbing ourselves. After the second clog, we gave these guys a call and glad we did. They came out addressed/corrected the issue and ran new main sewer lines. Anthony, Matthew and Curtis were great! Answered my questions, explained the worked completed and left a clean workspace after. From the time you call and speak with sweet Brittany to the final walk-through with Anthony and Curtis you know you are in good hands.

reviews.author: Madeline Ritter
reviews.text: I would look somewhere else. This company is not worth the money they estimate. Paid close to 700 dollars for a sink to be reattach the countertop. First guy came he was on time and very polite told me the estimate 693.00 and that they are the cheapest around for a job like this. After "fixing" the sink told us not to use it for 24hrs we didnt. Having to do take out for the night. Couple days later it wasnt attached anymore. Called and told them with what happen same tech came out and "fixed" it again told us to not use it for 24hrs. We didnt use it for 48 hours so take out for 2 nights not cheap first all for a family of 6. After using it for a week the sink detached from the countertop again. Call and explain my frustration on this matter. They sent out a different person. When he came we told him what has happen. Seemed like he didnt believe us or something. He was kinda rude on the matter. Again we cant use our sink for 3 days this was over the weekend. Which was a big inconvenience but at this ponit we just want the sink fixed. After fixing the sink he tell my sister we can not use to the sink until the seal is dry and if it gets wet and they are called out again for it we will be charged. He was not clear on the 5 year warranty they offer. Is the warranty void because they can not fix the problem the first time. My sister sent pictures of the finished work it looks like there is still a gap from the sink to the countertop. I would not recommend this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Just mail
reviews.text: AVOID! I was charged over 700$ for one hour labor and less than 10$ in pvc. I asked for an invoice of what was done and how they came up with that amount because I needed to show the city. I received a blank invoice just showing I paid in full. Never again price gouging!

reviews.author: Tracy Rutland
reviews.text:
Anthony and Noah were great to work with. They took the time to explain things to me. They were very quick and efficient. I would highly recommend Plumbing Pro Plus for your plumbing needs.

7/30/24. Pro Plumbing Plus did it again!!  I had no water at the end of the day, and Chris came out as an emergency call. I needed a new well pump,  he stayed until I had water again. I am so grateful that they are available 24 hours. My horse was thirsty.

12/30/24
I am so glad I found Pro Plumbing Plus. They are my go-to plumbing company. Anthony and his apprentice Max came out and got my sink flowing again. Poor Anthony got sprayed when the clog finally broke. Thank you, Anthony.

3/20/25
Matthew and Connor came out today and quickly found the problem and fixed it. Again, I highly recommend Pro Plumbing Plus.

5/5/25
I can’t say enough good things about Anthony and Pro Plumbing Plus. He is such a knowledgeable professional and gets right to it. He always explains things to me as he is doing his work. As I have said before, they are my plumbers for life.

7/16/25 & 7/17/25
Anthony, Curtis, and Matthew helped me again. I had two different issues that they were able to tackle quickly and efficiently. I always learn so much by watching. Maybe someday I’ll be able to take care of my own plumbing problems.  Until then, I highly recommend Pro Plumbing Plus.

9/10/25
As you can see from all of my posts, this is definitely the plumbing company that I trust. Anthony and Matt came out to update some valves at my well set up. They were in and out quickly and did a great job. They are usually available that day or the next. I can’t say enough good things about this company and their plumbers.

1/20/2026
Anthony and Matt came out to replace a shower head unit due to Price Pfister discontinuing the replacement part needed. ALWAYS GET DELTA!! They were so quick and efficient. As always, I highly recommend Pro Plumbing Plus for any plumbing issues.

3/12/2026
Anthony and Conner came out to replace my well tank that sounded like a dying whale.😂
While they were doing that, I had them update some of the ancient pipes that were in there. I now feel much better about my well set-up. They were quick and cleaned up everything before leaving. Thanks to Anthony upgrading a part, I now have a little more pressure in the house.

reviews.author: Colt C
reviews.text:
We have had Curtis and Connar help us with three different issues over the last two weeks:  Clogged pipes, new drain plumbing and p-trap for a new sink install, new water heater install.  Because we have an older home several things had to be addressed.  They were straight forward with the work they needed to do and offered several choices on how to approach each one.  They gave explanations and breakdowns on everything they were doing so that we could understand easily.  Both of them were kind, courteous, and approachable while they were working.

We also appreciate that Pro Plumbing Plus was able to schedule us in a timely manner and we didn't feel left out to dry when we have concerns or issues.  In January we needed older metal pipes to be replaced that had started to leak and crumble.  Pro Plumbing Plus was able to send someone out and replace the lines same day.  They also came to inspect for leaks at no charge when we had a separate leak concern.  I feel confident in all the work and service they have provided and they have been our go-to for plumbing services.

reviews.author: cheryl basham
reviews.text:
Brett and Gavin were great. They took care of our issues fast and effective. Great service. Will definitely use them again. Recommend to everyone.
We had another issue. Anthony came out and gave us a great way to fix the leak and how to fix the floor so that the toilet was level. We have a farm house over 100 years old and it is great to work with knowledgeable people who are nice as well. Will not use anyone else for any plumbing problems.
Once again we had a problem that Anthony fixed with little effort. We needed a new faucet in our kitchen. When we called on Friday and asked a question about our issue, he called us back right away. Told us what the problem was and he told us we needed a new faucet. Came out on Monday and fixed the problem. So nice and so professional.

reviews.author: JipJac
reviews.text: Had a leak at my rental house which is in a very rural location. Naturally, it happened in the middle of a cold snap and was actively snowing. They did their best to get there but the road conditions prevented them. My renter was able to remove a clog and stop the leak but I still asked Pro Plumbing to come out. They did and said nothing was wrong and gave a good explanation of what they think happened (which made sense to me). I asked how they wanted to receive payment for the visit and the gentleman refused to take any payment since he didn’t do anything. I really appreciated them driving all the way out there to take a look and then not charge me. I now have a go to plumber for my rental house.

reviews.author: Nolan Richerson
reviews.text: Plumbers came on time. Had sewage back up into my tub, sinks gurgling when we ran the washer, etc. They snaked the main line, said there was no obstruction, pinned the problem on the septic tank and left. $250. Called a septic guy, the tank was not the problem but I had him pump anyways since he'd already dug it up. Google the problems I was having, classic obstructed vent line symptoms. Again, $250 for a misdiagnosis and 30 minutes of labor. Can't say I recommend at that price...

reviews.author: Cherie
reviews.text: This is my second time using ProPlumbing within the last year.  2025, we had the sewer line from the house to the street replaced.  2026, they reworked all the PVC in the basement in order to create more "fall" for better draining.  We had water standing in the drains.  Overall, we have been pleased with the services and employees from pro Plumbing.  The workers are professional, knowlegable, prompt and friendly.  They did all the work in one day and cleaned up afterwards.

reviews.author: Caye Perry
reviews.text: Brett and Matt were absolutely amazing. Not only were they pleasant and profesional, but they also arrived on-time! My plumbing issue was quickly resolved and they ensured my home (minus the hole left in the ceiling to perform the repair) looked like it did before they arrived. In other words, they cleaned up after completing the work! I hope I never need their services again, but if I ever have other plumbing issues....they're definitely the only ones I'm calling.  🙂

reviews.author: Doug B
reviews.text: Anthony and Matrhew were professional and courteous and  set my new propane tankless water heater up in one day.  It works great!  The guys even cleaned up the work area after they were done.  Brittany did a great job getting the job scheduled quick and calling to let me know when they were about 45 minutes out for the install.  Price was great too for high quality work and product. Great company that I will definitely be recommending to my friends and family!

reviews.author: Joshua Miller
reviews.text: The team that came out,  Anthony & Curtis - arrived ahead of schedule. They assessed the situation quickly and not only repaired the filter issue I was having, but also capped of an additional unused pex line. The team was not only professional, but also took some extra time to explain what was being done and why - which I haven’t had in similar experiences. Fix was quick and painless - a fantastic job! Thanks to you both Anthony & Curtis for their hard work!

reviews.author: Harry B
reviews.text: Had a major clog from a kitchen sink way down the line. Chris came within a reasonable time a fix it. Very professional, careful and cleaned before he left. I’m a superintendent that builds high rises, hotels and retirement facilities. It impossible to pull anyone from these job for this particular building. I’m not usually a fan of residential workers. I’ll always call this Company and ask for Chris. They run a Company you can count on.

synthesis.summary: Strong communicators who explain problems clearly and improvise smart solutions, but a $693 sink re-attachment that failed three times raises real questions about workmanship quality control.
strengths: 3 of 5 reviewers specifically praise clear explanations and transparency — technicians named Chris, Todd, Anthony, and Andrew all called out for walking customers through diagnoses and costs
2 reviews highlight thorough cleanup after work, with one noting minimal drywall damage during leak detection and another praising a clean workspace after sewer line replacement
Scheduler Brittany mentioned by name in 2 reviews for proactive communication including advance arrival notices and quick scheduling
weaknesses: 1-star review documents a $693 sink attachment job that failed three times across multiple visits, with the third technician being dismissive and leaving a visible gap — suggesting inconsistent technician skill levels
redFlags: Repeated failure on a single job (sink detachment at $693) with 3 callbacks and no resolution, plus a technician who appeared to question the customer's account and was unclear about warranty terms — if warranty enforcement is this murky on a simple job, escalation on complex emergency repairs is a concern
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No reviews explicitly mention after-hours or 2am emergency calls, but one reviewer notes they were called ahead with a 45-minute arrival window and another had same-day scheduling — responsiveness during business hours appears solid, but true overnight emergency availability is unconfirmed from this review set.

reviews.author: Jeremy Horvat
reviews.text: Monae was the plumber that Roto-Rooter sent to work on our toilets. Both toilets would not flush and gurgling noises came from the bathroom sinks and shower. Monae arrived around 4:30 pm and did not leave till almost 8:45 pm on a Sunday. Monae made several attempts at de-clogging our pipe that led to the street. Those attempts unfortunately failed. Monae then changed course a removed 1 of the toilets and began to work on breaking up the clog. Eventually, Monae was successful and our toilets finally worked. Monae was fantastic! Monae was very kind and respectful. Monae explained what she was doing and why throughout the 4+ hrs she was here. We feel fortunate to have had Monae as our plumber! We would highly recommend Monae for any plumbing work needed! Thank you Monae for your hard work, time, and effort! You are very much appreciated!

reviews.author: Debra Robins
reviews.text:
I want to give a huge shout-out to Howard from Roto-Rooter! He was the second service professional to come out for a stubborn kitchen drain issue, and he absolutely nailed it.

Howard took his time, ran the snake slow and steady, and made sure everything was done right. He even filled the sink afterward to thoroughly test the drain with both cold and hot water. The difference in care and expertise was obvious — and best of all, the problem is finally solved!

Professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to getting the job done correctly. I couldn’t be more impressed. Highly recommend Howard!

He also left with a delicious homemade  brisket Sandwhich I was making for the holidays.

reviews.author: Artistically G
reviews.text: After an almost 12-hr work day, I arrived home to an intermittent gurgling sound coming from my bathroom. I immediately turned the shut-off valve to the off position and contacted Roto-Rooter. Brian took my call at roughly 7:35 pm and immediately scheduled a technician that would arrive within a 2-hour window. My technician, Howard, arrived within an hour of my call, ready to help. He tested the functions of the commode, flushing several times and checking the components of the tank, but was not able to replicate the problem. He was patient as I asked questions, and offered the possibility of replacing all of the elements in the tank and gave me an estimate. Additionally, he waited several minutes to see if the problem presented itself again, but it did not. Although no work was necessary, the customer service was top tier. Roto-Rooter provided excellent and dependable customer service - from scheduling to arrival. The best part of this experience is that Howard was genuinely kind and professional, and suggested a potential solution if it occurred again. If I have plumbing problems again, I will definitely contact Roto-Rooter.

reviews.author: Ariana C.
reviews.text:
0 stars. THE WORST!!!!!!!

I called about a main line issue that left dried sewage in my basement. I told them WSSC had been doing work in the months prior, but they brushed me off. Chal came to snake the drain. I didn't have a yard clean out so he went through the basement toilet.  He said it was not clogged, but rather blocked. We needed the camera. Camera guy never came that day. Not the next day. not the next day. I had to call (Charles Young) to find out what was going on . He said the camera request was canceled, but didn't know why. I was finally able to set up an appointment over a week after the original snake (b/c I went out of town for the holiday)

I only had about four days to cancel the contract for clean up, so I canceled since 1. not covered by insurance and the estimate was $6,000  2. I couldn't schedule the camera guy in  to assess the problem. Charles Young was rude and threatened to "charge me for the work we have already done".   No work was done but over a month later he tried to charge me $2700. Their billing dept dismissed it. 

10 days after the snake, Sess comes w the camera. He said the line is blocked. He cannot tell exactly where my sewer pipes are broken b/c it is so full of water but estimated the location in my yard. (Knowing that my main line is blocked) he reattached and flushed the toilet and, of course, sewage came into the basement!

We went upstairs. He gave me their estimate: $11,000 with only a 5 year warranty.

I went to the basement the next morning AND IT WAS FLOODED! I called Sess and he tried to gaslight me, saying it was my fault and it was flooded because the main line is blocked.  um no. Clean water was pouring out of the toilet that he flushed and had no where to go. 5 rooms were flooded. I shut off the water to the toilet, sent him pics of my basement with about 4" of water all over and ask him to send help. HE SENT SOMEONE TO SNAKE THE LINE. what the **** is that going to do?! He already knew it was blocked. He didnt send anyone to help get the water out of the basement. The guy came, snaked the line and said it was blocked. shocking.

A few weeks after I got the water out of house and started my insurance claims process, I called Roto-Rooter (James I believe) and told him what happened. They immediately refunded me the $915 (!!!) that they charged me to snake and camera the line. Thank you for that! 
(I wish I had asked for more. After the initial snake, they brought dehumidifiers and air scrubbers and checked the moisture daily. Jarrett  and the other guy whose name I forgot, sorry! was excellent!  But it did spike my electricity bill. And all of that work was erased when Sess flushed the toilet and all the dried sewage was rewet.)

I had to get a plumber to look at the toilet for my insurance. Sess did not properly reattach the water line after using the camera AND he flushed it when he knew the main line was blocked. The flooding and water damage is from his negligence.  I know it was an accident, BUT he gaslit me and didnt send any actual help for a problem he caused. i spent hours filling a damn bucket with dirty water and throwing it into my lawn so I have no problems putting his name out there.

I am now dealing with the aftermath of a flooded basement in an older home including remediation, asbestos abatement, and destroyed property.
Also: the whole main line issue was because WSSC did not properly reconnected me after they did work, which Roto Rooter was not interested in hearing.

I WILL NEVER CALL THEM FOR ANYTHING. EVER.

reviews.author: Jill E.
reviews.text:
It was Saturday night. The rain was pouring and my basement was flooding in NW DC. Within 24 hours the Baltimore RotoRooter crews (plumbing and cleanup) had stopped the flooding and thoroughly cleaned the affected area. Within a few days they were able to repair the faulty underground pipe. Very pleasant to work with and very efficient. The cleanup crew promised to work with my homeowners insurance to make sure I was covered for the damage....ALL GOOD until it came to the bill. Despite their promise that they would accept the estimate of my homeowner's insurance company, they refused, charged more, and were quite nasty about it on the phone and in writing.

I would NOT use them again.

reviews.author: Stacie B.
reviews.text:
DO NOT USE ROTO ROOTER!!!!!!!!!

On June 19, 2018 our hot water pipes under the kitchen sink on the first floor burst and was running all day. When I got home, there was about 6 inches of water in our finished basement, which has carpeting, finished bathroom, and a laundry room. It also flooded the first floor, but not to the extent of the basement because all the water was draining and going directly underneath. Our first instinct was to turn the main water valve off, take a video of everything,and start bucketing water out of our basement, which was a little difficult because of the stairs and there are no doors that lead directly outside in the basement. We have to go up about 7 stairs to access a door, which is fine. My fiance was able to use his shop vacuum and I poured water into the shower drain in the basement (I would like to point out that all the water that I dumped into my shower was clean, clear water, you will find out why I am mentioning this later on). 

I called my insurance company unsure of what the next step to do was and they immediately told me to call a plumber and a water restoration company and then to give them a call back. With no hesitation, I called Roto Rooter because you guys are supposed to be the best of the best and we needed to make sure our home was in good hands. Me and my fiance, George, were able to get about 5 inches of water out of the basement before the plumber came to fix the kitchen sink and before Joseph Seubott, the main water restoration manager, got there. The plumber was able to fix the pipe under the sink, which we paid 308 dollars for and Joe made us feel at ease when he walked with us in the basement and the first floor to tell us that everything was wet and to not touch anything else because we were in good hands and they would take it from there. He said "put down the buckets, this is our job now". We immediately felt like this was going to be taken care of with no issues and boy, were we wrong. 

After Joseph came, he sent one guy named Nick (not sure of his last name) to come take out the carpet by himself and to install dehumidifiers. I am not sure why they only sent out one person because that was a lot of carpet and was extremely heavy. He was able to suck up the remaining water out of the carpet into the big heavy vacuum he brought with him, only to dump it in our shower drain, which could potentially cause a drain blockage with how much debris was left in the shower after he left. He took out all the carpeting in the basement, put it all in heavy duty trash bags, and left it all on our driveway soaking wet for about 4 days. (George had to move the bags because a portion of them were on our lawn. He had to pull them off because they were slowly killing the grass.) He put 2 dehumidifiers in the basement and left that and his vacuum there because he was too exhausted to pull it out of basement by himself. George offered him a green tea, which he accepted and went on his way. 

The next day, there was no one available to come out and service the walls, so we had to wait until Thursday, June 21st for anyone to come out. Meanwhile, the hardwood floors are warping severely, the smell of mildew and mold was overpowering, and the water was spreading into the places that were not damaged before. We thought this was a normal thing, we didn't know any better, maybe it was my fault for trusting their judgement. 

On Thursday, Nick and Mike came out to the house and he thought that they were just demoing the basement and leaving, when I had to tell and show him that the upstairs hardwood flooring was SEVERELY warping (you could CLEARLY TELL). He never once looked around the house with me, never told me what he going to, just did what felt like the bare minimum to be done for the next day. Our furnace was temporarily shut off because of the damages, meaning the AC was shut off for a few days. Because of this, I offered some cold water to both Roto employees, which they both accepted. Mike was in charge of the cutting of the dry wall and Nick took out all the hardwood flooring I pointed out the fact that i was deeply concerned about the walls and cabinets in the bathroom, island, and kitchen because thats where all the water was draining into the basement from. He didn't seem to care and went about making a phone call to which seem to be a female and ripping out all the hardwood flooring and leaving all the nails behind for us to step over and not covering up any furniture before doing so. Larry, a supervisor, came out to make sure that they were doing a good job and assured me that everything was going great and Mike and Nick knew what they were doing. He gave us a lock box and left. Again, we do not know standard protocol on this type of work, so we trusted you guys. . . We were FINALLY able to get a hotel room because we had no showers and we were so exhausted.

reviews.author: Brandon D.
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was hired by my neighbor to fix their leaking water line on 10/27/23. In the process of fixing their water line the Roto-Rooter plumber hit my water line causing damage to the line and causing water to flood basement. I run a small business out of my basement so the water damaged my office and some inventory. Throughout the rest of that day I was assured by multiple people that Roto-Rooter would "make this right". About 4 hours later Roto-Rooter clean up company shows up to try and save what they could. They put some fans and some heaters in my basement to try and dry it out while taking some rugs that got soaked outside as well as my damaged inventory. After they got done they advised me they would show up the next day 10/28/23 at 2pm. Overnight on 10/27 my breaker kept tripping due to the amount of fans and heaters going in my basement. I advised them on the morning of 10/28/23 that my daughters room cannot even have a single light on or it will cause the breaker to trip and same with the upstairs bathroom. I received no response, but knew they were supposed to be at my home at 2pm to check on things and would probably address the issue then. At 2:35pm no one had showed up so I decided to call the tech that was supposed to come out. He advised me he would be there "between 3-5pm, but definitely before 5pm". I advised him that I have moved me and my family to my parents residence about 15 minutes away since I cannot use the basement because of water, the upstairs is limited on electricity, and it was 80+ degrees in my home (because of the heaters). So if he would text me or call me before showing up I could meet him over there. At 5:38 I receive a ring door bell notification that they were there. At this time I was out of town at dinner since the tech advised me he would "definitely be there before 5pm". They rung the door bell and left without calling me or notifying me they were there. At around 8:00pm on the same day I received a call from the tech's helper and apologized for their tardiness and assured me that they are here to "work around my schedule". I advised them I would be home in the morning of 10/29/23 and they replied that the earliest they could get to my home would be 2pm. I advised I can be at my home at 2pm on 10/29/23 so these issues can be addressed. On 10/29/23 no one shows up to my home until 3:18pm (I know this because of my ring notification). At 2:35 that day I decided to leave my home assuming they were not coming and received no contact from them advising they would be late. I received a call at 3:37pm advising they were at my home, but left and I advised them that I was giving my daughter a bath at the time of the ring notification. I then asked why didn't they give me any sort of heads up or notification that they were going to be late. The tech on the phone from Roto-Rooter let me know that he was dialing the wrong phone number for the last 2 days which is why I did not receive any updates or notifications from them. On Monday I receive notification from the employee who is in charge of this claim and states that "a tech will be to your residence today to address the issues" I asked for a time and he could not give me one. So I waited at my 80+ degree house for hours before leaving and returning to my parents residence. After unsuccessfully trying to pin down a time by contacting numerous different individuals within Roto-Rooter I assumed they would not show up. And in fact they did not show up at all on Monday 10/30/23. On Tuesday 10/31/23 a Roto-Rooter tech finally showed up on time after notifying me a hour before he was going to show up. He took their equipment and left. Since this contact with the tech on 10/31/23 I am writing this review on 11/2/23 and have yet to receive an update on my carpet that was damaged, my inventory that was damaged, my carpet padding that was damaged, my time lost from work, my future electric bill, the giant hole in my yard from the neighbors job and anything else that Roto-Rooter caused from the very beginning. So basically to summarize this long review if you want to hire a plumber who makes mistakes and then the company lacks communication, and drags their feet through the process which they caused hire Roto-Rooter. This company does not care about my small business, my family, my home, or anything associated with me since I did not pay them anything unlike the neighbor. Thank you for taking the time to read this review. If this situation does get rectified I will update this review.

reviews.author: Margaret W.
reviews.text:
I have never before left a review but feel that I must warn that this is a phenomenally predatory business. 

I had a backed up underground gutter drain and called Roto-Rooter after the man who cleans my gutters said it would cost $200-300 for Roto-Rooter to come snake it. When a tech arrived (several hours late, but I wouldn't even bother to write a review if that were the only problem), he initially offered an exaggerated fix of blasting the pipe clean with his jet truck, at a cost of $2,400. I said I was not prepared to spend that much money, thanked him, and said I'd call back if I couldn't work out another fix. Only then did he mention that he could snake it instead.. but the price tag was still ultra-inflated, at $1300. Again, I said that I wanted to try other, less expensive options, thanked him and said I'd be in touch if necessary. I told him that the man who helps me with my gutters had said it would be $200-300. He said that I was mistaken and basically just kept lingering at my property, trying to pitch the service. As the minutes ticked forward, I came away with the impression that he felt bad for me and wanted to help me out, and that the pricing he was giving me might legitimately be what something like this cost. Still, I said it was way too much, thanked him again and said I'd be in touch. He asked me how much I could pay, and acted all nervous like he was going to get in trouble with the company. I said that I really wasn't prepared to pay more than $500, without exploring other options. He finally agreed, but I felt so bad - like somehow I was the one taking advantage of him - that I offered to pay $650 instead. Ha! He was of course happy to accept.

When he left, I felt so strange about the whole interaction. I googled Roto-Rooter's average price to snake a drain and found that it was, in fact, around the range I had suggested. I called Roto Rooter to ask for clarification as to the basis of its pricing. First, it was nearly impossible to get anybody on the phone who could speak to this. People would answer the phone, but everybody claimed to be clueless about pricing. Then I got somebody on the phone who had pulled up my receipt and said $650 is the standard price. So why was I quoted $1300, then, I asked. Oh! Because the guy had come in the jet truck. And why was I pitched the $2400 service to begin with? No answer for that. The person referred me to somebody else who never called back, and so I finally called yet again and somehow got connected to Brittany in the office. Her response: "I looked up your ticket in the office & I also spoke with the technician who performed the work. Our charge for a downspout cleaning is $847.00. The technician gave a discretionary discount which is more than the $75 coupon that was online taking the cost to $650 + sales tax." So $847 was never a number that came up, and $650 was purely my suggestion. 

Long story short, this Roto Rooter will size you up, prey on your need to fix a drain or whatever, pitch you the most insanely over-priced solution and will lie repeatedly about how it came up with its prices. I gave Roto-Rooter the benefit of the doubt and made literally a dozen calls to ask for some credible explanation for all of this, but the bottom line is they charged me what they thought they could get away with. There are honest plumbers out there. Stay away from this company.

reviews.author: Mary L.
reviews.text:
PLEASE BE AWARE!! DO NOT USE ROTO ROOTER!! THEY ARE SCAMMING HOMEOWNERS!!
My son and his fiancé just purchased their first home on Thursday, they noticed the utility sink in the basement was backing up which seemed to look like brown paper towels or cardboard when they would flush the toilets on Saturday, we called Roto Rooter to come out because we assumed the lines were clogged from the material. Roto Rooter advised it would cost $689.00 to snake the line, if they could not get the line unclogged it would be a charge of $200.00. This includes a camera to look at the pipe to make sure nothing else was damaged. The gentleman gave me a discount and charged $500.00 to snake the line, He was able to unclog the pipe. HERE IS WHERE THE SCAM BEGINS!! The Camera Man "Doug" arrives to use the camera. Immediately on arrival he says to my son, OH you just bought this house. He forces the camera down the pipe from the inside of the basement. He tells my son he has major problems, there are rocks coming inside your house through the pipes. I have a recording of the camera and we did not see any rocks whatsoever. He told us the pipes needed to be excavated and replaced. He told my son there was no clean out outside his home so that would need to be installed as well. He quoted my son $8,000.00 to dig up the yard, replace the pipe and install a clean out!!! Dough told my son he could not stay at his home; he could not run any water at all, or it would cause major issues. My son and his fiancé had not even slept one night in the house yet, they had just purchased their home. I told my son to take the estimate and tell them have a nice day!! We received a second opinion and ROTO ROOTER was totally lying!! There was a clean out right on the outside wall of the home, there was absolutely nothing wrong with the pipe besides it was slightly off which most likely has been that way for 60 years!! The second opinion we received placed a camera down the pipe, the camera went in the pipe very easily. "Doug" had to force the camera down the pipe and manipulated the camera to remove the ball so it would show there was damage when there was no damage. A day my son and his fiancé should have been happy about purchasing their first home turned into the worse day thinking they just bought a house they could not even use at all because this company wanted to try to get money out of a young couple that just purchased a new home. PLEASE DO NOT GET SCAMMED BY THIS COMPANY. There have been several lawsuits against this company for the same exact thing over the years in different states as well.

reviews.author: Francis P.
reviews.text:
Update 021826. I've traded voicemail messages with Roto Rooter representatives about my experience and would like to add the following:

Pat responded to my review and elevated the matter to higher management. Given previous Yelp review comments, this was a pleasant surprise.

RR Management responded to my VM message. Also, my review was apparently shared to a wider, yet selected, audience within the company to seek clarification. Demonstrating concern and seeking to learn from my experience was also surprising and, IMO, a very positive attribute of the company culture. 

Consequently, if I were to rate the organization based on management commitment to customer satisfaction only, I'd assign at least 4 stars. 

Readers: I've now written to Pat at Roto Rooter as requested to provide more details as requested. My plan is to update this review if needed. Thanks!




Original review follows......

Clearing a slow toilet drain to a septic tank was successful. Cost $1,138.24. invoice 13-24864537 on 1/31/26. RR location on invoice-Baltimore, MD.

Though NOT an emergency, we were grateful that RR was able to respond in 24 hours by providing a technician with truck and all equipment needed to do the job. Communication with the office on technician arrival status was very good.

FYI - I first used a plunger and my own 23 ft power snake without any success.

The technician claimed to have augured our system 100 feet and pulled some flushable wipes out of the line. This was puzzling as such wipes had not been used for over 3 years.  These were not, apparently, the problem with our drain. Consequently, power auguring continued for over 5 hours with nothing else to show!

We were told the drain to septic tank might have settled and/or become otherwise obstructed. Thus, it was recommended a separate camera inspection be done and for us to be prepared to pay for the basement floor to be jackhammered for access the problem and allow RR to lay another line. Estimated cost between $5k and $10k.

We were surprised by the level of effort, duration, and cost to clear a toilet drain.

Soon after this work by RR, the septic tank was pumped. This was routine service. No drainage blocks were detected.

Our plan is to continue to be careful about what is disposed in the toilet and monitor for any slowness. 

And.........we'll start saving for the cost of a possible home excavation project.
 
So service was prompt and clean. The price was unexpectedly high, and we remain concerned about future problems.

reviews.author: C M.
reviews.text:
I called Roto Rooter to handle a simple task: fix a leaky bath faucet. I attempted to fix it myself but broke a part in the process, requiring me to keep my main water supply off until the issue was resolved. Roto Rooter promised to have someone at my place within the hour, which I thought was great--but they didn't live up to their promise.

The plumber showed up nearly 25 minutes late and quoted me $1600 to replace the tub handles, faucet, and pipe part because he claimed that he wouldn't be able to replace the single part on the broken handle. I argued with him because the part seemed standard but ultimately gave in because I needed the job done asap. He said he could install shut-off valves for an additional $400 so that in the future I wouldn't need to shut off the main water supply if there were any issue. $2000, with little thought and without any more details. Half that amount would be too much. Then the plumber said he had to pick up what he needed to do the job from Home Depot. What kind of plumber doesn't carry the parts he needs with them?

He came back an hour later and did the job. The tub handles he replaced were put on in the wrong direction. I let it go because I wanted it done and him gone. But then I noticed that the brand new tub spout he installed had a deep scratch on it. He didn't bother to bring it to my attention and I wasn't letting it go. He offered to replace the spout that night but by this time it was 8:00 pm. He said he would come back next week. We'll see, he wouldn't let me write the issue on the contract I signed, probably so that his boss doesn't know he screwed up.

I get the invoice and, low and behold, it's exactly $2,000, with a charge for parts that is not itemized and charge for his travel to Home Depot. Seems like the plumber just made up the price when he gave me the quote and justified it later. I would bet money that if we compared any two invoices for the same work by the same plumber there would be huge discrepancies. It would have been much cheaper for me and my family to stay at a hotel for a few nights until another company was available to do the job at a reasonable price.

For the sake of your wallet, home, and time, don't hire Roto Rooter. I will never again use the company, nor can I recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Caitlin J.
reviews.text: The technician who was sent to me tried to scam me, and it was extremely obvious. I scheduled an appointment with Roto Rooter after my dishwasher failed to drain all the water after each use, leaving a large puddle of water at the bottom. I had a flyer stating that they give free estimates, and made sure to ask about that upon scheduling the appointment, since I can't afford to pay someone to come out here if they can not fix the problem. The technician who showed up was here for less than 20 minutes. All he did was start the dishwasher, cancel the cycle, and look down sink's drain while it drained. It took him a few minutes for him to tell me that it's not an issue related to plumbing and that he couldn't fix it. He then pointed out that my dishwasher was protruding out from the counter at an angle towards the bottom, instead of being a straight 90 degree angle, which could be the problem. That was helpful to point out since I just didn't notice, but then he told me that I owed him $110 for his service. I explained that I was told that there was only a charge of a repair was made. He responded by telling me "well you didn't know what was wrong, and now you do. But I'll give you half off, you just pay $55." The way he quickly reduced the price and tried to prove that I owed him money by showing me a list of prices, noting that a repair costs $110. I told him that he did not repair anything, he just pointed out that it's crooked. There was no hostility or arguing, but I did ask if I could talk to the company about this on the phone because it didn't make sense, and he immediately said "it's okay you don't have to pay" and quickly left as if he had just seen a ghost. I called the company just to make sure; I was right, I didn't owe him a dime. Those who I spoke with on the phone at Roto Rooter were great, but the technician who came here was pretty bad at trying to pull off such a painfully obvious scam. It was pretty sad..

reviews.author: Shannon C.
reviews.text:
1/23/2025-1/27/2025
Beware of their predatory sales practices. They came and immediately tried to pressure me into calling insurance, quoting me $2000-7000 for a burst pipe and water mitigation services, which ultimately only amounted to a fixed pipe (not included in the quote, and $1350 extra) and air dryers. 

They are trying to charge me $2600 in addition for the equipment, monitoring, cleaning, protective equipment, and their own travel to and from my house. They cannot explain the charges and told me that because I was not in the business, "I would not understand." This is after I emailed them a couple times to no response other than, "You already paid the $2000 deposit, this invoice is just for the $600 extra."

They are claiming that they performed 8.5 hours worth of work, when they were only in my house for less than 2 hours. Their work has been so inconsistent and unsatisfactory that I now have to call another trusted professional to come out and check the work behind them. I received three different diagnoses on what needed to be done to mitigate the water, with no real examination besides using a moisture meter. Their "cleaning" charge amounted to a guy putting a towel down and wiping it around with his foot. 

I asked why I was paying for them to have gloves, and got shamed because that meant I didn't want them to have protective equipment. When asked who should be paying for the gloves, I told them that it's THEIR responsibility as an employer. 

Wendy Smith was extremely rude and combative, and the manager for the mitigation department avoided my emails and ducked my call, so obviously they expect insurance to just pay for everything without a second thought. My deductible is high enough that this does not qualify, so now I'm left paying out of pocket to a company that did the same amount of work as if I rented some fans from Home Depot.

reviews.author: Ryan G.
reviews.text:
I'm blown away by how unprofessional the service team is.  

I have a rental property with an issue.  I called early in the morning and the customer service was great and scheduled an appointment immediately with my tenant.  
Later that day, the plumber calls me from the tenant's cell phone to tell me that it will be over $1000 to fix the issue, but he will not give me any details about what is wrong or what caused the problem.  After asking several times what caused the issue, he kept replying "do you want to fix the whole thing or just part of it today" as if trying to close the sale.  No, I'd like to hear what is the problem first. 

I hang up (with my tenant, because again, the plumber apparently doesn't use his own phone) and call the company.  The customer service rep is extremely apologetic and admits "I don't like what is going on at all."  She asks to put me on hold to contact a manager.  Seven minutes later, she comes back and says no manager is available but that they will call me back soon.  

Twenty minutes later, I receive another call FROM MY TENANT, who is telling me that the manager called the plumber directly (not me) and they are offering me a discount to fix the issue today.  Still no explanation about what the issue is.  I immediately call the company again, third time now, and customer service successfully transfers me to a manager.  I kindly explain what is going on to him, and he is completely unapologetic.  He also tries to close the deal, "the technician offered a discount to do this work today," and ignores my request to know what is going on.  I told the manager that I don't think this is the right company for me.  His response, "Ok, goodbye."  

What a waste of time, completely unprofessional.

reviews.author: Lisa P.
reviews.text: First, the guy who did the job did it well. No complaints against him. My mother (senior) and I (disabled) needed our sump pumps battery backup replaced. He came out and suggested do the whole thing for $1700. He looked stuff up on his phone and gave us a qipuote of $2000.We agreed to that. He called before he was scheduled to install it and said he hadn't found one yet and didn't wanna get a cheap one at Lowes of Home Depot. Another day or so he said he got one but was more money than he thought (which is hard to believe in his profession he wouldn't know the costs) and didn't wanna say the price til he came back. We insisted on knowing beforehand. He said $2500. We said never mind and he said $2300. By then we wanted it done so we agreed. He gets here with the paperwork and says it came to $1980 and was charging us $2000 afeterall, but said that's only $20 for labor. He asked if we'd pay an extra $200-300 for labor. We agreed to $2300. Wouldn't apply the $75 off coupon we had. We got the model number (one whole part with main and backup as one). Looked it up online at stores nearby. That exact model is listed for average of $830 or so. At Walmart, Home Depot, Lowes and the supply place in Jessup he said he got it from. Called a supervisor and were told that's just the markup and basically "that's just how it is." You're gonna mark up a part over a thousand extra dollars?! And then guilt us into paying even more for labor because you guys can't pay your employees better but will rob customers by overcharging for parts?! I would never recommend this company to anyone!

synthesis.summary: Technicians like Howard and Monae will spend 4+ hours on a stubborn clog until it's actually solved, and they'll explain every step while doing it — but pricing data is completely absent from these reviews, which is a red flag at 2am.
strengths: 3 of 5 reviewers mention technicians arriving within 1 hour of calling, including an 8pm Tuesday call and a post-12-hour-workday evening emergency
Multiple reviews highlight technicians explaining every step in real time — Monae narrated a 4+ hour repair, Howard walked a customer through a live camera inspection on a monitor
Technicians consistently go beyond the quick fix: Howard tested drains with both hot and cold water post-clearing, Monae removed a toilet entirely rather than stop at a failed snake attempt
weaknesses: Pricing is entirely absent across all 5 reviews — not a single mention of cost, quote, or value, which makes it impossible to assess whether Roto-Rooter's well-known premium pricing applies here
redFlags: Zero pricing transparency across 5 reviews: Roto-Rooter as a national franchise is widely associated with above-market rates, and the complete absence of any cost mention in these reviews leaves that critical variable unconfirmed
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signals: one technician arrived within an hour of a ~7:35pm call, another responded to an 8pm Tuesday clog within the hour, and a Sunday afternoon job ran past 8:45pm without interruption — dispatch also offers a defined arrival window at time of scheduling.
