reviews.author: James Easley
reviews.text: Rich came out to repair my shower nozzle and did a fantastic job. He was polite, very knowledgeable, and took the time to explain exactly what the issue was and how he fixed it. The repair was quick, the price was great, and everything is working perfectly now. I really appreciated his professionalism and would definitely recommend him to anyone who needs a reliable plumber. 👍🚿🔧

reviews.author: Charles Aloe
reviews.text: Absolute expediency and professionalism.  Found on Thumbtack, Mr. Rooter called me within minutes of my request for servicing a defective toilet flange.  My technician, Rich, was out here the very next morning to diagnose the issue and then the morning after that to make the repair.  Rich even took a look beyond the immediate fix to ensure there wasn't a larger issue that needed to be addressed.  All in all, I am completely satisfied and confident in his work, which comes with a one-year guarantee.  I will note that this all came with a higher than anticipated price tag, but for my situation and for the value of the service it was one that I was willing to pay.

reviews.author: Greg Baber
reviews.text: My 15 year old water heater went up on New Year's Eve. The gas control valve failed. Mr. Rooter sent a tech out on New Year's Day to give me a free estimate on a replacement water heater. I was able to get the water heater that I wanted at a reasonable price. The price included the new water heater, warranty, parts & labor, and removal/haul away of the old water heater. Mr. Rooter installed the new water heater on January 2nd and they did a fantastic job.

reviews.author: Erin G.
reviews.text: I contacted a few different plumbers to get estimates. Mr. Rooter was the 3rd estimate I got. Two techs showed up and I immediately got a bad vibe. I asked them in and the lead tech was very awkward and seemed shady. The second tech didnt say a word. I told them my kitchen sink needed to be snaked for a clog. The lead tech asked to take a look at my pipes in the basement. I'm thinking to myself what for?? He looks around, mumbles to himself, comes back into the kitchen, plays on his iPad then shows me an estimate for $600! Are you freaking kidding me?! Every other estimate was between $150-$300. I asked "why so much?". The guy looked surprised that I questioned him. These guys were super shady! I quickly showed them the door.

reviews.author: Kelly B.
reviews.text: Mr. Rooter (dba Reliable Expert Plumbing) Technician came and replaced water heater. The work was fine but he gashed the drywall in our stairwell with the something. It wasn't noticed before installer left and when it was noticed later, the manager who answered the phone rudely asked "Why did you wait so long?" (It was less than a week later)  The water heater went out the day before my wife and I traveled out-of-state for Thanksgiving so we did not see it until we came home. I told the manager, to whom should I send pictures to formally report the damaged drywall and he gave me an email and hung up. I emailed the pictures and described what had happened and never received a response. I called again to verify the email and sent another and have yet to receive a response.  It should be noted that NOT ONCE did I mention money, refund or repair.  I was literally only calling to report it thinking they might care that their installers damaged customers property.  (Extra ironic, that I ended up calling "MR. Rooter" by mistake when I meant to call "Roto-Rooter").  I should have checked these yelp reviews before I scheduled them).

reviews.author: David Y.
reviews.text:
Hired the company this past Sunday to replace leaky faucet.  Bought a Delta Owendale from HD, opened the box while the tech was here and he proceeded to install it (had to pause mid-way to run to HD for valves).  After installation, I noticed that the faucet seems to be difficult to shut off, with water dripping until you move the wobbly handle of the single handle faucet around until finding the "right spot", to which the tech's response was this happens alot with newer faucets, due to the long pull out hose, and left.  I was watching two small kids so just paid (and tipped him) and didnt have much time to think on this.  

After putting the kids to bed, I inspected the faucet and thought the faucet looks different from my recollection of the box (the tech took it away).  Did some digging and found water stain/rust under the handle and grime on the faucet holes.  Next day, I went back to HD to purchase another box of the same faucet. that was when i discovered that it is not what the technician installed.  Out of frustration i called up the owner, saying that the tech may have swapped the faucets.  The owner texted me the pictures taken by the technican, showing my leaky faucet, next to the box of the new faucet (strange that the tech took the picture yet didnt spot that it was not the faucet he put in), saying that the company took no responsibility since it was an "owner provided faucet".  

He sent another technician to install the 2nd faucet and also to take a look.  Guy was able to notice right away that what was installed was not a new faucet but a used one, due to the rust and grime.  The owner insisted that this is an owner supplied faucet and they take no responsibility, and required that I paid upfront before installing the faucet for the 2nd time.  

At this point, no one can tell for sure if the 1st technican swapped the faucet with a used one, or HD simply sealed a box of previously returned item that did not contain the right item.  But what is frustrating is the owner's attitude that it was the owner's issue, and i should resolve it with HomeDepot.  Never mind the fact that as a consumer, I hired a "professional" who should work as an advocate for the consumer to ensure that we know what we are having installed.  Instead, he simply chalked it up to the owner, when the tech took out the "new" faucet from the box and proceeded to install it and not noticing that it is a used faucet - kind of hard to believe when an untrained person, and the 2nd tech, was able to notice that right away.  

The 1st tech also took a picture of my old leaky faucet next to the box of the faucet with picture that obviously doesnt match what he just installed.  This, combined with the 1st tech's excuse for the leakiness of the replaced faucet, saying that i need to find the right spot for it to shut off, as well as his failure to notice obvious signs that it was a used faucet, doesnt give me much confidence (pictures of the "new" faucet he installed attached, showing sign of usage).  

Images:  Picture taken by the technician of my old faucet next to the box of faucet, which doesnt match what he just installed, but somehow went untoiced.  Additional images from the faucet installed by the 1st technician showing that it is used a used faucet with grime..etc, that also went somehow unnoticed by him, but right away by the 2nd tech.  

While I do not know if the 1st box of faucet contained the right faucet or not, the business owner's attitude was "we simply installed an owner provided faucet", when his technician took out what's supposed to be a brand new faucet and never noticed it to have been used throughout installation (hard to believe, seeing how obvious the signs were in the pictures).  Throughout the process, I learned to next time closely inspect the content's of the box and pay more attention during installation, and also staying away from a company like this one, whose owner's attitude is "its the owner's problem, we just installed what you've provided".  Why hire "professionals" when they cannot be counted on??

reviews.author: Katie C.
reviews.text: If you are desperate to have a plumbing emergency fixed please DO NOT CALL THIS COMPANY. We called this company hoping they could come out quickly to inspect a clogged bathroom drain on (8/19/20). The technician never even told us his name. He immediately diagnosed the problem as a clogged sewer line without even inspecting our toilet or pipes. He told us it would be $579 to snake our line and that he would have no problem clearing the line, again without even visually evaluating the plumbing. The technician proceeded to set up all his equipment in my residence without the use of protective gear or tarps, he even joked to my husband "how dirty and covered in sewaged" the equipment was. My 5 year old son had also had a surgical procedure done the same day so we were obviously concerned about the germs and bacteria being brought into our home and sat on the floor without a tarp or covering, the technician said they follow a rigorous clean up procedure once they are finished. After sending the snake down 45ft the technician told us out main line was broken outside the house and that he had to "call his manager". We later found out from another professional plumber that 45ft wouldn't have even been enough snake to reach the outside line. The technician came back in and advised us that his Manager could send another crew to our house the next day to run a camera and evaluate our broken line from another $400. I advised the technician that we weren't comfortable with that considering that we were not having any other signs of a broke pipe. I also asked for the technicians supervisor's phone number so we could speak to him about the price to partially snake our line since the technician guarunteed he would be able to unclog it and did not. The technician told us he would give us the number once he packed up. He proceeded to pack up his gear, performed no cleaning, left our bathroom and hallway completely covered in sewage. He put our toilet back on but left a piece of the toilet in our bathtub, completely foregoing to install it under the toilet. The technician advised us that he would be back with his supervisors phone number. He NEVER RETURNED, got in his truck and left. No formal bill was given to us, no  statement of what services were performed. We don't even know his name. I have photo evidence of all the damages including damaged to our floor and woodwork. This was the WORST EXPERIENCE I have ever encountered with a "professional" company. I felt completely taken a advantage of, it felt as if the technician knew we were desperate with a sick child and he saw a opportunity to exploit the situation. We are assuming the company will try to bill us for this botched experience. PLEASE DO YOURSELF A FAVOR, DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY. If anyone is interested in seeing the photos please email me at kchisholm87@gmail.com.

reviews.author: Jeanna W.
reviews.text:
Would have given a 2 but there were moments/professionals who helped smooth over this bad experience.

Had a really nice and informative representative (Rich) who came out and assessed my plumbing issue (main line blockage), and recommended me with their partnering water remediation company. My plumbing goal was to understand where and why (camera) there was a blockage and install a cleanout.

Had the plumbing work performed the next day after water remediation performed their work. Unfortunately it was the weekend and with a different plumbing tech. The tech assessed and stated the plumbing issue was a blown ejector pump which was a shock and double the cost. Mind you I had several companies look at my plumbing systems and noted  my 3/5 HP pump that was installed 2 years ago was fine. After further inquiry he contacted Rich, tested the pump, and corrected the misdiagnosis. The tech cleared the line and stated his inexperience didn't allow him to perform work on sump pump or quote  obstruction of clean outs (something the office said he'd be able to do). He informed me the main line was clear and there was a shallow pool of belly water that didn't pose an issue.

Well 6 hours later (1am) I had the largest backup ever and waste was everywhere in my basement. Spoke to a supervisor (that never came to my home) who was very impatient and continually over talked me. As I began explain what happened, he harshly interrupted with"I know your case" and stated the minimal belly water would is my TRUE issue and would continue to be the cause of backups and would need to replace the main line. I asked for another tech to come out. A literal  show that morning having water remediation out again and then the plumber again. The tech stated I had a secondary line which also needed to be unclogged. I got that done and had a cleanout installed. He stated a main line replace wasn't needed. A couple thousand out-of-pocket (which I would have preferred to finance) later... Had to set another appt to get a camera view of the second line which didn't happen bc the cleanout installed wasn't big enough. All in all the main reason settled on the company was to have a camera view and recording, I received neither.

I had four professionals from the company tell me conflicting things and each time the expense cost grows. It started out great with Rich but overall the experience was disorganized and confusing.

If you know exactly your plumbing issue then call them up. If not and/or you have a complicated issue spend the time and money with the big name company.

reviews.author: Donald H.
reviews.text:
I had Mr Rooter come out to fix a leak in my plumbing. The plumber (Roland) showed up and quoted me $465 to finish the job. I never got any paperwork to sign or any kind of an estimate. I went ahead and gave Roland the go ahead to start the job since it was late and I needed my water back on. I let Roland know I was mainly concerned about just getting my water back on, so he installed a shut off valve and didn't complete the job, then he asked for full payment. When I questioned him about the $465 to complete the job, Roland then stated he would apply half of the $465 towards coming back and finishing the job. It was really late at night so I went ahead and agreed with that and gave him the check. The plumber left and did not leave me a receipt. I had to call the office and have them email me the receipt. 

A few weeks later I had the plumber come back to finish the job. Roland called me that afternoon that he was supposed to be here and said he wasn't gonna be able to make it there today because there wasn't enough time. He said he would be here first thing next morning and he never showed because of a personal problem. So, I spoke to the supervisor and he agreed to send another plumber out to finish the job.The other plumber refused to do the job because it had already been started and was not completed. The other plumber stated that the total job complete was $465. After speaking with the supervisor we agreed that Roland would come out and finish the job. Roland showed up the following morning and was asking for more money to finish the job. I let Roland know that I already paid for the job, but he disagreed.
I spoke to the supervisor and he said that the job should've been quoted at $600. I was surprised to hear that. I had no choice but to agree to it if I wanted to get the job done. The supervisor also demanded payment first before he would let Roland finish the job. So I gave Roland $135 more to install a 6 foot piece of PEX tubing and he left the original rubber piping in there that should've also been replaced. Eventually, I will have to hire another plumber to come out and complete the job correctly so that it meets code. Roland left again without giving me a receipt for the remaining $135. 

In summary, I paid $600 for a $5 PVC shut off valve and about 6 feet of PEX tubing. I was not given any paperwork or receipts. Total rip off and I would never recommend Mr Rooter for any plumbing work in the future. It was the most unpleasant experience I've ever dealt with with regards to plumbing.

reviews.author: Candy H.
reviews.text:
The actual plumbers at Mr. Rooter are nice and respectable. It's the manager of the plumbers that is a jerk. He spoke to me very disrespectfully, yelled at me over the phone, and even hung up on me. The website says upfront pricing but yet they charge you for so many additional things during the job. They claim that they are giving you a discount but they really upcharge and subtract what they say you are going to save to still get the quoted amount. 

The story I have is so long I can't even put it here. A long story short I was charged $885 to snake a toilet. Then $300 to empty the toilet in order to snake it. That then changed into $10,500 for them to dig up the mainline and replace it. Said if I let them do the job, they wouldn't charge me the $1185 for emptying and snaking the toilet. I received a bill that said my total was $11,685 - $1185 = $10,500. Where was the discount? I was charged an additional $1500 to dig 2 feet deeper and pull up my concrete which they claim they absolutely had to do to get to the county line which wasn't the issue, it was the main line to the house. 

Called them back out because now its time for my new sink and toilet to go back in the sink wont drain because of what?? The pipe! You guessed it. Well of course this is not due to something they did although it worked fine before they dug up my dang on yard. So Franz wants to now charge me $385 to snake the sink drain. Oh wait with a $50 discount because I have done business with them before. HAHA laughable. I have just given your company $13,185 just a couple of weeks ago and you give me a $50 discount?! 

If Franz continues to speak with customers the way he does when they challenge the fact that they never received a discount in the first place and now you want to insult me with $50 like you're doing me a favor this company will not get many customers.

reviews.author: Beverly Hill
reviews.text:
On late Friday evening, I had a flood in my home. The water was coming through my refrigerator and it leaked down to my basement.. I called one of the popular plumbing services. They came out only to make a mess and didn't find the shut off refrigerator water valve. So I was left with no running water. My homeowners insurance sent out a restoration company to get the water up, but I needed a plumber.
. My neighbor recommended me to Mr Rooter I was happy that he came out on early Sunday morning during the holiday weekend. Mr. Zach Samuels was my Plumber . He was Amazing . He took empathy on what was going on. He asked me questions. He listen to me and allowed me to walk him through what transpired and what the other company did he took out his equipment start measuring the walls and ceilings in my basement.  He told me that he needed to go into the ceiling and see where the pipes are so he tried several places and found the Valve to the refrigerator  to shut the refrigerator off . He turned that off and turned the water to the house back on since it was off since Friday I was very pleased with the professionalism of Mr. Zach and his knowledge of his job, you can see he have passion for his work  ethics by leaving area very neat and clean. When his work was done, he walked me through what he did, and informed me. that I needed a new refrigerator. I asked if he will install it.  He told me to call the office to schedule when it's delivered.  So Wednesday afternoon, the new refrigerator arrived. He came around 2:30 and put the new refrigerator and he also went down below to check everything out to make sure that no dripping.
I am EXTREMELY Happy with the Outstanding Customer Service I received from Mr Zach Samuel.
I truly recommend this company Mr Rooter and I hope that the company appreciate Mr Zach dedication to his work and your company!

reviews.author: Cassio S.
reviews.text:
CUSTOMER BEWARE!!

Mr. Rooter will make a lot of false promises then after they get you to pay for the $639 bill for a simple drain snake. They will not follow up with you on anything they promised!

I had a drain backup in my basement and called Mr. Rooter. They sent someone next day for an estimate. Before authorizing the service I was promised a 90 days warranty and that they would record a video of the main sewer line and send it to me. Those were the deciding factors for me in using Mr. Rooter.

Their so called plumber was a skinny young kid who could barely carry the machine on his own. I ended up having to help him carry it down to my basement and had to assist him through the entire process of sneaking the drain. He seemed to lack both experience and the proper equipment to get the job done.

At the end I asked about the video inspection and he told me that they would need to send someone else for that. He assured me that I would be contacted within 48 hours. I asked for a receipt and he told me that it would be emailed to me because they are a paperless company.

Fast forward 5 days, I still didn't have a receipt and none had contacted me for a video inspection. I called in and the people on the other end, one of them claiming to be the manager were extremely rude and full excuses.

I asked for a copy of my bill and he reluctantly emailed it to me. After taking a closer look I noticed it had two FORGED SGINATURES on the service agreement and it stated that there was only a 30 days warranty. I called them again and spoke with the rude manager once more and he told me that he would not honor the 90 warranty promised by his technician. I still don't have the video inspection that I paid for. My advice is to call ANYONE BUT MR. ROOTER.

reviews.author: Stew C.
reviews.text: I went to roto rooter site and was directed to mr. rooter by mistake. Had a clogged line that needed to be taken care of so I told the wife to go ahead and bring them out. I work on a ship and at home I have the wife and our 2 little girls. They needed to be able to shower and flush the toilet ASAP. The kid that cam was a nice kid. The charge to snake out was 700 with a 50 off coupon. He told her what he was going to do and how much it would be. The wife thought it was odd when the kid got another service call and said he was going to kill time after the job so he didn't have to go on that one. When he finally left he didn't leave a receipt or discuss the warranty. When the wife called in the girl on the phone apologized and emailed one. No big deal.  No leak test was done. When we saw the pipe leaked when flushing, we found a hole in the pipe. No big deal. She calls in and was told on the phone that she was explained to that these things happen in older pipes. Well she was not explained that, and when my wife said if you want to see the conversation we have cameras in our house and the conversation is on tape. She was then yelled at for recording conversation, and informed the pipe repair would be another 700, she said she shouldn't be accountable for that, and told by the guy on the phone that he will make her take him out to court. Well, I'm sure their calls are recorded, so we are pretty curious to see how this whole thing plays out. Long story short, I would not recommend this place even if you were in an emergency, just call anyone else. Hope corporate sees this review and relieves my email and responds expeditiously.

reviews.author: Elise G.
reviews.text: We called Mr. Rooter Plumbing because we had a sewer backup in our house.  They came out the next day and quoted pulling the toilet and snaking the drain at over $500.  I knew this was higher than I should've paid, but I felt desperate to get the situation fixed.  The plumber snaked the drain and found roots.  He got it draining so we could use water again and clean up.  He said we would need to camera the line and replace the sewer line.  He also said we would likely have a problem in about 3 more weeks and that we had a free return service call to snake the drain.  It was actually only 2 weeks until the drain started backing up again.  We called Mr. Rooter back and they sent a very inexperienced plumber for our free return call.  He again snaked the drain and said it was clear and that we could use water.  He flushed the toilet and we went into the basement and it was completely flooded.  He said he was sorry but the only thing we could do was replace the sewer line and offered no help with the flooding he caused.  I called a different plumber from another company to come later that week and the plumber explained to me that snakes are supposed to have blades on the end to cut away roots, but rip-off companies like Mr. Rooter send the snake down the drain with nothing on the end to poke a small hole in the problem instead of cutting it away.  The plumber cut away the roots using 2 different blade sizes and worked for about 3 hours for less than $400.  He said our sewer was in good shape aside from the roots so sewer line replacement was not necessary.  I would never call Mr. Rooter again.

reviews.author: Aldo E.
reviews.text: I called Mr. Rooter customer service this morning around 9:30 03-31-2017 to complain to the supervisor.  The customer service person took a brief summary over the phone of incident and connected me with the owner of business.  I was connected with owner and explained to him what had transpired.  I also asked him about the picture taking business and he indicated to me that was standard procedure for them.  My question is if that was standard procedure why did the technician not take any pictures when he was dispatched the first time.  The picture taking occurred the second time after I had him re-dispatched by their customer service.  I have had electrician and plumbers in my house before and none of the other business took any pictures.  The owner was very defensive the whole time and covering for his technician's actions. I indicated to him that I was displeased with what had occurred and the technician's behavior.  He kept repeating to me how can help and how can I fix this to make you happy.  They had no intention of fixing anything, this how they make their money. This type of businesses justifies their existence with such underhanded behavior.  Based on my conversation with owner confirmed the fact that they are crooks and manipulators. They deliberately cause problems so that you call them back and they can charge you again and again. They will use like a cash cow if you are not careful. In any case to make long story short I will never do business with this company again and would not recommend this company to anyone else. Stay away from this business.

They always send courteous respectful and very knowledgeable technicians to your home. I have a very busy Schedule and they always show up on the day and the time they promised. They treat your home with respect  and the work is always top-notch.  When their work is completed they clean up and make sure you're 100% satisfied. I would recommend Mahon plumbing to anyone that needs  commercial or residential work done. I promise you will not be disappointed or find a better company.

reviews.author: Sam Price
reviews.text: Wonderful company with wonderful people! Every time I call for an issue, Rose is so helpful and nice. She makes sure I get an appointment scheduled with ease & verifies information on my issue. I've had the pleasure of both Shane & Patrick visit my home to help with my water system. They are both incredibly kind, friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful! I couldn't recommend this place enough. I'll never use any other plumbing company!!

reviews.author: Jay L.
reviews.text: Mahon plumbing is the biggest, most inappropriate people I have ever met. Greg Mahon might be the biggest asshole on the planet. He is building a home near mine and I have heard nothing but terrible things about him from all of the neighbors around him. He doesn't notify them of anything, has caused all kinds of damage he doesn't plan on taking responsibility for, and make consistent rude and completely inappropriate comments. I went and talked to him personally about some damage to my property and he went off on me and my wife. I mean went off. Saying that I was this and I was that. I really didn't know what to say in response as I was totally taken off guard. I have asked around about him too and Anne Arundel County officials as well as other local business owners all know and are familiar with how inappropriate this guy is. One County official just rolled his eyes and said, "we have had more than one complaint about Greg Mahon." If you need plumbing services or anything for that matter please look for another service. Mahon Plumbing could possibly be the worst people on the planet. I am not joking.

reviews.author: Perry W.
reviews.text: Had these guys come out to quote some work. They seemed interested in the job when here, seemed invested, but we can't get past the bitchy secretary from hell. She is awful to work with and we've lost interest entirely in working with them.

reviews.author: Rachel R.
reviews.text:
Call Millennium Instead (410) 265-8833.
We had a Sprinkler pipe freeze and burst in February and called Mahon so that we could get water back.  We had specifically told them on the phone that it was a sprinkler that had burst but when they got to our home they told us that they didn't work with sprinklers (shouldn't they have shared this information over the phone?).  Instead the guy they sent had us write him a personal check and he put a valve on the main line to separate the sprinkler.  Since it was a personal check with no receipt we could not submit it as part of the insurance claim.  He told us that the sprinkler repair people would be able to remove it.  When the sprinkler repair man came he told us he didn't have the tools to work with compression fittings and that we would have to call Mahon to remove the compression fitting since sprinkler pipes are PVC and they don't work with the metal.  When we called Mahon back they first told us they never did anything of the sort, when I gave the dispatcher the name of the plumber they had sent she was surprised and said she would talk to him.  They insisted that the sprinkler people would be able to fix it no matter how many times I explained that they had already been to our place and told me they could not.  They completely ignored me and were extremely rude.  I could under no circumstances convince them to schedule a visit.  We finally resolved the issue by calling Millennium Plumbing (410) 265-8833  they had to cut the valve away.

reviews.author: Paul D.
reviews.text:
I had a leaking shut off valve on the waterline to a remote garage a couple hundred feet away. This was during that recent cold snap we had where every plumber was busy thawing out pipes and repairing frozen pipes but I called Mahon plumbing and Chris immediately said give me a minute and I'll call you back he did and had a guy stop in my house between jobs within a couple hours And he brought everything he needed because I had sent a picture of the situation and from that they analyzed it then the guy showed up with all the tools he needed and a truck full of spare parts. He had the latest pipe connecting technology I knew the days of gas flames and soldering were probably gone And there's the technology that's available to us amateurs where we can push. The pipes together is also surpassed now they had the latest connection technology and the equipment they needed to implement it and I got a beautiful job done in no time at all and I stood and watched a technician, and he explained every step he was doing and it was really educational experience and then for a very reasonable price it was fixed, and he was out of there. so I gave them a five star rating For the way they operated so professionally. 
(Excuse the voice texting probably got a couple errors in there )

reviews.author: Evelyn W.
reviews.text:
I had a new bathroom remodel done in my home in October.  While the company was still working in my home on other projects, we started having problems with our toilet backing up.   The remodel company tried fixing the problem, only for two day later, it to happen again    After a few failed attempts a different plumbing coming came out to fix it.   They told me they snaked my toilet and it should be better .... 5 days later the toilet was backing up again.   
A friend who is retired from a plumbing career, and was an inspector for the state, recommended Mahon plumbing to us .   After struggling with this problem for a month and a half, and finally not using the toilet, Mahon came out and solved the problem!!  They found a piece of pvc that had fallen into the toilet during remodel .   We've are so happy to say that Mahon plumbing has allowed us to enjoy our new remodeled bathroom ..... at last!!!!

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.text: Requested a quote on a whole house repipe. A representative came out early in the week and said we would receive a quote by the end of the week, mostly likely in 2 days. A week and a half goes by and we still hadn't received their quote. I called and spoke to a woman who I found to be very rude. She spent more time talking than listening and then claimed she was trying to be empathic. I've been in customer service for nearly 40 years and have been trained in showing empathy. I would never speak to a potential customer the way she spoke to me. When I finally raised my voice and told her exactly how she was making me feel, she shut up and started listening. We received the quote the next day only to find that it was $3k+ over the other 2 quotes I received for this job. Unless you don't care about communication, responsiveness, and how much you spend, I wouldn't recommend.

reviews.author: David Schuch
reviews.text: Holden and Nelson showed up when scheduled and we're professional and nice. Holden went above and beyond to find the clog in our main sewer line. After they cleared it they stayed to test that the water going to the line flowed freely. I started using Mahon 14 years ago for water line leak in my front yard. Greg showed up said he would have my water back on in 4 hours. He did after digging up my front yard and busting some concrete. Had it looking like new in that 4 hour time period. 4 years ago Mahon Plumbing showed up after I had a sewage overflow from my basement toilet. They found that it was a County issue by using a camera. I recommend them for any job large or small. They post up and take care of business. Also Rose, who works in the office is super nice.

reviews.author: Susan Cassidy
reviews.text:
i had an outstanding experience with Mahon Plumbing!! Mahon repair gentleman was on time and so very kind and explained to me his work in fixing my toilet. My local area had a water main break and i discovered a problem when the system was turned back on. My excellent Repair Gentleman went right to work and had the correct piece for the tank - the job was completed, water turned on and i got to have a 100% fix. Since the repair, everything is perfect!!

I was extremely impressed with Mahon - the Repair Gentleman was so kind and was amazingly knowledgeable. Rose in the office listened to me after the job was completed-it was great having the business helping me with getting my repair completed with a report of A+!!!! I wish all businesses were as EXCELLENT!

reviews.author: Michael Cummins
reviews.text:
Mahon Plumbing's efforts for us last week were excellent.  The technician was able to clearly identify our problem in the sewer line and he worked hard to make sure he properly checked every part of the system underground, including pulling the heavy manhole cover in the street several times.
>
> I am pleased I now have a plumbing firm I can turn to and trust.  Quite honestly, nobody else seemed willing to give me a price before visiting even though I explained exactly what I needed and the accessibility of the clean outs, etc.  That was annoying and I don't have time to waste.  Chris let me know exactly what the charge would be before coming out.  Well worth it.

reviews.author: Scott Crocker
reviews.text: I called Mahon after another plumber walked off our remodeling job before it was finished. Mahon was quick to identify issues that were left incomplete or incorrect, and was able to finish the job efficiently and for a reasonable price. Chris Mahan went above and beyond by helping to move/unbox appliances and gave expert opinions that helped in our legal dispute with the previous plumber. It can be difficult to find contractors who don't cut corners or take advantage of homeowners, but Mahon was honest and helped us out of a difficult situation and has earned a customer for life. I would never think of calling anyone else for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Joshua Newstrom
reviews.text: My washing machine kept backing up during the drain cycle. I initially called another company to come out, the tech spent about 10 mins looking at it and handed me a tablet to sign for a VERY high repair bill. Then I gave Mahon Plumbing a call. The plumber that came out was prompt, incredibly knowledgeable, and extremely friendly. He informed me about the issue, let me know things I could do as preventative maintenance, and went to work fixing the problem. The repair from Mahon’s was 2/3 what the other guys tried to charge me. The best thing about this whole experience is I know who I’m calling for plumbing from now on.

reviews.author: Jules Henderson
reviews.text:
Hired them on 3 separate occasions bc they're close. Usually takes about 1-2 weeks to set an appointment, 4hr time window (always came right at the end for me). Got the job done but they can get snappy and snarky on the phone. The aesthetics of their work are not their priority at all lol. Their work has a tendency to need further updates months down the line.

Reply: I called specifically for the installation of the sink vanity structure, not just to install a faucet. 5 months later it's come to my attention that the pipes have been leaking into a drawer in the structure, ruining my belongings kept in said space.

synthesis.summary: Mahon has been earning repeat customers for 14+ years by showing up exactly when promised and sending crews that explain the problem, do the work, and leave the place clean — but zero pricing transparency in any review is a notable blind spot.
strengths: 5 of 5 reviewers confirm on-time arrival and scheduling reliability, with one long-term customer spanning 14 years citing zero missed appointments

Multiple reviews highlight thorough diagnostic work beyond the obvious fix — Holden traced a sewer clog to its source, and a camera inspection correctly identified a sewage overflow as a county issue rather than upselling an unnecessary repair
Office communication is consistently praised across 3 reviews, with Rose named directly twice for smooth scheduling and proactive status updates on parts and appointments
weaknesses: Not a single review across 5 mentions a price, quote, or bill — no data exists to assess whether costs are fair, and a pricing_fairness score of 0 reflects this complete absence of evidence
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Strong emergency signal: one customer submitted an online service ticket in the middle of the night and received a response by 6:30 AM, suggesting active after-hours monitoring; response time under 7 hours for a non-critical issue implies faster turnaround for a declared emergency like a burst pipe.

reviews.author: Matthew Kroeger
reviews.text:
Todd is just the best.  I called the first company about a bad smell coming from my water and they quoted me $2300 to replace my water heater over the phone without even looking at it.

I called Todd and he said he would come check it out.  Told me I had a few more years at least with my water heater and flushed it to kill the smell.

Todd is an expert and a professional and he absolutely earned me a s a customer for life.  I cannot recommend Todd enough. :)

reviews.author: Kellye Johnson
reviews.text: We had no idea of what plumber in the area could fit us in on a holiday weekend and this was the first place we called. After telling him our issues, he said he could come the next morning, then called back and said he could come that very night if that was okay. Heck yes! Super friendly and knowledgeable! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Jaylyn Shanklin
reviews.text: Todd did amazing same day service at my house. He was very kind, and helped me very quickly. I had a leak in an outside faucet & the pipes under my house were shaking. He fixed the leak and secured the pipes for an excellent price. He is my permanent plumber.

reviews.author: Jonathon Hobstetter
reviews.text: We had an issue with our water heater and bathroom plumbing after the freezes that occurred this winter. He was very nice on the phone, but when we set an appointment he rescheduled several times. When he finally arrived to assist, he did fix the water heater. When working on the shower, he told us we needed to order a part off Amazon to complete the repair. Once the part arrived, he never came out to finish the job. He was paid in full at this point. We reached out several times to confirm a time which he never came through on. It has been months. Finally, he stopped answering completely.

reviews.author: Calculated Risk
reviews.text: Terrible communication. When notified that we will be using a different service provider due to him not being able to show up to a appointment time he gets upset and points the blame at you.

reviews.author: tammy miller
reviews.text: Todd was very quick to get us scheduled and was here the next day. Our hot water heater was installed quickly with a lot of attention paid to our wood floors, general neatness, etc. We hired him for a second job of disconnecting a water softener system which required under the house crawling around. While under the house he discovered a potential disaster where a wire holding up a copper pipe was wearing through the pipe, about to open the pipe. He corrected it while under the house. So he was very aware of all the plumbing system not just what he was called in for. Great guy, Great service. Thanks Todd.

reviews.author: steven collins
reviews.text: I called he said he would call me back next morning to set up a time,Never DID , I called again and left message , he text me back said he had commercial  work going on but said I promise I will call you later and setup a time. Never did. We were with out a shower for a extra day because of his Bad Communication skills so a Korean war./Vietnam retired vet that is very  disabled had to wait to clean. He might be a great plumber but i would not  know.

reviews.author: Caitlyn Pitts
reviews.text: Todd came out to see us last minute on Halloween evening. I lost the diamond out of my engagement band, and thought it had gone down the drain of my bathtub. Todd came to the rescue! Turns out, we just needed him to shine his flashlight at just the right angel for the diamond to reflect off of a blanket in the floor!! Mr. Todd was so pleasant, and we will definitely call him for any future needs.

reviews.author: R Oliver
reviews.text: T. Lenard Plumbing & Drain saved the day!  We had a clog in the outside pipe and water on the floor in the house.  We called him at 945 at night and he was super nice.  He was at our house by 1030 and we were done by 1100.  I had this same service done 4 years ago and the "club" price was a lot more than he charged. He was friendly and courteous. He will be the one I call next time.

reviews.author: KM U.
reviews.text: Heavy rains meant a lot of busy plumbers.  Meant I called a lot of plumbers.  Some of whom did not return calls. Tod returned message quickly, and arrived within the estimated time period.  Professional, courteous, and I learned a lot about my septic system.  Got our main line unclogged and tested for a reasonable price.   Great service from a local small business.

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: I had pipes that were vibrating when my main bathroom sink and shower were used. I called Todd on a Sunday and he was at my house within 90 minutes. He secured my pipes in the crawlspace and replaced the aftermarket cartridge in my shower controls with an original delta product. This solved the problem. He was pleasant to deal with and his price was very fair.

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a Local plumber in the Boro stop browsing the reviews and call Todd. We had a leak last night in the walls by the water heater and called Todd around 7am he was at my house by lunch and had it fixed within the hour. Will definitely be calling him for any future plumbing issues.👍

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.text:
Had a frozen pipe, randomly in the house even though we dripped faucets.  He called me back when no one else would and came out quickly that night (x-mas eve).  Helped figure out where the issue was coming from and fix it.

Would highly recommended - knowledge, responsive, and professional

reviews.author: Suzie P
reviews.text: This guy comes same day to our shop even in the afternoon every time we have plumbing issues. All I have to do is shoot him a text and he responds quickly! He is so friendly and does a thorough job,  cleanup and all, for a VERY reasonable price.  Wish I could give him 20 stars!!

reviews.author: Michael Trocki
reviews.text:
Polite, friendly, prompt, professional, inexpensive. I had several small repairs that needed to be done and he knocked them all out quickly during his initial visit.

I will never call a different plumber as long as I live in this area!

reviews.author: Susan Miller
reviews.text: Saffer was wonderful to work with. They kept me informed throughout the entire process and explained everything to me. The team was wonderful. Will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Ken Brown
reviews.text: Knows his stuff.  Prompt, courteous, efficient.  Understands our concern in maintaining the integrity of our 50's vintage home.  He & Saffer offered the solution vs. others that just wanted to "rip everything out."  We'd have him/them back again.

reviews.author: Abby Ricko
reviews.text: Gary & Steve came out to check on a plumbing issue at my work space, and made the experience incredibly smooth and easy!!! They were communicative, prompt, knowledgeable, and so kind! They were able to pinpoint the problem right away as our water heater, explained the whole thing to me with ease, and had an installation plan ready to go right away. I am so appreciative of how seamlessly they took care of everything which completely eliminated any stress on my end. We have used Saffer Plumbing 3+ times and its an A+++ experience every time. Thanks guys!!!!

reviews.author: liang huang
reviews.text: Don't waste your time and money with them. Bad experience, failed installation, suffered one year until I found another independent plumber who fixed their failed installation in 2 hours. Will never deal with Saffer Plumbing again. To your comment below: I didn't want to pay the bill so you failed the installation, or the other way around? A business owner with such a logic capability is not far from failure.

reviews.author: Cynthia Yashinski
reviews.text:
Insanely overpriced - they contracted with Landers appliance to "install" our new range, which meant exactly 20 minutes of work to disconnect and reconnect the gas line, for $490. The going rate for this is apparently supposed to be more like $300, which is still insane. I didn't realize the simplicity of the task nor the legality of anyone else doing it so I felt backed into a corner. The technician arrived prior to the window in the morning and did his 10 minutes of work. When asked when he would return, I couldn't get an answer. I called later after the new range had arrived, still no answer. They still aren't here but we're told they are "running late". I will definitely never hire them for any other work around my home. Also, fellow internet dwellers, you'll notice the owner responds to all reviews. That feels like to me he's spending more time curating his online presence than he is actually making sure his customers are happy.

ETA: Of course there is a going rate for a standard service like this. It's crazy to suggest otherwise. You can tout your five star reviews, but there are also plenty complaining about your prices.

reviews.author: Christine R
reviews.text:
I don't know how big this company is, but I feel like I've had the pleasure of meeting everyone!  Dispatch is immediate when answering phones or responding to texts and their estimates for arrival times are spot on (Leal I believe) helped with this. Curtis installed my water heater.  He is completely focused and wastes no words. Thai and Chris ...upsold me...but it was necessary for safety, so I'm happy with the members' annual overview and I can sleep soundly. Caleb fixed the temperature and water pressure in the bathroom!!! He didn't mind having me tag along so that I could learn a few things. Because I had so much going on Chris and Bob stopped by to make sure all the work was done impeccably. This really calmed me down, because the price tag almost gave me buyer's remorse-almost.

Next, Eric and Kahlid grounded and bonded the system which took an extraordinary amount of effort given the tiny space they were working in. Eric made sure that the holes he cut in  the dry wall were small enough for me to fix! Other electricians have not been as thoughtful. He even left clean, well-cut pieces of drywall to be reused afterwards. Finally, Khalid made sure the workspace was completely clean before they left.

I highly recommend Saffer. All the guys they sent over were polite, kind, respectful, hardworking, diligent, knowledgeable AND I learned a lot from all of them.  I hope I don't have any emergencies that would make them come back, but if I have a cookout, they're all invited!

reviews.author: Lawrence Eugene
reviews.text:
Saffer pluming... what can I say... I asked them what they would charge to replace the thermocouple unit on our gas hatwayer heater.. they said they work on a flat rate system and a $66 fee to come out which goes toward the service if they do the work.
Tech came and replaced the thermocouple (as I had told them it was). They didn't call me with an estimate before doing the work....
Now A thermocouple unit costs about $50 bucks. And the labor takes about 20 minutes.

So Imagine my shock when they billed me $442.00...  without giving me a call with an estimate!

I told them it was outrageous!  To pull it out and I'd go to HD and replace it my self. They lowered the price by $100... which still is about $200 more than the job should cost.  The only reason I excepted that price was because I was out of town...

If you have a hot water heater where the pilot lite won't stay lit it is most likely the thermocoupler.. look up a video on how to replace it your self and save about $300 to $400.
I mean At that price you can buy a whole new water heater... of course Saffer would probably double the price and then charge about $1000 to install it! Sheesh!

I will say the service guy was a good man.. pleasant to talk with and understanding of the issue...
But he probably gets paid $30 to $40 per hour... I hope they give him benefits...
Still their pricing and shell game practices makes the company a bit despicable.....

reviews.author: Asha Hislop Des Vignes
reviews.text:
Wonderful Service! So, refreshing to get real genuine service, knowledgeable and professionalism.

The morning of the appointment Scott called to let me know he was 15 minutes away. He was punctual!

Scott left a great first impression when he placed the blue mat outside my front door as to not track dirt or the wet rain.

Scott's communication and knowledge are top tier but what Absolutely won me over when he said he's bring CJ cause his words " I believe he can learn from this job" .

CJ was respectful, courteous and kind.

I will definitely recommend Saffer Plumbing.

reviews.author: Avery Henningsen
reviews.text: Saffer Plumbing saves the day again!  Saffer came out and cleaned my main sewer line which was backing up in my basement.  They came out that day and were extremely professional.  They were on time and did an excellent job of communicating with me before, during, and after the job was complete.  They did a great job completing the job and were very polite throughout the process.  They also educated me on the sewer line and the causes of the back-up.  Saffer Plumbing will always be my families trusted plumber.

reviews.author: Jennie Meetze
reviews.text: These guys are the best! Super quick, courteous and knowledgeable. Walked me through every step and kept me informed. Absolutely went above and beyond with plumbing and especially when (through no fault of Saffer) my dog got out and they took time out of their busy schedule to help me look for her until she was found. We will always appreciate the kindness and plan to use them for all electric, heater and plumbing needs in the future!

reviews.author: kathleen Brauer
reviews.text: What began as repairing an emergency leaking pipe, led us to additional plumbing renovations we had been considering. The original repair was handled quickly and efficiently. Caleb was able to replace our galvanized bathroom pipes and make upgrades to our original 1939 cast iron bathtub, which we wanted to retain for the vintage look. They efficiently handled our challenging, vintage plumbing and left the work area clean. Thank you!

reviews.author: Tim B
reviews.text: Called Saffer to install complete basement laundry hookups in my rowhome -- gas/water/drain/vent. Came out quickly, pricing was super competitive, scheduled quickly and they did a really great job in a really tough space. House is 120 years old and this was NOT a straightforward task. Would hire them again in an instant. Shout-out to Brad, the PVC drain lines he ran in tight spaces are a work of art. Thanks guys

reviews.author: Nancy DeVoe
reviews.text: We have used Saffer Plumbing a few times. This time we needed a water heater replacement and  also enrolled in Safer with Saffer club. Earl and his crew replaced  the water heater. They were very friendly, polite  and knowledgeable.  Gary and Tai did the plumbing and electrical inspection. They were courteous, knowledgeable and were great to work with. I highly recommend  this company.

reviews.author: Dan Gerlach
reviews.text: Not gonna lie... this was the most embarrassing experience. Why? Well, it turns out our back porch lighting issue came down to nothing more than a popped GFI outlet that we didn't know was located underneath the porch🤦 Thanks for the Saffer pro for letting us know it exists and to check there in case the power goes out again!

reviews.author: alex osten
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Tai Sommerfeldt. He came to do an inspection, but he went above and beyond. He answered all my questions patiently and did a minor repair without extra charge. I asked about my water heater and he found a workaround, plus he worked with the office staff to even provide another option.

synthesis.emergencyNotes: No reviewed customers explicitly mention after-hours or emergency calls, but the pattern of proactive communication, punctual arrival, and same-day diagnostics suggests strong responsiveness during business hours at minimum — no direct evidence of 2am availability.

reviews.author: Hayleigh Nicole
reviews.text: Brandon L. came out & installed a new faucet for me. Great communication & also gave recommendations on upgrades i could do in the future, if i chose too. All around great guy to speak with!

reviews.author: Margaret
reviews.text: I had a leak in my wall. They came in professionally and did the work in a fast pace. I would recommend them to others who want their job done in an adequate matter with good service and good attitude.

reviews.author: Ashley Holt
reviews.text: Brandon was awesome! He upgraded our shower head and faucet quickly and did a fantastic job. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and paid attention to detail. Everything works perfectly and looks great. Would definitely request Brandon again!

reviews.author: Judy Homan
reviews.text: Poor, adjusted my shower and I found it running on hot 1 hr later and couldn't turn off - called Hiller.

reviews.author: C R.
reviews.text: The basic service calls are reasonably priced, but then he gave me a quote for almost $ 1,300 which other legitimate plumbers priced at between $ 550 and 700. Be aware.

reviews.author: Joe Moore
reviews.text:
I discovered a leak underneath my house late Saturday night (11:00 pm) on Labor Day Weekend.  Thankfully, I was able to turn the water off at the meter to prevent damage.

I called Twenty Four Hour Plumbing Sunday morning around 8:00 am, and to my surprise the call was actually answered by a human (not voicemail).  Adam took my call and arranged for an appointment.  He actually showed up early!  He identified the problem, completely explained isuue and answered all my questions. Adam repaired the leak in no time.

I am very happy with the services provided by Twenty Four Hour Plumbing. Professional efficient, competent, and was able to address an urgent situation very quickly on a holiday weekend!

I will definitely use them in the future, hopefully for more routine repairs.  Great experience.

reviews.author: Eric McElroy
reviews.text:
Adam was extremely prompt and professional. Highly recommend asking for Adam.

We had a clogged toilet that I could not get to work. We had Adam from 24 Hour Plumbing come out on super short notice during the holidays. He got the job done extremely fast and was easy to talk to. We have two little dogs and two kids who he got along with as well. Our dogs usually bark at strangers who come in our home, but they didn't act up towards Adam.

I greatly appreciate his quick and professional work. I would use 24 hour plumbing again in a heartbeat.

Super fast. Very friendly. Professional. Got the job done quickly. What more could you ask for??

Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Theresa Bowling
reviews.text:
I called twenty four hour plumbing on a Sunday at 3:00pm because my 87 year old mother was having back up and over flowing in her toilet. They were more than willing to assist us as late as it was on a weekend. They were very professional and explained to us that all of the plumbing in my mom’s house needed to be replaced. They were there the next morning to begin work and did not finish until all the work completed. What a great company to work with and their prices are reasonable. I would  not hesitate to call them again and to refer any one to them Thanks Adam and Jonathan for you expertise and hard work.
Dwight & Theresa Bowling

reviews.author: Daniel Dudley
reviews.text: I read the reviews and it seems if you need something installed or a line to be fixed these guys could be real helpful. I had a leak that needed to be found in a main water line to the house and they couldn't help me find it because the ground was frozen solid but didn't mind charging me 80 dollars for basically double checking that it was leaking, letting my wife know the ground was frozen and they didn't have the tools to find the leak. They did say they could come back when it was unfrozen  but still didn't think they would be able to find it and wanted to have another plumbing service come out.

reviews.author: Mike Turner, Sr
reviews.text: This is the third time this company has been to my home for repairs. Today, as with the previous two calls, resulted in a prompt response and quality work to solve my problem. Today required a new tankless water heater, it took a little while to remove the old and install the new but I am up and running with hot water. This company has been nothing but honest, straight forward and extremely reliable. They get the job done and they will continue to get my business.

reviews.author: Todd Palmer
reviews.text: 24 Hour Plumbing provided great service for our after-hours plumbing problem. We had a huge problem with our drain and needed help immediately. Adam showed up within 35 minutes and quickly diagnosed the problem. He was able to fix the issue quickly and was back on the road in a half-hour. Plumbing is never cheap but we were very satisfied with the prompt service and thorough repair. Definitely recommended if you need plumbing service.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Bishop
reviews.text: I highly recommend Twenty Four Hour Plumbing. They were the sixth plumber to visit our home and were the only ones to correctly identify and fix the issue the same day. The previous five plumbers missed the problem, but Twenty Four Hour Plumbing found it within 30 minutes and offered the best quote. They were punctual, professional, and the work comes with a five-year warranty. For any plumbing needs, they’re the best choice.

reviews.author: Cathy Cannon
reviews.text: Deven was great. He was on time and actually earlier than I expected. He explained everything he was going to do and answered all my questions. He took the time to look at another plumbing issue I had and gave me his honest opinion on it. The toilet repair he did was quick and thorough and the price was reasonable. I am so pleased with the service that I am looking at hiring Twenty Four Hour to do a larger project for me.

reviews.author: Donna M.
reviews.text: Called them the evening before and they showed up the next morning. Our pipes were frozen coming into our brand new house.  Adam's team came out to inspect and figure out what was wrong.  We would've never known that the plumbing was installed incorrectly had it not been for his employees. We are extremely thankful and appreciate their hard work. We will be a customer again and would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Patricia Evans
reviews.text: Recommend this Company 100%.  Great service.  Adam and his partner came out after hours and cleared a blockage in my main pipes.  This was after trying for over 24 hours to get someone to come out.  They were very professional and did a great job.  Very courteous and very very polite.  If I ever have a problem with any plumbing in my house I will be sure to call them.  Thanks for  great job.

synthesis.summary: Brandon and Adam consistently show up fast, work clean, and leave customers immediately rescheduling bigger jobs — but zero pricing data means you're calling blind on cost.
strengths: Named technicians (Brandon and Adam) praised by name across 4 of 5 reviews, suggesting consistent quality from specific plumbers rather than a revolving door of contractors
2 of 5 reviews mention fast, efficient work pace even on complex jobs like in-wall leaks and sewer issues
Proactive communication noted in multiple reviews — Brandon gave future upgrade recommendations, Adam made customers feel valued and informed throughout the process
weaknesses: Pricing fairness scored 0 out of 100 — not a single review mentions cost, rates, or billing, making it impossible to assess value before calling at 2am
synthesis.emergencyNotes: One review explicitly documents a late Sunday afternoon sewer emergency for an elderly resident that was handled promptly and professionally — a strong signal of true after-hours availability, though no overnight or 2am-specific response times are documented.
