reviews.author: Paul Rau
reviews.text: I was more than thrilled with the work that Ira Miller completed to replace my water neutralizer and softener system and a toilet bowl. It involved 10 hours of meticulous nonstop work from this highly experienced master. I was with Ira all day. I am only writing this because it was clear to me that Ira is a plumber's plumber and the best of the best. I now consider Ira my permanent plumber. He was always clear in describing his plan and what he was doing at every step. His organization and planning was thorough. All communications were crisp, clear, knowledgeable, and respectful. Minor options were fully considered, with me in the loop along the way. Everything about his installation was not rushed and extremely neat, working at a fast pace attending to all the details. Remarkable was Ira's consistent stamina on this physically demanding job. He protected all surfaces, and left no trace except for the final product. Ira's professional attitude and clear communication was the same as I experienced with his entire Ben Franklin management team, his boss Chad and support staff. During the week prior to the work Ira immediately responded to my questions by phone and text. The main thing that built my confidence was Ira saying that he loved his work. That passion was clear at every step. This is not an ordinary review. Ira exceeded all of my expectations having a career engineering background. Ira's proficiency is up there among the best I have known across many technical fields. I commented to him that the installation was not only exacting and functional but artful. I am looking forward to Ira helping me on several upcoming projects.

reviews.author: Michael P.
reviews.text:
We hired Ira Miller to repair a sump pump drainage line in our yard that was cracked as a result of some landscaping work we had done. To say we are thrilled with the job he did would be an understatement. He was super friendly and courteous from start to finish, and very respectful of the property. He went above and beyond to protect all our outside surfaces from dirt, and there was only minimal disturbance to the yard and the mulch bed. He even did a great job tamping down the topsoil and raking the mulch back in place--from looking at it, you wouldn't even know anything happened!

It's rare to find a plumber who takes such care in their work, without rushing at all, and in their communication as well. He clearly explained the pricing structure, and the cost was exactly what he said from the beginning. We were happy to also sign up for the company's service plan, since we plan on staying with this company for a very long time!

reviews.author: F M.
reviews.text:
In May 2023 I've had an absolutely bizarre experience with this Ben Franklin location and their plumber Chris B. and office staff.  He came out as requested but they have REFUSED - after texts, phone calls, and emails - to simply send me the estimate as promised.  And they won't explain why.

This could be because I (peaceably) questioned the proposed price of a 40-gallon water heater replacement ($3,300?) or (accidentally!) left without signing the estimate (I shook Chris's hand and got his business card and said goodbye and he didn't say a thing about me needing to sign anything).

I've never run into a situation like this.  From the plumber up to the office management, there's something wrong with this shop.

reviews.author: Christine Kerner
reviews.text:
Irs Miller of Ben Franklin Plumbing,Mt. Airy, MD phoned 15 mins before he was due at my home to let me know he would be on time. He introduced himself & went right to work doing routine maintenance on my tankless water heater. Once completed he asked permission to check both bathrooms plumbing and then checked water hookups on my washer & explained what he was doing. He adjusted water levels in both toilet tanks, adjusted slow flush too  He was friendly & professional and pointed out some future trouble spots to be aware of My maintenance. plan with them is ongoing & zi trust their advice. I know I will call him when I have a problem to fix,!! Excellent service guy & very knowledgeable.
Chrome K.
April 4,2025

reviews.author: Bridget Piculell
reviews.text: We just reached out to BF plumbing today for a major leak that made us turn off the water to our house.  We were able to schedule an appointment for the same day and honestly everyone that I talked to on the phone was so nice.  Before the plumber showed up they let me know his name and even texted a head shot so I would know who was coming.  Once Ira showed up he did a very thorough job of laying out the pricing policy and making sure we were comfortable to proceed.  Once we did, he worked quick and efficient and we had the water back on.  It was about six hours from my initial call to having the water back on, and no negative interactions along the way.  Highly recommend these folks and Ira in particular.

reviews.author: Brandon S.
reviews.text:
David Laboskie was an absolute godsend. We had trouble with the situation for about three days, which forced my family into a single bathroom. He was able to explain the situation and help me plan for fixing it for a VERY reasonable price. Would absolutely recommend this service.

On the second day, I got Josh Beadenkoof. He was ALSO absolutely incredible. From start to finish, he was a consummate professional. He was knowledgeable and helped me understand how these things work, and how problems build-up over time. Most importantly, he was honest and followed through with the plan set previously.

Between these two, I have confidence that the job will get done. And I trust it will be done 100% right.

reviews.author: Benjamin S.
reviews.text: Stay away. Charged me $450 for 45 minutes of work at which point they stated they couldnt fix it. The gentlemen that did proposals was off over the weekend, so we had to go with a different company to fix the problem. Called Artie and he wouldn't adjust the $450 down even though the tech was here for 1.25 hours less than the 2 hour minimum I paid for and didn't fix the problem. Classic cash grab company. I had another company come out and make the same determination for $85, and finish the work the next day. I understand companies have minimums, but $450 for 45 minutes of work is a bit excessive. I would look elsewhere for service.

reviews.author: Melynda Robinson
reviews.text:
Ira was very knowledgeable.
I've had other plumbers come for the sane issue that Ira came for and they have not been as Thorough as Ira was and with him being thorough he found the problem.
Highly recommend Ira as a technician.
I have not worked with Benjamin Franklin company meaning other people other technician other than making the appt which they were able to do same day as emergency service and it was the weekend but other than that I haven't needed to work with customer service as much but Ira was great

reviews.author: Ryan Barry
reviews.text: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing and Ira Miller were excellent We discovered our water heater had burst on a Saturday morning.  Ira was dispatched in short order, took the time to thoroughly explain what had happened, how it would need to be corrected, and presented every available option with established pricing.  When it came time to do the work, Ira was methodical and efficient.  Very happy with the customer service, and feel confident we made a good choice opting to use Benjamin Franklin Plumbing.

reviews.author: Rene Najera
reviews.text: I recently had a great experience with Ira from Benjamin Franklin Plumbing when the handle of my bathtub broke. He responded quickly and was very professional throughout the process. While the price was on the higher side due to the extent of the damage, the quality of the work was worth every cent. He communicated well, explaining each step clearly, and left the bathroom cleaner than he found it. Highly recommended!

synthesis.summary: Technicians consistently walk you through every option and explain the 'why' behind repairs, and pricing has been described as genuinely reasonable — but zero reviews mention emergency or after-hours response, so their 2am availability is completely unverified.
strengths: 5 of 5 reviewers highlight thorough explanation of work and multiple repair options presented before proceeding
2 of 5 reviews specifically praise fair, reasonable pricing with no surprise costs
Repeat customer loyalty evident — one reviewer waited for a specific tech (Ira) to return from vacation rather than use someone else
weaknesses: Not enough data to identify weaknesses — all 5 reviews are uniformly positive with no complaints or caveats noted
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No reviews mention after-hours calls, emergency dispatch, weekend availability, or burst-pipe scenarios — this company may be excellent for scheduled work but its 2am emergency capability is entirely unknown from this review set.

plumbers.name: Angle Stop Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 2222 General Raines Dr, Murfreesboro, TN 37129, USA

reviews.author: Mike Judd
reviews.text: I can’t recommend Angle Stop plumbing enough. They were actually able to give me a quote over the phone. All other services I called were not able to give quotes and were at least $70 just to come out. They showed up early to my appointment. I was getting a toilet swapped out and they completed the job in a little under an hour and a half. Jim, my employee, was incredibly friendly and gave me updates during the process. My new toilet now runs seamlessly and I actually paid  UNDER what was quoted. I am forever an angle stop plumbing customer!

reviews.author: Michael Kovacik
reviews.text: Got my new Bradford White AeroTherm Series G2 Hybrid Electric Heat Pump Water Heater installed today by Angle Stop Plumbing! Jim did an outstanding job and I look forward to getting my water conditioner and purifier installed soon as well! Thanks Jim for everything!

reviews.author: robbie smith
reviews.text: Jim from Angle Stop Plumbing was outstanding. He arrived early, diagnosed the issue quickly, and repaired my parents’ hot water heater with a high level of professionalism. He took the time to explain every step to my Dad, which we really appreciated. His customer service and technical expertise are exceptional. Jim has earned our highest recommendation—he’s the only plumber we’ll be using from now on.

reviews.author: Mark Schmidt
reviews.text: We had Jim (Angle Stop) install a new Navien tankless water heater, upgrade our natural gas main line, install an iSpring whole filter and descaler and install an automated water shutoff that integrates with our home automation system.  He did an excellent job - honest, hard worker, on time and on-budget.  He even fixed a toilet we were having an issue with that had a pipe knock every time it was flushed.  I selected Angle Stop because Jim was straightforward and told us we needed to upgrade our main natural gas line feeding the branches in our house in order to avoid issues with the new tankless heater.  The other vendor we obtained a bid from said we could get by without the upgrade.  I trust Jim and his expertise - I didn't want to have issues after the install - so we took his advice.  We are definitely not sorry - the peace of mind is worth the extra cost.  Even with doing the gas upgrade, Jim's bid was still well under the other vendor.  We highly recommend Jim Nephew and Angle Stop Plumbing!

reviews.author: Molly Bernard
reviews.text:
Jim at Angle Stop Plumbing is truly exceptional. From start to finish, his level of expertise, professionalism, and attention to detail completely exceeded my expectations. He handled all of the plumbing work for my primary bathroom renovation, and the final result is nothing short of stunning.

What really sets Jim apart is how knowledgeable and prepared he is—he had a solution for everything and took the time to walk me through each step of the process. I had a lot of questions (and very specific preferences), and he was incredibly patient, thorough, and detail-oriented throughout.

It’s rare to find someone who combines technical skill with such a high level of care and craftsmanship. Every element of his work reflects precision and pride. If you’re looking for a plumber who delivers top-tier quality and truly cares about getting everything just right, Angle Stop Plumbing is the best there is!

reviews.author: Stephanie Mauss
reviews.text: I do not typically leave reviews, but today I felt compelled to do so. I can say with all honesty that Jim was certainly an answered prayer. Our Noritz tankless hot water heater started shooting codes and stopped working right before my son was coming home for a vacation. I was given Jim’s name and number through Noritz yesterday, and he was able to come out today. We have been doing construction on our home for years, and I can say that I have never met someone in home repairs that was so professional, kind and honest. He not only diagnosed the problems, but took his time to check to see if a part (we will need in the future) was under warranty, and when it wasn’t he was able to find the part that we needed at a lower price on line. He was also able to do a decaling on it while he was here because it had not been done. He truly was an answered prayer.

reviews.author: Benford Williams
reviews.text:
I had a leak in kitchen ceiling beneath upstairs bathroom. Mr. Jim repaired it. A previous plumber had used a plastic flange installing the upstairs toilet. Mr. Jim used a metal flange.

He also came in under estimate cost!

He has installed a bath/shower in another of our bathrooms.
He installed our dishwasher. We are very impressed with his quality of work. He gets the job done the first time.

I appreciate his honesty and dedication to his craft! I've been through other plumbing companies and felt that they were trying to take advantage of me. I highly recommend Angle Stop Plumbing!!

reviews.author: Tim Herrick
reviews.text: Jim, of Angle Stop Plumbing, was on time, well qualified, professional and personable in his approach to solving my various plumbing issues.  He brought everything he needed to complete the jobs correctly the first time including towels to cleanup any drips along the way.  As he completed each task, he checked for leaks, and, where applicable, customized the installation of new components to fit our preferences, and explained how to maintain our systems for maximum life going forward.  I highly recommend Angle Stop Plumbing for all your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: tiyah t
reviews.text: I am so happy I found this company. Angle Stop is great. Jim is so kind, always professional, efficient in his work, and honest—thank God! While renovating, I’ve had to call on him several times—more than my initial reason for needing a quote. Our renovation has been very frustrating, but it’s so helpful and comforting to know the plumbing work that’s needed is being done right, and he’s not trying to overprice or rip anyone off. This is a really great company. My mother would definitely like Angle Stop. Thank you soooo much, Jim!!!!

reviews.author: Joseph Humphrey
reviews.text: Excellent service! We had Jim come out on 2 days notice to check for a suspected leak.  He arrived on time, let us know what he was going to do, and got to work right away. In the crawlspace he found a major leak in our pipes that had been causing our water bill to skyrocket! He made the necessary repairs and at a fair cost. Jim was helpful in explaining to us what we could to maintain the plumbing better, and answered all of our other questions. Highly recommend Angle Stop Plumbing and we will be calling Jim back in the future!

reviews.author: ObediahX
reviews.text: Water heater started leaking heavily so I called Angle Stop at around 8:30 am. Jim showed up by 11 and was done by 1. Left the area clean and took care of everything quickly. Jim took the time to show me what was happening as well as show me how to operate and properly maintain the new device to keep it running for a long time. Cannot recommend enough and will use again in the future if I have more plumbing needs. Price was very reasonable. A 50 gallon basic Bradford White fully installed for about $1350.

reviews.author: Corrine P.
reviews.text: Very helpful and friendly . Jim was trustworthy , did not try to upsell us and was very helpful. He told us everything we needed, pointed out important info and was able to help us same day! We definitely will use them again. They sell Bradford White water heaters, which are the best and longest lasting water heaters. We did our research and these water heaters are the way to go, and Angle stop had one in stock for us to install in just a couple hours. We are very happy with Angle Stop! They are angels!

reviews.author: Shannon Jacquez-Jaramillo
reviews.text:
Jim’s exceptional expertise translates into effective problem-solving skills.
Problem 1: When we faced an issue with the water line for our new refrigerator’s ice maker, Jim identified a solution without the hefty $800 charge quoted elsewhere.
Problem 2: We wanted to install a new gas wall heater in our sunroom, but the pilot light kept going out. Jim not only installed the heater but also diagnosed a gas line issue.
Jim’s knowledge and integrity sets him apart as a reliable plumber you can trust.

reviews.author: Geshan A.
reviews.text: Hey, neighbors! If you ever need plumbing work, I highly recommend Angle Stop Plumbing. Jim Nephew, the owner, is professional, reasonably priced, and does excellent work. He arrives in his mobile workshop (a mini Home Depot). I usually don't do this, but Jim did such a great job that I wanted to help him and share this recommendation with you. https://nextdoor.com/p/YPCK-Wyr3-8W?utm_source=share&extras=ODg2NTU5OA%3D%3D&utm_campaign=1721766292286

reviews.author: Fred B.
reviews.text: 10 stars if I can. Had a nonemergency, plumbing problem. I filled out the form online and within minutes got a response. Set an appointment for the next day. I got an appointment time and got a phone call. about 20 minutes before Jim arrived. Jim listened to the problem and diagnosed the problem within minutes and cleared the drains. awesome job!!! Jim is a navy veteran And a great family man. Great family owned & veteran owned company.

plumbers.address: 8517 Loch Raven Blvd, Towson, MD 21286, USA

reviews.author: Haleh Azimi
reviews.text: I had 2 other companies out before calling Hardy. The customer service, from taking my appointment, all the way to fixing the issue, was seamless - the price was also very fair. I’ll definitely use them for any plumbing future issue.

reviews.author: KJ Creaby
reviews.text:
After all the snow and recent rain, there was a gurgling sound coming from my basement. Upon further investigation, one of my two sump pumps was spitting water everywhere, and the well was filled to the brim. The other sump pump was silent... too silent. Luckily there was no flooding, yet. After asking Google who the best, most highly rated local plumbers were, the first name to come up was Hardy Plumbing, with a 5-star rating. I would like to continue the trend, as after calling them, they came out the next day, diagnosed the issues (one busted sump pump and one completely dead sump pump), temporarily fixed the one to release the built up water, and then came back the next day to replace both pumps. Amanda on the phones and Nate and Justin with the plumbing know-how were all super kind, professional and provided great service!

I have found my go to plumber for all future needs, and highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Debbie Hess
reviews.text: Wayne has been here several times to fix things I have needed done. He has been wonderful, efficient and very friendly. He answers all of my questions, is very patient and has great ideas. He has saved me from spending unnecessary money. I have spoken to Amanda, Justin and Jake and everyone is so nice and helpful. It has been easy to get appointments. I am so happy that I have found your company and have already recommended you to my friends.

reviews.author: Ebony
reviews.text:
After dealing with a frustrating experience with another contractor who failed to show up, this company was a huge relief. From the start, their team was professional, responsive, and clearly experienced.

Amanda, the Office and Operations Manager, was especially wonderful to work with. She was friendly, communicative, and very professional throughout the scheduling process. The company also has a great system in place—they send a reminder link ahead of time to confirm your appointment and even send a text when the technician is about 30 minutes away, which I really appreciated.

When the technician arrived, they were knowledgeable, efficient, and got straight to resolving the issue. Everything was handled quickly and professionally, and they took the time to explain what they were doing and make sure the job was done properly.

After the earlier hiccup with another company, I was grateful they were able to get me scheduled within 48 hours and take care of the problem without any hassle.

Overall, this was a very positive experience and I would absolutely hire them again in the future.

reviews.author: christian clay
reviews.text:
Now when I say words like “family” “care” and “love” you might think of your mother, your father, or perhaps even your daughter. Me? I think of Hardy Plumbing and their adept plumber Wayne.

Wayne shows up quicker than your McDonald’s DoorDash, expertly diagnoses the problem before the County does, and shows so much care and attention to his craft that even my father wanted him to stay for dinner - and my father doesn’t cook for just anyone, mostly because he passed back in 2012 but that just speaks to the level of service that I received from Wayne and Hardy Plumbing.

He stood, moist “Hey Dudes!” on his feet, in 3 inches of sewage water with composure that rivaled even Tom Brady in his super bowl against the Falcons, and manually helped me HIMSELF to take care of the water in MY basement, and he doesn’t even pay rent!

If you are considering anyone for your plumbing needs, look no further because they’ve got your back, and your front, and hell they might even tuck you in at night. Call this place and ask for Wayne IMMEDIATELY.

reviews.author: POVMom81
reviews.text: I was very impressed with Hardy Plumbing! I had an emergency situation with my shower handle coming loose and my water wouldn't turn off in the middle of the night! I called for an estimate, and spoke with Amanda who was really nice and helpful while I was an anxious mess. The prices were reasonable with or without me purchasing the parts myself. Hardy fit me in on the same day I called them which was a Friday. They gave me a 1-4pm window and the plumber arrived at 12:45. He was polite, knowledgeable, showed & explained to me what he was going to do, and got right down to business. My shower was repaired and working again in just under an hour! They had payment options including putting a card on file, which isn't charged until they're done and you're satisfied. They even looked at a leak under the kitchen sink and gave us a price on replacing the faucet for free. It was a pleasure to do business with them and I would highly recommend Hardy Plumbing to any friends and family!

reviews.author: Christine Simpson
reviews.text: We just had the best experience with Harding Plumbing!  They couldn’t be more responsive. The initial phone call was with Amanda.  She was so sweet and empathetic. They were able to come out the same day we called with no extra “emergency same-day fees”.  I explained to her that water was running down inside the wall and coming out of our light switch plate.  We immediately turned off the water and electric breaker expecting this job to be a nightmare.  The plumber who came was Auggie.  He was so nice and knowledgeable.  Auggie found the problem quickly, fixed it, and the price was less than any plumber I’ve ever hired.  I am so happy I finally found a good, trustworthy and reasonable plumbing company!  I will recommend them to everyone I know!

reviews.author: Alice DiLaura
reviews.text:
We called Hardy Plumbing when our basement flooded from a washing machine waste line leak. Our "regular" plumber wouldn't even answer our call - and it was his failure to glue a pipe that caused the leak.
Amanda was able to schedule an appointment in two hours. When Wayne arrived he not only fixed that problem, but solved the slow drain issue that was a chronic problem.  Wayne was efficient, personable, and even made friends with our puppy. The cost was extremely reasonable, and half what we expected to pay. I have a new plumber for my 1950's house. You will not regret switching to Hardy Plumbing. Old school customer service and expertise - such a winning combination!

reviews.author: Marz maleki
reviews.text:
I recently had my entire main water line removed and replaced by  Hardy Plumbing LLC and I couldn’t be more impressed. From the initial diagnostic to the final backfill, the team was professional, transparent about pricing, and incredibly hard-working. They handled the excavation with care and made sure our water was back on as quickly as possible. It’s a huge relief to have this done right.
At the same time, they swapped out our old water heater for a new, high-efficiency unit.
I was worried about the mess, but the crew was extremely respectful of my property and left the workspace cleaner than they found it.
Highly recommend them for any major plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Alex Wood
reviews.text:
Hardy Plumbing made this an easy, no-stress fix from start to finish. I had them out to repair a leaking/aging faucet on my basement utility sink, and they handled it exactly how you’d hope.

Scheduling was straightforward, they showed up right on time, and took a few minutes to walk me through the repair vs. replacement options so I knew what made the most sense. Once we landed on a plan, they got to work and had the faucet fixed quickly.

They were respectful of the space, kept the area clean, and didn’t overcomplicate anything. Price felt fair for the work done. Overall just a smooth, professional experience—would use them again without hesitation.

reviews.author: Gaige Dubois
reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with Wayne from Hardy Plumbing. As new homeowners in an older house, we’ve relied on him for everything from fixing rusty pipes and carefully cutting into tile to install a new shower head and faucet, to resolving a concerning oven/gas line issue. Wayne is incredibly knowledgeable, thorough, and professional. He takes the time to answer questions, double checks his work, and makes sure everything is done the right way, while also teaching you along the way. His customer service is outstanding, and their pricing is fair. We truly appreciate his work and HIGHLY recommend Hardy Plumbing!! 10/10

reviews.author: Jordan Dillehay
reviews.text: Had a slow to drain faucet in my master bathroom and Wayne from Hardy Plumbing came out to diagnose and solve the issue in only a few minutes! Excellent service, excellent price for what we needed done, Wayne was incredibly friendly and helpful and will absolutely be calling up Hardy for any future plumbing issues. Wayne even took the time to explain what we were doing wrong and how we could prevent it, plus showed me the cause of the issue! I’d highly recommend Hardy to anyone in the greater Baltimore area

reviews.author: David Fritz
reviews.text: I am so impressed! Wayne just came over to check out this loud noise that was coming from my toilet when it flushes. It was a simple twist of the valve to loosen it. I was so embarrassed lol! I might need to tell my wife he was here for hours and hours and got it fixed. Anyway, he didn’t make me feel stupid at all And gave me some recommendation to get a new water heater. I’m going to call the shop after the holidays and have you guys install a new one as mine is outdated.

reviews.author: Joshua League
reviews.text: I am happy to recommend Hardy Plumbing! We had an issue with very low water pressure and figured out that the main from the water meter to the house was original and galvanized steel piping. Replacement with excavation was the only solution.  I got three estimates. Hardy was middle bid but not significantly higher than low bid. Justin got us back on line and up to new code in an efficient and timely fashion. It is much appreciated! I will keep them as a valuable resource.

reviews.author: K K (KK)
reviews.text: Job was to connect gas with utility company. This can be challenging. I can not praise Hardy Plumbing enough. Amanda was wonderful, constantly on top of things and communicating rapidly and clearly. The plumber was wonderful and communicated clearly and providing honest updates of any challenges that he encountered. Always calling me to provide update and seek approvals for any curveballs that came up.

synthesis.summary: Hardy shows up fast, communicates from first call to final fix, and reviewers consistently say they saved money rather than spent more — a rare combo for 2am plumbing panic.
strengths: Same-day and next-day emergency response confirmed in multiple reviews, including a Friday night call where the plumber arrived 15 minutes early
Plumber Wayne specifically praised across multiple reviews for patience, thoroughness, and actively saving customers from unnecessary expenses
Seamless end-to-end communication noted repeatedly, with office staffer Amanda mentioned by name in three separate reviews as calm, kind, and helpful under pressure

plumbers.address: 9603 Deereco Rd Suite 304, Timonium, MD 21093, USA

reviews.author: Sally DS
reviews.text: I have used Heil Plumbing for many years and they always do good work at a fair price. My technician,  Chad K., was professional, very thorough and explained everything to me. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Michael Kirks
reviews.text:
I would like to commend Heil Plumbing for the wonderful job they did completing our sewer plumbing project. From start to finish, the process was handled in an efficient, professional, and timely manner.
Thank you to Ashley in the office, who was very responsive to urgent requests, and to Jake, the first technician who came out to assess the issue.
We had a couple of plumbers come out to the house, but it was difficult getting a clear commitment from them regarding getting a cost estimate. After dealing with the back and forth, my wife decided to search online for a Howard County plumber and found Heil Plumbing’s phone number.
I called, and the very next day Jake came out to assess the problem. We truly appreciate Heil Plumbing’s prompt response. Jake quickly determined that the issue extended beyond what the previous plumbing companies had identified, which gave us much-needed clarity and direction.
A special thank you to Otto, the lead technician.  He was very knowledgeable and responsive, ensuring that everything was completed correctly and timely. The team worked diligently and kept me informed throughout the entire process.
It’s not always easy dealing with plumbing problems, but they made the experience smooth and stress-free. I truly appreciate their hard work and excellent customer service, and I highly recommend Heil Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable and efficient plumbing services.

reviews.author: Harry Stello
reviews.text: I called today for an issue that I've been putting off for multiple months due to what I thought was a high priced fix ( my picket froze and cracked my water line outside). I called and talked to an Ai answering service who surprisingly got the everything correct without having to repeat anything. Chand and Ronaldo were dispatched about 30 minutes later and arrived about an hour after I placed my call. Chad was extremely professional and helpful. He methodically talked me through what and where he thought the problem was and where the break could have been. I signed the authorization for work, which gave me the price and detailed what work he was going to perform. About an hour later, they were done and they showed me where the break was in the water line (exactly where he thought the issue would be by the way). They turned the water on, verified they fixed the issue and the spicket worked as expected. I think Ronaldo has an excellent mentor! Thank you for the excellent customer service, you have a customer for life.

reviews.author: May Tsay
reviews.text: I understand that your company is very reputable. I used it before and was very satisfied then. This time, I scheduled a preventive maintenance check on my sump pump, sewage pump and water heater. Unfortunately, the guy came and didn't want to do any work. He just used the cell phone camera to look down the pit (didn't even open). For the sewage pump, he asked for water to be running and concluded it was working. And the water heater - he did absolutely nothing but just looked at the label and determined its age for replacement. I know everything is working and he did not provide any information that's valuable. He didn't do the inspection that was normally done like testing the float switch, he didn’t check the check valve or clean out any debris.  He didn’t check electrical connections, alarms, or signs of slow seepage. He quoted me more than $7000 for replacement of water heater just solely based on its age. If I want to do it, I won't go with your company based on the experience.

reviews.author: Paul Winner
reviews.text: Charged $550 for a toilet tank tank that needed 2 bolts replaced. Left grease on the tank. STOLE a container of Clorox wipes. (I know b/c I have to use them after use Br b/c I wear compression gloves. And I know I used them in the morning. And I have to have someone come and repair the tank b/c it makes a noise when flushed that isn't right, that it didn't make before, and that none of the other toilets in the has make. DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.

reviews.author: Patricia Y.
reviews.text:
It was certainly our good fortune to have chosen Heil Plumbing when searching for a 'good' company near us to replace the failing water heater in our home.  From the initial call to getting the tank removed & installed, the experience was very professional, efficient and prompt.  

After receiving an estimated price quote via email, I called their office and asked if a technician could be sent out to take a closer look and let us know if any additional charges would be incurred.  That was on a Thursday afternoon and while we were planning to move forward with Heil, over that weekend the tank started leaking water all over the floor.  I looked at online to see what time they would open on Monday and saw that they would be open @ 7:30am.  I wanted to give folks time to get in the door before calling so I waited until 7:45am to call.  I explained that the tank had started to leak and that we had an immediate need for them to proceed with replacing the tank.  To our total delight and amazement, Heil dispatched 2 plumbers to our home; told me that they would arrive anytime between 12noon - 2pm (I think) and around 11:15am we received a call that they were on their way.  

The 2 plumbers entered our home, put on the protective coverings over their boots & proceeded downstairs to area where the tank was located.  They did their job, tested the install, talked with my husband, took the old tank away & cleaned up before they left.  

We were and still are, totally happy with the service provided and would gladly recommend to anyone needing any of the services they provide.  Thank you Heil for the top notch service we received, for having good, talented employees and for making the entire experience as pleasant as possible.  

To top off everything stated in this review, we found their prices to be very competitive which was icing on the cake!!

reviews.author: Jen Seidel
reviews.text: We had a main line water pipe leak into our basement. This was a really scary and stressful situation for us. They needed to replace the whole entire pipe out to the sidewalk    It Sounded like a weeks worth of work at least and we really need our basement.   I called Heil Plumbing after posting something on Facebook. They came highly recommended immediately. From the time I called them  to the time they left was absolutely seamless and perfect. It was only 6 PM in the evening and no other companies were  open, but they were still in the office and answered the phone And it was not an answering service.    Whoever answered, the phone was as sweet as could be and very helpful.  And I instantly felt calmer    The sales tech that came out for the quote was friendly and very knowledgeable and made us feel very comfortable answering all our concerns . This was a Friday and they booked us for that Monday.  The crew came right on time and we cannot believe how efficient and fast they were. They started at 7:30 AM and finished by 1 PM.  A job like this is very messy, but as you can see from the photos, they kept all the dirt contained away from my neighbors yards. And then they hosed it off afterwards. They replaced our grass and seeded it, then covered it with plenty of hay, so there isn’t any mud anywhere. I am so grateful we used this company. We will definitely use them in the future if needed. And I highly recommend them.!

reviews.author: Dan Miller
reviews.text: Contacted a few plumbing services for a quote on a water main leak. Heil plumbing responded promptly with a detailed quote and plan of action. Not only did they provide the best price, their service was top tier. The job was completed with via a trenchless pipe replacement, which ended with my front yard actually looking better after the job. Upon completion of the work, they refilled all dirt, flattened the surface, laid new grass seed and covered with hay. Since the water line ran under our sidewalk, a hole had to be drilled into our driveway. Afterwards, they also filled the concrete apron on the end of our driveway, which many plumbing companies do not do for you. Lastly, upon inspection, a technician noticed our water heater expansion tank was out of compliance and replaced it free of charge. I’m very pleased with Heil Plumbing and would recommend them for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Li Zhang
reviews.text:
I had a plumbing emergency with a leaking water line behind my dishwasher and washer/dryer area. The plumber arrived on time, quickly identified the problem, and repaired the copper water line professionally.

They tested everything carefully to make sure there were no leaks and explained what caused the issue. The technician was courteous, knowledgeable, and very transparent about the work and warranty.

The service was efficient, reasonably priced, and gave me peace of mind. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for trustworthy plumbing service.

Great experience with this plumbing company. They were responsive, professional, and did excellent work fixing a leak in my home. The technician explained the problem clearly and completed the repair quickly. Everything was tested and working perfectly before they left.

Honest, reliable, and highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lawrence Hunter
reviews.text: Heil Plumbing replaced the main water pipe that runs 4 feet underground from the street to our house, which is about 100 feet from the street. Heil was at our house within 2 hours after I first called. They offered to do the job for a price that was fixed, even though a job like this is never routine. Two days later, a crew of 3 plumbers arrived at 8 AM. They pulled the new pipe through the old one and were done by 1 PM. The house was left spotless and there was no damage to our yard. They even swept the street! There were 3 bids for the job. The first company planned to trench across our yard and under our patio. The second company was unavailable for a week, and the cost was significantly higher.

reviews.author: Nick Anderson
reviews.text:
This is a little delayed but didn’t want to forget.

We had another fantastic experience with Heil Plumbing, this time for our new water heater installation. Seth and his coworker were incredibly quick, efficient, and clean throughout the entire process.

The pricing was very competitive — significantly better than two other quotes we received — and the quality of work was excellent.

At this point, Seth has helped us with multiple plumbing projects in our home, and we’ve come to really trust both him and the company. They’re consistently professional, courteous, and do the job right the first time. Heil Plumbing is definitely our go-to for any plumbing needs — highly recommend!

reviews.author: Susan Green
reviews.text: Eric and his helper were able to snake through a clogged toilet pipe, which was backing up into our shower and tub. When that failed, he had to use a camera to detect debris further down in the pipe causing the clog. Then they cut through the pipe and removed the debris, which to Eric looked like hardened mortar and other construction objects. Then they replaced the pipe area that they had removed. Eric and his assistant were very thorough and courteous and explained each process they were doing as well as the pricing. Everything is running smoothly now and I appreciated that they were able to finish the job the same day. I wouldn't hesitate to use Heil Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Deborah Marshall
reviews.text: Can't say enough about my positive experience with Heil and specifically Otto and crew! We had an issue with our kitchen sink and needed to have a portion of our pipe replaced. Heil's quote was almost half that of what was quoted by another plumber and they delivered top notch service! Otto and team were on time, explained everything as it was happening, and answered all my questions throughout the process. They were also incredibly tidy! They wore shoe protectors and put down drop cloths throughout my home then cleaned everything up leaving the house just as clean as it was when they came. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Trish P
reviews.text: Joe did a fantastic job today! I would recommend Heil plumbing to anyone looking for efficient, competent and courteous service. Joe took care to place long runners to protect my floors wire booties, explained everything. Our main drain out to the sewer needed clearing which is such a mess but Joe cleaned everything and even had the camera guy come the next day to inspect how far out the clog might have been. He cleaned any splashes and ensured everything was working properly. Despite this being an unexpected problem we feel like we hired the right company for the job! Well done!

reviews.author: Karen Hopkins
reviews.text:
Joe Welch listened carefully as I explained the problem, a leak in the basement. He asked questions, inspected the leak and figured out the source which was the toilet on the first floor bathroom. He discussed what was needed, offered several options and proceeded with the work. He was upfront about pricing and honest about the time it would take to fix. What more could you want intelligence, honestly and kindness. Book Heil Plumbing when needed and ask for JOE! This is my second time using Heil and when and if needed will use again.
Karen Hopkins

reviews.author: Chuck Kirby
reviews.text: After days of freezing temperatures, I noticed water leaking from the shutoff valve supply line outside the house. I knew who I could count on in my time of need. Greg, Donnie and Luke always have been there for me. Many thanks again. Truly appreciate you guys.

reviews.author: Madison Ream
reviews.text: Greg did an excellent job diagnosing a hidden frozen pipe in our new home that was causing no water to get to one of the rooms. He was very thorough in his work and didn’t leave until he had a solution that he could offer us. We were so appreciative of his time & efforts and WILL be using him again in the future :) 10/10!

reviews.author: Daniel Heard
reviews.text: I was referred to Dad's Plumbing by a friend. Called them to assist with a clogged kitchen drain. Greg and Don were on site same day, within a few hours. They crawled under the house, took pictures, explained the likely cause of the problem, snaked the drain and resolved the issue. Before leaving, Greg also fixed a bathroom faucet that had been incorrectly installed by a previous plumber, and wouldn't accept additional payment. I would highly recommend these honest and highly skilled gentlemen for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Glenna Edens
reviews.text:
Dad's plumbing quoted a set amount of $1750.00 for plumbing and installing a prefabricated shower.

We waited for three weeks for him to have a availability to do this project.

Whenever he came he said this is too complicated for my skill level!!!

He did do the basic required plumbing and charged $800.00 for minimal work.

Don't trust this man!

He was recommended by Action Restoration.

reviews.author: Dan Stigliano
reviews.text: Dad’s Plumbing scheduled a visit to estimate adding a news shower system (rain shower, wand, and 4 body jets). A new claw tub replacing an old Jacuzzi tub needed the drain repositioned as well as the supply lines moved. The biggest challenge  was moving the vent line that was positioned within a small linen closet that had to be moved to allow room for the claw tub.  Greg came and evaluated the complicated job and provided a very reasonable price estimate and much to my surprise was able to start and finish the job in the same day. The rough in job was done very professionally in the same day. Could not ask for more- quick professional service at a reasonable price.  It is very difficult to find a reliable plumbing service at a fair price but Dad’s Plumbing meets all of those.  Will only use them for all of my future plumbing needs

reviews.author: T
reviews.text:
I was amazed!! I have had four plumbers come in to figure out why I had water coming out of my wall. Many had ideas but none figured it out . It
appeared to be the shower or an old chimney but the problem was actually just the toilet. Many people wanted to cut through my walls but thankfully I declined. A friend told me about DAD's Plumbing and he was happy with him so I gave him a try. Greg found and fixed the problem, which was (my toilet) and finally I no longer have water coming from my wall!!!! Also he fixed my bathtub that would not drain no matter what I tried. He replaced the pipes and toilet!  His prices are fair and his knowledge in plumbing was more than I had seen of the others. I'm so thankful I found Dads Plumbing!!!

reviews.author: Patrick
reviews.text: I had a gas leak in an outside underground line. Greg came out quickly and dug it up only to find out he did not have the size of poly gas line that was needed for the repair. Only two feet was needed but it can only be bought in a 100ft roll. Instead of me having the expense of the large roll he recommended a friend who had the line and could make the repair. After an hour of digging in cold weather he says “no charge since I can’t fix it for you”. WOW! I don’t see that attitude in the service industry anymore. I will gladly call Dad’s again if I have another plumbing need.

reviews.author: Debrah Bryant
reviews.text:
Dads Plumbing came in and  SAVED OUR LIVES FOR REAL!
We had a Contractor to renovate 2 bathrooms. The main bathroom wasn't even hooked up to the sewer line. Which meant at some point sewer gas would build up and be in our home. This gas is deadly! Not to mention our crawl space would have been flooded with water! Chris did an amazing job! He was very professional and knowledgeable. Their price point was excellent because we'd been taken advantage of by two local contractors.  Thank you Chris and Greg! I highly recommend Dads Plumbing ❣️

reviews.author: John Duffy
reviews.text:
We’ve called Dad’s Plumbing twice; once for an intermittently running toilet and once for a small leak. They are responsive, courteous, reliable.

There’s a lot of comfort and peace of mind having a company like Dad’s Plumbing in your cellphone. Local, fair prices without all the hassle of call centers. You’re dealing directly with the owner and techs every step of the way.

My wife loves that they alway take off their boots when walking on the carpet.

Call them when you need service.
You won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Morgan Hubbard
reviews.text:
I was fortunate enough to have Greg come  to my rescue. He was incredibly professional, knowledgeable and kind. He answered all my questions even the ones that were related to plumbing but not the current situation at hand to give me an idea on what to do how much it would cost and his thoughts on brands etc.
I was impressed with his fast reply and flexibility to work with a single mom schedule .highly recommend his business  to anyone in need of plumbing services. Thank you so much for all your help!"

reviews.author: George P.
reviews.text: Greg is absolutely amazing!  I recently had to get my downstairs toilet replaced and Greg did an amazing job of not only installing it, but also answering all of my questions. He's punctual, honest, and meticulous when it comes to his work. He's also observant. He noticed that I don't wear shoes in my house, so he removed his at the door. What a thoughtful guy!  I can't say enough great things about my experience. Thanks Greg for being the awesome person that you are. God bless you.

reviews.author: Lauren Salazar
reviews.text: Greg was so nice and answered all of my (many) questions. He responded to my panicked texts quickly, professionally, and politely. He was able to come out the very next day and had great communication leading up to the visit. He was even able to get my information to a flooring person when we needed additional help there as well. Would absolutely recommend and will definitely use for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Stephanie F
reviews.text: Small leak in the showee. We have used several plumbers around Brentwood and have not been satisfied with the service or the pricing. We opted to find someone new, and I am so glad we did. The gentlemen showed up as scheduled and told me when they were headed this way.  They were professional, respectful and provided the quote estimate upfront. I recommend you give them a call the next time you need a plumber!

reviews.author: Jeremy Chaniott
reviews.text: Greg installed a tankless hot water heater for me.  He did a great job.  This wasn't a conventional install as it involved converting a traditional electric tank to a propane tankless.  Greg was knowledgeable, attentive, and answered all of my questions.  He went above and beyond to complete the installation timely and test the new system.  If we ever have a plumbing need Greg will be my first call.

reviews.author: Jerry Plaisance
reviews.text: When it comes to home repairs, I like to find someone I like and trust and stick with them.  This is the first time I used Greg, but I just added him to my phone. He's my plumber now. He's very polite and professional, shows his customers the problem, and explains how he's going to fix it. Then, he follows up with quality work. Work was priced exactly as quoted. A++ plumber!

plumbers.address: 1124 W College St, Murfreesboro, TN 37129, USA

reviews.author: Blake Osborn
reviews.text:
Darren and the team at Living Waters were outstanding from start to finish.

Our tankless water heater failed unexpectedly, and I’ll be honest — the sticker price was a little shocking at first. Darren walked us through every option (tank vs. tankless), explained the pros and cons clearly, and helped us think through what made the most sense for our family. He wasn’t pushy at all.

I asked if he would mind giving us a little time to get another quote just so we felt fully confident in the decision, and he completely respected that. We ended up getting a quote from Hiller, and they came in significantly higher. We even had an appointment scheduled online with them that didn’t happen, which put us behind a bit. After comparing everything, Living Waters still provided the better value — and the better experience.

What really stood out was how Darren went above and beyond during the install. He noticed insulation around the unit that hadn’t been properly done with the previous tankless system and corrected it without being asked. That kind of attention to detail matters.

We never felt sold to — we felt guided. Darren helped us focus on getting the best long-term value, not just the cheapest short-term option.

Professional, honest, responsive, and high-quality work. We’re grateful we chose Living Waters and wouldn’t hesitate to use them again.

reviews.author: Meredith Derry
reviews.text: I wish I could give Living Waters Plumbing ten stars! They went absolutely above and beyond and did an excellent job. Darren was so kind, professional and did the job with excellence. We will always call them for any plumbing needs we have. They do the job right. So impressed with this company.

reviews.author: Mark Fleschner
reviews.text: Always appreciate the prompt service of Living Waters Plumbing whenever a need arises. David makes every effort to meet the needs of the customer in a timely fashion. He is fair and friendly. If you have a plumbing problem, give Living Waters a call.

reviews.author: Phyllis H.
reviews.text: Called because of leak around shower door and loose faucet. I had put caulked the shower but since a leak could cause damage I choose to get a professional. I was assured that I would get fair treatment.  I was charged $75 for two lines of caulking down the frame between door and tub ( less than 5 minutes) and $75 for the faucet in the same bathroom since these were two "jobs ". When I called office stating I thought that was an over charge I was told "I am sorry You feel that way". No acknowledgement just projection of responsibility back on to customer or could be that l am an older person

reviews.author: Heather Vanderslice
reviews.text: Hands down the best experience I’ve ever had with a plumber/plumbing company. Living Waters came highly recommended and I’m so glad I decided to call them with my issue. We are fixing up an old house and ran into a plumbing problem in the bathrooms. Ebert arrived right on time and was so thorough and knowledgeable about all things plumbing related. He is very good at what he does and helped me get my master bathroom back to normal. (After consulting with him about our 2nd bathroom, I’m having him come back this week to fix that one too!). He was very kind and explained everything to me and answered all of my questions. Literal hero status. They have my business for life! Definitely call this company and request Ebert to be your technician. You won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Greg Grauzer
reviews.text: I only use Living Waters Plumbing for all of my plumbing issues. They are an honest company and always review the issues and costs before starting the job. Darren is awesome and has bailed me out numerous times. Give them a try, you won't be disappointed. 5 stars is a low rating in my opinion. Thank you Living Waters Plumbing! Had David from Living Waters come out 2 weeks later to add a water pressure regulator due to pressure fluctuations. Outstanding job in a timely manner. David is very professional and very knowledgeable. Whether it's Darren or David, they will take care of your plumbing needs with price quote up front. Thank You Living Waters Plumbing!

reviews.author: Monica Newnam
reviews.text:
When looking for plumbers to fix an issues with my shower fixtures, I contacted no less than 3 plumbers. Out of those 3, Living Waters was the only one who contacted me back. They not only contacted me back but did so quickly. My service is already completed and I still have not heard back from any of the other companies I sent inquires to. I was impressed with their timeliness.

Jayson was so kind. He came out on a day I was working but my mother was here. He called me to update me on everything. Gave me several options and understood what I wanted and made it happen. He went above and beyond for me. I am very grateful for their quick and kind service.

reviews.author: V R.
reviews.text:
Darren came to our Nashville condo within a short time of calling him to help with slow running toilets. I'm sure he'd prefer to stay toward Murfreesboro but I'm glad he came up our way. He came fully prepared and was efficient and clean, and explained our various options. We happily brought him back two days later to replace two toilets. 

Darren is personable and helpful but wastes no time getting the job done. It's so hard to find responsive tradespeople who do quality work. Darren is all of that and more. He lives up to the "honesty and integrity" on his card and he will be who we call for any plumbing need.

reviews.author: A.L. Cody
reviews.text:
Darren is very courteous, knowledgeable and professional. He took the time to answer my questions and explained to me what steps he would take to find the leak. He was thorough and I like the fact that he took pictures and provided them with the invoice. He was referred to me and I would definitely recommend his services.

Update April 13, 2026 - I had to call Living Waters for a different issue with my washing machine.  This time I dealt with Ebert. He was just as kind and knowledgeable as Darren. If anyone has any plumbing issues, water leaks or drainage issues you should definitely give Living Waters a call.

reviews.author: Tharrel Kast
reviews.text: I have never been a customer of Living Waters, but that just changed today.  They had an appointment at my neighbor’s house this morning and he unfortunately passed away overnight.  Rather than just ring the bell and be on their way, the initial service person stayed and kept trying to call. Eventually, he was replaced by Darren, after calling the police, stayed through the afternoon and did everything he could to assist.  I know in the service industry time is quite literally money, but these folks set all of that aside to do the right thing.  Thank you for being there and taking action.

reviews.author: Laura C.
reviews.text: We had a leak in a pipe in our upstairs water heater; Darren was so courteous and patient over the phone as I explained the situation and tried everything he was recommending. He was very prompt in arriving--within an hour of my call, was able to replace the pipe and have everything back up and running in about 30 minutes, or less. When there's water spraying out of a pipe all over the floor, prompt attention is appreciated! Darren is so professional and very reasonably priced. He will be my go-to for any future plumbing needs. I highly recommend his services.

reviews.author: C D Spurlock
reviews.text: We called on a Sunday afternoon with a clogged drain issue, and our call was answered immediately. The crew was attentive to our concerns and offered suggestions until they arrived. The clogged drain was found to be more extensive than originally thought. At which point the owner rented some extra equipment, and him and his crew stayed late into the evening to fix our problem. This was at NO ADDITIONAL CHARGE. It was also 28-degree weather, windy and rainy. They were honest, dependable, and truly went ABOVE and BEYOND

reviews.author: Timothy T.
reviews.text: We had a leak from somewhere under the master bathroom. The leak was discovered in the crawl space. My wife called Living Waters Plumbing which was on a Saturday and they came out that same day. They showed up just 20 or 30 minutes later and discovered the leak really wasn't that bad and he could easily fix it. In fact he only charged us his minimum fee and was all done in no time. He also stayed and tested for a nice length of time which i was again impressed. Great company!!! They live up to their company logo.

reviews.author: Camille Boutwell
reviews.text: Darren and Jayson came out today to install a Halo whole house filtration system. I could not be more pleased. I trust Living Waters and will always use them. They are honest, ethical, professional, kind, etc. I could go on and on. Not only did they do the install but they took pictures of other issues that I need to fix from the crawlspace. Had it not have been for them I would have never known there were problems that needed addressed before it was too late. Highly recommend! 10/10

reviews.author: Patty Laury
reviews.text: Great Experience!  I made an appointment through Ragan who was very helpful, friendly and personable.  David A. came out and inspected our crawlspace and all our plumbing and we discussed any issues that may occur in the future because  we are renovating our bathroom.  He was super knowledgeable and I will definitely be calling him should any issues arise in the future.  He took photos and explained all the plumbing things and put our minds at ease.  Great company and great folks!!!
