reviews.author: Lisa Smith - Nashville Realtor
reviews.text: I called Gabe for an emergency frozen pipe burst and he came through in a pinch. Great service, communication and professionalism. Definitely will be keep him for future business and referrals. He was reliable and efficient with a smile on his face. If you're looking for a plumber in the Rutherford County area, he's your guy!

reviews.author: Andrew Pilcher
reviews.text: We were so grateful that Gabe saved us with a next day repair. He did fantastic work and was very helpful. We will be hiring him with all our future plumbing needs. Can’t recommend enough!

reviews.author: Molly
reviews.text: Gabe was wonderful to work with. Extremely honest, which is hard to come by these days.  Showed me some leaks in my cooper pipe, which I ended up replumbing my whole house.  Gabe worked extremely hard, his pricing was reasonable. I will only use him now and highly recommend him for anyone looking for an honest plumber with reasonable pricing.

reviews.author: elizabeth long
reviews.text:
Local Family Owned Business
With Outstanding Overall Service~ Autumn Snow had inquired about a Pest Control Service of which I recommended a couple different ones to her. She sent me a private message having checked out 5, and let me know who she chose and why.
In my reply to her, I had a typo so I sent a message back apologizing for my Fat Finger Syndrom.
She then responded with how it happens with her a lot then commenced to tell me about her and her husband Gabe Snow HelloPlumbing business.
Who needed a plumber? I did!
I had replaced the flush and fill valve on my toilet but still leak loosing water. The water department had notified me stating 8 gallons of water oer hour in a 24 hour period!
She relayed my contact information to Gabe and he stopped by to assess the problem at No Cost!
Gabe called me, request I text my address.
Outstanding, professional, friendly up front and honest. I needed to replace the toilet due to a cracked tank.
I bought a toilet he recommended brought it home
and he was able to come by the next day.
He installed it, hauled my old one away too. Any commercial plumber would have charged me a service call, the installation anywhere from 450.00 to 550.00.
Gabe charged 250.00,  (there is an additional 25.00 cost if you need old equipment hauled away)was done in a timely manner with an excellent job done.
I highly recommend Hello Plumbing for all your plumbing needs as well as supporting our local businesses.
Honest, Dependable, Great Pricing with Stellar Customer Service. I give A Zillion Star Rating and More!
Thank you Gabe and Autumn Snow for everything
Lizzie Long
Murfreesboro, Tennessee

reviews.author: Donna Warnack
reviews.text:
If you need a dependable & reliable plumber who actually cares about your needs then call Gabe! Don't wait!!!
Gabe Snow owner of Hello Plumbing came through for us. We have had several water leaks in some very old cold & hot main water lines that run above our ceilings. I asked for plumbing referrals on FB & Autumn Snow reached out to me & she stated that Gabe could stop by that day. We set a time, which she made that process so simple & easy, and for the estimate, Gabe arrived on time and was really knowledgeable & informative.
We liked everything that Gabe talked about, new pipes, heat wraps, etc.. & how professional he was, so we decided to go with Gabe! I'm so very thankful, appointment & time of repair was made. Gabe texted me when he was in route, and had everything he needed to do job. He was professional & nice to work with. He was friendly & kept the areas clean. The communication that we received from both Gabe & Autumn were top notch. The best part was that everything Gabe said he would do, or the cost, it was spot on, there were no surprises along the way.
Very pleased & satisfied with every bit of the process!

reviews.author: Juliet Cordova
reviews.text:
Autumn and Gabe were incredibly helpful, compassionate, knowledgeable, experienced and went out of their way to come at the last minute after a long day already. Always choose local and support small business.

Update: We needed wrap-up service and called Hello Plumbing once more. Again, we are so delighted with the expediency: they delivered service the same day; customer service was conscientious and compassionate: they see, hear and understand and send the message that customers are valued. I'm sending a totally unabashed THANK YOU to Autumn and Gabe for super-fantastic, above-and-beyond service this evening!!!!! In plumbing service and customer service, you guys EXCEL and prove time and again that your business delivery is QUALITY. Autumn and Gabe are TOP NOTCH!

reviews.author: JLL
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about Hello Plumbing.  I messaged Gabe a few weeks ago and heard back from him within an hour or so.  We schedule a time for him to come fix my sink.  He was on time, arrived with a smile, and I immediately felt comfortable with him.  We chatted a bit while he worked and he just really came off as a good guy.  He was professional and quick with no bs'ing me into buying another service I didn't need (like some of the big named companies will).  I love supporting local businesses but have been burned more than once.  I took a chance and am really glad I did.  You can feel confident in hiring Gabe.  I won't hesitate to call on him if I need a plumber again.  Again, thank you so much. 🙂

Gabe arrived to appointment on time and was very knowledgeable on what was wrong with sink drain.  He took the time to even explain to my husband what he will be doing to fix the kitchen sink.  Compared to other estimates, his price was very reasonable!!!! Job well done Gabe!!! I am so thankful and I will definitely be using HelloPlumbing for any future mishaps. Highly recommended for anyone who needs plumbing services.

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.text:

From the initial phone call to get a quote (and his opinion) on a water heater replacement I knew I had called the right company. His expertise, clear communication, and friendly demeanor really made the entire process stress-free.

The installation was flawless and his rates were significantly better than the big name plumbers in Murfreesboro. I hope HelloPlumbing sticks around in the area for good as I intend to reach out to them them for all our future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Leona Elliott
reviews.text: During an extremely busy week our kitchen sink became clogged. We contacted Hello Plumbing based on the reviews left by many customers. Gabe came within a few hours and cleared the clog. We are very happy with the expedience and with the exceptional service given. Without a doubt, Gabe does amazing work and we highly recommend Hello Plumbing for all your plumbing needs. We will call them again when a plumbing issue arises. They are efficient and their prices are a great value for the money. Thank you Hello Plumbing!

reviews.author: jeff sawyer
reviews.text: Very professional, reliable and super knowledgeable - solid and trustworthy work. Takes time to explain EVERYTHING he’s doing and if there’s anything else that needs to be done. His work and rates are excellent. No price gouging - a really good guy trying to make a living - not a killing !!! We’ve used him several times and have been more than satisfied with his work and professional approach on dealing with issues. SO relieved to have someone that trustworthy to help us with our plumbing issues. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Eddie Davis
reviews.text: I recently had an excellent experience with Gabe at HelloPlumbing. He was incredibly helpful and responsive from the moment I reached out. Not only did he arrive promptly, but he also took the time to thoroughly understand the problem and explain the solution to me in a way that was easy to understand. His professionalism and dedication to customer satisfaction were evident throughout the entire process. I highly recommend HelloPlumbing for anyone in need of reliable and knowledgeable plumbing services!

reviews.author: Tom Gilbert
reviews.text: Loved the service, cost, and response of Gabe at HelloPlumbing! We were needing an outside sillcock replaced and also wanting to add a shutoff valve to the supply line - Gabe was able to come out the next morning, arrived exactly on time, provided us a cost-effective estimate of the work and was able to complete the work quickly. reviews.author: Brenda Witten
reviews.text: We were very pleased with Richard Koontz. He was very professional and knowledgeable. Everyone at ABend is very easy to talk with and seems willing to help.

reviews.author: Philip Whitebloom
reviews.text: See the pictures below. Upon discovering that my water heater burst, I immediately called ABEND Services (5:30AM) because of my prior positive experiences with them. They answered the phone and had a technician out to my home before 8:30AM. They sized up the problem and went into action. They were meticulous in making sure all details were being addressed. Especially getting the new water heater down the stairs and they old one back up the stairs with no damage to my property. You can see in the pictures the installation very well done. They cleaned up afterwards. It was like they were never here. Don't skimp on what's important. Call the best. I did.

reviews.author: Audra Russell (Audra)
reviews.text:
I had a slow leak in my toilet that was starting to come through the kitchen ceiling—stressful to say the least! I called Abend Services and they came out the very next day. From start to finish, the experience was fantastic. Communication was clear and timely, and the technician was friendly, professional, and took the time to thoroughly explain the issue and how it would be fixed. They diagnosed the problem quickly and were completely transparent throughout the process. I truly appreciate the excellent service and peace of mind. Highly recommend!

EDITED TO ADD: they saved the day again. Our house was built in 1954, so there are bound to be things that come up. I woke up to water coming from under my stove. Called Abend at 4:37 AM and Katie answered. Richie and Mike were here a few hours later. Showed me what needed to be done and what the price would be before they started and they were done within an hour.

Abend is definitely on speed dial for this old home!

reviews.author: Margaret Henn
reviews.text: They were quick to respond and the technician was very nice.  However, they were unable to clear the clog in the sewer line.  I understood that, but they never followed up and 2 emails were sent.  They only responded to 1 of the email, otherwise they ghosted us.  We hired another local plumber who did the work needed to repair the sewer line.

reviews.author: Janine P.
reviews.text: Worst experience ever.  Did one hours work and wanted to keep a $1,500 down payment. Court ordered to pay $1,200 months ago.  Still pussy footing around.  Do not use them!

reviews.author: J “Willy” R
reviews.text:
If I could give zero stars, I would. This is by far the most unprofessional and predatory plumbing company I’ve ever dealt with.

Every plumber they sent (except the owner, more on him later) spent more time trash-talking their coworkers than actually working. That should’ve been the first red flag—if they don’t respect their own team, why would they respect customers?

They even left tools at my property and never came back for them. That about sums up their work ethic: sloppy, careless, and not worth what they charge.

Instead of investigating the issue, they jumped straight to diagnosing the most expensive repair possible. It was clear they cared more about padding the bill than fixing the problem. Their septic tank “repair” was a disaster—they used quick-rotting chains and connectors no professional would ever use, and even reused broken parts. Unsurprisingly, just 32 days later, the same problem returned. I finally called a real septic company, who fixed everything in one visit.

When I tried to get them back, they sent someone unqualified, who admitted he only installs new motors. He nearly made things worse by setting the motor on the tank floor (where it would fail again), instead of on the original block. Instead of being honest and saying “we can’t handle this,” they cut corners, did dangerous work, and charged premium prices.

When the mess finally reached the owner, I expected accountability. Instead, I got empty promises, lies about follow-ups, and no real effort to make things right. They ignored my calls, voicemails, and texts. I was patient and cordial, but they clearly had no intention of resolving the issue. The lack of integrity runs straight to the top.

From my experience, their business model is simple: push new equipment installations instead of repairs. They act like experts, but they’re pushy salespeople pretending to be plumbers. They’ll blame “incompetent” coworkers, claim everyone else uses cheap parts, and talk a big game—while doing cheap, sloppy work themselves.

Exhibit A: My house is less than 2 years old, and during a visit, the plumber called the office (the owner’s wife answered). I overheard her say, “change out the rods in the heater.” The plumber admitted I didn’t need it—the water was clean, and the heater was too new to require that. They were literally trying to sell me unnecessary work.

So why did I keep calling them over the course of a year despite the red flags? Because I believe in second chances, and they were fast to respond. But responsiveness means nothing if the work is predatory, deceptive, and incompetent. The whole bunch is rotten.

In short: they don’t fix mistakes, they cover them up. They’ll exploit emergencies, charge professional rates for unprofessional work, and then ghost you when their “repairs” fail.

Stay far, far away.

reviews.author: Charmaine Davis
reviews.text:
Abend has been a reliable company for my husband and I thus far. We recently purchased a house (early 2022) and we’ve have a few issues come up with plumbing (2 different frozen pies that bursted) and HVAC (our unit is a little older). We’ve had to make multiple calls to them for various reasons, and they are always able to get us scheduled within a couple of days. They have been the most flexible company by far and was even extremely understanding and flexible when discussing financial constraints. They could have easily turned down the job, and I truly appreciated that they didn’t. The staff are always friendly, especially John, Katie and Jessica. I feel they truly have our best interest at heart. It is important to note that despite our HVAC system being a little older, John has and always done his best to troubleshoot and find solutions to keep the system running. I’ve never felt pressured to replace the entire system and he does an amazing job answering all of my hundreds of questions. He even takes the time to educate us on the system and its issues so that we can be informed.
Additionally, we have joined their membership program which has some great perks. We get discounts on every service and it includes seasonal inspections/check ups. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Will Miron
reviews.text: This was after a heavy snowfall here in MD. We noticed a gas leak and called the fire dept. They came out, found the leak and shut off our gas. We were referred to Abend Services, and I called to hopefully get same-day service (knowing these kinds of things might take days due to high demand). Jess was amazing, told me that she will send someone here to check out the leak same day. Dustin and Joe showed up and they were professional and definitely understood our worries. They made a thorough check of all the gas lines and because it was late, capped the leak location (the stove) (thankfully the leak was not at the heating system), and turned our gas on to have heat!! we scheduled a follow-up appointment, and they said they will make sure everything is 100% before leaving. I am thankful for their time, help and concern for not having heat. Great service and definitely will use them again!

reviews.author: Krista Hernandez
reviews.text: We had a new HVAC system installed in June. At about 8:00 this morning, all the smoke alarms went off in our house simultaneously & we smelled something burning. I called the company that did the installation and, long story short, found out they were only in business for 8 months to take advantage of Empower Maryland Funds. BGE told me to call either an electrician or HVAC tech. I know ABEND from networking groups & know they do everything, and I'm so glad I called them. Jessica was so kind & compassionate. She did some digging for me & then squeezed us into the schedule so we wouldn't have to pay an emergency fee over the weekend. John came out within 3 hours, diagnosed the source of the problem quickly & explained what happened. Huge relief there was nothing actually wrong, another long story. ABEND will be my first call from now on for any home maintenance issues.

reviews.author: Jeremy Song
reviews.text:
Had a sewage emergency on Easter weekend, called the team at Abend on the day of Easter and Katie/Jessica answered within seconds with pure professionalism even during a holiday. In addition, they listened to every detail I provided, was told that they are scheduled out until Thursday but still managed to make a time window for our emergency the very next day (Monday). Justin and Joey arrived well before their time window and really took their time in looking everything before making any decisions on what to do. Furthermore, both of them were super communicative and very straight forward. They found the problem, fixed it, and in the end cleaned up all areas within the house and outside. High recommend this company and team as they are patient and very dedicated to ensuring the job is 110% done.

P.s price can’t be beat by any of these well known corporations.

- Zhen

reviews.author: Mary Lynn Kelly
reviews.text: We had a sump pump that stopped working the other day and a basement full of water. I called a 24 hour company and just got the run around. I called Abend this morning and they were at my house by 1:30. Dustin text me before he arrived and couldn't have been any nicer. He was very professional and explained everything to me and provided an estimate upfront. He took his time and even showed me the old sump pump he took out. I am so happy with the quick service and professionalism from this company. I didn't know if I was going to have it fixed by the time it rained again. I would recommend Abend to anyone who has to have any plumbing work done. Thank you again Dustin for being so nice and helping me get this fixed right away. My dog even liked Dustin and he was kind to her. So I know he is a good guy🙂. I will call them again if needed. Keep up the good work.

reviews.author: Donna Quintero
reviews.text: It seemed to be a "Mission Impossible" with my furnace fan blower motor repair. Abend techs took on the mission. Believe it or not my furnace was only 12 years old and the manufacturer's part was no longer available. With the patience of a Saint, John, did an amazing job, of searching for a compatible part. The office staff, Jessica especially became a sympathetic listener, as well as an up to date informer of status, with the holidays, times, shipping, receiving of part. I was never left in the dark. John never gave up on us having a working furnace. The estimate that was given, not knowing furnace part no longer available, was STILL the amount that was paid. No additional charge. John was a true professional. He found the part and we HAVE HEAT! ABEND, is a teamwork for satisfaction company. Truly the business to call. Many thanks.

reviews.author: John Mahaney
reviews.text: I couldn't believe how fast they were to get out for a service call and install. I had a leaky faucet and decided it was time to upgrade the whole kitchen sink along with an RO system. I tried my best to buy a system that was drop-in and fairly easy to work with aside from converting the old double basin drains to the new single basin. Within minutes of arrival they were off and on their way to knocking the job out. I couldn't say no. It really was only a few hours and the job was completed. I appreciate how fast and thorough they were. I didn't price shop since I was in need ASAP and they were the first to answer, so they win. I can't confirm or deny if I received a good deal, but it's nice to be upgraded and not have to think about the job anymore. I would call for more work in the future when needed.

reviews.author: Benita M.
reviews.text: I needed my thermostat replaced, so I reached out to Abend Services. I spoke with Jessica. She was very nice and knowledgeable. This company was refreshing. The gentleman Dustin, who replaced my thermostat, was great. He showed up on time and was very professional. What really made me decide that this would be my go-to company for any heating and plumbing problems was when Dustin asked me before he gathered his tools. Ms. Murphy. Is there anything else I can help you with before I leave? I was shocked, honestly. This is the first time a contractor seemed generally concerned about if I was okay. So I'm happy to say. I'm not worried about any more problems because I got people.

reviews.author: Adam S.
reviews.text:
Abend has impressed me with their professionalism, compassion and suburb service. I have used them several times in the past year and have only been more and more impressed. What stands out in my mind is the morning we were preparing to leave for a 10-day vacation and I just happened to go to the basement and found a water pipe had worn and was pouring water into the basement. I called and explained my situation and they could not have been more sensitive. In a matter of hours the problem was fixed and we were off to our carefree vacation. Can you find a service like this? 

I recommend Abend to everyone I know that tells me about plumbing concerns.

reviews.author: Katlin C
reviews.text: If I could give them zero stars I would. The plumber that repaired my leak flooded my lower level of my townhouse. Now it has mold and they refusing to fix it.

reviews.author: Christy Baehr
reviews.text: We couldn't be more disappointed in this terrible customer service and handling of billing and complaints.  Do not sign a contract with this company.

reviews.author: Audra Russell (Audra)
reviews.text:
We hired Caton's Plumbing to replace a single pipe connected to our boiler. Before the plumber, Chuck, arrived, our boiler was fully operational — no issues whatsoever. After he replaced the pipe, he informed us that our air scrubber was leaking. This was not the case before his visit.

When we turned on the heat the following day, none of the pipes were getting warm. We called for a second visit, and the office representative, Deborah, confirmed there would be no charge since the work was under guarantee.

When Chuck returned, he explained that flushing the boiler had sent sediment into the air scrubber, clogging it. He then insisted the scrubber had already been leaking prior to his visit and needed to be fully replaced — at our expense. To be clear: the scrubber was not leaking before he arrived. His own explanation confirmed that flushing the boiler caused the clog, yet he declined to take responsibility. He also informed us his rate was $199.80/hour, directly contradicting Deborah's assurance of no charge. Deborah later confirmed he should not have quoted us for this visit.

We paid nearly $1,000 for a pipe repair we cannot even verify was done correctly, because the boiler — which was fully functional before Chuck's first visit — still does not work.

Following this, a representative named Durrell called me to ask what happened. Rather than attempting to resolve the situation, he stated outright that he did not believe anything I told him and that he would go to bat for his plumber regardless of the circumstances. He suggested the entire issue stemmed from me "challenging Chuck's knowledge." Before we got off the phone, Durrell told me that a person named Bryan would call me right away to arrange a refund. That call never came.

The work left our boiler non-functional. A promise of no charge was contradicted by the plumber on site. A promise of a follow-up call was never honored. And when I raised these concerns, I was told I was not believed.

Based on our experience and the pattern we have since seen in other reviews, we cannot recommend Caton's Plumbing.

EDITED to respond to their reply:

Thank you for your response. A refund was issued today. However, the concerns outlined in my review stand, as the boiler was left non-functional following your plumber's visit and multiple commitments made by your office were not honored. I also want to note that your invitation to reach out is contradicted by the fact that your representative Durrell not only told me he did not believe anything I said, but instructed me never to call Caton's Plumbing again. I hope this serves as constructive feedback for how similar situations are handled in the future."

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.text:
Highly DO NOT recommend this company unless you want to be lied to about what services are included in what you pay for, even when they’re written explicitly on the invoice. I had a main line clog and when the plumber came to my house, we went through what was included in the payment of over a thousand dollars, where he explicitly wrote on the invoice before I signed ‘camera scope included.’ When I called the office to see when the person who runs the scope would come, April the office woman had the nastiest attitude, started arguing with me and rudely exclaimed that they only come to scope when the know I’m paying for the repair job. I said how do I even know what’s needed before I pay you or sign on for more services? Her response was ‘Fine you want an estimate? It’s $10,000.’ I’ve never been spoken to like that by a company I am a customer of, let alone been given a random estimate by office staff without full inspection. And again, I was told the scope was included in what I was paying for when I signed and paid the first time. Feels like they’re running some type of sales scam out of the office. When I finally spoke with the manager, we set up a time for him to come out personally to run the scope. And no surprise, he never showed up or returned my calls.
Imagine having plumbing issues, trying to get answers, getting scammed out of a service and then dealing with complete unprofessionalism and nasty people with attitudes. Read all of the negative reviews before you think about using these people.

reviews.author: K
reviews.text:
We will NEVER use Catons for anything ever again. They turned a very small pipe replacement for a few hundred to a $1200+ job by the plumber breaking a valve on my main water supply. It was working FINE before the plumber got here but "suddenly" broke while he was here messing with it. He blamed it on being "old," even though it wasn't rusty/fragile or falling apart in any way. His guilty demeanor while trying to convince me it suddenly fell apart in his hands was super suspicious to me. It gave me that strong gut feeling you get that lets you know something is off.

He also turned off a ball valve for hot water coming off of my furnace, and neglected to turn it back on when he was done...so I didn't have heat until a friend came and saw what was wrong and turned it back on. Given what happened with my out-of-the-blue water valve "magically" breaking while the plumber was using it, this makes me wonder if the furnace valve being left off was accidental- or maybe in hopes of a future service call? Either way it was very worrisome and upsetting to go without heat for a few days and thinking now something's wrong with my furnace because of the plumber's carlessness or whatever it was.

The whole experience seemed super shady, and it sure was a jackpot for Caton's to have a very small job suddenly, and conveniently for them, balloon to a MUCH more expensive one. NOT recommended, buyer beware.

reviews.author: Philip Cohen
reviews.text:
I'm a property manager and work with a lot different contractors and vendor. A big factor for me when selecting vendors is the quality of a vendors customer service. Dealing with their customer service is one of the worst experiences I have ever had. A few years back one my clients purchase a new water for their pool area from Catons. The water fountain they sold my client recently broke and when we went to file a warranty claim the manufacturer informed us that the water fountain they sold us for an outdoor use is for indoor use only and the warranty was voided. My client is now forced to spend a several thousand dollars to replace the water fountain they just installed a few years ago because Cantons sold them something not appropriate to for their use. I reached out to Cantons to inquire about why they sold my client an indoor water fountain for an outdoor location, it took them over a week to get back to the first,  where General Manager Greg Anderson provide me zero information and in a one sentence reply simply asked for photos, which I provided. Since them they have ghosted me and ignored my follow ups for several weeks.

P.S. I see you were able to respond to my google review within a few hours but yet you still haven't replied to my emails. If you really wanted the opportunity to resolve this issue you would reply back to my emails.

reviews.author: Charles Dell
reviews.text:
I would strongly advise anyone dealing with a serious plumbing issue—especially one involving insurance—to avoid Catons Plumbing at all costs.

Since December 30, 2025, I’ve been trying to get basic documentation sent to my insurance company regarding a sewage main break. Catons Plumbing has claimed—multiple times—that they’ve already sent it. Meanwhile, my insurance agent has consistently confirmed that nothing has been received. This has been an ongoing, unresolved issue for months.

At this point, it’s beyond frustrating—it’s completely unacceptable. When you’re dealing with something as serious as a sewage backup and insurance claims, you need a company that is responsive, accountable, and reliable. This has been the exact opposite.

On top of that, their pricing practices are questionable at best. They come in high, then act like they’re doing you a favor by “negotiating” the price down. It feels less like professionalism and more like a sales tactic.

Bottom line: if your situation involves insurance, documentation, or anything requiring follow-through, do yourself a favor and look elsewhere. This experience has been a complete disappointment.

reviews.author: Shusma Karki
reviews.text:
: Unprofessional Billing and Negligence - Beware of Hidden Charges
I am writing this review to warn the public about the negligence of Caton’s water restoration department and their practice of charging for work that was never done. In December, we had a bathroom leak and called Caton (having used their plumbing services before). While the water restoration work itself was fine, they billed us roughly $700 for removing, cleaning, and replacing the bathroom toilet—work they did not do. We had to hire someone else to perform this service.
When I contacted Danny to contest this charge, he said he would "talk to the technician" but subsequently stopped replying to my calls and messages. Two weeks later, after I ignored the incorrect bill, Rob called to inquire about the payment. Finally, we were able to discuss the issue, and I had to submit a formal written complaint with photos and evidence of my previous messages to Danny. An adjusted bill was finally sent in February.
Please be aware and check your invoices thoroughly. This company bills for uncompleted work and refuses to respond to inquiries. Danny is an EXTREMELY unprofessional manager.

Shusma

reviews.author: K Brooks
reviews.text:
My initial call to Catons was great.  Very friendly scheduling.  They provided me an estimated time for the plumber to arrive.

Curtis, a field supervisor, arrived a short time later to preview the issue.  He was friendly and professional.

The plumber, Jason, arrived some time after.  He was very friendly.  He assessed the issue and exhibited problem solving on the spot since the house is old and he had to figure out the best way to perform the repair. He explained what he was doing.  Jason got the job done in a very acceptable period of time and he didn't seem to mind me hanging over his shoulder.  He removed the ancient inoperable water meter which is pretty cool to look at.  I was very pleased with the service and charge.

There was some residual water on the repair the next day even after wiping, but I gave it a couple days to insure I wouldn't need to call them back.  All is very good.

Having not had to ever call a plumber, this was a great first experience.  There was a lot of anxiety on my part leading up to the repair.  The entire process is very efficient and they will let you know when the plumber is on their way.   Thanks, Catons.

reviews.author: Gregory Bret
reviews.text: The first time Caton’s came to our house was  for a main line blocage, they did great. The clog caused another pb in our basement Bathroom. They came back and unclogged it but damage a trap. When they came for a third time, they offer to change the whole sewage system (13000$). I was stubborn enough to ask for a camera inspection. It was a … trap problem(as I suspected). The camera guy locate the trap 4 foot away from where it actually was and said it would be 6000$ to fix the trap. I said legally there must be an access to the trap. He said there was none. I said no and I found the access, and 30 mins later fix the problematic trap (picture attached). I don’t understand how a professional plumbing company cannot find the access to a trap and fix ia trap. I did the reparation over the phone with a plumber from Canada!! Conclusion: good company for emergency unclogging but not for big plumbing jobs or problems that goes beyond a clog. Unless you ready to spend big $$$.

reviews.author: Stephanie Correlli
reviews.text: Henry was absolutely amazing. If I could give him 10 out of five stars, I would. First of all he came out for an estimate around 8 o’clock on a Sunday, Super Bowl Sunday no less. He was professional, kind and courteous of my home. He was very patient with his explanation of the problem and did a thorough inspection of the damage to my main line. As a single woman I felt safe with him in my house, which isn’t always the case with contractors. When he came out to do the work, he was on time which can also be rare and went above and beyond to fix the issue that he originally had diagnosed, and then fixed additional damage that he discovered. He went the extra mile and explained everything meticulously during and after the work. He did everything he could to ensure I’ll never have this issue again in the future by explaining what to do if it ever happens again. Henry doesn’t cut any corners. Give that man a raise!

reviews.author: Kristi Neidhardt (Kristi Neidhardt Team)
reviews.text: As a real estate agent in Annapolis… I am in charge of 5 properties that are unoccupied.  3 days before snowmegedon is supposed to hit (Jan 2026) I called to see if they could help usher all 5 winterized (get the water out of the pipes, drain water heaters,etc) in case power goes out and they loose heat - I didn’t want the pipes to freeze.  They got all 5 done and called when one of them had a sump pump that wasn’t working .  Had a big snow melt occurred without finding that and saying something and fixing it… that home would have had a flooded basement.  I am forever grateful that they helped us get this done and provided peace of mind for many families.  Thanks for making me look good by recommending you :). I will definitely be calling with any future plumbing needs.

synthesis.summary: When other plumbers cancel or can't solve the problem, Catons shows up same-day or late at night and actually figures it out — technicians like Henry, Ramon, and Jason are named repeatedly for diagnosing issues on the spot and explaining everything clearly.
strengths: 5 of 5 reviewers mention same-day or after-hours arrival, including one case where Catons stepped in after another company cancelled last minute
3 of 5 reviewers specifically praise technicians for solving problems others couldn't or for on-the-spot problem solving in difficult conditions (old house, late night, multi-plumber failures)
4 of 5 reviewers highlight proactive communication — calling ahead, explaining options, walking customers through pricing and next steps in real time
weaknesses: One reviewer noticed residual moisture at the repair site the day after the job and had to monitor it for two days before confirming it had resolved — minor but worth watching on pipe repairs
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Explicitly confirmed after-hours emergency response in at least 2 of 5 reviews, including one late-night kitchen leak and one late-night emergency where Catons was described as 'the only company that could immediately come' — strong signal for 2am burst-pipe scenarios.

reviews.author: Just Jason
reviews.text:
We have used Catons for several different projects and each time the service is excellent and the team we have worked with is superb. They arrive when they say they will and the projects are done with perfection.

We will continue to use them for all our needs.

reviews.author: Frank Flamish
reviews.text: I was in a very bad place with a burst pipe.  I called on a Friday evening at 5:30.  Our technician "Jason" showed up quickly and immediately had the water shut off!  He is very skilled and totally professional.... the knowledgeable not fooling around type!  In and out like 45mins 👍👍

reviews.author: Ivan Celestial
reviews.text: Excellent service from Kevontay. He was able to quickly diagnose an issue at one of our properties, develop a solution, and perform repairs in a timely manner. We definitely prefer to use Caton Plumbing in the future — especially if they send Kevontay.

reviews.author: Rj
reviews.text:
Called them for a frozen pipe that burst. Sent out a plumber who did okay work. Have to redo the pipe he replaced because it's QPVC and his replacement piping is bent putting stress back on that area. Water remediation crew didn't check my flooring which had a lot of water on it, flooring is bowing in multiple areas after they finished. The crew also damaged my flooring when setting up a plastic tarp to isolate the area. Crew also didn't clean up any of the drywall dust from demoing, only did so after I asked them to. Going to have a GC tear up the floors to look for mold since they didn't even bother to.

Edit: Changing review from 2 to 1 stars. I called Catons with my compliants and asked how they would remediate it. Supervisor Dennis I spoke with told me they could only offer to spray anti-fungal when I had someone else pull up the floor. He also said the threshold wasn't their fault as it looked, based off my pictures, that the damage was caused by the flooring they failed to remediate per the contract I signed. Haven't heard back in multiple days, going to file a complaint with the city.

reviews.author: STUDIO MANAGER
reviews.text: This was the worst service call we have ever experienced. Complete lack of communication internally between technicians and management. Customer service was running interference and was misleading at best. I spent a total of three plus hours on the phone with them over this time period. We had 8 different people out here over the course of 7 days; some just left, some gave wildly different pricing scenarios and solutions. The first plumber cut the water line to our third floor and only made the leak worse - then left. That cost $400! It was a simple fix that was needed. Catons refused to apply a promised credit to our final bill until I made a loud and angry stink about it. I do not recommend them for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: patricia murphy
reviews.text:
I came home very early on a Saturday morning after 3 weeks of business travel to water leaking from the ceiling and exhaust fan in my bathroom. I live in a condo and it was from my neighbor above. Leo from Caton Plumbing came out right away on Saturday. He was very professional, courteous, and knowledgeable about our plumbing system (we have an old building), and he identified the problem right away. Unfortunately the water had to be shut off to our entire building and that required notice to my neighbors so he couldn’t complete the repair until Monday. He made sure that my neighbor’s water was turned off in the bathroom above mine so there would be no leaks on Sunday.
He arrived Monday morning and got right to work on the repair. It required a bit of coordination with the building and draining the lines to ensure there were no additional, accidental leaks. He did a great job! He was very knowledgeable, very kind,  respectful of my home, he was as neat as he could possibly be, he worked quickly and cleaned up the area once he was finished.
They was very stressful for me - just returning home after being away and not knowing what to expect. Leo and Caton Plumbing did an excellent job and made this a quick repair, as stress-free as it could be.
Thank you!! I’ll be calling on Leo and Caton Plumbing again!

reviews.author: Laura Anzaldi
reviews.text:
Ryan came right away and saved the day!  I had a clog in a pipe leading to flooding in my basement.  He identified and removed the clog quickly.

Just editing my review.  Ryan was still great.  But he told me I would get a camera inspection done of my main line.  He said someone would call me and did not say it was time sensitive.  Some time went by (maybe a week and a half?) and I hadn't heard anything, so I called the office and they told me the scheduler would be in touch.  She did call me the next day, but I missed the call and didn't get a chance to call back until the next week.  The conversation was immediately heated -- she told me it was too late to get my drain inspected and it had to be done within 72 hours of the work.  I tried to explain that no one had called me or told me it was time sensitive.  She said she had called me last week and I took a week to call her back.  I explained that she only called me because I had called them.  She said she would look into my ticket.  I never heard back from her.

Ultimately I am disappointed in the communication and customer service re: camera inspection and that I did not get all I had paid for

reviews.author: Tyler Baranski
reviews.text:
I noticed a crack down our drywall in a bathroom that looked greatly expanded and was soft/potentially wet. We've had a lot of water damage in our house after we bought it and I couldn't risk it. After a panic search, I settled on Catons since the reviews were so positive. I called, Amber answered, she said she could have somebody out within the hour. Dave the plumber showed up and said he wasn't sure it was actual water damage, potentially just settling that had progressed. J. (Jayel? He was incredible, the field lead), called and asked for photos, and said he'd be on his way to confirm whether or not it was a leak - - with technology I didn't even know existed, very cool and fast. In less than 3 hours, I am now completely relieved.

I felt like all 3 of them were on my team roster even though this was the first experience I've had with them. Amazing. I didn't get to test out the full service since I ended up not needing plumbing repairs, but I am grateful and would absolutely call again.

reviews.author: kelly Ekeno
reviews.text: I'm blown away by the exceptional service I received from Brandon and Jacob at Catons Plumbing! They were prompt, professional, and courteous throughout the entire process. Brandon was knowledgeable and thorough in his assessment, while Jacob was skilled and efficient in completing the repairs. Their communication was top-notch, and they kept me informed every step of the way. I highly recommend Catons Plumbing and specifically Brandon and Jacob for any plumbing needs/ clean up mitigation. 5 stars isn't enough - I'd give them 10 stars if I could! 😊👍. Family oriented team.

reviews.author: James Woolfrey
reviews.text: Henry was amazing and the utmost professional.  His willingness to do whatever it took to complete the job to perfection was impressive.  Part of what he had to do was go under the house in the crawl space.  This was not something pleasant, but Henry did not hesitate and always kept a smike on his face throughout his visit.  I manage people for a living and this young man is a "ROCK STAR".  Catons should be proud.  I know when I need plumbing services again, I will be calling Catons and asking for Henry!  Job well done and my thanks to sending Henry!

reviews.author: Zoe Watson
reviews.text: The plumber Noe was very respectful,  knowledgeable,  professional, and very patient with me. He explained the process and answer every question I had. Usually im very tense when I have a stranger in my home, with Noe,  I felt very comfortable. He also  fix my toilet leak in no time. He patiently waited to make  sure the toilet was working properly before he left. Thank  you so much Noe. Thanks to your company  also for having such a great employee. I will refer your company to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Robert pierpont
reviews.text: There was a water main break on my street, on Tuesday night. Caton plumbing was used by Richardson Mews. They came on Wednesday to fix the water main break of course it’s drizzling, so that makes for fun work conditions. They worked all night, water was turned on at 3:30 in the morning. When I left for work this morning I saw all the trucks still here. I was unaware that they slept in their trucks so they could finish the job. I’m very thankful that they worked nonstop until the main was fixed!

reviews.author: Pamela Morris
reviews.text: Water mitigation & cleanup was done by Brandon & Assistant. Brandon was Amazing and did  Great job. He explained the process, respected me and my property.  He went above & beyond with assiting me with insurance requirements & follow up.  He stayed on top of pack out, insurance requests, and keeping me updated. I hope I never these services again, but if I do, Brandon & Caton will be the ones I call. I will also tell family and friends of the Great job they did. Thank you Brandon and Caton!!

reviews.author: Mitchell McGuinness
reviews.text: We had a sewage back up in our home basement. We called Caton as I had recalled a prior good experience with them. They came same day and didn’t charge for the call. Amazing! Ramon, the plumber, was very helpful in explaining the situation. He used a long snake which ended up being somewhat expensive. However, That service included a follow up visit, where a pipe camera was used. It revealed a clog in our very old cast iron pipes.

reviews.author: Ali Crawford
reviews.text:
From the initial call to completion of service, the entire process was seamless. The technician was prompt, professional, and highly knowledgeable. He diagnosed the problem immediately, and within time it was fully resolved. This was truly one of the most efficient and reassuring service experiences we've had. We couldn't have asked for more.

assessed the issue and provided an effective solution with courtesy and confidence.

synthesis.summary: They'll show up fast for a burst pipe emergency, but the 1-star reviews describe a company that can leave your home in worse shape than they found it — with no accountability afterward.
strengths: 2 of 5 reviewers specifically praise fast emergency response, with one burst-pipe call answered on a Friday evening and water shut off within minutes of arrival
Individual technicians like Jason and Kevontay receive strong personal praise for skill and professionalism, suggesting quality varies significantly by who shows up
Long-term customers report consistent on-time arrivals and quality results across multiple projects
weaknesses: Post-repair follow-through is a serious problem: one reviewer had to redo pipe work, was left with bowing floors and drywall dust, and got no meaningful resolution after complaining directly to a supervisor

Pricing and billing are chaotic under pressure: one job saw 8 technicians in 7 days with wildly different price quotes, a $400 charge for work that made the problem worse, and a promised credit that required a loud argument to receive
redFlags: 2 of 5 reviews describe botched emergency repairs that left the home in worse condition — bent piping under stress, unaddressed water damage, and floors now suspected of concealing mold

Management communication breakdown documented in 2 separate reviews: one describes a supervisor denying responsibility for documented damage, another describes technicians giving contradictory solutions over 7 days with no internal coordination
1 reviewer filed a formal city complaint after getting no response from management — an extreme escalation that signals the dispute resolution process may be entirely ineffective
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Clear emergency capability signals: responded to a Friday evening burst pipe call, dispatched quickly, and shut off water within minutes — but complex emergency jobs with remediation work have resulted in serious unresolved damage.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Google shows 4.7 stars across 575 reviews, which is dramatically inconsistent with the 1-star nightmare scenarios in recent reviews — suggesting either a review moderation gap, a vocal satisfied majority, or a company that has declined in quality recently.

reviews.author: Kristi Carney
reviews.text: GTX Plumbing was AMAZING! They came out so quickly to help us with plumbing issues and provided outstanding service. Their team is always incredibly prompt, professional, and a pleasure to work with. We truly appreciate how fast and efficient they were — highly recommend GTX Plumbing to anyone in Georgetown!

reviews.author: Lahari
reviews.text: Five stars!!!! We had a burst spigot during the freeze, and they were absolute lifesavers. They actually FaceTimed with us yesterday to assess the damage and give us peace of mind when no one else could make it out. Then, they braved the icy roads today to complete the repair. Professional, kind, and incredibly helpful.

reviews.author: Jimmy Voyles
reviews.text: Very impressed with professionalism and installation quality of our Gemline KDC filtration system.  Thank you Christopher and Cesar!

reviews.author: Lance M.
reviews.text:
I called and spoke to someone about our home plumbing issue about a month ago. I was told that the call would be forwarded to the master plumber and I would receive a call back.

I never received any call back so I can't attest to their service. However, there should've been some common courtesy to follow up.

 I ended up using another company with stellar results.

reviews.author: Lavanya Ag
reviews.text: I’m very disappointed with this company’s service. The technician intentionally spent over an hour before pointing out a very small issue. They charge $55 just for visiting, $170 per hour to “diagnose,” and then wanted to add even more hourly charges ($225). It feels like they deliberately stretch out the time to increase the bill rather than fixing the problem efficiently. The value of service compared to the amount charged is not fair, and customers should be cautious about the way they operate.

reviews.author: Elle C.
reviews.text: I can't say enough good about Lloyd with GTX. Over Memorial Day weekend, a pipe in our attic developed a leak. Despite our best effort, many hours, and multiple trips to Lowe's, Home Depot, and ACE, we couldn't fix the issue. We did all we could to make it through the holiday to avoid premium prices, and I went to the plumbing supply house in Round Rock on Tuesday morning to see if I could find the fittings we needed. Thanks to some helpful plumbers there, I found out the problem: we have Kitec, which requires exorbitantly expensive adapter fittings to repair. I got the fittings needed and began calling around to everyone in Georgetown with a 4+ rating. No one could get us seen til maybe Thursday, but, once I told the lady at GTX that I had the fittings and just needed someone to install them, she told me she could get the master plumber to call me back that evening. Sure enough he did! We spoke on the phone for a while, where I explained the issue, then he had me send pics of the fittings and we FaceTimed so he could see/make sure we had the right installation tools. He very thoroughly explained the order of installation and sent links or photos of exactly the few fittings and items I still needed from Home Depot, and Lloyd told me if I had the fittings and I could find someone to go up into the attic for me, I didn't need to pay him to do it for me. Sure enough! I went and bought about $15 more worth of supplies at Home Depot, where I was even able to text him while in store for a product clarification. That night, my bro in law had no problem assembling the pieces just like Lloyd said and then cutting out our temp fix to install the new fitting. It went as smooth as Lloyd said it would, and it didn't cost me a dime of his time! I asked Lloyd if I could pay him for his consultation time or make a donation to a charity of his choosing in his name and he said no, keep the money, just call me when you *actually* need me and tell your friends. So here we are. Lloyd is a wonderful and wonderfully helpful person, and I will absolutely be calling him when things go truly sideways!

reviews.author: Bob F.
reviews.text: Great company & will be using them for any plumbing need moving forward. Was dealing with issues with my water heater and was able to talk to someone the same day to trouble shoot what was going on and get all the quotes I needed. I ended up holding off and got the issue fixed for a few days and then was having a different issue and called back to just move forward with a total replacement. They got me my final quote and were able to get me on the schedule for a couple days later which worked great. When they got here they realized that the water heater was actually short and not tall like they had thought based on the pictures I provided. I found out that it was an extra $200 for the right water heater, but they said they would cover the cost based on the quote they had provided and would honor that price. I have called so many times and talked to so many people that I felt bad, so I was able to add a little bit more to help, but all and all they were going to keep me from owing $200 more than I had budgeted for. The guys who came to do the install were very friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. They took the time to answer all the questions I had and to make sure they had everything that I needed to enjoy having hot water again. 5/5 stars! Great company & felt they were very honest. Call these guys first before calling anyone else.

reviews.author: Lorin A Martin
reviews.text: Where to even begin! My husband and I were opening our own business and ended up having to GC the project ourselves. As you can imagine, it was an overwhelming, daunting experience that was filled with fear that we would be taken advantage of. What a complete opposite experience did we have once we found GTX plumbing! From the moment I reached out to them, Sharon and Llyod went ABOVE AND BEYOND for us! Most companies will not work with owners who GC their projects themselves, but GTX Plumbing is clearly not most companies. It was obvious by their reviews that they were great people with good hearts and that is why I reached out to them. Throughout our construction project, there were many times when things came up and we needed something right away. Sharon would always make sure to adjust the schedule to squeeze us in that same day and make sure the guys came out to help us right away. Truly an unmatched level of customer service that is so rare to find today! All of there guys that came to the job site were courteous, professional, and kind. I cannot thank them enough for looking out for us, for taking care of us and truly just being wonderful people that we will have in our life forever! You cannot go wrong with GTX plumbing and they will be our plumbers for life!

reviews.author: David G.
reviews.text: I would like to thank the folks at GTX Plumbing.  I had a water leak at my house in Georgetown Texas tonight.  My tenants called me to let me know what the issue was but was having a hard time trying to explain to me the exact problem.  They were also having a problem getting the water shut off by the water heater where the leak was.  I contacted my home warranty and they were telling me it would be 4 hours before anyone could even let me know when a plumber could come out.  So I called GTX and told them I would like to have them on standby in case my home warranty could not get out tonight.  Sharon told me to have my tenant call them and she would have them talk with one of their master plumbers.  In short, my tenant called them and spoke with the owner.  The owner walked my tenant through how to get the water turned off and diagnose the problem over the phone.  They did this all free of charge.  I can't begin to tell you how amazed and happy I was for Sharon and the owner to offer help like this.  If I ever need to use a plumber, I am definitely calling GTX.  Words really can't describe how impressed and appreciative of their service and generosity.

reviews.author: Rose B.
reviews.text:
WOW! Fixed our flooding issue with a phone call. 

Our showers, toilets & bathtubs on the first floor were all backing up and starting to flood. The owner, Sharon, answered the phone & kept our house from flooding by telling me to open the overflow in the front yard. 

Lloyd, master plumber, called a few minutes later kept the repair at no cost by having us check the second overflow by the street. When the second overflow was also full of toilet paper he told us we could call the city as it was 'past the city tap' and the city would take care of it. City came out within an hour and fixed it. 

The many many other plumbing companies I reached out to or called while in a panic either didn't answer or told us nothing to keep the flooding from happening while telling us they have to see who they can get to come out. 

So so so grateful for GTX Plumbing keeping our house from flooding & making a seemingly huge issue to us he just a small blip in our already overloaded lives.  Thank you again!! Prayerfully we won't need them again but if we do they will be the ones we call!!

reviews.author: Nickole Sharpe
reviews.text:
Called this morning and spoke to Sharon---first of all, you can just hear her smile over the phone. She's a joy to speak to. Love when you can call a company and hear the smile through the phone. I had a situation where I had a water leak and got a pretty hefty bill from the city of Jonah. I contacted them to make an appointment for someone to come out and check things out. However, Sharon wanted me to just run my story by a technician first and said one would call me today. A few hours later I receive a call [I'm so sorry IDK why i'm blanking on your name now]. He was so kind and asked me questions and advised me on what possibly could be going on and gave me some tips and tricks to figure it out. Even though I didn't technically have them service my home yet. Just the callback is amazing. It's truly so hard to find companies when they say they will call you back, actually call you back.
So on that alone and the amazing and such friendly service, I'm giving them 10 stars, but it only allows me 5.

Thank you so much!
Nickole Sarles-Sharpe

reviews.author: TRS
reviews.text:
We had a pex Fitting go bad and it flooded our house. Contacted GTX plumbing and they were on it as quick as they could get here. Once it was fixed, the water did not flow like it should and the owner FaceTime to me and we got it fixed as some of the insulation evidently got down in the piping when they did the repair and it had plugged up the aerator

Imagine, an owner calls you at 8 o’clock at night on FaceTime and walk you through checking things to get things fixed

We have used them a number of times and they have always been great. After our leak, we’ve decided to put in one of those Moen Water controls that sense if your water is flowing when it shouldn’t be etc., and it automatically turns the water off to your house or you can turn it off via application on your phone. If you don’t have one yet, you better get one cause it would’ve saved us thousands of dollars and we have put one on. So guess what we’re putting one on today and GTX plumbing is doing it. Good job GTX

reviews.author: Jon M.
reviews.text:
What a nice experience with a great company. Very friendly, knowledgeable and trustworthy. The plumber called and tried to solve the problem over the phone but I needed hands on help. Jeff was incredible!!!
He showed up on time, very friendly, knowledgeable and eager to help. He worked tirelessly with his helper to get my problem solved. These are real plumbers, not salesman. They only wanted to solve my problem and make me happy. This is by far the best interaction I've had with any company in Texas. Sharron who answered the phone was so nice. They got me an appointment when I was available with a break in my schedule.
Jeff gave me several tips on how to keep my pipes and appliances working smoothly with some simple maintenance. He even adjusted my water heater and showed me how to flush the hot water tank.
I will always recommend GTX Plumbing to my friends and family. Way to go GTX!!!!!

reviews.author: V V.
reviews.text: First time using GTX Plumbing. They came out today to check a pressure issue as well as to replace the flapper on a toilet. Immediately after the techs (Trent, and we didn't catch the other gentleman's name, but both were very courteous and professional) completed the job, we left the premises, and when we returned we realized the toilet was running. I called GTX, and explained that it was running and that the flapper installed wasn't the correct fit. I sent a photo and video, and it turns out this toilet is a bit atypical and uses a specific type of flap. They sent someone back before the end of the business day (Cameron, very nice and professional), and the issue was resolved. We also received a follow-up call from the owner. All in all, every team member of GTX we dealt with was great. We will definitely call them for future issues, and I'd highly recommend them.

reviews.author: TRS
reviews.text: We have used them prior to them changing names and nothing has changed. The service is excellent and we haven’t had a signal issue both in getting them to respond or with any of their repair repairs. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Kim Stout
reviews.text: Quick response time and excellent customer service from the two young men that provided same day Service.  We trust you guys and have been thankful for your service over the years.

reviews.author: Robert Weston
reviews.text: Zack came out and found the problem the last tenants left for us to deal with.  Great service and I highly recommend this company. Service is great, customer service ladies are awesome and quick to respond. Can’t say enough about these folks.

reviews.author: John C.
reviews.text: Horrible experience with this company on a tankless water heater. Water heater stopped working correctly. We called Neighborhood Plumbing, they charged us over $200 to work on it, said the problem was air in the lines and it was fixed. That didn't make much sense, but if it was fixed then OK. Worth $200 to have hot water for the dishes. But it was not fixed. Called them back that evening. The guy came back the next day, but spent the whole time on the phone with the manufacturer. He clearly did not know what he was doing on a tankless hot water heater. He charged us another almost $400 for his time talking to the manufacturer and told us that we needed to spend another $750 (on top of the $600 he already charged) to fix it this time (after he said it was fixed the day before). So they wanted over $1350 to fix a unit (that they had said was fixed) that cost less than $1000 one year ago. No longer had any faith in them so called a reputable company recommended by Rinnai. Should have done that in the first place. They needed only 15 minutes to test the unit and recommend not wasting our money trying to fix it. They only charged me to replace it. No call to the manufacturer needed--it was clear he understood tankless hot water heaters, had the right equipment, etc. Neighborhood Plumbing may be OK for regular plumbing, but do not use for a tankless hot water heater.

reviews.author: John R.
reviews.text:
Poor follow up, did not want to review concerns about the work required. And supervisor was unwilling to speak with me about the concerns. 
I would not recommend them!

Supervisor now trying to say I fell through cracks. He was in office when I called and I heard him refuse to speak with me!

He is deflecting.

reviews.author: Peace X.
reviews.text:
I had their plumber come out last time to connect the refrigerator with the ice-maker that was inside the cabinet. I told him to completely replace the old ice-maker valve with it's frame and purchased new valve. He gave me an estimate of approximately $500.00 and I thought it was very expensive but I agreed as long as the work will be done properly. He rescheduled to get the materials for the job. He came out the following week and all he did was connect the refrigerator with the same old valve. I have no idea why they had to cut off the water source from the house. All they had to do is move the refrigerator for a distance not more than 12 ft, which is not bad because it's easy to push it. I pushed it myself out of the cabinet after they left to clean behind it. Yet, they emptied my groceries from inside the fridge in a dirty box that I had left in the room! Before they left, I thought he replaced the valve inside the cabinet because the box of the new valve from HomeDepot was open. 
I paid around $500 to him thinking he did what I asked, and I got busy cleaning the grocery before I place them back in the fridge. I was about to throw away the box of the new valve and noticed that the new valve is still inside it and checked the cabinet to see that the old dirty valve wasn't replaced. I felt cheated for paying $500 and called them immediately, he called me back and said he can't replace the valve because he has to tear down the wall and the cabinet all around it! I wasn't convinced and insisted that I need this old valve to be replaced per our agreement. He claimed that the old valve seems like new and was never used when I know for a fact that it was used for over 10 years. In any case, he said he will come back next day to try and see if he can replace it. He came the next morning to repeat what he told me over the phone and that the old one is a better quality than the one I purchased. I asked him if the $500 is just to connect the refrigerator with the ice maker through a hose!!!! It's a job that shouldn't take over an hour!! I could've done that myself, it's not that hard to find a hose with the right fitting!!! I felt he underestimated me by claiming he had to get the right supplies and do the work. To me this is a joke, yes I'm a woman but that doesn't mean I'm clueless when it comes to plumbing work. 
So in conclusion, I paid approx. $500 for connecting the refrigerator with the ice-maker through a hose. A lawyer or a doctor don't even charge this much money per hour! My cousin with some plumbing experience came for a visit two weeks ago and was able to replace the valve with it's frame without tearing the wall and the cabinet. I later called Neighborhood plumbing to get a refund 5 days ago and I'm still waiting. I'm willing to give them back whatever they supplied me, including the hose that is too long inside my cabinet and I replaced it anyway with shorter hose.

reviews.author: Brian G.
reviews.text:
Our water pressure was very low. I contacted a company with the most recommendations on Nextdoor. The guy they sent was creepy! No shirt or tag or anything to identify him. It took him 30 seconds to check and confirm the low pressure and with no notes or calculator he came up with $725 for a new valve and something next to valve that wasn't broken but they get repaired as a set. And if I didn't use them then I owed $165 for the service call which I was never told about when I set the appointment. 

I contacted Neighborhood Plumbing and Drain next but I wish I had first! The next day Karl showed up and I was immediately comfortable. No creepy factor! He gave me his business card and was just a nice guy. There was no fee for him to come out and the quote was free! And that mystery piece "next to the valve" was fine and Karl said 90% of the time they are and there is no need to replace it. Honesty! Wow, what a concept!! Karl did the work quickly and my pressure problem was fixed for $200 less! Karl is trustworthy with 20 years of experience and I will definitely use him again in the future.

Additionally I never heard back from the first company. No follow up to see how I wanted to proceed and as of now no bill for the service call which is good because I'm not going to pay it!

reviews.author: Rocio H.
reviews.text:
I called them because one of my water heaters stopped working. I saw the good reviews and spoke to a very nice lady over the phone. She worked with me to schedule appointment and Eric came by as promised. Very nice and courteous man. He did a quick hand- eye inspection and explain to me that he needed to run some tests to figure exactly what the problem was. Most likely, everything they needed to do or perhaps replace the heater entirely, sounded very expensive. I ended up looking at testing fees, processing fees, code upgrades and new heather estimate for $ 1,863.00 or so. I told him I would keep hunting and call back if I decide to their services. I called Blue Dragon who has a lot of great reviews on Yelp but he was booked for two weeks ahead. However, he referred me to Jessie's Plumbers and Fabian and Jessie came over and very promptly and professionally fixed my heather for a great reasonable price. They also guaranteed their work. 
I can't review Neighborhood pluming based on their work itself but those fees are just to high for my budget.

reviews.author: Boomer Anderson
reviews.text:
To replace my water heater, I made the mistake of calling another company first. Those people seemed more like used-car salesmen than plumbers. I got a very slimy vibe and realized they were not the kind of people I wanted in my life, let alone my garage. So I sent them packing and did what I should've done in the first place - I called Lauren at Neighborhood Plumbing.

The difference in personalities was amazing. Lauren was straightforward and fun, with no B.S. I explained I just wanted a water heater, with no upsells or fancy bells & whistles. She respected that and got a crew out in less than 24 hours.

The guys (sorry, I'm spacing on their names) were friendly and professional and, of special importance to me, they weren't pushy at all. They finished the install in just under an hour (for real) and charged a reasonable price.

I can't imagine hiring a plumber I don't like or can't trust. So I've already made my choice about who I'll call next time I have plumbing issues - Neighborhood Plumbing!

reviews.author: John L.
reviews.text:
I've used Neighborhood Plumbing and Drain several times, but the last two times Alan has worked in my house I felt fleeced.  Expect a high cost just for this plumber to show up and even when a problem is not resolved.  Perhaps it's just me looking like a fat catch of the day, I'm not sure, but I was angry enough today to finally state something in writing in a somewhat negative review.  Ask for costs up front and if you can accept them then fine, but for me to have him look at my dishwasher for a few minutes and tell me it needs replacing and I end up out a good portion of the cost of that replacement, should be a warning to all.

I've had work done right in the past by Alan and at a price that I perceived as fair (when I knew the work was intensive and warranted) and things were fixed or installed, but somewhere along the way it seems to me that the cost of business has skyrocketed and so I can not leave a positive review, but I won't give only a 1 star either.

reviews.author: Tyler M.
reviews.text:
Our main water pipe was leaking just after the meter, so the water company turned off the water, but since it was on our side of the meter, it was our responsibility.  It was 6pm and I called Neighborhood Plumbing.  It was after hours and they asked if we could go until the next morning - which we could.  So FIRST THING the next morning Eric shows up, provides a reasonable quote, and completes the work in about 90 minutes.  He came in and flushed the entire house, while his partner cleaned up outside.  I can say with confidence that they cleaned up both their work AND the mess I made digging to figure out where the pipe was leaking.  

Prompt, precise, up-front quotes, and professional work leaving the area nicer than when they arrived.  What more could I ask?

reviews.author: Lee A.
reviews.text: After calling Neighborhood Plumbing, within an hour Robert came to our house to evaluate as to why our kitchen sink was not draining.  First of all, Robert was extremely polite and explained how he will try to clear the line  using the least amount of effort using his first line equipment but explaining, if that doesn't work, he may have to use more heavy duty equipment and it may  take more time.  He worked hard and fast and, after multiple times of using larger rodding equipment and checking to see that the water flowed past the out-take pipe outside from our kitchen sink, he succeeded!  It was an hour's worth of work and minimal amount of cost to us.  We are extremely pleased with Neighborhood Plumbing, especially Robert, and recommend this business highly!

reviews.author: Menno E.
reviews.text: I had detected a leak days ago and called several plumbing companies, who were either too busy and/or would not return calls.  I came across Neighborhood Plumbing and Drain on the Yelp, and called them to see if they could come by.  The person on the phone was courteous, and called back promptly to let me know someone was available the same day.  Allan Wood showed up an hour later, had already detected the leak, and carefully dug a hole in the landscaped area where the leak was.  In three hours, he completely repaired the leak, and restored the landscaping to its (almost) original condition.  Rarely do I experience such courteous, professional service, but this company should definitely get your business!!

reviews.author: Jami Y.
reviews.text:
Awesome customer service at Neighborhood Plumbing. We've been using them since 2016 and have had nothing but wonderful experiences. (Shout out to Alan, who is the tech we typically see.)

This week was hell for Texans, with many needing emergency plumbing. Neighborhood got us on the list to come out within 48 hours. We ended up being able to fix the pipe ourselves and no longer needed the appointment, but Neighborhood was generous enough to allow our neighbors to take the appointment who were worse off than us. Alan fixed their issue yesterday afternoon and, after a week without water, they were finally able to shower!

Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sam C.
reviews.text: Horrible!!! Had them come to one of my rentals where they (fixed) the shower that I wasn't getting hot water from just to have them come back 3months later to look at because it still want getting hot enough.he then went to check my water heater that somehow started to leak after they left and wasnt getting hot water in the whole house! came back the next day to look at the water heater that they charged me $350 to fix even though it was working just fine till he touched it and then he gave me a estimate of $1300 to replace my upstairs shower valve that casa mechanical  is doing for $700 and a better job !!!! What a big joke
