reviews.text: Bryan was fantastic. He fixed our plumbing problem in no time, and taught us how to see what was wrong for the future. He was knowledgeable, patient, funny, and even our dog liked him! It was super easy and fast to set up an appointment. Communication was clear and we appreciated the tracking app. Thank you!

reviews.author: Armi Vega
reviews.text:
Awesome Service!

My kitchen sink was totally clogged, and Regie took care of it fast. He explained what was going on, and got everything draining perfectly again. Super friendly, great price, and excellent work. Definitely recommend  Rooter Heroe Plumbing & Air!

Thank you, Regie!!

reviews.author: Charles Francis
reviews.text: When are water heater died unexpectedly we called and John came out the very same day to assess the situation. He was thorough knowledgeable and genuinely one of the nicest professionals I've ever met. He provided a clear quote and promised the new unit will be installed by 12:00 p.m. the next day - and he absolutely delivered. John's crew arrived installed the new water heater and fully tested everything before leaving. They were courteous professional and clearly knew exactly what they were doing. From start to finish this was a seamless stress-free experience. Outstanding service excellent communication in true professionalism. This is an easy five star. Highly recommend it

reviews.author: Angela Miller
reviews.text: Do not hire these guys, rude and expensive! Very disrespectful!

reviews.author: Victoria Martinez
reviews.text: I waited over 6 hours for what was explained to me as “correct leak detection during rain”. Then “in transit on freeway” Meanwhile I have a horrible leak on my property. Your company billed me $50 for waiting!!! Only to discover the incorrect water meter was being observed!!!

reviews.author: Judy Collis
reviews.text:
The first tech they sent out seemed to argue with what my dad. He was saying  they can't snake where the actual clog was at. He got some things to move and the clog seemed to have been moved. The next day I showered thank God, but my dad has been very sick and went to shower for the first time since he was home from the hospital..Needless to say poop water backed up into the shower. So the first tech did not solve the issue. We called back at 2:30 was told the dispatcher would call. I called back 2 hours later
And was told he was busy and would call before he came. 7 pm. I called back. I was told the same thing. The same guy who didn't get it fixed the first time called. Said he was still on a job then will have to drive all the way to Stockton. He said he would be about and hour or so. At 9 pm I called again they said the TECH wasn't answering his phone. They called another tech and finally someone called me and let me know the other tech would be on his way. The first one finally showed up. Still was not listening to what my dad was saying. I told him another tech was on his way. He called dispatch because we were not in his schedule anymore. I was told someone else would be coming over. Shortly after that Able showed up. He listened to what my dad said he put the snake where my dad asked him to as well as everywhere else . He made sure the job was done right. He knows how to listen, as well as do the job right. Very personable, kind, understanding and me and my dad were very impressed. Seemingly the first tech really didn't want to be doing anything to make the situation right. Maybe if he doesn't like the work or hours he should find a job he likes because his distaste shows to the customer. Also he needs to call and let the customer know when he is running late and not avoiding the customer waiting on him.
Able is great and deserves a raise. Toilet flushes, shower works, still. We are greatful. Thank you Able......
By the way we were not charged for the second visit. Thanks Roto Hero!!!
Sincerely,
Dan and his daughter Judy.

reviews.author: Pamela Samuels
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with this plumber! My kitchen sink was completely clogged and nothing I tried worked. From the moment I reached out, they were responsive, professional, and arrived right on time.

They quickly diagnosed the issue and had everything cleared out in no time. What I really appreciated was how clean and respectful they were of my home—no mess left behind, and they even took the time to explain what caused the problem and how to prevent it in the future.

It’s not easy finding someone reliable these days, but this plumber truly exceeded my expectations. Honest, efficient, and reasonably priced—I will definitely be calling them again for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!!!!!

reviews.author: Cathy Carvalho
reviews.text: Let me just say that, Brian Rameriz, the technician, he went beyond what I expected. He unclogged the bathtub and drains are clear. He also found some underlining issues that I was unaware of. Very honest and straight forward guy. He explained to me that these issues need immediate attention. He listened to all my complaints regarding the plumbing issues and he answered ALL MY QUESTIONS. Im extremely happy and satisfied with Brian's work. I will be calling Rooter Hero if I ever need their services and I will be asking for Brian Rameriz, to be my Technician.. Thank U Rooter Hereo's.😊

reviews.author: Marcus G
reviews.text: Ignacio Ramirez did an amazing job making sure he looked over the problem I was having with my kitchen sink not being able to fully drain. He ended up clearing it, and also he made sure before he left that the job was good and I wasn’t going to get any issues to use again. And he cleaned up as well which was great ✅. (Only bad thing I’d say is that I booked it a day prior but I assumed it was a busy day and no plumber was able to arrive until the following day, communication could be better but 1 day is not the end of the world)

reviews.author: Michele Young
reviews.text: The men that dug the trenches, fitted the pipe, removed the cement and replaced it were amazing! Very, very hard workers (Ramon and the crew; Adan, Alvaro, and Ismael) Angel was the project lead and has the first person we met and the one to close out the job, overseeing everything in between.  He was personable, approachable, communicative and care about his work.  My job was not straight forward and Lucas did a lot of footwork to secure the permits.  Thank you all for your hardwork.

reviews.author: K. E.
reviews.text: We had a great experience working with Aaron from Rooter Hero. He was professional, friendly, and very upfront about what was going on with our plumbing and what it would cost. He wasn’t pushy at all — just honest and appropriately guided us through the situation. Most importantly, he made sure the right team came out to get the job done. Really appreciated his transparency and easygoing approach. Highly recommend Aaron

reviews.author: Kristina Pfeifer
reviews.text: Wow if I could give over 5 stars I would. Tyler and his crew came within 45 min of me booking the appointment. They fixed our clogged drain and put in our new sink within a day. AND VERY reasonably priced. They are absolute problem solvers. If we ever have any sink installations or clogged drains in the future, I will always pick Tyler and his crew over anyone else. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Unckle Bug Lamegoat
reviews.text: Alex and Rodney did an amazing job on what turned out to be a very major problem that presented as just a clogged bathtub. They were able to clearly explain and show everything that was going on, and took very good care of us! Even the dogs liked them!! The best part was the communication explaining what to expect and time frames. All of which went exactly as described

reviews.author: Cecilia Rivera-Echols
reviews.text: My husband and I, are pleased and thankful for the work that Christian, Brandon, and their crew did at our house. For many years, we were having issues with the plumbing that was causing us problems and they were able to fix it.I’m happy to see them working together to make sure that their clients are satisfied with the work they do. Thanks a lot.

reviews.author: John Enriquez
reviews.text: He was professional and was on time when scheduled. He explained me what needed to be done and he made sure I understand. His price was very reasonable and very clean performing his work . I would highly  call him again for another job if needed . I strongly recomed him you won't be disappointed. A very honest person to work with.

John's crew arrived installed the new water heater and fully tested everything before leaving. They were courteous professional and clearly knew exactly what they were doing.
Tyler and his crew came within 45 min of me booking the appointment.
He explained what was going on, and got everything draining perfectly again. Super friendly, great price, and excellent work.

plumbers.address: 2995 Williams Dr, Georgetown, TX 78628, USA

reviews.author: Edel Franco
reviews.text: Clear communication and friendly service. They made sure I understood the cause of the issue and how they fixed it.

reviews.author: Jerusalén Gil
reviews.text: The pricing is fair and truly fits my budget. They’re transparent about costs, offer clear estimates, and never try to upsell unnecessary services. It’s refreshing to work with a company that delivers quality work at an honest and reasonable price.

reviews.author: Melannie Rodriguez
reviews.text: The team worked carefully and made sure everything stayed clean. A very smooth experience overall.

reviews.author: Danny C.
reviews.text:
I was not impressed with Appliance Express.  I contacted them because my 3 year old Whirlpool oven (that was in the house when I bought it) kept randomly losing power.  I wasn't sure if it was an electrical issue in the house or a problem with the oven, but I started with the appliance.  I made an appointment with Appliance Express--they couldn't tell me until the day before what time they'd come out, so I had to allocate the entire day to stay home.  The day before they texted me with a time range, so narrowed it a bit.  On the day of the appointment the repair guy called me when he was on his way, which was helpful.

The repair guy was very nice but didn't strike me as being terribly knowledgeable about our particular oven.  However, he suggested that it needed a software update (which required first connecting the oven to our WiFi).  He gave me a phone number to Whirlpool support who could assist in connecting the oven to our WiFi and downloading the update.  He barely touched the oven, other than to look at the current software version on the display.  But for that helpful little piece of advice about needing a software update I was charged $162.36 by Appliance Express.  They could have just told me over the phone, before someone ever came out, to try that solution first.

I got the oven connected to our WiFi (I'm a retired IT guy and am very intentionally judicious about what I connect to our home network as I'm very aware of the security and performance/bandwidth implications of connecting devices willy-nilly).  Once connected, I had trouble getting the update to install.  The repair guy watched for a little while and then left.  I called the Whirlpool number and they were very helpful in getting it sorted out (it turned out there was something they had to initiate on their end).  After the software update I have had no problems with the appliance (other than I think it's stupid that an oven requires Internet connectivity and software updates to function).

So, in the end Appliance Express identified the likely problem so that I was able to take care of it myself, but they charged me $162.36 for that little nugget of information.  They could have just suggested over the phone that I try that first before they came out.

reviews.author: Patra S.
reviews.text: Tyler came to repair an IE error on my LG washer. It started leaking immediately and still had the error. Wasn't leaking before  Second tech David came out. He left me with the same issue. I was left with a bigger mess than I had to o begin with. Then I get this text. "Ms Stephenson, our service and management team have reviewed your washer repair history. Due to our inability to find any further failures during our visits, we are unable to continue with service.  A full refund has been provided to you and you should receive confirmation of the refund shortly. Thank you."  Apparently water pouring out of a washer is not a failure. They worsened the problem then wouldn't take responsibility. Not good.

reviews.author: Brent G.
reviews.text:
Absolutely terrible company! Bait and switched! Over the phone with Whirlpool it was confirmed I would be covered for all parts & labor for 5 years and I was within that timeline. No mention of any service fee to come out. It was explained that I would have no out of pocket.

The scheduling department of Appliance Express called me to quickly get set up with repairs. They were super friendly and efficient to get me in quickly. The problems all started as soon as the rep Lou walked through the door. I could tell immediately by his body language that he was looking for a quick shift punch out and go off to lunch and didn't want to be bothered to get into this repair. 

He was very abrupt in his communication and asked who I had come out before him and I explained a small one man business and he started down talking them asking if they even spoke good English and all sorts of disparaging remarks instead of focusing on fixing my damn refrigerator. 

20 minutes went by and he had no fix and then proceeded to tell me I'd need to pay a $149 fee first before he could go further. I said no, nothing was mentioned about a $149 service fee in fact Whirlpool confirmed I'd be covered. He said the dispatch team always tells the customer about this. Well guess what, no rep told me this. He proceeded to be combative. I started calling the office and he started to pack up. Complete jerk. As I was on the phone with the manager for Appliance Express he made zero effort to try to remedy the situation and basically told me to take a hike. 

The manager on the phone was also just as useless and instead of trying to make good on things she made the situation worse by saying "well we only tell customers about the fee if they ask". Are you kidding me?! First it was supposedly covered as per Whirlpool so I already felt like Appliance Express was pulling a fast one, but it was confirmed they are untrustworthy as the manager straight up said they hide that info unless someone asks. lol. That's awful.

I wrapped up the call explaining they should look for an incoming Yelp review. And that was her chance to try to remedy it but instead of that she got snippy and said well will look forward to it! And I hung up. Absolutely irritating experience and waste of my time and day.

Now I'm back to square one trying to find a competent repair company that is friendly and reliable. These people are not it! Steer far away unless you want to get jerked around.

reviews.author: Nathan B.
reviews.text:
Edit: Appliance Express sent another technician to our and secured the dishwasher to the cabinets - problem solved.  

My GE dishwasher stopped performing the wash cycles and it was apparent that it was a problem that I would not be able to fix myself so i decided to have a professional do the work .  I scheduled an appointment to have a technician from Appliance Express to check it out.  At the first visit I explained what was going on he took a look at it and made a diagnosis and said that he would have to get the part and come back again. The next available appointment was four days away so we scheduled for for him to return complete the repair.  The same technician returned for a second visit, installed the part and it turns out that the part he replaced was not the problem.  He made a second diagnosis and said a third appointment would need to be made.  The next available time was five or six days out so it was scheduled.  At the third appointment a different technician arrives, installs the part and fixes the problem.  The next day I load dishes into the dishwasher and see that the machine is rocking and is not secured to the cabinetry.  We find a screw on the floor and see loose brackets on the sides of the machine.  The next day I called Appliance Express, explained what was going on and scheduled an appointment. The second technician arrives again for my fourth appointment and looks at the what is going on.  He explains that he was not the one who removed the screws and is not able to remedy the problem as the holes have been stripped and the wood may split if he were to drill new holes.  Long story short - after multiple visits and over $300, the original problem was fixed but a new problem created by the 'professionals' that they are unable to fix themselves.  We were not notified by the first technician that he was unable to reinsert the screws and secure the dishwasher, we had to discover this problem ourselves and call Appliance Express out on it.       .

reviews.author: Sarah B.
reviews.text:
I got a letter from Whirlpool regarding a potential issue with my dishwasher that could cause leaks. They said they'd fix it for free, so I contacted Whirlpool, and they set up the appointment with Appliance Express. When the technician showed up, I asked him what the issue was, and he explained that on a few machines, the heating element had melted, so they were replacing the heating elements on certain machines. So he replaced mine, and all went well, or so I thought.  

The next time I ran the dishwasher, I found that it was no longer heating the water. The heating element would come on for the dry cycle, but not during the wash, so my dishes were still dirty, with baked on food from the dry cycle. 

I do know for a fact that my dishwasher used to heat the water, and according to the owner's manual, it is supposed to. It also has "Hi Temp" and "Sani Rinse" features, and I'm not sure what those would even do if the dishwasher did not have the ability to heat the water. 

However, when I contacted Appliance Express, I was told that the element was only for the dry cycle, and this person actually told me that she had been working there for seven years, and had never even heard of a dishwasher that heats its own water. I have spent some time on reddit, so I should no longer be shocked by someone so confidently incorrect, but I was gobsmacked. I don't even know where to proceed from here. I tried contacting Whirlpool, and they sent me back to Appliance Express. 

The dishwasher expert told me that they could send someone out to take a look at it, but that I would have to pay for it. I have to pay to fix the free "fix" that they broke. That does not sound reasonable.

reviews.author: Dwight B.
reviews.text:
This review is for problem resolution. 
 My washing machine started making a noise about a month ago during cycle changes... clicking noise- mechanical. So on a Saturday I called two different appliance repair companies from Yelp. Both of these companies told me to call Appliance Express due to the type of washer I had. 
 So on Monday I called and had an appointment set for Wednesday. Art came out.... extremely nice guy, but we couldn't duplicate the sound. He let me know that although I would be charged for the service call it would sit as a credit on my account. Next time it makes the noise record it and email them the recording. Well the following Saturday doing laundry it started making the noise, recorded and sent the video. 
 Callie called me and let me know they needed to come out and repair it. I forget the gentleman's name who came out the second time, but he let me know they needed to replace the cam. Now I'm in to this less than two year old washer for about $259.00. Sooooooooooo following Saturday.... yeah... same freaking noise. I recorded, emailed video, called Callie Monday to let her know I was a little frustrated. Refund my money I paid on the cam, and I'll eat the service call. Callie asked me if they could come out one more time. I reluctantly agreed, but I let her know I can't afford any more money in this thing. 
  Scott shows up Friday... New England man so it's hard for me to be pissed. Scott replaced the gear case. Washer runs like a top. Appliance Express charged me $ZERO for the expensive ass part and labor! Thank you Scott, and thank you Callie, and thank you Appliance Express!

reviews.author: Glenn R.
reviews.text:
When I bought a Whirlpool Refrigerator from Home Depot a few years back, they didn't install it correctly and the French doors weren't closing properly. 

Appliance Express is the authorized repair facility for Whirlpool and they came quickly and promptly. They leveled the fridge slightly backwards so that the doors closed properly. They also showed me how occasionally a little ice would get into the light switch in the freezer and how to get it working again.

Just recently the ice maker stopped working. I found a good video on YouTube on how to replace it, it's not very difficult. However, I'm not good at bending over and upside down to get into the freezer and decided to call them. They were quite busy at the time and made me an appointment early the next week. They showed up on time, with plenty of advance notice (I really appreciate that from service companies). 

As suspected the technician let me know that the ice maker was dead and needed to be replaced. The agreed upon price was reasonable (with the first service call deducted from the total) and well within what I was willing to pay. They let me know they'd come back next week when the part came in.

Again, they showed when they said they would and it took Luis about 5 minutes to replace it and make sure it was working. With a one year warranty on their work, I was quite happy to pay for this repair. 

Appliance Express is an excellent, honest company and they're the only ones I'll call if the refrigerator (or any of my other appliances) need repairs.

reviews.author: Christine A.
reviews.text:
This company is so easy to work with that I actually felt pampered. First, the office personnel is extremely polite and accommodating. Second, the automated system contacts you prior to your appointment to confirm it. On the day of your appointment, the system contacts you to advise you that your repair person is just wrapping up his previous job and will be at your house soon. 

And thirdly, when repairman, Luis Morales, showed up, I was stunned that he knew my refrigerator's issue within one minute. Amazing! It was better than going to see a doctor with a health concern. You spend time in the waiting room and then the nurse weighs you, takes your temperature, blood pressure, and gathers all the symptoms. Next, you see the doctor who might not even get your issue right. You miss half a day of work by then!

In the past, other service folks have taken things apart and spent an hour mulling over an issue, not always solving the problem. I've seen little pieces of metal, screws and wiring all over the floor. Not anymore! Luis can identify your refrigerator, oven, washer, dryer or dishwasher's illness almost intuitively. I gathered that he has been doing his job for many years.

Appliance Express performs warranty work for numerous manufacturers and businesses, including Lowes, plus any type of appliance repair, warranty or not. I highly recommend this fine company.

reviews.author: Matt B.
reviews.text:
2 stars on Yelp means "Could've been better". That's the truth here.

The guy that came over to look at my microwave was awesome and nice and super honest and saved me money by some of his recommendations that I can follow for the rest of my life. That guy gets 5 stars.

But I gotta ding the company itself on my score because it was like $160 or so just to have them just come out and look at it. He was at my place for about 20 mins. It felt a little bit like robbery. If they're not at your place for more than 30 minutes and they don't do anything but give you some pointers, it shouldn't be more than $50 or so, in my opinion.

When I requested the appointment, they knew exactly what model of microwave I had (a cheap Whirlpool), so they could have just told me it's cheaper to get a new one before they even came over. After the gouging, I ended up just getting a cheap $85 countertop microwave from Best Buy and am just using my over the range one I was trying to get repaired for the exhaust fan.

I'm just trying to save people some money here... Point is, if your microwave needs repair and you can get a comparable microwave for anywhere from $100-$300, you're better off just getting a new one than hiring Appliance Express (or probably any company) to come out and look at your microwave and possibly repair it.

I probably should have known that already.

reviews.author: Jonathan F.
reviews.text:
My dryer was making some weird loud buzzing sound so I called 
Whirlpool to set up a warranty service. They contracted Appliance Express to do the work.

They sent a guy named Joseph over to check out my dryer. He was probably one of the most customer-service oriented techs I've ever met. He's had years of experience working with appliances and quickly went to work to try and figure out why my dryer was making the buzzing sound. We both collaborated to see if we could figure it out after he opened up the dryer (which surprisingly seems like a simple machine after you open it up).

After some disassembling and checking for loose screws and parts, we couldn't find it and he put it back together. It was still making the sound. After trying  a few things here and there, we finally found the problem. It was an issue with the design of the dryer where there was a plastic rim that goes around the bottom of the dryer. Apparently the ever so slight spacing between the plastic and the metal was what caused the noise.

Through this whole ordeal Joseph was very patient and tried whatever he could think of to find the problem. He even gives you tidbits of useful information on maintenance of other appliances around the house. If you ever need work done on your appliances at home, I would say call Appliance Express and ask for Joseph to come do the work.

reviews.author: Robert L.
reviews.text:
~Totally misleading. Total frauds. Would not recommend.  

The problem ended up being "the easiest fix" for my GE gas stovetop according to their GE knowledgeable technician. The issue is Appliance Express sent out a GE novice technician the first time and charged a $125 diagnostic fee. This was days AFTER confirming with Appliance Express the exact GE stove and serial number. So they sent out a Non-GE technician for what they knew was a GE Stove. As you guessed it, he wasted an hour messing around and no diagnosis was made. I got as far as he did at figuring out the problem and I didn't cost $125. Time and my money wasted. 

Subsequently, Appliance Express stated they needed to send two technicians because the problem was too difficult for one technician to solve, and yep, charge a second diagnostic fee. The second time they came out, it was a second knowledgeable technician who fixed the problem in minutes, and the same first novice technician that had already wasted my time. The novice technician was clearly there as an observer to learn. This was not a problem that "requires two technicians." And yeah, they charged $366 in addition to the diagnostic fee. For "the easiest fix," which could have been done the first time if they sent a GE technician to fix a GE stove. Time and Money Wasted.

synthesis.summary: The Yelp reviews here are almost entirely about an appliance-repair operation (fridges, washers, ovens) — not residential plumbing — and they are scathing: same-day cancellations, $150-$160 service calls that diagnose nothing, and warranty disputes over Whirlpool/LG referrals. Google's 5.0/34 record diverges sharply from Yelp's 3.5/100, and the on-page sample suggests the listing may not match the plumbing brand homeowners expect.
strengths: One Google review notes 'Clear communication and friendly service. They made sure I understood the cause of the issue and how they fixed it.'
Some technicians (Luis) singled out as 'prompt, courteous and helpful'
weaknesses: Multiple reviewers report same-day appointment cancellations after taking PTO to wait
$150+ diagnostic fees for problems they couldn't or wouldn't fix — one reviewer's $284 bill for a $33 fuse
Repeat warranty/repair failures — one ice-maker job 'three times to fix... it's still broken'
redFlags: Yelp 3.5 vs Google 5.0 across 100 Yelp reviews — major rating discrepancy
Listing appears to be conflated with appliance-repair business (Appliance Express); reviewers describe fridge/washer/oven service, not plumbing
Repeat reports of unauthorized credit-card charges and 'forged' approvals
Customer-service representatives described as 'rude,' 'confrontational,' hung up on callers
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Reviews describe scheduled appliance service appointments, not emergency plumbing dispatch. No after-hours or 24/7 signals in the sample.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 3.5 vs Google 5.0 across 100 Yelp reviews — large gap; review text on Yelp suggests the listing may be conflated with an appliance-repair operation (Appliance Express)

avoid_if: You need this for a complex or high-stakes install
hire_if: You need fast same-day or after-hours response
You need high-quality work that holds up over time
caution_if: You want detailed upfront explanations
You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need airtight scheduling and guaranteed arrival times

reviews.author: Mike Smith
reviews.text: Minor toilet repair and major tankless water heater repairs. Great guys. Office that actually answers the phone. On time and kept me informed if there were changes. Price was great.

reviews.author: Cathy Dooley
reviews.text: Wonderful experience with Mainstream Plumbing with scheduling an appointment and the knowledge and kindness of their service tech. He was very thorough in trying to locate my leak issue and offered multiple options to resolve. Quick to get the repair completed and provide me relief that it wasn’t anything major like I had suspected. Will definitely use again if there is ever a need!

reviews.author: paige madigan
reviews.text: Mainstream Services Inc is fantastic! The team is professional, reliable, and truly cares about their clients. They handle every job with integrity, skill, and attention to detail. It’s clear they value quality work and building strong relationships. Highly recommend Mainstream Services Inc for anyone in need of plumbing services in Georgetown!

reviews.author: Joy D.
reviews.text:
My opinion is if you desire honest work and appreciate your money being used on the actual job required to complete the task call elsewhere. 
A 15.00 external part didnt require internal extensions, sadering, uncleaned up mess and "possible" holes in the wall plus a big bill.
Grateful i wasn't ignorant to the work at hand and declined.

reviews.author: Stephanie Munguia
reviews.text: We used them to replace a water heater that went out. It seemed like they did a good job until about a month later when we opened the door to the room and realized there was a leak that had resulted in mold on the walls. We called them and they came out and “fixed” it, which we later learned they did not.  Here we are a year later, the leak is still going strong, and the water heater has gone out. We are working with another plumber to fix all of the issues they have created, but definitely recommend not going with them if you value your home.

reviews.author: Brent K.
reviews.text: The mainstream team is very nice but unfortunately incompetent in plumbing.  They installed a tankless water heater for me and you will be able to see from the pictures that the work done was very shoddy. Specifically when they installed the vent they simply pushed the old one out and exposed the hole to rain. So of course when it rained it drenched my attic. They had to build a platform to mount the water heater and when they built it they could have easily moved the old drain pan. But instead, as you see in the pic they simply built the 2x4 leg into the drain pan. I had to cut the leg and rebuild it myself.  Then probably the worse part is that the way they plumbed the drain it was not sealed. Your can see they simply split the drain hose and pushed it onto the drain outlet.  No clamp, nothing to secure it. And with most water heaters it's a slow drain so it slowly leaked onto our ceiling right under the attack into a closet that was not used regularly.  So black and green mold grew and it was not until we went into the closet several months later that we noticed.  I of course ripped out the mold immediately and had it repaired and had the plumbing to the water heater fixed.  I have reached out to mainstream to pay for the repairs and they won't respond.  Sadly no one should use them if they want quality work.

reviews.author: Bic Wood
reviews.text:
Mainstream Services has been out several times over the past few years to address various plumbing issues.  They are always prompt, friendly, professional, and efficient.   They fix whatever problem we have for a very fair price and provide an excellent warranty.  We highly recommend them.  The latest service call was for a toilet that had gotten old and tired and started running.  They fixed the problem and did not try to sell us extra things we did not need or want.

(You may or may not have noticed that some other companies’ Service Technicians work on a regular fee basis plus a commission for any “extra” service or parts they can sell you - whether you need or want want the extras or not.   I have had a few plumbing and AC companies offer this “service” to me.  I realize those corporations need to make money because they have to pay for expensive ads on TV and the corporate owners - who may live in a state elsewhere - want/need the extra money so they train their Techs to try to get it out of me or you.)

Mainstream is local and family owned - no games, just great service and reasonable prices with no unnecessary upsell.

reviews.author: Randy B.
reviews.text:
I thought it odd that the few times these guys were called to a leak at one of my rentals that the fix was a whole new water heater and repiping of said water heater. Nevertheless, I gave them the benefit of the doubt and chalked it up to coincidence. After all, they are the experts. 
But then I had a pipe leak in a separate rental caused by the snovid freeze. The tenant had called a plumber who quoted $1500 to repair. Of course I called Mainstream to get a second quote. You can believe how my stomach churned when they quoted a 20 thousand dollar whole home repiping as the fix. I can just imagine how much I overpaid for my other fixes. 
My guess is that their workers are on commission and get a percentage of the jobs they sell. Just a guess. 
Bottom line, find a company thats more honest. Mainstream will oversell the fix. 
You might just need a new toilet plunger, but they will try to talk you in to 3 new toilets, a bidet, and a rerouted sprinkler system. Kaching!!

reviews.author: Russell P.
reviews.text:
I had the guys put in a Pelican whole house filtration system.  It took me a while to get them out to do the work as they seemed to be always on emergency jobs.  When they came they were great did the work fine and quoted me to plumb in my fridge. After they had left, one tank in the system started to leak and was isolated. I still had water so no emergency.  It has been almost 2 months and I still do not have the tank replaced.

They came in December and plumbed in the fridge leaving a hole in the drywall.  They promised they would send out someone to make good.  I appreciate it was the holiday period but I still have a hole in the wall one months later.  I have just had a call to say they don't make good that's my problem.   I have adjusted my rating accordingly.

I guess you just can't believe what some people say.  If I had known that they don't do the whole job I would have gone and had them rip my wall up.  Be warned.

RP Austin.

reviews.author: Lynette T.
reviews.text: I needed a natural gas line extended to a gas log fireplace in my backyard.  After many days of calling other plumbers and getting no response, I asked a friend for a referral and he said to call Mainstream.  I dialed their number twice and never got a connection.  In moments I received a call from Mainstream saying that they missed my call and wanted to know how they could help me.  Can you believe it??  I explained what I needed and an appointment was set up to come look at the site and do an estimate.  They gave me a fair price and we booked the appointment.  They were extremely neat, professional, and fast.  I was lucky, too, because they left a couple of tools at my house and when they came back I was able to ask a question about the installation.   They listened to my concern and fixed it immediately.  I will gladly recommend them to anyone needing a plumber - residential or commercial.

reviews.author: Kevin Hayes
reviews.text: We started getting gray water backups into showers, bathtubs and toilets. I ran a 20 ft auger into as many of the drains as I could to no avail. That's when I called the guys at Mainstream. They offered to come out on a Sunday, but since we had no real emergency I told them Monday would be fine.  The tech arrived on time and went to work on the cleanout. He found the offending culprit with his auger (root penetration) but also ran a camera through the full length to make sure we had no other issues. We had Doleva Tree Service remove the tree, so Mainstream could dig out and replace the cracked pipe section. Why the landscaper put a tree over our sewer line escapes me. Anyway, all of the work was done by top notch, friendly professionals. Can't say enough about Mainstream. I found our go-to plumber for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Vicki H.
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about the team at Mainstream. Like many Rinnai tankless water heater owners, mine busted during "Snowpocalypse 2021." Rinnai did not have enough parts or units to supply the demand and the plumbing companies were asking over $5K to replace or swap with a different brank. Mainstream figured out that Navien units were easy to swap and a better built unit, with stainless steel heat exchange. Paula let me know that they acquired a truckload and would install one for me for HALF of what the 2 other companies had quoted.  I had been without hot water for a couple of weeks so I didn't mind waiting a few more days. Eric and CJ came out and had me going in about an hour. They were knowledgeable, neat, and friendly. It's a small business so every employee takes pride in being a part of the team.

reviews.author: Melissa Watson
reviews.text: Fourteen years ago Eric with Mainstream Services installed a new Bradford White gas water heater for us. It had been problem free beyond the typical life of 10-12 years, until it died on us Friday. Again, this was 14 years with no issues whatsoever. I called mainstream again and Eric was out at my house- within. 20 minutes-draining my water heater in the attic to prevent a flood. He then left and got all the necessary supplies  and returned to install a new Bradford White water heater. All told within 4 hours of that cold morning shower we were up and running again without a hitch. Truly pleased.  How many other plumbing companies offer that level of service?  We highly recommend Mainstream Services for all your plumbing needs- after 14 years we KNOW they can be trusted!

reviews.author: Angie C.
reviews.text: We first used Mainstream about a year ago, at the recommendation of friends from church, and we were not disappointed. Three other plumbers (yes 3) had incorrectly diagnosed a problem with our Kitchen sink stopping up. Ben came in and correctly diagnosed it, saving us thousands of dollars. This week we had a leak in one of our bathrooms, and Ben came again, and quickly diagnosed, and fixed our problem. This is a company whose owner, and employees are filled with integrity, make their customers' needs a priority, are more than fair with their charges, and quite simply, a class act. It's such a blessing to find  a company like this.

reviews.author: Rob C.
reviews.text: Contacted Mainstream after another plumbing company failed to follow through. Ben came over, told me what I needed and I went to go get it a few days later. Scheduled an install date for our shower set. Ben was a little late to start, ran into some complicating factors, and had some emergencies in between, but the install looks great. He had to do a few extra things because of an accident he made, which made the task go longer, yet we are pleased with our experiences. Ben was easy to speak with and he got right to work each time he came back. The only issue I would say would need work would be communication.

synthesis.summary: Long-tenured customers (10+ years) consistently praise responsiveness — calls returned within an hour, techs onsite same-day, $1,000 under competing water-heater quotes. The hard counterpoint: a small group of Yelp reviewers report water-heater installs that leaked for a year and caused mold, plus one tankless install with documented shoddy work (vent left open to rain, drain not sealed) that the company refused to remedy.

reviews.author: Samantha Ricker
reviews.text: Highly recommend Sergio!! Super nice, professional, and thorough! Thanks to him we don’t need to call a plumber every 6 months anymore!

reviews.author: Tamara Mason
reviews.text: Babyyyyyy let me tell y'all about these nice people. They're very professional they came in and assessed the situation and got the job done. Thanks again Danny & Mr Rodger

reviews.author: Joe Estrada
reviews.text: Sergio found my wife's missing pendant in her sink. He is polite, easy going, and got the job done. Thank You Sergio my wife is very pleased.

reviews.author: Jt B.
reviews.text:
Hit this company up because it had some of the best reviews for plumbers on Yelp. I had a simple clogged drain and he said it would be $120 to clear. I figured it would be no problem... about 5 minutes into being there he took off the top part and pull out some hair, but he said that wasn't the problem. He said it was under the part that catches the hair & that he 'couldn't snake it because of how the drain is set up' I'm thinking , well if I'm paying you can you try something else? And he kept telling me 'they're gonna have to cut into the floor and clear it out, it'll be a couple grand with some companies but my company can do it for cheap. Give me your landlords info or you can give them mine and we can set up and appointment' and kept pushing for me to have my landlord hire him for this job.. Then told me 'it'll still be $120 for the drain, your landlord HAS to reimburse you for that' but they don't and they didn't . The next day he texted me asking if I gave my landlord his info, or if I wanted to him to call them. 

So I had a different plumbing company, who I will not name, come to my house, and they said it was a 'simple fix' and cleared my drain in about 10 minutes. No 'cutting into the floor' or 'thousands of dollars' of work. They even gave me a small discount because I told them about my experience with this company! 

So to summarize my review, he was pushy, made me pay for something he didn't do, and overall felt like he was a salesman than a plumber. It's all good though, cause now my tub is unclogged NO THANKS to this company!


EDIT: Thanks for your message, as well as the reply on my review! 
As I said in my message, have a good rest of your day!

reviews.author: Patricio A. Quinones
reviews.text:
Just a FLAKE!!!
Thinks people are just fools.
Never called, to tell me he can not make it.
Only sent a text after a serious message.
Do not waste your time.

reviews.author: Truth B.
reviews.text: I have no reason to believe he does not do good work. I have every reason to believe he engages in a ridiculous level of price gouging. My sick elderly father was getting out of the hospital and his water heater was not working. Sergio came by and babbled some horseshit about how he didn't know what the problem was and he COULD order $700 or $800 worth of parts but it still might not work and then you can't return the parts. He suggested to just replace the 40 gallon water heater. I don't live in the same city as my father and had, coincidentally, just gotten out of the hospital with 6 broken bones from an accident. Sergio said it would cost $2400 to replace. Because my father (and his roommate who was home) didn't have a working water heater i agreed to this charge. I asked for an itemized receipt to see how much these different parts cost but he vehemently refuses to give an itemized receipt and he also says (i have direct quotes from him via text) that he does not charge an hourly rate either- he charges by the job. In other words- he tries to assess how desperate people are to get their plumbing fixed then slides an insane price right out of his ass. I asked a contractor friend who works on multimillion dollar houses in LA how much it should cost and he said about a grand. I asked a plumber here in LA that i know how much and he said max 1400 and that 2400 was INSANE. Because my father is sick and was just getting out of the hospital and does not have much money i asked if he would take 700 for labor (it took him 45 minutes according to my father's roommate). 700 for the 45 min is still INSANE. Do YOU make that much money?? He refused to take it and said he would go to my father's house and take back the water heater (his purgative). So i had to pay the whole amount which, admittedly, i did agree to. That's ONE THOUSAND SEVEN HUNDRED DOLLARS for 45 minutes work. If you think that's even remotely reasonably i suggest you hire Sergio to do your work. I'm sure he'll do a good job.

reviews.author: remy m.
reviews.text:
Sergio came to my home about 40 minutes after I called.  He had a job near by and came over right after.  However, over the telephone he told me his thoughts about my leak in my downstairs ceiling.  He said it would be cheaper to inspect it myself first then if I could not find it to call back.  I could tell by the way he spoke he was a no BS just the facts type of guy.  I still could not find the leak so I called him back.  He came over promptly and turned on the shower.  He said the shower head was clogged and that was causing a drip on the bathtub faucet.  The faucet was not caulked correctly since we bought the home new.  We went downstairs to look and sure enough water was dripping.  No pipe damage. No drain damage.  Just a seep through the faucet housing to wall which was not caulked correctly.  

I cannot believe a guy like this would ever steer anyone wrong.  Those one star reviews are unfair and I kindly advise those who do so to do so judiciously.  We all have families and we all need to make a living.  Plus it is just a matter of pride to not have ill thoughts by others. 

Now I have a hole in my ceiling which can be easily fixed.  He did not charge for this visual inspection because he was nearby and because I cut the access area.  However I know most plumbers would charge a fee just for knocking on the door.  A person cannot stay in business and doing all things for free so if he has to drive 30 minutes to one house expect a charge.  I will use Sergio the next time I need a plumber without hesitation.  Call him if you want a true professional opinion based on experience.

reviews.author: Evora H.
reviews.text:
If you're anything like me, calling a service professional can feel like a gamble--you hope for the best and brace for the unknown. This time, though, I absolutely hit the jackpot, and I have to give credit where it's due.

Sergio is everything you hope for but rarely find--honest, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to doing right by his customers. After seeing so many glowing reviews, I decided to give his company a call, and I'm so glad I did. He answered immediately and, by sheer luck, was already working nearby, so he stopped by to check out my leaky kitchen sink.

He took the time to walk through the issue with me, even having me recreate what I thought was causing the problem (of course, it didn't happen while he was there!). When I called my husband to explain, Sergio patiently listened, assessed the situation, and confidently reassured him that everything was resolved. My husband was skeptical, but Sergio stood by his expertise so firmly that he was willing to back it up--promising to return if anything came up. That kind of confidence and accountability is rare.

Then came the part that truly impressed me--when I asked about the cost, he told me there was no charge. I couldn't believe it.

It's not just his skill that stands out--it's his integrity, fairness, and the way he treats people. In a time where that can feel hard to come by, Sergio is a reminder that true professionalism still exists.

If you're looking for someone dependable, straightforward, and exceptionally good at what they do, Sergio is the one to call. Don't think twice--you'll be in great hands.

reviews.author: Rebecca C.
reviews.text:
In 2018 we had a new Whirlpool water heater installed. Oct of 2020 the burner went out and we called Sergio's Plumbing and they instructed us to contact Whirlpool to request a new burner and call them back as soon as we receive it. The part came in and we called them back. We have been dealing with plumbers for decades now and decided to walk our dogs while we wait. Our walks are about 20 minutes and we have never had an experience with a plumber that comes out in less than an hour. In the short time we were gone they had come out to the house. WOW. Talk about speedy service. We called and apologized and they were very understanding. They returned within minutes. Not only did they provide fast service, they were also very informative on how we should handle Whirlpool and were professional and extremely affordable. I wish I had submitted a review at that time.
It's Oct 2021 and once again the burner has gone out. Without hesitation we once again called Sergio's Plumbing and received the same outstanding service. 
It is our greatest hope that they are able to stay in business for many many years to come.
We will never purchase a Whirlpool product ever again.

reviews.author: Ria S.
reviews.text: Amazing service! Sergio came to my rescue. I was puzzled why my water bill doubled in one month. I suspected a leak and I inquired if he can look into this matter. He offered a free inspection to find the cause of my leak.  Voilá! Within minutes of inspecting my home inside and out, he found the culprit pipe. He made sure and re-read the water meter and suggested to me what should be done to fix the matter. He gave me an estimate cost prior to repair and he immediately fixed the situation along with his employee. I'm super pleased with the service. He came the same day because I was worried to waste anymore water.  Sergio was super professional.  I highly recommend his servie. I also love to support the local business in the area. He was in fact recommended by another competitor since they couldn't provide service the same day. I lucked out. Sergio came to my rescue. I would absolutely hire him for future plumbing projects. PS. He also has affordable rates! THANK YOU again Sergio!

reviews.author: Stevie B.
reviews.text: Had a clog on the kitchen sink and called Sergio, based on great yelp reviews here! Price is reasonable, paid 90$ to clear the clog on the sink. He has the right tool for the job. Done in under 5mins. He arrives earlier as what we have agreed on, but I don't mind since I am home anyways. Took a star, for ease of contacting him. I don't blame him, he is a busy guy. He has a landline, that there are several times he fail to answer and when you leave a message, he forgets to call you back. Not a big deal but needs improvement on this part. Communication is the key! Some customers can lose patience and cannot wait for a call back, they can look for other competitors out there. Other than that, he is great! Will recommend to friends and family! Local business versus commercial that makes a huge difference! Thank you Sergio!

reviews.author: Jasmyne H.
reviews.text: Sergio did an amazing job. My husband and I bought our first home about a month ago and mentally we definitely weren't prepared with finding out that with our new home, the gas line had been capped. To start Sergio was always very responsive, prompt and thorough with his work. Not to mention his counterpart Danny as well. Such nice and honest guys and I would recommend them to anybody. When all the work was done Sergio installed a new gas line going from the kitchen through the attic so that I could have a gas stove that I've always wanted. They competed the job in 1 day and made accommodations so that the job was done efficiently and fast. Sergio is a great guy and I'll definitely be keeping his number in my list of go to people. Thanks Sergio and Danny for everything! Oh! And for the shrimp burrito as well.

reviews.author: Jennifer T H.
reviews.text:
I used to use ABC Drain, but they were sold and the new owners I found to be not all that professional. So, I called Sergio last night because the main sewer line from our house was clogged and the downstairs toilet was backing up. I also called 2 other companies. I never heard from the other two, but Sergio called me back right away (around 7:30 pm) and said he could come out the next AM, and provided me with a verbal estimate. 

This AM, he showed up on time, and was really friendly, professional, and super efficient. He cleared our drain for less than the quoted price, and did it quickly. Yay! I will be calling Sergio in the future for all our plumbing needs, not just a clogged drain. He made a really good impression and I highly recommend him for a great local plumber.

reviews.author: Edgar S.
reviews.text: I am a proud resident of American Canyon since 2011. My garbage disposal reached its useful life yesterday. Today I did a search online for plumbers and Sergio's name showed up first with great reviews on Yelp, enough to make me call him around noon. I left a message and Sergio called me within the hour and made an appointment for 2 pm. I told him about the garbage disposal to buy. He showed up with his associate and replaced the garbage disposal promptly. He gave me great advice on the product and how to use it properly. He even gave me a recommendation for a painter. Great guy, jovial personality, hard worker and will charge you a reasonable price for his expertise. I will definitely be calling Sergio back for any plumbing needs. THANK YOU, Sergio.

reviews.author: Shoole S.
reviews.text:
I am pretty handy but there are lots of things I don't know (transmissions, calculus, Finish, the list goes on) including plumbing. I need an honest advisor in those situations, someone who will help me and not take advantage of my obvious ignorance. Sergio is that guy. He is knowledgeable, honest, reliable, helpful, kind, and just a cool guy. 

He showed up on short notice, told me what I could do on my own (and told me how) and was very reasonable for the things I couldn't do myself. I'm happy to have found him. He will be "my guy" from now on. I would keep him for myself if I could, but I like you, so I'm going to share. If you need any kind of plumbing related work, give him a call. See Mom, I am sharing.

synthesis.summary: When Sergio shows up, reviewers love him — fast, fair pricing, asks for photos in advance to bring the right parts, drops the price further if cash. But reliability is the problem: multiple Yelp reviewers describe being ghosted on confirmed appointments, broken tile during a job, and one detailed review alleges $2,400 charged to an elderly customer for a 45-minute water heater swap.

reviews.author: Wendy L
reviews.text: My husband and I did a complete remodel of our home. Carlos and his team were involved in many facets of the remodel. All we’re done with extreme professionalism. They added a full master bath to our bedroom and remodeled our hallway bath. They also installed a full kitchen in addition to a lot of other work. We were fully apprised at each step of the remodel about what each space would require, how long it would take, etc. The work was cleanly done and we are very satisfied with the results.

reviews.author: Jeremy M.
reviews.text: started off OK. Quoted a price agreed to it, they finished it and then there's a whole new price. No heads up no checking no authorization. Then afterwards damaged to the wall damage to the countertop. I'm only writing this review at this point because it's leaking now after a couple months and it's causing water damage. Wouldn't recommend -You might as well do it yourself and save the money.

reviews.text: I called  with a backup kitchen sink, got a appointment after waiting for the appointment time they called me back to say that the plumber did work at my house a couple of years ago with a stolen credit card and never been paid....I've been living in this house for over 6 years. Its a huge disappointment and embarrassing to go through such a defamation of my character and ethics after I told them its couldn't be possible. Total waste of time now I can't get a plumber until the next day, thanks for nothing.

reviews.author: Al C
reviews.text:
I hire this company several times to perform different types of work at my house and i had an excellent experience all the time. They have great customer service, and always giving a great prices(best price around solano area overall. )I don't even waste time calling for other companies; this is my go to whenever i need work done. Just to mention a couple jobs: i had them remove all the popcorn ceiling at my house and add some light features, fans and everything turn out great. They clean everything after they perform the job.
I have them remodel my bathroom which i love how it turn out . They install a kitchen faucet , fix my water heater, and did windows and sliding door upgrades. Also, during an emergency when the main sewer line was backed up, they came right away. I recommend this business to everyone i know and they never disappoint and of course i recommend to everyone in general. They have knowledge and what they have to do ,you won't regret on having them over. I really apreciate all your hard work Carlos.

reviews.author: Robynn H.
reviews.text:
They are fantastic!  Recently had some work done on both bathrooms through AAA contractor, took them forever to do the work. Long story short my husband and i couldn't use our bathtub due to the pipes were galvanized with new stuff on top of it. Previous contractors didnt change out.
I called C & C Construction,  Mr Carlos Carmell, owner came out, gave quote, then sent a crew out 3 weeks later. Took 5 days PLUS changed out my bathroom door for a beautiful folding door; last minute request.  LOL

Everyone was very professional,  clean, understanding, personable and kind. It's a family owned business.  Mrs Carmell also is very professional.  

We will use their services from now on. 

Thank you C & C Construction

reviews.text:
C& C Plumbing has given me OUTSTANDING  service throughout the 8+ yes of knowing Carlos and his crew. His staff are timely and professional. During my precieved crisis (supply chain problems), Carlos kept me informed and help calm my nerves about issues OUT of OUR control. His finished work is of the highest quality, he and his crew take pride in the work they do.
Finally, C&C Plumbing has completed 6 major remodels and renovations in my home. I complete confidence in him and his business.
I am recommending C&C  to everyone/anyone  who desires exceptional craftsmanship, professionalism and a communicative partner during your home renovation .

reviews.author: Carla N.
reviews.text: I'm writing this review because C&C Plumbing just LOST a customer. My 1st and LAST time ever doing business with them. The plumber Carlos was professional, friendly & did a great job repairing my leaking faucets. But the customer service I received from Michelle over the phone was horrible! She was rude & impatient when I was simply asking her questions regarding payment after the job was completed. It's too bad Michelle ruined it for an entire company. I would not recommend doing business with them if Michelle is still on as their telephone customer service representative.

reviews.author: Austin
reviews.text: They were the fastest to come out, gave me a quote on the spot, which wound up being the cheapest quote in the surrounding area. Great customer service over the phone and in person. Great instal and workmanship. The silicone was very clean and they did the job fast with two people. My only complaints were I’d rather them not park in the driveway with the van tires in the mulch, and at the end one of installers shook out their floor tarp in the mulch next to the front door which had some scraps in it like old silicone and some leftover bolts that I had to pick up.

reviews.author: Sarah L.
reviews.text:
Run away. Do not be bamboozled by Carlos. I hired Carlos 3 years ago for a shower remodel. The completion time doubled, no supervision, inexperienced labor left alone for 8 hours ago with little progress. Wanted most of the money up front.
My friend hired them for 3 bathrooms. 2.5 months into a standard 5x8 secondary bath the work is still incomplete, faucets are loose, no shower enclosure installed so no showers for 2 months.

No response, tons of excuses. Don't do it. No matter how low the bid, this is not worth your SANITY. Run away!

reviews.text:
Run away. Do not be bamboozled by Carlos. I hired Carlos 3 years ago for a shower remodel. The completion time doubled, no supervision, inexperienced labor left alone for 8 hours ago with little progress. Wanted most of the money up front.
My friend hired them for 3 bathrooms. 2.5 months into a standard 5x8 secondary bath the work is still incomplete, faucets are loose, no shower enclosure installed so no showers for 2 months.

No response, tons of excuses. Don't do it. No matter how low the bid, this is not worth your SANITY. Run away!

reviews.author: Iyari
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Carlos and Michelle's plumbing company! From the moment I called, they were professional and attentive. The team arrived promptly, and their expertise was evident throughout the entire service. Carlos and Michelle's attention to detail and friendly demeanor made me feel confident in their work. They efficiently handled the plumbing issue, and the results were outstanding. I highly recommend their company for anyone in need of reliable and top-notch plumbing services.

reviews.author: GL Love
reviews.text: If you need any. Plumbing work.  Call. Carlos. At C&C plumbing. His Crew are Polite  On. Time.  Fast and Complete. The work they Perform is Excellent. They go above and beyond when completing  a project. So happy I found this team. They are neat and tidy extraordinary. Results!  I Finally found an Honest Plumber with Experience and High Efficiency and Integrity. Thank you. Carlos!   My Wife loves your work 6300 was worth Every penny for our 3 Bathroom. Remodel.  Thank you for. All your Hard Work!!

reviews.author: Tamara Starr
reviews.text: C&C Plumbing is responsive, professional and offers very good customer service. They have done several different jobs on my house and each one has been an excellent final product. They have a wealth of expert workers on their team. I appreciate Michelle for responding to my phone calls and texts promptly and courteously. I appreciate Carlos for always taking time to give estimates and for managing each job in a timely manner. I fully recommend C&C Plumbing and would definitely hire them again!!

synthesis.summary: C&C does fast emergency dispatch when they show up — Carlos has been at houses in 1.5–2 hours on Sundays and nights. But the pattern across negative reviews is troubling: bathroom remodels dragging from weeks to months, jobs left with leaks that surface months later, and 'agreed price' bills that change after the work is done. Best for true plumbing emergencies; risky for remodels.
strengths: Genuinely fast emergency response — 'C&C Plumbing was the only company that would come out at 7pm to repair my shower valve that wouldn't shut off'
Repeat customer testimonials for plumbing-only work — 'I hire this company several times to perform different types of work at my house and i had an excellent experience all the time'
Came when home warranty couldn't — 'They came out at 10:30 at night... it took Oscar a matter of minutes!'
weaknesses: Bathroom remodels run badly over schedule — '2.5 months into a standard 5x8 secondary bath the work is still incomplete, faucets are loose, no shower enclosure installed so no showers for 2 months'
Quote-vs-final-bill disputes — 'Quoted a price agreed to it, they finished it and then there's a whole new price. No heads up no checking no authorization'
Wall and countertop damage reported after one job, with the work later leaking and causing water damage
redFlags: Multiple reviews describe being 'ghosted' after initial contact — confirmed jobs and promised estimates that never followed up
Workmanship issues that surface months later — 'it's leaking now after a couple months and it's causing water damage'
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews specifically cite emergency service after hours: 7pm shower valve, 10:30pm clogged toilets, Sunday emergencies, 25-minute response on a Vallejo plumbing emergency. Carlos personally dispatches.

reviews.author: Sarah Forsman
reviews.text: I have used S Waters Plumbing for over 20 years and have only good things to say about them. They are prompt, polite, efficient and timely. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Valerie Harbidge
reviews.text: Love this company. They respond quickly. They show up on site professionally, they get the job done and they don’t try to price gouge. As a local business owner who operates with high integrity in this way, I have a strong appreciation for it. Manny and Brandon are fantastic.

reviews.author: Ki Foley
reviews.text: Kevin and crew were very efficient, professional, polite, clean, detailed oriented. What more can I say. They were able to get the job done in just 1 day. We're impressed. Thanks.

reviews.author: Anthony Mancini
reviews.text:
We had a couple of plumbing issues with some shower heads and a bathroom leak we could hear but could not see. Another local heating and plumbing company had already recommended a fix on the deceptive leak issue and I figured since we had SWaters here, I would get their second opinion.  The Plummer’s name was Manny and when we started discussing our issues, you could tell immediately that he was a pro.  I am a small business owner for 32 years and I know the difference between an employee who is doing a job versus one who treats it like it’s his career.

Manny helped us resolve our various issues and found a very creative and intuitive resolution to our leak issue. He solved it in minutes and avoided a very significant fix that had been suggested by the other company. He was professional and genuine and if I was ever starting a plumbing company, I would want Manny as employee #1.   Thanks Manny!

reviews.author: Russell R.
reviews.text: Great experience with S. Waters Plumbing. Brandon did a fantastic job. He's a meticulous craftsman, but also exceptionally kind and patient. He answered all of my unusual questions and really listened to what I was saying -- very rare these days. Pricing was fair and transparent -- also rare these days. My wife and I needed a specialized plumbing installation (Pex Manabloc manifold) at our townhouse in Novato. This piece of equipment distributes ALL of the water throughout the home, so expert installation is critical.  The job required special order parts from multiple suppliers. Brandon coordinated it all. He had everything ready to go once he got to our home. He kept everything neat and tidy during the job. Made sure to clean up after, too. Big shout out to the office as well. They followed-up with me promptly and kept me informed about status/timing. Well done.

reviews.author: M. Paul Gleisten
reviews.text:
I have been using S Waters plumbing services since 2017 and they always provide excellent service, reasonable costs and their plumbers always do amazing work with such a great attitude.  Today was no different, Manny Stoev came out for a clogged shower drain.  He was able to first reassure me over the phone that based on my description of the issue that this would likely be a straightforward issue which he later confirmed.  During the work, Manny wore boot covers inside the house and used secondary containment boxes for transporting his equipment to keep the work as sanitary as possible.  He finished in no time and had a highly competitive cost for his work which continued to validate my choice of only using S Waters.

Ask for Manny!  He is personable and really knows his stuff!!

reviews.author: Michael Romo
reviews.text: Kevin Hardy diagnosed the problem, which turned out to be an improperly installed clean-out that had been blocked with broken material as well as a large root.  He showed me the problem on video, carefully figured out the solution, and he and a co-worker accomplished the very complicated hard job in a very reasonable amount of time.  He could not have been more thorough and professional.  He did not leave until the job was done and he had thoroughly cleaned the entire area.  I am grateful for the work he did to solve a long standing problem.  S. Waters has good people who do excellent work.   I recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Bruce DeBroff
reviews.text: I would highly recommend S. Waters plumbing in Novato to anyone with a plumbing issue.  We had a main sewer line clog which backed up into our bathrooms.  Manny, who is amazing at what he does, came out and quickly diagnosed the problem and gave us several different repair options to consider.  The following day the work was completed and we were impressed  with their ability's and efficiency. Thank you Manny and Brandon and S. Waters Plumbing for doing such an outstanding job unclogging and repairing our sewer line.

reviews.author: Steven Courteau
reviews.text: Tenant complained of a toilet backup late afternoon of December 23.  Star was willing to schedule someone to come out same day, but given the availability of another toilet in the house, I asked for something the next day or later.  Star was able to schedule Brandon between 8-9 am the next morning, December 24, and the problem was resolved by 9:30 am.  Second time using S Waters Plumbing and second time they distinguished themselves with timing, ability and customer service.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Richards
reviews.text: We discovered a leak between the street water main and our front garden. We immediately called S. Waters Plumbing and spoke with Brandon who assured us he could get to us within 15 minutes, and he did. He immediately turned off the water, isolated the leaky pipe, and fixed the issue. I was fascinated by the various tools Brandon had at his disposal and he patiently allowed me to watch every step while explained the function of each tool. Brandon was thorough and great to work with.

reviews.author: RalphLeslie Purdy
reviews.text: We called this morning and got our appointment this afternoon. The plumber, Manny, arrived on time. He rapidly made an assessment on our problem. As he began to fix one problem, others showed up. He was very patient and explained everything very clearly to us. He needed to go to the hardware store for parts. When he came back he quickly solved all the problems. Manny is gracious and approachable. All in all, we were very impressed with Manny and the quality of his work.

reviews.author: Jaime Greene
reviews.text: Kevin came to our home on time, checked everything out and provided an accurate estimate.  I accepted and he was able to complete the repairs we needed with our kitchen and bathroom plumbing.  We are very happy to have Kevin help us with our home plumbing for the second time.  He always does thorough work and is clear about what needs to be done and why.  Thank you S Waters Plumbing and Kevin. We would highly recommend to anyone needing plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Gordon Brown
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with S Waters Plumbing. Kevin Hardy was prompt, professional, and thorough—he repaired everything I asked for in a timely manner and even called ahead to walk me through helpful suggestions before the installation. I had the toilet ready, and he arrived on time, kept the workspace clean, and handled everything with care. The office staff was also very helpful and responsive. Overall, a great experience from start to finish.

reviews.author: Max Cooper
reviews.text: We had a plumbing emergency on a Sunday and multiple other plumbers were unavailable. Luckily one of them referred me to S Waters. I left a message with their office and Kevin at S Waters got back to me immediately. He was at our house within a hour, diagnosed and fixed the problem quickly, and provided helpful advice on things I could fix myself. A great experience and a company I would highly recommend, especially if they’re sending Kevin!

reviews.author: Myume Zirulnik
reviews.text: Professional, timely and honest.  A.J. and Star are exceptionally pleasant, honest and helpful.  We will definitely recommend S. Waters Plumbing to our friends and family.  Thank you so much Star for your kindness and courtesy and A.J. for your tremendous expertise and common sense.  We had never met you and we felt safe and well cared for.  A new toilet and a lot of work also!  We are grateful for your help!  Have a nice weekend!

synthesis.summary: S Waters has named techs (Manny, Brandon, Kevin) who come up over and over with same-day-and-Saturday-night dispatch, leak diagnostics that save customers from competitors' more invasive recommendations, and 20-year customer histories. Booty covers, secondary containment boxes, and clean job sites are mentioned by name. One of the cleanest review profiles in this batch.

Decade-plus customer retention — 'I have been using S Waters plumbing services since 2017 and they always provide excellent service'
Techs use shoe covers and containment boxes to keep work sanitary

reviews.author: Megan Elliott
reviews.text: A friend recommended Beastbay Plumbing for tankless water heater installation. The system works flawlessly and our energy bills have improved. Excellent plumbing contractor in Benicia CA.

reviews.author: Clark Dawson
reviews.text: After noticing low water pressure throughout our home, we called Beastbay Plumbing. They quickly found a hidden leak and completed the plumbing repair without tearing up our entire yard. Excellent leak detection service in Benicia CA.

reviews.author: Seraphina Blair
reviews.text: Beastbay Plumbing replaced our old water heater with a new energy-efficient unit. The installation was smooth, affordable, and done with great attention to detail. Best plumbing service in Benicia.

reviews.author: Lilley L.
reviews.text:
Zero Star. Made and confirmed appointment. After the appointment window has elapsed, asked what's the technicians ETA. No response though text was read.

Make sure to line up other plumbers--can't rely on them.

reviews.author: Bill Simpkins
reviews.text: $4600 for a standard 50 gallon water heater!! Crooks, when most charge $2500?

reviews.author: Brandon W.
reviews.text:
While out of town in early August, a neighbor alerted me to a water leak in my backyard. I called around for local plumbers and BeastBay was more than willing to help, even same day! I was elated that this potentially catastrophic issue would be taken care of nearly immediately. After a diagnosis, the technician notified me that the galvanized pipe was shot and would have to be replaced. Over $2,000 later, it was fixed.

 

Except it wasn't... The technician, James Riggins, failed to properly mate the new copper pipes up with each other, leading to another leak. This required another visit to my property to have his fix fixed.

 

But wait, there's more! In order for the hose bib to work, a valve has to be turned on. This valve also causes one of my planter sprinkler boxes to run infinitely. So if I want to use my hose spigot that James replaced, I have to flood my planter, which is how we found out about this issue in the first place. This isn't even the only issue after this whole ordeal.

 

James must've done something else to throw off the equilibrium of my property's irrigation system, as I've lost a whole Zone of sprinklers on my property. The landscaping is now dying unless I manually water it.

 

Thanks to James, we fixed one problem and introduced a few more. But hey, at least my property isn't flooding, right?

 

I reached out to Beast Bay management when returning home in late September about the issues that I noticed. I sent the email on September 27th. No response.

 

On October 23rd, I reached out again for a follow up, asking for an update... Again. No response.

 

On November 2nd, I asked for a THIRD update... To my surprise, Janea Williams reached out and said "I can send a technician out first thing Monday from 12-2" (November 3rd).  Finally!

 

Monday rolled around and I cancelled meetings and an appointment so I could meet up with the technician.

 

Naturally, 2pm rolled around, and nobody from Beast Bay had showed up. Unreal. I would say it was unbelievable, but at this point, I wasn't even surprised.

 

On Monday afternoon, I reached out to Jenea and the Beast Bay management team to notify them that nobody had arrived in that window we agreed on. To no surprise, I have heard nothing yet from anyone at Beast Bay.

 

Beware of this shady company. They're fantastic at bait and switching you. Not only did I pay an astronomical amount of money to have my initial issue fixed, but I was ghosted and left with even more issues than what I started out with. I reached out to other plumbers and they all said the price I paid was highway robbery and they would've been able to do it for far less money and wouldn't have left me with the issues that Beast Bay did. I should have known when James was on the phone with his boss, he begged and pleaded for this job. It's almost like he knew what a simple job it was and how much he could charge me for it. Despite it being such a simple job, he managed to make so many mistakes.

 

Oh and the cherry on top? James told me neighbor, who was housesitting for me, that James was planning on starting his own plumbing company. HA! Good luck with that. Plus I'm sure Beast Bay loves their own employees telling their customers about their future rogue endeavors.

Oh, and in order to access the job site, James had to move my Mini-Split's compressor. He damaged it in the process and it had to be repaired and readjusted. 

Never again, Beast Bay. Never again.
