reviews.author: Iris W.
reviews.text:
We had a bit of an urgent situation in a detached Guest Unit of less than 400 sq ft.  Our Guest left unit with toilet clogged and backing up into shower, the bath sink not functioning  & kitchen drain leaking . 
Beastbay was 1st to answer and the only company able to come out same day & within 3hrs of call.
The pricing is what diminished my star rating. We're on Septic and was afraid the issue could end up affecting our main house. On top of that it was the weekend (Saturday). There was no mention of "weekend pricing" but we needed issue fixed so gladly pd to have issue resolved. The fix for $1000 included removing toilet, snaking line w/ camera and flushing (via running water) for approx 10-15 minutes. Seeing no backup drains cleaned & toilet replaced.

A second appointment was suggested and scheduled for Monday  following. However after careful consideration we cannot (at this  time) take on the additional  $2500 debt quoted for installing a 2-way clean out; to tie in the kitchen drain into the 10ft of replacement pipe running less than 2ft deep along the side of our  small (less than 400 sq ft) unit and removing the existing external pipe drain for kitchen sink. Even with the wonderful  "interest free" payment plan offered - The $1000 we've paid for lifting our toilet and snaking the line w/ camera was already more than we could afford. 

The 2 Gentlemen that responded were exceptionally pleasant. We appreciate their skills and knowledge of their trade which included information on comparative pricing and their willingness to give us a great deal reducing the added work from $4500 ultimately down to $2500...  We unfortunately had to cancel that work (for now).
Again We certainly appreciate their swift response and resolving our immediate issue.
Thank you BeastBay!
Iris Winn

reviews.author: Avi J.
reviews.text:
We had a bathroom sink faucet that needed to be replaced. It was more than 30 years old and was showing advanced signs of wear. I went through the standard Yelp drill on a Friday evening, and quickly had multiple automated messages in my Inbox from providers who had finished for the week and promised to get back to me on Monday.

Janea from BeastBay got back to me immediately. I sent a video detailing the issue, and explained that I would be tied up all day on Monday. BeastBay was happy to accommodate me by sending a technician out on Saturday for a free estimate.

The estimate was just a little higher than I had expected (and a bit higher than a competitor's estimate), but as it turns out, it was well worth it: For one thing, the price was all-inclusive, so I didn't have to go to a supply store and shop for the unit myself. Jared C, the technician who provided the estimate and did the job, would source and purchase the faucet unit, come right back, and install it immediately. And the warranty included in the price was very reasonable.

Jared was professional, courteous, and thorough. I could see that the job turned out to be far more frustrating than he had foreseen: The existing drain and faucet were old and corroded, requiring far more work than Jared had envisioned. In fact, Jared actually had to go back to the hardware store for additional parts because some of the legacy parts broke as Jared was removing them. Still, Jared remained calm and professional throughout, and kept to his original estimate despite the extra work and extra trip.

We are extremely happy with the result, and strongly recommend BeastBay and Jared for any household plumbing job.

Well done! You guys saved my weekend.

reviews.author: Trevor L.
reviews.text:
Without Daniel I'd sever my relationship with this company completely. In years past I've gotten great service. Not the experience from the last 2 times I've had to use BeastBay. 

The tech name Miles was a horrible experience to have in my home. I had to supply him with protective plastic as well as a shop vac. He asked me at one point if I wanted the job to be completed (because he didn't bring all the needed parts with him), when I responded "do you want all the money for the job?" He replied with "oh I don't care, doesn't matter to me." Getting this kind of attitude from someone you're paying for a service is completely out of line. He made no attempt at any clean up except to wash all the Sheetrock dust and tile down the bathtub drain. My wife had to stop him and vacuum up all the debris herself. He left the house mid job to go on a parts run then still never completed the work. On top of that all, Miles put a nice size chuck into my fiberglass tub basin. The supervisor Daniel had to come finish the job on a different day. 

Overpriced, poor customer service, attitude, messy. That's how I feel about my recent experiences with BeastBay Plumbing. It's very unfortunate as I'd love nothing more than to have a solid, local plumbing company that I can count on. The only way I'll do business with this company in the future is by reaching out to Daniel the supervisor directly. It's sad to see that they've gone down hill in recent years. 

Contract at your own risk.

reviews.author: Marissa Johnson
reviews.text:
On Wednesday 8/13/25 at 830p I watched a Beastbay Plumbing Box truck barrel down first street in Benicia doing 40+ MPH in the dark and only just BARELY miss hitting a pedestrian crossing the street. The driver did not brake, only swerved at the last possible second, I was certain the pedestrian was going to die, and then the driver immediately got right back on the gas and sped off without pausing to apologize or check that the pedestrian was OK.

I immediately called Beast Bay, received a call back the next day from someone claiming to be the office manager who said they have GPS on the trucks and they would be able to tell which truck it was and therefore who was driving it. I asked for follow up from the owner to be sure this was dealt with- never got a call back again.

Clearly this business doesn’t care about accountability or community. The behavior of that driver was dangerous and abhorrent, and it’s possible the driver was drunk (I can’t imagine why an unaffected person would just speed off from such a near-miss without either extremely low morals or an altered state of mind). I was told they have the tools to get to the bottom of it and do something about it, but have no evidence that any such action was taken- just as dangerous and abhorrent as the behavior of the driver himself.

Give your money to a business with morals and follow-through instead, as this one can’t be counted on to do the right thing.

reviews.author: Jaime P.
reviews.text:
So I should start by saying, I have been using this company for years for various work, including major plumbing work, toilet installations, and running a gas line.  With that said, on a Saturday evening, I accidently broke the water faucet/hose outlet connected to the main water shut off.  So water was going everywhere.  I was confused, as we had just spent a lot of money running a new line to the street 2 years ago.  So I called BeastBay to see if they could come fix it, as I had no running water.  

The dispatcher told me they didn't have anyone available until Monday!  I told her I had an 80 year old senior citizen in my home (my mother).  After I took my Monday appointment, I tried calling 2 other companies.  One well known company told me they don't service Vallejo, while the other one *ahem* rooter pretended they couldn't hear me on the phone.   Jerks!!

Next thing you know Ron, the owner from BeastBay called me directly and he sent one of his employees out that night to patch my water line.  No questions asked!  Turns out they had connected the new waterline to my 40 year old pipes with the original job.  Either way, I am happy customer as we have running water again, and no leaks.  I highly recommend this company, especially for Vallejo since those other companies think they are too good to come out here!

reviews.author: Chris B.
reviews.text:
Know going into an emergency situation you feel rushed to take care of an issue as fast as possible. That was the case here. Not to drag out the story I will just state the issue. The plumbing under the tub had some sealant fail and it started to leak into the drywall. They were the highest rated and available immediately to come and fix. They removed the drywall and located the issue and needed to replace an elbow and drain in the tub.

The technician damaged the drain surrounding in the tub and we did not notice until later that it was still leaking. They came back out 2 days after telling them the issue. The technician that came showed me the damage and said that is why it was leaking. I called their office and the manager was very hostile telling me they couldn't have damaged it. Point being that if it was damaged before how was this not pointed out when they replaced the parts. So they sent the original technician back and he explained how he had a lot of difficulties removing the drain and how it broke when removing the old one. He put silicone all around the drain and plumbing under. This is not what you would expect from a highly rated company as well as expecting more professional standards when speaking to your customers about a problem. Furthermore I would not recommend them based off of my experience.

reviews.author: J G.
reviews.text:
Scammed by BeastBay Plumbing.  No response after confronting them.  ( my email below). Seemed honest and straightforward at first. And a hurry to get this shut off installed for insurance. They took advantage of that. They told us "this is just how much they cost". Complete lies.  Sent them the email below and they never responded.  THEY RESPONDED BUT GHOSTED ME AFTER THE EMAIL BEFLOW. 

Hello, thank you for sending this over.(hadn't received the detailed receipt)

I'm writing regarding a recent service provided by your company. There are some concerns I'd like to address about the charges:

1. Daniel quoted and charged us $2,200 for the service.
2. Upon further research, I found that the device itself costs approximately $500.
3. Assuming a 100% markup on the part, which would bring it to $1,000, it appears we were charged $1,200 for labor.
4. Your plumber was on-site for only 90 minutes.

Given this breakdown, I'm struggling to understand the justification for the $2,200 total. The labor charge seems disproportionate to the time spent on the job.

Could you please review this charge and provide a detailed breakdown? I believe we may have been overcharged.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I appreciate any clarification or assistance you can provide.

AVOID THESES HUSTLERS

reviews.author: Edward M.
reviews.text:
Giving these guys another 5, even after a miscommunication this morning. I needed 2 bathroom faucets replaced and was price shopping this time around. Money is tight these days with inflation and all. I spoke to their office/sales guy on the phone and he promised a price cheaper than another provider so I went ahead and scheduled the appointment. Upon arrival, the quote was hella off and almost double what the guy on the phone said. I was HOT, but the guys who came to the house were understanding. They got their owner, Ron, on the phone and he quickly made it right and took care of me. 

I got my faucets replaced plus some old valves as well as they were seizing up pretty bad. Shout out to Claudio and Daniel for being super thorough, efficient and understanding. The work they performed today was solid. 

I'm taking this moment to apologize to them for getting angry this morning but understating where I was coming from. It's hard dealing with upset customers and they handled it well.

Mistakes happen. Miscommunication happens. At the end of the day, it's how situations are handled and that's what separates good businesses from bad ones. I appreciate how BeastBay handled this one.

They didn't lose a customer today, they reassured one's trust.

synthesis.summary: Beastbay shows 4.5 Google / 4.4 Yelp on the surface, but the BBB F rating (not accredited) and review text reveal a 'doubled-on-arrival' pricing pattern, an unauthorized credit-card application, and one reviewer reportedly offered $100 to take down their 1-star review. Same-day response is real, but the price quoted in the morning is rarely the price paid by evening.
strengths: Same-day and within-the-hour response repeatedly mentioned — 'Came out within an hour of our call,' 'sent a guy out that day' the week of Thanksgiving
Specific tech (Jovan) repeatedly singled out for friendly, fast, professional service on shut-off valve and snake jobs
weaknesses: Quoted price doubled on arrival in multiple reports — '$350-$500' became '$900', '$1800 to replace one foot of tube' demanded after drywall opened
Workmanship failures with damage left unrepaired — bathroom remodel left at 25% complete after 75% paid; tub drain damaged and contested
Reviewer reports being offered $100 to remove a 1-star Yelp review — direct review-curation evidence
Reviewer reports an unauthorized credit-card application after being told it was a soft inquiry
redFlags: BBB F rating, not accredited
Unauthorized credit card opened in customer's name reported on Google
Reviewer offered $100 cash to remove negative Yelp review
Pattern of doubling quotes after work begins
Reckless driving incident with pedestrian near-miss reported and ignored by management
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Same-day and within-an-hour dispatch is well-documented (no water on day-after-Christmas, same-day backyard leak), but the responsiveness comes paired with surprise pricing once the tech arrives.

water-heater.topQuote: $4600 for a standard 50 gallon water heater!! Crooks, when most charge $2500?

burst-pipe.topQuote: After noticing low water pressure throughout our home, we called Beastbay Plumbing. They quickly found a hidden leak and completed the plumbing repair without tearing up our entire yard.

faucet-fixture.topQuote: I called to have a kitchen faucet replaced. Quote was $400 to $600. A simple single hole, faucet with screw nut

drain-cleaning.topQuote: I needed a kitchen sink line snaked & he took care of it in no time.

bathroom-remodel.topQuote: We hired these guys to do a bathroom remodel job. Early on they caused a leek on the upper level of our house ... They maybe finished 25% of the agreed upon work.

toilet.topQuote: tried to upsell me on a new toilet install costing over $300 ... minor leak was corrected by replacing the toilet connector which only cost me $7.18

avoid_if: You need this for a complex or high-stakes install
hire_if: You need fast same-day or after-hours response
You need high-quality work that holds up over time
caution_if: You want detailed upfront explanations
You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need airtight scheduling and guaranteed arrival times

reviews.author: Aria Jones
reviews.text: Strong attention to detail and excellent service. They handled a complicated issue with ease and professionalism.

reviews.author: Manana papava
reviews.text: The technician was very knowledgeable and handled our bathroom plumbing issue with confidence. I appreciated how clearly he explained what needed to be done before starting the repair.

reviews.author: Cromer Landin
reviews.text: The technician was knowledgeable and diagnosed the issue quickly, saving both time and stress.

reviews.author: Fredy V.
reviews.text: They overcharged me for services. They came to check for a gas leak in my house. I thought they would have some expensive, intricate way to find my leak, but no, they just used a bike pump and a diaphragm gauge and didn't even find the leak. Barely 2 hours of "work" and they charged me once 750$ then an additional 160$ the next day. For what, I have no clue. I never even received a quote or an invoice, and when I was told someone would call me to discuss pricing, no one ever did. I have tried calling several times, but it always sends me to an AI operator. When I called with a different phone number, I was able to reach an actual person who simply said I would get a call back, which I never did. Please rethink doing business with this company, as they will essentially scam you for your money. I will personally ensure those around me AVOID this company.

reviews.author: Aj P.
reviews.text: This company will take advantage of you if they think they can. We had them come out and look at our water heater That was having some issues. They informed us that it needed to be replaced, but the good news is that it was under warranty. They then quoted us $1900 to replace it and lied telling us that only plumbers could utilize the warranty. I was able to go to the store get the warranty covered and replace the water heater myself for $43 and 2 hours of work. Would not recommend this company to anyone they do not utilize honest business practices.

reviews.author: Garrett C.
reviews.text: We had a gas leak shortly after moving into our new home.  Energy company turned off the gas emergently, and we had Reliant come out to give us a quote for repairs.  They did come out same day/quickly, which was appreciated (though it still cost $150 for being after-hours @ 6PM).  They quoted me an outlandish price thousands of dollars over what was reasonable or expected.  I spoke to their manager over the phone who was rude and argumentative, and every service I discussed with them was priced well over industry standards, and they were completely unwilling to come down in price at all.  I called a competing company out the following morning who completed the work at less than 1/4th the price of what Reliant quoted me and were much more personable and pleasant to deal with.  As best I can figure, Reliant knew that we were between a rock and a hard place with our gas shut off and no hot water in our house, and were just simply taking advantage of the opportunity to extort us.  Would not recommend this company.

reviews.author: Charlie Jones
reviews.text: We called for toilet installation in our newly renovated bathroom. The plumber aligned everything properly, sealed connections securely, and tested flushing multiple times. Installation was clean and precise. Highly professional plumbing company.

reviews.author: Helene Ray
reviews.text: I had a leak that kept coming back and this plumber finally fixed it the right way. The work was done carefully and everything was tested before they left. I have not had any issues since.

reviews.author: Rita Dexter
reviews.text: Amazing experience. From booking to completion, everything was smooth and well managed. The plumber was friendly and did an excellent job.

Buyer-beware until more independent reviews accumulate.

reviews.author: Dewayne Grayer
reviews.text:
I recently used Top Rated Plumbing and couldn’t be happier with the service! From the moment I called, they were professional, responsive, and easy to work with. The plumber arrived on time, explained everything clearly, and completed the job quickly and efficiently.
The quality of work was excellent, pricing was fair, and they left everything clean and tidy. It’s hard to find reliable and honest plumbing services these days, but Top Rated Plumbing truly lives up to their name.
Highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing repairs or installations!

reviews.author: Steven Mitchell
reviews.text: These Guys don’t play around ! We lost our hot water heater and it was at a critical time when that happened. So we called these guys and lo and behold it almost seemed although all we had to do is click our heels 3 times and presto…… These guys were there with a brand new Hot WaterHeater asthough they new I’d be calling. Now speaking on on fast courteous and showing real professionalism, These guys hands down had it all together. They knocked the job out like it was as simple as changing a flat tire. I’m grateful and will forever use and recommend Top Rated Plumbing and Remodeling…… you won’t be disappointed !!!!

reviews.author: Cathy Riley
reviews.text: Anthony & his team are my go to construction guys.  They have done everything from interior renovation to exterior remodeling for me.  I have the utmost respect for his work & expertise.  He is very compassionate which is something I look for in a contractor as it shows me that he cares about his customers.

reviews.author: Curro R.
reviews.text:
My experience as a customer of Anthony is that he came to my home for a consultation, charged me $100, promised me an estimate, and then never followed through.  I never received the estimate he promised.  I wrote a review about this on Yelp.  Anthony responded on Yelp, denying that I was his customer or that he knew me.  I noticed he also did this to other people who had left him negative reviews on Yelp.

My experience as a customer of Anthony then got really scary.  I began receiving personal threats from Anthony about what would happen to me if I did not remove my negative review.  Anthony made it clear in his threats that he knew where I lived and he would be coming after me.

My review was later removed through Yelp HQ, because "it didn't include enough detail about your experiences as a customer."  I avoided details because I was scared, but I wanted to warn others.  I hope this new review provides sufficient details about my experience.  I wonder how many other people have been swindled by Anthony, only to be intimidated into silence.

Be very, very careful about letting this man into your home.

reviews.author: Louis
reviews.text: Bad second encounter made me change review.

reviews.author: Gordo G.
reviews.text:
Our family highly recommends you call Anthony with any of your plumbing and general contracting needs! We feel very fortunate we did. Here is our story: 

We weren't very familiar with atmospheric rivers and bomb cyclones previously, yet we received a very quick education in them as we were watching our grill glide thirty feet across our backyard, and our canopy structure somehow shifted dangerously close to the back of our house. Luckily, it stopped short of the house. Unluckily, it busted a pipe coming from the house and started gushing water into our already water logged and flooded backyard. Uh oh! 

At this point we are frantically trying to diagnose what's going on and shut off the water. Problem is that the only way to stop the water is to turn off the water to the entire house. Even though this was a inconvenience we could live with temporarily, the fact that we have an infant and a toddler and had important events to get ready for...we had a problem.

We called our normal plumbing service...not able to make it after hours. They could come the next afternoon. Called another 24/7 plumbing service. Nope. No answer (they did end up calling the next morning). "Call every plumber you can find," my wife exclaimed! We tried plumber after plumber. It's going to cost what to come out now! All we could find was unavailability and price gouging. Ugh!

And then we called Anthony's Plumbing and Help U Plumb. He was very courteous and informative on the phone about his rate and eta. He had to drive up from American Canyon (we're in Napa). He arrived and diagnosed the issue quickly and got straight to work. Needing more parts for our specific issue, he went out to the store to pick it up and returned promptly. He was able to not only get us running water again, but also fix the pipe from the storm and improve the fixture (as my father in law had made some "repairs" that could have or were causing further issues). Awesome job! We were back!

Every step of the way, Anthony answered all my questions and concerns regarding the work being done. He explained the process, and I truly appreciated his communication and professionalism. 

He even took a look at our kitchen faucet which was having a pressure issue. He explained what was going on there and gave us information to explore further. We have hard water that is producing some serious mineral buildup that is causing issues throughout the plumbing. We plan to address that with Anthony in the near future! We had multiple plumbers come look at this issue and each time they cleaned the debris blocking the pipes without getting to the root of the issue. Repeat trips out with multiple charges. So glad we found Anthony.

All in all Anthony's plumbing service more than exceeded our expectations. He's a pros pro. He cares about the quality of the work first and foremost. He came to us in a time of need, with a very competitive rate. His customer service and communication were excellent. He really went above and beyond throughout the entire experience and we were extremely grateful for him traveling to us and working outdoors in the dark during a storm. Bonus, he was very personable and our son liked him so much he drew him a picture to take home with him :) 

Thank you Anthony! 

Do yourself a favor and give Anthony's plumbing and remodel a call.

reviews.author: David D.
reviews.text:
Called on a Saturday afternoon, during business hours posted on Yelp ("Mon-Sat 8 am - 6 pm"). Call was not returned either that day or the next, despite other reviews which state that he was available on Sundays as well.

It's now Monday, without a callback, and we need to find someone else.

UPDATE: Monday morning (not long after posting the review above), I did receive a call back from Anthony, and for that reason alone, I added two stars. Additionally, Anthony responded to this review, by appending his own comments, saying that his company is not a "24 hour Emergency service company" and that he "take[s] time for [his] family and cant save the day all the time. We have Work hours that are Stated Clearly."

Let me start by saying I totally support the right of hard-working people to take time to be with their families. The problem I have with my experience, is NOT that he took well-deserved time off!

Rather, the issue arises because I did call during the "Work hours that are Stated Clearly": As of last Saturday, his Yelp page said his hours were "Mon-Sat 8 am - 6 pm" (cut and pasted from the Yelp page itself). I noted those hours when I called his service on Saturday, well before his posted Saturday closing time (If memory serves, I rang around 3pm). Had he called back, and said he was booked, or closing early (or had his voicemail greeting said these things in contradiction of Yelp-posted hours), I would have totally understood. Likewise, had the posted hours said "Closed Saturday and Sunday" I would have also understood.

But I called during the posted hours, got no call back until Monday, and then (instead of regretting what appears to be a confusion due to incorrectly-posted working hours) I was told he was not a 24-hour service.

I notice that Anthony has just changed his posted working hours on Yelp (they now read that he closes at 5pm on Saturdays --- but even by these shorter Saturday hours, I did call before closing that Saturday). I respectfully suggest that Anthony modify the posted hours to read "Saturday, by appointment only" which would give him the flexibility to answer calls if he wished on weekends, or not answer them if he wants to set the time aside for his family.

This clearly was an unfortunate misunderstanding, and hopefully a change to posted hours on Yelp will prevent it from recurring in the future.

reviews.author: Jeremiah C.
reviews.text: Let me preface this review by saying I cannot put into words how honest, forthright & to the point this guy is. It's profoundly refreshing! Our journey started with me thinking I could refresh the look of a tub/shower by replacing some valve stems , a diverted stem & drain grate. Well I broke the drain pipe in the process of removing the old grate. Well long story short, this quickly became a repair I could not handle on my own. I believed the only way to repair it was to tear out the head wall & if that had to done then a remodel might as well happen since the walls are tiled. I searched Yelp for a plumber/ general contractor for remodel quotes & several messaged. Anthony was the only one who said: I'll do whatever you want. But what if I can fix it without remodeling? He explained to me the going rates for remodel vs. the cost of what he thought it might cost to do a repair. He also told me that it would be $100 to come out to do an estimate but that $100 would be applied towards the overall cost if work was to be done. To some this may be a turn off. To me, I see it as someone whom values their time as I do mine. Needless to say I had him come out & he told me what needs to done & how much it would cost "if" that's the problem. I said let's do it! As luck would have it, that repair wasn't the only issue & as it turns out other things were wrong. Some my doing, others being the original materials used in building the house. He explained everything every step of the way, showed me every step of the way, made it a point to involve me & even gave me pointers for next time. At several turns he could've up sold me, taken advantage of me or even made it a bigger job to benefit him & yet he didn't. He made adjustments to his original game plan, & completed the job the same day. Despite the prospect of that happening appeared bleak without his quick thinking & intuitiveness. All in all I'm happy I chose this man. He isn't the cheapest & he's certainly not the most expensive. But in life you learn...you get what you pay for. Anthony is just an honest, hard working man, trying hard to make an honest living in a field chalk full of phonies & crooks! I've found my plumber for life

reviews.author: Lisa H.
reviews.text:
This review is long over due! Last summer I had a bulbous ceiling! (what? yeah! it was crazy looking!) apparently a slow leak from the bathroom upstairs! I went on Yelp and did the request quote etc.. to see who would get back to me and fast! 

Anthony was consistently getting back to me and pretty darn quick for actually getting over here. He literally walked me through details like, "I shouldn't be able to lift your toilet off the ground" and then did so! He literally explained all that should be and that wasn't~ in the layout of my plumbing. (I know nothing of plumbing so it's a little scary to not know if someone was gonna just make up stuff.)  He was keen to get the job and so threw in a lot of little other things that he noticed were needed or wrong and offered to right them. Now, that is the kind of service I think we are ALL looking for!

Basically, he explained to me the whole process of what I was about to go through, First I would need to call remediation etc..then he'd come back out...Meanwhile I needed to find the tile to replace my floor. The remediation people ended up accidentally chopping the wires to my heated floors, so Anthony had to replace that as well. In the end, I could not find my tile and had to figure something else out. I was super picky of every single tile being replaced and they (He & Rosie) let me choose each and every piece in the layout. Swapping out pieces back and forth. They were so patient. They will tell you how things "should" be done but will do whatever you want, so it's a great rapport to figure out what you want and why things might need to be laid out a certain way etc. if you are wanting to keep control of your design. They were great listeners and understood my fighting for certain design elements.

They keep everything positive and moving and if I ever needed to remodel a bathroom let alone remodel a house, I'd hire these guys in a minute for their timeliness, workmanship and staying on budget. Though they came from far away, they were probably the best plumber/contractor I could have asked for!

reviews.author: Capt G.
reviews.text:
this guy is the real deal. Our bathroom was recently remodeled when I noticed a leak coming from around the toilet. We couldn't get ahold of our contractor Jose, so we called Helpuplumb since we needed plumbing help. Anthony was upfront explaining there would be a 1 hr min charge that would be applied to the total if there was a more serious problem than an easy repair. So figuring it would be a simple fix since we just had our bathroom remodeled we made the appointment. Anthony pulled up the toilet to check things out and he found that the contractor just tiled over a rotten old sub floor and the new toilet was leaking for at least 3 months under the layers of floor and tile to now create a bigger problem. The wood under the toilet, (what wood) was gone and had no way to secure the toilet permanent to the floor which explains why it was moving the whole time!
After basically redoing the plumbing under the floor for the toilet he found many other shotty poor fixes and at that point we realized we were in trouble. We just spent 10K on the bathroom and basically we were going to have to start over since there was no space under the house to crawl meant the new floor had to come up to fix the rotten pipes that were just left that way to leak another day.
I guess saving money by not getting a permit was a bad idea which was suggested by our contractor!
Come to find out He just said he was a contractor, after looking for Jose on the CSLB website we realized he wasn't licensed to begin with. I wish we took our time and did our research before we got into this mess. Even thought Anthony's job was not a simple fix I'm glad we got the right  professional to complete the job he had permits and got the job inspected and gave us a one year warranty when it was all over we have not had a problem since its been a couple years now thanks Anthony.

reviews.author: Chris Hanson
reviews.text:
I've hired Anthony multiple times because he does such great work! Most recently I discovered a leak in my fire sprinkler system and when he inspected it he noted that the water softener installed by Culligan was reducing the size of the piping upstream from the sprinkler system potentially reducing its effectiveness--though that wasn't the cause of the leak, it could have caused problems in a fire. So he re-did the pipes and suggested installing a Moen Flo device--a whole home automated water shutoff valve in case some other pipe started leaking. His suggestion saved me some money on my homeowner's insurance premiums and I have piece of mind that my house won't flood if a pipe breaks!
Previously I hired him to come fix our kitchen disposal and he discovered that our remodeling contractor didn't put an angle in the pipe, causing water to sit--when opened up, the pipe was half-full with debris even though the remodel was only 5 years ago. A new disposal and properly installed pipe saved me a ton of headache in the future!
The first time I met him he correctly installed a toilet and vanity from yet another remodeling contractor who did it wrong!
He is very straightforward about his pricing and has great advice about the best replacement parts for things that were done incorrectly or poorly by the "other guy".

reviews.author: Daniel M.
reviews.text:
I had a very tired old bathroom that my wife had been begging me to get remodeled for her. I really didn't know where to start.
After calling a few contractors. The 1st never got back to us with an estimate. Another never showed up.
I finally met Anthony he walked me through the process and let me know how much it would cost , how long it would take, and really made my wife and I very comfortable with his company.
I have an older house with iron pipes and an older water heater. We came to the decision to install a new Navien water heater with a recirculation pump and get rid of those old dirty pipes. He showed me the inside of one of the pipes, and I couldn't believe we had been drinking and showering in that.
So after it was all said and done ,WoW! The attention to detail and the professionalism of him and his team were well above expectations.
The bathroom is beautiful , and our water pressure is INCREDIBLE! We have never run out of hot water in the new tub/spa , and as soon I turn on the faucet, I get hot water.
We are not fancy people by any stretch, but Anthony went out of his way to make us feel like royalty.
Next is the kitchen!
Sorry, no pictures. The lens on my phone is cracked

reviews.author: Megan D.
reviews.text:
My dad and husband were putting in a new sink when an old, rusted pipe broke and began spewing hot water all over my kitchen.  While they are pretty handy guys, they didn't have the tools necessary to weld the pipe back.  As it was a Sunday, we were prepared to get screwed with a high fee.

My husband put out calls to several plumbers in the Vallejo area and got all voicemails.  As it turned out, Anthony at Help-U-Plumb was the ONLY one to call us back, and it only took him about 10 minutes.  A little over an hour later, he was there and getting down and dirty with our sink.

My dad and Anthony chopped it up while he worked.  My dad was impressed with the quality of supplies he had to replace our old, crappy pipes.  Anthony said it would take him "a couple of hours" and within an hour and a half, he was done.  He charged $95/hour, which is the normal going rate for work during the week, so I was stoked it wasn't jacked up for a Sunday.

He was friendly, efficient, and even showed my dad a few tricks.  I really appreciated his work and he is definitely our #1 guy when it comes to plumbing!

Oh, and he has a fishing company too he told us to check out at youtube/helpufish!

reviews.author: Steven Tan
reviews.text:
I had a leak coming from the ceiling and I was mega-stressed about it, as I wasn't sure what was causing it, and I also didn't know whether to find a general contractor (to tear out ceiling and inspect) or find a plumber first. I saw that this business had great reviews and that Anthony did both plumbing and general contracting so it seemed like a good way to go.

I'm glad I called Anthony. He was very eager to talk me through exactly what he was looking for and how he ruled out various problems. He said he liked to explain every step of his examination so his clients understood his reasoning and process and so they knew they were getting a solid value and no unnecessary repairs.

In the end, he ended up finding a gnarly (but only intermittent) leak from one of my sinks. He replaced at a fair price and did a great job and even did extra sealing in the bathroom that wasn't part of the fix.

He also gave me further advice on what other items should be addressed (due to the leak and other neglected items) but zero pressure to try and get them done now.

I was very happy with the service provided!

synthesis.summary: Anthony shines on smaller jobs and remodels in older Vallejo homes (1933, 1942 houses) — same-day arrival, after-hours pilot-light fixes with no upcharge, and bathroom remodels customers say came in on budget. The complication: one detailed Yelp review alleges he charged $100 for a consultation, never followed through with the estimate, then sent personal threats demanding the negative review be removed.
strengths: Same-day or 20-minute response on emergencies, including after-hours calls with no extra charge
Specializes in older homes — '1942', '1933' houses where other plumbers walked away
Holds firm on quoted prices and explains issues without condescension — multiple repeat-customer reviews
weaknesses: One detailed Yelp review describes a $100 consultation with no follow-up estimate

redFlags: One reviewer alleges receiving 'personal threats' from Anthony demanding a negative review be removed
One review describes him cursing and becoming aggressive in a pricing dispute, with police called
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviewers describe after-hours and Sunday emergency responses (water heater pilot light at no extra charge, snake on a holiday at fair price, sewer call at 8:45pm) — but business-hours posting is inconsistent and one reviewer never got a callback during posted Saturday hours.

reviews.author: Jesse Obrien
reviews.text: We’ve had plumbers come out for several different jobs at our house, and each time the work was done really well. The prices have always seemed fair, never overpriced. They’ve installed a garbage disposal, put in three new toilets, and cleared out some clogged drains in both our sinks and shower. Everything was fixed right the first time, so there’s never been a need for a second visit. Terrence was great with scheduling and even called back sooner than we expected to set up our appointment. I highly recommend these plumbers if you need any plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Patrick Willis
reviews.text: Recently, wright brothers plumbing & gas took care of a full plumbing renovation for our master bathroom in Vallejo. melvin and the team handled everything—removing the old tub, vanity, floor, and most of the walls. they upgraded our shower, installed a new glass door, retiled the floor and walls, redirected the drains, and put in all new plumbing fixtures. we really appreciated the detailed work plan they gave us, with clear schedules for each part of the job. they kept in touch with us the whole time and made sure everything ran smoothly. the project finished right on schedule and stayed within our planned budget. we are extremely happy with the quality of their plumbing work and would absolutely recommend them for any plumbing or renovation needs. we will definitely call them again in the future.

reviews.author: ray carpenter
reviews.text: The team at Wright Brothers Plumbing & Gas did an amazing job. I had a serious drain blockage that needed urgent attention, and they handled it quickly and professionally. I called in and Brian answered right away, promising to get back to me soon. In just a few minutes, he called back to let me know Melvin would arrive within half an hour. When Melvin showed up, he carefully inspected the situation and explained that the drain needed to be cleared from the roof access. He gave me a fair price before starting the work. After some time, he let me know the job was done and everything was flowing perfectly again. I had reached out to several other plumbing services before, but none could offer same-day help like this. These plumbers were fast, reliable, and really knew their stuff. I’ll definitely be contacting them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: samuel madden
reviews.text: When my wife and I were both dealing with some health issues, we unfortunately found out we had a leak in our hot water pipe under the slab of our Vallejo home. We reached out to a local plumber one evening, and the next day Melvin came by to check things out. He quickly arranged for their leak detection specialist, who arrived within the hour and found not one, but two hot water leaks, with one under our kitchen island. A couple of days later, Melvin returned to give us an estimate, and I also asked about completely re-piping the house. He brought Ezra, the field supervisor, so they could walk through the house and see what needed to be done. The crew started work that Thursday, and by the end of the next day, most of the job was finished and we had both hot and cold water flowing again. The team came back the following week to wrap everything up, and I was fully satisfied with their work. Melvin, Ezra, Terrence, and the rest of the crew worked hard, were very considerate of our situation, and always cleaned up after themselves. They carefully covered any holes they made and did a thorough walk-through with us at the end to make sure everything was perfect. In today’s world, it’s great to see plumbers who truly care about their craft, do the job right, and respect their customers—especially when the customers are recovering from health issues. I highly recommend this team to anyone in Vallejo who needs plumbing work done. They set a great example of what a professional plumber should be and treat their customers with real kindness.

reviews.author: L Pratt
reviews.text: having terrence and his team handle our plumbing needs for the first time was an incredible experience! we've made up our minds that we won't be needing any other service! terrence and his crew, including brian and melvin, exceeded our expectations! from providing the quote to finishing the job, their expertise was top-notch. what started as a simple rerouting of bathroom plumbing to a new septic system swiftly turned into a full drainage replacement after they discovered severe leakage in the drainage pipes beneath our house in vallejo. they didn't just expect us to take their word for it, they provided visual proof and explained what would be needed to fix the problem. the level of empathy they showed upon the discovery of our issue was beyond words! terrence suggested a restoration company and once the cleanup was complete, he and his team swiftly returned to replace our entire cast iron drainage system. after the primary job was done, i requested terrence to replace the water line from the road to our house. true to form, he had it done a day after completing the initial task. if you need plumbing work done, there is no one more trustworthy and knowledgeable than terrence and his team. they score a perfect five stars in terms of cost, knowledge, professionalism, keeping us updated on developments, and promptness. terrence didn't just do a job, he treated us like family! their service was a blessing and we will always be grateful for their exceptional expertise and care!

reviews.author: Gina Watson
reviews.text: As someone helping my aging parents, I needed to make their bathroom safer and easier to use, especially since they're on a fixed income. After my dad was in the hospital, it became clear that a bathroom update was necessary. While I had a contractor take care of most of the cosmetic changes, I ran into a problem when it came time to switch the old bathtub drain to fit a new walk-in shower. I didn't realize that the plumbing for a walk-in shower is different from a regular tub! That's when I reached out to Wright Brothers Plumbing & Gas. Melvin came out to take a look, and the job turned out to be more challenging than expected because the corner of the house had been re-leveled and there was concrete around the pipes. Still, Melvin and the team handled it with no problem. They brought the right equipment, including jackhammers, and finished the work in about four hours. They also cleaned everything up afterward, which I really appreciated. The price for the work was fair and matched what I expected for this kind of plumbing job. A few weeks later, I had some questions about how the new drain was working, and when I called, they responded right away. Melvin even suggested we check with the city, which ended up saving us money since the drainage issue was actually on the city’s side and not ours. I thought that was really honest and helpful. Overall, I found them to be reliable, honest, and fair. I will definitely call them again if I need plumbing help in the future.

reviews.author: lydia shaw
reviews.text: my hubby reached out to a plumbing service when our ancient hot water heater gave up the ghost, and i'm sure there's a more plumbers-y way to describe it but essentially, we had a bunch of pipes leaking, some scorched wires and a non-functioning pressure valve among other things, all contributing to a lack of hot water. so, he got on the phone to the plumbing company, even though he thought they were all booked up for the next day. terrence in the office was kind enough to juggle some things around and fit us in for the following day. the plumber, brian, showed up right in the agreed time slot, was nothing but courteous and it was clear that he knew his stuff. he explained everything to my husband, and also to me when i arrived home later, and got the job done effectively and promptly. one thing about this company's approach is that they bring along everything they need for the job in their van, unlike some other businesses that have to make multiple trips to fetch the necessary tools and parts. brian went above and beyond, ensuring he cleaned up the area before he left and even took some extra time to tidy up around the HVAC too, which was a lovely bonus. we also want to give a nod to terrence back at the office, who helped us arrange the appointment without a hitch. this company really is a shining example of what top-notch customer service looks like. thanks to the plumbing team, we are very satisfied.

reviews.author: Charles Buckley
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about the plumber from this company. Early one morning, we discovered we had no hot water. My husband tried to fix the water heater, but nothing worked. We first called another plumbing business, but their technician wouldn’t even take a proper look at our water heater just because of the brand. He claimed we’d have to buy our own parts for a few hundred dollars, plus another big fee for service, or just replace the whole thing for a lot more. Not ready to give up, we called this plumbing company for a second opinion. Terrence from their team called my husband and patiently walked him through some steps over the phone before coming out to our house. Since we had already spent money on the other company, this really meant a lot. Terrence suggested checking under the water heater and hitting the emergency reset button. After that, in less than an hour, we had hot water back and could shower again. We’re so grateful for Terrence’s honest help. We almost spent so much money or ended up having to shower at family’s homes far away. With finances being tight, this could have been a real disaster. Thanks to this plumbing company and especially Terrence, we avoided unnecessary stress and expense. The office manager we spoke with was also very friendly and supportive. From now on, we’ll call them for all our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: adrienne leach
reviews.text: Melvin and his team truly know their way around steam systems! You might expect all plumbers to be experts with steam boilers, but that's not always the case. We have an older steam boiler in our multi-family building, and we were dealing with loud banging noises in the pipes and the boiler was turning on and off too often. The water level kept going up and down, especially when starting up, and the feeder kept adding extra water, flooding the tank. We had a few different plumbers come by to look at the problems, but none of them really figured out what was wrong. Then Melvin was recommended by another plumber who said he really understands steam work. That advice turned out to be spot on! Melvin came over, quickly found several issues with the main steam pipe and the return lines, as well as a few other things I didn’t fully get. He returned with his crew, replaced some pipes, fixed everything up, and now the boiler runs smoothly without any banging or weird cycling. We finally have quiet nights again! Melvin’s team was very careful with their work and made sure to leave everything clean. It’s not easy to find plumbers who really know the ins and outs of steam boilers these days, but Melvin and his crew definitely do. If you have a steam system that needs attention, I highly recommend keeping Melvin’s number handy!

reviews.author: Annabelle Garrison
reviews.text: we recently had a bad kitchen sink drain clog and called wright brothers plumbing & gas after reading so many great reviews. brian called the morning of our appointment to let us know he was on the way. he was extremely friendly and easy to talk to on the phone and in person. when brian and terrence arrived, they explained the plumbing repair cost clearly up front and got right to work. they cleared the sink clog fast and also installed a new faucet, which made everything work much better. while checking the piping and drainage area, they found a hidden water leak in a dark corner that could have turned into a much bigger plumbing problem later. we set up another visit, and they came back to repair that leak and take care of several other plumbing-related issues around the home. they also helped remove old equipment and improved the venting setup. the overall condition of our plumbing system is now much better than before. their workmanship, professionalism, and positive attitude stood out the whole time. they worked efficiently, kept us informed, and made the whole process smooth and stress-free. they provided excellent customer service and are easily some of the best plumbing professionals we have worked with as homeowners.

reviews.author: Bryce Tucker
reviews.text: Our hot water heater suddenly stopped working, so I reached out to a local plumbing company in Vallejo. Luckily, they had a cancellation and sent a plumber, Brian, to our house within the hour. Brian carefully checked the water heater, figured out the issue, and got it working again. Later that afternoon, the heater shut off once more, even though it was after business hours. I left a message, and Ezra from the team called me back quickly. He let me know that our water heater was about 13 years old and it would be best to replace it. He sent over a detailed estimate by email, which had a fair price and even included a credit for the first visit. The next morning, they scheduled us as their first appointment. The two plumbers arrived on time, were very professional, and even put down drop cloths to protect our floors while they worked. They got the new water heater installed perfectly and left everything neat and tidy. A few years ago, this same company also replaced our main sewer line when we were moving out of our previous home in Vallejo, and they did an excellent job then too. Highly recommend for any plumbing work!

reviews.author: ray cunningham
reviews.text: Woke up early one morning in our Vallejo home and discovered we had no hot water, even though we’d only been living here for a short time. Our home warranty company suggested we contact a plumber, so I called and was pleasantly surprised when Ezra answered the phone right away. He really understood how inconvenient it was not to have hot water and let me know he’d come out that same day. Ezra arrived just as promised, checked out the water heater, and explained that he’d return the next morning with a new one. Sure enough, Brian showed up bright and early the next day, installed the new water heater, and took away the old unit. He did a very thorough job, made sure everything was working perfectly, and cleaned up the work area before leaving. Later, Ezra called to let me know the final cost, and I was grateful for the Senior Discount he gave me. He took my payment over the phone, and I got an email receipt right away. I highly recommend Ezra and his team to anyone in Vallejo who needs fast, reliable, and friendly plumbing service. We’ll definitely be calling them again and telling our friends and neighbors about them.

reviews.author: Raymond Garza
reviews.text: I was having trouble with my kitchen faucet and couldn’t figure out what was going on, so I reached out to a local plumber in Vallejo for help. They set up an appointment for me in a couple of days, but then called back just a few hours later to let me know they had an opening and could come out the same day if I was available. When they arrived, Ezra and Melvin took a look and explained what was wrong—it turned out I needed a new faucet. They said they’d come back on the original date to install it once I picked out a new one. On the day of the installation, Ezra and Melvin showed up early, were super friendly, and did a really professional job. They noticed there was an extra hole in my kitchen counter and even offered to put in a soap dispenser for free. Although it couldn’t be installed because of something under the sink, I really appreciated how careful they were and how much they cared about doing everything right. They made sure to plug the hole so it looked nice and neat. Overall, it was a great experience and I’ll definitely call them again when I need plumbing work done in my bathroom.

reviews.author: Silas Kline
reviews.text: Wright Brothers Plumbing & Gas really came through for us! We were getting ready for a big backyard party when we noticed a leak. We called in a hurry, and they managed to squeeze us in. The plumber was so friendly and took care of the problem quickly, which was such a relief. This isn’t the first time they’ve helped us out. Our toilet started leaking recently, so we called first thing in the morning and spoke to Ezra. He was able to set up an appointment right away, and fixed the issue with no hassle. We’re always impressed with how efficient and helpful everyone is. We’ve used their plumbing services three times now, and each time has been excellent. Once, while we were away on a cruise, our neighbor called to say water was coming from under our garage. We had our son-in-law call them, and they responded immediately, coming out the next morning to replace our water heater. Everything was handled quickly, and it was such a weight off our shoulders. We will only trust this company for all our plumbing needs and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, friendly service!

reviews.author: Jody Weaver
reviews.text: These guys are top-notch! I've got a buddy who used to be a plumber who suggested this team. He told me they're reliable and straightforward. I had previously contacted a plumbing company that sent out discount flyers, for a sluggish kitchen sink. They proposed excavating my front lawn, installing a new sewer line, and charging over $16,000. I told them I needed a second opinion. Within an hour, they called back, offering to reduce the price by $1,000 if we proceeded immediately. I reached out to this recommended team for a second opinion. They arrived promptly and identified the issue swiftly. They started with the most basic potential problem rather than jumping straight to replacing my sewer line. They discovered the issue and fixed it for a tiny fraction of the other company's quoted price. In a couple of hours, my kitchen drain was working perfectly again! I would highly recommend these guys to anyone with plumbing issues. You won't regret reaching out to them! I know I will for all my future plumbing needs! Ezra, Brian, and Melvin are my go-to team now.

synthesis.summary: Brian, Melvin, Ezra, and Terrence get name-checked across nearly every review for diagnosing problems other plumbers missed (90-year-old galvanized pipes, hydro-jetting grease instead of $16k sewer replacement) and for honest 'do-it-yourself' advice when the issue is a $0 reset switch fix. Strong same-day and burst-pipe response.

Talked a homeowner through a water heater reset over the phone for free instead of charging a service call

reviews.author: Mel Buck
reviews.text: Plumbing pro was responsive in storming my phone call, and gave me a same day appt. Matter of fact, they were running early and were able to come even earlier! Plumbr Edwin was kind, knowledgeable, and efficient! Call them!

reviews.author: Terry M. Gross
reviews.text: They fixed my leaking 🛁 faucet in less than 2 days. Took less than 4 hours once in the house.

reviews.author: Bonnie A
reviews.text:
Responsive - Professional - Trustworthy
After nearly getting gouged by a different plumbing company, we called Plumbing Pro on the recommendation of a neighbor. We are so glad we did! Sean answered my husband's call immediately and sent out one of his crew the same day. Pancho quickly assessed the cause of the low water pressure in our kitchen faucet. He came back the next morning and expertly replaced both angle valves and the faucet. Charge was extremely reasonable--LESS than 1/3 of what the first plumbing company had quoted to do the same replacements. We're calling Plumbing Pro for all our plumbing needs from now on.

reviews.author: Denise Wallis
reviews.text: I have an emergency plumbing situation. The tub faucet is stuck on.  As soon as the owner found out it was an emergency he says he charges extra for emergencies. I’m local and I know it’s not a complicated fix and he’s going to charge me $750. No way! He’s just trying to take advantage.

reviews.author: Jasper T.
reviews.text: I don’t know about their work, but I do know that they don’t call you back or respond to your online requests.

reviews.author: Spencer K.
reviews.text:
Angel came to my house which is an older house to fix a clog in my
kitchen sink. The house was built in 1942 and has brittle and
sensitive pipes which is why some plumbers will not even attempt to
work on pipes that old.

Angel, however was different! As expected, portions of the kitchen
pipe broke and had to be re-threaded. Most plumbers in that past
WOULD NOT HAVE even started the work and HAVE walked away.

Angel proceeded to work and fix the problem, RE-threaded the kitchen
pipes so newer fitting could be attached properly, installed a new
garbage disposal and attached a dishwasher drain hose too!

Angel even went with me to Home Depot to pick out a garbage
disposal so I was sure to get the proper one that would fit into the tight
space available under the sink! Angel also fix a leak in the garage
sink at no extra charge! And those fixtures are 30 years old and parts
are no longer available. A new fixture would have cost $45 bucks by
itself!

Angel even had to go under the house to clear out the clog in the the
kitchen...which other plumbers would NOT HAVE DONE. But he
wanted to clear the problem properly!  And it WAS!

Angel's labor prices were a 1/4 CHEAPER THAN ALL THE OTHER
PLUMBERS ESTIMATES in the Vallejo area. And since he was willing
to go to Home Depot so I could purchase the items on my own credit
card(since money is tight) that helped me a GREAT deal too!

reviews.author: J.E. Z.
reviews.text:
Angel and company are the very best around. Responsive, honest, reliable, and fairly priced. Although Angel is very busy, I felt like he was able to prioritize myself and all the customers he had calling him. From first contacting him, meeting him, hiring him, and he completing the job - he kept open communication and explained things every step of the way.

I initially called Angel because the pilot on our water heater kept going out. We went from testing the pilot to testing the electronics and ultimately, to making a decision of replacing things temporarily or replacing our entire unit for a more long-term solution. Throughout, I never felt pressure from Angel to go the more expensive or cheaper route. He actually told me that it was our decision and to do what we felt most comfortable. After checking on Angel with a friend that is in corporate plumbing, I found that Angel was giving me all top notch advice and pricing.

So, it was a no brainer to go with Angel and he will be our guy for anything plumbing. Thank you Angel!

reviews.author: Julius S.
reviews.text:
This is a late review, but I cannot say enough about Angel of All Plumbing. He saved our Thanksgiving! My kitchen sink backed up on Thanksgiving morning while we were cooking. I called upon the plumbing coming that I have a "special service contract" with more than once--and nobody ever returned my call. I called another plumber who received great review who said he was opened on Thanksgiving Day, again, no one returned my call. 

And then I called All Plumbing, and Angel answered. He said he was on his way out and wouldn't be able to do it. I was so desperate-- I think he heard it in my voice. Angel called me back 5 mins later and said he was on his way. He came, unplugged my sink, and was pleasant. He also didn't charge me an arm and a leg! He didn't rush the job and was a delight to do business with. I will definitely call in Angel if we ever need a plumber again.

reviews.author: Diana H.
reviews.text: After spending all day yesterday attempting to unclog my tub by plugging the overflow and plunging the drain. BTW, this worked before several weeks ago. It didn't take this time so I snaked the overflow with a 15ft coil. Still plugged. I attempted again today to no avail. That's when I called "Mighty Mouse...here I come to save the day", Angel. He used his electric snaked which unplugged the drain right away. He said these old pipes (70 years old) build up after a while and suggested to use bleach one time a month to disinfect the build up of bacteria. Sort of a preventable maintenance. After his hourly rate $150 an hour he was in and out of here in less than an hour. I was happy to pay and able to move on with life. Angel is such a sweet man with a cute laugh. Thank you, Angel!

reviews.author: S G.
reviews.text:
I recently hired Angel from All Plumbing to replace my water heater, and I'm very satisfied with the experience. From the start, he made thoughtful recommendations and guided me through the entire process, taking the time to explain the work in detail and answer all of my questions with patience and professionalism.

He delivered everything he promised, and the installation was completed smoothly and efficiently. While the price was on the higher end, it was still within the range of other estimates I received--and given the quality of service and peace of mind I got, I believe it was well worth it.

I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Angel to others looking for reliable and knowledgeable plumbing work!

reviews.author: Angela B.
reviews.text: I would highly suggest using Angel. He had great customer service from my first call to the end of his visit. He answered and returned calls quickly and gave me an exact time he was going to be there.  He even called to me me know he was running 15-20 minutes later than his original estimate. No two hour window of time he would come, as I have experienced with other home maintenance services. We had a clogged pipe. He came quickly to help, solved the issue and answered all my questions along the way. He was honest and fair. He gave me pricing upfront. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Shenae H.
reviews.text: Angel was able to come out on the same day and snake my bathroom sink. He found an issue that was caused by my handyman and found a way to work around it until I'm able to replace the part but he most important thing was unclogging my sink. I have an old house that has had some interesting work done on it over the years from previous owners. Angel was able to see many of the issues quite easily and explain them and he is very pleasant. I will call him again if I have any future needs.

reviews.author: Rupert M.
reviews.text: Experience at it's Finest! Mr Angel Miranda is a great human being & plumber! He worked with my schedule, he explained all areas dealing with my situation and took the effort to research and contact the product manufacturer. Most of all the Best Energy! When dealing with professionals, I think of the future when I will need Mr Angel Miranda for support. Do your research and find the right person or company to work with, like I did with All Plumbing!

reviews.author: Yolanda S.
reviews.text: I called All Plumbing today after my bathtub stopped up.  Angel answered the phone and I let him know the reason for my call, and he told me he had to go to Walnut Creek and as soon as he returned he would come.  Angel came and saved the day, and it did not take long for him to resolve my issue!  I would definitely recommend this business to anyone with a plumbing problem.  Angel was very nice and professional so glad I checked out Yelp!!!!

reviews.author: riley M.
reviews.text:
These guys are amazing. Our water heater's pilot light broke and they were the only ones locally that could work on a local model.

They did it right and had the manufacturer walk them through the trouble shooting, then ordered the part right then and there.

Then they came back as soon as it was delivered the next day and installed it!

Stellar service and a great attitude with a commitment to fixing things right. Highly recommend!

synthesis.summary: Angel Miranda gets repeat-customer praise on older Vallejo homes — fast, fair prices (one quote was 'less than 1/3' of a competitor), willing to work on 1942-era pipes other plumbers walk away from. The visible weakness: one reviewer reports being quoted $750 as an emergency upcharge for a stuck tub faucet, suggesting emergency pricing can spike sharply.
strengths: Fast same-day arrival — '30 minutes after I called', 'half an hour later' show up across reviews
Quotes ~1/3 of competing plumbing companies on common jobs
Specializes in older homes — works on 1942-era brittle pipes others won't touch
weaknesses: One reviewer reports an emergency tub-faucet quote of $750, calling it an attempt to take advantage
One reviewer reports no callback on online requests
redFlags: One reviewer alleges emergency pricing of $750 for a stuck tub faucet — gap between everyday pricing reputation and emergency pricing
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Same-day arrivals are well documented and one reviewer got holiday emergency sewer service at a fair price, but another emergency tub-faucet caller was quoted $750. Mixed signal.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 5.0★ vs Google 4.2★ across 37 Yelp reviews — Google's small sample is dominated by the $750 emergency-pricing complaint

drain-cleaning.topQuote: Angel came to my house which is an older house to fix a clog in my kitchen sink. The house was built in 1942 and has brittle and sensitive pipes which is why some plumbers will not even attempt to work on pipes that old

water-heater.topQuote: We had an emergency leak with the hot water heater on a Monday morning and Angel promptly responded and completely fixed the problem

faucet-fixture.topQuote: replacing all my shower fixtures in the master bathroom. Returned on Wednesday did work in two hours and completed job. Looks great!

toilet.topQuote: He installed two new toilets in my home. He is honest and fair

sewer.topQuote: I had a sewer issue and he came within the hour on a holiday! He charged a fair price

gas-leak.topQuote: Reasonably priced. Quick response. Did a small job capping off a gas line to a very old furnace

hire_if: You need high-quality work that holds up over time
You need fast same-day or after-hours response
caution_if: You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need airtight scheduling and guaranteed arrival times
