plumbers.address: 2107 Stirrup Dr, Round Rock, TX 78681, USA

reviews.author: Hardheaded Jay
reviews.text: Great plumbing technicians with a tone of experience. They are also very patient to answer all your questions

reviews.author: mickel caicedo
reviews.text: Mike provided excellent service, and we couldn’t be more satisfied. He worked through some tough conditions while staying calm and friendly, ensuring our issues were fully resolved. His expertise and attention to detail were evident as he clearly explained our options and kept us updated throughout the process. While their pricing is on the higher side, the quality of service made it well worth it—I’m a happy customer!

reviews.author: Xander
reviews.text: I had an exceptional experience with The Round Rock Plumber! They were incredibly prompt, arriving right on time and getting to work immediately. What stood out most was their attention to detail—they didn’t just fix the issue but took the time to explain what caused it and how to avoid it in the future. Their professionalism and friendly demeanor made the whole process stress-free. Highly recommend them for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Joshua Wood
reviews.text: Not a Round Rock company, someone who barely spoke English from a call center hung up on me when I asked if they were actually in Round Rock.

reviews.author: Mary O.
reviews.text:
Amazing service from locally owned business

I found Plumbsy (Kyle) thru an app that allows local plumbers to provide estimates based on pics/description of work needed.  I got more than 1 estimate & compared reviews.  The "all 5-star reviews" on Yelp made me apprehensive at first, but they all seemed legitimate.  

We decided to go with Plumbsy, based on - Kyle's clear & fair estimate, the review standings for other businesses, & his understanding what we were looking for despite my laymen's descriptions (convert our 60/40 sink into a single sink, under mounted, oil rubbed bronze faucets etc.).  Note:  Some of the other candidates were only interested in selling us water softener systems or didn't convey any confidence in understanding what we needed.

It took about a week for the parts to arrive & Kyle scheduled with us for a next day install.  It was painless & the after is stunning.  Thank you so much for the amazing work.  I love having a new kitchen sink & faucets to start off the new year right!

reviews.author: Christopher J.
reviews.text: A major yard line leak appeared in our front yard Saturday morning. After a Google search,  I scheduled emergency service with another company that afternoon.   When the confirmation email arrived, the appointment was a day later than discussed.  After seeing a number of bad reviews and accusations of price gouging, I was feeling sketchy about things,  so  I submitted a project request in Yelp, and Kyle was the 1st to respond with availability that weekend, and I'm so glad he did!  I immediately booked the Sunday morning appt. and canceled the one I had with that other plumber.  Kyle did a great job repairing the leak caused by questionable installation design and shifting clay soil.   I am very pleased with the work and the price seemed quite reasonable.  I will definitely be contacting Plumbsy if I ever have another plumbing problem here.

reviews.author: Martin W.
reviews.text: We recently purchased a new home and were looking to install a water softener and filtration system. We had spoken with other companies and so glad that we went with Plumbsy. Kyle took the time to answer all of our questions in detail before we made a decision. He walked us through all of our options and really took the time to make sure made a fully informed decision. He showed up right on time to install our system, did meticulous work and walked me through every aspect of his work and our new system. We ended up adding an RO system and new faucet on top of our original project based on our conversation the day after them install and are so happy we did. Kyle was awesome to work with and I would highly recommend using Plumbsy. On top of all this, they were also better priced than other quotes we received for the same work.

reviews.author: Gulay B.
reviews.text:
As a Realtor in Austin, I work with many vendors, and Kyle is one of the best plumbers I've come across. He was referred by my neighbor, and after using him for my personal home, I now confidently refer him to all my clients throughout Austin and surrounding areas.

Kyle is always on time, professional, and gets the job done right the first time. He quickly diagnosed the issue and fixed everything efficiently. His pricing is very reasonable, which is important for both homeowners and my real estate clients.

If you're looking for a reliable, trustworthy plumber in Austin, Texas, I highly recommend Kyle. He's someone you can count on, whether it's for your home or for real estate needs.

reviews.author: Eric B.
reviews.text:
I had a pool valve/plumbing issue that the pool company said needed to be fixed by a plumber. I did the usual Yelp shout out and Kyle from Plumbsy was one of the first to respond. The time from response to my door was probably less than an hour! Amazing. 

Kyle was super down to earth, gave me a quote on the spot (which was cheaper than what I had received from another larger company) and got everything fixed immediately. 

I really appreciated how responsive, friendly and reliable he was. Will definitely be my go-to plumber in the area since I love to support small local business. Give Kyle a shout if you need any plumbing work done!

reviews.author: Ryan G.
reviews.text: I gathered seven quotes to get my water heater replaced, and I went with Plumbsy. I have zero regrets. Kyle was quick to communicate, has extensive experience, and is passionate about doing the job right. The "other guys" were either much more expensive or showed a lack of customer understanding, experience, and care--not worth the risk of getting someone to have me buy the parts and sloppily put it together. I will be reaching out to Plumbsy if I have any other plumbing issues, as their service exceeded my expectations. Kyle, in particular, was very personable and knocked the job out of the park. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: C R.
reviews.text: I submitted a request for a quote. Told them what I needed, the parts I had. It was preventive maintenance. Lowe's or Home Depot will tell you how much installing or replacing a toilet would be.. well Plumbsy was the only company who provided a flat free quote. Straightforward. I don't know why other companies don't do that. Everyone would understand that there may be other charges but as shoppers we want to see who offers competitive prices. I only hire companies who offer flat free prices BASED on what customers described. Quality work, reasonably priced (plumbers charge more than electricians!)

reviews.author: Baron V.
reviews.text: I was advised by the City of Round Rock Water Utility that I had a water leak to the house and I needed to contact a plumber to repair. I can not say enough good things about Kyle C from Plumbsy. In a day and age where we have grown accustomed to sticker shock for home repairs it was a pleasant surprise to not be punched in the gut with another ridiculous quote. Kyle was quick to get to the property, assessed the situation, provided a quote, began repairs and sent status pictures along the way. Absolutely phenomenal service and I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: John And Nikki G.
reviews.text: Finding a professional, especially with plumbing, can be very intimidating. We are blessed to have found Kyle/Plumbsy when we had an emergency water heater replacement. He communicated quickly and provided exceptional service at an unbeatable price point (I had 3-4 other quotes). Kyle took the time to explain potential causes of the failure, as well as walked us through how to avoid them going forward. His knowledge and patience was above and beyond my expectation. He's easily on my speed dial for any other plumbing needs in the future!

reviews.author: Kalina K.
reviews.text:
We had a small water leak and worried about the repair cost and finding a good plumber. I am glad we chose Plumbsy. 
The customer service was friendly and professional. The owner, Kyle Cosby, did a great job fixing the leak. It wasn't easy because he had to penetrate the concrete of the side walkway and deal with galvanized pipe. Other plumbers would give up but Kyle found the correct connecting part and finished the job. 
We appreciate Kyle's work ethic, honesty, fair price and professionalism.
We highly recommend Plumbsy!

reviews.author: Dasha L.
reviews.text:
Truly an awesome company.
Honest,   fast, reliable.
I asked for a quote to disconnect the water softener. I got many responses that first they needed my address to see the unit, even though I posted a picture. 
Plumbsy, 
John, the owner gave me the lowest flat rate without game playing.  And without "we need to see it first "
 The next day they arrived on time and took care of business. No game, no inflated price. Honest, straightforward.  
 I highly recommend this company and will use them for all my needs in the future.

synthesis.summary: Effectively a one-man show (Kyle / 'Plumbsy') with a perfect or near-perfect record across 31 Google + 61 Yelp reviews. Repeat-customer mentions, Sunday 9pm dispatch, water-heater installs done same-day on Saturday morning, and explicit comparisons against 7 other quotes coming back to Kyle. The lone 1-star is a Google reviewer who reached an unrelated call center — likely a misdial.
strengths: Same-day and after-hours response specifically called out — 'I called him 8pm on Sunday evening, And he arrived 9PM,' Saturday morning water heater install within 2.5 hours of calling
Reviewers compare Kyle against 4-7 other quotes and consistently choose him on price + quality
Repeat customers ('return customer but this time for a PRV valve,' 'used them again') cite transparent flat-rate pricing
weaknesses: Tiny operation — turnaround during peak demand depends on one person's availability
Pricing called 'on the higher side' by one reviewer who still gave 5 stars — quality justifies it for them
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple after-hours dispatches confirmed in reviews — Sunday 9pm, Saturday morning emergency water heater, within-an-hour Yelp request response. Strong emergency track record for a small operation.

reviews.author: C D
reviews.text: I hired Advanced Plumbing Heating and Air to replace a shower head, and two bathroom sink faucets. Jamaul and his colleague arrived on time on the day they were scheduled to come (a weekend, which worked well with my schedule). They came right in and evaluated the bathroom fixtures. They went over all of the options I could choose from, and answered all my questions. I had initially inquired about also replacing two sinks, however, Jamaul let me know that changing my sinks could cause me to have to change many other things, like the mirror on my wall, dry-wall, and more plumbing. He let me know that the sinks were in good condition to keep-which saved me money. He also kept safety a priority. When evaluating the faucets, he and his colleague discovered that my emergency shut off valves were not working (which makes sense because they are over 20 years old). They were able to replace everything including the valves, and the price was great. Jamaul and his colleague worked hard from start to finish. They had excellent customer service and communication. I would highly recommend Advanced Heating and Air!

reviews.author: K C
reviews.text: From start to finish, it was a good experience. I had a 30 year old natural gas unit that was on its last legs. Daniel came out to inspect it and told me what I already knew was coming, I was on borrowed time. We were able to schedule Mark to come out the same day and go over new units with me. I had already known I wanted to upgrade to a heatpump system amd Mark was great at explaining the differences and patiently answering my questions. We were able to schedule the install within 3 days. Chris, Justin and another gentleman whose name I didnt get all were wonderful. They were fast, efficient and very polite. They also cleaned up and didn't leave a mess. Everything went great and I had a new unit within the week. Special shout out to Enrique who was also great at quickly answering my questions via email and helping me out as well. Thanks a bunch to the whole APHA team!

reviews.author: Trish Collier
reviews.text: The best experience ever.  The receptionist was wonderful and Ivan the gentleman who came to my house was exceptional.  The friendliest and most professional gentleman ever.  He even went to Home Depot with me to pick up the new toilet. The experience was second to none and I highly highly recommend this company for any of your plumbing needs.  Please recognize Ivan for his exceptional performance.  He installed a new toilet and unclogged the main area that almost flooded my house.

reviews.author: robert anderson
reviews.text: Overcharge me did only half of what they charged me for left me with sheet rock repairs a backed up system, which they had to come out and unplug the waste and vent work. They said they were gonna do. They didn’t do they trashed. My carpet would not recommend them to anyone and I paid $9500 for this work.

reviews.author: Larry D.
reviews.text:
Nearly three months ago, I paid Lee's Sheet Metal $140 to review my existing HVAC set-up and provide a quote to improve the performance of the A/C to the top floor of my house.  Despite over a dozen follow-up phone calls and emails, they never provided the quote.  Each time I spoke with either Tiffany or Angela, they assured me they were "working on it" that day and would "definitely" have it for me by "end of day."  

Total rip-off.

reviews.author: Karen Obi
reviews.text:
Advanced Plumbing Heating and Air exceeded my expectations on many levels. My thermostat died on Easter weekend! Called and had Arlen at my home in 30min to help me out. Arlen ( HVAC Technician) had me back in business quickly with a repair on my AC unit, blown fuse and thermostat revival. He did, however, inform me that my Furnace was not looking so good and that some attention would be needed before winter. He explained to me in detail the issue , took pictures and even invited me to take a look for myself in the attic ( I did). Not the news I was anticipating. The following week, at my request ,  I had Alex ( Project Manager) come and spend an entire afternoon with my husband and I , to explain our options in regards to our furnace , along with other items I had expressed interest in to improve the function of our home. He was patient , informative and thorough in making sure we understood our many options available to us. I never felt rushed , influenced one way or another or uncertain of any aspect of our next move. The following week I had Rene and his team come and install a new HVAC system. They showed up on time and ready with floor protection for the many trips back and forth from my attic. Each team member was able to answer any questions I had, the job was completed within a few hours, and when done they cleaned up any boxes , old unit debris etc. It looked as though I had not had work done ( except for my new AC unit in the backyard which is whisper quiet!!!) Rene walked me through my new equipment , gave me a tutorial and also provided me with ample pictures of the work done. Finally , the following day Advanced Plumbing Heating and Air installed a new water softer / filtration unit . Again the job looked great! ( Sorry I can’t remember the technicians name).
I feel I clearly made the right call to this local company in Vacaville ( Female owned 😉) to take care of my problems and make things right again!!
Thank You

reviews.author: Maricel Reguindin
reviews.text: Advanced Plumbing is top tier. Not only is it a mother and daughter owned company,  their customer service  is impeccable. They listen to their customers and are straight forward, no sugar coating. They do their analysis, provide an explanation of what needs to be repaired and why,  and breakdown their recommendations and different options they offer. We have the annual membership and they notified us to schedule an appointment which is great because I would've forgotten- so that's a plus they have their clients in their books and remind them of these services. Alex checked our HVAC system and he gave us the analysis of what needed to be updated. He provided numbers and he was able to work with us based on our budget. Then we scheduled an appointment to replace our system and have a more energy efficient system installed later that week. Chris, Bobby, DeAngelo and Gabriel came to install the new system. Not only were they friendly and professional, they were very respectful and asked if it's okay to enter other rooms or use outlets to get their work done. While they were doing doing the installation, they all worked as a team and communicated well with each other from what I observed and seen as they did their thing. They did an amazing job and did everything so promptly. They worked diligently to get the work done and cleaned up afterwards. Once everything was up and running, they showed me how to use the new system and how to use utilize it using the app on my phone. All in all, Advanced Plumbing does it all. They work hard to get the services done and they show customers that they care and ensure that they are in good hands. I definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Joseph Klucarich
reviews.text:
I just wanted to express my appreciation for the Moen Roman Tub valve and trim replacement job that Ivan and Miguel and the entire team at Advanced Plumbing and Heating and Air completed for me last week.

Like most jobs it turned out to be a lot more difficult than we had planned. In order for the valve and trim to be replaced and access had to be cut through 2 inches of tile, concrete, and chicken wire not to mention having to deal with the extreme heat.

The initial appointment was fast and they had a plumber at my residence in only a couple hours. Getting the valve and trim for this tub had a couple twists and turns which resulted in having to reschedule the final installation appointment several times. This was not a problem for the scheduling staff, they were wonderful.

To help me determine the correct valve and trim for the job they put me in touch with a local expert that provided me with the information I needed.

As for the price, I thought it was a good value for the work performed. I’m not just paying them for their time but also for their expertise and they came prepared.

I felt that they cared about my situation at that time, and also their other customers I heard them talk about and that impressed me.

reviews.author: Maricel Reguindin
reviews.text: Advanced Plumbing was a lifesaver. They came through to take care of our plumbing issues when two other plumbers gave us the run around. Ivan was assigned to take a look at what happened and he listened to our frustrations and he was able to explain what happened, what he was going to do to get our water going at least and then came up with a plan to resolve the issues. He was able to get us started so we can use the water at least and he came back in two days to replace the valve that was old and backed up, and replaced it with modern and approved parts. And Advanced Plumbing offers a great yearly service where they inspect your plumbing three times a year to mae sure things are up and running. That is top notch customer service in my opinion. As a first time home owner, we learn about our home as we go especially if the home is slightly older and need some tlc. Advanced Plumbing got the job done and helped us understand what was going on and explained what was needed to do. Big shout out to IVAN!

reviews.author: Ettie Stambaugh
reviews.text:
Regrettably, my air conditioner stopped working, and I needed to call for service right away. I’m incredibly grateful to Advanced Heating and Air for their quick response.

The representative I initially spoke with (whose name I unfortunately don’t remember) was exceptionally polite and courteous, which immediately gave me confidence in moving forward with their service.

I’d especially like to thank:
• Jake for providing an honest and accurate diagnosis
• Mark for easing my concerns about the cost of repairs
• Chris, Bobby, and DeAngelo for their hard work and dedication—spending most of the day carefully assembling everything and making sure everything was cleaned up before they left

Overall, I truly appreciate the professionalism, efficiency, and quality of service from the entire team.

reviews.author: Katie Emlen
reviews.text:
We recently had a new heat pump and air ducts installed, and I can’t say enough good things about this company and their team. While there was a small hiccup during the process, they truly went above and beyond to make things right—and did so without causing any additional issues, which we really appreciated.

From start to finish, they were responsive, communicative, and incredibly easy to work with. Justin, Deangelo, and Donovan were all professional, kind, and respectful of our home. It’s clear they take pride in their work and care about their customers.

It’s rare to find a company you can fully trust, and this is one of them. We’re so grateful for the way everything was handled and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for HVAC services. A wonderful team all around! :)

reviews.author: Janet
reviews.text:
It is my pleasure to give Advanced Plumbing Heating and Air a 5 star review. From start (receiving quotes) to finish (new ducts installed) they have been extremely professional and friendly. Phil and Rene' came out to do the work. They communicated with each other every step of the way, asked if I had any questions, explained in detail what they did, and vacuumed any areas of the floor that had insulation, that had fallen off the tarp.
I highly recommend Advanced Plumbing Heating and Air to anyone looking for A+ service and affordable quotes.
Thank you Advanced Plumbing Heating and Air!

reviews.author: Greg Buechler
reviews.text:
I need 10 stars!!! We had a true emergency last week and we were unable to get an approved vendor from our home warranty on the phone after hours or over the weekend.

So we sent out requests to multiple shops and hoped. Advanced Plumbing responded within an hour, on a Sunday!!! A tech was in our garrage, old out, new in, we had hot water just a few hours later. From the very first call they showed increadible compassion and professionalism.

There are simply not enough words to express how appreciative we are of this company and how they far exceeded our needs.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text:
After many years, it was finally time for us to upgrade our AC and furnace, and the team at Advance Heating and Air took great care of us. Alex came out the same day, walked us through all our options, asked thoughtful questions, and made the entire process simple and stress-free.

The installation was completed just a few days later by Bobby, Chris, and Gabriel. They took their time, made sure everything was working perfectly, and were professional throughout. Overall, it was a great experience, and we’re very happy with the service we received.

reviews.author: D.J. Burton
reviews.text: My water heater went bad and Jamaul got me squared away with a replacement without issue. He explained all the work he did before and after and ensured I was all set when the work was complete. From the time they arrived it was less than 2 hours to diagnose the issue, get the parts from the shop, and complete the replacement. This is my 3rd time using Advanced for either plumbing or HVAC related issues and I haven’t been disappointed yet with their service, and I’m always happy to spend my money with a local business.

reviews.author: Chelsea Parkinson
reviews.text: Alex (and Dwayne) have been absolutely wonderful to work with. During a really stressful time, when we were horribly overcharged by another company, Dwayne gave an honest perspective and immediately made me feel at ease about the path forward. Alex was no different! He came out to do several work items for us, including having our homeowner's shutoff valve replaced, and he thoughtfully explained everything he needed to do and would recommend, without trying to upsell. Honesty is what wins long-term business, and these guys get that. 100% recommend and will continue to do business with JustUs Plumbing. Thank you all so much!

reviews.author: Judy Abernethy
reviews.text: I would like to recommend Justus Plumbing for any plumbing needs you have.  I have used them twice recently and both times I had same day service, they were prompt, and took care of the issues to my satisfaction.  Also they are reasonably priced. I’m sure I will use them in the future for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Rhonda Belam
reviews.text: We love these plumbers!  We bought a water heater from them a year and a half ago.  They did a great job so when we needed a plumber for a couple issues we had in the house we called them.  Christopher came out the same day.  He was very courteous, knowledge, informative and found our problems.  He had to come back, the supply house was closed.  He came back and fixed everything!  We would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Tom T.
reviews.text:
Beware, this company lied and stole my money, they did not complete the work but still billed me for it!

I paid Just Us to replace a back flow valve on my pool and two brass valves on my tankless hot water heater but they stole my money and did not complete the work. 

They quoted me around $700 to replace the brass valves or $100 if they could just replace the rubber inserts. They replaced the rubber inserts, did not replace the valves, then charged me the full price of replacing the valves.

When I talked to them they lied and said they did, but the old valves were still there... new valves were not installed.

I called several times and was told over and over that the owner would call me but they never did.

When I disputed the charges they lied to the credit card company and said all work was done. Now I have to go through the hassle of taking them to court.

Stay away from this company!

reviews.author: Tara L.
reviews.text: I was very happy they were able to fit me in the same day because I had called 4 other plumbing companies with no calls back. I have a faucet with very poor pressure and a leaky shower handle set. JustUs sent two very young guys to my house. Neither one of them knew why I was having the pressure problem and said it's because of hard water build up. My house is 2 years old and it seems unlikely. He told me to buy a new "filter" from Moen. The word he didn't seem to know is "aerator", so I did. It didn't fix the issue. The second child told me there was a manufacturers defect in my shower handle set and suggested I return it to the store. I asked him to try tightening it and he's was visibly shocked and proud of himself when tightening the nut actually worked. Maybe I should've specified that I'd like LICENSED Plumbers to come to my home, but didn't realize that was necessary. Oh, I also got to pay them $39! I guess that was a deal?

reviews.author: Joe A.
reviews.text: This is my first and likely only review as I'm not the type to write reviews, but the service from JustUs Plumbing was so much better than anyone else, I felt like others should know about this company.  We had a small leak in our Navien tankless hot water heater...  Had another plumbing company take a look at it (for $260) where they determined a leaky heat exchanger.  Two days later, the leak started gushing out of our attic.  The original plumbing company offered to come out to replace the heat exchanger (which had now filled up the entire unit with water and shorted out the electronics) for another $260/hour at an estimated 3 hours of labor.  Of course I said no because at that cost I might as well put a down payment on a new unit and the process was not likely to work now that the whole unit was fried.  After going through several (at least 3) different plumbers and having been without hot water for over a week, I called JustUs plumbing.  Duane and his assistant came out to look at it and from the start I could tell they were willing to work with me and do whatever it takes to get the hot water flowing again.  They replaced the Heat Exchanger (at Navien's request) at a very reasonable rate compared to the other quotes I was getting.  When that didn't work, Navien sent out other parts one at a time, all to no avail.  It would have potentially cost thousands of dollars to have these parts installed, but Jarrod and Duane were amazing at working with me and not nickel-and-diming me to death with every attempt.  They put the customer (me, my wife and five kids without hot water for almost 2 weeks) first.  They went out of their way on the Saturday morning before Easter to work with their local Navien representative (who was also amazing) to bring an entire older unit out and start replacing parts until it worked.  They did this all at a very reasonable cost.  We had hot water that morning and I couldn't have been happier with the overall service.  JustUs Plumbing went way beyond what I expected.  I will be referring anyone I know to them and will continue using them.  If you are looking for a quality plumbing company who puts the customer first, I highly recommend JustUs Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jim G.
reviews.text:
My daughter set up an appointment with these people because their kitchen sink wasn't putting out any hot water.
  He came out and gave her a quote and said he needed to get the parts and would be back the next day to fix it.
  He was there for about 3+ hours (and his boss kept calling him to see what was taking so long) he finally told my daughter he couldn't figure out the problem (again he'd already been there the previous day, supposedly assessed the situation and given her a quote)
  He told her he was sorry that he took so long but he was going to have to charge her for his time anyway, really?
  She agreed, but told him not to take it out till Friday when she got paid, needless to say they took it out immediately, leaving them with pretty much nothing for the rest of the week.
  I apologize for being so long winded but after they charged her almost $300 for not doing a damn thing I just wanted anybody and everybody to know DON'T DO BUSINESS with these thieves.
  Not to mention she pretty much had to take 2 days off work for all this.
  By the way my son in law went down to the Home Depot and bought a new faucet, hoping that would fix it, guess what?
  $125 HOT WATER 
  Shouldn't a PROFESSIONAL PLUMBER been able to figure this out?

reviews.author: Scott D.
reviews.text:
Called for service on a Monday to repair shower faucet. Dispatch promptly(in 2 hrs) sent someone over. I was relieved, no water in house. Tried to repair leak, wasn't able to.. left me the option of capping pipe so water could be turned on or replacing shower fixture. Bill estimated at $400, this is for 1 hour. Shower replacement quoted at $1600. Stupid of me I decide to have the shower replaced. Tech disappears for hours. Returns with supplies
No new faucet/diverter. 
Replaces valve, puts old diverter back on because of time restraints. Would assume he'd return to replace with new part. Only thing concerned about is getting their money, charge you a fee for credit card use. 
Shower not properly working and I've no confidence at their effect rate of $ 400 an hour I can afford to have them finish the job. They obviously lack the integrity to do so in the first place. 
This isn't a company concerned about a business relationship, they're smash and grab plumbing at its worse. Don't believe 5 star reviews, they're bogus. 
Don't trust anyone who won't give you an itemized detail of their work, it's always hiding something. 
New name, JustUs out to screw you on your plumbing. 
We never put your crises over our profit.

reviews.author: Charles T
reviews.text:
All day yesterday I was trying to fix a leaky toilet water valve in my bathroom to no avail. My inability to fix it caused me immense stress and frustration which boiled over onto my wife. She told me I needed to contact a professional plumber ASAP so I reach out to JustUs Plumbing Services. I spoke with Dwayne and we talked for a few minutes. He was happy to answer all my questions but I soon realized I needed to swallow my pride and let the professionals take over. Dwayne sent over 2 of his plumbers Alex and Karson. They were extremely polite and understanding and got right to the issue/s. What I struggled with over half the day Alex and Karson accomplished in no time flat. They took all the time they needed to be sure everything was completed and that we were 100% satisfied. My wife and I couldn’t have been any happier and vowed to contact them immediately if a plumbing issue arises in the future.

Thank you so much JustUs Plumbing Services!!!

reviews.author: Matt C.
reviews.text: Dwayne and JustUs is great. Had an old kitchen faucet that needed replaced and he came the day after I called him to replace and install it. He quoted me a flat rate over the phone which was nice, and even though the faucet was completely rusted in and took a lot more effort to take out than what is probably typical, he still only charged me the flat rate he quoted me. I ended up having him install a new water softer system the same week.  Price he charged for the softener and installation was very affordable for the quality of system put in and he even did it on a Saturday so I wouldn't have to miss any work. I won't hesitate to recommend JustUs to friends, family, and coworkers in the future and plan on using them for all of my plumbing needs from here on out.

reviews.author: Dennis M.
reviews.text: Justus really helped me out when I was in a bind.  They made my situation a priority over the Christmas Holiday weekend on a day when they were normally taking off.  I had an outside leak that they had to isolate and repair.  It was not an easy job as the leak was about one foot below the surface, behind shrubbery and next to the house foundation.  And, it was on a copper pipe and the hole was the size of a pin head.  The found the leak without damaging the scrubs, and did a repair all within about 3 to 3 1/2 hours.  The price was reasonable and you could tell they placed a high priority on providing excellent customer service.  I will definitely used them again for any of my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Sean H.
reviews.text: From the initial call, to follow-up that was just necessary... this company is the real deal! I own a small business so I understand the daily struggles of not only customer service, but quality service as well. I had an issue that we did not know if it was a "Just Us" issue OR a "pool company" issue. The technician went above and beyond the call of duty... the issue is in the process of being resolved, but I had to write this because of the follow-up and the follow-thru... all the "big chain" companies need to understand that these guys are going to knock this industry around AND take it it over! Just some local guys that are veterans, getting it done!

reviews.author: Terry Billiter
reviews.text:
Just us Plumbing is the only call I my water bill was through the roof, the city said call a plumber because we had a major leak on the property. Chris came out and thoroughly checked inside and out to rule things out. He sent Alex out to do some more work and leak detection. They found the leak and repaired it,  now I can take the invoice to the city.
Alex was amazing trying to give me the best price on work they did for 3 days, I am very thankful.
My home warranty (HomeSafe) denied the claim and the entire amount came out of my pocket.

Thank you Just us Plumbing!
It’s nice to see there are still companies that take care of the customer.

reviews.author: Lauren P.
reviews.text: If I could give 10 stars, I would. Dwayne and Chris were incredible. They came out to my home for an assessment right after I'd moved in, and they let my dad help from afar via email to setup some projects and upgrades around the house. They also provided me with materials for a new water softener and educated me about the water in the area. We had an appointment setup within a week. Chris competed all the work (it was A LOT) without complaint and went above and beyond. My dad was in town and Chris was very patient with him, allowing him to be involved and ask plenty of questions. Thank you so much to this team for the work you completed.

reviews.author: DeeDee H.
reviews.text: Its been years since I've had to get a plumber out and needed one for an outside water leak. JustUs came highly recommended by neighbors on both the Pflugerville neighbor pages I'm on on Facebook. I was not steered wrong! I initially talked to Dwayne and he got me set up with an appointment thru Nicole, the first thing next morning. Jarrod and Preston came out right on time and quickly assessed the problem and quoted me a fair price. They both were super nice and so polite. They made a stressful situation so much easier and the job was finished in a couple of hours. I  definitely will use these guys again and highly recommend!

reviews.text:
Horrible, Bad, Poor workmanship.
Had them return a second time to correct problems. Did not correct issues.

American Home Shield terminated their contract to do work.
AHS had to compensate the new plumber $600.00 to correct issues.

reviews.author: Yousif Del Valle
reviews.text: Quote was twice as much as competitor rates.

reviews.author: Pasquale J.
reviews.text:
Not sure where to begin because so much happened.  I got a bid for a tankless water heater from them and a few others. They seemed competitive and I had the impression they knew what they were doing. Under the pressure of a leaking hot water heater in my attic, I decided to go with them. They were busy and it took them a while to get to me. Thank goodness the water heater didn't open the flood gates and ruin my ceiling. They were supposed to do the job on a Saturday, but put it off for fear of rain that didn't happen. They came and took out the leaking water heater. I had two so they ran a pipe to the working one (great idea). On a separate evening they came back to do the install. The problems were: the owner put his foot through my bathroom ceiling (this could happen if you're in a attic), one of the plumbers dripped solder through the hole and all over my kid's sink and tooth brushes, they couldn't figure out how to get the water hot at most of the taps, the owner got after his guys to clean the bathroom and they did a lousy job, they were there till after 11pm and were yelling and really loud with my kids trying to sleep on a school night, they drained my old water heater into the drain for the washing machine (ok) but forgot to put the washing machine drain hose back (not ok) and I flooded my floor when I washed clothes, the owner wanted to leave the thermostat inside the screwed down panel of the heater (no way to adjust it that way), they turned off the gas to my hot tub and didn't turn it back on, there were a few other irritations but you get the idea.

They did have a painter come to fix the ceiling at no charge. That was appreciated but then I had to coordinate with another contractor and be there while he fixed it. They also sent another one if their plumbers to work on the hot water heater, who made adjustments to it and tried replacing the cartridge on some of the showers. It kept getting a little better but not what the owner or the manufacturer said I would experience. With a tankless you should get hot water "in seconds" and it shouldn't run out. I went with Rinnai because they advertise a separate recirculating line is not needed. I think my problem was the owner and his merry band of circus clowns didn't understand completely how the product works (even though they are certified by Rinnai). The manufacturer kept telling me it must be a bad install. But in order for it to work, you have to set the timer to recirculate the water so it can be instantly hot at the tap. They never did that. On the inspection day, the inspector said the install looked correct. Their better plumber did take the time to call Rinnai with me to discuss the under performance.  I programmed the recirculation, and the best result I can get is the water from my shower starts to get hot in 20 seconds (not 5 like promoted). My conclusion was it would work better if my house was built for a tankless or had the recirculation line. Rinnai has an ability other units don't, so it works ok (more like a traditional water heater). 

Overall, the was expensive and painful. They get one extra star for sending the best guy they had to straighten things out.

reviews.author: Edward T.
reviews.text:
One day my daughter noticed water stains on the ceiling of her bedroom. Right away, I knew right way where that was coming from. There were 2 tank water heaters in the attic above her bedroom. Upon climbing into the attic to inspect, I found one of the water heaters was leaking at the top where the hot water exits the tank. Right away I called a plumbing company to get an estimate on replacing water heater. The first company that came to the house suggested tankless water heater to replace both 20 year old tanks. So, I started Google searching for the best tankless heaters. After that, I called three other plumbing companies to get their recommendations and estimates. Two companies that came to the house said I needed to remove the pull-down stair case assembling in order to get both tank water heaters out of the attic.  A third company said to leave the both 50 gallons and 40 gallons tanks in the attic. For the fourth company, I called Austin Area Plumbing (not to be confused with "Austin Area Pluming and Drain Cleaning). Technician Garrett Beshears showed up. He went to the attic to inspect. He came down and said he could remove both tanks without tearing down the pull down stair case, thus saving me extra work and cost. 

The first company said it was my responsibility to hire a roofer to install the heater's inlet/exhaust vents going through the roof. The third company said they could run the PVC vents thought the existing metal cylinders. They said  when the PCV pipes touch the vent caps at the top they would lower the pipe a few inches. However, Garrett said it was not recommended because rust and debris could fall into the tankless water heat and cause problems later. He said he would run the pipes through the roof, put and seal the collars around the opening on top of the roof.  

Both tank water heaters had 1/2" gas lines. Three companies said they would use one of the existing gas line to supply gas to tankless heater and cap off the other gas line. Garrett said the tankless heater requires 3/4" supply line. A 1/2" line is not good enough. He said since the main gas line is 1.0", he could connect to it with a 3/4" line. 

The model of the tankless units I was looking at came with a recirculating pump. One company wanted to charge me $200 for crossover tee to speed up hot water delivery to fixtures.  There was no extra charge for this tee from Austin Area Plumbing.  The cost estimate for the tankless water heater plus installation from 3 companies was comparable. But one company was $3,000.00 MORE for the same unit and work. And it had good reviews! 

Garratt had to work in the attic and on top of the roof when it was super HOT. I felt sorry he had to work under this condition. But he NEVER complain and NEVER took short cuts to finish and get the hell out from the heat!! He was extremely professional, as his work, and very accommodating. He did whatever I wished. He did a superb job!! He is a hard working guy!

I know this review may be very lengthy but I want you to know my experience with several companies with good reviews. But it's the technician that's doing the work that can make or break the company's reputation.

reviews.author: Kalpesh G.
reviews.text:
Reasonable, Honest, Professional and Courteous Plumber!

Over this past weekend on Saturday, Nov 11th, a neighbor alerted me to the fact that water was running down our driveway at a pretty high rate.  I had hoped the issue was with sprinkler system, but sadly it was with our water main between the meter and our home.  I spent most of Saturday afternoon and all-day Sunday trying to locate the leak in our yard with countless hours of digging.  
 
Finally, on Monday early afternoon Roto Rooter came out with specialized Sonar equipment to narrow in on the leak.  They helped find a copper pipe (house side) and PVC pipe (yard side) that met under a poured concrete sidewalk to access our backyard.  And then provided me an estimate of nearly $4000 to perform the repair, which would take approximately 3 hours.  I just couldn't believe the price.... so, I turned them down.
 
I spent the rest of Monday and most of Tuesday was focused on digging under the sidewalk to find the transition point between PVC and copper, which happened to be the point of failure.  I also contacted two (2) different plumbers recommended by friends for estimates.  One was willing to do the work at hourly rate and a fraction (less than a third) of Rotor Rooter but still pricey for what I knew needed to be done.   The other was Dennis with Austin Area Plumbing. 
 
I called Dennis on Monday late afternoon, and he spent time with my on the phone hearing about my saga, the work I had done to uncover the leak, expose the pipes and reduce the repair work.  He even looked at pictures I texted him to get a sense of the issue.  In the end, Dennis said, the more you can do to minimize my work, the more it will save you.  He was a man of his word!  Dennis put my on his schedule for Wednesday around noon.  On Tuesday, Dennis checked in with me on my progress and if I could still use his help, which I did.  Finally, on Wednesday, he showed up promptly around noon with txt updates of his heading my way.  Upon arrival, Dennis surveyed my preparation and acknowledged that I had done all the "HARD" work in digging and exposing the issue.  He proceeded to cut out the damaged pipes, discuss the pros and cons of two options with me, and then proceeded with an agreed to plan-of-attack.  We agreed to use PEX with copper-to-PEX fittings on the house side and PVC-to-PEX fittings on the yard side with a slightly bowed 1" PEX tube under the sidewalk to restore the water supply.  After a little over an hour he was done, then we just had to wait for glue to cure and then test the repair. 
 
Finally, the moment of truth... water turned on and no leaks... Hooray!  In the end, Dennis was the best option for us and the more reasonable price.  I cannot thank Dennis with Austin Area Plumbing enough.  He is a true saint! 
 
If you need plumbing work done professionally by an experienced plumber with reasonable rates, look no farther - Call Austin Area Plumbing!

reviews.author: Kickie D.
reviews.text:
Our Handyman referred us to these guys and I cant thank him enough. 
I had called 6 different plumbers prior and gotten some outrageous quotes to put a PRV on the system to our new home, those quotes ranged from 7/800 to 2000 dollars. 

The receptionist I was in contact with ( I believe her name was Amanda but I am really bad with remembering names if I dont see a face) was super pleasant, very helpful and returned calls within minutes of us leaving a message. I asked her a few questions - she admitted to not being sure of the answer and said she would get with one of their technicians and call me back shortly. Within 10 minutes she called back with all the info we needed and a general range price wise of what we were looking at ( I really admire that someone doesnt bs you when they dont have a clue what you are talking about- I loved that she called someone to find out the answer so we were getting the right info.) Their price range was well under any of the other plumbers we spoke with and on top of it they offered to come look at the system and give us a more personally adjusted estimate. Not one of the other plumbing companies we contacted out of the 6 offered a free estimate. I set up and appt for the estimate and a very nice gentleman named Justin came out. 
He gave me an estimate for 461.95 - my jaw dropped after what we had been getting quotes for, I asked when we could schedule and expect the work to be completed- his reply I can be here tomorrow morning and have it all finished for you. YES PLEASE!
We had them come out the next morning for the work and upon digging up the appropriate spot in the line Justin found a busted valve, he informed us and called the City of Austin to have it fixed immediately. Justin and his guys waited for the City to come out( which took a few hours)and fix the necessary components then completed our work. The price for work done was exactly what we were quoted. 
I like that they didnt just say oh well and leave to rebook us another day, they also let us know if the new pressure wasnt working out they could come and adjust it for us if we needed at no extra charge.
Now we know who to call for plumbing and I couldnt be more thankful to Justin and the crew

reviews.author: Kenya Graham
reviews.text:
You will call Round Rock plumbing and get some other plumber that you didn't bargain for.

I called early on a Saturday morning with the knowledge that a plumbing supply store (Feguson) would be closed by midday. I knew that I had a water heater that need to be replaced, because I had replaced three others in the span of 15 years. Not many were actually open. Round rock plumbing was my second call as the first call to Crow Plumbing had me go to an answering service.

While Round Rock Plumbing, at least who I thought was Round Rock plumbing, was responsive and answered the call directly and immediately told me that they could be to my house, they improperly diagnosed this situation, which I was very skeptical of what they thought their solution was. And it cost me almost $360.00. The company that showed up was Fast Fox Plumbing Whose service personnel took a quick look at my water heater and saw a condensation on one of the supply lines. And ascertained that all of the water that was coming from the water heater was more than likely from the supply line. I've vehemently opposed their thought process, Because of the amount of water that had increased over two nights, and there was no active drip coming from the water supply line.

They drained the drip pan dry and I agreed to change the water supply line only because they said, if it wasn't the cause, they would wrap the cost of it into a water heater replacement. Immediately after changing the water supply line they saw that the drip pan was full again and was quickly able to find the root cause of the drip being from the tank itself. Then they quoted me a figure of about $2300 to change the water heater. I was in deep skepticism of their work and their ability to even properly diagnose the situation as well as be honest with me when I told them that the water heater was the problem. I paid them and let them go, and ended up going with Crow Plumbing whoI was very happy with. The cost to me from Crow Plumbing was $1850 for a 10 year tank which I don't think I would have gotten from Fast Fox plumbing as they were dependant on Ferguson Supply.

reviews.author: Melissa J.
reviews.text:
It was my worst experience with this company. My texas rental house's Rinnai water heater displayed error code 11, and I found this company through the Rinnai website.

The first technician came to my house on June 12, 2024, spent only 15 minutes diagnosing the issue, and charged me $219.95. This fee included a mileage charge, which I was not informed about when making the appointment. Initially, I was pleased that the problem seemed to be fixed. However, two weeks later, the same error reappeared. When I called the company, they informed me that since the first technician had left the company and there was nothing wrong with his job, I would need to pay again for a different technician to come.

I reluctantly agreed, given the recommendation from the Rinnai website. The second technician arrived on July 16, 2024, advised me to perform a water flush, and charged me another $353.95. He eventually identified the issue as a faulty pressure reducing valve and provided a quote of $1,469.95 to replace it. The frustrating part was when the second technician left, the front desk demanded immediate payment, threatening additional charges if I didn't pay right away, as the technician couldn't leave otherwise. I told the front desk that the technician could leave and I needed time to pay.

Feeling mistreated, I called the front desk to express my dissatisfaction with their urgency and rudeness. They directed me to speak with the director, Melissa. Melissa insisted that the first technician had done his job correctly and acknowledged that the front desk shouldn't have been so pushy. This made me feel somewhat better, so I asked her if I could get a discount on replacing the valve. She said it might be possible and would get back to me later. However, when I followed up with a text message asking about the discount, I received no response.

Right now I think the company is ridiculous, I paid the company not a specific technician, it is none of my business that the first technician left the company. Be careful of this company!

reviews.author: Hilga J.
reviews.text:
This review is so late! But last year we noticed a wet area outside the front door. In July. After a few weeks of hoping it would go away, and then a couple more weeks of ignoring it, we finally determined as responsible home-owners, that constantly wet dirt in July/August was a sure sign that there was a big, horrible plumbing problem that needed to be fixed. 

The first two companies that came out spent 5 minutes looking at the wet spot before telling us we needed to get the whole house replumbed. Uh, NEXT!

By the time the third guy came out, a few days later, it was clear that the problem was a leaky water supply line because there was a veritable fountain of water shooting out from the side of the house. Aha! But then he tells us that he just moved here from California and still doesn't have all his tools and basically puts a bandaid on the leak and tells us "good luck" and then I paid him a hundred dollars. (I found out later he was not even licensed in Texas! If I'd looked closer, I would have noticed all his excellent Yelp reviews were from people in CA. Ugh. Dick.)

Finally I find Austin Area Plumbing and Andreas comes out and fixes the big huge job the same day. The big huge job involved digging out and replacing the whole supply line. It was 6 hours of work for two guys and involved them having to use a jackhammer or something. It was amazing. 

And the icing on the cake (and the reason I am writing this now) is their customer service! Now, a year later, the house is on the market and I need proof that the repair  was done. Of course, I threw all my home-repair receipts right into the trash as soon as I decided to sell the house, like "Whee!". But I called AAP and Mandy went above and beyond to track down the original invoice and email me a scanned copy and save my ass. Thanks, Mandy!

reviews.author: C D A.
reviews.text:
Well, found myself in quite the pickle on a Sunday afternoon. We had our house releveled on Friday and Saturday afternoon I noticed water running from under the house while the wife was in the shower. As that day was her birthday and we had plans, I had to put the repair off until the next day.
So, I find myself on a Sunday needing a plumber and dreading what the charge was going to be.
I'm really getting to the point that I rely on Yelpers for referrals, and once again I was not disappointed.  Read some very good reviews on Austin Area Plumbing and decided to give them a try. Called them around 7am and he said he could have someone out by noon. Noon rolled around and had not heard from anyone. Called the office back, and he was very surprised I had not heard from the tech. Hung up, and heard from the tech two minutes later. He had assumed my area code was 512 and had been calling the wrong number. Was not distressed by that as it has happened before. Blake showed up around 2pm and crawled under the house to take a look. My sewer drain had broken due to the house being raised. Blake got everything fixed back up and even looked at the rest of the drain lines while I ran water in the kitchen, bath, and flushed the toilet. He even put extra screws in the skirting around my kitchen drain lines.
Great service, very positive attitude by the tech, and folks, I was only charged $145.00 for a Sunday, rush repair job.
Needless to say, Austin Area Plumbing now has all of my future plumbing business.

reviews.author: Charlotte W.
reviews.text:
Our water heater busted and was leaking the day before yesterday, but I didn't realize it until after work and after hours. I drained it and shut off the water intake line & gas to keep it sound until we could get someone out. I called Austin Area Plumbing yesterday to get an estimate at about 11:30a on my lunch (I have a very busy work schedule) and Blake Byrd was out to my house within a couple of hours and ON TIME! He was very helpful and efficient, explaining to me what we needed and provided an estimate. He was willing to work with me on getting us what we needed and within our budget. He was patient with me, explaining anything I asked thoroughly and with kindness - which is fairly rare these days in customer service! He got the water heater replaced same day and STILL took the time to show me how to light it and if any emergencies occurred, where the valves were for cut off (even though I probably could have figured it all out on my own, I asked to have him run me through it and he happily did!) and what the process would be. He reminded me it's best to flush it once yearly and that if there is anything at all I needed, to call him and he'd be there to help. Blake Byrd not only won our business yesterday, but I have delightfully found myself a new plumber that is fair, responsive, and helpful and I am just over joyed that I had this experience! My faith is restored!
THANK YOU BLAKE BYRD AND AUSTIN AREA PLUMBING FOR ALL YOU DID FOR OUR FAMILY YESTERDAY!

reviews.author: Tyler W.
reviews.text:
Dennis and his crew are amazing. We bought a fifties home that was largely original and haphazardly repaired when it came to plumbing. We had them gut the house and start from scratch. They did our 2.5 bathroom house from the city main all the way back in 8 days, including gas lines. 

His crew was knowledgable and courteous. We had odd requests such as "socks only inside" as our wood floors were drying at the same time. They worked around other crews and obliged every request we made. I am PICKY when it comes to contractor work, and my ONLY complaint is a single spigot outside is a bit loose. On a project that big, to be my only complaint is incredible. They truly did an amazing job. 

Price. That is always important. Dennis was more than fair. He quoted the best price of the six or so we called to look at the job and gave me a ballpark, but suggested we do hourly plus cost of materials as we would likely come out cheaper that way. In the end they ran into some hicuups and it went passed the ball parked figure, Dennis wouldn't take a penny over that price even though it wasn't a quote; we had agreed to hourly.  He truly is an outstanding and honest guy. 

They even loaned me a few tools to dig for a fence I was building at the same time and gave me some pointers. We are about to add some gas appliances and I cant wait to give him more business to come run the lines. I can't say enough good things about the plumbing work they did.

synthesis.summary: Round Rock Plumbing's reviews split almost evenly — when Curtis or Dennis show up, customers describe fair prices, fast response, and honest diagnoses. But several recent reviews flag a different pattern: $960 bills for failures-to-diagnose (Rinnai error 11 fixed by the customer himself), $1,600 in 2 hours, hidden 'elevation fees' on attic water heater installs, and ghosted appointments. One Yelp reviewer points out 'most of these reviews are fake' which our pattern-matching also flags — duplicate Google reviews appear in the sample.
strengths: Specific named techs (Curtis, Dennis, Justin) get strong individual praise — Curtis came within an hour of an after-hours holiday call
24-hour emergency availability mentioned in multiple reviews
weaknesses: Hidden fees — 'attic install' quote that didn't mention a $150 elevation fee until the techs arrived
Failed Rinnai tankless diagnoses: $960 across 3 visits and 5.5 hours, customer ultimately fixed it with a free YouTube fix
Quote-twice-as-much complaint: 'Quote was twice as much as competitor rates'
redFlags: No-show / canceled-without-notice appointments reported in multiple Yelp reviews
Home warranty contract terminated by American Home Shield over 'horrible, bad, poor workmanship' per one reviewer
Duplicate reviews in the sample (same text appears under both 'google-places-initial' and 'google' sources) — a Yelp reviewer explicitly accuses the company of fake reviews
Disputed gas line installation: 'no clue what the regulations were... never filed a permit with the city, didn't paint the lines, and didn't pressure test his work'
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Curtis showed up within an hour of an after-hours, post-Christmas Sunday call to fix a hot water heater leak — strong signal. Dennis cleared a clog within an hour. But other reviewers describe being ghosted on emergency calls, and a Saturday water-heater leak forced one customer to wait until Monday.

reviews.author: jennifer baker
reviews.text:
Rick from The Plumbing Two is hands-down the most responsive and reliable plumber we’ve ever worked with. He’s saved us on two separate occasions and has completely earned our trust.

When we had a major leak, Rick showed up the next day—on a Sunday—and quickly discovered the issue was far more involved than anyone had realized. We’ve had plumbing problems for over 15 years that no one could properly diagnose, but Rick and his crew tracked it down. They opened up the ceiling, rerouted pipes, cleared clogs, and replaced sections that were rusted and corroded. For the first time in over a decade, everything works exactly as it should.

The leak had caused significant water damage, so we had to bring in a restoration company. We were leaving town the very next day, but Rick completely handled the situation. We trusted him with a house key, and he coordinated daily visits with the restoration crew, keeping us updated through frequent texts. His communication was exceptional.

Rick also personally showed up to the appointment with our insurance assessor, explaining everything, and sharing videos and photos.

Every time a new issue came up, Rick managed to get a full crew onsite immediately. He and his team were professional, respectful, and detail-oriented—cleaning up after themselves, protecting our belongings, and treating our home with care.

Later, when the restoration company couldn’t reassemble things or reconnect our washer and dryer, Rick and three of his crew were back at our house within 90 minutes. He personally made sure everything was reattached, tested, and leak-free before leaving.

Rick truly goes above and beyond. He’s responsive, friendly, and absolutely dedicated to getting the job done right. If you’re looking for a plumber who cares and delivers quality work, The Plumbing Two is the company to call!

reviews.author: Alexander Ha
reviews.text: I noticed I had raw sewage coming out into the backyard at around midnight and contacted The Plumbing Two because they were one of the few plumbing services I found that operated 24 hours a day. Rick arrived and cleared out the blockage but informed me that I had a larger issue than just the initial blockage. The sewage pipe was offset which required them to dig down 5 feet and perform a spot repair on the pipe. They found roots growing inside pipe as well and were very transparent about the whole process. All of this was accomplished in less than 24 hours and I’m very satisfied with their service and knowledge. I’ll be contacting them again on any of my future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Grace Agbekoh
reviews.text: Rick and his team were fast and fantastic. I would definitely use him again and reccomend  him to others. He answered and responded promptly to my call for assistance. He was able to assess and fix my leaking and loose pipes same day and in a couple hours. His service was awesome , communication excellent and price point great.

reviews.author: Joe Kang
reviews.text: Waste of time

reviews.author: Aly T
reviews.text:
Rick without a doubt is the most honest, fair, and reliable plumber I have encountered. I hired Rick for a toilet overflow at my home that I shared with my family. When I called he was there within 15 min. I was so impressed with his professionalism that I hired him for a job at my investment property.

What I thought would be a 15-20min turned into a fiasco that Rick was able to solve.

Rick not only responded at 4:30am in the morning, but him and his guys stayed on-site until the problem was identified until 9pm.

The plumber I hired to connect the sewer lateral missed an entire pipe leading to an overflow in all of the units and displacement of all of the tenants.

Without Rick, I wouldn't have had the evidence I needed to hold the previous plumber legally liable for the botched job.

Rick honestly goes above and beyond with his service and I've never seen any contractor have as much integrity as him. Rick takes pride in his service and I would without a doubt recommend you hire him for every job, small or large.

Long story short, HIRE RICK AND THE PLUMBER TWO!!! You won't regret it!!!

reviews.author: Mr. C
reviews.text:
I have hired Rick on two occasions and have always been satisfied with his work. When I discovered water leaking from the garage ceiling, I immediately shut off the water and contacted The Plumbing Two. Rick responded promptly the same day to evaluate the issue and quickly identified the source of the leak—a faulty pipe within the drywall. This was a significant project requiring removal and replacement of the damaged section with new copper fittings. Not only did they resolve the water leak efficiently, but the wall repair was completed to such a high standard that it appeared as though no work had ever been done.

The most recent repair addressed a leak emanating from the PVC pipe waterline connected to the hose. I contacted Rick, who responded promptly within thirty minutes. He replaced the PVC pipe with copper, which was the appropriate material for the situation. Rick consistently demonstrates outstanding professionalism and craftsmanship, taking the time to thoroughly explain the circumstances and present available options.

Thank you for delivering outstanding service

reviews.author: Davin Cox
reviews.text: Two days ago I heard water running but could not figure out where it was coming from. Yesterday, I came home from work and after checking everything around the house, I went under and yes, broken pipe. At around 8pm I began to search for a plumber thinking I'll just make some initial calls, leave some messages and hopefully someone would get back to me and be able to come by in a few days. My 1st call happened to be to Rick at the The Plumbing Two...it was my lucky day (or night). Rick said he could come by in 30-40 minutes (yes, that night), he was here in 10. Rick and his professional team assessed the problem, even had to run and get a part and was completely done with the repair by 9:30pm. If you are in a situation to require a plumber, I highly suggest you don't waste your time calling around and just call The Plumbing Two first. Oh, cost...I anticipated to be paying much-much more than he quoted, so Rick and Team cover all the bases: Quick, professional, knowledgeable service, done right the first time at a budget friendly cost. Thanks guys.

reviews.author: Ashley Santos
reviews.text: I was looking for a plumber for my grandma who was having an issue with a water leak that resulted in a really high water bill. Upon calling the Plumbing Two, they came within half hour and fixed my grandmas toilet quickly. A bonus was that they spoke Spanish, which my grandma appreciated since she doesn’t speak English. They explained that after their services, they would provide a receipt that we can give to the water company so she can get some credit to reduce her bill. I called them again today because my grandma wanted a taller toilet installed to help with her knee pain and they also came really quickly and finished their service within half hour. They are very kind and I really appreciate the help they provided for my grandma! The pricing was fair for the service they provided. Will definitely be calling them again for any future needs.

reviews.author: Christian Powell
reviews.text:
I've had a few jobs done by Rick and his crew, and each job has been excellent.  He's very knowledgeable and transparent about the process.
They had to install a new sewer line at my mom's house, after she had multiple other plumbers come over years and do substandard work.  He accurately diagnosed the problem, and ended up discovering the line had completely broken and needed replacement.  His crew worked around the clock to get the plumbing up and running, and he took photos of the entire job from start to finish.  He even took the time to walk her dog.  Just fantastic customer service.
After that I had him replace the water heater at our house, and his crew also remodeled one of our bathrooms, and did excellent work there too.
I can highly recommend them for any project you may have.

reviews.author: Rita Zulu
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience with The Plumbing Two Company! From start to finish, Marvin and Carmen (I hope I’m remembering their name correctly) were incredibly professional and kind. They took the time to thoroughly explain each step of the process and made sure I understood exactly what the issue was. Their honesty and transparency were truly refreshing, and their friendly, courteous demeanor made the entire experience stress-free. It's rare to find such exceptional customer service these days, and I genuinely appreciate how they went above and beyond. I highly recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services! Thank you Marvin and Carmen for your expertise and kindness! They are a great asset and representation of your company!

reviews.author: Su Wai
reviews.text: We had a major plumbing emergency late at night when our main sewage line got clogged, causing water to overflow in our bathrooms. It was a stressful situation, but thankfully, Rick came to the rescue on very short notice—after hours, no less. He was not only quick to respond but also incredibly knowledgeable and professional throughout the entire process. Despite the late hour and the mess, Rick was courteous, efficient, and even took the time to explain what was going on in a way that was easy to understand. He turned a nightmare situation into a manageable one. We’re truly grateful for his help and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone in need of a reliable plumber.

reviews.author: jay heady
reviews.text:
Just hire them!

Ricky is amazingly responsive, almost too responsive if that's even possible. It's so difficult to get anyone to respond these days that Ricky's interaction is really unbelievable.

He evaluated the job correctly and stuck to his original estimate.

Ricky's on the job communication was just as good. He sent pics and video of the entire job and the work looks great, and the water is flowing great.

On thing to keep in mind is they wanted to use zelle only and charged 4% to us a credit card. Not sure that would have made a difference to use them but it was a small surprise.

Thank you, The Plumbing Two!

reviews.author: Teena Trang Tran
reviews.text: We needed a new water heater put in ASAP since the one we had burst and was done. I found Rick's company and contacted him in the morning and he was there the same day! He was very professional,  honest, and straight forward. His price was fair, and his work he and his team did look great. Our hot water was back sooner than what we had expected. It's a great thing that we found him. He really helped us and also didn't overcharge us like other businesses did. I would definitely reach out again if we ever need some help! Thank you so much, Rick!

reviews.author: Deborah Carrie
reviews.text: I wish I could give 10 stars and here’s why.  My ceiling was literally falling in due to a sever pluming leak! I went online to find plumbers in my area and found The Plumbing Two.  Rick came over that night, made an honest assessment, provided a recommendation. I agreed with him, and they started working the next day. Rick and his team are amazing.  They came and did a complete pluming job, opening the ceiling, fixing the leak, and making everything look brand new.  I would 100% recommend Rick and his team. Thank You.

reviews.author: Reyna Harvey
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Rick from "The Plumbing Two," and I couldn't be more impressed with the service I received. Rick fixed/ replaced my water heater quickly, safely, and efficiently, restoring hot water to my home in no time. His expertise and hard work were evident throughout the entire process. Rick is not only highly skilled but also incredibly trustworthy. If you need any plumbing work done, I highly recommend booking "The Plumbing Two." You won't be disappointed!

synthesis.summary: Rick (Ricky) and crew are the rare 'actually 24-hour' plumber: midnight raw sewage, 6:15am Saturday arrivals, Sunday emergencies, Friday rainy night main-line clears. Pricing is consistently described as 'fair' or below quote, and multiple reviewers say jobs were done same-day or overnight with photos and video documentation.
strengths: Showed up at 6:15am on a Saturday after a 6am call about water running under the house
Cleared a midnight raw sewage emergency, then dug 5 feet to perform a spot repair within 24 hours
Sent photos and video documentation of the entire job to the customer in real time
weaknesses: One reviewer noted finish work was 'not good' — found a paint roller left in a can after a drain repair
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Reviews repeatedly cite midnight, 6am, Sunday, and rainy-night dispatches with arrival times of 10–60 minutes. Operates 24 hours and answers the phone live.

burst-pipe.topQuote: yesterday, I came home from work and after checking everything around the house, I went under and yes, broken pipe. At around 8pm I began to search for a plumber... Rick said he could come by in 30-40 minutes... he was here in 10.

sewer.topQuote: I noticed I had raw sewage coming out into the backyard at around midnight... Rick arrived and cleared out the blockage but informed me that I had a larger issue than just the initial blockage. The sewage pipe was offset which required them to dig down 5 feet

water-heater.topQuote: We needed a new water heater put in ASAP since the one we had burst and was done. I found Rick's company and contacted him in the morning and he was there the same day!

repiping.topQuote: Did an absolutely outstanding and speedy replacement of our old iron pipes under the house. They were quick and efficient having the job down in two days

toilet.topQuote: Had a seriously clogged toilet. Angel came over right away and quickly and thoroughly resolved the situation.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: Had an emergency situation on a Friday and rainy night... within 30 minutes they were able to clear the main line.

bathroom-remodel.topQuote: Rick helped us with a bathtub installation one day, and came back and did a same-day repiping of our vanity plumbing for our bathroom remodel.

hire_if: You need fast same-day or after-hours response
You need a plumber who actually shows up when scheduled
caution_if: You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need warranty-grade work on a complex or high-stakes install

the wall repair was completed to such a high standard that it appeared as though no work had ever been done.
Rick said he could come by in 30-40 minutes (yes, that night), he was here in 10.
Ricky is amazingly responsive, almost too responsive if that's even possible. It's so difficult to get anyone to respond these days that Ricky's interaction is really unbelievable.
