reviews.text: This company is awesome they came and fixed my sink problem for cheap an they told me how to prevent future problems. Tod was friendly and professional. I’m more than satisfied

reviews.author: wellsfamilyblue
reviews.text: great service Scott came right out did a beautiful job and now we can help with the drought again. I highly recommend him. good price too

reviews.author: Kim Leslie
reviews.text:
They refer out to preferred plumbing I called PP was told I would be put on the emergency list at no extra charge  about two hours later I get a call asking if I called yes two hours ago then nothing about  an hour and a half later I get a text asking to rate their service what service I am still waiting for a technician to come over. A total of FIVE HOURS later the technician calls can I meet him I said no gotta go to work been waiting all day I explain the problem there is water in the gutter and on the sidewalk he says oh it's just damp not too bad. Really the meter was spinning crazy
STAY AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY!!!

reviews.author: Victoria Bellone
reviews.text: I called for a appointment on Saturday and a gentlemen answered the phone I didnt no he was the BOSS!!! He told he was giving me an appt. for Wednesday DEC 23,2015 between 10and12 the plumber would be here WELL I'LL BE DAMN THE BOSS NEVER MADE MY APPT!!! SO THE WOMEN ANSWERING THE PHONE SAY SHE DOESN"T HAVE ME DOWN FOR AN APPT FOR TODAY BUT MAYBE SHE CAN GET SOMEONE OUT LATER TODAY BETWEEN 4 AND 6 BUT I TOLD I SHOULDN't have to pay for your boss Mistake!!! SO BASICALLY she told if i didn"t pay the higher rate then she couldn"t help me and hung up!!!  But before she hung up she did give me another number to a different plumbing company that was nice!!! And the first time i used this company they where great the plumber Chuck was wonderful really nice man new what he was doing and got the job done!! It took little bit longer cause the BOSS kepted calling him and asking what was he doing and when will he be done!!!!! REALLY DIDN'T THINK I WAS GOING TO HAVE ANY PROBLEMS THIS TIME BUT I GUESS THE BOSS DOESN'T NO WHAT HE IS DOING!

reviews.author: Carson B.
reviews.text: The quality of customer service with this company is slipping. I hope that you never get Gabriel as a technician. I have had this guy to my property twice. I complained about him after the first time he worked at my property because he is rude only to have them send him to me again. It is very confusing how sometimes this company charges by the hour and sometimes they try to bid the job. Be careful when they bid the job because the price goes up drastically. Gabriel almost walked off with my sink strainer. If I hadn't followed him to his van it would of left my property. For the cost of a visit the experience should not need to be micro managed by me. I had to ask him three times about it before he realized he almost did this. I was told blatantly by him that he could do the job in 10 minutes and the parts were under $10 but he needs to bid it or he will make no money. He kept referring to himself not making money. I don't know if the employees are paid by the job or the hour. Maybe they get perks for making the company more. I have no idea but he kept saying he makes no money which was odd. He kept really wanting to argue with me and I had to eventually just walk away. I have used this company for many years now. They have done probably a dozen jobs on my apartment building. My issue is inconsistent pricing based off of which plumber comes to your property. Something cost this amount one month and the next month it is almost double because they bid it. I know because I have a 12-plex and a lot of similar repairs come up over and over again. Your end price depends on how much of your time you want to spend debating with them. Talking to the receptionists is time wasting. They wasted a ton of my time. They pretend to listen and then all the info you give them about your scenario isn't properly explained to the manager. Finally got an email from Rick (manager?) who wanted to change my price and completely lost what I was frustrated with in the end even after going into depth to explain it to two receptionist. This company use to have a really good reputation for quality & customer service. It is all slipping now. The number one issues most people have with plumbers is they feel swindled by them. Most plumbers use the fact that somebody has to have a repair done soon to their advantage. This company use to not be like this but now they are exactly like this. Pressure sales. It seems just like so many things Covid has changed them. I'm going to try another company next time I need a repair. Hoping there is a better plumbing company out there. Hoping I can find somebody in this day and age that uses more technology to make the work on my end less. I'd like to be able to submit a job via a text or an app and follow it's progress via a text or an app. Instead I got to always pick up the phone and deal with a clueless receptionist that always needs to ask somebody else.

reviews.author: Diane L.
reviews.text:
I can't believe I haven't reviewed JR's Plumbing sooner. These guys are worth their weight in gold! We live in a mid century home with it's original plumbing combined with some Mcgyver-esque "improvements" the previous owners did over the years. The first time we used their services I found them on Yelp. Our situation was a clog, that turned into something bigger. It ended up being a major clog that required Scott going underneath the house and cutting out and replacing a section of pipe. And since he was here he also replaced the p-trap of our utility sink and a couple other small things that we asked for. The quote was reasonable, the service was excellent and the work is holding up well.

Then we had an incident where a disposable toilet brush got flushed down the toilet. Again, old pipes, old toilet. Cedric suggested it would be more cost effective to replace the toilet than try to repair. It was an old toilet, so no love lost there. Within a couple hours we had a shiny new toilet expertly installed. No mess left in the bathroom, great communication and again at a reasonable price. 

Then, last week we needed JR Plumbing once again for our little old house. Our water pressure went to absolute crap within the last month. Scott walked around and cleared the lines that he could in the bathroom sink and shower. But the kitchen faucet was too full of rust and corrosion to clear so he suggested we get a new one. I hated that faucet honestly, so within a couple hours he put a shiny new faucet. And also fixed a small leak under the same sink by replacing a corroded washer. Again our pipes aren't easy to work with. He put in a lot of effort getting the old faucet out which I appreciate. He also let us know that the only real fix at some point is to repipe. But there was no pressure from in the form of upsells or fear based sales tactics. Just honest advice. Which I appreciate so much. And having the new faucet and repairs done by JR Plumbing cost less than just buying a new faucet.

Lastly, it's very easy to make an appointment by phone. They have a dedicated person who always answer the phones and they are very quick to schedule an appointment when time is of the essence. (Ahem, one bathroom house). And they take Credit Cards. Which is great when you have a plumbing emergency. If I have to pay for a repair, it's always nice to get Amex points/miles out of it.

reviews.author: rilredd 2.
reviews.text:
While taking a shower the handle broke off before The water turned all the way off.  Water was then dripping through the hole from the missing handle.  Before calling Jr's Plumbing, home warranty and home owners insurance were no help.  For 3 days I had to use the kids shower and we had to manually turn water on and off from the outside because remember water was still running in my shower going into the wall.  Exhausted and frustrated, I called a few plumbing services who all thought I may have to take down the tile on shower wall to get access to the pipes, THEY WERE NOT AVAILABLE ANYWAY! 
I called Jr's Plumbing and they were able to come out the next day, however the first technician thought he could fix the problem but could NOT because a blow torch was needed. He did insure us that the company has a guy that works with blow torches and would come by the following day.  That's when Scott showed up!! He did disclose that when using the blow torch and working with a small opening that if something went wrong, they would not be responsible.  I literally had no choice but to give the go ahead.  
Scott is a professional blow torch handler because in less than 30 seconds he succeeded in getting the stubborn piece off with blow torch and was on his way to the hardware store to get me a new shower handle set.  
He was back in no time, replaced hardware, got it working, cleaned up after himself and thanked me for my patience.  What I paid for this service was way cheaper than taking the shower tile down and drilling through the wall.  And I was able to take a shower in my own bathroom after 4-5 days!

This company did not tey to scam me or  charge me some crazy price! I will def call again if needed.

Thank you Scott!!

If you think thats good, Jr's plumbing-Scott- came back out free of charge to look at my water pressure. OMG!!

reviews.author: Martin Y.
reviews.text:
Last August 25, 2015 , I needed a plumber for my restaurant in Vallejo . I found Christian Plumbing at Yelp . Very good reviews .the business name itself CHRISTIAN PLUMBING and their logo of the Holy Cross made me decide to avail of their services .

After a few hours I booked the service , Jasmine dispatched  Anthony to the site and checked the water heater . He billed us $500 and we paid him in cash . He said he will be back the next day to check on it again and bring with him the receipt . He came back as promised but he said the receipt will be emailed and gave us a business card . He never showed up.

I called Jasmine and told her the water heater wasn't fixed . And we needed a receipt. She denied having sent anyone but said she will tell Anthony about it .
Anthony came back the next day and assured us there was a warranty . He wasn't able to fix it !! 

We called Jasmine the other day . To my surprise she denied having had any transaction with us . And said there was no warranty as Anthony no longer works with them . 

I had to pay $88 per hour or $109 per hour if after 5 pm.
I agreed . She booked me the next day December 2 between 11 and 3 pm
. I waited but no one came . I called Jasmine and she said the technician came by 2X  but employees said water heater was working well .  She suggested I call Preferred Plumbing , who are much better . This pissed me off !! I smell something wrong . Owner is not aware there is another business going on in his business ! 

Be careful yelpers ! Don't be deceived by the business name , 5 star reviews and their Holy Cross logo . Pay by check or by card and get a written warranty !!

reviews.author: A R.
reviews.text:
Scott is the best!  I recently moved into a house in Vallejo that had a loose toilet and the home inspector said that it was possible that it could be caused by some kind of damage under the toilet.  Another plumber quoted me up to 450.00 for fixing whatever was wrong without even checking under the toilet.  Scott assured me that it wouldn't cost anywhere near 450 to fix and in fact quoted me 135.  He not only fixed the loose toilet, replaced the missing/broken parts but also took the time to walk around the rest of the house with me and explain what I could do myself to troubleshoot problems in the future.  As a first time home owner, you have no idea how relieved I was to get this walk through.  He showed me our water main.  How to cut off the water in an emergency.  He told me about the temperamental water heater brand that we have that is prone to having the pilot light go out and suggested solutions that would be easy for us to do ourselves.  He even checked our sump pump and explained how it works and how to check it. 

We talked about how I was drawn to call his company because it used to be called Christian plumbing and he told me a heartwarming story about how his employer runs the business without trying to overcharge customers.  For $135.00 I got a lot of helpful information, my toilet got fixed and I got a heartwarming story.  Sounds like a great deal to me.  My husband and I agreed that if we have any plumbing issues in the future we will definitely be calling these guys!!  If I could give them 10 stars I would!

reviews.author: William S.
reviews.text:
They could not fix my problem; so, why the 5 star?... because of the professionalism and people skills of the tech.  I believe his name was Scott, but i assure you he will remember me because of the situation.

It was a rainy day, my main sewage drain line backed up and i was calling everyone that i could find to come snake the line for me.... Scott (i think) was the only person that actually came out.  He showed up, to the unincorporated/county section of Glen Cove, and despite the rain, said "let's take care of your drain and get you flowing again"  (or something to that effect).  

Long story short, in his effort to fix my problem, he broke his new 300 dollar cable and was SOL because my line was collapsed; essentially, he had wasted his time for nothing as he could not snake my line.   

Ultimately, it became apparent that someone at the office misquoted me for the price of the job, and despite this, Scott (or the tech, if it was not a scott) was super courteous and respectful.  

Super kudos to this tech.  He deserves a raise!  Seriously!  Even though he didn't fix my problem, i will never call another plumber besides him, and I will refer him to all of my friends and family for every plumbing issue that reveals itself!

Great job man! If your bosses are reading this, print this and save it in his file for his next review; ALL YOUR TECHS SHOULD ASPIRE TO BE LIKE THIS TECH!

reviews.author: Ru B.
reviews.text:
An electrician doing work in my attic (slab foundation house) knocked a gas line and caused a gas leak. JR's P&D performed after hours emergency work. I called at 5:00pm and the plumber was on site at 7:30pm -- the same day!

After an initial assessment, he explained the overall plan and then as each step progressed, provided me an update on what he did and what he would do next. When PG&E arrived on site around 9:30pm to turn the gas back on, he walked the utility technician through everything he did and re-checked every gas appliance.

The attic crawl space is horrific (very narrow, gabling that impedes access, hot as hell, etc.) but the plumber, Derek, took it on like a champ and never complained, even when he had to cut out the existing hard gas line (with little or no room to saw the pipe or swing a hammer) and replace it with flex line.  He put his ALL into it and hustled! Not a moment wasted!  

Since the offending electrician was picking up the repair cost, the office staff were very helpful in coordinating his payment. Also, their dispatch checked in with me frequently, providing updates on the plumbers ETA from the time I called, around 5:00pm, until they arrived on site.

All told, he was VERY courteous, extremely respectful and even laughed at my jokes :-)  Nice, professional young man.  Great response time and good work performed.

reviews.author: David O.
reviews.text:
As a property management company we use JRs Plumbing for all our plumbing and drainage needs and we have always found them reasonable and reliable.  However recently I had the need for a plumber to repair my shower at home.   Having checked out the problem on You Tube I self diagnosed the problem as being a broken shower cartridge.  Of course I called JRs knowing the company.  They told me that the repair would cost between 450. -  550.00 inc.  I told them to go ahead.  Unexpectantly the plumber called at my house on Saturday(double time I thought but the job needed to be done).  The technician stripped the unit down and advised me that the cartridge was in fine working order but calcium was the problem.  He cleaned the unit, lubricated and gave me advice.  And only charged me the normal hourly rate.  Fantastic.

So not only was the technician professional, courteous and honest (he could have quite easily have ripped me off by charging me for a new shower cartridge something which has happened to me before with plumbers) but he was extremely reasonably priced, especially for a Saturday call out.

I might add that the technician did not know that I worked for the property company.

All in all I would whole heartedly recommend JRs Plumbing for price, professionalism and service.

reviews.author: Stevie B.
reviews.text: 01/24/22- Kitchen sink clogged on my parent's house and I knew right away who to call! Called to setup an appointment (thank you Cedric for setting the appointment- very nice and humble guy) for a sink that has a clog and an outside part of the pipe needed to retread as the rusts ate the tread part of it- unable to close. Miguel came and gave the price tag before he start the work which is 174$. He snaked the clog from the outside down to the drain. They don't retread the rusty opening, as it could result to more damage but instead placed a plastic cap that seals the opening without a leak. He is on time. Adrianna (receptionist) called 15mins before his arrival which is around 10:15am. 9am-11am is my time frame. Miguel explained really well what needs to be done and he is knowledgable of his job. Neat work, organize with his tools, wore his mask and work diligently the whole time. Honest and went above and beyond! He had to get the needed cap twice as the butterfly kind leaked and replaced it with a different one! Thank you and see you next time for whatever family's plumbing needs may arise! Service that can be trusted! Now, I am not scared if ever I will have plumbing problems in the future, but always looking forward to get the best service! Excellent job once again!

reviews.author: Raye M.
reviews.text:
JR's Plumbing again saved the day, with Cedric Johnson to the rescue! This morning Roto quoted $385 to snake my house's main drain from the clean-out to the street (less than 90 feet, more like 50 even if you go all of the way to the manhole). I was so shocked! They came down to $301 but I still couldn't do it. I called and got a much better quote, but I wanted to see what JR's would say since they'd done such a great job on a fix for me last year. The woman I spoke to quoted a number much lower right over the phone! Not only that, Cedric, who helped me last year, was available and came by half an hour later! All done in under an hour for a price less than half of the other quotes I got. I am so very pleased and will definitely recommend JR's and Cedric to my neighbors!

In June 2018 I had a slow kitchen leak from the washer. Cedric Johnson found the problem super quick, switched out the leaky pipe fast and gave me a fair price. He was as helpful as you could ask for! Unlike the competitor, there was no upselling or nonsense, just genuine, honest assistance. JR's understood what needed doing and got it done!

synthesis.summary: Bimodal: when they take the job they often save the day on weekends and emergencies (Christmas Eve party, Sunday flooding, Napa earthquake area), but a parallel pile of 1-star Yelp reviews describes 8x-competitor pricing ($2,200 vs $300 for a blocked shower), missed appointments the boss never logged, and referrals out to a separate 'Preferred Plumbing' shop that left a customer waiting 5 hours. Yelp at 4.6 with 100 reviews is genuinely strong; Google at 4.3 with 19 hides a hostile distribution.
strengths: Emergency dispatch when no one else is open — 'I called 7 different plumbing companies and Christian Plumbing and Drain was THE ONLY place that could send a technician out in a timely manner'
Real after-hours response — 'Our main drain was backing up and flooding our downstairs at 7pm on a Sunday... I called 3 plumbers and these guys were the only one who answered the phone'
Upfront pricing tiers explained on the phone — 'I was given pricing in accordance with what to expect. For instance if the toilet had to be taken out to complete the job, what that price would run'
weaknesses: Pricing variance is enormous — '$2200 to fix a blocked shower' vs $300 from a competitor; '$110 just to drive over the bridge' for an estimate that wasn't disclosed upfront
Office-tech disconnect on appointments — 'the BOSS NEVER MADE MY APPT!!!' and several reviewers describe being told one thing on the phone and another by the tech
redFlags: Inconsistent estimate-vs-final-bill — '$250-$350' estimate became '$860' invoice; reviewer says he had to remove the toilet twice with $120 flat charges
Refers customers out to 'Preferred Plumbing' which left a reviewer waiting 5 hours and gave dismissive callback when finally called
One reviewer alleges a potentially fraudulent tech pocketed cash and never returned a receipt
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple Yelp reviewers cite 'JR's was open and a real person answered not a recording' on Sundays and after-hours, plus a documented Christmas-party rescue. But other reviewers waited 5 hours via a referral, so emergency reliability is uneven.

sewer.topQuote: They came out within the hour... I had a Sunday emergency-black sludge coming out of my laundry room floor drain

plumbers.name: Complete Plumbing Works
plumbers.address: 537 Fairhaven Way, Vallejo, CA 94591, USA

reviews.author: cory haynes
reviews.text: Marco is professional, on time and efficient. He always delivers top quality. I will hire him again and again.

reviews.author: Dabed G.
reviews.text: Marco was great. Capped a gas line behind my stove. Made it so the gas line wasn't sticking out of the wall. And replaced my hot water valve under the sink. Was quick and walked me through everything he did.

reviews.author: Y. Abigail H.
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Complete Plumbing Works!!! Customer service is top notch, from the initial phone call through service. I called on a Wednesday and left a voicemail to describe my issue. I received a call back right away and Marco said he could be at my home within the next few hours. I ultimately asked him to come the next day to better accommodate my schedule and he was punctual and came prepared. My main issue was a garbage disposal (which pretty much hadn't been working for over 1.5 years), Marco fixed it almost instantaneously. I appreciate how knowledgeable he is! He was able to quickly identify and troubleshoot my issue, all while being very personable. Marco also went above and beyond -- he noticed that my kitchen faucet had low water pressure and dripped (which has been the case for several months) and he fixed it so easily. I didn't even have to ask, but he willingly fixed it. 

I look forward to calling Complete Plumbing Works for future plumbing needs! In the meantime I'll definitely refer him to everyone I know!

reviews.author: Michelle P.
reviews.text: After an auto accident, needed a price on a simple repair: change the flapper on a toilet. Something ordinarily I could do myself in a few minutes max. Their quote was $235 which seems predatory. So while they have gotten good reviews, perhaps you should check what they are charging you. I work with plumbers on a routine basis in Berkeley and have never been quoted such a high amount for a simple repair.

reviews.author: Syed S.
reviews.text:
I had called Complete Plumbing Works to replace some valves for my laundry room and to fix a leaky faucet in my bathroom.  Marco came and made the repairs.  He was pleasant and while we have no issues with the work in the laundry room the faucet is still leaking.  The faucet was leaking immediately after Marco left.  It actually leaks worse now then before the repair.  We did call back after a week and they did send Marco back to repair the faucet, but it did not work.  The faucet is now loose (and it wasn't before), and it leaks much more than before the repair.  It used to be slow constant drip, but is now more of a constant stream.  

Also, on my initial appointment with Complete Plumbing Works they had me double booked and they rescheduled at the last second causing me to reschedule other appointments.  And, while the work they say they have a three month warranty on the work they do, they are not very responsive to come back and fix issues that weren't resolved.  You have to leave multiple messages and then maybe you'll get a call after a week or two.

reviews.author: Yihan T.
reviews.text:
Marco is wonderful! 
We hired him to work on a few different projects around the house - kitchen sink, toilets, water heater replacement, and more. He's always on time, professional, friendly, and responds in a timely manner. 
Two things I would like to highlight after multiple interactions with Marco. First he did very clean and professional work - left our garage clean exactly as he found it. Second, he was super honest and patient with us. Took a lot of time explaining things and answered all the questions we had. 
Our water heater had a bad leak, called him around 8pm, and he was able to come the very next morning at 7am. Worked the whole day to replace our old nasty water heater (and hauled it away), and installed a drainer for us in case there was another leak. 
It's always stressful when you have plumbing issues, but Marco made it easy for us every single time. We highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Nova S.
reviews.text:
Overview:
Most of you have read my restaurant posts and I speak solely on what I see! With Complete Plumbing Works, you'd probably want to make them your first choice from here on out if they have serviced your residence! I called, explained my issue (leak under my kitchen sink), they gave me a date they would arrive, Marco arrived on that date that was given and he was  ON TIME, he took a 10 second look at the problem, knew exactly what it was (old garbage disposal), gave me a price for parts and time, and it was the right price! never had any problems since!! The type of people you can trust who you know will get the job done - for that I give Complete Plumbing Works a complete 5 star rating! Thanks guys! :)

reviews.author: Robert K.
reviews.text: I can't say enough positive things about this plumber.  I had an Emergency situation at my Napa home late Friday evening, a clogged kitchen sink that was not improving with mulitple rounds of Draino. I attempted to take apart the drain trap myself and unfortunately broke the connection to under the basin.  He responded promptly, and was available at 8pm when most plumbers were telling me they weren't available until the following week. He worked incredibly hard to repair the damage, clear the line, and went above and beyond to make sure the area was cleaned up afterwards. The cost I thought was very reasonable. I would definitely use him in the future and would recommend to others.

reviews.author: J E.
reviews.text:
Had a bad sink backup. Initially called Roto-Rooters (cause it's a brand name I'm familiar with) and they wanted to charge almost $300 for a fix. Decided to Yelp and find a good reputable local business and came across Complete Plumbing Works.  They quoted me about 1/3 the cost AND Marco was able to come out on a shorthand notice.

Not only did he fix th issue, but inspected the piping and garbage disposer and gave me a heads up suggesting that it would soon need replacement. He was very thorough, efficient and quick.

I highly recommend these guys for any plumbing needs, and I highly recommend that you support your local businesses. THANKS GUYS!!!

reviews.author: Deborah B.
reviews.text: Best plumber ever. Not only did Marco pick up when I called but he quoted me a price over the phone, showed up on time, quickly cleared our backed up line and then when I showed him a 10% off coupon I had, he told that the online coupon was 20% so he doubled my new customer discount. It gets better. After he left and I went down to the family room bathroom to clean the yucky sewage-splattered shower stall, I had a pleasant surprise. Marco had cleaned it himself!  In all our years as homeowners with a terrible drainage system, no other plumber has ever gone this extra mile for us. That was impressive. Great guy. Great work ethic.

reviews.author: Maccine A.
reviews.text: Excellent Job!!!    I have had so many issues with my plumbing being backed up the toilet and the bathtub ever since they had a power outage with PG&E  the power outage happened 3 different times within a few days. I had 2 or 3 different plumbers and either they didn't know what to do  or so called fixed it but the problem persisted until I called COMPLETE PLUMBING. he explained everything to me.  took pictures to show me what was going on and fixed the problem just like that. Thank you Mr. Marco. I will definitely be giving you a call if ever I need any plumbing  issues

reviews.author: Max H.
reviews.text: I called Complete Plumbing due to a leak in our main water line coming into our house. Marco showed up within 45 minutes to check out the situation and provide an estimate. On the scheduled day, he showed up on time (to the minute) and did an excellent job without tearing out the complete front yard. I can't say enough about his professionalism and his pride in his work. When he was done, he cleaned up everything like he was never there. I would definitely recommend with no reservations. Excellent, excellent, excellent!

reviews.author: D G.
reviews.text: More like Complete laziness or Complete moron. Called Marco for a multi thousand dollar job. Told him where parking space is and he found it but couldn't count the 13 houses between there and our house. I called him and said to walk up the flat walkway 800' to our home; he said he didn't want the job. If he's in a wheelchair, I'll cut him slack....but if not, and he's too lazy or can't count to 13....you should only use him in a dire emergency, and if you have parking right outside.

reviews.author: Elizabeth B.
reviews.text: Marco was great. Our toilet clogged and was leaking through the bottom seal. Marco could of told me the wax seal needed to be replaced off the bat, but instead he was honest and said that it may stop leaking after the clog was removed and the pressure was released. It's always good to know you are dealing with an ho set business man. I will recommend him to anyone I know.

reviews.author: Christine C.
reviews.text: Marco put in new copper pipes for the entire house as well as a tankless water heater.  He works efficiently and stays to the task.  He's careful of surrounding areas and is very clean and tidy.  I was impressed with his dedication to the task, his knowledge, and the quality of his work.  He did this plumbing job in 2018 and there have been no problems.  Thank you Marco!

synthesis.summary: Marco (the owner) personally answers calls, frequently quotes a third of competitors' prices, and shows up nights/Sundays. Yelp 4.4★ across 30 reviews backs up the picture. The few 1-star reviews flag one persistent leaky-faucet job that wasn't fixed on a callback and a $235 toilet flapper quote — outliers in an otherwise strong record.
strengths: Quoted 1/3 the price of Roto-Rooter for a sink backup and came on short notice
Available at 8pm Friday when 'most plumbers were telling me they weren't available until the following week'
Cleaned a sewage-splattered shower stall after a job — 'no other plumber has ever gone this extra mile'
weaknesses: One repeat callback for a leaky bathroom faucet ended up worse than before — 'used to be slow constant drip, but is now more of a constant stream'
Quoted $235 for a toilet flapper change which the customer flagged as predatory
redFlags: One reviewer reports double-booking and last-minute reschedule on first appointment, plus poor responsiveness on warranty callbacks
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviews describe Saturday-night, Sunday, and 8pm emergency response — one of the few plumbers Yelpers say will pick up on weekends.

plumbers.name: Roger's Plumbing Georgetown Plumber
plumbers.address: 1500 W University Ave Suite 110, Georgetown, TX 78628, USA

reviews.author: Bertha Olsen
reviews.text: Excellent job! I had a new kitchen sink, faucet and RO system installed. Marc was friendly and professional and did a great job. He also showed up earlier than the appointed time and I really appreciate that.

reviews.author: Sanjay Borra
reviews.text: Huge shoutout to Marcus at Roger’s Plumbing. We had a concealed leak behind our garage wall that was causing moisture outside. Marcus was able to locate the issue immediately—a nail driven through the pipe by the original builders. He replaced the damaged section of the 1-inch main and the smaller line efficiently. He provided clear photos of the damage which was incredibly helpful for dealing with our builder warranty. Professional, skilled, and honest. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Margie Cunningham
reviews.text: I Highly recommend Rogers Plumbing. Reasonable pricing , explained in detail work required and cost. Technician Jackson  very respectful and polite, performed quality work in a timely manner. Thank you Jackson for all your hard work. Margie Cunningham

reviews.author: todd H
reviews.text:
I greatly appreciate them coming out super quick and replacing a thermal expansion tank on our hot water heater that was spraying water.

However they quoted me $3200 to replace my hot water heater.  That was 3x what I paid to have my last hot weather replaced.  Luckily it wasnt an emergency so I could call another company out.

reviews.author: David Hughes
reviews.text: After 2 days and $3,500, I had to get a better plumber. They fixed the problem is about 2 hours and less than 25% of the cost. I asked owner for at least 25% of charge back and he gave me less that 10% refund.

reviews.author: Tim Masters
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of working with Marcus and Shane from Rogers Plumbing, and I cannot recommend them highly enough! From the moment they arrived, their professionalism was evident. They were not only dressed impeccably but also incredibly kind and approachable. It was clear they were well-trained and knowledgeable about their work.

They guided me through the entire process, providing detailed proposals and quotes, and even introduced me to the Jolly Roger plan, which turned out to be an excellent deal. I was genuinely impressed with their presentation and service, leading me to believe they might be part of a national company. However, I learned they are based in Leander and that their owner, Roger, works closely with them, ensuring continuous training.

As the founder of Freedom Fun USA, a Leander-based company that has now expanded into 8 states with 20 locations, I have a lot to learn from Roger. He truly knows how to run a business and create a phenomenal team.

I appreciate the level of service and professionalism exhibited by Marcus and Shane. I even took pictures of the materials they provided for reference in my own business. Rogers Plumbing has earned my highest recommendation for any plumbing needs or services they offer. Thank you, Marcus and Shane, for your outstanding work!"

reviews.author: Tyler Alexander
reviews.text: Roger's Plumbing was excellent. I had my foundation repaired by another company and after lifting my plumbing test failed. I called Roger's Plumbing and they had somebody out the next day to inspect it. Unfortunately I had a broken pipe that required excavation under the house, but at every step of the way my Jackson was very kind and helpful to my situation. Nobody likes hearing that they are going to have several thousand dollars in repairs after just paying thousands for a foundation repair - but Jackson did his best to keep the costs low and Roger's Plumbing operates on a very transparent pricing guide. I was very impressed when Roger himself reached out to discuss the situation and answer any questions I had. When the scope of work increased because a second break was discovered I felt like the team at Roger's was doing all they could to make the process clear and as affordable as possible. I also want to say I appreciated speaking with Linda who was very on top of getting the crew out to work on my home as quickly as possible. Hopefully I don't need anymore plumbing work from Roger's, but if you do, this is who you should go with.

reviews.author: Edgar Finkelstein
reviews.text:
Marcus arrived on time, ready to work and effectively described the tasks, cost and options. While on site we discussed an under the counter water filter that I was interested in replacing. He told me they do not carry them, however, while removing items from under the sink he found a replacement filter and installed it without an additional cost!
He conducted an inspection of our plumbing and informed me of potential issues.
We’re very happy with our new kitchen faucet,  Marcus answered all my questions and prior to leaving insured, I was happy with the work and to see if I had any further questions. Excellent all the Way around.

reviews.author: Philip Ordner
reviews.text:
Marcus and Shane came to my home to remedy a shower drain issue. The short version is they were excellent. Professional and courteous, straight forward and transparent about pricing, and answered all my questions. They were very nice to my family and dog. Can not say enough good things about them.
It's never easy allowing "strangers" in your home; however, they made the experience easier to digest. Truth be told, more severe plumbing issues were discovered along the way of original service call and I will have to remedy at a later time, but both of them allowed me time to process this information. The original issue was fixed.

reviews.author: Alan Henkelman
reviews.text: We recently had Roger’s Plumbing replace our old water heater that they had installed 12+ years ago.  Marcus, their lead technician, showed up on time and presented me with several options.  I can’t say enough nice things about Marcus.  He was very professional, hard working, and represented his company well.  I trusted him enough to allow him and his assistant to complete their work after we had left town and to lock up the garage.  Marcus called me after they were finished to give me a run down on how he had locked up.  In the future, I for one, will continue to use Roger’s Plumbing.  Simply the best in town!

reviews.author: Dani Owen
reviews.text:
Marcus and Shane from Roger's Plumbing came out ASAP to fix a problem with my water heater. A pinhole had developed and a leak had dripped for some time during the night. Imagine the unhappy surprise I had early in the morning!
They came out and replaced the water receptacle quickly, and got our water back on . Not only were they knowledgeable about the problem, but, were transparent with pricing up front. It was a pleasure doing business with such friendly and polite service pros. Hoping I don't need their services again anytime soon, but if I do I will be calling Roger's Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Karen Zerrillo
reviews.text: Jim and Shawn were absolute professionals. Jim explained exactly what he was inspecting for in order to determine what the optimum solution was to fix the problem. They went to the extra effort of inspecting all sinks and cleaning spouts that had hard water build up reducing the water flow. All areas were cleaned up and returned to working order. Jim and Shawn were personable and made sure we had contact info should something arise in the future. I would ask for them for any future. Plumbing issues!!

reviews.author: R Armstrong
reviews.text:
Roger plumming was great marc is excellent .

I am new to the area and my water softener was not working well. I originally went to raidiant plumin,  and my experience was very bad.
But with rogers plumming
My technician came ou and looked at my system. He was honest, knowlagable and repaired the issue same day.
He spent time teaching me and my wife on how to maintain the system as well he listened to us and made recommendations based on our needs.

I will definitely be going to them again

reviews.author: Victoria Modak
reviews.text: I needed to get some outdoor faucets replaced but decided to check around because the plumbing company I usually use seemed overpriced.  Roger’s plumbing had good reviews so I decided to try them.  I could not have been happier with the results and the price!  Orlando did a fantastic job!  He explained everything, completed the job quickly, and the price was much lower than my old company.  I will definitely continue to use Roger’s and will be requesting Orlando for future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Tharsio Rodrigues
reviews.text:
Jackson and Marcus were great. Although they found more than I expected and the price felt a bit high, the work was done well and quickly with a nice warranty. They did get me on their subscription thing but I liked it was non auto renewable. Jackson did a good job walking me through options and Marcus was kind enough to fix some water pressure issues for free.

Great call if you want speed and peace of mind, probably not the cheapest, although I didn’t compare quotes.

synthesis.summary: Roger's runs a sales-forward operation with a transparent pricing guide and 2-year warranties — and most reviewers come away calling it polished and professional, especially Marcus, Jackson, and Orlando. The catch: pricing is consistently 2–3x competitors ($3,200 water heater vs ~$1,000 elsewhere; $4,000 quoted on a job a homeowner DIY'd for materials cost). Great if you value documentation and warranty; expensive if you don't.

plumbers.name: Sosa Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 2200 S Church St Unit 7, Georgetown, TX 78626, USA

reviews.author: IMRedeemed
reviews.text:
Great experience w/ Sosa Plumbing!  Called yesterday early morning and was immediately scheduled for that afternoon.  They had a tech call in sick and immediately called me and explained they had to push me out to today.  Very apologetic, courteous and professional.

I was told Steven was delayed today and would be on site later this afternoon, but he showed just after original time today.  Really pleasant young man!  I had asked if he wouldn't mind my watching, so I could learn.  He was more than accomodating.  He took the time to answer any question I had and explained what he was doing throughout the repair process.  We chatted about all sorts of things while he was on site.

Would highly recommend both Steven and Sosa Plumbing and will call them with any furture plumbing needs I might have.

reviews.author: Demian Saffer
reviews.text: Jason was out to my house twice - for two separate issues with clogs in cast iron pipe under the slab (once on Friday and again for a different line on Monday...when it rains, it pours, I guess). On both occasions, he was efficient, communicative about what he was seeing with the camera and in explaining what he was doing, and professional. In both cases, augering the lines was not sufficient to release the clogs, and camera work and hydro-jetting was needed to clear them. I especially appreciate that there was no attempt to upsell services or use scare tactics on the customer - it actually seemed like he was "on my team" here, and wanted to sort out the issues as quickly as possible as opposed to hoping to pad the work and hours on the job. All in all, I am very happy with Sosa and Jason's work. They'll be my go-to from here on out.

reviews.author: Juli Butler
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jason at Sosa Plumbing. He showed up on time, was professional and courteous, and clearly knew what he was doing. He replaced a kitchen faucet and an outdoor spigot efficiently, explained the work, and didn’t waste time. Everything was done right the first time, no mess, no surprises. This is how a plumber should operate. I wouldn’t hesitate to use Jason again or recommend him to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: binny paul
reviews.text:
Shower cartridge replacement

$600 for shower cartridge replacement! The two stars is only for the price. Charging $450 in labor for 1 hour job seems a bit too much.

Rest everything was fine - scheduling, the job was completed within reasonable time, and the plumber was respectful

reviews.author: Guillermo Guerrero
reviews.text:
I used Sosa plumbing for a repair job, the plumber who came out was very courteous and professional, completed the job efficiently. Replaced the O ring, placed new bolts and nuts to secure the toilet, however about 3-4 weeks after the job I noticed a hairline fracture on the bottom left of the toilet seat by the bolt that was replaced, upon research online it stated the plumber may have over tightened the bolts or not did not provide any support to the front and the seat shifted a bit, I called them back and sent pictures of crack and they stated they would be going out to look at it and assess if it was the plumbers fault or just the age of the seat. About a day before the appointment to assess the owner called and stated they were refusing to accept any responsibility and would be canceling the appointment, even though we had a warranty for the repair. And the repair was not cheap, about $350 for the service. I would be weary about contacting them , because even if you have a warranty in writing they don’t honor it. Do your research before hiring Sosa Plumbers, i know we want to support our small
Business owners, but I would not recommend them.

reviews.author: Blanca F.
reviews.text:
They treated me badly after I had paid them over $3k for work. 

I previously posted a better review because the gentleman did a good job and was courteous, but when I asked the company to check an issue of contention that was raised to me by a neighbor claiming to me that my plumbing work had impacted her plumbing,  Sosa blew me off.  

The work was done in a condo where all of infrastructure is shared, so you have to be extra careful not to disrupt your neighbor's infra. A neighbor came by and said that her shower didn't drain anymore and given I had just had this work done recently,  and me wanting to be a good neighbor and set my neighbor's and my mind at ease, I called Sosa to send someone to investigate this claim.  I would have been willing to pay so that it didn't always stay in my neighbor's mind that I had done something to her plumbing.  I'm sure one can relate that once a relationship with a neighbor goes south, it's hard to repair it. 

But 2 minutes after I called for help and made an appt, they canceled my appt because the "manager" said there's no way that the work they did would have had an impact on my neighbor.  Seems odd the "manager" could so quickly recall the work their tech, Jason, performed weeks ago and know the inner workings of the condo's plumbing to make such a confident statement. No follow up questions asked of me.  Now,  they may have been right, but that's not the point. I didn't call for warranty work, I called for help with a plumbing situation between me and a neighbor.  I just paid over $3k for work on this investment property when it appears the company cares more about what they can get out of you than customer care or customer retainment. Seems short-sited. They actually wanted the neighbor to call. They said that the neighbor should call them for help. Perhaps they saw an opportunity to charge her, rather than potentially do warranty work for me?

I saw a text saying my appt was canceled before I even finished stating my concern to the lady on the phone BY the lady on the phone (she was literally listening to my plea for help while clicking cancel at the same time). Just made me feel really unheard and little.

It's a shame, too, because for a minute there, I thought Sosa was a good company, but they showed their true colors. Just very disappointed

reviews.author: rodger robinson
reviews.text:
Great customer service. Absolutely insane pricing. I was in the kitchen and noticed we had no water. I knew it was either the city shut it off or there was a leak in the front yard. There's a PVC pipe in the front that has given us problems in the past and sure enough that was it. Water was gushing out. I shut the water off and called Sosa.

I used to work for an electrical contractor before I retired a few months ago, we used them for some work at our office. I was hoping they would become my go to plumbers.

Pros: Girl on the phone was very nice, she even set me up for same day service between 4 and 6. She said the plumber might even make it early and he did. 2 hours early. Woo Hoo, a great start. BTW Stephen the plumber was also very good, no problem with him.

I showed Stephen what was wrong. This was not a hard job. Plumbing 101. Dig down a bit, ground was soft and wet and replace the broken PVC Maybe a job that would take a couple of hours. He prepared the estimate. $1,536.98. I thought he was joking but he wasn't. Now I'm stuck because I'm getting older and my knees are kind of hosed up, so doing it myself would be difficult. Didn't have much of a choice because we need water. So we reluctantly agreed to it.

The job took about 3 hours, an hour was spent shopping for parts and waiting for the PVC glue to dry. Parts were a PVC stick and a couple of elbows, $20 maybe.

When I worked for the electrical contractor we charged $125 an hour for service calls. Sosa is charging what works out to be close to $500.

Taken directly from their website: Despite the success, we still stick true to our core values of providing high-quality plumbing solutions at fair, competitive rates the average homeowner can easily afford.

Hmm. The average homeowner in the Pflugerville Round Rock area averages $120,000 in household income on the high end. That's $63.87 an hour. I'm confused, how is the average homeowners who are bringing in $63.87 an hour going to easily afford your services when you're charging them 8 times what they're making????

reviews.author: Marcos P.
reviews.text:
Performed multiple services to my satisfaction, but there were errors along the way that I feel would be avoided with more communication among crews and more training.

Replaced water softener (perfect service) and replaced two shower cartridges. Hot and cold water were left inverted, which I fixed by rotating the shower handles.
During softener installation, I found leak in the pressure reducing valve (PRV) next to water meter. Hired Sosa again and crew fixed, but stated that PRV were installed on wrong side (between meter and private shut-off: should be installed after shut-off).
Hired Sosa to replace PRV and install it after private shut-off. Crew first dug neighbor's pipe and luckily I alerted them on time before cutting neighbor's installation. Crew was going to install new PRV before private shut-off (the very goal of the service, to install the PRV after the private shut-off); I also alerted on time to fix position.

Again, these were errors that could have been avoided with more attention and communication. Nevertheless, services were completed, price is competitive and response is fast.

reviews.author: Sarah McMullen
reviews.text:
Update below!
Stephen and Nathan from Sosa Services are one of a kind! They are knowledgeable, friendly, professional,  and hard working. We were referred by a neighbor to use Sosa Services to install a water softener. Not only were they able to assess our home for what would work best, but they also took the time to explain why and how it would be done in the most cost effective way. If you think the big name brands are "getting you the best price", call Sosa first and have them come give you a quote. We will call Sosa again for our next plumbing need. 10/10 recommend!!

Update: Jason came out today and helped us find the problem in our sink not draining properly. He not only spent time cleaning out the pipe, but also in talking is thru the root of the problem, possible solutions, and ways to help in the meantime. Thank you SO MUCH Jason!! We always look forward to working with Sosa and now we can add Jason to the preferred tech list. 15/10 recommend!!

reviews.author: M S.
reviews.text:
The Owner texted me over the holiday weekend when we had a leak and had to shut off water to the house at the meter. He Gave me a quote of $300 to $500 based on the photos I texted. I thought that was high, but he was the only plumber I communicated with who'd give me an appointment day and time. 

The owner called that morning to confirm the appointment, and the young man called when 30 minutes away, was respectful, cleaned up after himself, etc. I liked the work the young man from Sosa Services did yesterday. But he had to go to the supply store two different times, which took hours. 

But then, when the work was completed, I was asked for $575. I thought that was exorbitant.  I paid $500 but thought that was still too high. 

I would recommend them if you're in a situation where you've just got to get something fixed ASAP, but I am going to keep looking for someone more affordable.

reviews.author: rodrigo v.
reviews.text:
Had an emergency leak near the main water cuttoff. Sosa Services was very responsive, they sent a certified plumber over to check it out the same day. They didn't charge me a fee just to come over, unlike many other businesses that I talked to.

Hunter was very transparent and helpful, he quickly dug up the ground and found the source of the issue. He addressed all of my concerns and answered all my questions. I gave approval for doing a fix right then and there. He started working and was done within 1-2 hours. He showed me the result and proved to me that it was working. Then he quickly covered the hole and left. 

Hunter also provided an invoice and walked me through the process of using it to request to forgive the extra portion of the water bill caused by the leak. The invoice also provides a full warranty for the work done.

reviews.author: Jon E.
reviews.text:
January 2022: We hired Sosa for some natural gas line repairs and installation. Their prices were competitive, and Alex was very communicative. Anthony and Isaiah did the work, and they were very professional. They showed up on time, explained what they were doing, and their quality was good. There was a small issue with needing to add a regulator to the line they installed, and they bought one and installed it without additional charge. Highly recommended.

8/4/22 update: our water heater started leaking last night, texted Sosa well after hours (like 10PM) and got a reply. They sent over Hunter at 11:00 this morning who confirmed its death and quoted to replace it same day. He left 4.5 hours later, with a new unit installed and tested. 

Punctual, professional, friendly service.

reviews.author: Linda V.
reviews.text: My faucet water pressure was very low so I called to see if they could replace the cartridge.  Isaiah came out and replaced the cartridge. That helped some but the pressure was still low. Isaiah took the whole faucet apart and cleaned all of the parts. Unfortunately,  the 20 year old faucet needs to be replaced.  I was not charged for the cartridge or the extra time it took to take apart the faucet and clean it. Isaiah said he would not charge for the extra work because he could not fully resolve the problem. I am going to buy a new faucet and will definitely call Sosa Services to install it. I never thought I would find an honest and affordable plumber. I would highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Hai P.
reviews.text:
I requested a quote via Yelp to replace a broken main shutoff valve and pressure reducing valve on a Friday afternoon Alejandro from Sosa Services reached out to me within 15 mins  and was able to come out the same day to give me an in person quote after assessing the scope of work. Upon request, he scheduled a follow up appointment to come out on the following Monday morning to repair my water pressure issue and replace my broken water main. Always on time and communicated to be honestly what needed to be done and the price was beyond reasonable! 

They've earned a loyal customer and I will be sure to call for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jennifer Stringer
reviews.text: Sosa Plumbing was absolute greatness.  First of all, they had me set up for an appointment in less than 24 hours.  Jason sent an email that he was enroute and showed up right on time.  He looked at the site of my leak, did a little digging, and gave me three options (good, better, best).  I chose the option I wanted, and had my leak fixed with a new shutoff valve in a box in the yard put in place in less than 2 hours.  Jason was great at explaining everything, and he was fast.  This cost way less than I was expecting.  Thanks to Jason and to Sosa Plumbing.  I am highly impressed and will recommend you to anyone who needs plumbing work.

synthesis.summary: Sosa earns its 4.9 Google over 433 reviews mostly through one strongly-named tech, Jason, who appears in review after review for clean, on-time work at fair prices. The negative reviews (a sub-cluster of 1-2 star ratings) cluster around two issues: warranty pushback when problems recur, and surprise $200 permit markups vs. $35 city cost — worth watching.
strengths: Specific tech (Jason) repeatedly named — same-day scheduling, hydro-jetting cast-iron clogs, kitchen-faucet replacement done right the first time
Reviewers compare Sosa to competing estimates and consistently find Sosa $100+ cheaper
Proactive communication — texts when running 30 minutes late, calls when 30 minutes away
weaknesses: Multiple reviewers report being charged again for issues they paid Sosa to fix the first time — 'same exact issue ... No response to any messages'
One gas-line bid included a $200 permit markup vs. the city's actual $35 permit fee
Shower-cartridge replacement billed at $600 ($450 labor) for a one-hour job — single complaint but specific
redFlags: Warranty / callback issues — one reviewer reports cracked toilet weeks after install with no response, another reports same drain re-clogged a year later with no response
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Same-day scheduling repeatedly reported (early-morning call, afternoon dispatch). Holiday weekend and Christmas-week work referenced. Owner texted directly over a holiday weekend on a meter leak. No explicit 24/7 advertising in the sample.

water-heater.topQuote: Sosa has replaced my water heaters over the years. This includes the one in my attic, which is a PITA to work on.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: Jason was out to my house twice - for two separate issues with clogs in cast iron pipe under the slab ... camera work and hydro-jetting was needed to clear them.

faucet-fixture.topQuote: Excellent service from Jason at Sosa Plumbing. ... He replaced a kitchen faucet and an outdoor spigot efficiently

toilet.topQuote: Steven of Sosa Plumbing Services is very competent. He did an excellent work of our toilet repair.

water-softener.topQuote: Sosa services has been amazing since I moved into my new home in Feb 2023. They came out quickly, within days of my inquiry and installed my softener and filter.

garbage-disposal.topQuote: Team showed up exactly when they said, installed a new garbage disposal quickly, gave me all the details, and charged a great price.

gas-leak.topQuote: John Sosa and his associate Stephen came to my house to move the gas line for a new range placement

You need clear communication and upfront explanations
caution_if: You need rock-bottom prices with zero flexibility on the quote
You need airtight scheduling and guaranteed arrival times

plumbers.name: Smart Rooter & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1290 Kilcrease Cir, El Sobrante, CA 94803, USA

reviews.author: Bryan Butawan
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Sam at Smart Rooter & Plumbing! From the start, he impressed me with his speedy response—he was on-site quicker than I expected, which gave me peace of mind right away. The price was fair and transparent, which is something I really appreciate when it comes to plumbing work.

What stood out most was Sam’s thorough follow-up and professionalism. He didn’t just fix the immediate issue and leave; he took the time to explain how the main sewer lines work, what warning signs to look for, and the potential problems that can arise if certain issues aren’t addressed early. I walked away not only with the problem solved but also feeling more educated about how to prevent future headaches.

If you’re looking for someone reliable, fair, and who takes pride in educating his customers, I’d highly recommend Sam and Smart Rooter & Plumbing.

reviews.author: Anthony McMullen
reviews.text:
A Five-Star Experience from Start to Finish!

From my initial phone call about a clogged sink, their team was incredibly responsive, offering to be at my house in less than an hour.

I also inquired about replacing my outdoor water taps, as they were old and leaking when on.

Since it wasn't a true emergency, I was happy to wait.
Their scheduler was wonderfully accommodating and immediately booked me for the following day at my earliest convenience. The technician arrived on time, and was highly professional.
The quality of work was outstanding. Not only did they use top-tier materials like all-brass fittings, but they also took the time to explain what they were doing and why.

I couldn't be more satisfied and will definitely be a returning customer. They also gave me a 90 day warranty on the work done.

reviews.author: Anuja Kumari
reviews.text: Smart Rooter & Plumbing did an awesome job! They showed up right on time, quickly figured out what was wrong, and explained it in a way that made sense. The repair was done fast, everything was cleaned up, and the price was exactly what they said it would be—no surprises. Super friendly and professional crew. I’ll definitely call them again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Q. M.
reviews.text: They saved me! My water heater decided to die out of nowhere and Bernardo came over with his team and replaced my water heater the same day. Our situation was very complicated but he worked with us the entire way! He also kept his word on everything he said as well. My family loves to support other family businesses and this one will be our plumber from now on! He put in a new water heater which was better than the one before and it was almost the same price as our old one. Our system was very very old and it had tons of valves that didn't need to be there. He simplified our system and replaced our pipes and was done in a fairly good amount of time. Since we live in apartments he needed to shut off water to our other 3 neighbors including us and turned the water back on for them in a short amount of time (one of them was not very friendly. Bernardo understood and we got no complaints!) If it needs to be done that day he will get it done! Our air conditioner also wasn't getting any heat so we were cold for so long! We talked to our AC people and they were just giving us the run around. Told Bernardo and he helped figure it out! Turns out our AC was also super old and our water heater was connected to our AC, which is no longer what modern systems have. Bernardo worked with us for a good couple of days to figure out our situation. He stayed all day one of the days and gave us a really good deal for all the work that needed to be done. Very humble people. We ended up not having to call the AC people for the fourth/fifth time who kept giving us the run around because Bernardo fixed everything. He did say he doesn't do electrical or AC but he helped us with this and for that we are so grateful for it. We gave them very good tips just because of how understanding they were and all the hard work they did! Very good work. I've had no problems since. I love these people they will be our plumber from now on!! 10/10 in every way! Thanks again Bernardo and family. You guys were amazing! :)

reviews.author: Kev V.
reviews.text:
My water heater decided to give out on cold evening. I could not get anyone to look at the water heater the same evening until I saw That's Good Drain & Rooter on Yelp. I decided to give them a call, and they responded to me right away! They promised me that they will have someone come out within that hour, and within 20 mins Bernado from the company showed up. Bernado is super knowledgeable and super friendly guy. He assessed the water heater, he knew the problem right then and there. He got to work right away that evening! He helped me to haul the new water heater from the store and took my old broken water heater away. I am so amazed by their workmanship! He and his helper got my new water heater installed that same evening! 

When he was replacing my water heater, he noticed the water psi is unusually high . He figured out the solution right away. He promised to return the next morning to get it done. He came on time the next morning with all the equipments and parts. He got that water pressure problem fixed within that morning! 

I m so glad I called Bernado that evening when my water heater broke. He and his team is very knowledgeable, helpful, friendly, on-time and honest. He offers great price for quality works.

reviews.author: Renato S.
reviews.text:
Emy and Bernardo are life savers!

I reached out on a Sunday afternoon about a clogged drain that caused water / disposal backup in my garage sink, and they were able to come help within the hour. 

More importantly, they were honest and hard working people. I had another plumber take a look at the clogged drain earlier and quickly told me I needed a specific type of service called a hydro jetter, which would cost me around $1,500. However, Emy and Bernardo took a closer look and were able to clear my drain with a simpler method which cost me less than 1/3 of the cost! 

When I told them I needed a hydro jetter service they asked me why I believed I needed that type of service, and then quickly assured me that it wouldn't be necessary. They could have went with it and milked me for the high priced service, but instead they did their best to help me and do it the most efficient and cost effective way possible. 

Don't be mislead by their limited number of reviews.  They've been in the business for over 20 years and it shows in their work. I highly recommend them and I will definitely go back to them for any future plumbing work.

reviews.author: Therese C.
reviews.text:
My husband found a leak in our irrigation system so we needed repair done right away. I am SO glad found That's Good Drain & Rooter on Yelp. I called on a Friday afternoon and Emy answered right away, she was kind and helpful. They said they could be at my house within an hour and they were, they even kept updating us on their ETA. Bernardo checked out the leak and knew exactly what to do, he left to go buy some parts and came back right away. I really liked how they updated us with each step of the work being done. He completed the work, it required some waiting time for drying and they stayed and waited for it to dry to make sure the work was complete before leaving. They communicated very well during the entire process. I could tell they're honest, hardworking people. And I would definitely call them again for any plumbing or similar services in the future! 

PS: my kids were so curious with the work that Bernardo was doing and he was SO kind and responsive with the questions and comments they had for him!

reviews.author: Sajan Singh
reviews.text:
Mr. Sam and his team at Smart Rooter & Plumbing provided outstanding service! He is an authentic and trustworthy professional who truly cares about doing ethical, high-quality work. His diagnosis was fast and accurate, and he completed the job efficiently without cutting any corners. The quality of the work was excellent, and everything was handled quickly and professionally.

I was previously quoted a $$$$-figure plumbing job by another company based on a false diagnosis. After hiring Sam, he properly identified the real issue and got the job done in just a few hours. He saved me a significant amount of money on unnecessary parts and labor that the other company had recommended.

Mr. Sam truly represents professionalism, honesty, and ethical workmanship. Highly recommend him if you’re looking for reliable and trustworthy plumbing service.

reviews.author: Rebecca P.
reviews.text: So we had a clogged tub. Contacted Emy and she said she's sending Bernardo out. I asked for an estimate she said he'll come and check and give us a rate before the job. So he came checked the line. Said if it doesn't work he won't charge us, if it does the flat rate would be. So it worked and he even cleaned out our tub with clorox. It was pretty nasty. Since it was our first time booking an appointment with them they gave us a discount. He recommended also a catch for the drain to get all the hair that gets trapped. This guy Bernardo is super nice, great service, and if we ever need a plumber I definitely would recommend them.

reviews.author: Mariah B.
reviews.text: Bernardo and Emelita were fantastic! Our toilet started leaking yesterday evening and all the go-to tactics were not working! I sent out a request hoping for a response but not hopeful due to it being a rainy Friday evening. We got a response quickly with a reasonable rate and they were at our house within the hour. The issue required them to come back the following day and they agreed to return at 7am! On time and finished the job within the time quoted. We really appreciate their flexibility, professionalism and kindness for making us a priority because we have a kiddo! I will def recommend them and use them in the future!

reviews.author: Kathy V.
reviews.text:
Looking for a plumber? Look no further--Good Drain & Rooter is the one to call!

Bernard and his son came right away to fix a leak under my mother's sink. He was referred by a good friend and, to our surprise, mentioned that he was friends with my late father--which made the experience even more meaningful.

Bernard quickly assessed the problem, explained what needed to be done, and offered helpful suggestions. Their service was fast, professional, and knowledgeable. The pricing was very reasonable, and the quality of work was excellent.

Highly recommend Good Drain & Rooter for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Cole A.
reviews.text: Fast response, fair and honest estimates, and friendly service - Bernardo and team have been a pleasure to work with. They replaced our water heater and performed various other plumbing repairs around our home. The work was done quickly and with great attention to detail and quality and we have not had any issues since. Emy is super responsive and easy to communicate with and the team is knowledgeable about all the products they install. Five stars and will definitely be working with them for future projects. We also plan on referring our local friends and family for any of their plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Rita M.
reviews.text: That's Good Drain & Rooter was absolutely awesome. I am so happy that I found them. They were quick to respond to my inquiry and they they were at my home within an hour of my call. Bernardo was able to quickly diagnose my plumbing issue and fix it. I am always nervous and wary when it comes to this sort of thing but Bernardo walked me through everything that he was doing and also found another problem that we weren't aware of and fixed that too. Great communication skills, professional and reasonably priced. Will definitely use That's Good Drain & Rooter again!

reviews.author: Adrian T.
reviews.text: I needed a quote to swap a water heater and make sure it was up to code. I called and Emy set up an appointment on the same day. Bernardo came at the arranged time, inspected the unit, and provided a competitive and fair price to do the service. They even offered to do it right then and there. I decided to have them do it. They did a fantastic job swapping the unit, installing new pipes, and installed additional piping for the pressure release valve. I would definitely recommend him for plumbing service. Thanks again Bernardo, Emy, and family!

reviews.author: Catherine Ames
reviews.text: My toilet is fixed!  I had a leak inside the tank that caused my water bill to spike :(  I took a chance and called Bay Area Smart Rooter located in El Sobrante.  Sam came the same day to give me a free quote.  He came back today (its SUNDAY!) and replaced the parts inside the toilet.  He even fixed my faucets in 2 bathrooms that had a leak - all for a very reasonable price.  It's great to find a plumber that is trustworthy, professional and local!  If you're looking for a plumber call Sam @222-2297.  Highly recommend!

synthesis.summary: Sam (and his son Bernardo) at Smart Rooter come up across both Google and Yelp as the kind of family operation that follows up weeks after a job to check the work, uses brass fittings instead of cheaper alternatives, and offers 90-day warranties. Main water lines, water heaters, sewer backups, and toilet issues all show consistent same-day or within-the-hour response. Caveat: a cluster of 5-star reviews on the same August 21, 2025 date reads more generic than the rest.
strengths: Sam personally follows up weeks after jobs — 'Sam followed up with me a few weeks later to make sure everything was still working well'
Same-day water main replacement — 'Our water main broke and they replaced it the next day. Very solid value, and great help when we needed it'

Educates customers on prevention — 'he took the time to explain how the main sewer lines work, what warning signs to look for, and the potential problems that can arise if certain issues aren't addressed early'
Uses higher-grade materials and offers 90-day warranties — 'they use top-tier materials like all-brass fittings'
