plumbers.address: 375 Green Acres, Georgetown, TX 78626, USA

reviews.author: Carol Graff
reviews.text: Walker plumbing is awesome! They came out within 20 minutes and fixed a major problem. Owner is very nice and trustworthy. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Daniel C
reviews.text:
Had a great experience with Noah & Walker Plumbing Co. We woke up at 7 am to the sound of the 10 year old+ water heater leaking in the garage. Called around and landed on Walker Plumbing. They managed to expedite a technician within the hour and we got a brand new water heater installed (and old one removed off the property!) by 12 pm. Awesome full service.

Noah provided great & knowledgable service and we will definitely call Walker for our future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Laura Facchini
reviews.text: Noah came out to correct a different plumbing company’s mistake and did not charge me. He was on time and courteous too! I will plan on using Walker Plumbing next time.

reviews.author: Kay Kitts
reviews.text: Walker Plummer came only cleaned gooseneck & charged me $190.00. Only drained for 2 months!  Now zero draining!  Will never call again!

reviews.author: Ann Hagmann
reviews.text:
I discovered signs of a leak near where the water line comes into the house.  Jeremy from Walker Plumbing did an outstanding job finding the leak and repairing it.  And it was not an easy task , as the water lines were behind a raised flower bed with scrubs!  After digging down a ways he actually found the leak by feel.  After fixing the pipe, Jeremy cleaned up the work area and put everything back together.  I was pleased not only with his diagnostics and the carefulness of his work and cleanup, but with his timeliness and the reasonableness of their fee.  The only negative was I had to wait two days for service because of their workload. (Had the leak been major we would have had to shut off the water or call a 24 hr plumber.)
I hope not to have anymore plumbing issues, but if I do I will certainly call Walker Plumbing again.  Well done.

reviews.author: Rick B
reviews.text: I can't speak highly enough about Walker Plumbing....They've been working in the Williamson County area for decades.  My house was plumbed with Kitec by a well renowned custom builder in Georgetown.  We had numerous plumbing problems in the same wall between 2007 and 2024 all related to the failure of Kitec fittings.  Peyton has repaired each fitting as they failed and everyone has performed flawlessly.  I have used Walker plumbing for other repairs and upgrades as well and have never been disappointed.  They are the only plumbing company I'll call and I'll always ask for Peyton if he is available.  He is an exceptional plumber.

reviews.author: Richard Goodman
reviews.text:
5 stars is not enough for how great Walker Plumbing has been to work with. They beat the price of an unnamed Austin based plumbing company by a wide margin and were much more knowledgeable and actively looked for ways to help us fix the problem without spending unnecessary money. Perry and Noah could not have been more friendly or helpful and their dispatch team was very responsive.

They came out in the pouring rain and were able to quickly identify the break in our line and get it fixed on the same day. I will be a lifelong customer for Walker Plumbing after the amazing level of customer service we received today.

reviews.author: Stephen Baker
reviews.text: We just moved to Georgetown a few weeks ago and our hot water heater stopped heating. Our house came with a home warranty who only gave us delays and run arounds for five days so we asked neighbors and they recommended Walker Plumbing. After calling Walker and explaining our predicament, they had Payton at our place in two hours and had our water heater up and running in ten minutes with an adjustment. VERY HONEST, CONSIDERATE AND PROFESSIONAL SERVICE. We will always call them in the future. Love doing business with local family owned businesses and they are great.

reviews.author: Dennis Pratt
reviews.text: Three things you want in life, an auto mechanic you can trust, a family doctor you can trust and a plumber you can trust.  Well, I've found the plumber.  Walker Plumbing is definitely a thumbs up.  Called them about a water flow problem, and rather than just automatically sending a plumber out this wonderful lady, Francie,  offered a couple of suggestions to alleviate the problem, and they worked!  Took care of it myself and saved some money.  So, a big THANK YOU to Francie and Walker Plumbing.  Will definitely call them in the future.

reviews.author: Mark Meeks
reviews.text: Had a leaking pipe in my attic and they came out right away, and the problem was fixed in less than an hour. This was about the fourth job I've had them do for me, and they are always  very quick, friendly, and professional. One thing that I noticed about them, is they don't just fix leaky pipes- they solve problems. They fix things so that problems don't reoccur. Also, I was surprised how little they charged to fix my plumbing emergency. I can't say enough good things about them. Call them, and you won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Rob Petrecca
reviews.text: I woke up to a water alarm this morning and found my hot water tank leaking.  I called Walker Plumbing at 7:45am and was surprised when someone answered the phone 15 minutes before their 'official' open time of 8am.  She called me back in 15 min telling me someone was on the way!  They arrived on site and replaced the tank all within about an hour.  Very professional and they did clean work.  Super nice guys. Walker Plumbing will be my go to outfit in the future!!

reviews.author: Buddy Bradford
reviews.text: Walker Plumbing is second-to-none incredible! We have two fairly new awesome commodes that had minor issues. Upon calling Francine today, Nathan came to our home to fix the issues at no charge. We were very grateful! Walker Plumbing is the very best plumbing company in Georgetown, Texas. Walker Plumbing is dependable, 100% ethical, friendly, and everything you will want in a plumbing company! Mr. Walker is a great man as well! Buddy and Sue Bradford

reviews.author: NB C
reviews.text: Once again, Perry at Walker Plumbing, comes through with 5 stars.  His company always provides excellent customer service from the moment the phone is answered with your need.  Perry provided a quick repair in a timely manner with our clogged bathroom sinks today and gave us preventative tips for the future.  Thanks again, Perry!!  Walker Plumbing is so reliable

reviews.author: JENNIFER MILLER
reviews.text:
Toilet decided to start leaking on Memorial Day.  Called Walker Plumbing based on NextDoor recommendations, and they not only answered the phone, but were able to send a guy out within an hour.

Excellent work - toilet never ran better.  Price was extremely fair, no up-sell was attempted, and the guy really knew what he was doing.

Great job all around!

reviews.author: Teresa Reniker
reviews.text: I called Walker Plumbing for a leaky water heater.  Ours was 14 years old.  I talked with Francie and she took info on the water heater.  Peyton and Nathan showed up within an hour.  They had a replacement water heater on the truck. It was installed in an hour. They were polite, professional and the price was very reasonable. I highly recommend them.

synthesis.summary: Walker is the family-owned counter-example to the upsell-heavy Georgetown shops — they reportedly charged $400 for a repair another company quoted at $1,200, refused to charge a customer when fixing another plumber's mistake, and the receptionist Francie gave free phone advice that solved a problem without dispatching a tech. Same-day water heater swaps and 20-minute emergency arrivals show up multiple times. One outlier complaint about a $190 charge that drained for only 2 months.
strengths: Honest pricing called out repeatedly — 'a repair that another plumbing company quoted for $1,200. Walker Plumbing completed the job quickly and charged only $400'
Won't charge for fixing another plumber's mistakes — 'Noah came out to correct a different plumbing company's mistake and did not charge me'
Same-morning water heater replacement — 'They managed to expedite a technician within the hour and we got a brand new water heater installed... by 12 pm'
Receptionist Francie gives free phone advice when a tech isn't needed
weaknesses: One outlier — 'Walker Plummer came only cleaned gooseneck & charged me $190.00. Only drained for 2 months! Now zero draining!'
Sometimes booked out 1–2 days for non-urgent jobs — 'I had to wait two days for service because of their workload'
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple emergency dispatches documented — leaking water heater fixed within hours, freeze-broken valve repaired fast, garage flooded from water heater handled within the hour. Family-owned operation that prioritizes emergencies.

Great service.. always very responsive
Very organizing and clean
Happy to recommend to anyone

reviews.author: James Anthony Shih
reviews.text: Our toilets and showers were backed up and clogged.  The Munoz Services in El Sobrante, Ca came to our home in less than 1 hour.  They worked diligently without breaks and cleared up the clogged mess.  They brought in their snakes and went below the house without hesitation and cleaned up after themselves with a most reasonable price. We highly recommend them!  We will use the Munoz Services again to insert a Clean Out.

reviews.author: Judi Guadarrama
reviews.text: I had water flowing out from under my mobile home and called them. They came out the same day and checked thoroughly under the trailer. They found it was not a pipe leak but likely a drainage problem on the property so no plumber was needed. They did not charge me for this excellent service. I appreciated their help.

reviews.author: Yasir I.
reviews.text: Won't recommend  at all.  I shd be filling complaint against company and Ruben threatening me. Look at dead grass pictures stay away

reviews.author: Sheila B.
reviews.text: In Jan 2021. I had them come out for a simple concrete slab. A few times they did not show and didn't communicate why until I reached out. Once they started digging up the grass they discovered that there were 3 irrigation pipes that needed to be either re-routed or removed. Francisco said they were dead lines and had no water going thru them so he cut them. They laid the slab, it turned out very nice. I did not have my irrigation on because it was winter. Once I turned it on I discovered it was leaking under the slab! Ruben comes and digs under the slab and caps the leak sight unseen, I imagine that will be a problem at some point. Later when the weather warmed up I realized that a whole line of sprinklers wasn't working. I called and texted Francisco multiple times starting may 4th and he kept telling he would be coming to check it out. A month later he told me to call Ruben. I called Ruben on June 9th and he said it would be $50 to analyze if it was their fault and if not they would charge me to fix it. Fine, I needed it fixed. He still hasn't come. I finally had it fixed by someone else today. Beware, not reliable and once the job is done it seems they don't care.

reviews.author: Lori Chinn
reviews.text: I had a water leak in my water heater and called this morning to see if Munoz Services could help.  Mario called back very quickly and  asked me questions about the problem as well as reviewed photos of the problem. He was very professional, knowledgeable, efficient, detailed and friendly. He arrived promptly, assessed the situation and we came to the conclusion a new water heater was needed.  The broken water heater was  drained and disconnected, a new appropriate water heater was purchased, driven to the house and a new water heater was installed within 3 hours of when I first called.  Mario went over the steps that were done to ensure that I had a good new water heater and we even noticed that we were getting warm water already.  I would highly recommend Munoz Services with Mario as their excellent representative who provides great quality, good value, prompt, responsive, efficient, friendly and on time service.  I am a very happy and definitely a returning  customer.

reviews.author: Rebecca D.
reviews.text:
I texted Ruben about our sprinkler valve box being flooded with water and draining down our entry way. He was kind, informative, and very helpful. He sent his guys out to fix it the very next morning. We are so grateful! Anyone else that I talked to couldn't come for an estimate until the end of the month and it was such a relief to be able to get the situation fixed. Ruben's guys replaced all three of the sprinkler valves after pressure testing them. They also raised them so they would be more durable and efficient. They worked so hard and got the job done in under three hours. We are so relieved and grateful to have this problem fixed well and so efficiently (and on a Sunday!). Also, their prices were incredible and the guys made sure everything was cleaned up better than when they arrived!! We are very happy customers! 

Thank you so much Ruben and team you really outdid yourselves!

reviews.author: Natacha B.
reviews.text:
Rubén is truly a rare gem in the construction world. Not only does he offer fair and transparent pricing, but he also keeps you in the loop every step of the way which, in my experience, is very rare. After dealing with companies that overcharge, ghost you during the process, and deliver subpar results, working with Rubén was a breath of fresh air. He genuinely cares about his clients and consistently goes above and beyond.

The team he works with is just as professional and committed, working efficiently to deliver on time and within budget. Rubén transformed our sad-looking front yard into the best-looking house on the block! That upgrade was huge for us since we're planning to rent the house for my parents' retirement, and I'm confident we'll now get top market rent.

I won't trust anyone else with my projects moving forward. Rubén is the real deal.

reviews.text: This company exemplifies what a business should be. The owner, Ruben is very honest and trustworthy. I had him install sprinklers, replace the old sod and install concrete curb on my backyard. They are truly one of the best in the Inland Empire, the way Ruben treat his customers shows how he is devoted to his business and to his people. I really appreciated the no pressure quotes and how his crew showed their expertise with their work. From start to finish Ruben made good with the work he promised. A man who can be expected to keep or follow through with his promises or intentions that is Ruben and his business will prosper in the years to come.

reviews.author: Maria P.
reviews.text: I would not recommend this company at all.  I have been in contact with Ruben for over a month and he has cancelled on me three times and only because I would message him the day before to confirm appointments even though confirmation should come from the business. They try and make out like they are a professionally ran company but that is not the case. Ruben was very prompt to respond and answer all questions in the beginning but then fell of the face of the earth. We have several jobs we are doing to the outside of our home which are being pushed back due to this companies continued cancellations.

reviews.author: Lee Thompson
reviews.text: On July 1st, we woke up early in the morning to the sound of rushing water due to a compromised section of the pipe fed by the water main. Munoz Services was the 2nd plumber I called early that morning. They were at our place within a half hour to diagnose and provided an estimate in less than an hour later. They were back in about an hour and after four hours, including jack hammering, digging and fixing, problem solved and a holiday weekend saved! I highly recommend Munoz Services as they know their stuff and will get the job done in demand!

reviews.author: Keri E.
reviews.text: Vallejo Property Preservation turned our unusable side yard into the perfect little green belt for my family to enjoy with our pup! They replied to our text requests promptly and arrived for our estimate in under 48 hours. We were thrilled to hear they could begin our job the next day! From initial contact to a gorgeous side yard in under 5 days! We are thrilled with the results!!! Vallejo Property Preservation was professional, prompt, and got the job done in record time! Big thanks to your team for transforming our space with a smile! -Keri

reviews.text: About 11pm my kid comes in and wakes me up to tell me bathroom is not flushing and water is in tub.. now! I tried small tricks I know to fix clogged pipes after an hour of that not working. Called Roto Rooter and about 30 minutes later tech Zach calls says he’s finishing a job and can be there in an hour. He gets to my house in about 30-45 min after conversation. Less than 30 minutes after arrival house is flushing like it should. Thank you Zach. Price was expensive but late night emergency callouts are to be expected at this price. Which when I asked around seemed reasonable with after hour plumbing.

reviews.author: Tami C.
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I'm not able to recommend this business to anyone. Given the opportunity to make it right for $75, the owner refused. The first technician was unqualified, leaving the water turned on, resulting in flooding on the bathroom floor.  After him not being able to fix it in two visits, a second technician came out,   rigged the toilet with shower washers, and tried to charge us again.  When he was advised that payment wouldn't be made, he got angry and slammed the door as he left. Interestingly, the second technician who stopped the leak, provided a bill that was $75 less than the first person charged.  I was looking to be refunded that amount as what was billed was a ripoff considering their lack of technical skill and the loss of valuable time.  I feel that a senior citizen was taken advantage of and now has no recourse and a toilet that still may leak at any moment.

reviews.author: Veerappa R.
reviews.text:
The guy from Roto-Looter wanted $2800 to tell me what was wrong with the gas powered water heater, when a new one costs only about $700 - $800. This is in Fairfield, CA. And he said it will cost an additonal $800 to replace the defective water heater.  

If I were you, I would avoid them like plague. These guys have no conscience, morals or ethics. If only they could, they would charge you $100,000 to replace the damn water heater. 

I love these blood suckers. And if you choose them, they will suck every drop of your blood.

reviews.author: Jerry E.
reviews.text: We've used Roto-Rooter's services three times now.  Once to replace a faucet in our bathroom, once to replace the main water line coming in from the city's 'S meter into the house, and once to replace a leaking faucet and shutoff valve in our kitchen.  The water pipe replacement went fine.  The faucet replacements not so much.  We got the same plumber/tech on both the faucet replacements.  On the bathroom faucet replacement he got the handle on backwards and the faucet  was off center, so my wife rushed out to get him to come back in to fix the issue.  He did and we were fine with it.  Fast forward a few years later and we get the same Tech in to do the hands free faucet swap out and valve replacement.  He spent about 20 to 30 minutes reading the installation manual and then installed the fixture.  He finished the job but couldn't get the sensor to work on the faucet.  It did work fine in manual mode.  Then asked me which direction the plastic control screw should be turned on the controller that controls water flow to the faucet when the sensor was engaged.  The manual said turn the control screw a full turn to the right.  He did that and tested the faucet.  You could hear the controller click when you waved your hand over the sensor, but no water came out of the faucet.  He spent another 20 to 30 minutes working on the controller to get the faucet to work and couldn't get it going.  It was late, so we had him stop working on the faucet and operated it in manual mode.  He indicated on the receipt that the controller;s sensor was bad out of the box.  I went to the Koehler sit to look at their troubleshooting guide, checked all of the wiring and water line connections and they were all correct.  I got to thinking about it and thought that the controller might have been set for hands free operation right out of the factory.  I went under the sink, took a penny and turned the plastic screw a full turn to the right.  Tested the hands free operation of the faucet and it worked just fine in hands free mode.  I'll let you draw your own conclusions.

reviews.author: LaKeisha C.
reviews.text:
Horrible customer service from Mike, who said he was the owner. Had appointment set for a leak in an apartment building I own, for yesterday 3-5pm. Plumber called an hour later at 6pm to say he'd be there in an hour at 7pm (2hrs late). Then called back to reschedule for the next day stating he just finished a sewer job and was too dirty to go into my tenants apartments. The next day he called on his way there to say it would be $500 to run the leak detection test. This was disappointing because when I originally set the appointment I was told they would give me a free estimate and if I decided to move forward with the repair they would give me an estimate for the work. (This $500 was not to do the repair but needed to be paid just to get an estimate.) I would have paid for the work had I known in advance of their pricing. I own several buildings and have no issues paying for repairs and service. However, Mikes bad attitude was unacceptable. He yelled and spoke over me instead of listening and valuing my business. I felt disrespected. I explained to Mike, that with COVID 19 concerns, they shouldn't have scheduled a plumber to go from a sewer job...into tenant occupied apartments for the very next job. It's unsanitary and not safe! Once they knew the plumber was going to be 2+ hours late and involved with a sewer repair, they should have sent out another plumber. Furthermore, they need to be transparent with pricing. He yelled telling stating he disagreed with me and not to tell him how to run his business. He didn't get it. The owner takes no responsibility and argued back and forth with me. Doesn't know how to effectively communicate to resolve customer issues. Needless to say, I canceled the appointment. This is NOT a company with transparent pricing and the owner has terrible customer service. 

I'd recommend taking your business and hard earned money elsewhere to a company that values your business, Safety and time.

reviews.author: Robb H.
reviews.text:
BEWARE. I've never had this poor of an experience with a plumber. We had an emergency on a Saturday (downstairs bathroom was flooding), and we knew the issue was tree roots blocking our main line (which has to be cleared occasionally, and we had clearly waited too long). Roto-Rooter Fairfield sent a plumber pretty quickly (within a few hours), and he informed us it would be $569 due to the premium they charge on the weekends. But it was an emergency, so we agreed. He told us that would get us 2 hours of his time. 

He was done clearing the main line in 45 minutes, which solved the problem. BUT, he refused to clean up in the downstairs bathroom (where the flooding happened). I've never experienced a plumbing service where the cleanup was not part of the service (and in Roto-Rooter's case, "Plumbing & WATER CLEANUP" is even in their name). The guy wouldn't budge and refused to clean up. So we called to file a complaint, and they confirmed on the phone that cleanup is definitely part of the service, and they apologized that the job wasn't done correctly. But to make up for it, they only refunded us $56 (10% of the service charge). That is NOT enough when they've admitted that the job wasn't done correctly. NOTE: Their customer service person, Brenda, is an absolute rockstar and she deserves 5 stars for how she helped us, but unfortunately her manager only approved the 10% refund so there was nothing more she could do. 

So unless you want to pay a huge premium to have only half of the job done, I would avoid Roto-Rooter Fairfield. Terrible service, terrible experience, and crazy expensive. I've used several other plumbers in the Napa area (none of which were available that day, unfortunately), and all have been less than half the price for that same service, plus they actually completed the full job and cleaned up.

reviews.author: Kamie P.
reviews.text:
Roto Rooter     are lying  thieves.My kitchen sink was leaking water and it was 
  leaking  on the back of my wall.It was ruining my sheet rock.I do not have a lot of knowledge about plumbing.So I called Roto Rooter,I thought because they were so high in price they would probably know what they are doing.Little did I know ,they were horrible.When the plumber came in I specifically told him ,and physically showed him were the leak was coming from.He went under the sink and told me there was a blockage in the dishwasher.So he got a $3:00 dollar part,and put it under the sink.I was relieved that the problem was done.The day I looked at the kitchen and there was water still leaking from the back of the sink.I call the company up and I told them what happened.And the receptionist told me there would not be a charge.The same plumber came out.And I told him the leak was still there.He told me that ,he has a leak detector and it would cost me $800.00 dollars and he could not guarantee that he would find it.I told him I do not have that kind of money.Then he rudely  said good luck and good bye.And walked him self out the door.I called his boss and his boss told me that is how they work.I told him that I paid $400.00 dollar for something that did not get fixed.He told me the only thing he could give me is a 10%discount on the leakage.I told him forget it. All the guy needed to do was put in a separate valve so we could shut the water to the dishwasher off independently from the sink. This part was about a thirty dollar angle stop that had two valves coming out of it, one for the sink and one for the dishwasher.


Please if anybody had a problem with them call me and let me know.If we all get together we could put these liars back in there place.Here is my name and number (707)812-3793 Kamie.

reviews.author: Burton H.
reviews.text: Terrible experience from start to finish,  the tech, when he arrived was the only good thing I have to say about them, he was very polite, and to the point.  I called in for Emergency drain clog, I was told I would have to wait till the next day..... what's the point of 24hr emergency service if it's not actually 24hr.  I was told a tech would arrive the next day between 2-4pm.  At 2:30 I got a call from a service manager to inform me that my call had got pushed from 3-5 to 6-8, so first off that wasn't my original time slot but ok, but now my emergency service call is apparently not important to them because I kept getting pushed back, not to mention I had to call a second time to find out what was going on, and they had no idea who I was....  the tech finally arrived and worked until 9:30pm only to tell me he could not fix our problem, unless he stayed later which they would start to charge me the hourly rate, and he could not give me an estimated amount of time it would take him.  So i clearly wasn't going to pay someone to do something that could not give me at least an estimated time frame, I thanked him for his time and sent him on his way.  I can handle the fact that they simply couldn't help us, but to say you can't help and still charge someone $335?!  I live in Colorado, I was out here to visit my Father, and it's terrible to see business conducted in such a poor manner. In Colorado if someone can't provide the service you are paying for, they don't charge you. That's called good business, Roto-Rooter's business model sucks and so does their customer service. Enjoy getting robbed by Roto-Rooter

reviews.author: Sheila B.
reviews.text: My son had come over to help me replace the valves in my bathroom faucets on a Sunday. We started by trying to shut the water off to the sinks by turning the shut off valves under the sink when on of the valves broke off at the pipe and started to leak water badly. My only option was to shut the main water off totally, leaving me without water to drink, shower, brush my teeth and flush toilets. AAAAARRRRRGGGGG!! I tried calling a plumber who wanted over a 1000.00 to fix. I had just used Roto Rooter a week or so prior and gave them a call thinking they would be closed. Ashley picked up my call and was so sweet and nice to me. She said she would make a couple of phone calls and it may be a little bit before she could call me back but she would try to get someone out to fix my broken pipe. Several hours later the phone rings and its Ashley telling me the plumber was on his way. I was ans am so grateful that she kept trying to find a plumber who could fix my pipe and she did! Eric was the plumber she sent. You could not ask for a more efficient plumber. He came in saw the problem and went right to work fixing it in no time at all. Plus  while he worked he talked with me the whole time telling me how much he loved doing the work. I felt like I hit the jackpot with these two gems. Have a plumbing issue? Call Roto Rooter Fairfield and ask for Ashley. She will get you the help you need......an excellent plumber Eric!! I'm not calling any other plumbers. I know a great thing when I see it. ROTO ROOTER FAIRFIELD

reviews.author: Monica S.
reviews.text: My mother owns a  small 6 room motel. A sink in one of the rooms became plugged up. Unfortunately I wasn't with her at the time so she made the mistake of calling this business. She was told over the phone that the charge to come out would be $270.00 so she accepted those terms as she was desperate to get her tenants sink fixed. To make a long story short, the plumber came out and spent about 45 minutes in the room and charged her $390.00! Personally I consider this elder abuse! This very same company came out a year ago to snake the sewer line, wish she had remembered that. Luckily I was with my mom this time as I was caring for her after surgery. In any case, the plumber showed up, but sat in his truck for a full 15 minutes in the parking lot. Yes we timed him. He then did the job and when he was done he spent nearly a half hour cleaning his equipment with my mothers hose and water! He then presented me with a bill for $530.00. I asked him why he added so much on, he explained that it took him more than an hour. I told him that we noticed that he sat in his truck for quite awhile after he arrived and I didn't think we should have to pay for the time and water he used to clean his equipment. He became belligerent going on about "not dealing with people like you." I was actually afraid at that point, but he ended up taking off the extra charge and left. The mess he left for my husband to clean up was absolutely disgusting! Still looking for an honest plumbing service, this was just sad.

reviews.author: Jenal S.
reviews.text: When my shower in the master bathroom wouldn't drain properly & the toilet was bubbling, I called Roto Rooter.  They sent someone out who gave me an estimate of $611 to pull the toilet and have a 2nd man to help bring the machine up my steps.  Funny now how I thought that was high at the time!  Of course being desparate, I scheduled Roto Rooter to come out in a few days.  They were supposed to be here at noon but did not arrive until 1:30.  He pulled the toilet and proceeded to work on the clog for quite some time until he thought it was clear.  He then reset the toilet.  Upon coming downstairs I saw that my kitchen sink was now full of black dirty water.  The technician then proceeded to use their machine to unclog the kitchen pipes and got it stuck!  The clog must have moved as the water did finally go down!  They went out to their truck and left for at least 45 minutes without tell me what was going on!  When he returned he had a "senior Tech" with him who made him pull the toilet again!  Around 6:30 they felt everything was clear so they went out to their truck and tallied up the bill.  They presented me with a bill for $1,560!!!  I wanted to dispute it but at that point, A contractor friend told me that they should have stood by their original quote or at least met me somewhere between $600 & $1,560!  I felt they had me over a barrel.  I did pay the full amount but feel they took advantage of me!  I will NEVER call Roto Rooter again!

reviews.author: Pronaarum Inc
reviews.text:
I would give them 0 stars if that was an option. The company's owner refuses to stand behind what his technicians promise, and I was a fool to trust in what people say/promise.

I submitted a service request through the RotoRooter's Concord CA website. Some time later I get a call that they can come over that same afternoon and give me a free estimate. When they come, the technician says he has to auger the toilet. I told him I had already done that multiple times, and it would not help. Technician says, he has to do it to get to the next step of giving me an estimate, and if it does not solve the problem, I will not be charged for it. I told him about the $75 coupon that the website had and he says, he can add it later. I sign the service request (stupid me for trusting people). He augers and ofcourse nothing happens. Then he tells me that I need to snake the toilet -- which is what I called them for, and he gives me an estimate that is through the roof (i got it done for half of what he quoted me). I declined the service. Later I get a bill for the augering. I talk to the Manager/owner and he says well they did work on the toilet and have to charge me. I ask them to honor the $75 coupon and they say, "Oh that's concorn, we dont honor that, even though that is where they got their request from). All in all, this is the last time I ever do business with RotoRooter. I would especially stay away from the Fairfield branch of this franchise.

reviews.author: Knania B.
reviews.text: If I could give negative stars I definitely would. I called Monday, for a leak. The city of Fairfield said I must have a leak since my water bill has been outrageous. It's jumped 4 times what I usually spend. The last bill being 1k. I believe his name was Mike, specifically said it's a FREE CONSULT. he said someone would be out Thursday. I work nights so of course I already new I had to adjust my schedule so I would be awake. Thursday came and the dispatcher (Mike) I believe said they would be there within 2 hours. No one came and I stood awake the whole damn day. Then Friday morning comes , Mike apologizes and says the plumber is on his way. The plumber comes within a few hours to tell me the fee to get started is $299 to run a LEAK DYNASTIC! WTF??? Where is the free dynastic at???? So, there was never a free consult! The tech needs approval to start and I must agree to the fee. I'm pissed at this point. I call the dispatcher and he says I must've been mistaken. How am I mistaken when you said.... free consult??? Then the tech comes and says you have a leak.  TO SEE WHATS WRONG, TO SEE IF A LEAK IS EVEN PRESENT I MUST RUN A LEAK DYNASTIC!  So, basically the dispatcher intentionally gave me false information to get his plumber here and prevent me from finding a cheaper place. If I wasn't on a time frame, I would've canceled. And I pretty sure this dispatcher (Mike) is aware of this!!!! I would never use this company again!

synthesis.summary: Despite an A+ BBB rating and 4.4★ Google average, the actual Yelp review text in this batch is brutal — $300–$750 charged for jobs other companies do for half, multiple no-shows on emergency calls, and reviewers describing being told 'free estimate' then charged $150–$500 just for the diagnosis. One reviewer was quoted $20K for a main waterline that the homeowner fixed himself with a Home Depot part.
strengths: When a tech does show up on time, the work itself sometimes lands — one reviewer cleared a main line in 45 minutes for $335 and called service great
weaknesses: Pricing roughly doubled year-over-year per a long-term customer ($250 → $500 same job)
Multiple reviewers report 24/7 emergency service calls with no callback or next-day-only response
$569+ weekend premium for 45-minute jobs, with techs refusing to clean up the flooding they were called to address
redFlags: Pattern of high pressure sales — $11.5K, $20K, $34K quotes that other plumbers clear with augers in minutes
Multiple reports of franchise refusing refunds even when supervisor previously authorized them
Reports of techs becoming aggressive and slamming doors when payments are challenged
'Free estimate' marketed but customers charged $150–$500 'diagnostic' fees
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Despite 24/7 emergency branding, multiple reviewers describe being told to wait till the next day, appointments rescheduled hours-late repeatedly, and 24/7 calls going to no-show.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 2.3★ vs Google 4.4★ across 58 Yelp reviews — large gap; Yelp captures the pricing and no-show complaints

plumbers.name: Lee Whiteaker Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2100 Co Rd 152, Georgetown, TX 78626, USA

reviews.author: Vito F
reviews.text:
I can't believe I hadn't reviewed these guys yet after all of the good work they've done for us in the last two years. I really enjoy working with RC. He's been to our house multiple times, both for bathroom remodel projects that included tub/toilet replacements, and water heater replacement. I've worked with lots of contractors, and they are one of the few that I've worked with that I trust, and consistently offer the best combination of service and pricing. No high pressure upsell's or doom and gloom stories about your plumbing; just honest dialogue about the best options for your specific situation.

More recently Mason came by to replace our water heater. He was on-time, polite, knowledgeable, and did good work replacing our water heater. I checked in throughout the job, and noticed that cleaned as he worked, leaving everything in better shape than it was when he got there. Great communication throughout the process.

I can't talk this company up enough, you can trust Whiteaker Plumbing for your home plumbing needs.

reviews.author: H Smith
reviews.text: Excellent service by Mason at Whiteaker Plumbing.  Honest, clear reasonable pricing, good communication.  He was on time, cleaned up even in my garage and did a great job.  Explained everything to me. They will be my go to plumbers in the future.

reviews.author: craig lewandowski
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend Whiteaker Plumbing.  Mason the plumber was very personable & explained how things worked as he went along.  He took special care to make sure everything was fine until the next day when the final hookup would be made. He cleaned up after the job & went out of his  way to get the part we were missing for  one of the jobs.  Thanks to RC for recommending a countertop man or this job wouldn't have been possible.

reviews.author: Luciano Rivera
reviews.text: He never called back

reviews.author: Steve M
reviews.text:
We had a break in the water service line at our home in Georgetown. A neighbor recommended Whiteaker Plumbing based on the great experience he had with them on several indoor and outdoor projects/repairs.

Fortunately for us, Mason from Whiteaker was able to come and make the repair that same day. Mason was professional, knowledgeable, and meticulous in making the repairs. He was also friendly and happy to explain what he was doing and how it would be an improvement versus how the original service line (and attached irrigation line) had been run.

In the end the issue was resolved, we were extremely happy with Mason's work, and the price was very reasonable.

I would definitely recommend Whiteaker Plumbing, and will be using them for any future projects and repairs.

reviews.author: Toby Mellon
reviews.text:
A leak from badly installed toilet flange caused damage to the baseboard and allowed mold to develop inside the wall. Neighbors recommended Whiteaker Plumbing whom I called. They were responsive and recommended a good contractor to repair the wall and baseboard. Whiteaker Plumbing sent Moe out to assess the problem and damage and accurately diagnosed the cause and extent of repairs required.

After the wall was repaired, Whiteaker Plumbing returned to install a new flange, wax ring, and reset the toilet correctly. Moe did excellent work.

Whiteaker Plumbing is now our plumber for repairs and advice. The entire staff is friendly and calls prior to arrival: no surprise visits and reasonable charges. I recommend Whiteaker Plumbing for any plumbing repair.

reviews.author: Kendra Porter
reviews.text:
I called them at 8:00 and left a message. RC called me in less than an hour and was at the house by 10:00. He was super friendly, explained everything and was extremely diligent. I had called other places and they couldn’t get to me for days. Whiteaker plumbing was on top of it and took great care of us. They warranty their work, use name brand products, and most importantly they don’t overprice the work.

Thank you Whiteaker Plumbing and RC for being on top of great service.

reviews.author: Becky Abrahamson
reviews.text: We highly recommend Mason with Whiteaker Plumbing. He responded very quickly and arrived right on time. He assessed our leak issue and explained the problem as well as showed us what needed to be repaired. He gave us a repair cost which was very fair and reasonable and then he got to work. He was extremely professional and personable. He did a great job and cleaned up everything when he was done. We are very satisfied and will definitely use him for all our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Aissa Davis-Powell
reviews.text: So grateful to have discovered this wholesome and trustworthy business. R.C has been a huge God send for such a messy situation. R.C fixed the SUMP pump and explained every step of the waste management process and even took the extra mile to help me contact the correct people to troubleshoot a major issue. TRUSTWORTHY, HONEST, and RELIABLE describes R.C with Lee Whiteaker Plumbing. If I could give a million stars I would... HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

reviews.author: Lisa Wood
reviews.text: Saw a leak in guest bathroom on Veteran's day in late evening.  We had guests flying in next afternoon.  Texted them next day before they opened and they came were at my house at 9:30am and replaced the toilet tank (which was cracked) before noon. They were fast, efficient and reasonable.  We were able to pick up our guests at the airport that afternoon and enjoy their stay!! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.text:
I had a shower valve that was leaking intermittently.   I spoke with RC about it,  and he didn't even need to see it in order to diagnose the problem.  It turned out that he was absolutely right, and the fix was quick and easy.  Obviously, these guys are experienced.

I have two water heaters that are probably due for replacement, and when the time comes, Whiteaker will be my guys.

reviews.author: Edward Schindler
reviews.text: Have used this company many times over the years.  They are the best.  Stand behind their work and always do a first-class job.  Have purchased 2 hot water heaters and installed a hot water recycler system among other things.  Mason is great and truly customer focused which is an exception among many.  You cannot go wrong for personal household plumbing needs here.

reviews.author: Sandra Smith
reviews.text: I found myself with broken and busted pipes from the freeze. All the other companies i called were wait listed for up to a week. Lee retuned my call personally and fit me in very quickly. They had my pipes fixed within Two days. Amazing company!!! Great workers. Amazing work!! I will recommend them from now on to anyone needing help!! Thank you SO much yall!!

reviews.author: Jeff Doering
reviews.text: Most impressed with RC and Mason at Whiteaker Plumbing! Straight forward with pricing and schedule. Mason arrived when he said he would, confirmed price, and when he had to do extra to spend extra time locating the part did not add to the invoice. Seems like a family business with no agenda of gouging or upselling. Added to my contact list in my cell phone!

reviews.author: Rob Shook
reviews.text: Such speedy, thorough, communicative help from RC. Had a water line to the house break at the PVC (from the street) to the copper (at the house) junction. He told us where to look and what to do; once we had the pipes exposed (great help from our landscaper) he came quickly, when promised, and had it fixed completely. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Shiran Friedman
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly Recommend Mother Modern Plumbing! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I just had to take a moment to share how incredibly impressed I am with the service from Mother Modern Plumbing.

From start to finish, they were professional, communicative, and genuinely great people to work with.

👉 Their team showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and treated our home with respect-even taking care to keep the workspace clean.

👉 They didn’t just fix the problem, they walked us through what needed to be done and why.

👉 Every person we interacted with was friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about doing excellent work.

Honestly, it felt like working with people who genuinely care- not just about plumbing, but about their customers and community.

I’m more than satisfied, I’m genuinely happy to recommend them.

If you need a reliable, professional plumbing team that’s respectful, trustworthy, and truly skilled-this is it! 💯🙌

reviews.author: Sue Roche
reviews.text:
We were in the midst of remodeling a bathroom when we ran into a problem which required some of the existing plumbing be replaced. We thought this might involve cutting out a piece of the wall behind the shower. Colton came and assessed the problem, got the required materials, and fixed it very quickly. He found a way to do it without cutting into the wall which we really liked!
Colton was professional, friendly, and did a great job!! We'll definitely call him again for our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Thomas Allen
reviews.text:
Mother’s came out to assess a sewer drainage leak that we had. Colton and his team were extremely helpful, and very knowledgeable.

They came to my house within 24 hours of me calling, and were incredibly thorough and fair. Steven and Colton were great, and the pricing was extremely transparent. I like the fact that everything was digital and emailed to me!

Fast forward, Jerry and Brian came out and completed the entire re-route in a week. They were thorough and updated us daily with their next steps. Can’t say enough good things about Mother and the work they did. We trusted them with our largest plumbing project to date and they delivered! Calling them whenever we need a plumber in the Plano area. We also got our Water Heater replaced through them and that was a breeze.

reviews.author: Michael L.
reviews.text: At first, they were very considerate to my problems. Matt was very personable and made me feel like they had my best interests in mind. But then the sales guy comes. And give me 3 quotes. One $5,800 to replace the pipe with trenching. Two $5000 for trenchless replacement. Three for just repairing the pipe. After looking at it myself, it was just two loose fittings. Watch yourself with this company.

reviews.author: Minzhi Shao
reviews.text: Ben showed up on time and we got charged but the problem was not fixed! This was the worst experience I had with a plumbing company. We had a problem with laundry room drain clogged, when I called the company, I was quoted $299 (with website coupon $269) for camera inspection and deep cleaning and the warranty of 120 days . Ben found the problem with the drain, instead of spending more time to fix it, he spent almost 30 minutes trying to get me to agree on the jet cleaning which was a much higher price, after hearing my declining, he said the cleaning he did that day would not guarantee! The laundry room flooded the next day!!!

reviews.author: Ashley Jay
reviews.text:
The reason for three stars is the cost point.
Matt and his apprentice that came out today and did the work were professional, knowledgeable and very nice. I was disappointed that it took two trips on two separate days to get the work done. That meant me missing two half days at work. Colton came out yesterday and was also very nice , but said he didn’t have the necessary parts with him to fix the leak. The guys today had to leave and go to the hardware store to get parts before they could get started.
It took no more than 10’ of pipes and fittings. It cost me $1574 .04 to run two pipes from the water softener to the outside pipes to the main line. They did not have to plumb the actual softener. The only parts replaced were near the cutoff valves down. It’s was approximately 3.5’ to 4’ per line.  They did replace 3 cutoff valves, but I have bought them before and know they aren’t terribly expensive. Overall I am happy with the actual work, but not at all happy with the cost.  They do encourage a member ship that cost about $330.00 a year  and gives you a discount on the service and a few other perks, but that ended up only costing about $100.00 after the discount ($236.96) on the work. I usually get more than one bid, and it’s my fault I didn’t, but I can’t change that now. So did they do good work? Yes! Are they super expensive?  I feel like they are for the time it took and the minimal parts needed. Seems like it was way over $500.00 per hour when all was said and done. I might mention there was no digging involved to reach the pipes.
The company is good about telling you who your service person will be and gives you their tracking so you know when they will be there which is a plus.
My name is Angela. I’m not sure why it says Ashley.

reviews.author: V G
reviews.text:
First of all the company was very responsive, good communication.  They stayed true to their timeframe they gave me.   I was 40 minutes away and he waited patiently for me.

Both of my toilets had water underneath them seeping out.  They were not overflowing, but the water was seeping out beneath them.

The first plumber, Ben, arrived, checked my sewage line and pointed out some things that could become a problem later.
He checked both toilets. He Was very precise and showed every step of the process that he was conducting.  Right away, he went to the clean out on the outside of the house and put the camera and looked.   He showed me there was nothing going on there, relief.
He pointed out what needed to be fixed and what wasn’t a problem.
The second plumber Julio arrived. The company had sent an entailed biography of each plumber and a picture.  That was a very comforting to me.  They explained every step and were very personable.  Julio so detailed he mentioned the bathroom trashcan  might be out of place and apologized.
This company cares about the customer.
The first thing I asked when I called If the plumbers were subcontracted.  She said no, they worked directly for them.  That was another sigh of relief for me.
Everything was left in the proper place and very clean.
I definitely recommend this company.  And if I ever have issues or want to improve my system, I will definitely give them another call.
These are the takeaways:
Excellent Communication Skills
Professionalism and Safety
Expert Inspection
Trustworthy Staff
Cleanliness

reviews.author: Nicole A.
reviews.text:
I am in awe of just how wonderful mother modern plumbing company was. From the first person to the last person you guys are professional, efficient, honest, and speedy. Not only things that make a great business, but their team also has integrity and heart. Dustin, Steven, Jerry, and connor plus the excavating team went above and beyond the scope of their required jobs. They were there to fix a leak under our foundation that had been quoted a ridiculous number by another company so we went with Mother after they came out to do a second opinion with no fee. They also helped me install a showerhead and filter that has been sitting in my home for over a year. Then after all the work was done at the end of the night Connor saw myself and my 78 year old grandmother struggling  to move some furniture offered to assist us. The kicker was during a follow up call to see how the job went and I mentioned in passing that my daughter's bday was that day. THEY SENT HER A GIFT FOR HER BDAY. No one does that! Mother modern does tho!
I have already recommended mother modern plumbing to 3 people one of which just had a leak happen a few days ago

reviews.author: Patty Valadka
reviews.text:
⸻

We had a really good experience with Mother Modern Plumbing!! Julio, Mauricio, and Willie were great to work with. What started as a clogged sink turned into replacing the sewer line, which I was not thrilled about, but they made the whole process way easier than I expected. Everyone involved was very professional. They explained and showed evidence of exactly what needed to be done.

They showed up when they said they would, and kept me in the loop the whole time. The office was also really good about communicating who would be coming and when. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

The crew they brought in for digging and refilling the trench did a great job too, and everything seemed really well coordinated between them and the guys overseeing the job. When they were done, they actually took the time to put the yard back together, with care getting it back as closely as possible how it looked before, which included relaying some sod!

Overall just a solid, professional group and easy to work with. I’d definitely use Julio, Mauricio, and Willie again. I opted for the yearly service plan as well was reasonable!

reviews.author: Matt Presley
reviews.text: I recently had Melvin Hill and Josh Dudley from Mother Modern Plumbing handle a residential plumbing project at my home, and I couldn’t be more impressed—easily a 5-star experience from start to finish! They arrived right on time, fully prepared, and his professionalism shone through immediately with their courteous demeanor and meticulous attention to detail. They walked me through every step of the process, explaining the “why” behind each valve and fitting in a way that was clear and easy to understand, even for someone like me who’s not a plumbing expert. Their communication was top-notch; they patiently answered all my questions (including a few I’d been saving for “later,” just like his advice suggests!) and made sure I felt informed and confident throughout. Off the clock, knowing he’s a dedicated family man and youth coach just adds to the sense of trustworthiness. If you’re in the Waxahachie or Midlothian area, I highly recommend Mother Modern Plumbing and Mel—professional, communicative, and truly customer-focused!

reviews.author: Teyah S.
reviews.text:
I had a kitchen sink backup that I partially resolved by using a hand auger to break up the clog. But after spending a day trying to clear it, I knew I needed professional help. After contacting several plumbers, Mother Modern Plumbing stood out for their attentiveness, honest commentary and straight up, fair pricing. 

I ended up booking the $299 drain clean special which came with a warranty and I'm so glad I did. I booked and received a confirmation call and email. The day of the service, I received a text with bio of the plumber that would be servicing my home. Adan Diaz showed up and he was fantastic! He was pleasant and knowledgeable. Not only did he solve the problem but he gave pointers on what to look for and other homeowner misses that can ultimately end up causing thousands if dollars if not addressed. He didn't try to upsell or force. He came, did his job and educated. If I need a plumber in the future. I'll fit sure call Mother!

reviews.author: chris h.
reviews.text:
****Update*****

The owner of the company called me a few minutes ago to have a conversation about my request and offered a free estimate for the work I'm requesting, and he provided his cell number if I should have any other concerns. 

I can't speak towards their level/quality of service, I called asking for a quote for a natural gas line installation and while I've received two free quotes from other companies, Mothers said it would be a $39 charge to send someone out to inspect the needs of the service and provide a quote.  I canceled the request because there are too many companies that will offer a free estimate, I couldn't justify paying for one.  I have never been asked to pay a trip charge to get an estimate for anything I've ever looked into doing by any company before, I was quite surprised when he said there would be one.

reviews.author: LeeAnna McComas
reviews.text: I just bought a meticulously renovated 1922 Tudor in Junius Heights. I noticed my primary bath toilet was leaking around the bottom. I attempted to get a hold of my contractor and waited a week then looked for a good plumber referral. I found out about Mother Plumbing based on a social media referral. I have now found a plumber for life. Marcus was my technician. He was kind, friendly and super honest. Gave me advice on the issue and told me to get a hold of my contractor and hold him to his word on the warranty. He was honest and extremely helpful. I will now have them out for more work. I need a house water filter and will be referring them to all my neighbors. I am super grateful to find an honest company out there who has educated, knowledgable and kind techs. Call them!

reviews.author: Brad Mitchell
reviews.text: Adam Diaz was very knowledgeable, polite, and kept the work area clean.  I liked the service he provided.  The cleaning solution had a very strong perfume smell that required us to open windows and turn on all the exhaust fans to get rid of the strong odor.  The $600 fee for a one time flush of our tankless water heater was ridiculous.  It forced you by default to choose the annual plan for $330.  The annual plan does include some other perks, like a free drain clean out and a 16% discount on other work.   After some investigation, they corrected my email address and I receive a copy of my bill with the list of items included in writing as promised.  Everything was transacted on an iPad.

reviews.author: Keith
reviews.text:
I've been using plumbers for decades for both commercial and residential projects and have to say these folks are the best I've ever worked with.  Their technician was prompt, had all the necessary equipment and knowledge to clear the sewer line problem we had.  And, he did it in less that an hour.  Plus he didn't try to sell unneeded services or pad the bill.  I couldn't be happier and have already recommended Mother to another friend.  This firm is going on my permanent contact list for service providers!!

Thank you Mother and your tech Stephen for a great job!!

synthesis.summary: Strong workmanship and quick response — they answer late-night requests and routinely show up within 24 hours, with clean digital communication. The catch: pricing runs hot (one reviewer reported ~$1,574 for ~10 feet of pipe and three cutoff valves, calling it 'way over $500 per hour'), and one Yelp reviewer flagged a $5,000–$5,800 sewer-line quote that turned out to be 'two loose fittings.'

Workmanship and cleanup get specific praise: 'everything was neat as a pin,' 'wore booties prior to entering house'

weaknesses: Pricing runs high for what shows up: $1,574 to run ~10 feet of pipe with three cutoff valves
One reviewer was quoted $5,000+ for trenchless replacement on what turned out to be 'two loose fittings'
redFlags: Pattern of quotes that look inflated relative to actual scope of work

reviews.author: Clancy Hawkins
reviews.text:
Troy was great to work with. He was professional, knowledgeable, and clearly very experienced — his 46 years in the industry really show. He quickly figured out what was going on, explained everything clearly, and made sure the issue was handled properly.

What I appreciated most was how straightforward and helpful he was throughout the process. He took the time to answer my questions and made a stressful situation much easier to deal with.

I’ll absolutely be calling Troy again for any future plumbing needs and would definitely recommend him to others.

reviews.author: Rachel Lane
reviews.text:
After our water heater unexpectedly failed, we spent an entire weekend trying to fix it ourselves, only to realize it was beyond repair. By Monday, after three days without water and a broken cold water inlet on top of it, we were completely overwhelmed. The plumber we’d used before couldn’t come until the next day, and we simply couldn’t go another day without water.

We called at least 10 plumbing companies, and that’s when Tony with Public Service Plumbers came to the rescue. He made an after-hours visit, showed up promptly, and immediately put us at ease. Tony was professional, courteous, and communicated everything clearly. He explained exactly what needed to be done, didn’t try to upsell anything unnecessary, and the pricing felt completely fair.

In less than two hours, we had water again.

Tony truly turned a stressful situation into a great experience. We highly recommend him and Public Service Plumbers, they’ve earned our business for life.

reviews.author: Kari Drews
reviews.text: Appreciate Jason's professionalism, experience & customer care for the large repiping he did. He even noticed a flaw in the new toilet he installed so I had a new one delivered. Very detail oriented!

reviews.author: Ana P.
reviews.text: We called Public Service Plumbers yesterday because we had a clogged shower and kitchen sink. They unclogged the shower and while unclogging the kitchen sink, they broke a pipe. Water began coming out of the wall into the living room floor and all over the kitchen floor. The plumber said the pipe was old and it was not his fault. We called their office and spoke to the office manager but he was not helpful and sided with the plumber without looking at the pipe first. He said they could send someone to fix it for $800 - $900.  Since then two different professionals have come look at the pipe and they both said the drain snake the plumber used was too big and the pipe had not broken if they had used the proper equipment. Now I'm out more than $1000, and it looks like I have water damage on my floors.

reviews.author: Sean R.
reviews.text: Terrible customer service experience. I had a backup happening in the master bathroom so I called Public Service Plumbers. The guy comes out and tries to snake the drain...nothing. Then he gets under the house and says he thinks the problem is with a certain fitting that was used on the pipes. Fair enough, I thought. At least we found the problem. As the tech is about to leave he tells me my bill is almost $400. Realizing I got charged for his "apprentice" to be there was the first frustration. That kid could have stayed in the car and no one would have noticed. THEN comes the second frustration. Immediately after he leaves my second bathroom starts to clog/backup (it had been working fine for the previous two weeks while the master was out of order). So at this point I paid almost $400 to basically lose my only working bathroom. When I called back and told them it was emergent, I was advised the earliest they could come out was in three days. I was told that I would have an estimate for the repair shortly. When the estimate came it sounded like they were throwing out numbers arbitrarily. I couldn't even get a hold of a supervisor to help me understand the fee structure. After getting passed to several dispatchers who didn't know their ass from a hot rock, the best anyone could tell me was anywhere from $1 - $1,400....to change a PVC fitting... after that I called another company that came out same day and fixed the problem for significantly cheaper. Don't even bother calling these guys. Good customer service is all but dead here.

reviews.author: Chad Meis
reviews.text:
**UPDATE** for April 15, 2025.
Juan with A-1 Air called approx 35 minutes before arriving, which was within the timeframe (30-45) that PSP stated. Juan has a great attitude and is very professional, showing respect for the customer and their property. He was here for our free regularly scheduled maintenance as a paid member. Juan stated that our indoor and outdoor units are in great shape and that nothing is needed, to continue keeping the unit in good health by continuing the preventative measures of changing the air filter regularly and washing of the outdoor unit at the same time. Very happy with Public Service Plumbers and their partner companies. Huge thumbs up to Juan and crew!
**UPDATE** for November 17, 2025.
Gabriel Locklear showed up perfectly on time, after the company confirmed our appointment about an hour ahead, and he called 10 minutes before arrival. Very courteous, very professional, and genuinely a great experience. I asked if there was anything needed, on our end, for preventative measures. He let me know that everything is operating properly and to just keep doing what we're doing. No upsell. No extra services to make extra money. This is the best company I've had the pleasure of doing business with. Thank you, PSP!
Nate was on time, professional, courteous, and very knowledgeable. Provided all info needed and left us with no questions or worries. Very comfortable using this company, after 3 estimates, for sewer drain repair. The overall experience was painless, affordable and professional. Arturo, James and Tyler were courteous, knowledgeable and professional. I am so glad I chose Public Service Plumbers and will be using them for all future plumbing and HVAC needs.
*Update for 01/27/2025
I love this company for the integrity and professionalism that is practiced. Troy Curtis and his partner in training did a phenomenal job for our annual maintenance inspection of the plumbing. I was given multiple options for needed repairs and updates. I am a very happy customer and thankful to be a Shield of Protection plan member.
Thank you, PSP!!
*Update for 02/18/2025
Awesome job as usual. Scheduled our annual inspection of the A/C system. Noel and the gentleman helping him did a fantastic job. Very professional and thorough. Provided pictures, video and quotes of items that could be addressed to help the system run more efficiently and save us money on the electric bill. Very happy with the service.

reviews.author: Cole S.
reviews.text:
THIS WAS ONE OF THE WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE EXPERIENCES I HAVE EVER DEALT WITH.

I am a landlord and made an appointment for them to unclog a shower drain. I gave the plumber the tenants phone number to set up the appointment, since the tenant occupies the property. The drain gets unclogged and I received an invoice for $514.64! Much to my surprise, this was a lot more than I was expecting to pay for unclogging a shower drain. I was communicating with the plumber, Wayne Vaughan through email, and I said that the invoice amount was never authorized by me and I never gave permission to complete this job, so I said I wasn't going to pay for it. The plumber, Wayne Vaughan said the tenant approved the job. I told him that the tenant was not paying for it, so he had no right to give approval nor did Wayne have the right to move forward with the job with just his approval. (I admit, that saying I wasn't going to pay wasn't the right thing to do).

Instead of picking up the phone to explain and resolve the issue, Wayne Vaughan proceeds to call my boss, to a job that is COMPLETELY UNRELATED to my job as a landlord, and tells my boss that he is going to put a lien on the property because I won't pay the invoice, and continues to bad mouth me to my boss. My boss calls me to let me know and I call Wayne. Wayne never once called me to resolve this issue and thought is was a good idea to look me up on google and see who I worked for. He not only embarrassed me with my boss, but also shouted at me on the phone when I called him to resolve the issue. I paid the Invoice after a $80 reduction, because I felt like it had already caused more trouble than it was worth. I have never dealt with this kind of unprofessionalism in my life. I admit that I didn't initially handle the situation great, but there are many more steps that could've have been taken to resolve this matter professionally by Public Service Plumbers.

reviews.author: Lane K.
reviews.text: FRAUD!!! This company is now part of Willard and, in our case, sent out a third party electrician from a company we had never heard of. Every aspect of his wiring has been faulty. He was supposed to deactivate wiring in one room for the painter, but days later the painter almost electrocuted himself due to the wiring still being live. The chandelier box the electrician installed, turned out to have no actual live wires connected to it so we had to pay another electric company to do what Public Service charged for "installation." In total the bill was almost $1,500, and we've paid over $2,000 more to have this work actually done. What a fraudulent horrible company! The conglomerate as a whole runs each of these sister companies very poorly, and the fact they get third party contractors, from other companies whose reputation consumers can't even research, is terrible. You don't even know who's actually in your home. In our case the man had an overall bad attitude. He seemed unwilling to want to do the work, and as it turns out, he actually didn't do any work. After countless complaints the company refuses to stand by their "work." I would avoid this and all Willard affiliates not to mention any other company that has recently been bought and lumped together with other companies. Chances are they will be just as poorly run as this group of unprofessionals.

reviews.author: Sandra K.
reviews.text:
Update 4/16 received a call from the office manager. Receptionist was new and training will be addressed. Manager told same thing a second plumber did, that draining and flushing the heater that old (10 years) may actually cause more problems and may worth the cost involved. Plumber will be coached. Manager credit us the cost of the visit. Thank you Aline. 

They lost a customer today. Called to have a plumber come out because the water heater was making clunking/knocking sounds. Based on what i read on websites the heater needed to be flushed and drained. Told the receptionist who set up the appointment that it probably needed to be flushed. (heater still heated the water well, able to long hot showers etc... just made knocking noises). When the plumber got here, he said that heaters don't need to be flushed drained anymore, he checked to make sure water heater still worked (i already knew it did) and looked at one other issue we had and charged us $98 for the 30 min visit. If i had been told up front that they don't drain/flush water heaters anymore, i would not have had them come out (by the way, the manual for my Whirlpool water heater says it IS supposed to be drained/flushed every 6 months). I don't appreciate being lied to and i don't appreciate having to spend the time and money to hire someone else to do what this guy should have done.

reviews.author: M D.
reviews.text: We called Public Service Plumbers to serivce our tankless hot water heater that kept turning off on Friday midday and they insisted upon seeing the unit on Monday morning instead so that they could converse with the company of the water heater. Luckily the hot water would intermittantly work so we were able to make it through  the weekend without too much inconvience. However on Monday morning when they came to evaluate the problem, the unit never switched off. They did charge us over $200 without any diagnosis besides needing to order a new circuit board that might fix the problem. When the hot water turned off again, I called the company back to get the part ordered and to schedule installation. They told me it would be 7-10 days for the part to get in and the woman on the phone could give me absolutely no kind of price estimate for the install and would not return my calls to the number she and I discussed. So I went ahead and ordered the circuit board myself directly from the hot water heater company myself on Wednesday and it was on my doorstep early on Friday morning (only two days later when they claimed it would take 7-10). Since my phone calls continued to go unreturned and I could not be provided any sort of  estimate for the installation, I contacted another company to install the circuit board for less than the cost of their visit.

reviews.author: Melinda Johnson
reviews.text:
Updating my last entry.

Cristian Ovalle in April 2026 did a rebuild on a Toto toilet for us. Really appreciate his timeliness, his care and concern and handling the job professionally. All good!!!

Jacob - June 2025-  time for the tankless flush. Jacob comes on time? Performs it quickly and efficiently.... and also bring some new cut off handles for my water box that I have requested.
Thank you for your good work!

Jacob Armstrong did my annual plumbing inspection in May 2025.  I always appreciate his knowledge, advice and suggestions. He is 5 star!  Thank you!!

Today I had Jacob Armstrong and Eric and they were great!  Answered all my questions, fixed what needed fixing,'and installed a new faucet for my laundry room. They were complete and neat and I always appreciate their knowledge. Always polite as well.

Helped me with some other questions and tasks.

Thank you.

Josh and Clint were on time and professional. Very knowledgeable and clean and precise, they did a full home plumbing check. Gave me some options to make my plumbing more up to date. I appreciate them and use the company for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Sarah D.
reviews.text:
So glad I found this company on Yelp! The men that came to the house were great! Very nice, professional,  answered all of my questions, and best of all- fixed the problem!!! After taking off work for the afternoon to meet a different plumbing company, I was told they did not have the ability to fix our clogged kitchen sink. I would need to find a company that was able to climb on the roof and enter the pipes through the vent because the clog was too deep in the pipe for ground maintenance.

I called around and the earliest any company could send someone out would be tomorrow afternoon. I understand that isn't very long, but not ideal since I already took vacation time for one plumber and we are running out of frozen dinners (no kitchen sink equals no ability to wash dishes)! I called Public Service Plumbers around 1:00 pm and they were here by 3:00 pm. The woman I spoke with when I called fit me in same day and was incredibly kind on the phone! All around it was a great experience and I would recommend them!

reviews.author: Ron H.
reviews.text: The plumber that came out was courteous and did clean up, but I had a big problem with their pricing structure that wasn't fully revealed until after the work was done.  It turns out they have a "materials" charge for several things that aren't really materials but rather the use of equipment, such as a basic augur ($15 materials fee), etc. They also charged $10 for him using gloves and a rag to wipe up. I called to talk to them about it and said it's the first time a plumber has charged me an additional fee (on top of the 146/hr fee) for the use of their tools, plus I had mentioned before I had the same augur in my garage to the guy when he first showed up. To me this is the equivalent of a mechanic charging me extra to use a wrench, caliper or any other basic tool needed to do the job above and beyond the service fee.  The office told me that's what they have to do and have done for 50 years, end of story.  Oh well, the search continues for a go-to plumber I can fully trust.

reviews.author: Pat Silva
reviews.text: My double kitchen sink was clogged with food and water, and the garbage disposal was backed up and not working.  Your team came to unclog it on Tuesday, April 21 2026, and they did a great job. I asked them if they had time to work on a slow-draining tub in the master bathroom, which they were able to address quickly.  Lastly, the recommended that Taylor come to clear out sludge in the drainage pipes from the kitchen sink. Taylor arrived the next day and explained what he was doing, about how long it would take, and allowed my 85 lb gentle Goldendoodle to supervise!  My son recommended Public Service Plumbers to me years ago and are the only plumbers I have used since then.   I appreciate the team’s professionalism and detailed information regarding safety, cost, replacement part availability and timing. I also signed up for a maintenance package. Excellent service. Thank you.

reviews.author: Dane S.
reviews.text:
In short, we used to love Public Service Plumbers, now we don't as much. The premium service wasn't really worth it. The work is good, and their plumbers were always super friendly. 

We used Public Service Plumbers and even subscribed to their premium service due to our home's age. Unfortunately, there was a time where they left us stranded, even with this premium service. The pricing was pretty high for most projects, even simple ones. However, their work is very good! 

If you have a disaster like we did, they'll work with insurance and ensure city code and permits are proper. 

One of their plumbers recommended an awful water damage company that was different than the one the company recommends and cost us a bunch of money, time and stress. When I called to discuss this with the company, they blew me off. Don't hire American Water Damage if a plumber recommends them.
