plumbers.name: At Your Service Plumbing Company
plumbers.address: 225 Union Blvd #150, Lakewood, CO 80228, USA

reviews.author: Matthew Reich
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things about Dominic and Jon from At Your Service Plumbing Co. We had a serious emergency at one of our Airbnb properties over New Year’s Eve — the toilet was completely backed up after a guest accidentally flushed something that got stuck in the pump motor, and no one else we called could come out on short notice.

Dominic and Jon were the only company willing and able to respond immediately, and they handled the situation professionally, thoroughly, and with great communication throughout the entire process. They diagnosed the problem, worked diligently on a very challenging clog, and kept us updated every step of the way. Their expertise, reliability, and commitment to getting us taken care of made a very stressful situation so much easier — we couldn’t be more grateful.

If you need honest, skilled, and responsive plumbing professionals who truly deliver in an emergency, Dominic and Jon are exactly who you want. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Roger Thompson
reviews.text: I hired at your service plumbing company to install a water heater for me, I was very impressed with the performance and professionalism from Dominic. He is a very skilled plumber tech. who knows his trade. No wonder he is the owner of the company, he really knows how to treat his customers. From one business man to another, I can relate to how you need to be very professional and knowledgeable in you job scope. Dominic and I talked about each other's businesses of being owners and how we both enjoy fishing and long trips. I would definitely recommend hiring Dominic and his company for the best plumbing service in town.

reviews.author: Stacey Howes
reviews.text: Finding a trustworthy and quality plumber has always been a challenge and so I was so happy to have found At Your Service. They were quick, professional and got everything running smoothly again for under $400 (after we'd been quoted 25k for a full sewer repair just days before by another company). Highly recommend and will definitely be working with them in the future for all our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Robert H.
reviews.text: I called on Monday 11/28/16. I set up an appointment with Tricia for 11/29/16. she told me the plumber would arrive by late morning and he would call me with a 1 hour window as to his arrival. 4:30pm, no show, no call. I called the office and spoke with Barbara who put me on hold, she came back and said the plumber tried to reach out to me and could be over in 15 minutes. I was home waiting all day and up at 7am to get the areas ready for him. no one called me, I have a hard line with an answering machine, caller ID etc. nothing. very rude and discourteous. i'd look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Howard J.
reviews.text: I'm sorry to say with did not have the same experience as everyone else. The plumber didn't fix the leak, going as far to actually break the toilet, and on top of that, the owner tried to push his Christianity on us by handing us a DVD that "we might be interested in." I thought it was unprofessional and offensive.

reviews.author: Linda B.
reviews.text: Finding water all over my basement bathroom floor, it looked like the tank on the toilet was leaking.  I had the same problem in my master bathroom a year ago and my heart sank.  It's not cheap to replace a toilet and I had just replaced my hot water heater in May.  I found "At Your Service Plumbing and Rooter" on Yelp and relying on the positive reviews and the content of their web site, I called them.  I was shocked when, after explaining what I thought was the problem, the gentleman said they could repair the tank; I would not have to buy a whole toilet (sounds like last year's big name plumbing company took huge advantage of me).  Juan, the service person discovered the overflow valve was not working and could easily be replaced.  Without hesitation, he reduced the originally quoted price of labor and supplies for repairing the tank and went to his truck to get the replacement valve. On the way out, he noticed, what looked like a newspaper, had been thrown on my roof.  He pointed it out and offered to get it down for me, if I had a broom he could use, which I did and he quickly retrieved what turned out to be a phone book in a white plastic bag.  Juan was friendly, professional and efficient.  He worked quickly and left his work area clean.  I was amazed at the quality of service, the reasonable (REASONABLE) rates (we're talking plumbers!) and the professional service.  I now know where I can call a plumbing service that operates with ethics.  I don't write many reviews, but this time I feel it is important to let people know they can call "At Your Service Plumbing" with confidence that they will be treated ethically.

reviews.author: KAB C.
reviews.text:
In response to the company owner:

Lowell - yes, you are correct that the prices were quoted in advance.  As I mentioned in my review, I was in a bind.  The bottom line is that $300 for the work performed is not right.  I expressed that at the time but it was the second trip out and I just needed the work done.  

What strikes me most is that in none of the conversations I had with either Jonathan or Eduardo was there any interest expressed in my satisfaction.  Eduardo, while professional, argued with my position and basically told me I was wrong.  Had you guys considered dropping one of the trip charges, we probably wouldn't be having this conversation.  Perhaps you can learn from this experience that sometimes a small gesture to a customer can go a long way.  Digging in over a $40 trip charge results in this.

In regard to leaving 2 reviews.  I found you on Yelp so I posted a review on yelp.  You texted me and asked me to leave a review on Angies list so I did there as well.

Look - you have lots of good reviews so presumably you guys are doing something right.  In my situation however, I felt gouged, plain and simple.  Alas, we see things differently but we can part ways amicably.  

I appreciate the follow up call and comments - I wish you well.

reviews.author: DonJuanito ..
reviews.text: About a week ago my wife went to the basement to do some laundry, next thing I here is her screaming. I went down to see what's going on, and I find nothing but waste water on the floor and lost of S**t, literally. Since I've always lived in apartments I really didn't know what was going on. I called my friend the one I'm renting the house from. He told me that all we need to do was get the line "snaked". So I got on yelp and found one of those big name companies. Once they got out they where trying to sell me on $500+ worth of work and they couldn't warranty the work, and on top of that they wanted to do a camera so they can warranty the work. To me it sound like they want more money, by selling a sewer line replacement. I couldn't have them do the work it was outrageous. I got back on yelp and found "AT YOUR SERVICE PLUMBING". They came out the same day. When Jonathan got here he looked at the problem and told me that all we needed was to snake the line. I was surprised he didn't try to sell me more like the other guys. 45 minutes and $137 later he was done. Couldn't be happier, he was polite, clean and most importantly HONEST. I could recommend Jonathan and At your Service Plumbing to anyone.

reviews.author: D. L. Z.
reviews.text:
Dominick Timothy Calderon located at 1990 South Sheridan Blvd., Denver, Co 80227 is listed with Colorado Secretary of State as the Owner of this company.
1. Mr. Calderon is a sleazy, dishonest miscreant and liar who took advantage of this Disabled Veteran. He quoted a price and his technician demanded another 20% - Bait and Switch Tactic!
The "technician" used a Snake with NO BLADE ON THE END AND FAILED TO ELIMINATE THE PROBLEM WHICH BACKED UP ALL OVER MY BASEMENT FLOOR 4 DAYS LATER. THEN THE COWARD RAN AWAY FROM HIS RESPONSIBILITY AND LAUGHED ABOUT IT
2. Calderon REFUSED to reimburse me for their failure and REFUSED TO SEND SOMEONE TO RESOLVE THE PROBLEM
3. Calderon REFUSED to guarantee their work despite assurances
4. Calderon REFUSED to send a Technician with a Camera to confirm the problem and then told copious lies regarding "what it could be"
5. Calderon REFUSED to answer for damage he created by using a system much too large for our application - WHICH GOT SEVERELY STUCK IN THE SEWER LINE AND THE TECHNICIAN HAD TO REPEATEDLY PULL ON IT WITH ALL HIS STRENGTH TO REMOVE IT
6. Calderon REFUSED to send an Invoice after (6) requests with multiple excuses
7. THIS CAN HAPPEN TO YOU!

reviews.author: Joan S.
reviews.text: I read all the previous reviews and thought I would be getting excellent service at a great price. I was wrong to presume without getting estimates from others. I was charged $350 for one hour of simple faucet and sink installation where I supplied all the fixtures and parts. Terry and Mark were excellent on the phone, and Juan did an excellent job. But phone conversations with the owner Lowell, when I called to ask if he could explain such a high fee, were defensively rude and unprofessional. He was correct, and I never disputed, that I was given the estimate at the start of the work, and I agreed to the high amount. I tried to explain that I did so because he had cancelled on me the week before, I was desperate to get my bathroom working, and I had already taken two days off for plumbing appointments. Rather than addressing why they charged so much, or having any sympathy for my situation, he just berated me for not sending Juan away and finding a different plumber. Next time I WILL use a different plumber and I will get an estimate BEFORE they show up. You should too.

reviews.author: Mona Calderon
reviews.text:
Great service! I was scheduled quickly and my install went perfect. The plumber was professional, friendly & provided great service. Need a good plumber? Look no further!!

Update:

I was so impressed with their service last year for a routine job that I trusted their expertise for a major repair - water damage. My toilet flooded my bathroom , and Dominick not only managed the work, he helped navigate the tricky insurance process so that the full rebuild was covered. They also worked quickly so that the inconvenience didn't last as long as the initial estimate of 2-3 months and turned out to be less than 1 month. We are extremely happy with the results! Thank you, Dominick, Jesús & and crew, for your professionalism, hard work, and fast turnaround!! 👍🏽👌🏽 They really went above & beyond to complete the job.

(Before & after pix) Although I loved my bathroom before, I'm ecstatic with my newly designed bathroom. Dominick had a vision and asked me to trust him to see it through. I did and am now enjoying a modern state of the art en suite.

reviews.author: Ann C.
reviews.text: Trust me, use these guys! Prompt, reliable, and affordable. Great service! I can't say enough nice things. We were getting ready to list our house for sale and, of course, the water heater started leaking. They came out right away to disconnect the heater and walked me through on the phone how to start draining the heater before they got there for a quicker job. We had them come back another day to replace the heater since we wanted to clean up the area a bit. Once I called for them to come out, Lowell came right away and did an excellent, quick job. Before he came back, we saw that there was a leak in a pipe in the bathroom next door. He assessed the situation and was able to fix the pipe and charged very little for the fix. I expected to pay much more for these services. He charged me the original quoted price for the water heater install even though they ended up coming to our house twice. That is great customer service and just so nice in general. I can't think of anything to improve; overall fantastic job!

reviews.author: Tina Castillo
reviews.text: Beware of this plumbing company. I called them for a fractured leak in my pipe and they came out. Did some mitigation tore down drywall that was soaked with water where I had my leak in the basement asked me to provide trash bags to put all the debris in and then Left four fans, pulled up my wet carpet and didn’t contact me or come back to finish the job for 10 days after I hired them and signed a contract for them to complete plumbing work in my basement on my pipes. Very very disappointed I do not recommend this company for anyone. I was without water for five days. My yard started turning brown because my sprinkler system wouldn’t go on. I did not have water and kept calling them to send somebody out and they kept promising the next day the next day the next day and they never came back out left me hanging after I paid them half of what was quoted to me on the contract and never finished the job I am posting this to warn everybody do not use this company. They will rob you and steal your money from you.

reviews.author: Mike W.
reviews.text: I was using this company to clean out my sewer line. I believe they did a good job with this, so I hired them to make a sewer line repair that they recommended. They made the repair, and said they would return to fill in the hole after giving time for the dirt to settle. Well,  it rained a ton, and the hole grew very large. I called on the phone and talked to them numerous times about returning to fill in this trench in my front yard. Each time they said they would call me back. Eventually he stopped taking my calls and I gave up. This was approximately 3-6 months after the job was completed. I had a 5-year warranty on the receipt. Eventually, I had no other choice but to fill it in myself using my garden spade, old pickup truck and Home Depot dirt. This was many hours of labor and also the cost of the dirt. Going by the hourly rate that he charged me, he owes me about $4,000 for my labor and dirt. This was two years ago. I was really disappointed, I naively thought he would make it right.

reviews.author: Ken H.
reviews.text: Never, never again! My regular plumber was two weeks out and all I needed was a new bath/shower valve, which I had in hand, to replace the old one as we were ready for tile in a few days. I called and they said they could take a look on Monday. I believe I called Thursday. Jonathon arrived at the appointed time. Nice guy. He then proceeded with the alarming news. $29 for the stop or $470 to sweat in a new valve. That's removing the old valve and soldering in a new valve. I thought he was going to catch my house on fire with handling the torch. It took him exactly one hour and 13 minutes start to finish. Not including drive time, even that is highway robbery. Normal pricing is about $200-250. I was in a jam and he knew it. "Standard Pricing" is what I was told. If so, they're the richest plumbers in town. I was also told I could save $10 if i gave them a good review. Keep that in mind when you read other reviews, please. 1 star for timeliness. 1 star for a nice guy.

synthesis.summary: Massive split — when At Your Service shows up, work tends to be solid (sewer clears, water heater installs done same-day). But a heavy stream of reviews describe missed appointments, no callbacks, and pricing fights with the owner. Yelp 4.0 vs Google 4.7 hints at heavy review curation.
strengths: Same-day or next-day arrival when they do come — '$400 sewer fix after another company quoted $25k'
Strong on water heater swaps and gas valve work — 'replaced gas valve to furnace and water heater, did a great job'
weaknesses: Owner repeatedly described as rude, dismissive, and combative on pricing complaints — 'be aware the owner is rude and horrible to speak to'
Multiple reviewers describe a pattern of no-call, no-show after a scheduled window — 'waiting all day, to never call or show'
Uses third-party contractors and disclaims responsibility when work goes wrong — 'they hire outside contractors that they let you believe are their employees'
redFlags: Pattern of missed appointments and ghosted callbacks across multiple reviews
Owner refuses refunds and blames customers/contractors when work fails
Drywall left torn out and fans abandoned after mitigation work — billing disputes follow
Yelp 4.0 vs Google 4.7 with 56 Yelp reviews suggests possible review curation
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Reviewers mention same-day arrival for active leaks ('$400 fix after the basement was flooding'), and a Thanksgiving-weekend rescue, but follow-through is inconsistent.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 4.0 vs Google 4.7 across 56 Yelp reviews — possible review curation

reviews.author: Amber Mendoza
reviews.text: Philip was so helpful and didn’t even mind answering my questions while he was working on my leaky toilet. He was cheerful which was nice and super fast. He cleaned up after he left as well! Would definitely call again and will recommend to my friends.

reviews.author: Tingting W.
reviews.text: Update: the city inspector came and FAILED the AC install twice. Waiting for the company to respond regarding a refund to make things right.

reviews.author: Jim M.
reviews.text: I reached out for service and provided my location in the contact form. I quickly received a response from Keiri at Rescue Air and was informed a tech would be able to come out the following day. So, I provided my street address and then I was told Rescue Air needed to check if they service my area. I never heard back so I followed up at the end of the week. I received an apology and asked which days would work for the service. I let them know I was available any day. It has now been a week since and I still have not received aresponse. I'm sure the service itself is probably good, but Rescue Air was not interested in my business so I cannot comment.

reviews.author: Julia Trupp Schlecte
reviews.text:
It's officially been a week in nice, cool, fresh air and we're loving it! After requesting a seasonal tune-up through our home warranty company, the service tech told us we had a refrigerant leak and needed a full replacement. Rescue Air was one of the companies we called for a "second opinion" and free estimation. Not only did they come out and take a look, they did a full-on complete 2-hour inspection, explaining every step of the way. Joe visited and invited me with him to inspect our outdoor condenser and the air handler inside, explaining what he was looking at, what could be the matter, and his initial recommendations. Our condenser was indeed leaking refrigerant (it was a 23-year-old unit, featuring R-22... Throwback!), and replacement seemed to make more sense than servicing an ancient machine. He wrote up three different estimates with financing options, and his customer service alone helped us make the decision to hire Rescue Air to replace our HVAC system. Joe was so personable, knowledgeable, and respectful in the initial inspection process. He helped us with financing too (YAY financing because as first-time homeowners, this is another huge investment!) and made sure to be available for any questions we had in the quick application process. He had us scheduled for replacement three days later; amazing!

Installation day arrived and three service technicians showed up early in the morning around 8:30: Austin, Ty and Greg. This trio was fantastic! I work from home, and they gave a detailed overview of how the day would go. They were so organized and tidy (bringing in tarps and wearing shoe covers every time they came in and out of the house), respectful, professional, efficient (spoiler alert: they were done by 2 o'clock that day, which was awesome), thorough and mindful with their service. They felt knowledgeable, trustworthy and on top of their stuff from the get-go, and we're impressed with their work. A week in, we have noticed such a difference in our AC performance and the general air quality in our home. We're so excited to have installation done by Rescue Air and they'll be our go-to for any maintenance calls in the future. We're so grateful for Joe, Austin, Ty and Greg. These gentlemen made sure we were taken care of from pre-installation to the time they packed up and finished the job.

Also, they were great with animals; we have a very social cat named Sylvan who was happy to be project manager for the day and watch them from her sun-spot in the window, and they paid no mind (unless she slow-blinked as they walked in and out of the room, ha! She says hi to her BFF Ty!).

reviews.author: Will Patterson
reviews.text:
Updated 3/29/26:
Still as great a company as we've ever had service our home. We've been loyal customers since they installed our new systems at our old house and they're still servicing our units in our new house. 5 stars still very thoroughly earned.

Updated 4/15/24:
Rescue Air has been and continues to be my go to HVAC company. Clayton was courteous and informative and provided multiple options for our inquiries. We've joined back up to the maintenance program and can't wait to continue to see Rescue Air techs for many years to come, but hopefully only for preventative maintenance! 😂

Updated 11/14/19:
Junior and Jesus and the rest of the install team that was here today did a tremendous job installing a complete new system for our downstairs, which had a crack in the exhaust housing, potentially causing carbon monoxide to be circulated into our air. They also replaced our 240V disconnects outside and a new outside unit for upstairs which was over 15 years old; their install looked immaculate. Jesus asked if I'd like to go with him to the attic to inspect the installation and answer any questions, which I jumped at the opportunity, as a journeyman electrician myself. The furnace looks amazing. The seal job, getting ducts up and strapped to the ceiling, the emergency drain pan with 2 cut-off floats. He showed me where the filter was and how to replace it; as well as how to purge the water from the drain line should it ever need it. He then took me outside to show their craftsmanship on the outside units. The wiring and copper lines were wrapped perfectly with a shielded insulation wrap, the thermostat wire was run in MC and ziptied. I can't speak highly enough of them. They had a long day here today and I am very thankful for the professionalism and quality of work of Junior, Jesus, Joseph, and all the others I didn't catch the names of.

Original: Rescue Air is awesome! They took the time to sit down with us and explain all of our options and their recommendations. We ended up purchasing a new furnace through them. They came out and installed it in no time flat and everything is great! Our downstairs furnace stopped producing heat a few days after they installed the new on for upstairs and they came out next day to check it and install the replacement part. Rescue Air is definitely our go to HVAC company now.

reviews.author: Jennifer E.
reviews.text:
Updated review:
The manager, Oscar, did a good job handling their mistake with our recent plumbing order with them. He corrected the issue and made us feel much better about the entire situation. We now feel differently and hope to use this company again in the future if needed.

(Previous review):
I told you, Juan, that I would leave this review if you didn't have a manager call me back! 

$308 for a little black rubber bib gasket?! 
I am not happy at all by being overcharged by at least $100 or more just to change out a bib gasket! I understand being charged $99 for a service call, but being charged for over $200 just for the worker to be here for 25 minutes and change out a two dollar part? Does that mean that this company charges $400 an hour? I also feel like we were taken advantage of because I wasn't here to to handle the service technician like originally agreed to and planned.
Instead, Rob Lopez came an hour earlier (3:45 PM) than what I told their office representative to send him out. I told Caroline that I wouldn't return home from my daughter's swim lesson until 4:40 PM and that they could send the technician by at 4:45 PM.
My husband was working in our front office at our home that day, but I feel like he was taken advantage of because he couldn't give Rob his 100%, undivided attention when he showed up. My husband had to keep his earbuds in and actively listen to his coworkers while the plumber was here.
Just to give an example of why I feel like we were ripped off, we had our front hose faucet replaced by a different plumber last year and he was about $130 cheaper than this company and he was here for the same amount of time. Plus he gave us a brand new, frost proof faucet!! The whole job only cost $175.
So, if you want to feel like you've been given a bit of a bait and switch with scheduling and be ripped off by at least $100 for a non-emergency, then call this company!

P.S.: The invoice from this company says that they replaced the whole hydrant, which is not true. They only changed out a little black gasket. So, right there, we were charged for something that we shouldn't have. But, no one will return my call!

reviews.author: Joe S.
reviews.text:
### Rescue Air - 5 Stars 

If I could give Rescue Air more than 5 stars, I would do it in a heartbeat! Listen to this: My day started off with a perfectly fine working A/C unit. Another company that I called first to do some maintenance ended up breaking it after a wire became disconnected and they wired it back wrong. Told me my compressor was shot, nothing they could do. OMG! Seriously? I needed a second opinion. Then I called Rescue Air!

Enter Rescue Air: my saviors on this hot, humid day.

 **Prompt Response**  
I called Rescue Air in a state of panic, and their customer service was top-notch from the get-go. They were empathetic, listened to my concerns, and promised to send a technician out the same evening.

 **Timely Arrival**  
Roman was my technician and he arrived exactly when they said he would. No waiting around and no vague 4-hour windows. They understood the urgency of the situation.

 **Expertise & Skill**  
What impressed me most was Roman's expertise. He quickly assessed my A/C unit and discovered that my compressor was NOT shot as previously diagnosed. With skillful hands and a clear understanding of the system, he fixed what the other company broke. 

 **Fair Pricing**  
After such a swift and effective repair, I was expecting a hefty bill. To my pleasant surprise, the pricing was more than fair, especially considering the speed and quality of service. No hidden fees, no unnecessary upselling, just honest work.

 **Professionalism**  
Throughout the service call, the technician maintained the highest level of professionalism. They explained every step, offered tips on how to maintain my A/C unit moving forward, and ensured that everything was working perfectly before they left.

Rescue Air has earned a lifelong customer in me, and I will be singing their praises to all my friends and family. Thank you, Rescue Air, for turning what could have been a dreadful day into a sigh of relief.

You guys are true to your name; you really are the 'Rescue' when it comes to air conditioning woes!

reviews.author: Robert D.
reviews.text:
I believe the other negative reviews to be spot-on.   Be very, very careful with this company.  They came in to give an estimate for one repair, but that turned into a big, scary report of all the issues, pointing strongly at a completely new system.  Ok.  They had photos.  Their explainations sounded reasonable, especially when coupled with the photos they quickly flashed through on their tiny phone.  

So, I told them that we would likely move forward, but I require two things - a copy of all of those photos, and two estimates, one for what they wanted to sell me, and a separate itemized repair list.  I got two estimates - one for the original they were pushing, and another for something MORE expensive.   No itemized list of repairs.  No photos.   

When I reached out in email, they wanted a phone call.  There is almost always a good reason for not wanting to leave a record via email.  But, $15,000-ish for a new 5 ton unit, with no new duct work... yeah, you'd better *really* back that up.   They could not (would not?)  I now have to suspect that thier photos were doctored in some way, maybe even not all of my unit.   Who knows?   Who looks inside, like that?   And, I suspect their reason for not sending me copies of those were dubious.   

They also pressured the sale claiming that "prices go up next week for Summer."  Sha.  Ok.  This was in March.  Good luck with these tactics.   Not for me. 

If you want to give them enough rope to hang themselves to find out for yourself, just act ignorant and as excited for a new unit as they suddenly are to sell you on it.  You'll see.  It'll cost you $120 for the scammy diagnosis, though.

reviews.author: Scott Handley
reviews.text:
04/07/26 update - today we had the pleasure of working (again) with Charlie Haddock, this time for plumbing help as he installed 2 new toilets for us.  Once again Charlie was fantastic! He’s very knowledgeable, professional, personable and competent.  We continue to be so pleased with Rescue Air - for HVAC & plumbing needs!  Very fair pricing!

Our sales experience yesterday afternoon - a Saturday (!) with Cole K. was great. He is incredibly knowledgeable and worked with us to find the right solution for our needs.  Today (Sunday!!!) our installation experience was outstanding!  Austin M. & Ty F. came out bright and early and hit the ground running. Then there was a small hiccup with an incorrect part that got delivered - Austin got on the phone and made stuff happen and kept his word that he and Ty wouldn’t leave until we had a cold house (again - on a Sunday!!). The level of attention to detail was next level from them both.  Things we never would have been smart enough to know if corners had been cut - they pointed out and explained how thorough they were being, and God Bless them for that.  Austin and Ty are next level.  Professional, knowledgeable, nice, easy to work with.  Rescue Air is very lucky to have them representing the company.  We couldn’t be happier with our choice.  They are not the cheapest - and I completely understand why. With Rescue Air you get what you pay for, and you can’t put a price on peace of mind. Great job, guys!

reviews.author: Adam H.
reviews.text:
The techs that come to your house are either not given the proper tools or the proper training to do their job. Someone came over to my house to perform routine maintenance, and at the end he reported that the evaporator coil had a leak. He showed me a video of one of his tools going off, indicating a leak.   The cost of replacing this coil would be $5100.

I thought this was strange as the AC seemed to be working fine, so I decided to get a second (and third) opinion and neither of those companies detected a leak.  If I had trusted this employee I would have been out a sizable chunk of change.  I like to give people the benefit of the doubt, so I'm guessing either the tech was incompetent or was working with malfunctioning tools.

It should also be noted that once he gave me the news he then tried to get me to act fast, and offered discounts if I moved quickly.  I would advise anyone who works with this company to resist the pressure to get the "repair" done quickly and get at least a second opinion.

Edit: I talked to the business owner and he offered to have someone come over and perform two more tests to see if there is, in fact, a leak in the evaporator coil. Supposedly these tests are more thorough and definitive than the test the tech performed. This further proves my point of that the employees need more training or are inept at their job. If I'm going to tell someone they need +$5k in repairs I'm not going to rely on a sub par test. I would perform the "gold standard" test the first time, or at least confirm the inferior tests results.

reviews.author: K Thomas
reviews.text:
Philip Blystone and Jesus Mendoza at Rescue Air and Plumbing came out the same day as called to take care of a shower drain and adjust the scald guard on our shower.

Philip is awesome, and we request him for anything plumbing related that comes up. He’s a second generation plumber who brings his know-how to every job and always with a heartfelt smile! Jesus and Philip are like the dynamic duo in lock step with each other and get the job done right!

Philip is excellent at communicating issues,  explaining the plan to resolve, and executing flawlessly! He and Jesus have been in our house over the years to fix toilets, sinks, showers, install piping, rough-ins and trim kits, and recently installed a new kitchen faucet too.

We are a long time customer at Rescue Air & Plumbing and we are happy with the service. Dispatch calls and texts to tell us when we’re next in line, then texts us when the tech is on his way with a photo and tech’s name. This removes the mystery of when someone is actually coming. So needed with our busy schedules. All work and costs are clearly explained prior starting.

Are there cheaper options out there? Sure, but in our experience we get what we pay for and are happy to pay for Rescue Air & Plumbing’s responsiveness, plumber expertise, and white glove professionalism. The work is warrantied and they stand by their work.

Thank you!

reviews.author: J H.
reviews.text:
Let me first say that Philip KNOWS HIS STUFF!!!
I've been having an issue with 1 of my downstairs toilets for well over a year, I have 2 other restrooms so it wasn't a bid deal to where I needed to drop everything to address it.

The issue was that there was a super slow flow in the water line that caused the toilet to fill up extremely slow and for the cold water side of the faucet to flow slow as well.

After Philip asked me a few questions and I answered them, he then asked if I had valve box and my answer yes and I took him to it.

Turns out that the valve that controls the water flow to that restroom was pretty much cut off, causing the flow to be slow.

Philip opened that baby all the way up and that water flow came rushing through like it's supposed to!!!

The crazy part about it is, I actually had 2 other companies look at it when I first noticed it a year ago and they both concluded that it was some foreign object in the line and that they'd have to cut through my wall to retrieve it. That's the reason it took me so long to get it fix, I just wasn't ready to pay out of the Wazoo to have the work done!!

I REALLY appreciate this company! It pays to have someone that actually KNOWS what they're talking about and not just guessing!!

reviews.author: Robert F.
reviews.text:
I recently had Rescue Air and Plumbing handle a tankless water heater repair at my home in Dallas, and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish.

The team was professional, responsive, and clearly knowledgeable about tankless systems. They diagnosed the issue quickly, explained everything in straightforward terms without any high-pressure sales tactics, and completed the repair efficiently with high-quality work. What really stood out was how fairly priced the service was--no surprise fees or unnecessary upsells, just honest, value-driven pricing that made the whole process stress-free.

A special shoutout to Dylan, who was absolutely amazing! He was courteous, thorough, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was done right and that I was completely satisfied. His expertise and friendly attitude made him a top reason I'd choose Rescue Air again without hesitation--and I'd highly recommend them (and specifically asking for Dylan if possible) to anyone needing plumbing repairs, especially for tankless water heaters.

If you're in the DFW area and dealing with a similar issue, give Rescue Air a call--you won't be disappointed! 5 stars all the way.

synthesis.summary: Rescue Air's positive reviews repeatedly praise the same things: fast text-based scheduling, photo notifications of the tech who's coming, and named techs (Eric, Derrick, Saul, Phillip) who customers trust by name. The negatives cluster around pricing — $308 for a hose bib gasket, $99 service call that escalates, $5,100 evaporator-coil quotes that two other companies couldn't reproduce — and one alleged AC install that failed city inspection twice. Strong on responsiveness and communication, weak on price.

reviews.author: Mickey Vogt
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Mark and James did an exceptional job replacing our water line. From start to finish, they were professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient. They took the time to explain the process, answered all our questions, and made sure everything was done right the first time. The work area was kept clean, and the job was completed on schedule with great attention to detail. It’s clear they take pride in their work. I highly recommend Mark and James to anyone needing water line replacement or plumbing work—top-notch service all around!

reviews.author: Hannah Allison
reviews.text: James and Mark did an absolutely amazing job on my water heater. From start to finish, they were professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient. They took the time to explain what was going on, answered all my questions, and made sure everything was working perfectly before they left. The quality of their work was outstanding, and they left the area clean and tidy. It’s clear they take real pride in what they do. I couldn’t be happier with the service and would highly recommend James and Mark to anyone needing water heater or plumbing work!

reviews.author: Sergio Ramirez
reviews.text:
I can’t believe this company has a 4.4-star rating—if I could give them zero stars, I would. I had the worst experience with Reliant Plumbing.

Back in July, they came to my home to install a Flow Tech descaling device. Just a few days later, I noticed the device had completely shut off, so I called the company and was told a technician would come the next day. I waited the entire day and no one showed up. I called again the following day, and they told me the same thing—but once again, no one came.

After several attempts, I decided I no longer wanted to deal with this device. I called Reliant Plumbing and specifically asked if I could receive a full refund. They confirmed that yes, I would get all my money back.

The next day, on August 15th, someone finally came to remove the device. Today is November 20th, and I still haven’t received a single dollar. I’ve been calling them almost twice a week, and every time they tell me a manager will call me to discuss the refund. No manager has ever called. The only thing I’ve gotten from them is excuses and false promises.

At this point, I don’t know what else to do. We are talking about $3,000 that they took from me, and I urgently need my money returned

reviews.author: Angelica V.
reviews.text:
On July 24, 2026, I ordered a Flow Tech descaling device to be installed in my home. The next day, July 25, a technician came and completed the installation. I paid $1,505 before installation and another $1,505 afterward, for a total of $3,010. About two weeks later, I opened the sink cabinet where the device was installed and noticed it had shut off. I immediately called the company to report the issue, and they told me they would send someone to inspect it. The next day, I called again and received the same response. After several calls over three days with no action, I told them I no longer wanted the device and requested a full refund. They assured me I would receive the reimbursement within a few days. On August 15, a technician came to my house and removed the device. Today is November 03 /2025 , and it has been almost 3 months since the removal. I have called the company at least twice a week to follow up on my refund, but each time they tell me that I must wait for a manager to approve it. All I want is my money back for a product I no longer have. After the manager contacted me. More than a week ago I am still waiting for my refund (Nov 11-2025)
Company full of lies !!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Denis Onofrei
reviews.text:
If I could give negative stars, I would. This was by far one of the worst experiences we have ever had with a company. This work was to move our faucet water lines 2 feet.

It started with an incompetent appraiser who significantly underestimated the scope and cost of the job. The appraisal was completely wrong and far below the actual work required. Once they found out my wife had been approved for financing, their attitude immediately changed and they tried to squeeze every single dollar out of that approval.

Things went from bad to worse when another extremely incompetent worker showed up with an oversized jackhammer and broke our pipes, creating damage that left us no way to back out because we were already too invested. From that point on, it was constant chaos—people coming in and out of the house, standing around on their phones, and barely doing any actual work.

The job was reappraised from $6,000 to $9,000, and then suddenly we were told—multiple times—that they “had to dig from under the house.” We were repeatedly promised the job would take one day, then two days. In reality, it dragged on for an entire month. During that time, we had a massive hole in our kitchen floor that filled with water whenever it rained.

Management was just as bad as the workmanship. I had to repeatedly change managers, and the one we dealt with most was rude, unprofessional, and dishonest. He aggressively tried to convince us that we had to pay an additional $20,000 to dig under the house—damage that was caused by their own mistake. When I firmly refused and pointed this out, he suddenly “agreed” not to charge us. It felt like a clear attempt to scam us, assuming we would give in under pressure.

To make matters worse, they even tried to charge my wife for something as simple as soldering a copper pipe—something I later did myself for about $50 in materials.

This entire experience was exhausting, stressful, and deeply disappointing. Had we known what we were getting into, we never would have moved forward with this company. The original appraisal was wrong, the execution was worse, and the management was dishonest and unprofessional. I would strongly warn anyone to stay away

reviews.author: Alieya Leechelle
reviews.text:
Reliant replaced our pipes in Feb 2025, and by April 28th at 3am feces, raw sewage was overflowing from our shower drain with two small children in the house. Despite paying for their “preferred member” plan and 24/7 emergency service, we were left waiting all night with toxic fumes in our home and never received a single call or text back. Another company arrived in 15 minutes, documented multiple code violations in Reliant’s work, and confirmed the installation was done incorrectly from the start. They advised us to go back to Reliant since the work should have been covered under warranty.

Over the next few months, Reliant scheduled multiple appointments - and every single time we were left sitting at home for hours with no calls, no updates, and no one ever showing up. My husband and I took off work multiple times, moved nap schedules around for our kids, rearranged our entire day - only to find out about cancellations after we called them ourselves. Most recently, we were told Dallas “isn’t a priority market,” which explains the constant no-shows and excuses.

Reliant’s lack of communication, accountability, and professionalism has been staggering. We’ve spent thousands, lost countless hours, and months later still don’t have a fully functioning bathroom. Their “24/7 emergency service” and “preferred member” plan are nothing but empty advertising.

Learn from our mistakes: read the recent reviews and take them seriously. DO NOT trust Reliant with your home.

And to Reliant - please save the copy-paste Google reply. What you need to do is have your manager pick up the phone and finally call us back.

reviews.author: Brandon Ortega
reviews.text: Horrible experience, negligence, incompetence, theft and lies. Wrong water heater installed, installed it incorrectly, blew my breakers and damaged them. Sales tech said they wouldn’t install a Home Depot water heater and did exactly that. Initial installers lied about how they messed up, but I was there so they couldn’t get away w it. If I hadn’t been I would have had to pay for the first round of electrician charges for the damages to my breaker box. The “Manager”Alan Torres kept trying to divert the fact that they had messed up big bc the technicians were “good guys”. He insisted he would take care of me once the dust settled but he really just ghosted me.  I was told they would charge me for the second half when the work was done, I was charged while sitting in my house with no power or water. Initial techs stole my flashlight  that I lent them bc they were doing the instal by their phones and couldn’t see well enough. You’re told you are being put on their service plan to save you hundreds, but the reality is it’s a contractual year that you can’t cancel early and you must give a 30 day notice by email. I strongly recommend using another plumbing company. Lucky I can’t give zero stars.

reviews.author: Alex Pulido
reviews.text:
I rarely leave reviews, I wish 0 stars was an option but this situation has been beyond frustrating. Over six weeks ago, the company approved a refund due to a completely inadequate camera inspection. Their technician sent just pictures and claimed it justified a 10,000 dollar job with no video recording.

After recognizing the issue, they agreed to issue a refund, but I still haven’t received anything. Since then I’ve made multiple attempts to follow up. I’ve been told to “give it more time” and “ call back later” over and over. I was assured several times that a manger and someone from the refund department would contact me the same day. That never happened.

The lack of accountability, follow through and transparency from multiple departments is extremely disappointing. I would strongly caution others before working with this company.

reviews.author: Rush H.
reviews.text:
sewer line repair

Reliant plumbing said that the project would take a day and a half. It has been 2 weeks and there is no end in sight.
They don't believe in keeping the customer informed about the status of the project.


They wanted half of the project cost up front and the other half when the project was completed. They wanted all of it paid for before the project was completed.

They are not able to work with the City of Robinson inspection department. 

They left the work site in an unsafe condition. Repeated requests have been ignored.

The customer service is horrible. They respond to your emails right away with "someone will get back to you". The problem is that nobody does.

ALL I WANT IS FOR THIS PROJECT TO BE COMPLETED.

reviews.author: Ruben R.
reviews.text: The whole organization is totally unprofessional The quote process for same day service was very high but needed the sink replaced before going out of town.  They didn't try to repair the same day as was implied. The service was not to include garbage disposal but was started until told to stop by me. It took most of Saturday and Sunday morning to get it installed!! I contacted customer reps repeatedly to discuss poor service, workmanship. I was told I would receive $200+ refund on $1800+ service. 4 months later, NOTHING!! They never intended to refund, they just kept putting me off hoping I would give up. I would never, ever use them again!!!

reviews.author: Terry Allison
reviews.text: The technician James, that was sent out was very polite and very professional. Even put on protectors to protect my floor I called them because I had a warm spot on my floor he asked me a few questions.  And it turns out that I have had several slab leaks from the research that he done, and he gave us a few different quotes.We went ahead and proceeded with a whole house water supply repipe and i could not be more happy with the services that I was provided. James walked me through everything and made sure that there was no lack of communication, I highly recommend reliant, pointing for all of your plumbing knees in the DFW area

reviews.author: Ahmed Hall
reviews.text:
This is a company you shouldn't trust. They go for your throat with their estimates and lie to your face. They left a mess at this property. They cut and dug holes in places that was unnecessary trying to find a slab leak. It was like a treasure hunt. They didn't use a slab detection device which they didn't have.We were charged for this service and they failed to deliver the right way. It took about a
month for these guys to complete their work. They are not consistent with their work. We had to call multiple times and  beg them to finish the work. This is a company you should avoid enter at your own risk.

reviews.author: K E
reviews.text:
Buyer beware for anyone planning to submit their receipt to insurance- they do not provide itemized receipts, so you will be unable to get reimbursed. They do not communicate this to you before you sign their paperwork. This experience left me with a very bad taste in my mouth about their business practices. I spent over $4,000 on their services, and they can’t provide me with a single itemized receipt? Shady.

In their response to this review, they give the illusion they want to discuss this further but I’ve already reached out multiple times, & they are still unwilling to provide a receipt.

Pattern is a sales-heavy organization where the after-the-sale experience falls apart.

reviews.author: TriAngel Investment Group
reviews.text: We recently experienced an issue with the gas line leading to our fireplace, and Zach and his team handled it exceptionally well. They quickly diagnosed the problem, completed the necessary repairs, and ensured everything was functioning properly before finishing the job. They also addressed related non-plumbing items to make sure the entire project was handled thoroughly. We truly appreciated their professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to making sure we were completely satisfied with the work.

reviews.author: David Grams
reviews.text:
Nathan and Eric did a great job on a hard to remove faucet cartridge and tub drain.  They are very professional and took the appropriate time to get the job done right.

I use Knee Deep Plumbing for all my plumbing projects.

reviews.author: kelly mills
reviews.text: Zack did a great job replacing a loose flange under my toilet. He went over and beyond securing and sealing it so there will be no future issues. He included a warranty, was very polite, on time, polite, and had great quality work. This company is very reliable and quick to provide you service as soon as you need it. I would highly recommend Plumbing Unit! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Claude Tracy Griffin Jr.
reviews.text:
I must express my satisfaction with Plumbing Unit. They were introduced to me by my fireplace company, which sold and installed a new gas fireplace in my recently renovated condominium. Naturally, proper plumbing was required for the new gas line. Their work was exemplary, prompting me to hire Plumbing Unit to relocate my hot water tank from the kitchen to the laundry room. This task necessitated locating an existing water line within my 48-year-old condo, which Zack identified accurately within the walls. They adhered to current building codes, a detail appreciated not only by myself but also by my three neighbors in the building. Their professionalism was evident in tasks such as insulating every water line, including those inside the walls, to prevent freezing and minimize noise.

Despite multiple scheduled jobs, the team prioritized my hot water tank relocation, ensuring I could still take a hot shower that evening. They demonstrated commendable dedication by sacrificing personal time, staying until 11:30 pm. to complete the work. Their commitment to customer service was admirable; most contractors might have postponed the job, but Plumbing Unit remained highly responsive to calls and texts, typically returning responses within a few minutes to two hours.

My overall rating is a perfect 10 out of 10. Their level of service and professionalism unequivocally merits this designation.

reviews.author: Dalia Benguigui
reviews.text: Absolutely stellar service from beginning to end. Our water heater exploded out of nowhere and water was rushing out of our attic like crazy! It was a terrifying situation but they showed up almost immediately to help us with our emergency! Within the same day they had a quote for us to fix everything - replace the water heater (we actually upgraded to tankless and we love it), clean up all of the wet mess, remove and replace all the damaged drywall, etc. they had an amazing efficient team and got the job done with such attention to detail! They were priced so great and I would recommend them 10 times out of 10! We knew to call them because we had used them for a smaller job for a pipe that wouldn’t drain from our tub - but I didn’t know how great they were for bigger projects too! Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Michal Hirsch
reviews.text:
Finally I found a reliable company that have workers that actually solving problems and not fixing it temporarily!!!!! In the past I had plumbers coming to fix my sink stocked up and causing a leaking as well because of that and spending an hour or so saying all good getting their payment and the sink is stocked up again within a month or two😩
Plumbing unit team came to my house at 9:15pm!!! After their working hours and stayed for 4 hours! Until 1:20am taking so much buildup Greece and oil from my pipes going deep as 80 fit!!!! And on top of it this hard worker stayed to clean all the oil and Greece!!!
I am more than impressed! I definitely found finally a good reliable plumbing company🙏🏻

reviews.author: Ashley Raley
reviews.text: I called Plumbing Unit for some leaky pipes going into my water heater. They came out the same day - Zach was my guy. He was very kind, professional, and listened to what I wanted. I’m aware my water heater is old but I’m on the mindset of if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. He respected that, told me info about my water heater and when he would suggest to get a new one, and then fixed my issue all within the same day. I really appreciate this because many times I have felt pressured to make some other big expensive purchase when I really just needed a repair. Pricing was fair and my hot water was up and running again within an hour! Would highly recommend Zach!!!

reviews.author: The Experts Garage Doors Repair
reviews.text:
Ziv did an outstanding job handling our plumbing repair. He was professional, knowledgeable, and very efficient from start to finish. He quickly identified the problem, explained everything clearly, and completed the repair with high-quality workmanship. The area was left clean, and the whole process was smooth and stress-free.

I highly recommend Ziv to anyone who needs a reliable and honest plumbing technician. I will definitely call him again for any future plumbing needs. 🔧💧⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Judy Tribble
reviews.text: This amazing company is so great!!! They act so fast to help you!!! During this last week during another Texas crazy storm,  went above to assist me with faucet covers so my pipes didn't bust. They sent an amazing employee to put faucet covers on my outside ones. Not only did he come out early he also tightened my leaking ones. Highly recommend!!!!!! Thank you soooo much!!! I will recommend this company to everyone I know!!!! Keep up the great service!!!❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: Official.Deaundrea
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Plumbing Unit. I called them for an emergency cleaning, and they showed up fast and handled everything professionally. The team was knowledgeable, honest, and made sure the job was done right the first time. Their customer service really stands out—they kept me informed the whole way and treated my home with respect. If you need reliable plumbing work, especially in an emergency, I definitely recommend Plumbing Unit.

reviews.author: Michal Andresen
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience with Plumbing Unit! I needed a drain cleaning in Dallas and they came out fast, were very professional, and got the job done right the first time. My main line was completely clogged and they cleared it quickly without any issues.

If you’re looking for a reliable drain cleaning service in Dallas, these are the guys to call. Honest, knowledgeable, and great customer service. Definitely my go to plumber from now on!

reviews.author: Gilbert Gerst
reviews.text:
Plumbing Unit was called due to a potential leak from my water heater at my 100+ year old home. He quickly crawled under my house, located the 2 leaks and made the repairs in a timely manner and at
a reasonable cost. He also provided some recommendations for on-going maintenance that will extend the life of my equipment. I will definitely use them again and would refer them to any of my friends and family in need of quality plumbing bservice.

reviews.author: Sarah McBrine
reviews.text: Plumbing service was great, they cleared the drain line to my washing machine which was overflowing. It was an extra charge for them to video my drain lines to/from my property and found sitting water and backup at city main, good peace of mind. And they took the time the explain everything and show me the work done. I called on a Saturday afternoon and they were out for my non-emergency issue Sunday morning. Would definitely hire again.

reviews.author: Mayan Bernat
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this plumber! He showed up super fast, was professional, reliable, and incredibly knowledgeable. The service was top-notch from start to finish — he explained everything clearly, fixed the issue quickly, and left everything spotless. It’s rare to find someone who is both skilled and genuinely cares about customer service. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy and efficient plumber.

reviews.author: Asaf Barzellay
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Plumbing Unit. I called them for an emergency issue and they showed up fast and handled everything professionally. The technician was very knowledgeable, explained the problem clearly, and took care of the drain cleaning quickly. You can tell they know what they’re doing and really care about their work. Highly recommend them if you need reliable emergency plumbing or drain cleaning in Dallas!

reviews.author: Liz Griffith
reviews.text: Had an issue with the hot water going to my washer after the recent hot water repairs by Metro.  Called and talked to Bree and she was able to get Luis out to check the problem within 30 minutes.  Luis was knowledgeable and friendly and found the problem quickly and resolved it easily.

reviews.author: Bob Brock
reviews.text: Absolutely the friendliest and most accommodating technicians   I've encountered in a very long time. I wanted to know which of my options made the most sense, ballpark pricing, and potential timelines. Normally this would be like pulling teeth to get a straight answer, but Michael Murphy not only went over my chosen options but presented me with several more, along with not just ballpark prices but a guaranteed set price for each, and suggestions on when I could get the work scheduled and completed.  Both Michael and Javier were courteous, clean and professional, and the exploratory work they did was super clean and with as little intrusion into the structure as necessary to ascertain the scope of the problem. When they left I had the peace of mind knowing that the work was scheduled, when it was scheduled to be completed, the details what the work would  involve and what I was paying for it. This is the kind of company I like to do business with.

reviews.author: Meera Menon
reviews.text: Michelle was very good at his job. I had asked Metro Pumbing to put in a R.O water Filteration disinter my sink. Michelle arranged the right counter top guy to come a drill the hole through the marble counter top. He was very patient. He took extra care to call and ask a specialist regarding a question I had about my main Water Filteration. He was through and did a great job. Overall I liked the way Metro Pumbing took care of this job. Even the dispatch staff was always courteous. Most importantly I feel they listened to me and did the job wonderfully well.

reviews.author: raul hzz
reviews.text: Paid 89 for them to come out just to show & do nothing because I wasn’t there (me). Plumber called me why wasn’t I here? Told him that I was at work & that my brother will be home which he was so the job can start, told me that I was the one that called (before) so I called dispatched & I told her I wasn’t going to be there but my brother was & she said that’s fine so idk who’s confused… wanted me to pay another 89 if I wanted to “book appointment “. Bad communication & unfair “work”. Didn’t want to argue but wouldn’t called them again, it wasn’t after hours so don’t mention it 😂

reviews.author: Karen M.
reviews.text: We called this company on a Sunday because we thought we had an emergency (which we really, thankfully, did not. They came out (for a $150 service charge) and told us that it would cost over $500 to ream out our pipes (in addition to the $150!). We were horrified!  Thankfully we did not do it. The next day our regular plumber came out and did the job for $160.  If you want to be scalped, give them a call. OUTRAGEOUS prices.

reviews.author: Wesley A.
reviews.text:
This is a very, very deceitful company. I needed a new toilet in the kids bathroom, and wanted to put in a good one. I got prices from Lowe's and Home Depot, then decided to check with the "professionals". I called the company and asked about pricing, and was told they cannot give any prices until the plumber comes out and looks at the situation. I said can you give me a range or price for a "normal" install?

No, of course not. So, dummy me, I agreed to pay $49 for a bid. I thought that if they were a bit more than the retail stores it might be worth it.

The plumber that came out was very nice, very professional, and cleanly dressed. Then I started feeling like I was at an Amway meeting. He pulled out presentation cards that explain how they do things. At this point he had been there almost an hour and I had yet to get a price. Then he explained they use something like flat rate prices. This meant the guy on the phone was lying, because they have a set price for everything. He also would not split out the price between the labor and materials.

Then he finally showed me the prices. To quote my teenagers "OMG"! The toilet I wanted would be $1,000 installed. I went out later and order the exact same one with installation at Home Depot for $438(before a 10% HD credit card discount).

When I gave the plumber the $49 check and told him to hit the road he was a bit snooty and commented on their great service. My first thought was if this is the type of ongoing service I can look forward to, forget it. My second thought was that you can provide some pretty good service if you charge more than double for your products and service.

I am usually not a "sucker", but I was suckered by Metro-Flow Plumbing and their lack of honesty. I assume they much leach onto the elderly or people who are unable to go out and check and validate prices. I may yet file a complaint with the BBB.

reviews.author: Logan C
reviews.text:
Edit: company called to offer a partial refund for the high cost of the service bringing it close to $530 from $725 , still expensive for a simple kitchen drain clog but it's appreciated to have a company followup on their work and customer concerns.

Luis Maldonado did a great job with his service and was friendly. But we got charged $725 including dispatch fee for a simple clean out of a slow flowing kitchen sink which as far as I can tell from research is at least twice the price of what it should be. I'd love to give 5 stars because as I said Luis did a good job but these plumbers are way too expensive.

It seriously feels like we got car shop ripped off.

Edit: apparantly it took 15 minutes to do. We totally got scammed. So. Cautionary tale for anyone planning on using this company AND he apparantly tried selling us those BioOne drain cleaner bottles for $100 each when you can find them online for $30 to $50 each.... While I appreciate Luis's work and he was overall friendly, Its the only reason it's not one star and I'll never use this company again unless they correct this

reviews.author: Tony P.
reviews.text:
I had them come out for a dripping faucet and had already bought a replacement, thinking that I would just have them yank the old one and replace with the new one.  When they came, I learned that they could likely fix the old one with a part from the truck or replace with the new one.  Now get this...getting a part from the truck and repairing it was going to be more than doing the replacement.  And the replacement cost $444 - excluding what I had already spent for the faucet.  They were finished within 90 minutes, and I have been kicking myself ever since for letting them do the job.  I wish I had shown them the door.

It was quality work (I suppose), and they were diligent to put on the little boot covers every time they came in and out.  But their service price was beyond outrageous, and I don't care about their 5-star rating.  That would to be a pretext to charge Neiman-Marcus rates.  So, I suggest that you, Mr. and Mrs. Review Reader, get estimates.  If you do, I expect that you will not use this one.

reviews.author: Hunter D.
reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!!  TERRIBLE SERVICE!!!   I called Metro Flow Plumbing on a Tuesday to schedule a service appointment on Saturday at 9am due to a busted line to the water heater.  I spoke with Darryl and he assured me they would be the best plumber I had ever used and I could count on them. I called Friday and confirmed my appointment on Saturday and then called Saturday morning at 8:30 am to confirm again.  Due to the winter storm, I knew they would be busy.  The answering service assured me each time that I was still on the schedule and that a technician was coming out.  At 11am I called for a 4th time for and Darryl let me know , very abruptly, I had been taken off the schedule and would need to reschedule. He began yelling very aggressively and let me know there were other people who had used them for years who would come first . Darryl was threatening and condescending. We will NEVER use this company and I will advise all of our clients against using them as well.

reviews.author: Kt S.
reviews.text:
Expensive expensive expensive.
I've used metro flow 3 times now. The first two times was an emergency, they were the only ones available, and I was a first time homeowner so I didn't know any better about pricing. But they were very professional, clean, wore booties, and always came in pairs for some reason, and on time. 
I just used them again, two knowledge-gained years later and holy moly!!! They are expensive. More than FOUR TIMES the price of another plumber . But here's the trick--they charge a SIXTY FIVE dollar service fee just to give you a quote, and that price does NOT go towards the cost of the work done. So to avoid paying $65 for nothing, I paid the 425$ total to snake one drain. If you don't know, that's totally absurd. It took them 15 minutes. For 425 dollars.  The drain was snaked well, I supposed, but that's not exactly complex plumbing. I feel a little robbed, and I wish they told me an estimate for snaking a drain over the phone before coming out. Sigh.

reviews.author: Beth K.
reviews.text:
I hate to report this kind of thing but I feel like I have to.

We had one of the Metroflow service contracts. Metroflow did some expensive work for us that leaked badly in a big thunderstorm about 8 months ago. That in and of itself wasn't a problem; it was that we had a video of the leak, which we sent to them and followed up with voicemail, with no reply. (It's still on my YouTube and I have all the emails and contacts) We were busy, it would be a lot of trouble to follow through, and we let it go. 

After many months, we had our free yearly contract inspection this morning. 

All is well until an under sink leak is found in the bathroom; lots of water underneath. I had been in that cabinet not ten minutes before and it was dry as a bone. Either something in the process of checking caused the leak (and all that water) or the leak was created; it does not really matter which. Can't trust them. Canceled.

reviews.author: Will F.
reviews.text:
Plumbing issues are never fun, but with Metro Flow my wife and I had a great experience

We had a weird leak coming from the kitchen drain, but was draining in the garage. Weird. Had to call and have an emergency consult. RJ & Ted were able to take the call late and were on site at 6pm. They were able to locate the affected pipe with camera.

Because it was late we needed to reschedule the work to be done two days out. Which was today, Christmas Eve! They came sharply at 9AM and were done by noon. Not only that, they were able to patch and repair the wall that was cut with some scrap sheathing we happened to have. Amazing, because this is not part of their normal job. And on christmas eve. We probably would have had holes in the wall for a couple of weeks before we could get around to patching it.

Great communication and great problem solving. Above and beyond really.

reviews.author: Elaine E.
reviews.text: We were very lucky to find Metro-Flow Plumbing. The company was responsive and clearly explained what needed to be done. We initially called about a stopped up sink and leaking pipe. After running a camera through the pipe, they found a busted pipe and quoted a price to fix. We had them fix the leaking pipe and told them we needed to get other quotes on fixing the busted pipe. After getting additional quotes, we decided to authorize Metro-Flow to do the work. In addition to competitive pricing, we liked the professionalism of Daryl and his attention to detail. The work was completed as scheduled. Juan, who was responsible for the digging and cement phase, was professional and quick.  From start to finish, we were delighted with the work and highly recommend this company. I know we will use them for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Howard S.
reviews.text:
I agree with all of the other "victims".  After forking over $65 for a quote, I said I'd call them back after discussing this with my wife. Their initial cost to repair a leaking gas valve was $2100. After calling another licensed plumber, I paid only $500 to do the same repairs.  Rather than install a new valve, Daryl from Metro-Flow wanted to tear down the piping beyond the brick wall which, as a professional engineer, I thought was excessive. I was right. I will definitely contact BBB to get back my $65 for deceitful and unprofessional practices. DO NOT CALL Metro-Flow unless you want to be entertained for the price of admission of $65.  FYI...other plumbers will give you free quotes...so why should you think $65 buys you better advice?

Everyone said their prices were 3X more than others...mine was 4X

reviews.author: Christen M.
reviews.text: Do not even bother calling this group. Their estimates are astronomical and they try to cover that up by offering a variety of convoluted "discount" programs. Also, they charge a $49 "service fee" just for giving you the high cost estimates. When I asked for the fee to be refunded, the owner was rude and argumentative with me and basically hung up on me. I think these guys are dishonest and try to take advantage of customers that don't know much about plumbing. Basically, I was told that it would cost $267 to install my kitchen faucet, $269 to hook up my gas stove, $267 for the sink basket, and $450-800 for a new garbage disposal. They also wanted to charge $200 to cut into my wall to check out a potential problem.

Repeat customers describe it as a 3x premium for what should be standard service.

reviews.author: Deidra Collins
reviews.text: The technician (James) was professional and efficient . I appreciate him remembering having serviced my home before. That goes a long way with me. The problem was  diagnosed and completed. I will continue to call Dial One for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Ben Hart
reviews.text: Jose called and let me know that he was available earlier than scheduled, which was excellent. Arrived, diagnosed and fixed my furnace problem within 10 minutes. Very pleasant and easy to work with. Top service.

reviews.author: CJ Johnson
reviews.text: Mold light install in vent system went well. Fast and clean! Other problem areas were identified and an intervention was to avoid future problems, of which was much appreciated. Very informative about what was done. Overall pleased with the service

reviews.author: Steve Elwell
reviews.text: Service was excellent but I guess at $500 per hour it should be

reviews.author: Brenda Wilkins
reviews.text: i got nothing and i didn't understand why i was charged so much, he touched my carpet and told me i needed a plumber and charged me $89. for what?

reviews.author: Lapmha T.
reviews.text:
We had a main water leak and the DEP gave me a notification to have it altered in four days. I sort of blew up and began calling a bundle of plumbers however just got ""someone will get back to  you ASAP"" or the folks who showed up made me feel like they were attempting to get one over on me. When I called Dial One Johnson Plumbing, they grabbed immediately and could give me a considerable information on call I was happy with how intelligent and in control he was particularly compared with the others.
The price wasn't that far away from what others were asking However after giving a rough estimate they assured me that everything will be taken care off and made me comfortable with it. They came the very next morning and the work was done by the time I returned home from work not only this, they took care of the cleaning as well. I hope this problem does not come up again, but of does I know whom I need to contact in the first go. Thank  you so much.

reviews.author: R F.
reviews.text: I bought a new dishwasher and during the install process was informed that I needed new shutoff valves due to mine being too old and wouldn't work with the new appliance.  I called another company who said they would come but I never heard from them the day they were scheduled.  Because I needed the job done that day due to the dishwasher installers coming again the next day I got in touch with Dial One Plumbing. Kind of by accident really.  The number I called was not their main number but somehow I was routed to them.  Lucky for me.  I explained the situation to them and miraculously they were able to fit me in the same day.  The technician was very nice, professional.  Very impressed.  They were there when they said they would be.  Was called prior to arrival to give me time to get home.  All and all a great experience with them.  I will certainly be using them again and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: JOSE CRUZ
reviews.text: Travis came out this morning to do a check up on our AC/Heat system. He is very courteous, polite and professional. He was very thorough and clear in his explanations of what he recommends for our system. Travis has a great personality and it was a pleasure having him to come out and do the inspection on our system. Dial One Johnson always sends the best people out. Thank you for your awesome customer service and great workers! These guys truly are the best, cant recommend them enough. If you need AC, AC service of any kind, Johnson Dial One are the very best in the field! You can’t go wrong with them. Thank you again for sending Travis to us; he is truly a credit to his profession and represents his company magnificently!

reviews.author: J. Andrlik
reviews.text: When it comes to SERVICE, Ashton, Jonathan, & Kerlin work with & listen to you... They're very helpful. For me, they have skillfully relocated gas lines, re-routed water pipes, removed 40-gal water tanks & replaced corroded cast iron hubs. They know what they're doing, & they do it well. From scheduling to completion, Dallas' Dial-1 is professional & polite, all while providing solid services at competitive prices. And there's integrity in all they do. So, if you're looking for reliability through good people, I highly recommend Dial-One Johnson Plumbing for ALL your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Marianne R
reviews.text: Dial One was quick to book an appointment. Their friendly admin staff was very helpful. The call-out fee is mandatory, and they only come to assess, so the work wasn't done the same day.  But once the plumbers were there 2 days later, they did all they could to figure out and fix the problems.  A big shout-out to James & Will, who were excellent in their communication and work-ethic.  I will certainly call on these folks again.

reviews.author: Wendy S.
reviews.text:
We bought our own water heater and needed it to be installed.
We were quoted 1100.00 to have the old one taken out and the new one installed.
No new lines or anything??  Needless to say we said absolutely not but had to pay the 50 dollar service fee!!  We called another plumber who came the next day and installed for 300.00 and we have been very pleased.
These people will rip you off!

reviews.author: Roger Sims
reviews.text: Today Jonothan performed a plumbing check on my home. He was very professional in his examination.  He discovered a hot water heater that was leaking. Luckily when it was installed I had a drip pan with a drain under it.  He gave me a quote to replace it.  Continuing with the examination he said everything else looked good.  I would recommend Dial One to anyone.

reviews.author: Ron
reviews.text:
Travis and the Dial One folks are great. They are very responsive and really communicate well. I appreciate the thorough explanations of the issues and repair options.
They just finished working on my A/C unit and I couldn't be more satisfied in the work quality, timeliness, and price for the repair.
I would not hesitate to call Travis and Dial One again.

reviews.author: hemitonicpentatonic
reviews.text: Just bought a new home and a few toilets were not flushing properly and the shower in the master was not getting all the way hot. Mike came out, checked all the toilets, fixed the one needing fixing, fixed the issue in the master, showed me everything he did, and the price was better than expected. Mike is super nice and honestly wants to help you out.

reviews.author: Chuck Freeman
reviews.text: We could not have asked for a better experience.  The technician, Parker, arrived on time with a great smile and positive attitude. He completed his system maintenance task in a timely manner.  Parker was very knowledgeable about our system and helped us program our cell phones so we can adjust the temperature from our cell phone.
