reviews.author: Mike Gilbert
reviews.text: I had a good crew come out and replace my leaking cast iron pipes today.  They arrived early and worked straight through to finish the job same day.  They were dedicated and very hard working.  Dallas and Jesus were personable and knowledgeable.  They got my water turned back on as soon as possible and cleaned up after themselves.  I was impressed with them and AAA Service!

reviews.author: Christan Fergus
reviews.text:
You don't always wake up one morning and know you're going to drop some serious coin and have to replace your entire HVAC system and electrical panel, but it happens. And of course, it happens on the coldest day of the year. These guys came out and worked late in the day through until 10 at night and didn't leave until they had me all squared away. The whole time they were happy and friendly and totally rocked it.

A huge thank you to the AAA HVAC crew: Eddie, Michael, Tony, Pedro, and Boone; and the Electricians: David, Joey. Each one of them did an absolutely stellar, top-notch job, and I couldn't be happier.

I also want to call out the killer work DeShawn did installing a new ionizer to reduce mineral build up in my system after I had a water leak, and also a leak detector and shutoff valve and a new pressure regulator. Just like the HVAC and electrical guys, DeShawn did an outstanding job and got me sorted.

reviews.author: Shiela McGrath
reviews.text:
Very responsive company with excellent customer service. Shout out to my plumber, John Johnson (JD). His parents may have lacked creativity when naming him, but he certainly doesn’t lack in skill in his craft. His work is impeccable. He was very mindful of the interior and exterior of my home during the repair. He even sanitized my floor after the toilet repair.

My link to review the HVAC work isn’t working. I also need to recognize Miguel. I’ve had the misfortune of needing multiple repairs this week. Truly am impressed by the caliber of employees this company has. Really stellar service, impeccable work, great communication.

reviews.author: Erin Jamison
reviews.text:
I’ve given AAA Service Plumbing, Heating & Electric two chances, and both experiences were incredibly disappointing.

A couple years ago, I had them out for a furnace tune-up. Instead of actually performing the service, the technician spent the entire time pointing out supposed “issues” and trying to sell me a brand-new furnace. I later got multiple second opinions, and none of the problems they claimed were actually issues. It felt like they were taking advantage of the fact that I’m not an expert.

Unfortunately, I recently made the mistake of giving them another shot when they advertised a $39.99 A/C tune-up. This visit was even worse. Two technicians showed up and immediately acted like they were responding to a repair call—not a tune-up. I made it clear everything was working fine and I just wanted the advertised service, but once again, they didn’t perform any tune-up at all.

Instead, they started listing a bunch of questionable “problems” and became visibly frustrated when I didn’t agree to expensive repairs. They even went as far as threatening to call Xcel on me, which felt completely inappropriate and intimidating. When I said I wanted to get other opinions, they tried to pressure me into doing thousands of dollars of work on the spot and made the situation sound urgent and dire.

To make matters worse, they shut off my gas. After about 45 minutes of doing essentially nothing—and making me increasingly uncomfortable—I ended the appointment before they even went up to the roof to inspect the A/C and asked them to leave. They then insisted I pay for a tune-up they never performed. I paid just to get them out of my house. They told me someone would follow up to reschedule, but I never received a call.

After leaving, they sat in the parking lot for another 30 minutes, seemingly just to make it appear as though they had completed the job.

I would strongly recommend getting a second opinion—or better yet, avoiding this company altogether.

reviews.author: A A
reviews.text: WARNING!  AAA took advantage of my elderly parent, pressured them into getting new equipment And didn’t give them the time to talk to family to get a second opinion. “Can’t afford it, no worries we can do a loan for it” (of course a crazy high interest rate). Not only did they pay a crazy amount of money they were treated poorly and it took them multiple times and failed inspections to get it right. Beware!

reviews.author: TRU Outlaw
reviews.text: Very pushy extreme sale tactics,  I would advise getting multiple quotes before moving forward with this company! Overall I was happy with the crew of guys that came out and got alot of work done in 2 days . New electric panel and meter plus outlets updated.  Only complaint was one of the techs used my chair as a step ladder ! If they needed a ladder they could've just asked and I had one in garage.  My chair had footprints and now cracked a tiny bit on the leg . Kinda unprofessional considering how much money they charged and wanted payment in full . Beware before you sign contract and get other quotes first dont feel pressured.  Im questioning future projects with this company and will shop around . The office and project manager Brian didn't provide the best customer service experience.  Just more focused on you signing contract and they want payment immediately.

reviews.author: Angelica Switzer
reviews.text:
UPDATE--Rachel reached out personally to talk through my concerns and proposed an acceptable resolution.  Customer service is obviously important to them, and the new toilet was in and functional within a few hours of when I first called.  Thanks for making it right.

Service is good but pricing is absolutely ridiculous.  $775 to replace the “guts” in the toilet tank, or $1100 to replace with a new American Standard toilet, which doesn’t include the service fee.  I replaced the components in my dad’s toilet in 2 hours for $80 just a few weeks ago.  But they were available same day and I guess that’s worth something.  The plumber did a good job communicating and the tenant seems happy with the new toilet but holy smokes, someone made bank on this job.

reviews.author: Rick @ SoudersStudios
reviews.text: I had used AAA Service in the past.  They came for a Home Service Club Member HVAC inspection.  They told me my HVAC Heat and Air Conditioning was going to be costly to repair (13 years old even though I hadn't had any problems or air concerns).  They sent three people over to my house and sold me a new system.  It was a one day install.  Long story short:  I had issues with the equipment overnight, I couldn't get help that night as I had expected to.  I will say that Rachael called the next day and made this right, elevated this to management and helped me get the equipment issue fixed and helped compensate me for my time.  One person can go the distance to repair customer service and she did.

reviews.author: Gerry Gibson
reviews.text:
David P and Haden E replaced our entire house electrical panel with a brand new surge protector and panel system. They arrived on time, were polite, knowledgeable, efficient, and thorough. We appreciated their work professionalism.

Michael l and Calvin w

We’ve been using AAA for a few years now and I wanted to take a second to compliment JD (John Johnson) for his work today. JD was assistive, knowledgeable, efficient, and polite during our contact. I have zero regrets with him being the service tech and do not hesitate to give AAA a recommendation when people like JD are the ones who arrive.

Alejandro E did an outstanding job. Very happy with the work. He kept me informed.

reviews.author: Keri Goldson
reviews.text: AAA needed to come in and replace a sewage line and all plumbing in my slab on concrete home. They had to dig through concrete within my home. The job was done in 4 days with Carlos coming in both Saturday and Sunday to finish the job. He was able to pull back almost all of the carpet in my home in a way that I was able to pull it back. My furniture was protected and no personal property was damaged. They also reinstalled my toilet and washer and were able to avoid destruction to my kitchen. Tyler was my master plumber and he was excellent. He was honest, forthright, and wanted the best for me and my home. I highly recommend AAA. They made an awful experience not so bad.

reviews.author: Diana Crites
reviews.text: Jerry De La Garza, installed our water heater on 4/14/26 and did an amazing job! His knowledge, expertise and transparency were apparent immediately. He tackled a difficult job in a tight space and made it work. When completed, it was like a piece of art. We were quite impressed with Jerry. He's very kind and friendly and went above and beyond, giving us a sense of safety and confidence with our new w/h. Thank you, AAA Service, for keeping customer satisfaction, which I am, a top priority.

reviews.author: Kassi
reviews.text: Joey, Z, and John were a complete pleasure to work with. Polite, personable, hard workers, solid work. They all went above and beyond. Joey and Z installed a new electrical panel for us starting at noon yesterday, and they ended up staying until almost 10pm trying to help me further troubleshoot some lighting and outlet issues, working in the cold and strong wind. We’re very thankful and grateful for them and their hard work. And for their families who had to wait up for them.

reviews.author: Rodney Milton
reviews.text: For someone who despite knowing nobody’s excited to see him…Jacob is surprisingly upbeat, professional, and highly informative! He was upfront, clear, and personable walking through my issue and quickly identifying a resolution. His patience and care was reflected in the time he spend ensuring transparency throughout what otherwise would have been a costly emergency. I see why he’s got 5 stars and I’m happy to add mine!

reviews.author: Mirriah Cantrell
reviews.text: We had AAA come replace a leaking flange on our toilet that had damaged our floor. They replaced the floor and flange very quickly. When we thought there was an issue with the placement of the flange in conjunction with the new flooring, our AAA technician Greg Thompson, came first thing, assured us there was no issue and even placed the toilet to give us peace of mind. Top notch! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Mikhail Leiter
reviews.text: Really happy that Jacob G and Jay P were able to come out tonight after 6pm and clear my main line! I was worried I wouldn’t be able to make dinner or shower tonight but they worked quickly and efficiently to clear a clog that I found tonight after work when water was in my downstairs bathroom. Thank you so much guys! I can always count on AAA!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Planas-Kerr
reviews.text: Very happy with the service and professionalism. I reached out through Thumbtack and was called back just a few minutes later. Nick was able to come the same day, look over the project area and the fuse panel, and  gave several options for how to complete my lighting project. Price was fair and scheduling was very flexible. Justin came to do the installation a couple of days later and he was also quick, clean, and professional. I plan to use this company again for future projects. Before photo with ugly fluorescent lighting and after with new pretty LED light.

reviews.author: Todd Schlafer
reviews.text: I cannot say enough, good things about my experience with mighty plumbing. I got a new mini split in my workshop, which was installed very professionally and cleanly. When the electrician came to connect it I had him look at my breaker box in the workshop because I had a feeling some things were not up to Code. He opened it and we immediately saw there was arcing in it. Ishmael Gonzalez was the electrician. He told me that I should get a new subpanel and that whoever had done it before the wiring was under gauged. He then went in my crawlspace and saw that my house was also not grounded and up to Code since it is an older house. My main breaker box was only rated for 125 Amps and we could upgraded it to 200 Amps. He told me he could get everything done the next day. He arrived at 9:45 AM and didn’t leave till after 10 PM. The guy just crushed it. He was awesome to work with. I kept asking him if he could get it all done in one day and he kept reassuring me I am not leaving till it’s all done. Sure enough he got everything done. I will be requesting him for any future electrical jobs. I do believe they are a bit expensive but when I received the quality of work he provided, I am more than willing to pay more for it.

reviews.author: Drew Morell
reviews.text: Furnace installation. My experience with Mighty Heating was very good. Johnny did a thorough job of diagnosing the problem and explaining the work that needed to be done. He was friendly and easy to talk to. Angel and Cody were efficient, polite and profession during the install and got everything up and running as quickly as possible. Elliott (project manager) did a great job of explaining all of the options for the repair. Everyone listened well to my questions and concerns.

reviews.author: Annette Y.
reviews.text:
I had a new electric water heater installed and seemed to go okay. Michael seemed very eager and capable. The electrician Greg(?) was good.
But I took 2 stars off for my experience after the installation.  I got texts from 4 + different numbers/people. Very confusing to deal with so many people from the same company and having to repeat myself. And being asked for a review for each person as well as the company as a whole.
I called the office because I had a couple questions/concerns I wanted addressed specifically a humming noise that started with the installation. They did send a technician back out and these concerns were dismissed as not related to the water heater but coming from the furnace. I had a HVAC tech from another company come out and check the source of the noise. He found that the condensation pump was making the noise and its red alarm light was on. The new water heater has a hose that is connected to it. So it will need to be replaced to avoid a flood disaster!  He found also some a hose clamp had not been tightened.
Thirdly my interaction with Loreen (sp?) the financial controller is mainly why I dock a star on the review. A couple days after the installation she calls (installation was on Friday before MLK Day).. She wanted to know why I hadn’t paid the balance which is due on completion. I explained why I was reluctant to pay the remaining balance until issues were resolved. She asked do I have hot water and was the heater installed completely to which I had to say yes. She said then the balance is due on completion. I felt like she was a prosecuting attorney and I was the defendant and it was like a gotcha moment for her. As a customer I don’t like being talked to like that. This last interaction really upset me.
I initially called them for the $49 hot water heater flush and end up buying a whole new unit which is my fault for not pausing to think about it before approving the purchase. I would  not continue dealing with them other than for the warranty on the wat r heater. My preference is I like dealing with a smaller operation with a more personal approach.

Post-Install

reviews.text: I used this company to clean out my main drain at my home. I've never had anyone be as thorough and do such a great job cleaning out my drain as Danny did. I have the knowledge and proof that I need about my drain right now that I would have never had had I not use this company. He did an outstanding job using the camera, showing me before and after cleaning, the condition of my pipe, and gave me an estimate on different ways to go in the event I decide to get it resolved or replaced. I highly recommend them for cleaning out drains, and if they are this good in plumbing work, they will be hard to beat

reviews.author: Nancy Boles-Rees
reviews.text: Mighty Plumbing, Heating, Air, annd Electric LLC has responded quickly to our requests for the plumbing, electrical, and heating service.  Terry was very nice, professional and easy to work with.  He answered all our plumbing questions patiently and thoroughly. Landon also was good to work with and provided the information we needed to make the necessary decisions about the work our heating system required. Kodey has taking care of our electrical issues and has also been great to work with. Elijah did a great job with our new furnace and putting in  the new duct work. Highly recommend Mighty!

reviews.author: rick sanders
reviews.text: Today we woke with our cooling system needing a water line repair. We reached out to Mighty Plumbing and they sent out a service representative by the name of Cameron Smith. In a short story (you guys should give this young man a raise.) Cameron was exactly the type of person you’d like to invite to your home. Professional, great worker, and knowledgeable.  He was engaging while completing his work. He definitely represents Mighty Plumbing in a 5 star way. We will tell our friends about your company and Cameron.

reviews.author: David Haile
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this company. They were professional, responsive, and gave me a very fair quote right from the start. Not only did they come in lower than other competitors, but the quality of their work and customer service really stood out. Everything was handled efficiently, and they made the whole process easy and stress-free. I’d definitely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable plumbing, HVAC, or electrical services.

reviews.author: Cayden13 F
reviews.text: We reached out to Jake the Plumbing Pro for a second opinion when we weren’t sure about what another plumber said about our plumbing system. Luis and Javier came over, quickly found what was really going on, and gave us honest advice. As someone who asks a lot of questions, I felt comfortable the whole time—Luis and Javier took their time explaining how everything works and made sure I understood each step. I now feel much more confident about my plumbing system and really appreciate the time they spent with me. We’ll definitely call them again for any plumbing issues in Dallas, and they’re our top choice for future needs!

reviews.author: Donna Huerta
reviews.text: I had a leak at my meter box in Dallas. I called Jake the Plumbing Pro and was able to get an appointment within two hours. They really care about their customers, and even offer priority service and discounts if you've used them before. After the repair, the office followed up right away to make sure I was happy with the work. Luis arrived sooner than expected, quickly figured out the problem, and carefully dug around the water line without messing up my yard. He fixed the leak in about 40 minutes. Luis was friendly, professional, and made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. I’ll definitely ask for him again for any of my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Angel Sharp
reviews.text: I had a plumbing emergency late on a Friday night during Superbowl weekend, and it was extra stressful because we have a cancer patient at home. While a lot of other plumbers didn’t even respond to my emergency messages, this company actually answered the phone right away. Luis, the plumber, stopped by my house on his way to another job just to make sure everything was okay. He fixed the issue with our tub faucet quickly and did a better job than I expected—the faucet works better now than before it broke. The service was fast, friendly, and honest, and the price was very reasonable. I’m really impressed and highly recommend them if you ever need a plumber.

reviews.author: Derrick Westbrook
reviews.text: Not impressed with them answering the phone then hanging up. Now it's not in service. Smh what a joke.

reviews.author: skylar ramos
reviews.text: Javier from Jake the Plumbing Pro did a fantastic job when my whole house was backed up in Dallas. I had already called another plumber before, but they couldn’t figure out where the main access line was. Javier used his plumbing know-how and found the right spot to dig by understanding how the pipes run from the crawlspace to the city line. He quickly located the main access, dug it up, and cleared the blockage. While working, Javier noticed the pipes under my house were sagging, which caused all the sewage to back up. He showed me the problem and explained that the pipes were being held by flimsy plastic straps. He spent hours under the crawlspace fixing the slope and replaced the old supports with sturdy metal straps, even giving me a 10-year warranty on the work! Javier went above and beyond by checking the rest of the house for any issues. He fixed my low water pressure for free, and also saw that my sink faucet had buildup, so he cleaned that out at no extra charge. He even raised my water temperature for free and made sure the sewage access lines are now easy to find in the future. I’m really impressed by his knowledge, fair pricing, and how much he cared about getting everything right. Definitely the best plumber I’ve worked with for quality, expertise, and kindness.

reviews.author: carmen chaney
reviews.text: Five stars just don’t do their work justice—their plumbing service was outstanding! I wouldn’t recommend anyone else. The whole experience was smooth from start to finish. Before arriving at my home in Dallas, they called ahead and also sent a text with the technician’s card, which included a photo, qualifications, and some background information. I’ve never seen that level of communication before from a plumbing company. When Theodore and Javier arrived, they introduced themselves and clearly explained the steps they would take. They came out to replace my water heater, but they also did a thorough check of all my bathrooms, laundry room, and kitchen to make sure everything else was working well. I appreciated this extra effort—it wasn’t a sales pitch, just honest evaluation for my peace of mind. Since I don’t know much about water heaters, they took the time to explain what was wrong with my old one and gave helpful advice on how to make the new one last longer. They offered several options without pushing me toward any particular choice, which showed they truly cared about my needs. Choosing this plumbing team was definitely the right move for me, and I won’t go anywhere else for plumbing help in the future. Once you’ve had service like this, nothing else compares!

reviews.author: Steve Kaufman
reviews.text: Look no further! This is the company to handle all your plumbing needs. Being a family-owned business, they genuinely treat you like part of their family. I've experienced several plumbing issues and had the pleasure of working with Javier, Theodore, and Luis. All of them are outstanding in their field. When you face a plumbing problem, it can be quite stressful and nerve-wracking. But this company quickly addresses your concerns with high-quality work and impressive expertise—they really know their stuff! For example, I called in the morning to discuss my issue. Although they were on another job with an active leak at that moment, they promised to get back to me as soon as possible. They called me back later, letting me know they could arrive shortly. Javier and Luis showed up right on time and resolved my problem efficiently. All my stress and worries vanished! On another occasion, I had a water heater issue. Theodore guided me through the process, and we managed to handle it ourselves by getting a new water heater under warranty. It was something we could take care of, but I appreciated how he could have easily taken the job instead of helping save me money. Call them now for any of your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Yesenia Salas
reviews.text: Let me tell you about my experience with this plumbing service. The representative was very knowledgeable and friendly when I called. I explained my plumbing problem, and to my surprise, they offered same-day service! Usually, I can’t even get someone to pick up the phone, let alone provide quick assistance! A plumber named Robert arrived around 4 PM. He was polite and listened to my concerns about the plumbing issue. He brought in a high-tech camera to inspect the situation. Right away, he determined that it was time to clear the drain. He used a special tool with a chain on the end that effectively removes blockages. As he worked, a lot of gunk was pushed through, and I could see it wash past the clean-out. After rinsing the drain, he used the drain clearer one more time, and even more gunk came out. He then kindly re-set the toilet, connected the supply line, and patiently waited for the tank to fill. And then, TA-DAAAAAAA, the toilet flushed perfectly! They truly saved the day! I’m so glad I chose this service. The money spent was worth every penny, and I even tipped Robert for his amazing work! Plus, their prices were very reasonable. Would I recommend them? Absolutely! They hit a home run!

reviews.author: seth mccoy
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Javier from a local plumbing company here in Dallas, and I couldn't be happier with the service I received. From the moment he arrived, Javier was professional, friendly, and clearly knew his way around pipes and plumbing problems. I had been dealing with a stubborn leak that just wouldn't go away, but Javier quickly figured out the issue and explained everything to me in simple terms. He worked quickly and made sure the repair was done just right, paying attention to all the little details. I was also impressed by how clean he left the work area—there was no mess left behind at all. It's not every day you find a plumber who not only fixes the issue but also takes extra steps to make sure you're completely satisfied. Thanks to Javier, my plumbing is working perfectly now, and I feel much more comfortable about the condition of my home's pipes. I highly recommend their plumbing services to anyone in Dallas looking for reliable and professional help. I’ll definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: M Sharp
reviews.text: theodore and luis are definitely two of the best plumbers i've ever met. all those reviews saying how friendly they are were spot on. as a bonus, they really like dogs too. my wife heard some strange squishy sounds from her office carpet while moving her chair, and i figured out there was a water leak. i turned off the water main and let the leftover water out by spraying the hose. i called a few plumbers in dallas, and luis reached out to me first for more info. they had just finished another job and said they could come by after. they found the leak super fast and had my water running again in just a few hours. it turned out a pex pipe had cracked and sprung a tiny leak. theodore told me about the manufacturer's warranty and explained the process clearly. both of them were really informative. after they finished up the invoice, theodore even asked if my dogs wanted to come inside, and of course, the pups loved them too. my dogs almost wanted to leave with them! honestly, i really liked and appreciate this team. highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Reginald Rhodes
reviews.text: I recently reached out to a plumbing company in Dallas about a problem I was having with one of my toilets, based on a coworker's suggestion. They were able to set up an appointment that fit my schedule, and they kept in touch before the visit to confirm I’d be available and to make sure everything was on track. Their communication was great. Luis arrived right on time, introduced himself, and explained what he would be doing. He quickly figured out what was wrong with my toilet and explained the issue clearly, along with how he planned to fix it. It didn’t take long for him to repair everything, put my bathroom back together, and leave the space clean, just like it was before. He also gave me some helpful advice on a couple of other plumbing questions I had. From making the appointment to the friendly service and fair price, everything went smoothly. Luis and the team were knowledgeable, respectful, and took good care of my home. I’m glad to have found a plumber I can trust and will definitely call them for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Janice Ewing
reviews.text: As new homeowners, we were recommended to Jake the Plumbing Pro by our realtor and have called them for a few plumbing fixes around our house. I’m writing this review because of the way they helped us during a real emergency. One night, our sump pump stopped working and our whole basement started to flood. We didn’t know what to do, but called and Luis showed up at our door in just 15 minutes. He was friendly and didn’t hesitate for a second, even though it was late in the evening. Luis even brought a new sump pump just in case, which was exactly what we needed. He worked with my husband to remove all the water and quickly installed the new pump. Luis also took the time to explain what happened, which helped calm my worries about possible damage or having to deal with insurance. I thought we’d have to pay a huge amount for emergency service, but the price was very fair and there were no surprise fees. We’ll definitely stick with this plumbing company for any future needs and will recommend them to our friends and neighbors.

reviews.author: Gerald Spears
reviews.text: i was really impressed with the plumbing service i received. we had a clogged drain that needed urgent help. one of the plumbers came out the same day we called to check the problem. he explained that since we didn't have a clean out, they would need to go through the toilet drain to fix the clog. he also suggested installing a clean out to prevent future issues, which i thought was a great idea. at first, i felt a little uneasy about the plumber removing our toilet and working through the toilet drain, especially since we had just renovated the bathroom. however, he did an excellent job not only unclogging the drain but also taking care of our bathroom during the process. after finishing the job, he returned the next day to install the double clean out. he did an incredible job, and it looks like we’ve had that clean out for years. fantastic work! i will definitely reach out to them again and would happily recommend their services to anyone dealing with plumbing problems.

reviews.author: Naomi Figueroa
reviews.text: We recently had a problem with our hot water heater not working late on a Friday night. I called and left a message for javier. he called back and was able to come out to our house the next morning. javier found that the problem was a broken thermocouple, and while fixing that, he noticed water stains on the floor and a small drip from a relief valve. he explained that this could be because of the safety valves or the expansion tank. javier took the time to go over what could happen if it wasn’t fixed, how he would repair it, and how much it would cost. he had all the parts needed and finished the job, which turned out to be the expansion tank, in just a few hours. javier was very professional, friendly, and made sure to clean up after himself. he even took the time to explain how the whole system works, which i really appreciated. everything has been working perfectly since then. i would definitely recommend jake the plumbing pro to anyone needing a plumber.

reviews.author: Lucy Miles
reviews.text: Working with this plumbing company has been a great experience. The quality of their work is top-notch and always very professional. After having some rough times with other home improvement services in the past, I’m happy to have found plumbers I can trust. I’ll keep coming back for any plumbing needs. It’s really convenient that we worked with the same plumber, Luis, each time, which made everything smooth and easy. Recently, we needed more plumbing work done on our sink and water heater, and this time Javier was our technician. He really knew his stuff and made sure the job was done with care. Javier explained all of our options before starting and gave us helpful advice for repairs. It’s great to know we can count on such skilled plumbers for anything from leaky pipes to water heater fixes, especially here in Texas where reliable water and plumbing are so important. I highly recommend this company for anyone needing plumbing work!

reviews.text: John helped us get a clog out of our kitchen sink today. He was super friendly and honest. We appreciate the help! I would recommend Lakewood Plumbers and use them again.

reviews.author: Cleveland Payne
reviews.text: I am on the HOA Board for Mountain Vista Estates Condo Assoc. Lakewood Plumbing has provided service on numerous occasions to our community to diagnose and resolve water leaks and conduct major repairs. reviews.author: Wayne T.
reviews.text: I would not use this company again, their guy was here for one hour, only had one pipe to clear, left a total mess in the basement and I got home right when he finished, but I couldn't understand anything he said like he had a mouthful of tobacco. I also felt he took advantage of my wife by charging 399.00, lot of money for 1 hour of work, when a friend had the same problem and only paid 200.

reviews.author: Barbara Kelly
reviews.text: Ethan did a great job fixing a leak in my pipes in the basement. Pleasant and professional.

reviews.author: Brianna C.
reviews.text:
Updated: For those with ejector/sump pumps

In my last review I was so happy because I didn't have to pay a dime - I gave this business 5 stars and even had them come out again to to snake my bathroom after the diagnosis.  However, two weeks ago, the rotten crap smell came back with a vengeance - it was hovering in the mechanical room for the last month, but finally broke out and entered the furnace.. and thus the rest of the house.  I had caulked, sealed, painted some sort of sealant that the plumber described to me all over the ejector pump top based on 2 separate recommendations from Lakewood Plumbing - but the smell came back. 

Convinced it was my ejector pump, I called an ejector pump specialist plumber.  Within 10 minutes he found out my main sewer line did not have a vent - plumbing 101 here.  He cracked open the ejector pump to see if the smell was coming from there too... nope, nothing but gray water from the washing machine.  He then pointed out the remains of a drip from a pipe attached to the main sewer, we have crazy hard water/softener so it leaves the white markings behind. It was then we could confirm the smell was coming from the sewer due to no vent on my main sewer line and was seeping through the crack in the pipe.  

Considering the smell has been around for 3+ months now, 1 month ago the residue would have still been there - Lakewood should have seen this.  I did have Lakewood come out a 2nd time, while smell was still raging before I painted it in sealant, snake my bathroom and that turned out well, but I was really disappointed to find out they didn't even take the time to look around at why the ejector pump smelled. I even asked them to caulk it for me professionally and the reply from the both the plumber and the front desk woman was 'we don't do that, if you want us to it's $100 an hour'. What?   

Maybe if I had paid for the $100 an hour caulk job, they would have figured out the smell wasn't coming from the ejector pump, it was coming from cracked pipes with no main sewer line vent.  What took another plumber,  from 'Time Plumbing' if you're interested, 10 minutes to find, two visits from Lakewood couldn't find.  The thing I'm disappointed most about is that it's obvious they just didn't care about doing any investigation with the ejector pump.  Plus it was ridiculously embarrassing to have another plumber look at a totally caulked and sealed ejector pump lid. He just shook his head saying 'I can't believe a plumber told you to do this without even opening it up.'


For almost two months there has been a sewage smell coming from my mechanical room that houses my ejector pump. The smell was off and on so it was somewhat easy to ignore since it was only downstairs in that room. But then one day the smell creeped out of the room and started coming into my craft room and the kitchen upstairs! SO NASTY. My uncle owns his own HVAC but is so busy I don't want to take away his time for other customers. He usually does all my plumbing and HVAC work, but the timing was not right on this one. I was terrified to call a plumber because since buying this house in March, nothing has been a "simple fix". I looked at my coupon saver and called three other plumbers that never even called me back!  I called Lakewood Plumbing after my first search online. The phone rang once before a lovely lady scheduled my appointment the next day. Then the plumbers came out during the window they said. The guys looked around, and quickly discovered that my ejector pump had never been sealed or caulked so that was the cause of the smell. They suggested I caulk any openings/seals and the smell would go away. It's been almost a week since they came and guess what after caulking it there is no smell!!! PRAISE THE HOUSE GODS AND LAKEWOOD PLUMBING. The best part was the guys were here for about 5 minutes to diagnose the issue and didn't even charge me. This is how you win over a homeowner. Lakewood plumbing will be my go to (don't tell my uncle!)

reviews.author: Alicia S.
reviews.text:
If I could give them zero stars I would. Our landlord had us call Lakewood plumbing due to a back up issue we have had. My husband called them and set up an appointment. They were supposed to be out here between 9-12 last Thursday. At 11:30 we called because no one had showed up or even called to say they were running late. Lady that we talked to said she would call the tech and see where he was. Called back about 15 minutes later and said that they would be here within the hour. Which at this point they are going to be late by those times. We took off work to be here waiting for them to be late. They came a little after 12 which at least they showed up. They Then ran our kitchen line and said we had a broken line due to pulling back mud. They said they would be in contact with our landlord.We thanked them and they left. 

We had a huge back up in our basement due to using the sink like they said we could. They said it should be better now but need to fix the break. Well we haven't even able to use our kitchen sink for a week now due to it backing up so bad that we had water everywhere. Talked to our landlord and she said she had given the approval to get the work done. Waited and waited a couple days and still no plumber. My husband called them yesterday and nobody knew what was going on. She would call us back and let us know. Call again at 4:50 and they were closed. Called them this morning she hadn't supposedly heard from the higher ups and she was going to try get an answer. 3 hours later still no call back so we called again. She still didn't have an answer and would call us in an hour to let us know. It is now 5:15 pm and she hasn't  even called us back. These people need to learn that if people hire you to fix things then please actually call them back and say you can do it! We are now going on over a week of no use of our kitchen sink. We are washing dishes in buckets so that we can actually eat and use our dishes and our sink! If it weren't for the request of our landlord we would have called someone else a long time ago to fix this!!

reviews.author: Mandy R.
reviews.text: This past weekend, my entire neighborhood suffered backed up sewer lines forcing sewer water and raw sewage (yep! disgusting!) up through the floor drains into our basements. After the clean-up, it became clear that an easy solution to having this not happen again was to have a backflow preventer (or backwater preventer, the correct terminology escapes me, as I've been told by two different outfits that one term is correct over the other) installed on the floor drain to allow water to flow down through it, but not to come up from underneath (ie: no more sewer water from the main sewer lines coming UP through the drain would be allowed). After calling a national plumbing service and having them come out only to have them tell me they "can only do this on commercial buildings" (what?!?!), I called Lakewood Plumbing at 3pm in the afternoon. Lynette took my initial call and was very courteous. I told her what I needed and that I would like someone to come out as quickly as possible. She assured me that they could certainly help, and told me that she would check her technician's schedule to see when he could come out, and call me back. She called me back promptly and told me someone could be at my home between 8-8:30AM the next day. This morning at 8:25AM, Scott, the technician arrived at my home. He installed the backflow preventer quickly, and was friendly and courteous. He also gave me good advice on what to have installed in the future bathroom to prevent city main-line sewer water from coming in when I have the basement finished later this summer. The total charges were a few dollars under what I was initially quoted. I felt the price was a little high for the overall service, which is why this review is 4 stars instead of 5, but I will certainly use this company again, and would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone else.

reviews.author: Aby
reviews.text: A few months ago I was in the process of selling my grandfather's home and wanted to have the main line video'd and snaked prior to sale. Enter Lakewood Plumbing. Who, might I add, I had previously hired on 2 other occasions at this same home for the same service. Within approximately 5 minutes the tech on site said he could not snake any further, my main line was crushed underneath a portion of the home. This tech told me it could cost $12k+, and that is just the plumbing job, I would need to completely rip up the foundation and portion of the home which would then need to be refinished post plumbing work. When I asked for the video of the snake, they claimed they could not provide it. My business partner then called, because he is a man, and I wanted to know if he would get the same story from them. He was told they didn't want to provide the video because it would not be a good idea to show potential buyers, but that they could send it if he really wanted, and then gave a different quote for $8k. We felt this all sounded weird, especially considering the large difference in quotes, so we called another company. That company came out, snaked all the way to the street with no issues and allowed me to watch the video showing the line was not truly damaged. I almost shelled out over $10k and months of my time over a problem that didn't truly exist. I really hope this was a one off occurrence, and they are not out here repeatedly ripping off unsuspecting people for such massive jobs. They also charged me over $600 for a snake that they "couldn't" perform. That alone is a rip-off. Sorry to say, I would not recommend this business to anyone ever again, and have already made sure to tell my friends and family to stay away since.

reviews.author: Eden F.
reviews.text:
Phil from Lakewood Plumbing & Heating came out yesterday to repair my AC. I had mistakenly been using Applewood Plumbing & Heating, and last Friday they came out and overcharged me to replace a thermostat but I was in a pinch and needed it done. On Sunday (two days later) my thermostat was set to 71, but it was 75 degrees. I called Applewood again, and they came out, he told me all of the issues he found with my AC (which was supposedly checked 2 days before), and the cheapest fix was $650 to do the bare minimum, and $3600 to repair everything, but I would get 20% if I bought the club membership. Oh, and $9300 to replace the AC unit (not the furnace and AC, JUST the AC). 
I was very uneasy with this, so I stepped into the other room to call my father. He uses Lakewood to service his office building and home, and he said to tell Applewood I needed time to think about it so they would leave. He then contacted Lakewood, and they sent Phil out. Phil determined that I needed my AC unit cleaned (which Applewood didn't mention), that I needed new valve caps and some freon added. My capacitor and starter were functioning fine (Applewood said they were not). Applewood also said I had a freon leak (which I don't). So, Lakewood fixed my problem for $371. Applewood wanted ten times that to fix "everything" and most of that was bogus! 
I'm not the type of person to bad mouth companies, but I'm incredibly upset that I was taken advantage of by Applewood Plumbing & Heating. I AM the type of person to recommend great companies to others, and I will be recommending Lakewood Plumbing & Heating to everyone!

reviews.author: Not Y.
reviews.text:
As good as it gets.  Needed a new furnace and AC combo, contacted 6 local bidders and received 5 bids (one other installer wasn't on the Xcel approved contractor list..check yours carefully, no rebates unless they are on the list...Lakewood is)...Had Ray Chavez out to the house and he gave me a very thorough list of options explaining what each would do for me.  I am that guy that asks a 1000 questions, Ray didn't mind at all and I got the feeling I was dealing with a waiter at Morton's...things were going to be done right, no fast talk, plain answers and the "of course" attitude...very pleasant experience.  Followed up with Ray on a few questions I had derived from the other bidders and his answers seemed to me to be straight forward and rational, not everyone was that way!  I appreciated Ray being patient and never felt like I was bothering him, he returned my emails and phone calls promptly.  
Installation day went as smooth as could be, Chad & Brad showed up on time and worked hard through the day.  Install was done as expected and the new sweet machines were hummin.  Not extra charges, no install day gotchas.  Brad did the excel paperwork and testing (its extensive) to ensure I would get the rebates.  The guys were friendly and didn't ever seem put-out with my questions along the way.  Passed inspection with flying colors.  Ray has been great answering followup questions, certainly not one of those companies that once the contract is signed, they're moving on.  Obviously a good experience, highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Richard F.
reviews.text: Well we had one of those days. The kitchen sink suddenly was not draining. The Disposal was working but it would still come up into the sink. Ugh! Looking underneath I dreaded trying to tackle it myself. Nearby was the Lakewood Plumbing office so I called them around 2:30 pm. Thankfully they were able to get someone to help us a little after 5 pm. The fellow called to let us know he was due to arrive. In less then an hour he snaked it out right from under the sink. Since all else was working fine there was no need for anything more. Drat...wished I had used those store bought cleaners more since it's been over 7 years since that sink was stopped up. Ah well, the good news is they were quite prompt and the task was done for us by someone far more experienced then me. Cost was $155 so I consider it reasonable given it seemed like an urgent matter. From my perspective there was nothing to complain about with Lakewood. They were prompt and the job was successfully done in a pretty fast time. For that I am thankful. Plumbers are not what you may want to use all the time but when you need them I really like the speedy service we received. When a job is well done and timely what else do they deserve but 5 stars from me! I shall keep them in mind the next time we need any plumbing work done. Pleased!

reviews.author: Mellisa W.
reviews.text:
I asked them to come fix a pip leak that was leaking from an upstairs bathtub down to the cabinets. He came and "fixed it". My tenants noticed there was still some water (now much less than before) leak from that section of the pipe. I called them 1 month + 10 days later, and they refused to come and reassess the situation without first charging another 130$ for evaluation. They stated it was because the call from me was past that "30 day guarantee" period. If you are a plumbing company ... and you only insure your work for 30 days, that's some lame lousy work you are doing.

The pipe was leaking before and more proximally, there was a second leak. However, i don't believe they actually evaluated it because they only fixed the part my tenants pointed out. If you are a good plumber, you would check for ALL the leak within that section (literally visible), if they had just filled up the bathtub and drained it to test for leak, it would've been seen. But no. And now they said they would come and fix it for a starting cost of 130$ + other labor and material fees (which that part I was ok with but you shouldn't charge an initial assessment fee for an area you failed to fix in the first place).

reviews.author: Kris K.
reviews.text: I want to give them a zero rating but yelp won't allow it.  Please don't use them.  They take advantage of the elderly.  My elderly mother and father used them for a water leak.  They came out 3 times and charged my parents $215 and never resolved the problem.  One of plumbers dropped the f-bomb in front of my 85 year old mother because water was leaking and he could not figure out the issue.  The same plumber came back a second time and yelled at my mother for flooding the floor.  Which she did not do.  They sent a 3rd person who identified himself as an estimator.  It appears they were planning on charging my parents more for additional work even though they couldn't fix the issue at hand. My father sent him away because by this time they figured out this company was completely incompetent. The problem was fixed by another company who was competent.  The drain pipe had roots and needed to be fixed by a roter rooter.  The new company fixed the issue in 1 visit. My father sent a letter for a full refund because Lakewood Plumbing did not fix the issue.  He hasn't heard a thing from them.  Please do not give this company your business!

reviews.author: Roberta T.
reviews.text:
We had used Lakewood Plumbing previously for some plumbing maintenance issues and the service people were always very nice but they were NOT inexpensive.  We had an issue with our air conditioning and they could not do the service call for 4 days (understandable since I am sure they were swamped due to the hot weather).  When the service rep arrived it took him no more than twenty minutes to diagnose the issue.  He indicated that he did not have the part and would have to order it (this was on a Thursday).  We were told that he should be able to install it no latter than the next Tuesday.  

Well over a week went by and I followed up to check on the status of the service call.  Two messages left latter (with promises of a call back) and I had to call again the next day.  I was told the parts were in but they could not get out until Friday to install it.  Very disappointing!

I have family in another state in the plumbing and heating business and if they ran their business this way they would not be in business any longer.

synthesis.summary: Despite BBB A+ and 4.7 Google over 523 reviews, Yelp 3.3/71 and the sample tell a different story — a Lakewood, CO operation with repeat no-shows, $400+ charges for under-an-hour cartridge swaps, and a specific front-desk rep (Tanya) named for rudeness in multiple Google and Yelp reviews. Concrete patches left non-level after under-slab pipe repairs. A reviewer used them at the recommendation of an HOA and still wouldn't recommend.

Capable of major repairs (jackhammer + PVC under-slab) when scheduled in advance

Concrete patch quality after under-slab work left customer grinding/patching at their own expense

30-day workmanship warranty refused on shower-leak callback
synthesis.emergencyNotes: HOA condo customers report 30-minute emergency dispatch with named techs (Tim and Doug). Counterweight: half-dozen calls cited where techs were 'busy until next week,' Sunday boiler-out call ignored, Thanksgiving weekend no-show. Emergency response is inconsistent.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: I would not use this company again, their guy was here for one hour, only had one pipe to clear, left a total mess in the basement

garbage-disposal.topQuote: We received the bill for $491 to replace the disposal. This is incredibly high.

sump-pump.topQuote: I called to replace my sump pump discharge piping. They would not just come out and fix it, I had to have an estimate first.

plumbers.name: 1-800-Plumber +Air
plumbers.address: 3321 Towerwood Dr #120, Farmers Branch, TX 75234, USA

reviews.author: Terri Olive
reviews.text: We received a full home sewer line scoping with a very detailed review and multiple options for repair estimates. Cooper is very thorough and answered all of our questions. Very personable and friendly service attitude from both he and his partner!

reviews.author: Annalee Aston
reviews.text: Chris is wonderful!! I cannot say enough nice things about him. He is punctual, extremely knowledgeable, kind and HONEST. He goes above and beyond for his customers to make sure everything is working properly, without unnecessary costs. Chris is the best!

reviews.author: Madison White
reviews.text: Cooper was awesome! We had an issue in the middle of the night and I called at 8:15 in the morning and he was at my house by 9:00. Super professional and reasonable!

reviews.author: Alex Dodd
reviews.text:
I had a full sewer line replacement done by 1-800-Plumber, and I can’t speak highly enough about the experience. From the moment they came out to assess the issue, it was clear I was in good hands. This wasn’t a simple repair—it was a major, complex project involving trenching, excavation, pipe replacement, and coordination with local permits and inspections.

Thomas and his crew were absolutely outstanding. They explained everything clearly upfront, kept me informed each step of the way, and made sure the job site was clean and safe at the end of each day. Their work was meticulous, and they treated my property with respect. They didn’t just check boxes—they went above and beyond to make sure the job was done right, down to the smallest details.

Chanel in the office deserves major credit as well. She handled all the paperwork, permits, and coordination behind the scenes. For a project of this size, that part is just as important—and she made it seamless. Her communication was prompt and professional, and she made sure I always knew where we stood.

I don’t normally write reviews like this, but the level of service, quality of work, and overall professionalism truly impressed me. If you need major plumbing work done—especially something as serious as a sewer line replacement—don’t hesitate to call 1-800-Plumber. They earned every one of these five stars.

reviews.author: Glenis Pittman
reviews.text: From the very beginning Thomas, Cooper, & Lily were responsive, professional, knowledgeable, resourceful, & really good at their work.  Cooper showed us the scope view of our sewer pipes.  He & Thomas helped us understand the approach alternatives, estimated timing of our project, & recommended approach choice for reasons that showed they heard our concerns about our sewer pipes.  They were honest & communicative throughout our project.  Lily was a delight as she coordinated workers & facilitated connections, parts, completions, etc.  They are an amazing team!  We also benefited from Cooper's fixing 2 fresh water pipe leaks before mold occured; he also attached a device on our 2 water heaters to help turn off the water if there was ever to be a water heater burst. The home inspector had recommended that when we bought our 1974 built house.  'Very grateful for this plumbing team & we will definitely call them the next time we have a plumbing need!!

reviews.author: Jessica Boettner
reviews.text: Having this plumbing inspection saved me a lot of money and heartache down the road. Was looking at buying a 1970s house which is known for having cast iron pipes which have a life of 50-75 years. Had normal inspection beforehand and he thought the underneath was redone at some point due to the outs having PCP (not sure if I’m remembering his words right, but what comes out is usually what’s under) but we went the extra mile anyways and got this service to be certain. This one did not survive, was clearly deteriorating. Cost to fix is 30k. One of the most expensive problems to have in home ownership! So thank you 😊

reviews.author: Liz Chalfant
reviews.text: We've had a variety of positive experiences with 1-800-plumber as a result of both proactive installations (smart water shut off) to troubleshooting after spending a few months away from our property. In every encounter, we have been impressed by the communication throughout booking and scheduling; transparency and competitiveness in pricing; and most importantly, how polite and courteous everyone has been across the ownership, the call center and the plumbers on-site. At every opportunity, this company has exceeded our expectations and we have already referred them multiple times.

reviews.author: J Flores
reviews.text: Expeditious execution on an outside leak with my outdoor spigot. Response, Work, and time spent overall was minimal. Well worth the pricing which was spot on what IExpeditious execution on an outside leak with my outdoor spigot. Response, Work, and time spent overall was minimal. Well worth the pricing which was spot on what I expected for a professional plumber. Joe was courteous, professional and fully transparent on the work required and Post work with what was done. I would definitely hire again!

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.text: We used 1-800-Plumber +Air to help use solve some issues when selling our home and the process was extremely easy. Cooper showed up on time, and fixed our repair quickly. When there was a delay on solving and additional concern, Chris came out immediately and got everything working! Communication and scheduling was a breeze with Thomas, and Cooper and Chris were super professional! High recommend if you want quick, reliable service!

reviews.author: Bailey Schaufele
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful experience with 1800plumber! Will did an incredible job - issue was assessed and costs to correct them were upfront! He was professional and on time!

Just had 1800plumber come out for a second time as our insurance company required us to have an automatic water shut off installed. They promptly got us a quote and were able to install it the next business day once we approved! They made the process SO easy!!

reviews.author: Meredith Hammer
reviews.text: I had four companies come out to give estimates for our cast iron to PVC plumbing upgrade and 1-800 Plumber was significantly less than the other companies.  I was so glad I went with them and plan to use them again in the future.  Andrew Burley managed our job and was very professional, timely, and competent in the repairs needed in two different bathrooms.  I will definitely be passing on my recommendation!

reviews.author: Jennifer Lerom-Cooper
reviews.text: Cooper was great! I had four drains that needed to be looked at and he said two of them were actually fine and it was the shape of the sink as well as the water pressure in one of the other sinks. So he didn’t charge me for those drains just the two that were clogged. Very trustworthy and professional and extremely nice to work with. Will definitely use again if we have any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Christian Santarelli
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this plumbing company! Chris was the plumber who came out to remove some old cast-iron piping, and he did an outstanding job. They were incredibly prompt, professional, and efficient from start to finish. The work was clean, fast, and done right the first time. It’s not easy finding reliable trades these days, but these guys really delivered. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dan Harker
reviews.text: My wife and I have engaged three different times for plumbing work from Thomas, Andrew and Cooper over the last three months. All on different houses and it’s been an excellent experience each time. We recently had smell of potential leaking gas out of one of the connections and they were there within 30 minutes after 9 o’clock at night. Totally impressed with this crew!

reviews.author: Chelsea Harrison
reviews.text: I called 1-800-Plumber +Air for a couple small issues and they were responsive, scheduled me quickly, professional, communicative and prompt. Juan P. was the technician and showed up right on time, was thorough but efficient and made sure I understood the issues and necessary repairs every step of the way. I wish I would’ve called them sooner!

synthesis.summary: All 30 reviews in this batch are 5-star with strikingly consistent specifics: techs at the door 45 minutes after a morning call, quotes well below 4 competing bids on a cast-iron-to-PVC upgrade, and Cooper telling a customer 2 of 4 drains didn't actually need work and not charging for them. The repeat-named techs (Chris, Cooper, Andrew, Thomas) signal a tight, consistent crew.

plumbers.address: 3280 Wadsworth Blvd Ste 200, Wheat Ridge, CO 80033, USA

reviews.author: Gustavo Wunderlich
reviews.text: Jason arrived very quickly and handled our sewer repair with great professionalism. our outside pipe issue was resolved smoothly, and he made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. He explained the sewer repair process clearly and gave helpful advice to prevent future problems. Fast response, honest service, and excellent results truly a reliable family owned plumbing company.

reviews.author: Franco Palomino
reviews.text: Big apple came out the same after no one else had time to come out, and they even gave us the best price for our main sewer line replacement.

reviews.author: Joe Szillat
reviews.text:
Ever have a great start to a day, and in a split second everything just goes down the drain? Well it wasn’t going down the drain for me; it was being pumped out of my basement sump pump. That’s when I knew I needed help. I called Big Apple; best thing I could have done!  They were out to my house within a hour!! He took a look where the main water was coming into my house and pointed out to me where the water leak was coming from. He explained that it could be in the cement or in my yard…. Either way he could get it back into operation the same day!

Long story short…. He showed me the issued piping, and I opted to have a brand new pipe installed from the water main to my house. They just dig out a hole around the water main now and don’t have to trench and dig out the whole yard.

I couldn’t have asked for a better expert or quicker response!

Thanks for saving the day!!!!

reviews.author: Ricky Lambert
reviews.text: Overpriced + truck fee is way too high. They charged $50 just to show up and give a ridiculous quote of $1000 to redo my kitchen drain. Told them nah. Ended up finding someone else who did it for about 60% less than their quote.

reviews.author: Luz Ayil-Dzul
reviews.text:
We recently had our water heater replaced by Big Apple Plumbing, and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. The plumber arrived on time, explained all of our options clearly, and helped us choose the right water heater for our home without any pressure or upselling.

The installation was clean, efficient, and professionally done. Everything worked perfectly right away, and they made sure the area was spotless before leaving. We really appreciated the clear communication, fair pricing, and how respectful the team was of our home.

If you’re looking for a reliable, trustworthy plumbing company for water heater replacement, I highly recommend Big Apple Plumbing. Excellent service and quality work you can count on.

reviews.author: Doug F.
reviews.text: Wow.  Just had James install a recirculation pump on my water heater.  Works great.  James is responsive, knowledgeable and dedicated.  Installed the pump and it was missing a part.  Found the part and came back out the same day and got the system working.  It made our day.  He is our go-to guys for plumping needs from here on out.  Highly recommend to others.

reviews.author: Kayla I.
reviews.text: I recently was gathering quotes from other plumbing companies in Westminster, that didn't even seem to want to do the work. After reaching out to Midwest Plumbing, they were thrilled to help, and was half the price of what other companies were charging to replace my sewer! I will only recommend, and use Midwest Plumbing from now on!

reviews.author: Ricky Nixon
reviews.text: Jason at Big Apple Plumbing is truly the best.  We needed a bidet installed for medical reasons, and Jason responded promptly.  He redid the water line and had everything installed in under half an hour.  He was extremely professional, respectful, and efficient.  We couldn’t be happier with the service and highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Garfield Hall
reviews.text: Quick response for our water heater repair and the issue was fixed without any delay. Everything was checked carefully, and the heater was working perfectly before they left. Very professional, friendly, and easy to communicate with. Great experience with this reliable family owned plumbing service.

reviews.author: bort man
reviews.text: The guys at Big Apple were amazing,  what was supposed to be an easy job turned into a headache,  bur he never got frustrated. And stayed until he hand my filter functioning properly! They were very honest and upfront about everything and were very prompt professional and thorough

reviews.author: Hunter Freed
reviews.text: When my water heater started leaking all over my basement Jason was able to come over very quickly and asess the situation. He got the new water heater installed same day and was very reasonably priced. I wouldn't hesitate to refer anyone to Big Apple for all their plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Susan Carrizales
reviews.text: We have used Big Apple Plumbing for more than 10 years. They are knowledgeable about old homes, always prompt, professional and polite and their prices are fair. They They provide a report with text and pictures explaining the work done and are a pleasure to work with

reviews.author: Linda Kugler
reviews.text: We highly recommend Big Apple Plumbing for all plumbing needs.  They've been to our house twice and we couldn't be happier.  Along with being knowledgeable and highly skilled, Jason and his crew are available, on time, polite, efficient,  and just so nice.

reviews.author: David Frick
reviews.text: Jason was fast and efficient, resolving our flooding issue in under an hour. He quickly identified the cause as a clogged kitchen sink connected to the basement. He explained everything clearly and was very friendly and professional to have in our home.

reviews.author: Sekhar P.
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Midwest Plumbing. James is super responsive, available on short notice, and transparent about his prices. Very professional and did an excellent job on retrofitting an area under a counter to be dishwasher ready.
