plumbers.address: 5414 Forest Ln, Dallas, TX 75229, USA

reviews.author: Kevin S
reviews.text: Had Milestone help with the plumbing and electrical work needed for a back-up generator and replacement of old load centers.  Big job and they did outstanding work.  Very good communications every step of the way. Technicians that take great pride in their work, enjoy what they do and have no problem explaining as they go.  Shout out to Logan, Randall, Jeremy, Abram, Jonathan, Shan, Ryan, Robert, Jeff and Shanna. It was a pleasure working with all of you. Milestone will probably not be the cheapest quote you may receive, but based on my experience with them, they will be well worth the price.

reviews.author: Deborah Sherman
reviews.text: Milestone was very helpful when an outlet I plugged a charger block into sparked and smoked on me! They didn’t have a technician available to come out that day but suggested I call the fire department. And they would be able to turn off the breaker to that outlet. The next day they sent out Ricardo Monge. He did an excellent job replacing the outlet for me and checking other outlets and the whole breaker box. I felt so much more secure! Thanks, Milestone!

reviews.author: Brittany Harris
reviews.text:
Omg I’m so incredibly grateful for ROGER RUIZ!!!

I called in at 8pm with a hose leaking from a refrigerator where I was HOUSE SITTING. I was freaking out- talking to the homeowner and then finally called these guys.

Roger helped me locate the shut off valve and stop the emergency. I couldn’t believe it! He literally saved me and the homeowner from a horrible situation.

He even suggested that I reach out to the appliance people as it might be within their scope as opposed to the plumber’s.

I’m so impressed and blown away to see there are still people doing business like this today. It’s so hard to find honest contractors. Like wow.

God bless you my guy. That was super hero work for real.

reviews.author: C D.
reviews.text: I'll spare you the details, but suffice it to say I've been fooled by Milestone for several years.  I even paid for the "membership" for several years.  It's a gimmick.  Trust me, do not ever think about hiring Milestone unless you have extra money laying around to burn.  I gave two stars instead of one bc they actually do good work.  However, their charges are consistently thousands (yes, thousands!) more than other companies.  They will ALWAYS try to upsell you another item, service or repair that you didn't call them out to the house for.  ALWAYS.  Just spare yourself and avoid this company.  They only want your $$$. The plumbers and electricians are trained in sales.  Each one is a salesaman.

reviews.author: John O.
reviews.text: I paid $240 for the annual "Milestone Advantage" agreement. I ordered the filters and UV filtration lights in advance from the Milestone website. Upon arrival for my first bi-annual A/C maintenance appointment, the technicians informed me that they were not allowed to install the UV lights unless Milestone had originally installed the filtration system. I had them double check with their manager. They did. I even offered to pay them extra. The result is that it did not get done. Milestone markets themselves as "Your Trusted Home Service Experts." They told me that if they replace the UV bulbs, they will then be responsible for any failure to the UV system. Which begs the question...what else will they NOT do AFTER you pay them for their Advantage program. I called to cancel my agreement. After two phone calls, they said that it was all a miscommunication. Now, they are sending out someone to replace the bulbs in another three hour window this afternoon.  This should not be that hard.  Buyer beware.

reviews.author: Rene F.
reviews.text:
I fell for the scam.  SMH.  I have a room that doesn't get cool, like the others. I heard the commercial that Milestone would come out and fix it for $189 and if they cant fix it, I don't owe anything.  Of course when I called the sales team began working.  Offered me the $19.99/mo deal that included 2 "tune-ups".  I fell for it and scheduled my first appointment.  Very polite people came out and did the whole, shoe cover thing, in an effort to impress.  After checking my 10yr old system, that is currently working, I got told the bad news.  I NEEDED A WHOLE NEW SYSTEM.  The technician couldn't believe how bad my system was. The technician made me a fancy video showing all the bad things going on and then he left with a promise that the "sales" guy would come out soon to go over their recommendations.  
Two days later, on a Saturday mind you, the sales guy showed up.  He apologized for not having shoe covers and asked if he could step on my floor. lol.  He was polite and courteous.  He then started to cover his presentation.  wow.  I have been to presentations from timeshares in the past and the only thing this guy was missing was that he didn't offer me a margarita.  He went on to explain the history of the company and how family friendly they are.  He asked if I had any questions on the company.  He then went on to explain that he had three options for me, the basic, the better and the best.  Since I answered that this is my forever home, he suggested that I should really consider the best option because it "makes the most sense".  I about fell on the floor.  The best option he was offering and according to him he was able to discount down to an amazing $62,000!!!! This was the top of the line with all the bells and whistles and warranties.  He also offered the middle better option which, after his discounts, came to about $52,000.  And just because he offered the plain jane 3rd option, the plain, run of the mill option for about $32,000.  I have a 3300 sq ft house with two units.  I didn't pay that much when I got it installed 10 yrs ago.  
Long story long.  He left with a thank you for your time and a promise I would call back.  
I called another company who came out for a second opinion. This company was honest and said nothing is wrong with my systems.  I explained what Milestone told me and even showed him my concerns from the video that Milestone provided.  This guy laughed and said, "yup, thats what they do".  

Run.  Dont walk, RUN away from Milestone.  I cant stress this enough.  At the very least get a 2nd and 3rd opinion from other companies.

reviews.author: Diana H.
reviews.text: When a plumbing issue became a major problem at our house, I remembered the MILESTONE ad on tv.  Recently, there had been a steady onslaught of Milestone commercials being played repeatedly one after another...multiple times...over & over...like a broken record.  Those repetitive tv ads that played continuously on a loop are what's known as AMBUSH MARKETING.  We were so bombarded with their ads in our zip code that they were the first plumber that I called.  Their tv commercial said, "WE HAVE 5 TRUCKS IN PLANO...RIGHT NOW!  CALL TO GET $60 OFF ANY PLUMBING ISSUE."  So, I called to set an appointment.  The Milestone representative was nice over the phone.   However, I waited for 2 hours for the Milestone plumber to show up!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  I called Milestone back and asked, "Where is your plumber?"  They said, "Well, he's gonna text you 30 minutes prior to arrival."  That would have put his arrival time at 2 hours and 30 minutes.  So much for their line that WE HAVE 5 TRUCKS IN YOUR AREA RIGHT NOW!!!  Milestone missed their own window of arrival time.  That equates to a NO SHOW in my opinion.  So, I told him to remove my email and phone number as a customer since their plumber never sent me a text and never showed up.  He was a complete NO SHOW!!!  I called another local plumber in Plano instead.  He actually honored the $60 discount for me as a courtesy and showed up in a timely manner.  In other words, he showed up when promised...exactly on the dot!  You should definitely call around before making an appointment with Milestone in Dallas.  Otherwise, you'll be waiting for nothing!  Try one of the smaller plumbing companies...one that doesn't play non-stop commercials.  If Milestone didn't spend so much money on annoying ads, maybe they could actually focus on plumbing instead!  p.s. After reading other reviews here...I think it was lucky for me that Milestone was a NO SHOW!  Other reviewers call Milestone SHADY & TOO EXPENSIVE.  Maybe if Milestone stopped playing those stupid commercials constantly...they could charge a fair price instead of price gouging women and/or senior citizens, etc.  Yikes!!!  I dodged a bullet.

reviews.author: Larry R.
reviews.text:
Save your money! If you want a reliable plumber then DO NOT call Milestone Plumbing in Dallas/Fort Worth. In addition, their subscription program is a farse as I found out.
I joined their Subscription Program after the "Snoawmagedon" event in the Dallas Fort Worth area in 2020. I did this because it was very difficult to find a plumber when that event and for $20/month I thought I would be treated with some sort of priority. Well, we are now in a very cold snap and one of my outdoor tankless water heaters froze.  I had a trip planned with my wife with deposits and reservations made and we were supposed to leave onm the 16th.  Milestone Plumbing could not get to my home until the 17th so I delayed our departure until the 18th due to their word they would be at my home on the 17th. I scheduled the appointment towards the middle of the day because the forecast temperatures for then were to be in the low 40s and I expected that the water heater would be thawed by then.  At 08:15AM today Milestone calls me and tells me they will not respond because the water heater was still frozen.  I explained to them the conversation that I had with the scheduler just 2 days prior where I was ASSURED that Milestone would be at my home on the 17th to check my water heater.  The caller said he would "check with the team" and call me back which he did just to tell me that they would NOT HONOR their promise to be at my home on the 17th. I then asked Milestone, as a "premium subscription member" if they could send a plumber to my home so they could show me how to turn off the water and natural gas to the water heater and I would schedule another appointment when I returned.m  Answer to a "premium subscription member":  "the manager said that we cant come out to show you how to secure your water heater.  That was it!!!!!  If they are ready to flip-off a "premium subscription member" then what can anyone expect from them? Answer: Not much. Don't waste your time and money on Milestone and call a real reputable company not one that inflates their customer ratings and makes false promises. Do not rely on them.

reviews.author: Dell D.
reviews.text:
If I was a billionaire and money wasn't an issue I'd probably use Milestone.  They do the job right and the employees are good.   However, you will always be quoted the maximum price.  And when I say the maximum price I mean the maximum.   And they will always say you need 5 other repairs in addition to the one you called them out for.    If one of their guys gets in the door you're getting some kind of estimate that makes you say, "Holy cow."
We got a quote on AC repair from them for $18,000.   Other companies quoted us $12,000.   Milestone claims the difference is quality, but after researching the unit they would have installed compared to the other companies, it's the same level.   And these other companies that quoted us $12,000 were both known and reputable.
A $6,000 difference is extreme and means they don't respect you.   And the rep said, "If you agree to buy today I'll knock off $900."    Shady.
I know you pay for good work, but there's a limit.  It's too much.
But I think the thing that irritates me the most is that we paid for the Milestone membership (whatever they call it) and it seems like that counted for nothing.   It certainly didn't get us the lowest price.  
We still paid through the nose every time.  Even though the visit was "free" they find a way to get the money anyway.
The membership was just a way for them to spam your text with offers for a free checkup which are clearly a way to give you a $3,000 estimate for some repair.

reviews.author: Gregg J.
reviews.text: Okay good and bad. Nathan Hager is Wonderful! His co worker Luis is also awesome. Both high quality work on my new Garland city approved breakers and box and they did exactly what they said they would do. Nathan went the extra mile persay. The installed the old receptical in the wall behind oven to get new oven stove working. Nathan was back as promised on time three days later to.put new parts in. The work.is incredible. The part I don't care for is out of techs hands! It's the prices. Way high prices. I work extremely hard to maintain my old place and have a home my wife and I can enjoy. The problem is when you advertise often and pay commission that the overhead is so high that you then pass it along to the customer and cause high prices. It's probably should have been 25% less in cost for job done but again prices high. I spent lots of money on new AC and heat unit last year and new washer pipes in wall and now new breakers and box but still high prices. Yes Milestone beat Levy and Sons price on the AC unit by 20% and hight efficiency unit but still not a very big discount on lady job when spending lots I don't have to waste. Bad part is all in pricing. Nathan Hager, Luis, and Julio Aguilar are awesome! A jay need to get other bids in future all because of prices. Masters Touch in Rockwall are 5 star too and much less expensive on plumbing do to low overhead. Customers look for lower prices and great work. Thanks! Sincerely, Gregg

reviews.author: Rosemarie K.
reviews.text:
The technician that was in my attic was rubbing the hvac tube back and forth on the strap that holds it in place...it wss right by the attic entrace and he didnt know I was watching . I could not watch longer thsn a minute cause insulation was starting yo come down.  Once he was out of attic he told me showed me pictures of the venting tubes and there were holes in them that were not sll the way through, and vents were dirty.  He offered to put algie stop tablets in system, told me yhat they were 89.00 . The treatment USE to bebincluded in my club membership but no longer is. I question whether he damaged my vent tube more than it already was at this point. Plus, he charged zn outrageous amount for the tablet treatment. 
NOW hd tells md that I need one of the hvac specialist to give me an estimate. But, the other tech who was with him told me it would ptobzbly start at 3000.00 and go up from there! ( club members are SUPPOSE to get discounts!) EVEN IF they gave me a discount it would still be way over priced...like the treatment for algie growth! I got an estimate from another reputable compzny fir 1300.00 to fix and clean all vents! I dropped my Milestone club membership like a hot potato. 
Dont use Milestone unless you are filthy rich, and want to throw your money out the window!

reviews.author: Arthur H.
reviews.text:
Horrible horrible customer service. I was quoted an 11-2 window to come out and service my thankless water heater. Day 1 no one showed in that window. Finally received a call telling me they would need to reschedule. Provide me with the same window for the next day. I was clear that I needed the tech there on the earlier side of the window due to needing to catch a flight. At 1pm, still no tech. When I called I was told that once again they were running way behind. So, rescheduled once again for the same window. At 11 am, no one showed up or called. I called and their rep told me that I was next on the list. Tech had 30 minutes of work left and then would be headed my way. He would call me once on his way. At 2:10 pm no Tech, nor did I receive a call indicating he would miss the window for now a 3rd time. I called and recounted this entire story to the rep. She said she talked to dispatch and a manager and they promised I would be next as soon as a tech became available. I told her my expectation at this point was for them to say the tech is on the way. I was not going to wait any longer given they had already wasted 9 hours of my time.

My recommendation to Milestone....stop saying "we'll fix it in a flash" . You can't even get there in a flash. So disappointing.

reviews.author: Doug C.
reviews.text: Everything old can be new again when one upgrades their closet fluorescent light. After 27 years the contractor special  light was not working. I had changed the blubs several times over the years but this time nothing worked. Checking on the internet showed that the ballast was shot and required more than my personal experience with fixing home electrical appliances to repair. Called Milestone Fri and got choice of appointments for Mon as Sat was taken up. On Mon they called and offered to come earlier which I took advantage of. Problem was quickly resolved as bad ballast and only a few minutes to effect a LED relamp. "Led relamp" refers to relamping with LED bulbs  designed to replace existing halogen lamps in fixtures  without requiring complete fixture replacement or rewiring.  The original light system has been changed to LED now so new blubs won't work in original fixture without changing the ballast to the new tech. Sidenote: the tech checked the circuit box and noted that it should be considered for an upgrade. Internet says circuit boxes should be replaced after 25 to 40 years for all sorts of reasons. We got three quotes good for 90 days to consider making the upgrade.

reviews.author: Wes D.
reviews.text:
We've used Milestone for years and the technicians are generally very good. Recently their sales practices seem to have changed and we're unlikely to use them again due to these sales practices. 

We agreed to a yearly maintenance plan for one year, which was automatically renewed without notice or consent. The process to cancel this membership is difficult to find and complete (seemingly intentionally).

We called to cancel this one week after the auto renew occurred and requested a refund. After multiple calls  Milestone agreed to refund half and would not agree to refund the other half. So we paid for 6 months of a service we had for 1 week and did not use. 

Additionally, in the weeks leading up to this renewal Milestone called unsolicited at least once a week to try to send someone to check the house, which we did not need. They did not mention the membership renewal in any voicemail or text (of which there were many).

I gave two stars because their technicians are great, but it looks like they're resorting to some of the business practices of other companies that we stay away from.

reviews.author: Beth H.
reviews.text: Where to even start??? How about the service technician that told me they couldn't quote new HVAC systems without my husband being available to talk through the quote? You know because the lady of the house wouldn't be the one making the decision and paying for it??? Then we were told a warranty part on our system was out and was unavailable for 4 months, so our option was to wait 4 months or upgrade to a new system even through we only had this one 5 years. When we called Carrier it turned out you could order direct and expedite and get the part in less than two weeks. Then to replace that part, labor was $1,799. Ummm what?? Oh it's because the system kept shutting off after the part and their "expert" service team couldn't figure out why. After hours a manger was called and asked them to check the gas pressure, bam that was it, it was adjusted, they were done and we were charged for all the "labor" required to fix the system. This company is extremely overpriced and has unethical sales tactics. It's honestly embarrassing we stayed with them this long.

synthesis.summary: Google says 4.9 across 19,000+ reviews, but Yelp 3.2/81 and the actual review text tell a consistent story: the work is acceptable but the pricing is multiples of competitors, the membership plan auto-renews, and 24/7 service is advertised but not delivered. Reviewers repeatedly note quotes that come in 2x-10x other plumbers ($32k vs $3.4k AC, $500 vs $100 breaker, $688 vs $70 cartridge).
strengths: Multiple reviewers concede 'they actually do good work' and that technicians are 'professional' on installation jobs
Same-day arrival reported on plumbing/electrical calls when techs are dispatched
weaknesses: Reviewers consistently report quotes 2x-10x other plumbers — $688 to replace a shower cartridge another plumber quoted $70, $32,000 to replace an AC unit a contractor did for $3,400
Membership plan reported as auto-renewing without notice with intentionally-difficult cancellation
Despite 24/7 advertising, multiple reviewers refused service on Sunday/cold-weather emergencies — 'water heater broke and flooded my house' four days after Milestone cancelled the appointment
Repeat upselling on every visit — 'they will ALWAYS try to upsell you another item, service or repair'
bestFor: large HVAC installs (if budget is no object)
redFlags: Pricing complaints dominate the negative reviews — multiple jobs quoted at 5-10x competitors
24/7 service advertised but not honored on a 21-degree HVAC outage
Cancellation of confirmed appointments without notice during emergencies
Yelp 3.2 vs Google 4.9 across 81 Yelp reviews — large discrepancy
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviewers cite the 24/7 advertising failing in practice — one was told 'I could get an appointment on Thursday or Friday' on a Sunday with HVAC out at 21 degrees; another's tankless water heater flooded after Milestone cancelled.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 3.2 vs Google 4.9 across 81 Yelp reviews — possible review curation; Yelp text consistent with overpricing complaints

plumbers.name: Plumb Pros Inc
plumbers.address: 6525 W 52nd Ave, Arvada, CO 80002, USA

reviews.author: Tyler Burke
reviews.text:
My heat went out today during the snowstorm, and I was really stressed that it was going to be a big issue or take a long time to get someone out. I called Plumb Pros and they had a technician at my house within 90 minutes.

Charlie was awesome! He was friendly, professional, and very straightforward about everything he was doing. He explained the issue clearly, gave honest feedback, and had my furnace fixed in no time.

I’ve used Plumb Pros multiple times for plumbing, AC, and now furnace work, and they’ve been consistently excellent every time. They are extremely customer-oriented, true professionals, and always reliable. They never try to upsell or take advantage of the situation, and they do exceptional work without breaking your wallet.

I’m very grateful for their help today and highly recommend Plumb Pros to anyone looking for trustworthy and reliable service.

reviews.author: Summer Kirkpatrick
reviews.text: I called Plumb Pros to come out and fix our heater and backed up kitchen sink. Not only did they resolve these problems and ensure that our appliances were back up and running properly, but they were professional and well educated. Charlie & Fonz were so polite and very informative as they went over all of the options for payment, financing, and available discounts as well. Definitely glad we called this company and would certainly recommend them to anyone in the future! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Cathy Montoya
reviews.text:
This company has my five stars! They have been servicing my home for almost a decade. The brothers Fonzo and Alfredo have gone above and beyond to make me happy and my house warm. Matt David Alfonso and Fonzo are always professional knowledgeable and on time. They make the wrongs right and I know I can count on them. Claudia is on point and knows her job well. She always takes care of me. The owner is great and runs a good business. I would recommend them to all I know. Use them you won't be disappointed
Cathy Montoya

reviews.author: Reagan D.
reviews.text: Yikes...quoted over $9,000 for two 50 gallon water heaters. Home Depot sells for $734. Makes me want to also get another plumber here to see if we even need them. Not a company you should trust. And of course, they want to up-sell to have their company extend the warranty.

reviews.author: Margie C.
reviews.text:
Plumb Pro is really expensive.  They wanted to replace a faucet for $1,100 (nothing special with the brand of of faucet)  I got another plumber to do it for $325, great job)

They had worked on fixing a toilet, didn't fix it and then I was desperate and they charged me over $800 to replace a toilet (That was with credit, they would have charged me over $1,000. The toilet was a higher grade, but not an extreme luxury brand. I would never use them again.  You can find much less expensive plumbers who will do just as good a job.  Uggh..feel so ripped off, but I was desperate, had people coming in to town, needed it done.

reviews.author: Chef E.
reviews.text:
The Facts, and Nothing But the Facts:
- The tech was dispatched and arrived in a timely manner
- Alot of trash fell out of the tech's truck into our gutter upon arrival
- The tech seemed more of a used car salesman and less of a plumber, who spent the first 10-15 mins trying to up-sell vs just fix our clogged toilet. More so, he didnt  know his products well or their prices (-he kept referring to some binder.) 
- The tech's equipment was "broken" so he went to an inferior (snake) machine that he  claimed "This probably wont work, but we'll try it anyway."
- The inferior machine in-fact did not work.
-The tech spent the better part of the next 30-35 mins in the back of his truck trying to fix the first machine. No success.
- With no other options, the tech called his dispatch and had another machine sent out.
- After about 2 1/2 hours (what should have about a 60-90 minute job), I was told the clog was fixed.
- The tech charged me and left. 
-That night, the clog returned AND we noticed a tile in our bathroom where the tech had been working was now cracked.
- The following day I called and spoke with Phil who was polite and seemed to care about this bad business transaction. He asked to schedule a time the following day to come out and fix the problem. I had explained we already called another plumber and the problem had been fixed. He said he wanted to at least come out and see the crack in the tile.
- The next day, Phil had an employee call me to cancel our appointment and that I should email photos/ images of documents/ That he would put a refund check in the mail.
- I sent the email and waited.
-The entire week of Sept 16 came and went with no refund check in the mail. (we live 1 zip code away from their office)
- I Called and inquired over the course of 2 days and finally had to go to their office to collect my refund.
- Fun Fact: The issuer of the check Hand-wrote on the back of the check something to the effect of "By signing and cashing this check, I agree the issue is resolved and no bad reviews would be posted online."
Not a company I can recommend nor will I ever call on again.

COLORADO SEWER SERVICE INC saved the day !!!!!
(in about an hour)

reviews.author: Patrick K.
reviews.text:
If I could give them a 0 I would.  

It had been a few years and I had forgotten about how bad this company is.  I have a York furnace and they are one of the few contractors in the Denver area certified with York.

Basically, during the course of having other work done, we discovered that the heat exchanger had a few holes in it.  This presents a safety issue as combustion byproducts could make their way into the airstream.  The furnaces is only about 12 years old and in otherwise good condition, so I had no intention of replacing it.  The warranty on much of the furnace is either lifetime or 20 years mind you.  Recognize that Plumb Pros inspected it just a few years ago and indicated that everything was good.

So I sent documentation to the office staff, so that they had the model info, warranty info, along with some photos of the HX.  I specifically told the office staff that I wanted a quote for replacement of the HX, which I believe to be still under warranty - it's in the manual.  There was really no need for them to come out and make a site trip, as they had all the info.  But they insisted that they had to send out techs to take a look.  So I reluctantly agreed.

So they came out the next day and once again, they showed their true colors.  They started trying to blame other conditions or installation for the holes and said the HX wasn't under warranty.  Lies, lies, lies.  Then they began to guess what...try to upsell me again into what would probably be a $10 to $15k new furnace.  I asked them directly if they would quote installation of a new HX.  They refused.  Another bait and switch.  At which time I stopped the discussion and asked them to leave.

It's really astonishing and shameful how unethical these guys are.  Not listening.  Just continually shoveling crap and sell people expensive solutions they don't need.  I feel bad for any customers out there that have been scammed by them.

I will never call them again.   Do yourself a favor and do not contact this contractor.

reviews.author: Megan H.
reviews.text: We bought our home in June of 2019 and Plumb Pro's were the ones to install the entire sewer system and sump pump before our move in. We were given the paperwork on the warranty at the signing of our house. On 1/24/2020 our basement toilet was holding water, tried the plunger and nothing. Realized that the sump pump wasn't working. Called Plumb Pro's around 7pm that evening. They had a tech at our home 9am 1/25/2020 after inspecting everything the tech informed us that it would be a $476 charge for the pump to be cleared out. We were confused since we had a warranty on the entire system. We called the manager Phil and explained our situation and confusion. He explained to us that the pump was under warranty for 6 years but it did not cover labor. Only the sewer lines were covered for parts and labor. Phil was very understanding of the unexpected charges and was willing to give us a good discount for the cleaning of the pump and other things that needed to be done. I'm not someone who expects something for free but I wasn't ready for the charges after replacing our hot water heater the previous weekend. Our tech JD was extremely nice and understanding of our situation. He cleaned up after he finished his work you couldn't even tell he was here. Overall the service was great even with the unexpected charges. I'm happy that JD, Phil and Plumb Pro's were able to work with us to offset some of the unexpected cost and I truly appreciate it. I would recommend their services to anyone who needs it.

reviews.author: Alexys K.
reviews.text:
Horrible service and over priced. 

Had them come to fix clogged dishwasher- $1,000 later still clogged. They did electrical work put in new pipes and an air gap all stating it was either necessary or to bring up to code. I called them back saying it wasn't working they blamed the disposal. To come take a look they charged us another service fee $50. We were told another $1,000 to fix of course more electrical and disposal. When we let them know this was a crazy amount they said the electrical wasn't necessary and they would cut us a deal to $500. They left and we were able to fix the "broken cannot be recovered" disposal. Literally took a wrench to the bottom of the disposal cranked it back and forth and viola. Once we got looking more the work done wasn't worth the money the new pipe was already leaking. The air gap isn't necessary (we should have known we didn't have one before and it worked) and they didn't put the appropriate cover over the splice (if code is in question) they should have. There is the new pipe just in our cabinet not even tack it along the back just cutting right through so we can't use. I don't see where this is $1,000 work. We have made another call in to report all these findings and pictures we have I am told owner/manager will be looking into this. We will see what happens and if it is fixed I will update this review. 

But as of now we have nothing fixed 4 visits $1050 in the hole and still a clogged dishwasher.

reviews.author: JD B.
reviews.text:
I had a leaking outdoor faucet - Sept. of '24.  It was leaking from the metal handle area.  Wanted to get it repaired and called Plumb Pros.  Jim comes out and I show him the issue.  Now at this point I had already ordered a Woodford faucet repair kit, so I knew approximately the repair should be under $100 using the kit I had purchased.  I was stunned when he quoted me four outrageous bids  - one for $1639, one for $1489, one for $965 and one for $1125. He wanted to cut through our drywall in the basement ceiling to access the faucet line, etc.   He got a little pushy when he saw our reaction and said "now what can I do to get you to agree to one of these options".  We showed him the door immediately.  Several months later another company - a reliable company - came out to fix out water pressure regulator.  Just before they left I asked them if he could look at the leaking outdoor faucet.  He gladly did and said, "oh, that should take me a second - I just need to tighten the packing nut behind the wheel handle".  It was tightened in 10 seconds and the drip stopped.  And he refused to charge me.  

These guys are scammers - at least Jim is.  Wouldn't hire them for ANYTHING - unethical.    Would rate them a 0 if I could.

reviews.author: Sarah K.
reviews.text: had a very bad experience with this company today. The technician showed up an hour after the dispatcher said he would be here.  when he saw what we need to do (fix a silly little dripping faucet) he said it would cost $302 to fix it! we then said we had a coupon for $35 off and he stated, ok but he was adding a service fee.  We asked him how much it would cost to tighten our kitchen faucet.  He said $150!!!!! we looked at him like he was crazy. he asked how much we would pay and we said no more then $75... he said he would think about it.  obviously we were not going to deal with that... we can life with a loose faucet.  He leaves is binder on the kitchen counter and I look at it and there is a price sheet of how much things should cost. the first line is talking about dripping faucets and it says it should cost $125. i asked him about this and he made up some lame excuse why it was not that one.. but the $302 one.  at the end of the day, the guy changed only the cold water so it would not drip anymore and if that one starts leaking then they will come back and fix it.. but if the hot water starts leaking then we have to pay again. what?!?!?!?!  do not use them!!! all for a drippy faucet!

reviews.author: Kim Marcom
reviews.text:
I appreciated Plumbpros being open on a Saturday.  Jason, Plumbpros technician arrived that same morning a d took a complete description of what had happen with my furnace.  He discussed with me possible reasons for the furnace failiing to heat but still run the fan.  After performing several tests he determined the furnace needed to be replaced.  I was delighted to hear that Plumpros  stocked Carrier brand furnaces and also had a senior discount to help with the cost.  On Monday, Jason and Ezra arrived to install my new furnace .  I was impressed by their effort to insure my rugs were protected from any damage or   dirt when moving the furnaces up and down the stairs to the basement.  Both Plumbpros technicians were very professional and easy to talk to, answering any questions I had.  I was amazed watching how technical installing a new furnace is.  After my experience with Plumbpros and their staff, I will certainly use them for future projects.
Kim Marcom
Parker CO

reviews.author: Holly P.
reviews.text:
Rude and overpriced!! 
Called yesterday to get estimate for kitchen sink plumbing hook-up and new faucet install. A guy named Terry showed up and decided that $700 would be about right. Then he asked for $35 for the estimate, which was not mentioned when the appointment was made. He called his office. Then while he was still on the phone, he started being rude with my daughter, who was the only one at home. He raised his voice asking her if she thought this would be free and threatened to put a lien on the house! Seriously?? 

I called the office, and the gal said that the trip charge was $29, not $35, and that since the fee wasn't mentioned, not to worry about it. Good call.So I don't care if this company has good ratings otherwise, they are over-priced by a huge margin ( I found someone today who will do the job for $250), and they hire plumbers who are rude as hell. I will never call again, and make sure that everyone I know passes them by as well.

reviews.author: Greg Meyers
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Plumb Pros for your plumbing work. TL;DR: Fonz and team installed a Rinnai tankless water heater with expertise. Solid install and very professional interactions.

The longer story is that I had an 18-year old failing tankless water heater that needed repaired or replaced. I called a recommended plumbing company to address the issue and the plumber made the entire experience feel transactional. He didn't ask questions to understand my issue and simply did not convey any sense of wanting to help. I called Plumb Pros on the next day. Fonz came out, assessed the situation and gave me options - something we all want - including a well-priced replacement solution. He and team came out soon after to do a complete replacement. Nothing was left incomplete and no shortcuts were taken. I believe in writing solid reviews for companies and people who deserve them. Plumb Pros earned not only business, but also my trust.

reviews.author: Alan C.
reviews.text:
Extremely overpriced for what you get. I had asked for help replacing a faucet and drain in the bathroom. We used them when we first bought our house and needed to repair plumbing, we were very satisfied with the service then-- so I was shocked how bad they were this time. 

They looked at the sink, went to their van for a few minutes and came back with a quote for $950.  I told them that was way to much. He immediately said he would do it for 750. I was surprised how quickly he knocked off $300!

I still felt that was a little high and said I would go for 650 and he refused. They still charged me a $45 fee for showing up.  After I declined, they stood by their van in my drive way for about an hour smoking and joking before leaving to another call I assume. 

I called a handy man who replaced the drain at cost. $45 in aluminum piping and installed the sink for $85. I would recommend skipping service from this company.

synthesis.summary: Plumb Pros has the BBB A+ and the Google 4.7, but Yelp 2.9 across 70 reviews tells a different story — page after page of price gouging on elderly customers, $9k water heater quotes, and 'up-sell business model' complaints. They show up fast, then quote 3-5x competitor prices.
strengths: Will dispatch fast in an emergency — 'technician at my house within 90 minutes' during a snowstorm
Some long-time customers report consistent service with specific techs (Anthony, Charlie)
weaknesses: Repeated allegations of taking advantage of elderly customers — '$786 for a new toilet for my 86 year old mother'
Pricing is a recurring theme — '$9,000 for two water heaters Home Depot sells for $734', '$1,100 for a faucet replacement another plumber did for $325'
Multiple reviewers describe being upsold instead of having the actual problem fixed
bestFor: emergency dispatch (if you accept the price)
redFlags: Repeated claims of elder financial abuse — 78yo grandmother charged $6,000 for a water tank, 86yo mother charged $786 for toilet
Quoted prices 3-5x what the same job costs elsewhere — pattern across 20+ Yelp reviews
'Pretty bad experience charged me 600$ to remove my toilet and not put it back on'
Yelp 2.9 vs Google 4.7 across 70 Yelp reviews — strong sign of review curation

reviews.author: Clayton Riding
reviews.text: Midwest Plumbing has done a lot of work at my house. They did a spectacular job with my shower valve install, my toilet shutoff valve replacement, and main water shutoff valve replacement. They’re quick to respond and quick to come out. They’re a local family owned business and they should be your first call if you need a plumber

reviews.author: Kim Preston
reviews.text: I am really glad I called James at Midwest plumbing. We had a sewer issue, and he responded very quickly. Communication was great, and he arrived about 15 minutes early. He called to give me a heads up about arriving early, which was awesome. James was able to clear our line and clearly discussed our options moving forward. He was both knowledgeable and professional. The price was very reasonable as well. I highly recommend Midwest plumbing.

reviews.author: Emily Fleming
reviews.text: Wow! These guys are fantastic! If you want to support a family owned business call the brothers with Mid-West Plumbing! They are not only kind, but very thorough and ensure they get the job done right! They guarantee their work and have very fair/reasonable prices! Scheduling was easy and they were able to address my concern the same day! I’m so glad I found a plumber I can trust!

reviews.author: John Morlan
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience with James and Kaile from Midwest Plumbing. After growing tired of being overcharged by large contractors, I decided to give a smaller, local company a chance—and I’m so glad I did. Midwest Plumbing provided prompt, professional service at a fair price. They quickly fixed a leaking faucet in just a few minutes, were friendly and personable throughout, and even brought some humor to the visit, which was much appreciated.

They also referred me to BoneDry Services to assess potential water damage. The team from BoneDry was equally honest and helpful—they evaluated the situation, assured me the damage was minimal, and even explained how I could handle the fix myself. No pressure, no upselling—just genuine service.

Moving forward, I’ll be sticking with the "little guys." Thank you, Midwest Plumbing, for a job well done.

reviews.author: Clara Stoffel
reviews.text:
I recently used Midwest Plumbing. Co for the installation of a new hot water heater, and I could not be more impressed!

The team was so prompt, thorough, communicative and helped me understand all of the different options and solutions. They also did a courtesy walkthrough of the house to make any other recommendations for issues to address. I ended up also getting a washer box replacement.

The price and service was SO much better than any of the other multiple services that I received quotes from.

I won’t be using any one else in the future. The Midwest Plumbing team is incredible and I’d highly recommend them to anyone! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Jacob McMillen
reviews.text: James with Midwest did it again. Last time he crushed it with the water heater and this time was a re-pipe of my 1954 galvanized water pipes. I wasn’t comfortable connecting 3/4” pex pipe to the old 5/8” galvanized pipes and he knocked it out real quick. And again the pricing was significantly more reasonable than the other two places I reached out to. I said it before but I’ll say it again, he’s the real deal and I would recommend Midwest to anyone looking to get any plumbing work done. It’ll get done right and at the right price. That is all.

reviews.author: Kelly D.
reviews.text: We just moved into a new place and James and his brother did a great job for us.  We will have them do plumbing work for us in the future.   They replaced a very old hot water heater in a crawl space, replaced three toilets and did some work under the kitchen sink.  James came out to give us a quote first and then came the next week to complete the job.  James was friendly and polite.  He followed up after the work was completed to make sure all was to our satisfaction. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Darcie Brandvein
reviews.text: James with Midwest plumbing was amazing! He was very friendly, knowledgeable, on time and kept me In the loop at all times. He answered any and all questions that I had and made sure I was satidfief and all my questions were answered. He returned my call immediately and was at my job site within a couple hours that I needed him. I had a timeline I had to meet and he was there. I highly Recommend the Midwest plumbing. A 5+ star company!!

reviews.author: Nick Kotter
reviews.text: Had a very clogged bathroom sink that our children use. They were able to diagnose the problem and offered to charge just for a p trap replacement due to the age of the existing pipe - which could be a problem for snakes. Most of the clog was in the trap and the rest was taken care of with the Glug product. Thanks to Midwest for getting our barhroom working so quickly.

reviews.author: Brendon Ducham
reviews.text: Have worked with Midwest Plumbing a few times now. James is awesome and I would recommend them to anyone needing plumbing services. They have always shown up on time and are very responsive with communication. The work done is quick and efficient and they are more then happy to answer any questions or concerns. I already have a few more projects lined up with them.

reviews.author: Doug F.
reviews.text: Wow.  Just had James install a recirculation pump on my water heater.  Works great.  James is responsive, knowledgeable and dedicated.  Installed the pump and it was missing a part.  Found the part and came back out the same day and got the system working.  It made our day.  He is our go-to guys for plumping needs from here on out.  Highly recommend to others.

reviews.author: Kayla I.
reviews.text: I recently was gathering quotes from other plumbing companies in Westminster, that didn't even seem to want to do the work. After reaching out to Midwest Plumbing, they were thrilled to help, and was half the price of what other companies were charging to replace my sewer! I will only recommend, and use Midwest Plumbing from now on!

reviews.author: Todd Anderson
reviews.text: Outstanding service, James is quick and efficient, and has the ability to put you at ease during a stressful time. He explains the problem and the solution well, and answers your questions without making you feel like you're bothering him. We live in a 60+ year old home, so a good plumber with abilities you trust is key.

reviews.author: Alexa Dupill
reviews.text:
James at Midwest Plumbing is absolutely fantastic. Midwest is timely, professional, and they gave us a great price on our water heater and gas work.

We had a gas leak and James was able to come out with in an hour to fix the issue. He made my somewhat stressful problem into a great experience. Thanks Midwest Plumbing!!

reviews.author: erikjuergen
reviews.text: These guys are fantastic! I recently got a condo with a very shoddy DIY "remodel" and shit just fell apart. Kaile came in straight away and fixed it ASAP! They even followed up a week later to make sure everything was okay.  Who else does that? Nobody. I cannot recommend them any higher!

Zero negative reviews in this 30-review sample. Best for homeowners who want a small-business plumber over a big-brand operation.

reviews.author: Vivian Li
reviews.text: Pascual came and did a speedy and wonderful job fixing our bathroom sink plumbing that was leaking.  He was patient to find the problem since it is a slow leak but definitely there, and was quick in fixing it in less than an hour.  He had a cheerful personality too and was considerate to take his shoes off when he came in.  Thanks Pascual!

reviews.author: Brian Bacher
reviews.text: Ian came out to assess a kitchen clog we couldn't fix. Not only was he personable, but he also figured it out quickly and uncloggd our pipes. He also provided great advice on how to avoid deep clogs in the future. We used Mr. Rooter before and will definately use them.again. Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: Alejandro Suarez
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of being helped by Keyfer and Dillion. Outstanding experience. Keyfer was extremely thorough when explaining the possible solutions, stand out guy. Once we settled on a solution he got right to work showing me what had caused the problem. He was also training Dillion at the time who was also very nice, Keyfer did a great job of describing the steps to Dillion and verifying his understanding. I hope to not have any further plumbing issued but if I do I will call Keyfer in the future, thanks gents.

reviews.author: Jooky D.
reviews.text: Called for an appointment and got one quickly. They would not provide a price even though the guy that came had a price book with fixed prices. $350 to run a camera through the drain.  Originally he told me that it would be $500 but I told him I wouldn't pay more than $300. So he said he would do the camera work for free. He ran a camera through the drain and showed me some roots. Told me that it would cost extra ($250) to remove toilet and snake out the the roots. At this point it seemed like a big ripoff and I told him I would handle the clog myself. Lesson learned: Don't call someone on a workday after you just got up and try to solve the problem while you're still sleepy. If you know a good plumber just call them and pay their hourly rate to figure out whats wrong first and then proceed.

reviews.author: Mike R.
reviews.text:
Before you hire this firm to do any digging in your main sewer line, they will quote you a price for just using their camera to determine the cause.
My previous plumber, said a camera use would have cost $125. This firm charged me $500. However since my plumber was not available I had to pay the $500 or have it included in the $3,600 for digging up the source of the blockage.
Looking back, I should have just paid the $500 and waited for my plumber who would have charged me $1,200 for the digging, thereby saving me $2,300.
If your blockage has cleared wait and get an estimate for the camera use and get an estimate for the digging. Also, don't get their recommendation of using American Water Damage. The manager came in and tore up the baseboard and carpet believing insurance would cover it all. DOES NOT WORK THAT WAY. INSURANCE REFUSED TO PAY FOR THE AMOUNT OF DAMAGE HE DID.

reviews.author: Vinod P.
reviews.text:
WARNING: LONG

I sent an inquiry on their website to have them come visit my home on 1/21/19 for a leaking sink. That appointment was confirmed on the phone 5 minutes after the inquiry, but no one showed on that day. It turns out that whoever scheduled my appointment set it for 1/21/20. I let it go and had them come that Wednesday instead (1/23/19). Idiocy, but fine. They did their inspection and provided the quote that I agreed to, and then they stated they would come back the next day to complete the work. The tech told when he diagnosed it that he could be there between 2-4 the next day. He said whatever his job was that morning wouldn't run over. I knew I couldn't after 4pm that day and told him as much. He ensured that the job wouldn't take 2 hours, which is why I was fine with scheduling it. The company told me afterwards that they aren't sure they can make scheduled appointment times because they don't know what a client's problem will be until they inspect it. True, but then maybe, just maybe, they should tell their techs not to tell clients a specific time if they themselves aren't sure they can make it. Obviously, he didn't make the specified time frame, and I was rescheduled again for the following Monday (1/28/19). The work was finally completed on that day and the technician told me I could use the sink immediately. Surprise, it continued to leak the next morning. I called AGAIN after that to have someone come back out and look at the repair, at which point I was told someone would come later that day. AGAIN, no one showed up. They called me at 5pm to tell me they weren't sure they could send someone that day. At least someone who wasn't the original technician that I for obvious reasons did not want to see. Stop telling clients times if you can't meet them. It is NOT difficult. 

At this point, after THREE no-shows (and 1.5 days of lost vacation time at work), I called Benjamin Franklin to fix the problem, which they did the next day. That technician told me the puddy wasn't even the issue; the pop assembly was replaced that correctly fixed the problem. They attempted to fix Rooter's puddy job and tightening everything, but it unfortunately didn't work. I let them go that route first before the assembly was inevitably replaced in hopes I didn't need to get the part, but they did state it was the likely outcome. The Benjamin Franklin tech even told me verbatim that the manner in which the puddy was applied by Mr. Rooter would cause me to replace the piping if there is further problem. Fantastic. A plumber who literally made your plumbing worse.

I also had them replace a fill valve on another toilet. The problem for that came back after a couple weeks as well. I ended up replacing that myself instead of calling for a warranty repair. I frankly wasn't sure anyone would come.

They said they would meet me "halfway" and give me $150 back. My bill was for $430. They can't even do math correctly. Halfway of a $430 bill that they essentially did nothing on isn't $150. What it essentially amounts to is that I called Rooter out to my house, was told an estimate, and declined it. Both "jobs" they performed were fixed by people other than them. Why call for warranty work when you don't know if they'll come, and then you have to take even more time off for someone who's given you ZERO indication you can trust or rely on them? I gave them one opportunity to fix it again when I really shouldn't have, and they still missed it. It isn't your job to accommodate a company continuously into your schedule without guaranty they will come. Not for something you are paying them for.

I literally provided the invoice/receipts in my complaint that reflects that I did in fact have the parts replaced/repaired after their work and they turned a blind eye. It was ALL there. How convenient for them to blatantly ignore everything since it explicitly shows how they misdiagnosed my issue. And they seriously still can't understand why I wouldn't want their shit company back in my home for warranty work? What's the point in calling for warranty work when they don't show up? How many chances is a company that's shown to be completely incompetent supposed to be given? They know if they were in my shoes that they wouldn't allow someone who's treated them the way they treated me and my time back into their home either. They didn't even try to address my (completely valid) points in my last response email. And I have all correspondence if anyone wants to read it to see. Apparently, they don't realize they're essentially admitting fault for it all but refusing to do the right thing? So now I will share it with anyone who wants to read it. 

DO NOT use these guys. You can't trust them as far as you can throw them. Give Benjamin Franklin a call and have your work done correctly and on time.

reviews.author: Lewisville L.
reviews.text:
Horrible Experience. At first, the interaction with the technician was great,  anyone could tell very quickly from having a conversation with him, that he was very knowledgable. I was dealing with a broken sewage pipe under a new patio I had just finished building and I knew that repairing this was going to be tricky. The Mr Rooter technician suggested that we cut a 3x3 space in the newly poured concrete so that he could get under the patio to do a spot repair. This technician first quoted me $3,900 to have the concrete cut, the hole dug and the spot repair completed. For all of that work, that price actually seemed to be fair. Since this was a very important matter (until this was to be fixed, we couldn't use two of our full bathrooms) I decided to make the deposit of just over $1,000 so we could get the work scheduled, this is what I was told we had to do in order to get a project started. Before beginning, I wanted to speak with my patio contractor to make sure everything would be okay. She was afraid that if we were to do that, some support might give out as there was a stone fire pit about 6 feet long right above where the spot fix needed to happen. After exploring other options of how to get around having to cut the concrete, we decided that it was really the only logical path to go down. This is where the issues and dishonesty of the company began to come alive.

Once I notified the technician that we would like to take the offer and began on the agreed upon project, he said he would have to now come back out and re-estimate the work. Very strange, right? When he shows up, he now says the work will not be $3,900 but, it will be closer to the mid $5,000 range. Keep in mind, at this point nothing has changed. This was very unsettling for multiple reasons, 1. This was clearly a rip-off tactic, 2. I had my contractor agree to cut the concrete for me, out of the $3,900 estimate I was given, this was a $1,099 line item cost. 3. They already had my over $1,000 deposit that I could not get back even though they hiked up the estimate substantially. But wait, It gets worse.

Once the diggers show up, they don't bring enough tarp to fully secure the patio area and they leave dirt and filth everywhere. That didn't bother me all that much. What bothered me is when they were scraping their shovels recklessly to fill the hole back in, they were dragging their shovels against new stone stairs, scratching them up very badly and causing damage (all because they did not put tarp down). When I confronted them and the Mr Rooter technician about it, the Mr Rooter technician became very defensive and argumentative. He began to walk around the backyard to areas far away from where the work was being done and began saying that there are cut marks all over the stone work in other places (absolutely not true). When I disagreed with him about that, he began with very sarcastic remarks, like "I cant bubble wrap the whole house". He then proceeded to tell me that he felt like me complaining about this "was a slap in the face" and that "he's been trying to help me". I'm sorry, in case I missed something, I am paying Mr Rooter to be here, this is not volunteer work. After our bad ending to the day he went to get the paperwork for completion and then began admitting that the diggers had done wrong and apologized and said that he uses them all the time and that they have never done anything like that before. Sounds like an admission of guilt to me.. I asked multiple times to speak with a supervisor, his answer to me was that since it was late and they were gone from the office, that someone he already spoke with would be calling me first thing in the morning. That was a lie. No one called. I have followed up with their office after filing a formal complaint and I still have not received a call. DO NOT EVER USE THIS COMPANY.

reviews.author: Maria A.
reviews.text:
As I sit here on a call with the "gentleman"  named Thomas who is handling inbound calls for Mr Rooter (after he hung up on me once before) 
He's telling me that if my intent is to file a complaint upon completion of work he wouldn't  be honoring the warranty from the horrid work Pasquale. 
There is a "60 Day Warranty" on their OUTRAGEOUSLY PRICED WORK.
We were charged a total of $675.00 for a drain clean out and a "camera" to be run which we were NEVER shown and footage off. When I mentioned "Could it be from flushable wipes..? He instantly saw a glimmer of hope and clung onto that as a cause! It was almost comedic when it happened how he lit up like "YES..this is how we get them" 
As a new home owner having a drain clean out service seemed like something almost normal. But the fact that work was done 3/10/2023 and we are now on 4/29 as it's happened again is wild. 
There are two people who live here and we don't make poor decisions when it comes to what is flushed and such. 
What's really interesting is when we asked Pasquale "Does the drain clean out lid need to be shut?" He insisted NO! I told him I'd never had one before being in apartments all my life and told him I was seeking guidance but he obviously knew what he was doing. Prepped up for the next clog. Left that sucker right open. Do yourself and favor and don't believe the fabricated reviews from their friends and family. Out of now 96 reviews we all know the fact that they are at 1 star speaks volumes. If I had come to Yelp before using their services I can assure you we would have never made this mistake so I hope we can save you from this nightmare!

To add insult to injury, after having Thomas hang up on me and attack me verbally he put me on a long hold and came back and offered to charge me 99.50 to come out tonight...leaving us NO CHOICE but to pay. This review I'm hoping saves you from this joke of a company. Call Mr Local Plumber and save yourself the headache.

Cut to 3 hours later and we spoke with Lewis "The Receptionist" who for 15 minutes tip toed around the fact that he said he works at a desk in a office building and just takes inbound calls and submits requests into a system. He had no record of my ever giving my credit card number to Thomas (so now I need a new card before Thomas does fraud on my account) and Lewis "the receptionist" still has no idea if the emergency call we made at 4:00 was ever made. In fact he found it comical he couldn't help me and eventually just put me on hold and never came back. 

Then we have Kevin call. (He works for an after hours company) 

Here's the TWIST...

So how Mr rooter works is they offer up to a 60 day guarantee on the work they provide (so they say) BUT ONLY AND I STRESS ONLY if the SAME person comes back to essentially further damage the first job he did. 
Kevin explained that even if we paid the $99.50 emergency charge he had to charge us in FULL in order to then submit for a reimbursement later. 

The ONLY and ONLY glimmer of hope in this is the fact that Kevin took initiative which NO ONE ELSE has (Thomas and Lewis ) and called his counterparts at work and they advised they would allow him to come and handle the issue and they would essentially take it up with Mr Rooter and Pasquale. 

This has been an absolute nightmare and I can't wait for it to be over.

reviews.author: Stuart B.
reviews.text:
I am not sure why others have given such bad reviews.  I can't say the prices are the best as I have nothing to compare them to.  But when I had my insurance adjuster out to see if they could help cover the cost, he said that for as much as they had to dig up he did not believe we were being overcharged.

With that said, a toilet was lifting up from the floor in our front bathroom and it would gurgle when water was run in other drains.  When the plumber came out they ran a camera though the outside access.  They saw roots in the pipes (they let me look) and the camera went under water more than twice.  

The drain pipes were ancient.  They were still made of concrete and were in poor shape.  Some were leaking under the foundation and there was quite a bit of waste water under our home.  The plumber, Donny, explained everything and did not sugar coat the cost.  They started work pretty much the next day and kept us informed of everything that was happening.  

They tried extremely hard for the repairs not to impede our daily lives and did a really good job.

Can I say I loved to pay what we paid to have the work complete?  No, I am not insane.  but the work needed to be done or it would eventually do more damage to the plumbing and the foundation.  I can't say that I wouldn't have charged as much or more for everything they did.  I saw some of the roots they pulled from beneath the house.  They were huge.  It took them about a total of 6 days to complete the work, but they strived to work around our schedule.

When we were concerned about an item, the plumber came back and took a look to ensure it was good to go even after the work was completed.  

They were nice and professional and I really don't have anything bad to say about them. 
 I would call them again if I need more work done.  I feel they will take care of me right THE FIRST TIME.  So many contractors here don't seem to care.  This one did.

On a final note I would give them 5 stars but can't really judge the price as I don't have anything to compare it to.  Other than that we have no complaints and were very satisfied.

reviews.author: Brandon L.
reviews.text:
Beware!  These "good reviews" are fake!  See their Yelp reviews and the Better Business Bureau before hiring these guys. They are a total scam!  It cost me approximately $1000 for them to basically come out and break my toilet.  

I called them on a Saturday evening as a toilet sewage was coming up from the drainage and going into the shower.  I talked to an answering service that said it would be $90 for the plumber to come out, however they would apply the $90 towards whatever needs to be done to correct the issue.  2 hours later, I get a call stating that the answering service was wrong and that it is approximately $180.  So, by that time it was too late and no other company was answering their phone. The plumber goes out to the property and calls me back after inspection and states to me that they don't get up on the roof for cleanouts as they needed to go thru the air stack to do the clean out. Therefore, he wanted to charge me $180 just to come out and tell me that.  He then gave me a different option that would cost more expensive of removing the toilet and cleaning out the drain for a total of $780 for an hour (additional fees if longer than an hour).  By that time, I had no option but to go with it because he was going to charge me $180 just to tell me that they didn't get up on the roof. 
Now get this, approximately 20 mins later, the plumber calls me back and states he broke my toilet and that he would credit me approximately $100 for breaking my toilet (which ended up costing me an additional $300 to replace and install a new one).  
Lastly, 3 days later, we start to have the same issues with the drain and had to call a different company to come out and do the job correctly. After the new company did the cleaning, I paid them to camera the drain to make sure that the only issue was a clogged pipe.  It came back that the issue was a clogged pipe and that Mr. Rooter did not fix the issue.  

So basically, it cost me almost $1,000 for Mr. Rooter to come out and break my toilet.  You have been warned!  This company is a complete scam!

reviews.author: Katie M.
reviews.text:
As many have said, zero stars would be the most appropriate rating. DO NOT EVER CALL THIS CON ARTIST PLUMBING COMPANY!!! I called with a clogged washing machine drain line. The tech showed up and saw the age of our house (late 50's vintage) and must have seen dollar signs. He immediately started talking about how these old houses have cast iron pipes and they can corrode and would need total replacement. He then got the camera out to look in our drain and saw a cast iron p-trap and immediately said it must have collapsed. He then used a drum auger to make two attempts at clearing the clogged drain. The auger was getting locked up and started twisting around. He showed me all this to make a point of showing me that this was failing and nothing could be done. He then went on to say that the sanitary line would then need to be up-sized to meet code requirements so we would need to do a total replacement of the sanitary line from the kitchen and laundry area. He then provided an estimate of $15,796.32 to do this work.
I did also point out the main clean-out near the street and the kitchen clean-out to the tech but he never opened either.

I had another plumber out the next day for a second opinion. They used a pistol auger and were able to make headway in the clog. They then opened the kitchen clean-out and snaked from that side as well. They even opened up the main clean-out to ensure there were not issues from that side.
With an hours worth of effort they were able to fully clean our line and leave us in better shape with our entire drain line with all of their effort. For two techs working this long they only charged me $175.

Their tech, however, after telling me the sky is falling when he put in 5 minutes of effort, charged me $286.17. 

I cannot help but feel scammed. I paid a ton of money for next to no work to then have him try to up sell me on SIXTEEN THOUSAND dollars worth of work. I am stunned by this charade.

reviews.author: Brad N.
reviews.text:
I don't like to leave negative reviews, but I will this time. Don't be confused by the bait and switch this particular outfit engaged in with me. I hired Mr Rooter to come out and assess the situation, a small leak in my main line. The individual who came out was nice and pleasant, but really didn't know how to assess or locate a very small leak in the line. In fact, it was stated that his company didn't even have equipment necessary to really do so. Despite that, he recommended somebody else coming out with more experience, but not a master plumber, to try to assess the situation. One hour was nearly $550. He originally wanted almost 1100 for an initial two hours, which I did not feel comfortable paying for. I told him to figure it out in one.

Unfortunately for me, my house is very unique and I think they bidded their subsequent so-called and insane repair bid at $21,500 based on the appearance of what I can afford. I will NEVER recommend this company. In fact, I will suggest people not to hire them for anything. They should be ashamed of themselves. They should get back to honest billing if they want to survive. If not, they should be shut down permanently.

For the $550 bill, it was $250 per hour for the one who didn't know what he was doing and $350 per hour for the other one. A master plumber doesn't even charge that. But out of desperation, virtually, everybody is willing to pay whatever it takes to get the repair analyzed and hopefully done. Hopefully everybody else will read this review before ever considering this company.

Be aware. And don't be taken like I was. I have already enlisted the services of a master plumber who I anticipate his total aggregate fees being only around $500-$1000, not $21,500. And I will update with what his total bill is once he completes the job tomorrow

reviews.author: Steve H.
reviews.text:
I only wish I had come to this page before. Mr. Rooter does not care about repeat business. They are expensive and the owner/managers only care about the short-term buck. You just need to look at their Facebook page--it is all from Mr. Rooter, or customers who have had a bad experience.

A Mr. rooter plumber came to my house to clear my kitchen drain. There were two problems that day:
1. The snake machine Mr. Rooter supplied was broken so the technician had to use a smaller drill version which could NOT clear the drain. In the process, he used this "work-around" tool and snaked towards the kitchen breaking my u-bend pipe.  I did not recognize this issue for a couple of days.

2. He fixed the proper clean-out tool on my front porch but got a lot of grease spots on the concrete. I actually felt sorry for the plumber, his company sends him out with faulty equipment and he has to fix it. He got the drain cleared and I paid the appalling sum of $275 for the service. (I agreed to it but it was late friday afternoon and I had little choice.)

So Sunday when I am doing dishes I realize water is pouring out the sink from the u-bend. This was OBVIOUS how it was damaged. This $2.77 part was never meant to be snaked with a tool of this type. You can see how it scraped through the part and cracked it at he bend. Moreover--this was NOT the problem area.

I understand that things can go wrong--grease and breakage--but when I called this morning, the dispatcher explained to me that nothing they use could have broken that part and that he'd be happy to send someone out, but that they'd most likely have to charge me. When I asked for a referral of a product that I could use to get the grease off of my patio--he hung up on me!!  Can you believe it? DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY!

reviews.author: Sherry D.
reviews.text:
I had the best experience with Mr. Rooter.  I woke up Easter morning and came downstairs to my dining room and kitchen 
  flooded.  I called Mr. Rooter and they said someone would be out 11:15 am.  At 10:55 am, Ian Ontiberoz, with Mr. Rooter showed up.  He was absolutely fantastic!  He immediately turned the water off so no more water would leak.  He located where the leak was coming from.  He determined it was the hot water pipe because the water was hot from the leak.  So  he turned the water back on but shut the hot water off so I would at least have water.  He called restoration team for me so they could get the water cleaned up and getting fans going.  The restoration team was there within an hour. The cleaned up the water and got the fans and dehumidifier going.  At least that put my mind at ease.  The next day, Ian was there first thing in the morning with another technician, David Couder.  They determined that the leak was coming from under the slab.  They said instead of tearing up my kitchen floor, they would have an excavator come out and dig a tunnel outside under the slab.  David and Ian were so great with communication  Both were always keeping me up to date of what was going to happen and what was going on.  This was a very frustrating situation and Ian and David made it less stressful for me.  I couldn't ask for better service.  Ian and David were so knowledgeable and very easy to talk with.  They fixed the leak.  Both of them were here everyday till the leak was fixed.  Ian and David did a fantastic job and because of these two, I will be using Mr. Rooter from now on and requesting these two.  I couldn't ask for better service than from Ian and David.  Thank you so much Ian and David.

reviews.author: Jonathan F.
reviews.text:
Customers Beware!!!!  PLEASE LEARN FROM OUR MISTAKE!!!!  Do not do business with this company!!!!!

On a Friday morning, my wife called Mr. Rooter to fix a clogged drain in our laundry area.  (She called our "regular" plumber first, but he was too busy.  Because we were hosting out-of-town guests that weekend, he reminded her that a simple de-clogging could be handled by one of the "drain rooter" companies.  Boy, did we learn our lesson!!!) 

 Mr. Rooter's employee showed up, quickly looked at the drain,  and said that the drain pipe was definitely clogged. He used the drain snake (auger) to unclog and was finished in about 15 minutes--a VERY routine plumbing procedure.  As he was packing up his equipment, I arrived and met him in our kitchen where he presented the bill:  It was for $550.17!!!!!!!!

Needless to say, we could NOT believe it!!  We asked him about the outrageous costs, and he gave us a very incoherent and doubtful explanation--said it took "special equipment," the flat-rate pricing is set by his company, etc.  So, we asked him to confirm the price with the central office/dispatcher.  He became angry and very belligerent at that point, and said there was no use talking with the dispatcher because HE (the apprentice plumber) was the owner and she worked for him!!!!  (Obviously, not true.)   At that point, we tried to keep him calm, but we felt very threatened by his aggressive gestures/language.  This "negotiation" continued for almost 30 minutes.  We finally called Arlington PD because we were concerned for our safety.  They told us to go ahead and make payment (via phone) and then dispute the charges later which we will definitely do!!!

synthesis.summary: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Farmers Branch has dozens of overlapping complaints: missed appointments, $25,000 quotes that competitors fixed for $150, unlicensed techs, and a $439 unauthorized credit card charge. The Google 4.7 doesn't match the actual review text — Yelp 1.9 is closer to truth.
