reviews.author: John Allen
reviews.text: I am a long time customer of Pure Plumbing and they are great! They replaced 2 bathroom faucets and I signed up (again) for the Pure Plan (1970s house, lots of plumbing issues). Their prices are very reasonable. They notify you when they are coming, show up on time, give accurate estimates, keep you informed, are knowledgeable, polite and neat. Fantastic!

reviews.author: Jordan Harris
reviews.text: I’m a big fan of Dylan Burns at Pure Plumbing. He’s trustworthy and hardworking. I gave him a call a few days after he completed some work to fix something that occurred during install, and no questions asked he fixed it under warranty. Thank you for hiring quality guys like Dylan.

reviews.author: Kim Long
reviews.text: Dusten not only does fantastic work, but he's very kind and patiently explains everything he's going to do. Always on time, great communicator, trustworthy, and super clean. I'm thrilled with his service! He installed a gas fitting for my new portable generator, which he also picked up for me from Lowe's. He assembled the wheel kit and tested the whole system.

reviews.author: Anthony P.
reviews.text: Ok, so I've called Slate Plumping to get some residential plumbing issues taken care of and was told that Pure Plumping had taken over their residential work.  Set up an appointment early appointment between 8 and 11 on a Monday for Friday.  Received a text reminder Thursday the day before that my appointment was from 10-1, no big deal ok!  Waited until 3:05 Friday afternoon and called to see if they were coming out to my house.  I was told that someone would be calling me to let me know what was going to and it's time-stamped as outgoing on my phone.  Never received a call back so I called today 12-26-23 and asked what happened that nobody came out or called!  Her reply was she could see a phone call AT 3:05 that an Office Manager called me to let me know they would be out there at 6.  1 that was my phone call to you and 2 nobody called or bothered to show up at 6 like she said.

reviews.author: Cassie W.
reviews.text: Unfortunately I cannot recommend this company. We called them to come work on 3 repairs. The first 2 were very simple yet we were charged $168. The major repair was to unclog our shower drain that was not draining. The plumber was unable to drain it because the handyman who redid our bathrooms 4 years ago washed grout down the drain which overtime formed into cement. Therefore it needed to be addressed from the outside by digging under the house to replace the p trap. This company quoted us an outrageous amount of $7800!!! We had 3 other companies give us estimates which came out to $3800, $4600 and finally $2650. Obviously we hired the cheapest one and the job was done perfectly! Clearly pure plumbing is money hungry, so beware!

reviews.author: Dan Y.
reviews.text:
I would give 0 stars if it were an option. We were scammed and misdirected by both Pure Plumbing and Brigham Restoration. In the middle of June we found signs of leaking outside the house and in some sparse areas of the utility room and found more leakage in July. The leaking was not significant, and the water meter didn't show any change, however we wanted to address this issue before it progressed.

We found Pure Plumbing through the internet, and when they came for a diagnostic, they brought with them Brigham Restoration for mitigation. We did not think that mitigation was necessary. The amount of water leakage was limited to tile. However, Pure Plumbing insisted that mitigation needs to be done before repair, which involved tearing down large sections of our home including 2 feet in wall height in large sections of our walls and several doorframes, also the cabinet under sink in utility room. This didn't sound right to us at the time, but being inexperienced, we decided to trust the company. They had us sign an agreement where they would directly speak with insurance. 
Pure Plumbing's 1st repair (after stab leaking diagnosis) was in the utility room, where a tunnel was dug, and Brigham tore up large sections of our home for mitigation. A few days after they finished, we noticed even worse leakage at the exactly same area! This required further repair. They diagnosed leaking on the service line and did a 2nd repair: We had to have another long tunnel dug and have the whole service line changed. Perhaps they had a faulty initial diagnosis, or perhaps there were unforeseen problems? Their one-year warranty meant nothing because they insisted that these were two different leaks at the same time despite the leakage being the exact same! At the beginning, we were told by the Pure Plumbing that insurance would cover their excavation work. However, this wasn't true! It turned out that we had to pay $24,000 out of pocket for these two repairs.

Brigham Restoration's behavior following their mitigation is unacceptable. We were at first led to believe that they would fix our wall, doorframes and cabinet. We called multiple times to ask for an invoice, but our phone calls were ignored. We had to call with a new number for them to pick up, and they refused to give an invoice since they preyed on our inexperience and had us sign the insurance agreement before.  We asked our insurance and found out that they had paid $16,000 for the excessive mitigation work involving mostly unaffected areas of our home and they won't fixed what they did. An estimate insurance gave for the costs of restoration was only $3500. This leads us to believe that Brigham Restoration knows to perform excessive work on inexperienced homeowners to play insurance companies for money. The fact that they ignored our calls and only picked up when we used a new number is damning evidence of shady business practice. They should be called the Brigham Destruction company! 
Now it is hard to find door frames and cabinets that match our original furnishings which were a nonstandard size. After calling many vendors, we have had to pay even more for the custom size door frames and cabinets. Restoration of our home after Brigham's destruction has yet to be finished.  

This whole ordeal demonstrates how these companies work together and use their experience to extract money from homeowners and insurance company!

reviews.author: Paula S.
reviews.text:
We had a leak in our front yard in the flower bed.   Another company provided me with a quote that I felt was a bit high.   Based on a referral from a family member, I called Pure Plumbing to get a second quote but they said they couldn't provide a quote over the phone.   They offered to come and take a look at the problem and provide a free estimate.   The plumber came and said it would cost $325 for an estimate.  I told him what the other company told me was the problem but he said he had to make sure himself.  Since it was already mid-afternoon, I told him to go ahead with providing me an estimate thinking that I could talk to the office later about the charge for providing an estimate they told me would be free.  After about 10 minutes, the plumber confirmed that the leak was coming from the homeowner's shut off box (which is what the other company told me as well).   His verbal quote was almost twice what the other company quoted me.   He did offer to take the $325 cost of the estimate out of the repair price.   However, he refused to email me a copy of the estimate and said that we would have to close out the transaction before he could provide me with the written estimate.   I asked him to wait outside so I could contact my husband to see what he wanted to do.   I also called the other company to see if they could come out to fix the problem that day but they were booked until the following week.   Since I work from home and didn't want to go without water for another 5 days, I agreed to have him do the work.   After the work was completed, he emailed me the receipt/invoice which has no details of the repairs performed.   I contacted the office the following day about my feeling misled on the "free estimate" and the invoice.   The person told me they would talk to the supervisor and get back to me on Monday.   On Wednesday, I still had not heard back so I called them again.   The person I spoke to said that the charge for $325 was for work done to locate the leak (10 minutes that he spent to dig in the flower bed to find the hole in the plumbing), and if the problem had been obvious they wouldn't have charged me for the estimate.  It still doesn't make sense to me how they can say free estimate when it's only free when the problem is obvious.  She said she would talk to one of the managers and get a revised invoice to me within 24-48 hours.  

It is now Friday evening and I received no resolution and still have not received a revised receipt/invoice.  I would not recommend this company at all.   While their free estimate claim may not be fraudulent, it is completely misleading.

reviews.author: Alberto Lomeli
reviews.text:
CONSUMER BEWARE!

I was away at work, I sent my spouse a screenshot of the national average repair price for cutting and replacing a leaky pipe ($415-$500), while simple exposed repairs like ours in a crawlspace (ours is encapsulated and easily accessible) start around $150. We have used Pure Plumbing before and were pleased with their work and pricing, so I wasn’t too concerned.

Fast forward to later that morning when I see a charge for $925 go through. After a few days waiting and numerous phone calls, I finally got the itemized invoice I requested to help me understand and justify this blatant thievery. The bill was actually $1025, we had a “coupon” for $100 off.

In speaking with the owner, he informed me that they do “margin pricing” which in my opinion is a fancy term for maximize profits at the customers expense. Please take a look for yourself of the ridiculously high prices itemized on the invoice, circled in red in the attached pic.

Materials: $231.25
Labor $416.25
Admin $277.50

Totals $925, already high but they forgot the invoice was for $1025, unless there’s no true value to their “coupons”. Which would then make one of their fees:

Materials: $331.25 (for a $40 copper pipe)
Labor: $516.25 (for just over 1 hour of actual labor)
Admin: $377.50 (my share of admin fees for a simple service call is nearly $400?? INSANE!!!)

The invoice even states: THIS TASK IS FOR A SIMPLE WATER LEAK REPAIR”

I am angry  and disappointed, we switched from our “big name” plumbing company to Pure Plumbing to prevent these types of practices, in reading other similar reviews about these con jobs, it would appear they have forgotten why their business is growing, and likely why it will decline going forward.

As a gesture of goodwill to resolve this, I requested at least a 30% refund which would drop the cost to $600, still on the high end for the work performed, I did not hear back.

I’ve read all the copy and  paste replies to your negative reviews (“thank you for bringing this to our attention”, “we understand your frustration and disappointment”, “we have brought this to the attention of our management team”) …..please spare me the insincerity and don’t bother, they have lost their minds and my business, and hopefully yours.

reviews.author: Shelly R.
reviews.text:
I contacted Pure Plumbing based on several Facebook recommendations due to no hot water in one of our showers.   Plumber told me the issue was related to a shower valve and would be costly to repair.  Because he had to open up the wall to get to the issue at that point I elected not to repair since my long term plan (long term as in a year or two) was to renovate the particular bathroom.   Fast forward - I fast track unplanned bathroom Reno only to find out after replacing the shower value with the renovation contractor based on what Pure Plumbing Plumber had told me - still no hot water.   Turns out it was a hot water heater issue, and the plumber never bothered to check it even though I mentioned we had a hot water issue in another part of the house!!!   Absolutely ridiculous!   I spent thousands of dollars on a unneeded at the time bathroom reno when I really needed and still need a new hot water heater.   While I am not a plumber it seems to me that plumbing 101 would be to check all possibilities of a cause before giving no other option then to open up a wall.  

I learned it was the hot water heater after calling to complain and Pure Plumbing sent another plumber out that initially told us it was the shower value again.  After I told the it was not since the entire thing had been replaced they investigated more and found the hot water heater issue.   I was told a manager would call me as I was obviously very upset, but I never received a call.  Took me calling again.   

In the end they did refund the original charge, but Service Manager never apologized for their gross negligence which cost me thousands of unplanned dollars and still need a buy a hot water heater!

reviews.author: Charles F.
reviews.text:
Have to describe the great plumbing service experience I just had in the middle of the night with Jacob and his company Pure Plumbing.

Three toilets and two showers started backing up and flooding my downstairs bathrooms at about 1am this morning.   Called my regular (now "previous"!) plumbing company - no response.  Tried two others that claimed online that they were "24hrs", also with no response.

4th try was Pure Plumbing, based on a great online review from another guy who had an issue just the other night.  Jacob called me back within an hour, and was at my door within another hour, at about 3am.  

Very courteous/friendly guy.  Texted me when he arrived instead of knocking/ringing the doorbell, as he knew this would disturb my sleeping family.  That's just really thoughtful and much appreciated.

He advised that it was likely the main, since all of the downstairs bathrooms were affected.  Used a camera to find the blockage, actually showed it to me on the screen, then brought in another machine to clear the blockage.  Was completed quickly and professionally, with explanations all the way through. 

Everything about the experience with Jacob was friendly, no drama, fully explained, quickly executed, and reasonably priced.

And this guy is the owner, who is on call with the rest of his guys.  That's impressive.    Just found my new plumbing company.

reviews.author: Robert M.
reviews.text:
I wrote a raving review for my first experience with this company. My second experience compels me to re-evaluate.
A friend who is having significant health issues needed an outside spigot replaced before the Arctic blast arrived. 
I recommended Pure and called for her.  I explained the issue and was told $125 for the job. Arrival window was 8-5.
Confirming email 10-7.  Tech did not arrive until after 8 pm.  
Was told 125 was only to show up and replacing spigot was an additional 295.
I was shocked. Under the circumstances and since we had waited all bloody day for this guy - under duress, I said do it.
Then the fun began. The tech had a helper who had difficulty in opening the lid for the water meter. Then the helper did not get the water turned off at the meter which resulted in a geyser of water shooting up.
Total time for this was about 30 minutes - paid over $400.
I paid for my friend as she did not need the stress of canceling and getting someone else.
Very disappointed with being told one price and paying another.
The tech said he "couldn't make any money at $125"
Guess you can when you charge 3x quoted price.
A very disappointing experience.
If you have to choose them in a pinch - I suggest you get the price in writing in advance, especially if you are going to wait all day for them to show up.

reviews.author: Barrett T.
reviews.text: Amazing professionalism, responsiveness, and customer service from Uriel and the folks at Pure Plumbing. Saturday morning free flow leak from an old hose bib that rusted through so bad you could see daylight through the holes once it was dug out. Uriel made it out within an hour or so of our call, immediately dug out the area around the leak to find it and see if patch or repair was possible. He crawled under our 100 year old pier and beam home to assess the situation (I followed) and he found that getting to the pipe would require hand digging trenches under multiple beams to make room to belly crawl to the target. He did all this work to make sure the quote for the work would be accurate, and I am glad he did. We agreed on the scope of work and price, he showed up on time the next morning, knocked out the work (and even replaced the dug out hole from the old hose bib). Unprompted, he told me that his shop was short on pipe insulation so he would have to return the next day to finish insulating the pipe. I never would have known. He returned as promised, then sent me pictures of the fully insulated pipe. He was courteous and incredibly friendly despite having to spend Saturday night crawling through mud and spider webs in 100 degree heat. Highly recommend this company and Uriel, in particular.

reviews.author: U'kay E.
reviews.text: Chase and Amari came out to service my leaking water heater. The confirmation for my appointment was consistent this week, and I received a call on today, hours before, which was extremely thorough. I already had three other companies lined up but moved Pure Plumbing ahead of the line simply because of the FREE CONSULTATION to come out, which is rare. This was a great decision knowing what I know now, but as expected the arrival within the expected window was met. Then after seeing the damage, Chase and Amari identified exactly what the source was, and the pros and cons of the overall project. They were never pushy or salesy about payment and even when I did decide to move forward they provided multiple quotes for flexibility in payment understanding the season the nation is in financially. At the end, I have a new water heater, and Chase actually included a second drain line. The work didn't leave a mess or damage to property and as probably assumed by now-I'll be calling back all other companies to cancel them coming out, and so should you. Pure Plumbing is definitely earning their 5-Stars and if you're lucky Chase and Amari will get called out for your repair. Very happy with the results! Thanks again.

reviews.author: Daryl Mars
reviews.text:
Here’s a polished, professional, and heartfelt review you can post on Google, Yelp, or Nextdoor for Michael Trent at Pure Plumbing:

--5 Stars – Pure Plumbing & Michael Trent Deserve Major Props!

Michael Trent from Pure Plumbing is an absolute lifesaver! He came out on short notice when we noticed a strong gas smell, and what he accomplished was nothing short of a miracle.

Even with Atmos Energy on-site and preparing to shut the entire system down, Michael stayed calm, professional, and confident. He respectfully asked for a few more minutes to check one last area — and sure enough, he found and fixed the leak!

You could tell Atmos Energy was watching closely and appreciated his expertise and precision just as much as we did. Huge shoutout to Atmos for their patience, and major props to Michael for his skill, quick thinking, and commitment to safety.

If you ever have a plumbing or gas issue, call Pure Plumbing and ask for Michael Trent — he’s the kind of expert you want on your side when an emergency happens

reviews.author: Leah
reviews.text:
It was a pleasure working with Pure Plumbing for several of our recent home needs, and they delivered on each one.  These guys are pros – thorough, professional, friendly, respectful, and do a great job.

Scheduling was easy - I scheduled through their online system during the weekend for an appt on Monday.  I got a call first thing Monday morning from their office and Jacob came out the same day at no charge.  After looking at our most pressing problem, we were so impressed with his knowledge and problem-solving skills that we asked him about our other issues.  He was extremely knowledgeable and helpful, patiently talking through each one and providing recommendations on how to solve them.

Scheduling the work was also easy and Jacob, Dillon and Hugo completed all the projects promptly, including installing a new water heater and water softener.  Thank you for the excellent work and customer service Pure Plumbing!

synthesis.summary: A split company — long-tenured customers (Pure Plan members) report consistent excellent work from named techs (Dylan, Michael, Jacob), while one-time callers report no-shows, $325 'estimate' fees that should be free, and quoted prices 5-10x parts cost. BBB A+ and 4.8 Google over 921 reviews, but Yelp 4.1 and the negative reviews show a clear pattern of upselling on first-time calls.
strengths: Members of the 'Pure Plan' report consistent fair pricing and named techs (Dylan, Michael, Jacob) with strong workmanship
Same-day and within-the-hour emergency response reported on burst pipes during winter freeze
Free estimates honored for repeat customers; quotes given upfront before work begins
weaknesses: Multiple no-shows reported with weak excuses (door codes, dispatch errors)
Reviewers report being charged $325 for an 'estimate' that was advertised as free
Quotes 5-10x competitor pricing on small jobs — '$800 to fix a $15 in materials and 25-30 min job'
30-day workmanship warranty not honored in at least one case ('Dillon and Darron Branch')
bestFor: Pure Plan members for routine work
redFlags: Two specific named techs (Dillon, Darron Branch) flagged for refusing warranty repair without additional charge
Pattern of advertised free estimates being billed at $325
Multiple no-shows with what reviewers describe as fabricated excuses
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviewers report within-an-hour response on burst-pipe winter emergencies and Christmas water heater rescue. Counterweight: at least 2 confirmed no-shows on scheduled appointments.

burst-pipe.topQuote: during the winter freeze, we had an exterior pipe burst. The Pure Plumbing team was quick in deploying Jacob to help us. From the initial inquiry to the fix of our pipe, it took just under 2 hours

water-heater.topQuote: Dylan helped my 82 year-old mom today during a Christmas crisis. Water heater was running out of her garage and Dylan went out of his way to take care of my mom at a moments notice!!

slab-leak.topQuote: From the first visit—when Jacob diagnosed a slab leak—to the most recent service call, the level of professionalism, honesty, and expertise has been outstanding.

faucet-fixture.topQuote: They replaced 2 bathroom faucets and I signed up (again) for the Pure Plan ... Their prices are very reasonable.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: Michael came out next day and fixed my clogged drains same day. Quick, easy, simple.

sewer.topQuote: Pure Plumbing came out and addressed a sewer clog on my home. They also included a Camera inspection

reviews.author: Haeman Noori
reviews.text: Jordan was INCREDIBLE!  He was able to help me out on a Friday afternoon when no-one else could or would and then went out of his way to be extremely flexible with timing of the repair and also made it a point to not repair things that did not have to be (so we wouldn't have to pay needlessly more).  His professionalism, customer service, expertise, and communication are all truly 5 star.  I have definitely found a plumber for life!  Thanks Jordan!!

reviews.author: Victoria Toth
reviews.text: If I could leave Jordan and Defense Plumbing a ten-star review, I would. Jordan is quick to respond, knowledgeable, efficient, and kind. My husband and I have contracted Jordan for several plumbing projects over the last few years and we are amazed at the workmanship and quality of service every time. If you are searching for a plumber, look no further! Defense Plumbing is the best of the best!

reviews.author: Michael Belperio
reviews.text:
Jordan from Defense Plumbing was the guy I spoke to the phone and also the guy that showed up the next morning to give me a quote.
After calling a couple of other plumber groups in Denver and getting routed through some sort of switchboard/call back service, being able to talk to the person who also shows up was great.
Jordan showed up promptly; was thorough in assessment and helpful with my queries.

reviews.author: Steven L.
reviews.text:
I scheduled Defense Plumbing, through thumbtack.com, to fix a number of things that were wrong with an investment property I ended up with. The first item was to fix a leaking shower valve. When the water was shut off it still dripped. 

Patrick came out and had a list of recommendations to fix the leaking shower valve. The price would be $3100. I calmly told him he was insane. 

I went to home depot, bought a price pfister repair kit for $63 and fixed it myself. 

I won't be calling Defense Plumbing again. This is definitely not the company you want if you are an investor.

reviews.author: Heather Gabriszeski
reviews.text:
Jordan is the absolute best! It’s so reassuring to have a plumber that you can trust 100%. Over the years Jordan has installed 3 toilets and a hot water heater for us and done an excellent job. Most recently, we had a broken hose vacuum for our outside faucet so I called to have him come take a look. Instead of immediately trying to replace the whole thing, Jordan went above and beyond to try to find the inexpensive replacement part that we were having trouble finding on our own since our house was built almost 25 years ago. With some trial and error Jordan was able to find a replacement part. We were charged for labor and a 60 day guarantee if the part fails. Jordan said he would come back and replace the faucet and put the labor charge towards that. If you are in the market for an honest reliable plumber Defense Plumbing is where it’s at!

Update November 2024: Jordan continues to exceed my expectations. Every time I need him he is able to come out and get the job done quickly and efficiently. We had a washing machine mishap over the summer and had a lingering leak I couldn’t figure out. Jordan came out and saved the day once again. He replaced the washing machine valve after quickly finding the source of the leak. I called him again recently to replace the stop valve on my toilet and as always he came right on time and got the job done! Thank you!

reviews.author: Rachael Garrett
reviews.text:
I enjoyed the entire experience!!! That booking was easy and for them to come and look at my problem was FREE.
They texted me a couple days prior to remind me and sent a photo of the man that would be doing the job.
I needed 2 sinks replaced and 2 faucets. I knew how to do it but I just didn’t have time.
When he got there and quoted me the price I felt like it was a tad bit much but he said I could watch him do one and then I could do the other. I appreciated the offer but I told him, I knew how I just didn’t have the time. So we went ahead with his service.
I didn’t have the sinks on hand so I had to run to Home Depot. He wasn’t sure if he was going to have time to do both sinks in my current appointment especially since I had to run to the store.
So, I went to the store got the sinks and the faucets. When I got back home and he realized that I got the wrong sinks. He waited while I went BACK to the store to get the right sinks.
He booked my appointment for the next day just in case but he worked really quickly so that he was able to get both sinks installed in one appointment.
I did a check over once he was done and I WAS VERY PLEASED!
No complaints here! Great job Patrick!

reviews.author: Deborah
reviews.text: I have had service from Jordan in the past when I lived in Littleton. At least 4-5 different reasons for hiring his company back then. INow I live in Lakewood and one of the first things I did was call Jordan for a general maintenance visit. Jordan is extremely professional, very skilled, and he took the time to explain everything he was suggesting and was sensitive to the cost involved, which was more than reasonable. I will continue to use him and highly recommend him to anyone considering a plumbing need.

reviews.author: Petr Valkoun
reviews.text: I had great experience with Jordan, he answered the phone (no dispatch service middleman involved) and was able to review the issue based on pictures I sent him. He was able to come the next day to assess the extent of the repair and to fix it the next day.  He was very professional and helpful. He also tried less costly solution first which saved me significant amount of money. I will recommend him and Defense Plumbing from now on.

reviews.author: toby cooper
reviews.text: Jordan is always so informative. He is very responsive and offers reasonable rates.  He works with his clients and give them various options to consider that will work for their plumbing project.  He is able to correct plumbing jobs that other have done incorrectly, and complete jobs that other have not completed.  He does all this with a smile on his face and without breaking your bank!  He is the SUPER PLUMBER !!

reviews.author: Kate Stander
reviews.text: Jordan was great. Excellent communication, respectful and got several jobs done quickly. He's high energy and is clearly doing what he loves. (Also my dog was cool with him-that tells me something) Defense gave us free estimates and was able to book our service quickly. Very competitive pricing---we got a LOT of estimates and Defense was the lowest. Very happy with the work that was done. 👍

reviews.author: Alex D
reviews.text: We have called Defense Plumbing twice before and had no qualms about calling them this time. Jordan was prompt, understood the multi-part task, and quickly set about fixing the leak. He’s a pleasant man and can give and take a joke while never losing sight of what needs to be done.  We’re comfortable having Jordan in our house and will call Defense Plumbing again when needed.

reviews.author: Mark Hardcastle
reviews.text: 4:30 Sunday afternoon, the main house water shutoff valve failed and started leaking. Jordan (Defense Plumbing) picked up after 2 rings, and next thing I knew he was on his way. Prompt, friendly, and efficient. It took him all of 15 minutes to cut out the old valve and install a new one. We had our water back in time for dinner. I couldn't have asked for better service!

reviews.author: Jen-L Morris
reviews.text: This is my second time working with Defense Plumbing. I had contacted Jordan over the weekend on short notice, and he promptly scheduled a visit for Monday morning. He arrived on time, efficiently diagnosed the issue, and completed the repair within a couple of hours. I continue to be impressed by his professionalism and reliability. I highly recommend his services. Ty!

reviews.author: Roger Low
reviews.text: We are so glad we found Defense Plumbing! Jordan is awesome. Our shower had an annoying leak - Jordan fixed it. The first thing we tried didn’t work - Jordan was super responsive and came back right away to fix the issue without additional charge, and now it’s totally fixed. We are super grateful. And grateful to have a local plumber we trust who does excellent work:)

reviews.author: Nicole Bunn
reviews.text: We have used Defense Plumbing for a couple pluming needs now and we have been impressed both times. Friendly, honest and has fair pricing. Jordan helped us trouble shoot, followed up and asked how our water heater was working later that day. Overall, I highly recommend Defense Plumbing and will most definitely use them for further plumbing needs.

synthesis.summary: Defense Plumbing is Jordan, owner-operator, who picks up his own phone (no dispatch service) and a Sunday-4:30pm water-shutoff-valve emergency was on its way after 2 rings. The negative review here is a single price-disagreement on a shower valve fix ($3,100 quote vs a $63 DIY repair); every other review describes fair, competitive pricing and Jordan trying the cheaper fix first before recommending replacement. Multi-year repeat customers are the norm.

reviews.author: Chad Davis
reviews.text: I called on a Friday afternoon for a natural gas issue and they were able to squeeze me in last minute. Jay and AJ were great and solved my problem very quickly. Cost was less than I expected, which is always nice. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Erich Tompkins
reviews.text:
Stop searching for a plumber and use these
guys they are great!!!    I am a new customer
we searched online during the snow storm
b/c our water heater failed mid storm- they were out the next day after inspecting and were done with the full install after about 5 hrs, permits, electrical plumbing and they installed flood stops and sensors and hauled out the old one.   Jay build
an excellent plan and All don the guys who came out were clean friendly polite intelligent and professional.   Just a great efficient operation and my new go-to plumber!!!!!

reviews.author: Dayna Moser
reviews.text: During the most recent winter storm Our water heaters froze and broke causing water damage to the fist floor. Tribeca responded with a sense of urgency - they came over within hours to assess the situation and began researching our warranty. By the next morning they contacted us to confirm our order and a few hours later they were back for installation. Their team was courteous and respectful and got the job done quickly. They went above and beyond to lend us a space heater so the new water heater wouldn’t freeze overnight. We had hot water within 24 hours of reporting our issue. I would highly recommend them when you need help.

reviews.author: Chip F.
reviews.text:
Extremely rude, unprofessional company.  Do not use.  If I could give zero stars I would.  

I called this company to request service and inquire about price.  The next day, the plumber calls and states he is on his way, I ask for clarification on the price for the service call, the plumber told me the price.  I then get a call from the office telling me the service I requested was a waste of their time w slight agitation and rudeness.  Confused, I ask politely why the cancellation?  The man from the office told me that his plumber told him I wasn't going to pay for the service call. I explained this was incorrect, I never said that and had every intention of paying. The man then got heated with me saying he "EXPLICITLY" told me the price the previous day, and hung up on me.  Needless to say, no service was completed, and clearly this company is in a position to choose their business.  Do your self a favor and please do not choose theirs.

reviews.author: Jordan A.
reviews.text:
I paid Tribeca Plumbing about $15,000 to replace all of my sewer and drain lines over 3.5 years ago. This was supposed to be a once-in-decades type of project. Recently my kitchen line slowed to a crawl, so I called them back. Their own master plumber ran a camera and found a 14-foot belly in the new PVC sewer line under my slab. A belly of that size means the line was installed improperly and will never drain right, in my opinion.

To make matters worse, Tribeca admitted that the plumber who did the original job was an "untrustworthy" employee who was later fired for poor workmanship. Even with that admission, they refused to honor any workmanship warranty. Instead, they told me the belly was "settlement" (even though my foundation has shown zero movement) and quoted me $7,750 to fix their mistake.

Bottom line: I paid top dollar for work that failed in under four years, and Tribeca Plumbing will not stand behind it. Homeowners deserve to know this before trusting them with a major job.

reviews.author: Ben C.
reviews.text:
Unprofessional and Unprepared - Very Disappointing Experience

I rarely leave negative reviews and generally try to be understanding of small businesses, but my experience with Tribeca Plumbing in Dallas was extremely frustrating and unfair.

We called them for an emergency sewage backup, and they charged $225 just to come out. Upon arrival, they didn't have the proper equipment and told the tenants they'd return the next morning to complete the work. Unfortunately, the sewage continued to back up overnight, causing significant damage.

The next day, they canceled the appointment shortly before they were supposed to arrive, claiming their equipment wasn't working after all -- leaving us scrambling to find another plumber while the situation worsened. Despite not fixing the problem (and the backup becoming much worse), they later billed us $475, claiming they had "cleaned up the sewage" while they were there. 

Because of the delay, we ultimately spent over $6,000 on professional cleanup, drywall replacement, and biohazard remediation.

After months of back-and-forth through our property manager, I finally called Tribeca Plumbing directly to discuss a fair resolution. I remained calm and respectful, but the person on the phone -- identifying himself as "Richard Wayne" -- was hostile and threatening, saying it was "a crime not to pay bills in Texas" and that they'd pursue legal action if I didn't pay immediately. When I mentioned I would leave a review warning others of the way they treated their customers he accused me of trying to take advantage of them.

I ultimately paid the full amount on the call so they got everything they asked for. My goal in writing this is not about the money -- it's to warn others. In my experience, Tribeca Plumbing was unprepared, unprofessional, and unwilling to take responsibility for their part in worsening an emergency situation. 

Truly the worst experience I have had with any plumber in Dallas. 

There are many fair, capable plumbing companies in Dallas. Stay clear of this one.

reviews.author: Madeleine F.
reviews.text: Chris and Ethan came over on a brutally cold Sunday morning.  We thought we were about to have a pipe burst through the ceiling of our kitchen and couldn't turn off our old City of Dallas water mains.  Tribeca Plumbing responded with remarkable speed, considering it must have been happening all over the city.  They took a while to locate the problem, but discovered it was a cast iron drain pipe, which had a 18" crack running the length of it.  This pipe was located behind the drywall of our staircase.  Chris and Ethan, were extremely professional.  They calmly and methodically worked through the problem and while it did involve cutting into the drywall in the ceiling as well as the stairwell, this was inevitable.  They did a great job of cleaning up, and were really lovely young men.  Above all else, I was expecting a much higher bill.  They were here for over 3 hours, on a Sunday morning, and the bill was under $1000.  In the freeze of 2021, Baker bros capped a pipe in my garage.  It maybe took them 45 minutes and they charged me over $1000 for an emergency call out.  I highly recommend this company and will be using them moving forward.

reviews.author: Jayla C.
reviews.text:
Called this company to fix a shower issue I had. They did fix the issue, I paid $500 but left me with another problem THAT WASNT THERE BEFORE. Instead of exemplifying good customer service, they wanted to charge me another $200 to come back out to fix the leak that was caused. I expressed to them that it wasn't fair that I had to be charged again, on top of the $500 I already paid, for a problem that they caused. We suggested that Tribeca covers half ($100). They then came back again to only offer $182, saying they agreed to go half of what they were charging. $182 is not half of $200. The technician, receptionist and owner were not on the same page and kept giving out different quotes for parts & labor. 

After explaining to the owner all of this, he continued to still offered me pay $182. He didn't acknowledge my experience & proceeded to believe I was wrong. I declined the offer & will not be using them again. I will also not recommend anybody to use them as they are more concerned about money than helping customers plumbing issues

reviews.author: Geri J. F.
reviews.text:
Jay was simply THE BEST when I needed a plumber to do repairs while under contract on a listing in the Dallas Area. The guys at Tribeca Plumbing are responsive, knowledgeable & fairly priced.
Jay was at the property within 24 hrs of my call for an estimate, and actually called me while he was UNDER the house (pier & beam) to report what needed to be done along with a rough estimate of what it would cost to fix the leak. Tribeca's estimate was 1/2 the cost of a previous estimate, for TOP KNOTCH service! Of course I told him to proceed, upon which Jay crawled out from under the house and immediately went to pickup his supplies & returned ready to perform the work. The whole process took less than a day! The property owners, the buyers & I were MORE than satisfied with the work performed by Tribeca Plumbing (and Jay) and would highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work preformed in the Metroplex.
Regards, Geri J. Fox-Realtor®

reviews.author: Charlie S.
reviews.text: I would not work with them again. They charged $995 to not fix our HVAC system and simply "diagnose" the problem. They changed the invoice 2 times when we pointed out that it was not accurate and included work not performed. Their solution: charge the same amount and just relabel the repair work not done as diagnostics. I was traveling when the invoice back and forth was going on so it took me a month to find a time to speak to the owner, Richard, about it. I had hoped he would engage in a discussion about the value of what they delivered and the fact that the changes to the invoice were suspect. He just wanted to lecture me on the value of his time. I paid Richard for his "valuable" time but I didn't get $995 of value from these guys and Richard's approach to customer service convinced me to never use them again.

reviews.author: Blue T.
reviews.text:
Tribeca plumbing came out to repair lack of hot water from our tankless water heater, from the questions I was getting, they didn't know much about tankless heaters. Ours may have been their first electric one in a small apartment complex. They spent some time troubleshooting with the company on the phone and were unable to get the water hot. I was still charged $125 for not doing anything, they said it was trip fee which should had been disclosed prior to arriving. Their prices to install a tankless water heater onto an existing plumbing was very excessive, maybe they are used to highland park customers, so just beware, these guys are pricey !!
I gave them 2 stars because they were very professional the whole time, arrived on time and sent me an invoice via email, but I would not be calling them again.

reviews.author: Mary M.
reviews.text: I have used Tribeca Plumbing on two occasions and have been very happy with them. On the first occasion, it was to repair two outdoor faucets that cracked during a winter freeze. They were prompt and effective, and their work was well-priced. On the second occasion, I needed three toilets repaired at a rental property. Two were running, and the third had a phantom flush. Jay did an outstanding job, was thorough and professional. He is also very knowledgeable! The repair work was reasonably priced, too. I was frustrated since another plumbing company had rebuilt two of these toilets less than six months ago. That company tried to upsell me on several things that were not needed, so I turned to Tribeca. Tribeca fixed the problem quickly and did NOT try to upsell me. I highly recommend Tribeca Plumbing!!

reviews.author: Rebecca Atkins
reviews.text:
I called because my bathroom sink was draining slowly, and wanted to figure out why and have it fixed before it potentially leads to bigger issues. The woman on the phone told me the service call fee + the fee to have it fixed.

The two young men that came to fix my sink were really nice, but ultimately weren’t able to fix it or tell me how to fix it.  They did switch out a piece of PVC pipe and charged me the service call fee + fee to fix it + $50 for the piece of PVC… so again, they came and were nice but ultimately I’m out $425 and still have basically the same issue I had before they came.

That being said, I’ll have to schedule a different plumber come out for the same thing :/ so let me know if anyone has any recommendations.

reviews.author: Brooke C.
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Tribeca Plumbing. We called to receive advice and guidance when we became extremely concerned that another plumbing company  was misdiagnosing our problem and trying to overcharge us by thousands of dollars. Richard, the owner, took the time to guide us through possible steps and provide his thoughtful expertise. He immediately sent a team to our home. Jay and Sam did an excellent job working quickly and efficiently to accurately diagnosis the plumbing issue and fix the problem. We were charged an honest and appropriate fee, and treated with great respect. We are grateful to Tribeca Plumbing for their excellent work and integrity. They will be our first call for all plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jim C.
reviews.text: I live in a 50 yro highrise, which means that there are many idiosyncratic issues with plumbing, created over 50 years. We own two condos, and there is another one in the family, and, thus, we've had many plumbing repairs over the years. We also used several plumbers or plumbing companies before we found Tribeca. I found Tribeca's prices to be more than reasonable. Additionally, it's response time is the quickest I have EVER experienced, and Tribeca's plumbers have never been stumped by the weird plumbing issues in our building. I will never use anyone else, and refer all of our building issues to Tribeca, which are lot, because there are about 350 units in the building!

reviews.author: Emily Melany
reviews.text: When you gut a house down to the studs, the plumbing work alone is extensive. In this project, we needed a full water line repipe, new drain and waste lines, proper venting, shower and tub valve installations, new hose bibs, kitchen and bathroom rough-ins, and a complete sewer line inspection before closing everything up. On top of that, we upgraded the water heater and ensured all plumbing met current Denver code requirements. Professional Plumbers Denver handled every part of the process with precision and efficiency.

reviews.author: Rayne Kelsey
reviews.text: As a real estate flipper here in the Denver area, I work with contractors constantly — and finding a plumbing and HVAC company that is reliable, honest, and priced fairly is not easy. I recently used Professional Plumbers Denver on a full gut renovation where we completely redid the piping and replaced the entire HVAC system, and I can confidently say they exceeded my expectations.

reviews.author: Jakayla Calvin
reviews.text: I recently completed a full home flip in Denver, and hiring Emergency Plumbers Denver was one of the best decisions I made during the entire renovation process. From the first phone call, their team was professional, responsive, and extremely knowledgeable. When you’re flipping a house, time is money — and they understood the urgency right away.

reviews.author: Walker Atkinson
reviews.text: Not actually in house. These guys are brokers for actual plumbers. They had someone respond to a leak I needed fixed at a rental property. Never heard back, didn’t get any messages or photos they were there. THEY DIDNT FIX LEAK AND LEFT. Then I called them this morning complaining and the person basically hung up on me when I was expressing frustration. Find an actual plumber. Not a brokerage middle man

reviews.author: KING AJ
reviews.text:
I woke up at 3 AM to the terrifying smell of gas in my kitchen and panicked. I called Emergency Plumbers Denver LLC and they were incredible. Even at that hour, they answered immediately and had a technician at my door in under 45 minutes.

If you need a reliable 24 hour plumber denver, these are the experts to call. They found the leak in the stove line quickly, explained the repair clearly, and made sure everything was 100% safe before leaving. It is a huge relief knowing there is a trustworthy emergency plumber denver that actually shows up when they say they will. Professional, fast, and very fair pricing for a middle-of-the-night crisis. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sophia
reviews.text:
We’ve worked with Mike and Emergency Plumbers on many of our kitchen and bath projects, and they’ve consistently provided excellent service to our clients. Their team is professional, responsive, and reliable!!! Which makes the entire process smooth from start to finish.

When we refer them to our customers, we know they’ll be treated with honesty, clear communication, and quality workmanship. It’s a huge relief having a plumbing company we can trust to deliver top-notch results and stand behind their work.

We’re grateful for the partnership and highly recommend Mike to any homeowner or contractor looking for dependable plumbing services in the Denver area.

reviews.author: Simon Draganis
reviews.text: After calling what felt like half the city and hearing some wild prices, this amazing small local business showed up in the middle of the night to save the day (or should I say, the pipes)! 💦 They did an incredible job — fast, clean, and super affordable. Honestly, best combo of price and quality I’ve seen. Highly recommend these heroes of plumbing! 🚿🔧

reviews.author: Evelin Cash
reviews.text: I had a plumbing emergency late at night, and Emergency Plumbers Denver LLC responded immediately. The technician arrived on time, diagnosed the issue quickly, and fixed it without any hassle. Very professional service and fair pricing. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rachael Nicole
reviews.text: Excellent experience from start to finish. I called Emergency Plumbers Denver LLC for a burst pipe, and they handled everything efficiently. The plumber was knowledgeable, polite, and left the area clean after the job. Will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Ricky Graham
reviews.text: Emergency Plumbers Denver LLC truly lives up to their name. I needed urgent help with my water heater, and they resolved the issue quickly. The team was friendly, skilled, and very responsive. I’m extremely satisfied with their service.

reviews.author: Sheryl M.
reviews.text: We have had Blue Sky twice now for issues in our home. Once for a furnace that would not start and yesterday for a backed up sewer. Both times they arrived within the time window, did the work professionally and with friendly communication and were done in a reasonable amount of time for a reasonable fee. Both service technicians who came were personable, knowledgeable and communicated well with us on what the issue was and how they were going to resolve it and the price estimate for the work. I really appreciated the fact that they texted me with a picture of the technician coming so I knew who he was before his arrival - thereby giving me peace of mind as to who I was letting into my home - and that they told me a couple little personal things about him.  This company is the real deal - competent, easy to trust with their client transparency at all levels and clean, reliable technicians. I also like it is a local, family owned business. We will continue to hire and highly recommend them for Plumbing, Heating and Electric needs around our home

reviews.author: Haley Clark
reviews.text:
Andres with Blue Sky Plumbing was awesome. We had a cracked outdoor spigot pipe, and he handled everything quickly and professionally. He was knowledgeable, extremely kind, and took the time to clearly explain what he found and how he fixed it.

The company was very responsive, he arrived right on time, and he left the area clean when he was done. He even helped communicate with our landlord since we rent, which made a stressful situation so much easier. Pricing was transparent and very fair. We would absolutely request him again and highly recommend him

reviews.author: Margaret Eckel
reviews.text: Blue Sky did an excellent job installing our new boiler after our original one needed to be replaced after 40 years.  They worked diligently and together to replace it in a couple of days.  A beautiful job, respectful of us and our schedules.  Great work!  A piece of art!!

reviews.author: greg bortz
reviews.text:
I have waited to do any kind of comment or review.
It is often said to never review anything while angry. Don't "YELP" angry.
The work done by Blue Sky Plumbing was done in September 2025
It is now mid January 2026.

I've had a great deal of time to look at all aspects of the work and formulate my opinion.
Right after the work was "completed" I called the representative who originally estimated / Sold the job
He came to our property to look over the work and listen to my concerns / complaints.

To start the two people who performed the work were polite enough with me, the home owner.
While on the job there were all kinds of mixed communications between the two. I noted at times they were conflicted and would appear to argue.
Other times over the few days here the seemed to be on the same page.
On at least one occasion one of them seemed possibly ill or lacking much if any motivation to work.

All of this is what resulted in the condition our property was left in at the conclusion of the job.
The approach to the job seemed to be to get things done as quickly as could be done.
I've found that most contractors take this approach to save as much in labor cost as possible, regardless of work quality at times.

I've taken several pictures of the finished work as well as the condition of the property upon completion of the job.

Here is a list of my concerns and complaints expressed to the Blue Sky Representative for this job.

A great deal of over spray  due to neglect of proper prep prior to painting the installed gas line
This left our brick, foundation, and cedar gate painted with gloss black.
I consider this to be damage to our property that could have easily avoided with attention to detail.
Blue Sky got paid, our property got sprayed.

According to the licensed inspector who reviewed the work, it was not even necessary, according to code,
to paint many of the unions and valves that were painted in whole. That being said, the very last piece of black pipe installed
was left unpainted and left to rust in the rain. Left unpainted after it was explained to me by Blue Sky
how it was required that the entirety of the gas line be painted (again, not necessary) Again a lack of attention to detail.

During excavation the downspout drain to the garage was destroyed . No repair or replacement was offered.

Debris was left on the property from work performed.

When a Blue Sky crew returned to fill the trench that was dug by a company they contracted. A few people showed up to refill the ditch by hand with shovels
as opposed to using the same contractor that dug by machine. It took a much longer amount of time, and the yard was left considerably uneven. This again, I assume
was in an effort to save expense, where as bringing a grader back for a fill and a few passes to even things out would have left our yard as it was prior to the work performed.

reviews.author: Tom M.
reviews.text: Complete rip off. They wanted to charge me $1200 for a water jet pump. I found the exact same pump for $271 at home depot. Avoid this company at all costs. I had Isaac Romero as my tech visit to fix a leak from frozen pipes and it is still leaking.

reviews.author: April W.
reviews.text:
You know this was quite the experience! The worse experience ever. Being a single woman and having your furnace go out... DO NOT and I do mean DO NOT call this company! Horrible customer service on many occasions! Horrible just horrible!! I called this company out paid a $150 fee for an emergency dispatch and the tech came in and sat out in my furnace room and was talking on his phone the entire time acting as if he was trouble shooting my furnace to get it to work. He came in and said my mother board would need replaced so I said order it and let's get it fixed. Had a different tech come out to install the mother board two days later. And yes I had to pay for the mother board which was over $650+ dollars. Furnace was working when the tech left, however 5 hours later ended up failing in the same way I explained from the start. Same problem is existing. Same issue is occurring. Another tech comes out to diagnose the furnace and says that the filter I had was to thick and he replaced it with the one I should be using (Mav8) and said that the mother board was fried and that it was a bad switch that must of been the original issue and overlooked. They did replace the switch and the mother board at no extra cost however the heater still failed. They sent another technician out and this one hard wired my thermostat stating that was the issue. And that the furnace was overheating. He said he would call and have someone schedule me. No phone call to get on the schedule to get the furnace fixed I had to again call them. Called and talked to their manager Brian and he was a jerk and rude. Besides telling him that after leaving multiple messages I never got a call back previously and he was supposed to call me and failed to that himself. He did apologize however that changed real quick. He said he didn't like to hear that his customer service was bad.
Brian stated he would send another technician out however I had to wait until the next day and that he was going to come out himself, he also stated he was canceling the technician that was supposed to come out on the emergency call that was just dispatched out. I had to wait in the middle of a snow storm and at that time we had negative degree weather up here in the mountains. I can't go without heat. I paid them to diagnose and fix and they had no problem taking my money yet the same issues were occurring same symptoms same issues! And I have to wait.. nope  Still no fix, after speaking with Brian and stating that this was unacceptable to have to wait when I spent the funds for an emergency service. In turn with being so frustrated with loosing money from my job now, he told me to fuck off and that he would refund my money. I said thank you and hung up the phone. 24 hours later my money was refunded! Thankfully!!
I called another company and they came out and diagnosed the furnace and said it was overheating however it was overheating due to the registers- not enough floor vents for proper ventilation and that it was a easy fix! Then he pointed out that the filter that was replaced (Mav8 filter) was the wrong one to replace with and that I needed a Mav4 or a Mav5 to provide the proper circulation within the unit. Funny because the filters I had before it was replaced in the unit was a Mav8 I figured out later after donating the full box of unused filters. Needless to say it was the wrong filter and the unit was overheating. Now the unit is fixed and it isn't overheating and no more issues! Tech installed a Mav5 filter. Sad I was sold a new motherboard that wasn't needed! 
I did review previous reviews and thought that since they had some good reviews that I would give them a chance! NOPE!! Save yourself the migraine and unreal experience I had and find a different company! Trust me find a different company!

I have witnesses who heard Brian.. Trust me don't use this company even when reading their weak response to my review. This company just wants your money!!! I wouldn't recommend this company to anyone not even a homeless man! Don't use this company!! Horrible customer service and horrible management Brian and I am using his name for a reason! This company would get a Zero star however they don't let you do that! Have a good day Jesse as it's unfortunate that your company needs a full overhaul of new people!!! It was a Win for me to find a new company! Couldn't even put the correct filter in telling me mine was wrong and they in turn installed the very same filter that they took out. I guess you would call that hard to diagnose 
People save your money and find a different company. As you can see not even Jesse wants to own his companies mistreatment and wants to smooth it over to seem as if the experience with this company was my fault and I was the one who was rude. I paid you... I'm a single woman that your company took advantage of. I'm not the only one, look at the reviews..Take those into consideration before calling this company!!

reviews.author: Eliot A.
reviews.text:
If you don't want to read the details, here's the quick summary from a long-time customer that paid a premium for Blue Sky's annual service plan: this company has gone dramatically downhill and I highly recommend you look elsewhere for your heating needs.   

Not sure if it is the latest generation of ownership, but our most recent experience with Blue Sky caused us to decide we will never do business with them again. Their "expert" technician came to look into an issue we were having with our heat and hot water. He determined we needed to do 3 things: replace a valve, replace a gauge, and relocate the intake and exhaust of our system because of a deck we recently built above the original intake/exhaust. He quoted all the work and I followed up to schedule the appointment to complete the 3 items. The day the technician came back, he informed me he could only complete 2 of the 3 items and would need to re-schedule for the 3rd. The first two items were completed without issue and we scheduled an additional visit for the intake/exhaust relocation.   

The fateful day finally came and the same technician showed up with an apprentice to help him drill the necessary holes and run the new pipe for the intake/exhaust. Shortly after their arrival, the apprentice was wandering around looking confused. He told me that he didn't know where the technician was or what the plan was. Eventually, they got to work drilling through the first of the two walls they would need to drill through for the new pipes. After about an hour, the technician came out and told me they would need to charge me an extra $200 for the job. While not happy about being asked to pay $200 more than the original $1400 quote, I gave him the benefit of the doubt. They then left to get a "bigger drill." They returned and spent the next 6 hours drilling 2 holes through a single 8-inch think concrete wall. At 5pm, the technician came out of the basement, and told me they had only managed to get through 1 of the 2 walls and would need to hire a core drilling company to complete the job. He said he would follow up with timing for that. So, postponed once again.  

The next day, the technician called and said the core drilling company could be at our house the next week and that the additional cost to complete the job would be $900. I told the technician that almost doubling the cost of a job whose scope had not changed was unacceptable. I followed up with a call to Blue Sky's office and asked for the Service Manager. The person who answered told me he was in a meeting with the other managers and that he would call me back when he was out of that meeting. Four hours passed with no call, so I called back. This time I was forwarded to the Service Manager's voicemail. I left a message describing the situation and my frustration and asking him to return my call. 24 hours later and still no call, so I called Blue Sky's office to let them know that I would be going with another company (one that quoted the same original $1400 for the job) and would no longer be doing business with Blue Sky.   

It's now been a week and I still have not heard from Blue Sky. I don't know if they have made a conscious decision to try to take advantage of their customers during the pandemic, but they clearly couldn't care less about retaining a long-term customer that was paying a premium for their annual service plan.   

Buyer beware - this company combines incompetence (I've spoken to multiple other companies that have all said it was obvious a core drill was needed for the job) with dishonest sales practices.
