reviews.author: Heidi Z.
reviews.text:
It appears that I went into the wrong field I should quit nursing and become my brothers apprentice to become a plumber, as it seems to pay around 600 dollars an hour for labor (give or take the $30-50 for parts), according to Blue Sky Plumbing. 
I wanted to support a family business as I had a leak coming from my hot water heater and a company that according to my brother (who used to work there 5 years ago and is a Journeyman Plumber) was an honest, trustworthy company. I sadly did not have this experience. 
The service slot was from 12-2 pm and I received a message saying they were possibly going to arrive after 2pm most likely, I understand that sH*t happens, and previous calls can run over so no biggie. The tech did arrive before 2 (1:44), so cool that was nice. When I led the tech down to the water heater in our basement and told him that the water heater was leaking a little from the bottom area and showed him where the insulation stuff was a little wet still, but that I had turned the water off.  I asked him if he would like me to turn the water back on so he could see for himself. Which he replied no, and then proceeded to tell me that I needed a new water heater, and that the brand that I had (Rheem) was not great brand and notorious for leaking. I said that it was only 5 years old or so and he then said that they usually break around 5-6 years. I was like ok, this is going a different direction. I had even told the man on the phone when I made the appointment that my brother (a plumber remember) had thought that it was the drain valve most likely when I facetimed him and showed him the leak. 

Had the Blue Sky tech seen the leak with the water turned on or even Touched the water heater himself I may have been more apt to trust what he was recommending. Which makes me feel bad for an elderly person, or any person really that would have just trusted what he said and gone ahead with the very expensive recommendation. 

I told the tech all the previous information, and he said "Oh I must have misunderstood you"...ok I am still trying to give him the benefit of the doubt so he says he will fix the drain valve and I ask him how much it will be. He goes onto his iPad and pulls up an estimate/invoice which says $568.46 for the work. Being that I do not know pricing (and what average homeowner would) I signed it and an hour later or so I paid the invoice for $670.10 with the additional $59 added for the service call. 
I called my brother to tell him what had been fixed and told him the cost. He said that I had paid way too much, that this should have cost me around $200. I believe he even called the owner of the company to ask about the pricing but did not receive a call back from him. 

So, taking this all into consideration sadly, to say, I would never use this company again and I would advise that if you do use the company get a second opinion as I am lucky and have a brother that can advise me (sadly he moved out of state). If I didn't have that luxury, I would be waiting for a brand new hot water heater to be installed, and who knows how much that would cost at Blue Sky!

reviews.author: Marla J.
reviews.text:
We have been long time customers of Blue Sky.  That's why I wonder why it has been over a week and I have not heard from a supervisor regarding a poor job that was done Dec 29, even though I have called at least 4 times the week after the incident.  We called to have our furnaces maintained and cleaned.  When the tech was done he said everything was good and working. I paid about $500 for two heaters to be cleaned and maintained-they were in working condition but it had been a while since they were serviced.   Three days later we noticed it was cold in the basement and realized there was no heat.  When I called on January 2, they sent another tech out January 3.  That tech cleaned the unit (it had not been done) and said the unit had been turned off and not turned back on.  When he turned it on, it failed to start.  I asked him for a written estimate on the repair and replacement and only got a ballpark cost for the repair, but no other written estimate.  I called a second company to give me another opinion and they said the same part was broken and gave me prices to replace heater as well as repair it.  I then tried to call Blue Sky January 3, 5, and 7.  Each time I was told a work order was put in for a supervisor to call me within 24-48 hours.  No one has ever called. I wanted to find out why the furnace was working when the first tech came out, but when he left it was turned off and when the second tech turned it back on, it was not working.  I also wanted to find out why he didn't tell me it wasn't working, if he knew that.  Also, if I could get my $240 back for the first tech not doing his job, and the furnace not working after he left when it was working the day he arrived.  Granted, the second tech did clean the furnace and diagnosed the problem, but I have a lot of unanswered questions.   My biggest issue is Blue Sky saying someone would call but never did and it's been over a week.  
Not sure what happened with Blue Sky.  They used to have pride about their customer service but I have been left in the dust-still with a cold basement and no estimate or explanation why a furnace was working and then not working after a tech serviced it, why he left it off, and why he did not at least clean it and remove dirt and debris. I also want to know why they did not provide any written estimate.  It's like they are avoiding me and do not want to deal with a complaint. It's evident now that they are not interested in calling me and considering reimbursement for poor service.    It's unfortunate that I can no longer give Blue Sky's name out to my large circle of friends-instead, I will relay this incidence.  Is it worth the $240 to Blue Sky to lose a customer, as well as many other potential customers? This could have been avoided by one simple phone call from a supervisor, in a timely fashion.  It would be wise for Blue Sky to change their system to take customer calls more seriously and not have the "24-48 hour call backs" as protocol.  In my case, it has been 8 days with no call back.

reviews.author: M P.
reviews.text:
I really don't want to get into a ratings war, but need to clear up some issues brought up by Jesse, who was not there .
First issue of roots, tech never got to roots first night as he ran the line up vent pipe where it was sticking out of it with no cutting head 
It was myself and the tech up on the roof looking for it, none found
Also take a good look at the picture of the broken head, does is seem it couldn't cut through a paper bag as old and warn out as it is 
Tech could not attempt any cleaning of line as within first 15 minutes there, head of tool off, he never made it to the line.
Second issue: sewer was not backed up, toilet was flushing slowly, needless to say, following morning (remember metal head in line does nothing according to others) tech arrives with two large magnets and rope, goes into roof and sends them down pipe to see if he can retrieve said none important broken head 
When this failed he took the heavy equipment to roof to try and push broken head through the line, once again failed 
Despite the rumors that monstrous roots broke the head, at this point no attempts are for roots but all morning attempting to find said metal cutting head 
Three: the 'other" company spoken of which I wonder how others would know extent of their work, however after they used modern equipment like ground penetrating device they knew where the monstrous roots were 
In fact they put a professional camera into complete line, and did video showing no need to pipe replacement.
I had the choice to remove the "monstrous roots "or just replace that with new PVC, which I chose PVC 
Lastly and I could keep going, 4 hours that day looking for the unimportant broken piece, now ends up 10 hours, beat that.. as well saying service manager attempted in helping, guess what, not only do we have security cameras on our garage and home recording, we also record with ring door bell which in fact will show all time placements. The SD card has been saved for reference .
Regardless of me vs him, I would never do any kind of business with them them, however it is up to everyone to make their choices when it comes to using your money wisely.
Buyer beware...

reviews.author: Daniel Haggar
reviews.text:
A couple weeks ago I hired Blue sky Plumbing for a $12,000 sewer line replacement. On the positive side, Chris was responsive, they helped with the insurance process, and they showed up on time. The trenchers were in and out in about six hours, but unfortunately, that speed came at the expense of my property.

They didn't bother to mark any sprinkler lines and ended up ripping out seven of them during the excavation. When I tested the system the next day, it was a mess: two zones were completely dead and one zone was tied to two valves, causing it to run twice. To make matters worse, the sloppy plumbing work actually caused a sinkhole to form -- several of the hoses were not even hooked up!

I had to take several hours off work to babysit them while they rushed through the repairs, explaining where the zones were while they acted like they were in a massive hurry to leave. While looking at the sprinkler line debacle with the guys fixing it, we noticed that the pinch clamps they used were not installed properly - exascerbating the problem. During the "fix," they removed two sprinkler heads to troubleshoot, but when they put them back, they were pointed directly at the street. I let them know about the heads spraying the street and received no response at all. I had to go out and readjust them myself. After they left, I did another thorough walkthrough and found yet another sprinkler head that is completely dead.

Honestly, if you’re a professional sprinkler repairman looking for extra work, you should hire these guys for a sewer replacement—they’ll give you plenty to do. For everyone else, beware. I’m just going to fix the rest of this myself rather than dealing with the high-pressure attitude I get whenever I call them for repairs. Despite the high reviews, it felt like they only cared about slopping the job together as fast as possible to get to the next paycheck. I will never use them again.

reviews.author: Anonymous R.
reviews.text:
Absolutely horrible service and obscenely expensive.  They installed a hot water heater which was ok, but a bit of a mess that I had to clean up upstairs where they installed it.  However, they left me with a water hammer that rattles and slams my pipes every time the toilet is flushed, but they then claimed weeks later when I called about it that it was not their fault or their problem (and yes they would be happy to charge me a big fee to fix it).  It did not exist before the hot water heater was installed.  The manager was supposed to call me about this, but could never be bothered.

I also found, when I looked around in my crawl space to see if I could fix it myself, that they had ripped off all of the insulation around my vent to the furnace and also left that pile of insulation and all of their scraps for ME to clean up.  Super expensive for the install because they knew I had few other choices, and then they wanted to charge me another huge fee to fix the water hammer that they created by not properly draining and testing the system after the hot water heater install.  

Now I have a HUGE mess in my crawl space to clean up, I have to buy new insulation and re-wrap my venting and try to fix the water hammer myself since I am now so far in debt from the water heater that I simply can't afford to get it fixed by someone else.  Very disappointed and disgusted in this and all of the other work they have done for me lately.  I will not be using them again for anything since I am not interested in having my pocket picked (again) while they then leave me with a big mess to fix (again).

Note:  tried calling the manager as noted below and he never called me back.  Comments here are only for Yelp readers, apparently.

reviews.author: Leigh Ann Jordan
reviews.text:
This is the worst plumbing company around. They have terrible front office management and they are way overpriced. Find a good local plumber and stick with that. The owner of this company is a total fraud. I manage properties and in one of many cases, this company went out on a call for a boiler, charged a lot to "service" (said they cleaned it) and sent a bid for over 2k for additional service. I sent out a second boiler tech from another company, he sent pictures that clearly showed it was not cleaned and he was able to fix it on the spot for a small fee (Under 150). The owner of Blue Sky would  not call me back so I could get a refund for the owner for the lack of service they said they performed and charged us for. He doesn't care. He only cares about making money.
Today I sent Blue Sky to a property for a water heater leak. Of course it needs to be replaced and wanted approval to do the work. I had to ask for a bid. 5000k for a 50 gal gas water heater replacement.
I am having another company do the work for less than half the price. For referene, A Rheem 50 gas 38000 natural gas water heater costs 850.
You MUST give them a credit card so they can charge you without consent. They only care about making money. They hire people who are not well trained and cannot manage communication on every level from the admin to the techs. Worst company ever. Every time I work with them, they are terrible. I only call when I have an emergency but after today, never again. Find a local ethical plumber, don't use Blue Sky. It's unfortunate I have to give 1 star here, they don't even deserve that.

reviews.author: Brad Martin
reviews.text:
We contacted Blue Sky to investigate installation of a mini-split HVAC. The sales consultant was a former installer of other equipment, but seemed knowledgeable about the equipment and was polite and thoughtful. Of note, he'd been with Blue Sky for a long time as an installer and now a sales consultant. Near the end of the tour, he "prepared" us for the coming quote with a number that seemed on the high side, even including rebates from the power company. But he had to work up the quote to refine it.

When we received the quote it was nearly double the ballpark number he floated while at our house.

We replied to the quote to gain understanding. No response.

We received a call from a different person (seemed like an administrative person) asking if we had any questions. We said yes and that we had replied to the quote. The person said they were sitting with our sales consultant and would make sure he got back to us. No response.

We waited a few days and again reached out. No response.

We've since moved on and found not one, but two good companies that provided quotes for the identical equipment at 1/3 the cost quoted from Blue Sky. Those companies were within 4% of each other in price.

The lack of response to our inquiries regarding the written quote provided was unprofessional. We had always heard Blue Sky was very expensive and that was indeed confirmed. There are lots of competent companies to do work and we would encourage potential customers to get multiple quotes if considering Blue Sky.

synthesis.summary: A long-time Denver-area name with 4.8 Google over 4,300 reviews — but Yelp 2.8/100 and the actual review text describe a steady decline: $570 to replace 2 feet of copper pipe, $1,200 quoted for a $271 pump, advertised 24/7 service that doesn't answer at 6:50pm. Multiple reviewers explicitly say they used to recommend Blue Sky and no longer do.
strengths: On-the-clock technicians often described as 'competent' and 'pleasant' even when pricing is disputed
Long history (decades) suggests the company itself is established
weaknesses: Pricing complaints dominate — '$647.28 for the repair' that warranty paid, only $175 refunded; '$570.00' to replace 2 feet of copper line; '$1900' to reset a toilet
Multiple no-shows on scheduled appointments — 'I set an appointment and no one showed... Again no one showed'
24/7 advertised but unreliable — 'over 16 hours and we still haven't heard a thing'
Customer-service rep reported hanging up on customers when complaints raised
Misdiagnosis pattern — reviewers report Blue Sky claiming a $4,300 water heater needed replacement when a $25 drain valve fixed it
redFlags: Repeat reports of 24/7 service not honored on weekends and emergencies
Multiple confirmed no-shows on scheduled appointments
Yelp 2.8 vs Google 4.8 across 100 Yelp reviews — large discrepancy
Customer-service rep reported hanging up on complaints
synthesis.emergencyNotes: 24/7 emergency service is heavily advertised but reviewers consistently report being unable to reach anyone after hours — one waited 16+ hours after evening AC outage; another paid $154 weekend service fee for 10-minute non-diagnosis.

This is the drain and pan install that cost thousands but will never ever look clean or tidy because grime and gunk are sealed into it and it’s visible around and through the strainer.  The pan will always feel cheap and hollow underfoot because it was NOT installed per manufacturer instructions and method. BIG promises, BIG cost, very shabby shameful work. The people they send out to make promises are NOT the people who actually do the work and nothing carefully discussed gets passed on. Save money and aggravation and USE ANYONE ELSE.

reviews.text:
I am 100% convinced the plumber who came out to flush our tankless water heater INTENTIONALLY left us without hot water when we decided not to purchase their annual maintenance agreement. From the moment he left, we have been unable to get anyone from Blue Frog to respond to our numerous calls.  If I don't hear from them soon I will call another plumbing company to resolve our hour water issue and dispute the charge to Blue Frog with my credit card company. Do not use this company! They do not stand by their word!

After doing my own research, the Rinnai is obviously on. However, the plumber did not turn on the proper gas valves to restore the hot water. All I'm asking for is to restore my hot water the way it was before your company flushed my tankless heater!  Owner/Manager/Alan, you asked about my name and I responded. I expected it to be resolved by now!  This is an easy fix!  Dianne Francis

reviews.text: As in all my reviews, I hate the 2-3 hour windows.  My window with blue frog was 10-12.  Martin called at 9:55, that he is on the way.  Prompt courteous guy.  He came to have my hot water tank flushed.  Before Martin began, he told me all the what ifs…He explained all   But fortunately, none of the what ifs happen.  The flush was special $99.00 which is great price, but I also see some other plumbers charging that.  I also gotten an estimate to replace all the fixture inside the tank toilet.  As others pointed out, they are a bit pricey, but he gave me other options, which I thought was quite reasonable.  Martin was great, but I decided to postponed the fixture replacements for now.  Thank you.

reviews.author: jolanta abakanowicz
reviews.text:
I’ve been a client of Blue Frog Plumbing for a long time, and they have always provided excellent service. Some time ago, they resolved a major water backup issue in my kitchen sink after another plumbing company failed to fix it, despite the money I had already spent.
Most recently, Blue Frog Plumbing determined the source of a water leak that caused damage to my bathroom wall. They identified that the leak was coming from the other side of the wall, most likely from my neighbor’s kitchen. Their diagnosis was thorough and professional.
I truly trust their expertise and highly recommend Blue Frog Plumbing for their knowledge, honesty, and reliability.

I didn’t ask for that but I really appreciated the offer. I would recommend Bluefrog plumbing for any plumbing needs.

reviews.text: We had both upstairs showers that really needed the valves replaced so that they would work, and work efficiently, with no leaks. Chris replaced both valves quickly and did a great job! He also let us know about other services that we might benefit from in the future for bathroom upgrades.

reviews.author: Tex Hep
reviews.text:
I recently used Total Plumbing Service for some bathroom work at my home in Melissa, Texas, and I couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, they were fast, friendly, and very reasonably priced—no surprises or upsells.
The technicians, Johnathan and Fabian, were absolutely outstanding. They arrived on time, took the time to explain everything clearly, and provided an exact estimate upfront with no hidden fees. They worked efficiently, completed the job swiftly, and did a thorough cleanup afterward. Honestly, the bathroom looked cleaner than it did before they started—attention to detail like that is rare!
I'm so impressed that I joined their maintenance program right away, and I've already scheduled them for a couple of smaller jobs coming up. If you're in the DFW area and need reliable plumbers who treat your home with respect, look no further. Total Plumbing Service is the real deal—highly recommend!
Thanks again to Johnathan, Fabian, and the whole team!

reviews.author: Penny Robinson
reviews.text: Total Plumbing answered the phone after hours and was able to offer me next day service since it was not an emergency. My serviceman Alexis Cervantez was very knowledgeable and fixed everything I needed. Very professional as well was very kind. And with that ... I very much can appreciate this kind of service. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Steve Brown
reviews.text:
Not a good look when your drivers are going 85(at least) in a 70 on hwy 380.   Truck P-016 3/18/26 at 730pm

Reading a few other reviews about the same problems, maybe your fleet manager needs a talking to as well.

reviews.author: Nad S
reviews.text: Overpriced.  Never again.

reviews.author: Fran M
reviews.text:
2/17/26 Angel and Manny were able to come out same day and were thorough and meticulous with the diagnosis and repair. They were both professional and positive, and I highly recommend!

4/3/24 Joe is always timely and professional. We appreciate his service!

3/11/24 Joe has been out a few times now and always takes care of us in a professional and realistic manner. Thank you!

11/6/23 Evan provided attention to detail with his work, as well as helpful tips to ensure our system was safe and efficient.

3/9/23 Jubal was professional and provided a quality inspection!

2/13/23 Jesse is punctual and straightforward. Much appreciated!

7/13/22 Trevor and Seth were professional and thorough!

1/6/22 Sebastian was responsive and professional, and completed quality work in a timely manner.

4/22 Chris did a great job and and also gave good recommendations on a few other potential issues. We’ve been very satisfied with all the Total Plumbing associates!

12/21 We had a great experience with Raul & Nick, who repaired sewer line leaks in our home. They were punctual, professional, polite, and
communicative throughout the repair process!

11/21 Marco and Nick arrived on time to isolate a sewer line leak that 2 other plumbers missed. While they were here, they installed three new toilets. They were professional, courteous and extremely thorough. They explained the repairs and answered all my questions. We will definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Meghan Lambert
reviews.text:
Excellent service.  I called Total Plumbing out for just a routine checkup, maybe check a few old toilets, tell me about their club membership, look into preventative maintenance.

Chris showed up and delivered exceptional service.  Total Professional.

Didn’t rush me.   Answered all my questions. Educated me without making me feel stupid.

After he gained my confidence and trust he was hired to replace laundry room sink and a day later I read his proposal to replace toilets.

I notified him this morning to install new toilets Friday.  He explained the difference between a total makeover vs new toilet and showed me the estimates and price points of several options.

No guess work. Just no nonsense info.

I became a club member and look forward to partnering with Chris and Total Plumbing for all of our plumbing needs in the future.

We have warranty company for major expenses but hesitate to use just any plumber they may send out from now on.

My husband owns a property and casualty insurance business and he’s already referred a client to Total Plumbing.

Based on my impression of Total Plumbing you will be the only Plumbing Company he refers clients to!!

reviews.author: Stephanie Shaw
reviews.text: We had an outstanding experience with Jubal and this plumbing company. We couldn’t recommend him more highly. He was incredibly professional, punctual, and efficient—completing the job quickly without sacrificing attention to detail. It’s rare to find someone who works this fast while still being so thorough and diligent. Beyond just fixing the issue, he took the time to walk us through what he was doing and offered helpful tips and advice for maintaining our future home. That extra level of care and expertise really stood out.If you’re looking for someone reliable, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to quality work, this is your guy/company! Truly a 5-star experience from start to finish!

reviews.author: Brandy Cloud
reviews.text: My place of employment had Total Plumbing come out and I was impressed with the workers they sent out. We work in a quiet environment. Jubal and Bobby arrived and understood the atmosphere immediately. That is a nice surprise- to not have to explain how to behave in a professional environment. The communication was excellent. They were very respectful of the staff, office and clientele. They did a great job. The issue was resolved quickly. Great guys, would recommend!

reviews.author: Tathi Serna
reviews.text:
Alexis, Trevor, Adrian, Fabian and Raul have been amazing. They did separate items in different times and each one have been very professional, respectful, willing to explain the problems we had, as well as explaining the process. Special thanks to Raul, Adrian and Fabian, they have done an excellent job and being so nice.
To the team in the office, THANK YOU for working with me on the options and time to do the work.

reviews.author: Neil Buhrmaster
reviews.text: I found out my water meter was running constantly and had a mystery leak somewhere. I called Total Plumbing Service and spoke with Cody who let me know they could have someone out same day to inspect. Jonathan Cortez came out later that day and was able to find were the leak was coming from. They were very professional and took care of us quickly so I would recommend them to anyone in need of a good plumbing service!

reviews.author: Lee Kendall
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised they were able to install the new toilet in such a short time and in my tiny bathroom. I've never called a plumber before. My dad was the family plumber, but he is 90 now, so my brother recommended these guys. They diagnosed that it wasn't the new sewer system that the city put in, but the toilet. I didn't realize just how bad the old toilet was until they installed the Kohler.

reviews.author: Leticia Smith
reviews.text: Trevor arrived at home as scheduled. Pleasant, courteous and finished the job as I expected. I thought the price was high for a simple job to replace a corroded faucet and seal a slow drip around shower head connection. Was honest and concurred the price with explanation from company chart pricing and others. With my senior discount I thought the price was still high with the issue I describe above.

reviews.author: Donald Maddux
reviews.text: I received next day service and the plumber (Jesse) arrived during the assigned time frame on that day. He explained two options to solve my plumbing problem. I chose one and he started to work to fix the problem. He was polite, professional, and promptly completed the task. I was impressed with the way my call was handled in the front office and the service provided onsite.

reviews.author: Erin Leigh Caruth Mugavero
reviews.text: The guys were courteous, professional, and finish the job ahead of schedule By two or three days. We had a broken pipe that was pouring water in the front yard, and they diagnosed it and had it dug out and repaired two days after. They have not backfilled it yet, so I hope that all goes well, but these guys have done their job well as far as I can tell.

synthesis.summary: Reviewers consistently call out specific named techs (Jubal, Johnathan, Trevor, Raul, Adrian, Fabian) for clean, on-schedule work and clear upfront estimates. Pricing is the one consistent gripe — 'price was high for a simple job' and 'overpriced' show up even from otherwise satisfied customers. A+ BBB-accredited.
strengths: Upfront fixed-price estimates — 'provided an exact estimate upfront with no hidden fees'
After-hours phone pickup — 'answered the phone after hours and was able to offer me next day service'
Named techs get repeated praise across multiple reviews; appears to be a consistent crew
weaknesses: Pricing runs high for simple jobs — senior with discount still felt overcharged for a faucet replacement
One reviewer: 'Overpriced. Never again.'
redFlags: One review flags drivers speeding 85+ mph in 70 zones — references 'a few other reviews about the same problems'
synthesis.emergencyNotes: After-hours answering and same-day or next-day scheduling is real per reviewers, but the review base is dominated by remodel-style work (replacing pipes, bathroom upgrades) rather than 2am emergencies. No specific 24/7 or emergency mentions.

reviews.author: Gary Sheer
reviews.text: Brett installed our water softener with zero issues. We loved the quick and easy service. Hire Brett!

reviews.author: Bill Blyzes
reviews.text:
Could not have asked for more from Brett and team. Communcation, timely service, knowledgeable, fair pricing - Things that we consumers ask for but rarely get.

Top it off with I found a great referral for my own customers which is extremely difficult these days 😊
Thanks Brett!

reviews.author: Jim Reichert
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Homestead Plumbing. They replaced our wastewater lined and system in our crawlspace. Brett and his crew were efficient, completed the work to a high standard, and cleaned the site up nicely. They were courteous and knowledgeable throughout the process and did the work for a reasonable price. I would recommend them without reservation and will use them again should another plumbing issue arise.

reviews.author: Colette V.
reviews.text: A $59 quoted service call to look at, and possibly repair my A/C unit turned into a $500+ bill.  The service person was more interested in selling me a new A/C AND Furnace.  I declined buying new units.  He put in 2.7 lbs of refrigerant, which costs $200 retail and he emailed me a unitemized bill. My A/C was not fixed. The company did not return any of my calls after I received my bill via email. This company also runs under the name of Hardline.  I would choose another company, any other company would be a much better choice than this one.

reviews.author: Andy W.
reviews.text:
We had a small amount of water in the pan under our water heater.  I called Hardline and spoke to Justin on the phone.  He was very friendly and helpful, and I was able to setup an appointment with Frank for the next day.

Frank arrived at the expected time, and was friendly and thorough in his inspection of the problem.  After running through a series of checks, he found that the problem was that the drain valve was not completely closed, and had a slow drip, which he closed and capped.  It was nice that is was such a simple fix, and that there wasn't any attempt to mis-characterize the problem or try to up-sell things that weren't needed.  The cost of the service was their diagnostic fee plus the cost of the drain cap, which was fair.

I asked several additional questions, and Frank was patient and helpful in answering my questions - I didn't get the feeling that he was just trying to rush out after the job was complete.  He also took some time to point out and explain several other potential issues with some outdated/lower-end plumbing installations we have, which I appreciated.  I also asked for ballpark costs for various repair/replacement jobs, and he give me detailed answers on what various jobs would cost, but it felt more like an informative conversation than a sales call.

I can't speak about having major work done by Hardline, but I felt that they were very professional and friendly in a smaller diagnostic/repair job, and I would plan on using them for future jobs, big or small.  I don't normally write long reviews, but I've had mixed experiences with plumbers/contractors/etc. in the past, so I wanted to leave a positive review for a company that seems to care!

reviews.author: Panno J.
reviews.text:
This company deserves a 6th star  and they take pride in their work. They were efficient, knowledgeable, and respectful... and shine in customer service. Look no where for your plumbing business. 

I had my Bradford White water heater installed by Frank and Brett in a tight closet April 6th 2023 and waited to write this review to ensure their work held. Not only did they do a great job they also educated me on how to operate, debug and drain it annually for maintenance. They were professional and planned their work well in advance, asked for photos and measurements so the process was smooth and seamless on installation day. They charged reasonably, didn't feel like they charged us extra for living in North Boulder like a lot of businesses do. 

Most importantly they treated us like family. I think this extra step of caring for the customer and treating them and their home well really leaves a positive impression for a lifetime. 

The only thing I would say is to be mindful of is their work hours. They are closed on weekends so if you have an emergency after hours or on weekends not sure if they have a service or contact for that. 

History:
I had originally worked with "Justin" from "Hardline plumbing" in 2018 who was also exceptional and but couldn't find them and their business anymore. Looks like Justin had relocated and Frank and Justin had maybe opened Hardline Plumbing together. We now have "Homestead Plumbing and Heating" instead.

reviews.author: Randy S.
reviews.text:
I had a slight leak in a decorative gas shut off valve that was under the counter in a kitchen island and it was Friday afternoon.  I got hold of Justin (Hardline) via Yelp and he was available in 30 minutes - just coming off a prior job.  He assessed the problem, quickly ordered the part and picked it up prior to stores closing.  Whoever put the pipe in originally did not think about having to replace the valve.  Justin had to cut the gas pipling just to get it out and then reconfigured it with an additional union so if the issue came up again, it would be something I could do - I have decent basic skills with this stuff.

Besides a decent price and high quality work (does it the right way), he was very easy to talk to and explained things to me as he completed the job.  Justin has only been in Colorado for 3.5 years, but has established a great business that does small and large jobs.  

I do a lot of stuff myself and am pretty picky on the job done, I would hire Justin (Hardline) again if and when needed.

reviews.author: Honey Ahijevych
reviews.text: We had Homestead Plumbing install 2 new faucets in our house a month or so ago. We had our counter tops replaced and the contractor didn't install our faucets, as promised. At 8pm that night, I found Homestead and they picked up the phone right away. They were due to do another job that night and promised to come first thing the next day. After I hung up, they called me back in 15 minutes and said that their other job fell through due to the weather. They came to our house and installed 2 faucets. It turned out that the contractors had made a mess of our pipes so Homestead had to fix the pipes and install new connectors. They did this in 2 hours and with amazing ease, professionalism. They cleaned up and thank goodness..otherwise we would have had a minor flood and no faucet. I highly recommend them! they are amazing. Great communication and very efficient! Hire them!

reviews.author: Charles P.
reviews.text:
I would definitely recommend their service, and they will be my first choice for all future plumbing work at my house!

As a first time owner, I'm a beginner at knowing what to expect when it comes to maintaining my home. When I decided to switch to a gas stove, the first plumber I called gave me an estimate that seemed huge. They wouldn't itemize their price, and it made me feel frustrated with the process.
Luckily, I didn't give up and I'm so glad Justin from Hardline plumbing was amongst the plumbers I asked for an estimate. Everything was itemized, he was incredibly forthcoming when it came to all my questions and gave me a great impression.
A few weeks later, the work was done and I couldn't be happier. He really went above and beyond, even going so far as giving me a free house visit to ensure the Gas Range delivery men would have it super easy.

reviews.author: Matt G.
reviews.text: I had Mark come over and check out what I needed only 2 days after reaching out to companies in the area.  They were very quick to help and fast responding on yelp!  Mark made the process very easy giving me a couple options for can lights and lights while explaining the pros/cons of them all.  It was also highly appreciated.  I met with a couple other companies to find out Hardline had the best price in the area and promised to do DRY WALLING which is important because most companies do not do this!!!!  So  I ended up choosing them for their services and dry walling capabilities.  Mark and the other electrician were very professional coming over, laying plastic all through the house and finishing the job in only 6 hours.  All in all I was highly impressed and will be using hardline in the future.

reviews.author: Amy V.
reviews.text: I spoke with Justin after another plumbing company came out and was unable to scope the main from my house to the street or identify the cause of a momentarily backed up drain. Justin was very informative, generous and professional during the phone conversation and as a result, I hired him to come to my house to scope, diagnose and repair the problem. He showed up as planned, did excellent work, was very thorough and interested in pointing out specifically what was going on. He identified potential problems to watch for in the future. I never felt he was trying to sell unnecessary services. He was respectful of my home and left it even cleaner than he'd found it.  Justin is now the go-to plumbing service provider for my beloved mid century modern home. Thank you, Justin!

reviews.author: Zachariah Jones
reviews.text: These guys are absolutely lifesavers! We had some pretty bad advice given and work completed by another bigger plumbing company that left us with a replaced shower tile floor that still leaked after a full drain pipe and tile replacement. Frank and Brett had me describe what happened and then came by and accurately diagnosed the issue, what needed to happen to make it right and then also completed the plumbing work properly at a much better rate than the larger company. I will only use Homestead for this kind of work going forward as they have always been incredible fair and honest and are just really good guys. As early home owners it means the world to have a company we can finally trust for this kind of thing.

reviews.author: Shawn R.
reviews.text: Excellent company to work with. They were quick to supply an estimate and even faster to do the work. They are a small company, locally owned and operated. The type of company I like to support they did excellent work and were very fast. I met several of the team and they were all polite, friendly and professional. They even wore show protectors to avoid tracking in any dirt while working. They take pride in doing their work the right way. It's hard to find for of people in the trades, these are good guys and I'd use them again in a minute. We had them fix a sink and an outside frost free faucet both are now working great.

reviews.author: Ad V.
reviews.text:
Integrity, responsive, easy communication, friendly, and really good at what they do. 

Justin and Endi over delivered on everything for the rough-in of my basement bathroom. The communication and scheduling from Amanda and everyone at Hardline was very easy and the job was done faster than I had expected. The cost to add a bathroom in my basement was very reasonable and the quality was exceptional. My wife and I totally scored with Hardline and we won't be going to anybody else for our plumbing needs.

I'm not kidding when I say they go above and beyond what they quote.

reviews.author: Janie S.
reviews.text:
Hardline did an excellent job in four ways. One, their plumbing work is careful and skilled. Two, they willingly fit in to my  short timeline, and made the project finish on time. Three, they were always prompt for their appointments, and would also call when they were heading over, as a reminder to me. Four, their estimate was detailed and carefully explained to me as we were discussing the project, and there were no surprises on the cost at the end of the project. 
Overall, they did great work, and made it all a pleasant experience too.

synthesis.summary: Homestead Plumbing (Frank and Brett) is the Lakewood small-shop counterweight to the big-brand HVAC chains — multiple reviewers explicitly say Homestead came in cheaper than a 'bigger plumbing company' and refused to push replacements when repairs would do. Picture-based quotes, free estimates, and fast 5-minute callbacks are repeated. The single 1-star review is HVAC-related (also operates as Hardline) — a $59 service call that became $500+ with a non-itemized bill.
strengths: Picture-based quotes — multiple reviewers say they didn't have to take time off work for an estimate visit
Repair-first mentality — explicitly fixed problems where a 'bigger plumbing company' had said replacement was the only option
Beat competitor quotes on multiple jobs and refused needless replacements
weaknesses: One HVAC service call (under their Hardline brand) escalated from $59 to $500+ with an unitemized bill — but this is HVAC, not plumbing
synthesis.emergencyNotes: An 8pm faucet-installation emergency was answered immediately and Frank came the next morning. Fast response is documented but specific 24/7 emergency calls (burst pipe at 2am, etc.) are not in this sample.

reviews.author: Jann Boyer
reviews.text:
I had a new water heater installed by Will. Brian did the diagnosis of old heater a month ago, and he was on target: old tank had a lot of debris, way too much to flush out. It was time to replace it.

Alex called early to advise of delay in Will’s arrival, about 40-50 minutes behind  scheduled window. Not a problem and I appreciated the early call.

Will was helped by Fernando during the heavy lifting parts. Otherwise worked efficiently on his own. He was courteous, answered my questions willingly, and cleaned up neatly. He showed me what to expect as air bubbles (from water shut-off) worked through the system. All seems in good order.

reviews.author: Megan Boone
reviews.text: Jorge was fantastic to work with. He struck the perfect balance between professional and personable, making a stressful situation much easier. He clearly knows his craft and took the time to explain the diagnosis in detail. I especially appreciated his honesty—he laid out all my options without any high-pressure sales tactics for expensive repairs.

reviews.author: Dale Becker
reviews.text: Had great service on a recent project with Nate and Erin.  Super professional in all communications, showed up on time and finished the job in a timely manner.  Solutions oriented, no upselling.  Just great service and a professional process from start to finish.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: David H.
reviews.text: I asked Mac-vik to correct the flagged gas leak XCEL had put on a pipe and to review th boiler for proper operation.  I was very specific in describing the location.  It took about two weeks for Mac-vik to show up.  Even though this was a yellow, not red, tag meaning it was not an emergency I thought two weeks was excessive, but they said everyone is busy due to the season.  After spending an hour looking around the technician called me to tell me he could not find the tag and he wanted to charge me $1200 or on the boiler to make it operational and safe.  There was difficulty in communication because he could not speak good English, but he did say the owner would call.  I described to the owner the simple task I had requested and he said he would need to charge somewhere around $150 for the visit.  I told that I felt nothing was done other than providing what I felt was a quote for service I did not think were needed.  Sure enough, another company came in, serviced the leak and billed me $125 within two days of my call to them.  They also said the boiler is working fine.  The next time I heard from Mac-vik was a bill collector.  I never got a bill or a phone call from Mac-Vik, just a call from their bill collector.  I've put two emails out to them since asking where he invoice is asking them to call or email me, but nothing.  I feel these guys run a bad business where even if they perform poorly, you have to pay a ransom.  Their follow-up and customer service magnifies the problem.  I'm waiting for some response, which will probably be someone in collections for me to pay a bill for terrible service.

reviews.author: Spencer S.
reviews.text: My new furnace, under warranty, is not working and no one is answering Mac Vik's phone despite promising and advertising "24/7 emergency service." It is 30 degrees outside. False advertising!

reviews.author: Ripley J.
reviews.text:
I went with Mac Vic after another much larger company stated that I had five gas leaks, after doing an annual furnace tune-up, that were "explosive" and could cause life loss but then left my house with my gas turned on, which was not appropriate. I decided on a second opinion. 

Mac Vic was a lot more affordable and left my home after 1 and a half hours on a Wednesday morning stating that they fixed the one gas leak they found. Their invoice stated one gas leaked repaired, no other gas leaks found. 
After sharing my story with friends and a family friend of another highly reputable plumbing company (not in the area), I was encouraged to have Excel come out to check for gas leaks.  I showed them the disparagement among the two company invoices and they agreed that I should be retested. Unfortunately,  they found at least  one leak, only a few hours after my repair,  and shut me down. That means your meter gets locked and you have to have a full inspection by the city before Excel will unlock your meter.
I called Mac Vic and they agreed to find and repair the missed leak, after initially debating with me about what their invoice stated and who was responsible to repair it, to now pressure test all of my pipes and to unhook and then re hook all of my gas appliances. It came down to their word versus my locked gas meter box..

Once the city Inspector came on Friday at 10:30am, after the repair was made, I was only able to see Excel much later on a Saturday night around 9ish;  they must report to gas leaks first before turning on gas in homes, so you're at the mercy of waiting and you have to be home.  Excel specifically told me that they could not touch another company's repair job to relight the pilot lights; Mac Vic told me that Excel would light the pilots when they unlocked my meter. Excel stated that Mac Vic should know this.
 That weekend the temps were dipping below freezing so I called Mac Vic to have them come out that Saturday night to relight my pilots and get my heat back on.  I was concerned about my pipes freezing.
The Mac Vic tech came out and it took about 10 minutes to relight my hot water heater, gas stove and furnace. The charge was $165.00.
Mac Vic initially told me that I would only be charged an extra $90 for couplings and a permit, which I paid, after I held them accountable for the false invoice. They then stated that they would not reimburse my $165 when they at first stated that they would relight the pilots and then that Excel would do it. They told me that because I used after hours to light the pilots, that I was responsible for the charge.

Mac Vic was initially the hero, but then gave a lot of mixed messages when I reported my gas being shut down by Excel, about who is responsible for what and then tried to state that I, the customer, was responsible for knowing how things like Excel operate, for example.  I couldn't believe it that Mac Vic tried to state that I knew and told them Excel would relight my pilots. This is called displacement, refusal of responsibility or lack of knowledge and poor customer care. When I talked to the owner, he flatly stated that he did more than enough to take care of me and flatly said no to reimbursing the $165 to relight the pilots.
 Yes, Mac Vic did spend approximately 7 hours at my home all day Thursday to fix the second leak and run the pressure test which they did not charge me for, aside from the $90, but which also cost me  time off from work and I was without heat for 4 days; I don't know how long it would have taken another company to repair this second leak. The repairman at one time had to return to the shop to get larger wrenches and a different pressure gauge as apparently the one he was using kept dropping significantly to indicate an unfixed gas leak. I had to take additional time off from work to wait home for Excel to show up.
Also, even though the repairman was a really nice guy and he was always right on time, he uses the old fashioned soap and water method to test for leaks and told me initially that he doesn't like to rely on the gadgets used to test vapor and stated that he never tested my entire crawl space after seeing the invoice from the first company that stated I had five leaks to start.  If the purpose of this was to be boastful about the amount of money that I was charged for the repair of the one leak, well, I was left with a gas leak that Excel shut me down for and that's not what I and my family was asking for as well as the unexpected aftermath.  I relied on Mac Vic to have all leaks discovered and repairs made the same day  the one leak was repaired on that Wednesday and had planned my  work hours to accommodate this.

Now at least I'm much more educated and hopefully you are as well.

reviews.author: A W.
reviews.text:
I had 2 of their people come out today.  They said because I was having 2 of their people out (one for plumbing, one for furnace) I wouldn't be charged for a trip charge twice.  They charge a $60 trip charge!  They are in Golden, I live in Lakewood/almost Golden.  How does that add up to $60?

The furnace guy came out when promised.  However, he didn't call first as the office had written down my wrong phone number.  He was very helpful, informative, and nice.  But he was doing work for less than 40 minutes (including the time it took for him to write my bill).  I am wondering if he stretched out his work to make it go slightly above the half hour.  I was charged 100 for labor, since he was working for slightly more than then 30 minutes (which would have been $50 for a half hour).  

A plumber was supposed to be out/call me around 10:30.  No one called or showed up.  I called them at 11:45.  Instead of apologizing, the guy seemed to think he was doing me a favor.  He was at my home by 12:30.  

He was in my home from 12:30-12:45 and then was outside writing the bill for 5 minutes.  Though he was quick and he seemed kind, he charged me $100 for his labor and told me he had included his drive time in the labor charge, since I wasn't charged 2 trip charges today.
I told him I was getting price gouged and he seemed to think that he had no control over what my bill said.  He said to pay him full and call the office to see if they would give me some of the $ back.

So I was charged a combined $300 total for EXTREMELY minimal work by both men that barely took any time.  Yes, both men were helpful and professional.  But both greatly rounded up, in charging me for their time. 
I also had to sit around all morning, waiting for my 2nd appt.  And no one was apologetic about that.

I did call their office immediately, once the plumber left.  They said they would send me a check $50 for the excess labor charge from the plumber's labor.  We'll see.....

Finally, I found someone who was somewhat empathetic, in the lady on the phone.  She did apologize and say it was a crazy day.  But I still think reimbursing me $50 is too little.  

Though the workers in my home were fine/nice, there seems to be something screwed up with this company's system/management/business model.  It seems their employees are encouraged to try to wrangle every cent they can out of customers by excessively rounding up for labor charges.  Had they not done so, they would have had my repeat business and my recommendation and referrals.  But because of this get-every-cent from the customer mentality, they definitely do not.

reviews.author: Charlene M.
reviews.text:
Quite awhile ago we called Mac Vik w/a plumbing issue. Two men who said they work with Mac Vik sometimes came to do the work. Nice man & his son - pleasant & friendly and did a great job. Also advised me of a part we needed for a guest room toilet & assured me (since I had asked him) that it was an easy part to install. I was reluctant to do it myself what with the potential for leaks & puddles of water, so I called Mac Vik for the second time within the last few months to replace that part (which I had purchased).  

A man came out and instead of replacing the part, he made an 'adjustment' that he said fixed the problem. I asked if he felt that was all that was needed. He said, "it's fixed the problem fine". He repeated that a few times during our discussion. I asked if it was his toilet would he have done the same thing. He assured me he would have. What I completely failed to consider at that moment was that he's a freakin' plumber so if the adjustment failed HE could fix his own toilet!! At any rate, he made me feel comfortable w/the adjustment and charged me $140 (for an adjustment....hello!!??!)  and he left.

The next morning the adjustment was no longer holding (big surprise huh?) and the toilet was running again. I called and the phone was answered by a woman named Joanie who said, "hello" and then stammered and added "Mac Vik". She seemed very distracted by something and wasn't particularly attentive or friendly. I briefly explained the issue to her in a pleasant manner, even making a joke at one point. She then asked if I wanted to schedule an appointment. (I had asked the man who did the adjustment what the cost would have been if he'd replaced the part - $160) Since we had no intention of paying $160 plus the already charged $140 for a simple toilet part, I said 'no thank you' and was in the middle of a sentence when she slammed down the phone and hung up on me. Odd behavior for ANY company. Plus - their 'trip charge' is $90. Exorbitant amount under any circumstances, but especially since their place is in Golden - near west part of Colorado Mills and we're in Green Mountain near the Jefferson County Fairgrounds. Maybe an 8 minute drive apart. Wouldn't recommend this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Amy R.
reviews.text:
DO NOT USE!!!!  I called Mac Vik to clear a basic drain clog.  They were unable to clear the clog, didn't send a person to follow up the next day as promised, and the result was a sewer backup that caused $40,000 of damage to my house.  Drain Terrier came out and was able clear the clog no issue and came out on a Sunday to fix the issue (which Mac-Vik was unwilling to do after they caused all the damage in the first place). Not only that but they wouldn't pay a dime to me to make it right, not taking responsibility for any part of it at all.  I would avoid at all costs.

Update: Thanks for the feedback Tom, it's the first I've heard from you personally throughout this ordeal (the last month and a half), so I appreciate the response.  Feel free to reach out to me directly to discuss, your team has had my contact information since early July, and I'm happy to discuss it with you. It's not surprising that the facts (as you lay them out) are disputed, but what I think your customers really need to know is that a plumber came out and cleared the drain no problem after your plumber couldn't, and that a pipe specialist came out to take a look at the pipe (said it didn't require replacement) and independently told me without me asking that your plumber dragging roots back through the line when he incorrectly cleared it most likely caused the backup into my kitchen. While that is frustrating to me, the follow up customer service is what is most problematic (i.e. I haven't talked to you once since a $40K kitchen loss).  Again, I am happy to talk if you'd like to call me instead of putting all of the facts on this thread.  Thanks, Amy

reviews.author: Ike N.
reviews.text:
I had been a client of Mac-Vik Plumbing a few times in the past and had no issue or problem with them and their work.  

This last time I called them to clear a sewer line.  A tech came out to clear the main sewer line, but only had 110 feet of snake and my line is longer so he spent 4.5 hours working on it with no success.  He came back the next day and had a second person I'd never seen before along to help him.  Later, when I received the bill for $2100 and saw I was charged $475. just for the helper and $125 for the snake extension they brought the second day to complete the job, I tried calling the office, the owner.  After several attempts to reach the owner by phone to discuss/dispute the charges I finally reached the service manager, who asked that i come into their office in Golden to discuss it.  I did so.  The sales mgr. at this point, after going back and forth into the boss' office, did finally drop that $475. Charge and also took off an additional amount of $200 or so.  

While the sales mgr. finally did work with me to correct my bill, I needless to say, will not be calling this company again and would not recommend them at all.  They came to the job day 1 without the proper tools, had to return the next day with the necessary equipment, plus a helper and tried to nickel and dime me with a helper charge $475. and a $125. charge for a snake extension.

reviews.author: L E.
reviews.text:
In reponse to the "Frustrated Contractor " mailing promotion, I requested estimate 12/20/23 for a new HVAC system. The "Comfort Advisor" Alan, came out and prepared 4 quotes based on on site inspection. On 12/22/23, I approved the promotion estimate because good value. That part seemed professional and easy but what came after, is perhaps, a better insight of the company's poor customer business practices. After holidays, I called the company 7 times tfor a callback to clarify size of equipment not included in estimate narrative. I spoke with dispatcher 6 times requesting a call back from comfort advisor.  No promised follow up or call back was provided by comfort advisor. Today they notified me they were NOW to busy to honor estimate and work, that's 62 days after I approved proposal.  If that's the kind of "Bate & Switch" company culture MAK VIK subscribes to, I may have lucked out in the long run.  

(Bait and switch is a morally suspect sales tactic that lures customers in with specific claims about the quality or low prices on items that turn out to be unavailable in order to upsell them on a similar, pricier item. It is considered a form of retail sales fraud, though it takes place in other contexts.) Oxford Dictionary

reviews.author: Randy D.
reviews.text:
I was driving on Interstate 70 eastbound when I was tailgated by a Mac Vik Plumbing and Heating van. The driver then switched lanes and began tailgating the next car further up. This process continued until he was out of my sight. I estimate that the van was less than 3 feet from the bumper of each car it tailgated. I wrote down the number for Mac Vik and called them almost immediately. Heather answered the phone but would not put me through to the manager/owner. So I described the situation to her and she suggested I call the Colorado State Patrol. I asked her to leave a message for the manager/owner and she took my number. The call was not returned. Several days later, I called back to leave another message which was never returned. 
I am forced to conclude that the management doesn't care about this incident.
Why am I writing this on Yelp? Because it may be a good indicator of how they manage their business. A business that won't respond to something as simple as reckless driving probably won't be responsive to your complaint either. Just beware.

reviews.author: Drew M.
reviews.text:
I have two great experiences with Mac Vik in the past few weeks.  FIRST. After driving all over town looking for a particular rubber washer, I ended up at Mac Vik, right down the street from me.  I had been unaware they sold parts. The guy who works the parts counter was out, but the receptionist did her best to look for it for me, but couldn't find it.  When I went back, the guy let me know I was looking for the wrong part all along and told me how to fix my faucet.

Second: I needed some corroded pipes replaced and called a few places to do an estimate. Andy came out exactly when he said he would. He took one look at the problem and knew what to do right away.  He called me later with his estimate,, which was about half of what the bigger chain was going to charge me. His fix was far less complicated than what they wanted to do. His plumber came out when scheduled and got the job done in just a few hours.  

From my first phone call, to the plumber cleaning up and leaving, everyone I dealt with was pleasant and professional

reviews.author: Alta T.
reviews.text:
They don't care about client safety and will put clients at risk for their profit.

We used Mac Vic in the past but, they just got weird about client safety and refused to send anyone because I asked about Covid vaccination status. We are elderly and at-risk, so we want the protection.

They incorrectly claimed it was a HIPAA issue, which it is not. Go to HHS website and read it for yourself.
https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/privacy/guidance/hipaa-covid-19-vaccination-workplace/index.html

When I pointed out their error, they refused to accept the truth and apologize. It seems that they are dead set against being vaccinated for whatever reason, especially client safety.

If they sent a worker who could not present a valid vaccine card, they said that they would charge us $75 if we sent him away for not being protected.

Beware of companies who do not care about your safety, especially when we are in the midst of a worldwide Pandemic.

reviews.author: C J.
reviews.text: Hot water heat boiler went down. Called after hours, they called back with in a couple of hours.  They were still on a call, and at least I knew the story.  Went over the procedures over the phone and figured out what was wrong.  It was 7 degrees out side and my house was 41 degrees with no heat.  They showed up the next morning with what was needed, fired up the unit, went to get the official parts and were done in a couple of hours.  The tech Rick, handled it from start to finish and knows what he is talking about.  The trip charge @60 and the tech charge@100 hr might seem high. But not wondering if they are going to show up, and knowing what and how on residential boilers, the money is well spent.  The company is under new owners and they also know what they are doing. And my contacts in the plumbing supply business, say they are legit.  No regrets.

synthesis.summary: Mac-Vik has 1,438 Google reviews at 4.9 — but Yelp tells the other story at 2.9 across 45 reviews, with detailed multi-paragraph complaints describing pricing that doubled within a year for the same service, a $40,000 sewer backup after a missed follow-up, and a 30-degree night where their advertised '24/7 emergency service' didn't answer the phone. Strong individual techs (Marius, Jorge, Will) get good reviews; the management layer above them has been flagged repeatedly for years.
strengths: Specific techs deliver clean installs — 'Will... worked efficiently on his own. He was courteous, answered my questions willingly, and cleaned up neatly'
Camden gave a no-pressure quote on a home power system — 'gently corrected my misconceptions... communicated when we strayed away from his expertise. His price quote was reasonable'
Solutions-oriented for some larger jobs — 'Solutions oriented, no upselling. Just great service and a professional process from start to finish'
weaknesses: Pricing has reportedly doubled — 'I was charged $530.00 for replacement of a water-heating system zone-valve motor. This charge is more than double the charge of $168.75 for the same service' a year earlier
Bait-and-switch reported on a HVAC quote — 'they notified me they were NOW too busy to honor estimate and work, that's 62 days after I approved proposal'

Subcontractors charged through Mac-Vik delivered poorer work — 'MacVik really let us know by sending a subcontractor, Snappy Sewer Service. They did a terrible job, charged $450 for a service we later learned should've been $300'
redFlags: Two separate December 2025 reviews report the advertised 24/7 emergency line going unanswered when furnace was out in 30-degree weather
Sewer-clog clearing job that allegedly caused $40,000 in kitchen damage with no accountability — 'they wouldn't pay a dime to me to make it right'
A representative reportedly arrived for a quote 'appeared intoxicated, was stumbling, repeating himself'
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Despite advertising 24/7 emergency service, the most recent emergency reviews (Dec 2025) describe the line going unanswered when callers had no heat in freezing weather. Treat the 24/7 promise as marketing.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 2.9 vs Google 4.9 across 45 Yelp reviews — the Yelp distribution describes pricing and accountability issues that don't surface on Google

plumbers.name: King Rooter & Plumbing | Plumbers Denver, CO | Drain Cleaning | Sewer & Water Line | Tankless Water Heater Repair
plumbers.address: 100 Fillmore St #500, Denver, CO 80206, USA

reviews.author: Scott Forsythe
reviews.text: Professional, prepared, no quit until it’s done right. Courteous to our needs. Would recommend.  Repaired sewer line and Installed liner.

reviews.author: Patrick Hansen
reviews.text:
I made a service call on a Sunday evening and they were able to schedule a visit the very next morning.

They were very friendly & helpful service over the phone and with discussing info about my plumbing problem and with the scheduling.

I was dealing with an internal basement sewer main clean-out issue with an older cast iron pipe.

Dan, the technician arrived at the expected time in the morning, was friendly, knowledgeable and very informative.

He listened to my issues and what I have been dealing with. He accessed the problem and provided 3 potential options with very reasonable pricing.

We discussed the options and chose the best route for my needs, and proceeded w the repair. He had to depart momentarily to retrieve some materials, but came back quickly to start the project.

Dan handled the repair within a couple hours after returning & starting. When he was done, he notified me and I went down to review the work, it was a solid clean repair which aligned to what we discussed & agreed upon. He also did a great job cleaning up the area - couldn’t even tell he was there or a repair was recently made.

I am very satisfied with Dan and this company.

Overall, they were very helpful, friendly, timely, reliable, knowledgeable, and offered reasonable pricing.

I will definitely work with them again for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jack Sims
reviews.text:
King Rooter teamed up with Anytime Plumbing from Santa Fe, New Mexico to do a re-line project at Kendall HOA, Purgatory Ski Resort, Durango, Colorado. It was an extensive project that  required re-lining the entire plumbing system in a 5 story building. It was over $2,000,000.00 in work that had to be completed in 4 months. Considering multiple hidden conditions, King Rooter and Anytime Plumbing did an excellent job.
Jack Sims
President Kendall HOA

reviews.author: Samuel Montano
reviews.text: DONT GIVE THEM YOUR BUSINESS. MAKE SURE THEY SHOW YOU HARD COPIES OF THE ESTIMATE BEFORE YOU AGREE TO ANYTHING.  For my mom’s residence. Water was coming up from the floor sewer. They came and talked my mom into 1500 dolors worth of work. My mom thought she was getting the pipe fixed so it wouldn’t leak anymore. They were called to fix a leak. Turns out they were there to snake the drain and replace pipe above ground that is not leaking. Therefore leaving the leak in the ground unattended. Then after saying that she needs to pay more for a coating. When she was under the impression that the leak repair was included in the estimate. They left and never gave my mom an estimate on what it would cost to fix the leak it’s been a week. This company is BS. STAY AWAY.

reviews.author: Thad Hunter
reviews.text: I took their earliest appointment which was a week out. They called and canceled the morning of the appointment and offered another appointment a week later. After stating this is an unacceptable solution they said maybe someone could make it out in two days.  Not a professional company. Call someone else.

reviews.author: Cynthia Wellbrock
reviews.text:
Two weeks ago I had an emergency situation with the main line from my house to the sewer terribly blocked and water was backing up into my basement.  Brandon and Jeff came out the next day, diagnosed the problem, set me up with a temporary fix until the team could come out with the  "big gun" and scrape out all the gunk in there a few days later.   They did a great job and my drain is like new!.

Three years ago I had two issues that needed to be repaired,.  The owner came out and inspected the situation, explained everything clearly to me and gave me an estimate for the parts and service.  The actual servicemen they sent were extremely professional and polite.  They had to cut into my basement ceiling for one of the repairs and they cleaned up everything before they left.   I had questions about the two items they replaced and they patiently explained everything to me about how to adjust them, etc.   I would definitely recommend using this company.

reviews.author: Billy Ortega
reviews.text:
Jeff and the team at King Rooter are great to work with! I had them come out to my home to repair a leak on an irrigation line. When I called and scheduled, they said they would let me know when the tech was on the way. As promised I did receive a call from the technician one hour before he arrived at my home. When the technician arrived, he immediately found the problem and explained what needed to be done. A few minutes later, I received a call from the service manager, who gave me three options for the repair. Once I chose the option for me, they immediately got to work and repaired the leak within 30 minutes. What I really enjoyed about this is that there was no pressure on either option.

I also received a call from Jeff the owner later on that day to make sure that I had received satisfactory service.

I recommend King Rooter for all of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Joseph Rosas
reviews.text:
Jordan was extremely helpful in replacing an outside faucet, installing a pressure regulator valve, and replacing the old galvanized pipe with PEX tubing.

Initially there was a leak in the original galvanized pipe after work, which took a couple days to find a solution, and we ultimately replaced all the galvanized with pex and copper. The job was bigger than any of us expected, however, I appreciated they came to our house three times, a supervisor helped present solutions on the last visit, and they credited my payment from job that didn’t hold originally to the final job.

They were professional and persistent with the challenge, and I do feel they made an effort to make sure we felt the price was fair and the job was done well. Thank you to Jordan and Hank for your help.

reviews.author: Ken Trujillo
reviews.text: I contacted King Rooter Plumbing through a friend who referred them to me. I explained and sent King Rooter a video of a leak that we were very concerned about. King Rooter came over to my son in laws home and Robert and supervisor diagnosed the issue replaced the PRV and stayed at the house until everything was back to normal. They were efficient, professional, friendly and amazing to work with. We were very pleased and I would recommend King Rooter plumbing to anyone who is having an issue or emergency issue related to plumbing.

reviews.author: Libby Pavelec
reviews.text: Overall a great experience. Had them come fix a toilet on my commercial property. A couple hiccups getting scheduled due to being booked at a time not available and then technician not having time as the new scheduled time. Team was great at rectifying the situation with a small discount to make up for the mishap. Kollette in the office is great at communicating, always updating on when the tech is on their way, etc. Tech was great about providing different options at different price points to fix the toilet.

reviews.author: Christopher Thomas
reviews.text: Jonathan is the man! He was able to come to my house and diagnose the issues I was having with my Shower as well as help me get a toilet installed. I cut my hand while doing a remodel, so having King Rooter send out a tech to help me complete some work at my home was greatly appreciated. I work in the construction industry and must say it was a joy to work with a company as well a plumber who do great work and give it to you straight. Again thank you and Jonathan for helping me get my bathroom working again.

reviews.author: Stacy E
reviews.text: Jonathan and Brandon came to the rescue with our sewer line emergency.  The line was broken under our 100 year old garage, 5 feet down.  They were great! Not only professional,  but quick to diagnose the problem, figure out a solution and fix the break.  The repair was completed in a few hours,  all while taking into consideration the structural integrity of the garage.  When finished, it was if they hadn’t been there. Considering the stress of the situation,  we couldn’t be happier with the experience.

reviews.author: Evan Lay (Evanthegirl)
reviews.text:
Update: the owner reached out and has offered to make things right. She was out of town when this happened and the manager handled it very poorly. Updating to 4 stars because the work was done quickly and the crews were nice. Thank you, Stephanie!

I had a cracked cast iron pipe in the basement replaced by King Rooter. The quote was about half as much as our normal plumber's quote, and the reviews are good, so I decided to go with them. The work was done quickly and the crew was polite.

reviews.author: Carly
reviews.text: They did a fine job, but they blew sewage out of the cleanout into our yard and didn’t clean it up. They also dumped all of their trash, including unsealed bags of sewage, into our recycling. Because they were not tied, they had spilled all over our recycling can already, plus me while I was moving them. Additionally, they used items around our yard like our dog’s water bowl to clean out the sewage and left them filthy, smelly, and unusable.

reviews.author: Erin Wills
reviews.text: King Rooter & Plumbing was amazing. I had an issue with a backed up French drain, causing standing water and water in my basement. Al came out to inspect the issue. He gave me 3 options for solutions, talked through each one, and made me feel confident in his expertise. Before booking, I called for clarification. Whoever I spoke with reassured me, answered my questions, and was very kind. The repair process was painless. I am very pleased!

synthesis.summary: Strong on bigger jobs — sewer line relining, $2M condo replumbs, no-pressure 3-option quotes — and reviewers single out specific techs (Hank, Mario, Jonathan, Jordan) for clean work. The catch: scheduling has visible cracks, including one same-day cancellation that bumped an appointment a full week, and one reviewer reports techs dragging wet equipment through carpet without protection.
strengths: Reviewers consistently get 3 priced options with no-pressure presentation
Specialty in sewer line relining and root removal — large-scale projects (5-story HOA) completed on time
Same-day or next-morning scheduling on Sunday evening calls
weaknesses: One reviewer's appointment was cancelled morning-of and offered a week later
One reviewer reports techs left sewage-stained recycling and dog water bowls behind
Tarp for protecting carpet was an additional charge
redFlags: One detailed review alleges techs sold an unrelated $1,500 above-ground pipe job to an elderly customer who called about a leak — leaving the original leak unaddressed
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Sunday evening calls schedule for next morning, sump emergencies and sewer backups handled within hours by techs other companies couldn't diagnose. But one same-day cancellation and a week-out earliest appointment suggest capacity isn't always there.

reviews.author: Chris Russell
reviews.text:
Steven did an outstanding job clearing a very stubborn kitchen sewer blockage. He showed up on time, diagnosed the issue quickly, and explained everything clearly before getting to work. What really stood out was his persistence—this wasn’t an easy clog, but he stayed with it until the line was fully cleared and flowing perfectly again.

His professionalism, skill, and respect for my home were top‑notch. If you need a plumber who knows what he’s doing and takes pride in doing the job right, Steven is the one to call. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Taylor Maxwell
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was great! We had a bit of an emergency and they were here within an hour on a Saturday night. Mason was very knowledgeable and handled everything efficiently and professionally. They will be our choice anytime we have a plumbing issue.

reviews.author: Logan R
reviews.text: Called for an emergency issue and crazy enough Steven can out to help. I’ve worked with him before at another location and was more than pleased with the service he provided.
