reviews.author: Andy W.
reviews.text:
Use anyone else other than this completely rip off company.  Not only do they outright lie, they charge far too much for an easy job I could have done myself.  
My house is close to 7 years old and never had any issues until suddenly our drainage stopped. No toilet would flush.  Tried using a snake and even removed the toilet as we thought a toddler had put something down in the drain.  Nothing.  Called for service and they came out. Just to flush the line with their snake was $399 after a discount.  That only took about 15 minutes.

They put a camera down into the sewer line and said there was a broken pipe.  Said the line was 4 feet deep and they had a way to go in and repair it without digging up the yard. Cost was $3,000.  What choice do I have.  I'm old and can't really dig down 4 feet. Or at least didn't want to so we agreed.  Guy came out to do the work the following morning.  Suddenly he is driving away.  Salesman calls and said there was some sort of data line and they would have to dig it out and do the repair.  The cost is now $4900 but would only charge $3200.  That changed to $3000.  Said they would bring in digging equipment and blah, blah, blah.  He said they would be out first thing in the morning two days later.  They didn't show until right at 5pm.

They only used shovels and we found it wasn't a data line, but the sprinkler pipe. It had been broken even before we moved in and miraculously lasted all this time. But the pip was barely 2 feet deep.  No digging equipment was used after he made it sound like this grand undertaking that was necessary.  I sent the guy a text and asked him if his price was anywhere close to fair and he said yes.  I stated 3 guys who used about $30 worth of parts and were here and gone within 1 hour 45 minutes was really worth 3 grand.  He said the cost going to an emergency room wasn't fair, but he had to pay.  He was turning into a real jerk.  They lied about the depth and when they didn't even have to dig as far as he stated, cutting their time by a massive amount you would think they would discount their already outrageous price.  He said he was coming out to put a camera in the line to make sure it was done properly.  After my questioning he never showed.  He turned out to be a worthless piece of garbage liar.   I never mind paying a fair price for service.  I hate snakes who use the situation to get as much as they can.  He was one of those snakes and the company he represents don't appear to be much better.  Told the person on the phone and rather than do something about it, just said file a review on their site.  You can't!  NEVER, ever use them.  Wait until a reputable plumber can get there.  They are overpriced thieves in my opinion.

reviews.author: J C.
reviews.text:
started as an electric water heater (6 yrs old) making a noise. when they left I called them back re: a leak in the wall. ended up a pipe under the master bathroom with water shooting up into the closet, bathroom, around vanity and into dining room. we went 2 days with the water shut
off to the house. they came to repair. trenched out hole under the bathroom and fixed the pipe with the small hole in it. quoted price and set me up with financing with no interest. I had to digitally sign several times for the water clean up. the invoice I was given the plumber said he was leaving out the water restoration costs but my insurance would know and it was included in the financing. I started getting calls from restoration companies in NY, CA, San Antonio TX and Ohio. I didn't sign a thing with any of them and the company in Ohio is telling me I signed with them using a digital signature and it's the cost of my deductible. they have taken my digital signature with a local company and sold it or something to these frauds for payment. I had zero work done by any of them nor did I sign anything with them. I have the total costs financed and made my 1st payment. PLEASE
DO NOT USE THEM. THEY ARE NOT TOTALLY FORTHCOMING AND SOMETHING WEIRD IS GOING ON. I will NEVER use them again and I will 100% not recommend them to anyone. I had used them a few months prior to clean out the pipes from the house to the city. I also was conned into a filter on my hot water tank. which was also said that he was leaving it off the bill but was included. because I asked him about the warranty. they took more dirt from the tunnel they made under the house than what they put back. they said they fill the hole with water then put enough dirt in to complete the fill. and that the dirt will expand over time. no it's going to settle and the dirt is gone to fill it up with. all the plumber, liaison , and the water restoration guy abandoned us when these 3rd parties got involved. the third parties have been nothing but nasty. I don't owe some lady living in Ohio anything. I asked them to cease and desist. but it's still going on.

reviews.author: Samuel B.
reviews.text:
We contacted Roto-Rooter because our washing machine was causing water to backup into a wall. We shared we had just bought a house and believed the problem was the washing machine pipe had a 2 inch output whereas the wall drain was 1.5 inch. They sent a "drain technician" to the house who said he didn't think that was the problem and said the line just needed to be cleaned. He snaked the line and sold us a cleaning solution. Total cost was over $500. Right away, as soon as we did a load of laundry, the same thing happened. The pipe does drain water - it always drained water - but cannot handle the output of the washing machine. 

We contacted Roto-Rooter to convey the situation. They said the line cleaning was warrantied for 6 months and they would send a technician to clean it again. After some back and forth, they agreed that a dirty line was likely not the problem and said they would send an actual plumber who would be qualified to fix the problem. I was not aware the first employee was not qualified to do plumbing work and, since we conveyed what we thought was wrong from the onset, I'm not sure why an unqualified technician was ever sent. 

The problem is Roto-Rooter completed unnecessary work. While they will now send an actual plumber, they said the repair will be completely separate and we will have to pay again. I asked if they would apply the funds from the unnecessary work and they said no--since there is no way to prove there wasn't some level of clog as well. We will be using another company for the repair as we obviously have no confidence in Roto-Rooter, and there is no reason to use them since they will treat it as a completely different charge.

We are now in the same situation we were in at the start--except we are over $500 in the hole. Save yourself from our mistake, call someone else.

reviews.author: B W.
reviews.text:
My kitchen drain was slow, I searched internet and found Roto Rooter with good reviews, so submitted a request online. A technician called Eric came to my house yesterday afternoon, not only he made problem worse but also created new issues and left us with all the mess. The sink is now completely clogged with new leaking at three different places. 

He broke my under sink pipes and waste disposal connections yesterday, asked me to change to new pipes and a new waste disposal, we agreed. So he came back today and installed the new pipes and waste disposal. We tried to test it after he completed the work, he said no need to test. We insisted to test it and the pipe connections started to leak within two minutes. First he tried to find an excuse but then committed it was an issue, he tried to fix the issue without success so decided to leave it as is. 

We paid him 50% yesterday and agreed to pay another 50% after completing the work, but with all these issues we decided not to pay the rest 50%, he threatened us to call collecting company to get the money. We called their customer service but they would not come until tomorrow knowing our kitchen sink is completely out of order because of their work. This is the WORST experience we've ever had.

reviews.author: Brice R.
reviews.text:
Update :

In October 2022, I had a shower valve replaced and it cost approximately $750.  On May 11, 2023 (after days of calling to try and get someone out to my house) - Roto-Rooter came out to replace the shower valve cartridge in the same bathroom; however, immediately we noticed that when the hot water was turned on, there was a loud noise, so today (5/23/23) Roto-Rooter came out again and told me that in order to fix the problem they would have to rip out the tile (which they would not be able to replace) and then it would cost $1,500 for parts and labor.  I asked the plumber (the same plumber that did the original work in October 2022) why he didn't tell me this option back then and he said that we got a free cartridge on May 11, 2023.  This was an incredibly rude response and shows that he does not care about the customer at all.  Overall, I am extremely disappointed in this company and will never use Roto-Rooter again and will make sure everyone in our neighborhood knows about the awful customer service I experienced.

reviews.author: Melody McGee
reviews.text:
Last night around 6 PM, a pipe burst under our kitchen sink. We called Roto-Rooter, and they assured us someone would be out as soon as possible. Ken, the water damage field supervisor, showed up quickly, assessed the issue, and thankfully confirmed that our water damage was minimal. He was very professional and upfront that it might be a few hours before a plumber could come since they were handling some big jobs.

Around 9 PM, the home office called to let us know the earliest available appointment would be first thing in the morning, and they even offered a discount for the inconvenience — which we really appreciated.

Robert arrived promptly this morning, was super knowledgeable, and explained all our options clearly. He worked efficiently, and our sink is now back to normal!

We’re giving 4 stars only because we had to wait until the next day for the repair, but overall, the experience was great. The team was professional, reliable, and took good care of us. We’d definitely recommend Roto-Rooter!

reviews.author: Dustin G.
reviews.text:
I have had them out before to do a line clearing.  Took about an hour and it was $460.  That's fine.  I am well off enough that it's not a big deal. 
But...
When I call to have you come out a few months later to price gouge me on changing 2 shower valves and a toilet ball stem, because I'm willing to pay it, you don't even show up. No phone call or text.  No email. Nothing.  Til about 4:35pm. Appointment was for 12-4 with a $65 service fee.  They call at 4:35 to tell me "Good news, we have a tech in the area to take your service call". Well it's too late.  "Do you want to reschedule?" 
Well, if there is no service charge then sure. "Oh, no we can't do that, but if you change your mind give us a call back". 
Uh...no thanks.  You lost out on easy money and could have charged the full amount or maybe more but no no no. You couldn't even do common business protocol. That's too bad.  I'll call Belkeys! Lol.

reviews.author: Michael D.
reviews.text:
I had a clogged drain on my patio and had previously used another company twice (in 11 years) to clear out the drain. They charged $99 but due to the current situation had increased their charge to $169.  I decided to contact Roto-Rooter to get a second bid.  
The technician arrived and said the cost would be $365 per hour for a minimum of 2 hours.  When I said that was not acceptable, he said, "What if I just charge you for an hour?"  I told him that I had contacted another company and had decided to go with them.  He asked what they were charging and when I answered $169, he said, "What if I call my company and can do the job for $200?".  I escorted him out and thanked him for coming out.  
Coronavirus Gouging.

synthesis.summary: A textbook 'fast response, predatory pricing' chain — they will get there same day, even on Saturday night, but expect $400-$700 minimum quotes for jobs other plumbers do for $80-$200. Multiple Yelp reviews describe broken pipes, signed digital paperwork sold to third-party restoration scammers, and refusal to quote over the phone. Steven, Mason, and Robert get genuine praise, but they're the exception.
strengths: Steven cleared a stubborn kitchen sewer blockage and stayed until the line ran clear
Same-day response on Saturday night for a kitchen sink emergency
weaknesses: Charged $552 for a clogged toilet that turned out to be a septic-pump issue (homeowner solved it themselves)
Tech Eric installed a new disposal that leaked at three places within minutes — refused to retest before claiming the work was done
redFlags: Multiple reviewers report digital signatures from restoration paperwork being passed to third parties in NY/CA/Ohio with bogus deductible claims
Refuses to give pricing over the phone, then quotes 4-5x competitor rates once on site
$3,000 quoted for a 'spot repair' that turned out to be a 2-foot-deep sprinkler line broken before move-in
Repeated no-shows: 3-day cancellations on emergency calls, 5+ hour late arrivals
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Saturday night and Thanksgiving service confirmed in some reviews, but offset by repeated no-shows and 'cancelled my appointment 3 days in a row for emergency services because they couldn't locate their technician.'

reviews.author: Patrick A.
reviews.text: Called Baker Brothers on the recommendation of a neighbor because of a possible slab leak.  Technician came out same day which was great but failed to find the leak. Said we would have to replace the homeowners valve (2100$$) to begin the process of elimination to determine the source of the leak. When I asked about infrared thermal imaging he said he didn't know what I was talking about. Cost me 60 bucks and I still have no clue where my leak is coming from.  Gonna call someone else!

reviews.author: Jo Ann G.
reviews.text: I called Baker Brothers out to repair a commercial faucet. The only thing that was wrong was the small handle on the faucet needed to be replaced. They quoted me almost $600 and told me that because it was commercial it cost more. I sent them on their way because I thought this was highway robbery. reviews.author: Mark W.
reviews.text:
Customer service, in terms of communication with the customer, sadly, appears to be the weak link of this company. Furthermore, when they do communicate, the level of unprofessionalism is simply breathtaking. This review is not about the competence or quality of work by their plumbers, at all, just for clarity. This review is about customer service, professionalism and attitude.

Thus, viewing through this lens, below you will find a text I received from their field supervisor for our area. For context, I was given an estimate the day prior for over $7000 to do the plumbing work that I desired to have done. I needed to absorb this massive amount for a bit and had told this supervisor to give me a couple days to think about it. However, about an hour after talking to him the next morning, with a few questions I had, I just decided...let's just get the job done. So, I messaged the supervisor back at around 11:AM and asked him to please give me a call when he got a chance. Obviously, I didn't expect not to hear from him for another eight hours. I was ready to ink the contract and go. However, by 6:30 pm that evening I still hadn't heard from him, didn't hear from office staff, or otherwise. Ziltch. Just left hanging.

So, once again I messaged the supervisor and let him know that it appears I must not be relevant to them as a customer and thus, I would just take my business elsewhere. Again, zero customer service, I had no choice. I needed to roll since we've got a bad prv out here. Okay, maybe the supervisor was busy, you ask? Have the office team reach out to me... that's called professionalism! That's called customer service! Stop for 30 seconds and let me know you're tied up, will get back with me as soon as you can. A $7100 project was on the line here, folks. A dismal customer service failure. And, when the supervisor finally did reply back to my final text message... this is the message he sent back to me:

"I'm sorry you're not my only customer I've had to talk to today you said for me to call you when I had a chance. And I'm also sorry I don't have a set schedule" for work.

Wow! Shockingly unprofessional response that exposes an attitude that's unacceptable. In other words, sorry buddy, I got more customers than you...deal with it.

Folks, there's your sign. They just lost a very nice $7100 job. I will never use Baker Brother's again. Would you? After years in senior management for the largest news company in America, great customer service means alot to me. It truly matters, big time. If companies feel customer service is not a top priority and desire to become famous for subpar customer service...we, the customers, can let all of DFW and America know. Actually, that's my speciality with a news background. Only as necessary, I'm sure customers would be more than happy to oblige, pursuant to their own personal experiences for receiving less than satisfactory customer service.

Mark Welch
President
Fox Studio
(Retired)

reviews.author: Ray I.
reviews.text:
High-Cost Installation, Zero Post-Sale Support or Communication

This review is regarding a $31,000 investment (a $25,000 system/install plus $6,000 for additional insulation) that has failed to deliver on professional customer service or clear communication.
​Failure to Offer Maintenance: I was never offered a maintenance plan at the time of the initial system installation (two years ago). As a customer who just spent $31,000 on a new system and insulation, I absolutely would have purchased a maintenance plan if it had been presented to me.
​Blaming the Customer: Two years later, when I called for service, the company now informs me about the necessity of maintenance and attempts to shift the blame to me for the system not being properly maintained. I relied on them, as the supposed experts, to advise me on how to protect my massive investment.
​Poor Management Response: When the issue escalated to a manager, the conversation was unproductive. Despite my clear frustration--and while I acknowledge I used some strong language--Oscar the manager attempted to prematurely terminate the call by claiming I was talking over him, even though he was doing the same to me.  The conversation just felt like lines were drawn and he was defending the company, placing the blame on me rather than taking care of me as a valued customer.  And today, the service was extremely disappointing, especially after paying a discounted rate of $305. All the technician did was pour water in a tube and blow air into it. This minimal effort took less than 5 minutes, which felt like a complete waste of money for the diagnostic value provided.
​Unresponsive Call Center/AI: The company uses an automated AI answering service, which often feels like a way to avoid customer service. My issue was classified by the system as "urgent" and escalated over an hour ago, yet I still have not received the promised callback.
In ​Conclusion: This company installed a high-cost system but is indistinguishable from "the rest of the run-of-the-mill companies" when it comes to professionalism, follow-through, and customer support. The lack of proactive communication and subsequent blame-shifting is unacceptable.  I used to highly recommend this company, but I'm not sure that I can do that any longer after my experience with them today.

reviews.author: Jody S.
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Bakers Brothers and would strongly caution others before using them.

I originally called because my electricity was acting strange while Oncor was actively working on nearby lines. Bakers Brothers told me it would be a $60 diagnostic fee, which I agreed to. When the power issues seemed to improve, I called to cancel--but was encouraged to keep the appointment "just to be safe." That turned out to be a costly mistake.

When the technician arrived, I explained the situation and he observed voltage fluctuations that were likely tied to the ongoing utility work. Instead of advising me to wait until the external repairs were fully complete, he began recommending upgrades.

He quoted me $1,266 for a surge protector upgrade, then escalated to $2,548 total after talking through additional "lightning protection" components. He used personal anecdotes about damaged homes he's seen and emphasized warranties and protection coverage, and signing up for a membership could save me $400 on the work today. Which made the situation feel urgent and risky to ignore. Based on that, I agreed.

After installation, I reviewed the receipt and found it was charged as two identical items at $1,266 each, with a note saying installed three components. When I researched those parts myself, I found retail prices around $185, $94, and $79--roughly $338 total. Even with labor,  Industry guidance suggests installed costs typically fall in the $500-$800 range. I was charged over $2,500.

When I called to question this, I was told the pricing reflects their overhead (call centers, fleet, etc.) and warranties. That explanation does not justify such a massive markup, (312%) especially given the circumstances and the sales pressure.

I feel taken advantage of during a situation that was likely temporary and caused by external utility work. What should have been a simple diagnostic visit turned into a high-pressure upsell with pricing that appears significantly inflated.

 I would recommend getting multiple quotes and doing your own research before agreeing to any work with this company.

reviews.author: Jeff Jasenof
reviews.text:
Had a horrible experience with Baker Brothers. Ordered a new water heater. Install was completed. I received a huge gas bill. Turned out when installed they set it to the highest setting. Called Atmos who said that was the problem. Called Baker Brothers and spoke to a very rude person in some department. She asked for the last three months of my gas bills. I sent them and they would still do nothing. One top of that the installer told me the City of Plano would be out on a certain date to inspect the water heater. I stayed home and nobody showed up. Called Baker the next day. Lady on the phone said it was inspected over the internet. No apologies, nothing. Now it only gets worse. No hot water. Called Baker. Guy comes out hardly looks at the water heater and says I have a hot water leak. I called to ask for another tech. The second tech came out the next day. He checked the hot water heater , pulled off a hose and said the gas was off. Apparently Atmos turned off the gas after I called them. I had it turned back on immediately. Now the situation gets worse. The second tech.wants to check for leak. He charges $454.00 to check. He says we have one but he is not sure where it is. I said how much when you find it.,He says over $14,000 to fix it. I call another plumbing company. They come out and charge me $250.00 to locate the leak. They had to do a lot of digging. The final bill was $6500.
Do not use Baker Brothers under any circumstances. People are rude, in competent, and prices are crazy. Only the last person I saw from Baker Brothers knew what he was doing. Stay away, they will rob you.
I am 82 years old, a widower with a disabled son. Shame on them for treating a senior citizen like this.

reviews.author: Teresa H.
reviews.text:
July 31, 2025 started out with us getting a roof that we had to pay for through Mesquite Roofing and construction.  The process of getting the roof install was pretty smooth until the workers hit the a water line on the water heater leaving damage to the attic water wise,  leaving Sheetrock damage in the garage area.  Bakers Brother was the company that installed the water heater with the exception of the pilot light going out twice,  it's had been a deceit experience.  They came out each time and showed up on the same day of the call.

Fast forward Baker Brother (Bobby Townsend)said the water line was where it was due to poor construction by the builder and their job was to only replace the water heater.  Not prevent any future issue such a as today's.  (Josh) They finally said that they replace the water line but wouldn't take accountability for their work.  The house was built in 1989 and Im almost positive that if a company replaced a product,  they should take measures to make improvements and not just do  minimal work and take people hard earned dollars.  

They also laid the blame on the City of Mesquite inspection saying it must be good enough or they wouldn't green tag it.  ( its words).  They blaming Mesquite Roofing and Mesquite Roofing is blaming Bakers Brothers for the install.

Basically nobody wants to take accountability and after paying out of pocket for a roof l am also having to get the area dried out and have the ceilings.

Moral of the story,  don't your homework.  I definitely would not recommend Bakers Brothers after this is incident or Mesquite inspection department 

Trust No one...

reviews.author: Alex B.
reviews.text:
Do not use these overpriced scammers. Shame on me for putting up with it for so long.  First, they tell me they can't fix a toilet that I've now found out just needed a $20 part to repair and then charged me $700 to install a new toilet I don't like.  It also has aesthetic issues.

Next, they charged me $600 to replace the cartridges in my shower valves.

The final straw was when they came out to replace a closet flange for a different toilet.  Charged $168 to remove the flange and quoted me $384 to put it back on after I reinstalled the water damaged flooring (why I was doing this in the first place).  Then when they came back out to reinstall it, they quoted me $800 plus $500 to install the toilet and I told them to get out of my house and that they'd lost me as a customer.

I had another plumber come out, install a closet flange, install the toilet, and fix the same problem from the first issue above (I had the same toilet everywhere in my house before they threw out the perfectly good one), all for $345.

Let's walk that back.  Baker Brothers wanted to charge me $800 for the flange install $500 for the toilet install, and then they'd probably make me buy a new toilet for a few hundred instead of fixing that issue they didn't fix with my first toilet.  The plumber I had do it... $345.  That's over one thousand dollars less, likely $1200 less for the exact same job.

The blatant lying, scamming, and overcharging is inexcusable and I'm embarrassed for falling for it for so long.

reviews.author: James H.
reviews.text:
I was extremely disappointed with the service I received from Baker Brothers and feel compelled to warn other business owners.

I specifically requested a morning appointment, yet the technician did not arrive until the afternoon, which already disrupted my salon's operations. Once he arrived, I was quoted an outrageous amount just to change sprayers on our shampoo bowls.

To be clear, only two out of six shampoo bowls were not working before he arrived. When the technician left, only two were working -- the two he never touched. The four bowls he worked on were left non-functional.

On top of that, I was quoted $5,000 to replace four vacuum breakers that were working perfectly before he showed up. Despite all of this, I was still charged $800, even though the only actual repair completed was a small pipe issue on one bowl that took maybe 20 minutes.

It also felt concerning that the technician had to call his manager for nearly every decision, which did not inspire confidence. I was left questioning whether a less experienced technician was sent because I was a new client.

Overall, this was a very frustrating experience, and I genuinely feel like I was ripped off. Like other reviewers have said -- beware. The charges are excessive, and the results did not match the cost or expectations.

reviews.author: Darin S.
reviews.text:
I was really disappointed with my recent experience with Baker Brothers. I scheduled a visit to have a simple faucet replacement done, but the technician came up with multiple reasons why he couldn't or wouldn't do the job. He didn't want to turn off the water under the sink because it was an "older style" shutoff. Then he didn't want to turn off the main water to my condo unit because of liability concerns--he even mentioned that if a neighbor's water heater wasn't full when the water was turned off, it could "fry" it, and they didn't want to be responsible.

Instead of focusing on how to solve the issue, the technician kept pointing out why he didn't want to do the work. He criticized the PVC pipes, saying he doesn't like working with them. He also gave his unsolicited opinion on my faucet choice, saying touchless ones "go bad in two years." Frankly, I didn't need commentary--I just needed the faucet replaced.

To top it off, I was charged $59 for the visit even though no work was done, and he didn't even realize I was a "family plan" member (which I had signed up for), because I booked the appointment online. Shouldn't that be something checked before arriving?

The whole experience felt like a waste of time and money. I expected better from a company with such a strong reputation.

reviews.author: Jonathon W.
reviews.text:
Baker Brothers is the kind of company that gives the entire industry a bad name. I called them out when my HVAC stopped working, and they told me the blower motor needed to be replaced $1,900+ for the part alone. I paid the service fee, only to later realize my system was still under warranty, meaning the part should have been covered.

When I called back to ask what the labor charge would be to install the part under warranty, they shamelessly insisted that the $1,900 was for labor only. That's right, they tried to charge nearly two grand for what is, at most, an hour of work.

Either they're completely incompetent or they're running a deliberate price-gouging scam, neither of which makes them worth your time or money. The blower motor itself costs under $400 online, and anyone with even basic knowledge of HVAC systems knows this.

This is not a company interested in doing right by their customers. They're interested in exploiting people who don't know better. Save yourself the frustration, the money, and the insult to your intelligence. do not call Baker Brothers.

reviews.author: Rick W.
reviews.text: I had cracked plumbing pipes as a result of having my foundation raised. While I was not shocked that I had this new issue to deal with (the foundation company had made it clear that this was a possibility), I was disappointed, especially after a conversation with the plumbing company they work with and the quote for the repairs. I decided to get a second opinion and called Baker Brothers. I had used them recently on a different issue and they had done a great job. I requested the same plumber that was assigned to me the first time, Andrew Hayes. Baker came in at a considerable savings. Andrew performed his duties exactly how he explained and then met with city inspectors and conducted a hydrostatic pressure test that is required, as it ensures that there are no leaks in the system, and they signed off on his work and gave their seal of approval. I have found Baker Brothers to be efficient, communicative and transparent and would not hesitate to recommend them.

synthesis.summary: Baker Brothers carries a 4.8 Google over 24,600+ reviews and BBB A+, but Yelp 4.1/100 plus the negative review text reveal a sharp split: dedicated water-heater install crews ('Caleb and his assistant... removed and replaced 2 upstairs gas water heaters') deliver clean fast work, while one-off plumbing/electrical visits routinely bring quotes 5-15x competitor pricing ($345 toilet flapper, $600 commercial faucet handle, $700 toilet replacement vs $20 part). Pattern looks like a large company with strong installation teams and aggressive upselling on smaller jobs.

Saturday-evening emergency dispatch reported with under-30-minute resolution

weaknesses: Pricing complaints dominate negative reviews — '$345 for a toilet rebuild kit' for a $20 flapper, '$600 to replace cartridges in shower valves,' '$1900 for the part alone' on a blower motor still under warranty
Repeat upselling reported on routine maintenance — '$2000-$3000' in recommended repairs after furnace/AC tune-ups
Brand-new AC installs failing 4 months later in at least one case
'Family Plan' membership pushed aggressively at every visit and reportedly difficult to cancel

reviews.author: Taylor Coghlan
reviews.text: I have hired them 3 times to do miscellaneous things for me, they fixed my shower once, installed toilets and just recently installed a water filter and a new kitchen faucet. They do great work, are efficient and have excellent quotes. Thank you again guys, I look forward to working with you again in the future.

reviews.author: Dana Shelayne Kroeger
reviews.text:
Isaac was amazing, smart and kind.

He fixed my issue in less than 5 minutes. And now I have a bigger issue that I discovered tonight that takes a lot more to fix.

Honestly I would have never found the other issue if it weren’t for Isaac problem-solving the first. Thank you Isaac.

But here is what I learned about ‘Plumbers Near Me’ today. I found them on Google. I was doing a broad search as most “Plumbing Companies” charge an and a leg for even the easiest of fixes that could simply advise a person on how to fix on their own.

If I didn’t have a Mom in hospice, a dog to take care of and a job - I probably could have figured it out on my own.

But I don’t have such time or luxury right now.

What stood out was that it was a family run company, which matters to me. I come from a family of farmers. It matters.

I know most plumbing prices and they are typically exorbitant when unnecessary to charge people such costs.

So that is what is going to insure Plumbers Near Me THRIVE!

Kind, caring and smart plumbers or associate plumbers because guess who I will always call in every scenario in the future? Inexpensive or expensive.

Plumbers Near Me LLC.

Good people. Smart people. Dependable people that actually care about the human they are helping.

I have to believe that there are many that feel the same as me. And if not they haven’t dealt with the monopolies.

Thank you.

reviews.author: Tim Farrow
reviews.text: We had a different company out first and they misdiagnosed the issue with our toilet. Carlos quickly and correctly found our issue and was honest in telling us how to fix it ourselves. I would happily use them again, especially since I feel almost guilty they didn’t charge us for extremely helpful information!

reviews.author: Julie F.
reviews.text:
Hello
I would not recommend Plumbers Near Me.  303-993-1339 or 720 401- 1019.
Living in an older home I understand sewer lines and the need for maintenance. I get my main line snaked every six months because I have a lot of trees.  When Plumbers near me came I said snake my entire yard but don't go all the way to the main city line or you will get stuck.  The plumber spoke English.  There was no miscommunication in my statement.  He ran the snake to the main line.  He got stuck.  He could not get the snake out.  He left with the snake in my main line and walked away. I had to pay another plumber 575.00$ to remove the snake.  So what normally costs me 100.00 for the main line clean-out snake cost me 714.00$.  He charged me 139.00$ for the faulty work. Avoid them unless you have an extra 714.00$ sitting around.

reviews.author: Thomas W.
reviews.text: "Plumbers Near Me" is the worst plumbing contractor I've ever used. Asked them to install my new disposal. Nothing complicated, but the person this company sent out did not follow the manufacturer's instructions and photos. He installed the disposal wrong for $223.90 and later it leaked. I called another plumbing con-tractor who took pictures of the obvious mis-takes, and reinstalled the disposal correctly for $175. I asked the original plumbing contractor, "Plumbers Near Me," to reimburse me, and Saul Mejia, I presume the owner, apologized and said he would reimburse me. 83 days later no reimbursement despite my emailing Saul and calling him several times. Never again for "Plumbers Near Me."

reviews.author: Robert L.
reviews.text: This family-owned company is as good as it gets!  I will never use another plumber again.  I found them because I actually searched online for "a plumber near me."  Very clever name for this company.  They squeezed us in on a Friday night.  Jonathan and Christian not only came out at 8:00 in the evening but stopped by a hardware store in order to get the part we thought we needed.  Unfortunately, because our house is 120+ years old, it needs special faucet fittings only available at plumbing supply houses.  On Saturday morning, Jonathan made trips to two open places both of which said they had what we needed, only to discover they didn't.  He kept in touch and Monday morning was back with the right thing!  He did a great job at a reasonable price.  $405 included the cost of the faucet and all of his work. From my first phone call to Saul at the office to each of our encounters with Jonathan, the people at this small company are pleasant, competent, courteous, and helpful.  They even offer a discount for community servants (police, firefighters, teachers).  You cannot go wrong using their services.

reviews.author: Michael N.
reviews.text:
I have used Plumbers Near Me in Arvadaon two occasions. The first was relatively simple; installing a new pressure tank and replacing a worn switch. Jonathan did an excellent job and charged me a very reasonable price. 
The second was a major and urgent project, which Jonathan supervised: the drain from the house to the main sewer was blocked. If you've never had this experience, be glad. If you have, you know what I mean. Three men came out for a day and a half to replace the line. They were very experienced and knew exactly what to do at each step. Hard and heavy physical labor was required, and they were certainly up to it, working continually until they broke for a quick lunch at 4 pm. They were scrupulous about cleaning everything up and, as promised, left the yard and sidewalk looking exactly as they had before. They even installed an outdoor access pipe so it is no longer necessary to service the line from the basement. The final bill exactly matched the bid - not a penny more. Plumbers Near Me will always be my choice for any plumbing work I might need.

reviews.author: Jeffrey F.
reviews.text: After spending weeks on an off try to get a water line pressure regulating valve put in my house I finally found a good plumber.  I was trying to save $50 by having a handyman come over but they were very difficult to contact/arrange.  I contacted one plumbing company and they never called back.  So I tried these guys and called them at 1 pm and by 5 pm there was an installer.  If you want the work done right and to code its best to used these skilled installers and worth the extra $50.  I finally found a good plumbing company and will be using them in the future.  I recently had to get a hot water heater installed.  Same story, you can maybe get one in for $800 to $1000, but to be done right and by code a good one is about $1300.  That's what I paid another company but I would use this company had I known them. These guys are prompt and professional and keep you informed of arrival via text messages.

reviews.author: Vanessa U.
reviews.text: Wanting to shower this morning but notice the water isn't getting warm/hot at all. So checking on our water heater, we noticed the lighting status isn't blinking at all which according to the heater it is off. We were hoping we can have someone to see what happened, and hopefully able to get it running again for hot water. "Plumbers Near Me" responded back ASAP! Stressing out thinking it'll be impossible to make an appointment with anyone around the afternoon but "Plumbers Near Me" made it happen! They were able to squeeze me in around 3-6pm. They actually surprised me showing up early than my appointment we scheduled which was even better! Thinking it's going to take another day to make an appointment with anyone, Plumbers Near Me made me feel important, and was able to fix my problem asap. I recommend them! Thank you so much! I'll definitely continue doing business with them. Great service!

reviews.author: Tim H.
reviews.text:
We had a blocked drain  in the kitchen.  I called Plumbers near me, after several hours of plunging the drain.  I spoke to a very informative person on the phone, he educated me on how a garbage disposal is normally the culprit with clogged kitchen drains.  He asked me several questions about the other drains in the house and then asked if I could wait till the morning, he told me he didn't want to charge me an extra charge for after hours call, that is great customer service.  The price was right and Jony arrived just as I was told he would.
Jony is a great guy too, he "snaked" the drain and talked to me about the garbage disposal and gave me some helpful hints on how much water to run while using it.
Now drain runs out so fast I'm afraid to get my hand near it, for fear I will be sucked in. LOL!
I will use Plumbers near me, again if needed, they have made a customer out of me!

reviews.author: Todd M.
reviews.text: I found Plumbers Near Me on yelp today and decided to give them a call because our bathtub had stopped draining and our sink was starting to clog as well.  We bought the house a year ago and the draining has always been spotty.  We tried a couple different liquid drain cleaners from the store to clear it out and nothing would work for long.  The water just stopped draining last night.  I called and scheduled a same day appointment between 11am - 1pm which was really nice.  I received a text when they were close by so I knew to expect them.  Jonathan and his team were punctual, polite and they worked quickly.  The pricing was fair and the service was great.  The tub and the sink drain quickly now.  Thanks Plumbers Near Me!

reviews.author: Danielle A.
reviews.text: Incredible service by these guys! They have their stuff together. They were on time, they always communicated well with me and they left everything really clean after the job was done. They repaired my boiler and thankfully they were able to do it the next day after I had called in. Boilers are a little more complex so as soon as I saw the name "Advanced Boilers" I knew I wanted to use them. They even looked at my AC system to make sure everything was looking good and working properly. Which yes, thankfully it was! Their customer service really impressed me and they couldn't of been more kind and respectful in my home.

reviews.author: Mark R.
reviews.text: We had a leak from an 80-year-old galvanized pipe that was 100% rusted and located behind a wall.   The access was extremely difficult.   "Carlos" was fantastic in dealing with the pipes that were almost impossible to separate due to the corrosion.   He worked tirelessly on the project.   At the end, he wanted to make sure everything was perfect.    PNM was able to get address the problem on a late Saturday afternoon and they completed the job on Monday.    We couldn't be happier with the service.   Their estimate was upfront and their fees are very reasonable.   A million Thanks go out to Carlos and PNM!!

reviews.author: C Carroll
reviews.text: Initially pleased, but then oy Christmas Day. I had to have two separate call outs because I could not convince the tech that the toilet wouldn't flush. It flushed a few times for him so he didn't believe me that it wasn't working well. Fast forward to CHRISTMAS DAY and no one can get the toilet to flush--such a bummer. Had to pay for TWO service calls even though I really tried to get him to do the work on the first call. Called the office and emailed to see if they would credit me one of the service calls since I did everything I could to get it done right the first time and it was crickets. Frustrating.

reviews.author: Luke M.
reviews.text: These guys are the best. I have a few properties in the metro area and they have become my go-to company for jobs big and small. I have had them replace pipe under the slate of a house, fix leaks under sinks, and re-do pipe infrastructure under a house. They have a unique combination of great business practices and good prices and I find everything from their communication tool to their invoicing process to be top notch for managing my business. And, I trust the guys who come do the work. They work well whether I'm present on the job site or away and always communicate beyond my expectations. Use 'em!

reviews.author: Jasmin Curwen (Jaz Love)
reviews.text:
Highly recommend!
Robert contacted my husband to let him know he Would arrive within 30 minutes, He was timely, knowledgeable, and very professional! After that snaking he saw that we had tree branches growing into our sewer line. He jumped right in, got it taken care of and had the roots cleared out in no time! He double checked his work before he left to make sure there were no leaks after Removing and replacing back the toilet, Upon noticing a small amount of water, he redid the seal and double checked again to make sure there were no issues before he left. I truly appreciate how professional he was and how clean he kept the entire project. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Jacqui Quinn
reviews.text: Very happy with this experience all the way around. Robert responded immediately to my early text message. And was out to my house within 4 hours on the beginning of Labor Day weekend!! I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Trevor Harwood
reviews.text: Lets just say my house is really one of the worst things to work on (a frankestein house with old parts, tight conditions and access). Shane and his team went above and beyond with the project saving my sidewalk while trenching, cleaning up after, and more to get me to a good spot again. Would recommend to family and friends.

reviews.author: Eric Taylor
reviews.text:
They said they were going to be here in ten minutes and never showed up.
Really lousy communication and customer service
Probably can find a better plumber.

reviews.author: Eric Bakken
reviews.text: With years of experience, you'd think a plumber can poke his head out the back door or in the crawl space to figure out what's going on with the mainline he's gonna snake before pulling a toilet. Maybe it was a bad day, maybe when I called him to call him out on pulling the toilet it was a bad day too, but I sure got a mouthful of anger from the plumber that serviced the rental house I own.  The cleanouts could be seen from the back window in about 20 seconds, but this plumber didn't want to hear or be called out on this. If a plumber in his tirade says he's got years of service and he knows best and doesn't want to pull a toilet....but doesn't take a literal minute to understand the system he is working on....not a company i would work with again. If you're not doing new installs you're working on old stuff that you have to try and understand a tiny bit before you go running a snake or doing any other service on it.

reviews.author: Tamara Pohlenz
reviews.text:
Shane and Ozzy are excellent! I would recommend these two to anyone.
I had an emergency with my shower, and after many calls to plumbers, and many expensive quotes, I called Alpha Omega. Shane answered promptly
and came right away. And the price was very affordable.
Shane and Ozzy even stopped at home depot to get the parts that were needed.  Shane sent me pictures of the parts and prices so I could pick out what I wanted for my shower. They were honest about the cost and what needed repair and what was salvageable. Which most parts in my shower were salvageable.
After the job was finished,  Shane and Ozzy ran back to home depot for a screw that was needed to make everything complete.
They were both very professional,  polite and knowledgeable. Best plumbers I have ever used. And will be using these two from now on.
These two go above and beyond.
I already booked them to replace my hot water heater.
I give these two 5 stars.

reviews.author: Rick Peart
reviews.text: I have to say, whenever I am in need of any kind of plumbing service or advice, my first and only call is going to Shane at Alpha Omega. I am always a bit hesitant when it comes to any kind of home repair as there are just too many scams and lazy work that goes on these days. After one call to Alpha, I spoke with Shane who actually tried to talk me out of everything I was requesting but I told him I just wanted everything updated so it would be less for me to worry about with my busy lifestyle. He was at my door the next day and had everything installed, tested, and performing at the optimum level 48 after my initial call. Absolutely fantastic service and would recommend to anyone in the area that is needing help with ANY kind of plumbing issues. Thank you Shane. You know I now have you on my speed dial!

reviews.author: Misti Jackson
reviews.text: This company is definitely worth using for air conditioning needs.  The equipment came the day before they were scheduled to work so there was waiting for parts the day they were scheduled to install the unit.  They came on time and were ready to start working.   They stayed until the work was done which ended up being later in the night.  We appreciated this instead of coming back the next day as we couldn't take off work the next day.   They were very nice and friendly.  Any mess that was made was cleaned up before they left.   They were very reasonably priced as well.   I would use this company again for other HVAC and plumbing needs.

reviews.author: John Koch
reviews.text: Shane took my call late on a Saturday night and arrived first thing on a Sunday morning to clean out a pipe clogged with roots. The team was very prompt, friendly, and knowledgeable. They explained what they were doing and made suggestions for longer term repairs in the future. They didn't suggest or push for unnecessary services and made sure we were happy with the work before taking payment. The price was very reasonable even including some unforseen work. As a bonus they were great with young kids who were very interested in what was going on and asking them tons of questions.

reviews.author: Julie Peknik
reviews.text: Cannot say enough positive things about Shane. My shower got stuck in the 'on' position.He promptly came out and fixed the issue. At the time I had also discovered a puddle near my furnace. Yes, when it rains it pours and my anxiety was on overload. Shane fixed both without concern to his own time that he wasn't planning on fixing both. He is professional, responsive, competent, and reasonably priced. I will recommend him to friends and family without hesitation.

reviews.author: Breynden Bellows
reviews.text: Shane, provided excellent service. He's an honorable man that stands by his work. My property's building requires scheduling for water shut off since the water valves are controlled by a master valve in a water closet, that residents cannot access. Shane was able to accomodate the brief scheduling window of the property and get the work i needed done in a timely and efficient manner. Highly recommend using Alpha Omega Plumbing for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jim
reviews.text: I called Shayne at the last minute on the weekend and he responded immediately and came within an hour. Shayne is by far the best plumber with the most integrity I have ever dealt with  He had the problem repaired and in the least expensive way. I can’t recommend him enough. I will never use any other plumber but Shayne. Thank you Shayne for your fast professional service and even more for your integrity. Jim

reviews.author: Kathleen O'Donnell
reviews.text: Shane was timely and professional in every part of the process from communication to installation. He explained all options we needed to know about replacing our water heater, and had a fair market price for the job. He also fixed our backyard hose which had been leaking for years. Everytime I go to water the flowers in the backyard this summer, I'll be sending my thanks to him for a job well done!

reviews.author: Kyli Owen
reviews.text: We called Shane at 5:30am and he was at our house by 7am. We had to have our sump pump replaced unexpectedly before leaving town and he was efficient (and informative) so we could hit the road. We couldn’t have called a better person for the job. And along the way, even consulted other stuff because Shane is full of knowledge. Thank you for helping us when we were in a panic!

reviews.author: Shantal blea
reviews.text: Alpha omega plumbing is my to go to company for all my plumbing needs. Highly recommend, Shane has completed two services for my residence- replaced my water heater and fixed my plumbing to my washer. In both instances, they were professional, efficient and completed the work flawlessly. I highly recommend their service as they also respond quickly to emergency calls.

synthesis.summary: Alpha Omega is the kind of plumber the brand voice was built for — '4am day after Thanksgiving' and 'Christmas Eve plumbing crisis' both get same-hour response, and pricing is fair. Shane Paz is the owner and is named in dozens of reviews for honesty and integrity. Two negatives stand out: one no-show and one mainline diagnosis dispute.
strengths: True 24/7 holiday emergency response — '4am day after Thanksgiving... only plumber who answered'
Christmas Eve plumbing rescue — 'Shane came right out to make sure all was taken care of'
Owner-operator integrity is the dominant theme — 'best plumber with the most integrity I have ever dealt with'
15-minute arrival on water heater emergencies — 'at my door in 15 mins and had it back up and running'
weaknesses: One reviewer reports a no-show — 'said they were going to be here in ten minutes and never showed up'
One mainline diagnosis dispute over a pulled toilet
synthesis.emergencyNotes: 4am Thanksgiving day, Christmas Eve, last-minute weekend, 'within an hour for emergency' — repeated across many 5-star reviews. Strongest emergency signal in this batch.

sewer.topQuote: Shane and his team are great and really saved us after our main sewer line backed up. They were quick to respond, communicated through the entire process

water-heater.topQuote: Shane is amazing! I called for help with a water heater that wouldn't start. He was at my door in 15 mins and had it back up and running

drain-cleaning.topQuote: What a great local find! Honest, hardworking and respectful dudes! I was scheduled the next day for a clogged drain/sewer line

toilet.topQuote: My son flushed a few cars down the toilet and they came and saved the day right before Christmas Eve

burst-pipe.topQuote: When no one else could detect the Leak, They found the leak immediately, fixed and completed the job in a timely manor

You need a plumber who actually shows up when scheduled
