reviews.author: Scott B.
reviews.text:
I contacted Greenwell plumbing regarding warranty work to be performed on a less-than one year old water heater. They told me that estimates were free so I had them come out. When the plumber arrived he first told me "I don't know much about those...", referring to the water heater I have. He did not bring in a single tool or instrument, he just went to look at the water heater. He also said the estimate was free but there would be a $99.00 diagnostic fee. I spent 25 years running field service and the last time I checked, you have to diagnose a problem to determine what and how much the solution will be.  I told him to go ahead because this was a warranty situation and Rheem would be paying for it.  His diagnosis consisted of calling Rheem's customer service and after doing so told me Rheem said the water heater would have to be replaced to the tune of well over $700.00. 

 After the young man left I called Reem's customer service myself and after a few checks the walked me through they ordered two parts and scheduled a plumber they work with to come out and fix the water heater, not replace it. 

 I contacted Greenwell Plumbing (first via email then after no response by phone) to get the charge to my credit card reversed.  Although the credit was issued no one ever responded until after the credit was issued.  I am pleased the  credit was issued as there was no benefit at all provided to me by this plumber's service call.  I do think however that Greenwell needs to work on their responsiveness to customers.

I hope this is an isolated event, but telling someone that an estimate will be free, then telling them upon arrival that there will be a charge for diagnosis is a DECEPTIVE practice.  I also don't think the plumber who was sent out has much experience, or if he does, he should find another line of work.  I'm not sure how he could have even spoken to Rheem's customer service and come to the conclusion I needed a new water heater when it was repaired with only a couple of parts and maybe 20 minutes of work by a knowledgeable  plumber.

reviews.author: W E.
reviews.text:
I called Greenwell to come and service our furnace when it was short cycling. The technician who arrived spoke very poor English and had a difficult time communicating with me. He misdiagnosed the problem as a faulty circuit board and quoted me $1466 to replace it. I knew this was an outrageous price, but I was in a vulnerable spot with a house full of young children and a record-breaking cold front setting in. As I was writing the check, the furnace began to short cycle again, so I shredded the check and directed him to investigate further. He took a quick look at the furnace, lied to me about the age of the unit, said nothing else could be done, and that I needed a new furnace to the tune of $5800. I had him remove the circuit board and collect his things. I paid him, foolishly, for the diagnostic fee ($99) and the $10 "fuel charge" for him to drive less than 1 mile to my home. I called another company who had their technician at my home within the hour and who was correctly able to diagnose and fix the problem with the part even being covered under warranty. They also were able to rectify some damage left to our unit by Greenwell's technician. They also added that their charge to replace the circuit board, if that had been the issue, would have been $488. Nearly $1000 less than Greenwell's.

I have reached out to Greenwell on 3 times now and been passed to 3 different people all of whom were "waiting for management to decide if they would be taking any action to remedy the situation". All I have asked for is a refund of the $109 diagnostic and fuel fees since this technician misdiagnosed the issue, lied to me, and tried to charge me thousands of dollars for a new unit I did not need. Greenwell is completely avoiding responsibility for their very poor service, and as of this morning has cashed the check I wrote for $109.

If you're in need of HVAC or plumbing services, do yourself a favor and call anyone else. These scammers will not help you and will look for every opportunity to cash in on their deceptive practices.

reviews.author: Jeffrey D.
reviews.text: Responsive, professional, courteous, polite, and extremely qualified in their disciplines! I had plumbers out installing an electric backup sump pump and an HVAC technician installing a whole home dehumidifier on the same day! They did not stop at 5pm, but stayed until their respective jobs were completed. The plumbers even discovered a serious builder defect that resulted in the release of the toxic and noxious hydrogen sulfide gas into our home. Schuler Homes vented the sewage gases directly into our living spaces AND mere inches away from an HVAC cold air return facilitating the circulation of this adverse health hazard (respiratory distress, severe headaches, etc.) into our entire home for the 3 months we had lived in this brand new home! My family had suffered respiratory distress, severe coughing attacks, dizziness, and headaches only weeks after we bought and moved into this toxin ridden home! When Schuler Homes was notified, they did NOT accept accountability or offer an APOLOGY to my family for their physical and psychological distress! Schuler Homes preaches customer service, but that's only on paper. Stay away from Michael David Schuler's homes!!! But not for the Greenwell employees, my family would have continued with their respiratory distress and, quite possibly, could have died in their sleep! Thank you Devin & Cody! You likely saved the lives of my wife and son!!!!

reviews.author: Jonathon B.
reviews.text: This is a gripe not connected to their actual service but does reflect on how they operate in general from the top down. As I was pumping gas at rush hour this morning one of their trucks pulls in to fill up but instead of pulling behind me or another car he pulls in nose to nose with me. He did leave enough room to appear that he was giving me the space to get through. Well I tried and damaged my car on the barricade around the pump. I know it was my fault but looked to the driver for a reaction or an apology for the practice of pulling up that way. He was not remorseful at all. I thought maybe the owner would be concerned about this incident and how it reflects on his company so I called the number on the truck. The receptionist, who I believe to be related to the owner, took my info called the owner and driver and called me back. No concern whatsoever, "We didn't hit you so we aren't responsible". What they say is true but when your last name is on the side of the truck every encounter with the public is an extension of your brand and your family's name. These are high stakes that shouldn't be taken lightly. Doing the right thing in a situation or even showing concern or remorse goes along way to strengthen your brand and your name. You failed in this instance Greenwell Plumbing.

reviews.author: Roger R.
reviews.text:
We had Greenwell Plumbing and heating come out to do an estimate for installation of a toilet, pit pump, shower and corner sink and another utility sink. Aaron Jackson was the technician that provided the estimate in a very reasonable time.
We had a few items that needed to be completed before the work could be done; but he still provided an estimate.
Other remodeling was completed made a few changes of the above and he quickly re-did the estimate to adjust it.
Contacted Greenwell to move forward and schedule it.
Scheduling was quick and Aaron showed as scheduled and started the work. He continually keep us in the loop as he progressed or if he had a question for our input before performing a the task just to be sure we were okay with what he was going to do or provided some other options.
He a wonderful person and good technician. He always cleaned up after himself which in itself is a testament to his standards. ( we had other workers that that just didn't seem part of their job, it makes a difference)
This is the 2 nd time this year we have used Greenwell and have been pleased with the staff and work performed.
We recommend them and if you get a choice we recommend Aaron Jackson.
Also the staff, Karen Watts was great to communicate with throughout this process.
Kudos all around!

reviews.author: Rita Koontz
reviews.text: Drew did a wonderful job explaining our power vent gas water heater and a tankless water heater. He was very professional and efficient. He wore shoe covers and explained everything he did thoroughly.  Thanks Drew! Thanks Jarboe Heating, Cooling and Plumbing!

reviews.author: Christina Mercado
reviews.text: I booked an appointment this morning because I was having issues with the water temperature in my bathroom. I was able to book an appointment for them to come within 2 hours. The technician, Jonathan D, was great! He was very communicative, nice, and respectful. He quickly fixed the issue and did not charge me an arm and a leg which I was worried about with plumbing. Highly recommend Jarboe's and will definitely go back again if I have any issues.

reviews.author: Jaime Bronfman
reviews.text: Very friendly, professional and efficient team. Really appreciated the updates leading up to our appointment. Reasonable rates and we actually paid nothing in the end because they couldn’t diagnose/find the problem. Our issue may have just been ice/temperature related. We will definitely use Jarboe’s again in the future.

reviews.author: Ronald Ireland
reviews.text: Three years ago the upstairs tenants in a condo where I lived, they hired Jarbos plumbing to come out and take a look see where the leak was coming from in my living room ceiling. For some reason they must have talked this over before they come down here, the plumber actually said the leak was coming from the roof. I've been to maintenance man for 28 years, my parents flipped 14 properties I think I know where the leak was coming from. It was coming from a rotten toilet flange because the other plumber told me they were tired of them trying to lie out of everything. I ran them out of here cussed all of them out ! Don't ever assume someone doesn't know anything about maintenance because that's clearly what your plumber did and I called him straight out on it !

reviews.author: Shanneca O.
reviews.text: Had a technician come out to my home yesterday to look at my heating issue. He stated I needed an igniter but he didn't have one on his truck. He also stated that he would call to see if any other technician had the part today. There was no follow up call about the part from any technician! I called back and the dispatch stated it would be $200 fee to open the parts department to LOOK for the part because it may not be there.

reviews.author: Tess Hayes
reviews.text:
Brandon made an appearance to do a maintenance plumbing service I have paid monthly for, for over a year, just now got. HVAC was promised twice a year, only got one last year and said they had no availability until end of July.

Brandon tried to upsell me on a multitude of things that would estimate over 6k. All I wanted was a leaking pipe patched. I refused multiple times. Still sent invoice dor it all. I said i only want the small part of pipe patched. 500$ for that.

Asked repeatedly I leave a review (3-4 times during 20 minutes of doing nothing but tightening my faucet. The multiple requests for reviews, tips and to make sure I include how he "fixed my sink because he's so nice" when I asked if he could tighten the faucet which took 3-5 minutes.

Turned my water heater off without telling me. Didn't realize until I went to shower. Had to spend several minutes trying to fugure out issue.

I was clearly distressed over costs of repairs to house and expressed that and as soon as he knew I was ignorant of plumbing repairs, tried to insist I needed 6k worth of work done and 2-3 times said I can leave him a tip.

Checked nothing but pipe I specifically asked for. Spoke to me in a condescending, monotone voice with patronizing questions to make me feel worse and convince me I needed 6k+ of work. Paid a monthly subscription for a year and got one HVAC service who uphold me on duct cleaning and one plumbing maintenance who did nothing but turn my hot water off, tell me I need thousands in work done.

When I said I couldn't afford that, I had to make a hardship withdrawal from retirement just to cover the other repairs just done, casually said I'll owe a lot in taxes and he knows that forsure because he has a friend that's a tax guy, okay. Like I'm not stressed enough.

Stressful. Uncomfortable. Blaise attitude. No care to what can help, just fishing for $$$$ not worth it at all. Constantly asking for reviews, tips and telling naive people they need thousands in repairs is insulting, pathetic, gross, belittling and sleazy sells pitch and self promotion.

The real kicker is calling to tell their AI robot my water heater was shut off by the technician and they said they could have someone come out Monday to fix their mistake for 80$ I spent 20 minutes figuring out how to fix it myself, after a brutal, long day. Canceling all services. Made a pretty penny off me for doing next to nothing.

reviews.author: William Y.
reviews.text:
I was very pleased with the service I received from Jarboes. I saw their coupon in the value pack for a tune up and called them, turns out my system was leaking and and as the country is doing away with R-22, the cost to try to repair a leaking system and re-service it with R-22 , I might as well get a new system.
I used another coupon from Bryant for a second opinion on my unit, just to ensure my peace of mind that the unit was broke hard.
I got 4 bids and was kind of leaning towards a Carrier unit and Jarboes came in not only $1800 under the next Carrier bid , but it was the exact same unit type down to the same serial number model.
In addition, they were the only ones that wanted to install new copper supply lines, none of the others wanted to do that , even when I asked about it. I guess that is standard, to pressure test and use old lines , but I was thinking I am replacing a 12 year old leaking unit and I have no clue where the leak is , I want new supply lines.
Than they also GAVE me a new Honeywell wifi digital thermostat, everyone else said they could install a new thermostat, but it would add between $300 -$400 to the bill.
Once I talked to Mike Meehan the sales rep and we confirmed the deal  a few days later Loren Bierly and Jack Story called they were 15 minutes out and they showed  up at my door and promptly went to work. I want to say it took them about 4 to 5 hours and they had my new unit in with new supple lines and my new digital wifi thermostat in place and operating as advertised.
I can not imagine a better installation process, Loren installed my new coil inside as Jack went to work on taking out the old unit. they ran the new supply lines and serviced the new unit up to specs.
Being an engineer by trade, I was very impressed with how these guys operated. 
In the end, I  got the unit I wanted for a better price , I got the extras I wanted, at no extra cost and as part of my deal there is a CAIRfree maintenance visit added for free and a Plumbing visit as well for free.
I highly recommend theses guys, of course you should always shop around, if you are in the market for a new AC unit at the very least three bids, I had four and Jarboes came out ahead.
Yep as good as it gets I think.
Thanks Mike, Loren and Jack.

reviews.author: Kirk S.
reviews.text:
Warning if you are thinking about buying from Jarboe's heating and cooling do NOT. They give the worst service I have ever experienced. I bought an air conditioner from them last year. It has since stopped working. I have called several times. The first appointment I set the people did not even show up. They finally sent someone days later and I was told they could not help me fix it. They said they would be back and that was over a month ago! I keep trying to call customer service and they wont let me speak to a manager. This is ridiculous! I highly recommend using someone else.

Update:
I have spoken to Nathan Williams and his response is they will be able to service the air conditions on June 25. This will be 2 MONTHS after I made the first call. This is unacceptable since they have told me on multiple occasions that they would be coming out to my home today. They have the nerve to tell me I agreed to the June 25th date which is not true! I have moved my work schedule around in order to be home for the service. The heat index is increasing and now it is becoming unbearable.

Update:
I have a dispute that I opened with the better business bureau I cannot wait to get this resolved. They took $500 from me for a service agreement and they have not been to my house one time. We have scheduled three different appointments and they did not show up any of those times. I've dealt with their customer service Nathan Williams and he kept telling me they always do the right thing yet never came out within three phone calls and always had excuses each time. I called Maeser Plumbing and heat and air they were out the very next night and fixed everything. If you had the same experience with them you can call the BBB at 502-583-6546

New Update: it is 9/9/2020 and I have yet to receive my $500 refund. This is ridiculous! I have never dealt with a more unprofessional business in my life.

reviews.author: Jason Moore
reviews.text:
I had a very frustrating experience with Jarboe’s Heating, Cooling & Plumbing and would not recommend them based on how this situation was handled.

I initially called them out to inspect a furnace after LG&E and a licensed plumber identified a gas leak and determined the issue was likely coming from the HVAC system. The first technician came out and told me she couldn’t find anything wrong.

Because LG&E continued to detect a problem, they came back out and met with the plumber. Together, they tested all the gas lines and confirmed that the only line losing pressure was the one connected to the furnace. At that point, it was clear something had been missed during the initial visit.

I called Jarboe’s back to explain the situation and scheduled a return visit. I was explicitly told over the phone that I would not be charged another diagnostic fee since they were coming back out for the same issue.

However, the second technician called me ahead of the appointment and immediately questioned how LG&E and the plumber could have determined the furnace was the source. He then said he would just repeat what the previous technician did and, if nothing was found, I would be charged another diagnostic fee anyway. He also stated that they “can’t keep coming back out for the same problem if nothing is wrong,” which was incredibly frustrating given that multiple parties had already confirmed there *is* a problem.

The tone was dismissive, unprofessional, and frankly rude. Instead of taking the new information seriously and trying to resolve what is clearly an ongoing gas issue, it felt like they were more concerned about avoiding responsibility and charging additional fees.

At the end of the day, this is a safety issue involving a gas leak. I expected a higher level of professionalism, thoroughness, and customer care. Unfortunately, that was not my experience.

reviews.author: Mark K.
reviews.text:
"Two bad experiences! 

1st On a "AC check up" in April, I was told my unit needed gas and the gas is obsolete but available. Cost of gas and labor would be approximately $2300 . I called other service for a second opinion and they recommended replacing the gas with a new replacement gas and the total price would be $700. I had unit repaired for the price quoted and the unit has been working great now 5 months later.

 2nd bad experience. I was out of town when my son who was recuperating from an auto accident experienced a backed up drain. He called for their $93 drain cleaning. He was charged $200 to remove and install toilet ( I am not a professional and can easily R&R toilet in 20 min have done it many times. ) He was not made aware of an additional charge. Rather than $93 He was charged $325.  An estimate was given for repairs to properly repair the problem for an additional $1647.00 (to replace 5 plastic pipe hangers and install 1 clean out) I performed the above repairs myself in approx. 1 hr.  and $10 for materials. FYI: I am not and have never been a plumber. 

 Let's face it; they can't service an AC unit or clean out a drain for their advertised prices! They rely on additional charges to make the service call VERY profitable. I feel that a reputable company would be upfront and advertise a reasonable price and charge a fair price for a repair job."

I attempted to contact their "Customer Assistance Team" and received answer, so I left a message and have received no response. 

I feel that both situations described above were examples of an intentional ripoff of a customer..

I will NEVER use Jarboe's again and will recommend and encourage others to never consider them and to  contact their local hometown Plumber, HVAC or  Electrician when any of these services are needed.

reviews.author: David B.
reviews.text: Ive used Jarboes along with other plumbing companies multiple times as im in real estate. I called Jarboes on Saturday jan 31st 2026 due to a leaking bath tub faucet. The plumbing tech Drew S showed up, evaluated the leak, stated he needed to shut the water off to make the repairs. There was snow on the ground and needed to access the water shut off. He completely over looked the main shut off in the house. I asked for a few minutes to clear off the snow and Drew said it was my job to have it cleared off before he got there. With not knowing he would need access to the main shut off in the yard it wasn't clear. Drew was there a total of 10 minutes, refused to wait for me to clear off the snow and billed me $150 with zero work performed. He left, I went out in the yard and cleared off the snow, called jarboes back and drew said he would charge another $150 to come back out (same day), I didnt agree with the charge but needed the repair done so asked him to come back out. He then refused to come back out and told me to find another plumber based on me not wanting to be double charged. This is completely unprofessional and unacceptable. I then called Tom Drexeler and they came out in a timely manner and made the repairs. I tried to call and discuss this with jarboes customer service and there's zero support after the service is done if there's a issue. Out of all the plumbing companies in Louisville I would not recommend jarboes based on the poor customer service I received from drew along with NO customer service after the fact from the company

reviews.author: Pen R.
reviews.text:
Jarboes installed a new water heater in May 2020. The pilot would come on but would not light the water heater so since they installed I called for repair. 
immediately said it was a faulty gas valve and would be 869.00 for the part. I looked online and the part is under 200.00 in two different stores. There is actually a manufacturer defect in the Honeywell gas valve. That should have been replaced with a different model at no cost to me and I also had the 6 year parts and maintenance warranty on my paperwork they did not honor. 
water heater was not repaired. I received an estimate for a new water heater at just under 3000.00 dollar's. Really? In less than 4 years I need to replace my water heater? Last night I looked at YouTube videos and reset the gas valve. It's up and runnin! Shower, two loads of dishes and load of laundry and still hot water. If the water heater fails again I shall never call Jarboes for repair service or installation of a new one. They do not honor the warranty and know it is a defective part.
Also the tech said it was not up to code because it had no drain pan. The old one had one and the new one came with a drain pan. The installers installed the water heater before putting the drain pan in and would have had to disconnect and reconnect so they took it back with them. In the estimate says drain out line in crawl space. There is a drain out line already existing!

reviews.author: K A.
reviews.text: I called Jarboe's to have my furnace cleaned.  I had never used Jarboe's before but had a coupon for a low cost furnace tuneup.  When I bought the house I knew the furnace was old, but I had no idea it was nearly 30 years old and rusting out.  The tech showed me another offer on the coupon that would give me over $2900 off a new system.  I wasn't about to let that slip by me.  I called 2 other companies for quotes.  The man from Jarboe's came the next day to price a new system for me.  He came with presentation material and explained everything in detail.  (Another company had already come to price a new system.  He came with a clipboard, paper and pen, then when he had his figures, he presented me with pricing.  That's it.)  While Jarboe's was there I called and cancelled the third company.  I knew I could not get a better deal for a 2-stage furnace and A/C unit.  I am very pleased with my new furnace.  I'm much more comfortable because my house temperature stays more consistent.  Plus the unit is so quiet I often don't realize when it's on.  Day one the tuneup.  Day two the presentation and agreement to buy the system.  Day three the installation.  Over these three days 5 men.  All were detailed, polite, and knowledgeable.  I highly recomment Jarboe's.

reviews.author: Tim L.
reviews.text:
Major ripoff. I wonder how many elderly and unsuspecting people have really gotten the shaft?
My A/C stopped working and I called Jarboe's on Thursday, a tech showed up in the time frame given checked out my A/C and said I needed a new fan motor and a new blade it wound cost over $3000 I said I can't afford that he said let me see if there are any discounts I can give you then came back and said if I pay for this maintenance service for a year at a cost of $189 he could do the job for $1425  but he would have to come back the next day, now that was $$189 maintenance for 1 year, $860 for the motor and $378 for the fan blade not sure why I needed a fan blade. I couldn't afford that either so I paid his service call which because there was a holiday this weekend he said it was considered holiday pay and overtime because he got there after 5 pm so $150 in all. 
 I contacted a friend the next day he picked up a OEM motor for $112 plus tax did not replace the blade had no reason took him about 30 mins and my ac is working fine his trip charge, labor and parts for the day before July 4th was less than what Jarboe's was going to charge me for just the blade. Please research any repairs cost before getting ripped off by this crew.

reviews.author: Madhukar D.
reviews.text:
We had a moderate leak under the kitchen sink, so we called Jarboe's.  On Dec 19th, a service person came and decided that we needed to change the air gap for the dishwasher.  He changed it, but the next day, the leak was still there, so we called Jarboe's again, who told us they will send a "Senior plumber", who came on the 21st.  He decided that sealing the periphery will solve the leakage problem, but won't be aesthetically good. Alternately we could replace the sink. We didn't care about aesthetics, so he went ahead and sealed the periphery. We asked about refund for the airgap replacement which was unnecessary and he told us to call the company. The company told us an email to the refund department will be sent and they would contact us. Nothing happened for a month so we called the company again and the lady told us she could send another email to refund department but we could neither call them directly nor have any other recourse than to wait for decision of the refund department. We have yet to hear for a fair resolution of the problem. It seems we are out of luck as far as a fair refund is concerned.
All I can do is to call the better business bureau or forget the whole thing (except to write this review).

synthesis.summary: Despite an A+ BBB rating and 4.8★ Google average from 5,915 reviews, the actual review text is overwhelmingly negative — pricing complaints, missed appointments, and aggressive upsells dominate. Multiple reviewers describe being quoted $1,000+ for jobs that other plumbers did for under $200. The 4.8★ vs 2.2★ Yelp split is one of the largest discrepancies in this batch.
weaknesses: $189 charged for a 5-minute toilet handle swap; $781 for a furnace board other companies quoted at $400–$600
Multiple reviewers describe upsells of $3K–$16K on jobs that ended up costing $200–$1,400 elsewhere
No-shows and missed promised arrival times — 'Never got a call or anyone show up' at 10pm appointment
redFlags: Pattern of price gouging: reviewers quote $6K, $8K, $11.5K, $34K estimates that other plumbers fixed for a fraction
Multiple reports of techs upselling vulnerable customers (80-yr-olds, 90-yr-old, elderly, female-identifying customers)
Refused to honor service contracts and refunds; reviewers report disputes escalated to BBB
Tech turned off customer's water heater without telling them, then quoted $80 to come back and fix it
Driver allegedly threatened a leashed dog at a neighbor's property — reported across two reviews
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Reviewers report being told a plumber would arrive by 10pm and never showing — 'urgent' calls bumped 3+ hours with no resolution. Same-day calls were sent to a different department mid-day, leaving 'water everywhere.'
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 2.2★ vs Google 4.8★ across 48 Yelp reviews — the review text in this batch is overwhelmingly negative; the high Google average appears at odds with the actual review content

plumbers.name: Golden Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2430 Bowman Ave, Louisville, KY 40217, USA

reviews.author: Raven Meredith
reviews.text: Golden Plumbing was very helpful after another company chose not to help repair a leak in my old weird house. Quick repones and scheduling, and very helpful and professional service from Dean! Will definitely use them again for future needs and will recommend to anyone who asks!

reviews.author: Michael Hommrich
reviews.text: Dean Titus was super.  He and his apprentice were very knowledgeable , friendly, and efficient.  The entire team, Janet, office manager and Jacob Allen were great to work with.  Great service and reasonable pricing.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brittanie Steele
reviews.text:
I am absolutely going to use Golden Plumbing for our next job. The technician Jacob Allen was so sweet and extremely helpful. He and his helper not only repaired the water leak outside our home but also came in and did a quick diagnosis of another issue we are having.

We look forward to having them back to get that resolved as well.
Our water line needed to be repaired immediately. We didn't have time to wait because having our water off put the rest of our pipes in danger of freezing due to the cold weather. Golden plumbing came right out. The price they gave us was extremely competitive and affordable. They were out the same day and when they left we had water and we were extremely happy with the job they did.

reviews.author: Charles Satram
reviews.text:
Fraud & unauthorized use of credit card information: After hiring Golden plumbing for a plumbing job, a job that was originally estimated to be completed in 2 DAYS, we found ourselves more than 2 MONTHS later with the following conditions (see attached photos). After providing my credit card information over the phone, to submit payment in line with our agreement, weeks later I recieved two more unauthorized charges to my credit cards for $4,000.

“Spence” is the supposed owner of the company and is never to be seen or heard from unless it’s about payment. This entire project was an absolute nightmare from start to unfinished. Countless hours of me having to manage this project and working with different Golden Plumbing employees every time they decided to show up. I have no problems with the employees because they were so grossly ill informed and mismanaged.

This company is not registered with the Better Business Bureau, but I’ll be filing a complaint anyway. That includes the Fraud/Unauthorized use of my credit card information.

My main concern at this point is potential vandalism of my property and unauthorized entry into my home. This may seem extreme but if “Spencer” is capable of fraud and destroying our home to this degree, I can only expect this situation to worsen with his involvement.

reviews.author: Michael Alan Hall
reviews.text: I thought i was dealing with professional but it seems the gentleman behind the phone is very defensive. Not sure why.. we pay good money out here.

reviews.author: Karl Williams
reviews.text:
On December 1st, I contacted Joe Riley, who promptly referred me to Golden Plumbing to address a significant problem: an underground leak that was consuming an alarming 13,000 extra gallons of water each month.

Speed & Communication: I received a detailed estimate within the hour.

Scheduling: Due to a snowstorm on the 2nd, the repair was scheduled for the following Thursday.

Professionalism in Conditions: Jacob and Devon arrived right on time, despite the challenging conditions—it was only 30 degrees outside and the worksite was a muddy mess. They went straight to work without complaint.

Quality of Work: They quickly and efficiently located the leak and completed the repair.

The team's professionalism and outstanding communication throughout the process were truly impressive. I wouldn't hesitate to hire them again for any future plumbing needs.

Highly recommended!

reviews.author: T G
reviews.text:
I was initially happy with the service Dean provided with Golden Plumbing. We had a gas leak and he was able to quickly find it and get it sorted. It wasn't cheap considering it didn't require any parts ($408), but I was happy for the peace of mind.

Where things took a turn was when I had LGE come back out to turn the gas on, the technician noted that because there was a flex connector through the furnace wall that needed replacing with a rigid pipe, he had to red tag the furnace. When I called Golden to see if they could come back out (having just left an hour ago), they gave me a $450 estimate over the phone. For a small piece of pipe and something that should've been caught when they were here? No thank you.

Dean was a pleasure to have in our home, but the Golden Plumbing office seems more interested in high upfront costs than retaining long-term customers.

reviews.author: AIrobot
reviews.text: Jordan Heibert, was the plumber that was sent to my house… came to fix a leaking faucet for my bathroom tub… when he arrived, he was shown the bathroom that has the issue (I have 2 bathrooms) and went to work right away, made sure he had all necessary supplies to complete the job, arrived at my home within the timeframe they give you, good communication skills, and the issue seems to hopefully finally be Fixed…. BETTER… the person they have answer their phones is also very nice and polite and is very helpful when it comes to scheduling plumbing appointments that can work with your needs…… and just because I didn’t rate it a 5 stars, don’t mean its not five stars….  If you know you know what I’m talking about

reviews.author: Steffany Huckaby
reviews.text: Living in homes that are over 100 years old around Louisville, I’ve become quite familiar with various plumbers and have found the best plumber in town. Good Plumbing did a fantastic job. Gave many different options in different price brackets to fix the problem, all of them very reasonable and affordable. They were spot-on diagnosing the problem and executing the solution. Both Ron and Tyler went over and above, very patient in explaining making a complex issue easier to understand. Very upstanding employees anyone would feel comfortable welcoming into their home. On time and going over and above with service and doing more than what was quoted and not charging. I can’t recommend them more highly.

reviews.author: Molly Rojas
reviews.text:
I called yesterday to get a quote on a gas leak, they had an appointment the next day . Jordan H. came out and was very informative on the issue , I was quoted about 1180 to fixed the issue from a different company . Golden plumbing was able to fix the issue for 4.5x LESS than the other company . I am a very satisfied customer and will be using Golden plumbing for any future needs .

UPDATE:So they had to come out two more times and we finally got the issue fixed , in total I spent less the half of the original quote for solving all three issue and times they had to come out . Definitely recommend this company.Honest, upfront and great customer service.

reviews.author: Lauren Dowell
reviews.text:
You know, they had a good vibe. They came in. They got the job done and they used the magic words “we don’t want you to pay too much for this. Let’s check and make sure it’s not something cheaper”

I know some of you are probably concerned about this, so you need to know I didn’t get an “ick.” You also probably need to know, a geriatric Chihuahua Rescue was cool with them being in the house.

I trust them in my house. Perhaps more important, the dog trusted them.

oh, and on top of all of that, they actually got me in at a reasonable time and they showed up early! Like for real, I can see why they have high reviews.

reviews.author: Kim Lee
reviews.text: I want to give kiddos to Golden Plumbing. I have had to use a few different repair companies in the past and Golden Plumbing has surpassed them all by miles. Not only did they communicate everything going on but did so in the nicest way. And I want to give a special thanks to my technician Dean Titus. He was punctual, very professional, and all around nice guy. He explained everything he was doing and why. I would trust him with my whole house. He is definitely the type of employee you want to represent your company. I will recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work!

reviews.author: Jacob Haley
reviews.text:
Jacob Allen came out for my service appointment for a clogged drain. They were earlier (not a complaint) than expected, knocked out the work, and we're out the door in under an hour. He was well spoken, up front, and honest. Which was appreciated.

The 4 stars is more so about the price rather than the service, seriously Jacob was great, I would have rather done 4 1/2 stars tbh. While I get that some people probably enjoy having 3 options given to them, I simply wanted the drain taken care of and did not need to hear about 3-4 thousand dollar projects.

reviews.author: Nicole Turner
reviews.text: Jordan did a great job. Had a horrible experience with United Plumbing and had to get another plumber to fix our problem. What was told to me by United was it was an all day or half day two man repair, Jordan got completed in 15 minutes. That doesn’t include the time to get the parts because the information was not correct from United. But over all I was very happy with it being fixed, the information he gave me and he addressed all my concerns. Jordan gets an A+ and 5 stars.

reviews.author: Kimeisha Riedley
reviews.text: I recently had my son’s toilet fixed by Golden Plumbing and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Booking was quick and hassle free and I was even able to move up my appointment when an earlier spot opened. super convenient! The plumber who came out was extremely knowledgeable, professional, and efficient. My family is very pleased with the service, and it's clear to us that Golden Plumbing will be our go to for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Omega Toliver
reviews.text: Very professional! Great prices. Educated homeowner on exact problem. Showed up on time! Really nice guys came out today! I needed last minute service and they showed up!  Thank you so much! Will definitely use this company again!

reviews.author: Shawn Houchens
reviews.text: Brian was our plumber technician. He was efficient and knowledgable. He completed the job and cleaned up everything and explained the reasons and workings of all repairs. We highly recommend  Daniel Brown plumbing

reviews.author: Kelli Braun
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with this plumbing company. Josh and their team responded very quickly, and their communication was outstanding from the start. They were helpful right away and even offered support and possible solutions before coming out, which I really appreciated.

Bryan was who came out, and he was excellent ! Very professional, respectful, and clearly knowledgeable. He took the time to explain everything and made sure I understood what was going on, which made the whole process much less stressful.

I’m very thankful for the help and would absolutely recommend Bryan and this company to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: Wil J.
reviews.text:
COVID SCAMMER

CHARGED $572.00 FOR A $140.00 JOB

AT $150.00 PER HOUR

For a $5.86 bronze toilet flush handle to be screwed on (they bought at Home Depot, the very cheapest available) and a $3.25 wax ring to be placed under the toilet. The kid also flushed out some buildup in the sink faucet's screen...

It took him over 3 hours, with 40 minutes in his truck, and he removed some of the working perfectly toilet tank mechanics (before) leaving it damaged and leaking now.

He left bragging about the high tech replacement.

Dan Brown kept saying he was coming, he apparently incompetent,  and  finally showed up after over 2 weeks sending some kid...

reviews.author: Joseph O.
reviews.text: I called Daniel Brown Plumbing for several rooms - some with clogs, some with leaks, some with loose faucets, etc. They sent out a technician - Brian within an hour of me calling saying there is a no-cost quote. The technician quoted me a price, I agreed to the price and he immediately began doing the work. He had to come back a second day due to the several problems that I had with my plumbing. I wasn't charged a single penny until the job was done and I was satisfied with the work done. He is a young guy who is incredibly respectful. I know he was frustrated with my standards of fixing the issue so I don't need to call back or call another company, but he remained completely respectful even after being covered in nasty clog drain water (thankfully not toilet output, but still very nasty either way). I respect him being so young and having so much respect and work ethic for his job. I have to replace my toilet soon and he even hoped to be sent out to do that because he seems to find satisfaction in fixing issues and making the customer happy. No one wants to pay to fix issues that happen in their homes, but when I get technicians like Brian, it makes it a better experience. I hope he keeps up his work ethic and doesn't become one of those old guys who give up and say you need to replace it, of all my issues I only had to replace two things and even then only one of those things is a complete replacement due to my decision. He offered to quote me a price to fix it, but I opted to get a price quote to replace it instead as I knew it wasn't standard equipment and I wanted something more common. Thank you Brian, I will request your services again for my toilet replacement and you have earned you and your company a new customer who will continue to use your services. I never want to use those services as they cost me money, but you make that process less painful by what I said above. - Joseph

reviews.author: Michael Lamey
reviews.text:
We have been using Daniel's Plumbing for the last 25 years.

Are most recent call was to have a freestanding bathtub installed along with a vanity and top and toilet reset.

When I called the office I spoke with Josh who was very polite and very attentive to what our needs was and what we were asking, Josh I would like to say thank you to you .

The estimators that came out were very courteous, thoughtful and nice, as well as respectful of our property.

The plumbers that came out and did the work Ted and Charles we're not only knowledgeable and professional as well they were courteous and understanding of our needs in the house. We wanted the work done if possible before Thanksgiving and Ted and Charles made sure that happened.

The freestanding tub along with the vanity base and top and toilet look amazing they did a fantastic job, cleaned everything up when they were finished it looked so nice.

We would highly recommend Daniel's Plumbing to anyone needing plumbing services in the future, not only are they fare on their price their professionalism and knowledgeable staff and plumbers can take care of any of your needs.

We will certainly be using them in the future for any of our future needs.

To the owners of Daniel's Plumbing thank you for having such knowledgeable and caring employees who have the talent that they do. Ted and Charles went out of their way to make sure that my wife was happy with everything. To have employees like Ted and Charles the plumbers that came out with your company.

I can see why you all are five star across the board on all the review sites. Again thank you for the wonderful work that you all did.

reviews.author: Ryan V.
reviews.text:
My rule with trades people has been "If they are on TV, don't hire them." I have had more plumber problems (not to be confused with plumbing problems) than any other trade. So, who do you call when your plumber is broken? Daniel Brown Plumbing!

They were on time and they do not have hidden fees. Their fee is $155 per hour as I write this and they were gone in less than 2 hours. They unclogged 2 drains: one took 15 seconds to unclog, the other was a bigger issue in the tub. They took the time to educate me on how to prevent the clog in the future and recommended using drain cleaners that have a biological component (unlike Draino, which can harm pipes).

The two plumbers who arrived were named Joey and Adrian. Both were very professional, friendly, and they did not dilly dally. They wore masks the whole time, which I do value as I am immunocompromised. They also did not have to be asked to put on the mask and they did not 'wait and see' if I were wearing one first. After the job was finished, Joey spent 15 minutes wiping down everything with disinfecting wipes to leave everything clean.

I told both Joey and Adrian I generally hate plumbers because I have had so much trouble finding good ones. Pretty much all the TV plumbers are horrendous and a few others I tried were just terrible. But, Daniel Brown Plumbing is excellent. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Lorie L.
reviews.text:
We found Daniel's company via Yelp and had bookmarked the account for when we needed a local plumber. Keep in mind you may need to leave a message or wait a few days to have a job seen and quoted; however, if you have time, I recommend you hold tight for Daniel and his team.

Rick was the person assigned to visit us. He arrived on time and was able to check out our plumbing challenge with new bathtub hardware. We'd been advised to have our new hardware available (great advice) so Rick was able to quote the job immediately and complete the job.

I especially appreciated Rick's attention to detail. The new tub hot/cold handles didn't quite fit to his standards and he wanted to point out a slight wobble. I walked upstairs with him, turned the handle on and off and still didn't see what his expert eye did. He assured me there wasn't a concern about leakage, only the look or feel. All good!

We paid by check which gave us a slight discount. Credit cards are accepted as well.

reviews.author: Dale B Billingsley
reviews.text: My wife and I knew Daniel's parents about 45 years ago, and they told us about his plumbing service soon after we met.  We have used his company since then--because we live in an old house, those services have been necessary more often than we might prefer--and we have been pleased with every job and with all the plumbers from his staff.  We were anxious when Daniel retired that the quality of the staff and the excellent service might decline, but that has not been the case.  Brian Kavanaugh came last week to fix a leaky kitchen sink and to scope our sewer line (a preventative measure, as recommended by Daniel).  A recent addition to the staff, he did a fine job, was clear and frank about the problem and the solution he intended, and was affable and courteous besides.  All to the good for us, and we continue to appreciate Daniel Brown Plumbing Service so much that we recommend it to any friend who needs reliable plumbing work.

reviews.author: Erika Schneider
reviews.text:
We’ve been using Daniel Brown Plumbing for several years now, and they just keep delivering. Most recently, we had a leak coming from an upstairs shower — not exactly a fun situation. Their team came out to take a look, and even though they didn’t have the part on hand that day (a Thursday), they texted first thing Friday morning to say they had it and could come fix it immediately. Super quick turnaround.
What really stands out with these guys is how straightforward they are — they walked us through exactly what was going on, laid out the cost upfront, and explained what the fix would involve. No guessing, no surprises. The repair itself was done quickly, and we were back to normal before we knew it.
One small suggestion: it’d be helpful to know the service visit fee when booking an appointment. Minor thing overall though. We’ll absolutely be calling Daniel Brown Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Catherine K.
reviews.text:
This plumbing company gets it! I would rate them 10 stars if i could! From the moment I got on the phone to explain my issue i was treated with respect and understanding. Dan listened to my issues, he even asked for pictures so he could give me his best estimate over the phone (instead of wasting time with an additional consult). 

This morning Adrien called about 30 minutes out, arrived on time and completed the job in about an hour. He had covers over his shoes and left my bathroom clean afterward. He took time to listen which I appreciate most of all! The estimate i was provided was exactly what I was charged, which was an amazing price! 

I am so happy i found these reviews on yelp and decided to go with Dan Brown Plumbing, if you're in the Louisville area and don't know where to start, THIS IS THE COMPANY YOU SHOULD USE!

reviews.author: One G.
reviews.text:
My old 80-gallon water heater failed (bad leak) in the wee hours of the night.  About 8AM I called Brown Plumbing and told them I needed a new 50-gallon water heater.  Within minutes of that call, I was contacted by Curtis, one of their plumbers; he said he had the new water heater on his truck and would arrive in a few minutes.
Curtis called up a couple of other guys to help remove the old 80-gal. heater which was much larger & heavier than the new heater.  He finished the job in a professional manner.
I was quite impressed, and very thankful, that Brown Plumbing was able to address my "emergency" so quickly and professionally.
If I need a plumber again, I will call Daniel Brown Plumbing without hesitation.

reviews.author: Skip D.
reviews.text:
I had a new washer installed by one of the big box stores and after the installation I discovered one of the very old water input valves was leaking. It was dripping even in the off position. I called Daniel Brown Plumbing and they said they would have someone out the next afternoon but would try to get creative with their schedule so they could get here earlier. I received a call at 8:30 the next morning and was told a plumber could be here within the hour. 

The gentleman was friendly, safe, efficient, and did an excellent job. 

I've dealt with Daniel Brown Plumbing in the past when that did some work at my dad's house. Their customer service and communication skills are just as top notch as their work.

reviews.author: Gregg Gilpin
reviews.text: I went to send a big shout out to Daniel Brown Plumbing. I HAD a persistent drain clog in a secondary drain-line under my house. I texted their number this past Sunday and got an immediate response, saying a crew would be out Monday morning.  Andrew and Nick got to my house by 9:00 AM. It was a very complicated problem. They called in Superman Rick to help assess the problem. Ended up, I had a broken cast iron pipe under the concrete slab. They did some bobbing and weaving and re-routed two drain lines to a different pipe. Done by 4:00. Amazing job and I got a great price. Can’t say enough about the guys. Please give them a consideration if you need help with plumbing problems. You won’t be unhappy.

reviews.author: Ryan C.
reviews.text: I moved into a new home and found out that the water heater was not functioning. I called around for plumbing services to try to get someone out to my house ASAP, and Daniel Brown Plumbing was the only one who was able to come right away on the same day. The technician came and fixed the water heater right away! Not only that, it ended up being such a simple fix that they didn't charge me anything! I would have expected that I would be charged for some kind of a service charge just for the technician coming out to my house. Very fast and reliable service. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for plumbing services!

reviews.author: Dan W.
reviews.text:
Maeser Master Services
58-Day Heat and Air Nightmare Installation

On May 17, 2023, Maeser Services in Louisville, KY came to our home to bid on installing a new heat and air system. The estimator determined that a 3-ton unit would be more than adequate for our home.  During his 20-minute visit, I asked him three times if was he sure a 3-ton would do the job. Each time he assured me it would be more than efficient. The bid was for an air handler with variable speed indoor heat pump and a plenum, with a one-day installation.
May 22:  Maeser came to install the new unit. They took all day, but they didn't get the unit installed, so there was no air in our home. They left after 5:30 and didn't say when they would return.
May 23: I called to see what time they would be coming. The scheduler said they were to come out all day to finish the job. I waited until after 10 AM and called again to see where they were. Another scheduler said they weren't coming today. I told her they had to come now to finish the job, because it was going to be in the high 80s, and we needed a working air unit to stay in our home. They finally showed up and finished the installation.
That weekend the temperature reached over 90 degrees and the new unit was holding at 78 degrees and would go no lower. At that time, I knew the unit was undersized. I also saw where the installers burned our carpet and two walls with a blowtorch.  (Pictures below)
June 2: The installation manager came out to inspect the damage and the undersized unit. He said we had a two-fan speed unit. We had paid for a variable-speed indoor heat pump. They had installed a lesser unit.
July 5: After 33 days, Maeser finally came back to install the correct-sized unit. Before they started, they wanted me to sign a paper saying they were not responsible for any damages incurred during the installation of the equipment. In other words, while they are using their blowtorch, which they had already burned our carpet and 2 walls, they wouldn't be liable if they burned our house down.  I refused to sign the paper.  They finally consented and started the installation of the second unit. They got most of the work done, but then informed me I had to pay for the plenum, a key piece of equipment that joins the new unit to the existing ductwork. The estimator said, from day one, that the new plenum was included in the bid. I refused to pay because it was already paid for. At that point, the installers walled off the job. So, for the next 14 days, we had to leave our home because we had no air conditioning during the heat of summer. During that time, I fabricated our existing plenum in order to for them to come back to finish the installation.  What homeowner has to do that?
July 19: Since I now had a plenum, Maeser agreed to come and again they said I had to sign their paper saying they were not responsible for any damages done during the installation process. I again refused. After a few phone calls, they finally installed the correct unit after 58 days to do a one-day installation.
July 20: However, the next day the installers had to come back because the unit was leaking water on our wood floor.  They determined that they had not used glue to hold the drainpipe together.

*The installers were not licensed, unprofessional, used the f-word several times, and never apologized for all the delays, mistakes, and damage they caused to the home. For a total of 15 days, we were unable to stay in our home due to the exterior high temperatures, because our new air system was not installed.

reviews.author: Shane W.
reviews.text: We were five star monthly members with Maeser for several years.  We canceled recently after a terrible experience with the company.  John Day with Maeser along with another gentleman came to do our 6 month Heating/Air inspection and when they were finished he went through a list of things he noticed including telling me that the last guy who came six months ago didn't put all the screws back in our unit upstairs.  He went through everything and told us the outdoor coils on both units very extremely dirty and covered in hair as well as the heat pump and needed to be cleaned.  He said it would cost $106 for each unit, so $212 for both.  I told him that we had a lot of expenses currently but we would do the worst one right now as he made it seem like it was a huge concern.  Before they do anything we had to pay the $106, after paying my wife and I noticed John and the other guy go outside plug a water hose into our faucet and John simply sprays the outside of the unit with a water hose for 5 minutes and then he does the other one for 5 minutes, 10 minutes labor to spray a water hose while the other guy stood and watched.  When hearing they would clean the unit we thought that they would actually clean the unit as we have a water hose right by the unit which we could have sprayed it down ourselves.  As I can imagine no one would ever pay $106 for someone to a spray water hose for 5 minutes per unit.  So, they are charging $106 to spray a unit with a water hose for 5 minutes nothing else, no actual cleaning.  After the ten minutes of spraying a water hose, John has the nerve to come in and say it's still not totally clean but better than it was.  I felt I had just be conned, so I proceeded to call Maeser thinking this was a mistake no way they charge $106 to a "priority member" to spray a unit with a water hose for 5 minutes. I called once and dispatch never called me, so I called again and no one called and the third time I spoke with someone and told him what happened and what I was charged to which he replied, "wow." The third guy I spoke with emailed customer service to give me a call.  After over a day someone finally called me back and I told him we were members and the experience I had and what I was charged, he did nothing but just said that's what we charge for that service and the price was "fair" and justified.  I was shocked and immediately called back to cancel my membership.  After I did this I received a call from Scott Bowles who said they'd refund the $106 and then he said "we'd agree to do business with other people."  I never once received an apology for the experience and being in customer relations myself, I can honestly say this is one of the worst customer service experiences I have ever received.

reviews.author: Juanita R.
reviews.text:
I needed a new water heater installed, old one removed and taken away. Basic replacement, 40 gallon short for a 40 gallon short. Maeser was my 3rd estimate. I wasn't going to call them at all due to a small valve repair that they bilked me on.  That said, I went to Home Depot and saw that they could replace a water heater, same day and they used Maeser as their plumbing company. So I decided to set it up. The Maeser Tech Larry Taylor came out and looked at the water heater. I told him I wanted the Rheem water heater from Home Depot. He did his calculations and came up with $2,188 ... then said, HD is out of 40 gallon gas water heaters, and we will have to use our preferred brand that is not sold at Home Depot. I asked the price of the water heater they would provide and he said he had no way of knowing that because he just plugs in the work to be done and his iPad comes up with the total. I know the 40 gallon short gas water heaters at HD were under $700 and they were in stock, in many of the local HD's. He also added that he couldn't take away the old heater! Bate and Switch! 

Price Discrepancy:
The significant difference between the Home Depot water heater price (around $700) and the Maeser estimate ($2,188) is a major red flag.
The technician's inability to provide a breakdown of the water heater cost is also concerning. A reputable company should be transparent about their pricing.
"Bait and Switch" Tactics:
Claiming Home Depot was out of stock when I knew they were not, and then pushing their "preferred brand" is a classic bait-and-switch tactic.
This suggests a lack of honesty and an attempt to inflate the price.
Refusal to Remove Old Heater:
Most water heater installation services include the removal and disposal of the old unit.
The technician's refusal to do this is unusual and adds to the overall impression of poor service.
Past Negative Experience:
My previous negative experience with Maeser regarding the valve repair is also relevant, as it establishes a pattern of potentially questionable business practices. They refunded $400 for a $900 over charge- the best they said they could do.
Home Depot and Maeser Relationship:
While Home Depot uses Maeser for some installations, this doesn't guarantee a positive experience. Home Depot contracts with many companies, and those companies are still responsible for their own actions.

I will contact Home Depot about my experience with Maeser. 
I will file a complaint with the Better Business Bureau (BBB) , and post on Google reviews.

It's important to protect yourself from potentially deceptive business practices!

reviews.author: Lorie L.
reviews.text:
We've hired Maeser twice for two unexpected water issues - but isn't this the case for most plumbing needs? The first visit happened when my husband broke the porcelain toilet while changing the seat. So much for a cheap upgrade! He called a couple of plumbers and Maeser said someone could come right away with a toilet. Not an ideal scenario but my husband was terrified if the toilet broke beyond the crack we'd have a small flood. The service technicians were quick and didn't leave any mess behind.

Our recent visit happened this week. A bubble in the kitchen ceiling paint brought attention to a leak from the upstairs bathroom. The drywall was cracked along the seam. Our appointment time was scheduled between 10a - noon, which is the period the service technicians arrived. The team very thoroughly checked the fixtures, not only in the upstairs bathroom but the master bathroom next to it. After checking a handful of areas we were left with the conclusion we'd have to cut a hole in the kitchen ceiling to reveal the pipes.

After cutting away the drywall we could see it was very wet but our pipes were dry! It had the service technicians stumped. I was thankful my husband was staying with them to ensure they kept looking. It led the service technicians to uncover a small gap between the bathroom tile and closet doorway, which sits next to the bathtub. Very, very small. When water was poured into the gap it poured into the kitchen downstairs! 

While I'm happy the fix wasn't replacing pipes or another experience alternative I can't believe a gap in caulk led to wet drywall and a hole in my ceiling. Our tub and edges are now fixed and we added a tub splash guard as recommended by the service technicians. 

Again, another job well job. Responsive, friendly and helpful service, cleaned up the area well and answered my husband's questions. Maeser does charge a diagnostic fee that can be applied toward the service. It's better than most (we've not found a plumber with free estimates). We will call them again for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Aaron M.
reviews.text:
Maeser came very highly recommended from a friend of mine, so we reached out to them for some very routine maintenance and service for our single family home's HVAC unit. They were very personable on the phone and initially helpful in scheduling this service. 

The day of service rolls around, and no one showed up to my house for service. As this was on a Friday, I waited through the weekend to call them to see what the problem was. Turns out, the receptionist who took my call wrote down the incorrect phone number, and as such, the technician in the field couldn't reach me. I took this in stride, "no big deal," etc. We rescheduled for a later date. 

That second date (5/22), again, another no-show. I called Maeser to see what was going on this time around. Again, the technician had tried reaching me at my cell phone, and as there was no answer, my appointment was not completed. No voicemails left. I confirmed with the receptionist taking my call this time around, Ricardo, that they had the correct number on file, which they did. I've had my cell phone on me with completely normal service this entire day, and I've received countless phone calls from other people today. So, either they never called me, or the field technicians still have my incorrect number. 

Ricardo offered to reschedule again, but I was pretty livid at this point and declined. I cannot continue leaving work for the afternoon and have people no-show for appointments. I've been available on both dates with a fully functioning cell phone at the appointment times twice now, and I can't give them the benefit of the doubt a third time. Will be seeking service elsewhere.

reviews.author: Jess A.
reviews.text:
I came home on a hot July Friday night to a loud vibration shaking my house and quickly realized it was my HVAC, and whatever it was...wasn't good. What was I going to do at the beginning of a weekend to get this fixed fast without spending a fortune??

I turned to Yelp early the next morning - as a new homeowner I didn't have any resources on hand and needed to find a trustworthy company to help me out. My fellow Yelpers steered me in the right direction ~ Maeser Master Services. I was impressed with the owner's credentials, I loved the fact that it was a local business, and thrilled when someone answered the phone on a Saturday before 10 AM and promised that a technician would see me on the same day, even though I'm a bit further out in Oldham County.

Although the tech was a bit late (the job before mine was more complex than they realized) I was kept in the loop the whole day by the customer service operator and my appointment was kept. My technician found a relatively inexpensive issue and showed me the problem (long story short - don't use cheap air filters in those things). Even though he could have easily made up some bigger more expensive problem and I wouldn't have ever known it, he charged for a small part and his trip fee. He was kind to my kids, professional, and efficient.

I would absolutely recommend Maeser to others for HVAC services - and with the positive experience that I had I would also call them for their other services.

reviews.author: Katie S.
reviews.text:
I wish there was an option for 0 stars...  My father and both grandfathers were well respected in plumbing and plumbing supply for the last 50 years in Louisville. It was upon their recommendation that I use Maeser.  The work that I have had them do in the past was done well and without issue, but NEVER again! 

We called them out to look at a small job at our home, and got side swiped by an unbelievable estimate more than 4x what we expected.  They will not have my business for this job, but after 5 minutes in my home they walked away with my $69 (mandatory service fee).  When we called the main office to inquire about the service fee, we were met by rudeness.  We have another company coming to do the work tomorrow, for a respectable price.

I come from a family that knows the business and knows the average cost for a job.  What they offered today, is pure robbery.  Having to paying them a $69 "service fee" for that estimate is unbelievable!

reviews.author: Shane K.
reviews.text:
This is the second time I requested service from this company. The first time was an amazing experience. The technicians who came out were very professional and finished the repair in a timely manner.

This time is a completely different experience. Last night I set up an appointment for them to come out today between 8a and 10a. I had some plumbing issues in the upstairs bathroom. 10a rolls around and nobody has shown up. I contacted them and was informed that the technician got behind on the first job but should be at my plane within the hour. 

I informed them, again, about my issues and that in a couple of hours I will need to leave to get my daughter (I have a feeling the project will take a few hours). I wait almost an hour in a half and they still haven't arrived or called. 

As a result I decided to go with a different company. It appears that they are short on technicians which is unfortunate.

synthesis.summary: The Yelp reviews tell a brutal story for a company sitting on a 4.8★ Google rating: $5,000 AC installs that didn't cool the house after 38 days, a 58-day 'one-day' install that burned carpet and walls, and a 'maintenance' visit where techs charged $106 to spray a hose for 5 minutes. One verified positive review from Tyler getting same-day service stands almost alone.
strengths: Tyler arrived in the scheduled window with 30-minute advance notice and a tech photo, fixed the pipe quickly
weaknesses: Quoted $1,322 to repair an A/C; competitor did the same job for $268
Repeated no-shows where techs claim they called but no voicemails are ever left
Charges by 'type of repair' not by hour — one valve under a sink quoted at $153 with $3 in parts
redFlags: Installers reportedly burned carpet and two walls with a blowtorch during a 58-day install
Charged $106 to spray an outdoor coil with a hose for 5 minutes and called it 'cleaning'
Multiple reviewers report being asked to sign liability waivers before installers would proceed
Review reports a tech and trainee stole tools, jig saw, and bags during a drain job
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviewers report no-shows and unanswered callbacks; one reviewer 'made 5 phone calls in 3 days and never received a return call' on an unfinished job.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 3.6★ vs Google 4.8★ across 100 Yelp reviews — a 1.2★ gap with this much Yelp volume strongly suggests review curation on the Google side

plumbers.address: 1115 Pine Portage Loop, Leander, TX 78641, USA

reviews.author: Christy Hinterlong
reviews.text: I cannot recommend Carl(in) enough from Vaquero Plumbing! I had the unfortunate worst case scenario with a main line slab leak. Carl, Javi, and his contractors came in to save the day several days this week to get me back up and running. They took the time to show everything to me step by step to reassure me of their decisions, checked in with me when new issues arose, and answered any question I had. They came highly recommended in my neighborhood and I’m so thankful I chose them for this service. They now have a new loyal customer based on how this all went.

reviews.author: Melissa Jecker
reviews.text: Eddie is phenomenal!!! He educated me and as a woman …to me that is key. He was prompt, respectful of our property, knowledgeable and was just amazing. The call center was very efficient and kind. The office lets the customer know when the tech will arrive. Eddie also shared  an option for the “ club” a yearly check on all shut off valves etc in the home. I would call this company again in a heartbeat. I very much appreciate how the  entire company operates from start to finish!!! The little extra touches down to not walking on the grass just supports their professionalism. THANK YOU EDDIE.

reviews.author: Priscilla Frigon
reviews.text: Eddie did a fantastic job fixing the leaking tub spout in my shower. He was incredibly helpful, arrived on time, and clearly very knowledgeable. I appreciated how professional and efficient he was throughout the entire process. I would highly recommend Eddie with Vaquero Plumbing to anyone in need of plumbing services!

reviews.author: George L.
reviews.text: I hired Vaquero Plumbing as the plumber for a bathroom remodel.  First, the gentlemen who came out to do the work were good people and easy to welcome into my home.  The hard stuff, busting up concrete and moving piping went fine; however, they managed to hook up the hot water to the cold side and the cold water to the hot side of my new thermostatic shower system.  Took them a couple trips to diagnose that was the problem, but I tried to remain patient.  VP had to tear up a new wall to switch the lines; however, they promised me that they'd also repair my wall.  Well, that was 4 months ago now.  I have given up that VQ will do what they'd said they would do.  Just do what you say will do.  When you're in the service business; it's mission critical.

reviews.author: a h
reviews.text:
I called to get a quote for fixing my toilet that intermittently ran.  I tried swapping out the flapper myself but that wasn’t the issue. I had to replace the flush valve if I wanted to stop the phantom drain.  I explained this all to the person on the phone.  The person I spoke to was friendly and offered a free in-person quote. They were very accommodating to my schedule and allowed me to change the arrival window multiple times.

When the plumber came he suggested to swap out the complete set in the toilet tank for over $500. I was shocked. The parts are $25 at Home Depot and it typically takes 20-30 minutes. I asked about just swapping out the flush valve and he quoted me over $300.  Too steep for a 30 minute job.

I ended up getting a complete toilet repair kit from Home Depot for $25, watched a YouTube video, and did it all myself in 30 minutes. Saved me $500.

I was expecting that hiring someone to switch out the tank components would cost $150-200, which is reasonable for a quick job.  If anyone gets a quote higher than this I recommend going with another company or just fixing it yourself… it’s actually easy!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Riley
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic service! As a real estate agent in Austin, TX I rely on many trades for clients and only refer those I use personally.  Our regular plumbers had limited availability so after a colleague highly recommended Vaquero Plumbing, I gave them a call for a plumbing need at my home.  Not only was the plumber, Robert, incredibly responsive, but he also arrived EARLY and I was thrilled to learn the company is woman owned.  Their commitment to customer service was impressive and Robert quickly diagnosed and fixed the issue.  I can't recommend Vaquero Plumbing highly enough for anyone in need of reliable and top-notch plumbing services and they are our new go to - both personally and professionally. Five stars!

reviews.author: Lindsey Hill
reviews.text: What a great experience! From booking the appointment to the completion it was seamless and everyone I talked with was great. Eddie came out and explained everything he was doing, showed me what the issue was, fixed it and checked to make sure we were all good. He was kind, professional and very knowledgeable. I will definitely be calling them for all my future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jeri Prather
reviews.text: This company is the BEST!  From Melissa in the office to Javier & Eddy fixing a leak in our slab and installing a new hot water heater, they could not have been any more knowledgeable or professional.  They do good work for an honest price.  I will definitely be calling on them again if I need plumbing repair and I would be happy to recommend them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Linda C.
reviews.text: We had a plumbing concern and Vaquero Plumbing dispatched Javier Estrada to address it. He has 15 years experience and quickly diagnosed the problem. We also had him replace two older toilets and we are so pleased with the never models that he recommended. This is our second time using Vaquero Plumbing and we have been pleased with their quality of work and courtesy.

reviews.author: Wendy B.
reviews.text: Water heater had a meltdown on Christmas break, leaked all over the closet and started molding, even going through the wall to my bedroom closet. These guys came out same day and started helping us work through it with the construction guys. Really saved us and during the holiday, too. Solid team, worth the price. Thanks guys

reviews.author: Lance' P.
reviews.text:
Vaquero took care of a few tough plumbing jobs at our rental property.  They were responsive, punctual and freindly.  Most importantly, they did exactly what they promised. 
We referred them to a friend for a water heater replacement and she was also very pleased with their services.
Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Lina Tovar
reviews.text: I highly recommend Vaquero Plumbing for anyone in need of plumbing services. Their professionalism, expertise, and commitment to customer satisfaction makes them a top choice. My water heater replacement was done efficiently and cleanly I will definitely be using their services again in the future.

reviews.author: C Freeman
reviews.text: Outstanding service from a great local plumbing company. They were prompt, professional, and clearly take pride in their work. Everything was explained thoroughly and handled efficiently. It’s always refreshing to work with a company that truly values quality and customer service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nathan Jones
reviews.text: I will only be using Vaquero Plumbing from now on. They provided amazing service when having my old shower valves replaced. They had to special order a cover plate due to the original design but quickly found the required part and kept updated with install. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alan Moreno
reviews.text:
Eddie was a complete professional. He talked me through my options the whole time when it came to replacing an old shower cartridge and it felt like he really had the homeowners best interests at heart.

I can't recommend this company enough. Will use them again in the future.

synthesis.summary: Vaquero crushes communication and emergency response — answered on the 4th of July, showed up same-day for a slab leak, and techs walk through every step. Pricing is the catch: a few reviewers paid $600 for a simple PVC elbow swap, so confirm scope before signing.
