reviews.author: Debra Hensley
reviews.text: These professionals are really good. They are prompt,  trustworthy,  hard working,  skilled, and extremely knowledgeable.  They figure out the problems and solve them without delay.  I will go to this company for my plumbing,  electrical,  and handyman services.  The owners have thoroughly vetted their employees.  I couldn't have asked for better service.  Thank you.

reviews.author: Patrick Henshaw
reviews.text: Jacob was incredible! Courteous, timely, efficient and effective! The ability to also text them photos of the work I needed was a game changer for a quick and accurate estimate that I was already comfortable with before they arrived! Will definitely be using St. Matthews plumbing again and would recommend you do so as well!

reviews.author: Wyman Marshall
reviews.text: The tech’s from St Matthews plumbing were great! They pointed out some issues that had been done incorrectly with the former owners toilet install. While fixing it correctly, they accidentally damaged the toilet flange. They told me about it immediately, and repaired it better than it was before (with no extra cost). Businesses like this are hard to find these days… And I appreciate people who admit their mistakes and do the best they can to fix them. I would highly recommend St Matthews Plumbing to anyone.

reviews.author: Angela B.
reviews.text: Please don't use this company I had a broken valve on my shower handle these guys charged me $400 dollars just for that unfortunately I was @ work and couldn't not found someone else that quick, so I had no choice vey disappointed

reviews.author: Wc B.
reviews.text: After reading several glowing reviews, I wanted to use this company but found them to be unreliable. Would not recommend.

reviews.author: Adele P.
reviews.text: After doing some research, I decided on St Matthews Plumbing, primarily due to it's consistent 5 star rating on Google reviews (21), Yelp (1), Angie's List (4), and BBB (2). My initial contact was Doug Peacock, its president, who'd responded to my online request for service. He sent Chris out for a free estimate that same day (Monday), then set my appointment for today (Thursday) when I called back after the estimate. I had 4 things I needed/wanted done. In the end, the 2 needs were addressed. The other 2 are minor and postponed for now. When Chris was here Monday, he (1) tightened up the pipe under my kitchen sink (no charge) and (2) advised what type handle/faucet I required to replace the constantly dripping tub/shower one in the main bathroom. He explained the 2 choices available (with washers or easy quarter-turn and no washers), and suggested I get it at Plumbers Supply, which I did AFTER I checked at Home Depot and Lowe's. The job also involved cutting out an access in the drywall to the plumbing - it's in the bathroom closet - nicely squared, so it will be easy for me to fix with a panel of some sort. Chris is knowledgeable, polite, and his post-job clean up was fine. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Betty M.
reviews.text: Needing a plumber for a stopped up double kitchen sink, I combed the reviews, called people, etc.  Its so hard to find reliable, trust worthy people.  I called St. Matthew's Plumbing and heard from them first thing in the morning.  I spoke with Dan (the owner) and he said he could have someone out between 4 and 6. Yeah!  I lucked out because the service man was able to arrive earlier.  Kieran showed up and we discussed what was going on, he checked in the cellar to see what kind of pipes were used.  We discussed pricing and what he thought was the issue.  A little over an hour later he was cleaning up and the water was flowing through the drains.  I was very impressed with the company (small local owned) overall.  If I have any plumbing issues down the road I will definitely call St. Matthew's Plumbing.  I feel they are reliable with a lot of years experience and didn't try to oversell or overprice me.  I'm extremely happy with the work and the professionalism of everyone I dealt with.

reviews.author: Jennifer Hummel
reviews.text:
St. Matthews Plumbing did a great job! They answered all my questions about the sewer clean out. They were very professional and showed up on time. We would definitely use them again.

St. Matthews Plumbing did a wonderful job installing my new water heater! They came out quickly and gave me a quote the same day. I was able to schedule the work the next business day. They were very professional and answered all my questions. I would definitely use them again.

St Matthews Plumbing came out and installed a new toilet on Christmas Eve. We really appreciated them installing it before the holiday and family coming over to visit. St. Matthews Plumbing is always professional. They do an excellent job. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jenny
reviews.text: St Mathew’s Plumbing is the bomb! They checked every box for a plumbing company.  They are courteous, efficient and reasonably price.  I cannot say enough to express my gratitude for the service they provided to unclog a drain after I accidentally poured a cleaning rag down the toilet of my son and his family’s home that they had just moved into.  Jacob and three other guys worked tirelessly and with great attitudes determined to unclog the pipe.  They were successful thankfully!!  Reasonably priced on top of great service.  What more. Everything a customer could want!  They also confirm appointments with texts, emails and phone calls.

reviews.author: mary lassiter
reviews.text:
Got a really high water bill this month. Louisville Water suggested performing the food coloring test and sure enough, without us knowing, our toilet was running and wasting gallons of water.
I called St. Matthews Plumbing at 8 a.m. and Jacob arrived promptly at 9:30. Took one look made the adjustment and said to call if we had any more trouble. Done.✅
We moved to Louisville ten years ago and three properties later continue to call St. Matthews for all our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Michele Moses
reviews.text: St. Matthews Plumbing has been wonderful to work with. They are always professional, honest, and easy to talk to. They really listen to your concerns and take the time to explain things clearly, which makes a huge difference. We’ve appreciated their strong guidance and how confident and knowledgeable they are when helping us make decisions. It’s hard to find companies you truly trust, and they have definitely earned ours. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: catherine astorino
reviews.text: We liked their personnel and communication. We appreciate the Veterans  discount. However, we felt that the initial recommendation of a new toilet should have been the last resort in the problem solving process. When discussed, they agreed to auger the line and that is working right now. That may change over time. However, we appreciated doing the least expensive first.

reviews.author: Rebecca Lysohir
reviews.text: Fast service, very nice technician.  Did what he could.  Did not have a camera to find where the  sewer break is and then St Matthew’s Plumbing was going to charge me an additional $400 to run a camera.  Decided to use another company who did free diagnostics.  I always call St Matthew’s Plumbing first when I have an issue.

reviews.author: Sydney Combs
reviews.text: This might be a little thing, but they were great about wearing their lil blue booties over their shoes anytime they weren't in the cellar. Stuff like that really makes a difference to me. They also managed to fix my hot water heater without performing any significant repairs, so that was nice. $250 all in all.

reviews.author: Tania Miles
reviews.text: Jacob was professional and personable. Explained everything to me and was able to get everything fixed and my plumbing back up and working during a last minute weekend appointment. I’m thankful and grateful for his expertise and kindness. The cost also was affordable when thinking of a last minute appointment.

synthesis.summary: Owner Dan and techs like Josh, Brent, Kieran, and Chris show up same-day, text-quote from photos, and own their mistakes — when they damaged a toilet flange they fixed it 'better than it was before (with no extra cost).' Two early Yelp 2-star reviews call out a $400 shower-handle quote, but the recent pattern across 30+ reviews is consistently high quality.
strengths: Texted photo estimates so the customer is 'comfortable with before they arrived'
Christmas Eve toilet install before holiday family arrived
Sunday water heater diagnosis with the tech showing the homeowner how to fix it in the future
weaknesses: One reviewer was charged $400 for a broken shower handle valve and called the price disappointing
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Same-day and Sunday service confirmed in multiple reviews ('Tony came out on a Sunday', water heater installed 'next business day'), but no explicit 24/7 / overnight evidence in the sample.

reviews.author: Drew D
reviews.text: We recently had a plumbing issue that turned into a bigger issue due to a literal hole in our pipe under the driveway. Becca came to our house several times to help with the issue and was able to fix it in a very fast time frame. Their communication was excellent, answered all of our many questions and explained in an easy way for us to understand, and were super upfront with all costs. We had reached our after business hours and Cody was super responsive to us. While I hope we don’t become regulars (no other plumbing issues 🤞🏼), I’m very happy to have found a super reliable company like Queens for any of our needs.

reviews.author: Keila Ventura
reviews.text: I contacted Queens plumbing and they had Becca out there in a jif! She offered me a few options as to how they were going to fix my leaks. They provided their most honest opinion and had the problem resolved within a very efficient amount of time. Very trustworthy very hard-working accredited plumbers that I will contact for any further issues I may have in the future.

reviews.author: JW Tipping
reviews.text:
I've had multiple jobs done by Queens Plumbing and their work is top notch!
Both Cody and Becca are incredibly professional and willing to address any concern a homeowner might have!

reviews.author: Hayden J
reviews.text: Cody was great! I called all the main plumbing companies in Louisville for a water heater replacement “rough estimate” quote. All refused to give a quote on the phone, except Cody. I explained Cody the issue he told me the estimated quote. All other companies required a technician to come out, costing me a full day of work. After each company came out, all had overshot Cody’s quote and were more worried about  their membership award program than my water heater leaking. Cody was excellent and gave me a breakdown on the cost. I plan to call Cody for all other plumbing needs. One of the popular Louisville companies up charged me so much, it was double the quote Cody gave me. Call Cody first if you need a plumbing quote or job done.

reviews.author: Linda Evans
reviews.text: I contacted Queens Plumbing for replacing a garbage disposal and a slow drain in the master bathroom sink.  I gotta tell ya, Cody and Becca did a good job of fixing the problems I had, and I wouldn't hesitate to use them again.  They called before they came and explain everything they needed to do.  I enjoyed talking with them and they also guaranteed their work for one year.    Don't hesitate to call them for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: mancis allison
reviews.text: Cody Queen arrived at my house as scheduled. My bath tub was not draining and I tried everything I knew to fix it. I couldn’t. Cody came out and found the problem drain flipper had lost the weight off plunger. Cody quickly had my drain working, gathered his tools, rinsed the tub and was a real pleasure to meet. Cost was reasonable and his name and number is filed away in my phone contacts. Highly recommend Cody Queen.

reviews.author: David Stevens (dethmetaldave)
reviews.text: Cody is an absolute professional! He removed the leaking cast iron plumbing from my bathroom, replaced it all with new PVC, and he did it very quickly at a price that was more than fair. His cleanup was thorough, and he was great with my kids and my stubborn dog. The only sign of his presence is the great work he left behind! You can absolutely trust Queen's Plumbing with your home!

reviews.author: Jayme Horn
reviews.text: Wife and I were having an issue with our toilet tank. We called around and another place said that the repair would cost around $600. We called Queens Plumbing and Cody came out to look at it and repaired it. Only charged us half of the other companies. We've called Cody a few times since and he's always been professional and prompt with the repairs. Price is always affordable.

reviews.author: WPB WebDesigns
reviews.text: Cody did an amazing job helping us with our kitchen remodel. He relocated our water line and worked on the slab, all at an affordable price. Cody is not only a highly skilled Master Plumber but also a really nice, down-to-earth guy. His professionalism is outstanding, and he completed the job in a timely manner, ensuring everything was done correctly. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Courtney Cummane
reviews.text: Cody was super efficient and nice. Explained to me what the issue was and what needed to be done now and in the future. I had an emergency situation late at night and he still serviced the issue with accuracy. Even assisted with my warranty situation. I will definitely reference him to family and friends and using his service again. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Laura Morris
reviews.text: Highly recommend Queens Plumbing! They were incredibly responsive to our emergency clogged kitchen drain. Despite the bad weather, they were able to schedule us in quickly. The plumber was professional and spent the time to thoroughly troubleshoot and got the job done. We were very impressed with their service!

reviews.author: Jackie Beckley
reviews.text: Excellent customer service! Cody does excellent work and is on time. He  was able to order, install, and do needed updates for a leaking water heater with only a few hours of me contacting him. Cody has also replaced our 2 sump pumps on a previous service call. Highly recommend, very professional and friendly.

reviews.author: Emir Dzankovic
reviews.text: I've known Cody for years and have used him multiple times for plumbing needs. Just recently I called him about a plumbing emergency I had he was able to send out Rebecca to get the job done the next morning. She did awesome and they were able to get my water back on fast. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Amanda Decker
reviews.text:
Queen’s Plumbing was Super friendl/polite,, fast response and hands down will use for all future problems and issues. Was the end of the day/shift and still responded out to help! Was able to diagnose our problem within minutes and fix on the spot!

Thank you again!!

reviews.author: Daniel Jolly
reviews.text:
Water heater flooded our basement. Cody
returned my call while on vacation and was able to diagnose the problem for us over the phone. The customer service and pricing were great enough to convince us to wait for him to replace after he returned from vacation.

synthesis.summary: Owner Cody Queen and Becca run a small operation that does what big plumbing chains won't — quote over the phone, charge half what competitors quote, and even waive fees when the issue turns out to be HVAC, not plumbing. Across 30 reviews there are zero negatives and multiple instances of 'half the price' or 'free of charge' for adjacent fixes.
strengths: Cody is the only Louisville plumber who will give a phone quote — saved one customer 'a full day of work' that competitors required
Replaced water heaters and ran new water lines for kitchen remodels at prices customers describe as half the big-company quote
Fixed a small washer leak free of charge while replacing a water heater
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Multiple reviewers describe after-hours and emergency response: 'I had an emergency situation late at night and he still serviced the issue with accuracy', and Cody returned a call from vacation to diagnose a flooded basement.

water-heater.topQuote: I called all the main plumbing companies in Louisville for a water heater replacement 'rough estimate' quote. All refused to give a quote on the phone, except Cody.

gas-leak.topQuote: Needed a gas leak located and repaired. Replaced the entire line with a few extra things done within a day. Prompt response when called.

toilet.topQuote: Wife and I were having an issue with our toilet tank... Cody came out to look at it and repaired it. Only charged us half of the other companies.

garbage-disposal.topQuote: I contacted Queens Plumbing for replacing a garbage disposal and a slow drain in the master bathroom sink.

water-line.topQuote: Cody did an amazing job helping us with our kitchen remodel. He relocated our water line and worked on the slab

bathroom-remodel.topQuote: Cody and Becca have been exceptional! Excellent communication, always show up on time, and have done great work redoing all the plumbing as part of our 1st floor remodel.

You need clear communication and upfront explanations

reviews.author: natalia medrano
reviews.text: Great plumbing company. They went above and beyond. They replaced my water heater but also helped me replaceing a outside faucet. Recommended

reviews.author: Kristina Camacho
reviews.text:
Came at 9:45pm! Very kind, quick, explained everything to me over the phone and again in person. Ben was very patient and had almost all of the parts already in his truck even though this was a last minute call.

The price for the emergency service was incredibly reasonable as well.

Thank you very much. I appreciate you!!

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.text: I needed a plumber on Thanksgiving Day and Ask Bill's Plumbing sent someone out. I was pleasantly surprised at the cost considering it was a major holiday. They did a good job and didn't try to upsale me.

reviews.author: Faye Campbell
reviews.text: I called this plumbing company because the house pictured is 1 block away from me, and with the pictures of the kids, it seemed like he would be down to earth.  Not to mention that the reviews seemed good.  When I called the number, it was an "umbrella company" All-State Plumbing out of Austin.   They charge $139 to come and "diagnose".  I emptied under the sink before he arrived.  When he got here, he didn't do anything.  Not one thing.  Literally tells me it will cost $489 to run the cable.  I ask him if that will fix the problem, at which point he says "let's hope".   I paid the trip charge (if I had thrown it in the trash can I'd be in the same spot), and passed on their services.  I wish I could have gotten to the original company that I called.

reviews.author: peter McCoy
reviews.text:
Last night there was a puddle of water around the toilet base. I dried it off and a few hours later was another puddle of water.
Irealiza there was a leak and if I didn't fix quickly it could damage the bathroom floor,so I called Ask Bill's Plumbing and they sent one of their technicians out the same day. He found the leak and fixed it
I'm glad they were quick because avoid any floor damage.
I am pleased to the service..

reviews.author: Carole Ann
reviews.text:
When my garbage disposal broke, my
neighbor recommended Ask Bill's Plumbing.  She had used them recently, and was very happy.
So I called.  They were able to get out toy house right away. . Very professional. They did excellent work. And did it quickly. The price is fare, and service superb.

reviews.author: Miguel Aldama
reviews.text: Great service and very responsive. I noticed water on the second story bathroom from the base of the toilet. They came and found a broken pipe and took a couple of hours to fix it. I’m happy with this company

reviews.author: Wilson Contreras
reviews.text: Ivran was the technician that served us today. He was very friendly and even though it took him a while to find the leak, he was able to solve the problem successfully. I will use this plumbing company again.

reviews.author: tania lara
reviews.text: Great job by Ben and his team. They dug the backyard to get to the pipe that was broken and did his magic to repair the leak. They left everything clean and working. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Ender A'c Nieves
reviews.text: Needed a plumber to fix a sewer clogging. They were recommended by a neighbor. They unclogged the lines and removed a tree root that was causing the clog. Good job

reviews.author: Stephan Shafer
reviews.text: Tim from Ask Bill’s Plumbing came out today to help me with a new water heater. He advised me on what brand to buy and he installed in no time. He did a good job.

reviews.author: Irania Jazmina Mendoza Murillo
reviews.text: I want to thank this plumbing company for helping  me with my water heater. I broke on a sunday morning and they came to my rescue and did and excellent job.

reviews.author: Keishla Rodriguez

reviews.author: Floriam De leon

reviews.author: Gema Luna
reviews.text: My nephew called this company to help me with a clogged toilet. They were very friendly and after unclogging the toilet they left everything clean!

reviews.author: Marcia Rhodes-Tyler
reviews.text: Orlando was amazing from the moment he arrived until the moment he left. He was kind, patient, and incredibly informative the entire time. It’s rare to experience this level of service these days. Thank you for genuinely caring and for taking the time to walk us through the whole process. We highly recommend using Roger’s Plumbing!

reviews.author: Lou Sigety
reviews.text: Third time using Roger's Plumbing and all experiences were very good although a bit pricey. However sometimes more work is required than one would think and that seemingly pricey quote covers the unexpected.  This last time Orlando did a fantastic job installing a seemingly simple RO system and ran into some unexpected issues. He spent the time to get the correct parts and did a great job with the install. He was prompt and very professional - highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sherry Todd
reviews.text: Jaskson was great!  He was polite and respectful.  He told me what he was doing each step of the way, asked my opinion and gave me options.  He left my bathroom really clean, much better than he found it.  He even brought in packages that were sitting on my front porch.  She went above and beyond.  I will definitely call Roger’s Plumbing next time, like I have for many years.

reviews.author: James Oliver
reviews.text:
Although I specifically requested a. Technician with Rinnai tankless water heater experience. he clearly was not. He could not get his manometer to connect, only cleaned the igniter and focused on selling expensive warranties and services. I continue to have the same problem plus others that began while he was onsite. I will not recommend or use you again.

In a response by Rogers, he asserted I had refused the technician's offer to call Rinnai for support. In fact, the reason I called them was that Rinnai will not communicate with the customer (very poor customer support) directly and I needed technician to communicate with them. When it was clear the technician sent was not experienced with that type of heater and could not get his manometer to work, I had very little confidence in his work. He also was reluctant to call Rinnai as I initially requested but did clean the ignitor, based on Roger's rules and focused on pushing overpriced services.  Not a good experience and I will share my review often to as many potential customers as possible.

Your latest response insisting that the technician recommended a call to Rinnai for technical support and it was declined is not true. If you are being told that by him, you are being misled. As I stated earlier, I specifically called to get someone experienced to contact Rinnai as they will not respond to the customer, but he stated that he could only follow "Roger's rules". Although he was personable, in my judgement, he was not experienced on that product and did not want to call Rinnai at that time. When I pressed him, he indicated that it might not even be possible to get a response from them at this time, but he thought it was likely the board.

Apparently, the owner attempts to micro-manage his staff as they respond to calls. When I scheduled service, I was assured their technicians were knowledgeable on the Rinnai tankless heater and I accepted that assurance. However, the technician ignored my description of the problem and after failing to get his manometer to function, blindly followed Roger's rules. Not the technician's fault but that management style does not allow for him to adapt to the customer or react to intermittent problems. The owner's response seems to blame the customer and make no effort to reach out to understand the situation.  It would only seem to be designed to increase company revenue. It appears I am not the only one with this experience, as there are several reviews on Yelp from others with a similar experience. I should have checked there before contacting Roger's, but I do recommend reading the one stars reviews to anyone considering doing business with this company.

The owner did call after my latest post. He attempted to justify his charges by claiming they provided extra service, support and great warranties on their services whether the customer needs or wants those. He also asserted that the technician claimed I refused his offer to contact Rinnai but, in fact, he initially failed to consider my description of the problem and only followed "Roger's rules" and cleaned the ignitor after failing to get his manometer to work. Even though I called specifically to get a technician to contact Rinnai as they would not provide any support directly to the customer. He then attempted to quote for additional overpriced services which included calling Rinnai if cleaning the ignitor failed as we both believed it likely would. I did find the charge of $355 per hour on the call laughable but that was on his way out the door as I had lost confidence in this company and his competence. The owner's micromanagement policy may work for straight forward problems but will likely also be overpriced while allowing him to provide lower skilled technicians.  It fails to react to intermittent problems and responses expected by some customers. I recognize that it is his choice how he runs his business, but I will consider the $238 payment (which only seemed to worsen the problem), I made as sunk cost to learn not to use this company or this product again.

reviews.author: Amy B.
reviews.text: They "fixed" my dripping faucet last March. Said it was under warranty. They have been back 7 times and made it worse most of them. Almost always late. Yesterday that claimed problem solved and it started dripping again almost immediately. Now I have another appt for an "estimate". So I  guess warrantee doesn't really mean that. Please don't waste your time with these people. Ladies at the front desk are every nice though.

reviews.author: Sammy L.
reviews.text:
Had a dreadful evening last night to say the least.  My old faucet in the shower/tub decided to do the old drip drip drip for weeks.  Being the fantastic fixer that I am, I decided to fix what was the original faucet from 1984.  What could go wrong, I just thought if I unscrewed the faucet knob to see what was wrong I'd of course see something wrong and fix it.  Unscrew a decades old knob without cutting the water off and just see what can go wrong.   I did just that.  I am a pretty smart guy I like to think, lots of common sense, not this day!  I admit it, can you?   I unscrewed the knob, tugged on it and wha la!  the knob came off and so did the insert inside the faucet and water shot out like a gyser, it started blowing the shower curtain outside the tub and I had no way to cut off the water except to take my drenched ass out to the road and luckily I had one of those cut off tools to cut it off at the street!   I came back in and had a dam mess from hell and back.   I called Rogers Plumbing this morning after all the trama, and they said they could send someone out Friday AM.  But they would put me on the list for today if someone cancelled.  They called me, someone had cancelled or they just fit me in,  and set up an appointment for today instead of tomorrow.   Orlando, I feel like hes family by now since he has been out to my place before to fix my gas pipe behind the stove.   Within an hour he had fixed the pipes, added cut offs on both the hot and cold so if I ever have any problems with this particular plumbing I can cut it off inside without cutting off all the water in my house.  I can enjoy my weekend without worry about drip drip drip, you all know how annoying that can be, well,  all is fixed and done now.  When he left I could finally friken breath again!   I see some postings on how expensive their,  this or that quote was.  These people went to school to rescue us from something we obviously know nothing about.  Sure you can get the neighbor to fix it bc hes cheat, O I mean cheap,  and will do it now, right this minute type of guy.  but when you come home to a dam flood, where is he?  No where to be found and your problem is worse than ever because why?  what is the old saying?  You get what you pay for. When you go to Star Bucks and get your iced coffee, do you complain bc its like how much these days?  $add that up in a month.   When you go get a burger, fries and drink, do you complain when you get your check and its 20 something dollars plus tip?   Do you complain when you grab a water at the convenient store do you complain bc its an outrageous price?   Every company no matter who it is these days have rent and employees taxes and EGGS to buy, kids in school and their needs, Oh and dont forget the upcoming wedding that you are happy to spend 10s of thousands of dollars on just to find you want a divorce 6 months later.  If you want a good plumber, electrician, etc...  someone professional that insures restful sleep when you go to be at night bc you know  your house isnt going to be flooded bc uncle earl was cheap and screwed it up.  There's a reason that we pay more,  and yes sometimes a lot to fix things in our house, its our biggest investment in life/so our house doesnt flood or burn down, its not just bc we don't want to hear drip drip drip, its all about safety for us and yes sometimes our families.  That comes at a price but it also comes with peace of mind and yes with a guarantee.  I bitch about the price of eggs but I don't want to get some chickens, I might complain at times about the price of a plumber or electrician or other contractor,  but I don't want to go to college to get a degree for one or the other but im certainly glad someone else did.   Sorry about the spelling and punctuation.  I do have common sense, thats why I will call the professionals next time instead of thinking I know it all, I don't nor do you.       Thank you Rogers Plumbing, I will sleep well tonight. 
Sam J.

reviews.author: Andy S.
reviews.text:
Roger's Plumbing is a life saver.  I call them for the routine stuff, but also the difficult stuff and they always come through for me, big job or little job, routine or difficult,  When others disappoint, Roger saves the day.   I know that they will get it done right and will always be straight up honest in their estimates and dealings.  Whether the news is good or bad, they tell the truth and do right by you.  After they have fixed something, you won't have to worry about it anymore.  It will be done right.  Very right.

I've been using them since I first became a home owner in 1999, back when Roger's was just Roger and one truck.  I bought a duplex on the east side that had a lot of plumbing problems, and Roger fixed them all.  Since then I bought another old multifamily home, so I have four units that they work on, and that's a lot of plumbing.  

They don't mind if I watch them work and I have learned a few things about plumbing from watching them.  They have plenty of work to keep them busy so they don't mind if I pick their brains for how to fix the simple DIY stuff myself.

There are other good enough plumbers in town and sometimes I've had to use others because it was an emergency and Roger's could not get to it.  When you are as good as Roger's, you are in demand and can't be everywhere at once.  But that is the only reason I would hire anyone else, I always call Roger's first and I would not even consider hiring anyone else unless Roger's was totally backed up and not available.  

We hired a well known company to install our tankless water heater because we were unaware that Roger's also did those.  Boy, that was a mistake. This other company was not honest.  They left us with a big gas line mess that they would not fix.  It was a difficult job.  We called Roger's and they fixed it.  They are like the cavalry, to the rescue.  They even got the permit closed out for us, though that was the responsibility of the other company.

I can't say that I enjoy having plumbing problems or spending money on pluming but it is always a pleasure to work with Rogers.  Every single person on the team is friendly and professional.  I always feel like they did right by me, they keep their word to the letter.

So after all this glowing review, you must think this is not for real, too good to be true?  No.  I will say they are not the cheapest in town.  You can hire one of the big companies and they may be cheaper, but the next time they come out, it will be a different crew and you don't know if the next guy is going to be good or not.  I like that with Rogers, it is always the same people who I have come to know and you have a business relationship with them.  That is worth extra to me.  And sometimes they get backed up with work, but they will let you know if that is the case.  They could hire more guys and get more trucks, to have people on standby, but quality goes down with that, in my opinion.  They are the best and that's why they are busy.

reviews.author: Hien N.
reviews.text:
My two outdoor water spigots were leaking and in trying to repair them, I found out that my main water shutoff valve was broken.  And so, I had to look for a plumber.  At first, I found one using a phone app, scheduled a time, and waited...and waited.  45 minutes later, still no one showed up, and so I called and got the excuse that he forgot to call and let me know he was going to be late, and that it would be another hour before he would arrive.  Yeah..that wasn't going to happen.  I canceled and the very next day called Roger's Plumbing.

Angela answered and was very nice, and said she could have someone meet me up the next day, and the next day I met up with Chris.  He was on time and very professional.  I explained the situation, he took a look and explained to me in detail what was needed, explained the pricing and warranty, and we then set up a time to get the job done.  It was hassle free!

Sure enough, Chris came on the day that we set up and texted me to let me know he was getting started.  I was at work, and appreciated that he informed me that he was on the job.  He even texted me pictures, showing me progress along the way.  I got to see the pipes and valves after he dug into it and the beautiful new pipes and valves after he finished the job.  And a bonus surprise, as I found out later, was that he went ahead and even replaced the two leaky spigots with brand new ones.  I had thought he was just going to fix them.  This was at no extra charge.  Excellent!

The entire experience was excellent, and I had repairs done in a matter of days.  They are now my go to plumbers for any future projects or repairs.

I highly recommend Roger's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jessica D.
reviews.text:
Roger's Plumbing is my go-to plumbers. I am a Realtor and it is pretty common to need a plumber either when preparing to sell a house or after a buyer has had a home inspection and problems are identified, so I have plenty of experience with them. They are consistently professional and courteous, and I trust them. They do quality work and that is what you want when it comes to such an integral system as plumbing. Their pricing is straight forward. Yes, with some repairs such as a leak under a slab foundation they cannot give a quote until they pinpoint the location where the repair is needed, and that is scary to some people, but the fact of the matter is, you need a repair done and homeowners insurance may pay for part of it if there is a good insurance policy.

It has been my experience with Roger's that they come during the window of time I am told, and they call me when they are on the way. I read the other reviews and it looks like probably what happens is a couple of times a year there is a misunderstanding or scheduling error and people come on here and complain, but I am sure there are hundreds of times the company does an excellent job and people are satisfied and don't think to share the great review online. Especially since plumbing work is not exactly the type of thing you get excited about and want to tell everyone, like a great restaurant. 

Side note: I wish everyone posting reviews on Yelp would consider what it would be like if the people they affect through their work could post online reviews of them.

reviews.author: Ed M.
reviews.text: Great service!!  I had a plumbing emergency and called, what felt like, every plumber in Austin and was getting nowhere. Called Roger's and was met with a friendly rep who got me on the schedule asap. Marcus and Shane showed up promptly and were friendly and professional. They took the time to listen to my findings, quickly found the problem. Were very transparent on what they were doing and why. Once they found the problem, they stopped to show me what they found and then took the time to research the needed materials and made sure they had what they needed on the truck or what they needed to get. They provided clear estimates on the repair. Marcus gave multiple options on the repairs including pricing, warranty, labor etc.   I felt absolutely no pressure to make a quick decision. They took the time to listen to my concerns and answered all my questions patiently. They were able to do the repairs very quickly, including removing dry wall, replacing piping, testing, cleaning and they even put the kitchen back together!!  I can't say enough great things about Roger's, but especially Marcus and Shane. The level of service, professionalism and courtesy was unbelievable. I how to not have any more plumbing problems, but no doubt Rogers will be my only call if they come up!!!

reviews.author: Io E.
reviews.text: Way way way over priced, but fast to get out to fix our issue because of a canceled appointment somewhere else. The men that came out were nice enough, but I felt I didn't get the full perspective of what they were doing, as he pulled out the price sheet, pointed to a number (the cost) and described "digging" and "replacing" of pipes (the work was outside in the lawn) in order to turn a valve. If I knew more about plumbing perhaps I could have asked more pointed questions... Upon agreeing and thinking they would be out there for at least an hour with the work, I heard a knock after about 10 minutes, if that, and them saying they had completed the work and needed to test the pressure. They fixed the issue but to pay hundreds of dollars (approximately $500) for under 10 minutes worth of work seems completely ludicrous, seeing as how they literally could have told me how to do it and it was simple enough, it turns out, that I would have be able to easily fix it myself. I called and was told Roger will get back with me to discuss this but I never received a call back. Overall they were nice and got the job done but I really felt ripped off and with no call back I assume customer service is low on the priority list.

reviews.author: Mark F.
reviews.text:
These guys are the people I call whenever I have plumbing problems. We had an issue a few years ago that I couldn't fix myself. I got Roger's Plumbing from the Better Business Bureau website. I was nervous calling in a business I've never worked with but I didn't have any friends who could recommend Plumbers. One of their guys came in and replaced the broken part. He was very courteous and polite. I kept asking him questions about what he was doing in the hopes of picking up some knowledge on how the job was done. He showed me what he was doing step by step with a smile!

In the end the fee was a bit more than I anticipated but he got it from a price sheet. They don't bargain. They're straightforward on their pricing. Also there was a 2 year unconditional warranty for the part.

A year later, it started leaking and after searching for the receipt and warranty I called them. They sent someone down the next day and never even asked for any receipt or paperwork. They replaced it with no questions. Only smiles! In fact, when he came the 2nd time to replace the part, it had already stopped leaking. He replaced it anyway!

I highly recommend this company for any of your plumbing issues, you'll thank me later!

reviews.author: Stan P.
reviews.text:
Our Moen Motion Sense kitchen faucet started leaking over the recent holiday weekend.  Seems it was their "1'st" generation and the computer was bad.  After speaking with Moen on Tuesday, I called Rogers and spoke with Roxanne to review what was going on.  We scheduled a technician come out on Friday, as the new faucet was to be delivered on Thursday.  When I learned that there was a delay with FedEx, I called Roxanne late Thursday & pushed the time out.  Garrett came about around 1, and while FedEx had not yet arrived, he had the old faucet removed and then hung out until the delivery was made.  He had the new faucet and "2nd generation" computer installed quickly.
Garrett was so nice, efficient and explained all he was doing.  Our dog is not keen on strangers, yet Garrett took time to win her over with lots of petting and speaking so kindly to her.  Once again, Rogers has come to our rescue, and provided excellent customer service.  Not only the technician, but also Roxanne who made a point of reaching out to me while we waited for the FedEx delivery and ensuring we'd have this fixed on Friday.  They are definitely in my phone as a contact and I'd refer them to anyone!!

reviews.author: Kris G.
reviews.text:
I had a water leak in my main water line that was either under my foundation or in my yard. I am in Central Austin with a foundation.

When I called Roger's they communicated to me their prices based on different scenarios, including the $45 initial fee for coming out which included the 1st hour. They were not able to schedule them to come out for 3 days.

When Jarrod showed up, On-Time, he was very nice and communicated very well his process of what he was going to do. I was in a very insecure position and Jarrod could have easily told me he would have to use the "Sonar" machine to find the leak in the lines. This would have cost me $310 per hour to use. Instead he utilized a metal probe that has probably been around for 100 years and simple.  He started sticking it in the ground around spots that are usual suspects for the lines.  Within 10 minutes he found the leak, and it was in my yard close to a tree.

To sum it up he cost me $45 dollars and in less than 30 minutes had found my leak to fix. Now they are plumbers and are not the cheapest you can find...but their experience can possibly save you money and time to pinpoint the problems quickly.

reviews.author: Kris A.
reviews.text:
The worst! Completely unprofessional.

I scheduled an appointment a couple of days out for the 2-4 pm window. I received a call from Angela at 2:20pm telling me that there's no way her guys are going to make it that day. She rescheduled me for after 3pm the following day. I get a call back from her  at 4:40pm telling me her guys can come now...I'm on my way out the door, so I stick with the rescheduled time the next day. Next day rolls around and Angela's calling me at 10:30am wanting to know if her guys can come earlier. I'm at work and tell her I may be able to make it a little earlier than 3 and will call her when I'm on my way home. I call at 1:15 to let her know that I will be home by 2:00. Her response was "it's going to be after 3, I'll call you when they're on the way". It's now 3 days later and I still haven't heard from Angela ar any other member of the Roger's Plumbing team. I called and left a message the day I was waiting around for them...still nothing. I wish I had checked the reviews here before I called..clearly this is a recurring theme. These people do not deserve your business, find a professional.

synthesis.summary: Roger's runs on 'Straightforward Pricing' — flat-rate quotes that reviewers say are 2-4x what other plumbers charge. Some long-time customers stay because the work holds up; others walked after a quote like $3,600 for a water heater swap or $782 for a faucet install. Yelp 3.6 vs Google 4.8 is the headline.
strengths: When they show up, techs (Marc, Marcus, Orlando) are reported as polite, knowledgeable, and warranty their work
Slab leak detection and main-line repair capability — '$5k slab leak repair with a good warranty'
Will fit emergencies onto the schedule when other plumbers can't
weaknesses: $53 'drain clean special' is actually $152 with the trip charge
Pricing complaints dominate Yelp — '$782.00 for a kitchen valve and faucet install, only here 45 minutes'
Multiple no-show reports — 'rescheduled 4-6 times', 'Angela called at 2:20pm to cancel a 2-4pm window'
'Straightforward Pricing' criticized as flat-rate model that overcharges for short jobs
bestFor: water heater install (if you accept the price)
redFlags: Repeated 'Diamond Club' membership upsells customers say they didn't consent to
Pattern of last-minute reschedules and no-shows for scheduled appointments
Quotes $3,600+ for water heater swaps competitors do for under $1,500
Yelp 3.6 vs Google 4.8 across 72 Yelp reviews — wide enough to suggest curation
synthesis.emergencyNotes: One reviewer credits Roger's with fitting an emergency in when no one else would, but many others report 2-week wait times and frequent reschedules. Inconsistent emergency dispatch.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1600 S Preston St, Louisville, KY 40217, USA

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text: Thanks Chris for being so thorough and efficient! I won't use anyone else besides Roto-Rooter from now on. From start to finish, it was an easy process and he arrived quick to resolve the issue. He explained what he was doing, and answered the questions I had. Overall, it was a quick and easy fix to a "crappy" situation.

reviews.author: Suzy Mohr
reviews.text:
We recently needed the help from Roto Rooter for a backed up drain in our basement. Kyle was our technician and I want to compliment him on cleaning everything up when he was finished. I wasn’t home most of the time while he was here and was afraid when I got home, I would have lots of cleaning to do. It was nice to come home and find he had already taken care of it.
We are happy to report that our drains are working the way they should.
Thanks

reviews.author: John Martin
reviews.text: Dalton was conscientious and provided a quote for the work required. He cleaned our line and found and removed the cause of the blockage. He ran a camera through the drain line to insure the line would remain clear and there were no other problems. The total was exactly as quoted. Very satisfied. Great service by Roto-Rooter. This was an after hours job. Very grateful that they were able to solve our problem quickly when we needed them.

reviews.author: Jean Claude Niyonshima
reviews.text: Very bad experience with them. Bad customer service call and scheduling in Louisville KY

reviews.author: William Vincent
reviews.text: didnt fix my problem. the tec forgot his camera. charged 682. plus needs to come back and finish the job. still waiting.

reviews.author: Sony Steier
reviews.text: I recently used Rotor Rooter on a rental property of mine. We first tried two other plumbers who worked on this powder room toilet but they left and said it was better. However, The problem still existed and this toilet was Mount Vesuvius after those plumbers left! Somehow, they made it even worse. It was the Friday after Thanksgiving, and the only plumber who we could find was Rotor Rooter. They did not charge holiday hours and came within a few hours. It was roto Rooter who finally found the problem with our sewer line. They determined it was a pipe that tree roots had grown into, and gave us a price to fix it. I had this issue before on a different property, so I was familiar with the hefty cost. Their price was surprisingly  reasonable for this scope of work. When they got to the Area of Repair, they soon realize that the damage extended even further into the line toward the road. They at first quoted a price to fix, but I asked to talk to their supervisor James.  In discussions with him, he said, he believed Msd should be responsible for the rest of this line because it was poorly made and passed a section that typically is what Msd plumbs to.  James took the time to explain the problem more and how I could discuss this with Msd, which was a huge help. When they came out there, Roto Rooter met with Msd and helped convince them to fix the problem with the rest of the sewer pipe. I was extremely thankful at his help and diligence, which saved me over $5000 on this additional repair. I would always suggest asking lots of questions and understanding the problem, and with Rotor Rooter and James in particular, they were extremely courteous and helpful with the best communication I have had in a long time. I wish I had called Roto Rooter to come out and fix this problem before using any other plumber. Hats off to Rotor Rooter.

reviews.author: Jimi Hance
reviews.text: I had a valve break on my main water supply line to my house at 1 am. It flooded my kitchen, part of my living room and dining room. I called around 3 am in need of a plumber and Chris called me back by 8 am. By 1130 am he was at my door and finished up before 1230. Chris was absolutely great! He was knowledgeable and knew exactly what was done wrong with the prior work on the pipe. He was easy to chat with and was very informative on what he was doing and why. I do think the price was a little steep for a smaller job, but I understand that this was done after hours and on a Sunday. I do not hold Chris accountable for the price. I do hope that Roto Rooter is taking good care of Chris! Good knowledgeable employees are hard to come by these days. I will recommend him to anyone in the future! Chris gets 5 stars for his work but RR gets 3 stars for the steep price. This job should of been no more than $300 or $350 AT MOST.

reviews.author: Heather Harrington
reviews.text: Called for service to get my parents toilet unclogged and it was kind of an urgent issue.  The message was put through to Dalton and I received the call almost immediately and he was at their house and solved the issue with an hour.  Quickest service we've ever had and Dalton was amazing.  He was very friendly, professional and explained everything so we could understand what we were being charged for.  Upon finishing He said that what he did was guaranteed for a week.  Can't ask for anything better than that.  Will definitely call again if needed.

reviews.author: Andre Harrison
reviews.text: We discovered we had a clog on a saturday evening and called roto rooter the first thing sunday morning, and they had someone out before one p m. The service technician. Chris was professional, knowledgeable and made the whole experience less stressful. Hey, fix the repairs.Explained what had happened and how to avoid any further issues. I expected excellent service because of the reputation.But my technician, chris went above and beyond my expectations. Five stars.

reviews.author: Michael Luttrell
reviews.text:
I spoke with James and he was able to send Dalton and Joseph out after hours on a Friday and to get our sewer line open. I had another Roto Rooter member, Kyle, out a week prior who was here for triple the time and left without fully opening our sewer line.

I am thankful that Dalton and Joseph were so efficient. James, Dalton, and Joseph turned this 1 star review into a 5 star review.

reviews.author: Nathan Jared
reviews.text: I had my main waste line back up on me today and was not having any luck getting anyone out on a Sunday afternoon.  Roto rooter was going to be my last call before giving up for the day and I had a call from Collin within 2 minutes of me calling the after hours line.  Collin was at my house within 30 minutes and took great care of me!  Highly recommend Collin and Roto Rooter!

reviews.author: Diane Yoke
reviews.text: Colin and Joseph were wonderful.  They drove all the way to Madison, IN to help us fix our plumbing issues.  They were both very professional and thorough.  Colin explained everything he doing and gave suggestions on how to avoid the problem again.  Both young men were so kind.  I have already told friends about using Roto Rooter and the wonderful service we received.

reviews.author: Eric Archuleta
reviews.text:
Excellent! The best in Louisville! After calling several local plumbers, noone could or would show up. One call to Roto Rooter and the job was done quicky and efficiently.

Kyle exemplified exceptional customer service and demonstrated expertise that beggars description.

Stop calling around searching. Call Roto Rooter for your one and done experience!

reviews.author: Terrible Bullitt
reviews.text: Dalton came out and was able to look at the problem and got started and was able to unclog my mainline in a pretty quick time frame and for a good price. Highly suggest them as I called this morning and was able to get my toilets flushing again!! Thanks again for helping me out in a pinch!

reviews.author: Ziah Nelson
reviews.text: It is Christmas Eve and we had a clog in the shower. Collin B. was at our residence within the hour of us calling which is almost unheard of during the holidays. Not only did he solve the issue, he went above and beyond and was extremely professional. Thank you so much!!

synthesis.summary: This Roto-Rooter franchise (Louisville) earns repeat 5-star reviews on holidays and after-hours — Christmas Eve clog cleared within the hour, Friday after Thanksgiving sewer line saved $5,000+, supervisor James helping the customer get MSD to cover part of the repair. The downside is the same complaint that follows the Roto-Rooter brand everywhere: prices feel steep ('this job should have been no more than $300, I was charged $682') and at least one customer was charged $682 for an unfinished job.

plumbers.name: Graham's Plumbing Co. Inc.
plumbers.address: 3914 Bishop Ln, Louisville, KY 40218, USA

reviews.author: Chuck Horine (Charles Edward Horine)
reviews.text: I got a panicked call from my wife at 2:15 one afternoon that we had a leaking pipe. I rushed home and got the water shut off and called Graham's right away as they had replaced a faucet for me a few years ago and I was pleased with the work. I didn't expect to be able to get someone there until the following day, but Sam sent Adam within an hour of my call. He quickly located the problem and went to work to solve it. A couple of hours later, we were back in business. The quick service and quality of work were excellent, as was the price, and we were very thankful that we did not have to go without water overnight. I highly recommend Graham's for your plumbing needs.    Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Gary
reviews.text: Had Graham’s Plumbing out today to replace a shower valve.  Adam did an outstanding job!  Graham’s was half the price another company had quoted me.  Not only that, their price included suppling and installing an access panel where they had to open the drywall, the other company did not offer this service.  I think I’ve found a new plumber!

reviews.author: Whitney Burdick
reviews.text: Adam did an amazing job, friendly and knowledgeable. He didn't boast or brag, he just did what he was there for and answered any questions I had! Reasonable pricing! Thank you Graham Plumbing I will recommend you to family and friends!

reviews.author: C Avery
reviews.text:
Overpriced and under delivered. I paid 275 dollars for incomplete work. I requested a quick connect installed for my generator to prepare for the winter storm. They came and ONLY installed a shut off valve. When I called them to tell them I’m dissatisfied with the work. I was told I would have to complete the rest of the work myself. Wasted nearly $300 for just a shut off valve. Even the invoice was half done.
Would not recommend this company or Adam, the serviceman that came to my home.

reviews.author: John TJ Harris
reviews.text: Graham’s Plumbing truck pulled right out in front of me and nearly wrecked my car. Don’t use this company. They don’t respect people.

reviews.author: Matt Geiger
reviews.text: Called to get an estimate on replacing master and guest bathroom sinks. I was not asked what kind of piping I had in my house, so plumber had to go get additional supplies. I don't mind the delay in getting the job done, but what I do mind is getting charged drive time to get supplies when you should have everything you need on hand. Plumber was gone for 2 hours and said he ran into 2 accidents. Ring camera shows plumbers physically present at my house from 915a-1130a and 115p-340p, a total of 4.67 hours. At $175/hr this job should have cost me a little over $800, but instead I was charged $1,138. When I balked at paying drive time this was lowered to $1,050, so I still paid over $200 for plumbers to sit in traffic. I didn't have the correct side pieces for the sinks either which is on me, but plumbers did not have any supplies to fix damage to wall. Seems like if you're going to be doing work that requires prying things off drywall, you'd want to have supplies on hand to fix drywall if needed. Sinks work fine and other than wall damage install looks good, but I've been left with a poor opinion of Graham's after this experience. I've still got a lot of work to do myself to get bathrooms back to prior condition.

reviews.author: M Livesay
reviews.text: Plumbing issues I've had a few, to say the least, but Graham's plumbing has not only taken care of each problem, but also has gone above and beyond. What first began as a simple estimate call about an MSD back flow valve, soon turned into a request for an estimate on a new water heater. I so appreciated Sam's no-nonsense and forthright explanation of pricing and procedure that I did have them install a new water heater over the summer.  Only a few short months later, my downstairs shower diverter finally gave up the ghost.  Again, Graham's plumbing to the rescue not once, but twice when the newly installed valve died because of a manufacturing defect. Graham's plumbing replaced the defective valve with another new one, which involved more labor than the first time.  Furthermore, as a working family, Graham's Plumbing worked around our schedule versus forcing us to work around their schedule, which is amazing given the fact that most people do not have the luxury of being able to leave work to meet someone at the house. Trustworthy plumbers are not a dime a dozen. I'm glad to have found a company that is just that and more.

reviews.author: Anitra T.
reviews.text: Worst customer service and so unprofessional.   Don't choose them if you want dependability. Sam Graham gave us an estimate and told us to call when we had fixtures in hand and ready to start. Super nice up front but when I called he acted as if I was a complete bother for making his phone ring. I explained who I was and that he had met my husband at a job for an estimate.  I explained we were asked to call when we could schedule.  He did not respond. Silence. I said hello?  He said "yeah?  So what's your question?  I told him again my name and so on. It had only been a few days between the estimate and the call. He said  "do you have a job name?  I said no but gave him my last name again. He finally put my last name with my husbands and remembered. He said "Oh ok. I'm just overwhelmed right now"  i said me too, I can tell. He got angry and said "Yeah, I can tell!  You know what?  Just find someone else to do it! " and hung up on me!  Wow!

reviews.author: lucas marcoplos
reviews.text:
Graham Plumbing is reliable, friendly, and trustworthy. I manage a high volume restaurant housed within a building constructed in the 1890s. The inner workings of the building are a real patchwork. Needless to say, we experience many unexpected plumbing issues and we don't have the luxury to wait for them to be addressed.

Sam and his team are always prompt, informative, minimally intrusive, and extremely courteous. They are quick, but thorough, and are always sure to go over what the different options are for whatever the current issue may be. In my job, I deal with a lot of vendors and contractors, and I can say without any hesitation that Graham's Plumbing is the easiest company to work with. Prompt, professional, courteous, and reasonably priced. I have also used Graham's Plumbing for work on my home, and the results and care were just as impressive. I would highly recommend to anyone, commercial or residential.

reviews.author: Tony Durbin
reviews.text:
Recently I called Graham's Plumbing to replace some drain piping to a bathroom sink on the second floor that would not drain.  I was prepared for him to cut out the ceiling below, but he was able to clear it with just a snake!  The particular plumber I dealt with was named Nick, and he was very professional and called me to explain what he did.  I was very relieved to not have to deal with all the plaster repairs since he already fixed it.

In the past, I asked Graham's to clear the main sewer line to my house.  Sam came into the basement and noted that he would have to drag a drain cleaning machine into the crawl space, which would be just as expensive as installing a cleanout behind my house.  He installed the cleanout, which makes it much easier to clear anytime the line gets clogged up.  His price was very fair as well.  They are always my first call for any plumbing problems.

reviews.author: Carolyn Brown
reviews.text: Worked performed: We had our entire home re-plumbed with Pex piping. Our home is roughly 120 years old. The home includes three stories including a basement and four full bathrooms. The work was completed in four business days. Total cost for work performed $4820. Work was performed by two employees who were very professional. My husband I and both work from home and were not bothered by having the workmen in the home. The plumbers cut out very limited amount of drywall to get the work accomplished and left virtually no mess. Every day the plumbers would lay down plastic and cover necessary areas and then at the end of every day the plumbers would sweep up any debris. Very satisfied with the work performed. Have since used Graham’s plumbing for other unrelated house calls.

reviews.author: The N.
reviews.text:
Been living in my apartment for about five years now. Was having a few issues and told the landlord. He informed me that Graham Plumbing would be over the next day between 830 or 9am.

At around 820am, the plumber called me and informed me he would be there shortly. He arrived about 5 minutes later. That was good sign number 1, as he was not only on time, but early. 

When I answered the door, he introduced himself and offered a handshake. Very professional. Since I work nights, I asked him could he fix the toilet in my bathroom first, as I would be headed to sleep once he finished. He said no problem and did so.

In all, he replaced two toilets and a sink in around two hours. I had no issue sleeping even while he fixed the other bathroom. Awesome job. Awesome company.

reviews.author: Laura B.
reviews.text: Horrible. Rude and unprofessional staff. I called them to fix a problem with my washer. I went to use my washer several days later and it wouldn't work. I called and they said it was "not their problem." I wrote a negative review about them and hired someone else who fixed the problem immediately. Graham's Plumbing responded to my review by sending me abusive and harassing messages on facebook and making repeated harassing phone calls (I finally was able to black them on facebook and block all the numbers they were calling from). I now feel unsafe in my own home for fear that they will come by and harass me or worse. In summation, if you value your safety, do not call Graham's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jason B.
reviews.text: I don't write a lot of reviews on Yelp but they did such a good job I thought I'd help others find a good plumber here in Louisville.  I had what can only be described as a plumbing catastrophe that I didn't see how it could be fixed.  Called up Graham's and they were there same day within a couple of hours.  They had my problem fixed within a couple of hours and described in detail how it happened and how it could be prevented again.  These were two really incredibly nice, good humored guys who were definitely on the genius level.  I was amazed at the price.  I thought it would've been at least twice what they charged me.  I won't be calling anyone else in the future.

reviews.author: Nancy Brown
reviews.text: Good work and fair prices. I wanted the old fixtures changed on my shower and tub, and Sam said it was going to be fairly expensive, because I'd need to re-tile where they had to remove the tile to put in the new fixtures. Then he called back and had found some larger plates that would cover the openings left by the old fixtures, which meant I wouldn't need to get someone to re-tile the areas. That was great news and the plates and fixtures look great. I'm really pleased. He's done other work in the kitchen, since then that I am also happy with. Whenever I need plumbing done, I call Graham's Plumbing.

synthesis.summary: Graham's Plumbing is the rare small shop that quotes half what bigger companies charge — Pex re-pipe of a 120-year-old home for $4,820, shower valve replacement at half the competing quote. The catch: Sam Graham himself can be 'super nice up front' and then dismissive once you call back, and a few reviewers had install issues that weren't honored under warranty.
strengths: Frequently undercuts competing quotes by 50% — 'Graham's was half the price another company had quoted me'
Whole-home re-pipe specialist — '120 years old, 3 stories, 4 bathrooms, four business days, $4,820'
Returns calls fast and answers the phone — 'always communicates'
weaknesses: Customer service flips after the sale — 'Super nice up front but when I called he acted as if I was a complete bother'
Water heater install rusted within 2 years and warranty was denied — 'well, it's not leaking now'
Multiple reports of late arrivals — 'didn't even call til 8 pm. My toilet has been overflowing since 7 am'
redFlags: Water heater installed less than 2 years prior began rusting; warranty claim refused
One review describes a same-day emergency where call came back at 8pm after a 7am toilet overflow

reviews.author: Rachael Bradford-Feldman
reviews.text: We’ve had an exceptional experience with Dauenhauer for both plumbing and HVAC issues. The technicians are kind, efficient and explain things very well. Dan Grissett came by today to help with our furnace/HVAC and solved the issue day of while another company told us it would take 6 weeks for double the price. Always impressed with their service and highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gage Cumella
reviews.text:
Both Jeremy and Eric came to our house today and did a great job repairing an irregularly with our water pressure and water heater. Jeremy found our PSI to be high, around 120-130 psi where the normal range is supposed to be around 60. He then helped us determine whether or water company or builder had installed a PRV. After some time we were able to find out we did not have a PRV and he also highly recommended we get a water heater expansion tank which would help prevent any failure of the pressure valve. Through all of this process he was extremely patient and understanding due to our many questions. Overall he was amazing and I find him to be an excellent employee and an asset to the Dauenhauer team.
Once Jeremy assessed the issue and developed a plan of action he passed our case on to Eric.

Eric arrived on time and had already reviewed Jeremy’s notes and was very knowledgeable of what needed to be done. Before even unloading he went and studied the area and evaluated everything. Once he knew exactly how he wanted to perform the install and had his action plan, he began his work. He was very meticulous and proficient. He was knowledgeable and patient with the questions I had for him. Overall both men; Jeremy and Eric performed an excellent job and were professional, polite, and proficient in their jobs. I think both guys are a great addition to the Dauenhauer team. Thank you again Jeremy and Eric, you two made doing business with Dauenhauer enjoyable.

Sincerely,

The Cumellas

reviews.author: Nikia Conner
reviews.text: I truly appreciate the Dauenhauer team for coming out and making my home safe again for me and my children. Although it took a little bit more time than expected, the job was done right and professionally.

reviews.author: John Young
reviews.text: Tech was scheduled between 10-2 he showed up around 3:40 no communication what so ever on being delayed except when I called numerous times wasn’t able to complete due to supply house about to close at 4. And still no communication what so ever on being late 2 days straight and being charged full price.

reviews.author: Brian H.
reviews.text:
Property Damage Caused by Improper Installation of Emergency Sump Pump
I am filing this complaint against Dauenhauer Plumbing regarding significant water damage to my basement that appears to have been caused by the improper installation of my emergency (secondary) sump pump by their company.
On Sunday, March 8, 2026, I noticed that my main sump pump was running continuously without shutting off, which was abnormal. Because I had a newer emergency (secondary) sump pump installed as a backup, I unplugged the main pump to prevent possible damage and contacted Dauenhauer Plumbing to schedule an inspection for the following day.
On Monday, March 9, 2026, at approximately 8:30 a.m., I heard an unusual sound coming from the sump pump area in my basement. When I investigated, I discovered water forcefully discharging from piping connected to what appeared to be the emergency (secondary) sump pump system. I immediately contacted Dauenhauer Plumbing, and a plumber arrived within approximately 30 minutes and stopped the water flow.
According to the plumber who responded, the emergency (secondary) sump pump had been installed incorrectly. He also stated that he found nothing wrong with the main sump pump. He initially believed the discharge line might be clogged and cut the exterior line to inspect it, but there was no standing water in the discharge line.
The plumber then stated that he believed the underground discharge line might be broken and offered to arrange excavation. Instead, I suggested a temporary above-ground discharge solution to move water away from the foundation. The plumber went to Lowe's, purchased flexible piping, returned, connected it, charged me for the materials and labor, and then left.
As a result of this incident, my basement sustained water damage, including:
Basement flooring saturated with water
Drywall/sheetrock wet
Insulation wet
Possible defect or damage to the main sump pump
I have photographs and video of the incident and damage. I have also contacted my homeowner's insurance company, State Farm, and they advised me to begin emergency mitigation with PuroFirst. That process is currently underway.
I have made multiple attempts to contact management at Dauenhauer Plumbing regarding this matter and have not received a return call or meaningful response. Given the seriousness of the damage and the fact that their own plumber acknowledged the emergency sump pump had been installed incorrectly, this lack of response is unacceptable.

reviews.author: Nancy McDonald
reviews.text:
Mike Hill with Danhauer just came in response to some issues we have been having.  We had an issue with our toilet, shower, and our washer, and bc it was more than one thing, we were concerned it could be something related to the main line.  He was thorough, knowledgeable, and HONEST!  He had multiple ways to diagnose and rule out issues, and he took time to hear the various issues thoroughly and ask questions.  He really seems to understand the finer details of plumbing and he explained the issues we were experiencing and also laid out the options for addressing those issues to us.

We were nervous to have to call a plumber because we have experienced many companies in various fields trying to sell us things that are not necessary while using fear or pressure to get us to make a decision.  We are so grateful Mike did not operate that way, and we have found our go-to for plumbing issues!!!   He said he works Fridays through Mondays.  We plan to ask for him by name and will be recommending him to friends.

We are also grateful that Danhauer operates in a way that allows employees to be honest rather than attempting to sell services for nonexistent issues.  We feel skeptical and jaded because of other experiences, but it’s such an encouragement to see that there are still companies that deliver ethical and honest service.

reviews.author: MarkDennen KellyReed
reviews.text:
April 20 and 21, 2026

On April 21 we found an eight foot circle of water around the floor drain in our cellar.  We have a whole house dehumidifier that drains into this so there was clearly an issue with the drain, or so we assumed.

We called Dauenhauer Plumbing (a company we have used since moving to our current house for all HVAC, Electrical and Plumbing needs) and they scheduled that day between 10:00 and 2:00.

Plumber Chris Han was sent and spent several hours cleaning out the floor drain line and main drain line.  Ultimately he determined that the lines were clear to our septic holding tank where a pump sends the water up hill to the main city sewer line.

At this point, Chris determined that the pump had stopped working.  Furthermore the pump was very undersized (it pre-existed our purchase of the house).  Chris consulted with MSD to determine the pump we needed and purchased a new much larger pump on April 22.  He arrived back that afternoon and had us working within 2 hours with the new installation in the holding tank in our front yard.

This was an expensive repair because of the cost of the pump and Chris went the extra mile negotiating with the supplier and saving us about $1100 on the pump's price.

reviews.author: Josh Tummers
reviews.text: Their plumber Robert Compton did a great job of getting the installation of (2) 50 gallon water heaters installed quickly and efficiently. Our existing water heater broke down and was in need of replacing asap. There were also several installation issues with the previous water I had noticed and they made sure to correct those on this instal.  He provided great advice and provided multiple options with pricing. He walked through the valving with me to make sure we were on the same page on how to operate and isolated the individual tanks. I was happy that they sent out someone who knew what they were doing. A lot of companies send out a “tech” first who is really only trained in a few areas and they don’t know what to do so you have to end up scheduling another appointment with someone else in the company and end up missing more days of work. They gave me a window of arrival called 30 mins ahead of time and completed installation.

reviews.author: Tricia R
reviews.text: We are relatively new to Louisville and contacted Dauenhauer on a neighbor ‘s recommendation.  We’re happy that we did.  The technician arrived when he was scheduled to do so, texting us that he was enroute. We were extremely pleased with Jaden Jordan’s work in replacing two bathroom faucets and a kitchen faucet, all in rather tight spaces.  He was very pleasant and efficient, and he meticulously cleaned up all traces of his work. All the fixtures are exactly straight (even the brand names on the sink stoppers are perfectly aligned!), and we appreciate his attention to detail.  We’ll ask for him should we need other plumbing work.

reviews.text:

synthesis.summary: Dauenhauer is a big multi-trade outfit (plumbing + HVAC + electric) — 8,900+ Google reviews and a BBB A+ — and most reviewers report friendly, fast techs with good communication (photo ID + arrival texts). Negative reviews cluster around big install jobs: AC unit liquid lines that failed in 6 years, sump pump install that allegedly caused basement flooding.
strengths: Photo-ID arrival texts and clean tech communication — 'they sent a message with his picture on it so I knew was showing up at what time'
Multi-trade dispatch — plumbing, HVAC, and electrical from one call
Same-morning service for sudden outages — 'toilet wasn't working before Derby, out first thing in the morning'
weaknesses: Install jobs that fail years later see warranty pushback — 'system to fail within 6 years... improper size liquid lines'
Late arrivals with no proactive communication — '10-2 window, showed up at 3:40 no communication'
redFlags: Allegation that improperly installed sump pump caused basement water damage
AC install failed within 6 years from improper liquid lines; company difficult to reach for warranty
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Same-day morning service appears reliable and the company answers the phone, but no consistent overnight or 24/7 dispatch evidence in the reviews.
