reviews.author: M Young
reviews.text: The team at Noah's Plumbing & Water Heaters is always friendly, polite, and ready to lend a hand. Randall in the office was easy to talk to and made sure my plumbing issue was handled quickly. Jaxon and Brantley, the plumbers who came out, worked together well. After a long day, I had a busted water pipe in my basement. I shut off the main valve to stop the flooding, and they arrived soon after. They quickly isolated the problem pipe so I could still have water in the rest of my house. Even though it was late, they made sure everything was safe before heading home for the night. They returned the next day and finished the repair, and now everything works perfectly. I really appreciate their hard work and fast response. I’ll definitely call them again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kirsten Cunningham
reviews.text: I was at the hardware store searching for plumbing parts and needed some advice. I approached a friendly person who took the time to patiently answer all my plumbing questions. Later, I noticed he was loading supplies into a Noah's Plumbing & Water Heaters truck in the parking lot. I decided right then that if I ever needed a plumber, I would reach out to this company. When I found a leak under my kitchen sink that was starting to damage my cabinets, I called for help. Brantley arrived quickly, was polite and knowledgeable, and explained everything clearly. The repair was done perfectly and the area was left neat and clean. I’m really glad I chose this company for my plumbing needs and would definitely recommend them to anyone needing reliable service.

reviews.author: Katherine Mendoza
reviews.text: Our shower faucet and handle stopped working, so we called a local plumber in Louisville. They scheduled a visit quickly and gave us a fair quote for the repairs. We also needed a bathroom cabinet installed. Randall kept us updated about when the plumber would arrive. Kyle showed up right on time, took some measurements, and got straight to work. The job was done well, and the customer service was excellent. Their prices matched what you’d expect around here. I highly recommend this plumbing service—they’re even available 24 hours if you have an emergency. I liked that they also use text and online alerts to confirm appointments, which made everything easy to track.

reviews.author: Brad S.
reviews.text: High Pricing and very rude manager James Reesor. I was told one price over the phone and after installation, the price went up $500. Which really wouldn't have been that big of a deal. The issue was the management.  James Reesor at ASI pluming was very disrespectful. If you don't like your job in customer service, you should try a different field James!

reviews.author: Jennifer M.
reviews.text: They were very professional and I liked the upfront pricing, however, my "cleared" shower drain, started not draining again/same symptoms prior.  When I called about having someone return, they asked me how old my house was...well living in the Highlands obviously makes my home old.  He went on to explain my pipes are the size of a pinky finger basically and I would be re-charged if they returned.  Which I think is bs...I've lived here for over 15 years, never had a plumbing issue until now....I had even gone behind them and used drano just to extra clear the pipes after paying $189.....It was literally right at 90 days and they should stand by their work.  I'm now waiting for my 5 star rated plumber to come so I don't do this over and over, Very disappointed bc who has the money to throw away right now?! Make sure to ask what they guarantee, wouldn't have been hard for them to send some one back on a job that they obviously didn't do right:(!

reviews.author: Robert R.
reviews.text: I called to make an appointment on 6/28/2017 at 4:10pm was on hold until 4:40pm.  We only have one shower/bath and it was clogged so badly it could not be used and we have a 2 y/o, an 11 y/o, my wife and myself. This was an emergency and the lady said we can get you in 6/29/2017 at 12:00pm. I accepted the appointment and made arrangements to have someone at the house between12-2.  An hour later I had a voicemail saying there was a mistake and we don't have anything until Friday the 30th but possibly Monday 7/3/2017. I called and explained the situation and the lady said no way it can happen after a 10 minute conversation she said someone will be there 6/29. I received a call at 9:30am and the plumber said he was on the way. I spoke with the plumber after he broke a pipe snaking the drain, repairing the pipe and he said the old steel pipe must have collapsed inside and they need to cut part of the drywall out on the first floor and replace up to 10 feet of steel pipe. ASI was here about a year and a half ago, cut out a 6' x 3' section of drywall ( the same spot they were going to cut out again) , replaced only  the drain and connected the pvc to the same pipe they now wanted to take out. I asked how they knew that the pipe collapsed and I was told it is the most likely situation. I asked if the snake had any rust, metal shards, deposits or anything indicating an internal pipe collapse or any signs of blockage. I was told no but that is the way we have decided to fix the problem. I even called  the office requesting evidence of a collapsed pipe. I was told the manager said that is what he thinks too. I told her that I don't like going off guesses, if the whole house needs plumbed that is what it needs. I don't want to cut out my drywall and fix a section of pipe every year and a half, I want a total solution. She said that is what she was told and the manager confirmed.  I let them know I would use another company that can actually diagnose the problem before tearing out drywall and pipe( again same area they worked on a year and a half ago). She said ok and I thanked her for her time. Later that day Joe the manager called and said I might want a call. I said not really I just want a solution and evidence before tearing my house open. He understood and asked if I had a clean out pipe. I had no idea but said I will look when I get home from work. Joe said it will be really easy to send a camera if we do and to call back if I find it. The next day I called left a message for Joe informing him I do have a clean out and it is close to the house. I did not hear from anyone at the office. I tried again after the holiday weekend and left another message. Again no call back. I have been scooping water into my sink to empty the bath for days so everyone could shower but no call from joe or ASI. I called again and again he was out right now but will definitely return my call. Monday at 4pm on 7/10/2017 I called our home warranty company to see if this was a covered issue they stated it is and the earliest will be 7/12/2017. The company arrived on time and Josh snaked for 20 minutes, pulled a large sized hair ball out and all the water was gone. No holes, no new pipes, no $900.00 fixing something they fixed before for $1,000.00 a year and a half ago,  just sweet blissful drainage. Hot showers and baths without hundreds of buckets going from bath to sink. Go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Joshua Moreno
reviews.text: When we first acquired our property in Louisville, we were oblivious to the plethora of surprises that awaited us. The revelation of an above-ground septic line running across the floor after the removal of the old furnace certainly caught us off guard. The water and electric lines were oddly placed on the exterior of the wall. We were aware of the bathtubs and toilets positioned on platforms due to the elevated plumbing, but we underestimated the inconvenience of this setup. It was clear that the previous owners had taken a DIY approach with their additions, placing things in a way that was easier for them. We were familiar with Noah's Plumbing & Water Heaters, having enlisted their services previously. So, when we decided to address these glaring issues, we reached out to them. Our concerns were high as we anticipated the reaction of their representative, Randall, when he came to assess our situation. We wondered if he would be scared away by the chaotic setup. After surveying the tangle of lines and discussing our expectations, Randall offered a reassuring statement - where there's a will, there's a way. Soon, Randall, Seth, and Julian arrived, ready to tackle the challenge. After two days of intense labor under the sweltering heat, they transformed our troubles into triumphs. The water lines were skillfully repositioned within the walls, and the septic line was relocated under the house. The raised toilet was lowered, and the shower in the bathtub now drains so efficiently that we no longer wade in water while showering. The transformation was nothing short of incredible. We are extremely grateful for the exceptional work done by Randall, Seth, and Julian. The job was certainly no walk in the park, but they handled it with professionalism and dedication. They truly are an incredible team of plumbers and we are so grateful to have discovered them.

reviews.author: A. Jaden J.
reviews.text: After a terrible experience with this company last year, I found myself needing a plumber on a Saturday and they were on the list for 24/7 plumbing. I called, spoke with Ashley who said she was sending a message to Jimmy, the manager or owner and she transferred me to his voicemail asking me to leave him a message, however his voicemail was full. I called back to let them know, the rep who answered that time assured me I would get a call from him within the hour as she was sending him an email and a fax. I have yet to hear from anyone. Not to mention extensive hold times when calling.  Not good business! *Addendum* After a poor response on another review from this company, I would like to add greater detail which has my response to them. "Wow! I applaud you at the most arrogant and ineffective review response ever! Keep up the terrible work! You failed to mention that your technician advised that we would have to do a semi-kitchen remodel and pipe replacement in order to resolve the issue. Strangely the plumber that typically comes for our issues came the following day only to tell us otherwise. The drain was cleared within minutes. You also failed to mention that your tech broke my shower head and you failed to address that, leaving me to pay for a replacement. As far as you having a mishap in communication this time around, per two of your representatives who both communicated to me the same information, I would receive a call from YOU within the hour and I would be worked into your schedule on Saturday or Sunday if I opted to go with your company. But nice try in your attempt to make the customer look bad, which seems to be the case in your response on all of your negative reviews."

reviews.author: Kathy P.
reviews.text:
It was not my week for plumbing issues. We had a dishwasher installed because ours died Jan 1 (different company) and after that, the hot water stopped working. I looked for a place with good reviews and found ASI so I went to schedule online (usually a disaster in itself). I got to their page and they had an appointment for the next day, Monday, (Sceptical me 'ya right') So I booked it fully expecting them to call and reschedule.  They not only did not reschedule but they showed up precisely on time and told us we needed a new tap. While they were here they repaired a shut-off valve under the sink. I got a new tap that day and called to schedule having it installed. They did not have any appointments till Wednesday So I took that. I mean no hot water is a drag but we could live with it. That night the kitchen drain clogged up so we could not even run the dishwasher or fill the sink and wash dishes by hand (ugh) we tried and tried to unplug it but could not. So we called ASI back to beg for a sooner appointment. Amazingly they fit us in that day and Desmond came by and fixed the clogged drain and installed the water taps.  We now have hot and cold running water that drains.

Time for the bill. I was scared to even ask but when I was told the final cost I was terrific. . One thing I liked about them is that everyone we talked to made sure we knew the price ahead of time. I, till the end, expected them to add on hidden charges and upcharges but that never happened. They are reasonably priced, honest, and do fantastic work

I can not say enough good about this company. Do not hesitate to call them!!

I liked them enough I added them as a contact on my phone. I WILL use them again.

reviews.author: laurie stone
reviews.text: I got a new cast iron kitchen sink, faucet, and garbage disposal from Home Depot. At my request, they got in touch with Noah's Plumbing & Water Heaters to handle the installation once all the parts were ready. I got a call to schedule the installation shortly after. On the decided day, Randall and Julian gave me a heads up about their arrival time and actually showed up a few minutes early. Randall inspected the existing sink area and noticed some potential issues. The challenges became more apparent when Randall and Julian assessed the new sink (which was deeper and heavier than the old one), faucet, and disposal. It turned out there was a mismatch between the position of the existing drains and pipes and the new items' setup. Randall suggested that we might need to rebuild the under-sink area, which might require another visit and possibly extra fees. But Randall and Julian didn't just throw in the towel. They removed the old sink, faucet, and disposal and committed themselves to get the job done. They had the necessary materials on their truck, and Randall meticulously reconstructed the under-sink system. Before we knew it, despite encountering another big hurdle, the new sink, faucet, and disposal were perfectly installed and functioning. They didn't need to come back; and even though i offered to pay, there weren't any extra charges beyond what i paid upfront at Home Depot. They took away all the old stuff and carefully cleaned up the area. i couldn't have been happier with the service; and i highly recommend randall and julian without any reservations.

reviews.author: Jerry F.
reviews.text:
I had a hot water copper pipe leaking in my finished basement that I found on a Friday evening.   I turned off the water to our house to stop the water leak.  I then started looking for the best plumbing company that I could find so I could get it repaired quickly and get the water turned back on as soon as possible.  I also was concerned about some of the horror stories you hear about exorbitant charges in such situations.  I think I got lucky and did find the best plumbing company for my problem.   ASI has an online scheduling service that lets you know when they can come and take care of your problem.  In addition to scheduling on line Friday evening , I called Saturday morning and asked if they could give me a close estimate on the cost which they did quickly and correctly.  I had scheduled between 12 and 2 pm on Saturday and Plumber Carlton Pierce arrived within that time frame.   He was very pleasant, knowledgeable and professional.   He had my water back on in approximately twenty minutes  and also made some suggestions to me regarding my water pipes and other plumbing issues.   Although I would not say they are cheap I think their price was very fair and probably less than I would have paid at many other plumbing companies.  

 I was very pleased from start to finish with Mr. Pierce and ASI Plumbing.   They will be who I call for future plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Margaret H
reviews.text: We've had several plumbers come out since moving into our home in Louisville, but Noah's Plumbing & Water Heaters has been the best by far. When I called to set up a visit, they gave me a specific time, and Malachi arrived exactly as promised. We had a long list of plumbing issues, but Malachi listened carefully, explained everything he found, and laid out a clear plan to fix each problem. He worked steadily until everything in our plumbing system was running smoothly again. It took a couple of days to get everything sorted, but Malachi was dedicated to making sure we were completely satisfied. Now, our water pressure is strong at every sink and toilet, and all our faucets are easy to turn on and off—no more struggling or using tools just to get water! Malachi also recommended a small well filter to help prevent future problems, installed it quickly, and even took the time to show us how to maintain it ourselves. Both Malachi and his coworker were polite, professional, and made sure to clean up thoroughly after each job. They checked with us after every repair to be sure we were happy with the work. For all the parts and effort involved, the cost was very reasonable, and we were relieved not to be hit with a big bill. We highly recommend their plumbing services to anyone in Louisville!

reviews.author: Cole Z
reviews.text: i was really impressed with how fast Noah's Plumbing & Water Heaters was able to send someone out to check my plumbing issue. I called and within about 20 minutes, seth arrived and started working right away to get things fixed. they explained the pricing clearly, and the initial assessment didn’t cost anything, which i appreciated. after seth finished the repair, kyle and malachi came to my place to run a camera through the drain pipe to make sure there weren’t any other problems and also to set up the warranty for the work. all three plumbers were friendly, respectful, and seemed very confident in what they were doing. what stood out to me is that they focus only on plumbing, which made me feel better about their knowledge and skills compared to some places that do plumbing along with heating and electrical. they gave me peace of mind and were quick to answer all my questions, which made the whole process less stressful. before calling, i reached out to another big company and they said it would be a week before they could come out. but here, my plumbing problem was fixed the same day i called. i would absolutely recommend them to anyone needing a plumber and will definitely use them for any future plumbing jobs!

reviews.author: B Parks
reviews.text: Noah's Plumbing & Water Heaters was extremely helpful, professional, and fair when I had a plumbing problem at my home in Louisville. After I called, they showed up quickly that same day. Thomas and his team carefully checked out my plumbing and walked me through a few different ways to fix the issue, along with the costs for each option, which I really appreciated. What I first thought was just a simple clog and maybe a damaged pipe turned out to be a bigger situation involving my septic system and pipes. The crew took the time to explain everything step by step, making sure I understood what needed to be fixed right away and what could wait a bit. They worked several hours on the job, and when extra hands were needed, more help arrived quickly. The plumbers kept my house clean throughout the work, were friendly with my dog as they went in and out, and even gave me advice on how to take better care of my plumbing moving forward. If you need honest, hardworking plumbers in Louisville, I highly recommend calling this crew. I’ll definitely use their services again in the future.

reviews.author: Becky22 O
reviews.text: This was by far the smoothest plumbing remodel I’ve ever experienced, even compared to my previous kitchen and bathroom projects. Noah's Plumbing & Water Heaters made me feel comfortable right from the start, and the quality of their work truly lived up to my expectations. The costs were fair and clearly explained, so there were no surprises—everything was finished right on time and within budget. Everyone involved, including the local partners for things like glass and stone, was friendly and professional. It was great to hear even the other contractors complimenting the high standards and organization of the plumbing work. For this project, we completely gutted the guest bathroom, removing everything down to the studs, and replaced the old tub with a modern walk-in shower. All the plumbing and fixtures were upgraded, and the end result looks fantastic. I feel confident knowing that the pipes and work behind the walls are just as solid as what you can see. I’ll definitely be calling Seth and his team again when it’s time to update my main bathroom here in Louisville.

synthesis.summary: The Google reviews here read more like marketing copy than spontaneous reviews — many follow an identical template (named tech, same-day arrival, perfect outcome). The Yelp side is sharply different: rude management, $200 to snake a small drain, refused warranty work, an explicit '$83 or FREE Drain Cleaning' email coupon ignored on arrival. One Google review even flags the listing as a 'FAKE business listing' tied to a Texas-based listing-mill called 'Lexis Maximus' — investigate before trusting.
strengths: When a real call goes through, reviewers report fast callbacks (within 10 minutes) and same-day dispatch
Slab-leak diagnosis from a phone description specifically praised — 'figured out what was wrong just by talking to me on the phone'
weaknesses: Yelp reviewers report a $189 charge to snake a small drain after a $83 / FREE coupon promotion was sent by email
Manager (James Reesor) named multiple times for rudeness and $500 over-quote on water heater install
Warranty repair refused — 'pipes are the size of a pinky finger ... I would be re-charged if they returned'
bestFor: water heater installs (with caveats on pricing)
redFlags: One Google reviewer alleges the listing is a 'FAKE business listing' tied to a Texas listing-mill ('Lexis Maximus'); many positive reviews follow templated language (named tech, same-day, perfect outcome) which is a soft signal of curated content
Coupon bait-and-switch ($83 advertised → $189 charged) reported on Yelp
Manager named in multiple negative reviews for rudeness
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Some Google reviews report 24/7-style same-day dispatch (busted pipe in basement, slab leak diagnosed by phone). Counterweight: a Yelp reviewer with a single bath/shower clog and a 2-year-old + 11-year-old at home was bumped to next-day, then to two days out — emergency response is inconsistent.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: They charged me almost $200 to snake my drain. They then proceeded to tell me all of my pipes needed to be replaced because they were the old metal pipes

slab-leak.topQuote: brantley was the only one who actually called me back right away. ... he found the leak in my foundation after removing just one tile

toilet.topQuote: Our toilet downstairs had rubber erosion problem and kept flushing ... The labor and parts cost us more than $350!

sewer.topQuote: Our sewer backed up after moving into our home. We had an estimate from another company ... and it was twice what ASI charged!

burst-pipe.topQuote: I had a busted water pipe in my basement. I shut off the main valve to stop the flooding, and they arrived soon after.

sump-pump.topQuote: we were stumped by a complex sump pit/drainage problem. ... However, a recommendation led us to Brantley.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1000 S W Dr Ste 18, Leander, TX 78641, USA

reviews.author: Isaac Valerio
reviews.text: Was having trouble with my water heater and when I called Roto Rooter they sent Jonny within a couple of hours to Diagnose what was going on. Thanks to him he was able to find the issue and get it squared away for us. Thank you sir for the help.

reviews.author: Shelbi Wojcik
reviews.text: Corey and Caleb were our water mitigation and restoration team, they were fantastic. They explained everything to us and were very friendly. The whole process happened right before Christmas and they still were timely and professional. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Berenice Rodriguez
reviews.text: We are very happy with Jesus H work. He replaced the water heater in the attic. He was very good communicating what needed to be done and the cost. He did an excellent job! We highly recommend him if you are looking to get your water heater replaced.

reviews.author: Madhuri Korampally
reviews.text: Called Roto-rooter on a Saturday afternoon as we noticed a small leak under the bathroom sink cabinet. There was another pipe which was closed and apparently connects into the city drain, and the leak was from that outlet. The technician arrived promptly and unhooked the p-trap to find no clogs. He then said the second pipe maybe broken and that he had to cut open the wall on the other side to fix the pipe and it would cost $2100 but he can give a discount and do it for $1950 if we agreed to do it the same day. Without even opening the outlet how did he determine that the pipe was broken, it seemed bizarre and I am glad I trusted my instinct and told him we will call them later if we decide to get it done. I immediately called another company and they sent their technician first thing on Sunday. This guy opened the outlet and cleaned out the clog that was there and the issue was fixed for $350. Mind you Roto Rooter would not fix the hole in the wall if I went ahead with them, so another $1000 or so to get the drywall done and painted by an external party.

reviews.author: Chris L.
reviews.text: This place scams. They came out and did a five minute job on my dishwasher disposal. I'm embarrassed to admit I didn't realize that it just needed a couple of turns clockwise with an Allen wrench. Anyway, they spent five minutes and I'm being generous and then tried to charge me $290. I objected and the guy said "how about $190?" without batting an eye. It's pretty clear they're used to the overcharge followed by customer objection game. BTW, I tried hard to get a quote before they came out but to no avail. Suggest you don't use them or at least force a fixed quote upfront or they'll take you to the cleaners.

reviews.author: Lauren Szekelyhidi
reviews.text:
If you ever find yourself in a plumbing nightmare, do yourself a favor and ask for Barry at Roto-Rooter—he’s an absolute lifesaver!

We had a full-blown plumbing emergency on a weekend evening, which, let’s be honest, is the worst possible time for things to go wrong. But Barry showed up fast—like superhero-fast—and got straight to work.

Not only did he diagnose the problem quickly, but he also explained everything in a way that made sense (no confusing plumber-speak here!). He was professional, efficient, and—believe it or not—actually made a stressful situation feel light-hearted with his friendly personality. It’s rare to find someone who’s skilled, fast, and genuinely kind, but Barry is all three.

Thanks to him, we went from “total disaster mode” to “problem solved” in no time. If you ever need a plumber who truly goes above and beyond, Barry is your guy. Seriously, request him by name—you won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Tony Gomez
reviews.text:
If I can give Jude a 10 star rating, I would. He was great at communicating what went wrong, what it took to fix, when he would be showing up, and walked me through all the steps to take in the next emergency we might have. He was super professional and very kind. He really made us feel he and Roto-Rooter was the right company that would take care of us.

Here is what happened to us. We had an expansion tank rupture and the water heater is in our attic. It overflowed the drain pan and leaked into the bedroom on our second floor. The ceiling, the walls/closet, and carpets were soaked. On the first floor the ceiling was showing water damage.

We still have the abatement and taking out the drywall and carpet to go, but all the plumbing fixes are now behind us. Thanks Jude!!!

reviews.author: Jackie Marie
reviews.text:
I can't say enough good things about Elvis and his supervisor Auden at Roto Roover ! I had a major issue with my sewer drain backing up, and I was worried about a costly repair. They came out, inspected the problem thoroughly, and even used a camera (late night) to check the line.

After a careful investigation, they determined that the blockage was actually in the city's sewer line, not my property —all for free!. Instead of trying to charge me for unnecessary work, they advised me to contact the city, saving me a huge expense. Their honesty and professionalism were truly refreshing!

If you're looking for a plumber with integrity, Elvis/Auden/Roto-Rooter are the one to call. I highly recommend them and will definitely use their services in the future!

reviews.author: Renee Randolph
reviews.text: We had an emergency plumbing issue the day we were leaving on vacation, and Roto-Rooter had a team there within an hour. Adam, Geri, Nate, Dana, and Patrick were all wonderful, took the time to explain what they were doing, what needed done, and to also connect us with a company to repair the drywall and flooring after the water mitigation was complete, which was a real relief so we didn’t have to try to find a contractor when we returned from vacation. They also handled all the insurance stuff after we opened a claim. Dana handled the water mitigation process and did a wonderful job, and cleaned up afterwards. We can’t say enough positive things about these guys! We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Todd Wink
reviews.text: Fantastic experience using Roto-Rooter. We submitted an emergency call in a Sunday morning and we had a licensed plumber at the house by 12:30pm. After a quick assessment of our needs, the situation was fully explained and a timeline was given for repair completion. By 12:00pm Monday we were back in business. I would not hesitate again to use their services. Sharika with dispatch was extremely attentive and worked with me to coordinate services and arrival times. She was obviously invested to make sure our repair was on track. Also, huge thank you to Larry for taking care of us quickly and efficiently. Top notch experience all around.

reviews.author: Jeremy Lootens
reviews.text: Today (Saturday) our water heater failed and Rudy from Roto-Rooter came out to the house to assess the situation, gave me recommendations on how to move forward, and then ultimately resolved our issue within just a couple of hours of me realizing there was a major problem. Our water heater was sitting in a puddle, it had basically rusted through internally and needed to be replaced. Rudy was fantastic, he always had a positive can-do attitude and fully understood our water system. I highly recommend Rudy and will request him should I be stuck in an unfortunate situation again.

reviews.author: Peter Zhang
reviews.text: I’m often at work from very early hours until around 4-5 P.M., so the fact that Roto Rooter was able to dispatch a plumber after work was extremely convenient for me. The people were respectful, and scheduling this was easy. The plumber, Rudy, was friendly and helpful, and he told me the problem right away. Since he was unable to do anything as the issue was with the sink itself rather than the plumbing, he informed me who to contact instead to fix my problems, and he didn’t charge me for his time because it was a separate issue.

reviews.author: Anthony Gutierrez
reviews.text: Our entire upstairs was clogged preventing toilets from flushing and showers and tubs from draining. I tried snaking the drains myself using the big box store snake kit, but was unsuccessful.  Fortunately, Roto-Rooter was available within an hour from the time I called and was able to unclog the toilets and get us operational again.  Nate was not only professional, but also super friendly and knew exactly what to do. Thank goodness he helped us get out of the “mess” we were in. Thanks Nate!!

reviews.author: Gabriel Escobar
reviews.text: Had a very pleasant experience with a patient, kind and professional technician who took the time to understand our issue, explain his process and discuss a fair and comprehensive way to solve our problem. Did i mention he was able to show up within an hour of my service call? Highly recommend the company, and hope most people find as much levity and good spirit when interacting with, and helping their customers.

reviews.author: CY Pennick
reviews.text: I had been battling with the clogged kitchen sink and hot-water heater drain for 3 days.  I actually told my job that was at my wit's end and didn't know what I was going to do.  Then the door bell rang and it was the Roto-Rooter man, and I'm like "finally the BIG guns!". True story.  My drain is now behaving and I can get some rest, but last weekend I didn't get any.  Thank Roto-Rooter for your help.

The cleared-without-cutting case is exactly the kind of upsell Roto-Rooter franchise reviews flag elsewhere.

plumbers.name: MacLin Plumbing Co, Inc.
plumbers.address: 651 N US Hwy 183 Ste 335-144, Leander, TX 78641, USA

reviews.author: angelin abraham
reviews.text: I just had a simple service from them through my home insurance company. My plumber, Jerry Hamlin was early, quick, quiet, clean and considerate to wear shoe covers and not mess up my floors. He was also kind enough to give me some advice for future repairs. Never had a bad experience with this company!

reviews.author: Uma Shankar Yadlapati
reviews.text: My warranty company sent MacLin Plumbing to address an issue with my water heater. Matt from MacLin Plumbing arrived the next day, right on time. He was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. He replaced a part on one water heater and adjusted the connections on the second one. Matt also provided helpful advice on what to look for in the future. Overall, it was a five-star service!

reviews.author: Natasha Boston
reviews.text: Very professional, service the same day, on-time, and all fixed.

reviews.author: Bridget M
reviews.text: *AVOID* Cost me thousands of dollars because they did not want to do the job assigned by my home warranty company, American Home Shield. MacLin Plumbing CO. was assigned to my service ticket regarding my leaking hot water tank. As many Texas residents, my gas water tank is in the attic. When MacLin came to look at the tank, they told me that due to Texas regulations, they needed 25 in. clearance to get the new tank up in the attic, my clearance was only around 24 in., so I would need to provide the clearance in order for them to complete the job. They told me they do not provide access and my only other option would be a tankless water heater, which would not be covered by the warranty and cost thousands more. As a first time home owner that knows nothing about this stuff, I trusted that the plumber would have the experience with attic tanks to advise me honestly on my options. When I proposed if I could remove the attic stairs myself, which would give the necessary 25" clearance, he refused, and said it would not be safe for his men. Foolishly, I took his word that this was my only option, and agreed to their service provided I gave them 25" access. After consulting multiple people, and two plumbing companies about this, I not only realized it would be structurally impossible to carve out the clearance MacLin supposedly needed to complete the job, but also both plumbers told me their team would simply remove the pieces of wood trim to give enough clearance to complete the job. I was pressured to sign the service contract on the spot, then after getting my second opinions, AHS refused to allow me to reassign a new plumber to the service ticket, my only option was a cash out for far less than it would now cost me to replace out of pocket. A neighbor recommended Proven Plumbing. I called at 8:30am on a Friday, they showed up within an hour, & returned to do the job on Monday. They had NO problem cutting the wood trim to make enough clearance for the tank, even replacing it after the job was completed. I HIGHLY recommend using Proven Pluming for your water heater needs, especially if it is in the attic.

reviews.author: Cari G.
reviews.text:
A plumber came to my home WED, saw the drywall damage in the ceiling that’s coming from the upstairs bath; plumber goes upstairs to the bath, sees a saturated bath mat, tells me it’s a sloppy shower and leaves. He doesn’t even cut into the drywall to see if there is the possibility of a plumbing leak.
THURS I pay to get the drywall cut out and mold is discovered - too much mold to be caused by a ‘sloppy shower.’ This has been growing over time and we’ve only been in this home 4 weeks. Contractor says he has never met a plumber that didn’t cut drywall to see what’s going on behind it.
Today/FRI, I called my home warranty company (AHS) to find out the status of Maclin coming back and finding the leak only to discover Maclin has cancelled the follow up service call. I’m so frustrated I don’t want another Maclin employee in my home. AHS has found a different plumbing company for me.🤞

reviews.author: Alexander Brankner
reviews.text:
DO NOT use this company. EXTREMELY UNPROFESSIONAL. We are brand new home owners and only 3 weeks into living at the new residence we had our water heater stop working.

We called our Home Warranty company (AHS) to assist and they connected us with Maclin Plumbing Co. After scheduling, one of their plumber came out to assess our 12 YR OLD water heater for damage.

During the visit, I mentioned hitting the reset trip switch (ONCE) as mentioned in the user manual. The plumber decided to misconstrue this statement and reported to our home warranty company that the electrical damage was due to MISUSE caused by the home owners REPEATEDLY hitting the trip switch. This is not only a lie but extremely unprofessional and has caused us to be denied on our claim. Did I mention the water heater is 12 years old? (Avg. life of water heater is 8-12 Yrs). In reality a faulty wire had caused a electrical shortage that burned through the wires leading into the heating elements.

I tried to contact Maclin Plumbing but the representative was extremely unhelpful and non sympathetic. Additionally the do NOT keep a written report....they only speak to the warranty company over the phone so there's no hard record or evidence.

I hate to speculate but I believe there are incentives for the "approved" plumbing companies to deny claims. Maclin Plumbing acted as if they are under the payroll of AHS. I would've hoped for professionalism but none was received. Do yourself a favor and find another reputable company, this surely isn't one.

reviews.author: Colin Baillargeon
reviews.text: AWFUL! JUST. PLAIN. AWFUL. This is the company that our home warranty company contracted with, initially Maclin Plumbing seemed great, but that went downhill very quickly. Our water heater was leaking onto particle board, so the board was soggy and wet. They informed me that they would not replace it themselves, but if I left a properly cut piece of plywood they would be able to replace the particle board. Come to find out they just placed the new board on top of the old particle board. Didn't secure it or anything. Okay.. we'll let that go 'cause 'That's how I did it at my house' according to the owner. They finish the job and now we don't have water in the kitchen. The tech leaves because we need to file a new work order with the home warranty company. Two days later he returns to fix the faucet. Again, the tech leaves a huge mess in his wake.. left standing water underneath our sink that we weren't informed about. The next day we lose water pressure in the kitchen. Leave a message and hear nothing in return. Leave two more messages and again, nothing. Finally we call from a different phone line and they answer.. the explain that they will not come out. That no one would cover a 'secondary' issue (caused by the work they did?). In our final conversation they keep referencing a negative review we left with the home warranty company. I do not, and will not, recommend this company to anyone. I'm still left with rusty water stains to clean off the floor of my garage gym.

reviews.author: Christina Dienner
reviews.text:
I had a very troubling experience with this plumbing service. A plumber came to our house on a Friday to address an issue covered by our homeowner’s insurance. He identified the problem and said a crew would return on Monday. I didn’t sign any paperwork at that time, and despite asking him to call my husband for approval, no call was made. My husband left multiple messages that Friday during business hours and no one from the office followed up with him.

On Monday, a crew arrived, completed the work, and left without any paperwork or prior communication. Later, the plumber contacted my husband demanding payment, but we requested the paperwork first to ensure insurance coverage. The plumber agreed but still did not provide the necessary documents.

Things escalated when the plumber showed up at our house unannounced, banging aggressively on the door for ten minutes while I was home alone with my children. Feeling threatened, I called my husband. He spoke to the plumber, who then threatened him over the phone stating “he better pay or else”. He stayed on our property for 45 minutes.

My husband contacted the office, which stated that this behavior was unacceptable and that the owner would follow up. However, we never received any communication from the owner.

The unprofessional and aggressive conduct was deeply distressing. If you value respectful and transparent service, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

reviews.author: Brian Codd
reviews.text:
Not sure about the veracity of people leaving negative reviews, I had the complete opposite experience.

Today, my upstairs toilet overflowed.  Checking the tank, it was filled with a sand-like substance.  Checking all of the facets, they all quickly lost water pressure.  I don't know anything about plumbing, so I assumed that I had a burst pipe.  I requested a service via my homeowner's warranty, and chose MacLin because they were a local company.

I called them a short time later, because I thought that my warranty company's description didn't adequately convey the urgency of the matter.  I talked to the man who answered the phone (didn't get his name), and he had me do a quick check of the yard for any water leaks (indicating a burst pipe).  When I found none, he quickly (and accurately) identified my water softener as the issue.  He walked me over the phone on how to bypass it so I could get water to the house again.  He also instructed me on what I needed to do to clear the facets to get them working again.

15 minutes later, I had water restored to the entire house.

It was only one experience, but it was an awesome one.  Will be calling them again if I ever have further plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Kathryn Harper
reviews.text: This company was called out by our home warranty. They are not experts nor do they care  about the people/families they are servicing. They just work for the money and are told by home warranty company where their next job is. They don't answer the phone even if you call them right back but the worst part was the "expert" who came out decided both of our hot water heaters needed to be turned off and we believed he knew what he talking about. Several days later we got a second option company and this new guy (who was VERY familiar with Maclin Pumbing) said only one had to be turned off. So my family of 4 went 9 days taking cold showers or asking to use a neighbors. Had this guy cared just a little and listened he should have known that wasn't necessary. And he made sure to use all the right words so the entire until it NOT covered by our home warranty- when the 2nd opinion guy from another company was much more informative and saved us greatly. Also we called on a Friday and they didn't call back until Monday ti schedule an appointment 🙄

reviews.author: Renan Evangelista
reviews.text: This company was called out by our home warranty when our rental had the leaking shower fuacet on the second floor. They claimed that there was nothing wrong with the faucet or shower whatsoever and the cause of the flooding and the leak was sloppy showering. So I told the tenant about the findings and they bought a new curtain, they made it sure that curtain will be closed and no careless showering. But the leaking and flooding still happening, so I checked it myself and found out that the base of the shower faucet is leaking a good amount of water and it is not just leak water downstair but floowing the entire bathroom. File a complain in the home warranty and asked for a recall and revisit but no response and my service requests were cancelled several times. Then I called them and I was told that they are no longer servicing the area and keep insisting that there was no problem and it was just sloppy shower...

reviews.author: chris rattray
reviews.text: Neighbors, run the other direction instead of calling this company.  They are not knowledgeable enough about their trade.  They came out to clear a blocked kitchen sink drain.  We have a clean out with a ptrap below it under our sink.  They said they could not get past the ptrap to clear the blockage, so they gave us an estimate of $4500 to bust up our kitchen floor to fix it, then we'd have to go through our home warranty policy to put our kitchen back together.  So I called a second plumbing company for another opinion.  Had a licensed plumber out, Gary took a couple hours with a standard metal snake and cleared the drain.  Gary charged us $282.43.  MacLin Plumbing will take advantage of you if you give them the opportunity.  Please Please Please do not use them.

reviews.author: AMERICAN AUTO CENTER DEALERSHIP
reviews.text: Stay away from this company. I do have Home warranty with American Home Shield. They hire these people they came to my house and they said I need to pay over $1000  plus top of their money warranty companies paying forget about this, I called them a few times to get more information about the water heater we have in the house this guy who’s answering the phone very disrespectful. Very mean told me on the phone shut up what kind of customer service they running and what kind of business these people running stay away from this company even you have warranty company as soon as you hear this company name try to run away worst experience ever I have in my whole life take your business to another company and run away

reviews.author: Jessica Davis
reviews.text:
Does not do the work that they claim to do.  Claimed to replace the wax ring on toilet, instead just recaulced the toilet. This was obvious looking at the floor bolts that were surrounded by an undisturbed dirt pattern.  Later that night since the actual leak wasn't fixed the caulking ran around the entire floor on black marble.

The Dispatcher is rude and unapologetic to their mistakes.   Attempted to send the same tech who didn't do the job the first time back to my  house and went off the deep end when faced with logic.  The owner should clean this mess up.  They are blocked on AHS from coming back to my home.

reviews.author: Kim Hudson-Dilkey
reviews.text: We scheduled an appt for an estimate. MacLin sent a tech out, gave us a verbal estimate for the repair, and arranged to come by and perform the repair the following day. The next day came and went, and no one came to repair the problem. We have called and emailed them multiple times, but the only answer we've received is that they will "let us know when they are available." To be fair, they did tell us that one of their service trucks broke down, but we only got that answer after repeatedly calling them. We still have a busted pipe and no repair date on the calendar. Just going to go with someone else now.

synthesis.summary: MacLin is the home-warranty plumber AHS sends, and the reviews track that role: minimum-effort diagnoses ('it's a sloppy shower') that cover up actual leaks and mold, scope-padding to push work outside warranty, and reportedly aggressive collections behavior. A handful of positive reviews from Jerry and Matt show they can do the work — but only when the warranty company isn't paying.
strengths: Jerry arrived early, wore shoe covers, and gave advice on future repairs on a routine warranty call
Matt fixed a Thanksgiving-weekend garbage disposal leak quickly within a 2-hour window
weaknesses: Diagnosed a leaking ceiling as 'sloppy showering' without cutting drywall — homeowner then discovered hidden mold growing for weeks
Quoted $4,500 to bust through a kitchen floor for a clog; another plumber cleared it with a metal snake for $282
redFlags: Plumber reportedly threatened a customer over the phone ('he better pay or else') and stayed on her property for 45 minutes banging on the door
Multiple reviewers report MacLin denies AHS warranty claims by misclassifying issues as 'misuse' or refusing to provide written reports
$2,800 quoted for a job a competitor did for $300; reviewer says 'they don't want to turn a wrench, they just want to collect their $100 for a service call'
Manager reportedly told a tenant 'sir you're just a tenant' when asked for the owner
synthesis.emergencyNotes: No after-hours or 24-hour signal in reviews; warranty-driven scheduling with multi-day waits.

water-heater.topQuote: MacLin Plumbing CO. was assigned to my service ticket regarding my leaking hot water tank... they told me that due to Texas regulations, they needed 25 in. clearance to get the new tank up in the attic

toilet.topQuote: When the plumber came out, he told us he couldn't unclog the toilet, but could replace the toilet for $785. We asked him to leave.

drain-cleaning.topQuote: They came to clear a blocked kitchen sink drain. We have a clean out with a ptrap below it under our sink. They said they could not get past the ptrap... so they gave us an estimate of $4500 to bust up our kitchen floor

faucet-fixture.topQuote: the cause of the flooding and the leak was sloppy showering... I checked it myself and found out that the base of the shower faucet is leaking a good amount of water

garbage-disposal.topQuote: Our kitchen sink garbage disposal started leaking. James confirmed the appointment time (2 hour window). Jerry arrived on time. Diagnosed the problem and fixed it promptly.

hire_if: You need fast same-day or after-hours response

plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 8003 Vine Crest Ave Suite 12, Louisville, KY 40222, USA

reviews.author: Rachelle Sharar
reviews.text:
Dwight and Daelyn solved a year long issue with our lines backing up and spewing sewage out of my shower! I've have multiple plumbers and septic companies come and look and thank God we finally have a solution. It was fixed within 24 hours of our first visit.

Scheduling was easy, they were punctual and they communicated with us for every step. Thank you so much guys!

reviews.author: Jeff Toy
reviews.text: Daelyn came by today to replace a 20-year-old toilet that was well past its prime. He was a pleasure to work with. He gave me several options to save money. I bought my own toilet and he had it installed in no time. Left the workspace very clean, which I really appreciated. I'll be calling these guys again in the future when I need serious work done.

reviews.author: Julie Ann James
reviews.text: It seems like since Covid it has been really hard to find quality customer service and I should know, I worked in the industry 20+ years. From the time I booked my appointment it was a great experience. Dylan was right on time, knew exactly what to do and got right to it. At no point did I feel like I was getting the runaround, as I was with a previous plumber I had hired and quickly fired. He went above and beyond, as did Luis who showed up to give a hand. I would highly recommend them to anyone and will be using them for several projects coming up this Spring. Thanks Dylan! 10 stars!

reviews.author: Chris H.
reviews.text:
My unit is 6 years old, not 15. I was overcharged plain and simple.

Here's the problem with companies like this- overhead. Fancy decals on their trucks, employees in matching uniforms, answering services- the customer winds up overpaying to compensate through $300 initial visit fees and inflated labor/parts costs.

Do yourself a favor and find a family owned/operated plumbing biz (I recommend Maupin) and pay a fair price for expert service.

reviews.author: Sean G
reviews.text:
Terrible company that doesn’t stand behind their work or their products.

Charged me $800 to fix a spigot. Had to replace my old one with new “required” frost proof one. Left a massive hole in my wall and ceiling, that I got pay to fix myself.  Then, the new spigot broke in less than 6 months.

They want to charge me an additional $500 to fix the faulty part they installed. They claim their install is fine, it must be an issue with the product.
Product manufacturer claims the part is fine, and is attempting to blame me for somehow using a spigot incorrectly. Insulting tbh.

I’m right back to where I was to begin with, minus $800.

Never use this company.

reviews.author: R Barber
reviews.text: Yeah I will not be using these guys again all they want is the money so boom check this out they came out on Thursday to unclog my drain my basement first off I fell it was to quickly done  and in stead of them saying well let’s check your other drains as well all they did was the main one so I goes to take a shower at 8 pm goes to put my clothes in my laundry room and there it was again water in my laundry room so today is Friday I call them and I’m like yall just came out yesterday and I paid yall 320 and I can’t just keep throwing away money can you just look out for me since they basically just left David like nah we have to charge for any service that we do I’m like yall just came and did it yesterday. So I hung up on him and I WILL NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE TO NOBODY OR THEIR SERVICE.

reviews.author: Mackenzie Miller
reviews.text:
What we thought would be a quick do-it-yourself fix turned out to be a major plumbing issue, and 1-Tom-Plumber Louisville was our first call—and the best decision we could have made. The owners, Mike and Lesley, are incredibly kind and honest, which immediately put us at ease.

The team that came out to our home over two days to resolve the issue was outstanding. Daelyn Shirley and Marvin Brown were respectful, professional, and worked tirelessly to ensure everything was fully and correctly resolved. They were proactive, showed up right on time, communicated clearly throughout the process, and the pricing was more than fair.

If you need plumbing work done for your home or business, this is the team you want. I truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

reviews.author: Danny Taylor
reviews.text: My experience with 1 Tom Plumber was Great 👍 and very Professional ! The young man who came to my house to work on my plumbing was very Nice  and very Professional ! I really appreciate everything Mr. Daelyn Shirley did for me. I Highly Recommend this company to everyone. They really know how to treat their customers,and if you have any kind of problems with the amount they charge you, they are more than willing to work with you on the payment's. You will be completely satisfied with their Service and the way they Treat you. They are a True Blessing !

reviews.author: Jessica Williams
reviews.text:
If you need a plumbing repair job done right the first time, then you definitely want to have either Louis or Ian with 1 Tom Plumber come out to address your problem.
These two plumbers made me feel totally comfortable throughout the process by their nice demeanors; they wore booties to keep my floors clean which I truly appreciate, and they worked harder and more efficiently than I have seen anyone work in a long time.
I am truly thoroughly impressed and will be recommending them and 1 Tom Plumber to my friends and family!

reviews.author: Leigh Anne R.
reviews.text: Always nervous having unknown people in my home, but after a few visits (doing difficult tedious gruesome work), very comfortable, fair pricing, timely estimates, & truly professional, great servicing, patient and efficient (particularly Junior), glad to have dependable & reliable people, will absolutely recommend, & will likely have more work completed. Thank you, really appreciate all the time spent explaining on top of being polite...Great work, will be seeing again soon...

reviews.author: Gwen S.
reviews.text:
Our Team here at First Care Dental would like to Thank Julian, Dylan, & Michael. 
We have a very busy Dental practice, 
Our office had  frozen water lines and Patients waiting to be seen. We called 1-TomPlumber at 8:00am spoke with Julian,  within an hour of the emergency Call they were at the office to diagnosis the problem & we were up & running within a couple of hours.
First Care Dental now has a reliable Plumbed to call! Anytime!! Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Angela B.
reviews.text: Not happy with the service, I had a clogged sink so this guy came in and passed the snake through which didn't work, I have an unfinished basement where all the pipes are uncovered, I told him to go and check the pipes he didn't want to he only suggested to change the pipes brand new and I'd have to wait a week for that still with a clogged sink, he charged me $250 for an unfinished job very disappointed

reviews.author: Tad White
reviews.text: I had a backup emergency on a Saturday and I called three different plumbing companies. 1-Tom-Plumber answered. That was a huge deal for me as I had sewage in my basement.  Collin came out first thing Monday and provided a detailed assessment and  fixed the issues. Collin was nothing but professional.  I will refer and use the company for all my plumbing needs.  6 stars if I could.

reviews.author: Gina Gnagie
reviews.text: Left our shower head completely wobbly and are voiding the warranty to try and charge us to come out and fix, aka put two screws in the wall that we do not want. Tech also left a tool here and has zero clue… for $300 leaving us with a shower head that you can’t adjust is ridiculous. Yes, our leak may be fixed, but we are not happy with the results and that doesn’t seem to matter.

reviews.author: M Mahbubani
reviews.text: Justin was great! He was early for our appointment, polite once he arrived, wore covers over his shoes at all times and explained everything to me in detail. We will call him for all our plumbing needs for now on along with referring this company to my friends and family. You guys did not disappoint us or make us feel like we were being taken advantage of. Thanks again Justin!

Best for emergencies where you want a fast big-company response; expect to pay for the overhead.

reviews.author: Michael Mabe
reviews.text: Having the right light fixture in a room makes all the difference, hiring the right person to install it is twice as important. Ethan Knoer, the electrician who installed my dining room light,  embodied the perfect professional for the job! Professional, courtesy and attention to detail were his trade in stock! Five star review for this young man. From moving the fixture to the center of the room, solid installation, clean up, even having the right cap for where the old fixture was made for the perfect experience. Even offering to help move furniture back was what  elevates the experience. If I could give him 6 stars, I would! I would go with Advance Services again and would request  Ethan every time. Thank you Advance Services and a big thank you to Ethan Knoes for a job well done

reviews.author: Ashley Louden
reviews.text:
We can’t say enough great things about Joseph Redmond with Absolute Services. Because of how much we trust his work, we purchased their lifetime membership (a one-time $100 fee), which includes free yearly maintenance and free inspections, and it has been more than worth it.

During his most recent maintenance visit, Joseph took the time to thoroughly inspect everything and helped us understand that our hot water heater is over 20 years old and past its life expectancy, allowing us to plan ahead before it fails unexpectedly. He also helped us figure out why our toilet wasn’t working properly and explained that it needs to be replaced. What really stood out was that he never once pressured us to buy anything or upsell services—he simply provided honest, knowledgeable advice so we could make informed decisions.

This wasn’t our first great experience with Joseph. Last year, he came out to help us fix our outside faucets that broke during the winter, and once again he was professional, efficient, and incredibly helpful.

Joseph’s customer service has been outstanding every single time we’ve worked with him. He is knowledgeable, patient, honest, and genuinely cares about his customers. Absolute Services is very lucky to have him, he is a huge asset to their company, and we always feel confident knowing Joseph is handling our plumbing needs. We will always request him for our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Ciara Lockstadt
reviews.text:
Joseph R. was my technician when I chose to use Absolute plumbing after I attempted to install a bidet and wound up with a massive water leak in my ceiling. He was very friendly and explained the issue to me and was able to fix it quickly. I would use them again for their plumbing services. - 12/19/25

Ethan with Absolute electricians did a great job installing my ceiling fan. The technician explained why the fan wasn’t working and gave me several options with price estimates to get it fixed. He explained everything clearly and simply so I could understand my options. He also told me about the average lifespan of fans and how they have changed over the years. He was also very clean which I liked! - 11/4/2025

reviews.author: Ryan C.
reviews.text:
"* NO service call fees. NO dispatch fees." This statement should be followed by, unless you want actual service from us.
If so, then we will bill you for the "No" service fee, which I was never told.
Advertising "Free estimates" would be more appropriate and accurate.     

Manager said they always add service fees for service, just not for estimates. So, its a FREE Service Fee, unless you want SERVICE.    

Also, left greasy fingerprints on my garage door. 
Manager said we could have scheduled another service call to get the grease off? Not sure if I was going to be charged for another "No service fee" or not.   

When you try to post this review to their website you get an error. 
"An error occurred. Please try again later."
Don't be fooled by 4.9 rating.

reviews.author: Genuine R.
reviews.text:
Needed repair work. Was told it would be several hours, super hard, blah blah. $$$$
He was done in 1 hour. I was not charged forc1 hour. He said " flat fee".
During last tune up, the guy dropped something and there was damage to my hard wood floors and wall. I have been waiting for weeks for compensation.​​

reviews.author: Yakky Doodle
reviews.text: Another update to review... today (04/22/26) JARED came by to make sure my AC is ready for summer. He was so polite, kind, attentive to details, answered all my questions and was finished in no time. I feel great knowing JARED gave my system the ok for summer...super job! On 03/02/26 Absolute Services came out to inspect my heating after becoming a new member of their maintenance plan in February. HAYDEN and BOB looked everything over, gave a couple suggestions to improve system performance and was able to complete the work during same visit! Excellent customer service, friendly and left me feeling like I am in honest, safe hands. I can't say enough about Absolute Services...I am very pleased with everything! Review after the hot water heater install on 02/26/26. BRAYDEN was my first f2f contact. I told him I wanted a hot water heater relocated in the basement, how I wanted it to look and he offered several solutions to make that a reality. He did a great job communicating with me and his team. BRAYDEN was wonderful! He was friendly and wasn't the pushy salesmen type...I appreciated that! ELIJAH and CHRIS installed the new hot water heater today...the finished job is beautiful! It is exactly how I envisioned, just like a dream. They paid attention to all the details I asked for and gave superior work quality. Everything was cleaned up and back in place after the install. Elijah and Chris were knowledgable, friendly and were so respectful of me and my home. Absolute Services has been easy to work with from beginning to end. I purchased their yearly maintenance plan that covers electric, plumbing, hot water heater and hvac system. A couple other things I like...the company sends me texts with the name and picture of each person that has came to my home before their arrival..made me feel safe to know when I answered the door the person is legit. Also, Absolute Services offers services for all my home care. I will not need to search for individual contractors for future projects...awesome! Again thank you to everyone who has taken good care of me 😊

reviews.author: Leslie F.
reviews.text: Horrible, do not use this company for anything.  Six weeks to improperly install a new HVAC system. Gas connection was wrong 3 different ways: 1. Actual fittings and configeration was wrong. 2. They connected into line going to my dryer, rather than running new line to the new gas furnace. 3. The gas line that they tapped into was not big enough to supply the furnace, let alone furnace plus a dryer. Add that to every gas connection made by their HVAC guys leaked and had to redone by their plumber. Their plumber refused to run direct line to the furnace, as it needed to be. Also had issues with the new humidifier being installed wrong. Water ran directly from humidifier onto and into the furnace. soaking all of the electronics, and leaving standing water inside the unit. At this point I demanded that they take it all out and give me my money back. They sent a senior ops manager to bully and intimidate me, claimed there was nothing wrong with installation. Back to 3 different problems with gas line, and the system being flooded by the improper instalation of the humidifier. He kept telling me nothing was wrong and it was all perfectly safe. Sorry does anyone really believe that water and electricity mix well?  As for minor problems, in general it looked awful. Many problems with this install and how it was left. Six weeks with 6 in pipe open through the roof, they didn't take it out and repair roof as promised. They ran the new exhaust pipes in front of my electrical outlets, to where I would not be able to use them. I was left to repair a lot of damage caused by them. Everything that they did had to be taken out and done correctly. At this point, I wouldn't trust them to change a lightbulb.

reviews.author: Ed D.
reviews.text:
They came out last week and cleaned the main drain . It backed up the next evening when we did laundry.  I called them. They came back out and said there would be a charge of $338.00 ,again because it was a tree root issue . Personally I didn't think tree roots grew back overnight.  I thought it was operator error because the tech had struggled so much with the machine and failed to do a good job. He didn't even run water down the drain before he left . He did get tree roots out of the drain . Well I wasn't going to pay for another half ass job so I called roto rooter.  They came out and found that the tab that connects to the opening was broken . Since the first tech was the only person that ran a snake through the drain . I feel the they are responsible for the repair and roto rooter bill. The drain wasn't clogged the second time the tab had broken off and kept the sewage from draining . 
The second time Absolute came out there , the tech should of digignoised the problem instead of saying there would be another $338.00 . Techs are not trained properly and management wants to do a 2 step around the issue . 
I'm trying to locate others who have had dealings with them that have legitimate concerns. What ever happened to ethical business practices. Having been self employed since 1982 , I have never taken advantage or failed to acknowledge a mistake by myself or a employee.

reviews.author: Joseph S.
reviews.text:
I had Absolute Services come out to quote me on adding a pump to my HVAC system because it wasn't draining correctly. The technician inspected everything and gave me a written quote for $600. I signed the work order and scheduled the job for the very next day.

The morning the work was supposed to be done, I woke up to a call from a completely different plumber from their team saying she needed to "re-quote" the job -- and the new price would be significantly higher, likely double what I was originally quoted. This was never mentioned before, and I already had a signed agreement and confirmed appointment.

I immediately called the original technician who gave me the $600 quote. He told me he'd speak with his General Manager and "get it straightened out within the hour." That was the last I ever heard from anyone at Absolute Services. No follow-up, no explanation, no apology -- nothing.

They had a signed work order, a scheduled appointment, and then tried to pull a bait-and-switch at the last minute to squeeze more money out of me. This is one of the shadiest and most unprofessional experiences I've ever had with a contractor.

Do yourself a favor and avoid Absolute Services at all costs -- unless you want to deal with dishonesty, broken promises, and zero accountability. They should change their name to ABSOLUTE SCAMMERS.

reviews.author: Nancy G.
reviews.text:
We had a water heater installed on 8-13-2020 to the cost of $1678.10. 

Yesterday 8-27-2020 our downstairs neighbor had a leak coming from our condo at the location the water heater was installed. It did damage to her walls and carpet. The same technician that did the installation came out to check the problem on our end. He stated the tray the water heater sits in was cracked and the pvc pipe from our HVAC was causing water to pool in the tray and go down the crack to the downstairs unit. 

My problem is there was never a crack or leak before the water heater was installed and never any water coming from the HVAC to the tray, if there was a crack prior why did he not point it out and recommend a new tray at that time? I believe the tray was damaged during the removal of the old water heater or during the installation of the new one. He did come out yesterday and put silicone around the area and recommended a new tray "at an additional cost". This solution is unacceptable and now we are out addition money to repair the damages to the unit downstairs. 

I received a call from the company this morning and of course they passed the buck and gave every excuse under the sun how they were not responsible, I do not recommend this company and have filed a complaint with the BBB

reviews.author: M. T.
reviews.text: Don't believe the 5 star ratings of this company. Quality has gone downhill over the past couple of years. I've called this company for various issues over the years and without fail, the electrician/plumber/garage door tech pushes over and over again their home membership. Their service has deteriorated markedly, to the point where I will not call them again. Case in point: I wanted an estimate for a home charger for an electric vehicle. Received a text that the electrician was on his way (1.5 hours earlier than the window), so I had to interrupt work to let the home office know that now wasn't convenient and for him to come back at the previously agreed upon time. In the first 10 minutes of interacting with the electrician he asked what I did for a living. Strange. After he looked at the breaker box, he asked if he could sit at my kitchen table for 10-15 minutes to write out the estimate (again, strange request that I did not agree to).  Then asked if he could use my bathroom (I grudgingly accepted).  The estimate was nearly $5000 for installing a Level 2 charger! Absolute services is absolutely ridiculous. Good riddance. If I could give them zero stars, I would. Very unprofessional.

reviews.author: Jeremy R.
reviews.text:
Do Not Use Absolute Services
Absolute Services drastically overcharges and communicates terribly.
My furnace wouldn't ignite, so I called them-- they had installed it four years ago. The technician
seemed unqualified, needing to send photos to someone else for help. He eventually said my pressure
switch and exhaust pipe needed replacement, quoting $974 and claiming the cost was high because of
the labor. The repair, however, only took about 30 minutes.
Parts cost about $100 online, and other companies quoted $350-$450. Communication was
awful--days of no callbacks, mixed messages about whether I needed to be home, and they only
reversed their demand that I be there after I threatened to cancel. When the tech finally came, he went
to the wrong house, and I had to leave work to let him in.
When I asked for an itemized invoice, I got only a vague note. No one ever followed up.
Their Facebook reviews mention similar overcharging--none of which appear on Google.
$974 for 30 minutes is outrageous. Poor communication, inflated pricing, and zero accountability. Avoid

reviews.author: Jessica M.
reviews.text: What a nightmare using this company, hired them to fix a clogged toilet, which they tried to snake and ended up using a snake on the main line in my basement, charged me $437.00 and tried to up sell me on replacing my pipes for $4,400. Never used a camera in my pipes either. The technician never wore shoe covers in my home and when he cleaned out the pipe he didn't put anything underneath it on my floor and also had shit, literally on my baseboards in the bathroom and it gets better, upon leaving my home he apparently dumped the waste from my pipe in his shop vac onto my grass in my front yard , pretty sure that's a biohazard. Left a message with the company and had to repeatedly keep calling them about sending donn my robe out to clean it up the waste. Never spoke with A general manager and nothing was taken off my bill and they also did not recaulk my toilet seal like the invoice indicates they did.! The worst customer service, quality of work and overpricing I have yet to experience in my life with a plumber.

reviews.author: Mary T.
reviews.text: My review of Absolute Services is Absolutely Fabulous. Travis Harvey did a great job of putting what all I needed done. It started with problems with my electrical box, this was a panel rejuvenation which fixed my pblms with my lights going out & getting several wall circuits for my kitchen, bathroom, living room for Christmas & computer room (man I got rid of a few extra extension cords) & why now it no longer looks cluttered & lot easier to trace where everything is plugged in. Also got extra outlets for the outside at Christmas time (yay). I also re did all my smoke alarms. On Monday I had my garage door fixed, luckily I did not have to have a door but all the other repairs done & today I had my nasty dryer vents cleaned out. So glad I did about 2 yrs ago my neighbors house had a small fire due to the vents not being cleaned, by the way I did sign with a service contract & so glad I did. Maybe this is one way to keep my house up to date. The whole crew did a fantastic job! Well Done!

reviews.author: Vlad Pham
reviews.text:
I had a pipe burst in my home and needed it replaced quickly, so I called around to five different plumbing companies. Absolute was the first to pick up, and right away I had a good feeling. The person on the phone was friendly, easy to talk to, and genuinely helpful without feeling forced.

I was at work when our plumber came out came out to give the estimate, but my wife told me he hopped out of his truck with a big smile and was incredibly kind and professional from the start. That first impression really stuck with us.

After getting all the quotes, Absolute wasn’t the cheapest (they were right in the middle), but everything was competitive. What made the difference for us was the overall experience. From customer service to the quality of interaction, they just stood out.

We’re really glad we chose to work with Brayden Duke. He was professional, did great work, and made a stressful situation a lot easier to deal with.

Highly recommend.

synthesis.summary: Google says 4.9 across 4,683 reviews and BBB is A+, but Yelp 1.7/30 is brutal — re-plumbing jobs that flooded the basement two days later, 14 days without AC during a heatwave with no manager callback, and $300/year membership requirements just to get on the schedule. Honest read: large operation with strong individual technicians (Joseph, Ethan, Brad, Travis named in 5-star reviews) but a service-management layer that fails on follow-through, callbacks, and warranty.
strengths: Specific technicians (Joseph Redmond, Ethan Knoer, Brad, Travis Harvey) named in detailed 5-star reviews on lighting, panel rejuvenation, and bidet leak repair
Lifetime $100 membership offers free yearly maintenance/inspection — appealing to long-term customers
Quoted competitive HVAC replacement and got customer up and running in 3 days in one cited case
weaknesses: Repeat workmanship failures on major jobs — '$70,000 worth of work,' pipes burst 2 days after re-plumbing, basement flooding again a year later
Multiple 14+ day delays on emergency repairs with no manager callback
Pricing complaints dominate Yelp — $590 to install a faucet with nothing under the cabinet, $1,300 to drop in a single-bowl sink, $437 to snake a clogged toilet
Membership required to access service in some cases — customer of record told 'you have to pay for a membership' to be re-served
Repeat allegations of forged disclosure / liability forms
bestFor: longtime members willing to pay for the maintenance plan
redFlags: Yelp 1.7 vs Google 4.9 across 30 Yelp reviews — extreme rating discrepancy
Reviewers allege forged disclosure forms used to deflect damage claims
$800 refund withheld for over a year on returned garage-door springs
Repeat 'no call no show' on confirmed electrical appointments
synthesis.emergencyNotes: Despite emergency-services advertising and a paid membership tier, multiple reviewers report 14+ days without AC in a heatwave with no manager callback, and grinder-pump Labor Day weekend success in only one cited 5-star case. Emergency response is paywalled and inconsistent.
synthesis.platformDiscrepancy: Yelp 1.7 vs Google 4.9 across 30 Yelp reviews — 3.2-star gap, very large; Yelp text consistent with workmanship and warranty complaints

reviews.text: Ben did a great job, he replaced a shower cartridge. I was waisting a lot of water as the faucet did not shut of. Everything is good now
