reviews.text: shower cartridge replaced and kitchen faucet installation. Great work

reviews.author: LaShawn H.
reviews.text: I have been a long time customer of this location. However, my experience the past year has been awful as it relates to the Service Area. I have left my newly purchased 2023 vehicle at this location several times in 2024 and each time there was an issue. In February my car was left outside on their lot unlocked with my key fob in the cup holder overnight for 2 days when they were closed. I'm glad it wasn't stolen. The second incident my car was damaged while at the property over the weekend. The third incident my car was left outside on their lot again unlocked for 2 days over the Christmas holiday. I get notifications to my phone when the doors are unlocked and I was unable to remotely lock it both times. I have addressed by concerns with the Service Area Manager, Johnathan which only leads to more frustration. He is rude, dismissive and I truly don't believe he addresses these matters with the staff. He doesn't have any sense of urgency and does not honor any commitments. I've been charged for things I shouldn't have been charged for (still awaiting a refund). I've been promised an electric loaner since I have an electric car just to arrive and be given a gas loaner. I have raised my concerns to the Managing Partner but there still appears to be a disconnect for these incidents to continue to occur and all they ever can say is I'm sorry. I am truly disappointed with my experiences with Service at Sheehy Lexus of Annapolis this year. There needs to be a change in management for sure. As a "luxury" dealership customer satisfaction and safety and security of customer's vehicles should be a top priority for the Service Team.

reviews.author: Tira H.
reviews.text:
I'm quite disappointed in Sheehy Lexus of Annapolis. The service is usually stellar. I scheduled an 8am appt for my 10,000 mile service. I arrived at 8am and was told it would be an hour and a half wait. I was asked if I wanted a vehicle. I advised Payton that I didn't, but I would take it so I didn't have to sit inside the building with a mask on for two hours. I told him I would run some errands while I wait. After 2.5 hours, I text the number provided to check my car. No response. I give it more time then call the Service Dept. At this point,  it is 11 o'clock. Payton tells me car will be another 1.5 to 2 hours. So when we passed the initial 2 hour mark and my car was not even started, there was no thought to call or text and advise on a delay? I drove an hour to get to this dealership. I got up at 6:30am on a Saturday, drove an hour and spent 4 hours waiting. 6 hours out of my Saturday for a 10,000 mile service. I realize everything is moving a bit slower these days, but an honest assessment or the time frames and/or a quick phone call/text would have  prevented the complete obliteration of my schedule for today. 
*I will say the take appropriate COVID precautions. I observed consistent mask use and the disinfecting of vehicles.

reviews.author: J P.
reviews.text:
My advice:  Unless you're buying a car MSRP, or don't mind being taken advantage of...  AVOID THIS PLACE LIKE THE PLAGUE!  Rockville Lexus is great.  Bridgewater Lexus is also great.  Try either of them.  This dealership is what happens when standards are low, and customers are complacent with mediocrity.  Lexus makes a great line of products, just find another and dealership to reward with your hard earned money.

The abbreviated story:  I traveled a long way to buy a vehicle that was misrepresented.  The GSM, Jayson Craddock presents himself as an arrogant jerk.  The sales staff I worked with are either lazy, or blatantly dishonest.  Sheehy would prefer to pawn off their damaged vehicles on other dealerships to avoid making repairs to satisfy a customer.  Customer service is an distant after thought.

The long story:  I was searching for a new 2017 Lexus with a feature set and color combination that was increasing rare.  As a result, I ended up interested in a demo car located at this dealership.  I negotiated a deal and was told the vehicle was near flawless.  I asked if it had any chips or scratches and was told "none that I can see".  I heard the same description of the vehicle from the salesperson and the sales manager.  We worked out a deal and I purchased a plane ticket the next day.  On the day of travel received a text showing two paint chips in the hood.  I responded and asked if there were any more and was told "nope, it's flawless otherwise".  No offer to repair the damage was made.  I was told I could just "apply touch up paint", that I would have to buy on my own because they did not have it in stock and it was Haz Mat and could not be shipped to me.  As my ticket was non-refundable, and I was already on my way to the airport, I decided to go and verify the condition for myself.  The plan was to buy the car, assuming the chips in the picture were the only flaws on the vehicle, and drive it home.  I was supposed to be picked up from my hotel the next morning, at 8am, by Johnny Salinas.  At 8:15am, I contacted the salesperson and was told there was a mistake and that she would pick me up instead.  She picked me up, and we went to see the vehicle.   

When I arrived at the dealership, the vehicle was parked out front.  I walked around the vehicle and immediate noticed 4-6in scratches on both passenger side doors, a chip in the front left fender, the two chips in the hood (that visible in the photo sent to me), curb rash on the rear passenger wheel, a 3 inch wide paint scrape on the driver's side rear bumper (like it was scraped against a pole), another scratch on the rear driver's side door.  Essentially, every panel except the driver's door had damage.  

I pointed these out to the salesperson, and she brought Johnny Salinas out to see me.  Johnny said there was nothing they could do about the damage as they were "all-in" on the deal we had worked out.  I explained that I did not want a discount, but instead wanted the damage repaired and would fly back to pick up the car when it was done.  Johnny said they would not repair any damage as it was easier for Sheehy Lexus to "transfer the car to another dealer and let it be their problem".  So obviously the mindset here is Profits At All Cost and Customer Last.  I expressed this sentiment to Johnny and he just shrugged.  I asked to speak to Paul LaRochelle (GM/Partner) and was told he was too busy to see me.  

I'm a veteran and these guys are self described as "veteran friendly", but that was not my experience.  

I subsequently left, and purchased a flight home.  This was the worst experience I've had with any Lexus dealership, EVER.  It feels like it is run by amateurs.

reviews.author: Ted M.
reviews.text:
I will just state the facts in chronological order:

April 4, at 5:45 PM: I called the dealership on a Lexus LS 600hL they just posted online for sale and spoke to Elliott.  I asked about the car and he said it is still available.  I asked if I can put a deposit on the car and if he can hold it for me.  He said we are a "first come first serve dealership."  I agreed to the price of the car and asked what he would like me to do next.  He said complete the finance application online to get financing for the car.  I immediately completed the application.

April 5 at 9:00: Elliott asked me to send over a copy of my driver's license and insurance card. I sent both over to him right away.

April 5, at 10 AM.  I called Elliott to see what rate he can get me for the car as I can get 4.3% at my local bank.  He said the information is with the finance manager and that he will get back to me.

April 5 at 12:00:  I called Elliott again to see what the financing is looking like.  He said I should be next with the finance manager.  I was told that the finance manager is busy as they sell a lot of cars.

April 5 at 2:00:  I called Elliott again as I have a rental car ready to be picked up one way to Annapolis from Chicago for the next day. (I live in Illinois and would need to transport the car back to Chicago). He told me "I hope the car does not get sold during this process."  I explained to him that if they had the intention of selling the car to someone else, then my credit should not be run.  He informed me that they already ran my credit.  I said "good, then we should know any minute now."  He assured me he would call me back and even asked me what term I would want on the loan.

April 5 at 4:00:  I called Elliott as this is taking far too long.  The car should have been purchased by noon today.  Elliott did not answer.

April 5 at 6:00:  I called and asked to speak to the finance manager.  I was sent to Barbara who told me that they ran my credit, I have a 750 credit score, and that I was approved for a 4.125% APR.  She further asked if that is acceptable and if I would be using their financing.  I said yes.

April 5 at 7:00:  I called yet again and now was told they have someone coming in at 9 AM the next day to look at the car locally.  ARE YOU KIDDING????  I LOST IT!!!  THEY RAN MY CREDIT AND ARE NOW SHOWING THE CAR THE NEXT DAY TO SOMEONE ELSE.  YET THEY ARE A "FIRST COME FIRST SERVE DEALER."

I called to speak to the general manager.  Not available.  I called to speak to the owner.  Not available.  NO RETURNED CALLS YET.  

Additionally, I have already filed a complaint with the BBB and the Maryland Attorney General.  I am also contemplating legal action.

NOW, here is what I believe happened:

I believe that whomever is going to be there at 9 AM the next day is a friend of an owner, manager, or employee of the dealership.  I don't care if you don't want to sell me the car for whatever reason, but HOW DARE YOU RUN MY CREDIT THEN WAIT FOR SOMEONE ELSE TO COME SEE THE CAR!!!!!!!

Here's an update. Paul LaRochelle, the general manager, called me to tell me that's how they do business. When asked to remove my credit ding, he flat out told me no.

reviews.author: Doug S.
reviews.text:
If this Lexus dealership could get negative stars, they really should. I was a serious cash buyer looking to purchase a 2025 IS 350 F Sport. I called after seeing a certified one I liked that only had 167 miles on it. I called to see what the story was and they said that it had one previous owner. After inquiring further, they told me that someone bought it from another dealership, returned it and then they bought it from that dealership. (Strange). I then asked about the price of 51,962 and what the sticker was. They told me the sticker was around the same and they couldn't move at all on the price because they use "dynamic pricing" and it's a certified car. Yeah okay. I made an offer of $46,000 seeing as it had a previous owner already and would have crushed my resale value if I ever sold it in the future. They scoffed at the offer and didn't even counter. During further text exchange Bryan Steckel states "if a few thousand dollars is going to stop you from buying this car, I wish you the best?" Buddy, a FEW THOUSAND? I don't care how wealthy someone is, a few thousand isn't a small number to a large population of the country. This place wants new prices for used cars. After further investigation, I come to find out that a woman bought the car from another dealership on 2/9 and traded it into SHEEHY in the middle of March. They didn't BUY it from another dealership. Which means they fleeced that lady when she returned it, then made money on the next car she bought AND now they're trying to make MORE money on the car she traded in and they waxed her on already. I would say this is a one off, but I see they have another 2025 IS with **14,000 miles** listed for almost $50,000. Are you kidding me?? 

What's interesting is that I see they have ZERO new 2025 or 2026 IS's. I can see why! This dealership group is a bunch of PIGS and they probably come in under their numbers every single month and every single quarter so Lexus USA doesn't send these PIGS any good inventory. There is a dealership in Ohio that already has **32** 2026 Lexus IS. Probably not a shady dealership like this one!!

Anyways, I'll be buying a BRAND NEW with zero miles 2025 Lexus IS 350 tomorrow for under $50,000. I'm glad Sheehy turned down my offer, I know I would have been so disappointed had I done business with these clowns.

reviews.author: Brian A.
reviews.text:
My wife has been a loyal Lexus car owner for almost 10-years and we were looking for a new vehicle to purchase since her last vehicle was considered totaled after a severe storm.  I'm not sure why the overall reviews are not better for this Lexus location as I have nothing but great things to say.

We came in on a Monday to quickly look at the new styles of vehicles and we were greeted by Mr. Johnny Salinas who spoke to us about what we were looking for and he made it very clear that if we did not receive the service that we desired, to come speak to him directly.  He introduced us to Chad Sawyer who assisted us the rest of our time at Lexus.  Chad was fantastic to work with.  He was very knowledgeable of both the new and used vehicles and he was very customer service oriented.  You always go into a car purchase with the thought that the sales associates are out to get you, but with Chad, he seemed to care and allowed us to go at the pace that we desired with no pressure.  I can't say it enough, he was great to work with and I highly recommend asking for him if you're looking in the showroom.  

We test drove a new vehicle for my wife and I test drove a used vehicle for myself.  The Lexus brand is well known for their performance and luxury feel, so if you've never driven one before, you will be in for a treat.  

We came in on a busy Saturday to purchase two vehicles and while the process took a good amount of time (we had to take a break in-between signing paperwork due to a wedding shower), it went very smoothly overall.  The entire staff was very considerate of us and ensured that we were well taken care of throughout the day.  That is what a luxury elite dealership is all about.  You don't just purchase a Lexus for the vehicle, but you purchase the vehicle for the customer service that you receive throughout the ownership of the vehicle.

Overall, I was very satisfied with our purchases and I would highly recommend visiting Sheehy Lexus of Annapolis. I am happy to join my wife as a loyal Lexus owner.

reviews.author: Bridget C.
reviews.text:
I initially had a great experience with Rusha, my sales person.  She was wonderful and really took care of me and our family.  It is now four months later and I have found out the registration the dealership gave me is not valid.  I have exchanged emails, spent time with endless ringing on the phone with no answers, and in the end am told to go register the vehicle myself at MVA.  I already paid registration during the sale, I have apparently been driving illegally for four months due to fault of Sheehy, I have a medically complex daughter and work full time so I can't just run to MVA when I can get an appointment.  There is a reason that we do the registration as part of the transaction and I certainly wouldn't expect a Lexus dealer to be letting me down even four months later.  So please, if you are going to make a purchase here, MAKE sure you are covered with all of the transactional needs and have a VALID registration, what they printed me is absolute not valid, I confirmed with the MVA.  I still do not have an actual solution to this other than to contact someone that might be able to advise legally of what the dealerships obligation is when they were paid and provided a 'registration'.  I really liked this dealership too, everyone there had been great.

Also, just in fairness, to note, I purchased a used non-Lexus, so I am sure I am not getting Lexus treatment.  I did during the sale buy all of the Lexus extended plans, extended warranty, tire and wheel package and GAP.  When I tried to use the plans at Sheehy I found out I can't, they only are usable on Lexus vehicles.  I have to have service done on my own and submit for reimbursement to the plans.  They suggested I take my car to the VW dealer, but they don't accept the Lexus service plan.  The only one that is really worth my time and effort is the GAP plan.  So the security in having the policy sounds great when executing the contracts but trying to use them, not great.  I have requested cancellation, this is not yet confirmed.

reviews.author: Brandon H.
reviews.text: Yesterday I took my car in for the scheduled routine maintenance. The service department as always, was outstanding. I couldn't have been happier with the level of professionalism shown from those who work for this fine establishment. Here's my problem, I originally brought my car from the Lexus store in silver spring. I absolutely hate that dealership. With that being said, while waiting for my car to be serviced I asked if I could have some Lexus of Annapolis tag frames so that I can trash the ones that were put on my car by the Lexus store in Silver Spring, the gentleman at the parts counter was a bit rude in his approach and delivery of words. In other words, he gave me a harsh no after asking me had the vehicle be purchased there. I asked him why, he began to explain to me that the tag frames are to determine who gets free car washes and who don't. Coming from a person who works for a local dealership and have worked at a dealership for years, I understand where he's coming from. He stated that he would definitely lose his job and I in no way shape or form would want that. However, his approach was wrong. I just didn't want my car to have Silver Spring tag frames on it anymore. I figured that since all of my services will be done at Lexus of Annapolis, I figure... why not show them as much love as I can. To be honest, I can careless about a car wash. I've always washed my car myself  since the date of purchase and wouldn't drive all the way to Annapolis just to get over on a dealership for a free car wash after they've treated me extremely well. All in all, I'm a little disappointed. I would have never came off on any of my customers in that manor that this gentleman came off on me over some tag frames.

reviews.author: Ana K.
reviews.text:
For all you Pretty Women fans out there - this is the place to go if you want to be treated like a second class citizen. I (female) walked into the dealership with a (male) friend. We were both dressed down. I (female) was the buyer. After waiting a while to even be acknowledged by the sales team (dumb move #1), the first salesperson to stop by to say hello made a quick decision that we weren't worth the time (dumb move #2), passing us off to someone else. I (female) explained what car I was interested in, at which time this salesperson turned to my (male) friend to shake hands and exchange pleasantries as if I were invisible. My friend quickly clarified that I was the decision maker/buyer, but the salesperson's pro-male behaviors continued. In addition to the (VERY stupid) assumption that I didn't have the means or authority to buy a luxury car, the salesperson assumed (wrongly) that I was interested in a lower priced model because I couldn't afford anything else, suddenly steering me to used cars. I had a similar experience with this dealership a decade ago, which led me to buy another luxury brand. I was so hoping Lexus Annapolis had learned over the years how to treat ALL customers at face value with respect. Alas, that is not the case. I will, once again, have to buy a new car elsewhere.

UPDATE:  after looking at many other luxury models, I was still drawn to the Lexus. Like a fool, I went back to this dealership to give them a second chance. Alas, the treatment was the same, even as a solo female shopper. It's 2019 people. Women do shop for luxury cars.  They do have money to spend. The fact that I can't spend my money at my local dealership is appalling. Silver Spring, here I come.

reviews.author: Alexis B.
reviews.text:
5.22.24-After extensive research, I found a Lexus SUV that I really liked and was prepared to buy from Sheehy Lexus of Annapolis. We called on Tuesday to ensure the vehicle was still available. The salesman said Yes! It's available then asked when am I coming in. I said tomorrow. He recorded my mobile # & started texting me as the conversation was going on. I didn't need Lexus financing, just the vehicle. Simple right? 

I responded to his texts and said I will take leave from work and be there by 1pm.  He texted several more times to ensure I was still coming in on Wednesday at 1pm. We arrived around 12:45pm. After pleasantries, I asked to see the vehicle. He left for about 10 min.  Returned and informed me that the SUV that I drove an hour to purchase was sold YESTERDAY! I was bewildered in spite of the apologies from him & his manager. They explained that they share inventory with another dealership. Proceeded to try to sell me a brand new model that was 30% above the budget. 

This entire situation is unacceptable. I should've received a call informing me that the vehicle is unavailable. Not sure what type of unreliable inventory system they have, but something should have been in the system indicating that a client was ready to buy. Also, why wasn't the car cleaned and prepped for me PRIOR to arrival? NOTHING was done. Not even a quick walk to the key box. This was a complete waste of my time, gas, and leave. I expected a lot more from this dealership. There's more. I am now receiving multiple daily calls & texts attempting to sell me another vehicle that I do not want. 

Business Manager, feel free to contact me for further details & pls make the daily contact stop.

reviews.author: K T.
reviews.text:
Trying to communicate with The service department at  Sheehey Lexus of Annapolis is a time consuming headache.  If you speak with 4 different staff persons at Sheehey, you'll get 4 different stories.  Even uncomplicated, regularly scheduled maintenance service visits are a hassle.  No one knows what anyone else is doing and half of what you need done, is overlooked.   

Making a simple service appointment takes forever and the people who schedule the appointments are unable to answer the simplest of questions such as what is the cost for the 20K maintenance service?  What services are done on the 20K maintenance check?    I had to call twice and speak with 4 different people before getting an answer to what is included in the 20K check.  I called twice because I never received the return call I was promised after my first call (I gave them 3 full days to call me back)

After my car was serviced a man went over everything with me on my sedan. The problem is that I have a SUV.   I was charged for regular oil on my last check but my vehicle requires SYNTHETIC!   The service man said he's "pretty sure" they did use synthetic and that I am lucky to be charged for the lesser costing regular oil!   
Oil in a car is like blood in our veins, get it right!  

I think the entire staff of Sheehey of  Annapolis could benefit from proper customer service training.  They are selling The Lexus brand, not YUGO.  When you buy a luxury vehicle for $60K, you expect a modicum of respect and service without a side order of sarcasm. 

There are at least 5 Lexus dealerships in The MD, VA area.  We won't be returning to  Sheehey of Annapolis for sales or service in the future.

reviews.author: Justin D.
reviews.text: (Pete Paul-Service Director, i hope you read this) I dont know what it is With the "Kids" (runner boys) always messing around with my Cars. 1st was The damage Sheehy Lexus caused on my 2016 GS F about a year and a half ago. The damage was done to one of the aftermarket Wheels and the funny thing was they first tried to say the damage was already there... Anyways they ended up writing me a check for $800.00 for the damage. Now Lets Fast forward to my most recent issue on my Wifes 2016 GS350 AWD. I Had an Apt. on Sep 4th 2020 @ 7am for a recall. So my wife and i arrive to Lexus to drop it off we pull in and get the loaner (a beautiful UX250 F Sport that we loved and talked about even Buying). Once we were in the Loaner i realized i forgot to grab the phone charger. My wife's GS is still in the service lane so i run back in there to grab the charger and BAM!  look at that, i see all the "kids" standing around my wife car messing with the Aftermarket Air ride suspension controller trying to lower her car. Not realizing i walked back in, one of them even said "yeah its going down in the rear" . So i walk up open the pass door (mind you they all are pretending like nothing is going on) i grab the Charger and say the kid sitting in the front seat "come on man WHY do you have to mess with it" He didn't say a word back to me. I shut the pass door and walked out. I just don't understand WHY they have to fuck with stuff that 1. They don't own and 2. Have no CLUE how it works. I drive an hr and a half to come to this location. And due to the issues i have had with you i will never buy from you. And will be going to Lexus of Richmond from now on for service.

reviews.author: Ashley Uber
reviews.text: They came out quickly when I called and were able to fix everything and install new toilets same day! They explained the process and the costs very clearly. I would definitely use their services again and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Brad Ott
reviews.text: Josh provided truly outstanding service. His professionalism was exceptional.  He accurately diagnosed and resolved our issue. The entire process was smooth and efficient, and he made it easy to add an additional service without any hassle. We greatly appreciate his expertise and customer-focused approach.

reviews.author: Giselle Sada
reviews.text: Eric was genuine, kind, and made me feel at ease. Sometimes a new person coming to your home can feel awkward but I didn’t feel that way at all. He fixed a part under our kitchen sink and flushed out our hot water heater. He did a great job and I am grateful to him.

reviews.author: Jennifer C.
reviews.text: Cannot recommend. They came out but never got back with me for a quote like they promised. Unprofessional.

reviews.author: Anthony V.
reviews.text: They were sent to my house by a home warranty company.  I asked if they were vaccinated, and the lead guy said he wasn't, so I asked him to wear a mask.  He took a mask I offered and put it over his mouth.  When I asked him to cover his nose, he refused.  When I said then he'd have to leave my house, he did.  Absolutely no concept of what it means to be in a service industry or to be a guest in someone's home.

reviews.author: J C
reviews.text: About a month ago I called Backup Plumbing to get a quote on a sump pump and hosebib replacement. I was able to quickly get on the team’s schedule the same week. The team was very communicative and sent text and call reminders for the appointment. Josh A was the journeyman who showed up and immediately set to work inspecting the sump pump. It was about 10 years old and had been running way too frequently. He immediately knew something was wrong and set to cracking open the pit (sealed for radon mitigation) which was a pain in the butt. He walked me through everything, showing me the running water in the pit and discussing various tiers of replacement such as a battery backup. He then took a look at the hosebib and warned me in advance he’d have to cut drywall for access if I decided to replace it. Kyle talked me through pricing and told me Josh would be able to get everything done same day. This was a Friday so naturally I was surprised. After learning about their Service Plan, which for $12/mo gives you 12% off services on top of other benefits, I immediately said yes. Josh was even able to squeeze in my free water heater flush for the plan. Josh was great. He was very professional, always wearing covers on his shoes, mindful of my family during the time they were home, and he let me know how everything was going the entire time. When he left, he walked me through the repairs and was on his way. One month later, the new pump with the quiet discharge connection works great and sounds healthy and the hose bib has been in use watering our gardens as the weather gets warmer. All in all, I would recommend Backup Plumbing for any plumbing needs, inside and outside the home. I look forward to working with the team again in the future.

reviews.author: Dawn S.
reviews.text:
One of the plumber's from Durbin came to my house as a contractor for my warranty company on  10/29/2018. The didn't leave a card or even a receipt from where I paid my 75 copay. Fast forward to today 11/2/18 and I called to day to get an update. I was told by Tina that  they had to find out who the plumber was and she would call back. Two hours later after I checked my online claim with the warranty company I called Tina back. I was told Mr Durbin would call me in 30 minutes with an update. I have never received one. I called my warranty company and after holding for 30 min while they called Durbin's they fnally come back and say that Durbin's is claiming they cant get to my FLOODING BASEMENT for two more weeks. Why did I wait so long? Because on tuesday I also found out my child needed emergency testing on her kidney's so I thought well they will call and put it on the back burner. I now have a continuous leak into my basement and have to wait for another plumber to find a way to fit me in. That ladies and gentleman is crappy service. And even if they keep this from their website it will be on yelp and google. Edited to add Tina called me and said she had not heard from me in over 10 days so I was moved to her completed file.. The CHECK was dated 10/30/18 so someone also needs some math classes. She also tried to put it off on the warranty company as well.. CLASSY. Yes I hung up on her.
Dawn Skaggs

reviews.author: Shelley M.
reviews.text:
Huh, I could have sworn that I reviewed Durbin Plumbing before, but I must have written it as a draft or some such thing because they do good work and I wouldn't want to overlook them.

I have owned an older home for about 8 years. I've had Durbin Plumbing out for various jobs over the years, no repeats of course on their work, but different sections of the house.

Water heater install, exactly at quoted price even though it was a more complicated job than expected AND their price was at or less than that of other companies.

Replaced a deteriorating T-pipe joint and reconnected everything to it-- hourly rate was fair, work was clean and neat, pipe connections all tight, and they left the old pipe joint for me to see why it went wrong because I like to learn that kind of thing (corroded in on itself after 50-60 years).

Replaced washing machine hook-ups that started leaking.  I called on a weekend and even though it wasn't an "emergency" thing and I didn't want/need an emergency call-out like one might need for a gushing leak, they were out promptly at the start of the week which was darn near close to right away.  

Basically, good work at good prices from a company that honors commitments and won't try to up-sell you.

reviews.author: Steve & Sara Lose
reviews.text: This was our fist experience with Backup Plumbing and it was great!  We were in need of a toilet repair and I  gave them a call.  Everyone one I talked with was wonderful, from the woman that took my call (I wish I could remember her name), to Kyle that handled the appointment details to Eric who ended up doing the work. I called late one afternoon, and was able to set up an appointment for the next day.  The communication between the office staff, and the plumber that came to the house was fantastic.  When Eric showed up he was quick to access the issue and give me some options.  The prices were very reasonable, especially for the quality work that was done. My wife and I decided to just replace the toilet.  We are very happy with the work done.  Again,  this was the first experience with Backup Plumbing, and should we ever have plumbing issues again, rest assured they will be our fist call.

reviews.author: Rhonda M.
reviews.text: Was referred to this company through our home warranty coverage, the guys came out and diagnosed the problem, needed to order the parts and return later, upon return was told before the work was complete that everything was covered under my warranty, then after work was completed was told I owed the $65 co-pay plus $75 for additional parts that wasn't covered. I called the owner of the company to try and see if his workers was telling me the truth or if they was trying to get money out of me, and he was very rude and hateful and nasty and hung up on me. My husband called and tried talking to the owner about the issue also and he cussed my husband out in the background while his secretary was speaking to my husband and hung up on him also. We have contacted our home warranty provider and told them they do not want to use this company for their work orders.

reviews.author: Deborah C.
reviews.text: These people are unreal, signed up with a Home Warranty Company, accepted a claim on Monday morning and I finally called them on Wednesday afternoon since there had been no attempt to contact me and the woman who answered tells me oops, we accepted it by mistake, we aren't licensed in Indiana.  Told me she didn't know how to reach them and I should just call them myself.  Clearly no attempt to contact the home warranty company since their number is listed, they answer the phone and she sure as heck figured out how to sign up with them.  Nevermind she easily coud have called me Monday and told me they couldn't come out.  Meanwhile I have a leak in my basement that's gotten worse and I have to leave to town for the weekend in the morning.

reviews.author: Kimberly Hope
reviews.text:
They were professional and kind. Eric and Codie were excellent! They showed up on time, answered any questions and worked hard.  1-19-2026

I needed Backup Plumbing to come back and work on a shower drain pipe. Again, Eric and Codie came to fix it. They did  great work again and very professional. They answer any questions and always keep me well informed. Can't say enough kind words! Thank You Backup Plumbing! 2-2-2026

Once again, Backup Plumbing did a great job setting bath faucets and toilet! and they followed up the next day for a few finishing touches. Thank you Eric and Gage! 2-20-2026

reviews.author: Karen W.
reviews.text:
Doug, Tina, and Josh were awesome to work with.  I needed a new water heater, and they went above and beyond to file on my behalf.  They even saved me money as they knew it was covered under warranty, drove a great distance to pick up and deliver the replacement water heater and ensure that everything was fixed, replaced and cleaned up after! I can't recommend them enough.  And for those asking, I do have a home warranty and they went the extra mile there too to keep me and the home warranty company informed of the water heater's warranty status.

Highly recommend

reviews.author: Pat P.
reviews.text: They are the worst company I have dealt with in over 35 years of home ownership. Doug and his sidekick came to my house to fix a backed up sewage drain. Left after ten minutes to go "investigate" saying it might be a city issue. Guy never came back! Never called! I had to call their office to be told that they couldn't do the job. When I told her that was very unprofessional and that I had been waiting two hours for them she told me it was probably because I was rude and hung up on me. Really! My fault. Be warned,NEVER call Durbin Plumbing. Can't give no stars!

reviews.author: angela woods
reviews.text:
First experience needing a plumbing service and couldn’t have asked for better service! From Laura in the office to Kyle communicating and giving quote to Cameron coming to fix the issue, all were great!
What was thought to be a simple issue turned into a little more and Cameron was determined to not leave until fixed. The icing on the cake, Kyle did not charge anything additional for what took longer. The quote he gave for the work was not changed regardless of what came up. Absolutely incredible customer service and will be my go-to when needed again.

reviews.author: Michael Muller
reviews.text: Dan and his team did a fantastic job helping me with an emergency plumbing repair. They didn't have any openings in the schedule, but they were able to get someone to our house after normal closing hours to fix a major sink clog for me. They did great! Solid work, good cleanup, and reasonably priced. I love these guys!

reviews.author: deborah dennelle
reviews.text: Benjamin Franklin is very professional and top notch with customer service.  We had a wonderful experience with Stella whom is very organized, upbeat and a great communicator.  Anthony and Mark came out and replaced our tankless water heater along with installing a Halo5 conditioning treatment.  Explained everything very thoroughly and were so nice.  We are very pleased with the results and could tell right away the difference in our water quality.  We just moved here and were pretty nervous at first about needing new plumbers.  Benjamin Franklin squashed all our fears and we are so relieved to know that we can trust them for our future services!  Great job guys, thank you so much! 👏

reviews.author: Louie Laubheimer
reviews.text:
Anthony arrived and started on the job at hand. He explained what he was doing and why. He is very polite, helpful about different things I asked him.
This company is very reasonable on their work prices. I sent text to other
companies and they never responded back to me but this company did respond back to me in a timely manner. Other companies quoted me prices like $1,095 -   $625 - $606 . This company I will have back to do my work from now on.
Thanks again for your reasonable quote and workmanship.

Louie

reviews.author: Jonathan Finerfrock
reviews.text: Our experience began with Stella.  she was a delight to work with to get someone out to look at the job.  We wanted a natural gas line tied into our existing service then run outside for a Grill and a Blackstone.  Mark Griffin came out and was more than friendly and reviewed what we needed.  within 30 minutes he shot us an estimate which was about 1/3 what some of the corporate plumbing houses quoted us.  we scheduled and Mark was on time with all the tools supplies he needed.  Mark went right to work and when he was done he walked me through the installation start to finish.  Mark was working next to our water heater and saw that it was > 21 years old and made a heartfelt suggestion that we consider replacing it soon.  he gave us a realistic quote and now we need to decide when to have him back.  I can not express enough the appreciation for the knowledge and professionalism that both Mark and Stella provided!

reviews.author: Ginny Newell
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a plumbing company you can trust, look no further. This is the one you want on your side. The owner is an upstanding businessman who genuinely cares—not just about getting the job done, but about people. He treats both his employees and his customers with respect, honesty, and integrity.

You can tell right away that he’s dedicated to doing things the right way. No shortcuts, no upselling—just honest work done with excellence. He stands behind everything his team does, and it shows in the quality of their work and the satisfaction of their customers.

It’s rare these days to find a company where you feel completely confident from start to finish, but that’s exactly what you get here. If peace of mind, professionalism, and top-notch service matter to you, this plumbing company is the one to call.

reviews.author: tara graves
reviews.text: I have called Benjamin Franklin plumbing now for several jobs and they are now my go to plumbers for all my projects. They are replumbing an entire house for me and also have promptly come for even a small job such as hooking up my gas stove for an investment property and install a water heater for an apartment building that I needed done quick. They had it installed in less than 24 hours so the renter would not be without hot water. Anthony has gone above and beyond with his customer service and explains everything thoroughly.  Its hard to find a company that has fair pricing, reliability and good quality... which are the 3 things im always looking for. Anthony has met all those wishlist items and im extremely pleased to have found them. Thank u guys!!!!!!!! 💓

reviews.author: Theresa Gerstenkorn
reviews.text:
Anthony is hands-down the best plumber I’ve worked with! He’s helped me on several occasions, and every time, the work is done quickly, professionally, and right the first time. At my old home, he replaced the entire sewer line that previously had clay pipes that were root bound. At my new home, he repaired and inspected all the toilets, installed our dishwasher, and later replaced our water heater.

What really stands out is that Anthony explains what he’s doing, gives helpful tips on maintenance, and clearly knows his trade inside and out. He’s reliable, efficient, and takes pride in his work. I wouldn’t call anyone else for plumbing needs—highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brian Stafford
reviews.text: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing exceeded my expectations! From the moment I called, their team was professional, courteous, and quick to respond. The technician arrived right on time, explained everything clearly, and got the job done efficiently. I really appreciated the respect they showed for my home—everything was left spotless when they finished. It’s rare to find a company that delivers both top-quality service and genuine customer care, but Benjamin Franklin Plumbing does just that. I’ll definitely be using them again and highly recommend them to anyone needing reliable plumbing services!

reviews.author: Brittney Turner
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of having Andrew as my technician! Not only was he knowledgeable, he went over and beyond to try and accommodate me when we ran into issues with getting my new toilet installed. The company made my issue a priority and did what they could to get my secondary appointment an urgency . Everyone that I have made contact with in this company has been extremely helpful and friendly, Benjamin Franklins Plumbing will surely be one that I go to for all my plumbing needs thus forward.
Love your experience? Share this

reviews.author: Tiffany Brooks
reviews.text: Dan is the man!!! He treats you as a human first and then handles business after. I called him in distress when I had an unidentified water leak and he helped navigate the rest. Took the weight off me and handled next steps. Not to mention, patient. Had to fight with my insurance company over an invoice, never pressured me to pay and figure it out. Gave me the time I needed to address the situation and correct. Would recommend this place a thousand times over. Thanks Dan and team!!!!

reviews.author: Shawn M.
reviews.text: From the moment I called, Dan was very professional, he got us a quote and was able to get someone out the same day to repair our kitchen facuet. Nolan showed up shortly after my call to Dan. Nolan was very professional and got the work done quickly. Nolan also inspected our hot water heater free of charge and gave us a very reasonable quote for repairs. We will definitely use Benjamin Franklin Plumbing for our future plumbing needs. Thanks again, Dan and Nolan. Great work!

reviews.author: Jackie Williams
reviews.text: Very professional, polite, extremely knowledgeable, and trustworthy. Being a single woman… most repairmen come in with a sales pitch and feel the need to over exaggerate the urgency of anything to make a sale… Not these guys!!! I know it’s hard to believe… this is an honest bunch. They come in…done the job right…cleaned behind themselves. I have recommended them to my daughter….I have put their contact in my phone.

reviews.author: Karen Simon
reviews.text: We had a gas line ran to our fire place.  Andrew and Anthony were awesome!  Both are very knowledgeable and patient with all our questions, they explained all to us and showed us what we needed to do.  I had several estimates.   They had better price that comes with a guarantee.   I would highly recommend them.  Benjamin Franklin plumbing, they are great.  Thank you both!

reviews.author: Ashley Newton
reviews.text: Professional, honest and down to Earth, is the best was to describe Benjamin Franklin Plumbing. Anthony always explains everything, is honest and trustworthy. He has completed several jobs for me and I’ve always been highly satisfied. If you are needing a company that is honest and does incredible work, you can always count on Benjamin Franklin Plumbing!

reviews.author: David Colyer
reviews.text: I was very impressed with Nolan he was experienced, very polite and professional. He not only fixed my broken pipe he also did some extra maintenance in the area without me asking and at no extra charge. I was very pleased with his work so I signed a maintenance agreement for them to become my plumbing company and I will be requesting Nolan.

reviews.author: Tony Tricase
reviews.text: Wonderful service! Great follow up with me and our tenant. They have earned my business in the future because if their honesty and willingness to explain and help fit us in their busy schedule. I’d ad an extra star if I could for Shelly who was ready to answer any questions I had along the way.

reviews.author: ADRIANNE WRIGHT
reviews.text: I had a gas leak with my furnace and was referred to Vessels by a coworker; and I must say, I’m genuinely thankful for that recommendation.  Nick and Jaylen were kind, knowledgeable and informative in letting me know of the process step by step, until their job was done…and that’s important for someone like me.  I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ethel Bragg
reviews.text:
I really appreciate Leaha and Justin for working with me . They are really customer service excellence! They worked with me practically held my hands during this trying time of having my entire plumbing system underneath my home . There no dig process is highly impressive and saved my home from being...basically chopped in half just to replace the old pipes...this digless  process is a true home owners life saver.
Thanks again and GOD BLESS both of you made me feel like a true friend helping me and not some cold sales lead out to get some money...Tom Drexel can take a page from your customer care book!!! 😀 I wish you all at Vessels Plumbing and very merry Christmas and a Happy New Year 😊

reviews.author: Ken M.
reviews.text: I have no fault with the work they performed at  the time - but it's now 6 months later - we have a sewer blockage and find that the clean out has been plugged leaving us no access to cleanout a backup.  And to add insult to injury - it's a Friday night and vessels appears to offer no weekend service - even if it an issue they created.

reviews.author: Durenda D.
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed in the job that was done in my daughter's house.
we did a whole house remodel and changed out the old plumbing.
1st they did not discard the old stuff from the basement
2nd they did not secure  the sink faucet line to the water line.
My daughter got up to a flooded 1st floor . when we call and asked them to come out and repair we were told they had no record of doing the job and charged her for the repair. NOW she is stuck with a 17K floor replacement and a 3k bill from service pro. 
We are still trying to work this out with our contractor.

reviews.author: Mandy G.
reviews.text: Vessels plumbing was sent to our home VIA American Home Shield Warranty company to replace a shower valve. The plumbers replaced the valve did not communicate having ANY issues or problems replacing the valve. A few hours later a crack appeared in the ceiling of the bathroom below and water started leaking from the crack. I called Vessels back. They sent a different plumber over who was able to stop leak, this was almost midnight on a Friday. He assured me that this was 100 percent the plumbers fault that was here previously and that to fix the problem they would have to cut tile, he had made the owner aware and they would make this right the following day. I called back the following day, I was told I must have misunderstood they couldn't fix that on a Saturday and they were slammed and they would work me in to get it fixed. Almost a full week later they came back to fix the pipe. That's when I started getting the run around and Vessel's said they were not responsible for having to cut the tile. I had to call Vessels daily to get any response. This all started on February 18th. It is now March 8th. I still have a hole in my wall and ceiling due to the negligence of Vessel's plumbing and ultimately American Home Shield.  I WOULD NOT hire this plumbing company regardless of this being a job through American Home Shield their plumbers were incompetent and dishonest. They do not stand behind their work. My house is a disaster and I am left trying to put it back together thanks to Vessels Plumbing their lack of communication, professionalism and incompetence.

reviews.author: Chris Wilmes
reviews.text: I work as a general contractor and I have used many plumbers over the years. Vessels is by far the best that I have worked with and they have quickly become my go to plumber. Russ is an excellent communicator and he lets me know exactly how the process will work on every job and he takes the time to explain the things that I do not understand in a way that makes me feel confident that the work being preformed is going to be the right fit for my needs. On a recent Job I met Dave. He came out and installed new plumbing for me and his work was efficient and done with great skill. I could tell that he takes great pride in his professionalism. I know that from start to finish that the team at Vessels is going to do excellent work and I will defiantly continue to use them for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Leo F.
reviews.text:
We Contacted Vessels Plumbing for their cured-in-place pipe services.  Their lining process was the perfect solution for our sewer line issue.  Our yard has extensive landscaping, fencing and hard surface installations.  Even other plumbing professionals who had come on site to bid suggested that we consider the procedure that Vessels offers. 

The complete lining process from excavation to final inspection took less than 24 hours.  Vessels gave sound advice, the staff was professional, knowledgable and completely engaged in their service and the repair of our sewer.

In the end we had only to reconstruct an eight by three foot area of our garden path and were able to save the sixty year old red maple that was at the 'root' of the problem.

Thank You Vessels Plumbing

reviews.author: Ron C.
reviews.text: Was fairly impressed with this company! They were VERY good as to what my cost were going to be as the project evolved. The situation turned out to be much simpler and less expensive than first though and I was given several options as to how it could be fixed. The crew (sorry guys I'm awful with names) was very professional and right on it. Had me back up in one day. Tanya at the office was invaluable at keeping me informed and even bumping me up on the schedule because I was completely with out service which was MUCH appreciated.  The only negative was the mess that was left behind (busted concrete and some dirt) that they OBVIOUSLY did not want to mess with. Other than that, great work and would recommend!

reviews.author: Katie Burkholder
reviews.text:
Justin thoroughly explained the problem as well as the solution and could not have been more professional.

Once the work began, Justin, along with Les and Chris, were prompt each day, kept me updated through the entire process and displayed the utmost knowledge and problem solving methods during what could have been an very ugly repair situation, and gave me the confidence that I was in the best hands.

Nick and Jaylen also did an incredible job when they had to dig up the clean out.  When they were finished, you hardly knew they had been there.

I cannot recommend these young men enough.  They all did an outstanding job.

reviews.author: Bob R.
reviews.text: DO NOT USE VESSELS PLUMBING! Vessels Plumbing misdiagnosed a water leak and caused around 80% of our front landscaping to be removed because they replaced the WRONG pipe at a cost of almost $3,000! We had to call a separate plumbing company to come out and find the actual problem and fix it properly (United Plumbing) when Vessels refused accountability for their mistake. According to United Plumbing, everything Vessels did was absolutely unnecessary. When we contacted Vessels they said too bad and are refusing to refund us any portion of their mistake. THESE GUYS ARE THIEVES!!!!

reviews.author: Marilyn R.
reviews.text: I am grateful for Vessels Plumbing. While not urgent, the work was scheduled one day after I called.  Jesse demonstrated how the parts were not working and gave a ball park estimate on cost, which was reasonable and installed a fan motor.  The next day Jesse and Chris installed the furnace inducer motor, water filter for humidifier, and correctly installed a flue liner that had been previously improperly installed. My furnace has never been so quiet! Quality work done by professionals!!!  I will call Vessels Plumbing for every plumbing and HVAC need!!

reviews.author: Connie Druien
reviews.text: I highly recommend Vessels plumbing for your home plumbing needs. They installed a new liner system into the main sewer pipe in my basement without tearing up my yard. Chris S, Justin, Brit, Chris and Josh were efficient, polite, knowledgeable and took the time to explain each step of the process to me. Each one of them treated my home as if it was their home.  They cleaned up at the end of each day and kept communication open with me. I am satisfied 100% with their work and recommend Vesells plumbing without any reservations. Connie

reviews.author: Paul T. Eitel III
reviews.text: We had a main drain clog that another company did not clear after repeated attempts and wanted to charge a lot of money to dig it up. Vessels came out on time; the crew was professional & knowledgeable. We had them video scope the 4" line to verify what was a stake. Found it was only clogged for 15' and not what the other company indicated and wanted to dig the line up for a lot of money. Now we will have Vessels clean out the line for us as it should have happened. I should have called Vessels first.

reviews.author: Dave Crider
reviews.text:
Just found out about vessels from a recommendation had a back up in the basement. called them and it was nothing but top notch service. all the way from the receptionist getting on top of things to Leaha helping me out with many different solutions, to Justin coming to the house explaining everything in detail and get it all assessed to help my 85-year-old mom. A fantastic company, great people
Getting on their program to stay clean. They will be my go to compay for sure. Highly recommend
Dave Crider

strengths: Trenchless 'no-dig' pipe relining is a repeat-praised specialty — saved a 60-year-old maple tree, completed in under 24 hours

weaknesses: Multiple reviewers describe misdiagnoses on big-ticket repairs that required hiring another plumber — one paid $3K for the wrong pipe

reviews.author: Meg Dietzel
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Ask for Rick, he’s the best! I had a leak coming through my ceiling and he quickly figured out the issue and repaired it. He even helped me solution an issue I’ve had with my pipes freezing for 4 years!

reviews.author: Stacee Spurling
reviews.text:
Great customer service and very friendly and  know what they’re doing when it comes to satisfaction of service for customers!
Team they worked great together and explained everything to the point and truly didn’t mind me asking questions! I love those type of worker because inspite of they’re busy schedule and on top of staying focus on the job they took time out to explain to me why heating element wasn’t working properly!
I truly appreciate ! You all have a great team doing an Awesome job by giving me my hot water back  in and out in no time
woohoo!
Thanks Guys
William and Rickie

Truly,
STACEE SPURLING

reviews.author: Ms. Ti
reviews.text: Anna and Matt Biggs are the best. I would entrust a major plumbing deal with this company. Anna and Matt are very knowledgeable. The two have empathy for the situation one may encounter. The two most certainly place my mind at ease. I would most certainly recommend this company. High Quality service.

reviews.author: Danielle J.
reviews.text: They advertise emergency services, however, I called on a Sunday afternoon and was told they do no such thing. They wouldn't be able to assess the issue until Tuesday. If I could wait until Tuesday I wouldn't be calling for emergency services. Disappointing and frustrating!

reviews.author: Carmen Renfro
reviews.text: We used this company once and LOVED Jared and all his hard work, I told everyone about them! So naturally we called them a second time when we had a clog and they came back to help us. They couldn’t find the problem and went from “it’s something but we don’t know” to $10,000 and busting up my garage floor way too fast for my liking! We got a second opinion and the new company was here worked super hard, tried all the things, and found and fixed the clog in the FRONT YARD, not under the garage floor. When I called the office to chat about it all the office person was so rude and told me the only thing she could do was to have the tech call me and apologize….which would be the most uncomfortable thing ever!! Will never use or recommend this company again. Highly disappointed!

reviews.author: Patrick Evans
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Overflow Service, LLC highly enough! From start to finish, they provided an absolutely outstanding experience. When we discovered a plumbing issue in our home, we were worried about the cost and disruption it might cause. Overflow Service completely eased our minds.

First off, their pricing was incredibly reasonable. We received quotes from several companies, and Overflow Service offered the best value by far.  But the great price didn't mean any sacrifice in quality. Jared and Darian, the technicians who came to our home, were absolutely fantastic! They were friendly, respectful, and incredibly knowledgeable. They clearly explained the problem, walked us through the solution, and kept us informed every step of the way.

What truly impressed us was their honesty and efficiency. They fixed the issue within a single day!  No drawn-out process, no hidden surprises, just honest, efficient service.

If you're looking for a reliable, honest, and affordable plumbing company in Louisville, look no further than Overflow Service, LLC. Ask for Jared and Darian – you won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Sharayah Scott
reviews.text:
The work was good and everyone’s been super friendly, but when they did my sewer line replacement, they ran out of light and said they would be coming back the next week to finish the rough grade once the dirt dries out some (then again in 3 months once it settles). This was done in February - it’s almost April and I still can’t get anyone out to finish the rough grade. I have made several phone calls, had to remind them of the incomplete work, and even had an appointment scheduled for today…but they still haven’t come back. My yard is an unusable, ugly mess of a dirt heap - I can’t seed anything for the spring, dirt and dust flies around everywhere on the dry days, and it’s a horrible muddy mess if it’s raining.

EDIT 3/27: Updating to clarify that they did finally come back out today to complete the grading and it looks worlds better. I’m frustrated that it took over a month of back-and-forth to get it sorted, but the job finally was done and I would likely use Overflow again for plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.text:
5 Stars – Great Customer Service and Follow-Up

I recently had Overflow Services replace a leaky garden bib at the back of my house. The work itself appeared to be done well, but I had some concerns about the number of coupling transitions used—copper to PEX to 90 degree bronze fitting, then back to PEX and copper again.

I called the company the next day and spoke with Katye, who was very responsive and immediately scheduled a visit from their supervisor, Matt, that same evening.

Matt was a pleasure to deal with. He took the time to thoroughly inspect the work, listened carefully to my concerns, and provided a clear, detailed explanation that completely put me at ease.

It’s refreshing to see a company that stands behind their work and takes customer concerns seriously. I really appreciated the professional and respectful approach from both Katye and Matt.

Would definitely recommend Overflow Services based on this experience.

reviews.author: Ann Kresen
reviews.text:
Matt, with Overflow, helped identify a very hard to pinpoint problem with a sewer smell in my house. He listened to me, came up with a plan and a price for Plan A and Plan B. Then, they came and did the work and came in under the price that he was thinking it might be! How often does that happen?

The only thing I can say that wasn’t perfect is how when the job was finished the baseboards weren’t put back where they had been taken off. In Matt’s defense, he did say that he would come back over, with his nail gun, and install them properly. I told him he didn’t have to do that because we could do that ourselves…except we haven’t yet and they are still laying there. Looks like I should have taken him up on that offer after all!!!

All in all, they were great to work with, easy to contact and the best part of all is my house doesn’t stink at all anymore! I love it!

reviews.author: Rachel Hanna
reviews.text: Another plumbing problem, a badly clogged kitchen sink drain line, solved by Overflow Plumbing. William and Eric quickly arrived at a solution and the clog was removed. Additionally they corrected the design of our under sink pipe configuration and also installed a "T" Fitting with Clean Out Plug for future access. All the work was done in less time than we expected. Overflow Plumbing installed our new gas hot water heater last month so they were at the top of our trusted call list when this new issue arose unexpectedly.Reasonably priced, experienced, and quickly remedied!

reviews.author: Joshua
reviews.text: Can't say enough about Overflow Plumbing. Had a back up issue that resulted in us not being able to use any drains in the home. They sent out Will Casto who was extremely polite, took the time to thoroughly go through it all to find the issue and immediately got to work. They were upfront about everything and very reasonable on pricing considering the time and effort it took to resolve our issue. So thank you to everyone at overflow from Will to the office people who made sure we were a priority! Definitely will use again in the future.

reviews.author: Norman Zanger
reviews.text: Cody and Darian worked very hard to plumb a new bathroom in the basement as well as correct the leaky water lines going to the 1st floor Master bathroom. They set up an innovative and accessible manifold system to give me more control over the bathroom plumbing fixtures. They went above and beyond to make sure everything was to code and worked properly. During this multi day project their communication was excellent. I also feel that the fees charged were very fair. I will definitely call them again if l have a plumbing problem.

reviews.author: Steve N
reviews.text: Nasty clog in a line that was causing us issues for several months. We'd had a plumber out previously who snaked the line and replaced a toilet. Problem remained. Previous plumber recommended Overflow. They came when promised and worked most of the day first identifying exactly where the clog was (using a camera in the line) the clearing the clog, then confirming that the line was clear (with the camera). Very knowledgeable, clean, professional, and explained what they were doing all along the way. Highly recommend them

reviews.author: Harendra Kumar
reviews.text: I recently had a major water leak in my front yard, and I’m extremely impressed with the work done by William and Joe from Overflow Service. Their diagnostic skills were top-notch—they quickly identified the root cause of the issue and presented me with a clear plan of action. Their estimations were spot on, and the quality of their work was outstanding. They dug and fixed the leak at the exact right spot, and everything was done professionally and efficiently. I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Gina Kingsbury
reviews.text: William, Mike, and Eric were excellent. They gave me plenty of a heads up before my appointment. They arrived on time and were flexible when I asked them to move where they parked. They were receptive of all of my one-off questions and concerns. I really appreciated their attention to detail and how they went above and beyond to provide me as much information about our plumbing to make sure we could make informed decisions. We’ve used their services twice now and will definitely use them again. Thanks guys!

synthesis.summary: Overflow has 10-year repeat customers, came-in-under-budget stories, and named techs (William, Matt, Jared, Cody) who get praised for thorough diagnostics on hard-to-find leaks. But two recent and credible complaints stand out: a missed call for a clog that turned into a $10,000 garage-floor recommendation (another company found and fixed the issue in the front yard), and an emergency call on a Sunday where the dispatcher said they don't actually do emergencies despite advertising it.

reviews.text: Nick came in to service a gas leak. He was very thorough and talked my tenant and I through all the steps and what he was doing. He was very professional with his services and explained in details wha was needed. Highly recommend him.

reviews.author: liz charney
reviews.text: Shout out to Ronnie Levandowski  who has guided us through several initial assessments in order to address plumbing repairs and improvements. He is friendly, polite, attentive and thorough. He shares his decision making about next steps which  allows him to offers honest and appropriate options. Highly recommend Ronnie for your plumbing needs

reviews.author: Jonathan Buchholz
reviews.text:
Edgar showed up on time and ready to work... Great, personal guy who knew his stuff. Estimated I had approx. 30' clog from my sink, had it rooted out and done within 20 min. Excellent work.
-Jon

reviews.text: I needed someone to come and fix a toilet in an old building and J Blanton plumbing was the first to reply back to my inquiry from Angi’s list. reviews.author: Brent Hill - Realtor
reviews.text:
Horrible service, you can tell they're trying to rip you off!!!

I asked for general price and described the issue of a drain clog where the floor drain is accessible, where the water isn't draining, and the clean out that's roughly 5' away is clear and dry (so the clog is in the middle somewhere). He gave me the price of $75 to look at it and then will quote full price but roughly $300-400 to snake if no toilets need to be removed in order to snake it. I said that no toilets need to be removed, once again it's accessible, and I agreed to the $75. Thinking maybe he didn't hear my first explanation of the issue, I went to explain that I'm hoping and thinking it should be relatively easy and thus on the lower end of his quote, maybe even less, since it's a small run and no toilets or fixtures need to be removed but also that is a new building and barely used, but also, I understand that what is found will ultimately control the final price.

Apparently just saying that offended him!! I guess they want to get in and then make up reasons to jack up the price because this guy then went on to say that customers don't get to have any say in what their prices are. Then said based off how I described the job, it'll cost me $700! But of course, could be more. I was shocked and said what happened to the $300-400 and he said it sounds like a $700 job. I'm like what's happening right now, who talks like this. He then goes on to insult me saying that I don't have any money, I'm broke, I need to go and figure out how to make money to afford him before I call, and so on. Well, I guess not everyone can screw people over to make money like he does but clearly he makes too much.

No one should work with people like this, they clearly have the intention of pushing the price up and overcharging. They want stupid people that don't know anything about their problem so they can screw you over!!

reviews.author: Michael Nation
reviews.text: Tried to charge me $800 for the exact same work, or very similar, they did for me for $450. When I challenged, the tech (exact same tech!) came down to $600 and then to $550. I pulled up his prior invoice to prove to him he was incorrect in his bizarre justifications. This was NOT a matter of not all jobs are the same. I clearly understand that. This was an attempt to gouge. Hate to leave this review because they’ve done stellar work for me in the past, but don’t try to cheat your repeat customers. reviews.author: Spice N WerkoutGloves
reviews.text: Contacted Roto Rooter when I lost the contact info from another company, who had given me an estimate for some cast-iron pipe sewer work on my home. To begin,  Mike & Jonathan showed up on time,  were very courteous, answered all my questions, & addressed my concerns without taking offense. When they actually looked at the issue, they found a completely different situation than what the previous company said. They took their time and spend several hours diagnosing & finding the right repair option. I have no doubt that the previous company did not know where they were talking about. I am happy I was not able to locate their information. Mike & Jonathan were transparent & openly discussed several repair options in an attempt to save me money. We decided on one that worked best, considering my split level home and the way that my waterlines are set up. They struck me as having a lot of pride in their work, being quite honest,  and very professional. So in the end, I will be going with them over anyone else because of this fact and that their work is also guaranteed. Not everything that is cheaper is bette…I highly recommend 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.author: David Loftus
reviews.text: We have had problems with clogs and slow drains in our basement bathroom for the past few years but other plumbing fixtures in our house were perfectly fine.  Other plumbers have repeatedly plunged and snaked, but our problems have always returned within a few weeks.  Enter Vince from Roto Rooter.  He asked very intelligent diagnostic questions about exactly what we were experiencing, and immediately pinpointed a sewage backup valve sunk in our basement slab.  He explained how a normally protective flapper in the valve can break down and collect debris.  Sure enough, when he disassembled the valve, all manner of debris and backed up sewage came spewing out.  Turns out the other plumbers probably even damaged the valve further as they crudely snaked the lines.  He gave us a less expensive option to try to rebuild the 34 year old valve, or a reasonable price to replace it.  With the repeated problems we've had, we opted to fix it right and replace it. Vince was very polite and conscientious about keeping his work area clean, especially challenging given the nature of the work.  With a new valve installed and our lines verified clear with his sophisticated camera, we are now finally confident that we have the problem solved.  We will be calling for Vince for any future plumbing problems we have!

reviews.author: Jason Murphy
reviews.text: The Roto Rooter team was excellent! Mike (technician) was incredible with communicating the plumbing issues and how to best resolve them. He was prompt, thorough, respectful of my home, and worked intently until the issues were resolved. Nice guy as well! I am pleased with the high quality work Mike and Roto Rooter provided and the price was very fair for such a great service. I will use Roto Rooter again if ever necessary, and would certainly recommend their service to anyone else. Definitely a 10/10.

reviews.author: TaKnesha Hubbard
reviews.text: As you can imagine, having a major plumbing issue first thing in the morning is NOT an ideal start to the day. I called Roto-Rooter and they sent a plumber within an hour. The plumber, AL, was the absolute best that they could’ve sent. He explained what was happening and made the complicated easily understood. He fully replaced my water heater and thoroughly went over the details & warranties of the new equipment. In my time of crisis, AL made me feel at ease. I am grateful for the attentiveness, knowledge and professionalism of the Roto-Rooter staff. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Miguel Sanchez
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Jamaal and could not recommend him enough! From start to finish, he showed great professionalism and was extremely respectful. He took the time to explain what the issue at hand was and how he could fix it. We are beyond grateful for his hard work, especially for going above and beyond to make sure the job was done right!

If you are looking for a plumber who is honest and hardworking, Jamaal is who you are looking for.

plumbers.name: American Vintage Home Heating, Cooling & Plumbing

reviews.author: Tahiri Gutierrez
reviews.text: I had a consultation with Alejandro from American Vintage Home, and it was a great experience. He was very informative and took the time to thoroughly diagnose the heating issues in our condo with steam radiators. I really appreciated the care and attention he put into explaining what was going on and helping us understand our options. Thank you, Alejandro, very pleased with the service!

reviews.author: Reto
reviews.text: We engaged American Vintage Home to replace the sump pump / backup-pump, battery plus control-unit. It wasn't cheap, but it is an insurance, we live in a flat area and the water has to go somewhere. Tony did a great job, explained what he intends to do, gave us an estimate and days later he had all the parts and installed the new setup to our satisfaction. We picked the wifi-enable version to keep us updated on what the sump-pump does, or not. I feel better now with this old house we recently bought, great structure, but our previous owners did less than nothing and unfortunately the sump pump fell victim to their previous negligance. Glad we replaced it with the help of Tony, now we can afford not to think about it (kind of).

reviews.author: Jenna Casselman
reviews.text: Had our regular HVAC maintenance and Bautista did a fantastic job! Was very thorough, answered all my questions, and provided helpful information about keeping our furnace in good shape for the future. Leo also did a great job inspecting our plumbing system. Highly recommend AVH!

reviews.author: Matt Fenwick
reviews.text: Finding a technician who is both skilled and willing to explain the "how and why" of a complex system like a steam boiler is rare. I cannot recommend Alex highly enough for service. We recently had them out for a repair, and the experience was top-notch from start to finish. Our technician was incredibly patient and informative he didn't just fix the issue; he took the time to walk me through the system, explaining exactly what went wrong and how to maintain it properly moving forward. He brought along a trainee.The trainee was also very polite, professional, and hardworking. It says a lot about a company’s culture when they prioritize thorough training and maintain such high standards of courtesy.

reviews.author: Alejandro Salgado
reviews.text: Gabriel was very courteous and professional. He did a fantastic job on the installation of the boiler 5 out of 5. Would recommend American Vintage Home and Heating to anyone needing a new boiler, furnace, and any HVAC maintenance.

reviews.author: Harrison Steinbuch
reviews.text: I’ve had J Sewer and Drain out to my house twice now for two different toilet related issues - the original contractor must have done some shotty plumbing work. The leaky toilet on the second floor required some sub-floor to be replaced; the issue was resolved at a reasonable rate for the amount of work required. I appreciated the professionalism and attention to detail I saw with both teams.

reviews.author: Joey Samuels
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Milton from J Sewer & Drain Plumbing. He was thorough and efficient, and did not try any upsells when there was likely a potential for one. I always appreciate honest and kind workers and will continue to use J Sewer & Drain for my future plumbing needs. Would highly recommend this team!

reviews.author: Ann Doan
reviews.text: I was able to get an appointment same day for my toilet clogged. Marcelo was very professional and punctual, he came within the time that was confirmed, wore booties in my home, and fixed my clog within 15 minutes. I would highly recommend! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Bibi Andrade
reviews.text: Efficient, professional and reasonable. I needed 2 water tanks replaced and JSewer and Plumbing were able to complete the job within 24 hours. Great service from Jonathan and all the way to Jesus the main plumber on this job. They are my go to plumbers! I call them for all my plumbing needs. On another building I needed a water tank replaced. Very professional and efficient again. The tank was replaced and the tenant was very pleased. Great plumbers. Diego and Luis. Great plumbing company. Reasonable prices in a super competitive business.

reviews.author: Ken P
reviews.text: J Plumbing did an excellent job. I wanted a Rheem Power Vent hot water heater installed that I had selected at Home Depot. Everything is working fine now. It was all done in a prompt and timely manner because my 20 year old water heater had been leaking and I needed this replacement. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Armando Roman
reviews.text: Reached out to Flint Plumbing, the day I found out my water heater was bad and they were able to accommodate and change it the next day. Quick work, fair price, and overall really good quality of customer service and installation. Thank you so much, would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Curtis Lee
reviews.text: Flint Plumbing came out today to conduct a Hydrostatic Leak test on my sewer system.  Chad was very nice and professional and conducted the test within 1 hour.  I appreciate his services.

reviews.author: Alexis Ruch
reviews.text: We had Flint Plumbing replace the sink hardware in our en-suite bathroom and couldn’t be happier! From start to finish, they were professional, cost-effective, and right on time.
