It’s rare to find a company that’s both reliable and reasonably priced, but Flint Plumbing nailed it. Highly recommend for anyone looking for great plumbing work done right the first time!

reviews.author: Debra Perez
reviews.text: I am very pleased with Flint Plumbing! I received next day service and Jordan was very informative when explaining the issue to me. I recommend this company with enthusiasm. Oh, and very affordable! I am so glad that I always find great companies in my town, Buda.

reviews.author: Christina Spanos
reviews.text: The two technicians that came to my home today, Hernan and Ruben, were not only fast, efficient and friendly, but they were also extremely polite and respectful.  They explained everything to us so we could understand what they were doing and what was going on and answered all of our questions. There is more plumbing work that needs to be done at our home and I will definitely  have Capps do the work for us. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Robert Gemkow
reviews.text: Capps did an outstanding job. Jose and Eddie cleared a heavily clogged 2” kitchen line and took the time to ensure it was completely clean before they wrapped up. The camera inspection confirmed the quality of their work. I plan to use Capps for future plumbing needs, including a preventative main sewer line cleaning. Their pricing is competitive, they’re honest, and the workmanship is excellent.

reviews.author: Mike Bilton
reviews.text: Danny and Jose did an amazing job working on my main sewer line. A previous company was unable to get it cleared and they put in the time and effort to get it done. Very straightforward without any unnecessary services. I will definitely be using them again for future needs.

reviews.author: Peggy Schwebke
reviews.text:
My shower has been making some weird noises recently and, with the cold weather, I was concerned that my pipe might be freezing.  I called Capps yesterday afternoon and was able to get someone out this morning, including them accommodating my request that my time slot not be too early.  I received a call from the office, notifying me when Tim was on his way.  Tim was very polite and put covers over his boots as soon as he walked in the door.  I described the issue and he checked a couple things.  He explained that my pipes weren't freezing and how to know if they were.  He then explained a couple things that could be causing the noise, checked those, and did some work to correct that.  He was very patient, explained everything well, and asked if I had any questions.  He asked at every step if it was okay to proceed and explained what the options and cost would be.  He left the area clean and I received my receipt immediately via email.

I have had Capps do all but one of the plumbing and sewer jobs in the over 20 years I've owned my house, have been very pleased with their work, and truly regret the one time I tried a different company.  Capps is very customer-service oriented.  Gianna in the office helped me with a few different things this week and has been very nice and addressed everything quickly.  I highly recommend Capps for quality work.  (Note:  My bill was lower because I have a service agreement with Capps.)

reviews.author: Sue Plath
reviews.text: Very good experience getting quote and scheduling purchase and installation of a new toilet. Responsiveness and professionalism of Capp’s staff are just two reasons we only use them for all of our plumbing needs. Never have any issues with the work done by their technicians. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Rocket Plumbing
plumbers.address: 417 S Arlington Heights Rd Suite 100, Arlington Heights, IL 60005, USA

reviews.author: Kevin McGurn
reviews.text: From booking through Vicky, to service by Trevor, Jo-el and Hugo, everyone was great on my line jetting and basin drain. Hard working, good communication no BS or upselling. Line trouble identified and will work with them and the city to rectify it. A pleasant surprise to find Rocket Plumbing.

reviews.author: Stephanie D
reviews.text:
I noticed some water damage on the ceiling below my upstairs bathroom.. I started my search online for a new plumber and chose rocket plumbing because of all the positive reviews I was seeing- the reviews aren’t wrong.

I called in the late afternoon, the receptionist was very kind, helpful, and she was able to send a plumber out the next morning. The plumber, Geoffrey was professional, knowledgeable and patient (I had probably a million questions throughout the whole process since I was communicating the situation with my husband over text, he is the one who typically takes care of these things).

He very quickly identified the leak and to my surprise when i asked if it was a possibility to fix the issue the same day he said yes, and only left to go get the new toilet/replacement parts that we ended up having replaced- he did offer us multiple options to fix the issue at very different price points which was fantastic. And has extremely clear communication with every decision that needed to be made.

Unfortunately after he removed the old toilet he found how badly damaged some of the old plumbing in the floor was, and it became a much larger job than originally anticipated (due to a very poorly done repair in the past by a different plumber/company)Geoffrey still made the commitment to have the work finished the same day and spent most the day seeing this through while still keeping the cost very reasonable.

he even vacuumed, swept, and removed any trash/debris from the job when he was finished. And left contact information for a carpenter (to repair the damaged ceiling) and a restoration company to come look at any potential mold issues from the leak.

My husband and I are very pleased with the work that was done, and will definitely be using Rocket plumbing in the future.

reviews.author: L Y
reviews.text: This is my third time working w/ Luis. I really love that Rocket has the same person come out to you. It's like building a relationship with your barber. They get to know you, they know your house, they  know what your preferences are and what questions you may have--or maybe it's just Luis and he's a very thorough guy. I don't know. I hope I never have to find out. Before he goes Luis tells me exactly what I should to do upkeep the system to prevent future problems. I've never had a problem or had to call him back after he's finished with the work. Never have had to redeem a warranty on anything he's installed. It's the way our nation was built: by vocational programs and blue collared hands. Solid. Predictable.

reviews.author: Osmalyn Walton
reviews.text: Jose Guerra was back in our home installing a water heater, and refitting new pipes in order to bring up to code. Once again truly satisfied customers we are. Jose is a true professional. He made sure to answer all our questions. Took his time to explain product, and made sure we were truly satisfied customers. Should we have any additional concerns he made sure to let us Know Rocket, and the company will be there to answer them and put our minds at ease. He’s the best of the best.

reviews.author: Jane Hamidi
reviews.text:
Geoff is the best plumbing technician out there. Great communicator and very knowledgeable about all aspects of plumbing. He was able to turn the water back on using the 1.5 water key. Previously the Chicago department of water refused to come out to turn the water back on.
I highly recommend Geoff to anyone who needs professional and reliable plumbing technician.

reviews.author: Danielle Merida Gillis
reviews.text:
AMAZING JOB and HONEST!
I had another plumber come out that tried to really scam me. Advised a much larger job with huge price. I decided to get a second opinion. Skylar came out. He was honest giving me options and explaining everything along the way. He was quick and fair priced very polite very professional definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Darrel Branhagen
reviews.text: Water heater died and 1st company said they could come in 4 days and a new heater may cost $3000.  Called Dear Plummer and he came same day and had to evaluate and do one physical repair.  Had to dry everything out and following Skyler’s instructions the heater worked by next morning.  One hour and $100 so how happy do you think I am?  Oh, and Skyler and his assistant were very pleasant to work with, and they will be the first I’ll call in the future.

reviews.author: Kathy Pann
reviews.text: Today, I had the pleasure of getting a brand new sink and faucet installed in my kitchen by Skylar from Dear Plumber.  He arrived on time, was extremely pleasant and very professional, with great attention to detail.  My old sink was extremely heavy and quite difficult to get out, but he did a fantastic job of doing so, making sure that everything was handled with care.  It was a lot of work, but he gotc my beautiful new faucet and sink installed in no time.  In fact, there was a very small piece missing from the sink hardware box and he left and drove to Home Depot and bought one for me so my sink would be complete.  I can’t say enough about what a great job he did.  I highly recommend this company for any of your plumbing needs.  I added before and after pictures so you can see the big difference.

reviews.author: Denise Hebson
reviews.text:
Skylar has been nothing but professional and prompt seeing to our needs. A home built in th 20's and needed a water heater.  He had to make things work in the small area it was installed in. Above and beyond and fair price.

Our primary home, our tankless water heater went out during covid. Skylar searched abd searched for a heater for us. Within less that a week,  one was installed.  Once again a very fair price.

We were selling our primary home, and after inspection,  the now owners wanted sone plumbing done. Skylar to the rescue.  We recommend  Dear Plumber.  I say 5 plus star's. 🌟

reviews.author: Pete Wassdorf
reviews.text: Skylar is a really nice guy and did a good job; but he prices by the job rather than hourly. He gave me a fixed price beforehand of $511 and I agreed with it. But it only took a hour and five minutes. That’s more than my lawyer or accountant charge by the hour and three times what car dealers charge for mechanics. I just didn’t feel good about it in the end. It made me feel like I made a bad decision.

reviews.author: Ana Carolina Rodriguez
reviews.text: Had a new AC unit installed recently, and Gerald handled everything perfectly. He made sure the system was running efficiently and explained how to maintain it. If you're looking for HVAC services like AC installation or maintenance, they’re definitely worth considering.

reviews.author: Sophie

reviews.author: Mitzi Griffiths
reviews.text: Storytime!!...recently my wedding ring accidentally fell down the drain in my bathroom sink, I know!!, instant panic attack!!...I didn't know what to do and started searching on-line for plumbing companies open on the holiday Monday!!...low and behold Right Away Plumbing came up and showed it was open, Yaaaay!!...thankful to Wendy who was very empathetic to the sensitive situation and dispatched someone right away, I appreciate her calm demeanor during my not so calm time, lol!!...grateful the plumber text me to let me know he was on his way and sent me his ETA, very helpful!!..upon arrival,  Kallem was very professional, also quite calm and felt confident he would find my ring, this definitely provided me with some peace of mind!...he unscrewed the pipes, there was a delay at first, but then it happened, I heard the ring clink as it dropped into the bowl, Yaaaay!!!...big shout-out to Kallem who saved the day, found my ring and also made sure our pipes were secured before leaving!!..thank you for all your help...5 stars to the entire team at Right Away Plumbing!! *****

reviews.author: alyssa perry
reviews.text: Wow!! So professional and knowledgeable! He helped repair our toilets and reviewed all our plumbing needs thoughtfully! Will definitely ask for him again!

reviews.author: Paul Boulus
reviews.text: Tony was prompt, polite, and very communicative. He clearly articulated the issues and showed before and after photos which gave me a lot of confidence that we were all set. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Carlos Daniel Gonzalez Álvarez
reviews.text: Last night, I contacted the company for assistance with my malfunctioning furnace. They arrived promptly and provided a comprehensive explanation of their intended approach before commencing the pricing process. Their demeanor was professional, accommodating, and reasonable. I highly recommend this company to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Danelle Torres
reviews.text: Tony was hired for a plumbing inspection at one of my listings. He communicated for the appointment time, was prompt and professional. We were able to get the report emailed immediately. I’ve added him to my list of recommended vendors for plumbing and HVAC. Thanks Tony!

reviews.author: C P
reviews.text: Zach and Sean came out to install our Grohe water filter/ carbonator and a special drain for our master bathroom sink. I truly appreciate their skill and professionalism in handling our home. They wore shoe covers which is such a rare but greatly appreciated courtesy! I felt very reassured by their responses to my Many questions. Lol. We have used a few local plumbers but I really was left with a positive impression of Beyond Wow Plumbing and their work thanks to Zach and Sean. They had me thinking “Wow could all of our plumbing work had been this easy if we called them sooner?”. I hope to have them back out to install something else for us when it arrives.

reviews.author: Mandi Ruffin
reviews.text: I was able to get an appt within a week and the technicians that came out were very helpful in explaining what I needed, walking me through the parts and prices. They had the parts with them and got everything completed same day. They were careful to wear booties inside since it was muddy outside, and my dogs loved them. Highly recommend Weston and Carson!

reviews.author: Kristi Blansitt
reviews.text:
So, I initially gave a 5-star review because our service tech, Andrew immediately came into our home (before beginning any work) and stated that he and his colleagues were in competition to get the most “5-star” reviews. However, this was my grandmas house where he replaced the 30 year old faucet and this archaic faucet was better than what they installed! I had requested a service call because this thing has been leaking like  crazy since “Beyond Wow” installed the replacement faucet and mind you, we had a handheld shower head prior and apparently, they don’t also critically think about if it was a handheld shower before, maybe we want the same thing installed. I came back to my grandmas, to find a fixed shower head installed. Nevertheless, digressing back to my initial complaint (one of many with them and I’m not one to complain), we have never had a faucet leak and when Andrew came back to inspect the leak, he so condescending and curt and said that it’s an old faucet and he didn’t see anything leaking. Funny thing is, I put my sons bucket of toys under the faucet to show proof and furthermore, I conveyed to Andrew that my cats have never been so active in the bathtub since he installed the faucet. He fired back by saying that it is part of the territory on the age of the home and if we wanted to, they could start gutting into the walls, if that would make me happy!

At this point, what made me happy was him leaving our home, because this is another person that clearly doesn’t take pride in their work; nor do they care that he actually made matters worse with our faucet! It was just a ball-bearing that caused the faucet to need to be replaced and now, we can’t even regulate hot and cold water, because the whole faucet is “out of whack”! THIS COMPANY IS NOT WHAT THEIR NAME TRIES TO SUBSTANTIATE”!!!!!

reviews.author: Mazyar Amin
reviews.text: They repaired my front yard water main pipe leak back in Sep 2022, and now about 3 years later, the a leak reemerges from the same place. I called them and they said their warranty is only for 1 year. To me, a pipe which is flexible and is buried in 1 ft of dirt should not fail just in 3 years. Poor workmanship or planning by them. The manager did not even want to acknowledge that there could be any poor work by them and she said we are 100% sure we did the work excellent!!!! How can you be sure, and even she was not willing to give some discount to a returning customer who has had the same issue. I will not work with them anymore, and the first time I worked with them I believe they were very pricy. The 2-star that I give is only for for their nice greeting and conversation, although that is important, more important is quality of work and acknowledging possible poor work.

reviews.author: Andrew Collins
reviews.text:
Had two leaks, asked them to come fix the leaks. The toilet gasket seal had rotted enough to form a small leak. This is a $5 fix for parts, and a 5 minute fix, was willing to pay for the convenience since my other problem existed as well. The only quote offered was to replace the entire toilet with a several hundred dollar replacement "rebuild". This is despite them correctly identifying the leaking gasket. Simply replacing the gasket was never offered.

The kitchen faucet was also leaking at its base, slightly more complex issue that was going to require replacing the faucet. Similarly, the only quote offered was for a "full faucet rebuild", and specifically pushed a "nice delta faucet" for $350.

Between parts and labor, the quote for these fixes was over $1800, probably about $1600 too high. I asked for a customer-supplied parts quote (just paying for labor), and not too surprisingly this quote never came.

Additionally, my partner at home was asked alot of unnecessary questions about her and my occupation, and it seems quite clear based on the conversation that we were being evaluated as to whether we were someone who would just pay for higher prices than just the simple fix being requested. Pretty bad taste left here overall.

So we went on to replace the boiler and the hot water heater hot water heater heater was replaced that day which was perfect. It took about an hour and a half.  He then said someone from Intelligent would call me to set up the install of the new boiler.  Two guys came out to install the new boiler and they brought another guy Neal who helped me I’ll walk through the process of what’s gonna happen and what they’re gonna install what they’re going to leave in place Place and not touched due to the fact that I made damage didn’t even more. reviews.author: Kathryn
reviews.text:
We recently discovered water damage coming through our bedroom ceiling. While it wasn’t an immediate emergency, we knew we needed a proper inspection, so we called a few local plumbers for quotes. After reading the excellent reviews for Murati Plumbing, we decided to reach out — and we are so glad we did.

Denis was extremely professional from the very first call and let us know he could come by for an inspection that same week. After taking a thorough look, he clearly explained what the issue was and what needed to be repaired. We suspected our PVC pipes were leaking, but we had no idea the root cause was actually a poorly done job by a handyman hired by the previous homeowners. The glue on multiple connecting joints had completely deteriorated, causing leaks in several directions.

Denis immediately recognized the problem, explained exactly what each pipe was for, and walked us through how he planned to fix it. His knowledge is outstanding — and the fact that he offers a 10-year warranty is a huge testament to the confidence and quality behind his work.

We were scheduled for the repair within just three days, and Denis and his team replaced the piping, connectors, and elbows in about an hour. The workmanship was excellent, and we were genuinely amazed by how efficiently everything was handled.

Even more impressive, Denis noticed several problem areas in our attic roofing while he was working — areas where water had been coming in through attic vents. We would have never discovered this until it caused significant damage. His attention to detail quite literally saved us from future headaches.

Having worked with multiple large plumbing corporations in the past (which shall remain unnamed), we’ve dealt with situations where several technicians came out over months without providing real answers. Denis is the complete opposite — knowledgeable, reliable, and able to diagnose and resolve problems quickly and correctly.

We cannot recommend Murati Plumbing highly enough. Denis is truly exceptional, and we will absolutely be reaching out to him for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Clyde Miller
reviews.text:
Stellar Plumbing and Ken Saved Our Dream Home!
I had a serious plumbing emergency at my brand-new house—the dream home I was so excited about. Due to a high water table, the basement's sump pump setup, which was originally installed by a realtor that thinks he is a contractor (isn't good at either occupation), was running constantly (every 3.5 minutes!), destined to burn out and cause a major flood. I was incredibly nervous that I had bought a house that would constantly flood.

Fortunately, I know the owner of Stellar Plumbing, and they immediately sent out Ken. Ken has 16 years of experience in plumbing and even more in the trades, and his expertise was immediately apparent. He not only quickly assessed the faulty setup but also took the time to calm me down and walk me through the comprehensive solution.

This was a mini-construction project involving a deeper pit and a dual-pump solution with completely redone piping. While it was a significant investment, Ken assured me that his experience with similar projects meant this was the permanent fix I needed.

The results are astounding: our new system is robust, reliable, and the pumps now alternate, running only about every 15 minutes. I feel 100% more confident that my home is protected and has the right system in place. If you have any serious plumbing concerns, especially with water management, I can't recommend Ken and Stellar Plumbing highly enough. They are true professionals who deliver lasting peace of mind!

reviews.author: Josh Murner
reviews.text:
HVAC:

I've had a wonderful HVAC experience with Sean from Legendary.  Last winter, we had our heat go out and he showed up within the hour and made sure to work late in order for us to have heat overnight.  I was very appreciative that he had the problem solving skills to get everything working before the end of the day, especially because we have two small children.  They have a really good warranty on pretty much all of their products and I recommend becoming part of their annual maintenance agreement - it includes discounts on any plumbing and HVAC work needed.

Plumbing:

I also recently had the pleasure of spending a few days with Frank and Dylan from Legendary while they:

1. Hauled away an old tank water heater and replaced it with a new tankless water heater
2. Replaced a rocking toilet with a brand new one
3. Re-piped old galvanized steel pipes with new pex
4. Changed the shower fixture from two knobs to a single shower valve
5. Replaced an old wheel gate valve for the main shutoff with a new quarter turn ball valve
6. Replaced an outdoor hose spigot and kitchen drain basket

Everything was installed correctly and they worked hard to make sure the project was done in a timely manner.  Our water pressure is now incredible and everything works great!  I should also mention that while installing the new pex to our shower, they noticed and fixed a small leak with our tub drain which has likely been leaking behind our wall for awhile.

Since we had such a large plumbing project, Sean made sure to show up periodically throughout the couple of days to ensure everything was on schedule and the work being done was of the highest quality.  While Frank and Dylan did a great job, it also felt good to know that Sean was double checking everything was done well throughout the project.

I highly recommend Legendary Services for both plumbing and HVAC work!

When I complained about the price, the plumber said he would throw in the sanitation loop for free, but then left without doing it. reviews.author: N Allen
reviews.text:
Sean the Manager  from Welles Branch showed up to drain my water heater.  He didn't.  He said it was rusted and needed to be replaces.  He showed me water around the bottom of the heater in the pan on which the heater was sitting.  The water was not there the night before.  I removed the water.  There was no rust at the bottom of the heater.  There is no water there after two days.  He had a couple of minutes alone with the water heater so my conclusion is that he put  the water there to force replacing a functioning water heater and a couple of valves  a cost of over $3000.   When I priced what he was offering compared to what I could independently, I could do all of what he offered at around $1000. I didn't want to waste money to replace a fully functioning water heater.  I had one before that lasted more than 20 years.  Rheem water heaters interior is glass coated for a long life if they are maintained properly.
Be careful if you ever need anyone doing work in your house, make sure to ask around and get some decent people.  There are a lot of thieves skinning a lot of innocent people and there almost no regulation and no control.  We live in a strange time.

I'm satisfied and grateful.

reviews.author: Gregg Williams
reviews.text: I must of just been unlucky after looking through all of these reviews. My wife and I just moved into our home and one of the toilets were leaking from the backside. To start off, my appointment was scheduled any time between 10-2. 2 o'clock rolls around, no call/text about the plumber running late because of another job. I waited till about 3 and called their number to see what was going on. The woman I spoke to said she was going to reach out to dispatch or plumber, I can't remember. Another hour passes, still hadn't heard anything. I called again around 4 and they said the plumber was running behind because of another job. I said, "do you guys normally let people know that kind of thing?" The woman said, "yes sir." That's all she said. Anyways, the plumber gets here at 6:30 that evening, you know, only 4.5 hours after the appointment window had closed. He said he needed to change out the bolts and gasket. I said, "okay great." He finishes the work and goes on his way. An hour later I use the restroom and hear dripping from the back of the toilet. So here we are present day. My appointment window was this morning from 8-12. I stayed home from work hoping that they'd get here early enough so I could go in for a half day. It is now 4:16 and 1 phone call later, still no plumber has shown up. Completely unacceptable. The picture shows how much water has leaked since this morning around 7 a.m.

reviews.author: Sean Ball
reviews.text: After 1 year, this system started to leak. The installer used a stainless supply and coupled it with galvanized connectors for the expansion tank.  The galvanic corrosion caused a leak and the buildup of rust had these components nearly blocked. The expansion tank was only pressurized to 1/2 of my line pressure.  As a consumer I should not have to double check your work. If it was intentional to create a system that was doomed to fail or negligence on the part of the installers, this should have been caught when the salesman came to inspect the work. Do better.  The labor alone was 2.5x the cost of the entire previous tank replacement.

reviews.author: Lanese Allen
reviews.text: They responded quickly and arrived less than a day after I reached out. It’s rare to find someone who provides such fast service without overcharging. I’ll definitely be calling for any future plumbing needs!"

reviews.author: Hannah Hager
reviews.text: Incredible plumber. Michael has visited us a few times; almost always within 24 hours and always with reasonable prices. He did some free work on our garbage disposal the first visit. Since then he’s repaired our shower, unclogged drains, etc. I trust his judgment and appreciate his cool and calm demeanor. The best in the business!

reviews.author: Jessica Schlachter
reviews.text:

Once I explained everything to Paul, he came over right away and truly advocated for my family, making sure we had the correct system that was safe for our home.

reviews.author: Zach LeBlanc
reviews.text:
We hired Priority 1 Plumbing to install a new anode rod in our water heater. The existing rod and plumbing were installed by the original builder, so it was quite old with PVC lines to the water heater. We originally spoke with Christine to schedule the service and they ended up having availability for the same day.

The technician, Michael, arrived within an hour or two of speaking with Christine. He swapped everything out on both the hot and cold lines from PVC to copper. Michael also added a new shut-off valve on the cold water line, a massive improvement from the flimsy PVC valve. Everything came out professional and clean! We were very impressed by the quality of the work, professionalism of staff throughout the process, and the price we paid for the work.

Compared to other companies we had quoted, Priority 1 was by far the best quality and value; other companies weren't even including the swap to copper. Overall, I highly recommend using Priority 1 for your plumbing needs. We will definitely be using them as our go-to company for any plumbing in the future!

July 16, 2024
We were fixing the backyard faucet after a leak, and the line broke off, causing a watery mess. We called the city to shut off the main water line. I called Robert about our situation and if they were able to come out. On the same day, he had his crew come out and fix our faucet. He did an excellent job once again! Therefore, I highly recommend Controlled Plumbing!
****************************
I happened to google this company and it was the best decision I have ever made! We had a water leak and I called for a quote. I spoke with Robert, he came out the same day, and we want the repair done as soon as possible. We scheduled the time, they came out the next day early morning, and finished within 2 hours! Robert was knowledgeable, detailed, and his crew was professional! The service was outstanding! I support small businesses and this is the reason that we will continue to use this company for future repairs! Thank you Robert and crews!

reviews.author: Sandra Wiley
reviews.text:
I have had no experience with Contolled Plumbing until my sewer line had to be replaced. What a stressful way to start the New Year 2025.

So very thankful for Oscar, Francisco and Rob guiding us through the repair process!! They were extremely punctual and explained everything to us in great detail.

I would highly recommend this company! They were excellent.

plumbers.name: Stoney's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 574 Rockbridge Dr SE, Leesburg, VA 20175, USA

reviews.author: Matt Michau
reviews.text: Fast response and direct/honest pricing. Mike was easy to work with and very helpful. Needed new pressure valve and shower valve in my home and Stoney's made it easy and affordable. Great service and excellent advice!

reviews.author: Richard Moody
reviews.text:
Mike professionally cleaned out my kitchen sink drain clog.
Have used Stoney's Plumbing several times.
Great service, easy scheduling.

reviews.author: ChrisTheSavage656 Plus
reviews.text: Woke up to 43 degrees in Lansdowne and a completely cold shower-not how I wanted to start my Monday. I reached out to Stoney's Plumbing and Mike was out within a couple of hours. It turned out to be a faulty heating element that couldn't handle the extra strain of the cold weather. I am incredibly satisfied with the water heater service; Mike was professional, tidy, and even gave me some tips on how to prevent this next year. Highly recommend! 🤩🤯

reviews.author: Rene Payes
reviews.text: I recently had to replace my 75-gallon gas water heater and got estimates from three different plumbing companies in the area. Stoney's Plumbing in Leesburg stood out for all the right reasons. They offered the best price compared to the other quotes I received, but more importantly, they took the time to answer all my questions and explain my options clearly. When I mentioned my budget constraints, they were willing to work with me on financing, which made a stressful situation much more manageable. The entire process was professional and straightforward. I really appreciated their transparency and willingness to help me find a solution that worked for my situation. If you need plumbing work done in Loudoun County, I highly recommend giving Stoney's Plumbing a call. They're honest, fair, and genuinely care about their customers.

reviews.author: Karin Dean (KayDee)
reviews.text: Mike Stone, the owner of Stoney’s Plumbing, was outstanding! He replaced my garbage disposal quickly and left everything neat and clean. It’s clear he truly knows his craft—professional, efficient, and trustworthy. As an ex-military small business owner, Mike brings reliability and integrity you can count on. I’ll definitely call him again and highly recommend his work.

plumbers.name: My Local Plumber Water Heater Repairs and Leak Detection
plumbers.address: 2430 Squire Pl, Farmers Branch, TX 75234, USA

reviews.author: William Kitchens
reviews.text: I have and will always use My Local Plumber. 2 broken outside faucets from the ice storm. Pipes leaking in wall. I tried to fix it myself. Not a chance. Zac Cassel fixed it like a champ! You get live updates on the drivers arrival time, you get great pricing, and you get great service. What more can I ask for?

reviews.author: Kim W.
reviews.text: I called My Local Plumber for help with determining a leak detection within my home.  Their plumbers quickly came over and found the leak!  They were friendly and knowledgeable!  The office staff were also very helpful and attentive.  Thanks for helping me in my time of need!  I'm so glad I found their service!  I highly recommend for leak detection!  I wish I could leave 10 stars for their service!

reviews.author: Matt Roberson
reviews.text: So great, I had a big clog in our main drainage line on the Saturday of this latest snow storm in Dallas and they were able to send out Zach and Marco to help me on a day where hardly anybody could get out and around town. They quickly resolved the issue which allowed me to drip my faucets and potentially save me from disaster! Zach and Marco were very knowledgeable and very kind. Much appreciated guys!

reviews.author: Joanna C
reviews.text: We have used My Local Plumber for a couple of years now.  We will not use another plumbing company!  We got the recommendation from my realtor friend and I understand why they come highly recommended.  From scheduling to communication and expertise, everything is handled efficiently and professionally.  Trevor and Kevin just left after solving 2 separate issues.  Trevor explained methods and costs of everything before, during and after the process.  Thanks for a positive and reliable experience!

reviews.author: Rick Reid
reviews.text: I'm a repeat customer -- My Local Plumber had a super-quick response and turnaround time on snaking a drain, running a diagnostic camera, and fixing an annoying toilet mechanism that had gone south. They also helped me determine the cause of a new, leaky sink. Super pros -- a little spendy, but worth the peace of mind. I highly recommended My Local Plumber for caring customer service and outstanding quality workmanship.

plumbers.name: Dulles Plumbing, Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 44675 Cape Ct # 150, Ashburn, VA 20147, USA

reviews.author: Derek Smoot
reviews.text:
I recently had a no-heat situation and reached out to Dulles Plumbing, Heating & Air. Their Service operations Manager was able to quickly get a technician out to my home, which was a huge relief.

The technician was very professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain exactly what was going on with my system. What really stood out was that they provided multiple options for repair rather than pushing just one solution. They clearly explained each option so I could choose what worked best for my home and budget.

Overall, the service was prompt, honest, and very professional. I highly recommend the team at Dulles Plumbing, Heating & Air to anyone needing reliable HVAC service.

reviews.author: Andrew Colon
reviews.text:
We have used Dulles Plumbing multiple times for multiple projects. They have always done a great job and completed the work in a timely manner. We have always had a pleasure speaking with the team and scheduling appointments. Chris does a great job making sure each job is completed to perfection and clarifies what exactly is needed for each job.

I would recommend this company for all your plumbing needs.
-Andrew

reviews.author: Matthew Fitzgerald
reviews.text: Dulles plumbing did a great job replacing a cracked toilet for us.  They were fast, courteous and professional.  Pricing was very fair. Thank you for helping us with our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Damandeep Singh
reviews.text: So we had a Sewer line grading issue and we talked a 3-4 different plumbing companies. The main plumber from Dulles Plumbing group was  the most accurate in identifying the problem and gave a very clear plan of what needs to be done. He was accessible by phone and extremely good at explaining everything. The price and warranty provided to us was very competitive and we moved forward with the project. David and his team (Bobby and Pablo) was very professional and neat in their work from Day1. The project had some complications which David was able navigate through. I was really impressed by the problem solving and ingenuity from him. Due to complications the project went into the second day and Dulles Plumbing group did not hesitate to finish it properly on the next day. I would definitely recommend these guys. One of the best experiences I have had with a plumbing company.

reviews.author: Jake Yezzi
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Service and Professionalism

I recently had a leak in the water line between the meter and my house, and Dulles Plumbing did an outstanding job troubleshooting and fixing the issue. From the moment I contacted them, their team was responsive, professional, and knowledgeable.

They quickly identified the problem, explained the necessary repairs clearly, and completed the work efficiently with high-quality craftsmanship. The team was courteous and made sure everything was cleaned up afterward. I truly appreciate their expertise and dedication to getting the job done right.

I highly recommend Dulles Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable and professional plumbing services!

plumbers.name: My Plumbing Heroes
plumbers.address: 11521 Franklin Woods Ct, Nokesville, VA 20181, USA

reviews.author: Khalid C
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Jonathan to get my home situated for plumbing, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the experience. He was professional, knowledgeable, and made sure everything was handled the right way.I would highly recommend using their services. I plan on working with them again in the future for my well pump and any other services that are needed

reviews.author: Emily Floyd
reviews.text: Jonathan was great at My Plumbing Heroes! We had been having issues with our water pressure and he came out essentially the next day to take a look. He was so thorough and detailed in explaining what he saw and recommending what we should do next. It wasn’t a sales pitch or trying to lock down a sale - he really took the time and it didn’t feel like we were just customers on a checklist. The scheduling and follow-up process were great as well. I would recommend them to anyone with plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Jaime Ochoa
reviews.text: Jonathan came out on short notice and immediately repaired our  water line leak. He was very professional, knowledgeable, and just a genuinely cool guy to work with. Everything was fixed quickly and done right. I’d definitely do business with him again and highly recommend My Plumbing Heroes!

reviews.author: Matthew Melesio
reviews.text:
John from My Plumbing Heroes’s is top notch! I had issues with my sump pump and he fit me into his schedule, so my basement wouldn’t flood. He was very friendly and professional to say the least. Very detailed oriented to take time to discuss what my problem was and how it needed to be fixed. I was given several options on parts and what I wanted, instead of him just ordering another pump and installing it. John took his time to clean everything properly and didn’t leave a mess. He treated the install with the wiring and placement of the equipment just like he would in his own house. I was lucky enough to find My Plumbing Heroes on other reviews given for plumbing services in the area.

I will always support small businesses like his and is highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Steven Bui
reviews.text:
Just wanted to say how wonderful My Plumbing Hero’s was to work with. Our hot water heater went out Monday evening, and Jonathan was able to get to us by 7am the next morning and replaced our hot water heater (which was quite the job because there was quite a few things messed up from previous installation from another company) and did an awesome job! He showed up right on time, explained everything clearly, and had the new one installed and ready same day.
The whole process was smooth and stress-free. It’s so nice to find someone reliable, friendly, and honest.If you need any plumbing work done, I’d definitely recommend giving them a call!

plumbers.name: Pioneer Plumbers

reviews.author: Joe Lubic
reviews.text: I had a kitchen sink backup from the evening before that far exceeded my ability to clear (and I'm pretty handy).  Spoke with James the next morning at 9, he was great.  He was able to reschedule other work and Ben and Ryan showed up at 10 to do the job.  Had both the clog removed and the Hydro Jetting Service.  The guys were personable and friendly.  James saved the day for me.  I highly recommend them, and would use them again in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Catalina Sendra
reviews.text:
Pioneer Plumbing contacted me pretty quickly after they received my request for a plumber. Very responsive from the minute we spoke on the phone.
The technician, Ryan, arrived pretty quickly and is very friendly and professional. He assessed everything and was very good about explaining what he thought was going on. He made the repair and did a good job. I would definitely contact Pioneer Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Rashique Mustahseen
reviews.text: Max from Pioneer Plumbing was a great plumber for Pioneer Plumbers. He was polite and respectful, timely and thorough in his work. He of-course did a great job installing a new garbage disposal and cleaning everything up afterwards and made sure to test to ensure functionality after the work was done. He was in and out within a couple hours. Very happy with the service. Their initial price quote was too high but they matched a quote that was lower and we got it done.

reviews.author: Will Baird
reviews.text:
This review is for the NoVa company "Pioneer Plumbers." They are the seventh plumbing company I have worked with in this area and the best by far.  I hired them to do extensive work on my home and it involved Ben and Max, who were both kind, knowledgeable, and professional in the extreme.  They were working for over 12 hours straight and they were just as upbeat and focused at the end as they were at the beginning.  They respected my entire home and ensured complete cleanliness of the work space.  As if that weren't enough, let me tell you about their unparalleled office service. Most plumbing companies?  You can call from 9-5 on business days and you will speak to someone who has no idea what time it is.  Pioneer Plumbing?  Their main scheduler will actively text with you on a WEEKEND NIGHT to ensure that you are informed, comfortable with what the service entails, and receiving the best fixtures for the lowest price.

As long as Pioneer Plumbers is in business, I will not be using anyone else.  A million out of ten.

reviews.author: Ian Carter
reviews.text: Ben and Max did a fantastic job in a complicated basement rough in project for a new bathroom and wet bar. They were friendly, professional, and patient as they worked long hours to get the job done. I’d highly recommend pioneer plumbers for any work you need done at a fair cost and high quality work

plumbers.name: AAA AUGER Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 2437 E Union Bower Rd, Irving, TX 75061, USA

reviews.author: Kris Cook
reviews.text: Wow! AAA Auger is so professional. They sent Ramiro who was very thorough and informative. Our issue was a toilet not flushing. Additionally , the toilet was rocking and needed to be seated. He solved both problems quickly and efficiently. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jared Perry
reviews.text:
AAA Auger has been awesome to work with. We bought a home that had been flipped before the previous owner, and there have been issues galore. Having used other plumbers in the area, they often didn't catch the issues or weren't able to make a full repair.

AAA Auger has been out to our house probably 5 or 6 times now, and each time they've done excellent work in a timely manner for a good price. They show loyalty to their customers, and when our pipe broke the first day during this past freeze, they did everything they could to get someone out to us as soon as possible.

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.text: AAA Auger has been our go-to plumbing company for many years and we are still high on their responsiveness and quality service. They are fair and knowledgeable and do the work right. It takes several good experiences to gain this level of trust. We're lucky to have them available. Today's service by Tim McGrady was fantastic, easing our concerns about an outside spigot and cutoff valve that had broken. With the impending winter weather and hard freeze, we were very concerned but AAA Auger and Tim put us at ease. It took a morning online request, a call just a few minutes later and Tim was on his way. By early afternoon, it was all done. Thanks Tim and AAA Auger!

reviews.author: Terri Borrego
reviews.text:
i called AAA Auger, and explained to the gentleman in the office that I had 2 other plumbers come and I could give pictures and a smoke test video. He said they would take the information I had and do a visual and give me a free inspection and give me an estimate. The guy came out, told me it would be $437 for his visual, he would dig around under the house a little and look everything over really good. I was already in my feeling with my sewer pipes issues , so not really thinking it through, I allowed the inspection. In hind sights I should have sent him back, because I was mislead.
I’m glad I didn’t use them, What else would they have mislead me on.,….
AAA Augers guy pretty much found the same issue the other plumbers found. But AAA Auger quoted me an extremely higher price!!
I decide to call one more company, with years of experience, who actually honored their free estimate. They were in the same price range as the first 2 Companies.
I did Not trust AAA Auger, so I did not use them…

reviews.author: Marisa Trevino
reviews.text: Highly recommend AAA Auger for plumbing needs - these guys are awesome! I used them today for toilet change out and TIM did an outstanding job - professional, efficient and thorough. He left restroom looking good as new and even took time to review and discuss some additional plumbing concerns I had.  The work was completed with care and integrity, and Tim honored his original quote, so there were no surprises or hidden fees. I had compared prices beforehand, and another company quoted significantly more. I’m very glad I chose Tim/AAA Auger.

plumbers.name: Clover Contracting: Plumbing, HVAC & Air Purification
plumbers.address: 44679 Endicott Dr Suite 300, Ashburn, VA 20147, USA

reviews.author: Zach
reviews.text:
We received quotes from a lot of HVAC companies and ultimately used Clover. Ryan did an awesome job at helping us figure out the issue with our Furnace - blower motor and inducer was bad. Since the unit was so old (20 years old) we went ahead and replaced that. We noticed major corrosion on our water heater and I asked them about fixing the dryer exhaust pipes in the wall because somehow that was crushed.

Long story short we replaced the furnace, water heater and they fixed the damaged dryer exhaust pipe in the wall. They even replaced/fixed all the old gas and water pipes hooking up to the furnace/water heater.

They did an awesome job. We added on some extras like the Honeywell air filtration system and the extra home air purifier with a humidifier for the home. This has helped tremendously with allergies, and dry nose during the winter.

I only have the “after photos” but compared to before it looks 100% better, our furnace works great now. The piping system is still complicated but they made it way better than before.

Also want to say thanks for the muffins.

reviews.author: Andrew Potocko
reviews.text:
I called 6 different businesses in my area for quotes to have my broken and leaking water heater replaced. Clover hands down had the best value AND the best customer service experience! I was blown away!

While most companies charge for a quote or require a technician visit, Clover offered me a free, no-hassle quote over the phone by simply sending a few pictures (which they offer for certain services). I initially spoke with Lizzie on the phone who helped me get the process started. She was extremely helpful, understanding, and responsive with my primary call and follow up questions. She also walked me through their many guarantees and signature service benefits.

After choosing Clover, they were able to schedule me for next day service to quickly have my water heater replaced. The service technicians (Austin and Ricky) were incredibly professional and walked me through everything they were doing. They are clearly knowledgeable and highly trained in their craft and we’re well equipped to answer any questions I had.

I highly recommend Clover and will plan on using their services again if needed!

reviews.author: Jacquie Burian
reviews.text: Clover Services was one of very few responses I received (and were extremely quick) to respond to my request for an estimate to repair (but most likely replace) my elderly father's old boiler system from the 1970's. They arranged for one of their best technicians to evaluate the system as soon as possible and he spent a lot of time analyzing how best to replace and dispose of the the old system.  Their prices were competitive and the total amount was exactly what we expected it would cost to replace.  The company went above and beyond to get the equipment ordered and installed as quickly as possible so my father would have heat in time for the cold weather. This was not an easy job and not one that many companies wanted to attempt - but Clover Services, Ryan and all of their technicians took this job without hesitation and worked hard for two days to get it done. Ryan, the lead tech, was extremely professional, communicative and friendly (as was Wendy in the office) and they both made sure I understood the estimate, the timeline and all that the job entailed. They also treated my father and his home with dignity and respect. They did a fantastic job and I wouldn't hesitate to hire them again!

reviews.author: Shivasish Sindiri
reviews.text:
On Jan 16th I called CLOVER HVAC service because my HVAC was shutting down and home wasn't heating. They sent two technicians to home in short time. They observed the code 31 or 13 flashing on the carrier HVAC and told me it’s the pressure switch that is faulty. Since they claimed they were licensed and experienced technician I trusted them and paid $478 in total ( $99 for the visit  + $379 advance payment o replace the pressure switch for next visit ). After they left, the HVAC system was working, blowing hot air but doesn't take break when indoor temperature reaches thermostat set temperature. (This is quite dangerous for multitude of reasons). It was like furnace inside the home. I called them to visit home and check. They suggested, I should attempt to fix while they instruct me how to do it on phone. WHAT A WORST IDEA. JUST to keep my property safe I attempted it with lot of hesitation and fear of the furnace. Then I see the furnace started accumulating water quite close to the electric/mother circuit board. I was scared because its basic electrical 101, water with active current is a worst scene. They came back on the same evening and fixed it. I was really unsatisfied & frustrated and called their office and ASKED THEM "PLEASE CANCEL MY NEXT SERVICE OF REPLACING THE PRESSURE SWITCH" because of their inexperience and the mess. They told me that they will refund that day visit cost $99 and will send a senior technician to do "FULL SYSTEM DIAGNOSTIC CHECK AND IF AT ALL NECESSARY, THEY WILL REPLACE THE SWITCH". I didn't like the idea but I finally agreed after they repeatedly declining to cancel the next appointment with them. Then the senior tech came and couldn't really pinned down the issue and replaces the pressure switch without concrete evidence. The HVAC ran fine for 4 days and on fifth day it started flashing the same error code 31 or 13 . I called them and they sent same senior tech again as soon as they could. At this visit he claimed he did what he should have done in his earlier visits . i.e HVAC 101. ANY LICENSING SCHOOL WOULD TEACH THIS, WHENEVER HVAC FLASHING PRESSURE SWITCH CODE YOU SHOULD
1) OPEN THE BLOWER FAN, CHECK FOR ANY CLOGS, DEBRIS AND CONDENSATE LIQUID? THEY DIDN'T DO THIS. NOT EVEN TOUCHED IT.
2) CHECK EXHAUST, INTAKE AND DRAIN PIPES TO CHECK FOR ANY CLOGS. THEY DID EXAMINE THIS.
3) CHECK THE ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS FOR ANY ISSUE. THEY TESTED THIS.
WHY DIDN’T YOU CHECK THE BLOWER FAN?? WAS IT TOO SIMPLE AND DOESN’T COST MUCH TO CUSTOMER?

The HVAC stopped working again for the second time and this time knew I will be a total fool if I call them because $379 + three CLOVER technicians + four visits couldn't fix it . Either they knew what was the problem and they choose not to operate and scam me by replacing a well-functioning part or they don’t know above point (1).  By looking at the below attached pictures and not doing HVAC 101 point (1), you might be convinced the first case is likely true. i.e they wanted to do something which would bring more money and not doing simple cleaning which could have done during their first visit for just $99.
After waiting for two cold nights a  genuine technician came and said there is nothing wrong with old pressure switch (he tested it by replacing it) or another component. AND just the ducts and pipes needed further cleaning. IT has been a couple days it’s working.

I called them for a refund since they claim "MONEY BACK GUARANTEE” if their service was unsatisfactory. SINCE YOU COULD FIX THE PROBLEM AND DIDN’T DO THE BASIC CHECK IN YOUR FIRST VISIT YOU SHULD REFUND. They tell me, they already gave $99 discount and cannot offer any further discount. I WANT TO REMIND; YOU GAVE ME $99 BECAUSE YOU PUT MY WHOLE HVAC AT RISK BECAUSE OF THE WATER LEAKING FROM THE EXHAUST PIEPE. IT WAS YOUR FAULT. YOU DIDN’T DO A FAVOUR TO ME. Now I am asking for refund because even after four visits and charging me $379 you couldn't fix the issue AND REPLACED A WELL FUNCTIONING PART WHICH WAS TOTAL UNNECESSARY.
You break my confidence and trust.

reviews.author: Marcus Singleton
reviews.text: I hired Clover Contracting for some plumbing work at my home, and overall, I had a very positive experience. The plumber arrived on time, quickly identified the issue, and explained the repair process in simple terms. They fixed a leaky pipe and also checked the water heater to ensure everything was running smoothly. The service was professional, and the pricing felt fair for the quality of work. The only reason I didn’t give a full 5 stars is because the cleanup could have been a bit more thorough, but I’d definitely call them again.

plumbers.address: 415 E Airport Fwy # 330, Irving, TX 75062, USA

reviews.author: Danielle C
reviews.text: Eduardo and Jose were very effective and handled this promptly. They were polite and kind. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Elise A
reviews.text: We called several plumbing companies this evening and were very thankful that this company still had technicians available just before the ice storm. Eddie came out to our home, quickly fixed the plumbing issue, and was able to identify the root cause using his pipe camera. We’re grateful it turned out to be an easy fix and really appreciated the great service.

reviews.author: jess rojo
reviews.text: great service! affordable plumbers! 10/10 recommend - traveled all the way to Waxahachie Tx

reviews.author: ichiro young
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic service and team. Had done a complete pipe replacement from cast iron to pvc. Not only were they efficient time wise but  they took care of shoddy work done by previous plumbers that was hidden. Also the best price by far out of the 3 companies that I inquired with. They got delayed by a couple days because of weather, but to make up for the time lost they stayed late multiple days to get the job done by the deadline they set out (Eddie). Seamless from the workers to the back office keeping me updated constantly with how the project was going through out the whole time (Jessica). Absolutely would recommend 10/10.

reviews.author: Alex Gamez
reviews.text: Eduardo did a great reasonable quote and consultation. Im a General Manager a hotel and had a leak effecting 3 floors of room numbers. Eduardo and team did the job less than 8hrs and fast with great  detail.

reviews.author: Debbie Brooks
reviews.text: Allen was indeed very thorough with providing details prior to completing any work and answered all of the questions regarding my plumbing concerns. He was able to determine exactly what my plumbing problem was and explained the related issues. This gave me complete comfort and trust in his work. Very knowledgeable and definitely demonstrated excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Hatsumi Mann
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Chen Zhang, a technician. He was very friendly, professional, and clearly knowledgeable about his work. He took the time to explain everything and was extremely helpful throughout the entire process.
Chen arrived right on time and completed the job efficiently without cutting any corners. He worked diligently, made sure everything was done properly, and finished in a timely manner. It’s clear he takes pride in what he does.
I truly appreciate his professionalism and would highly recommend him to anyone needing HVAC services!

reviews.author: Livia Wolfer
reviews.text: I had Matt in today, with Jonathan shadowing him, and they did great work!  Every part of the process was explained to me - what was wrong, what that meant, what it was supposed to look like, and how to fix it.  They originally came in for the yearly free maintenance check you get with a membership, but they found an issue with our water pressure system.  They fixed it within a couple hours, and were out of my house by noon with a full comprehensive list of what they had done, how long it should last, and an easy expectation that if *anything* was wrong later, they would fix it (for free, up to a year later).  Both young men were very helpful, friendly, and professional.

reviews.author: Akua G.
reviews.text:
The representative was punctual and professional in demeanor. However, as someone who made it clear I’m not knowledgeable about HVAC systems, I was hoping for more explanation and guidance about the different options available.

I found myself repeatedly asking for clarification, and much of the conversation focused on the limited time of the Costco promotion rather than helping me understand the systems themselves. For such a significant investment, I would have appreciated who would have been more consultative and educative.

By the end of the visit, I found myself wanting to seek quotes from other companies, even though I genuinely would have preferred to move forward through Costco.

reviews.author: Scott H
reviews.text:
What started out as an issue with water acidity exposed a problem with the iron filter on my well. Allen came out to the house and assessed the problem and called on Jacob as the problem was larger than just adjusting the system.

Jacob adjusted schedule and came out. After identifying the problem he gave me pricing on removing the 25 year old iron filter and adding an equivalent and also addressed a problem with sediment. I didnt expect the visit to be so big a job and Jacob had to go get parts. It was 5pm by time he had everything at the house and, with a smile, he was ready to install and stay 2 to 3 hours past his work schedule.

He never griped or indicated any distress with having to work late. He did a great job of removing the old filter and putting the new one in place with all the plumbing changes associated. The new filter looks like it was there from the start.

As always, Furr really has a talented team that does goodlooking quality work.

plumbers.name: Triple Crown Plumbing
plumbers.address: 542 Haggard St Ste 514, Plano, TX 75074, USA

reviews.author: James Herbert
reviews.text: Miguel and his training were exceptionally polite, professional, and experienced. I will use them when I am ready to replace the pipes underneath my house and one of the best plumbers I’ve had so far.

reviews.author: Kelli Nguyen
reviews.text: The first time I called Triple Crown/DNA Plumbing for an emergency on a Sunday, Dylan got there right away and had it fixed less than an hour after I called. The second time was a scheduled installation, and Miguel showed up right on time and again was done in an hour. Both times the prices were reasonable, they left zero mess, and the work quality was excellent. Recommend 100%.

reviews.author: Chloe Brown
reviews.text: These guys came out to replace my water heater that busted during the freeze. I talked to Bobby on the phone and he got someone out for emergency service within an hour of when I called!! The guys were knowledgeable about each type of water heater and helped me understand which would be the best for my home. They even gave me an 8 year warranty hot water heater for the price of a 6 year water heater!! I will use their services for everything going forward, great job guys you earned a lifelong customer right here! I recommend this company to everyone needing any type of plumbing service.

reviews.author: Raymond Jobe
reviews.text:
Triple Crown was available relatively quickly to respond to a minor toilet leak issue in north Dallas. They said they could rebuild the toilet, but quoted me a price more expensive than a new toilet. I asked about installing a new toilet; they said I would have to get it and bring it back as they didn't provide that service. The quote for a new toilet install was $295.00.
I headed for Home Depot, and they called to say the water turn off was not working properly and it would be an extra $125.00. They got the toilet installed, but after they left I noticed when they installed the water turn off they didn't put a flange onto the pipe to cover the interface where the pipe comes out of the wall. They just left the open hole with the pipe coming out. For $445 to drop the toilet on the hole and connect the water line, and leave the sloppy looking pipe hole, the price was extremely high.
When I called them they tried to tell me that was normal. The service provided was not workmanlike. I do not recommend these plumbers.

reviews.text: We live in the Lantana area and called The Plumbinator. Mickey is amazing! Had some issues with a leaking hose bib. I really appreciated how he walked me through the issues and fix it efficiently. Was a great experience, 10 out of 10, would use The Plumbinator again!!

reviews.author: Kristiane Mandraki
reviews.text: We'll never use another plumber after working with these guys. I was worried we'd need to replace our bathrooms after two separate leaks started happening. They spent ages with us and never charged us since there was no leak to fix. They even gave us tips to protect our pipes in the freeze and prevent them breaking! A really genuine and trustworthy company with knowledgeable plumbers. We will definitely use them when we do decide to replace our bathrooms!

reviews.author: Luke Hebert
reviews.text:
Plumbinator gets the job done right. The crew is reliable—they show up on time, they’re patient, and they’re genuinely personable. They kept me up to date throughout the process and were flexible with scheduling while I sorted things out with my insurer where possible.

They worked hard to track down a difficult leak in my master bathroom. In the process, they also discovered an additional issue under my slab and made sure I understood what needed to be done next. They take care to clean up after themselves and are respectful of your home.

They work diligently until the problem is solved, and if something falls outside their scope, they’ll recommend someone trustworthy who can help. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Moe Kamalipour
reviews.text:
It is a breath of fresh air of Honesty and Integrity you will experience using this women owed plumbing business in Round Rock  and surrounding areas.
We had an issue with a tenant occupied property where they experienced random sewer smell in an 1100 sf house with one bathroom. 2 years ago when the complete remodeling took place new electrical , new water line, and new fixtures were upgraded . They gave the remaining partial cast iron sewer line under the house to be in good integrity.
Moving forward two years to now September 19-024 we were scratching our heads what could be the cause of the random sewerage smell. We had 4 plumbers to come out and each offered different ways. Two of them said just rip everything under the house out at cost of over $12,000.00 and it takes us 2 days. Others wanted us to tell them which test we wanted them to perform! Like do you want a smoke test at $980.00 or a camera inspection at this and that . You got to be kidding me they are so called experts and yet we should say to them what to do!!?
We are older retired age too and they did offer a 10% off their deal too.
It seems like a big scam to go to as many properties and just see what sticks and collect money without really providing anything of substance.
From all these we get this company The Plumbinatoraustin from Round Rock two technicians arrived very quiet listening and looking not talking too much , inspected the drain system over and under and came out saying nothing they can see is wrong. They suggested to let the tenants be aware that during these hot days the AC is running more often and the pea traps may dry up the water inside of them therefore the pea traps need some water with a bit of bleach once awhile to block the sewer gas randomly get in to the house.
We were so surprised that the cast iron leakage was not there as the other 2 plumbers claimed . To make sure after the Plumbinator’s technicians left I got the courage to crawl under the house to verify their findings and sure enough there was no evidence of any leaks or smell or muddy wet soil. I videotaped my journey under the house and showed it to the tenants and my family and we were so blown away from their integrity and honesty in Business.
What else one can say than cheering them on to greatness.
PS : Two of the parties came out were from the Angies list it’s a words of caution just because they are members of this and that it’s a marketing strategy do not fall for that and search small family run businesses and first of all Read their NEGATIVE reviews before reading the other ratings.
Cheers.

reviews.author: Annette Hairston
reviews.text: The Plumbinator is the only plumber I'll ever use.  I've been a customer of theirs since 2018.  After the first service, I knew I had found an old school plumber, one with integrity who cares about the customer and not just money.  They are highly responsive and prompt.  Recently, I started to have recurring issues with my water heaters, and Mickey and his sons worked on them till everything was perfect.  They did recurring visits for an extremely fair price, saying that I was a regular customer who is important to them and that they wanted to take care of me.  Who still does and says that these days?!  They are refreshing in this day and age, and I don't think I've ever trusted a business as much as I now trust them.

I was trying to make sure he was a real plumber, and I wasn't going to get flooded with callbacks, but I think he has to pay if the call lasts a certain amount of time, so he needed to hurry. reviews.text: Beware of them scam. I called them because I had a sewage backup at my house in round rock. I called and they sent a plumber to come to my house. He wanted 600 dollars to clear my clog and after me telling him it was too much money and I would pass he started insulting my family about how he drove all this way for nothing and was cursing all over my face in the driveway. Keep in mind on their website they claimed free estimates. After long talks he wouldn't leave and then said he could do it for $475. I agreed and he used his auger to try to clear my pipe. While he was clearing my pipe he started to complain that it was only for 45 minutes of work and if I wanted him to continue clearing the pipe he would have to charge more. What a sketchy business practice. Keep in mind he was smoking all over my face at the same time. After 15 minutes he said he couldn't clear my clog and still had the means to charge me $475 for 15 minutes of nothing. Keep in mind the whole time he was smoking in my face with all his drug smell and kept insisting he would have to dig my pipe up for $5000. Later in the day I called a different plumber who was able to clear the clog with their augur for only $175 dollars that took them 2hr+ because of a plastic piece was stuck in the pipe. What a scam, I never seen someone so willing to scam and rudly smoke in customers faces. I don't why this place has so much good review but they got to be fake. Keep in mind they put their location on google maps as the northtown mud apartment but they aren't even there. A locaton for them doesn't exist. Whatever you do if you call them expect a crazy rude drugged plumber to come to your house to scam you. They guy the sent me he drove a white chevy truck. Just be careful if you call I got scammed by them and the guy was rude and smoked all over my face. Better off calling someone else.

reviews.author: Escobar
reviews.text:
Stepping on wet carpet and seeing swollen base board at 10pm isn’t ideal. I spent hours cleaning up and cutting out wet drywall and flooring. I traced a leak that ended up under the slab.  I am well rounded and can fix many things around the house but I know when I need a pro. The next morning I called 4 major plumbing companies. Not a single one of them called me back so I decided to head to Home Depot and pick up some supplies.
That trip was worth every penny and more.
The vehicle I parked next to was AQUAMAN PLUMBING!  On his day off Tib showed up to my house within 30 minutes.  He listened to all the steps I took and checked all lines, meter etc. the leak was so slow it was not registering from the meter.  The rear hose bib was cut and capped isolating and stopping the leak.  I asked lots of questions from running a new line, changing from copper to pex, adding bibs, water pressure (90-92psi) and adding a PRV from the meter.  Tib answered all without missing a beat.  He noticed I had installed a water softener and made some adjustments to the overflow lines.  He mentioned the benefit of having a filtration system pre softener and potential layout of bypass and cutoff incase of leaks or maintenance.

We discussed 3 items with 0 sales pressure.   Tib, Raul, Andre and Tata (grandfather) showed up and tackled all 3 tasks.  Tib advised he would be back the following day for a 30min to an hour visit to check connections and button everything up.  I had to delay an additional day. Tib and Andre returned and I am going to say this was a godsend.  The water heater flex line was leaking, and had been leaking since we bought the house 4 years ago or longer!!!  The line was barely screwed on, no sealant tape, no pipe dope just hanging on by a thread and prayer.  Cut off the gas, sealed up and checked all gas lines inside and out.  Thank you again for your prompt service and attention to detail.  You saved us from a disaster and we are very grateful.

10/10

reviews.author: John L
reviews.text: Tib @ Aquaman was superb. I had a main water line leak somewhere in my yard in Lakeway and my main plumber had to call in reinforcements since it was such a laborious operation digging 2.5 foot deep holes trying to find the leak in a 70 foot stretch of yard. Tib and Raul showed up and they were great. They kept digging and triangulating until they found and fixed the leak. They stayed until 10PM to get the job done. Yes, you heard that right. This is why you always want to hire tradesman that are owner operators rather than big outfits with salaried employees. Ain't no way an employee would have had the resolve to stay that late to knock out the job in 1 visit. Can't recommend Aquaman enough. Great job and great attitude in a difficult situation.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text:
I feel compelled to update my original review after learning something that truly shocked and angered me. A neighbor around the corner, whose home is nearly identical to mine, recently had Piedmont Gas install the same gas line setup I requested — with a quick disconnect (which Waldrop told me I’d need to do myself afterward). His final cost? $300. Yes, you read that right — $300, compared to the $1,700+ I paid Waldrop for a similar setup.
When I heard that, I was stunned. I felt taken advantage of. I had hoped that by writing a detailed letter to Waldrop’s CEO about my experience, someone would respond — but I never heard back.
If you're considering Waldrop, I strongly encourage you to read my original experience below. I hope it helps others avoid what I went through..
________________________________________
Original Review (from December 3, 2024)
We hired Waldrop to install a gas line for a portable generator. What followed was over four weeks of delays, poor communication, and subpar service.
•	Initial quote: On October 4th, a technician quoted us just under $1,800. I asked about cost reduction options (we’re on a fixed income), but none were offered. My wife and I agreed to move forward for the sake of safety and professionalism.
•	Missed deadlines: Work began October 11th. We were told the inspector would come the following week. No one showed, and it took repeated calls to even get a response.
•	Communication issues: Calling the office was frustrating — constant recordings, AI, or long hold times. When we did get someone, they often lacked answers or never followed up. I finally spoke to James Kirby, who admitted the inspector hadn’t even been contacted and was surprised by the poor quality shown in their own technician’s photos.
•	Rework and mess: The crew returned October 24th to reinstall the line “properly.” They left a mess, chipped our sidewalk, and got paint on our siding. Even the state inspector commented that a regulator was missing, though he passed it due to the low pressure of our setup. Waldrop did install the regulator after the inspection and final adjustments.
•	I have many more details, though this should explain the basic reasons I am posting such a negative review.
We wrote to Jamie Porterfield (Waldrop) on November 7th. As of December 3rd — still no response.
This experience left us sadly disappointed. Others may have had better outcomes, but our experience was unprofessional, overpriced, and extremely frustrating.

reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Ethical Plumbing today replacing our water heater. From start to finish, the team was professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable. They explained our options clearly, answered all our questions, and completed the installation efficiently and neatly.

It’s refreshing to work with a company that is honest, fair, and truly lives up to its name. We felt confident we were in good hands the entire time. Highly recommend Ethical Plumbing to anyone needing reliable, high-quality plumbing work!

I was the ln charged almost double for the repair on top of the trip charge.  They quoted me some other repairs and 2 other quotes I got where less than half of what they quoted me. I only used them because I was in a pinch, but I will not be using them in the future.

We will use them in the future for our plumbing needs .  We highly recommend them.
