reviews.author: clark ballantyne
reviews.text: Mathew with Dipple was very professional and knowledgeable!  He came and serviced our HvAC needs and did a fantastic job.  He explained what needed to be done and the cost, which was very reasonable.  He completed the job and then explained how to best run our system so it would run efficiently and effectively, as it was supposed to.  Which prior to them, the original company had not fully completed our system properly and left one item broken and uninstalled!

reviews.author: Jessi Klein
reviews.text:
Billy West was amazing. I cannot say enough good things about this experience. From the moment he arrived, he was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough. He took the time to clearly explain what was going on, walked me through what needed to be done, and made sure I fully understood the solution before moving forward. There was zero pressure and just honest, straightforward expertise.

Beyond being technically unmatched, he was genuinely kind and thoughtful. He even brought my trash cans in without being asked. Such a small gesture, but it speaks volumes about his character and level of care.

I never thought I’d describe a plumbing issue as “delightful,” but here we are. This was hands-down the best experience I’ve ever had when it comes to solving a home problem. I almost wish I had more plumbing issues just so he could come back and help again.

Highly, highly would recommend.

reviews.author: Diane
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Brandon. He is knowledgeable, engaging and pays attention to details. I needed a light fixture replaced, Brandon ‘s assessment and installation were quick and efficient. He went the extra mile by patching up the holes left by the old fixture. Overall, a great and easy experience. Thanks Brandon!

reviews.author: Renee Hall
reviews.text:
Woke at 3:30am to a flooded kitchen!  Called Dipple and got a LIVE VOICE at 3:30AM! She was so kind and assured me a technician / service person would be out first thing that morning.  Dropped son at school and Danny was at my home, waiting for ME, at 8:15am!

He diagnosed and repaired one issue within an hour… Diagnosed a second issue and assured me he would be back the following morning to repair.

Danny was here by 8:45am, smile on his face, and new toilet IN HAND!  Like LITERALLY!  He installed the toilet and was finished within an hour.

I will DEFINITELY recommend Dipple to my friends and neighbors and will never hesitate to call Dipple again!  Thanks Danny and team!

reviews.author: Pamela Webb

reviews.author: April Needles

Will be using them again!

reviews.author: Holly Anderson

reviews.author: Kevin Hendricks
reviews.text: We had a major sewer line disaster and Plumbing in Pink came to the rescue. They were easy to schedule and got here quickly. Thank you, Plumbing in Pink!

reviews.author: Liz F.
reviews.text: Roto Rooter has always been able to clear out pipe clogs when they happen in my older house. Their prices are fair and they perform quality work. The dispatchers and technicians are always friendly and knowledgeable. I also had a leaky toilet fixed quickly as well. They don’t try to add in unnecessary work either. John was very helpful today and now we can use our plumbing again.

reviews.author: William Howard
reviews.text:
Travis Reid did an outstanding job!  The Frankenstein valve for the dishwasher the builder install started leaking and was lightly flooding the cabinet and floor.  Travis replaced it with a quality quarter turn valve and put in a new supply line to the dishwasher. Turned the water back on and it works perfectly.

We’ve used Rotor Rooter at our past house and had excellent experiences. The great experience today was no exception!

reviews.author: Michelle McLeod
reviews.text:
Miles and Jose were fantastic. They were punctual, respectful, and took time to explain the issues with our disposal and water pressure that were contributing to a leak.
They answered any questions, and made sure I understood and felt comfortable with the work and quoted costs.
They worked efficiently, and cleaned up after. They were also friendly!
Would definitely recommend their service.

reviews.author: Paragermania
reviews.text:
We called Roto-Rooter for an inspection on our gas water heater after noticing a leakage.
The person on the phone, (customer service) was excellent with a very fast response. Shortly after the technicians Ellis Wheeler and Tylor Fobian arrived. We felt in the best hands possible, due to not only very knowledgeable in the field but also very caring individuals. The whole team was working non stop until the project was completed. And let me tell you the finish product was flawless.
When we are talking about good, better, best. This company is truly THE BEST. 100% recommended. Very grateful and happy customer!

reviews.author: Jimmy Martin
reviews.text: Travis was very professional plumber and did a great job. My wife & I did not want to be without water a second night. Travis had to rebuild our tub faucet and build an access box. Highly recommend Travis and Rotor Rooter!!

reviews.author: Susan Carroll
reviews.text: Tom and his crew did a great job replacing defective toilet seals (wax rings), toilet tank parts, leak detection (cutting open a wall) and installation of a new p-trap under the sink. I highly recommend Budget Plumbing. They are prompt, efficient, and leave all areas they’ve repaired very clean, with no trace that they’ve even been there. Tom is very fair with job prices, as well.

reviews.author: Jessie Modlin
reviews.text: So happy with our service! Budget is our go to plumber and is always good work at the most fair price. They will also never try to suggest work that you don't *actually* need. When we have searched for pricing, they are consistently the most affordable, so we don't even call around anywhere now!

reviews.author: Lacy Tapp Wilder
reviews.text: I’ve had a great experience with this plumber on multiple jobs. They’re quick to respond, always show up on time, and explain everything clearly. The work is done professionally, the pricing is very fair, and the service is honest and reliable. I’d definitely hire them again and recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work!

reviews.author: Drew Pearce
reviews.text: After calling for an estimate, Budget Plumbing came out to make a much needed repair today. As usual, Tom and Sean did an excellent job.   Tom assessed the situation, explained what was required to make the repair and confirmed the estimated cost.  He and Sean worked together, finished the job promptly, and everything looked great.  They inspected the work, tested the system and as a courtesy, inspected the plumbing for a shower drain as well.  The cost ended up being exactly as estimated over the phone and in person.  No up-charges, no surprises.  We have used Budget many times over the years.  They do quality work, at a reasonable price, promptly.  They also clean up behind themselves and leave things better than they found them.  We couldn’t be more pleased to do business with Budget!

reviews.author: David Payne
reviews.text: Budget Plumbing is among the most reliable service providers I have ever used. I have trusted their services for over 25 years, and they have consistently demonstrated exceptional professionalism. They are always punctual, respectful of my property, and prompt in addressing any issue. Their workmanship is consistently excellent, and they reliably resolve problems correctly the first time. I highly recommend Budget Plumbing without reservation—they are simply the best in the industry.

reviews.text: Just had work done by Jenks and they were nothing short of fantastic! Friendly, professional and affordable. Can't recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Berta Mendozawatkins
reviews.text:
I have always had good experience with Jenks Plumbing & Heating Inc.  Recently in august 2025 I notice the water was not going down the drain in my shower bath & Tom came to get rid of hair in the drain.
Last year in 2024, I decided to add another water meter for the irrigation sprinkler system.  Tom came in Sept 2024 and he installed another meter in the basement.  He also explain which was the domestic meter & which was irrigation meter.  The cost was reasonable..  I saved money when I used the irrigation system this year.
In January 2022, one of toilet needed to be replaced . Tom suggested that I get a comfort Kohler toilet with a flush mate cartridge.  I was impressed because water & pressure save water.  I had my 83 yr sister in law living with me and it was easy for her to get up from the toilet by her self.

reviews.author: Jarod Herring
reviews.text: My shower head busted a few months ago and I was lucky to find Jenks Plumbing as most places were booked out for several weeks. The day I called them I had someone arrive within a few hours. 2 people came who were very polite and was in-n-out in under 30 minutes. I was a little nervous about what the price was going to be, but it was the most reasonable quote to where I used them again for installing my new dishwasher. Again, I called them, and they were able to come within 5 days. 2 people came to install the new dishwasher and did a fantastic job. He did great at keeping a clean work site and again the price was very reasonable. They had the new dishwasher installed and took away the other one in under 2 hours. I will only be using Jenks plumbing for my future plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Madison Uildriks
reviews.text: genuinely some of the worst services i’ve experienced. we’ve been trying to get them out to fix our urgent boiler problems for weeks and they’ve done nothing even after multiple promises “we’ll call you tomorrow!” “we’ll have an estimate tomorrow” with no follow through. every promise of a phone call to schedule has been ghosted and when they were supposed to show up they never did! shocker. the receptionist on the phone was very rude as well. what a waste of time and effort.

reviews.author: Sharissa Seger
reviews.text: While this company did the job that they were supposed to, I would not use this company again. The job was to get the water line to my fridge to work, which did happen but it took an unreasonable amount of time and included extra holes in my ceiling and a mess for me to clean up. Normally I wouldn’t complain about the time it takes for a job like this but when the guy admits to me that it could have taken a half hour if he had done something differently rather than 3 hours, then I get a little upset. On top of that, he used my step stool to do his work leaving it a complete mess and making me scrub it after the job. He also stepped on two chairs that I had in the room leaving footprints on my furniture. He also cut huge holes into my ceiling trying to find the line, which is not something this company fixes.  Afterwards I called the company to dispute the bill since the majority of the cost was the time it took which should not have been on me since it was his fault for doing the wrong thing in the first place. I spoke to Karen who assured me that she would look into it and get back to me that day. I didn’t hear from anyone for a month and a half until my check was cashed and I called again. I spoke to Karen again and she apologized for no one getting back to me and said she would call me that afternoon. It’s been over a week and I have yet to hear from anyone. The lack of response and taking responsibility for their mistakes is why I will not use this company again.

reviews.author: Natasha Johnson
reviews.text: We are thoroughly impressed with the customer service and the attentiveness given to us. Preston and Brandon were both kind, thorough, and professional in tackling our kitchen drain which was our main concern. We appreciated that they had our backs as far as homeowners and explained thoroughly what was going on with the plumbing in our home. I would highly recommend this place and it’s really the best you could want when you are having plumbing issues and wanting assurance on how your drains are functioning / what can be done to improve them. Thank you so much Spot on Plumbing for treating us like people more than just another customer.

reviews.author: wendy robertson
reviews.text:
Spot On Plumbing Company is truly excellent! We had a wonderful, top-quality experience with Hayden and Easton, who did an outstanding job installing our new tankless water heater and repiping our entire home with high-quality PEX. From start to finish, their professionalism, skill, and attention to detail were impressive.

If you’re looking for reliable plumbers in Tulsa and the surrounding towns and cities residents can trust, Spot On Plumbing absolutely delivers. Their 100% happiness guarantee really shows how confident they are in their work; if anything isn’t right, they’ll come back and make it right at no extra cost. Their goal is clearly to exceed expectations, and they succeeded with our plumbing needs. Spot On Plumbing is Veteran owned and operated, too.

Service was prompt, friendly, and genuinely thoughtful. We couldn’t be happier with the work and the service. Spot On Plumbing went above and beyond, and we highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Alisa Norris
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.text: Clear Creek Plumbing was amazing! I had a complicated plumbing issue that another plumbing company was unable to fix. I was referred to Clear Creek Plumbing for a second opinion. The guys were all so nice and smart, and really wanted to solve the problem without tearing down the wall. They worked really hard to solve the problem, and they did it! They found the problem and fixed it without tearing the wall down! I’m so thankful to them and will definitely use them for any future issues. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tara Ballenger

Nathan, the technician who did the work, was very friendly, cleared the obstruction, and the final price was exactly as Colton had predicted. So rare to find an honest plumber!

reviews.author: Sterling Stolle

During the process, he identified some necessary code updates and thoroughly explained everything, ensuring full transparency. The entire experience was smooth and professional. Highly recommend and will definitely use his services again in the future!

reviews.author: Liv

Thank you clear creek for always having great prices and great workers that do great jobs!!!

reviews.author: War Hawk 7

They do an excellent job and are respectful of leaving the job in the cleanest way possible. Who knew? I didn't.
Great install that was not easy. I sleep better now not waiting for the other 7 copper pipes breaking.

When people are good at what they do they don't need to push you into buying from them. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend them. Very pleased with the help they provided and work they did.

reviews.author: Jonathon Miller

Everything was better and cleaner when they finished than before they arrived. I've used them a few times now and likely will again in the future. I highly recommend these folks to take care of any plumbing needs you might have. Even give military and veteran discounts of 10% which adds up on the big jobs!

reviews.author: Yvette Hundley

I was already freaked out with all the damage but they made me feel better about the cause, effect and fixed the problem. They also referred us to a restoration company they highly recommend. Let me just say at this day and age it’s wonderful to have integrity, knowledge and kindness. I recommend them highly!!!!! Thanks Dudley and Josh for everything.

plumbers.name: Airco Service
plumbers.address: 4444 S 91st East Ave, Tulsa, OK 74145, USA

reviews.author: Myra Seeber
reviews.text:
They were wonderful!!
We were having a tankless water heater put in a small closet in our master bathroom.
They let us know everything they were doing and why it needed to be done. Even apologized that my asma was acting up due to the insulation.
There was no mess for me to clean up after they left. And I love my new water heater. If you are thinking of investing in a tankless water heater. Do yourself a favor, and call this wonderful team.

reviews.author: Marlene Hall
reviews.text: The technicians were very polite and explained everything that they were going to do before replacing the water heater.  They were efficient in getting it replaced.  They showed me the repairs after they completed it.  They explained all of the new features and recommended maintenance.  I will definitely continue to use AirCo Service for the maintenance of my HVAC and water heater systems.

reviews.author: Michelle Rombow
reviews.text:
Jordan was exceptional! He was the most thorough technician I have ever had.

I have a Smart thermostat that I have never been able to use. The technician who installed it could not get it to work via my phone. Jordan went above and beyond to figure it out. What I had to take a bank loan out to use my heat/air unit is now something I can fully use. I appreciated the extra time and effort by Jordan.

reviews.author: Sterling Thomas
reviews.text:
It’s rare that I’m on the negative side of reviews, especially with a company who has been around for a while.

My first and will be only experience was agreeing to a $99 diagnostic. The technician came and went into the attic to assess the problem.

He came back down about 15-20 minutes later to tell me what he found. He said while he was doing the diagnostic (moving things around) he found an insect where it shouldn’t have been and it fixed the problem

He said usually he’ll come back down and communicate how much it would be to fix the issue (which I confirmed with Jane before the appointment) but he decided to just go ahead and fix it.

In my mind I was thinking he was just going to charge the diagnostic fee because that’s all he did and happened to fix the issue while doing it. That is also all I agreed to beforehand. So I was very surprised to see a invoice of $288 on the tablet

I will say, I made the mistake of signing off and paying it because of my headspace of waking up in the cold. Did not think it through until after the fact

I called the office 20 minutes later to speak with a supervisor about the situation. Just wanted to ask if that’s their normal business practice. I was told a message was sent and someone will reach out to me

That was Saturday, it’s now Thursday and I haven’t received any form of contact. But I’m done waiting on a call and going to shrug it off and take the loss

I will also add everyone I spoke with were pleasant to talk to (including the technician). I seem to be an outlier of negative experiences here but it is what it is

reviews.author: Jessica Corbin
reviews.text:
We had an Excellent experience with AIRCO Service. From the beginning, their pricing was upfront and transparent with no hidden fees, which gave us confidence moving forward.

Luke Helm, the project manager, was amazing to work with. He came in, thoroughly assessed our needs, and clearly explained the process and recommendations. His professionalism and attention to detail set the tone for the entire project.

There were two separate teams involved, and both were outstanding. The team in charge of the ductwork installation, led by Justin, was extremely professional and efficient. Justin even took the time to walk us through the new control panel (thermostat)—which was well above our level of expertise 😂—and graciously explained all the features it was capable of. His patience and kindness did not go unnoticed.

Together, the teams installed a new HVAC heat pump along with new air ductwork, worked hard, respected our home, and cleaned up after themselves. What was expected to be a three-day job was completed in just two days, without sacrificing quality.

If you’re looking for a professional company, look no further than AIRCO Service. We Highly recommend them for anyone needing ANY HVAC work done right.

plumbers.name: Torch Plumbing, Heating, and Cooling
plumbers.address: 107 W 4th Ave, Owasso, OK 74055, USA

reviews.author: Andy Lackey
reviews.text: We've used them before.  They installed our water heater.  Excellent job.  These guys today came and fixed a problem with it.  Excellent job again.  Two thumbs up.

reviews.author: Daniel & Stephen Harrell
reviews.text: We had Torch come out and replace a shower valve assembly for one of our projects. They did a fabulous job. I’m a general contractor and they worked with me no problem. Trey was super friendly and professional, his work was done very quickly and properly. We will definitely use them again and I refer them to everyone!

reviews.author: Allie Rara
reviews.text: I needed a whole new HVAC system which is never fun news. After several quotes, Torch was the best option. David at Torch is knowledgeable and patient with all my questions and gave best recommendations for my home - did not try to oversell me on a new system. Owen and Luis were amazing! Super professional and thorough. Knocked it out in one day, including plenum repair and duct sealing. I felt super comfortable with them, and they made sure to check in with me about the process and the work they did. 100% recommend this while team!

reviews.author: Renata Jump
reviews.text: Torch is the best!!! I have used them over the past three years and could not ask for a better service company for my plumbing and heating/cooling needs. What makes them so special is their personnel. I have never called Torch and got an answering machine. Always, a courteous person answers the phone and I usually have one of their service personnel reach out the same day and most of the time, problem is handled the same day. I have been blessed to have met Gavin, Trey, Cougar, Dustin and Colby over the past few years. All of these have been to my house multiple times and have always been respectful to me and my property; always taking time to thoroughly explain the issues and cost for recommended course of action; always have approached the repairs thoughtful of existing structures, and mindful of any steps which could be taken to protect and prevent further issues; and most important to me is they always listened to me regarding any concerns I had. All of these reasons will keep me using Torch. And all at a reasonable cost. My most recent use of Torch was the Monday after the winter storm a few weeks ago...my hot water line froze.  Their prompt attention kept my pipes from bursting which saved me from a possible costly mess! And to top it all off, Dustin (Torch's service expert) cleaned the snow off my car for me before he left. They really are the best!!!

reviews.author: Richard Cranford
reviews.text:
“Shaggy” is the mentor in this case and very knowledgeable as I listened watched.
Call Torch and you won’t be disappointed!!!
They say a torch lights the way well in this case it’s true and Benjamin carries that Torch. Thanks a bunch Benjamin appreciate the professional approach to what you do.

plumbers.name: Sargent's Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 605 W Oakland Pl, Broken Arrow, OK 74012, USA

reviews.author: Ken Lane
reviews.text: Sargent's has become my back-pocket to-go plumbing service. After ONG flagged my busted and shoddily-installed water-heater and iffy gas line situation in a flipped home I bought, I needed a solution ASAP. Armed with a skimpy budget and no time to spare, I actually asked AI to scour review pages and user-generated forums for the most trustworthy plumber in the area and Sargent's was apparently the undisputed people's champion. I got quotes from them and 3 other plumbing companies, though Sargent's were the only ones that would actually come out to my house rather than just high-ball me over the phone. I approved their quote (which just happened to also be the lowest) on the spot and Alex and Alec immediately started draining my old tank and off to grab my new tank in minutes. About 2-3 hours later (including parts fetching), I had a brand new water heater installed. They gave me a full rundown of every step of the process, relighting protocol, and all other info I needed. They gave me a handful of business cards that will definitely be gone soon to everyone I know.

reviews.author: Rosario Termini
reviews.text: We had non emergency blockage that was creating an unpleasant, sulfuric smell in our hall bathroom. Alex & Alec got out to us within less than 24 hours. They snaked the line through our clean-out, did a thorough check of everything, & took care of the issue in less than an hour. Alex answered all my questions, offered helpful info, & was genuinely courteous. We are very impressed with Sargent Plumbing & will both recommend them to others & use them in the future for our plumbing needs! You guys are awesome, thank you!

reviews.author: Christy W
reviews.text: This will be my go-to plumbing company from now on! I had a water leak and my Daughter highly recommended them after using their services multiple times. She contacted them and they were out (late on a Friday evening) within an hour ready to get things fixed. I was an emotional mess due to the emergency situation but they did everything they could to help me and I can't thank them enough! They fast, informative, respectful of me and my property and left everything tidy at the end of the job. I hope you don't have an emergency like I did, but if you need to call a plumber, these are your guys!

reviews.author: J Allen
reviews.text: I DEFINITELY HIGHLY RECOMMEND SARGENT’s PLUMBING!!! Andrew and his team of two arrived on time. Kept me posted every step of the way , including En route process. Arrived about 15 minutes early. Very Professional, knowledgeable, courteous, friendly, polite, respectful. My old water heater 20 years old and on its last leg. I heard him conferencing with the team about process . Difficulties encountered but handled with shear expertise. Cleaned up as the work progressed. He even gave me a VERY SIGNIFICANT DISCOUNT FOR BEING A SENIOR CITIZEN AND ALSO BEING ON TOTAL DISABILITY. I offered to pay the entire cost, but he refused and insisted on the discount for me. It was very much appreciated!!! There are few companies who honor their word and do PRISTINE WORKMANSHIP !!! He also insisted on showing me his Plumber’s license, his apprentice did the same . He also had one young man in training who did none of the technical work, but observed and Andrew taught as he went through the process, including the unexpected circumstances. I LOVE THIS PLUMBING COMPANY!!! I will never use another! I cannot say enough ! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND ANDREW SARGENT PLUMBING.

reviews.author: Elaine Claxton
reviews.text: I was extremely impressed with service I received from Sargent's Plumbing & Drain (Tulsa, OK). I spoke with Andrew & he was very accomodating and helpful.  On one of the worst snow storms, her in Oklahoma, I was completely shocked (in a good way) that I was informed that I would have a service man at my house in just 1 hour. "ALEX" came and couldn't have been more polite, patient and extremely professional, diligent and knowledgeable about the problem at hand. He was thorough and task focused. Thank you to this amazing, friendly and excellent service! E. Claxton

plumbers.name: Allied Plumbing Service
plumbers.address: 1211 S Harvard Ave, Tulsa, OK 74112, USA

reviews.author: Janet Gibbons
reviews.text: Issac was wonderful. You are lucky to have him. He explained everything and methodically solved my problem in minutes. This was on the Friday before the big snow storm. I was lucky to get squeezed in. You now have a loyal fan!

reviews.author: Jodi Puryear
reviews.text: Alex and Noah did such an amazing job! They got there so fast. And they are so professional and friendly! I highly recommend Allied Plumbing. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Nicole Allen
reviews.text: Earnest & Noah were absolutely wonderful! Replaced our leaking water heater and handled all issues that came along with doing so. Highly recommend these guys! Also, shoutout to Seth at the office for being super kind and setting this up for us super quick!

reviews.author: HB Snow Kingsbury
reviews.text: I called Allied Plumbing this morning after discovering our water heater was leaking. The cut off valve did not completely stop the water sound, so I assumed the leak was more involved than just the hot water heater. Earnest and Brian arrived at 0930 and quickly assessed the situation; the leak was confined to the hot water heater, but the cutoff valve was only partially working. They explained what needed replaced, gave me time to get some water in containers before they cut off the water, and let me know when they were cutting off the gas, too. Before the work was started, Earnest gave me an estimate right down to what was going to be replaced and what needed to be brought up to code.  Then, both he and Brian got the necessary materials and worked steadily, keeping me informed the whole way. I always use Allied Plumbing Service, and this is why!  Oh, and the person who answered the phone, Seth, was extra helpful and patient, too.

reviews.author: John Land
reviews.text: Gavin and AL did a great job repairing a problem with my septic junction box. Real friendly and explain the repair process well.

plumbers.name: Golden Brothers Plumbing
plumbers.address: 9500 S Elwood Ave #6830, Jenks, OK 74037, USA

reviews.author: Cristian Mckenzie
reviews.text: I was dealing with issues in my main drain line and reached out to Golden Brothers Plumbing. They were quick to answer my call and were able to send someone out that same day. Kristopher and his partner showed up and were both professional and friendly. They got straight to work and finished the job efficiently, making sure the drain line was completely clear before leaving. The service was excellent, and I was really impressed by how fast and professional they were. I’m very satisfied and will definitely call them again if I need a plumber in the future.

reviews.author: Lee Hess
reviews.text: After moving to Jenks, we discovered that our older house had several plumbing issues needing attention. We called Golden Brothers Plumbing, and Asher came out quickly to check everything. He and his team handled all the repairs, including fixing a leak under our kitchen sink that showed up after we had new countertops installed. Asher arrived the same day to take care of it, which was a huge relief. He was friendly, professional, and we felt confident in his work. We now consider him our go-to plumber and would definitely recommend this service to anyone in need of plumbing help!

reviews.author: Lisa5 G
reviews.text: In a time when finding reliable and skilled plumbers can be tough, Golden Brothers Plumbing has really come through for all my plumbing needs at my home in Jenks. I called them on my only day off, hoping to get help with two leaks, and I was surprised that Erick was able to come out that same day. He arrived on time, explained everything clearly with a lot of experience, and worked hard until both problems were completely fixed. The price matched what you’d expect for good plumbing work these days, and it felt worth it because the service was top-notch. I truly appreciate the care and attention given to customers—something that's definitely needed here in Jenks. Great job, Erick!

reviews.author: Derrick6 M
reviews.text: We’ve called on this plumbing company in Jenks for many years, and they have always been dependable, honest, and fair with their work. Recently, we had a big plumbing problem when our old cast iron stack started leaking and needed to be replaced. The crew had to carefully cut through walls and ceilings on three different floors, working for almost a week to get everything fixed. Samuel was our main plumber and did an excellent job. He made sure to explain every step, how he planned to tackle the job, and kept us updated about the costs. They took extra care to protect our floors and walls, even better than any other contractor we’ve used in the past. Erick helped out, and the manager, Jonah, stopped by several times to check the progress and answer our questions. What I really appreciate is that this company doesn’t try to sell you on unnecessary maintenance plans or priority memberships. They focus on delivering quality plumbing repairs and great customer service.

reviews.author: Danielle M
reviews.text: Here's the revised review following your instructions: I wanted to share my experience with Golden Brothers Plumbing. I had a serious leak in the main water line going from the street to my house, and from my first phone call, the service was outstanding. Samuel kept me updated at every stage, from writing up a clear proposal to working directly with my insurance. The whole process, from start to finish, took about a week. The only thing that took a bit of time was waiting for insurance approval, which they explained upfront. I never had to chase them down or call for updates—they always kept me in the loop. As someone who works in customer satisfaction for manufacturing companies, I have high standards, and they truly impressed me. I would easily rate their service a 5+ and highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing help.

plumbers.name: Quality Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric
plumbers.address: 15072 S Dogwood St, Glenpool, OK 74033, USA

reviews.author: Bison Moving
reviews.text: Keyton S, Blaine F and Jaiden D came out this morning to install a new downstairs HVAC unit for us. What a great and friendly group of guys! Everything went very smoothly and they were super attentive and worked well together. This company has great employees across the board. We know what it takes to maintain a healthy company culture and Quality has obviously done a fantastic job!

reviews.author: Beth Wild
reviews.text: Austin was timely and very professional with a respectful and positive attitude, especially in light of an urgent after hours call. Quality Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric responded with professionalism to our after hours call, gave us a status of when we could expect Austin, and expectations for a courtesy call when he would be on his way, which he did. Follow up service that includes the camera in the snaking of our line was immediately scheduled for the next day, and they promptly sent a text and email confirmation for it. I've never experienced this level of customer service for plumbing issues. I highly recommend this company and will always call on them for any of their services.

reviews.author: E Shew
reviews.text:
My 70+ year old home has experienced 2 major Quality makeovers in the last 2 weeks!! Yehaw!! Plumbing repipe being last 3 days! Thank you so much Gabriel and helpers—Jacob P., Caydence B. and Jacob B. for how you took an old tight crawl space with remnants of past plumbers mess and made it new and neat for future plumbers (Quality plumbers!)
Not an easy job made even harder with my concerns in certain areas after completion.  You absolutely heard  my concerns respectfully made changes where needed and explained everything so thoughtfully. Thank you Gabriel!! Also Wow Gabriel, Jacob B. and Monty for an absolutely amazing final job closing all my crawlspace holes with Professional grade cement work far better than you removed!
Quality has definitely made me feel safe in my home for the first time since purchase and I am covered by your home plan now for continued confidence. Thank you Thank you Thank you ALL!

reviews.author: Jimmie Jones
reviews.text:
Had a great experience from start to finish. My house is 33 years old, original pipes. I had a leak and Mike came out after I got off work (convenient for sure) this was a Thursday evening. My entire home was repiped by Monday at 530 pm. Tanner was great spent most of the time under the house but maintained communication. Julian was very personable and made sure I knew what was happing throughout the day. Price for a 3000 sq foot house was reasonable with great payment options including 0% for 12 months which made me very happy.
I did sign up for the 14.99/month plan to have my home inspected 2 times a year so our home is protected from anything water.
If you need plumbing work done call them. Always on call and work is completed fast. And no messes left!

reviews.author: Leroy Staples
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with Quality Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric! They recently hooked up my Jellyfish permanent lights, and the whole process was smooth, professional, and incredibly well-done.

A huge shoutout to Blaine, Gene, Levi, Josh, Nate, Jaiden, and Billy—each one of them brought top-tier workmanship, courtesy, and attention to detail. You can tell they truly care about the quality of their work and the satisfaction of their customers. My lighting system looks amazing, and the installation was handled flawlessly from start to finish.

plumbers.name: Premier Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 904 Harness Trail, Simpsonville, SC 29681, USA

reviews.author: Katie Hottel
reviews.text: We have used Premiere Plumbing multiple times, most recently for a hot water heater replacement. As usual, they were quick to respond, showed up promptly, and are extremely kind and knowledgeable. Everyone we have encountered from booking service to the service itself is a joy to work with. They are the best in town!

reviews.author: debbie barron
reviews.text: On the morning of the 2026”ice apocalypse” my husband discovered our gas hot water heater leaking in the garage utility room. He quickly called Premier and within minutes they were at our house. Four hours later we had a new hot water heater installed-long before the first icy rain fell. We cannot thank them enough. Premier has always been prompt, efficient, and professional. They have installed faucets, toilet mechanisms, and now a hot water heater. Every time their work was top notch.

reviews.author: Ashley Belcher
reviews.text: I am thankful my now retired HVAC technician introduced me to Premier Plumbing.  They have replaced a garbage disposal, repaired a shower and several faucets.  They are knowledgeable and reliable.  I trust their advice and appreciate the time they take in inspecting and resolving plumbing problems.  The front office/support is always professional.  I am very pleased and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Evan
reviews.text: My go to plumbing contractor when the work scope gets beyond my ability or time. Very competent and conscientious from owners to techs and have always been able to get out and help me quickly. I had a new tankless water heater installed and it's been a great upgrade! They have access to and stock much higher quality products than can be purchased at big box stores and only offer products with a proven "in the field" track record. One of my favorite local companies, I highly recommend

reviews.author: Jefferson Duncan
reviews.text: These folks are awesome! Installed replaced our old water heater, and checked with us to make sure everything went well. When I reported a leak, they sent a technician the check it out, but neither of us could find the source of the leak. When leak appeared again, we contacts Premier again and had someone come out the next day to determine the source of the leak, found it, and repaired it in less than an hour. Great folks and creamery helpful! I recommend 100%

plumbers.name: Local Plumber and HVAC
plumbers.address: 106 Loma St, Simpsonville, SC 29681, USA

reviews.author: Shawna Kane
reviews.text: John at Local Plumber did a great job replacing the gas line on my water heater. He was well-informed and straight foward about the price and what he was going to do. I also appreciated talking to Gabby(?) when I called (rather than an automated service) to set up the appointment. I would recommend Local Plumber for their promptness and quality of service.

reviews.author: Keem Thompson
reviews.text: John came by and cleared up my leaking water heater with quick and efficient service. He gave me a fair price and let me know everything that was going on before he got started. Friendly service and excellent speed.

reviews.author: Francie Koch
reviews.text: John was on time, explained everything I needed done and went right to work installing a new sink and garbage disposal.  He was very pleasant and tolerated my puppy, so he will be the only plumber I will ever call!  Very professional and knowledgeable and cleaned up everything.  If you need a plumber, give this company a call - you will be very pleased with quality work.

reviews.author: C R
reviews.text:
It is hard to accurately describe how grateful we are for Local Plumber and for the services they provided for our family.
We recently experienced a water leak that flooded two rooms on the first floor of our home. The water was coming from somewhere underneath a built-in jetted tub, so we demolished the wall around the tub to discover that the water appeared to be bubbling up from under the concrete slab. We had no idea where it could be coming from, but turning off the water to our home was the only way to stop it.
I called a couple of “leak detection” specialty companies that I located online, only to be told they could not come out for one to two weeks. I was almost in tears when I called Local Plumber, but from that very first call they were amazing! Krista was able to send someone to our home that same afternoon, and kept me informed the entire time as to their ETA.
The plumber that responded to our call was John B., and we could tell from the moment we met him that we were in expert hands. He was extremely professional, thorough and knowledgeable as he diagnosed the source of our issue, and he determined that we had a leak in the pipe that runs  underground from our water well to our house. After telling us how he could fix the issue, John B. answered all of our questions and addressed our concerns. He was able to give us a quote within a few minutes after leaving our house, and because we were living with no water, the job was scheduled to be done 48 hours later.
From start to finish their communication was top-notch, and John B. is an absolute perfectionist.
The cost of the job was very reasonable and they guarantee their work.
We are grateful to have found such an amazing company, and cannot recommend them highly enough. Do not hesitate to give them a call!

reviews.author: Danielle Jeanty
reviews.text:
Rob was warm and friendly. He immediately gave me some options that made me feel comfortable with doing business with them!
The fact that he was a fellow New Yorker and Christ follower didn't hurt either! If we go with pros, you will definitely be hearing from us!

plumbers.name: Sfarnas Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 125 Kingfisher Dr, Simpsonville, SC 29680, USA

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text: George with Sfarnas Plumbing came out to look at our leaking water heater and quickly discovered it had been installed incorrectly by a previous plumber. He is extremely knowledgeable and took just a few minutes to fix the issue. He was friendly, professional, and very affordable. We are in Simpsonville and are so happy to have found a reliable local plumber. We will definitely be lifelong clients! He also showed us some pictures of some current bathroom remodels, truly a skilled tradesman!

reviews.author: Ember Hansen
reviews.text: George is a fantastic plumber. He came to fix our tub drain and although I needed an extensive repair, he was professional and friendly and transparent with me about the entire process. He explained to me each step of the process and he was very kind to my 3 yr old boy, who wanted nothing more than to watch him work. He let my son watch him and talked with him, and he was very nice to have in our home. We rent so I’m not sure about his fees, but if we need it we will call him again. He is a good, honest man and a local business we are happy to support!

reviews.author: Patrish7
reviews.text: Had the extreme pleasure of meeting George Sfarnas who came out to investigate plumbing issues at my home today .  He was knowledgeable, personable, and rectified the issues swiftly. His prices are very reasonable as well. We highly recommend him for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Rage Marshal
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Highly Recommend!

George was fantastic to work with from start to finish. He was incredibly prompt—not only in responding to my request but also in coming out to quote the job. I got five quotes, and while George was the second cheapest, it was clear from the beginning that he was going to do the best work. He genuinely cared about the quality of the job and took the time to walk me through exactly what he planned to do.

I’ll admit—I’m a bit of a micromanager, and this was my first time hiring a contractor, so I had a lot of questions. George never rushed me, never got frustrated, and explained everything in detail, which gave me complete confidence in his plan. Other plumbers either brushed me off with a “don’t worry, I’ll handle it” attitude or clearly didn’t know what they were doing.

George, on the other hand, is licensed, bonded, and extremely knowledgeable—AND still managed to be one of the most affordable options out of everyone who actually knew what they were doing.

On the day of the job, he arrived exactly on time, spent the entire day crawling under my house in 120-degree heat, and didn’t complain once. He worked with a smile, was genuinely fun to be around, and made what could have been a stressful experience feel easy.

I would 100% hire George again and recommend him to anyone looking for a plumber who is professional, skilled, and just a great person to work with.

reviews.author: Nina Nacey
reviews.text:
George was fantastic to work with. He communicated clearly about his arrival time and explained pricing upfront, which made the whole process feel very transparent and trustworthy. He’s clearly passionate about what he does and genuinely enjoys helping people.

We actually had a fun time diagnosing the issue because he took the time to explain everything in detail. He fixed our water pressure and also shared a lot of helpful, educational suggestions along the way. Huge thank you, our showers are so much better now!

plumbers.name: Ethical Plumbing
plumbers.address: 310 New Neely Ferry Rd, Mauldin, SC 29662, USA

reviews.author: Scott Schaberg
reviews.text: We found a garbage disposal leak the day after Thanksgiving. After calling the office, Tristan showed up within a hour and quickly diagnosed and fixed the issue. He was polite, friendly, and very professional. What could have lingered into the weekend was resolved with just a minor disruption. I would definitely use this company again in the future.

reviews.author: Mark MacDonald
reviews.text:
Very pleased. Ethical Plumbing was prompt and thorough. They uncovered another issue that was much more serious then what I called them for to begin with.

They explained the problems, complete with pictures, in detail. The second problem was in a part of my crawl space which I never would have seen for myself had they not discovered it.

I'd definitely recommend Ethical, and will use them again if need be.

reviews.author: David Lally
reviews.text: Scott has been to my house before to service a leaky toilet, and this time, a bigger job, as my hot water heater went kaput after Hurricane Helene and was leaking all over my garage floor. There is a comfort level with knowing your plumber and so the bad news hurt a little less. Both times he provided excellent service and explained what was wrong and what my options were to fix it. So many times plumbers don't really explain what is happening and you feel helpless but Scott was very clear about what needed to be done and gave me several proce levels of services to choose from. I'm very happy with the new addition to the garage.

reviews.author: Ci Ci Tinch
reviews.text: My hot water heater was leaking when we woke up yesterday morning. We have littles so we needed  hot water. I gave Ethical Plumbing a call and spoke to a nice young Lady who told me that she could have someone out to our home as soon the very same day. Nick and Dorian are very professional.  They were at our home in no time. Nick gave me plenty of time to decide  what i system I wanted. They did an excellent job. I recommend them %100. Thanks!

reviews.author: Kurt Washburn
reviews.text: Mitchell and John were great -very friendly, professional and upfront about explaining everything involving toilet repair vs replacement - they were on time, informative and fixed my toilet in a timely manner. Strongly recommended!

plumbers.name: Glen's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 118 McCall Rd, Simpsonville, SC 29680, USA

reviews.author: Lisa Miller
reviews.text: Great job installing my water heater

reviews.author: Becky Spooner
reviews.text: I was well pleased with their speedy  and excellent work .

reviews.author: Kenny Morgan
reviews.text: I had a water pressure issue to where I had low water pressure. I could not find any leaks so my neighbor recommended Glen’s Plumbing. The plumber, Richie Orfield, came out the next day and found that my pressure regulator was the issue. Within 15 minutes my pressure was restored. Great response, great service!

reviews.author: Cari Orfield
reviews.text: I was very happy with Glen's Plumbing!  I had to get my water heater replaced and Richie & Cab were on time, professional and got it installed quickly.  I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Ivy Cieluch
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful people!

plumbers.name: Chandler Plumbing
plumbers.address: 317 Rocky Creek Rd, Simpsonville, SC 29680, USA

reviews.author: Dan S
reviews.text: Andrew came promptly and was very careful in our new house to keep things clean.  He gave us sound advise on not doing some things we thought we needed to do.  He installed some bidets for us quickly and well and for a good price.  We will be using him to change our shower head soon.

reviews.author: Amanda Hand
reviews.text: I came home to find a leaking water heater. The first place I called did offer after hours service but nothing was available. I called Chandlers based on their rating. That 5 stars is well deserved. Andrew had his tech (Bob) here in 30 minutes. Bob was very thorough in explaining what was wrong and the replacement. I highly recommend them

reviews.author: David Wagner
reviews.text: I contacted Chandler Plumbing for an outside water faucet problem.  Andrew, the owner, answered my call on the second ring...even though he was working onsite at a job.  He arranged for Bob B., a Chandler employee, to stop by and assess my faucet problem the next day.   Bob arrived on time and quickly solved the problem.  Bob took a quick look at our intake water pressure regulator to make sure everything was satisfactory. I highly recommend Chandler Plumbing for any plumbing services you might have.  They are professional, trustworthy, and take pride in their work.

reviews.author: Ken Hooks
reviews.text: Hands down best experience with a plumbing company. Wished I would have stumbled upon Chandler years ago. Water heater went out on Sunday. Chandler answered my call after 7pm, told me he would be at my house at 9 AM. That was a lie. He was there before 9! Amazing! Got the job done, no mess, no fuss. Even gave me a tip on some other work I requested a quote for. Do yourself a favor and call. You and your pockets will be pleased.

reviews.author: April Rabb
reviews.text: If you need a plumber, Chandler is ABSOLUTELY the way to go!! I had several small issues and he was quick to return my call and get me scheduled. He came out today and not only fixed all quickly but gave some good info on how to fix little things in the future!! For me, the tips and tricks are priceless!

plumbers.name: One Call Plumbing
plumbers.address: 300 Southport Rd, Roebuck, SC 29376, USA

reviews.author: Joc Davis
reviews.text: Neighbors told me I had a water leak, I called One Call Plumbing.  Very professional and serving from the first moments.  Response time was within 3 hours from first call. Jesse was awesome,  he didn't waste no time repairing the water leak. He also updated the water lines and explained his work to us. He was done with leak in less than an hour.  Price was very fair for the service that was provided. High recommended

reviews.author: Joy Malone
reviews.text: We had a plumbing emergency after hours and had toilet spewing all over our bathroom. We had to turn our water off outside. One Call Plumbing answered my call and Jesse arrived and repaired our toilet within an hour. He was very pleasant and efficient! We are thankful to have a plumber on call!

reviews.author: Alexa Pack
reviews.text: We've been using One Call Plumbing for years and can't say enough nice things about them! They are consistently friendly and prompt, and their work has always been thorough and well done. Their rates are reasonable and always explained in advance. Today's visit from Ethan (and initial call with David) was no exception. Thankful for them and highly recommend!

reviews.author: Clara Clark
reviews.text: Our toilets and tubs suddenly started simultaneously not draining well late one night.  Early the next morning we called around and it was clear that One Call Plumbing was the choice plumber.  We were faced with having to have a Main Water Line Blockage fixed, and they made it painless, and even offered financing as an option.  They were professional, kind, as accommodating as possible, and they were able to get someone out within just an hour or two of us calling.  In addition, in comparison to some plumbing companies, they were affordable, and even took into account one of us being a Veteran, and gave a military discount.  Our technician was one of the best dispatched techs I have ever had the pleasure of dealing with.  In a world so focused on instant gratification, and in business to just make a buck, this company did not disappoint.  Would not hesitate to use again and recommend.  I don't leave reviews but this one was worth leaving one for.  Thank you

reviews.author: Ben Wineland
reviews.text: One Call Plumbing was the second call I made, but it should have been the first! They are very professional, knowledgeable and personable folks. I highly recommend their services and will use them again in the future. Shout out to Jesse, thank y’all for the good work!

plumbers.name: Warmer Water & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 101 Chickamauga Ln, Simpsonville, SC 29681, USA

reviews.author: EMERSON ECKELMAN
reviews.text: Josh is a great guy. They came out and knocked out our job out. I am a contractor and he is the only guy I will use for my jobs from here on out. He is very professional and polite.

reviews.author: jhorders
reviews.text: Josh did a great job for me at a very reasonable price. He was here on time, kept me informed, and always did exactly what he said he would do. Very professional. I highly recommend him . I have finally found my go to plumber

reviews.author: 778189 xyz
reviews.text: Very professional nice job! The team not only installed our water heater well but also help us fixed some other issues. It is a huge help for picking up the heater from store too. Thanks for the friendly and quality service!

reviews.author: Cynthia Riffle
reviews.text:
So my outside water bib froze and busted on 2/1/26 later in the day on a Sunday after two days of 12-15 degrees at night. On Monday 2/2/26 I googled  plumbers near me. I found Warm Waters. Called them prior to 8am. They promised to come. Within less than a half hour after arrival they dug out frozen bursted water hose bib line, capped it off, insulated it. Turned water breaker back on and all was great. I will definately call them to install a frost free bib and add one to front of house.  Very accomodating and reasonable price. There should be more honest contractors like these guys. Awesome.
2/16/26, Joshua came out and installed two new frost free faucets and a hose holder.  Excellent help again.  They will be my go to plumbing company from now on.

reviews.author: Dan Kelly
reviews.text:
I called Josh on Wednesday, and by Friday lunch, my broken sewer line was repaired.  Such friendly and honest service. We handled everything over the phone.  I didn't even need to be at the house for anything. He even replaced the mailbox he had to remove to do the work.

Absolutely awesome experience!  Thanks!

plumbers.name: JMC Services, LLC
plumbers.address: 408 Windwood St, Simpsonville, SC 29680, USA

reviews.author: Marie Strong
reviews.text: Jim did a great job when our garbage disposal went out Christmas Eve.  I texted him Christmas night, so he might see my message 1st thing the next morning. He called/texted with me that night and was at my house the next morning installing a new disposal.  He showed me what was going on, was tidy while working and took care of the problem.  And the price was reasonable.  The next time I need a handyman, he's guy I will call.

reviews.author: Debby Hannigan
reviews.text: Jeffrey was running early and called to see if he could arrive early. Work was done quickly and well and at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: CoolAunt75
reviews.text: We’re very grateful and satisfied with the work Jeffrey and Larry did installing two ceiling fans in our home. JMC Services LLC has all the qualities that make it an exceptional company. They show great knowledge, commitment, and attention to detail in their work—not to mention their kindness, quick response, and fair pricing. We’re happy to know we can count on them for future projects, and we highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Tameka Burton
reviews.text: JMC installed a ceiling fan for me today, it looks great and I’m very pleased. Jeff arrived at the scheduled time, he was very courteous. He is knowledgeable and explained everything that he would be doing. He also done some plumbing work and cleaned my dryer vent a few months back. I would recommend Jeff for electrical and plumbing needs😊

reviews.author: Sonia Leverette
reviews.text: Great communication, respectful of property, cleaned work area and accomplished my tasks professionally. I recommend and will use Jeffrey again.

plumbers.name: Integrity Plumbing of the Upstate LLC
plumbers.address: 1011 Old Stage Rd, Simpsonville, SC 29681, USA

reviews.author: John Yeary
reviews.text: We had a water heater blow out in our garage and flooded the new workshop I had just finished. We got a couple of quotes from various companies in the area. When we called Integrity, Russ (Owner), came to our house within 30 minutes. He provided a reasonable quote, and great explanation of our options for replacement. They offer a military/veteran discount. The team that came out later that afternoon included Stephen Libby who was fantastic. After they removed the damaged heater, it was discovered that there was additional damage. They worked with the water mitigation folks from USAA to clean and dry the area. When the general contractor that came to look at repairing the water damaged area would not be able to get someone out for another week, Integrity helped us again. Russ recommended a contractor that he worked with to come do the repairs. Once the walls were repaired and painted, Stephen came back and installed the new heater. He took the time to flush the lines, and make sure everything was in good order. He recommended heater settings and set them for us. The heater works great and the area looks great. I had a great experience from the owner to the technicians, and receptionist.

reviews.author: John Rush
reviews.text: DJ and Clayton replaced a few old water heater tanks and replaced with a new Navien Tankless water heater for us.  Pricing was fair vs the other estimates we received. I felt DJ had the best handle on what needed to be done plus were recommended to us by friends who had some work done by Integrity with excellent results.  Had no issues with anything. They were in and out in less than a day and did a good clean install. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Escher
reviews.text:
✨Very Grateful ✨
I had a great experience with Integrity Plumbing! Russ was professional, kind, and really went above and beyond. Not only did he take care of my water heater, but he also referred an electrician I needed, which made everything so much easier and less stressful. It’s hard to find people who are both skilled and genuinely helpful, and Russ is definitely one of them. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brian Thomas
reviews.text:
Thought we might have a burst exterior water pipe so I called Integrity.  Their technician Cole arrived right on time and quickly assessed our situation. Fortunately pipes were in good shape-one was just partially frozen and he gave me tips on how to manage that situation moving forward. I asked about making a payment and Cole said there would be no charge as this was just information and knowledge that he shared on this visit. What other companies would do this? Probably none.
They really live up to their name Integrity in their business.  This was my 2nd experience with them and I can truly say their technicians are incredibly knowledgeable,
professional, and eager to share tips for the average homeowner so they can avoid future problems. They have definitely earned my business for any future plumbing needs.
When I called the day before to schedule the appointment, Beth provided excellent service and communication and even had their Technician Cole call me in advance of his visit to answer a question I had about my pipe situation. If you are looking for a plumbing company you know you can trust, call Integrity!

reviews.author: Laura Brand
reviews.text: I called Integrity Plumbing one afternoon to request a quote on a replacement tankless water heater. Russ, the owner of the company, showed up at our house less than 45 minutes later and gave us a competitive quote. I was very impressed with Russ who really seemed to know everything about Navien water heaters. Integrity Plumbing was able to start and finish the install that very afternoon so we had working hot water by the evening. The new water heater looks and works great, and they were very conscientious to leave the install area better than they found it. Highly recommend this locally owned company.

plumbers.name: Jacob's Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 524 Woodcock Rd, Pelzer, SC 29669, USA

reviews.author: Rebecca Atkinson
reviews.text: Great team! Gave me the advice I wanted to consider what type of water heater install would work best for our replacement. Zero pressure to make a decision. They showed up for the work and got it all done in one day- cleaned up and I was all set! I would absolutely call them again for other plumbing/gas pipe needs!!

reviews.author: Mai B.
reviews.text: Jacob’s team is truly the best. They are always reliable, professional, and consistently deliver excellent service. They have been my go-to for all of my plumbing needs and have never let me down. I haven’t worked with any other plumbers since finding them over three years ago, and I couldn’t recommend them more highly.

reviews.author: Eric Djonic
reviews.text:
We had a burst sewer pipe in our crawl space and also a clog somewhere in the main line. We called and spoke with Jacob to get an appointment by the next day.

We were kept in the loop day of with anticipated arrival times. Once on-site, Brendan & Q gave us a breakdown of exactly what needed to be done prior to starting work.

The whole team was super professional, responsive, and provided a great price for the amount of work and attention to detail!

reviews.author: Tim Rountree
reviews.text:
Jacob's Plumbing has been my family's go to for all plumbing needs along with our businesses plumbing needs for many years.
Jacob and his team have done everything from minor leaks to full re-pipe jobs to setting up new waterlines and installing septic systems for us. I highly recommend Jacob's Plumbing They are fast efficient and extremely well priced and very professional.
10 out of 10 highly recommend!

reviews.author: Joseph Garcia
reviews.text: We've used a few local plumbing companies, but Jacob is certainly the best we have dealt with. Responded quickly, accurately diagnosed our issue and completed the repair at a fair price. Highly recommend and will certainly be my first call for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: David Drake
reviews.text:
We encountered the dreaded, dirty rusty water in our sinks and tubs and knew we needed to replace our water heater. I called Plumb Medic and after a brief discussion we were scheduled for a new install 2 days later.

They were on time, on budget and the area was spic-and-span when they finished up. The quality of the joints and connections of the new copper piping needed was impressive - it was like a work of art.

They were friendly, professional, honest and super easy and comfortable to do business with. I can highly recommend Plumb Medic without reservation!!

reviews.author: Shelly Cassin
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with them. They were prompt, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. They quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything clearly, and completed the repair efficiently. The pricing was fair with no surprises. It’s hard to find reliable service these days, but they absolutely delivered. Highly recommend for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: D S
reviews.text: Plumb Medic was great to work with. We had a water issue and they came out quickly, figured out exactly what was going on, and explained everything clearly along the way. The technician was patient, knowledgeable, and really on top of his work. He also referred us to a water remediation company to dry out the affected areas, which made the whole situation much easier to handle. I really appreciated the professionalism and friendliness they showed throughout the process. Overall, a very good experience and I wouldn’t hesitate to use them again or recommend them.

reviews.author: Christopher Martin
reviews.text:
The entire experience was great from start to finish.
It started with a phone call with Cameron. He gave me an estimate and when I mentioned I was getting estimates from other businesses he provided me with several questions to ask them.
Next step was an in person estimate. Cole came out, gave an estimate then emailed me what we had discussed.
When Cole came out with one other person (I forget his name) they were early, finished the work soner than they said, cleaned up then the bill was what we were quoted.
Great service, great people and reasonable prices.

I would recommend them to everyone adn will use the again when we need them.

reviews.author: Laine Riley
reviews.text: I called Plumb Medic after discovering water in my garage. The owner, Cameron, came to my home at 8:30pm and detected a slab leak behind the water heater. Repairs were made the next day. Cameron is very personable and professional. I highly recommend him and his team for all plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Fuller Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 1360 Union Hill Rd Ste 6g, Alpharetta, GA 30004, USA

reviews.author: Lee Anne Rice
reviews.text: We woke up Easter morning with an alert from our water company that we probably had a major leak based on water usage the last 48 hours. As it was a holiday, we called a company that offered holiday service at no extra charge. Big mistake! Two days later, we still did not have water or a solution. After viewing social media recommendations for plumbing services, we found Fuller Plumbing. Gary came out that day and diagnosed our problem. He had his crew out the next day, and within a couple of hours, we had a new water line and full service. Best of all, his charge was less than half what the other company was charging. We received photos of all the work and clearly saw the new lines and how deep they were laid. The crew was professional and respectful and even offered to carry my groceries while I was walking down our steep driveway in heels. Gary stayed after they left to make sure everything was working to our satisfaction. Two months later, everything is still great! Fuller Plumbing will be our FIRST call in the future when we need plumbing service. They are local and provide excellent, high quality service!

reviews.author: Jim Robinson
reviews.text: Had a really good experience with Gary from Fuller Plumbing.   Communicated well from the start.   Came out promptly and spent his time assessing the situation.   Had modern diagnostic tools and was able to rule out some costly and invasive repairs before recommending a fix.   Gary came back out the next day and installed the component.   Gary is very professional and personable.   Price was reasonable for the parts and time spent on the issue.   The job site was cleaned and the part well explained for future upkeep.   High recommend Fuller Plumbing.

reviews.author: JoAnne Wirtz-Ryan
reviews.text: We have a very steep descent from the road to the house. Our water main line had a leak so we contacted Fuller plumbing to find the leak and repair it. Gary thoroughly evaluated our situation, pointed out to me that with 20 yo PVC it's getting brittle. He also said that with the steep slope it's under pressure from ground movement and vibrations from vehicles, both which are not compatible with PVC as it doesn't tolerate movement well. We knew our neighbor with the same situation  had recently spent 10's of thousands repairing their water main line. He gave me the prices for finding the leak as well as prices for running a new line with a PEX that is flexible and would withstand pressure, vibration and freezing issues. Even though more money than repairing, We chose to install a new line. His crew showed up on time and stayed until 7pm to get it done. He also hired a pressure washer to come the next day to clean the dirt off the driveway. Lastly he never asked me for money until the job was completed. They're very professional and I appreciate that he gave me options that will save me from repeated leaks in the future, unlike my neighbor who spent 3x what I spent with a different company, only to repair a line that has a short life expectancy. I definitely will use them again when I need a plumber.

reviews.author: Chris White
reviews.text:
We wanted to get a tankless water heater installed as well as needed our PRV valve replaced. We had a couple of the big guys come out to do quotes. We got a word of mouth recommendation to check with Fuller and I'm glad that I did. Gary not only saved us thousands he was friendly, knowledgeable and worked throughout the day to get the work done. You could tell he knew exactly what he was doing .

I would not hesitate to recommend or call Fuller again for plumbing work.

reviews.author: Damon Outdoors
reviews.text: I called several plumbers before coming across Fuller. I got answering machines and no calls. I called Fuller on a Saturday and Gary answered and set me up for the following Monday. I received a text Monday AM letting me know he was on the way. Gary was very professional with a no BS install. Pricing was on par with the website and I felt it was fair. I would definitely use Fuller again.

plumbers.name: AZERPLUMB - Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 5145 Shiloh Rd Suite 111, Cumming, GA 30040, USA

reviews.author: Gary Evonsion
reviews.text: Gary was excellent, efficient and willing to share his knowledge. Nami is the person I booked it with and he was also great. It was a change out of a kitchen sink and booked a couple hours earlier.  These will be my go to plumber services guys from now on and I recommend them highly!

reviews.author: Mason Harris
reviews.text:
I had six or seven companies come out for quotes on various work.  I have history in plumbing adjacent industries, and have an ok bs meter.   In general, most were nice enough but overpriced. Some were less nice, more pushy and still overpriced.  Azerplumb easily had the best people to deal with in every position(u know who u are), sales, service , and administrative.  Also, best pricing by far.
There's nothing like feeling good about choices made with your hard earned money, and I feel amazing after choosing them over their competitors.   They feel like a unicorn company these days... Reasonable pricing, quality work,  ethical business practice.

reviews.author: Onur D.
reviews.text:
I found AzerPlumb online after reading the great reviews, and they absolutely lived up to them. When we recently had a water leak in our home, AzerPlumb did an exceptional job from start to finish. Nima was incredibly professional, responsive, and thorough. He took the time to explain the issue clearly, answered all my questions patiently and made sure every part of the repair was done to the highest quality.

The workmanship was excellent, the area was left spotless, and everything has been working perfectly since.

I truly appreciate the honesty, attention to detail, and commitment to doing the job right.  I highly recommend AzerPlumb to anyone looking for a reliable and skilled plumber.

reviews.author: Iman Aljaber
reviews.text:
An amazing place with an amazing owner! I very rarely write reviews, but after doing business with this company it's the least I could do. My family's finance is very tight, and we are going through difficult times with regards to medical issues.

Our water heater went out, and we couldn't find a place that could fix it within our budget. When I thought we would have to deal with cold water until next week, I came across this company, and I'm so happy I did.

The owner of this company, Nima, heard us out and made sure to take care of us. One of his plumbers, Gary, did a fantastic job and double checked everything. He explained every step he was doing and made sure we understood. He also gave us troubleshooting advice on our water heater.

If you want a company that not only does a good job but will do whatever it can to take care of your budget's needs, then you found the right place. If I could give this place 10 stars, I would.

reviews.author: Daniel Liptrott
reviews.text: A fantastic experience with Azer. We had an assessment from another plumber who I knew was overcharging me and so I decided to shop around. Azer were the very best - good pricing and very responsive. Nima is very knowledgeable and gave a clear, competitive price. Gary came and did the work that same day, staying until after 7pm to make sure everything was right. I will always use Azer from now on. Highly, highly recommend.

plumbers.name: TE Certified, Electrical, Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 9800 Old Dogwood Rd, Roswell, GA 30075, USA

reviews.author: Gail Summerskill
reviews.text:
I called TE Technicians because my water heater was leaking. The person on the phone was very helpful and courteous. I was given a window of time for the technician, Joshua, to arrive. I was sent a text message immediately with all necessary information, including information about and a picture of Joshua. On the phone, I was told I would receive another text/call 30 minutes before he arrived.

It all worked as planned. Joshua was friendly, courteous, efficient, and informative. A “small leak” turned into a replacement of the 20 year old heater. Bad news made ok by a technician who explained everything and showed me a  leak in the bottom of the heater that would not be my future problem.

If you want an excellent technician, ask for Joshua. Thanks to TE technicians and technician Joshua.

reviews.author: Don and Laura Zugel
reviews.text: I was having problems with my landscape lighting not working properly and finally called TE for help. Jeremy and Isaiah arrived right at the start of my appointment window. After listening to me describe the problem, they set to work diagnosing my system. Withing 15 minutes they determined the issue was with my old control box, which was over 15 years old. They installed and tested the new control panel (see attached photos) and all is working perfectly again. These 2 were efficient and knowledgeable about how my system operated and resolved the problem within an hour. Call the electricians at TE Certified; they know what they are doing and can fix whatever issues you have.

reviews.author: John Barnard
reviews.text: We just had a new Rinnai tankless water heater installed by Andrew. We were switching from a traditional tank heater to tankless, which requires a different exhaust system, new gas connection and new water piping. Andrew did an excellent job explaining what was needed and why, provided a fair quote, then did a very nice job with the installation and cleanup afterwards. He showed me how to adjust the settings and reviewed the maintenance recommendations. The new system works great and we are very pleased with the result. I'm a happy customer and will use TE again when needed in the future.

reviews.author: Rosa Maria Villanueva
reviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with the service from Luis Lopez at TE Certified. He showed up right on time, wore shoe covers, and took the time to listen and explain what he’d be checking. Luis quickly pinpointed the issue, laid out clear options with upfront pricing, and completed the repair efficiently with top-notch craftsmanship.

What stood out most was Luis’s true passion for his profession—you could see it in the care he took with every detail and the pride he had in doing things the right way. He tested everything before leaving, labeled what he updated, and left our home cleaner than he found it.

Friendly, professional, and incredibly reliable—Luis is the kind of electrician you keep in your contacts. Strongly recommend TE Certified and Luis!

reviews.author: Adam Knight
reviews.text:
TE Certified just installed a new Daikin HVAC system at my home and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Hunter Graham and his teammate were outstanding, punctual, professional, and incredibly respectful throughout the process. They explained everything clearly, walked me through the timeline, and made sure I understood each step.
The installation was quiet, efficient, and clean. They left the space exactly as they found it. The system is running perfectly, and their craftsmanship truly shows. I’m grateful for their high-quality work and highly recommend TE Certified to anyone looking for reliable HVAC service.

plumbers.name: Swelltec Plumber Roswell
